novel_info.title: Checking in for 100,000 Years
novel_info.author: Yi Chenxi
novel_info.summary: Ye Yun has transmigrated into a martial world filled with gods, demons, monsters, and ghosts, becoming the Dragon God Sect Master. After checking in for 100,000-years, he resurrects from an ancient tomb, brandishing Emperor Level, God Level, and even Super God Level divine weapons and cultivation techniques to the astonishment of his disciples.“Old Ancestor, this Divine Marrow Cleansing Pill is so precious! I really can't bear to consume it!”“Don't be reluctant to take it. This gourd contains ten thousand more Divine Marrow Cleansing Pills. You could eat them like candy, and it wouldn't be a problem...”

chapters.title: Chapter 1: 100,000 years ago, the ancestor came back from the dead!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1: Chapter 1: 100,000 years ago, the ancestor came back from the dead!
"DING! Will the host check-in?"
"Check-in."
"DING! Congratulations to the host for successfully checking in for 100,000 years, with a total of 5,256,000,000 check-ins. Your merit is now complete. The Check-in Space will begin to unlock. Countdown: 10 minutes..."
「In a vast, deep space.」
Ye Yun, present as a Prime soul body, suddenly heard the System’s voice, and his numb soul was finally infused with a hint of vitality.
100,000 years!
He can finally leave!
In this Mystical Space, shrouded in darkness, he had checked in every ten minutes for a total of 100,000 years.
Ye Yun silently waited...
He didn’t know what the world would be like after 100,000 years.
Did the Dragon God Sect become stronger, or more desolate?
「...」
「The ruins of the Dragon God Sect.」
「The back mountain.」
"Master, at last we’ve laid you to rest!"
"On the road transporting your ashes, we three martial siblings were pursued. Eldest Martial Sister covered for us, and to this day, her fate remains unknown..."
"I suspect... she’s probably dead..."
"Youngest Martial Brother... he was captured midway..."
"Now, I’m the only one left in the entire Dragon God Sect..."
"Master, although you passed the position of Sect Master to me before your death, I’m afraid... I may not be able to carry out your will."
"After I’ve seen to your arrangements, I will also leave this place, change my name, and never show my face in public again..."
"Master, I can’t hold on by myself anymore..."
Before a newly built grave, a girl in a patched and dirty robe knelt on the ground, burning incense, her dust-covered face filled with sorrow.
The girl was about sixteen or seventeen years old. Her robe was torn in many places, revealing her snowy-white skin. In some places, dark red, still-wet bloodstains had soaked through the fabric, a shocking sight.
She had muttered her innermost thoughts aloud before the grave.
The great weight in the girl’s heart seemed to lift. Her expression relaxed considerably.
Luo Li stood up and looked around. She saw nearly three hundred graves densely arranged in the valley where she stood.
Originally, I should have been buried here after my death.
But now, I’ve decided to disband the Dragon God Sect.
So after I die, I’m destined to have no connection with this place.
Although the Dragon God Sect was an unranked minor sect, it had a long history. Every Sect Master was to be buried in this valley after their death.
Before those densely packed graves stood ancient, weathered steles. Some were so old that, if one were to calculate their age, they had been there for at least a hundred thousand years.
"Alas, My Dragon God Sect was once said to be a top-tier, Eternal Level major sect. Who would have thought we’d fall to this state..."
Luo Li sighed, her small, dark face looking desolate.
As the destitute Sect Master, Luo Li was only at the eighth layer of the Gathering Qi Realm. She could be described as the weakest Sect Master in history.
In the years she spent practicing Cultivation with her master, she and her martial siblings spent their time either hiding from place to place or fleeing from enemies pursuing them.
How could there have been any time to cultivate?
Therefore, Luo Li’s cultivation base was pitifully weak.
It was said that the 250th Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect had once offended a major power.
From then on, generation after generation of Dragon God Sect disciples embarked on a path of flight.
Despite this, the Dragon God Sect still endured for nearly fifty more generations. By the time it was passed down to Luo Li, she was already the 298th Sect Master.
Recalling the bitter past, Luo Li’s face became even more somber, and she sighed quietly a few more times.
Perhaps it was the Dragon God Bloodline that gave the Successors of the Dragon God Sect such tenacious faith. Generation after generation of Sect Masters struggled to survive in dire straits, evading wave after wave of pursuit from their enemies.
Over time, the Dragon God Sect became weaker and weaker. By the time it reached Luo Li’s master’s generation, in several decades, he had only taken three disciples.
And her master was merely a Cultivator at the Origin Sea Realm.
"Alas, the past is too painful to recall..."
Luo Li’s mournful gaze swept over several ancient graves deeper in, and she suddenly murmured to herself, "Forget it. I won’t be coming back here anyway. I might as well offer a final stick of incense to the Sect’s ancestors!"
Having said that, Luo Li took a bundle of incense and walked towards the first row of graves deeper in the valley.
「...」
Starting with the grave of the Sect’s founding ancestor, Luo Li offered incense silently, her small, dark, dust-covered face solemn.
When she arrived at the 13th grave, Luo Li glanced at the ancient stele before it. The look in her narrow, almond-shaped eyes suddenly changed.
Is this the strongest ancestor in the history of the Dragon God Sect? I heard he was arrogant and domineering, offending many. He even dared to take liberties with the Saintess of the Ice Phoenix Sect! He incurred universal condemnation, and in the end, he only served as Sect Master for six years before abdicating...
Speaking of this, Luo Li’s full lips curled into a sneer, "HUMPH! He could be called the shortest-lived Sect Master in the Dragon God Sect’s history!"
Despite her indignation, Luo Li still offered a stick of incense. After all, this thirteenth-generation Sect Master had once led the Dragon God Sect to its most glorious achievements.
He deserved this stick of incense from her.
For the previous twelve ancestors, Luo Li had kowtowed after offering each stick of incense.
But before this thirteenth-generation Sect Master, she did not kowtow. She stood ramrod straight.
"Ancestor, if you hadn’t been so arrogant and made so many enemies, how could the Dragon God Sect have declined so rapidly afterwards?"
"And you yourself, I heard you suffered a cultivation deviation during Cultivation and just kicked the bucket! This made many of your enemies at the time rejoice, saying our Dragon God Sect had committed countless evils and got what it deserved..."
After voicing her complaints, Luo Li grumbled under her breath and turned, preparing to offer incense at the 14th grave.
Suddenly, the soil loosened, and faint rustling sounds emerged.
Watching the soil continuously bulge, Luo Li was aghast, her face instantly showing terror.
Has the corpse reanimated?
Has the ancestor come back to life?
Did he crawl out of his coffin?
Luo Li trembled like a leaf, scared to death.
Could an ancestor, dead for 100,000 years, really be so angered by my mockery that he’d crawl out of his coffin?
A white skeletal hand suddenly stretched out from the mound of earth.
BANG!
The grave mound suddenly burst open!
A white skeleton leapt high into the air, landing before Luo Li.
"Heavens, a ghost!"
Luo Li was so frightened she collapsed onto her bottom, the whites of her eyes showing, nearly wetting herself.

chapters.title: Chapter 2, The Old Ancestor of the True God Realm, Laughs at the World
chapters.content:
Chapter 2: Chapter 2, The Old Ancestor of the True God Realm, Laughs at the World
"Little girl, were you badmouthing me just now?"
Staring at the petrified little charcoal-black girl in front of him, Ye Yun, who had just crawled out of the coffin, suddenly broke into a grin. That smile made his rickety skeleton jaw produce a "CLACK, CLACK" sound.
Ye Yun looked down at himself, only to find that his chest was completely empty. Nothing but a bare skeleton remained.
Well, at least the skeleton is still here,
Ye Yun thought with slight relief. He possessed the Ancestral Dragon Blood and could regenerate his physical body.
"Old Ancestor, I was wrong! I shouldn’t have badmouthed you! Please, spare me!" Luo Li’s face was deathly pale and her expression panicked; she kowtowed repeatedly, banging her head on the ground, so frightened she burst into tears. She never imagined that her complaining would make the Old Ancestor crawl out of his coffin.
"Which generation’s Sect Master are you? How can you be so weak?" Ye Yun quietly stared at Luo Li; his hollow, skeletal eye sockets emanated a sinister and terrifying aura.
"Replying to you, Ancestor, I am the 298th generation Sect Master, Luo Li. Although my strength is a bit lacking, I am absolutely the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, guaranteed!" Luo Li timidly raised her head, her eyes filled with terror, and with trembling hands, she unsteadily took out the Clan Leader’s Token.
"So you really are the Sect Master..." Ye Yun glanced at the token and then surveyed his surroundings, immediately confirming Luo Li’s identity.
This place was the burial ground behind the ancestral hall, on the rear mountain, where all successive Sect Masters of the Dragon God Sect were interred after their deaths. He had personally set up a grand formation here, and only the Sect Master could enter.
Ye Yun no longer doubted Luo Li’s identity. However, this little girl’s cultivation realm... it was simply too low. If this were a hundred thousand years ago, a disciple of such caliber wouldn’t even be qualified to carry the shoes for the Outer Disciples of the Dragon God Sect.
"Has the world grown weaker, or has the Dragon God Sect?" Ye Yun’s deep, skeletal eye sockets fixed on Luo Li, his voice low and eerie.
"Replying to you, Old Ancestor, the world hasn’t changed. It is the Dragon God Sect that has declined... Now... now, I am the only one left..." At this, Luo Li plopped onto the ground and burst into uncontrollable sobs. Her already disheveled appearance worsened as tears and mucus streamed down her face, making her look even more pitiful.
What a pitiful little girl!
Seeing Luo Li cry so sorrowfully, Ye Yun sighed inwardly. He had never imagined that the Dragon God Sect would fall into such a dilapidated state. However, this was the cruel reality a hundred thousand years later. Ye Yun adjusted his mindset and began to confront this reality.
"Close your eyes," Ye Yun instructed. He was about to regenerate his physical body and didn’t want this junior to witness the process.
"Oh!" Luo Li obediently closed her eyes.
Ye Yun touched his wrist, and his Divine Thought reached into the System’s inventory, retrieving a porcelain vial whose contents he promptly drank. This was the Ancestral Dragon Blood provided by the System, the reward from his first check-in.
Every Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect possessed a dense Dragon God Bloodline. In his time, Ye Yun’s Dragon God Bloodline concentration had reached an astonishing 99%. By the time he was twenty-four, he had broken through to the Eternal Realm, standing at the pinnacle of the Cangnan Continent.
It was at this time that the check-in System was activated. The System had told him that if he wished to advance further on the path of cultivation, he had to discard his Dragon God Bloodline and replace it with the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline. Only then could he break through the Eternal Realm and enter the legendary God Realm. After deep consideration, Ye Yun agreed to the System’s request and entered the mysterious Check-in Space. He remained there for a full hundred thousand years, checking in a staggering 5.2 billion times...
After the Ancestral Dragon Blood was absorbed by the skeleton, fresh blood and flesh regenerated over the white bones at an astonishing, visible-to-the-naked-eye speed. With a light shake of his wrist, Ye Yun donned a snow-white robe.
"Alright, you can open your eyes now!" Ye Yun said with a gentle smile.
Luo Li moved her hands from her eyes, and her eyes instantly lit up. Clad in robes whiter than snow, the Ancestor possessed an exceptional grace. Noble and refined, he resembled an exiled immortal, his peerless bearing difficult to describe.
The Old Ancestor is actually so handsome...
Her cheeks flushed, Luo Li couldn’t take her eyes off Ye Yun, afraid of missing a single detail. In her entire life, she had never seen such a handsome man, as exquisite as jade. A young man in a white robe, elegant and poised, he was simply breathtaking.
Ye Yun stood with his hands clasped behind his back, a faint smile on his lips as he observed the pitiful little snot-nosed brat before him.
At that moment, the power of the Ancestral Dragon Blood surged through his body like a great river, and the Eternity Realm’s barrier within him shattered. Ye Yun had finally achieved his desire and entered the True God Realm.
In the Cangnan Continent, beneath the gods, cultivation was divided into ten major realms: Body Refining Realm, Gathering Qi Realm, Mysterious Pill Realm, Origin Sea Realm, Shaping God Realm, Divine Bridge Realm, Nirvana Realm, Destiny Realm, Life and Death Realm, and Eternal Realm. The Eternal Realm was already the peak; if one broke through to the True God Realm, they would become an invincible god who could look down upon the world.
In the Cangnan Continent, for hundreds of thousands of years, no one had set foot into the God Realm. The God Realm was merely an ancient legend.
"Ancestor, has your cultivation base broken through?" Luo Li stared, aghast, her eyes wide and her mouth agape. Through the unique resonance between her Dragon’s Heart Method and Dragon God Bloodline, she had previously been able to vaguely surmise that the Old Ancestor’s cultivation base was perhaps in the Eternal Realm. But just now, an even more potent Super Divine Dragon Breath had erupted from the Old Ancestor. When she sensed with her bloodline once more, she found she could no longer perceive the Ancestor’s realm.
"I’ve broken through!" Ye Yun said with a laugh.
"Old Ancestor, does this mean you are now... in the True God Realm?" Luo Li asked, her voice trembling. As the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, possessing the Sect’s foundational knowledge, Luo Li knew that above the Eternal Realm, there was the ethereal and legendary True God Realm.
"Yes!" Ye Yun nodded.
"Wow! It’s actually the True God Realm! Old Ancestor, the Dragon God Sect is saved!" Hearing Ye Yun’s confirmation, Luo Li first danced with excitement, then burst into loud sobs.
A God! The True God Realm! That was the terrifying, legendary God Realm spoken of in the tales of the Cangnan Continent. No one knew how many tens of thousands of years it had been since anyone last achieved such a breakthrough. Most cultivators had never even heard of the True God Realm.
Ye Yun touched the spot between his eyebrows.
It’s clear this little snot-nosed brat must have endured countless hardships and grievances in the declining Dragon God Sect.
"Little girl, tell me what has happened to the Dragon God Sect," Ye Yun said seriously.
"Ancestor, the Dragon God Sect today..." Luo Li wiped her tears and proceeded to tell Ye Yun everything she knew about the Sect.
After she finished, Ye Yun quietly asked, "So, according to you, you don’t know which superpower it was that the 250th generation Sect Master offended?"
"That’s right, Old Ancestor!" Luo Li replied, her face mournful. "It was too long ago, and the previous Ancestors were extremely secretive about it. As a result, even now, we don’t know who it is that has been constantly targeting the Dragon God Sect..."
"Fear not. No matter who it is, I will annihilate their entire clan!" A bloodthirsty glint flashed in Ye Yun’s eyes. His calm voice carried an iron will capable of destroying heaven and earth.
Luo Li was stunned.
This handsome Old Ancestor... when he’s domineering, he’s simply too charismatic!
Ye Yun used his Divine Thought to assess Luo Li’s aptitude. He discovered that the little girl’s Dragon God Bloodline was pitifully thin, and couldn’t help but feel a trace of disappointment.
It seems the current Dragon God Sect doesn’t even measure up to a third-rate sect.
But no matter. He had his ways.
Ye Yun touched his wrist again and took out a medicinal pellet.
"Take this Marrow Cleansing Pill first!" Ye Yun instructed, then with a flick of his finger, sent it flying towards Luo Li.
What quality is this...?
Luo Li’s gaze was fixed on the Marrow Cleansing Pill, which emanated Dao Rhythm. Her hands trembled as she held the pellet.
Heavens, what kind of quality is this? She had never in her life seen such an incredible Marrow Cleansing Pill!
"It’s a God-level Top-grade Marrow Cleansing Pill," Ye Yun said with a faint smile.
What? God-level?
Luo Li was so frightened she shivered. In her dazed state, the God-level Top-grade Marrow Cleansing Pill slipped from her trembling fingers and fell to the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Divine Pill, Shocking to Hear
chapters.content:
Chapter 3: Chapter 3: Divine Pill, Shocking to Hear
Seeing Luo Li lose her composure, Ye Yun smiled softly, a strange expression on his face.
Just a Divine Marrow Cleansing Pill,
he thought.
He had enough in his storehouse to build a mountain of them as high as the Himalayas.
At Ye Yun’s thought, the Marrow Cleansing Pill seemed to sense his call and floated back to Luo Li’s palm.
"How could it be God Level?" Luo Li came back to her senses, looking at the Old Ancestor in shock.
"Is God Level so strange?" Ye Yun looked at Luo Li curiously, smiling lightly.
"Old Ancestor, this Divine Marrow Cleansing Pill is so precious! I really can’t bear to consume it!" Luo Li held the Marrow Cleansing Pill in her palm, her eyes shining like those of a starving beast, and she swallowed hard.
A Divine Marrow Cleansing Pill!
she thought in awe.
Such a thing has never appeared in the entire Cangnan Continent. It exists only in legends!
Currently, the hierarchy of cultivation techniques, pills, and magical treasures, from lowest to highest, was: Mortal Level, Yellow Level, Spirit Level, Profound Level, Earth Level, Heaven Level, King Level, Emperor Level, and finally, God Level.
In the Cangnan Continent, people would kill for a Heaven Level Marrow Cleansing Pill. King Level ones, let alone anything higher, had never even appeared. Only ten levels were commonly known. Some pills might reach King Level, but anything Emperor Level or above was purely the stuff of legend.
As for Marrow Cleansing Pills... the highest grade ever seen is merely Heaven Level, Inferior-grade. That’s the best Marrow Cleansing Pill even the top alchemists in the Cangnan Continent can refine.
Luo Li had lived her entire life in poverty. The best Marrow Cleansing Pill she had ever consumed was merely a Yellow Level, Superior-grade.
At this moment, a green glint flashed in her eyes.
If I sold this Divine Marrow Cleansing Pill,
she schemed,
how many Heaven Level Marrow Cleansing Pills could I get for it?
Seeing the greedy look on the little girl’s face, Ye Yun smiled softly and took out a small Purple Gold Gourd.
"Don’t be reluctant to take it. This gourd contains ten thousand more Divine Marrow Cleansing Pills. You could eat them like candy, and it wouldn’t be a problem..."
Hearing Ye Yun’s words, Luo Li was shocked once again. She felt as if her entire brain had ceased to function.
"Old Ancestor, you... you aren’t joking, are you?" Luo Li asked tentatively.
If this Old Ancestor, who reached the Eternal Realm 100,000 years ago, happened to possess one Divine Marrow Cleansing Pill by some stroke of luck, that might be believable. After all, 100,000 years ago, the Dragon God Sect was incredibly prosperous. But to claim he has 10,000 Divine Marrow Cleansing Pills? That’s absolutely impossible!
"Do I look like I’m joking?" Ye Yun took out a small mirror and glanced at his reflection. He looked perfectly serious.
How do I look like I’m joking?
he wondered.
So, he casually tossed the Purple Gold Gourd to Luo Li. "Why don’t you open it and see for yourself, Luo Li?"
"Oh!"
Luo Li, still skeptical, took the Purple Gold Gourd. When she opened it, she discovered an entirely different space within. Countless Marrow Cleansing Pills floated densely inside; a quick count suggested at least eight or nine thousand. And each Marrow Cleansing Pill was exactly the same as the one in her hand. Every single one was a God-level Top-grade Marrow Cleansing Pill!
As if struck on the head by a heavy hammer, Luo Li was so shocked she was rendered speechless, her mind a complete blank.
This...
she stammered internally.
So many God-level Top-grade Marrow Cleansing Pills! If word of these got out, the countless powerful factions in the Cangnan Continent would surely fight to the death over them! Even Eternal Level major sects would be annihilated overnight! A single Divine Marrow Cleansing Pill could create a genius! A peerless genius!
"Old Ancestor, am I dreaming?" Luo Li rubbed her eyes, looking dazed, as if she couldn’t believe it.
"This is all real, little one," Ye Yun said gently, his expression kind. He could see that this 298th Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect had endured many hardships and grievances growing up. This touched Ye Yun’s heart deeply.
He inwardly vowed,
I must transform this historically weakest Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect into the most brilliant and dazzling prodigy on the continent!
"Boo hoo..." Luo Li covered her face and began to cry, overwhelmed. She didn’t know why she was crying. Perhaps she was just too overjoyed.
"Luo Li, stop crying. Hurry and consume this Divine Marrow Cleansing Pill," Ye Yun said with a smile.
Luo Li managed to stop her tears. Years of being a fugitive, constantly hiding, had forged an extremely resilient character; her self-control far surpassed that of her peers.
She respectfully handed the Purple Gold Gourd back to Ye Yun.
"This gourd of Divine Marrow Cleansing Pills is for you!" Ye Yun waved his hand.
Back then, when he was ’signing in’ every ten minutes in that pitch-dark space, he had eventually grown numb to it. Perhaps the System was intentionally goading him. After 30,000 years, the rewards from the System grew increasingly abundant. For instance, rewards used to be a single Purple Gold Gourd of Marrow Cleansing Pills. But later, a single ’sign-in’ reward could be ten thousand, a hundred thousand, or even a million gourds... Ye Yun didn’t dare to think about it anymore. He had acquired far too many things; it had become his most painful memory. In this lifetime, he never wanted to set foot in that warehouse again, to see those countless pills, cultivation techniques, treasures, and... Divine Pets. Heavens!
Seeing that the Old Ancestor intended to give her this entire gourd of Divine Marrow Cleansing Pills, Luo Li was instantly aghast.
A mere weakling at the eighth layer of Qi Gathering like me, how could I dare accept such an invaluable item? If I were careless and its aura leaked even slightly, I’d be dead for sure!
Having been a fugitive for many years, the young Luo Li was already quite worldly-wise; how could she not understand the principle of not flaunting one’s wealth?
"Old Ancestor, this is truly too precious! It’s better if you keep it!" Luo Li said with an awkward smile, placing the Purple Gold Gourd back into Ye Yun’s hand.
"Very well," Ye Yun nodded with a smile. He too had once been the Sect Master of a great sect and had roamed the martial world with his sword; naturally, he understood the dark undercurrents of the Cultivation World.
Next, Luo Li carefully consumed the Divine Marrow Cleansing Pill.
WHOOSH...
Her body began to change. She started to excrete black, foul-smelling sweat, followed by black sludge – all impurities from within her body. This process continued for the time it takes for an incense stick to burn.
"Oh dear, it smells terrible! Old Ancestor, I’ve embarrassed myself before you!"
After the marrow cleansing concluded, Luo Li was coated in a layer of pitch-black impurities, reeking of a foul stench. The little girl’s face flushed crimson with embarrassment, making her wish she could find a hole to crawl into and hide.
Just then, Luo Li heard the Old Ancestor ask her an unexpected question.
"What color Robe do you like, Luo Li?"
"Yellow!" Luo Li spoke without thinking.
A bright yellow light flashed. Before her eyes, a woman’s yellow Robe suddenly materialized, hovering in mid-air. This goose-yellow Robe was exquisite and magnificent, embroidered with a Divine Dragon pattern on the back. It radiated a sacred aura so intense that Luo Li found it hard to look at directly.
The quality of this Robe is beyond my wildest imagination! What grade is this?
Luo Li wondered.
I can’t even tell! The most powerful Robe I’ve ever seen in my entire life was merely Heaven Level!
Ye Yun sighed softly. "This Robe is only Emperor Level. You’ll have to make do with it for now."
An Emperor Level Robe?!
Hearing the Old Ancestor’s nonchalant words, Luo Li was utterly dumbfounded, her face a mask of shock.
Just casually wearing an Emperor Level Robe... I feel like I’m going insane! If I wore this out, would I even live to see tomorrow?

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood, Body Swap against the Heavens
chapters.content:
Chapter 4: Chapter 4: Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood, Body Swap against the Heavens
Ye Yun heaved a light sigh. The System had given him many robes as sign-in rewards, but most of them were for men. There were very few robes for women. The highest grade among them was Emperor Level, and there were also some beyond God Level, which Ye Yun felt were not appropriate to give out yet.
However, according to his experience, wearing an Emperor Level robe was enough to highlight the status of the Divine Dragon Sect Sect Master.
With a light stomp of his foot, Ye Yun and Luo Li appeared halfway up the mountain, far away from the graves. Then, with a light swipe of his hand, a clear stream of water immediately cascaded down from the heavens.
"Have a wash first!" Ye Yun gestured with his hand, setting up a shielding formation.
In an instant, he and Luo Li could no longer see each other.
Luo Li was no fool; she immediately understood her Ancestor’s kind intentions. "Thank you, Ancestor!" Luo Li said gratefully, then ran to the small, waterfall-like stream of water, quickly removed her clothes, and rinsed off the impurities covering her body.
Ye Yun turned his back. Despite the formation, he still maintained his dignity as an Ancestor.
After all, they were separated by so many generations; how could he have the leisure to peep at that soot-covered little girl?
Very soon, Luo Li’s voice came from inside. "Ancestor, I’ve finished washing. Please open the formation!"
Ye Yun was slightly stunned, then understood. Luo Li, who had survived for many years while constantly being hunted, was not as prone to dawdling as an ordinary woman. He withdrew the formation and also dispelled the waterfall he had created with mana.
Luo Li, now dressed in an exquisite goose-yellow robe, stood before him like a blooming water lily. This sight made Ye Yun’s eyes light up.
This girl isn’t ugly; on the contrary, she’s quite beautiful. Her skin is like jade, her features delicate, her eyes and brows picturesque, and her figure graceful. She could be considered a top-tier beauty.
According to Ye Yun’s standards, she definitely counted as an exceptional beauty.
With such a Divine Dragon Sect Sect Master, she can indeed hold her own...
Ye Yun praised in his heart.
His body shivered slightly as his cultivation base improved from the First Level of the True God Realm to the Second Level.
The Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood is indeed powerful.
Ye Yun estimated that once he completely absorbed the energy of the Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood, he would at least be able to reach the Tenth Layer of the True God Realm.
"Luo Li, your Dragon God Bloodline is so diluted. Is it because the sect no longer has any Divine Dragon Essence Blood?" Ye Yun suddenly asked.
"Yes!" Luo Li’s face darkened. "The 250th Sect Master was in charge of the Divine Dragon Essence Blood. After he died, our Dragon God Sect no longer had any Divine Dragon Essence Blood to use!"
"What a bastard!" Ye Yun cursed. If that bastard descendant were still alive, Ye Yun would definitely slap him to death.
"Luo Li, you don’t need to worry. The current dilution of your Dragon God Bloodline is actually a good thing, as I can now give you Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood!"
"What? Ancestral Dragon Bloodline?" Hearing her Ancestor’s words, Luo Li was so shocked her jaw almost dropped to the ground.
Ancestor Dragon! That’s the ancestor of the Divine Dragons! How precious would that Essence Blood be?
Luo Li dared not imagine.
As she was reeling from shock, Ye Yun had already produced a large wooden basin, fully five meters in diameter. He then took out a small porcelain vial and tipped it into the basin. Instantly, the entire basin filled with red blood.
"AH!" Luo Li trembled all over, screaming as she fell to her knees. Her diluted Dragon God Bloodline reacted to the oppressive Ancestral Dragon Bloodline in the wooden basin, and she lost control of her body.
The Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood is terrifying... But how could there be so much Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood?
Luo Li recalled the records within the sect: even a direct disciple of the Dragon God Sect could only consume one drop of Divine Dragon Essence Blood. Even an unrivaled prodigy personally nurtured by the Sect Leader could only consume at most three drops of Divine Dragon Essence Blood.
But what was in the wooden basin before her... There had to be hundreds of thousands of drops... And this is all legendary Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood! It’s so precious that even if all the Divine Dragon Essence Blood in the sect’s stores during the time the Ancestor was alive were added up, it would not be as precious as a single drop of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood!
AAAHHH! Luo Li felt like she was going mad!
Luo Li, her mind reeling in shock, shook her head repeatedly. "Ancestor, this is too wasteful! One drop is enough for me!"
Ye Yun rubbed his temples, a look of exasperation on his face.
What was this mere basinful of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood? Just now, he had swallowed a bottle of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood, a volume as large as a small lake. And the Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood in his storage was simply too numerous to count. But Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood could only promote cultivation base growth to a certain extent when used for the first time to improve physique and activate bloodline. A second use would only increase bloodline concentration. Once the concentration exceeded one hundred percent, Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood would have no further effect.
Luo Li was still kneeling, gazing at the crystal-clear Essence Blood that radiated a surging Ancestral Dragon’s Breath, shaking her head and pleading, "Ancestor, one drop is enough for me! This large basin of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood... I’m afraid I can’t withstand it all!"
Ye Yun lowered his head. He touched his chin and muttered to himself, "Hmm... that’s true. Haste makes waste. I was a bit too eager. After all, your cultivation realm is still too low, and your foundation is too weak..."
"Yes, yes, Ancestor, you’re absolutely right!" Luo Li quickly nodded.
Looking at this little girl, her delicate little face, her eyes shining with a strong will to survive, Ye Yun couldn’t help but smile gently. "Alright then, I’ll give you one drop of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood first. As for the rest, I’ll store it for you. You can take it periodically in the future to continuously increase the concentration of the bloodline in your body!"
Ye Yun flicked his finger, transferring the Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood from the wooden basin into an empty vial, then tossed it to Luo Li.
Luo Li was taken aback, her small face suddenly turning pale.
Carry so much Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood with her? How could she, a mere Eighth Layer Gathering Qi Realm cultivator, be qualified for such a treasure?
"Ancestor, could you keep it for me, please?" Luo Li, looking embarrassed, handed the small vial back to Ye Yun.
"Alright then!" Seeing the little girl’s apprehension, Ye Yun felt a bit helpless. He used his finger to draw out a single drop of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood and let it float to Luo Li’s mouth.
Luo Li opened her mouth and swallowed it, then immediately sat cross-legged. She began to absorb and refine it using the Dragon’s Heart Method, unique to the Dragon God Sect.
In just a few seconds, the Super Divine Dragon Breath around Luo Li suddenly changed, and she broke through to the Ninth Layer of the Gathering Qi Realm.
A few dozen seconds later, Luo Li broke through to the Tenth Layer of the Gathering Qi Realm.
Mysterious Elixir Stage First Layer!
Mysterious Elixir Stage Second Layer!
Mysterious Elixir Stage Third Layer!
...
Her cultivation continued to surge, reaching the Mysterious Elixir Stage Ninth Layer, and then the Mysterious Elixir Stage Tenth Layer.
Next came the Yuanhai Realm First Layer.
Yuanhai Realm Second Layer.
...
Having swallowed this one drop of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood, Luo Li’s Super Divine Dragon Breath became increasingly powerful; her cultivation base broke through successive barriers, advancing with incredible speed.
Seeing this, Ye Yun nodded with satisfaction.
This drop of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood is indeed extraordinary. Unfortunately, 100,000 years ago, this type of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood was considered legendary; the entire Dragon God Sect possessed none.
Ye Yun also wanted to see what realm this little girl, Luo Li, could break through to with this single drop of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood.
The Super Divine Dragon Breath erupting from Luo Li was like a volcano. This continued until she reached the Yuanhai Realm Tenth Layer, at which point the eruptive momentum finally ceased.
Luo Li opened her eyes. She looked at Ye Yun, her face alight with pleasant surprise, and said in a trembling voice, "Ancestor, my cultivation base... it’s reached the Yuanhai Realm Tenth Layer!"

chapters.title: Chapter 5: Divine Weapon, Supreme Golden Dragon Sword
chapters.content:
Chapter 5: Chapter 5: Divine Weapon, Supreme Golden Dragon Sword
"Mhm!"
Watching the little girl’s excitement after her breakthrough in cultivation base, Ye Yun just smiled faintly.
He had just perceived Luo Li’s bloodline.
The purity of Luo Li’s Ancestral Dragon Bloodline had reached 1%. At this rate, a few hundred drops of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood could raise her bloodline concentration to over 90%.
The lower the cultivation level, the better the effect of the Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood, and the lower the cost.
However, not everyone could withstand Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood.
Only those possessing a Dragon God Bloodline could use different types of Divine Dragon Essence Blood to enhance their bloodline concentration.
No matter the method used for enhancement, achieving a 100% Divine Dragon Bloodline was impossible.
Even Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood could not accomplish this.
The most one could attain was 99%.
Even though it was just a 1% difference, that small gap was like an unfathomable chasm, forever preventing humans from reaching the true power of a Divine Dragon.
The concentration of Ye Yun’s own Ancestral Dragon Bloodline had also just reached 90%.
This was because his realm was high, so his progress was rapid.
As for little ones like Luo Li, they could only improve step by step.
The further one progressed, the greater the cost, especially after surpassing 90%.
However, for humans to possess 90% of the Dragon Clan Bloodline was already sufficient.
"Luo Li, our Dragon God Sect has three great techniques: palm arts, swordsmanship, and movement techniques."
Ye Yun looked seriously at Luo Li, gave a faint smile, and asked, "How is your training in them?"
Luo Li stood up at this moment, her small face reddened slightly, and she lowered her head.
"Replying to the Ancestor, I am most skilled in the Divine Dragon Hundred Change Body Method, followed by Swordsmanship. However, I am worst at the palm technique, which I’ve barely learned at all!"
Luo Li said shyly.
Ye Yun laughed heartily.
It was no wonder Luo Li’s movement technique was the best.
Constantly fleeing for her life, how could she have survived without some solid skills?
Ye Yun speculated that it was not just Luo Li; likely, all disciples of the Dragon God Sect from the 251st generation onward had prioritized escape.
Thus, they had all become extremely proficient in the Divine Dragon Hundred Change Body Method.
"From now on, you won’t need to run."
Ye Yun smiled faintly, yet his expression unconsciously turned colder by several degrees.
SWISH!
He lightly brushed his wrist.
An astonishingly cold light instantly appeared in his hand.
It was an indescribable Divine Sword, as crystal clear and translucent as pure ice. Within its nearly transparent body, a life-like, seven-inch Golden Divine Dragon was sealed.
The sword radiated a dazzling brilliance and exuded a potent Super Divine Dragon Breath. The moment it appeared in the void, the surrounding space trembled and distorted slightly.
L Luo Li’s expression changed drastically.
This sword... it’s too strong! Unbelievably strong!
She couldn’t even determine the sword’s grade!
"Ancestor, what level is this sword?" Under the oppressive Super Divine Dragon Breath of the Divine Sword, Luo Li found it hard to breathe and asked with difficulty.
Ye Yun lightly flicked his hand.
The imposing presence of this peerless Divine Sword immediately retracted, and Luo Li instantly let out a sigh of relief.
"This is the Supreme Golden Dragon Sword. It’s considered God level, I suppose..."
Ye Yun smiled lightly and flicked the sword’s body, eliciting a clear dragon’s cry.
Flicked by Ye Yun, the sealed Golden Divine Dragon within the sword seemed to come alive, actually tumbling over inside.
Luo Li was dumbstruck.
She never imagined that the Ancestor, with his first move, would produce a God level weapon.
Luo Li was incomparably shocked.
How could the Ancestor possess a God level weapon?
On the Cangnan Continent, the most treasured artifacts of even Eternal Level powers were merely Emperor Level Divine Weapons.
And she, as the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, also knew that their Sect had once possessed a Divine Sword that reached Emperor Level.
However, that precious Emperor Level Divine Sword was ultimately destroyed at the hands of the 250th Sect Master.
"Luo Li, this sword is for you. As the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, you can be lacking in other areas, but the sword in your hand must absolutely not be!"
Ye Yun smiled faintly, his expression proud.
The Dragon God Sect’s greatest strength was its swordsmanship. Naturally, as the Sect Master, one could not lack a presentable Divine Sword.
"Oh..."
Luo Li, still in shock, dazedly accepted the Supreme Golden Dragon Sword. She gazed at the Golden Divine Dragon sealed within the crystal-clear body of the sword, her face a mask of astonishment.
Is this dragon still alive?
"The one sealed inside is a Dragon Soul; it is still alive..." Ye Yun said with a smile.
Luo Li nodded silently.
She lovingly caressed the sword’s body, unable to put it down. Her heart surged with ecstatic joy, her eyes shining brightly, feeling as if she might drool on the sword.
Luo Li never dreamed that she, formerly the most pathetic Sect Master on the Cangnan Continent, would one day possess a God level weapon that no one else on the entire continent had.
After the time it takes for half an incense stick to burn, Luo Li, having regained her senses, said with a sob, "Ancestor, this sword is wonderful, but I can’t possibly wield it out in the open!"
This God level treasured sword is world-shaking. If I were to take it out, I’m afraid it would incite a reign of terror and bloodshed across the entire Cangnan Continent.
Ye Yun smiled and said, "Don’t worry. I will add several layers of Seals to it, starting it at Heavenly Quality. Later, as your cultivation base improves, you can undo the Seals layer by layer."
Saying this, Ye Yun lightly tapped his fingers in the void.
The Super Divine Dragon Breath of the God level Supreme Golden Dragon Sword immediately began to decrease, eventually settling at the Lower level of the heavenly grade.
Luo Li breathed a sigh of relief.
"Oh, right, and the scabbard!"
Ye Yun suddenly remembered something. With a sudden smile, he took out a golden scabbard and casually handed it to Luo Li.
So strong! Is this still just a scabbard?
Upon receiving the scabbard, Luo Li felt an immense pressure that made her body sway, nearly causing her to lose her footing.
She cried out with a sob, "Ancestor, this scabbard’s grade isn’t low either, is it? Please, seal it quickly too!"
"This scabbard is Emperor Level. You could even use it as a club to bash people!"
Ye Yun laughed heartily.
After tapping the scabbard a few times, its Super Divine Dragon Breath completely vanished.
It became a most ordinary scabbard, merely Spirit Level.
Seeing this, Luo Li finally felt a sense of relief.
She inserted the Supreme Golden Dragon Sword into the scabbard and then hugged them both tightly with both hands, her expression extremely cautious, as if afraid the Divine Sword might fall.
"Someone’s approaching from outside!"
Ye Yun’s brow furrowed slightly, a hint of displeasure appearing on his gentle, jade-like face.
"Ancestor, it must be the people hunting me..."
Luo Li explained hesitantly.
"Let’s go!"
With a sweep of his large hand, Ye Yun enveloped Luo Li in a ray of light, and in an instant, they appeared above the ruins of the Sect.
Standing above the ruins of the Dragon God Sect, gazing at the crumbling walls overgrown with thick moss, Ye Yun recalled his childhood, growing up in this place, inheriting the position of Sect Master at eighteen... Countless past events surfaced in his mind, and he couldn’t help but feel a wave of sorrow.
One hundred thousand years. The seas had turned into mulberry fields.
All in the blink of an eye.
The once incomparably prosperous and flourishing Dragon God Sect had declined to the point of vanishing from the river of history on the Cangnan Continent.
"Luo Li!"
Ye Yun’s eyes narrowed slightly as he murmured.
"Disciple is here!"
Clutching the Divine Sword, Luo Li stood beside the Ancestor, her posture valiant and her expression solemn.
"From this day forward, your only concern is to kill!"
Ye Yun said calmly.
His voice contained boundless murderous intent.
BOOM!
As his words fell, heaven and earth seemed to react, and a sudden clap of thunder echoed through the void!

chapters.title: Chapter 6 - A Sword Execution, Luo Li’s Ruthlessness
chapters.content:
Chapter 6: Chapter 6 - A Sword Execution, Luo Li’s Ruthlessness
"Yes, Ancestral Master!" Luo Li’s sensual red lips puckered, and her arched eyebrows rose sharply. Holding her sword, she stood with an earthshattering aura.
At this moment, her heart was brimming with killing intent. Her petite frame seemed like a heaven-shakingly sharp sword, standing straight and tall, releasing an endless killing intent. Although her face was cold, Luo Li was extremely excited inside! Her graceful body couldn’t stop trembling slightly.
The Ancestral Master is a True God Realm cultivator, after all! In the nearly one hundred thousand years of the Cangnan Continent’s history, no Supreme powerhouse of the True God Realm had ever appeared! It could be said that the Ancestral Master was an invincible existence! A single thought from him could make an Eternal Level Super Sect be reduced to ashes! With the Ancestral Master by her side, Luo Li was full of confidence. Even if she couldn’t win, wasn’t the Ancestral Master still there? In the eyes of the Ancestral Master, any cultivator was like an insignificant ant.
Moreover... she was no longer the young monk of the Gathering Qi Realm she once was. Now, Luo Li was also a grand cultivator at the tenth layer of the Origin Sea Realm!
Looking at this young girl, Luo Li, radiating such a vigorous spirit, Ye Yun couldn’t help but nod inwardly, a soundless praise forming in his heart.
Luo Li’s master certainly has good judgment.
This Luo Li is decisive and astute in her actions, possessing both a gentle nature and an unyielding spirit; truly a rare prodigy. In the future, the Dragon God Sect could definitely regain its glory under Luo Li’s leadership.
As a Supreme being of the True God Realm, if Ye Yun were to act as Luo Li’s Protector, then naturally no one in this world could harm her. Of course, Ye Yun didn’t possess the heart of a saint. For Luo Li’s growth, he would let her go, allowing her to grow through trials and tribulations. He didn’t want her to become a flower coddled in a greenhouse.
Under their watchful eyes, a group of people appeared at the foot of the mountain where the Dragon God Sect ruins lay.
There were seven or eight men in total. Two were at the Mysterious Pill Realm, and five were at the Origin Sea Realm. There was also one young man at the Gathering Qi Realm.
"It’s right here," that young man said, trembling as he pointed at the ruins ahead.
"Alright, you can get lost now." An Origin Sea Realm cultivator waved his hand impatiently and sent the Gathering Qi Realm young man flying with a slap. The young man landed heavily on a giant stone, coughed up blood, and died.
"HAHAHA..." Everyone laughed heartily, none of them caring in the slightest about the life or death of the Gathering Qi Realm youth. He was just a guide; killing him was of no consequence.
After their laughter subsided, they quickly flew towards the Dragon God Sect ruins at the mountain’s summit.
"Eldest Senior Brother, only one fish slipped the net from the Dragon God Sect. That little girl is merely at the Gathering Qi Realm. Is it really worth so many of us coming to capture her?" a young man at the fourth layer of the Origin Sea Realm asked with a laugh.
"That sole surviving disciple of the Dragon God Sect is its final Sect Leader. If we capture her, the rewards we’ll receive will be extremely generous..." The middle-aged man leading the group turned back, a greedy smile playing on his lips.
Thinking about the massive rewards, he was unable to suppress the excitement in his heart.
"Little Junior Brother, you just don’t understand. Although that little girl from the Gathering Qi Realm doesn’t have a high cultivation base, she’s very alert and possesses an uncanny movement technique. All our previous attempts to capture her failed. This time, we absolutely cannot let her escape. Once we catch this big fish and hand her over, we’ll receive rewards more bountiful than you can possibly imagine," the second-in-command, a younger man, said with a laugh.
"Let’s hope the little brat doesn’t escape this time!" the Little Junior Brother said with a shrug and a laugh.
The others also chuckled dryly and quickly ascended to the mountaintop.
When they reached the summit, they found two strangers standing opposite them.
One was a young man in white. His face was handsome as if carved from jade, his features distinct and sharp. His eyes were as deep as star-filled skies, and his every movement exuded an indescribable Immortal Aura. Strangely, however, they couldn’t sense any cultivation base from him at all. This person seemed like an ordinary mortal, without the slightest hint of cultivation.
Beside the man stood an exquisitely beautiful woman in a goose-yellow Daoist Robe. Her skin was like snow, her features delicate and picturesque, her beauty unparalleled, and she exuded the potent Super Divine Dragon Breath of a tenth-layer Origin Sea Realm cultivator.
What astonishing Sword Intent!
The Eldest Senior Brother glanced at the stunning woman, a horrified look involuntarily appearing in his eyes. He too was at the tenth layer of the Origin Sea Realm, yet before this beautiful woman, he felt immense pressure.
It felt as if, in the next instant, her astonishing Sword Intent could slit his throat.
This Sword Cultivator is truly formidable!
The Eldest Senior Brother felt a chill creep into his heart.
He clasped his fists together and asked with a face full of smiles, "Miss, might I ask if you’ve seen a little dark-skinned girl pass this way?"
A dark-skinned little girl?
Luo Li grew annoyed. With a cold expression, she slowly unsheathed her sword.
Ye Yun, however, was smiling.
These fools were truly blind. Luo Li was right in front of them, yet they didn’t recognize her.
But it wasn’t entirely surprising. After all, Luo Li had previously been dressed in ragged clothes, her face all dark, like a little piece of charcoal. How could that compare with her current, unparalleled elegance?
"Eldest Senior Brother, this woman is not to be trifled with! Perhaps she’s the help that wretched girl from the Dragon God Sect called for!" the Second Senior Brother, his expression wary, leaned in and whispered.
"HEHE... is that so?" The Eldest Senior Brother’s face suddenly turned cold and grim. He drew his sword and pointed it at Luo Li.
The Second Senior Brother’s eyes glinted with greed as he chuckled in a low voice, "That Robe she’s wearing looks quite fine; it seems to be an extraordinary treasure!"
Eldest Senior Brother’s pupils contracted slightly, his gaze falling upon the goose-yellow Daoist Robe Luo Li wore. His eyes widened dramatically, and he gasped in astonishment, "It’s an Emperor Level Robe!"
What? An Emperor Level Robe?
Everyone was dumbstruck. They had rarely even seen King Level items, let alone Emperor Level ones. In an instant, everyone’s eyes turned red with greed.
If they killed this woman and obtained the Emperor Level Robe she wore, they would strike it rich beyond their wildest dreams!
Let’s risk it!
A ruthless glint appeared in the Eldest Senior Brother’s gloomy eyes.
As the saying goes, fortune is sought in danger. Should he obtain this Emperor Level Robe, he would acquire unimaginable resources and advance much further on his cultivation path.
Although there were two of them, the man was just an ordinary mortal, unworthy of concern. This stunningly beautiful woman at the tenth layer of the Origin Sea Realm was their true adversary!
He too was at the tenth layer of the Origin Sea Realm, and he had four Origin Sea Realm junior brothers to assist him. If they executed their Five Element Combination Attack swordsmanship, killing a tenth-layer Origin Sea Realm cultivator would be no problem at all.
The five men exchanged a look, then, holding their longswords, advanced towards Luo Li, surrounding her and Ye Yun.
Ye Yun stood with his hands clasped behind his back, a faint, indifferent smile on his face.
These ants are far too weak. How could they possibly be Luo Li’s match?
"Kill!" Luo Li cried, her sword slashing out.
At the same instant, the five men’s combined attack Formation activated. Unending torrents of sword light poured down like quicksilver from five directions.
A single sword’s cold light illuminated the Nine Provinces.
The sword in Luo Li’s hand, like a Divine Dragon emerging into the world, met the five men’s sword light.
CRASH!
The five swords shattered abruptly.
The razor-sharp Sword Qi pierced their bodies, shredding their hearts.

chapters.title: Chapter 7: Soul Searching Secret Technique, Begin to Break the Game
chapters.content:
Chapter 7: Chapter 7: Soul Searching Secret Technique, Begin to Break the Game
One sword!
It took only one sword!
Luo Li directly killed five cultivators from the Origin Sea Realm.
"I... I’m really so powerful!"
With the Supreme Golden Dragon Sword in hand, Luo Li’s delicate body trembled slightly, her beautiful face flushed.
Ever since she joined the Dragon God Sect, she had been wandering with her master. Her cultivation base was pathetically low, and she had never killed in such an exultant manner before.
But now, having met the Old Ancestor, she had transformed into a great cultivator at the Tenth Layer of the Origin Sea Realm.
With just one sword, she had slain five experts from the Origin Sea Realm. This experience felt surreal to Luo Li, almost dreamlike.
"Spare us!"
The two remaining youths from the Mysterious Pill Realm, seeing that all five of their Origin Sea Realm senior brothers had been killed, were terrified and knelt to beg for mercy.
Perhaps caught up in the killing intent, Luo Li gripped her sword and strode forward.
"Luo Li, don’t kill them yet!" Ye Yun said softly from behind.
Luo Li paused, her face flushing as she suddenly realized her rashness.
I was so caught up in the killing that I lost control,
she thought, her face burning.
Thank goodness the Old Ancestor reminded me. Otherwise, I would have killed these two Mysterious Pill Realm fellows as well.
Luo Li had long been a mere weakling at the Gathering Qi Realm. Suddenly becoming a great cultivator in the Origin Sea Realm, she hadn’t fully bridged the mental gap from this transformation.
Still, Luo Li had ventured through the martial world with her master for many years. Being relatively mature, she quickly regained her composure.
"Speak!" Luo Li pointed her sword at the two Mysterious Pill Realm youths and said coldly, "Where did you take my junior brother?"
"I don’t know! It was all our senior brothers’ doing!" one of the young men replied wretchedly.
"It seems you won’t cry until you see your own coffin!"
Luo Li was furious. With a flash of her sword, she lopped off the young man’s ear.
These pursuers had been after them for some time. Several times, Luo Li had nearly fallen into their clutches. If not for her quick wits and the movement technique of the Nine Changes of the God Dragon, she would likely have been captured long ago.
So, when it came to these people, Luo Li would show absolutely no mercy.
Ye Yun nodded, a hint of appreciation in his eyes. This young girl was shrewd and decisive in killing, possessing the commanding aura of a true Sect Master.
"Heroine, we really don’t know!" the other young man also begged loudly, tears streaming down his face.
"Old Ancestor, they might genuinely not know!" Luo Li turned apologetically and said to Ye Yun with a wry smile. "Had I known this, I would have spared those five!"
Ye Yun shook his head and said casually, "Since these two have no value, kill them."
A thrill of joy surged through Luo Li. She raised her sword, and with two swift flashes of cold light, their heads fell to the ground.
"Hehe."
After killing them, Luo Li couldn’t help but chuckle.
There was a time when cultivators of the Mysterious Pill Realm were like untouchable figures to me,
Luo Li mused.
But now, killing them is as easy as chopping vegetables. It’s just so effortless! And all of this is thanks to the Old Ancestor.
As this triumphant feeling settled in, Luo Li’s mindset began to slowly change.
Ye Yun walked a few steps forward with his hands behind his back, arriving next to the corpses of the five men.
He gently extended a finger. A dazzling ray of light shot out from his fingertip, instantly entering the mind of one of the deceased men.
Luo Li held her breath, her gaze fixed on Ye Yun’s actions with intense curiosity.
Old Ancestor, what is he doing?
A faint red soul slowly rose from the top of the man’s head, drifting aimlessly.
Ye Yun’s eyes narrowed slightly as light continued to flicker at his fingertips, seeping into this soul.
He was currently executing a supreme soul-extracting secret technique.
This secret technique could separately extract the soul of a recently deceased person, preventing it from entering the Six Paths of Reincarnation. At the same time, it allowed for a soul search, exploring the person’s entire lifetime of memories.
After ten or so seconds, Ye Yun slowly exhaled, his expression calm.
"Old Ancestor, have you discovered anything?" Luo Li asked softly.
He must be searching for something with these mysterious methods,
she thought. She wasn’t foolish.
"Do you know about Wanbao Pavilion?" Ye Yun looked up and asked Luo Li quietly.
"Yes, Old Ancestor. Wanbao Pavilion is the largest auction house in the Ancient Moon Dynasty," Luo Li explained.
"These people are from the Qing Sword Gate. They accepted a mission from Wanbao Pavilion. If we want to find your junior brother, we must go to Wanbao Pavilion," Ye Yun said softly.
After he finished speaking, he raised an eyebrow slightly, a thoughtful expression on his face.
It seems the power behind this isn’t simple,
Ye Yun mused.
They don’t act directly, merely using Wanbao Pavilion to issue tasks. They’re hidden very deep. Honestly, with the Dragon God Sect currently in decline and with so few members, they really don’t need to go to such lengths. Yet, unexpectedly, they remain as cunning as foxes, manipulating everything from behind the scenes.
This made Ye Yun very curious.
I’d also like to see who exactly is orchestrating this scheme against the Dragon God Sect from the shadows,
he thought.
A fire blazed up.
The seven people from the Qing Sword Gate were all turned to ashes by Ye Yun’s fire.
Then he rearranged the formation in the back mountain before leaving the ruins of the Dragon God Sect with Luo Li.
Ye Yun was unfamiliar with the Ancient Moon Dynasty, as it was a new power that had risen ten thousand years ago.
Luo Li led the way. Ye Yun displayed terrifying flight speed, crossing tens of thousands of miles in merely two or three breaths to directly reach the capital of the Ancient Moon Dynasty.
Such terrifying speed!
Luo Li marveled internally.
Could this be the power of the True God Realm?
The moment Luo Li’s feet touched the ground, she recalled the terrifying flight and couldn’t help but tremble internally.
This journey of tens of thousands of miles would have taken me at least half a month,
she thought, still reeling.
But for the Old Ancestor, it only took a few breaths!
The royal city of the Ancient Moon Dynasty was Dayue City. The two of them joined the bustling crowd and walked in through the city gate.
The Ancient Moon Dynasty was a nation of cultivators, so they could be seen everywhere on the streets.
After walking for a while, they arrived before the entrance of Wanbao Pavilion.
"Two honored guests, are you here to auction or to buy...?" a young attendant hurried up with a smile.
This young attendant was quite observant. Seeing that Ye Yun and Luo Li both had refined demeanors and an air of nobility, he knew they were certainly not ordinary people.
Ye Yun paid no attention to the young attendant and led Luo Li directly inside.
"I want to see your manager!" Ye Yun said indifferently.
"Alright!" The young attendant, startled by Ye Yun’s commanding presence, felt a knot of fear in his heart.
This man before him seemed to have no cultivation base, yet his every gesture exuded a powerful aura that made one’s spirit tremble.
The beautiful woman with him, so young, was already a powerful cultivator at The Tenth Layer Peak of the Origin Sea Realm.
He dared not slight them and quickly went to the second floor to report to the old manager.

chapters.title: Chapter 8: Draw Swords and Kill at a Single Disagreement
chapters.content:
Chapter 8: Chapter 8: Draw Swords and Kill at a Single Disagreement
Watching the young attendant scurry upstairs, Ye Yun merely scoffed. "Let’s go. We’re heading to the second floor."
"Yes!" Luo Li agreed and followed Ye Yun directly to the second floor.
Another young attendant was stationed at the top of the stairs. Seeing their imposing aura, he dared not obstruct them.
The attendant who had rushed upstairs to report never imagined Ye Yun and Luo Li would follow so closely. He had just reached the door of a private room to make his report when he saw Ye Yun and Luo Li walk in. This left him utterly flustered, unsure how to proceed.
The shopkeeper was an elderly man with a full white beard. When he saw them barge in, his face darkened, and his eyes blazed with anger.
"I have an important guest here. Please wait outside!" The old shopkeeper, his expression grim, issued an order to expel them.
Beside him sat a middle-aged man in a black robe. This middle-aged man possessed an extremely high cultivation base; astonishingly, he was a great Cultivator at the Peak of the Tenth Realm of the Origin Sea Realm.
"Both of you, please leave with me, and wait a while!" the young attendant turned, shaking his head with a wry smile.
"None of your business. Scram!" Ye Yun reached out and casually swatted the young attendant aside.
"Arrogant!" The old shopkeeper, enraged by Ye Yun and Luo Li’s audacity, said icily, "Do you two not understand the rules of our Wanbao Pavilion?"
"Rules are made by people!" Ye Yun’s gaze, sharp as a sword, fixed coldly on the old shopkeeper. He chuckled, "They’re also meant to be broken!"
"Very... fine!" Ye Yun’s words made the old shopkeeper’s face turn black, then red, then livid.
He couldn’t discern the depth of the young man before him; he appeared to be an ordinary person with no cultivation base whatsoever. Yet, the breathtakingly beautiful girl beside him possessed an astonishing cultivation, having reached the Peak of the Tenth Realm of the Origin Sea Realm. It was this girl he was truly wary of.
The black-robed middle-aged man, who had been sitting silently, suddenly stood up. With his hands clasped behind his back and eyes narrowed, he stared at Ye Yun and sneered, "To think that the insignificant Ancient Moon Dynasty would harbor such an arrogant individual. Truly an eye-opener!"
Seeing the black-robed man’s sudden anger, the old shopkeeper quickly turned and said apologetically, "Elder Liu, please forgive us. This incident arose because of our Wanbao Pavilion; naturally, we will resolve it!"
"HUMPH!" The black-robed man grunted coldly and sat back down, his face sullen. Evidently, he was showing deference to Wanbao Pavilion.
"Luo Li!" Ye Yun suddenly yelled, "Get him!"
Hearing her Old Ancestor’s command, Luo Li didn’t hesitate in the slightest. Drawing the Supreme Golden Dragon Sword, her aura surged as she slashed out, her Sword aimed directly at the black-robed man.
"Damn it!" Seeing this astonishing Sword strike, the black-robed man was terrified. He hastily scrambled up and dodged to the side.
Luo Li’s Sword abruptly changed direction in mid-air, instantly pursuing him.
"This is absolutely outrageous!" The black-robed man roared in fury. Finally freeing his hands, he drew his own Sword. A flash of Sword light shot towards Luo Li.
CLANG!
The two Swords collided. With a crisp CRACK, the black-robed man’s Sword shattered.
SWISH!
Like a fleeting dragon, another Sword light descended, and Luo Li’s Sword pierced the black-robed man’s arm.
The black-robed man cried out, staggering back repeatedly.
The entire exchange was incredibly swift, a dazzling blur of motion. Before the old shopkeeper could even react, the battle between the two great Cultivators at the Peak of the Tenth Realm of the Origin Sea Realm was over. What astounded him was that the teenage girl was so formidable, injuring Elder Liu with a single Sword strike.
The old shopkeeper was trembling all over.
The young girl’s Swordsmanship was fast, vicious, and precise; her killing power was terrifying. Unless he gathered all the experts in Wanbao Pavilion, only then might they have a chance against her. But he feared that before he could even call for help, this beautiful young girl would silence him permanently.
"Get lost!" Ye Yun glanced at the black-robed man indifferently.
Clutching his bleeding arm, the black-robed man didn’t dare utter a single defiant word. He scurried away from Wanbao Pavilion in disgrace.
He could see that the young girl had an extraordinary background and immense strength; she was far beyond anyone he could afford to provoke.
Now, only Luo Li, Ye Yun, and the old shopkeeper remained in the private room. The old shopkeeper trembled uncontrollably, unable to conceal his profound terror.
"Esteemed guests, please, ask anything. This old one will speak all he knows, holding nothing back!" his voice trembled as he spoke.
Pointing her Sword at the old shopkeeper, Luo Li demanded angrily, "Who exactly ordered you to capture the descendants of the Dragon God Sect?"
Hearing Luo Li’s question, the old shopkeeper visibly hesitated, on the verge of speaking but then catching himself.
"Speak. Or you can die right now!" Ye Yun glanced at the old shopkeeper with a murderous glint in his eyes.
At Ye Yun’s glance, the old shopkeeper felt as if he’d been plunged into an icy abyss, his entire body turning cold in an instant. For a moment, he hallucinated, seeing himself enveloped by an endless, blood-red Hell with no possibility of escape. This young man is terrifyingly powerful! His mind reeled, his heart in turmoil. He knew he had encountered truly formidable figures this time.
"My Lord, I... I don’t know who issued the task," the old shopkeeper stammered. "That person is highly mysterious and always wears a Bronze Mask. He posted the task to hunt down disciples of the Dragon God Sect, and the reward offered to our Wanbao Pavilion was exceptionally generous!" He recounted everything meticulously, his voice still trembling.
Ye Yun’s expression was indifferent.
The old shopkeeper’s words were within Ye Yun’s expectations. The true mastermind was exceedingly cautious, taking such care even when dealing with a minor power like the Dragon God Sect, never revealing their own hand.
"More than ten days ago, one of my junior martial brothers was captured by people from the Qing Sword Gate. Where is he now?" Luo Li pressed, her Sword still pointed at the shopkeeper, her voice hoarse.
"He was taken away by that mysterious masked person!" the old shopkeeper replied, his face pale.
"Do you know where he was taken?" Luo Li pressed urgently.
The old shopkeeper looked out the window, recalling for a few moments before saying, "As he was leaving, he only uttered three words... Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge..."
"What? Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge?" Luo Li’s heart trembled violently.
The Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge... according to legend, it’s a forbidden land. Countless malevolent ghosts are said to dwell there, a place rumored to connect directly to the Nine Soul Nether Hell. No one dares venture near that forbidden zone. Anyone who does has never returned alive.
However, there are exceptions. Every hundred years, the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge hosts a special ’Sky Lantern’ sacrificial ritual. This ’Sky Lantern’ ritual involves various factions of the Ancient Moon Dynasty capturing heinous criminals or even innocent Loose Cultivators and sending them to the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge to be lit as Sky Lanterns. Using humans as wicks and their flesh and blood as oil, they are said to burn for a full forty-nine days before finally perishing completely.
During this burning process, the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge erupts with myriad ghosts, their howls echoing through the mountains as if in celebration of a festival. Yet, those who deliver the offerings are always able to return safely. By coordinating this special sacrificial method of lighting Sky Lanterns, the major powers ensure a century of peace around the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge.
"Where is this Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge?" Ye Yun’s expression flickered slightly as he looked at Luo Li.
Luo Li hurriedly recounted everything she knew about the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge to her Old Ancestor.
Ye Yun nodded slightly.
It seems this Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge is another mysterious faction that emerged in later years.
Luo Li sighed, a dreadful guess forming in her heart.
Little Brother has been captured for over ten days now... His cultivation base isn’t high; sent to the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge, he wouldn’t last forty-nine days. He’s most likely... already perished.
「Exiting Wanbao Pavilion.」
Ye Yun swiftly led Luo Li towards the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge. The Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge was a full thirty thousand miles distant, yet they arrived in what seemed like mere moments.
The so-called Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge was a mountain range shrouded in dense Ghost Qi, exuding an eerie, deathly aura. This dark mountain range stretched for thousands of miles, covering a vast territory.
Hovering in the void, Ye Yun gazed downwards. He observed numerous Cultivators from various major factions, escorting bound Loose Cultivators or criminals under Seal, queuing up to enter the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge.

chapters.title: Chapter 9: The Forbidden Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge
chapters.content:
Chapter 9: Chapter 9: The Forbidden Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge
Ye Yun’s eyelids narrowed slightly, his gaze fixed on the depths of Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge.
Just one glance, and he saw through all the secrets of the entire Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge.
Ye Yun gave a nonchalant smile. He prepared to obliterate Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge with a wave of his hand.
But, seemingly thinking of something, he immediately withdrew his hand.
He was currently in the True God Realm, an unrivaled existence on the Cangnan Continent.
Bullying others like this seemed somewhat inappropriate. If word got out to certain places, he would surely be laughed at. Moreover, Luo Li, as the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, still needed further tempering. If he, as her Old Ancestor, casually solved everything for her, Luo Li would become like a coddled, delicate flower, unable to withstand any future storms. She would falter at the slightest breeze, wilt in a light rain.
Now, this place, Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge, could be an opportunity for Luo Li to broaden her horizons and gain some experience.
Upon this thought, Ye Yun changed his mind.
However, just as he was about to speak, his expression shifted slightly, and he looked towards a distant area.
「Several hundred miles outside Dayue City, atop a mountain.」
A middle-aged man in black robes suddenly landed. He was seething with anger, staring in the direction of Dayue City and vowing, "If I don’t avenge this, I, Liu, swear I am no longer human!"
A soft chuckle sounded through the void.
The middle-aged man in black robes was taken aback. He looked around and roared, "Who’s there? Who’s playing tricks? Show yourself!"
In the void, a faint face suddenly appeared. It was a young man with deep-set features and eyes like stars.
"How could it be you?"
The middle-aged man in black robes recognized him at once: the white-robed man from Wanbao Pavilion who appeared to have no cultivation base.
He was terrified, his heart instantly filled with tumultuous shock. The divine skills the other party was displaying surpassed his comprehension.
"Do you still want your revenge?" From within the illusion, Ye Yun spoke lightly, his eyes filled with endless mockery.
Back in Wanbao Pavilion, he hadn’t acted in front of Luo Li. But this arrogant fellow had offended him once. Ye Yun naturally wouldn’t let him live to see another day. A trace of his Divine Sense had been following the man, intending to eliminate him.
"Who exactly are you? We have no past grudges nor recent enmity. Why must you kill me to silence me?"
Staring at the faint illusion, the middle-aged man in black robes felt a terrifying dread descend upon him. His body trembled, and he couldn’t summon an ounce of strength. At this moment, it was as if he were facing a God Man. As a mere mortal, how could he find the will to resist a God Man?
WHOOSH!
Ye Yun’s illusory face suddenly exhaled lightly. This breath landed on the middle-aged man in black robes, instantly igniting a flame. The man in black robes was burned to ashes in a moment.
After doing all this, the illusion disappeared into the void.
「Near Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge.」
Ye Yun raised an eyebrow slightly, a faint smile playing on his lips. He looked at Luo Li and said with a smile, "That so-called ’Sky Lantern’ ritual involves over ten thousand people now. Most are barely clinging to life, so your junior brother should be fine."
"That’s great, Old Ancestor." Luo Li pressed a hand to her chest, letting out a long sigh of relief, still shaken.
"This place is somewhat interesting. You can go in and explore. I’ll intervene if necessary," Ye Yun added with another smile.
"Okay, Old Ancestor." Luo Li, slightly stunned, nodded vigorously.
After all, she was a quick-witted girl. As her thoughts spun, she seemed to understand the Old Ancestor’s intentions. This Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge was merely a forbidden area that had appeared ten thousand years ago. In the Old Ancestor’s eyes, it was as trivial as children playing in mud. He wouldn’t deign to give it a second glance. However, this forbidden Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge was considered an extremely mysterious and terrifying place within the Ancient Moon Dynasty on the Cangnan Continent.
"Such is the difference in realms," Luo Li sighed inwardly, gazing enviously at the Old Ancestor’s handsome and elegant figure. When would she ever reach the True God Realm? Forget the True God Realm; even reaching the Nirvana Realm would make Luo Li wake up laughing from her dreams.
On the Cangnan Continent, cultivation stages are divided into the Body Refining Realm, Gathering Qi Realm, Mysterious Pill Realm, Origin Sea Realm, Shaping God Realm, Divine Bridge Realm, Nirvana Realm, Destiny Realm, Life and Death Realm, and Eternal Realm.
Luo Li had only just reached the tenth layer of the Origin Sea Realm. There were still six major realms above her. Breakthroughs in each realm were extremely difficult.
In the Ancient Moon Dynasty, Origin Sea Realm cultivators were already quite rare. Cultivators like Luo Li, at the peak of the tenth layer of the Origin Sea Realm, could practically do as they pleased; ordinary people wouldn’t dare provoke them easily.
The Ancient Moon Dynasty also had experts at the Shaping God Realm, though they were relatively scarce. These powerhouses were usually ancestor-level figures from top-tier sects who rarely made public appearances.
As for the Divine Bridge Realm above the Shaping God Realm, Luo Li had never heard of it. Despite the Ancient Moon Dynasty’s vast territory, no Divine Bridge Realm expert had emerged in nearly a thousand years.
Ye Yun led Luo Li to the outskirts of the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge mountain range. He concealed his God Man-like aura, suppressing his cultivation to the Mysterious Pill Realm.
Ye Yun did this simply to keep a low profile. If he showed no cultivation at all, it would be abnormal and arouse more suspicion. It was better to deliberately reveal a little.
Currently, the Sky Lantern sacrifice in Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge was proceeding in full swing. Cultivators from various forces constantly escorted people into the pitch-black valley of Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge.
Luo Li, exceptionally beautiful in her yellow robes and possessing an unparalleled grace, floated like a fairy, attracting the attention of many factions. However, upon seeing Luo Li’s strong cultivation at the peak of the tenth layer of the Origin Sea Realm, no one dared to approach or make any presumptuous moves.
Being admired by the crowd, Luo Li felt a little elated. She was now a great cultivator of the Origin Sea Realm; truly, no one in this territory of the Ancient Moon Dynasty would dare to slight her.
"Let’s go," Ye Yun urged with a smile from the side.
This young girl was still too young. Although sharp, her nature remained in a phase of innocence and romanticism, making it hard for her to control her emotions. But this was simply human nature. Give Luo Li a few more years of training, and by the time she was eighteen or nineteen, she would surely be different.
The two of them slowly walked into the pitch-black valley of Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge.
In this Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge, black Ghost Qi permeated the air. The plants had long since died, stained completely black. Black, ghostly entities constantly flitted among the surrounding trees, their whistling creating various bizarre and eerie noises.
However, no one seemed particularly afraid at this moment. At this time, the ghost creatures in Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge wouldn’t attack humans.
After walking along the valley for a short while, the terrain ahead suddenly changed, and a huge canyon appeared before them.
In the middle of the canyon was a black pool, dark and terrifying, emitting thick, black Ghost Qi. And in the pool, Human Cultivators stood one after another. These cultivators were embedded in the pool like planted scallions, with only their heads visible above the neck. Every one of them had their eyes tightly shut, their expressions pained.
Above their heads, each person supported a dim, reddish candle. The candle was semi-transparent, and wisps of dark red gas constantly floated up from its tip.
From a distance, flickering lights dotted the scene, like countless candles burning.

chapters.title: Chapter 10 Ancestors Want to Light Sky Lanterns
chapters.content:
Chapter 10: Chapter 10 Ancestors Want to Light Sky Lanterns
"So this is the Sky Lantern?"
So this is the Sky Lantern?
Luo Li felt a shudder run down her spine as she gazed from afar.
She suppressed the indescribable fear in her heart and immediately scanned the pool with her eyes.
As expected, among the tens of thousands of people in the pool, Luo Li spotted her Junior Brother, Jun Moxiao.
Anxiety seized Luo Li’s heart, and she wanted to rush over and rescue him.
Ye Yun stopped her. "Which one is your Junior Brother?" he asked softly.
Luo Li pointed in one direction and described the person in detail, allowing Ye Yun to understand immediately.
However, he still held onto Luo Li’s arm, not letting go.
"Ancestor, I’m afraid Junior Brother won’t last much longer. He might die soon," Luo Li said, her voice choked with sobs.
Ye Yun smiled indifferently, unruffled. "Don’t panic. Let the Sky Lantern burn for a while longer. When his Essence Blood is nearly depleted, we can rescue him. If we then use the Ancestral Dragon Blood, its effects will be even better!"
Upon hearing the Ancestor’s words, Luo Li’s eyes widened in surprise.
So the Ancestor had this in mind all along.
Thinking of the potency of the Ancestral Dragon Blood, Luo Li’s perspective immediately shifted.
If my junior brother could absorb the Ancestral Dragon Blood, its effects would surely be better than what I experienced, and his future achievements would definitely not be less than my own. All I had absorbed in the past was just one drop. According to the Ancestor’s words, if Jun Moxiao is burned by the Sky Lantern for a little longer, he might be able to absorb two drops of the Ancestral Dragon Blood!
Luo Li was instantly overjoyed.
The two continued to walk slowly towards the dark pool.
The number of specters gathered in this gorge was exceedingly high. Many of them possessed quite impressive cultivation realms. Origin Sea Realm specters were a dime a dozen, and some even reached the Shaping God Realm.
Luo Li couldn’t help but tremble inwardly.
This Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge truly merits its reputation as the most powerful forbidden place! If these specters were to break out, the entire Ancient Moon Dynasty would face a great catastrophe. Luckily, these specters rarely leave the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge. The great powers constantly providing cultivator offerings for the Sky Lanterns to appease these specters had maintained this fragile peace over the years.
The two arrived at the edge of the pool, silently taking in the sight.
