The spectacle of over ten thousand people in the pool burning like candles was truly grand. Ghost Qi billowed ceaselessly, and many formidable evil ghosts howled nearby.
With such a scene, it truly felt like a glimpse into Hell.
The dark pool was enormous, with quite a few human cultivators standing around it. Among these human cultivators were those of considerable cultivation base, including some at the Tenth Layer Peak of the Origin Sea Realm and even Shapers. These were powerhouses from some of the major local factions.
A little while later, the number of people around the pool increased. People kept bringing new captives to the pool. Then, evil ghosts would pounce, apply bizarre divine skills, and turn the living humans into candles.
Luo Li’s eyes twitched at the sight.
This is too cruel. If I were a Divine Bridge Realm powerhouse, I would want to brandish my sword and slay all the ghosts in the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge! But alas, I don’t have that strength now.
Ye Yun just watched the pool indifferently, his face emotionless. Below the True God, all beings are like ants. Therefore, he did not have an ounce of sympathy. In his eyes, it was merely larger ants bullying smaller ones.
"Hey, little girl," a middle-aged man standing not far from Luo Li called out, glancing coldly at her and Ye Yun. "You’ve been here for quite a while. Why haven’t you made your move?"
"Can’t I just watch?" Luo Li glared irritably at the middle-aged man who had spoken so rudely.
This middle-aged man had an impressive cultivation base, at the Shaping God Realm First Level. Luo Li noticed their attire and guessed they were from the nearby Blood Robe Sect. The Blood Robe Sect was extremely powerful in the Ancient Moon Country; based on power rankings, they could be placed within the top ten.
"’My, what a sharp-tongued little girl. Looking to pick a fight, are we?’" The middle-aged man looked Luo Li up and down, finding the pretty young girl rather unfamiliar. However, seeing such a young girl possess such a powerful cultivation base and wear an Emperor Level Robe made him nervous.
Whose successor is this? From what power?
Until he thoroughly understood his opponent, he would not easily engage in conflict.
The minor conflict between the two attracted the attention of those around them. Everyone then noticed that Luo Li was standing by the pool, unmoving, and had not delivered anyone into it.
As such, everyone grew restless.
"Listen here, girl. This isn’t a place you can just waltz into. If you don’t light a Sky Lantern, I doubt these specters will spare you."
"That’s right! Hurry up and light the Sky Lantern, young lady, or nobody can save you!"
One after another, people condemned her, their expressions fervent.
And those powerful evil ghosts nearby were whirling around in the air, emitting chilling laughter. These evil ghosts had already developed Spirit Wisdom, no different from regular people. However, for some unknown reason, they didn’t speak or interact with humans during the Sky Lantern lighting period.
Luo Li’s face turned cold as she was being accused by everyone. Even though she had the Ancestor with her and wasn’t frightened, the barrage of criticism still unsettled her.
Ye Yun noticed. He calmly patted Luo Li’s shoulder and whispered softly, "If it truly comes to it, I can serve as a Sky Lantern."
"How could that be possible?! Ancestor, you are of noble status! How could you become a Sky Lantern?" Luo Li almost fainted from shock.
The Ancestor is at the True God Realm! If he really became a Sky Lantern to save me, I, Luo Li... I would become the Dragon God Sect’s greatest sinner in all of history!
"It’s fine. Just to quiet them down," Ye Yun said nonchalantly, a light smile playing on his lips.
This place wasn’t just for lighting Sky Lanterns; a kilometer beneath the pool lay an ancient black coffin. There slept a highly ranked evil ghost, perpetually slumbering. Ye Yun’s gaze pierced through eternity; he naturally discerned it was a specter that, despite absorbing the soul essence and blood of tens of thousands of people, still couldn’t awaken.
Since that was the case, he wouldn’t mind giving this little ghost a "boon," allowing it to awaken this time. Then, he could properly settle old scores with it.
Those who dared to offend his Dragon God Sect—Ye Yun would ensure they died understanding exactly why.
Luo Li had no idea about Ye Yun’s thoughts, but seeing the Ancestor so unwavering, she was worried yet dared not defy his intentions.
AWOO! AWOO!
Above their heads, evil ghosts of the Shaping God Realm hovered, baring their fangs and claws, incessantly roaring in a peculiar way. It seemed like a display of force meant to intimidate Luo Li.
Seeing this, the onlookers erupted.

chapters.title: Chapter 11: The Ghost King in the Depths of the Earth
chapters.content:
Chapter 11: Chapter 11: The Ghost King in the Depths of the Earth
"Little girl, light the sky lantern quickly. These ghosts can’t wait any longer," a kindly old man nearby advised.
There were quite a few human cultivators around the pool, including some from the Shaping God Realm, but the number of evil ghouls in Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge was too great. Just the ghouls from the Origin Sea Realm numbered in the hundreds, and those from the Shaping God Realm numbered thirty or forty.
This was a formidable power that the human cultivators present could not hope to match.
"Little girl, quickly push that Mysterious Pill Realm cultivator beside you into the pool," another person urged desperately.
Luo Li bit her lip, her expression complex, looking at her Ancestor without uttering a word.
"
You don’t need to feel guilty.
"
Ye Yun smiled gently, patted Luo Li’s shoulder, and then leaped into the black pool.
He waded hundreds of li into the pool, stopping at its center.
The black water exuded a strange power, as if countless insects were trying to burrow into his body.
Ye Yun did not react. Instead, he retracted his True God’s Super Divine Dragon Breath.
I fear that any leak of this Super Divine Dragon Breath would lead to total destruction here.
The power of the black water could not penetrate his body, nor even his clothes.
AWOOO...
The evil ghouls above the black pool swooped down, cackling as they raised their hands, shooting beams of black light that rained down on Ye Yun.
Ye Yun closed his eyes, his face calm, showing no expression.
In the eyes of the onlookers, the black light vanished as it struck him, appearing to have taken effect.
The next moment, a red candle appeared above Ye Yun’s head and was lit, becoming a sky lantern.
"Ancestor, he should be alright," Luo Li, at the edge of the pool, nervously watched this scene unfold, her heart in her throat.
She kept reassuring herself.
But seeing her Ancestor, though bearing a lit sky lantern, maintain his usual calm expression, she felt slightly relieved.
Everything before her eyes was an illusion conjured by Ye Yun.
A strange energy began to emanate from the sky lantern-like candle above Ye Yun’s head. It floated down, sank into the pool, and drifted towards a mysterious location.
「Several thousand meters underground.」
In a jet-black ancient coffin, a colossal ghoul was sleeping.
The wisp of energy from Ye Yun floated over and was swiftly absorbed by it.
Then it opened its eyes.
It was a pair of blood-red eyes, glinting with a baleful light.
"
The heavens are truly aiding me! This time, I will definitely be able to heal the wounds of my soul!
"
The evil ghoul, which proclaimed itself king, bared its white fangs in a savage grin.
It was the sole Ghost King of Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge.
It was once a powerful being of the Divine Bridge Realm, but due to an injury to its soul, its cultivation level had fallen to the Half-Step Divine Bridge Realm.
For thousands of years, it hid deep beneath Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge, constantly trying to heal its wounds.
The wounds on its soul were inflicted by an enemy.
Ordinary spirit pills and wondrous medicines were completely ineffective.
So, it hid in this remote corner of the Ancient Moon Dynasty to recuperate and evade its enemy’s pursuit.
While deep underground, the Ghost King accidentally discovered a black coffin.
The coffin held the secrets to a strange sky lantern lighting ritual, which had a miraculous effect on the recovery of its soul. Although the process was slow, it saw a glimmer of hope.
Thus, it gathered some of its ghostly descendants, teaching them powerful ghostly Divine Skills and transforming Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge into a forbidden ground.
These ghostly descendants helped it find humans from the Human Race to be burned as sky lanterns.
After all, with an enemy still out there, even in the remote Ancient Moon Dynasty, the Ghost King dared not act too conspicuously.
So, it coerced humans into offering themselves as willing sacrifices, using this as a way to barter for peace in the lands of the Ancient Moon Dynasty.
This was the origin of Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge and the reason for lighting the sky lanterns.
Over thousands of years, countless sky lanterns had been lit. Its soul was slowly recovering and was now just a small step away from complete restoration.
Based on its progress, it would require the lighting of three more sky lanterns.
Unexpectedly, however, among the humans used for this sky lantern ritual, one possessed a special spiritual energy that greatly hastened its recovery.
The Ghost King couldn’t help but silently rejoice.
Once my soul is restored this time, I’ll be able to return to the Half-Step Divine Bridge Realm! With another ten or twenty years of recuperation, I can probably attempt to break through to the Divine Bridge Realm again!
The mere thought of returning to its former Divine Bridge Realm thrilled the Ghost King.
It stared with its blood-red eyes, fixated on the black coffin lid, continuously absorbing the sky lantern energy from the Ghost Water Pool to mend the wounds in its soul.
"
Such incredible speed!
"
Feeling its soul healing at an accelerated pace, the Ghost King was ecstatic.
The wisp of energy emanating from the Ghost Water Pool grew stronger and stronger, causing its soul to recover even faster.
This filled it with delightful surprise.
Normally, lighting a sky lantern took forty-nine days. More than ten days had already passed, leaving less than thirty.
But at this rate, it probably won’t even take a few more days!
Ye Yun, standing in the Ghost Water Pool, gazed distantly at the Ghost King and sneered inwardly.
This Ghost King thinks it’s struck gold, little knowing I’ve orchestrated everything.
Ye Yun was in no rush.
He continued refining the Ancestral Dragon Blood within his body.
His cultivation base was also continuously progressing.
「Two days passed.」
Ye Yun’s cultivation base swiftly broke through to the True God Realm Third Level.
「Five days passed.」
Ye Yun’s cultivation base broke through to the True God Realm Fourth Level!
Feeling the still surging power of the Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood within his body, Ye Yun smiled faintly.
As expected, this Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood will allow me to break through to the True God Realm Tenth Layer. Unfortunately, I’ve already spent enough time in this place. That Ghost King has almost completely recovered and is about to emerge.
Ye Yun used his Divine Sense to glance at Luo Li by the pool’s edge. He noticed her standing there nervously, her small hands clenched into fists.
Her body was somewhat rigid.
"Don’t worry, Luo Li, I’m alright," Ye Yun sent out a Divine Thought.
Luo Li quickly nodded, the heavy weight in her heart finally lifting.
Then, she glanced at her Junior Brother, Jun Moxiao, and noticed his complexion worsening, as if he couldn’t hold on much longer.
She started to worry again.
Her Master had accepted three disciples.
Luo Li was the second.
She also had a Senior Sister named Su Wanyi, who was as beautiful as a celestial fairy.
However, her Senior Sister had gone missing.
Her fate—whether she was alive or dead—was unknown, and Luo Li had no idea of her whereabouts.
But one thing is certain, Senior Sister should not have fallen into the hands of our enemies.
"Little girl, which Sect do you belong to?"
Perhaps out of sheer boredom from the long wait, a white-haired old man at the Shaping God Realm struck up a conversation with Luo Li.

chapters.title: Chapter 12: The Birth of the Ghost King
chapters.content:
Chapter 12: Chapter 12: The Birth of the Ghost King
"I am from the Dragon God Sect."
Luo Li tilted her chin slightly, her youthful face revealing a touch of pride.
The white-haired old man paused, blinked, and searched his memory, but he couldn’t recall ever hearing of a Dragon God Sect.
Could it be a power from the outside?
he wondered.
Beside the old man stood a young cultivator at the fifth level of the Origin Sea Realm. Hearing Luo Li’s words, he couldn’t help but scoff. "Dragon God Sect? Is that a sect from the Ancient Moon Dynasty? How come I’ve never heard of it?"
Luo Li gave him an indifferent glance and stated calmly, "My Dragon God Sect is merely a minor sect, incomparable to your prestigious Wuji God Sword Sect."
The young man chuckled. "Good that you know your place. Our Wuji God Sword Sect is one of the top ten sects in the Ancient Moon Dynasty, currently ranking among the top five in strength."
Seeing his disciple speak so unguardedly, the old man turned and glared fiercely at him.
This stunningly beautiful young girl is clearly from an extraordinary background. Never mind anything else, the Emperor-Level Robe she wears alone is beyond the means of an ordinary sect. Even the Sect Leader of our Wuji God Sword Sect doesn’t possess an Emperor-Level Robe.
Thus, the old man dared not underestimate the young girl before him.
"Young lady, did you come here alone?" the old man asked, his face wreathed in smiles.
Luo Li nodded but said nothing.
At that moment, a peculiar glint appeared in the eyes of almost everyone present. The more experienced experts had already fixed their gazes on the Emperor-Level Robe Luo Li wore. Now that the old man’s probing words had seemingly revealed the girl’s solitary status, they felt fewer reservations. They could directly attempt to seize the Emperor-Level Robe from her. Besides, they could simply blame the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge afterward. Surely, no one would be so foolish as to challenge the Ridge over it.
However, with over a dozen major powers present, any attempt to seize the robe would undoubtedly lead to a brutal struggle.
The old man, his face a mask of benign innocence, stared at Luo Li and said with a kindly smile, "Young lady, that’s an Emperor-Level Robe you’re wearing, isn’t it?"
Luo Li shot the old man a cold glance, understanding his intentions perfectly. Having struggled and survived in the Jianghu for so many years, Luo Li naturally understood the meaning hidden in their gazes. Wealth incites avarice. No one could feign disinterest in such an Emperor-Level treasure.
"What? Are you planning to rob me of my Emperor-Level Robe?" A chill flashed in Luo Li’s eyes as she drew her Supreme Golden Dragon Sword, its tip pointed at the old man.
Although the old man was a powerful cultivator at the Shaping God Realm, Luo Li was no pushover. She possessed the Eternal Level Dragon God Sect’s swordsmanship, the God-level Supreme Golden Dragon Sword, and her Nine Changes of the God Dragon, an incredibly unpredictable movement technique. It was certainly possible for her to contend with this Shaping God Realm expert.
Even if I can’t defeat him, isn’t Ancestor nearby?
Luo Li wasn’t worried at all.
In the eyes of her Ancestor, a True God Realm master, these people are no more than ants. He could probably annihilate them all with a single breath.
Over a dozen major powers slowly closed in on Luo Li. A battle seemed on the verge of erupting.
「Just at this moment」
A sound like crashing waves suddenly came from within the ghost carriage. Then, a deep RUMBLING sound emerged from the depths of the pool. The powerful evil ghosts positioned around the pool roared in excitement.
What happened?
At that moment, everyone stopped, their expressions turning grave as they stared at the pool. The ritual of the Sky Lanterns had continued for millennia without such an astonishing change.
A vortex slowly began to form within the ghost carriage. The humans around, who were being used as Sky Lanterns, were swept to the edge of the pool by the vortex. Then, a sinister cackle echoed from the depths of the vortex.
Everyone held their breath, watching the scene with nervous intensity. The expressions of some Shaping God Realm experts, in particular, shifted subtly. They were surprised to sense an indescribably powerful aura emanating from the vortex.
Ye Yun, standing beside the ghost carriage, opened his eyes and silently observed the vortex.
The Ghost King, born from the earth’s depths, its soul now fully restored, is preparing to emerge.
Ye Yun had been waiting for this moment.
His meticulous planning had one simple goal: to ensure this little imp died knowing exactly why. Otherwise, if he simply obliterated it and it died in ignorance, there would be no meaning to it. He had signed in for one hundred thousand years in that mysterious Dark Space. What he feared most now was loneliness. If even killing could be done with flair, that would be right up his alley.
A terrifying aura suddenly surged from the vortex. The moment this aura appeared, the howling evil ghosts nearby instantly prostrated themselves, their faces alight with fanatical devotion. The nearby Shaping God Realm experts’ expressions changed drastically. They retreated repeatedly, staring at the vortex in utter shock.
"What... What cultivation base is this?" a middle-aged man asked, his voice trembling.
"It’s the Divine Bridge Realm," the white-haired old man stated, his expression grim.
What? A Divine Bridge Realm expert!
Hearing the old man’s words, everyone present was dumbfounded. In the next moment, a chill ran down their spines. The aura was clearly not human; instead, it was sinister and palpably thick with the energy of evil ghosts.
This was a powerful Ghost King. A Ghost King of the Divine Bridge Realm.
At this realization, everyone’s face turned ashen, and they prepared to turn and flee.
A black ghostly mist suddenly surged from the massive vortex. In mid-air, it writhed and coalesced, transforming into a colossal black figure. It stood a good fifty to sixty feet tall, wreathed in black mist. This supreme Ghost King had blood-red eyes, a green face, and protruding fangs, giving it an incredibly ferocious appearance.
"HAHAHA... I, your King, have finally recovered!" After millennia, seeing the light of day once more, this Ghost King couldn’t help but throw its head back and laugh.
"Run!" All around, the human cultivators shrieked in terror, scattering like frightened birds and beasts.
A voice like rolling thunder echoed throughout the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge: "I, your King, have reemerged! Should you not offer your congratulations?"
Immediately, some people froze, turned, and knelt, trembling in fear.
"Congratulations, Ghost King!"
"All hail the Ghost King!"
One by one, human cultivators knelt, stammering out congratulations from hearts gripped by terror. Some other human cultivators, however, were already fleeing rapidly.
The Ghost King, enraged by this sight, stretched out a massive hand and shot out rays of black light. The black light whizzed through the air, ensnaring the fleeing human cultivators and dragging them back. The Ghost King seized these humans and tossed them into its mouth.
CRUNCH! CRUNCH!
It crushed them and swallowed them whole.
Seeing the Ghost King so brutally devour their fellow humans, the remaining cultivators were so terrified they nearly fainted. A Divine Bridge Realm expert was too powerful! They were simply no match for such a being.
After devouring dozens of human cultivators, the Ghost King wiped its bloodstained mouth and roared with laughter. "It’s been too long since I’ve enjoyed myself this much!"
Just as its laughter died down, a gentle voice suddenly resonated throughout the space.
"Ghosts are merely ghosts—the lowest form of existence. They can never grace the grand stage!"

chapters.title: Chapter 13 The Terror of the True God, the Annihilation of Ten Thousand Ghosts
chapters.content:
Chapter 13: Chapter 13 The Terror of the True God, the Annihilation of Ten Thousand Ghosts
The Ghost King was in high spirits.
Upon hearing this piercing sound, he couldn’t help but fly into a rage.
His gaze swept around fiercely, but he couldn’t find the source of the sound.
"Who dares to slander me so boldly?" the Ghost King roared furiously, his aura becoming even more powerful.
At this point, his gaze abruptly halted, settling on a small human woman beside the pool.
Nearly all the Human cultivators had kneeled. Only this human woman by the pool still stood ramrod straight, like a sword thrust into the ground.
"You, a mere Human cultivator at the Origin Sea Realm, why do you not kneel upon seeing me, this King?" the Ghost King thundered. Furious, he swung his palm at Luo Li.
"I am the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect! I kneel to no one but our ancestors and the heavens themselves!" she declared, her voice firm and resolute.
Luo Li’s pretty face was icy, her features as if carved by a knife.
Her body suddenly transformed into nine illusory dragons, darting in all directions, making it momentarily impossible to discern her true body.
Having reached the tenth level of the Origin Sea Realm, Luo Li executed the Nine Changes of the God Dragon movement technique with even greater ease.
WHOOSH!
A giant ghost hand struck down, but it missed.
"What kind of movement technique is this?" the Ghost King muttered, greatly surprised that his attack had missed.
This little girl certainly has some skill. No wonder she dares to be so arrogant...
The Ghost King did not continue his attack. He still remembered the man’s taunting voice and suddenly felt uneasy.
Something is amiss; it seems a mysterious power is hiding in the shadows.
"Stop looking, little ghost," Ye Yun said with a light laugh, his body slowly rising from the pool.
Luo Li’s figure flickered, landing beside Ye Yun.
"Luo Li, your movement technique isn’t bad. It has some of my flair from back in the day," Ye Yun said with a smile, gently patting Luo Li.
He had initially wanted to intervene.
However, seeing Luo Li, like a newborn calf unafraid of a tiger, determined to escape the Ghost King—a Half-Step Divine Bridge Mirror expert—Ye Yun became curious to see if she could succeed.
The result was a pleasant surprise.
Luo Li had successfully escaped!
Although the Ghost King had somewhat underestimated her, it was still something to be proud of for a cultivator at the tenth level of the Origin Sea Realm to escape from a Half-Step Divine Bridge Mirror expert.
"Huh?" The Ghost King followed the voice and spotted Ye Yun.
He was slightly taken aback.
This young man before him is only at the Mysterious Pill Realm. To have soaked in the pool for so long and seemingly suffered no injuries, still appearing full of vigor. Just who is this person?
The Ghost King was somewhat puzzled.
He then carefully sensed the other party’s Super Divine Dragon Breath again and found it was still at the Mysterious Pill Realm; he relaxed slightly.
"Your tone is quite arrogant, Your Excellency!" the Ghost King said coldly.
Then, with a wave of his large hand, a dozen Origin Sea Realm evil ghosts immediately roared and charged toward Ye Yun.
Luo Li was about to draw her sword to protect the Patriarch.
But before she could even raise her sword, she noticed that these evil ghosts had all frozen in mid-air.
SNAP!
Ye Yun snapped his fingers. The evil ghosts instantly died, disintegrating into wisps of blue smoke as they fell from the sky.
"What a powerful Divine Skill!"
Seeing this, the Ghost King’s pupils contracted sharply, and he suddenly felt a terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath descend upon him.
He had misjudged! This young man was definitely not at the Mysterious Pill Realm! Perhaps he was a peerless figure even stronger than himself.
"
We’re finally saved!
"
The Human cultivators kneeling nearby each exhaled deeply, their faces reflecting the relief of having survived a disaster.
They hadn’t expected the young man in the pool to be such a peerless master.
This gave them hope for survival.
The Ghost King stared intently at Ye Yun. Suddenly, the thought of retreat sprouted in his mind. He transformed into a cloud of ghostly mist and fled, whistling through the air.
"Come back," Ye Yun uttered softly.
The cloud of black mist, as if summoned, immediately flew back.
"What? How is this possible?" a surprised cry from the Ghost King echoed from within the black mist.
He had used all his strength to escape just moments before, not expecting to be yanked back by an immense force.
This terrified him so much his liver and gallbladder felt like they would split, his very soul threatening to scatter.
Could this be... a great power of the Nirvana Realm or the Heaven Mandate Mirror? Otherwise, how could he possess such formidable strength, rendering me utterly incapable of resistance! Even if I recovered to my peak—the Divine Bridge Realm—I would still be no match for this young man before me!
Witnessing the Patriarch’s power to command with a word, Luo Li sheathed the Supreme Golden Dragon Sword and sighed in admiration.
The Patriarch is truly powerful! A True God, truly terrifying! Absolutely terrifying!
Ye Yun looked at the constantly writhing cloud of black mist, his brow furrowed slightly. He said indifferently, "Little ghost, the reason I’ve let you live until now is so you can die understanding why."
"Esteemed sir, how have I, this lowly one, offended you that you wish to exterminate me?" the Ghost King asked in alarm.
He was completely unaware of when he might have offended this great personage before him.
Ye Yun gave a cold smile.
"There is a disciple from My Divine Dragon Sect in that pool. You used him as a human candle to restore your injuries. For that alone, dying ten thousand times would not be excessive for you!"
"
So that’s what this is about,
" the Ghost King thought. He couldn’t help but beat his chest and stamp his feet in frustration, wishing he could kill those Human cultivators outside.
Such a minor figure had actually led to his demise. He truly couldn’t resign himself to this.
Ye Yun continued to sneer.
"Given your turtle-speed recovery, it would have been impossible to recuperate without using a human candle two or three times. So, I injected some recovery Spiritual Power into you beforehand, allowing you to awaken earlier this time."
Hearing Ye Yun’s words, the Ghost King’s eyes filled with terror, as if he had been plunged into an icy abyss.
So, the peculiar Spiritual Power he had absorbed within the coffin had actually been deliberately channeled to him by this great personage.
Now, he was doomed. But on the verge of death, he still wanted to make one last gamble.
"Kill him for me!" the Ghost King shrieked, ordering all the evil ghosts under his command to attack.
These evil ghosts were mostly under his control. Hearing his command, they shrieked and surged forward like a black cloud, blanketing the entire canyon.
He then took advantage of the chaos to flee into the distance.
"Child’s play," Ye Yun scoffed, blowing out a breath gently.
This breath, like a mystical flame, carried intense heat. It transformed into a vast, sky-covering flaming net, enveloping all the evil ghosts descending into the canyon.
"AH..."
Accompanied by blood-curdling screams and SIZZLING sounds, these thoroughly wicked evil ghosts instantly turned into blue smoke and dispersed.
Watching the Ghost King flee into the distance, Ye Yun gave a cold smile and blew another puff of clear air.
This puff of clear air instantly descended upon the cloud of black mist. Then, a miserable shriek was heard from within.
The entire cloud of black mist also transformed into blue smoke and disappeared.
Merely by blowing two puffs of clear air, all the evil ghosts of Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge vanished.
"This..."
Seeing this scene, all the surrounding Human cultivators were utterly dumbfounded, standing frozen like statues, their minds reeling in shock.

chapters.title: Chapter 14: Junior Brother Jun Moxiao
chapters.content:
Chapter 14: Chapter 14: Junior Brother Jun Moxiao
"Who exactly is this young man?"
"What is his cultivation base? With just two breaths, he exterminated all the ghosts in the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge. Isn’t that too unbelievable?"
The human cultivators all around stood up one by one, looking at Ye Yun, their eyes revealing admiration and burning with enormous fanaticism. They had never heard of such a powerful individual before.
Just now, a Ghost King of the Divine Bridge Realm had suddenly appeared in the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge, scaring them half to death; they might have even been devoured by that Ghost King. But unexpectedly, having narrowly escaped death, a benefactor descended from the heavens, and they were saved by this influential figure.
"Thank you for your assistance!"
Countless human cultivators cupped their fists, their expressions filled with gratitude.
Ye Yun surveyed his surroundings, his gaze remaining as indifferent as ever.
Seeing this influential figure so indifferent and seemingly disdainful, the cultivators from the various surrounding powers suddenly felt disgraced, and the atmosphere grew awkward.
"Let’s go..." The crowd exchanged glances and turned to leave the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge.
Just then, a frigid voice suddenly echoed throughout the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge.
"Did I permit you to leave?"
Hearing this familiar voice, everyone froze. They turned around, staring dumbfounded at the influential figure.
"Luo Li, were they trying to steal your Emperor Level Robe just now?" Ye Yun’s eyes narrowed slightly as he asked softly.
Seeing the Ancestor ask this, Luo Li’s delicate body trembled slightly. She nodded decisively and said, "Yes, Ancestor. These people all wanted to steal the Emperor Level Robe from me."
"Very well." Ye Yun gazed at the surrounding crowd, his eyes terrifying, and said indifferently, "All of you can die now."
Hearing this influential figure suddenly utter such inhumane words, everyone immediately erupted.
"Senior, you are, after all, a Wushang expert of our Human Race! Why resort to fratricide?"
"Indeed, Senior! You mustn’t do this! You are a hero in our hearts."
"Senior, you annihilated the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge with just two breaths! Such an achievement deserves to be recorded in the annals of the Ancient Moon Dynasty! We all take pride in you!"
"Senior, you were joking just now, weren’t you? Surely you wouldn’t actually kill us?"
At this moment, the expressions of the surrounding human cultivators varied greatly. Some couldn’t believe it, some were desperately flattering him, while others remained silent, their eyes glinting as they seemingly calculated their escape routes.
Ye Yun’s gaze was aloof and frigid. He looked at the people around him, his face devoid of emotion.
"Anyone who dares to bully someone from my Dragon God Sect—for any reason—will meet only one fate: death!"
After speaking, Ye Yun gently exhaled a breath of pure energy. This breath shot out in all directions.
Seeing Ye Yun once again exhale that terrifying breath of pure energy, everyone was scared witless. They immediately unleashed their potent Divine Skills and scattered, fleeing for their lives. However, their collective strength was even less than that of the evil ghosts of the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge. How could they possibly escape?
Amidst piercing screams, thousands of human cultivators were reduced to wisps of green smoke.
Witnessing this shocking scene, Luo Li’s pupils dilated in extreme shock.
The Ancestor is truly ruthless!
she thought with excitement.
In Luo Li’s mind, she would have, at most, taught these people a harsh lesson, not gone to the extent of exterminating them. But the Ancestor had directly killed thousands. Such decisiveness was utterly astounding!
Little did Luo Li know that in the eyes of a god, all life was like ants.
Ye Yun looked at Luo Li, patted her shoulder, and said with a smile, "There’s no need to sympathize with them."
"Oh..." Luo Li murmured, her face still somewhat pale.
Ye Yun chuckled. "Even if they die, a new crop of ’leeks’ will sprout eventually. No need to worry."
"Alright." Although Luo Li found the Ancestor’s words rather bizarre, she still nodded obediently.
"There, it’s quiet now." Ye Yun clapped his hands and chuckled.
Then, his brow furrowed slightly as he noticed some human cultivators in the pool, barely clinging to life. These individuals had been used as ’human lanterns’ for more than ten days and were on the verge of expiring.
"Might as well send you on your way." Ye Yun exhaled, and in an instant, more than ten thousand people vanished, leaving only Luo Li’s Junior Brother, Jun Moxiao.
With a wave of Ye Yun’s hand, Jun Moxiao flew out of the pool and landed on the ground nearby.
"Junior Brother!" Luo Li’s heart clenched, and she hurried over.
Ye Yun’s figure flashed, and he too arrived beside Jun Moxiao. Placing a hand on Luo Li to stop her, he said softly, "This pool water contains some kind of toxin. Don’t touch it for now."
As Ye Yun spoke, he searched his storage space, produced a small vial, and poured out a drop of green liquid. When this drop landed on Jun Moxiao, all the poisonous water contaminating his body vanished, much to Luo Li’s amazement.
Ye Yun didn’t explain further. He put the vial away and infused a trace of Mana into Jun Moxiao’s body.
Jun Moxiao then regained consciousness. He opened his eyes, and his vision gradually cleared, focusing on the exquisite face of his Senior Sister before him.
"Senior Sister, have we met in Hell?" Jun Moxiao asked with a dazed, bitter smile.
The Dragon God Sect had few Successors, creating a generational gap. After their Master died, the three Disciples’ situation became even more precarious. First, their Eldest Senior Sister disappeared while covering their escape, her fate unknown. Then, as fierce pursuers closed in, he lured them away to allow Senior Sister Luo Li to escape. Although his Senior Sister had escaped then, Jun Moxiao knew she would face even greater hardship alone. Against those pursuers, she likely wouldn’t evade them for long. He never imagined that after all this time, his Senior Sister had also perished and that they would meet in Hell...
"What are you talking about, Junior Brother? How could we be dead?" Luo Li chided Jun Moxiao good-naturedly, then laughed and lightly gestured towards the white-robed youth beside her. "Junior Brother, quickly pay your respects to the Ancestor," Luo Li urged.
Ancestor?
Jun Moxiao was stunned. He looked incredulously at the white-robed youth beside them.
This handsome youth in jade-white robes looked only a few years older than him. How could he be the Ancestor?
"Senior Sister, you... you haven’t made a mistake, have you?" Jun Moxiao questioned weakly.
"How could I be mistaken? Let me tell you the truth, Junior Brother: this is the greatest Ancestor in the history of our Dragon God Sect! I bet... you can’t guess who, right?" A blush crept onto Luo Li’s small face, her chin tilting up slightly, an expression of pride gracing her features.
This Ancestor, Ye Yun, was from the Dragon God Sect’s most prosperous era. He elevated the Dragon God Sect to the status of an Eternal Sect. It can be said his contribution to the Sect was the greatest.
Jun Moxiao closed his eyes and thought for a long moment, not speaking. After a moment, he opened his eyes and asked tentatively, "Could he be... the thirteenth Sect Master of our Dragon God Sect?"
"Yes, Junior Brother! You truly are clever!" Luo Li clapped her hands happily. Her Junior Brother was usually very astute; the two of them were often evenly matched.
"How is that possible? Senior Sister, you must be teasing me!" Jun Moxiao said with a bitter smile, shaking his head repeatedly.
Ancestor, my foot! The thirteenth Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect has been dead for a full hundred thousand years, hasn’t he?!

chapters.title: Chapter 15: The Younger Disciple is Stunned
chapters.content:
Chapter 15: Chapter 15: The Younger Disciple is Stunned
Ye Yun stood by, hands clasped behind his back, a pleased smile playing across his face as he watched the exchange between the senior sister and junior brother. Jun Moxiao’s reaction was actually quite normal. After all, he, the 13th Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, was from a time far too distant—a full one hundred thousand years had passed. How could an ordinary cultivator live for such an extended period? Even if they reached the True God Realm, they could not possibly live for one hundred thousand years.
Seeing Jun Moxiao’s utter disbelief, Luo Li stamped her foot, puffed her cheeks, and said, "Junior Brother, when have I ever lied to you?" At this, Luo Li abruptly raised the Clan Leader’s Token, her expression sacred as she swore an oath upon it. "I, Luo Li, as the 298th Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, swear that every word I have just spoken is true. If there is any falsehood, may the heavens strike me with five thunderbolts!"
"Senior Sister, you mustn’t! You can’t make such oaths lightly!" A sudden surge of strength coursed through Jun Moxiao. Propping himself up with his hands, he sat up and shouted in alarm.
Luo Li looked solemnly at Jun Moxiao and asked, "Do you believe me now?"
"Senior Sister, I believe you! I believe you!" Jun Moxiao nodded repeatedly. He looked up at Ye Yun, the shock in his eyes intensifying.
This Old Ancestor died one hundred thousand years ago... How did he come back to life? According to the Sect’s records, this Old Ancestor’s cultivation base was exceptionally high, having reached the pinnacle of the Cangnan Continent. But even at that pinnacle, it’s impossible to live for one hundred thousand years, right?
Luo Li chuckled softly beside him. "Junior Brother, you don’t need to worry about how the Old Ancestor survived until now. You just need to know that he is the Thirteenth Generation Ancestor of our Dragon God Sect."
"Alright, Senior Sister." Jun Moxiao nodded repeatedly. He struggled to his knees and kowtowed respectfully to Ye Yun. "Greetings, Old Ancestor."
Seeing Jun Moxiao finally accept his identity, Ye Yun felt a sense of relief. With a gentle wave of his hand, he released a stream of Mana, helping Jun Moxiao to his feet. "You are weak right now; let’s dispense with the formalities."
Ye Yun smiled faintly and took out a small vial. Seeing this small vial, Luo Li’s eyes lit up. She said excitedly, "Junior Brother! Your suffering is finally over! You’re about to embark on a glorious path!"
Jun Moxiao looked at Luo Li, puzzled.
Luo Li placed her hands behind her back, puffed out her chest proudly, and said to Jun Moxiao with a smile, "Junior Brother, take a look—what’s my current cultivation base?"
Despite his severe injuries, Jun Moxiao still had a little Mana left. After sensing for a moment, his eyes widened in shock, and he exclaimed, "Senior Sister, how did you reach the Tenth Layer Peak of the Origin Sea Realm?!"
"HAHA... I knew you’d be this astonished to see me! Let me tell you, it’s because the Old Ancestor used Ancestral Dragon Blood to perform a blood exchange for me that my cultivation base advanced by leaps and bounds!" Luo Li couldn’t help but burst into hearty laughter, showing none of her usual ladylike demeanor.
Ancestral Dragon Blood?
Upon hearing these words, Jun Moxiao’s mind reeled, his vision blackened, and he fainted.
"Hey, Junior Brother, why did you suddenly faint?" Seeing Jun Moxiao fall down stiffly, Luo Li rushed over and supported him.
Ye Yun smiled faintly at this. With a gentle wave of his hand, Jun Moxiao leisurely awoke.
"Old Ancestor, do you really possess Ancestral Dragon Blood?" Jun Moxiao stared at Ye Yun, his face a mask of shock and utter disbelief. As a Successor of the Dragon God Sect, he was naturally extremely sensitive to Divine Dragon Essence Blood. This was especially true for Ancestral Dragon Blood, which was deeply ingrained in their heritage.
"Mm." Seeing Jun Moxiao’s shocked expression, Ye Yun made a slight movement with his hand, and a small vial instantly appeared.
Upon seeing this familiar small vial, Luo Li’s face immediately bloomed into a wide smile. "Junior Brother, what the Old Ancestor has is Ancestral Dragon Blood, you know!"
Jun Moxiao stared at the small vial, licked his lips, and said with difficulty, "This vial of Ancestral Dragon Blood... there must be at least a hundred drops, right?"
"Are you kidding, Junior Brother? You think there are a hundred drops in there?" Luo Li widened her eyes, staring fixedly at her Junior Brother.
"Did I say something wrong?" Jun Moxiao also looked bewildered. He looked at Luo Li, somewhat unconfidently, and asked, "Senior Sister, are there only a few dozen drops then?"
"I really feel like whacking your head with my Sword." Annoyed, Luo Li immediately raised her Sword as if to bring it down on Jun Moxiao’s head, but she stopped it mid-air, lowered her hand, and then giggled. "Junior Brother, let me tell you the truth. Don’t be fooled by its small size; this vial actually contains its own separate space, and there’s plenty of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood inside!" Luo Li said, puffed up with pride.
"A lot?" Jun Moxiao blinked, staring intently at the small vial in Ye Yun’s hand, then asked tentatively, "Could there be... around a thousand drops?"
Seeing Jun Moxiao’s spineless display, Luo Li couldn’t help but stomp her foot and burst out laughing, "A thousand drops? How could that be enough? Let me tell you the truth, Junior Brother, there’s a whole basinful in here—at least over one hundred thousand drops!"
"What? Over one hundred thousand drops?!" Jun Moxiao was dumbfounded. His vision went black, and he fainted again.
"Sigh, Junior Brother, why did you faint again?" Luo Li looked utterly exasperated with him, like one lamenting that iron could not become steel. She stomped her foot, bit her lip, feeling completely helpless.
"Your Junior Brother is younger than you and hasn’t experienced much. He isn’t resilient enough for something like this," Ye Yun remarked with a smile from the side. With a gentle flick of his finger, he injected a wisp of Mana.
Jun Moxiao slowly opened his eyes and sat up again.
Ye Yun opened the vial, took out two drops of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood, and with a light flick of his finger, sent them flying before Jun Moxiao. Feeling the unique Super Divine Dragon Breath of the Ancestral Dragon Blood, Jun Moxiao felt as if all the blood in his body was boiling, as if there was a powerful call from deep within him. Although he also possessed the Dragon God Bloodline, it was extremely faint. Nevertheless, he could still feel a subtle resonance with this Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood.
At this moment, Ye Yun said with a smile, "In Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge, you underwent the Sky Lantern ordeal. While it severely damaged your body, it inadvertently aided you. You should be able to successfully absorb these two drops of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood."
"Old Ancestor, thank you so much!" Upon hearing Ye Yun’s words, tears suddenly streamed down Jun Moxiao’s face. The inhuman torment he had suffered in Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge seemed to be repaid in this instant. Moreover, the reward was beyond imagination—truly astounding.
Ye Yun smiled faintly.
Luo Li urged from the side, "Junior Brother, opportunity knocks but once. Quickly swallow these two drops of Ancestral Dragon Blood."
"Okay, Senior Sister," Jun Moxiao agreed. He opened his mouth, and the two drops of Ancestral Dragon Blood flew into him.
The potent Ancestral Dragon Blood transformed into countless streams of pure energy, surging throughout his body. At this moment, Jun Moxiao felt an indescribable, surging power within his body. He abruptly slapped both hands on the ground and immediately sat cross-legged. Following the unique mental cultivation technique of the Dragon God Sect, he began to absorb the Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood.

chapters.title: Chapter 16: Fish Leaping over the Dragon Gate, Shaping God Realm Level 4
chapters.content:
Chapter 16: Chapter 16: Fish Leaping over the Dragon Gate, Shaping God Realm Level 4
As the Ancestral Dragon Blood began to be refined, Jun Moxiao’s Super Divine Dragon Breath skyrocketed.
Gathering Qi Realm, Sixth Layer...
Gathering Qi Realm, Seventh Layer...
Gathering Qi Realm, Eighth Layer...
Gathering Qi Realm, Tenth Layer!
Mysterious Pill Realm!
Mysterious Pill Realm, First Layer...
Mysterious Pill Realm, Second Layer...
...
Origin Sea Realm!
Origin Sea Realm, First Layer...
Origin Sea Realm, Second Layer...
Origin Sea Realm, Third Layer...
...
During the process of refining the Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood, Jun Moxiao’s cultivation base was rapidly increasing.
Luo Li clenched her fists tightly, nervously watching her Junior Brother while softly muttering words only she could hear.
"Junior Brother, you must hang in there. Strive to break through the Origin Sea Realm in one go and reach the Shaping God Realm."
With his hands behind his back, Ye Yun looked at this brother and sister pair with a smile on his face, feeling very comforted in his heart.
After being baptized with the Ancestral Dragon Blood, both of them would become great cultivators of the Ancient Moon Dynasty in one fell swoop. If nothing unexpected happens, Jun Moxiao will certainly be able to break through to the Shaping God Realm. The next step depends on his good fortune. If it is good, he might be able to break through to the Fifth Layer of the Shaping God Realm. This is an even bigger breakthrough than Luo Li’s. Objectively speaking, Jun Moxiao’s talent is not necessarily better than Luo Li’s. Ye Yun had assessed both their talents before. They were on par, but Luo Li was more mature in terms of intellect, handled matters smoothly, and was far better than the inexperienced Jun Moxiao.
...
Jun Moxiao sat with his eyes closed, his face flushed, breathing heavily, as two streams of red gas shuttled back and forth through his nostrils.
His Super Divine Dragon Breath was still rising rapidly.
Origin Sea Realm, Eighth Layer.
Origin Sea Realm, Ninth Layer.
Origin Sea Realm, Tenth Layer.
...
BOOM!
A loud noise suddenly came from within Jun Moxiao’s body. He shuddered slightly, and his cultivation base unexpectedly broke through to the Shaping God Realm.
"Great! Our Junior Brother is the first to break through to the Shaping God Realm! This is truly a joyous occasion for our Dragon God Sect!"
Luo Li was incredibly excited, but she didn’t dare to shout out loud, so she could only keep clenching her fists.
Jun Moxiao’s Super Divine Dragon Breath was still increasing rapidly.
In the end, he stopped at the Fourth Level of the Shaping God Realm.
It was one small level lower than what Ye Yun had expected.
Ye Yun was rather satisfied.
At this moment, Jun Moxiao opened his eyes. His eyes sparkled with brilliant light, and his Super Divine Dragon Breath was strong, giving people an incredibly powerful feeling.
He immediately knelt on the ground and kowtowed three times to Ye Yun respectfully.
"Thank you, Ancestor, for your grace."
"Stand up now."
Ye Yun smiled slightly. A wave of mana swept out and lifted Jun Moxiao up.
"Junior Brother, your hardships are finally over. You have now become a powerful cultivator of the Shaping God Realm."
Luo Li walked over joyfully, patted Jun Moxiao’s shoulder, displaying a demeanor fitting for a Sect Master.
Jun Moxiao gave a shy smile.
"Senior Sister, all of this is thanks to the Ancestor’s help."
"Indeed!"
Luo Li was touched. She turned to look at Ye Yun, her gaze filled with gratitude.
Ye Yun pretended not to see, smiling as he asked, "Jun Moxiao, how are your skills with the Dragon God Sword Technique?"
Hearing the Ancestor ask this, Jun Moxiao’s young face turned red instantly.
"Reporting to the Ancestor, the Dragon God Sword Technique... I haven’t learned it very well."
"So, have you all mastered the movement technique of the Nine Changes of the God Dragon to the highest level?"
Ye Yun laughed.
Jun Moxiao nodded, his face blushing.
All three of them—he and his sisters—had trained the movement technique of the Nine Changes of the God Dragon to the extreme of the Gathering Qi Realm.
Otherwise, it would have been impossible for them to escape from those people in the Mysterious Pill Realm and Origin Sea Realm.
"You’ve all had quite a tough few years!"
Ye Yun sighed and patted Jun Moxiao’s shoulder.
With a light touch of his wrist, he immediately took out a precious sword.
"I’ll give this sword to you."
Luo Li sensed the Super Divine Dragon Breath of the sword and immediately said excitedly, "Junior Brother, hurry up and thank the Ancestor! This is an Emperor Level Divine Sword."
What? An Emperor Level Divine Sword?
Jun Moxiao was stunned on the spot.
He quickly sensed the Super Divine Dragon Breath of the sword. His mouth fell open, his eyes bulged, and he stood there frozen like a statue.
An Emperor Level Divine Sword! How did the Ancestor come to possess such a badass weapon?
At that moment, Luo Li picked up her Supreme Golden Dragon Sword, proudly saying, "Junior Brother, look, the Ancestor also gave me one, and it’s better than yours."
Jun Moxiao sensed Luo Li’s sword, couldn’t help but curl his lips, and said, "It’s not as good as mine. Yours is only Heaven Level."
Luo Li, somewhat annoyed, pouted and said:
"That’s because I asked the Ancestor to seal my sword, fearing it would cause misunderstandings. As my cultivation improves, the seals on this sword will be gradually undone. How about this: you also ask the Ancestor to seal your sword, just like mine. What do you think?"
After hearing Luo Li’s words, Jun Moxiao deeply agreed and quickly looked at Ye Yun, smiling as he said, "Ancestor, please seal this sword for me too."
"You also like keeping a low profile?"
Ye Yun asked with a smile.
"Ancestor, we’ve been following our master on the run since we were young and have grown accustomed to being low-key. So, it would be better for this sword to be more ordinary," Jun Moxiao said, his face reddening.
"Alright then."
Ye Yun nodded.
He could understand the mental state of these two siblings.
Both were fugitives who preferred to keep a low profile, believing it would help them live longer.
Ye Yun lightly tapped the sword with his finger, and its quality immediately dropped to Heaven Level.
"By the way, Ancestor, what is the name of Junior Brother’s sword?" Luo Li, direct and quick-spoken, asked from the side.
"This sword is called the Chaos Element Unlimited Sword," Ye Yun said softly.
"Good name! The name alone sounds extremely domineering! Haha, but Junior Brother, your weapon is still one level weaker than mine!" Luo Li said excitedly.
"Senior Sister, Emperor Level is already very good; I can’t even imagine God Level. Besides, you’re the new Sect Master of our Dragon God Sect. It’s only natural that my sword is a bit inferior to yours," Jun Moxiao said with a nonchalant laugh.
He lovingly caressed the Chaos Element Unlimited Sword, his heart filled with boundless surprise.
When had he, once a young cultivator at the Gathering Qi Realm, ever imagined owning an Emperor Level treasure sword? Now that his wish had come true, he could almost laugh out loud in his dreams. Everything had changed so fast. After experiencing the Ghost Ridge Heavenly Lamp and meeting the Ancestor, his cultivation base was upgraded to the Fourth Level of the Shaping God Realm. He had also obtained an Emperor Level Chaos Element Unlimited Sword. It all felt like a dream.
"Kid!" Ye Yun laughed from the side, then took out a black robe and threw it to Jun Moxiao.
"Your clothes are damaged. Why not change into this one?"
Jun Moxiao took the black robe. When he sensed the Super Divine Dragon Breath on it, his heart trembled, and he almost dropped the robe.
It was an Emperor Level robe! How could the Ancestor’s reserves be so profound? To think he casually gifted an Emperor Level weapon, and on top of that, an Emperor Level robe! It was too shocking for Jun Moxiao. Was the Dragon God Sect this powerful one hundred thousand years ago? Even if the Dragon God Sect had been an Eternal Level top sect at that time, it shouldn’t have possessed God Level and Emperor Level weapons...
Although Jun Moxiao was puzzled, he kept his doubts to himself.
Luo Li turned around.
Jun Moxiao removed his tattered clothes and put on the black robe.
Looking at Jun Moxiao’s still somewhat immature face, a thought stirred in Ye Yun’s mind, and he gently asked, "Jun Moxiao, when you were taken to Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge by that masked man, did you notice anything unusual about him?"
Hearing the Ancestor’s question, Jun Moxiao began to recall the entire incident.
After several tens of seconds, he gently began to speak, "Ancestor, that man was extremely cautious and was basically silent the whole way. However, once when I went to relieve myself, I inadvertently saw the emblem of the Outer Cloud Sword Sect beneath the coachman’s clothes. I’m not sure if it has anything to do with the Outer Cloud Sword Sect."
"Outer Cloud Sword Sect?"
Ye Yun looked at Luo Li.

chapters.title: Chapter 17: Heading West, Sword Pointing Through the Clouds
chapters.content:
Chapter 17: Chapter 17: Heading West, Sword Pointing Through the Clouds
When the Ancestor asked a question, Luo Li quickly explained, "Ancestor, the Outer Cloud Sword Sect is also one of the ten major powers of the Ancient Moon Dynasty. It’s located on Outer Cloud Mountain in the west, about ten thousand miles from the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge."
"Alright, we’ll pay a visit to the Outer Cloud Sword Sect then." Ye Yun touched his brow, smiled faintly, and then, with a flick of his hand, a black carriage materialized.
As soon as the black carriage appeared, it immediately emitted a ferocious aura. CRACKLE... The surrounding space compressed, creating layers of ripples, as if it could barely withstand the carriage’s presence.
"Recede!" With a light flick of Ye Yun’s finger, the overwhelming presence instantly vanished.
"My heavens, it’s actually a God-level carriage!" At that moment, Luo Li keenly sensed the black carriage’s level. Her mouth fell open as she gasped in astonishment.
Jun Moxiao felt it too. They exchanged a glance, the shock evident in each other’s eyes.
Jun Moxiao, in particular, grew even more curious about the Ancestor.
To casually produce a God-level vehicle... just how profound must the Ancestor’s resources be! No wonder it was said that a hundred thousand years ago, the Dragon God Sect was the number one sect on the Cangnan Continent, having reached the Eternal Level. It truly wasn’t an exaggeration!
After the black carriage appeared, no horses came with it. Ye Yun flicked his hand again, and a tall, black steed materialized.
This steed was covered in Dragon Scales, with a single horn on its head, exuding an exceptionally mystical aura.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao stared at the black steed, feeling the terrifying pressure it emanated, and couldn’t help but tremble.
At that moment, they felt as if some immense, terrifying creature had descended beside them, making them sense the threat of death.
Heavens, what kind of terrifying beast is this Black Horse?
Ye Yun walked over, patted the Black Horse’s head, and said with a smile, "Little Horse, you’ll frighten people looking like that. Better to appear more ordinary."
"NEIGH!" The Black Horse suddenly reared its head and let out a long cry. Its body trembled, and the Dragon Scales covering it vanished. The single horn on its head also disappeared, and even the terrifying pressure it exuded was gone. It transformed into an ordinary black horse.
"Very good." Ye Yun nodded in satisfaction.
"Master, rest assured, I won’t scare the little ones." The Black Horse suddenly grinned, revealing a row of white teeth, and spoke in human language.
"That’s good!" Ye Yun chuckled, then turned to the stunned pair of senior martial sister and junior martial brother. He smiled, "What are you waiting for? Get on the carriage."
After speaking, Ye Yun leaped lightly onto the carriage and entered the compartment.
Jun Moxiao and Luo Li exchanged a look, instantly snapping back to their senses. They rushed over and jumped onto the carriage, sitting one to the left and one to the right at the front, like drivers.
"Ancestor, may I drive the carriage for you?" Jun Moxiao tremblingly picked up the reins and asked cautiously.
"No problem," Ye Yun’s voice drifted from inside the carriage.
Jun Moxiao gently tugged the reins. The black horse glanced back at him, its lips curling as if in a smile.
"Let’s go!" Jun Moxiao said, his voice still trembling slightly.
The Black Horse set off on all fours, leaving the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge. Its movements weren’t fast, yet with each step, it seemed to cover several tens of zhang, its speed astonishingly deceptive.
After they left the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge, Ye Yun’s voice came from the carriage. "You two, senior sister and junior brother, are still not very familiar with our sect’s techniques. So, we’re taking the carriage. This way, you can recover more of your combat strength en route. When we reach the Outer Cloud Sword Sect, it will be up to you two to act."
"Rest assured, Ancestor, we will definitely cultivate diligently," Jun Moxiao and Luo Li quickly nodded in agreement.
Only then did the two understand the Ancestor’s considerate intentions. He actually wanted to guide them in the Dragon God Sect’s great Ultimate Techniques along the way. After all, their mastery was still superficial.
Even with the Divine Dragon Nine-Change Body Technique, though they felt confident in their abilities, in the Ancestor’s discerning gaze, it was still sorely lacking.
The wheels rumbled as the black carriage slowly began to move. It appeared slow, yet it quickly vanished over the horizon, heading west towards the Outer Cloud Sword Sect.
「A few Time Units later.」
Cultivators arrived at the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge. Discovering the massive changes, they were so terrified that they clutched their heads, their faces etched with horror.
Not a single ghost could be seen. The entire Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge was utterly deserted; not even Human Cultivators were present.
"What happened here?" Just then, more people arrived. Among them was a disciple of the Blood Robe Sect.
Upon reaching the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge, he was instantly shocked and muttered to himself,
"What’s going on? The Vice Sect Leader still hasn’t returned to the Sect?"
More cultivators soon arrived. They were all shocked to discover that their fellow sect members who had come earlier had all mysteriously disappeared.
What on earth had happened? Not only had all the malevolent spirits vanished, but even the disciples from the major powers were gone! All of them had simply evaporated into thin air!
Everyone stared at each other, utterly dumbfounded. After discussing for a while without reaching any conclusion, they all returned to their respective Sects to report.
News of this shocking event at the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge spread like wildfire throughout the entire Ancient Moon Dynasty and even reached neighboring regions.
Everyone eagerly discussed the great upheaval at the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge, speculating endlessly. Opinions varied wildly, and arguments abounded, but ultimately, no one could find a logical explanation.
The Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge incident became an unsolved mystery. Many cultivators, during their leisure time, enjoyed gathering for drinks and enthusiastically discussing the affair.
「Just as the entire Ancient Moon Dynasty was buzzing with excitement about this mystery,」
A black carriage arrived at the foot of Outer Cloud Mountain half a month later.
"Ancestor, this is Outer Cloud Mountain," Jun Moxiao said respectfully.
"Good. Don’t stop; continue upwards. If anyone dares to obstruct you, kill them with a single sword strike," Ye Yun’s voice sounded from within the carriage.
"Understood, Ancestor!" Jun Moxiao’s face lit up with excitement as he gripped the Chaos Element Unlimited Sword.
Thanks to the Ancestor’s guidance along the way, although his cultivation realm hadn’t broken through, his true strength had taken a qualitative leap. His understanding of the Dragon God Sect’s three great Ultimate Techniques had deepened considerably.
Beside him, Senior Sister Luo Li’s cultivation base had also broken through to the first level of the Shaping God Realm. Her combat power had similarly increased.
Both wore Emperor Level Robes, rendering ordinary attacks completely ineffective against them. Furthermore, they possessed divine weapons and the Dragon God Sect’s supreme Cultivation Techniques.
Their combined combat power, it could be said, was unmatched by cultivators of their generation.
This time, they were prepared to use the Cloud Sword Sect as a whetstone to test their current, true capabilities.

chapters.title: Chapter 18: A Strong Visit to the Outer Cloud Sword Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 18: Chapter 18: A Strong Visit to the Outer Cloud Sword Sect
At the foot of Outer Cloud Mountain, a horse-drawn carriage moved slowly, arriving shortly at the gates of the Outer Cloud Sword Sect.
Two disciples stood guard at the gates of the Outer Cloud Sword Sect.
They saw a black carriage approaching from afar, causing them to pause.
"Who goes there? Stop right now!"
One of the disciples immediately drew his sword, warily eyeing the incoming black carriage.
In the front of the carriage sat a boy and a girl, both quite young.
But when the two disciples sensed the visitors’ cultivation bases, they couldn’t help but gasp.
The girl was at the Shaping God Realm First Level.
And the boy next to her was, surprisingly, at the Fourth Level of the Shaping God Realm.
This is just too terrifying!
In their Outer Cloud Sword Sect, those who could cultivate up to the Shaping God Realm were invariably Elder Level figures who were over fifty years old.
"Call your Sect Master out," Jun Moxiao cast his gaze upon the disciples guarding the mountain gate and raised an eyebrow.
Call the Sect Master out?
The two disciples were taken aback again.
Isn’t this young man’s tone a bit too arrogant?
Right from the start, he demanded they call out their Sect Master.
"May I ask which sect you belong to? Identify yourselves," one of the disciples cleared his throat and asked with a stern face.
Our Sect Master holds a high position and is busy all day. If we go in and report directly without knowing which sect the visitors belong to, we’ll probably be in serious trouble and get punished by the Sect Master for such negligence.
"We are from the Dragon God Sect," Luo Li said, her face cold, revealing her sect.
The two disciples looked at each other, somewhat puzzled.
What is this Dragon God Sect?
Why have we never heard of it?
"Excuse us, we’ve never heard of the Dragon God Sect," one of the disciples said, bluntly refusing.
If it were a well-known sect of the Ancient Moon Dynasty, we would definitely know of it. But this Dragon God Sect is something we’ve never heard of.
Luo Li’s small face turned slightly colder.
As the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, being denied entry by two mere Mysterious Pill Realm cultivators made it difficult for her to maintain her composure.
Luo Li’s figure flickered, and like a phantom, she exited the carriage.
She abruptly landed in front of the two disciples, drew her Supreme Golden Dragon Sword, and with a fierce slash, stopped the sword’s tip just before one disciple’s brow, saying coldly, "It doesn’t matter if you didn’t know before, but you will know in the future. Go and report to your Sect Master. Otherwise, don’t blame me, the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, for unleashing a massacre."
The chilling intent from the sword’s tip seemed to pierce straight to his glabella, making the disciple’s face turn pale as cold sweat beaded on his forehead.
He was just a minor cultivator at the Third Layer of the Mysterious Pill Realm. Facing a powerful expert of the Shaping God Realm, the sheer pressure emanating from her made it hard for him to breathe.
"Please wait a moment! I will go and report to the Sect Master," the disciple stammered, retreating a few steps before turning and bolting towards the sect entrance.
The other disciple beside him was sweating profusely.
He looked at the beautiful young girl before him, his face full of fear, and swallowed hard.
This Shaping God Realm power is truly formidable!
Meanwhile, the disciple who had gone to report ran towards the inner courtyard, where he spotted an elder in a white robe.
"Elder Mu, there are people from the Dragon God Sect outside asking to see the Sect Leader! Please go and inform him!" the disciple said hurriedly.
"What sect is this Dragon God Sect? I’ve never heard of it! How dare you be so presumptuous?" Elder Mu scolded, his face showing displeasure.
"Elder Mu, those two people are too powerful! Both are Shapers!" the disciple exclaimed, his voice on the verge of tears.
"What? They’re Shapers!" Elder Mu exclaimed, visibly shocked.
In the Ancient Moon Dynasty, a Shaper was an incredibly powerful cultivator who could cause tremors with a single stomp.
Even in their Outer Cloud Sword Sect, they had but eight Shapers.
"Could you discern... their specific cultivation levels?" Elder Mu inquired further.
The disciple quickly responded, "I did, Elder Mu! One of them is a young girl, about sixteen or seventeen years old, and she has reached the Shaping God Realm First Level. She claimed to be the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect. The other is a young boy, about fifteen or sixteen years old, and his cultivation base is even higher—already at the Fourth Level of the Shaping God Realm!"
"What did you say?!" Upon hearing the disciple’s report, Elder Mu looked utterly shocked, nearly fainting from the revelation.
A fifteen or sixteen-year-old has reached the Shaping God Realm?
That’s terrifyingly impressive!
The entire Ancient Moon Dynasty doesn’t have such geniuses, does it?
Could they possibly be from outside the dynasty?
Realizing the gravity of the situation, Elder Mu hurriedly set off towards the main hall to report to the Sect Leader.
Upon meeting the Sect Leader, Li Qingshan, he immediately relayed the news.
After hearing the report, Li Qingshan’s expression became extremely solemn.
The arrival of two Shapers is no trivial matter.
"Come, follow me. Let’s see what exactly is going on," Li Qingshan said, exiting the main hall and heading directly for the mountain gate.
Elder Mu closely followed behind him.
When they reached the mountain gate, Li Qingshan saw two individuals standing outside.
A young boy and a young girl, both remarkably good-looking.
Upon closer inspection, Li Qingshan was taken aback. Just as Elder Mu had said, one of them was at the Fourth Level of the Shaping God Realm, and the other was at the Shaping God Realm First Level.
Both were powerhouses of the Shaping God Realm.
Looking at the two, Li Qingshan couldn’t help but sigh internally.
He had cultivated for decades, yet he had only reached the Fifth Layer of the Shaping God Realm.
Yet, standing before him were these ridiculously young individuals, already in the Shaping God Realm.
Especially that young boy. Given more time, he could even surpass me.
Beyond the two, Li Qingshan’s gaze fell upon the black carriage.
The carriage seemed ordinary, but it gave him an odd feeling.
Could there be... an expert inside?
Li Qingshan mused.
The cautious Li Qingshan quickly released his Divine Sense, scanning the carriage.
However, he found the carriage empty, not a soul inside.
This somewhat eased his tension. It seems the carriage belongs to the young girl.
Elder Mu had mentioned that this girl claimed to be the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect.
Though the idea of such a young girl being a Sect Master is somewhat amusing... Li Qingshan wasn’t laughing.
After all, anyone who could become a Sect Master at the Shaping God Realm First Level certainly has the qualifications.
"Greetings, friends from afar. I am Li Qingshan, the current Sect Leader of the Outer Cloud Sword Sect. May I ask who you are?" Li Qingshan greeted them with a fist-and-palm salute, a smile on his face.
Luo Li, her expression impassive, returned the salute and replied softly, "I am Luo Li, Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect."
Seeing Luo Li conduct herself with such propriety, Ye Yun, who was in the carriage, couldn’t help but smile knowingly.
Despite her young age, Luo Li carries herself with the dignified air of a true sect master.
Li Qingshan, hands clasped behind his back, smiled and asked, "May I inquire what business brings you to our Outer Cloud Sword Sect?"
"Summon everyone from your Outer Cloud Sword Sect who has ventured out in the past two months. I need to find an enemy," Luo Li stated, her eyes narrowing as she spoke in a cold voice.
Looking for an enemy?
Li Qingshan’s heart skipped a beat.
Could it be that some of our Outer Cloud Sword Sect’s Shaper Elders have offended this Dragon God Sect?

chapters.title: Chapter 19: Getting to the Crux of the Matter, Swords Drawn and Bows Bent
chapters.content:
Chapter 19: Chapter 19: Getting to the Crux of the Matter, Swords Drawn and Bows Bent
Li Qingshan’s heart felt a little heavy as he glanced at Elder Mu.
"In the past two months, have any Elders of our Sect in the Shaping God Realm gone out?"
Elder Mu thought for a moment, then furrowed his brows. "No one has gone out."
Li Qingshan understood immediately and smiled at the beautiful young woman.
"Master Luo, none of the Outer Cloud Sword Sect’s Shaping God Realm Elders have left the mountain in the last two months. I wonder who could have offended someone from your esteemed Sect?"
Luo Li didn’t reply, instead glancing at her junior brother, Jun Moxiao.
Jun Moxiao stepped forward.
The young man had a face as fair as jade and eyes like morning stars. He stood as straight as a sword, radiating heroic valor. He looked at Li Qingshan calmly and spoke in a deep voice, "Sect Leader Li, you can summon all disciples whose cultivation is below the Shaping God Realm and who have left the Sect in the past two months. I will identify them one by one."
Li Qingshan hesitated.
This young man before me, although his cultivation base is a minor realm lower than mine, exerts immense pressure on me. His vital energy is surging, as vigorous as a dragon. With every breath, the very air around him seems to tremble slightly. He’s truly a rare talent.
Especially since both this young man and young woman were clad in Emperor-level Robes, giving them an air of extreme nobility, Li Qingshan grew even more wary of acting rashly.
After some thought, Li Qingshan decided that maintaining peace was paramount.
So, he said to Elder Mu, "Go and gather all disciples who have left the Sect in the past two months in the main square."
"Yes, Sect Leader."
Elder Mu acknowledged and immediately hurried inside.
He understood the Sect Leader’s predicament. After all, these two young Shaping God Realm cultivators, with their extraordinary bearing, were clearly not ordinary individuals. The Outer Cloud Sword Sect could ill afford to offend them.
Li Qingshan smiled faintly at Luo Li again. "Please, follow me, both of you."
Luo Li glanced at Jun Moxiao. Understanding her unspoken cue, his figure flickered, and he reappeared near the front of the black carriage. He then guided it slowly through the mountain gate.
A gleam flashed in Li Qingshan’s eyes.
He was puzzled, wondering why they insisted on bringing the carriage.
However, despite his curiosity, he merely gave the black carriage a fleeting glance and said nothing, continuing to lead the way.
Luo Li followed behind.
Soon, the group arrived at the square.
Disciples began to stream into the square, their numbers quickly swelling.
Jun Moxiao leaped down from the carriage.
Standing in the square, his gaze as sharp as a hawk’s, he scanned each arriving disciple, searching for the person he had encountered before.
However, among the Outer Cloud Sword Sect disciples in the square, not one was the coachman he had seen that day.
Jun Moxiao wasn’t anxious; he simply continued his search slowly.
More and more people gathered, their numbers gradually swelling to several thousand.
Many disciples, upon arriving at the square, were baffled by the situation and began to whisper amongst themselves, creating a noisy hum.
"Sect Leader, everyone has arrived."
Elder Mu, having counted the disciples, reported to Li Qingshan.
Li Qingshan nodded and then looked at Jun Moxiao.
Jun Moxiao frowned; he hadn’t found the coachman.
"Is everyone truly here?" Jun Moxiao asked Elder Mu coldly, his gaze sharp.
"Essentially, yes." Elder Mu felt a chill under Jun Moxiao’s stare and quickly nodded.
"Impossible," Jun Moxiao stated with conviction. "I saw a disciple from the Outer Cloud Sword Sect that day. He’s not among them."
Li Qingshan looked at Elder Mu. "Elder Mu, think carefully. Is anyone missing?"
Elder Mu pondered for a moment, then suddenly slapped his forehead. "Ah! At the Ancestor’s secluded cultivation site in the back mountains, there are two attendant disciples. They’ve left the mountain before."
"Then what are you waiting for?" Jun Moxiao said coldly. "Bring them here at once."
A troubled expression crossed Elder Mu’s face. He looked at Li Qingshan and said, "Sect Leader, there’s absolutely no problem with those two. They’ve only left the mountain once."
Li Qingshan sighed.
Things have already come to this. I have no choice but to trouble Elder Mu to make another trip. Besides, I don’t want to make enemies of these two. If these two powerful Shaping God Realm experts were to turn against the Outer Cloud Sword Sect, even if we could defeat them, it would be at a terrible cost. I don’t want the Sect to suffer such a huge loss over a trivial matter.
Elder Mu accepted the order and departed.
Before long, he returned with two men, both young and around thirty years of age.
Jun Moxiao’s gaze swept over them.
Suddenly, his eyes lit up. He pointed at one of the young men. "It’s him!"
Li Qingshan glanced over and saw that this disciple’s cultivation base was only at the First Level of the Origin Sea Realm.
Only the First Level of the Origin Sea Realm?
"Master Luo," Li Qingshan asked, "this disciple of my Outer Cloud Sect has such a meager cultivation base. How could he possibly have become an enemy of your esteemed group?"
Jun Moxiao abruptly reached out, and with a telekinetic grip, pulled the Origin Sea Realm disciple, who had been keeping his head bowed, towards him.
"Do you still recognize me?" Jun Moxiao sneered, looking down at him.
The disciple raised his head, carefully scrutinizing Jun Moxiao’s face.
The longer he looked, the more horrified he became, and he suddenly began to tremble violently.
He cried out, "How can it be you? Weren’t you supposed to have died at Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge?"
"I’m alive, no thanks to you," Jun Moxiao sneered repeatedly.
Still gripping the disciple, he strode over to Li Qingshan.
The disciple struggled violently, shouting, "That’s not right! Weren’t you only at the Gathering Qi Realm back then? How have you become a great Cultivator at the Fourth Level of the Shaping God Realm in just over half a month?"
Jun Moxiao merely sneered, not dignifying the question with an answer.
Nearby, Li Qingshan and the others felt their hearts leap.
From the Gathering Qi Realm to the Shaping God Realm in just half a month? How is that possible?
For an instant, they even began to think that this disciple of their Sect had gone mad.
Just then, a sound like an explosive clap of thunder echoed from the sky.
"Where did these two brats spring from? How dare they come to my Outer Cloud Sword Sect to cause trouble and even seize one of my disciples!"
The voice boomed.
A streak of sword light flashed, and an old man in a black Robe with a Longsword on his back descended.
The elder exuded a powerful presence, emanating the aura of the Ninth Level of the Shaping God Realm.
"Greetings, Supreme Elder."
Recognizing the newcomer, Li Qingshan was startled and hurriedly bowed in respect.
All the other disciples in the square did likewise.
Instantly, a chorus of respectful greetings thundered across the entire Outer Cloud Sword Sect.
SWISH! SWISH! SWISH! SWISH!
Figures descended from all directions.
Every one of them possessed a Shaping God Realm cultivation base.
These were the Sect’s other Shaping God Realm Elders, who had also emerged after the Supreme Elder’s arrival.
"Li Qingshan, you spineless Sect Leader! The Outer Cloud Sword Sect has been bullied to this degree, and you still stand by? Are you even a man?!"
The Supreme Elder glared, pointing a finger at Li Qingshan as he berated him.
Li Qingshan’s face flushed crimson, and his body trembled.
I only wanted to prevent the Outer Cloud Sword Sect from suffering any losses, but I never imagined that in the Supreme Elder’s eyes, this would be seen as cowardice.
"No need for explanations!" the Supreme Elder snorted coldly. "Draw your sword and kill these two immediately!"
Seeing the Supreme Elder’s fury, Li Qingshan took a deep breath and drew his treasured sword.
The other Shaping God Realm Elders of the Outer Cloud Sect, their eyelids lowered, also drew their Swords, aiming the tips at Luo Li and Jun Moxiao.
In an instant, a palpable tension gripped the entire Outer Cloud Sword Sect, the air thick and chilling with murderous intent.
「Inside the carriage.」
Ye Yun watched this unfold with a faint smile.
Although this Supreme Elder looks like the mastermind, it’s probably not that simple. However, that coachman was indeed the one who took Jun Moxiao to Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge. As for whether this Supreme Elder is the masked man, it’s still too early to say for sure. The true culprit is hiding too deeply; it’s unlikely that a small sect like the Outer Cloud Sword Sect could orchestrate something like this. Besides, the Outer Cloud Sword Sect and the Dragon God Sect have no dealings with each other, so this Supreme Elder has no direct motive to act. There must be a greater power behind him.

chapters.title: Chapter 20: The Great Battle with the Outer Cloud Sword Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 20: Chapter 20: The Great Battle with the Outer Cloud Sword Sect
"Haha!"
A large crowd, including several strong cultivators from the Shaping God Realm, had quickly gathered. Despite being surrounded by formidable opponents, Jun Moxiao felt his blood boil with thrill and excitement.
"Little Junior Brother, it’s finally our turn to unleash our wrath today! We’re done living like fugitives!" Luo Li declared. She held the Supreme Golden Dragon Sword, her beautiful face flushed crimson with excitement.
"Indeed, Senior Sister!" Jun Moxiao affirmed. Armed with the Chaos Element Unlimited Sword, his handsome, jade-like face took on an eerie, bewitching intensity.
He shared Luo Li’s sentiment. For years, they had been hounded like stray dogs. Today was finally their chance to display everything they had learned and make their ancestors proud. They would make the Outer Cloud Sword Sect the first sacrifice to their Dragon God Sect’s might.
"Kill!" Luo Li scanned the powerful enemies and laughed heartily, her voice ringing with heroic abandon.
BOOM!
With a gentle stomp of her foot, a phantom Divine Dragon materialized behind her. This Divine Dragon was golden-yellow and dozens of feet tall. Though a phantom, it felt incredibly real, especially its pair of golden, vertical pupils, which exerted immense pressure.
