Jun Moxiao also laughed loudly. With a slight movement, a golden dragon phantom appeared behind him as well.
This was the true opening stance of the Dragon God Sword Technique. With the golden dragon borne on their backs, a single sword could slay all under heaven! When the golden dragon emerged, none dared to contend against it!
For the past half-month, Ye Yun had been teaching them diligently, re-explaining the Dragon God Sword Technique from the beginning. After all, the Dragon God Sect’s teachings had deteriorated significantly through the generations, from Ye Yun’s thirteenth to Luo Li’s two hundred and ninety-eighth. Consequently, the Dragon God Sword Technique Luo Li and her peers had learned was merely a tenth of the original.
This dragon-summoning opening stance was a hallmark of the Dragon God Sword Technique. By carrying the golden dragon on their back, the surging Dragon Blood within them would grant power like a raging river, allowing them to unleash the true might of the Dragon God Sword Technique.
"This..." The disciples of the Outer Cloud Sword Sect blanched in terror at the sudden appearance of the two golden dragons and scrambled back in fear.
As a result, only the powerful cultivators of the Shaping God Realm and a few at the Tenth Layer Peak of the Origin Sea Realm remained in the vast square.
The Supreme Elder gazed at the two golden dragon phantoms, his pupils deep and unfathomable, his thoughts hidden.
Li Qingshan also felt immense pressure. Especially from the young man at the Fourth Level of the Shaping God Realm; Li Qingshan had a dreadful premonition that if he dared to make a move, he would inevitably meet a bloody end.
What kind of swordsmanship is this? Why is it so powerful?
The surrounding Elders of the Shaping God Realm all wore expressions of horror. Among them, some had only just reached the First Level of the Shaping God Realm.
"Kill them! Leave no survivors!" the Supreme Elder commanded, his face cold. He brandished his sword skyward, signaling the attack.
Li Qingshan was the first to charge forward. His target was not Jun Moxiao, but Luo Li. In his eyes, Luo Li, only at the First Level of the Shaping God Realm, seemed like the softer target.
WHOOSH! WHOOSH!
Sword light, like roiling clouds, descended from the sky. This was the Outer Cloud Sword Technique, the strongest in the Outer Cloud Sword Sect. Li Qingshan had immersed himself in this swordsmanship for many years, and its power was immense.
"Well met!" Luo Li declared. The golden dragon phantom on her back pulsed with an incredibly strong aura. She held the Supreme Golden Dragon Sword and charged towards Li Qingshan. The Sword Qi from her blade, like a coiling dragon, pierced towards Li Qingshan’s cloud-like sword light.
A thunderous explosion ripped through the air! Her golden dragon Sword Qi instantly shattered the impenetrable Outer Cloud Sword Technique.
In the blink of an eye, a golden serpentine streak of Sword Qi was upon him. Li Qingshan, startled, hastily swung his sword to block, dodging aside just in time.
Unexpectedly, the golden dragon Sword Qi was incredibly deceptive. It bizarrely changed direction, pursued him, and struck his left arm. SLICE! His left arm was severed by the golden dragon Sword Qi.
Li Qingshan screamed in pain and hastily retreated.
"What?!" The Supreme Elder watched this, inwardly astounded.
I didn’t expect this young girl, despite her low cultivation realm, to possess such astonishing combat strength! Her swordsmanship, especially, is so exquisite it’s almost impossible to parry!
The entire square erupted into a battlefield.
Meanwhile, the other Elders swarmed Jun Moxiao. He unleashed the Dragon God Sword Technique, his sword light striking like divine dragons. Many were struck by his blade, sustaining injuries of varying severity. Almost no one was Jun Moxiao’s match.
The Supreme Elder’s eyes twitched.
To think these two youngsters possess such formidable strength!
he thought in shock.
"Little girl, die!" he roared, swinging his sword as he charged Luo Li.
Seeing the Supreme Elder charge at her, Luo Li dared not be careless. Relying on the Nine Changes of the God Dragon, she dodged to the side. Simultaneously, she counter-attacked with her sword, sending seven or eight streams of Sword Qi hurtling towards the Supreme Elder.
The two quickly engaged in fierce combat. After all, this Supreme Elder was at the Ninth Layer of the Shaping God Realm. No matter how astonishing Luo Li’s combat strength was, a significant gap remained between her and the Supreme Elder. After a few exchanges, she found herself at a disadvantage. However, relying on the Nine Changes of the God Dragon, she was not in immediate mortal danger.
The remaining cultivators, meanwhile, were furiously besieging Jun Moxiao. He fought as if divinely aided, displaying incredible might as he battled a dozen Elders from the Shaping God Realm and Origin Sea Realm. For a time, the fight was evenly matched and hard-fought.
As the battle progressed, more and more members of the Outer Cloud Sword Sect sustained injuries.
「Inside the black carriage.」
Ye Yun watched the somewhat desperate battle with a smile, lightly tapping his fingers on the armrest. He chose not to intervene yet.
After all, this is all part of their training,
he mused.
These two are still young. Experiencing such life-and-death battles will be of immense benefit to them.
The battle grew increasingly fierce, reaching a fever pitch.
Jun Moxiao’s execution of the Dragon God Sword Technique became smoother, its power growing stronger. Gradually, he gained the upper hand. The disciples and Elders of the Outer Cloud Sword Sect fell injured one after another, their combat effectiveness severely diminished.
SWISH! SWISH! SWISH!
Dozens of golden dragon Sword Qi emanated outwards, blooming like a lotus. Accompanied by a dragon’s cry, all the Sword Qi lances shot out. A large number of the Outer Cloud Sword Sect’s Shaping God Realm Elders instantly collapsed.
Before Jun Moxiao, not a single opponent remained standing. All the Outer Cloud Sword Sect Elders who had besieged him were grievously injured, blood pooling on the ground. They lay gasping for breath, with no strength left to fight.
ROAR!
Having achieved such a satisfying slaughter, Jun Moxiao threw back his head and laughed heartily. Then, he whirled around.
"Senior Sister, I’m coming to help you!" Jun Moxiao roared. He merged with his sword, transforming into a golden dragon that streaked towards the Outer Cloud Sword Sect’s Supreme Elder.
The Supreme Elder, seeing Jun Moxiao had actually injured all the Shaping God Realm Elders of the Outer Cloud Sword Sect, was utterly astounded.
Who could have imagined... this young man at the Fourth Level of the Shaping God Realm is so terrifying!
He let out a long cry, slashing with his sword. Sword light poured forth like quicksilver, rushing towards Jun Moxiao. Invigorated, Jun Moxiao met his attack, sword flashing. Despite being five minor cultivation levels below the Supreme Elder, Jun Moxiao showed not the slightest fear.
Meanwhile, Luo Li, who had been maneuvering, also launched a counterattack.
In an instant, the entire square was filled with crisscrossing Dragon Shadows and flashing sword light. Numerous surrounding buildings were destroyed one after another.

chapters.title: Chapter 21 - Disappear in the blink of an eye
chapters.content:
Chapter 21: Chapter 21 - Disappear in the blink of an eye
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao had been cultivating together since childhood, their synergy in battle remarkable. They both utilized the Nine Changes of the God Dragon, moving elusively through the sky, their forms shifting unpredictably. Streaks of sword light constantly shot out from all directions, and for a time, they fought evenly with the Supreme Elder of the Outer Cloud Sword Sect.
The Supreme Elder was rather frustrated. He had never expected that, as a mighty cultivator at the Ninth Layer of the Shaping God Realm, he would be unable to defeat these two youngsters who were still wet behind the ears.
From a distance, the disciples of the Outer Cloud Sword Sect watched, their hearts pounding with fear. The cultivation base of this young boy and girl greatly exceeded theirs, yet they were much younger.
The injured Shaping God Realm Elders had all crawled to the periphery, leaning against the walls as they watched the earth-shattering battle. Li Qingshan, in particular, couldn’t help but sigh at the sight.
It seems the Outer Cloud Sword Sect won’t escape disaster today,
he thought.
These two teenagers are truly formidable. If the Supreme Elder can’t defeat them, I’m afraid we old folks won’t live to see tomorrow.
BANG! BANG! Sword light continued to explode. The Supreme Elder leveraged all his skills, launching a fierce onslaught against Luo Li and Jun Moxiao. Amidst the storm of Sword Qi, only a small amount landed on them. However, the Emperor Level Robes they wore displayed amazing defensive power, leaving them unharmed.
"HAHA!" Jun Moxiao laughed heartily, his Sword Intent growing even sharper.
This Emperor Level Robe is incredible! Its defensive power is astonishing! The Supreme Elder’s attacks can’t pierce it at all!
This realization made Jun Moxiao even more audacious in his attacks. Luo Li, on the other side, was no different. Their Sword Intents soared as streaks of sword light shot towards the Supreme Elder.
The Supreme Elder was being pushed into one perilous situation after another by the two youngsters. He roared with rage, and after a desperate sword strike, he turned and fled.
"You think you can run away?" Jun Moxiao scoffed, instantly utilizing the Nine Changes of the Dragon God Sect to give chase. Although the Supreme Elder was extremely fast, the Nine Changes of the Dragon God Sect was an exceptional movement technique. Its speed was uncanny, allowing Jun Moxiao to stay right on his tail. Luo Li was a bit slower, following closely behind Jun Moxiao.
This Supreme Elder... was connected to the secrets of the mastermind, so they naturally couldn’t let him escape.
「In a blink of an eye, all three disappeared over the horizon.」
Ye Yun remained perfectly still in the carriage. His eyes were half-closed as he watched the scene in the distant sky, his expression extraordinarily calm.
Just then, Li Qingshan wobbled to his feet. He sighed and said to the other Shaping God Realm Elders, "Elders, disaster has befallen the Outer Cloud Sword Sect today. We should quickly pack up, leave this place, and seek refuge."
The other Elders, pale-faced and heavily injured, were helped up by their disciples.
"Sect Leader, those two youngsters are too strong," said a Shaping God Realm Elder, coughing up blood, his face a mask of bitter pain. "We don’t know if they have even more powerful seniors backing them. It seems that this time, our Outer Cloud Sword Sect has truly encountered a great disaster."
Another Elder said tremblingly, "In that case, let’s quickly descend the mountain, keep a low profile, and wait for this storm to pass."
The other Elders quickly agreed. Then, the remaining disciples also began to head out.
Just then, one of the Shaping God Realm Elders glanced at the black carriage. An angry expression appeared on his face as he shouted to the disciples behind him, "Don’t rush off, everyone! Let’s destroy this carriage first!"
"Alright!" a disciple immediately responded, raising his sword to strike the black carriage.
BAM!
His sword was repelled, and the black carriage remained unscathed.
This carriage is so sturdy! Could it be a treasure too?
The Origin Sea Realm disciple frowned. He gathered all his strength once more, and a fierce Sword Qi lanced towards it.
BOOM!
The Sword Qi shattered, but the carriage remained untouched.
"HAHA! It truly is a treasure!" a Shaping God Realm Elder laughed heartily, his eyes full of greed.
Li Qingshan said from the side, "They’re not here. Let’s quickly get this carriage down the mountain."
"Yes, Sect Leader!"
Countless disciples swarmed forward. Some went to take the black horse’s reins, while others tried to push the carriage from behind. No one expected the black horse at the front to suddenly rear up and kick a disciple. The disciple was sent flying, crashed into a wall, coughed up blood, and died.
"’Wow! This horse is so powerful?’"
Everyone was shocked. The disciple who had been struck was at the Tenth Layer of the Mysterious Pill Realm.
"Everyone, be careful!" Li Qingshan shouted. A fanatical glint appeared in his eyes.
This carriage must also be an extraordinary treasure. Even the black horse seems to have an unusual origin. Even though the Supreme Elder is no match for those two youths, he should be able to hold out for a long time. If we can take this black carriage down the mountain before they return, it’ll be an unexpected gain! And once those two youngsters return, where would they find us?
Li Qingshan’s injuries weren’t serious. Sword in hand and a murderous look on his face, he advanced towards the black horse.
Since this black horse won’t cooperate, I’ll knock it out first! A dignified cultivator of the Shaping God Realm like myself can’t even deal with a mere black horse? Impossible!
"You all... are truly insatiable!" Suddenly, a gentle voice sounded from inside the carriage.
There’s someone in the carriage?
Li Qingshan and the others were taken aback.
I clearly scanned it with my Divine Sense and found it empty. When did someone else get in?
The curtain of the carriage was lifted, and a youth in white stepped out. This white-clad youth possessed an otherworldly handsomeness, with refined features and eyes as deep as starry skies. He radiated an ethereal, celestial aura. A single glance left an indelible impression.
This young man seemed like a deity who had stepped out of a painting, not someone from the mortal world at all.
Li Qingshan carefully tried to assess the youth’s cultivation base but found he couldn’t see through it at all; he seemed like an ordinary person. Terror gripped Li Qingshan’s heart. He forced himself to remain calm, looked at the white-clad youth, and asked tremulously, "Are you... the senior of those two youngsters?"
"Indeed." Ye Yun nodded slightly. His gaze swept over the greedy members of the Outer Cloud Sword Sect, and a faint smile touched his lips. "Your Outer Cloud Sword Sect is filled with nothing but contemptible wretches."
"How dare you slander our Outer Cloud Sword Sect!" a Shaping God Realm Elder roared from the side. "We are one of the ten major powers in the Ancient Moon Dynasty! You’d better consider the consequences of your words!"
"A group of ants. What qualifications do you have to negotiate with me?" Ye Yun smiled faintly, then flicked his finger, releasing a wisp of clear Qi. This wisp of Qi, initially tiny, suddenly swelled to an immense size, transforming into a violent gale that swept out in all directions.
At the mere touch of this seemingly gentle breeze, the countless disciples of the Outer Cloud Sword Sect turned to ash. Naturally, the first to turn to ash was Li Qingshan, who was closest. He watched in horror as his body rapidly turned to ash. Then, the other Shaping God Realm Elders also turned into drifting ash.
Farther away, the disciples with lower cultivation bases watched this, terrified out of their wits. They all wanted to flee immediately.
But it was already too late.

chapters.title: Chapter 22 The Terror of the True God
chapters.content:
Chapter 22: Chapter 22 The Terror of the True God
A breath of purity, and the entire Outer Cloud Sword Sect had fallen.
All the buildings in the Outer Cloud Sword Sect turned to dust in that moment.
This was the terror of the True God!
Even the most powerful Eternal Realm Cultivators on the Cangnan Continent would dissipate in a matter of seconds under this pure atmospheric stroke.
Beneath the True God, all beings are as insignificant as ants!
「...」
"Why bother?"
Ye Yun smiled indifferently, feeling a bit helpless about the price these greedy individuals had paid.
But this was human nature.
Wealth moves the heart. When encountering treasures, people struggle to control their innate greed.
No matter their cultivation level, all cultivators are ensnared by the word "greed."
This holds true even for those who have reached the ultimate realm of "God Man."
Indeed.
「...」
"Little Horse, let’s go. Let’s see how the battle ahead is progressing," Ye Yun ordered, entering the carriage.
"Yes, Master."
The black steed’s spirits lifted; it raised its hooves and began to run swiftly.
After just a few steps, the Black Horse’s hooves suddenly left the ground. It trod on thin air, pulling the black carriage, drawing a black line across the sky before disappearing in an instant.
「...」
The Supreme Elder of the Outer Cloud Sword Sect fled at top speed.
Yet, he found...
That young man, radiating a keen edge, is still stubbornly following me, impossible to shake off!
This made him increasingly anxious.
The rapid turn of events in today’s battle was completely unexpected.
The combat power of both young men was surprisingly strong!
Their Emperor Level Robes possessed formidable defensive capabilities; he couldn’t penetrate their defense even with an attack at the Ninth Layer of the Phase of God.
As an Elder of the Outer Cloud Sword Sect, highly revered in the Ancient Moon Dynasty, the robe he wore was merely Heaven Level.
A King Level Robe was extremely rare in the entire Ancient Moon Dynasty, let alone an Emperor Level one.
If I could defeat these two young men by strength, I would definitely seize these two Emperor Level Robes,
the Supreme Elder thought.
Unfortunately, he couldn’t do so at this moment.
Fortunately, his cultivation base was higher than these two, and his Mana was more profound, allowing him to endure longer.
「After four hours.」
The Supreme Elder took a shallow breath and looked back, his eyes nearly bulging out of their sockets.
The young man was still maintaining the exact same distance from him, without any change.
How can this young man’s aura be so powerful?
The Supreme Elder was greatly alarmed, narrowing his eyes to look farther into the distance.
Far away, a small yellow dot was rapidly approaching.
Upon closer inspection, it was that beautiful girl.
This beautiful girl also possesses such formidable stamina; it’s truly unimaginable.
"What rotten luck!"
The Supreme Elder’s face darkened. Daring not to linger, he continued his desperate flight.
Behind him, Jun Moxiao, with a cold expression, kept pace, relentlessly pursuing him.
He had absorbed two drops of Ancestral Dragon Blood, making his body extremely strong and his stamina vast, far surpassing his peers. Thus, he was able to track the Supreme Elder for a long time.
Luo Li was slightly weaker, but she also kept up, showing no sign of fatigue.
WHOOSH!
The sky suddenly darkened.
A black shadow flew overhead and landed in front, blocking their path.
The fleeing Supreme Elder abruptly stopped.
Why is it that black carriage? This carriage, once parked in the Outer Cloud Sword Sect’s square, should belong to those two young cultivators. I never expected this carriage could also fly through the air. It seems that black steed must be an extraordinary Divine Beast.
"Stop running. You can’t escape!" a man’s voice called from the black carriage.
There’s someone inside?
The Supreme Elder was taken aback.
He had probed the black carriage before, and it had been empty.
When did someone suddenly appear inside it?
His old face was now incomparably pale.
The Supreme Elder suddenly considered a possibility—
An unparalleled expert has been in the black carriage all along, but due to my own low cultivation base, I was simply unable to sense their presence.
At this realization, the Supreme Elder was incredibly alarmed. His desperate desire to live prompted him to turn and flee in another direction.
Just then, the surrounding space underwent a peculiar change.
BANG!
The Supreme Elder crashed into an invisible barrier and was thrown back.
It’s over! This place has actually been sealed by this expert. I can’t break through!
Fear filled the Supreme Elder’s heart.
He hovered in the void, head bowed, his face alternating between pale and flushed, apparently making a difficult decision.
"Little rascal!" Ye Yun looked at him and said calmly, "I’ll give you a chance to live—speak! Who exactly sent you to Wanbao Pavilion to post that mission? Who told you to target the insignificant Dragon God Sect?"
The Supreme Elder clenched his teeth, refusing to utter a word.
Even facing the pressure from a Wushang powerhouse, he showed no sign of yielding.
At this moment, Jun Moxiao rushed over.
Seeing the Supreme Elder, he sneered. "Run! Let’s see where you can run now!"
With that, he thrust his sword forward.
The Supreme Elder gave a grim smile, looked at Jun Moxiao, and suddenly burst into laughter. "Even if I die, I won’t talk! Give up!"
Suddenly, the aura around him became immensely powerful!
Is he going to self-destruct?
Jun Moxiao felt a sense of foreboding. He immediately executed the Divine Dragon Nine-Change Body Technique, withdrew his sword, and retreated swiftly.
BOOM!
The Supreme Elder’s body suddenly exploded.
The powerful shockwave spread in all directions until it met the invisible barrier and was stopped.
Fortunately, Jun Moxiao reacted quickly. The Divine Dragon Nine-Change was extremely profound, and with an Emperor Level Robe protecting him, he suffered hardly any harm.
When Luo Li, who was farther away, arrived, she had just missed the self-detonation.
She came to Jun Moxiao’s side and sighed, "I didn’t expect that old fellow to actually self-destruct. He really was a tough nut to crack."
"Yeah, Senior Sister, the clue is gone now," Jun Moxiao said irritably.
Luo Li bit her red lip, her small face somber, and remained silent.
Suddenly, she looked at the black carriage suspended in the void and her eyes widened.
"Junior Brother, look quickly! Why is the Ancestor’s carriage stopped in mid-air?"
"It... it really is the Ancestor..." he stuttered.
Jun Moxiao’s attention had previously been on the Supreme Elder. Only now did he see the black carriage, and a shocked expression appeared on his face.
At this moment, Ye Yun stepped out of the carriage, appearing at the site of the Supreme Elder’s self-detonation.
Jun Moxiao and Luo Li immediately flew over.
"Ancestor, the clue is gone," Jun Moxiao said, scratching his head, regret written all over his face.
Ye Yun shook his head and said nonchalantly, "It doesn’t matter."
Seeing Ye Yun’s indifferent demeanor, Jun Moxiao’s eyes lit up. "Ancestor, do you have other ways to find clues?"
Luo Li, standing beside him, remembered the methods the Ancestor had used against the people from the Qingjian Sect in the past and immediately understood.
She tapped Jun Moxiao’s forehead with her hand and giggled. "Who do you think the Ancestor is? He’s a True God! Do you think such a trivial matter could stump him?"
"Haha, Senior Sister, you’re right," Jun Moxiao said, scratching his head and laughing sheepishly.
Just then, Ye Yun pointed with his hand. Slowly, a soul appeared in the void—it was the Supreme Elder.
Then, his fingertips flickered with light, seemingly manipulating the soul.
Jun Moxiao watched this scene nervously, while Luo Li looked relaxed.
After a few breaths, Ye Yun flicked his finger again.
The Supreme Elder’s soul immediately dissipated into the heavens and earth.
"Ancestor, who was truly behind all of this?" Luo Li asked quietly, her eyes full of hope.

chapters.title: Chapter 23: The Old Sword Saint and The Puppet Master behind the Scenes
chapters.content:
Chapter 23: Chapter 23: The Old Sword Saint and The Puppet Master behind the Scenes
"Sword God Sect... Is there someone among them known as the Old Sword Saint?" Ye Yun gazed at Luo Li, smiling softly as he spoke.
"The Old Sword Saint?" Luo Li paused slightly in surprise.
She pondered for a moment, then a look of astonishment spread across her face. She nodded repeatedly and explained, "Ancestor, indeed there was such a person. However... this Old Sword Saint has been in seclusion for over a hundred years. The Sword God Sect is currently managed by a new Sword Saint."
Ye Yun then asked, "What kind of power does the Sword God Sect truly hold?"
Luo Li hurriedly answered, "Ancestor, the Sword God Sect is the foremost Sect among the top ten powers of the Ancient Moon Dynasty. A century ago, it was overseen by the Old Sword Saint, Ximen Blow Snow. This Ximen Blow Snow possessed astonishing talent, an unparalleled genius hailed as the Ancient Moon Dynasty’s invincible Sword Saint. For several centuries, no one had been his match. However, a hundred years ago, this Old Sword Saint hung up his sword and retreated into the mountains, reportedly for closed-door cultivation intended to break through to the Divine Bridge Realm..."
"I see!" Ye Yun nodded, not particularly disturbed by the information.
The mastermind behind the Dragon God Sect’s persecution was exceptionally cunning, hiding their tracks impeccably and leaving no loopholes. This was evident from that Supreme Elder. This Old Sword Saint was likely just another puppet, with an even greater power manipulating things from the shadows.
Ye Yun was extremely curious.
Who on earth could it be? To be so patient and wicked in dealing with the insignificant Dragon God Sect, relentlessly pursuing them for nearly fifty generations. Whom exactly did the Sect Master of the two hundred and fiftieth generation offend? To provoke such intense hatred, causing this person to torment the Dragon God Sect generation after generation. Instead of granting them a swift end, this person plays a cat-and-mouse game, tormenting the Dragon God Sect ceaselessly. Could they be planning to continue this torment until the three-hundredth generation, completing a span of fifty tortured generations? Such a depraved psyche truly disgusted Ye Yun.
Once he unraveled this scheme and unmasked the puppeteer lurking in the shadows, Ye Yun resolved to seal this person for all eternity, subjecting them to a million forms of torture, life after life!
The current clue... pointed towards the Ancient Moon Dynasty’s foremost power: the Old Sword Saint of the Sword God Sect. This meant that in the Ancient Moon Dynasty, the highest authority orchestrating this was this Old Sword Saint. According to Luo Li’s account, this invincible Old Sword Saint had always been the strongest cultivator within the Ancient Moon Dynasty. A hundred years ago, he was already a formidable Half-Step Divine Bridge Realm cultivator. Now, a hundred years had passed since he went into seclusion. Although there had been no news of his progress, he was likely on the verge of breaking through to the Divine Bridge Realm. Currently, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao were only at the Shaping God Realm. Against a cultivator at the Half-Step Divine Bridge Realm, let alone the Divine Bridge Realm, they stood no chance of victory. Both of them needed a prolonged period of training.
Upon realizing this, Ye Yun devised a preliminary plan.
Finding the person pulling the strings was not urgent at the moment. The priority was to train Luo Li and Jun Moxiao, transforming them into the Dragon God Sect’s future unparalleled powerhouses. And one day, he would inevitably have to leave the Cangnan Continent. Therefore, Ye Yun was determined to groom these two as successors for the Dragon God Sect.
Ye Yun looked at Luo Li and smiled, saying, "We don’t have to rush to the Sword God Sect just yet. Instead, let’s travel around and take this opportunity to improve your cultivation base."
As he finished his sentence, Ye Yun took out two small bottles from his clothes. He handed them to the pair.
"Ancestor, what is this?" Luo Li curiously lifted the small bottle to her nose, inhaling a faint, ineffable scent that was incredibly comforting.
"This is the Dragon Tiger Pill," Ye Yun said with a smile. "Now that you’ve reached the Shaping God Realm, it’s the perfect time to use these Dragon Tiger Pills to enhance your cultivation base."
Jun Moxiao and Luo Li exchanged glances, both somewhat bewildered. They had never heard of this Dragon Tiger Pill before. However, since it was something presented by the Ancestor, it was certainly extraordinary. They both opened their small bottles simultaneously, glanced inside, and focused on sensing the pills’ aura.
"Ancestor, could this possibly be of God level quality?" Jun Moxiao asked, his voice trembling.
Ye Yun simply nodded with a smile.
Jun Moxiao and Luo Li were momentarily stunned, feeling as if they were in a dream. The two hurriedly released their Divine Sense, carefully examining the contents of the small bottles. To their immediate delight, they discovered that each little bottle actually contained tens of thousands of Dragon Tiger Pills!
"Heavens, there are so many God-level pills! Ancestor, you are truly too good to us!" Luo Li pressed the small bottle to her chest, shocked, overjoyed, and utterly captivated.
"HAHAHA..." Ye Yun burst out laughing, lightly tapping the two youngsters before him. He chuckled, "You two are the only remaining disciples of the Dragon God Sect. If I don’t nurture you properly, how could I face the deceased Sect Masters of the Dragon God Sect?"
These words made both Luo Li and Jun Moxiao blush deeply.
"These Dragon Tiger Pills are very potent; you can only take one per month," Ye Yun mused for a moment, then softly instructed. After all, Luo Li’s and Jun Moxiao’s bodies were not yet strong enough to withstand the potent effects of the God-level Dragon Tiger Pills.
As for their performance during the trip to the Outer Cloud Sword Sect, Ye Yun gave Luo Li and Jun Moxiao a barely passing grade.
These two are inexperienced in battle, their minds are too naive, and they lack ruthlessness.
Ye Yun thought for a moment, a plan forming in his mind.
After all, the Sword God Sect is still a long way off. There are still eight of the ten great Sects left, plus some quasi-first-rate powers. It would be best to challenge them one by one to properly temper these two youngsters.
With this plan decided, Ye Yun smiled and patted them both on the shoulders.
"Alright, let’s go."
Ye Yun entered the black carriage and gave a command, causing the vehicle to descend to the ground again.
Jun Moxiao and Luo Li hurriedly assented and sat near the front of the carriage.
"NEIGH!" The Black Horse whinnied, its hooves a blur as it sped along the rugged mountain road.
"Ancestor, what happened with the Outer Cloud Sword Sect?" Jun Moxiao was driving the carriage when Luo Li suddenly had a thought and asked.
"Those ants actually dared to covet this carriage..." Ye Yun smiled faintly, not elaborating further.
"Those people deserved to die!" Jun Moxiao said angrily.
Luo Li’s dark eyes darted thoughtfully for a moment, and a look of sudden realization dawned on her exquisite little face. She patted Jun Moxiao’s shoulder and giggled, "Does that even need saying? Of course, they’re all gone..."
Understanding immediately dawned on Jun Moxiao as well, and he began to laugh heartily.
The black carriage traveled onward. After exiting the mountainous region, it entered a stretch of plains. Over a hundred li away, a large, imposing city stood.
A thought flashed through Ye Yun’s mind, and the black carriage came to a halt.
"Ancestor?" Jun Moxiao was surprised, turning his head towards the carriage.
The Black Horse, which had been steadily trotting, suddenly halted.
This could only have happened because the Ancestor commanded it. Otherwise, he knew he couldn’t possibly make this Black Horse stop on his own.
Ye Yun stepped out of the carriage. With a light tap of his finger on Jun Moxiao and Luo Li, their cultivation bases instantly plummeted from the Shaping God Realm down to the Origin Sea Realm.
Jun Moxiao’s cultivation base dropped to the Fourth Level of the Origin Sea Realm.
Luo Li’s fell to the First Level of the Origin Sea Realm.
Feeling their cultivation bases drop so drastically, both of them were visibly aghast!

chapters.title: Chapter 24: Seal, Downgrade, Set the Tone
chapters.content:
Chapter 24: Chapter 24: Seal, Downgrade, Set the Tone
"Elder Ancestor??"
A look of shock was splashed across Luo Li’s small face, unable to comprehend why the Elder Ancestor would be so ruthless towards them.
Their cultivation base had been decreased by an entire Major Realm.
From the Shaping God Realm, they were brought straight down to the Origin Sea Realm!
Ye Yun didn’t speak, merely flicking his finger lightly.
The class of the two Emperor Level Robes was promptly lowered to Earth Level.
Next, the level of the two Divine Swords in their hands also drastically dropped to Earth Level.
Everything was being downgraded.
...
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao exchanged glances, a soul-scattering terror washing over them.
"Elder Ancestor, what are you trying to do?" Jun Moxiao wiped away a tear, his voice choked with sobs.
"To make you stronger!" Ye Yun stood with his hands behind his back, a faint smile appearing on his face.
Seeing their confused expressions, Ye Yun spoke softly, "True Sword Dao geniuses don’t rely on external objects. You two, however, currently rely too much on external aids. If you want to become unparalleled Sword Cultivators on the Cangnan Continent, remember this: you must strive to temper your Sword Heart as much as possible."
"The Sword Heart—the less it relies on external objects and the more it is continuously tempered, the more transparent and clear it becomes, and the more powerful it will grow."
"At that point, there will be nothing that cannot be slain by a single slash of your sword!"
After hearing the Elder Ancestor’s words, Jun Moxiao and Luo Li exchanged glances, blinking vigorously.
This cultivation of the Sword Heart had reshaped their long-held perceptions.
Ye Yun smiled faintly.
It appeared these two inexperienced children needed more time to digest his words.
This course of action was the result of Ye Yun’s careful deliberation along the way.
That Old Sword Saint, who had already achieved invincibility a hundred years ago, undoubtedly possessed transcendent skill in the Sword Dao. Once a Sword Cultivator reaches a certain realm, their combat strength becomes terrifyingly high. And one more important thing: the Old Sword Saint’s Sword Heart had long been incomparably clear, unstained by worldly dust. Such a person, even without a Divine weapon, could unleash supreme swordsmanship with even a simple wooden stick. Of course, this isn’t to say that weapons are to be rejected. If one possesses a Divine weapon, especially one of King Level or higher, it naturally enhances their power like a tiger growing wings. Ye Yun guessed... that Old Sword Saint, a Sword Infatuation deeply immersed in the Sword Dao for many years, must possess a nearly invincible and pellucid Sword Heart. Even if Luo Li and Jun Moxiao were aided by Divine Weapons, they would hardly be a match for the Old Sword Saint.
To hasten their growth, Ye Yun had sealed their cultivation bases. He also sealed their Emperor Level Robes and Divine Swords. This effectively cut off their retreat. It would force them to focus more on their Sword Dao cultivation, free from distractions, and temper a clear Sword Heart. Lowering their cultivation bases would also subject them to greater pressure. Breakthroughs achieved under such immense pressure are even faster than those made during normal cultivation in the Shaping God Realm. To defeat the Old Sword Saint of the Sword God Sect, Ye Yun had set Jun Moxiao and Luo Li on a treacherous path, akin to the perilous trails of Mount Hua. Once they successfully navigated this dangerous path, the future benefits for these two children would be immense. They would become the strongest Sword Dao titans on the Cangnan Continent, their radiance outshining all others.
This method of suppressing one’s cultivation base had also been used on Ye Yun by his master back then. The technique his master employed was identical to Ye Yun’s current approach. That was why, after Ye Yun later cultivated to the Cangnan Continent’s highest echelon, the Eternal Realm, no one at the same level was his opponent. Even ten Eternal Realm Strong Persons combined would not have been his match.
...
「After emerging from the Check-in Space.」
Ye Yun had obtained an unimaginable hoard of resources. Therefore, his initial thought was to simply pile resources onto Jun Moxiao and Luo Li to raise them. However, the appearance of the Old Sword Saint from the Sword God Sect suddenly made Ye Yun realize that this line of thinking had its pitfalls. Resources should, of course, still be used when appropriate. However, he had to impose some restrictions on the two children, forcing them to advance under pressure, so they could achieve even greater accomplishments in the future. He wanted them to strive to one day reach the glorious realm he himself had attained.
"Have you two figured it out?"
After an incense stick’s worth of time had passed, Ye Yun saw their expressions gradually calm, and he smiled gently.
"Elder Ancestor, I think I understand now," Luo Li was the first to speak.
"What about you?" Ye Yun turned his gaze to Jun Moxiao again.
Jun Moxiao’s small face flushed red, and he also quickly nodded.
"That’s good!" Ye Yun shrugged and chuckled, "Next, we will journey and challenge the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from all major sects, letting you experience the thrill of breakthroughs under pressure."
"Okay, Elder Ancestor." Luo Li grew excited, her small face flushing crimson.
Challenging the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from various major powers was something she had never even dreamed of before. Just the thought of it... felt exceptionally thrilling. In her eyes, these Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from major powers had always been lofty, untouchable figures. But now, she could defeat them! For a girl like Luo Li, challenging experts in the Shaping God Realm offered no sense of accomplishment at all. After all, those experts in the Shaping God Realm were all Elder Level figures in their sects, and quite old. But challenging Disciples of Heaven’s Pride in the Origin Sea Realm was different. These prodigies weren’t much older than them; some were even of similar age.
Seeing Luo Li’s excited expression, a thought struck Ye Yun. He gently patted her shoulder and said with a smile, "Luo Li, as the current Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, have you ever considered the future development of the Dragon God Sect?"
Luo Li was momentarily stunned into silence.
When she joined the Dragon God Sect as a child, the sect had only four members in total. As the newly appointed Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, she truly hadn’t given any thought to how the sect would develop.
"Jun Moxiao, what do you think?" Ye Yun then turned his gaze to the blushing Jun Moxiao beside her.
"Elder Ancestor..." Jun Moxiao stammered, "Could it be... you want us to start recruiting sect members now?"
Ye Yun shook his head.
Then he paused, giving the two of them a few minutes to ponder.
After another incense stick’s worth of time, seeing that neither of them had an answer, Ye Yun wasn’t disheartened. After all, these two children were still too young and had experienced too little.
"Hehe!" Ye Yun chuckled, looked at them, and said earnestly, "The development of any sect is inseparable from cultivation resources. If you start accumulating cultivation resources now, then one day, when the Dragon God Sect throws open its mountain gates and recruits disciples far and wide, you won’t have to worry."
Luo Li’s eyes instantly lit up. She giggled, clapping her hands, "Elder Ancestor, you mean... you want us to start plundering resources from the major sects while we challenge them?"
Ye Yun merely smiled without speaking.
Is that really okay?
Jun Moxiao, beside her, looked utterly shocked.
He looked helpless and said, "Senior Sister, we are the dignified Successors of the Dragon God Sect. Are we really going to rob others of their resources?"
"Hmph!" Luo Li placed her small hands on her hips, looking fierce and declared with conviction, "Why not rob? The Cultivation World has always been one where the strong prey on the weak! If our Dragon God Sect wants to grow and prosper in the future, resources are indispensable. The Elder Ancestor can’t shield us forever... We, senior sister and junior brother, will have to face the turbulent storms sooner or later, so we must start preparing now!"
Hearing Luo Li’s words, Jun Moxiao blinked, seeming to understand.
Luo Li waved her small fist and continued fiercely, "Little Junior Brother, the Elder Ancestor has already reached the True God Realm. He might leave the Cangnan Continent at any moment. When that time comes, everything will depend on us, senior sister and junior brother. So, while the Elder Ancestor is still with us, we must seize the opportunity to gather as many resources as possible!"
Hearing Luo Li articulate her thoughts so clearly, a look of admiration appeared on Ye Yun’s face.
Back then, when he was cultivating in the Dragon God Sect, he himself had plundered resources from countless sects. That was precisely what laid the foundation for the Dragon God Sect’s eventual promotion to an Eternal Sect. Now, this responsibility fell upon this pair of senior sister and junior brother.

chapters.title: Chapter 25: Ye Yun, the Villain from 100,000 Years Ago
chapters.content:
Chapter 25: Chapter 25: Ye Yun, the Villain from 100,000 Years Ago
"Haha, Senior Sister, I finally understand what you mean!"
Jun Moxiao suddenly became excited. He clenched his fists tightly and laughed, "Senior Sister, from now on, are we going to pillage, murder, and commit all sorts of atrocities?"
Luo Li glared at him in annoyance.
"Junior Brother, is that how you interpret my words?"
"No, no!" Jun Moxiao scratched his head and chuckled sheepishly.
At this moment, Ye Yun cast an approving glance at Jun Moxiao.
He looked at Luo Li and smiled, "Jun Moxiao isn’t entirely wrong. The Cultivation World is truly about the weak being prey to the strong. If you don’t plunder them, they will plunder you. If you rob them, they will certainly seek revenge. If you don’t kill them, they will inevitably kill you."
Luo Li recalled her encounters at the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge and nodded repeatedly in agreement.
The Ancestor was right...
This world is so cruel and realistic. In the beginning, the Dragon God Sect was so weak, yet it was constantly bullied by those more powerful.
Now, everything has changed!
Now, she and her Junior Brother were going to be the ones bullying others!
Plunder elixirs, Cultivation Techniques, Divine Soldiers, and all the treasures of heaven and earth...
Plunder every last bit of it!
Seeing Luo Li’s expression continually change, her eyes shining brightly and her aura growing stronger, Ye Yun smiled faintly. With a flip of his hand, he produced two rings.
He handed one to Jun Moxiao and the other to Luo Li.
He instructed softly, "These are God-level storage rings. I’ve concealed their auras. The space within each is immense. I hope you will fill them with the resources you plunder..."
"Exactly how big are they?!"
Curiosity piqued, Luo Li quickly slipped on the storage ring. She released her Divine Sense into it and immediately discovered a vast, boundless space that seemed endless.
"Heavens, Ancestor, it’s so big inside! How long would it possibly take us to fill this entire space?"
Luo Li stuck out her tongue, her face a mask of shock, then burst into laughter.
"Indeed, Ancestor," Jun Moxiao echoed, a wry smile on his face.
Ye Yun laughed heartily. "The path of cultivation is endless, so just keep plundering. In the future, our Dragon God Sect will not only stand tall on the Cangnan Continent but will also take root in other places."
Luo Li’s heart skipped a beat.
She asked in shock, "Ancestor, are you saying there are other continents?"
Jun Moxiao also looked at Ye Yun in confusion.
In his mind, the world consisted only of the Cangnan Continent, a place so vast and boundless that one could not hope to explore its entirety in a single lifetime.
"That’s right. The Cangnan Continent is merely an island. Beyond this island lie even larger continents, and over there, you’ll find even more powerful experts."
Ye Yun stood with his hands clasped behind his back, gazing into the distant void.
At that moment, his gaze seemed to pierce through eternity, through the entire Cangnan Continent, beholding the magnificent sight beyond the sea.
"Wow, that’s truly incredible!" Luo Li exclaimed, her heart leaping with excitement as she clapped her hands.
The Ancestor’s words had ignited a spark of conviction within her.
The Dragon God Sect wouldn’t just develop into a top-tier Eternal Sect on the Cangnan Continent; in the future, it would also branch out and establish itself on other continents.
This gave her immense motivation.
"Alright, don’t overthink things for now. Just focus on tempering yourselves in this little Ancient Moon Dynasty... When the day comes that you break through to the Eternal Realm, then you can consider exploring the world beyond."
Ye Yun reached out and lightly tapped each of them on the head, then withdrew his hand, a gentle smile on his face.
「A hundred thousand years ago...」
After reaching the Eternal Realm within the Dragon God Sect, he had once flown beyond the vast island of the Cangnan Continent.
However, the other side of the island was fraught with unimaginable dangers. He was utterly unable to cross that perilous expanse to reach the equally unimaginable continent beyond.
According to Ye Yun’s speculation, only upon reaching the True God Realm, or beyond, would one be able to break through that forbidden expanse of sea and reach that other continent.
Therefore, once he had helped Luo Li and Jun Moxiao reach a certain level, he planned to leave this place and venture to the lands beyond the sea.
"Ancestor," Luo Li touched her head and said with a playful grin, "for our first stop, which power should we go and challenge?"
Ye Yun shook his head, gazing at the city ahead with a smile. "No need to rush. There’s a city right in front of us. I’m hungry. Let’s go there and get something to eat first."
"Alright, Ancestor." Luo Li stuck out her little pink tongue.
The Ancestor had already reached the True God Realm, yet he still enjoyed the delicacies of the mortal world.
As a Cultivator at her level, the Shaping God Realm, she would be perfectly fine even if she didn’t eat or drink for an entire year.
Luo Li herself had long lost interest in ordinary mortal food.
After Ye Yun returned to the carriage, Jun Moxiao took the reins. The black carriage continued on its way and, before long, entered the city ahead.
This city was called Solitary Cloud City. The black carriage drove down a bustling street and stopped in front of a tavern.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao leaped down from the front of the carriage and respectfully helped Ye Yun alight.
The three of them entered the tavern, only to find it packed to the rafters and bustling with business.
"Esteemed guests, we’re completely full at the moment. Please wait a short while," a young attendant said with a smile, walking over and bowing obsequiously.
"Isn’t there a private room?" Luo Li’s expression darkened, and she frowned.
Her Ancestor was such an esteemed figure; how could he possibly dine in such a noisy and chaotic place?
"We do have one private room, but it has been reserved in advance. I must ask you three to please wait patiently for a little while," the attendant said with a smile.
"Since the party who booked it hasn’t arrived, this private room is ours. If that person shows up, just send them to me."
Luo Li pushed the attendant aside with a sweep of her palm and strode towards the second floor.
Watching Senior Sister Luo Li act so brazenly, Jun Moxiao couldn’t help but stick out his tongue, a mischievous expression on his face.
Recalling what Senior Sister Luo Li had said earlier, Jun Moxiao could understand her current behavior.
Because, from now on...
They were going to become "villains."
The Cultivation World operated under the law of the jungle.
In a mere tavern in a mortal city, as long as one had strength, what was snatching a private room?
Especially when it was for an Ancestor in the True God Realm, snatching a private room was practically a supreme honor!
Ye Yun observed this with a faint smile.
He was quite satisfied with Luo Li’s rapid transformation.
The strong should possess the demeanor of the strong.
Wherever one went, one must never suffer a loss and absolutely must display one’s strength.
If anyone dared to provoke them, no mercy should be shown; they should be beaten until they were thoroughly convinced and submitted!
The Ye Yun of old had also been a renowned tyrant on the Cangnan Continent.
He had even dared to harass the Saintess of the Ice Phoenix Sect—a sect as famous as the Dragon God Sect—going so far as to secretly watch her bathe and then brazenly appear before her.
This just showed the depths of his audacity and arrogance...

chapters.title: Chapter 26: In Memory of the Saintess of Ice Phoenix Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 26: Chapter 26: In Memory of the Saintess of Ice Phoenix Sect
Recalling the Saintess of the Ice Phoenix Sect, a look of nostalgia crossed Ye Yun’s face.
Ah, that young lass! With her stunning figure and a beauty that could outshine the moon and make flowers blush—she was truly a sight to behold! It was just that she always wore a frosty, stern expression on her beautiful little face, as if everyone owed her money, which was incredibly vexing. So, whenever Ye Yun had nothing better to do, he would go and tease this Saintess.
The relations between the two Eternal Level Sects were extremely strained, frequently leading to warfare. Fortunately, both sides exercised restraint and didn’t engage in truly decisive, all-out battles, allowing both Sects to preserve their strength.
Otherwise, if these two titanic Eternal Level Sects were to truly wage an all-out war, the entire Cangnan Continent would likely be unable to withstand the ensuing devastation.
Upon reaching the third floor, Luo Li found an attendant, asked for an available private room, and took the lead in entering. She found the room’s ambiance elegant and hurried back to Ye Yun, smiling, "Ancestor, this private room’s environment is quite nice. Shall we dine here?"
"Alright!" Ye Yun nodded and stepped inside.
Jun Moxiao stood at the entrance, clasping his sword with both hands, his expression highly vigilant.
Luo Li, on the other hand, entered the private room and stood beside Ye Yun, smiling obediently, "Ancestor, what would you like to eat? I’ll go place the order for you."
Ye Yun grinned, "No need to go through all that trouble. Just bring us all the signature dishes from here."
"Yes, Ancestor." Luo Li immediately turned and went out to arrange the order with an attendant.
Ye Yun’s gaze pierced through the wall. Seeing Jun Moxiao at the door, vigilant as if facing a formidable enemy, he couldn’t help but find it amusing.
"Jun Moxiao, no need to stand there like a statue. Come on in," Ye Yun instructed.
Jun Moxiao shook his head resolutely, "Ancestor, you go ahead and enjoy your meal. I’m worried that someone might attempt to snatch our private room."
Seeing Jun Moxiao’s unflinching loyalty, Ye Yun decided to let it pass.
For Ye Yun, who was in the True God Realm, the desire to eat some mortal food was simply to reminisce about his time on Earth.
Just then, Luo Li trotted back in and stood beside Ye Yun.
"Luo Li, come sit down and eat something too."
"Ancestor, I’m not hungry at all. And truthfully, I don’t have much interest in worldly food," Luo Li said, waving her hands repeatedly, her face slightly flushed.
In fact, she had already consumed a Dragon Tiger Pill on the way. The pill’s potent effects still made her feel uncomfortably bloated, so she couldn’t eat anything at that moment.
"Alright then." Ye Yun naturally understood, smiled faintly, and didn’t point it out.
Soon, a variety of exquisite dishes were served on the table.
Ye Yun casually noticed that the young attendant serving the dishes looked frightened, seemingly harboring a deep fear of this particular private room. He began to leisurely enjoy his mortal delicacies.
It seems... the person who reserved this private room has quite an extraordinary status. This young attendant is also afraid of their identity.
A thought suddenly struck Ye Yun, and his gaze shifted to the cashier’s counter on the first floor. The tavern’s old shopkeeper was currently as anxious as an ant on a hot pan.
At this very moment, several youths dressed in blood-red robes walked in from outside. These youths were valiant and extraordinary, each one exuding a formidable killing intent, as if shrouded in an aura of fresh blood. They were clearly not to be trifled with.
"Shopkeeper, which floor is our private room on?" asked the leader, a youth with a jade-like complexion, around seventeen or eighteen years old. Despite his youth, he was already at the sixth level of the Origin Sea Realm.
The old shopkeeper’s face instantly turned grim. He hurriedly stepped forward, a fawning smile on his face, "Young Master Bai, you’ve arrived just in time! Three unreasonable guests upstairs have actually occupied your private room."
"What? Someone dared to occupy the private room?" Before the youth surnamed Bai could even speak, the youths behind him erupted in anger.
"Interesting!" A cold glint flashed across Bai Yufeng’s bewitchingly handsome face. He sneered, "Excellent. In Solitary Cloud City, someone actually dares to snatch the private room reserved by my Blood Robe Sect!"
"Senior Brother Bai, let’s go up and see who these blind fools are! We’ll definitely break their damn legs!" exclaimed one youth, his eyes bloodshot and brimming with killing intent.
"Let’s go!" Bai Yufeng snorted heavily and led his group of junior brothers to the third floor.
"Attendant, where is our private room?" As soon as they reached the top of the stairs, Bai Yufeng grabbed an attendant by the landing.
The young attendant, recognizing these youths in blood-red robes, turned pale with fright and quickly pointed in a certain direction.
Bai Yufeng tilted his head, looking in that direction. He saw a youth standing at the entrance of that private room, a longsword in hand, his expression vigilant. He sized him up and down, discovering that this person’s cultivation base was not low—fourth level of the Origin Sea Realm.
But so what? Their Blood Robe Sect was one of the ten great powers of the Ancient Moon Dynasty, and the few of them present were also in the Origin Sea Realm.
The Blood Robe Sect even had a branch in Solitary Cloud City. Bai Yufeng couldn’t believe that someone had dared to snatch a private room right under their noses, on their own turf. This was a blatant slap in the face to the Blood Robe Sect.
A surge of anger flared within him. Bai Yufeng’s face darkened as he strode forward.
At this point, Jun Moxiao also saw the group. His lips curled, and a cruel smile appeared on his young, tender face.
So, the arrivals were disciples of the infamous Blood Robe Sect.
"You dare to snatch the private room?" Bai Yufeng advanced to about three meters away, his hand on his sword hilt, glaring coldly at Jun Moxiao.
"First come, first served. How can you call it snatching?" Jun Moxiao replied, his eyelids lowered, his expression impassive.
"He dares to snatch from our Blood Robe Sect! Kill him!" several Blood Robe Sect disciples beside him roared angrily.
They all drew their swords, shouting as they rushed towards Jun Moxiao.
"Little Junior Brother, I’ll help you!" Luo Li suddenly rushed out, sword in hand. She and Jun Moxiao, side by side, manipulated their sword light and charged into the fight.
Two against seven. In an instant, both sides were locked in fierce combat.
Jun Moxiao faced Bai Yufeng, who was at the sixth level of the Origin Sea Realm. Luo Li, meanwhile, took on the other six Origin Sea Realm disciples of the Blood Robe Sect by herself.
WHOOSH! WHOOSH!
Streaks of sword light flew through the air. Accompanied by successive shrieks of pain, the Blood Robe Sect disciples were struck by swords one after another, blood gushing from their wounds. They were no match at all.
The entire third floor, due to the rampant Sword Qi, saw most of its tables, chairs, and rooms destroyed. The tavern’s losses were truly disastrous.
"Who are you people?" Bai Yufeng stared at the young pair in shock, clutching the bleeding hole in his shoulder. These two didn’t have high cultivation realms, yet their swordsmanship was executed with divine skill. Their combat prowess was unbelievably high! At a glance, it was clear they were exceptional Disciples of Heaven’s Pride, nurtured by some major Sect.
"Leave your swords and storage rings, and you can scram. Otherwise, none of you will be leaving at all! Understand?" Luo Li brought her Supreme Divine Dragon Sword to her lips, gently blowing on the blade. A mocking smile played on her exquisite little face.

chapters.title: Chapter 27 Ancestral Teachings
chapters.content:
Chapter 27: Chapter 27 Ancestral Teachings
"Daydreaming!"
Bai Yufeng’s face twisted. Gritting his teeth, he said viciously, "You want us to leave our Swords and storage rings? How is that possible? Let’s go!"
With that, he turned and prepared to leave the tavern with his men.
"Shameless fools, unable to appreciate kindness!"
Luo Li’s beautiful face turned deathly pale with anger.
This was the first time she had acted as a "villain." Her harsh words, however, failed to intimidate them, which irked her immensely.
"Senior Sister, we absolutely can’t let them get away!" Jun Moxiao shouted, then chased after Bai Yufeng and his followers.
Luo Li’s expression hardened, and she quickly followed.
SHINK! SHINK!
Sword light surged like a tide.
The Disciples of Blood Cloth Sect sustained several more wounds, adding to their existing injuries, and completely lost their fighting capacity.
Jun Moxiao forcefully took the storage rings and the Swords from their hands.
"You may leave now."
Luo Li frowned. The entire third floor was a bloody mess.
This tavern was run by ordinary folk. It was just a small business. Besides, the Ancestor was still dining, so it wouldn’t be good to kill people here.
So, she suppressed her killing intent.
Bai Yufeng, having been struck by seven or eight sword blows, grew increasingly pale, but his eyes still emanated a crazed arrogance.
"You... just wait!"
He spat out the threat and led his junior brothers in a hasty departure from the tavern.
"Wait then. Let’s see what tricks you can possibly pull."
Jun Moxiao sheathed his Sword, sneering disdainfully.
Returning to their private room, they saw Ye Yun smiling gently at them.
Luo Li, looking ashamed, said, "Ancestor, I’m sorry for the ruckus outside just now. Did it disturb your meal?"
Ye Yun put down his chopsticks, his expression serene, and said slowly, "Is there a Blood Robe Sect Sub-branch in this city?"
"There should be..." Luo Li thought for a moment and quickly nodded. She remembered that Solitary Cloud City was indeed within the Blood Robe Sect’s sphere of influence, and they had a sub-branch here.
"What were his last words to you?" Ye Yun smiled faintly and asked gently.
"He told me to wait." Luo Li puffed out her chest and said proudly, "I’m not afraid. So what if they call more people?"
"Luo Li," Ye Yun looked up, his gaze soft, and said calmly, "Time waits for no one. You don’t need to wait either. Go directly to the Blood Robe Sect Sub-branch. Why wait? It’s pointless."
Luo Li blinked, a flash of realization in her eyes.
"I was wrong!" Luo Li, her face flushed with embarrassment, nodded vigorously. "Ancestor, you’re right! Time waits for no one, so why should I wait? Since we’ve made an enemy, we should attack directly!"
"This one is teachable," Ye Yun chuckled and picked up his chopsticks again.
In his heart, he would destroy anyone who dared to provoke him, no matter who they were. Even if it were the Heavenly Dao itself, if it angered him, he would shatter it.
Having received the Ancestor’s approval, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao hurried downstairs.
Just as they reached the entrance, a gentle voice reached their ears.
"Take the carriage."
"Alright, Ancestor!" Luo Li giggled.
It seemed... the Ancestor had indeed prepared a contingency for them! This black carriage was an incredible Divine Artifact, and the Black Horse pulling it was equally mysterious and terrifying. To this day, Luo Li was still unsure what terrifying cultivation base this Black Horse had reached. Even a powerhouse of the Shaping God Realm might not be a match for the Black Horse.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao boarded the carriage and sped towards the Blood Robe Sect Sub-branch.
Before long, she spotted several familiar figures.
Their black carriage raced past and then suddenly stopped.
An exquisitely beautiful face peeked out from the carriage window.
Upon seeing Luo Li, Bai Yufeng was shocked. He shouted, "We gave you the Swords and the storage rings! Are you still not satisfied?"
"No need to call for backup. We’re heading directly to your Blood Robe Sect Sub-branch!" Luo Li raised an eyebrow and sneered.
CLIP-CLOP!
The sound of horse hooves echoed.
The black carriage abruptly sped off, disappearing from everyone’s sight.
"Senior Brother Bai, do those two really dare to go to the sub-branch?" one of the younger disciples nearby asked.
"Those two fools! They might be somewhat strong, but our Blood Robe Sect Sub-branch has a Shaping God Realm Elder presiding over it!" Bai Yufeng gritted his teeth and said hatefully.
He secretly hoped the two of them would go to the Blood Robe Sect Sub-branch and get themselves killed.
"Haha..." The surrounding disciples laughed, but the movement aggravated their injuries, and blood began to flow freely.
The Blood Robe Sect Sub-branch was located in the northern district of Solitary Cloud City. The tavern they had been in earlier was in the southern district.
Riding in the black carriage, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao quickly arrived at the Blood Robe Sect Sub-branch.
"Who goes there? Stop!"
Seeing an unfamiliar black carriage speeding towards them, two Mysterious Pill Realm disciples guarding the gate of the Blood Robe Sect immediately moved to block the entrance.
"Get out of the way!" Luo Li waved her Sword, unleashing two blasts of Sword Qi.
The two Mysterious Pill Realm disciples were struck by the Sword Qi and collapsed, unable to get up.
BOOM!
The black carriage smashed through the main gate of the Blood Robe Sect Sub-branch and charged inside.
Witnessing the Black Horse’s ferocious charge, Jun Moxiao suddenly felt incredibly excited. His face beamed with exhilaration, though his body trembled slightly.
"Senior Sister, why do I feel so exceptionally thrilled?"
"Because you’re not a bad person!" Luo Li replied with a chuckle, holding her Sword.
Jun Moxiao looked at the crowd surging towards them and said with a self-deprecating laugh, "Perhaps it’s because we used to be weak and were so used to being bullied. This time... we can finally hold our heads high."
Luo Li smiled. "We are not bloodthirsty. If these people are sensible and obediently offer their weapons and storage rings, we can spare their lives."
"But if they show any killing intent, show no mercy! Kill them with a single strike!"
"Alright!" Jun Moxiao nodded in agreement.
"Junior Brother..." Luo Li looked in a certain direction, her expression full of admiration. "The Ancestor exhaled a breath of pure air, and everyone in Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge was reduced to ashes. We must also possess such decisiveness and power."
"Senior Sister, you’re right." A look of profound understanding appeared on Jun Moxiao’s face.
His sword heart grew increasingly clear.
After the black carriage drove into the main square, many Disciples of Blood Cloth Sect rushed out from all directions.
Everyone stared at the black carriage in shock.
Rage surged within them. These two Origin Sea Realm youngsters were too arrogant, weren’t they? They actually drove a carriage and broke down the gate of their Blood Robe Sect Sub-branch! This was a grave provocation!
"Who are you?" An emaciated elder in a blood-red robe walked out from the crowd, his face cold and stern as he stared at the two.
"You are not worthy to know!" Luo Li’s gaze was like frost, her tone resolute.
She stared at the Elder, a cultivator at the First Level of the Shaping God Realm, and said calmly, "The Disciples of Blood Cloth Sect are arrogant and tyrannical, and they deserve severe punishment. Quickly lay down your weapons, hand over your storage rings, and flee if you value your lives!"
Hearing Luo Li’s words, the Blood Robe Sect Elder, a cultivator of the Shaping God Realm, trembled with rage. His sallow, aged face instantly turned as white as frost.

chapters.title: Chapter 28: Breakthrough in Battle, Origin Sea Realm Level 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 28: Chapter 28: Breakthrough in Battle, Origin Sea Realm Level 2
"Attention to all Origin Sea Realm disciples of the Blood Robe Sect!"
"Slaughter the two provocateurs at once! The first one whose sword draws blood will be rewarded with a bottle of Heavenly Level Cultivation Pill!"
The Elder of the Blood Robe Sect issued the kill order with a harsh expression.
Upon hearing the reward was a bottle of Heavenly Level Cultivation Pill, the Origin Sea Realm Disciples of Blood Cloth Sect howled. Their spirits soared, and with beast-like, blood-red eyes, they wielded their swords and charged to kill.
"Haha, Senior Sister, our chance to hone our swords has arrived!"
Facing the swarm of Disciples of Blood Cloth Sect from all sides, Jun Moxiao showed no fear. Instead, he was excited, his blood boiled with anticipation.
There were about forty to fifty Origin Sea Realm cultivators around them. Such a large number of enemies would indeed put great pressure on them.
In the face of life and death, their cultivation base and battle experience could achieve rapid breakthroughs.
Although there were many Disciples of Blood Cloth Sect surrounding them, none possessed a cultivation base at the sixth layer of the Origin Sea Realm, like Bai Yufeng. Most ranged from the first to the fifth layer of the Origin Sea Realm.
"Junior Brother, I just took a Dragon Tiger Pill, and I’m itching for a fight! Come, let’s go kill with your Senior Sister!" Luo Li laughed heartily and sprang into the air.
A blaze of sword light whistled out in all directions.
Jun Moxiao also executed the Nine Changes of the God Dragon, transforming into several phantoms. While in mid-air, he unleashed the Dragon God Sword Technique. The sword light was like a silver river flowing on the ground, attacking in all directions.
The prowess of these two in Sword Dao was slightly inferior compared to their Divine Dragon Nine-Change Body Technique.
So, even though they were besieged by forty to fifty Origin Sea Realm cultivators, the two’s movement techniques were agile and divine. Amidst the tidal wave of attacks, they were able to maneuver effortlessly.
WHOOSH! WHOOSH!
Sword lights shot from all around.
The phantoms crisscrossed the square, and none of the attacks could touch the two of them.
Although they dodged wave after wave of attacks, it wasn’t easy for their own strikes to land on their opponents either. After all, for every single attack they launched, a dozen opponents would counterattack simultaneously.
BOOM! BOOM!...
The Sword Qi of both sides collided in the air, then exploded and vanished.
The battle was extremely fierce.
The Shaping God Realm Elder of the Blood Robe Sect, standing with his hands behind his back, watched this battle with a stern face.
These two youths, despite their relatively low cultivation levels, possess significant combat abilities!
he thought.
Exactly what power... could nurture such talents? The other major ten Sects don’t seem to have heard of these two.
"Hmm?" The Elder’s eyes flickered as he noticed several heavily injured disciples running in.
"How did you sustain such severe injuries?" Elder Liu looked stunned when he saw Bai Yufeng, his heart leaping in his chest.
Bai Yufeng was one of the top ten Disciples of Heaven’s Pride of their Sect. Although his ranking was low among them, it was still a significant matter for him to be so severely injured.
While Elder Liu was lost in thought, Bai Yufeng stared intently at the battle. To his shock, he realized the young man and woman who had broken into the Blood Robe Sect Sub-branch were now fighting his fellow disciples.
These two individuals, with their exceptional agility, dodged attacks like swimming dragons, their swords flashing like rain, yet not a single strike touched them. Even though they were besieged by many, they remained unscathed for the moment.
What kind of movement technique is this?
Bai Yufeng was utterly shocked. As a Disciple of Heaven’s Pride, he was exceptionally knowledgeable, but he had never seen such an incredible movement technique."Elder Liu, we were injured by them, and they took our swords and storage rings! Please, Elder, you must help us take revenge!" a Disciple of Blood Cloth Sect cried out to Elder Liu, his face contorted in grief.
"Rest assured, they won’t get away," Elder Liu nodded sullenly.
They had caused chaos at his Blood Robe Sect Sub-branch, injured Sect Disciples, and even stolen their swords and storage rings. How could he let them escape? If they escaped, he might as well resign as an Elder of the Blood Robe Sect.
「In a private room of the tavern.」
Ye Yun casually ate a bite of food, looked in a certain direction, and simply nodded.
On their way, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao had both taken a Dragon Tiger Pill. The power of the medicine hadn’t completely dispersed yet; much of it was stored in their bodies. Currently, with forty to fifty Origin Sea Realm Disciples of Blood Cloth Sect assaulting them, they both felt immense pressure.
Perhaps... the two of them can seize this opportunity to make a breakthrough.
Ye Yun mused.
Even with Ye Yun’s Seal suppressing them to the Origin Sea Realm, any minor advancement they made would be equivalent to advancing a full level in the Shaping God Realm. Thus, it wouldn’t affect Luo Li and Jun Moxiao’s true cultivation base. Ye Yun hoped the two could learn to fight opponents above their level without external help. This way, when they acquired Divine Weapons in the future, they could battle even stronger opponents who were above their level.
WHOOSH!
After Jun Moxiao repelled several disciples with one swing of his sword, he transformed into a Divine Dragon Phantom and vanished into thin air. Suddenly, he heard a faint sound in his ear.
A phantom descended from the sky, solidifying from an ethereal state. At that moment, Jun Moxiao sensed his Senior Sister’s cultivation base reach the Yuanhai Realm Second Layer.
Senior Sister actually broke through!
Jun Moxiao was overjoyed.
At that moment, the sword lights of more than ten Disciples of Blood Cloth Sect surged towards him like quicksilver. He hurriedly rushed forward and blocked this wave of sword lights.
After Luo Li broke through, her battle power surged, and she fiercely unleashed numerous sword lights.
This girl... she actually broke through in the middle of the fight!
Bai Yufeng gritted his teeth, wishing he could join the battle too.
Those who can break through during a battle... they are all peerless prodigies.
"Elder Liu, you can no longer stand idly by! Otherwise, that boy might break through as well!" Bai Yufeng said resentfully.
Elder Liu’s face was gloomy; he also sensed the severity of the situation. He drew his treasured sword, ready to join the battle and end it quickly, killing these two Origin Sea Realm provocateurs.
Suddenly, he caught sight of a black carriage at one side of the square out of the corner of his eye.
THUMP!
The Black Horse gently pawed the ground with its hoof, producing a crisp sound.
This crisp sound was like a thunderclap in Elder Liu’s ear, leaving him stunned on the spot.
The Black Horse raised its head, looking directly at him.
In that instant, Elder Liu felt as if he were engulfed by endless darkness. Within it, two enormous, blood-red eyes, like small mountains, rose and gazed ominously at him. At this moment, he felt incredibly insignificant. Looking up into the darkness, he saw a terrifying, towering Demon King looking down at him from above the Nine Heavens.
Elder Liu was drenched in a cold sweat, his whole body seemingly frozen. He stood rooted to the spot, daring not move a muscle.
Bai Yufeng found this strange.
Elder Liu... wasn’t he about to kill those two? Why has he suddenly broken out in a cold sweat and frozen on the spot, not daring to move?
"Elder Liu, what’s wrong?" Bai Yufeng quietly asked from the side.
Elder Liu didn’t utter a word, his expression dull, still immersed in that terrifying dark world.
Bai Yufeng sensed something was amiss. He scanned his surroundings but found nothing out of the ordinary. Feeling a bit uneasy, he shouted to the Mysterious Pill Realm disciples, "Everyone join the attack! Kill these invading enemies!"
"Yes!" A hundred Mysterious Pill Realm Disciples of Blood Cloth Sect shouted in unison. Their voices boomed like rolling thunder, carrying an immense killing intent!
Waves of sword light rained down from all directions, converging in the center.
The pressure on Luo Li and Jun Moxiao increased dramatically.
In an instant, the situation on the square drastically changed!

chapters.title: Chapter 29 Jun Moxiao Breaks Through
chapters.content:
Chapter 29: Chapter 29 Jun Moxiao Breaks Through
Although the Blood Robe Sect’s Xuan Dan Stage Disciples weren’t particularly powerful, they made up for it in numbers. With over two hundred of them continually launching long-range sword light attacks from the periphery, the pressure on Luo Li and Jun Moxiao intensified. The slight advantage Luo Li had gained from her recent breakthrough was now completely gone. The two could only rely on the unpredictable Nine Changes of the God Dragon to maneuver and defend themselves.
Having grown up and cultivated together, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao’s combat coordination was exceptionally in sync. While evading attacks, they would, as if by unspoken agreement, seize opportunities to launch sneak attacks on the Xuan Dan Stage Disciples at the outer rim.
Initially, they succeeded, eliminating dozens of Xuan Dan Stage Disciples.
However, the Blood Robe Sect quickly adjusted its strategy. They organized their Origin Sea Realm disciples into several Sword Arrays, whose members coordinated with extreme skill, successfully intercepting all of Luo Li and Jun Moxiao’s attacks.
「In the private room of the tavern.」
Ye Yun picked up a piece of braised pork, placed it in his mouth, and chewed slowly, a faint smile playing on his lips as he watched the battle unfold.
Suppressing their cultivation realms, treasures, and Robes has indeed greatly aided their Cultivation. Luo Li was the first to break through. And looking at Jun Moxiao, he seems to be on the verge of his breakthrough as well. After all, they both just consumed a Demigod Dragon Tiger Pill. This pill is a supreme treasure for Cultivation. No other pill of this level has ever appeared on the Cangnan Continent. Ordinary Dragon Tiger Pills can only be found in Sects at or above the Heaven Level.
On the Cangnan Continent, Sect forces were divided into five levels: Regular, Major Sects, Super Sages, Heaven Level, and Eternal Level.
The so-called top ten forces in the Ancient Moon Dynasty are merely Regular Sects. None of them can even be considered Major Sects. On the Cangnan Continent, there were only three Eternal Sects, the highest level, even one hundred thousand years ago. This just shows how powerful Eternal Sects are; they’re practically behemoths on the Cangnan Continent. Even a random Disciple from one could cause world-ending destruction. However, Eternal Level Sects should now be located at the center of the Cangnan Continent, where Spiritual Energy is most abundant. As for the distance from the Ancient Moon Dynasty... who knows how many hundreds of millions of miles that is!
In the eyes of Ye Yun, who had once been the Sect Master of an Eternal Level Sect, the so-called top ten forces of the Ancient Moon Dynasty were nothing more than ants. Besides, Ye Yun had now reached the True God Realm. All living beings were like ants in his eyes. He felt no pity.
Observing the long river of time, one would realize that life is just an endless cycle of growth, one generation after another. Even if one generation is wiped out, another will soon sprout.
Therefore, Ye Yun, the invincible True God, felt no emotional ripples when killing. It was like crushing a few ants. The life level of a True God was beyond the comprehension of ordinary Cultivators.
「The Plaza.」
The battle here was now extremely perilous. Jun Moxiao and Luo Li, relying on their powerful physiques, were tenaciously holding on.
Suddenly, with a loud BANG, Jun Moxiao’s body trembled slightly, and he abruptly fell from mid-air. At this very moment, he had successfully broken through from the fourth layer of the Origin Sea Realm to the fifth!
Seeing this, Luo Li quickly rushed over, unleashing a wave of sword light to block an incoming volley of attacks for Jun Moxiao.
"Haha, Little Junior Brother, congratulations! You’ve broken through too!"
"Yes, Senior Sister!"
After his breakthrough, Jun Moxiao’s Super Divine Dragon Breath grew even stronger. He swung his Sword, launching counterattacks in all directions. Although he had only advanced one small layer, it shouldn’t be forgotten that his original cultivation base had reached the Shaping God Realm. Now, having made a breakthrough while his cultivation base was suppressed, the increase in combat power far exceeded that of a conventional breakthrough.
At this point, Jun Moxiao immediately switched from a defensive to an offensive stance, no longer looking so battered.
Seeing this, Bai Yufeng couldn’t help but stomp his feet repeatedly in frustration.
Who on earth are this young man and woman? How can they achieve breakthroughs consecutively in battle?
"Elder Liu, why haven’t you made a move yet?" Bai Yufeng glowered at Elder Liu beside him, who was drenched in a cold sweat and trembling, then gave him an irate shove.
What time is it for him to be daydreaming?!
"Oh..." Elder Liu gasped softly, as if waking from a dream.
He was drenched in sweat, constantly wiping it away as he stared at the terrifying Black Horse in the distance, his body still trembling uncontrollably.
"Elder Liu, what in the world is wrong with you?" Bai Yufeng’s face darkened as he questioned him with extreme dissatisfaction.
Elder Liu was at a loss for words.
He wanted to join the fight, but he was terrified of that monstrous Black Horse. If he didn’t participate, he would likely face the Sect’s punishment. It was death either way.
Gritting his teeth, Elder Liu drew his Sword and charged towards Luo Li.
CLOP!
With the crisp sound of a single horse’s hoof, Elder Liu, then mid-air, suddenly heard a thunderous roar that made his head BUZZ. He instantly lost consciousness and plummeted to the ground.
"Damn it! That Elder Liu is faking his death!" Bai Yufeng seethed, grinding his teeth. Emboldened by a surge of malice, he snatched up a Sword and viciously stabbed at the fallen Elder Liu. The Sword pierced his chest, rupturing his heart, and the unconscious Elder Liu died on the spot.
"Brother Bai, why did you kill Elder Liu?" an injured Disciple beside him asked, his voice trembling.
