"He retreated in the face of battle! What use is such an Elder? I am cleansing the Sect’s ranks!" Having killed someone, Bai Yufeng’s audacity seemed to swell, and he spoke with vicious ferocity.
The other Disciples fell silent as cicadas in winter, not daring to even breathe loudly. However, they, too, had indeed noticed. This Elder Liu of the Blood Robe Sect Sub-branch, a Shaping God Realm cultivator, was indeed shirking his duties, leading to massive casualties for the Blood Robe Sect Sub-branch. Therefore, no one internally objected when Brother Bai suddenly struck down Elder Liu.
"Junior Brothers!" Bai Yufeng raised his Sword with one hand and roared furiously. "We must kill these two, even if it costs us our lives!"
Today... this battle can no longer end peacefully. If we don’t kill these two, all of us will die!
Hearing Bai Yufeng’s words, the Blood Robe Sect Disciples’ spirits lifted, and they desperately besieged Luo Li and Jun Moxiao with frenzied attacks.
The pair, however, did not falter. They remained calm and composed, evading attacks while counter-attacking, not falling significantly behind.
「Two hours later.」
Most of the Blood Robe Sect Disciples were pale and covered in cold sweat; both their stamina and Mana were severely depleted. But Luo Li and Jun Moxiao were still brimming with energy and vigor.
"Senior Sister, they’re almost done for!" Jun Moxiao laughed heartily, his Swordsmanship becoming even sharper.
A wave of sword light cascaded down. Instantly, three Origin Sea Realm Blood Robe Sect Disciples were struck by the Sword; they screamed and retreated.
"Kill!" Luo Li also launched a ferocious counterattack.
In an instant, they routed the Blood Robe Sect Disciples, forcing them into a continuous retreat. Many suffered grievous wounds, blood gushing from their injuries.
At this point, looks of utter terror filled the eyes of the Blood Robe Sect Disciples. The battle had lasted for nearly four hours, yet this young man and woman showed no signs of fatigue whatsoever!
What the hell... Are they even human?!

chapters.title: Chapter 30: The Saintess has a crush on Jun Moxiao
chapters.content:
Chapter 30: Chapter 30: The Saintess has a crush on Jun Moxiao
Ye Yun gently tapped the tabletop, his face calm, yet a hint of amusement flickered deep within his eyes.
This was the strength of Dragon God Sect cultivators. Possessing the Dragon God Bloodline, they were far from ordinary, with astonishing and enduring combat strength.
「A hundred thousand years ago.」
When Ye Yun faced the pursuit of over twenty Eternal Realm Strong Persons, he had fought with increasing valor, slaughtering half of them while the other half fled in terror.
Both Luo Li and Jun Moxiao had inherited the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline. Though diluted, it still made them far superior to their peers. Thus, a battle of this level meant little to them. The longer they endured, the more their situation shifted from disadvantageous to advantageous.
"Hm?"
Ye Yun suddenly raised his head, his gaze seemingly penetrating the ages.
A silver-white Silver Law Ship emerged from the clouds, stopping above Solitary Cloud City. On this Silver Law Ship stood a group of young women in brightly colored short skirts. Each of these young women was stunning, exuding an evil and alluring Super Divine Dragon Breath.
Ye Yun smiled faintly.
Suddenly, another force had emerged. Had another group come to further sharpen these two? It seemed Luo Li and Jun Moxiao were capable of another breakthrough.
He was full of anticipation.
Within the Blood Robe Sect Sub-branch, the battle raged on. Luo Li and Jun Moxiao unleashed their divine might, making their opponents wail and cry.
「On the Silver Law Ship.」
Among the young women stood a stunningly beautiful one, dressed rather revealingly. Her cultivation base was at the ninth layer of the Origin Sea Realm. At that moment, she stood on the edge of the Silver Law Ship, looking down, a hint of shock on her beautiful face.
"Miss, the Blood Robe Sect Sub-branch has been overrun!" an old maid beside her said with a sigh.
This old maid possessed a very high cultivation base, having reached the Shaping God Stage Second Layer.
The sensual young woman licked her lips, a wicked glint appearing in her eyes. "The Blood Robe Sect and our Huanhuan Sect have always been close. Faced with such a situation, we shouldn’t just stand by..."
She stared intently at the heroic and handsome young man on the battlefield, a deep pink mist beginning to suffuse her eyes. She had taken a fancy to him at first sight. The young man radiated an unimaginable masculine Super Divine Dragon Breath; he was incredibly handsome and unforgettable at first sight.
The Huanhuan Sect was also one of the top ten powers in the Ancient Moon Dynasty. As the Saintess of the Huanhuan Sect, Zhou Mengying was also on this trip searching for cultivation cauldrons. However, after several months of searching, she hadn’t found anyone who satisfied her. Unexpectedly, while passing Solitary Cloud City, she saw this exceptionally gallant young man, and Zhou Mengying’s heart instantly fluttered; she had fallen for him.
The old maid noticed the peculiar look in her lady’s eyes and understood completely. With a gentle raise of her hand, the Silver Law Ship rapidly descended.
A shadow drifted over.
"The Huanhuan Sect has arrived." Bai Yufeng looked up. Seeing the familiar insignia on the Silver Law Ship, his face lit up with joy. The Huanhuan Sect and the Blood Robe Sect had always maintained an excellent relationship. They had even formed alliances several times in history. With the Huanhuan Sect’s sudden arrival this time, it seemed they were prepared to help the Blood Robe Sect overcome this calamity.
"Greetings, Saintess," Bai Yufeng said with utmost respect, bowing deeply as he watched that sensual, beautiful young woman descend slowly from the Silver Law Ship. This was the Saintess of the Huanhuan Sect. Her status was second only to that of the Huanhuan Sect’s Sect Master. Furthermore, the Saintess’s cultivation base was at the ninth layer of the Origin Sea Realm, far surpassing his own.
"Brother Bai, what has happened here?" Zhou Mengying asked, feigning a surprised expression.
"Two vagabonds from who knows where have wreaked havoc in our Blood Robe Sect Sub-branch. I implore the Saintess, considering the generations of friendship between our sects, to lend us your aid," Bai Yufeng pleaded, cupping his fists with a look of earnest entreaty.
"Mm," Zhou Mengying acknowledged with a slight nod, a smile gracing her lips. "Rest assured. Our two sects are old friends. With the Blood Robe Sect in trouble, my Huanhuan Sect naturally cannot stand idly by!" She gently raised her jade-like hand, made a gesture in mid-air, and immediately, twenty to thirty Origin Sea Realm disciples from the Huanhuan Sect rushed out.
"Capture the man alive; kill the woman," the old maid beside her instructed in a low voice.
Hearing the old maid’s words, a blush suddenly flashed across Zhou Mengying’s beautiful face. This old maid, who had watched her grow up, understood her thoughts perfectly. She knew Zhou Mengying had taken a fancy to that handsome young man.
Standing in the square at this moment, even from dozens of meters away, Zhou Mengying could feel the immense masculine Super Divine Dragon Breath emanating from the young man. This Super Divine Dragon Breath surged towards her like an ancient Divine Dragon, enveloping her. It made her entire body feel hot and weak, and she yearned to throw herself into the young man’s embrace.
Luo Li was a sharp one. The moment she heard the Huanhuan Sect announce their name, she felt a sense of foreboding. She had, of course, heard of Zhou Mengying, the Saintess of the Huanhuan Sect. It was said that this Saintess was always searching for suitable cultivation cauldrons. Every year, she would spend some time traveling far and wide, searching everywhere.
"Little Junior Brother, I never thought someone would set their sights on you," Luo Li quipped with a grin, her sword flashing as she transformed into a phantom and swept past Jun Moxiao.
Jun Moxiao’s young face turned slightly red. He hadn’t expected this Saintess of the Huanhuan Sect to target him. He had, of course, long heard of the Huanhuan Sect’s reputation. But how could he possibly be interested in such a woman?
Taking a deep breath, Jun Moxiao’s face filled with killing intent. "Senior Sister, don’t worry. If she dares to show me any disrespect, I’ll kill her immediately."
"Little Junior Brother, well said!" Luo Li laughed heartily and threw herself back into the fight.
With the Huanhuan Sect’s Origin Sea Realm disciples joining the battle, the pressure on Luo Li and Jun Moxiao intensified.
The old maid scanned her surroundings warily. Suddenly, she noticed a black carriage and a Black Horse, stationed rather incongruously in a corner. She extended her Divine Sense to investigate but found it was merely an ordinary carriage and Black Horse, so she paid it no further mind.
At this time, she shifted her gaze elsewhere. She then saw Elder Liu of the Blood Robe Sect lying in a pool of blood on the ground.
"How did this Shaping God Realm Elder Liu of your Blood Robe Sect die?" the old maid asked Bai Yufeng.
Bai Yufeng braced himself and explained, "Matron, Elder Liu cowered before a strong enemy and feigned death. I merely enforced our Sect’s discipline."
"Feigning death?" The old maid was stunned. She exchanged a glance with Zhou Mengying, and both their eyes revealed shock.
Would a dignified Shaping God Realm cultivator really need to feign death to escape danger when facing two Origin Sea Realm juniors?
They both found this matter exceedingly peculiar.
Zhou Mengying’s gaze remained fixed on the handsome and heroic young man, whose body exuded a potent masculine Super Divine Dragon Breath. She quickly put the matter of Elder Liu out of her mind. Her starry eyes grew misty, and her face flushed like a peach blossom.
Why is this young man’s masculine Super Divine Dragon Breath so incredibly potent?
she wondered.
At this thought, Zhou Mengying’s legs clenched together, her sensual, delicate body becoming even harder to control.

chapters.title: Chapter 31 Uncle Ma is Here, Who Dares to be Arrogant
chapters.content:
Chapter 31: Chapter 31 Uncle Ma is Here, Who Dares to be Arrogant
「In the elegant private room of a wine shop.」
A bunch of good-for-nothings!
Ye Yun put down his chopsticks, a sneer of contempt on his face.
This lowly Huanhuan Sect. The art of dual cultivation they practice is the worst—the Yang harvesting and Yin supplement technique. The reason the Saintess of the Huanhuan Sect had a lustful reaction towards Jun Moxiao is solely due to the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline. The Ancestral Dragon Bloodline, extremely firm and Yang, is irresistible to the female Cultivators of the Huanhuan Sect.
TAP. TAP. Ye Yun gently tapped the tabletop, silently calculating Luo Li and Jun Moxiao’s cultivation progress.
If they can withstand the attacks from both the Blood Robe Sect and the Huanhuan Sect, they might achieve a second breakthrough. After all, the God-level Dragon and Tiger Pill they took for the first time had astonishing effects. Moreover, their bodies, remolded by the Ancestral Dragon Blood, far surpass those of their peers! This left their potential far from being fully realized. This arduous battle today is precisely what could enable them to break through under immense pressure!
Ye Yun looked forward to seeing the outcome.
The battle still raged intensely.
The old woman squinted. Witnessing the relentless attacks, she observed that although the two youths were hard-pressed, they skillfully used their exquisite movement technique to continuously conjure one Divine Dragon Phantom after another. Circulating in the air, they skillfully dodged all sorts of attacks.
She furrowed her brows.
These two young people look unfamiliar; where did they come from? Judging by their youth... one sixteen or seventeen, the other only fifteen or sixteen. To possess such a cultivation base at such a young age is truly commendable. The Saintess of the Huanhuan Sect, heavily nurtured with the Sect’s resources since childhood, only reached the ninth layer of the Origin Sea Realm at twenty. The aptitude of these two young ones before her is no weaker than that of her sect’s own Saintess.
The old woman’s eyes were very sharp; she saw it at a glance.
Even her own Saintess would definitely not be able to hold out if besieged by so many Origin Sea Realm Cultivators alone.
After an incense stick’s worth of time, Zhou Mengying, whose body was experiencing unusual sensations, finally couldn’t endure it anymore.
"Ma’am, capture that young man and end this battle quickly," Zhou Mengying urged, feeling an unbearable hunger and thirst.
"Yes, Young Mistress."
The elderly woman nodded respectfully, a smug smile creeping onto her face.
As a great Cultivator of the Shaping God Realm, catching a Cultivator at the fifth layer of the Origin Sea Realm is as easy for me as an eagle snatching a chick.
Just as she took a step—
BOOM!
Suddenly, a deafening roar resounded in her mind. The sound was so powerful it made her stagger, and she instantly fainted.
"Ma’am, what’s wrong?"
Zhou Mengying was startled and quickly supported the collapsing woman.
The elderly woman’s eyes were tightly shut, her Soul plunged into unconsciousness.
"What happened?"
Bai Yufeng came over, looking astonished at this great Cultivator at the Second Layer of the Shaping God Realm, who was now unconscious.
Suddenly fainting... It’s exactly the same as Elder Liu’s situation earlier.
Could it be that a hidden master nearby secretly attacked this Shaping God Realm expert from the Huanhuan Sect?
Bai Yufeng cautiously scanned his surroundings but found no clues.
To make a great Cultivator of the Shaping God Realm lose consciousness so mysteriously, perhaps only a Divine Bridge Realm Cultivator could achieve such a feat. But where in the Ancient Moon Dynasty could one find Divine Bridge Realm experts? Even Half-Step Divine Bridge Realm experts are limited to just the old Sword Saint from the Sword God Sect.
「At one corner of the plaza.」
The unassuming Black Horse shook its head and gave a soft sneeze, its eyes filled with intense mockery.
A mere Shaping God Realm Cultivator dares to harbor designs on the Master’s Successors? Didn’t they see that I, Uncle Ma, am right here guarding them! Whoever dares to touch the two young masters is disrespecting me, Old Ma! HUMPH! I, Uncle Ma, am here; who dares to be arrogant?
Seeing Little Black (the Black Horse) having twice blocked the attempts of Shaping God Realm Cultivators to intervene, Ye Yun smiled faintly.
Suddenly, an emerald-green fruit appeared in his hand.
With a flick of his finger, the emerald-green fruit, suffused with Dao Rhythm, vanished into the void.
The next moment, a familiar voice reached the Black Horse’s ears.
"You did well."
"Thank you, Mas—"
Before it could utter the last word, it suddenly found a fruit in its mouth. This fruit, suffused with Dao Rhythm, emitted an unimaginably deadly and alluring Super Divine Dragon Breath. As if fearing the Super Divine Dragon Breath would leak, it swallowed it without hesitation.
After eating this green fruit, its eyes suddenly shone with brilliant light. It seemed to have gained an immense benefit.
The Black Horse gently pawed the ground, unable to conceal its inner ecstasy.
The Master had given me a God-level Dao Fruit, allowing me to ascend a level. This feeling... it’s simply marvelous!
After settling the old nanny, Zhou Mengying drew her treasured sword and walked towards the center of the square. Although she didn’t know why the old nanny had fainted, this battle could not continue; she had to end it quickly. Capture that young man and leave this place immediately.
"Junior Brother, the Saintess from the Huanhuan Sect is coming towards you. Be careful," Luo Li softly reminded from the side.
"Senior Sister, don’t worry! I can take it!"
Jun Moxiao watched Zhou Mengying approach and let out a cold laugh.
Right now, he wished the pressure of the battle would intensify; the stronger it became, the better. The greater the pressure, the faster the medicinal effects of the Dragon Tiger Pill would circulate. Perhaps... he could even break through another minor realm.
With the addition of Zhou Mengying, an expert at the ninth layer of the Origin Sea Realm, the battle instantly became more thrilling.
As the Saintess of the Huanhuan Sect, Zhou Mengying’s combat prowess was also astonishing. Her target was now solely Jun Moxiao.
For a time, Jun Moxiao found himself perilously dodging powerful sword light attacks and was even struck by several swords. Because the quality of his Emperor Level Robe had degraded, Zhou Mengying’s sharp Sword Qi pierced through it, injuring him!
Jun Moxiao’s face was set with determination. He showed no sign of retreat and continued to battle fiercely with Zhou Mengying.
He felt he was getting closer and closer to his breakthrough. Especially after being struck by several sword attacks, the pressure reached its peak, and the urge to break through intensified.
As Zhou Mengying focused her attacks on Jun Moxiao, more Origin Sea Realm Cultivators simultaneously assaulted Luo Li.
Luo Li also faced a tremendous crisis. She, too, began to sustain injuries and bleed.
Nevertheless, relying on their formidable physiques, both managed to hold on.
"Little Brother, why are you still stubbornly resisting? Surrender quickly and return with me to the Huanhuan Sect. I’ll take you as my Saintess’s consort," Zhou Mengying said, her longsword weaving sharp and elusive patterns of light as she let out enchanting laughter. Her voice carried a natural enchantment, enough to sway one’s mind.
However, Jun Moxiao remained unaffected. His sword-heart was clear and resolute. Coupled with possessing the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline, he had a natural defensive power against such sinister techniques.
The battle continued for another incense stick’s worth of time.
With two sharp sounds, BANG! BANG! Jun Moxiao and Luo Li, after enduring a bitter struggle, astonishingly broke through simultaneously at this very moment.
Jun Moxiao broke through to the sixth layer of the Origin Sea Realm!
Luo Li broke through to the Third Layer of the Origin Sea Realm!
At this instant, their auras surged dramatically. Their Sword Qi was biting, their momentum imposing as a rainbow, and like a massive tide, they fiercely counterattacked.

chapters.title: Chapter 32: The Bloody Battle Just Ended, and a Strong Enemy Appears Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 32: Chapter 32: The Bloody Battle Just Ended, and a Strong Enemy Appears Again
Even though they had merely broken through a minor realm, their combat ability had skyrocketed. This caught Zhou Mengying and the others completely off guard.
"Impossible!"
"How did they break through again?"
Bai Yufeng angrily planted his sword into the ground. During the battle, these two fellows had broken through twice in succession.
Is there no justice left in the world?
In the Ancient Moon Dynasty, they had never seen such aberrant prodigies. If allowed to mature, the top ten sects of the Ancient Moon Dynasty would bow before them.
"What, they broke through twice?" Zhou Mengying was taken aback. Having heard Bai Yufeng, she could not hide the shock waves in her heart.
Had they broken through once before? So this was their second time! To break through two levels consecutively during a fierce battle is absolutely unheard of!
A hundred years ago, the invincible Sword Saint of the Sword God Sect had never mentioned breaking through twice in a single battle. The more she thought about this, the hotter her heart grew.
If I used this young man as my alchemy pot, I wonder how much it would boost my Cultivation.
Thinking of this, Zhou Mengying launched a frenzied attack on Jun Moxiao. Simultaneously, she also issued orders for all the disciples of the Huanhuan Sect to join the battle.
The battle became even more intense!
Streams of Sword Qi soared through the air. The sword light was like a tsunami. The surface of the square of the Blood Robe Sect Sub-branch was torn into chaos. The surrounding walls collapsed with a bang.
Despite the full-on attack led by Zhou Mengying and the Huanhuan Sect disciples, after advancing their realm, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao managed to withstand this wave of attack. The more they fought, the more spirited they became; they were vibrantly alive and not the least bit fatigued.
Zhou Mengying and the others were secretly astonished.
How do these two fellows have such a powerful physical constitution? Their physical strength and Mana seem inexhaustible!
"Ngh..." An old woman from the Huanhuan Sect abruptly awoke. A red necklace on her neck was continuously releasing a faint glow, which had woken her up.
"Who dares to ambush me!" The old woman hastily got up, her body slightly trembling, yet giving off the potent aura of the Ninth Layer of the Phase of God. Being the guardian of the Saintess, her strength was extraordinarily powerful. However, she always used a Secret Technique to suppress her realm to the Shaping God Stage Second Layer. In an instant, her robe was fluttering, her manner majestic, and her whole body exuded a sense of invincibility.
「In the private room of the tavern,」
Ye Yun smiled faintly.
Heh, the fox’s tail has finally shown. This old crone from the Huanhuan Sect has been hiding quite well, but how could she escape the divine eye of a True God like me?
Ye Yun lightly tapped the table with his hand. The Black Horse lightly stomped its hoof.
THUD!
A faint sound echoed unintentionally in the corner. To the old woman, it sounded like world-destroying divine thunder.
BOOM!
Her Soul trembled, her eyes rolled back, and she fainted once again.
Bai Yufeng, watching from the side, was frightened out of his wits.
A Wushang existence is hidden nearby!
It had struck several times in succession, forcefully knocking out two Shapers. Thinking of this, he quietly signaled a few of his junior martial brothers, and they turned, preparing to escape from the back door.
THUD?
The Black Horse again gently tapped its hoof. Bai Yutang and the others all fell to the ground, dead.
「In the square.」
The fight was intense! After a bitter struggle, Jun Moxiao and Luo Li had gained a slight upper hand. Xuan Dan Stage Disciples began to get injured and steadily retreat from the battle. Slowly, disciples of the Origin Sea Realm were also injured, losing their ability to fight again.
The more she fought, the more astounded Zhou Mengying became as the people around her grew fewer and fewer. A moment of inattention, and a sharp Sword Qi slashed over, landing directly on her. Luckily, she had a Heaven Level Robe on her that blocked this sharp attack. Nevertheless, she was still blown away by the powerful force, blood seeping from the corners of her mouth.
As Zhou Mengying was blown away, the pressure on the other disciples of the Origin Sea Realm suddenly increased. Jun Moxiao seized the opportunity and launched another wave of frenzied attacks, sending over a dozen disciples of the Origin Sea Realm flying again.
The tide of battle abruptly reversed!
"Senior Sister, I’ll assist you!" Jun Moxiao immediately rushed towards Luo Li. He and his Senior Sister joined forces, forcing their opponents to retreat continuously.
「After another incense-stick’s worth of time.」
Few people still stood in the square; only Zhou Mengying and a few disciples of the Origin Sea Realm remained. At this moment, they were all wounded, fighting drenched in blood, and no longer able to hold on.
Zhou Mengying had a wry smile on her face.
She never expected the final outcome to be their defeat.
Seeing the situation was lost, after retreating from the battle circle, she placed her sword across her chest.
"I am the Saintess of the Huanhuan Sect! You can’t kill me!" Zhou Mengying said with a trembling voice.
Luo Li, holding the blood-dripping Supreme Golden Dragon Sword, slowly approached, a cold smile on her beautiful face. "Why... so you’re allowed to kill us, but we’re not allowed to kill you?" With that, she pierced forward with her Sword.
At the same time, Jun Moxiao seized the opportunity to kill all the remaining Cultivators of the Origin Sea Realm.
Zhou Mengying parried Luo Li’s attack but didn’t anticipate Jun Moxiao’s sword light also stabbing towards her. She hastily withdrew. The three engaged in a fierce battle. Zhou Mengying only lasted for a few breaths before she was defeated, her body riddled with over a dozen sword wounds. She collapsed in a pool of blood.
"Junior Brother, we’ve won!" Luo Li, holding her sword, looked around the square where no enemies remained. Her delicate body trembled with excitement.
"Yes, Senior Sister," Jun Moxiao said excitedly.
Today, I unleashed a bloodbath, honing my Sword Heart until it’s even clearer!
"Don’t forget our ancestor’s instructions; we must collect all their weapons and storage rings!" Luo Li looked around with a smile and started to get busy.
"Alright!" Jun Moxiao agreed, also starting to scavenge resources.
"You guys have gone too far..." Zhou Mengying forced herself to sit up. Watching the two who were gathering the storage rings like devils, she said with unshed tears.
The old nanny beside her stirred, regaining consciousness once more. She abruptly stood up and looked around, her face drastically changing.
The Disciples of Blood Cloth Sect and the Huanhuan Sect... completely wiped out!
She rushed over to Zhou Mengying. "Miss, are you okay?"
"I’m close to death, Nanny. Hurry up and kill them..." Zhou Mengying said with a wry smile, her face pale.
"Alright, Miss, I will definitely avenge you!" The old nanny turned around, murderous intent rolling off her, her entire body releasing the powerful aura of the Ninth Layer of the Phase of God.
"Ninth Layer of the Phase of God!" Luo Li and Jun Moxiao turned around, both feeling nervous as they looked at the old nanny, as if facing a formidable enemy.
BOOM!
Their bodies suddenly made a soft sound. It was as if something that had been confining their bodies was shattered. At this moment, their momentum suddenly soared.
They broke through from the Origin Sea Realm to the Shaping God Realm in one fell swoop!

chapters.title: Chapter 33: The Strong One in Divine Bridge Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 33: Chapter 33: The Strong One in Divine Bridge Realm
"Ancestor, you’ve removed our seals!"
Luo Li’s initial expression was shock, quickly replaced by enlightenment. She held her sword with both hands and bowed respectfully in a certain direction, expressing her utmost respect.
The long-lost aura of the Shaping God Realm permeated her body once more, filling Luo Li with unparalleled confidence. She was now a Level Three Grand Practitioner in the Shaping God Realm. And her Junior Brother, Jun Moxiao, had also become a Level Six Grand Practitioner in the Shaping God Realm.
Back when they were at the Outer Cloud Sword Sect, the two of them, working together, had been able to make even a Supreme Elder of the Outer Cloud Sword Sect—who was at the Ninth Layer of the Phase of God—flee for his life. Now, they had advanced two more levels. Their combat power had skyrocketed.
Facing the Elder of the Huanhuan Sect, who was at the Ninth Layer of the Phase of God, they felt no fear. At this moment, it could be said that the two of them could completely crush their opponent.
The old crone watched as their auras suddenly transformed to that of the Shaping God Realm, her eyes widening in shock. Her wizened, wrinkled face was so shocked that even her wrinkles seemed to stretch taut.
"How is this possible?"
The old crone roared, brandishing her sword furiously. She had hidden her true cultivation, suppressing her cultivation base from the Ninth Layer of the Phase of God to the Second Layer. But this young pair in front of her was far more ruthless; they had suppressed their cultivation by an entire Major Realm.
This was truly horrifying.
"Junior Brother, this old hag from the Huanhuan Sect is a menace. She has harmed countless people. Let’s kill her!"
Her blood-drenched longsword in hand, Luo Li advanced on the old crone.
"Kill!"
Jun Moxiao also raised his sword, his expression cold, as he slowly closed in.
"You two little bastards! You’ve killed so many disciples of my Huanhuan Sect! Today, I’m going to chop off your heads and avenge them!"
The old crone’s face was grim as she charged towards the two, sword in hand. But as soon as they clashed, she realized her mistake.
Originally, I thought that with my cultivation base at the Ninth Layer of the Phase of God, I could easily crush these two youths and kill them quickly. After all, one of these youths was at the Sixth Layer of the Shaping God Realm, and the other was at the Third Layer. They were simply not on my level.
But she hadn’t expected her sword light to be shattered the moment they engaged. The coordinated swordplay of the young man and woman unleashed an unimaginable amount of power!
After several rounds, she found herself in dire straits, struggling to defend.
How can this be?
The old crone grumbled inwardly, her eyes darting around as she continuously retreated, trying to fend off their attacks.
I have to find a way out now. As Zhou Mengying’s Protector, I must get the Saintess away from here.
Luo Li instantly discerned the old crone’s intentions. She swiftly moved to block her escape route.
"Trying to run?" Jun Moxiao glanced over and instantly understood. He also began to attack the old crone furiously.
Finding her escape route blocked, the old crone couldn’t help but glower at Luo Li.
This wily little girl saw through my ruse!
She had no choice but to brace herself and continue fighting.
The three Grand Practitioners of the Shaping God Realm battled relentlessly within the Blood Robe Sect Sub-branch. Many buildings were damaged and destroyed in the onslaught.
After a dozen more exchanges, the old crone was struck by a sword. Jun Moxiao’s strike had wounded her right arm, hampering her ability to wield her own sword.
SHINK!
Another glint of cold, fierce sword light stabbed into her calf. This time, it was Luo Li’s strike.
The old crone had been struck twice, blood seeping from her wounds. Panic began to grip her heart.
SHINK! SHINK!
Jun Moxiao and Luo Li intensified their pincer attack. After a torrent of sword light washed over her, the old crone, now bearing seven or eight new wounds, collapsed to the ground.
Luo Li rushed over and ended the old crone’s life with a single sword strike.
Jun Moxiao, in perfect sync, walked over, sheathed his sword, and collected her storage ring.
"Junior Brother, we’ve finally killed all our enemies!" Luo Li took a deep breath, a brilliant smile blooming on her sweaty, beautiful face.
"Senior Sister, there are still some people in the square who are seriously injured but not yet dead," Jun Moxiao said.
"Go finish them off!" Luo Li said, gritting her teeth.
Today’s battle has reached a kill-or-be-killed point. We can’t afford to be soft-hearted now.
The two walked into the square and began to finish off the heavily injured disciples.
When they reached Zhou Mengying, the seriously injured Saintess of the Huanhuan Sect looked at Luo Li with a sorrowful expression, desperately pleading, "Sister, I’ll give you all my possessions. If that’s not enough, I can also have my Sect provide you with whatever you need!"
Luo Li laughed. Her cherry-red lips parted, revealing two rows of pearly white teeth.
"I want everything in the Huanhuan Sect Treasure Vault. Can you, as its Saintess, make that decision?" Luo Li suddenly chuckled.
Zhou Mengying was suddenly rendered speechless.
SWOOSH!
A sword light flashed. Jun Moxiao, standing nearby, swung his sword, sending Zhou Mengying straight to Hell.
"Little Junior Brother, you’re even more ruthless than I am! Such a voluptuous beauty from the Huanhuan Sect, and you killed her just like that!" Luo Li giggled, playfully sticking out her small, pink tongue.
I didn’t expect Little Junior Brother Jun Moxiao to be so decisive and swift.
Jun Moxiao wiped the fresh blood from his sword and said, gritting his teeth, "That damn woman wanted to capture me and use me as a cultivation furnace! How could I spare her?"
"Indeed, she couldn’t be spared!" Luo Li giggled.
A clear, resonant voice suddenly drifted down from the heavens.
"Who would have thought... that the little Ancient Moon Dynasty would possess two such fine cultivation seedlings!"
"Who’s there?" Luo Li and Jun Moxiao were both startled and instinctively looked up at the sky.
High above the clouds, a vague white silhouette hovered. Soon, this white silhouette descended through the clouds and landed before them. It was an enormous Immortal Crane.
Standing upon the Immortal Crane was a man in a white robe, appearing to be around forty years of age. He had a transcendent demeanor, like a lofty expert possessing great wisdom.
A powerhouse of the Divine Bridge Realm?
Sensing the man’s aura, Luo Li’s pupils contracted slightly.
This is definitely not an expert from the Ancient Moon Dynasty!
Upon sensing the man’s cultivation base, Jun Moxiao also tensed up, his expression grave as if facing a formidable enemy.
"You two little ones, from which sect or school do you hail?" The middle-aged man stepped off the Immortal Crane, landing gracefully. With his hands clasped behind his back, he smiled at the two of them. The more he observed them, the more pleased he became.
Earlier, while passing by Solitary Cloud City from a distance, he had noticed these two youths battling a cultivator at the Ninth Layer of the Phase of God. Despite their considerably lower cultivation bases, the two had managed to kill the old crone with ease.
Needless to say, this young man and woman were rare talents with astonishing potential. They were even slightly superior when compared to the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from his own Sect.
"We are from the Dragon God Sect!" Luo Li cupped her fists in salute, her small face lifted slightly, a proud smile touching her lips.
"Dragon God Sect?" The middle-aged man paused in thought for a few seconds, then slowly shook his head and said calmly, "Just a minor sect of little renown. You two possess good talent. Why not join my Qitian Sword Sect instead?"

chapters.title: Chapter 34: Disciple of the Dragon God Sect, You Can’t Bear it
chapters.content:
Chapter 34: Chapter 34: Disciple of the Dragon God Sect, You Can’t Bear it
"Unknown?"
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao glanced at each other and couldn’t help but laugh.
One hundred thousand years ago, the Dragon God Sect was the foremost Eternal Sect on the Cangnan Continent.
It was an existence like a behemoth.
Hm?
The middle-aged man looked at the young boy and girl, a strange smile suddenly appearing on his face.
Annoyed, he said dismissively, "You two little ones, I’ll tell you the truth. I come from the Qitian Sword Sect, one of the three major powers of the Shenfeng Dynasty. We are a great sect!"
A great sect?
Hearing this, Jun Moxiao couldn’t help but lower his head and smile.
"I’m sorry, Senior, but we have no intention of joining any sect. We appreciate your goodwill... we understand!"
Luo Li suppressed her laughter, clasped her fists, and politely declined.
The middle-aged man was speechless, his face turning slightly pale with anger.
He had never expected these two youngsters to be so obstinate.
As the saying goes, harsh lands breed unruly people. It was indeed so.
However, these two youngsters were rare geniuses. It would be a real shame to miss out on them.
"You are still young and know little of the outside world. Why don’t you come with me to the Shenfeng Dynasty and see what a truly great sect is like?"
The middle-aged man stood with his hands clasped behind his back, speaking indifferently, an air of unquestionable, sacred majesty on his face.
Luo Li frowned slightly.
Is this Divine Bridge Realm powerhouse trying to force us?
She shook her head.
"Senior, everyone has their own aspirations. Please don’t insist!"
A cold glint flashed in the middle-aged man’s eyes.
These two brats are so ungrateful! Offering them a kindness, and they spit on it!
"You should come with me!" he said with a cold sneer.
He suddenly reached out a large hand towards Luo Li and Jun Moxiao.
Suddenly, his hand halted in mid-air as if pierced by a nail, an unimaginable pain shooting through it. He quickly retracted his hand.
An indifferent yet majestic voice echoed all around.
"The disciples of my Dragon God Sect are not people your Qitian Sword Sect can afford to offend."
"Who’s there?"
The middle-aged man was greatly alarmed and quickly looked behind him.
Just then, he saw a young man in a white robe slowly walk in through the entrance.
This white-robed young man was handsome and elegant, with deep eyes and flowing black hair. He seemed like an immortal who had stepped out of a painting.
Strangely, despite his own cultivation base, he couldn’t detect any cultivation base from the other party, as if this young man were merely an ordinary person.
"Ancestor!"
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao were overjoyed at the Ancestor’s sudden appearance and bowed respectfully.
Ye Yun gently waved his hand, and the two were lifted to their feet.
He walked to stand between the three of them.
Looking at the Divine Bridge Realm middle-aged man before him, Ye Yun smiled faintly and said, "Qitian Sword Sect... are you planning on being erased from the Shenfeng Dynasty?"
The middle-aged man’s mind reeled, and he staggered backward, sensing an indescribable, immense terror emanating from Ye Yun’s eyes.
I’ve encountered a reclusive expert! This person’s cultivation is far superior to mine; I can’t sense his cultivation base at all.
The middle-aged man looked panicked. He quickly clasped his hands and bowed, his voice filled with an indescribable reverence. "Senior, I was just joking. Please don’t take it to heart."
"Misfortune issues from the mouth. It is too late."
Ye Yun smiled and flicked out a wisp of clear qi.
The man opposite, his face a mask of terror, was completely immobilized. The moment the clear qi touched him, he dissolved into a puff of azure smoke and vanished.
The giant white Immortal Crane also couldn’t escape this fate.
After dealing with the man and beast, Ye Yun gently shook his head and said lightly, "What is this Qitian Sword Sect? Just some great sect, and it dares to act so presumptuously before my Dragon God Sect!"
Jun Moxiao stared at the Ancestor, frozen like a stone statue.
It was the first time he had seen the Ancestor truly take action.
A mere wisp of clear qi had turned a Divine Bridge Realm powerhouse into ash and smoke.
This True God Realm powerhouse is truly terrifying!
Whether at Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge or the Outer Cloud Sword Sect, Jun Moxiao had never witnessed the Ancestor slaughtering thousands with a single breath.
If he had seen it, he would have been even more profoundly shocked.
"This time, you both made breakthroughs, advancing two ranks. Not bad at all!"
Ye Yun’s gaze swept over Luo Li and Jun Moxiao, and he chuckled.
"Thank you for your grace, Ancestor!"
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao knelt on the ground, immensely grateful.
If they hadn’t brought the Ancestor’s black carriage, their progress would not have been so smooth.
They had successively broken through two minor realms in a single battle.
Such an astounding feat had never occurred in the Ancient Moon Dynasty.
"Have all the resources been collected?" Ye Yun asked indifferently.
"Everything is ready, Ancestor. We can leave now," Luo Li said with a slight smile, standing up.
"You two enter the carriage first. I have prepared a medicinal bath for you!"
With these words, Ye Yun made a slight wave of his sleeves.
A gentle breeze swept out from his sleeves.
In that instant, the surrounding corpses and buildings dissolved into wisps of azure smoke and vanished.
Jun Moxiao, witnessing this scene, gulped involuntarily.
What kind of Divine Skills is the Ancestor using? It’s truly terrifying!
The entire Blood Robe Sect Sub-branch in Solitary Cloud City evaporated in an instant, swept away by that gentle breeze.
The area was now completely empty.
The gentle breeze didn’t stop, continuing to sweep outwards.
At this moment, Jun Moxiao saw that everyone in the vicinity seemed to momentarily freeze, their expressions slightly stunned, as if something had just happened to them.
Then, with a blur, their surroundings shifted, and they found themselves on a main road outside the city.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao were utterly shocked, disoriented by the Ancestor’s dazzling Divine Skills.
Leaving no trace.
Ye Yun chuckled softly, casually erasing portions of the memories of everyone in Solitary Cloud City.
Seeing the two were still dazed, Ye Yun flickered and vanished before their eyes.
The next moment, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao found themselves in a separate room.
In the room was a large wooden tub filled with hot water.
White steam curled upwards, carrying an indescribable, exotic fragrance.
The two were greatly shocked; they could actually sense the aura of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood in the water!
"Your bodies suffered considerable trauma in today’s battle. Soak in the medicinal bath and get some good rest!"
"Ancestor, does this medicinal bath contain Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood?" Luo Li asked, her voice trembling.
"Your cultivation is still shallow. I used less than a single drop of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood, divided between two tubs. This medicinal bath also contains several hundred types of heavenly materials and earthly treasures. Absorb them well, strive to break through another minor realm, and it will also lay a foundation for absorbing Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood in the future!" Ye Yun said with a smile.
"Thank you, Ancestor!"
Luo Li was so excited, her heart trembled.
She knew the Ancestor must have added countless precious heavenly materials and earthly treasures to this medicinal bath, things she wouldn’t even dare to dream of.
She hurriedly took off her robes and climbed into the wooden tub.
A vast surge of life energy immediately poured into her body through her pores, and Luo Li couldn’t help but let out a soft moan of pleasure.
It was simply too comfortable.
She felt her depleted mana rapidly recovering, and her physical wounds were also healing at a swift pace.
On the other side, the same was true for Jun Moxiao.
Both of them knew this was a great opportunity. They quickly sat cross-legged and silently circulated their cultivation techniques to absorb the energy in the medicinal bath.
The black carriage traveled along the main road.
At this moment, no one was driving the carriage.
Ye Yun sat quietly inside the carriage. He was alone, with no one to his left or right.
The black carriage was also a magical treasure, possessing its own self-contained space.
Ye Yun had divided it into more than ten small spaces. However, he had concealed them all.
「Three days later.」
Powerful auras surged from two of the small spaces simultaneously.
Jun Moxiao had broken through to the Seventh Layer of the Shaping God Realm!
Luo Li had broken through to the Fourth Level of the Shaping God Realm!
Both had broken through!

chapters.title: Chapter 35: The Old Sword Saint from Divine Bridge Realm Comes Out
chapters.content:
Chapter 35: Chapter 35: The Old Sword Saint from Divine Bridge Realm Comes Out
Sword God Sect.
At the Sect Leader’s Main Hall.
Sect Leader Zhao Wujie stood by the window, gazing out into the sky, his face extremely gloomy.
Over the past month, the ten major powers of the Ancient Moon Dynasty had been challenged by a pair of young male and female Origin Sea Realm cultivators. They challenged all Origin Sea Realm disciples of each sect. If they won, they would take all the resources from each sect’s Treasure Pavilion. If they lost, they would offer their own heads and hands.
The first to face the challenge was the seventh-ranked Blood Robe Sect. The entire Blood Robe Sect had two hundred Origin Sea Realm disciples. Everyone assumed that with the Blood Robe Sect’s numerous disciples, victory would be easy. However, this young pair proved shockingly powerful. Although initially suppressed, they both broke through later, turning defeat into victory. All participating Blood Robe Sect disciples were heavily injured in this battle. This infuriated the Sect Master of the Blood Robe Sect! A dozen Shapers made their move, trying to kill the young duo. Unexpectedly, this young pair had hidden their cultivation base. Once they revealed their true power, they were revealed to be grand cultivators of the Shaping God Realm! Therefore, in this battle, all Shapers of the Blood Robe Sect were wiped out. This shocked the entire Ancient Moon Dynasty.
The second to be challenged was the Sunset Sword Sect. Taking a lesson from the Blood Robe Sect, the Sunset Sword Sect dared not send out Shapers. Instead, they deployed all their Origin Sea Realm disciples to fight the pair. They too were defeated. In the end, they had no choice but to surrender all the resources in their Treasure Pavilion. This young pair, however, abided by the rules and did not go on a killing spree within the Sunset Sword Sect.
After that, the Poison Sect, Wuji God Sword Sect, Diamond Fist Sect, and Golden Roc Sect faced the same challenge. Without exception, all Origin Sea Realm disciples from these powerful sects were defeated.
They intend to challenge all ten major powers of the Ancient Moon Dynasty one by one!
Zhao Wujie muttered to himself, his mood indescribably agitated.
The top three powers were the Sword God Sect, the Three Wonders Sect, and the Golden Roc Sect. The Sword God Sect was the most powerful; even if the Three Wonders Sect and Golden Roc Sect combined forces, they wouldn’t match the Sword God Sect. However, Zhao Wujie still felt uneasy. Their Sword God Sect had numerous Disciples of Heaven’s Pride in the Origin Sea Realm, totaling over three hundred. If they deployed the Seven-Star Sword Array, these three hundred disciples could unleash astonishing combat power.
"Wujie..." An old voice suddenly resounded in the main hall. A white figure appeared abruptly.
Zhao Wujie looked up, and joy immediately surfaced on his face. "Master, you’ve come out of seclusion."
The elderly man before him was Zhao Wujie’s respected teacher. He was the Sword God Sect’s previous Sword Saint. And he, Zhao Wujie, was the current Sword Saint. The old and new Sword Saints hadn’t seen each other for a hundred years, and their reunion was filled with emotion.
"I have!" laughed the white-robed elder, who carried a treasured sword and had an air of immortal-like grace. At this moment, his Super Divine Dragon Breath radiated a Divine Bridge Realm cultivation base.
Zhao Wujie was overjoyed. His master, after a hundred years of seclusion, had broken through to become a Divine Bridge Realm expert! This was truly a blessing for the Sword God Sect.
"Wujie, what troubles you?" the old Sword Saint asked, looking at his beloved disciple with a smile.
As the top power in the Ancient Moon Dynasty, the Sword God Sect was even stronger than the second and third-ranked sects combined. Logically, sitting in the position of Sword God Sect’s Leader, one shouldn’t be so troubled. Unless a major external power had intervened. However, the Sword God Sect also had backing; they were supported by a large sect.
Zhao Wujie picked up several secret reports from the table and handed them to the old Sword Saint. After reading them, the old Sword Saint’s expression turned grim. With a flick of his fingers, the secret reports instantly turned to ash!
"Outrageous! They’re bullying our Ancient Moon Dynasty as if there’s no one here to stop them!" The old Sword Saint was livid.
"Master, what do you think we should do?" Zhao Wujie asked.
"My Sword God Sect is filled with geniuses. Why should we fear these two Wild cultivators of unknown origin?" The old Sword Saint scoffed, a cold light flashing in his eyes as he spoke frigidly. "Let my Sword God Sect’s disciples face them first! If our disciples win, we will naturally dismember those two! If they lose, then I, the Saint, will personally take action and slay them within our Sword God Sect. This will also serve as vengeance for the other major sects."
"Thank you, Master!" Zhao Wujie was instantly overjoyed, the pressure in his heart vanishing.
Those two youths, even with their seals removed, are only Shaping God Realm cultivators. They couldn’t possibly compare to his master, a Divine Bridge Realm expert. A century ago, his master was already invincible among cultivators of the same realm. He even once single-handedly fought ten Shaping God Realm experts of the same rank, defeating them all with a single move. This showed just how formidable the Ancient Moon Dynasty’s number one Sword Saint was back then. Since then, his master had retired from worldly affairs, focusing solely on breaking through to the Divine Bridge Realm. A century later, he had achieved his goal.
...
Outside the Sword God Sect’s gates, a black carriage slowly approached. Luo Li and Jun Moxiao were seated at the front of the carriage. After a month of intense battles, their entire demeanor had completely transformed. They sat tall, their eyes bright, as if containing boundless, sharp Sword Intent. With every move, they emanated a powerful Super Divine Dragon Breath.
"Luo Li, the Sword God Sect’s gates are just ahead. How about it? Are you two confident about fighting that old Sword Saint?" Ye Yun’s laughter echoed from within the carriage.
"Ancestor, we are naturally confident!" Luo Li replied with a smile, her eyes shining with strong confidence.
Her cultivation base had now reached the Tenth Layer of the Origin Sea Realm. Jun Moxiao was the same. Because Ye Yun had continuously sealed Jun Moxiao’s cultivation base, Jun Moxiao hadn’t advanced further after reaching the Tenth Layer Peak of the Origin Sea Realm. Now, their cultivation bases were on par.
But if their seals were lifted, Luo Li would be at the Molding God Realm Tenth Layer. And Jun Moxiao would reach the Half-Step Divine Bridge realm.
These were the results of a month of Ye Yun’s special training. They had challenged the top ten powers, starting from the Blood Robe Sect and proceeding according to rank. The opponents they faced grew progressively stronger. Luo Li and Jun Moxiao had not disappointed him, both achieving their current cultivation levels.
Ye Yun glanced towards the Sword God Sect. His eyes twinkled, and a faint smile touched the corners of his lips.
He could see that the old Sword Saint had come out of seclusion and was now a Divine Bridge Realm expert.
Ye Yun nodded inwardly.
This old Sword Saint indeed has some attainment in the Sword Dao. He’s worthy of being the one who dominated a small place like the Ancient Moon Dynasty a century ago.
Ye Yun retracted his gaze. He tapped lightly on the carriage.
The black carriage suddenly accelerated, arriving before the Sword God Sect’s gates in the blink of an eye. Before the two disciples guarding the gate could react—
The carriage sped through, coming to a halt on the grand plaza before the Sword God Sect’s main hall.
"Who goes there?!" The two Sword God Sect disciples were greatly alarmed. They had only seen a black streak flash past their eyes. One disciple looked back and was stunned to see a black carriage parked on the distant plaza. Recalling a certain rumor, their faces turned deathly pale.

chapters.title: Chapter 36: Revenge, Pointing the Sword at the Old Sword Saint
chapters.content:
Chapter 36: Chapter 36: Revenge, Pointing the Sword at the Old Sword Saint
For the past month, the top eight powers of the Ancient Moon Dynasty had all been challenged by a mysterious young man and woman.
The Blood Robe Sect was the first to bear the brunt. The Blood Robe Sect’s Shaping God Realm experts forcibly intervened but were all killed. This nearly wiped out the entire Sect.
Then, this young man and woman went on to challenge the other major Sects, without a single loss.
Those great Sects had no choice but to hand over all the Sect resources in their Treasure Pavilions. With smashed teeth, they swallowed their humiliation.
They were helpless against this young couple, because this young man and woman were two peerless powerhouses themselves—great Cultivators of the Shaping God Realm!
However, for some unknown reason, they had deliberately sealed their cultivation base, only displaying the cultivation level of the Origin Sea Realm.
Thus, this matter seemed exceedingly strange and became widely known throughout the Ancient Moon Dynasty.
As Disciples of the Sword God Sect, they had naturally heard of it as well.
Unexpectedly, the Sword God Sect could not escape this fate either.
Today, they too welcomed a challenge from this mysterious young man and woman.
「At the mountain gate.」
The two Disciples looked at each other and sighed lightly. Because they were only at the ninth layer of the Mysterious Pill Realm, they were unqualified to be involved in this fight. So, the two just stared nervously at the black carriage.
The striking young man and woman suddenly made their move.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao leaped down from the carriage.
The two stood in the center of the square.
Luo Li cupped her fists and shouted, "Sword God Sect, come out and fight!"
「Inside the main hall.」
Zhao Wuji and the Old Sword Saint, who were already prepared, exchanged a glance and quickly walked out.
When the Old Sword Saint stepped over the threshold of the main hall and his eyes first fell upon Jun Moxiao, an expression of utter disbelief and shock appeared on his face.
He was no stranger to this young man.
He quickly glanced at the stunningly beautiful young woman beside him, and his gaze instantly turned grim.
Aren’t these two remnants of the Divine Dragon Sect? How could they suddenly have such a fortuitous encounter and have their cultivation skyrocket?
The Old Sword Saint was filled with doubt. He had just come out of seclusion and hadn’t yet received news from the Wanbao Pavilion. So, his astonishment upon recognizing Luo Li and Jun Moxiao was immense.
Two mere Gathering Qi Realm Disciples had suddenly transformed into tenth-layer Origin Sea Realm Cultivators! If the intelligence reports were accurate, these two had sealed their true cultivation base and were actually great Cultivators at the Shaping God Realm Tenth Layer. This is simply unimaginable!
The Old Sword Saint’s eyes darted around as he pondered the various possibilities.
The Divine Dragon Sect has long been past its prime, with each generation weaker than the last. In the centuries the Old Sword Saint had been in his position, he had dealt with several Sect Masters of the Divine Dragon Sect. He knew this obscure Sect through and through. It was incredibly weak, not even qualifying for the lowest tier among Sects in the entire Ancient Moon Dynasty. So what kind of incredible fortune did these two young people stumble upon?
The Old Sword Saint’s gaze, sharp as a sword, swept over them but found nothing out of the ordinary.
Apart from their high cultivation bases, the Robes these remnants of the Divine Dragon Sect wore and the Swords they carried were of no remarkable quality. Could they have accidentally consumed some heavenly treasure? Or perhaps they stumbled upon the legacy of some ancient powerhouse?
he speculated silently.
Regardless, recalling the instructions from his superiors, the Old Sword Saint knew he absolutely could not let these two youths escape.
Perhaps that young woman, the so-called new generation Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, should be spared. Cripple half her cultivation base, let her live out her days. After all, she’s only the 298th-generation Sect Master. The Dragon God Sect hasn’t reached its 300th generation yet. My mission isn’t just to torment the Dragon God Sect’s Successors, but to ensure the Sect endures to the 300th generation before completely wiping it out, erasing it from the annals of history.
This was the secret mission the Old Sword Saint carried.
Initially, he too found this mission preposterous. But he had no choice; his superiors had once told him it was the will of those even higher up. The Old Sword Saint was aghast. His superiors were already major Sects. Two levels above them? Could it be a Sky-Level Sect orchestrating all this from the shadows? A Sky-Level Sect! Such an entity was a terrifyingly supreme power! A single Disciple from such a Sect could obliterate the entire Ancient Moon Dynasty. What powerful figure could the insignificant Dragon God Sect have offended to be hounded for dozens of generations?
The Old Sword Saint dared not dwell on it further.
Fortunately, these two remnants of the Dragon God Sect have now come to the Sword God Sect. Since they’re here, they won’t be leaving.
"Senior Sister, that must be the Old Sword Saint, right?" Jun Moxiao asked, his voice grave, as he squinted at an elderly man in white with an immortal-like bearing walking out.
"It’s this old bastard," Luo Li said through clenched teeth.
This old brute had hidden behind the scenes, giving orders that left several generations of Dragon God Sect members destitute and in miserable conditions.
"Today, we must kill him and avenge ourselves!" Jun Moxiao declared, drawing his Sword, his killing intent surging.
"Where are the Sword God Sect Disciples?" Zhao Wuji waved his hand, and hundreds of Disciples from the Sword God Sect rushed out from all directions.
"You two are truly audacious. Do you think our Sword God Sect is a paper tiger?" Zhao Wuji sneered.
As his words fell, the Origin Sea Realm Disciples around him immediately began to move according to a specific formation.
In an instant, the Big Dipper Formation took shape.
Luo Li glanced around and smiled coolly, "Zhao Wuji, you weakling, don’t bother blustering here. This time, we’ve come to directly challenge the Old Sword Saint. You can go rest on the side!"
"What? These two actually want to challenge the Divine Bridge Realm Old Sword Saint?"
The faces of the Origin Sea Realm Disciples, who were maintaining the formation, showed utter shock.
Zhao Wuji also looked taken aback.
Have these two become so arrogant as to be completely lawless?
At this moment, Luo Li’s and Jun Moxiao’s bodies trembled slightly, and the sound of a Seal shattering echoed from within them.
Their cultivation base was restored to the Shaping God Realm in an instant.
The powerful Super Divine Dragon Breath they exuded was startling. Even Zhao Wuji, at the Shaping God Realm Tenth Layer, felt his heart pound in fear.
"Old Sword Saint, you old scoundrel! You’ve hidden behind the scenes, tormenting my Divine Dragon Sect for nearly a hundred years! Today, we’ve come for revenge!" Luo Li cried, raising her Supreme Golden Dragon Sword, its tip aimed at the Old Sword Saint, her eyes bloodshot with intense emotion.
They broke the Seal?
The Old Sword Saint squinted, a muscle twitching in his cheek.
These two youths certainly have some skill. Either one of them is stronger than my direct Disciple, Zhao Wuji. But the Shaping God Realm is still the Shaping God Realm. Even ten Shaping God Realm Cultivators combined would be no match for someone at the Divine Bridge Realm. What’s more, I, the Old Sword Saint, have been immersed in the Sword Dao for nearly three hundred years. My mastery of the Sword Dao is earth-shattering. Even in the Shenfeng Dynasty, few in my realm can defeat me.

chapters.title: Chapter 37 Tug of War
chapters.content:
Chapter 37: Chapter 37 Tug of War
"Ha! Two Remnants of Shenlong Sect. I’m surprised you survived numerous calamities and even made such tremendous strides in your cultivation base. However, your luck runs out today!"
The old Sword Saint’s expression was icy as he unsheathed the King-level Sword from his back.
The blade was as white as snow, emitting a shimmering, cold light.
When the old Sword Saint gripped this sword, the surrounding air suddenly grew heavy. It seemed as if countless tiny wisps of Sword Qi were slowly brewing within it.
The temperature plummeted.
Seeing the old Sword Saint unsheathe his sword, the disciples of the Sword God Sect all revealed fanatical expressions. The old Sword Saint was the spiritual monument of the Sword God Sect, a god in the eyes of all disciples.
Ye Yun sat in the carriage, calmly watching everything unfold, his expression serene.
This old Sword Saint’s attainment in the Sword Dao is indeed remarkable. For Jun Moxiao and Luo Li, this will undoubtedly be a grueling battle.
But that was also a good thing, a form of tempering. After all, both of them had been stuck at the Molding God Realm Tenth Layer. If they could spar with the old Sword Saint and temper themselves, it would surely be immensely beneficial for their breakthrough to the Divine Bridge Realm.
Upon hearing the old Sword Saint’s words, Jun Moxiao’s eyes turned red with rage. His body trembled, and he spat contemptuously before cursing aloud, "You old scoundrel! So it was all your doing!"
"You mere Remnants of Shenlong Sect dare to scold me?"
Hearing Jun Moxiao’s words, the old Sword Saint seethed with anger and slashed his sword towards him.
The Sword Qi was earth-shattering. It flashed once in the void before arriving in front of Jun Moxiao.
Jun Moxiao was abruptly startled. The old Sword Saint’s sword-drawing speed was incredibly fast. If he weren’t a powerhouse at the Pinnacle of Shaping God Realm, he likely wouldn’t even have had the chance to draw his own sword.
In his haste, Jun Moxiao struck out with his sword while simultaneously activating the Divine Dragon Nine-Change Body Technique.
The two swords collided.
Jun Moxiao was sent flying backward by a tremendous force. He transformed into several phantoms in mid-air, dissipating the force before finally landing on the ground. His shoulders swayed slightly, and a trickle of blood seeped from the corner of his mouth.
In just the first exchange, Jun Moxiao had sustained a light injury.
"Junior Brother, are you alright?" Luo Li rushed over upon seeing this.
Jun Moxiao wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth and shook his head. "Senior Sister, this old fellow is incredibly powerful. We need to be extra careful."
Luo Li nodded with a solemn expression. Her strength was about thirty percent weaker than Jun Moxiao’s. If she were to face the old Sword Saint head-on and take a direct blow, her injuries would likely be even more severe.
However, their strongest Ultimate Techniques were not Swordsmanship, but movement techniques. Having been on the run for years, their Nine Changes of the God Dragon had reached an extremely high level, further enhanced by their Ancestor’s continuous guidance. One could even say that their proficiency in the Nine Changes of the God Dragon far exceeded their Dragon God Sword Technique.
"As expected of Master! That young man coughed up blood with just one move," Zhao Wuji thought, secretly delighted to see Jun Moxiao injured.
My master, the Sword Saint, was invincible in the Ancient Moon Dynasty a century ago. He had no equal in his generation and could even kill those in higher realms.
"Grandmaster is invincible!"
"Just one sword strike and that young man was wounded."
"So powerful!"
The surrounding Sword God Sect disciples all had fanatical looks in their eyes.
This young man... His body is strong!
Unlike the Sword God Sect disciples, the old Sword Saint was inwardly shocked. He had used half his strength in that sword strike, yet he hadn’t expected the young man before him to only have a thin trickle of blood at the corner of his mouth. This was completely different from what he had imagined. In his mind, that strike should have severely injured the youth, if not incapacitated him entirely. Yet, it had only caused a minor injury.
The old Sword Saint took two steps forward, swung his sword, and unleashed two more chilling beams of sword light that tore through the air.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao were already on guard. The moment the old Sword Saint moved, they activated the Divine Dragon Nine-Change Body Technique. The two of them transformed into more than a dozen Divine Dragon Phantoms, weaving through the air and narrowly dodging the old Sword Saint’s lethal attack.
The movement technique of these two Remnants... is indeed impressive!
The old Sword Saint was a discerning man and couldn’t help but nod inwardly. He recalled that some of his subordinates, despite being stronger than these Remnants of Shenlong Sect, had found it incredibly difficult to capture them. This was thanks to the Dragon God Sect’s unique movement technique.
Thinking this, the old Sword Saint sneered. Suddenly, he became an illusory figure, his sword technique flowing like a mighty river, relentlessly attacking the two.
The three began to fight in mid-air.
Although the old Sword Saint’s movement technique was formidable, it was still slightly inferior to the Dragon God Sect’s Nine Changes of the God Dragon. He used his movement technique merely to keep pace with the duo; his true killing intent lay in the sword in his hand.
Beams of sword light shot towards them from all directions.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao dodged while counter-attacking. Each time their swords met the light, both felt a shocking impact, as if struck by lightning.
After merely a dozen exchanges, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao had suffered injuries of varying degrees and had coughed up several mouthfuls of blood. Luo Li, in particular, had been struck by a sword, leaving a long, narrow gash on her left shoulder.
Ye Yun observed the battle, his expression as tranquil as an ancient well, showing no trace of emotion.
Then, he gently tapped a finger in the void.
The Super Divine Dragon Breath of the Robes on Luo Li and Jun Moxiao suddenly surged, instantly reaching the Emperor Level. Simultaneously, their swords also attained the Emperor Level.
The Super Divine Dragon Breath of Emperor Level Treasures permeated the air. The attacking old Sword Saint paused, a fervent glint in his eyes.
These two youngsters are indeed blessed with great fortune! The Robes on their bodies and the swords in their hands are all Emperor Level; only their Super Divine Dragon Breath was concealed.
The old Sword Saint cared little for the Robes; what mattered were the two swords in Luo Li’s and Jun Moxiao’s hands. The potent Emperor Level Super Divine Dragon Breath emanating from these two swords made it difficult for him to contain his desire. He had immersed himself in the Sword Dao for many years, yet the best sword he possessed was merely a King-level Top Grade. For so long, he had yearned for an Emperor Level Divine Sword.
He had never imagined that today, the Remnants of Shenlong Sect he had been pursuing for hundreds of years would deliver two Emperor Level Divine Swords to him! This filled the old Sword Saint’s heart with immense joy, and he was determined to seize both Emperor Level Swords.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao were simultaneously overjoyed.
Our Ancestor has unsealed them for us again!
With Emperor Level Robes and Emperor Level Swords, their combat prowess had once again soared.
The old Sword Saint’s heart burned with greed, eager to seize the swords. Thus, he launched the first attack.
Streams of sword light whistled through the air, enveloping them from all directions.
Jun Moxiao and Luo Li were immediately plunged into a dire crisis, struck by dozens of sword gleams. Even with the protection of their Emperor Level Robes, the tremendous force behind the strikes sent their Qi and blood into turmoil, causing them to cough up blood repeatedly.

chapters.title: Chapter 38: If you can’t beat them, you still have ancestors
chapters.content:
Chapter 38: Chapter 38: If you can’t beat them, you still have ancestors
The Elder Sword Saint was intent on seizing the treasure. For a moment, sword light rained down erratically.
In the center of the square, a sea of Sword Qi had formed.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao were like two small boats, constantly buffeted in the stormy weather.
Thankfully, their greatest strength lay in their survival skills.
Under the Elder Sword Saint’s frenzied attacks, they managed to slip away from peril every time.
Despite this, both were still injured.
Even though they were clad in Emperor Level robes, these were insufficient to block the powerful sword light.
Sometimes, the Elder Sword Saint’s King-grade Top-tier Sword would strike the duo. The sword, infused with the lethal power of a Divine Bridge Realm cultivator, would tear a hole in their Emperor Level robes.
The Elder Sword Saint, fighting more valiantly as the battle progressed, was unstoppable, like a deity incarnate.
Jun Moxiao and Luo Li were like fugitives on the run.
Exercising their Divine Dragon Nine-Change Body Technique to the utmost, they deftly evaded each dangerous situation by the skin of their teeth.
The Elder Sword Saint was putting an almost incomprehensible amount of pressure on the two.
At every moment, they were in a life-or-death crisis. A single careless mistake could prove fatal.
Seeing the Elder Sword Saint display his boundless, powerful demeanor, all the disciples of the Sword God Sect had a frenzied look in their eyes.
This was indeed the First Sword Saint of the Ancient Moon Dynasty, a great cultivator of the Divine Bridge Realm! He was so incredibly strong! His terrifying power was inconceivable!
Zhao Wuji stood with his hands clas meninas behind his back, a faint smile on his face.
His Master has started a killing spree and is running those two brats ragged. They probably won’t last much longer.
「Inside the carriage.」
Ye Yun’s expression remained calm as he quietly observed the fight.
He wasn’t surprised by this Elder Sword Saint’s strength. Someone who was matchless in the entire Ancient Moon Dynasty a hundred years ago certainly had his unique merits. Although Jun Moxiao and Luo Li had been cultivating since childhood, their foundations weren’t firmly established. They spent most of their time on the run. Despite having gone through a month of fierce battle, the two had only rapidly progressed their cultivation bases. They hadn’t faced a genuine expert yet. A true expert was someone like the Elder Sword Saint—someone invincible within his realm and capable of killing those of higher realms. If the two could withstand the Elder Sword Saint’s assault for a longer period, it would greatly aid their future cultivation. Although Jun Moxiao had already reached the Half-Step Divine Bridge Realm, breaking through to the Divine Bridge Realm wouldn’t be so easy. This battle might just be the opportunity.
Ye Yun was very patient.
Even though Jun Moxiao and Luo Li were now severely wounded and bloodied, he had no intention of intervening.
What did a few injuries matter? Back in the day, he, the foremost tyrant of the Cangnan Continent who wreaked havoc everywhere, had also encountered formidable opponents and sieges. Injuries were inevitable. But injuries could also make a person grow quickly.
Therefore, Ye Yun, with a heart of steel, held immense expectations for these two disciples from his Sect.
The future Dragon God Sect would have to be upheld by Luo Li and Jun Moxiao. He wanted to explore the world outside, to tussle with stronger opponents.
This past month, Ye Yun hadn’t fallen behind in his cultivation.
The latent power of the Ancestral Dragon Blood was still taking effect.
Currently, Ye Yun’s cultivation base had reached True God Realm Tier Seven.
The True God Realm was already very formidable, but Ye Yun’s cultivation base continued to soar like a rocket.
Reaching the next Divine Monarch Realm was only a matter of several months.
How can these two have such sturdy bodies? They’ve taken over a dozen sword strikes and are still standing!
「Above the square.」
The Elder Sword Saint initiated wave after wave of ruthless attacks.
The two remnants of the Dragon God Sect now looked like figures drenched in blood.
The Elder Sword Saint was also growing inwardly frustrated.
Enough time for an incense stick to burn has passed, and I still haven’t managed to completely take them down! Especially since, despite repeatedly using my killing moves, I still haven’t killed that young man, Jun Moxiao. I really want to kill this young man. As for the Dragon God Sect, leaving only that little girl alive will be enough. Today, I’ll leave that little girl barely alive, let her crawl down the mountain, and continue to cultivate disciples for the Dragon God Sect. Let them struggle on for a few more decades. When a new wave of disciples rises, I’ll kill Luo Li, this 298th generation Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect. I have less than a century left to complete my mission. My superiors promised that if I complete this task, I’ll be rewarded with an Emperor Level Top Grade Swordsmanship. Additionally, I’ll be supplied with cultivation resources until I reach the Destiny Realm. These conditions are too tempting, and for me, they’re also quite easy to achieve. However, because my superiors demanded secrecy, I had to go to great lengths, even using that Supreme Elder from the Outer Cloud Sword Sect as an intermediary for this task.
SWISH! SWISH!
Two more sword slashes landed, hitting Jun Moxiao on the shoulder.
Jun Moxiao staggered, nearly falling over.
Luo Li hastily rushed over to support him.
Seeing this, the Elder Sword Saint swung his sword again, sending Luo Li flying with one strike.
This sword strike was restrained.
This little girl absolutely must not die, or my mission will be a failure.
Taking advantage of this moment, Jun Moxiao executed his movement technique, fleeing in another direction.
Unable to overcome their defenses after a long battle, the Elder Sword Saint immediately became furious.
He abruptly changed his Swordsmanship.
This set of Swordsmanship was even more powerful than his previous one.
In the blink of an eye, Jun Moxiao was forced out from his illusory cover in mid-air. His body was struck several more times, and with a moment of carelessness, he fell from the sky.
"Junior Brother!" Luo Li cried out, her heart burning with anxiety as she fiercely rushed forward to rescue him.
The Elder Sword Saint unleashed another beam of sword light, striking Luo Li.
Luo Li was sent flying once again.
Is this... the new Swordsmanship Master recently comprehended?
Zhao Wuji, observing the battle from the side, couldn’t help the covetous glint in his eyes upon seeing this Swordsmanship.
Once this battle is over, I must find a way to learn this Swordsmanship from Master.
Jun Moxiao lay on the ground, his body bearing over a dozen sword wounds, blood dripping from them.
With a sudden flip, he tried to stand up and continue fighting.
Suddenly, his shoulder was touched lightly, and a gentle voice sounded beside his ear.
"You’ve both done very well today!"
Hearing this voice, Jun Moxiao turned his head and saw that the Founding Ancestor had somehow appeared by his side.
He coughed violently, spurting out a mouthful of blood. "Founding Ancestor, I’ve let you down! I couldn’t defeat this old geezer!" Jun Moxiao cried, his face dejected.
"There’s no shame in losing. Besides, don’t you still have me?" Ye Yun replied with a faint smile.
He walked a few steps forward, positioning himself in front of Jun Moxiao.
Meanwhile, Luo Li climbed to her feet again. Seeing the white-robed, Immortal-like Founding Ancestor, her eyes immediately brightened.
The Founding Ancestor is going to take action himself!
she thought, pleasantly surprised.
Opposite them, when the Elder Sword Saint saw the white-robed young man who had suddenly appeared beside Jun Moxiao, his pupils contracted sharply as he scanned him from head to toe.
He couldn’t determine the cultivation base of this handsome, Immortal-like youth, which left him aghast.
Could this be a peerless expert?
"Come here," Ye Yun said, gesturing lightly towards the Elder Sword Saint.
The Elder Sword Saint was suddenly horrified to find his body moving uncontrollably, legs lifting as he floated towards Ye Yun.
What kind of cultivation realm is this?!
At this moment, the Elder Sword Saint was terrified, his soul nearly leaving his body.

chapters.title: Chapter 39: Hell Opens, Eternal Suppression
chapters.content:
Chapter 39: Chapter 39: Hell Opens, Eternal Suppression
The Elder Sword Saint, who had lived for several hundred years, had never experienced such a terrifying moment. The white-robed young man, who seemed like a banished immortal, touched him, and his body lost control, flying up like a paper figure. The surrounding disciples of the Sword God Sect were greatly shocked, their eyes wide, staring at the uncontrollable Elder Sword Saint, unable to recover for a long time. Nearby, Zhao Wuji was panting heavily.
Countless thoughts flashed wildly in his mind. Who exactly is this white-robed young man who looks like an immortal? Why could he subdue Master with a single move?
The Elder Sword Saint’s uncontrollable body finally stopped one zhang away from Ye Yun.
"Who are you?" The Elder Sword Saint trembled all over, sweating profusely, his heart filled with terror.
"I am the ancestor of the Dragon God Sect," Ye Yun shrugged slightly, smiling faintly. Although he did not release any Super Divine Dragon Breath, everyone present felt immense pressure at this moment, finding it hard to breathe, as if a great mountain was crushing their chests.
Hearing Ye Yun’s words, the Elder Sword Saint found it unbelievable. He shook his head repeatedly and roared, "Impossible! How could you be the ancestor of the Dragon God Sect?"
"What’s impossible about it?" Luo Li quickly walked over, stood before the Elder Sword Saint, and said with a cold smile, "This is our Dragon God Sect’s thirteenth-generation Ancestor!"
"The thirteenth generation?" The Elder Sword Saint was instantly baffled. He knew that the Dragon God Sect’s lineage, by Luo Li’s generation, had reached the 298th.
If one counts back to the thirteenth generation, how long would that be? At least tens of thousands of years, right?! Even... possibly more than a hundred thousand years.
The Elder Sword Saint himself had only lived for several hundred years.
How could he possibly speculate the age of the thirteenth Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect?
He didn’t know much about the Dragon God Sect; it was like viewing a leopard through a tube. After all, the history of the entire Cangnan Continent had spanned countless generations in the past hundred thousand years. With the information the Elder Sword Saint possessed, he could at most grasp the Dragon God Sect’s development over the last ten thousand years. And in the past ten thousand years, the Dragon God Sect had merely been a declining Ordinary Sect."Who ordered you to harm my Dragon God Sect?" Luo Li, clenching the sword in her hand, struggled to suppress the hatred in her heart as she stared at the Elder Sword Saint and questioned him.
"Heh, I can’t say. Even if you kill me, I won’t say!" The Elder Sword Saint suddenly shook his head, a grim smile on his face.
Could he say it? This matter already involved Sky-Level Sects. The implications were enormous.
If even a shred of information leaked, not only would the Sword God Sect be completely destroyed, but the entire Ancient Moon Dynasty would not be spared.
"Then you don’t have to say anything," Ye Yun remarked indifferently from the side, arching an eyebrow. He then lightly tapped his finger, and the Elder Sword Saint immediately lowered his head, appearing as if he had fallen asleep. Ye Yun began to search his memories.
A few seconds later, he withdrew his hand, a thoughtful expression on his face.
"Ancestor, who was it?" Jun Moxiao, standing beside Ye Yun, asked anxiously.
