"The Shenfeng Dynasty, Shen Heng Sect," Ye Yun said softly, a slight smile playing on his lips. He didn’t tell Jun Moxiao the whole truth. In the Elder Sword Saint’s memory, the mysterious person from the Shen Heng Sect had once inadvertently revealed that the order to deal with the Dragon God Sect came from "those above those above." Counting back two levels, that pointed to a Sky-Level Sect. Directly beneath the Eternal Level was the Heaven Level. Sky-Level Sects were already the paramount powers on the Cangnan Continent. One could say that if the Eternal Level Sects didn’t intervene, this world belonged to the Sky-Level Sects.
A massive Sky-Level Sect, scheming against the tiny, Ordinary-Level Dragon God Sect, persecuting it for ten thousand years... How much karma and hatred must that involve? It seems the 250th Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect provoked a Sky-Level Sect.
Thinking of this, Ye Yun had a plan.
So what if it’s just a Sky-Level Sect? In his eyes, they are still as insignificant as ants.
"So it’s the Shenfeng Dynasty..." Jun Moxiao mumbled to himself, a bewildered look on his face. He knew nothing about this Shen Heng Sect of the Shenfeng Dynasty; after all, Jun Moxiao had never even stepped outside the Ancient Moon Dynasty.
"Don’t worry, no one will escape," Ye Yun said with a smile, patting the dazed Jun Moxiao on the shoulder.
Luo Li walked over. "Ancestor, through the Elder Sword Saint’s memories, did you find any trace of our Eldest Senior Sister, Su Wanyi?"
Ye Yun searched the Elder Sword Saint’s memories again, then shook his head and said softly, "Su Wanyi is missing."
"Missing? Does that mean Eldest Senior Sister isn’t dead?" A glimmer of hope dawned on Luo Li’s exceptionally beautiful face. Back then, her eldest senior sister had lured the pursuers away to protect her and their youngest junior brother. Since then, her fate had been unknown. But her eldest senior sister’s cultivation base at the time was only at the ninth level of the Gathering Qi Realm. She wasn’t much stronger than Luo Li. Indeed, she was still a young cultivator at the most basic level of the Gathering Qi Realm.
Therefore, Luo Li had always worried: had her eldest senior sister, from whom there was no news, been harmed by those behind-the-scenes manipulators?
Ye Yun pondered. According to the Elder Sword Saint’s memory, Su Wanyi was being hunted and, in her panic, had stumbled into a valley shrouded in white mist. Her pursuers went in to search but found no trace of her.
Thinking of this, Ye Yun said, "Our business here is finished. Let’s go find Su Wanyi."
"That’s wonderful! Thank you, Ancestor!" Luo Li and Jun Moxiao glanced at each other, their faces filled with irrepressible joy.
"Master! I will avenge you!" Zhao Wuji, his face a mask of tragic heroism, raised his sword and roared, "All disciples of the Sword God Sect, listen! The Elder Sword Saint has been harmed by a treacherous villain! Charge and kill him!"
As the new Sect Master of the Sword God Sect, Zhao Wuji held considerable prestige. His shout instantly resonated with many Sword God Sect disciples. In a flash, everyone drew their swords and rushed towards the center of the square.
Ye Yun looked up coolly, his eyes narrowing. His gaze swept over them, and it was as if a powerful shockwave spread out. Instantly, everyone froze on the spot as if under a binding spell, their swords clattering to the ground. Even Zhao Wuji, with the highest cultivation base, was now ice-cold and unable to move, his sword also having dropped.
The Elder Sword Saint, having recovered his senses, witnessed this, his eyes bloodshot, looking as if they might burst, with tears of blood welling. "Senior, could you spare the disciples of my Sword God Sect? I am willing to offer my own life in compensation!" He suddenly knelt, his knees bending to the ground.
"Heh, amusing. When you were harming generations of my Dragon God Sect disciples, did you ever imagine this day would come?" Ye Yun smiled faintly. His voice spread, and the air temperature seemed to drop. Then, he pointed a finger at the ground. "Open!"
A RUMBLE echoed as the earth began to shake. The entire Sword God Sect’s buildings collapsed with a crash, and the ground suddenly caved in. An incredibly vast, pitch-black chasm appeared, abruptly beginning to swallow everything. All the Sword God Sect disciples, including the Elder Sword Saint, fell into the black hole at that moment. Ye Yun and his companions, along with the black carriage, remained suspended in the void above the chasm, completely unaffected.
"The Sword God Sect has persecuted my Dragon God Sect for hundreds of years. From this day forward, you shall be eternally suppressed in Hell, suffering infernal tortures, never to be reincarnated!"
Ye Yun’s cold voice reverberated between heaven and earth. From within the pitch-black chasm, chilling winds howled, thick with Ghost Qi, carrying all sorts of terrifying, mournful cries.

chapters.title: Chapter 40: The Valley of White Mist, Mysterious Existence
chapters.content:
Chapter 40: Chapter 40: The Valley of White Mist, Mysterious Existence
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao were suspended in mid-air, looking down at the giant, pitch-black hole below. Gusts of chilling wind emerged continuously from it, mingled with terrifying screams.
The two involuntarily shivered, their faces instantly turning pale. Recalling the Ancestor’s earlier words, they felt even more terrified.
Is this Hell?
The Ancestor is truly ruthless... He actually connected this place directly to Hell and sent everyone from the Sword God Sect there.
Luo Li was afraid, but there was excitement in her heart as well.
The elderly Sword Saint of the Sword God Sect had wreaked havoc on the Dragon God Sect for hundreds of years. He had killed several generations of Dragon God Sect disciples and Sect Masters. He was the sworn enemy of the Dragon God Sect. Even killing him ten thousand times would not be excessive. The Ancestor didn’t kill them directly. Instead, he suppressed them in Hell for eternity, where they would suffer all kinds of torture. It was incredibly satisfying.
Jun Moxiao looked at the towering figure and asked tremulously, "Ancestor, is that really Hell below?"
Ye Yun merely smiled and didn’t answer the question. Instead, the Black Horse beside them became excited. Perhaps the sight of Hell ignited its ferocity.
It muttered to itself, "Master has used supreme divine power to construct an eighteen-layer Hell deep beneath the ground. Although it’s not the real Nine Soul Nether Hell, there’s hardly any difference."
I see.
Jun Moxiao clutched his chest, his mind in turmoil.
The Ancestor’s True God Realm was terrifyingly powerful, capable of creating an eighteen-layer Hell with supreme divine power!
He looked at the towering figure, intense fervor sparkling in his eyes.
"Seal!" Ye Yun uttered a single word.
Suddenly, countless amounts of soil gathered from all directions and poured into the pitch-black hole. It was filled in an instant.
The Sword God Sect was originally situated on a majestic mountain. Now, both the mountain and the Sword God Sect had disappeared. The place had been transformed into flat land.
Witnessing this miraculous, god-like display of power, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao couldn’t help but feel a sense of awe and marvel at the Ancestor’s strength.
"Let’s go, we’re going to find Su Wanyi..." With a single step, Ye Yun vanished into thin air and entered the carriage.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao hurriedly followed, sitting at the front of the carriage. Once the three of them were seated, the Black Horse’s hooves took to the air, transforming into a beam of black light that vanished into the sky.
Ye Yun had obtained the old Sword Saint’s memories, so he knew roughly where Su Wanyi had disappeared. He relayed the direction through a Divine Thought to the Black Horse.
The Black Horse sped along. In the time it takes to drink a cup of tea, it suddenly halted, turning around and saying with a grin, "Master, this should be the place, right?"
"Hmm!" Ye Yun chuckled, slightly opened the carriage curtain, and turned his gaze to Luo Li, asking, "Does this place look familiar to you?"
After glancing at the surrounding mountain ranges, Luo Li suddenly exclaimed, "Little Brother, look! Isn’t this where we got separated from Eldest Sister?"
Jun Moxiao swiftly surveyed the surroundings. After a few seconds, he confirmed the location and nodded energetically. "Senior Sister, it’s indeed this place. I remember Eldest Sister led the pursuers towards the southeast." As he spoke, Jun Moxiao pointed in a certain direction.
"Yes, I remember it that way too," Luo Li said, slapping her thigh fervently, her eyes gleaming.
Ye Yun nodded, saying softly, "There’s a valley over five hundred li to the southeast. It’s shrouded in mist all year round. Many people who enter get lost and find it challenging to get out. Some of the pursuers who chased Su Wanyi also disappeared there. The few who managed to escape never went after her again..."
"Ancestor, is there some powerful force present in that place?" Luo Li asked, her face full of seriousness.
Ye Yun glanced at Luo Li but didn’t say a word. Instead, he spoke softly to the Black Horse, "Little Horse, let’s go and take a look at that valley over there."
The Black Horse sprang forward, abruptly transforming into a beam of black light. In a blink of an eye, they arrived above a valley.
Mist billowed and swirled, so dense that they couldn’t see the path clearly. Under Ye Yun’s direction, the carriage gently descended into the valley.
"Let’s go and see what’s ahead," Ye Yun urged the carriage forward unperturbed, a hint of mockery in the depths of his eyes.
Just moments ago, Ye Yun had used his powerful Divine Sense to explore this valley but hadn’t found any trace of Su Wanyi. What he did find was an incredible creature. That fellow was sleeping.
In order to train Luo Li and Jun Moxiao’s courage and broaden their horizons, Ye Yun decided not to alert them. He simply instructed the Black Horse to enter the fog-enveloped valley.
The fog was dense, and visibility within the valley was extremely low. "How strange, what sort of place is this? My Divine Sense can’t penetrate more than five meters!" Jun Moxiao said, sitting in the carriage and holding the reins, constantly scanning his surroundings with a look of surprise on his face.
Luo Li’s youthful face looked somewhat serious. Brushing a strand of long black hair from her forehead, she said quietly, "This place is rather ominous. It’s said that many who enter never return, though some have barely managed to escape. I wonder if... our Eldest Sister will be so lucky."
Jun Moxiao sighed, his expression filled with sorrow. More than three months had passed. Their Eldest Sister was still missing, like a stone dropped into the ocean, with no news at all.
Perhaps she too has perished in this foggy valley.
The black carriage moved at a leisurely pace through the mist. As they ventured deeper into the valley, a variety of strange noises began to resonate from all around them. Some sounded like children crying, others like wild beasts roaring; all sorts of complex sounds echoed from every direction.
"This place is indeed quite ominous!" Luo Li exclaimed, drawing her sword, her beautiful face revealing a cautious look.
This mysterious valley had no name. Being located on the border between the Ancient Moon Dynasty and the Shenfeng Dynasty, it was sparsely populated, and very few cultivators passed through here.
At that time, the three of them—Senior Sister Su Wanyi, Luo Li, and Junior Brother Jun Moxiao—were escorting their master’s ashes when they happened to pass by a place five hundred li away from this valley.
Luo Li speculated in her heart. Perhaps... their Eldest Sister had been injured and had bravely rushed into this slightly eerie, white-fog valley. If she was lucky, she might even have escaped. If she hadn’t entered the white-fog valley, she would probably have been caught and killed by those pursuers.
Thinking of her Eldest Sister’s ordeal, Luo Li felt a wave of sadness, and tears welled in her eyes. "Senior Sister, don’t be upset," Jun Moxiao comforted her from the side. "I believe our Eldest Sister is highly blessed and wouldn’t encounter any serious problems so easily."
"Prepare for battle!" Ye Yun’s voice suddenly rang out without warning.
Jun Moxiao and Luo Li were shocked. They realized that numerous large, bamboo-hat-sized dark figures were emerging from the white fog.
Both of them swiftly drew their swords and slashed out dozens of Sword Lights. With accompanying screams, the dark figures were injured one by one and quickly retreated back into the fog.
My God, such large lice!
Upon seeing the figures clearly, Luo Li couldn’t help but be utterly shocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 41: The Aloof Black Cat
chapters.content:
Chapter 41: Chapter 41: The Aloof Black Cat
Upon hearing Luo Li’s shout, Ye Yun, who was inside the carriage, smiled gently.
Lice as big as farm hats are indeed rare. Moreover, every one of these lice has a cultivation base around the Shaping God Realm. Their bodies are as tough as iron. If they aren’t dealt a lethal blow, it’s tough to inflict heavy damage on these lice.
Ye Yun cast his gaze into the distance. With an unperturbed smile, he thought to himself,
I’m in no hurry. This is a good chance to continue the training of these two little ones.
They had been defeated in the battle at the Sword God Sect and were just a step away from breaking through to the Divine Bridge Realm. This foggy valley was a perfect opportunity for them to train.
"Senior Sister, I’ve never seen lice so large! Each one has a cultivation base around the Shaping God Realm. This is truly terrifying!" Jun Moxiao exclaimed, his face a mask of shock.
He continuously swung his sword, slashing at the giant lice flying toward him. Although these lice didn’t have wings, their cultivation was profound, and they were capable of flight.
Wave after wave, the army of lice charged towards the black carriage. Even though Luo Li and Jun Moxiao were strong fighters, faced with countless lice, they couldn’t fully protect the carriage.
Strangely, some lice that were flying towards the Black Horse suddenly gave up on their target mid-flight. They abruptly altered their course to attack Luo Li and Jun Moxiao instead.
The Black Horse sneezed.
You tiny lice, dare to covet yours truly, Uncle Ma?
he thought, sneering with contempt.
As for that fellow in the depths of the white fog, I noticed him long ago. In my eyes, Uncle Ma’s eyes, he’s pitifully weak. However, since Master is giving the disciples a chance to train, I shouldn’t interfere. So, all I can do is scare away the lice surrounding me.
Some lice flew towards the carriage, seemingly intending to destroy it. However, upon landing on the carriage, they were repelled by an unseen force and sent flying.
"Don’t worry about the carriage. Just unleash your full strength and kill these lice," Ye Yun said with a smile, shaking his head as he watched Luo Li and Jun Moxiao continuously wielding their swords while still on the carriage.
"Yes, Patriarch!"
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao exchanged a glance, then immediately activated the Divine Dragon Nine-Change Body Technique. They dove into the white fog and began to slaughter the lice swarming towards them.
The strongest of these lice were only at the Molding God Realm Seventh Layer, while the weakest were at the Shaping God Realm First Level. Due to their sheer numbers, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao fought for a full two hours, yet they still could not see an end to them.
The two were immensely shocked.
What mysterious power is in this fog that it can nurture so many lice?
they wondered.
They continued to slay the lice for another twelve to fourteen hours. Only then did the number of lice in the sky begin to decrease. Soon after, the remaining lice shrieked, dove back into the white fog, and vanished from sight.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao could finally catch their breath. After fourteen continuous hours of battle, the two hadn’t had a single chance to rest. The pressure had been immense. Luo Li, in particular, found these menacing-looking lice utterly repulsive.
She was terrified that these lice would pounce on her, pierce her skin, and suck all her blood.
"Get in the carriage. Let’s go see what’s ahead," Ye Yun said with a gentle chuckle.
The black carriage continued deeper into the foggy valley. Luo Li and Jun Moxiao jumped into the carriage and sagged down, finally able to catch their breath.
"Junior Brother, if the lice here are this terrifying, I’m really worried that Eldest Senior Sister hasn’t managed to escape!" Luo Li said, her face etched with distress.
Jun Moxiao was also overcome with sadness, and tears welled in his eyes.
At that moment, Ye Yun’s voice sounded faintly. "These lice are very picky. They don’t bother with cultivators of lower cultivation bases. So, your Eldest Senior Sister, Su Wanyi, definitely wouldn’t be attacked by them."
Upon hearing what the Patriarch said, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao’s eyes suddenly lit up. If these lice wouldn’t attack their Eldest Senior Sister, then her chances of survival were indeed very high.
Perhaps, after escaping from this foggy valley, she’s now hiding in some unknown place.
The Black Horse pulled the carriage onward for about the time it takes an incense stick to burn. The mist began to thin.
Suddenly, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao felt an overwhelming pressure bearing down on them from not too far away.
"What level of cultivation is this?" Jun Moxiao exclaimed, astounded. In the face of such cultivation, he felt as insignificant as an ant.
Luo Li licked her lips but said nothing.
After the Black Horse had traveled a few hundred meters more, all the fog suddenly dissipated. Ahead, a silver waterfall cascaded from a mountaintop, plunging into a deep green pool and stirring up countless white waves.
In this pool grew a blood-red lotus. This red lotus had nine leaves and emitted astonishing spiritual energy fluctuations. A single glance revealed it to be an extraordinary Immortal Herb.
Beside the pool, a large black cat lay crouched. It was curled into a ball, seemingly fast asleep.
"Strange. How did you manage to find your way here?" a deep voice suddenly echoed through the surrounding space.
Then, the large black cat stretched its body. It lazily shook itself, lifted its head, and looked towards the black carriage. It completely ignored the ordinary Black Horse at the front and paid no mind to the black carriage behind it. Finally, its gaze landed on Luo Li and Jun Moxiao.
"’Hmm, strange. How come these two little ones also possess the Dragon God Bloodline?’" the black cat uttered in surprise. It leaped down from the rock, hovering in mid-air as it condescendingly inspected Luo Li and Jun Moxiao.
"’Tsk tsk... These two little ones are even more impressive than the previous one, aren’t they? To think they’ve actually cultivated to the Molding God Realm Tenth Layer! Just one more step and they’ll reach the Divine Bridge Realm.’"
"’With such aptitude and cultivation, they would definitely be considered top-tier geniuses even in the Plough Heaven Dynasty.’"
"’It’s all Master’s fault for being too hasty back then. If he had left a bit later, he might have encountered these two even more exceptional geniuses,’ the large black cat mused to itself, a fervent glint in its eyes."
Luo Li looked at the large cat, feeling immense pressure. She found she couldn’t discern the cultivation of the black cat before her. However, from the large black cat’s soliloquy, she seemed to grasp another implication: it seemed their Eldest Senior Sister, Su Wanyi, had been taken away by this cat’s master.
At this thought, Luo Li lifted her exquisite little face, looked at the large black cat before her, and asked in a solemn voice, "Three months ago, did you see my Eldest Senior Sister?"
The cat extended its blood-red tongue, licked its black fur, and drawled, "Are you referring to the young girl who shares the same Dragon God Bloodline as you two?"
"Her... where is she now?" Luo Li’s breathing instantly grew ragged.
"Why should I tell you?" the large black cat nonchalantly licked its black fur and replied dismissively. It had no intention of bothering with Luo Li, a mere Human Cultivator of the Sculpting God Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 42: The Whereabouts of the Senior Sister
chapters.content:
Chapter 42: Chapter 42: The Whereabouts of the Senior Sister
Seeing this large black cat being so arrogant, Luo Li was helpless. She bowed her head, clutching her small fists tightly.
At this time, only the Old Ancestor could take action.
However, what was slightly reassuring was that Senior Sister Su Wanyi should still be alive.
This news made Luo Li somewhat happy.
The same went for Jun Moxiao beside her.
"Little Horse, go teach it how to behave."
Inside the carriage, a gentle voice suddenly rang out.
"Oh? There’s someone else in this carriage?"
The large black cat blinked, somewhat surprised.
It had clearly glanced into the carriage just now but hadn’t noticed anyone inside. Had it been seeing things earlier?
"Alright, Master."
The Big Black Horse cracked a smile, revealing a set of gleaming white teeth.
The sight of the Big Black Horse’s grin sent shivers down both Luo Li’s and Jun Moxiao’s spines.
This Big Black Horse is truly extraordinary! It’s an unfathomable being.
The Big Black Horse’s body trembled slightly. It tossed off the reins binding it and separated from the black carriage.
Then, he looked up at the large black cat in the sky, sneering, "Little Cat, hurry up and get down here to Uncle Ma."
"Hmm? You have quite the nerve, Big Black Horse!"
The large black cat grew angry.
It was just about to extend its claws to teach this Big Black Horse a lesson.
Suddenly, the Big Black Horse lightly stomped its hoof on the ground. A deafening RUMBLE resounded in the black cat’s ears, earth-shattering, as if the end of the world was nigh.
In an instant, its head felt muddled, and it plummeted from mid-air.
With a THUD, it crashed to the ground.
"Ouch! You nearly killed your Old Cat!"
The black cat rolled over on the ground and quickly got up.
All its long black fur stood on end, and its body arched tightly. It stared at the Big Black Horse before it, its eyes filled with utter terror.
It had actually misjudged this Big Black Horse.
"Little Cat, you know how formidable your Uncle Ma is now, don’t you?"
The Big Black Horse slowly walked forward, the Super Divine Dragon Breath from its body growing increasingly powerful.
The black cat’s body shrank into a ball, and it suddenly began to tremble.
Damn, what kind of cultivation base is this? It’s even stronger than my master! After all, my master is already a super powerhouse at the Life and Death Realm! However, the Super Divine Dragon Breath this Big Black Horse exuded actually surpassed the Life and Death Realm, making it impossible for me to discern what realm its cultivation base is at!
It immediately chickened out.
"Uncle Ma, this little one was blind and failed to recognize Mount Tai. Please, Your Excellency, be magnanimous."
The black cat prostrated on the ground, lifting its forepaws and continuously making pleading gestures.
Its large, black jewel-like eyes overflowed with a fawning expression.
The Big Black Horse walked over, lifted its black hoof, and gently tapped the cat’s head twice.
"Little Cat, the Master has asked me to properly teach you a lesson—how to conduct yourself!"
As he spoke, an unimaginably terrifying force flowed from his hoof, pressing the black cat deep into the ground.
The black cat struggled to lift its head and mumbled, "Uncle Ma, spare my life!"
The Big Black Horse stepped forward, planting his hoof on the black cat’s large face, and laughed heartily, "Just now, when my Master’s two disciples questioned you, you actually put on such an arrogant, despicable air! Today, your Uncle Ma will thoroughly stomp on your face!"
As he spoke, the Black Horse’s hoof pressed down with tremendous force, once again ramming the big cat into the ground.
"Uncle Ma, don’t hit the face! How about... I let you hit my butt instead?"
The black cat, on the verge of tears but unable to shed any, quickly covered its head with its paws and then stuck up its plump, fleshy rump.
The Big Black Horse was instantly furious.
"You filthy Little Cat, you’re covered in lice! Goddammit, go take a bath!"
With that, he gave a sharp flick of his hoof, sending the black cat flying into a nearby pool of water.
SPLASH! The black cat fell into the pool.
Seeing the Big Black Horse so mighty and imposing, defeating the Big Black Cat so miserably with a single move, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao couldn’t help but burst into laughter.
This Big Black Horse is just too formidable! Even the two of them couldn’t discern the Big Black Cat’s cultivation realm, yet the Big Black Horse had dealt with it so easily with just a flick of its hoof!
The two of them couldn’t help but feel that the Big Black Horse’s strength was even more profound and unfathomable.
The carriage curtain was lifted, and Ye Yun suddenly stepped out.
He strode to the edge of the pool, stood on a rock, and looked at the blood-red Nine-leaf Blood Lotus in the water.
"So, you are the one guarding the Nine-leaf Blood Lotus here?"
Ye Yun’s gaze fell calmly on the big black cat floating in the water.
This big black cat had, by now, been scared witless by the Big Black Horse. It was in the pool, frantically scrubbing mud off its body.
Indeed, it didn’t like baths, so it was infested with lice. The lice in the white mist earlier had all come from its body. Usually, these lice stayed hidden in its fur. Only when they encountered a scent they liked would these lice fly out.
The black cat looked at the Immortal-like youth on the rock, its pupils suddenly contracting.
This person before me actually seems like a mortal, without the slightest hint of any Super Divine Dragon Breath from cultivation. Yet, he gives off a feeling of Wushang radiance, as if a God stood there, emitting immeasurable divine light. This profoundly mysterious sensation... I’ve never encountered anything like it. Moreover, the moment this man spoke, he revealed the secret of why I guard this place. This caused immense shock in my heart.
"Little Cat, my Master is asking you a question! Answer quickly, or Uncle Ma will serve you some punishment."
The Big Black Horse moved to the edge of the pool and tapped a rock with his hoof.
The black cat instantly shivered with fright.
It immediately used its Mana to shake all the lice off its body. Then, opening its mouth, it sucked all the lice in and ate them.
After all, that terrifying Big Black Horse found me dirty, probably because of these lice.
Standing on the water’s surface, it looked at the Immortal-like youth and said tremblingly, "Esteemed Master, it is true that I guard the Nine-leaf Blood Lotus here."
"The young lady who came here three months ago, where is she now?"
Ye Yun glanced over.
Terror filled the black cat’s heart; it instantly felt as if it had been seen through completely. I know this youth before me is also an incredible Wushang powerhouse. I couldn’t even discern the Big Black Horse’s cultivation base, so there’s no way I can discern this youth’s cultivation base. It’s truly unimaginable! When did such a powerhouse appear on the Cangnan Continent?
"Master, when that young lady arrived back then, my own master happened to be here as well. At that time, he saw that the young lady possessed extraordinary aptitude and the Dragon God Bloodline, so he accepted her as a disciple and took her to the Plough Heaven Dynasty."
Plough Heaven Dynasty?
Ye Yun gently murmured this name, then shook his head.
It’s been 100,000 years! The world outside has changed so much! I’ve never heard of this Plough Heaven Dynasty. However, its level should far exceed that of the Shenfeng Dynasty.
"Which Sect is your master from? And what is his cultivation base?" Ye Yun asked calmly.
"Reporting to Master, my master is a great Cultivator of the Life and Death Realm. He is the Sect Master of the Ten Thousand Beast Divine Sect!" the black cat stated respectfully.
"Be more respectful when speaking before my Master! A great Cultivator of the Life and Death Realm? Can the Life and Death Realm even be considered the realm of a great Cultivator?"
The Big Black Horse sneered, angrily raising his hoof.
An illusory hoof shadow shot out. It instantly smacked the black cat into the depths of the pool.

chapters.title: Chapter 43 Tearing the Void
chapters.content:
Chapter 43: Chapter 43 Tearing the Void
THUMP.
The Big Black Cat was slammed into the depths of the pool by a powerful force.
This pool was extremely deep, hundreds of meters deep.
The Big Black Cat landed face-first at the bottom of the pool, getting a mouthful of sand.
It suddenly turned over and spat out the sand from its mouth underwater.
At this moment, the Big Black Cat looked utterly aggrieved, on the verge of tears.
A Life-Death Realm Grand Cultivator... Was I wrong to say that?
In the Plough Heaven Dynasty, a Life-Death Realm Grand Cultivator is the highest level of existence.
Yet, in the words of this Uncle Ma, they were dismissed as insignificant Young monks.
This Uncle Ma...
What exactly is his cultivation base?
And its owner, who shines like a divine sanctum, yet surprisingly shows no cultivation base at all.
WHOOSH!
With a sudden splash of water, the Big Black Cat shot up again from the bottom of the pool.
"Uncle Ma, Little Cat knows it was wrong. Please, your esteemed self, forgive this lowly one."
As soon as the Big Black Cat emerged, it knelt on the water’s surface, kowtowing and bowing.
The Big Black Horse snorted coldly without saying a word.
Ye Yun wore a faint smile on his face.
He suddenly reached out and pointed. The little cat’s head drooped.
The next second, Ye Yun withdrew his hand, and the Big Black Cat returned to normal.
He had done that just to verify the Big Black Cat’s words.
Clearly, this Big Cat hadn’t lied.
Su Wanyi had indeed been taken by the cat’s owner to the Ten Thousand Beast Divine Sect in the Plough Heaven Dynasty.
"Luo Li, Jun Moxiao, you two... do you want to see your Eldest Senior Sister?"
Ye Yun looked at them and revealed a faint smile on his face.
"Yes, Ancestor! We haven’t seen Eldest Senior Sister in over three months. I miss her so much!"
Luo Li looked like she was about to cry.
Jun Moxiao, beside her, was already crying unabashedly.
It seemed this little boy’s tear ducts were even looser than Luo Li’s.
"Since you miss her so much, I will bring her back now," Ye Yun said with a smile.
He slightly lifted his right arm.
As he lifted it, his right arm slowly began to emit streams of white light.
Finally, this white light became incredibly dazzling, so bright that it made everyone shut their eyes.
Ye Yun’s hand, transformed into light, plunged into the void and disappeared.
At the same time, the shining white light also vanished.
Ye Yun’s expression was calm, as if his arm was searching for something within the void...
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao stared with eyes wide as saucers, their hearts churning with colossal waves as they watched this unbelievable scene.
Could it be that Ancestor is going to use this Supreme Divine Power to snatch Senior Sister Su Wanyi from the Plough Heaven Dynasty with a single hand?
Feeling the terror of the white light, the Big Black Cat trembled all over. It murmured to itself, "Heavens, what kind of power is this?"
The Big Black Horse glanced at it disdainfully and said irritably, "Look at your pathetic insight. Utterly hopeless."
The Big Black Cat suddenly darted over, prostrated itself at the Big Black Horse’s feet, rubbed against them gently a couple of times, then looked up admiringly and asked, "Uncle Ma, what kind of Divine Skill did the Master just display?"
The Big Black Horse raised its head, somewhat smugly, and said, "The Master is, naturally, tearing space to go to the Plough Heaven Dynasty, to your Ten Thousand Beast Divine Sect to find the Successor of his Sect."
What?
The Big Black Cat was aghast.
This place is countless billions of li from the Plough Heaven Dynasty!
Over such a vast distance, could he really grab a living person with just one hand?
Seeing the shocked expression on the Big Black Cat’s face, the Big Black Horse raised its hoof, tapped the cat’s head lightly, and whispered,
"Others cannot, but the Master can."
The Big Black Cat looked dazed, blinking repeatedly as it stammered, "The Master... can?"
The Big Black Horse chuckled twice but did not speak.
「Plough Heaven Dynasty.」
Amidst a range of tall and majestic mountains, Spiritual Energy was abundant, and various powerful Spiritual Beasts flew everywhere.
This was the Ten Thousand Beast Divine Sect.
One of the five strongest powers in the Plough Heaven Dynasty.
At this moment, in a mountain valley, a beautiful girl in purple robes was surrounded by a group of Disciples from the Ten Thousand Beast Divine Sect. They pointed at her, their faces etched with mocking smiles as they jeered.
"Is this the genius the Sect Leader brought back?"
"Her cultivation base is too low, isn’t it?"
"She just broke through to the Mysterious Pill Realm. In the Ten Thousand Beast Divine Sect, she can’t even compare to an Outer Disciple!"
Hearing the various mocking voices around her, Su Wanyi lowered her head, her expression mournful.
Although she had been fortunate enough to survive and be brought to the Ten Thousand Beast Divine Sect by that powerhouse, she had, in fact, been subjected to much ridicule here.
Because her cultivation base was too weak.
In the past three months, despite cultivating desperately, she had only progressed from the ninth layer of the Gathering Qi Realm to the third layer of the Mysterious Pill Realm.
Although this speed was acknowledged by her current master, many Disciples of the Ten Thousand Beast Divine Sect still frequently ridiculed her.
Especially when some learned she came from a small place in the Ancient Moon Dynasty, they used it as a pretext to taunt her.
It was only when she arrived here that Su Wanyi realized.
The Ancient Moon Dynasty, so vast in her heart, was merely an extremely remote little place in their eyes.
The so-called ten great powers of the Ancient Moon Dynasty were nothing more than Ordinary Sects.
And their Ten Thousand Beast Divine Sect was already a Super Sect.
A Super Sect was incredibly powerful.
It was like a behemoth.
Even an Outer Disciple’s cultivation base was at the Origin Sea Realm.
Su Wanyi knew her words carried little weight and her cultivation base was low, so she didn’t say a word to those who mocked her.
She had endured so much hardship, hiding and fleeing with her master since she was young; what did these petty taunts count for?
One day, if she could surpass these people, she would naturally use her strength to slap their faces.
"Hey, Su Wanyi, can’t you hear us talking?"
A male Disciple stood in front of Su Wanyi, grinning at her.
Su Wanyi kept her head down, not saying a word.
The male Disciple stepped closer, then reached out his hand to touch Su Wanyi’s pretty little face.
"What are you doing?"
Su Wanyi was startled and immediately retreated two steps.
The male Disciple had a lewd expression on his face. He chuckled obscenely and took another two steps closer.
The others followed behind, jeering and egging him on.
Su Wanyi looked somewhat frightened. This male Disciple was the personal Disciple of The Ninth Peak’s Peak Master, and his cultivation base had already reached the Divine Bridge Realm.
Her face flushed red as she retreated a few more steps, Su Wanyi realized she had nowhere to run.
"Su Wanyi, how about I have my master speak to your master and have you betrothed to me?"
The male Disciple revealed a lecherous smile.
But the next moment...
BANG!
His body suddenly exploded, turning into a cloud of blood mist.
A gentle voice suddenly resounded all around.
"A Disciple of my Dragon God Sect... can you afford the consequences?"
"Who goes there? How dare you trespass into our Ten Thousand Beast Divine Sect!"
The surrounding spectating Disciples’ expressions all changed drastically. They immediately drew their weapons, facing a formidable enemy.
Dragon God Sect?
The panicked Su Wanyi, upon hearing these three words, suddenly lifted her head, a look of confusion on her face.
This powerhouse who spoke... could he also be a senior from her Dragon God Sect?
"Girl, as for these remaining people, I will spare their lives for now. When your Divine Skill is perfected in the future, you can personally take their heads!"
That voice rang in Su Wanyi’s ears again.
Hearing these words, Su Wanyi’s heart trembled, and she was deeply moved beyond control.
A large, luminous hand suddenly reached out from the void, landed on Su Wanyi, grabbed her, and she instantly vanished.
In the next moment, Ye Yun withdrew his arm from the void and gave it a gentle shake.
Su Wanyi, dressed in purple robes, appeared before everyone’s eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 44: Su Wanyi Awakening from a Dream
chapters.content:
Chapter 44: Chapter 44: Su Wanyi Awakening from a Dream
Traversing the endless void.
Su Wanyi was enveloped in dazzling white light, her vision unable to penetrate the layer of brightness around her.
When the white light dissipated, her feet suddenly touched solid ground. Su Wanyi stood there dumbfounded, her eyes wide with disbelief, taking a moment to register her surroundings.
"Senior Sister!"
Seeing the Senior Sister she had longed for day and night, Luo Li could no longer contain her emotions. Tears streamed down her face as she rushed forward, throwing her arms around Su Wanyi.
Jun Moxiao, too, was overcome. Tears welling in his eyes, he ran to their side.
"Senior Sister... you’re finally back."
Jun Moxiao was crying and laughing, his expression wild with emotion.
"This is so touching!" Big Black Horse nuzzled Big Black Cat’s head and sighed.
The Big Black Cat, its wide, bright black eyes fixed on the familiar figure that had reappeared, couldn’t help but feel a great dread fill its heart.
This God-like Master... What level of terrifying cultivation base did he possess? With bare hands, he tore space apart and effortlessly brought someone back unscathed from tens of billions of miles away. In the Big Black Cat’s perception, only one word could describe this Master: God! This Master was absolutely an unparalleled God in all the world!
Upon this realization, the Big Black Cat couldn’t help but tremble with excitement.
To think it had seen a legendary God in its lifetime—this was truly too shocking! But then again, how could there be a God on the Cangnan Continent? Even the most powerful Eternal Sects didn’t have God Men!
"Junior Sister, Junior Brother, am I dreaming? How can I be seeing you here?" Su Wanyi frowned, still completely bewildered.
Luo Li released her, wiped the tears from her eyes, and exclaimed with delight, "Senior Sister, it was our Ancestor who brought you back from the Ten Thousand Beast Divine Sect!"
Ancestor?
Su Wanyi was momentarily stunned.
The Dragon God Sect’s heritage had dwindled; the old ancestors had been buried for countless years. When had a new Ancestor appeared? Moreover, this place was countless billions of miles from the Plough Heaven Dynasty; what kind of power would it take to bring her here unharmed over such an immense distance?
Seeing her Senior Sister still dazed, Luo Li quickly grabbed her hand, shook it gently, and pointed, saying with a smile, "Senior Sister, look over there... That’s our Ancestor, the thirteenth Sect Master of our Dragon God Sect."
"What?" Su Wanyi, as if jolting awake from a dream, quickly followed Luo Li’s gaze.
About ten meters away stood a young man in white. This young man in white had well-defined features, deep eyes, and flowing black hair. He radiated an unfathomable, ethereal aura, like an Immortal straight out of a painting.
"Junior Sister, is he... really our Ancestor?" Su Wanyi lowered her head and whispered.
She remembered that the thirteenth Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect was supposed to have died a hundred thousand years ago, wasn’t he?
"The Ancestor didn’t die; he came back to life," Luo Li said excitedly, her words becoming jumbled.
Even she didn’t quite understand. Had the Ancestor died and then returned to life, or... had he never died at all?
Seeing his two senior sisters speaking so incoherently, Jun Moxiao quickly said, "Senior Sister, this truly is our Ancestor. You should hurry and pay your respects."
Hearing Jun Moxiao’s words, Su Wanyi finally came to her senses. She quickly withdrew her hand from Luo Li’s, walked briskly forward, knelt before Ye Yun, and kowtowed respectfully three times.
"Su Wanyi pays respects to the Ancestor."
"Rise!" Ye Yun smiled gently. A wave of mana drifted out, lifting Su Wanyi to her feet.
"From today onwards, you three disciples will no longer be separated," Ye Yun said with a smile.
Upon hearing the Ancestor’s words, Luo Li, Jun Moxiao, and Su Wanyi were both shocked and overjoyed. Their emotions were incredibly mixed. They embraced, crying and laughing at the same time.
For more than a decade, they had followed their master, wandering from place to place, constantly fleeing enemies, and living a miserable, inhuman existence.
Now, not only had the Sect’s Ancestor returned to life, but he had also provided them with the strongest possible support.
Ye Yun stood with his hands clasped behind his back, watching the three of them weeping in each other’s arms, feeling quite moved himself.
「Later.」
After they had cried their fill, the three disciples calmed down and wiped the tears from their faces.
Su Wanyi then took a proper look at her Junior Brother and Junior Sister.
She was astonished to find that Luo Li had actually reached the Molding God Realm Tenth Layer.
Jun Moxiao’s cultivation base, meanwhile, had reached the peak of the Molding God Realm Tenth Layer, just one step away from the Divine Bridge Realm.
"How... how did your cultivation bases advance so quickly?" Su Wanyi asked in shock.
"Because we have the Ancestor!" Luo Li pouted, a proud smile on her face.
"..."
Su Wanyi blinked.
She wracked her brains but couldn’t fathom what kind of heavenly treasures could have allowed Luo Li and Jun Moxiao to advance so rapidly.
"Su Wanyi, your aptitude is no less than theirs. Your future is promising," Ye Yun said, looking at the bewildered Su Wanyi with a gentle smile.
"Ancestor, do you also have a way to make me like my Junior Brother and Junior Sister?" Su Wanyi asked, her voice trembling, her beautiful face flushed red with excitement.
Ye Yun nodded with a smile. He took out a small vial and slowly handed it to her.
Luo Li hurried over and whispered in Su Wanyi’s ear, "Senior Sister, the Ancestor has Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood. If you take a drop, you’ll be able to break through quickly too."
Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood? How is that possible?
Greatly shocked, Su Wanyi’s eyes widened. "Ancestor, wasn’t all of our Sect’s Divine Dragon Essence Blood destroyed by the Sect Master of the 250th generation?"
Ye Yun merely smiled.
The quick-witted Luo Li hurriedly explained, "Senior Sister, what the Sect destroyed was Divine Dragon Essence Blood... What our Ancestor has is Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood. You heard right, it’s Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood!"
"Oh." Su Wanyi nodded blankly, as if petrified.
Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood—those words alone made her mind go numb with shock. As a disciple of the Dragon God Sect, how could she not have heard of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood? But wasn’t Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood something that only existed in ancient legends?
Seeing her Senior Sister’s current expression, Luo Li could imagine her own past reaction. She leaned in again and said, "Senior Sister, did you know? There are over a hundred thousand drops in that small vial!"
My heavens! So much Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood!
Su Wanyi was so excited she nearly fainted.
"Senior Sister, you must stay strong! Don’t be like Junior Brother, who fainted the moment he heard!" Luo Li said with a laugh, holding Su Wanyi’s arm and shaking it gently.
Hearing this, Jun Moxiao’s face instantly turned red.
He had fainted twice back then. Thinking about it now, it was truly mortifying.
The Big Black Cat, lying beneath the horse’s hooves, also heard the words "Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood," and its eyes gleamed with an intense light.
The legendary Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood. It had never appeared on the Cangnan Continent...
The Big Black Cat licked its lips, wishing it too could taste the Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood.
THUD.
A black hoof slammed down on the Big Black Cat’s head, pressing its face into the dirt.
"You little cat, don’t even think about getting any funny ideas! Be careful, or Uncle Ma here will kill you outright!" Big Black Horse said irritably.

chapters.title: Chapter 45 The Ancestor Bestows Gifts
chapters.content:
Chapter 45: Chapter 45 The Ancestor Bestows Gifts
"Uncle Ma, even if you were to kill me, I wouldn’t dare covet the Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood! I’m just a Little Cat; I know my own limitations. From the very beginning, I’ve never harbored such thoughts. I implore Uncle Ma to see clearly..."
The Big Black Cat struggled to lift its head from the mud, spitting out the dirt it had swallowed, its two paws clasped over its head as it pleaded pitifully.
"That’s more like it. You, little kitty, have a good attitude and know your place."
The Big Black Horse grinned, using its hoof to smooth the fur on the Big Black Cat’s head, then chuckled gleefully.
It had to admit, this Little Black Cat rather appealed to it. Every ’Uncle Ma’ from the cat made the Big Black Horse’s heart bloom with joy.
Ye Yun glanced at the Big Black Horse, the corners of his mouth twitching upwards into a barely perceptible smile.
This Big Black Horse was diligent and hardworking, never complaining, and usually silent. Now, however, it seemed to have found a kindred spirit. The Big Black Horse and the Big Black Cat, interesting!
「 」
With a gentle turn of the small bottle in Ye Yun’s hand, a drop of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood, radiating a vigorous Super Divine Dragon Breath of life, floated into the air and drifted slowly towards Su Wanyi.
Su Wanyi’s breathing quickened, her small face flushed crimson with excitement.
"Junior- Junior Sister, what should I do?"
Seeing the Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood fly straight towards her, Su Wanyi became flustered and didn’t know what to do.
"Senior Sister, what are you hesitating for? Quickly swallow this drop of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood, then circulate our Dragon God Sect’s Cultivation Technique to rapidly refine it," Luo Li reminded her with a smile from the side.
"Oh!" Su Wanyi understood.
She opened her cherry-like mouth slightly and, with a gentle inhalation, swallowed the drop of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood.
Then, her body underwent an earth-shattering, astonishing transformation.
She hastily sat cross-legged on the ground, circulating the Dragon God Sect’s Cultivation Technique to refine the Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood.
The Super Divine Dragon Breath from her body surged, increasing at an incredible speed.
Fourth Level of the Mysterious Pill Realm.
Fifth Level of the Mysterious Pill Realm.
Sixth Level of the Mysterious Pill Realm.
...
First Level of the Origin Sea Realm.
Second Level of the Origin Sea Realm.
Third Level of the Origin Sea Realm.
...
Tenth Level of the Origin Sea Realm!
"Senior Sister, keep going!"
Luo Li’s face was full of anticipation. Seeing her Senior Sister reach the critical juncture of the Tenth Level of the Origin Sea Realm, she silently cheered her on in her heart.
Previously, she herself had advanced from the Gathering Qi Realm all the way to the Tenth Level of the Origin Sea Realm. But Senior Sister was already in the Mysterious Pill Realm; she should have a chance to break through to the Shaping God Realm.
Ye Yun watched Su Wanyi’s breakthrough with a calm expression, his face still as serene as undisturbed water.
The Big Black Cat beneath the horse’s hooves stared with wide eyes as Su Wanyi’s cultivation base skyrocketed. It said with a perturbed expression, "Uncle Ma, does this Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood possess such immense power? Can a single drop really cause someone’s cultivation base to soar so rapidly?"
The Big Black Horse bared its teeth, glared at it disdainfully, and scolded, "You good-for-nothing Little Cat, so short-sighted!"
"Please enlighten me, Uncle Ma!" the Big Black Cat raised its paws and said with a fawning smile.
The Big Black Horse snorted coldly. "Do you think just anyone can consume Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood? It must be a descendant of the Dragon Clan possessing the Dragon God Bloodline. Furthermore, this kind of advancement in cultivation base only occurs the first time the bloodline in the body is replaced. Subsequent consumption won’t result in such a terrifying speed of improvement."
Rarely hearing Uncle Ma offer such a detailed explanation, the Big Black Cat showed a grateful expression, quickly raising its paws again and bowing repeatedly in thanks.
"Thank you, Uncle Ma, for taking the trouble to enlighten this Little Cat."
"Hehe..."
The Big Black Horse chuckled twice, its black gem-like eyes glinting with smugness.
This Black Cat’s cultivation base was low, merely at the Nirvana Realm. In the eyes of him, Uncle Ma, it was no different from an ordinary demon beast.
BANG!
Su Wanyi’s body trembled. Her cultivation base broke through from the Tenth Level of the Origin Sea Realm to the First Level of the Shaping God Realm in one leap.
Only then did the astonishing Super Divine Dragon Breath gradually subside.
"Senior Sister has finally broken through!"
Jun Moxiao, who had been anxiously watching from the side, showed a joyful expression.
Luo Li also broke into a smile.
「 」
After a moment, Su Wanyi slowly opened her eyes. She walked over to Ye Yun, her knees buckled, and she knelt on the ground.
"Many thanks to the Ancestor for making this possible."
"Rise. There’s no need for such courtesy."
Ye Yun smiled and waved his hand. A surge of Mana swept out, lifting Su Wanyi to her feet.
"What color of Robe do you like?" Ye Yun asked.
Hearing the Ancestor’s question, Su Wanyi was momentarily stunned.
Luo Li, covering her mouth, chuckled softly from the side.
The Ancestor is going to give Senior Sister a gift... A Robe and a Divine Sword—these have already become standard issue for disciples of our Dragon God Sect.
"Reporting to the Ancestor, I... I like purple," Su Wanyi murmured, her small face blushing.
Ye Yun nodded. He fumbled at his wrist for a moment but found no purple Robe, a hint of disappointment showing on his face.
There were too few Robes suitable for women. In his inventory, there really wasn’t a single purple Robe. This put Ye Yun, the Ancestor, in a bit of an awkward position.
Ye Yun thought for a moment, then retrieved a golden Robe.
"There’s no purple Robe, but here’s a golden one. Wear it for now."
Ye Yun gave a small smile, tossing the Robe, which emitted a faint golden glow, to Su Wanyi.
Su Wanyi looked at the golden Robe, which radiated a brilliant golden light and was clearly extraordinary. She was utterly stunned.
When she took it in her hands and felt its Super Divine Dragon Breath, she looked up in shock and asked, "Ancestor, could this be an Emperor Level Robe?"
Ye Yun nodded.
Su Wanyi’s eyes widened, her breathing quickened, her heart pounded, and she once again seemed petrified, like a stone statue.
An Emperor Level Robe! The Ancestor... this is too generous!
Su Wanyi had spent three months in the Ten Thousand Beast Divine Sect of the Plough Heaven Dynasty and had seen a fair bit of the world.
Even the sect’s Disciples of Heaven’s Pride didn’t possess Emperor Level treasures.
Such Robes were only worn by the Peak Masters of the Nine Great Peaks and the Sect Master.
To think... the Ancestor would gift her an Emperor Level Robe! This left Su Wanyi profoundly shaken.
Ye Yun fumbled at his wrist again and took out a sword.
This was a red sword with a red scabbard. The moment it appeared, it exuded a terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath.
"This sword is for you."
With a gentle lift of his hand, Ye Yun sent this terrifying Red Sword floating towards Su Wanyi.
"This..."
Su Wanyi’s heart trembled as she accepted the sword with shaking hands.
She could hardly imagine the grade of this sword. Even the Sect Master didn’t possess such a powerful sword!
"Heavens, Uncle Ma! What kind of sword has the Master taken out this time? Why can’t I recognize it?"
The Big Black Cat scratched its fluffy head with its paw, its face a mask of shock.
"You ignorant Little Kitty who hasn’t seen the world! I really want to smash that skull of yours open and see what kind of rubbish is inside!"
The Big Black Horse bared its large white teeth, stomped its hoof hard on the cat, and said proudly, "Listen well, Little Kitty, that is God Level!"
"What! Uncle Ma? This is actually a God Level sword!"
The Big Black Cat was dumbstruck, its body as rigid as stone.
It had, after all, come from the Plough Heaven Dynasty and lived for a long time, but it had never seen a God Level treasure.
Today, its eyes had truly been opened. First, it saw the Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood. Then, it saw an Emperor Level Robe that only a master could wear. And now, it had witnessed a God-level Divine Sword that it would never forget for the rest of its life. Too terrifying! Truly worthy of an existence like a God!
The Big Black Cat gazed at Ye Yun’s retreating figure, its deep black cat eyes filled with threads of fervent worship.

chapters.title: Chapter 46 Nine-tailed Spirit Cat
chapters.content:
Chapter 46: Chapter 46 Nine-tailed Spirit Cat
The conversation between the Big Black Horse and the Big Black Cat echoed all around.
Su Wanyi naturally heard it as well.
Her hand trembled, and she nearly threw the sword away.
Could it really be a God-level Divine Sword? That was too terrifying!
Trembling all over, Su Wanyi raised her head and looked at Ye Yun with tearful eyes, pleading in a whining tone, "Ancestor, I’m just an ordinary disciple. Why would I need such a fine sword?"
Seeing Su Wanyi’s expression, Ye Yun smiled faintly and turned his gaze to Luo Li.
Luo Li, quick-witted, hurriedly went over, gently took Su Wanyi’s arm, and whispered, "Eldest Senior Sister, just accept it. I also received a God-tiered Sword."
As she spoke, Luo Li raised the Supreme Golden Dragon Sword in her hand and proudly waved it around.
Feeling the Super Divine Dragon Breath of this sword, Su Wanyi gave a bitter smile and said, "This sword of yours doesn’t look like it’s God level, does it?"
Luo Li giggled and said, "Eldest Senior Sister, I had the Ancestor seal it."
So that’s how it is.
Su Wanyi finally understood.
She gently drew the Seven-star Dragon Abyss Sword. Its blade was blood-red, and upon it, the faint shadow of a Divine Dragon could be seen. Seven stars also adorned the blade, emitting a dazzling radiance.
Luo Li glanced at it and clicked her tongue. "Eldest Senior Sister, your dragon isn’t as distinct as mine, but your sword has stars, and mine doesn’t."
Su Wanyi smiled and promptly sheathed the sword.
The Super Divine Dragon Breath the sword emitted was too terrifying.
Su Wanyi estimated that without the Ancestor suppressing this sword, she might not even be able to approach it.
"Ancestor, please seal this sword too, and also my Robe."
Su Wanyi knelt, holding up the sword and the golden Robe with both hands, her face full of entreaty.
"Okay..."
Ye Yun let out a soft sigh and nodded.
These three children, all from difficult backgrounds, were used to hardship. Now, even possessing top-tier Divine Swords, they dared not casually show them off. However, this was also good. The minds of these three children were extremely resilient; they were all talents with great future potential.
With this thought, Ye Yun gently pointed, and the grade of the Seven-star Dragon Abyss Sword swiftly descended from God level to Heaven Level. The golden Robe also descended to Heaven Level. Simultaneously, the Robes and swords of Luo Li and Jun Moxiao also dropped to the same level.
Luo Li shrugged and smiled. She was already used to this.
Jun Moxiao raised the sword in his hand and said with a woeful expression, "Ancestor, why did you give both my senior sisters God-level Divine Swords, but I only get an Emperor Level one?"
Ye Yun casually glanced at him and replied, "You are a man. The burdens you will have to bear in the future will be even greater."
Hearing this, Jun Moxiao’s young face instantly flushed red. He was merely fourteen and had never considered himself a man, always thinking of himself as still young. However, he understood from the Ancestor’s words that immense hopes were being placed on him.
He absolutely could not disappoint the Ancestor.
Sensing her junior brother’s emotional turmoil, Luo Li also approached and comforted him softly, "Junior Brother, the Ancestor naturally has his reasons for everything. You mustn’t feel down."
"Don’t worry, Second Senior Sister. I just said that casually. My only thought now is how to become stronger," Jun Moxiao said with a smile, his usual confident expression returning to his face.
Luo Li nodded in response.
Watching the three disciples, the Big Black Cat sucked in several sharp breaths.
He hadn’t expected that the sword in the hands of the girl called Luo Li was also a sealed God-level Divine Sword. And the one in the young man’s hand was an Emperor Level Divine Sword. The foundation of this Dragon God Sect was too terrifying! Although there were only three disciples, so few in number, their weapons were either God level or Emperor Level. Even an Eternal Level Sect probably couldn’t manage that, could they?
At this thought, the Big Black Cat quickly rubbed his furry body against the Big Black Horse’s thick legs.
The Big Black Horse lowered his head and glared at him irritably, "Little Cat, what mischief are you up to now?"
"Uncle Ma," the Big Black Cat said, putting on a thick-skinned smile, "don’t you need a page boy to serve you tea, fetch water, and run errands?"
"Stop your damn nonsense!" the Big Black Horse snorted. "What would I need a page boy for? I’m just a cart-puller."
The Big Black Horse lifted his hoof and brought it down heavily again.
SPLAT!
The Big Black Cat got another mouthful of mud.
He was not discouraged in the slightest. He spat out the mud, knelt again, and repeatedly made beseeching gestures with his front paws.
"Uncle Ma, if you don’t need a page boy, then how about I scratch your itches for you every day?"
As he said this, the Big Black Cat deliberately glanced at the Big Black Horse’s sturdy hindquarters and added with a fawning smile, "Although your cultivation base, esteemed elder, is heaven-shattering, there must be some spots you can’t quite reach, right?"
The Big Black Horse’s eyes widened.
He had never seen such a shameless demon cat. Today, this Big Black Cat had truly broadened his horizons!
"What nonsense are you spouting, you little cat? When has your Uncle Ma ever had an itch he couldn’t scratch?"
WHOOSH!
The Big Black Horse brought a hoof down again. This time, it was even heavier, directly squashing the entire Big Black Cat into a pit in the ground.
Seeing the Big Black Horse and the Big Black Cat squabbling so enthusiastically nearby, Ye Yun couldn’t help but chuckle.
These two demon beasts... they’re quite a comedic duo! Although the Big Black Cat’s cultivation base is pathetically low, he’s very amusing. Much more interesting than those peerlessly powerful pets in his warehouse.
Meanwhile, Jun Moxiao, Luo Li, and Su Wanyi also couldn’t help but laugh when they heard the conversation between the Big Black Horse and the Big Black Cat.
Flipping himself over in the dirt pit, the Big Black Cat jumped out, spat out the earth and sand, and once again sidled up to rub against the Big Black Horse’s thick leg.
"Uncle Ma, I just want to stay by your esteemed side and serve you! For the sake of this shameless cat face of mine, could you please put in a good word with the Master and give me a chance?" the Big Black Cat said pitifully.
The Big Black Horse shot him a cold glance and said irritably, "Do you think just anyone is qualified? I’m merely pulling the carriage for the Master. Your cultivation base, little cat, is too low. You won’t enter the Master’s sight. Go cool off wherever you came from."
Hearing this, the Big Black Cat instantly grew anxious. He hurriedly said, "Uncle Ma, although my cultivation base is low, I can do things that are inconvenient for you! For example, scratching itches, or telling you a joke, or something..."
"PAH!"
Hearing the Big Black Cat’s ridiculous words, the Big Black Horse, infuriated, sent the Big Black Cat flying with a kick.
Ye Yun reached out and caught the Big Black Cat in mid-air, letting him fall to the ground with a THUMP.
He looked at the Big Black Cat and asked lightly, "Little Cat, with all this elaborate scheming, are you trying to change your allegiance?"
Seeing this god-like Master suddenly speak, the Little Black Cat immediately prostrated himself on the ground and burst into tears, "Master, I truly wish to follow you! These are my heartfelt words!"
Ye Yun’s gaze flickered. It was as if, in that instant, he had seen through the Big Black Cat completely.
He smiled faintly and asked, "Was your former master not good to you?"
The Big Black Cat nodded repeatedly. "Master, my former master wasn’t bad to me, but he simply couldn’t provide me with the means to break through..."
Saying this, the Big Black Cat vigorously shook his rear, raising three tails. He said pitifully, "Master, look! After all these years, I’ve only managed to grow three tails..."
The Big Black Horse, standing nearby, stared wide-eyed in sudden realization. "Oh! So you’re of the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat bloodline!"
"That’s right, Uncle Ma! It’s precisely because I possess a diluted bloodline of the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat that I wish to pledge allegiance to the Master and follow him!" the Big Black Cat wailed, his face a mask of sorrow.

chapters.title: Chapter 47 Try Walking 2 Steps
chapters.content:
Chapter 47: Chapter 47 Try Walking 2 Steps
Ye Yun gave a faint smile, having already seen through the Big Black Cat’s act.
He was unfazed.
This little Nine-tailed Spirit Cat didn’t impress him at all.
In Cangnan Continent, the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat might be considered a rare species of demon beast, but in Ye Yun’s warehouse, it ranked nowhere near the top.
"Kitty, don’t get cocky just because you have the bloodline of the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat."
The Big Black Horse stamped his hoof heavily and snorted coldly, "In the eyes of Uncle Ma, you’re not even worth a fart."
The Big Black Cat’s fragile spirit was ruthlessly crushed by the Big Black Horse.
But it was still very tenacious; kneeling on both knees, it shakily crawled over again.
"Uncle Ma, surely the bloodline of the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat isn’t as pitiful as you make it sound? It is, after all, one of the top ten Divine Beasts on Cangnan Continent!" the Big Black Cat argued with a desolate face.
The Big Black Horse lifted his hoof again and placed it on the Big Black Cat’s head. He then gently smoothed its fur. With a pained expression, he said, "Don’t feel so bad. You know, a demon beast like your Uncle Ma here can’t even make it into the rankings at the Master’s place."
As soon as the Big Black Horse finished his sentence, not only was the Big Black Cat stunned, but even Luo Li and the other two onlookers wore looks of disbelief.
If such a powerful demon beast as the Big Black Horse couldn’t even rank, then the other great demons the Ancestor kept... wouldn’t they be powerful enough to pierce the heavens?
The three of them exchanged incredulous looks.
"Uncle Ma, you can’t be joking with me, old sir! The Master is indeed formidable, but surely he doesn’t have any demon beasts stronger than you?"
The Big Black Cat shook its head, utterly disbelieving Uncle Ma’s words.
The Big Black Horse bared his large white teeth in a grin. Looking at Ye Yun, he chuckled and said, "Master, this little kitty doesn’t believe it. How about we let it take a peek inside?"
Ye Yun’s smile didn’t betray any emotion, though there was amusement deep in his eyes.
This Big Black Cat might not be strong, but it did have a humorous personality. Having it as company would, at the very least, prevent the journey from being dull.
Although Ye Yun had many powerful demon beasts in his warehouse, he lacked this humorous, comical type.
With this in mind, Ye Yun nodded.
Having received Ye Yun’s approval, the Big Black Horse couldn’t help but grin broadly.
"Please, Master, take us back to the warehouse," the Big Black Horse said respectfully.
Ye Yun raised his hand, and the Big Black Horse and the Big Black Cat were taken directly into his warehouse.
Luo Li watched the two great demon beasts disappear, her expression somewhat shocked.
She glanced at Ye Yun with some fear, her voice trembling as she asked, "Ancestor, do you raise many demon beasts?"
Ye Yun nodded.
"You could say that."
Luo Li quickly covered her mouth in terror, not daring to speak again.
A single demon beast raised by the Ancestor, the Big Black Horse, is already this powerful. Doesn’t that mean... in his warehouse, there are many more such formidable demon beasts?
Jun Moxiao’s eyes widened as he stared at the Ancestor in shock, thinking to himself,
The Ancestor is too strong! He himself is absurdly powerful, and he also raises such a large pack of demon beasts. How is anyone else supposed to compete?
Ye Yun stood calmly in place, simultaneously extending a wisp of his Divine Sense to observe the activity within the warehouse.
The Big Black Horse and the Big Black Cat only felt their vision blur, and then space seemed to shift around them. Suddenly, they found themselves in a peculiar space.
The surroundings were pitch black, and nothing could be made out.
The Big Black Cat looked around, pouting as it said, "Uncle Ma, this place is empty. There aren’t any demon beasts here."
The Big Black Horse sneered.
"Why don’t you try walking a little further?"
The Big Black Cat, a little defiant, took a few cat-like steps forward.
In its heart, the Big Black Cat believed that there weren’t many demon beasts in this world capable of surpassing it, and Uncle Ma just happened to be one of them.
Therefore, it firmly believed that there couldn’t be that many powerful demon beasts existing in this world.
The power it referred to was mainly about bloodline.
If it, the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, could one day grow nine tails, its power would become incredible, on par with the legendary Gods.
Just as the Big Black Cat had taken two steps, the Big Black Horse suddenly brought its front hooves together before its chest, bowed respectfully, and said with a beaming smile, "Brothers and sisters, Little Horse is back to see you all!"
When the Big Black Cat suddenly heard Uncle Ma, the incredibly revered figure in its heart, use such respectful terms and make such ingratiating gestures, it was completely dumbfounded.
Before it could react, pair after pair of impossibly large, blood-red eyes suddenly opened in the endless darkness.
Terrifying figures, each exuding an overwhelming Super Divine Dragon Breath, slowly began to radiate various kinds of light in the darkness.
"Little Horse! You finally decided to come back. I thought I’d never see you again."
In the far darkness, a mountainous figure, wreathed in blazing flames, stood at the summit of the universe like a demon god.
The flames radiated boundless light. Even if the Big Black Cat poured all its Mana into its eyes, it still couldn’t clearly make out the demon god’s appearance.
It vaguely saw a blurred projection, seemingly a gigantic humanoid creature.
"Heavens, what kind of demon beast’s Super Divine Dragon Breath is this? How can it be so terrifying!"
The Big Black Cat screamed and immediately curled up, shaking all over with fear.
The humanoid figure in the distance was hundreds of times more terrifying than Uncle Ma.
"Brother Monkey, it’s been a while since we last met," the Big Black Horse grinned, an ingratiating expression on its face.
"Little Horse, you’re back?"
"Long time no see!"
At this moment, one terrifyingly huge figure after another began to greet the Big Black Horse.
The Big Black Cat curled into a ball. It looked at those terrifying figures—eccentric and bizarre, their features indistinct in the bright light—and was so scared that it peed itself.
Heavens!
How could there be so many powerful creatures?
Each of them seemed to be even stronger than the Big Black Horse.
This was too terrifying.
"Who’s this little wild cat? It’s so timid, it even peed itself."
「In the black void.」
A streak of golden light flashed, and a gigantic golden figure appeared, hovering in mid-air.
Its body radiated endless golden light, and its terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath made it appear like a God.
"Big Brother Jin, long time no see! The Master encountered this Little Cat on the road. It’s quite arrogant, claiming to be the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, one of the top ten Divine Beasts of the Cangnan Continent. The Master had me bring it here to broaden its horizons," the Big Black Horse said respectfully, looking up at the golden figure in the sky.
"So, it was the Master who let it in!" the golden figure laughed, carefully scrutinizing the Big Black Cat below.
"How about... I take it to broaden its horizons first? There are many brothers and sisters up ahead who are bored to death. It’s a perfect chance to send this Little Black Cat over for them to see."
The Big Black Horse grinned, "Big Brother Jin, I’ll have to trouble you then. But please, you must keep it alive. It seems the Master doesn’t want it scared to death."
"HAHAHA... Don’t worry. Even if it gets scared to death, we have ways to bring it back to life."
A dazzling golden light swept over the huddled Big Black Cat, and it vanished in an instant.
On the ground, only a puddle of cat pee remained.

chapters.title: Chapter 48 Uncle Ma, I Finally Met You
chapters.content:
Chapter 48: Chapter 48 Uncle Ma, I Finally Met You
"Damn it, Little Black Cat actually left a puddle of stinky cat pee here. When it comes back, I’ll make it lick it clean."
Looking at the stain on the ground, the Big Black Horse disgustedly shuffled a couple of steps to the side, distancing itself from the cat pee.
However. Cat pee was cat pee, and it had a strong, foul odor.
The Big Black Horse couldn’t tolerate it and had to cast a spell, encapsulating the cat pee under a light shield.
"Little Horse, how’s the outside world? Did you happen to meet a compatible mare to be your wife?"
Suddenly, a terrifying figure appeared in front of the Big Black Horse, landing upon it.
The Big Black Horse’s body sagged abruptly, and it nearly collapsed to the ground.
"Sister Feng, please be gentle. My scrawny little frame can’t withstand your mighty pressure..." the Big Black Horse complained with a mournful expression.
"Oh, my apologies, I forgot. I thought you, Little Horse, had been eating and drinking well with the Master out there, and had grown much stronger!"
The intimidating figure uttered this in a coquettish female voice.
Utilizing her Divine Skills, she lightened her force.
The Big Black Horse finally felt a bit better.
It shook its head, chuckled bitterly, and said, "Sister Feng, there are no suitable mares out there for me. I’m prepared to remain a bachelor for life!"
The intimidating figure chuckled gleefully.
"Is it fun outside?" she asked again.
The Big Black Horse shook its head, then quickly nodded.
"What’s that supposed to mean? Shaking your head and then nodding. Is it fun, or not?" The intimidating figure became displeased.
"Sister Feng, the people outside are too weak. There’s no way to have fun with them... What I meant by ’interesting’ is that there are three disciples in the Master’s Sect, and those three little ones are quite amusing..."
"Oh, I see!" The intimidating figure thought for a moment, then suggested coaxingly to the Big Black Horse, "Why don’t you go back and ask the Master if his three juniors need a Divine Pet? If they do, we’re willing to go out and be their Divine Pets."
"Alright, Sister Feng," the Big Black Horse reluctantly replied, lowering its head.
If all these terrifying beings were to venture out, wouldn’t the world be thrown into chaos? The Master’s original intention was to temper and train the disciples of his Divine Dragon Sect. If they started keeping pets, how could they ever be properly trained?
But the Big Black Horse dared not voice this concern, fearing that if Sister Feng became displeased, she might poke a few bloody holes in it.
Suddenly, a golden light descended.
THUD!
The golden, terrifying figure tossed the Big Black Cat onto the ground.
It grumbled, "This little fellow is such a disappointment. As soon as it got there, it fainted out of fear."
"Big Gold, you surely had malicious intentions, taking it to the most terrifying place, didn’t you?" Sister Feng chuckled.
"Hahaha... I wanted to let it see the world. Who knew it would faint from fright as soon as it got close? I was afraid it would actually be scared to death, so I quickly brought it back to avoid being punished by the Master."
After saying that, this golden horror flickered and disappeared.
"Little Horse, this kitten is too timid. Wake it up later and comfort it." Sensing that things weren’t right, Sister Feng hastily made her escape.
In the darkness, the terrifying figures closed their eyes one after another, succumbing to deep slumber once more.
The entire warehouse was again shrouded in darkness and silence.
The Big Black Horse shook its head, seemingly unaccustomed to this silence.
It recalled how they used to fight all the time! Why have they all become so fond of sleeping lately? Could it be that they’re worn out from all these years of fighting?
After a moment of thought, the Big Black Horse approached the Big Black Cat.
It stomped its hoof on the Big Black Cat’s head, infusing it with a stream of Mana.
Only then did the Big Black Cat slowly awaken.
"WAAH! Uncle Ma, I finally get to see you again! I thought I’d never see you again in this lifetime!"
Seeing the handsome horse face in the dark, the Big Black Cat felt an overwhelming sense of comfort. It sprang up, latched onto the Big Black Horse’s sturdy legs, and burst into tears.
It had just seen the most terrifying demon beast of its entire life. So terrified that it fainted on the spot. The demon beast had merely half-opened an eye and glanced at it.
The Big Black Cat felt like it had already died eight hundred times in Hell. It was truly horrifying!
"Stop crying, kitty. You understand how terrifying the Master’s place is now, don’t you?" the Big Black Horse said irritably.
"I do, Uncle Ma," the Big Black Cat said mournfully.
"So, from now on, be a low-profile cat. Don’t think you’re so great just because you’re a Nine-tailed Spirit Cat. In Uncle Ma’s eyes, you’re nothing," the Big Black Horse lectured earnestly, every inch an elder.
The Big Black Cat wiped away its tears and nodded vigorously.
"I won’t dare to be arrogant again. From now on, I’ll definitely be a low-profile cat."
"That’s more like it." The Big Black Horse pointed a hoof in a direction and said grumpily, "Look at your pathetic state, you even peed in the Master’s warehouse. Lick it clean right now, or else Uncle Ma will throw you in there and let them eat you."
Hearing the Big Black Horse’s threat, the Big Black Cat’s fur stood on end.
It dashed towards the puddle of cat urine like a flash, opened its mouth wide, and sucked all of it into its stomach.
The Big Black Horse saw the Big Black Cat swallow the urine, lifted its head, and exclaimed with disgust, "Ugh! Stay away from me; you’re absolutely filthy!"
He was, after all... a Big Black Horse who loved cleanliness.
"Master Horse, please rest assured. I used my Mana to break it down; there’s no odor," the Big Black Cat said, raising a paw and chuckling.
"Clever of you," the Big Black Horse said sullenly, then turned and walked out.
Having witnessed the entire process, Ye Yun couldn’t help but laugh to himself.
This time, the Big Black Cat was scared witless. Presumably, this fellow wouldn’t dare to be so arrogant ever again.
With a slight flick of his wrist, Ye Yun plucked the Big Black Horse and the Big Black Cat out of the warehouse.
Seeing the light of day once again, the Big Black Cat greedily gulped a few mouthfuls of fresh air, its face showing the relief of having survived a disaster.
BANG!
The Big Black Horse instantly brought a hoof down on its head.
The Big Black Cat quickly understood that now was not the time to revel. It hurriedly trotted over to Ye Yun’s feet and kowtowed repeatedly, saying, "Master, Little Cat knows its mistake. Please, give me another chance."
A faint smile touched Ye Yun’s lips. He stood with his hands behind his back and said softly, "If you wish to follow us, it’s not entirely out of the question. However, the current Sect Master of the Divine Dragon Sect is Luo Li. You should ask for her opinion."
Seeing that the Master didn’t object, the Big Black Cat’s heart leaped with joy, feeling that there was hope for this matter.
It swiftly rushed to Luo Li’s feet, knelt on the ground, and kowtowed. "Master Luo, I beg you, please take me in! The Sect will surely need a Divine Beast to guard it in the future, and I am definitely up to the task!"
Seeing this Big Black Cat suddenly kowtowing to her, Luo Li was quite startled. However, the sight of a cat kowtowing also struck her as rather amusing. She didn’t particularly dislike this Big Black Cat. But, the idea of accepting it seemed a bit too hasty.
Su Wanyi looked at the Big Black Cat, a hint of gratitude in her eyes.
"Junior Sister, this Senior Cat saved me once; I owe it a debt of gratitude. Why don’t you take it in?" Su Wanyi suggested softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 49 Divine Monarch Realm? Soon...
chapters.content:
Chapter 49: Chapter 49 Divine Monarch Realm? Soon...
"She even saved me before?"
Luo Li was slightly surprised. After a few seconds of hesitation, she smiled and nodded, "Alright then, Senior Sister, I will accept it."
"Thank you, Sect Master!"
Su Wanyi clasped her fists, a heartfelt smile gracing her beautiful, jade-like face as she performed a very formal salutation to the Sect Master.
"Haha... Eldest Senior Sister, there’s no need for such formalities between us. I only became Sect Master because Master appointed me on his deathbed. In terms of qualifications, I’m far less worthy than you!" Luo Li said, quickly waving her hands, her small face flushed red.
Su Wanyi adopted a serious expression. "Junior Sister, Master passing the Sect Master position to you definitely carries profound meaning. You absolutely must not belittle yourself."
"Yes, Second Senior Sister," Jun Moxiao also nodded in agreement nearby.
Luo Li gave a wry smile.
Perhaps within the entire Sect, she was the most skilled at escaping. That was probably what Master saw in her.
"Yippee!" Seeing Luo Li agree, the Big Black Cat excitedly somersaulted several times in the air.
"Thank you, Sect Leader!"
The Big Black Cat landed and kowtowed three times.
Then, he rushed to the Big Black Horse’s side, rubbing vigorously against his thick legs.
"Uncle Ma, look! I’m now a Divine Beast guarding the Dragon God Sect! You have a companion now, old timer!" the Big Black Cat said with a fawning smile.
