The Big Black Horse abruptly raised its hoof and kicked him, saying viciously, "What are you so smug about? Just focus on doing your own work properly."
The Big Black Cat was knocked into the dirt by this hoof, getting a mouthful of mud.
However, he was so excited that he didn’t feel discouraged at all. He crawled out, spat out the mud, and became his cheerful self again.
Seeing this, Ye Yun smiled faintly. "Little Horse, I’ll leave its discipline to you."
The Big Black Horse grinned, revealing a row of white teeth. "Thank you, Master. This Little Cat indeed lacks discipline. It’s high time he was properly managed."
Seeing that the Master had spoken, the Big Black Cat was instantly too scared to say another word.
If the Master got angry and threw him into the dark warehouse, he would be miserable.
Ye Yun glanced around and said softly, "Alright, it’s time for us to leave this place."
"Old Ancestor, where are we going next?" Luo Li asked curiously.
"There’s nothing left for us in the Ancient Moon Dynasty. Our next stop is the Shenfeng Dynasty."
"There, you can all train diligently. Strive to confront the Shen Heng Sect soon and uncover the mastermind behind the persecution of the Dragon God Sect," Ye Yun said with a faint smile.
"Understood, Old Ancestor," Luo Li replied with a serious expression.
Ye Yun looked at Luo Li and Jun Moxiao. "You two have been through a great battle in the Sword God Sect and are now covered in injuries. Return to your carriages and recuperate."
With that said, he waved his sleeve, and both of them vanished instantly.
Su Wanyi was speechless, looking at Ye Yun in utter confusion, wondering where her junior brother and sister had vanished.
"Su Wanyi, come with me," Ye Yun said softly.
A gentle glow enveloped Su Wanyi, and she, along with Ye Yun, disappeared from the spot, reappearing inside the carriage.
The Big Black Cat deftly leaped onto the carriage, curled up, and settled there.
The Big Black Horse harnessed himself to the carriage and pulled it out of the valley.
"Little Cat, your Uncle Ma here doesn’t know the way to the Shenfeng Dynasty. You should know, right?" the Big Black Horse asked, looking around after emerging from the white mist of the valley, then turning to the Big Black Cat.
"Uncle Ma, you’ve certainly asked the right person! I’m practically an encyclopedia of the Cangnan Continent!" the Big Black Cat chuckled, raising his black paw and pointing southeast. "Uncle Ma, head that way, old timer."
The Big Black Horse chuckled and began moving towards the Shenfeng Dynasty.
Inside the carriage, Ye Yun started teaching Su Wanyi the three Ultimate Techniques of the Dragon God Sect.
「More than half a month later.」
The black carriage slowly entered the territory of the Shenfeng Dynasty.
Ye Yun had instructed it earlier, so the Big Black Horse did not rush. It simply proceeded on the ground at a normal walking pace.
"Master, we’ve arrived in the Shenfeng Dynasty. Ahead is Silver Moon City, the largest border city of the Shenfeng Dynasty," the Big Black Cat turned his head and said softly towards the carriage.
"Good," Ye Yun uttered a single word.
At this time, he was the only one sitting in the carriage. He had also sent Su Wanyi to a separate space to cultivate. During this period, Ye Yun had only been giving her regular guidance.
Ye Yun’s fingers tapped lightly, as if sensing something, and a faint smile touched the corners of his mouth. At that moment, from a certain space within the black carriage, an astonishing Super Divine Dragon Breath suddenly erupted.
Luo Li’s body trembled as if some chain within her had been unlocked. In an instant, her Super Divine Dragon Breath became incredibly powerful.
At this moment, Luo Li had successfully broken through to the Divine Bridge Realm.
"Old Ancestor, I’ve broken through!" Luo Li exclaimed, clenching her fists in exultation after her breakthrough.
"Very good. After your breakthrough, consume a drop of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood and continue to consolidate your cultivation for a while..."
A gentle voice echoed in Luo Li’s space. A faint light flickered, and a drop of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood materialized before her.
"Thank you, Old Ancestor," Luo Li said respectfully. She opened her mouth, swallowed the Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood, then sat cross-legged and began to refine it.
Ye Yun looked in another direction. Jun Moxiao had also broken through to the Divine Bridge Realm seven days prior and was now refining Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood.
Ye Yun felt greatly relieved now that these two young disciples had both broken through to the Divine Bridge Realm.
Currently, Su Wanyi was the one with the weakest cultivation.
Ye Yun planned to give her the same special training.
So, he summoned Su Wanyi, who was in the midst of her Cultivation.
With a light tap of his finger, Su Wanyi’s cultivation base instantly dropped from the First Level of the Shaping God Realm to the First Level of the Origin Sea Realm, a fall of an entire Major Realm.
"Old Ancestor?" Seeing her realm plummet so suddenly, Su Wanyi was startled. She looked at the Old Ancestor with a puzzled expression.
Ye Yun said lightly, "All disciples of My Divine Dragon Sect must be invincible within their realm and adept at combat across levels. Therefore, I have forcibly suppressed your cultivation by one Major Realm. This is to help you achieve a breakthrough under pressure."
"Oh..." Su Wanyi blinked.
Ye Yun smiled. "Luo Li experienced the same. In the past, her cultivation was also suppressed to the First Level of the Origin Sea Realm. Only after cultivating step by step to the Tenth Layer of the Origin Sea Realm did she remove the Seal and break through to the Divine Bridge Realm."
"So that’s how it is. Thank you, Old Ancestor, for your painstaking efforts to cultivate me." Realizing the Old Ancestor’s painstaking intentions, Su Wanyi felt a wave of shame and immediately knelt on the ground to kowtow.
Ye Yun stretched out his hand, and a stream of Mana swept out, lifting Su Wanyi.
He smiled. "The current Luo Li can defeat dozens of Cultivators of the same level without any problem."
"Little Junior Sister... she’s that powerful already?" Su Wanyi said in astonishment.
Deep within her eyes, a look of extreme envy surfaced.
Ye Yun looked indifferently towards Silver Moon City, seemingly perceiving something. He said meaningfully, "The overall strength of the Shenfeng Dynasty is more than ten times greater than that of the Ancient Moon Dynasty. Your trials... will begin in Silver Moon City."
"Understood, Old Ancestor," Su Wanyi said obediently.
Ye Yun closed his eyes again, resting his spirit.
His cultivation base had broken through once more; he was now at the True God Realm Nine Layers. Once he entered the True God Realm Tenth Layer, the cultivation base enhancement from the Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood would be almost completely consumed. At that time, Ye Yun could start consuming the various spirit pills, miraculous medicines, and heavenly resources obtained from his check-ins. Divine Monarch Realm? Ye Yun believed it wouldn’t be long before he could break through to that realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 50 Tri-element Martial Meeting
chapters.content:
Chapter 50: Chapter 50 Tri-element Martial Meeting
「Silver Moon City.」
At this moment, inside the newly decorated City Lord’s Mansion, lights and decorations were everywhere. Colorful ribbons fluttered in the air, and the atmosphere was joyous. People were coming and going; the scene bustled with activity.
Most of the people who arrived at the City Lord’s Mansion gathered in the main square. In the center, a high stage had been set up for martial arts competitions. Surrounding it were viewing stands of various sizes, all filled with guests, the crowd overflowing.
Inside the largest viewing stand, three powerful Shapers were seated prominently in the center. In the very middle sat a robust, middle-aged man with a heavy beard and a rather fierce appearance. Although he looked fierce, his face was wreathed in smiles.
He was the City Lord of Silver Moon City—Xiong Yinghao. The City Lord’s Mansion was so lively today because of the upcoming Tri-element Martial Meeting.
The Tri-element Martial Meeting was held every three years. In previous years, Xiong Yinghao’s mood had been indifferent. This time, however, he was the most excited. His son, Xiong Chumo, had been preselected as an inner disciple by the Qitian Sword Sect. Therefore, in this Tri-element Martial Meeting, his son was the true protagonist.
Although the selections were preset, the Tri-element Martial Meeting’s proceedings would still go on as usual. On his left and right sat the Clan Leaders of the Ouyang Family and the Dongfang Family, respectively. Ouyang Xiu of the Ouyang Family, at the Origin Sea Realm sixth layer, had also been preselected to join the Chaos Element Sword Sect. Dongfang Jade of the Dongfang Family, at the Origin Sea Realm fifth layer, had been preselected for the Qingyun Sect.
In recent years, Silver Moon City had seen a surge of talented individuals, producing an unprecedented three preselection quotas. The Tri-element Martial Meeting determined the Heavenly Yuan, Earthly Yuan, and Human Yuan positions. His son, Xiong Chumo, was considered to hold the Heavenly Yuan position. Ouyang Xiu was considered to hold the Earthly Yuan position, and Dongfang Jade the Human Yuan position.
Previous Tri-element Martial Meetings had always involved fierce competition before the top three spots could be decided. This time, however, the three major sects had already predetermined the placements. Therefore, the three Yuan positions already had their designated individuals. Everything was tacitly understood.
Whether it was the Xiong Family, the Ouyang Family, or the Dongfang Family, everyone was well aware of the situation, and no one would expose it. Today’s Tri-element Martial Meeting was still lively because the other families in Silver Moon City, as well as the surrounding forces, were still unaware of this news.
Just as the Tri-element Martial Meeting was about to commence, a black carriage slowly drove into Silver Moon City.
The Big Black Cat lay lazily on the carriage and sighed, "I haven’t been to Silver Moon City for quite some years. It’s still the same old place, no changes..."
The Big Black Horse turned its head and gave it a harsh glare.
"Uncle Ma, I was being too talkative," the Big Black Cat said, flustered. "I’m just a cat now; I shouldn’t run my mouth like that." It hurriedly swatted its own cat face with its paw.
Before entering the city, the Big Black Horse had warned it that this place had many eyes and ears, so it should speak as little as possible. The moment the Big Black Cat entered the city, it forgot this instruction.
At this moment, Su Wanyi, who was also on the carriage, watched the Big Black Cat punish itself. She couldn’t help but smile gently and said, "Senior Cat, you don’t have to punish yourself like this."
The Big Black Cat dared not speak. It shook its head vigorously and then sent a Divine Thought, "Miss, you must not call me Senior Cat. Just call me Little Cat from now on," it transmitted in a panicked tone.
"Senior Cat, you are older than I am and have saved my life. We mustn’t disregard the proper courtesies," Su Wanyi said softly, with a light laugh.
The Big Black Cat kept shaking its head, stubbornly refusing. "Miss, if you call me Senior, how could I possibly face the Sect Leader? How about this: you can call me Little Black. Don’t worry, this cat face of mine is plenty thick-skinned!"
Su Wanyi was speechless but had no choice but to shake her head and laugh bitterly.
After the Big Black Horse entered the city, it seemed to know the way, making numerous turns before arriving in front of a tall building.
Su Wanyi looked up to see a lofty, grand, vermilion gate adorned with lights and festoons. Many people were coming and going, making it extremely lively. A large golden plaque hung above the gate, bearing the three large words "City Lord’s Mansion."
"The Tri-element Martial Meeting is being held here. Su Wanyi, you should go participate!"
Just as Su Wanyi was feeling puzzled, the voice of her Ancestor suddenly rang out beside her ear.
What is the Tri-element Martial Meeting?
Su Wanyi was full of doubts. But since her Ancestor had given an order, she dared not disobey.
Su Wanyi quickly alighted from the carriage and headed towards the gate of the City Lord’s Mansion.
Ye Yun opened his eyes, watched Su Wanyi’s retreating figure, and said gently, "Little Cat, you go with her."
"Certainly, Master," the Big Black Cat replied, delighted. It immediately leaped from the carriage, transformed into a streak of black light, and landed on Su Wanyi’s shoulder.
It now appeared palm-sized, its two black, gem-like eyes darting around. Perched on Su Wanyi’s shoulder, it looked exceedingly cute. Remembering the Big Black Horse’s instructions, the Big Black Cat immediately suppressed its cultivation base. Now, it looked no different from an ordinary little kitten.
The Big Black Cat even specifically sent a telepathic message to the Big Black Horse, "Uncle Ma, how do I look?"
"Acceptable..." the Big Black Horse transmitted back, baring its teeth. "Remember, you are only there to ensure the Young Miss’s safety. You must remain low-key and absolutely cannot steal her spotlight!"
Su Wanyi felt something land on her shoulder. Looking down, she was surprised to see it was the Big Black Cat.
Before Su Wanyi could speak, the Big Black Cat grinned and sent a telepathic message, "Young Miss, you don’t need to say anything. The Master asked me to accompany you."
Su Wanyi nodded slightly, her heart warmed, and she was moved beyond measure.
Her Ancestor must be worried about me, to have the Big Black Cat stay by my side for protection.
As Su Wanyi appeared outside the City Lord’s Mansion, her glittering golden Daoist robe immediately attracted everyone’s attention. Her figure was graceful. With a red treasured sword strapped to her back, she exuded a heroic and valiant aura. Her beauty was so devastatingly captivating that words could hardly describe it.
A young girl in green, also with a treasured sword on her back, quickly caught up with Su Wanyi and asked with a smile, "Elder Sister, are you also here to participate in the Tri-element Martial Meeting?"
"Yes!" Su Wanyi nodded.
This girl in green was about fifteen or sixteen years old, roughly the same age as Luo Li. However, her cultivation base was quite high, already at the Origin Sea Realm Second Layer. She had a chubby, apple-shaped face, large, watery eyes, and long eyelashes, making her look extremely cute.
"That’s wonderful, Elder Sister! I’m also here for the Tri-element Martial Meeting!" the girl in green said with a smile.
"Perfect. Let’s go together," Su Wanyi smiled. The two of them then walked into the City Lord’s Mansion side by side.
Upon entering the City Lord’s Mansion, Su Wanyi surveyed her surroundings, pondering her next move. Just then, she heard the girl in green beside her say with a laugh, "Elder Sister, judging by your appearance, this must be your first time attending the Tri-element Martial Meeting, right?"
Su Wanyi nodded.
Her Ancestor had brought her here, and now she was inside the City Lord’s Mansion. She was still completely bewildered and had not the slightest understanding of this so-called Tri-element Martial Meeting.
The girl in green smiled, her eyes twinkling merrily as she explained, "The Tri-element Martial Meeting is a martial gathering held every three years by all the forces around Silver Moon City. Anyone under twenty years of age with a cultivation base in the Origin Sea Realm can participate. The top three in the Martial Meeting represent the Heavenly Yuan, Earthly Yuan, and Human Yuan. These three individuals will not only receive rewards from the City Lord but will also be noticed by powerful sects and recruited as inner disciples."
Listening to the green-clad girl’s explanation, Su Wanyi nodded. She now had some understanding of this Tri-element Martial Meeting.
BOOM!
Not far away, a loud noise suddenly erupted, followed by a chorus of enthusiastic cheers from the surrounding crowd. The girl in green looked towards the commotion, her face lighting up with excitement. Tugging at Su Wanyi’s sleeve, she laughed, "Elder Sister, there’s a Power-measuring stone over there! Let’s hurry and test our strength!"

chapters.title: Chapter 51 Measuring Force, Initial Shock
chapters.content:
Chapter 51: Chapter 51 Measuring Force, Initial Shock
Pulled along by the enthusiastic little girl in green, Su Wanyi felt it would be impolite to refuse and followed her.
"Little girl, what’s your name?" Su Wanyi asked with a smile.
"I’m Chang Lu Die. You can call me Lu Die, Sister," the little girl in green said with a grin.
"Mm, I am Su Wanyi," Su Wanyi also introduced herself.
"What a lovely name you have, Sister Su!" Chang Lu Die replied cheerily.
The pair chatted and laughed as they approached the crowd gathered around the Power-measuring Stone.
"What are they doing?"
A confused look appeared on Su Wanyi’s face.
In front of them stood a massive stone, ten meters tall and entirely black.
At that moment, a young man raised his Sword and struck the Power-measuring Stone.
BOOM!
As the Sword collided with the stone, a loud echo resounded.
A gleam of light suddenly shot out from the top of the Power-measuring Stone.
"The light is red."
The crowd burst into cheers.
"Haha... Another person has passed the Power-measuring Stone test," Chang Lu Die clapped her hands, laughing.
Noticing Su Wanyi’s confusion, she quietly explained, "Sister Su, although those under the age of twenty with a cultivation base in the Origin Sea Realm can participate, not everyone is allowed. So, this Power-measuring Stone helps eliminate those with insufficient strength."
Looking at the Power-measuring Stone, Su Wanyi asked with a smile, "So, a red light means I’ve passed?"
"Yes, if a red light appears, you can participate in the Tri-element Martial Meeting. However, you can only compete for places from fourth to tenth," Chang Lu Die explained.
"Besides red, are there other colors of light?" Su Wanyi inquired further.
"If your strike can make the Power-measuring Stone emit golden light, you will have the qualification to compete for the Heaven, Earth, and Human Realm." As she spoke, Chang Lu Die looked at the red leaderboard beside the Power-measuring Stone and said with a bit of surprise, "Wow! This year, nine people already qualify to compete for the Heaven, Earth, and Human Realm, far more than in the previous session."
Su Wanyi nodded her head.
Thanks to the little girl’s explanation, she now had a basic understanding of the Tri-element Martial Meeting. Since the Ancestor Dragon had instructed her to participate in the Tri-element Martial Meeting, he naturally wouldn’t expect her to aim for placings outside the Heaven, Earth, and Human rankings. Her goal was aimed squarely at the Heaven, Earth, and Human Realm itself. Thinking of her junior brother and junior sister’s extraordinary achievements under the Ancestor Dragon’s supervision—unparalleled among those of the same cultivation level—Su Wanyi clenched her fists. She felt that no matter what, she must achieve the best possible result in this Tri-element Martial Meeting. Even though she was only at the First Level of the Origin Sea Realm, she was determined to strive for the top.
"Sister Su, below the red light is white light. If one gets a white light, they can compete for ranks from eleventh to twentieth."
"That’s the range I’m aiming for this time," Chang Lu Die said with a beaming smile.
"Alright, let’s go test ourselves," Su Wanyi said with a light smile, and the two walked side by side, squeezing into the crowd.
The young man who had previously produced the red light, seemingly unsatisfied, launched a second strike. With another loud sound, red light emerged once again. He shook his head, collected a Token, and headed towards the central square arena.
Chang Lu Die led Su Wanyi to register, and then they joined the queue.
There were quite a few people ahead, but many didn’t meet the standard; some could only make the Power-measuring Stone emit white light.
Soon, it was their turn.
Chang Lu Die went first. She swung her Sword, landing it heavily on the Power-measuring Stone.
BOOM!
The Power-measuring Stone rumbled, and a white light rose from its top.
"Haha, this is incredible!" Chang Lu Die danced with delight, then turned to encourage Su Wanyi, "Sister Su, you have to do your best too! Let’s both aim for the top twenty!"
Su Wanyi smiled.
This Little Lu Die was at the Second Level of the Origin Sea Realm, so it was natural for her to encourage Su Wanyi, who was at the First Level.
Su Wanyi stepped forward, drawing the blood-red Seven-star Dragon Abyss Sword from her back.
"Wow! Sister Su, your Sword is actually Heavenly Quality!" Chang Lu Die couldn’t help but exclaim upon seeing Su Wanyi’s Sword.
Those who could wield a Heavenly Quality Sword always came from extraordinary backgrounds. The Sword she used, from a Second-Tier Major Clan in Silver Moon City, was only of Earth Level. Only her Clan Leader, her father, used a Heavenly Quality Sword. Chang Lu Die felt that this Sister Su was becoming increasingly mysterious.
Many spectators were gathered around, most of them Cultivators. When the crowd saw the young and beautiful Su Wanyi draw a blood-red Sword, they couldn’t help but be slightly startled. This Sword, though it didn’t carry a bloodthirsty killing intent, gave off an extremely stunning impression, especially with the seven stars on its blade, adding to its mystique.
Su Wanyi raised the Sword in her hand, her gaze falling upon its blade.
This Sword had been sealed by the Ancestor Dragon, so the spectral image of the Divine Dragon had vanished. Only seven slightly dim stars remained. Su Wanyi was calm and composed. Holding this Heavenly Quality Sword, she felt a sense of ease. If it were truly a God-level Sword, she wouldn’t dare to be standing here.
Each person had two attempts at the Power-measuring Stone.
Su Wanyi took a light breath, raised the Seven-star Dragon Abyss Sword, and brought it down heavily upon the Power-measuring Stone.
BOOM!
The resulting sound was earth-shattering, and the ground trembled three times.
Everyone was greatly shocked, their eyes wide as they stared at the exceptionally beautiful young woman.
That strike just now... Was it really her?
BUZZ!
A golden light burst forth from the top of the Power-measuring Stone. This golden light was incredibly brilliant, seeming to illuminate the entire surrounding void in that instant.
The Cultivator supervising the Power-measuring Stone stared, his eyes wide in disbelief at the sight. Although no Purple Light appeared, this golden light was so dazzling and vast that it had reached the very peak of gold. Who would have thought that a young woman at only the First Level of the Origin Sea Realm could possess such terrifying power?
Could it be that she possesses some kind of bloodline power?
Standing behind her, Chang Lu Die’s eyes widened as she exclaimed, "Sister Su, you’re too strong! You actually produced golden light!"
Su Wanyi felt a tremor in her heart at the commotion she had caused. She quickly sheathed the Seven-star Dragon Abyss Sword. Like Luo Li and Jun Moxiao, Su Wanyi was also of a cautious and low-key nature.
She had only used half her strength just now, yet she hadn’t expected to cause such an astonishing stir with the Power-measuring Stone. It had truly caught her by surprise. She secretly surmised that it must be the drop of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood that had replaced her own exceedingly thin Dragon God Bloodline. That Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood had completely remolded her body, granting her immense power.
In legends, dragons were Divine Beasts renowned for their immense strength. Humans possessing the Dragon Clan Bloodline, once it was activated, would find their physical bodies becoming exceptionally strong, and the power they wielded would far surpass that of their peers.
"Which sect are you a disciple of? Your strength is truly incredible!" the Cultivator in charge of recording approached, his face a mask of shock, and asked.
"I am from the Dragon God Sect," Su Wanyi said calmly.
At this moment, under the bright sunshine, with a gentle breeze, she slightly lifted her fair and radiant chin. In her calm voice, a hint of quiet pride was concealed.

chapters.title: Chapter 52: Dragon God Sect? Never heard of it
chapters.content:
Chapter 52: Chapter 52: Dragon God Sect? Never heard of it
"Dragon God Sect?"
The cultivator shook his head; he had never heard of this sect before.
Probably just an obscure minor sect with no reputation.
However, this disciple possessed extraordinary talent; her physical prowess was remarkably strong, causing such an astonishing stir with the Power-measuring stone. In past Tri-element Martial Meetings, such occurrences were not unheard of.
"This is your competition token, take it! As long as you achieve a good ranking, prestigious sects will accept you as an inner disciple. From then on, you will rise above the masses, thoroughly leaving behind those insignificant minor sects!"
The cultivator handed over a golden token, placing it in Su Wanyi’s hand. Then, with a slight smile, he turned and left.
Upon receiving the token, Su Wanyi’s cheeks unexpectedly flushed.
This man, how dare he call her sect an insignificant minor sect? She wished she could slay him with her sword. Her Dragon God Sect, if traced back one hundred thousand years, was so glorious! An Eternal Level sect, a colossal existence; any disciple emerging from it could make the entire Cangnan Continent tremble.
The Big Black Cat squatting on her shoulder immediately became restless.
"Damn it, this young monk dares to speak ill of our Dragon God Sect. I absolutely cannot spare him. I will make sure he has no descendants!" the Big Black Cat transmitted in an angry mental message.
Its two shiny black eyes emitted two beams of black light, which flashed and vanished.
The departing cultivator suddenly stumbled and nearly fell.
Another cultivator nearby, with quick eyes and hands, steadied him.
"What’s wrong, Senior Brother Li?" that cultivator asked with concern.
"My back... it hurts so much..."
Senior Brother Li clutched his lower back, feeling an unbearable pain, as if he were about to collapse.
"Let me help you to the back room to rest. Senior Brother Zhao can manage things out here."
The other cultivator’s expression changed instantly, and he quickly supported Senior Brother Li towards a room at the back.
Su Wanyi turned her head to look at the little black kitten on her shoulder and sent a mental message.
"What did you do to him?"
The Big Black Cat proudly lifted its head and chuckled, "Miss, I said I’d make him have no descendants, and so I really did make him have no descendants."
Su Wanyi laughed, though her face turned slightly red.
"It seems no one can see you, Cat Senior," Su Wanyi blinked.
This little black kitten, squatting on her conspicuous golden robe, should theoretically attract a lot of attention. But strangely, even Chang Lu Die, who had been by her side all along, hadn’t noticed it.
"Miss, I’m hidden. Only you can see me; they all can’t," the Big Black Cat replied smugly.
"I see."
Su Wanyi came to a sudden realization.
The Big Black Cat said with a mournful face, "Miss, please don’t call me Cat Senior anymore, or it will shorten my lifespan. From now on, just call me Little Black. We cultivators are particular about seniority, don’t you agree?"
"Alright then."
Seeing this Cat Senior so insistent on the title, Su Wanyi could only nod helplessly in agreement.
At this moment, Chang Lu Die, having recovered her senses, rushed over, grabbed Su Wanyi’s hand, and exclaimed in surprise, "Sister Su, I never expected you to be so powerful!"
"It’s alright," Su Wanyi replied with a gentle smile, showing no excessive emotion.
"Sister Su, come on, let’s go to the competition stage."
Chang Lu Die pulled Su Wanyi’s hand and quickly walked towards the stage in the center of the square.
At that moment, there was still about a stick of incense’s time before the official start of the Tri-element Martial Meeting.
Everyone was eagerly anticipating it.
Just then, a cultivator from the City Lord’s Mansion came over to check their competition tokens.
One of them led Su Wanyi to the Golden Token Region.
Chang Lu Die, on the other hand, was taken to the white token area.
The most crucial part of the Tri-element Martial Meeting was the competition of the Heaven, Earth, and Human Realms. The contest for the top three rankings would be held on the first day, while the competition for the subsequent rankings would take place on the second day.
「Next to the competition arena...」
A luxurious, large spectator stand had been built separately.
At that moment, nine teenagers stood under the stand, each exuding a robust aura, their faces filled with pride.
Among these nine, Xiong Chumo from the City Lord’s Mansion had the highest cultivation base. He had already reached the seventh level of the Origin Sea Realm.
Ranked second and third were Ouyang Xiu from the Ouyang Family and Dongfang Jade from the Dongfang Family, respectively.
As for the remaining six, the one with the lowest cultivation base was at the fourth level of the Origin Sea Realm. Most of them were around the fifth level of the Origin Sea Realm.
Footsteps sounded.
A middle-aged cultivator walked in, escorting a stunningly beautiful young woman in a golden robe, carrying a red jewel sword on her back.
Upon seeing this beautiful girl, everyone’s eyes brightened; they were astounded by her beauty.
This girl is just too beautiful! Her beauty is beyond words!
A hint of greed flashed in Xiong Chumo’s eyes.
But immediately, he crossed his arms, looked coldly at the middle-aged cultivator, and asked, "Did you come to the wrong place? This is the waiting area for golden tokens."
The middle-aged cultivator cupped his fists and bowed respectfully, saying, "Greetings, Master Xiong. I did not make a mistake. This young lady just received a golden competition token."
"Really?" Ouyang Xiu, who was beside them, looked at Su Wanyi’s exquisitely beautiful face with a shocked expression and frowned. "She’s only at the First Level of the Origin Sea Realm, yet she was able to produce golden light on the Power-measuring stone?"
The middle-aged cultivator nodded with a wry smile.
Then, he turned to Su Wanyi and said in a low voice, "Miss Su, please show your golden competition token."
Su Wanyi held up the golden token.
Seeing it, the nine teenagers beside them couldn’t help but gasp.
To produce golden light from the Power-measuring stone at only the First Level of the Origin Sea Realm—this girl has some real skill!
Xiong Chumo, with his hands behind his back, looked at the beautiful Su Wanyi and smiled. "Miss, you have good talent. If there’s an opportunity in the future, I will help recommend you to a major sect."
"No need!"
Su Wanyi’s expression instantly turned cold. She quickly walked to a corner, looked towards the stage, and said no more.
Seeing this beauty so cold and distant, a playful smirk appeared on everyone’s faces.
How interesting. Where did this girl pop up from?
Dongfang Jade wondered, a fervent light flashing in his eyes as he gazed at her graceful, slender silhouette.
He’d taken a fancy to this girl at first sight. After the competition, he absolutely had to investigate and find out which sect she belonged to.
「Meanwhile...」
A cultivator from the City Lord’s Mansion hurried towards the largest spectator stand in the field and handed a secret report to Xiong Yinghao.
Xiong Yinghao looked puzzled as he opened it, and his expression changed slightly.
"Lord Xiong, what happened?" Clan Leader Ouyang Zhentian of the Ouyang Family glanced over.
"Nothing much, just a little girl who produced golden light on the Power-measuring stone suddenly appeared..." Xiong Yinghao said with a faint smile.
"What? The competition is about to start, and another golden light contestant has appeared?" Ouyang Zhentian was slightly surprised and quickly asked, "What is this little girl’s cultivation base?"
"Merely the First Level of the Origin Sea Realm. Nothing to worry about!" Xiong Yinghao shrugged dismissively.
"The distinguished guest has arrived!" he exclaimed. Glancing into the distance, his expression suddenly changed. He promptly rose to his feet and walked out.
The clan leaders of the other two major families also saw three figures rapidly approaching from high in the distant sky. Surprise gleamed in their eyes as they hastened to follow.
The people from the three major sects had arrived.

chapters.title: Chapter 53 Ferocious Big Black Cat
chapters.content:
Chapter 53: Chapter 53 Ferocious Big Black Cat
"Greetings to the three Elders!"
The City Lord of Silver Moon City, Xiong Yinghao, flanked by the Clan Leaders of the major families and several Sect Masters from various factions, flew into mid-air to greet the three powerful figures arriving from a distance.
Everyone clasped their hands in a bow, their attitude exceptionally respectful.
The arrivals consisted of two men and one woman.
A tall, thin elder stood in the center, his cultivation base already at the Divine Bridge Realm. He was an Elder in Charge from the Qitian Sword Sect, responsible for recruitment in Silver Moon City during this Tri-element Martial Meeting. As one of the three major powers in the Shenfeng Dynasty, the Qitian Sword Sect’s only target this time was the predetermined Xiong Chumo. As for the others, the Qitian Sword Sect had no interest in them.
Another middle-aged man hailed from the Chaos Element Sword Sect; he too was an Elder in Charge. Unlike the Qitian Sword Sect, the Chaos Element Sword Sect was a quasi-top-tier sect. Besides the preselected Ou Yangxiu, he also intended to assess other disciples, hoping to recruit any suitable talents.
The last was a woman, the Elder in Charge from the Qingyun Sect. The Qingyun Sect was a first-rate faction, considered the strongest among the first-rate sects. She had come hoping to recruit several disciples with outstanding talent.
The Elder from the Qitian Sword Sect surveyed the surroundings, a faint smile on his lips as he asked, "City Lord Xiong, isn’t it about time for the Tri-element Martial Meeting to begin?"
"There is still about half an incense stick’s worth of time..." Xiong Yinghao replied with a smile, then made an inviting gesture. "Please, Elders, take your seats!"
"Hmm!" The Qitian Sword Sect Elder nodded, his demeanor proud. He descended and, with a flash, entered the spectator stand. He was currently the only Divine Bridge Realm cultivator in all of Silver Moon City. Representing the Qitian Sword Sect, it was only natural that everyone here deferred to him.
Everyone took their seats, with Xiong Yinghao sitting to the right of the Elder.
The Elder from the Qitian Sword Sect glanced casually at the arena and asked, "This time, how many contestants managed to make the Power-measuring stone emit a golden light?"
"Ten in total!" Xiong Yinghao replied with a smile.
"That’s not bad at all, two or three more than last time!" The Qitian Sword Sect Elder nodded, pleased.
「Half an incense stick’s time later.」
Xiong Yinghao, the City Lord of Silver Moon City, stepped out from the spectator stand and announced loudly, "The Tri-element Martial Meeting begins now!"
"Hooray!"
All the spectators in attendance erupted in cheers.
On the first day of the Tri-element Martial Meeting, the top three contestants for the Heavenly Yuan, Earthly Yuan, and Human Yuan rankings would be determined. Thus, the level of competition on this day was the highest.
A Cultivator acting as a judge stood on the arena and announced loudly, "First match: contestant number ten, Su Wanyi, versus contestant number seven, Bai Yuanshan!"
「In the spectator stand.」
Su Wanyi was slightly taken aback when she heard the judge call her name.
She hadn’t expected to be the first to fight.
"Young Miss, it’s your turn!" the Big Black Cat reminded her with a smile from the side.
Su Wanyi nodded lightly, preparing to walk towards the arena. Suddenly, a figure flashed past her.
The person stopped, turned back, and sneered at Su Wanyi, "You’re so beautiful, I’d hate to be too rough on you. When we get on the arena, you should just obediently admit defeat!"
With that, the young man let out a hearty laugh, spread his wings, and soared into the air, landing steadily on the arena.
Admit defeat? How could that be possible?
A cold smile touched Su Wanyi’s lips.
He’s only at the Fourth Level of the Origin Sea Realm, his cultivation stage the second lowest among the ten contestants. He’s not necessarily stronger than me.
As Su Wanyi took a step, her figure transformed into a Divine Dragon Phantom, streaked through the air, and landed high atop the arena.
"Wow, a dragon! So majestic!" Seeing Su Wanyi’s astonishing movement technique, transforming into a Divine Dragon Phantom, the onlookers couldn’t help but cheer loudly.
This instantly overwhelmed Bai Yuanshan’s presence.
「Inside the black carriage.」
Ye Yun watched this scene calmly, a smile playing on his lips.
Su Wanyi’s attainment in the Nine Changes of the God Dragon surpasses her skill in the Dragon God Sword Technique. That fellow Bai Yuanshan lacks talent but is incredibly arrogant. He won’t even be able to take a single sword strike from Su Wanyi.
Listening to the audience’s cheers, Bai Yuanshan’s face turned livid. He had also received cheers moments ago when he landed gracefully, spreading his wings like a great Peng bird. But he hadn’t expected the young girl to land with a flourish like a Divine Dragon whipping its tail, drawing even more thunderous cheers than he had, completely crushing the momentum he had painstakingly built. This infuriated Bai Yuanshan. His eyes bulged as he glared at Su Wanyi like a hungry wolf, as if wanting to devour her.
In his mind, Su Wanyi was merely at the First Level of the Origin Sea Realm, three minor realms beneath him; she couldn’t possibly be his opponent.
It wasn’t just Bai Yuanshan; almost everyone nearby thought the same way. Regarding this delicate and stunningly beautiful young girl, it seemed everyone acknowledged her beauty far more than her strength.
The Elder from the Qitian Sword Sect narrowed his eyes, his gaze landing on Su Wanyi as he asked casually, "This young girl, did she also produce a golden light from the Power-measuring stone?"
"Yes, Elder Luo!" Xiong Yinghao quickly replied.
"This young girl does have some potential..." The Qitian Sword Sect Elder’s eyes flashed, and he chuckled softly.
Seeing Elder Luo show interest in talent, Xiong Yinghao quickly added with a smile, "Elder Luo, if this young girl performs well, then you might be able to take one more back with you this time!"
Elder Luo chuckled. "Let’s see her performance. If she can defeat that Bai Yuanshan, then she might be worth considering."
「Atop the arena.」
The judge announced, "Begin!"
Su Wanyi drew her Seven-star Dragon Abyss Sword, its tip pointed towards Bai Yuanshan. With a slight movement, a Divine Dragon Phantom instantly appeared behind her. This phantom was over ten meters tall, coiling behind her and exuding an extremely powerful aura.
What kind of swordsmanship is this?
Bai Yuanshan was startled. Not daring to underestimate her, he immediately drew his sword.
Seeing Su Wanyi backed by the Divine Dragon Phantom, Elder Luo of the Qitian Sword Sect raised an eyebrow and remarked with a click of his tongue, "This swordsmanship is rather interesting..."
He then glanced at Xiong Yinghao and asked casually, "Which power does this young girl belong to?"
Xiong Yinghao thought for a moment before quickly replying, "It’s said she comes from a Sect called the Dragon God Sect."
"An insignificant little Sect." The Elder of the Qitian Sword Sect curled his lip, a look of disdain on his face. The Shenfeng Dynasty’s territory was vast, and he knew of all the first-rate Sects and above. He had never heard of this Dragon God Sect. Clearly, it was obscure.
On Su Wanyi’s shoulder, the Big Black Cat’s sensitive ears caught Elder Luo’s words. It became instantly furious, steam practically rising from its ears. Its inherent fierceness was immediately provoked.
This old codger from the Qitian Sword Sect is courting death! Damn it, Old Cat is in a foul mood again! Young Miss, just you wait, I’ll go kill him!
It prepared to go kill.
Suddenly, a voice transmission from the Big Black Horse reached its ears. "Little Cat, don’t be hasty. The Master said we’ll settle all accounts later!"
Hearing it was the Master’s command, the Big Black Cat retracted its killing intent and obediently lay down.
Recalling the Master’s terrifying methods...
The Big Black Cat licked its paws and grinned smugly.
Actually... the Master wouldn’t even need to act. A great demon of the Nirvana Realm like me could kill everyone present with a single swipe of my paw!

chapters.title: Chapter 54: Consecutive Victories! Dongfang Ming’s Rage.
chapters.content:
Chapter 54: Chapter 54: Consecutive Victories! Dongfang Ming’s Rage.
Su Wanyi also heard the Big Black Horse’s telepathic message.
Seeing the Big Black Cat calm down, she couldn’t help but breathe a long sigh of relief.
If it had slapped the Elder from the Qitian Sword Sect to death, the Tri-element Martial Meeting would have been thrown into chaos.
Bai Yuanshan, holding his sword in one hand, gazed at Su Wanyi, who was backed by the Divine Dragon Phantom. An overwhelming feeling of being outmatched welled up within him.
"Die!"
Finally, unable to contain his anger any longer, he roared and slashed out with his sword.
This sword strike was like a mighty river, its light surging endlessly forward, sweeping everything before it with devastating force.
This was his family’s ancestral Big River Sword Technique.
Its Sword Intent surged powerfully, ranking it among the top ten Swordsmanship styles in Silver Moon City.
Su Wanyi’s eyes narrowed slightly. She raised her Seven-star Dragon Abyss Sword and slashed back.
Her sword light contained the phantom of a Divine Dragon.
In that instant, the Divine Dragon Sword Light blazed into existence, sharp and unstoppable. With a single strike, it cleaved through the surging river of light from Bai Yuanshan’s attack.
Bai Yuanshan was greatly alarmed and hastily raised his sword to parry.
The two swords clashed.
BOOM! A loud crash erupted.
A powerful force surged toward him. Bai Yuanshan felt his body suddenly lighten as he was blasted away.
His body, like a kite with a severed string, flew uncontrollably off the fighting stage.
Below the stage, a cultivator immediately flew up to catch him.
A trickle of blood seeped from the corner of Bai Yuanshan’s mouth. He hurriedly struggled to his feet, preparing to fly back onto the stage.
"You’ve already lost. There’s no need to come back up," Su Wanyi stood at the edge of the stage. She re-sheathed her Seven-star Dragon Abyss Sword, looked down at him, and said calmly.
I lost? How is that possible?
Bai Yuanshan mumbled to himself.
He had never dreamed that Su Wanyi would force him off the stage with a single sword strike, causing him to lose the match. This was incredibly mortifying. It was utterly humiliating!
"I admit defeat!"
Bai Yuanshan clearly understood the rules of the competition. He spat out a mouthful of bloody saliva, frowned, and strode away.
"Su Wanyi wins!"
The referee’s voice rang out, announcing the end of the match.
"Wow! Sister Su is so strong! She forced a cultivator at the Fourth Level of the Origin Sea Realm off the stage with a single strike!"
Amidst the crowd, Chang Lu Die clapped her small hands and cheered.
She had vaguely guessed at Sister Su’s strength but never imagined she would be this powerful.
This girl is incredibly strong!
In the viewing gallery, Ouyang Xiu gazed at Su Wanyi, his face etched with shock.
He knew Bai Yuanshan very well; they had known each other since childhood and often sparred with their Swordsmanship. The Bai Family’s Big River Sword Technique was grand and sweeping, its power ferocious. Yet, he hadn’t anticipated that the delicate-looking beauty could knock Bai Yuanshan off the stage with a single strike. It showed her physical strength was unimaginably great. This far surpassed the physical prowess a cultivator at the First Level of the Origin Sea Realm should possess.
Su Wanyi retracted the Divine Dragon Phantom and flew back to the viewing gallery.
"Congratulations!" Xiong Chumo waved at Su Wanyi, his smile radiant.
Su Wanyi frowned, ignored him, and walked to a corner alone.
Xiong Chumo snorted coldly.
Dongfang Jade, with an air of easy familiarity, sauntered over to her, chuckling, "Su Wanyi, I didn’t realize you were so formidable, huh?"
"What, you want to test me?" Su Wanyi asked, feeling a wave of revulsion at Dongfang Jade’s smirking, flippant demeanor.
"I’m sure there will be an opportunity."
Dongfang Jade took a step back and immediately turned to leave.
At that moment, the referee called his name; he was up second.
His opponent was number four, Cui Xiao Ran.
After only a few rounds on the stage, Cui Xiao Ran lost the match.
Dongfang Jade returned, laughing triumphantly.
Xiong Chumo glanced at him indifferently, showing no further expression.
The three of them had already been pre-selected for advancement, so they were merely going through the motions now.
The competition involved ten participants and used a point-based system.
When Ouyang Xiu and Dongfang Jade faced Xiong Chumo, they would feign a few exchanges and then concede.
As for the other participants, none were a match for Xiong Chumo.
But now, Bai Yuanshan, incensed by his humiliating defeat, had withdrawn from the competition, leaving only nine participants.
This would allow the competition to proceed even faster.
The first round of matches concluded.
Then, the second round began.
This time, Su Wanyi was again the first to appear, and her opponent was none other than Dongfang Jade.
Dongfang Jade, at the Fifth Level of the Origin Sea Realm, was a full four minor realms higher than her.
The two stood on the stage, each having drawn their swords, facing each other from a distance.
A great battle was on the verge of erupting.
「In the spectators’ stand.」
"Clan Leader Dongfang, you seem a bit nervous?" Ouyang Zhentian shot a sidelong glance at Dongfang Ming and chuckled softly.
"Nervous? Me? A mere girl at the First Level of the Origin Sea Realm beating my son? What a joke!" Dongfang Ming curled his lips dismissively.
Elder Luo of the Qitian Sword Sect glanced at Xiong Yinghao and asked with a smile, "Who do you think will emerge victorious between these two youngsters?"
Xiong Yinghao smiled and said, "Dongfang Jade has long since grasped the true essence of the Dongfang Family’s Swordsmanship. I believe he should be able to defeat Su Wanyi."
At this moment, he naturally had to side with the Dongfang Family.
"Hehe!" Elder Luo chuckled lightly.
If this girl could defeat Dongfang Jade, then he would make an exception this time and accept her as an inner disciple. The ability to defeat someone at the Fifth Level of the Origin Sea Realm while only at the First Level—such capacity for cross-level combat was rare, even within the Qitian Sword Sect.
While they were conversing, Su Wanyi and Dongfang Jade had already begun their battle on the stage.
Dongfang Jade’s Soul-Chasing Life-Taking Sword Technique was characterized by one thing: speed.
Once the first strike was launched, each subsequent blow was faster than the last, giving the opponent no chance to breathe, relentlessly attacking until they were slain.
Relentless streams of sword light, like life-seeking phantoms, poured down like mercury, sealing off every inch of space.
Facing Dongfang Jade’s furious onslaught, Su Wanyi activated her Nine Changes of the God Dragon movement technique.
She transformed into numerous illusory Divine Dragons, constantly weaving and drifting around the stage.
This caused every one of Dongfang Jade’s sword strikes to hit nothing but air.
Dongfang Ming stared intently at the two figures on the stage, his face grim. Deep within his eyes, a murderous intent flickered.
"Su Wanyi, stop dodging!" Dongfang Jade roared in frustration, his sword light growing even more ferocious.
He was inwardly cursing his luck; he had launched so many sword strikes, yet not one had even grazed his opponent’s robes. The Soul-Chasing Life-Taking Sword Technique comprised a total of eighty-one stances. In this short exchange, he had already executed forty-nine of them. If he couldn’t defeat this Su Wanyi after executing all eighty-one stances, then if he were to use the Soul-Chasing Life-Taking Sword Technique a second time, its power would likely diminish. This particular Sword technique consumed an immense amount of Mana.
However, Dongfang Jade had gravely miscalculated.
Before he could even complete his first sequence of attacks, Su Wanyi, having already identified several flaws in his Swordsmanship, launched a fierce counterattack.
Her Seven-star Dragon Abyss Sword unleashed a torrent of sword light, and with each flash, illusory Divine Dragons erupted forth!
In an instant, the entire stage was filled with the phantoms of Divine Dragons.
The sword light and Divine Dragons merged, becoming an unstoppable force. It exploited a momentary opening, shattering the dense curtain of sword light created by the Soul-Chasing Life-Taking Sword Technique.
The Seven-star Dragon Abyss Sword descended from above.
Dongfang Jade’s face filled with horror.
THWACK! THWACK!
Several streams of Sword Qi struck Dongfang Jade. He screamed as he was sent flying backward.
「In the spectators’ stand.」
A figure shot out and caught Dongfang Jade in his arms.
Looking at his blood-soaked son, Dongfang Ming’s face contorted with fury.
"You vicious little wench! So ruthless! I definitely won’t let you off today!"
Dongfang Ming, his expression icy and terrifying, slowly advanced towards Su Wanyi, a powerful aura of the Shaping God Realm emanating from him.

chapters.title: Chapter 55: White Tiger Jinge Swordsmanship
chapters.content:
Chapter 55: Chapter 55: White Tiger Jinge Swordsmanship
"Injuries are inevitable in a competition. If you didn’t want your son to get hurt, you could have kept him from participating!"
Su Wanyi, her eyebrows tightly knitted and her slender figure held upright, stood on the arena stage, her sword tip pointing towards Dongfang Ming.
Nearby, the Big Black Cat said menacingly, "Young Miss, if this old fellow dares to make a move, I’ll obliterate the entire Dongfang Family!"
Su Wanyi’s pupils contracted.
This Senior Cat... he’s really quite the passionate character!
Dongfang Ming advanced with murderous intent, but suddenly, Xiong Yinghao’s voice reached his ears. His expression changed drastically; he turned, picked up Dongfang Jade, and departed.
After all, this was the Tri-element Martial Meeting. Furthermore, Elder Luo of the Qitian Sword Sect was presiding over it. If he truly attacked Su Wanyi, he would likely be unable to withstand the Qitian Sword Sect’s Elder Luo’s overwhelming wrath. Xiong Yinghao had transmitted to him that Elder Luo favored this girl. If she were to become an inner disciple of the Qitian Sword Sect in the future, his Dongfang Family would not dare to provoke her under any circumstances.
Seeing Dongfang Ming suddenly leave, Su Wanyi breathed a sigh of relief. She leaped down from the competition stage and returned to the spectator stands.
The others regarded Su Wanyi with extremely complicated expressions. Those whose strength was inferior to Dongfang Jade’s revealed fear in their eyes. Meanwhile, Ouyang Xiu and Xiong Chumo, who were stronger than Dongfang Jade, looked at Su Wanyi with a blazing fighting spirit in their eyes.
"Ouyang Xiu, do you think you can defeat her with your strength?" Xiong Chumo asked softly.
Ouyang Xiu recalled Su Wanyi’s breathtaking sword strike and said solemnly, "It’s hard to say, but we’ll have to fight it out."
Xiong Chumo nodded slightly.
In his view, Su Wanyi might be on par with Ouyang Xiu in terms of strength, but she was still a significant way off from his own level. He didn’t care about anyone else. As long as his position in Heavenly Yuan was secured, that would be enough. After all, among everyone present, his cultivation base was the highest. His father was also the City Lord of Silver Moon City, holding a highly prestigious position. So, under no circumstances could he lose.
A black carriage remained parked outside the City Lord’s Mansion. Though people came and went, it seemed as if no one noticed it.
The Big Black Horse turned his head, grinned slyly, and said, "Master, those participants in the Tri-element Martial Meeting are too weak. I reckon only Xiong Yinghao’s son might give the Young Miss some pressure..."
"Patience," Ye Yun said with a faint smile. The Tri-element Martial Meeting was merely the beginning.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao were currently refining the Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood to alter the concentration of their Ancestral Dragon Bloodline. Therefore, during this period, Su Wanyi needed to gain experience on her own. Ye Yun held high hopes for this young girl. He planned to arrange powerful opponents for Su Wanyi step by step, allowing her to lay a solid foundation starting from the First Level of the Origin Sea Realm.
The Dragon God Sect only has three disciples,
Ye Yun mused.
As their Ancestor, I intend to cultivate all three into Sword Dao titans, each capable of holding their own against any challenge. It’s equivalent to creating three versions of my past self. That way, if I leave the Cangnan Continent one day, the Dragon God Sect will still have successors.
As evening approached, night gradually descended. The City Lord’s Mansion was brightly lit, and the Tri-element Martial Meeting was in full swing.
Su Wanyi had won five consecutive matches and was considered the biggest Black Horse to win this year’s competition. However, she still hadn’t encountered Ouyang Xiu or Xiong Chumo. Ouyang Xiu, apart from his loss to Xiong Chumo, had not been defeated in any other duels. Currently, his points ranked him third. If he wanted to secure second place, he had to defeat Su Wanyi.
"Next match: Number Two, Ouyang Xiu, versus Number Ten, Su Wanyi!" the referee’s voice rang out.
The surrounding audience erupted in thunderous applause and cheers. This beautiful woman, clad in a golden Robe with a crimson Longsword on her back, had captivated all spectators with her unparalleled elegance. Su Wanyi possessed peerless beauty, a transcendent demeanor, and wielded superior Swordsmanship. She had won seven consecutive matches. Currently, her rank was, at worst, Human Yuan. If she could defeat Ouyang Xiu, she would break into the top two. Finally, she would face the ultimate showdown with the City Lord’s son, considered the strongest contestant this year.
Standing on the arena stage, Su Wanyi drew her Seven-star Dragon Abyss Sword, and the phantom of a Divine Dragon materialized behind her. She held no trace of disdain for Ouyang Xiu. Years of wandering and fleeing had taught Su Wanyi never to underestimate any opponent. Despite seven consecutive victories, Su Wanyi remained exceedingly calm and unflappable.
She was participating in the Tri-element Martial Meeting according to the Ancestor’s wishes. The Ancestor intended for her to gain experience. This so-called experience was not only to temper the strength of one’s sword heart but also to enable one to fight above their level when facing formidable enemies. So far, only Ouyang Xiu could be considered a powerful foe.
Su Wanyi also hoped to achieve a breakthrough in her cultivation base under significant battle pressure, just like her junior martial brother and sister. After all, she had also consumed a Dragon Tiger Pill.
That was a Divine Pill bestowed by the Ancestor... Most of its medicinal power is still stored within my body, silently awaiting the opportune moment of pressure to achieve a breakthrough all at once!
Inside the black carriage, Ye Yun’s expression remained placid as he sensed Su Wanyi’s Super Divine Dragon Breath growing increasingly potent, a hint of admiration in his eyes.
As the eldest apprentice sister, Su Wanyi was a few years older than Luo Li and Jun Moxiao; consequently, her character was the most mature. Ye Yun greatly appreciated this aspect of her. When the Sect faced a crisis, Su Wanyi had been the first to step forward and draw the pursuers away. Such a spirit of self-sacrifice and protection of others was rare and commendable.
As the thirteenth Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, Ye Yun had also taken a few disciples in the past. But that was during the Dragon God Sect’s most prosperous era, a time when no one in the world dared to provoke it.
Just as Ye Yun was reminiscing, Su Wanyi and Ouyang Xiu’s battle had already commenced.
Ouyang Xiu’s cultivation base was five minor realms higher than Su Wanyi’s, but he did not possess a gifted bloodline. Therefore, he didn’t hold an absolute advantage. However, Ouyang Xiu’s combat prowess was indeed formidable. The Ouyang Family’s White Tiger Geng Metal Sword Art specialized in metal-based killing arts; each ray of his sword light was astounding, containing sharp cutting power. If not for the sturdy Formations reinforcing the stage, it would have been destroyed long ago.
Similar to Su Wanyi, who was backed by a Divine Dragon Phantom, a phantom of a white tiger also manifested behind Ouyang Xiu. It was vivid and lifelike, with a massive form, sitting majestically in the void, exuding an imposing aura.
Streams of sword light, emitting dazzling golden radiance, clashed with the Divine Dragon Sword Light, producing a series of loud BOOMS.
After several head-on clashes, Su Wanyi found herself at a disadvantage, suppressed by Ouyang Xiu’s Swordsmanship. Fortunately, her Divine Dragon Nine-Change Body Technique allowed her to narrowly dodge each sword light attack. The sky filled with Divine Dragon Phantoms, each seemingly an image of Su Wanyi. Thus, even though Ouyang Xiu’s Swordsmanship was fierce and he continually shattered the Divine Dragon Phantoms, he could never pinpoint Su Wanyi’s true location.
"This young lady is truly excellent!" Elder Luo of the Qitian Sword Sect remarked, his eyes slightly narrowed, a look of appreciation within them.
The battle on the platform raged intensely. In what felt like the blink of an eye, two hours had passed.
Ouyang Xiu, truly deserving of his reputation as the second strongest of Silver Moon City’s younger generation, maintained a high-intensity offensive. Yet, he was astonished to find that Su Wanyi showed no signs of fatigue. Though heavily suppressed under his frenzied assault, she had not entirely lost the ability to retaliate.
Night fell. In the deep blue-black expanse of the evening sky, a few stars began to twinkle faintly. A full moon, like a golden disc, slowly ascended from the eastern night sky.
Inside the black carriage, Ye Yun’s gaze suddenly flickered as he looked down towards the depths beneath Silver Moon City.

chapters.title: Chapter 56: Secrets Underneath Silver Moon City
chapters.content:
Chapter 56: Chapter 56: Secrets Underneath Silver Moon City
"Master, have you discovered something?" The Big Black Horse also looked towards the underground but noticed nothing.
Ye Yun looked at the round moon in the night sky again and chuckled softly. "You will know in a moment. Who would have thought there would be such an exciting show?"
"Alright, Master." The Big Black Horse was eager to know the secret underground, but since his master didn’t reveal anything, he dared not inquire further and could only keep his curiosity to himself.
「On the arena.」
The combat between Ouyang Xiu and Su Wanyi was becoming more thrilling. Throughout the entire process, Su Wanyi had been suppressed by Ouyang Xiu and had few opportunities to retaliate. After all, there was a five-level gap in their cultivation. From everyone’s perspective, it was a miracle that Su Wanyi had managed to persevere this long without losing.
"Who would have thought! This girl is so tenacious; there’s still no sign of her admitting defeat." Elder Luo stroked his beard and laughed with relief. He admired Su Wanyi more and more for her determined will and outstanding talent. If cultivated well, she would undoubtedly become an incredible genius.
Xiong Yinghao also nodded and smiled. He had no particular thoughts about Su Wanyi. After all, he could see that Su Wanyi was struggling against Ouyang Xiu; she would surely be no match for his son, Xiong Chumo. Therefore, he had nothing to worry about. The Heavenly Yuan position was still exclusively his son’s.
The battle continued for nearly an hour.
Su Wanyi still showed no signs of fatigue. Ouyang Xiu, on the other hand, had started to break a sweat on his forehead.
This delicate little beauty has such strong resilience, rarely seen in my life!
he groaned inwardly.
If this fight continues, I’ll run out of both Mana and stamina, and the power of my sword techniques will decrease significantly.
Ouyang Zhentian also noticed this. He leisurely sipped his tea and said indifferently, "Little girl, you’re no match for my son. Why insist on struggling so hard? It’s better to simply admit defeat."
Admit defeat? How could that be possible?
Su Wanyi had no time to speak, but she sneered inwardly.
I have the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline. My physical body is incredibly strong now. I’ve been fighting for so long and don’t feel tired at all. Even if I had to fight for another ten hours, it wouldn’t be a problem for me! Being constantly suppressed by Ouyang Xiu also has its benefits. I feel like I’m on the verge of a breakthrough in my cultivation base.
"HUMPH!" Ouyang Zhentian grunted when he saw his words had no effect. The stubborn little girl, her lips pressed firmly together, was still fighting fiercely against his son, Ouyang Xiu. He couldn’t help but grunt in displeasure. However, in front of Elder Luo from the Qitian Sword Sect, he couldn’t say anything more aggressive.
In the blink of an eye, the time it takes for an incense stick to burn passed.
Ouyang Xiu’s stamina started to falter, and his Mana was also running low. Flaws appeared in his sword light.
A good opportunity!
A cold glint flashed in Su Wanyi’s eyes. She thrust her sword, exploiting the flaw in Ouyang Xiu’s sword technique.
Ouyang Xiu was greatly shocked. He hurriedly dodged, but Su Wanyi’s sword light followed him like a shadow. Ouyang Xiu had no choice but to block hastily.
PUFF!
The sword struck him right in the shoulder. A stream of fresh blood spurted from Ouyang Xiu’s shoulder. He screamed and collapsed to the ground. Exhausted and with an injured shoulder, his spirit broke; he truly couldn’t hold on any longer.
"I admit defeat!" Ouyang Xiu raised his head and said decisively.
"Good." Su Wanyi sheathed her Seven-star Dragon Abyss Sword and flew off the arena.
"Wonderful!" The surrounding spectators burst into enthusiastic applause.
"Wow, Sister Su actually won again! She defeated Ouyang Xiu, who is five minor realms ahead of her! Her Earthly Yuan position is now set in stone!" Chang Lu Die cheered, clapping her hands.
Ouyang Zhentian trembled with anger when he saw his son defeated by Su Wanyi. His son had clearly been suppressing Su Wanyi the entire time, yet this girl had unexpectedly won in the end. He began to suspect Su Wanyi must have cheated.
How could such a delicate woman possess such enduring combat power?
He was about to stand up and question her. But when he glanced at Elder Luo of the Qitian Sword Sect and saw the approving smile on the latter’s face, he forcibly suppressed his urge.
It seems this girl will become an inner disciple of the Qitian Sword Sect in the future, just like Xiong Chumo. I can’t afford to offend her.
When Su Wanyi returned to the viewing pavilion, only Xiong Chumo remained.
"I have to admit, you are a strong opponent!" Xiong Chumo stared intently at Su Wanyi and said seriously, "If we were both at the seventh layer of the Origin Sea Realm, I wouldn’t be your match."
"What are you trying to say?" Su Wanyi asked indifferently.
"You’ve been fighting for so long. If you fight me next, you’ll definitely lose. Why don’t we make an agreement beforehand? When we get to the arena, you can just surrender!" Xiong Chumo said with a smile, a look of confident calculation on his face.
"That’s not certain. We’ll see in the arena!" Su Wanyi coldly retorted and turned away.
Xiong Chumo’s expression froze.
This young girl is really stubborn! It seems I can’t hold back in the arena. I’ll have to go for a quick victory, using my most powerful sword technique to force her to concede.
「After a short while.」
The referee announced the start of the final match.
Su Wanyi and Xiong Chumo once again ascended the arena.
All the spectators clapped enthusiastically. The exciting dragon-phoenix battle was about to begin.
As the biggest dark horse of this Tri-element Martial Meeting, many people held out hope for Su Wanyi. After all, despite being only at the First Level of the Origin Sea Realm, she had defeated various strong opponents to reach the final match. The crowd favored her even more.
Just as the two began to fight, the Big Black Cat perched on Su Wanyi’s shoulder suddenly furrowed its brow. It sensed a strange, indescribable aura in the surrounding air. It looked up at the full moon in the night sky. Suddenly, its cat eyes widened slightly; it noticed a faint reddish halo had appeared around the moon at some point. The Big Black Cat had lived for a very long time and was vastly experienced.
At this moment, a certain possibility came to its mind. Silver Moon City... It’s said to be the former royal capital of the Silver Moon Wolf Clan. But ten thousand years ago, the Silver Moon Wolf Clan was defeated, and Silver Moon City was handed over to the Human Race...
the Big Black Cat mumbled to itself.
Although it felt a little uneasy, the thought of its master being nearby, along with Uncle Ma, with whom it had a very close friendship, instantly brightened its mood.
「On the arena now.」
Xiong Chumo immediately unleashed his most powerful Nine Turn Overlord Sword, launching a frenzied assault on Su Wanyi, attempting to defeat her quickly.
The sword light surged like a turbulent tide, each wave stronger than the last. Su Wanyi was like a small boat, struggling to stay afloat amidst the crashing waves.
BANG!
It felt as if some barrier within her body had shattered. Su Wanyi’s body trembled slightly. At this moment, she broke through to the Second Layer of the Origin Sea Realm!
Feeling her Mana surge and her combat power increase dramatically, Su Wanyi’s spirits soared. Like a Divine Dragon, she let out a long cry, unleashing innumerable sword lights as she launched a counterattack against Xiong Chumo.

chapters.title: Chapter 57: Refusing Qitian Sword Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 57: Chapter 57: Refusing Qitian Sword Sect
What? She actually broke through?
Xiong Chumo was greatly astonished.
He never would have dreamed that Su Wanyi could break through to the Yuanhai Realm Second Layer during battle. After the breakthrough, Su Wanyi was like a tiger charging down a mountain, unstoppable. Her combat power had increased by at least ten times.
How could this be possible?
Xiong Chumo screamed furiously in his heart.
His original advantage vanished instantly. The surrounding spectators were also dumbfounded.
They had not expected Su Wanyi to break through in the midst of battle and seize the initiative, fighting Xiong Chumo to a standstill.
"Go Sister Su!" Chang Lu Die was the first to react in the crowd, clapping her small hands and cheering continuously.
「Meanwhile, in the viewing stand.」
Apart from Elder Luo of the Qitian Sword Sect, who was all smiles, everyone else wore grim expressions. Especially Xiong Yinghao.
This City Lord of Silver Moon City had originally planned to reserve the Heavenly Yuan position for his son, but Su Wanyi’s sudden appearance disrupted all his subsequent plans. His greatest hope now was that Su Wanyi would exhaust her stamina from the prolonged battles and ultimately lose to his son.
"Tsk tsk...
This young lady is truly extraordinary; she can even break through during battle!
"
Elder Luo wore a smile, his eyes full of admiration. He did not care for the Heavenly Yuan position. He only wanted to recruit even stronger talents for the Qitian Sword Sect.
「On the stage.」
Su Wanyi was also shocked.
The God-level Dragon and Tiger Pill bestowed by the Ancestor had an incredibly potent efficacy. After sealing one Major Realm, she suddenly achieved a breakthrough, her combat power increasing at least tenfold. Now, she could match Xiong Chumo evenly. Even if Xiong Chumo’s swordsmanship was tyrannical, her Dragon God Sword Technique could firmly suppress him.
Xiong Chumo grew anxious, and his sword momentum suddenly changed. Dense sword shadows materialized. One after another, swords of light condensed in the air. Countless sword lights converged into a single point. Everything between heaven and earth was enveloped by the sword light. Boundless intent converged at this spot. Heaven and earth plunged into darkness; only this spot blazed with dazzling sword light.
A streak of golden light flashed past like a meteor tearing through the night sky, leaving an incomparably brilliant radiance in its wake. That golden radiance, seemingly imbued with boundless majesty and dominance, surged towards Su Wanyi.
Xiong Chumo unleashed the most powerful technique of the Nine Turn Overlord Sword: Myriad Swords Return to One.
Seeing this ferocious attack, Su Wanyi dared not be careless. At this moment, she unleashed all her Mana, thrusting out an astonishing sword strike.
This strike was also one of the nine ultimate killing moves of the Dragon God Sword Technique. It too had been passed down to her by the Old Ancestor. It was not recorded in the Dragon God Sword Technique her master had taught her.
This move was called Astonishing Dragon Kill.
A Divine Dragon materialized with a roar, a blood-red longsword clasped in its jaws. The longsword was entirely blood-red, exuding a potent killing intent. Instantly, the scent of blood permeated the void.
"ROAR!"
The dragon’s roar echoed through heaven and earth. The Divine Dragon bellowed in fury, the blood-red longsword in its mouth thrusting towards Xiong Chumo’s golden light.
"What swordsmanship is this?"
"So powerful!"
Upon seeing this, Elder Luo of the Qitian Sword Sect shot to his feet, his eyes wide with astonishment.
This move was too powerful! It was a sight rarely seen in his lifetime.
Xiong Yinghao also nervously stood up, his entire body trembled slightly.
He didn’t know if his son could withstand this strike.
RUMBLE!
The blood-red longsword clenched in the Divine Dragon’s jaws collided with the indomitable sword light, producing an earth-shattering explosion. The void fractured, and everything in its path was obliterated. The colossal explosion reverberated throughout Silver Moon City. At that instant, cracks appeared on the surrounding platforms, and countless terrified spectators fled in all directions.
"ROAR!!!"
The Divine Dragon roared skyward, its draconic form flickered, and it suddenly pounced on the terrified Xiong Chumo.
The Blood Sword and the golden light had both vanished. When the Divine Dragon Phantom struck Xiong Chumo, an unimaginably immense force sent him flying.
He was still in mid-air when he coughed up a mouthful of blood. A figure swiftly flew into the air and caught Xiong Chumo securely.
Then, Xiong Yinghao rapidly stuffed a healing pill into his mouth. He glared angrily at the beautiful young woman on the stage, furious yet not daring to voice his anger.
Su Wanyi had used that amazing ultimate move to defeat his son. Now she had become a favorite in the eyes of Elder Luo from the Qitian Sword Sect. Her future within the Qitian Sword Sect was boundless. She would likely soon be promoted from an inner disciple to one of the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride.
At that point, his son Xiong Chumo might even have to beg Su Wanyi for her protection. Xiong Yinghao landed, his heart filled with unventable grief and indignation. He could only maintain a stern, silent facade.
The pale-faced Xiong Chumo slowly improved after taking the pill. Although the Divine Dragon Phantom had struck him, its power was already spent, inflicting only minor injuries. After all, the strongest part of the Divine Dragon Phantom’s attack had been concentrated in the blood-colored sword light from its jaws.
Su Wanyi exhaled softly and returned her Seven-star Dragon Abyss Sword to its sheath.
There was no doubt that she was the final winner of this Tri-element Martial Meeting. The Heavenly Yuan position was hers, and hers alone.
She hadn’t executed the Astonishing Dragon Kill perfectly; she was still far from meeting the Old Ancestor’s standards. Currently, she relied entirely on the Seven-star Dragon Abyss Sword to perform this ultimate move. Had it been an ordinary sword, she would not have been able to unleash such an earth-shattering ultimate attack.
「Inside the black carriage.」
Ye Yun smiled slightly.
Su Wanyi had finally broken through, though her execution of the Astonishing Dragon Kill was still lacking. At its most basic, the Astonishing Dragon Kill required nine Divine Dragons to appear simultaneously, all breathing out nine blood-red sword lights, for it to be considered somewhat impressive. The current Su Wanyi could barely summon a single Divine Dragon Phantom. She was still a long way from meeting Ye Yun’s expectations. But Ye Yun was not in a hurry, for these three disciples of excellent character and conduct. Even if their talents were somewhat lacking, he had ways to address it. After all, all sword techniques of the Dragon God Sect originated from the concentration of the bloodline within the body. With the passage of time, as the concentration of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood within these three youngsters increased, the power of their Dragon God Sword Technique would naturally grow stronger and stronger. Until one day, they would transform into true Divine Dragon Bodies, capable of wielding a Divine Sword in their mouths and delivering a blow powerful enough to destroy heaven and earth.
"Su Wanyi wins!"
The referee beside the stage was stunned for a long moment before finally announcing the outcome of the match.
The surrounding crowd raised their hands in unison, cheering loudly. Those who had been optimistic about Su Wanyi, this dark horse, clapped so hard their palms turned red.
Su Wanyi stood on the platform, unfazed. She did not become ecstatic just because she had won the final victory.
Elder Luo of the Qitian Sword Sect suddenly stood up, a smile on his face as he asked, "Su Wanyi, are you willing to join my Qitian Sword Sect?"
When Elder Luo spoke these words, all the surrounding cultivators revealed expressions of envy, jealousy, and resentment.
There were three major powers in the Shenfeng Dynasty. These were the Qitian Sword Sect, the Shen Heng Sect, and the Yu Mo Sect. These three powers were all considered major Sects. In such major Sects, experts at the Divine Bridge Realm were as numerous as carp crossing a river, and they even had supreme Wushang powerhouses of the Nirvana Realm presiding over them. Their strength was unimaginable.
"I am a disciple of the Dragon God Sect. I do not wish to join any other Sect!" Su Wanyi said softly, her head lowered.
The surroundings erupted in an uproar. No one had expected this stunningly beautiful young woman to actually refuse Elder Luo of the Qitian Sword Sect’s invitation.

chapters.title: Chapter 58: Anger Born of Shame, Bloodshed in Sight
chapters.content:
Chapter 58: Chapter 58: Anger Born of Shame, Bloodshed in Sight
"What kind of Sect is this Dragon God Sect? I’ve never heard of it before."
"Maybe it’s just an obscure small Sect?"
"That girl is too stubborn. The Qitian Sword Sect is one of the three great powers of our Shenfeng Dynasty, with powerhouses of the Nirvana Realm. If she joins the Qitian Sword Sect, it would be a great fortune, and her prospects would soar!"
"This girl is too ignorant; she’s giving up such a great opportunity. I truly feel sorry for her..."
For a moment, a flurry of discussion erupted among the crowd, various complex emotions brewing in their hearts.
Is this little girl out of her mind?
Xiong Yinghao widened his eyes, looking at Su Wanyi with an incredulous expression. Today, Su Wanyi’s performance was extremely impressive, and she had caught the attention of Elder Luo early on. If she joined the Qitian Sword Sect, she would undoubtedly become one of the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride.
How could she not seize such a significant opportunity?
Hearing the ongoing debates around him, the expression on Elder Luo of the Qitian Sword Sect turned gloomy. He glared at Su Wanyi with murderous intent in his eyes, as if wanting to devour her whole. He hadn’t expected this girl to reject his invitation so straightforwardly. It was utterly arrogant and audacious. Who dared to even utter a word of refusal where his Qitian Sword Sect exercised its might across the entire Shenfeng Dynasty?
Elder Luo suppressed the anger in his heart and coldly asked, "Su Wanyi, why don’t you want to join my Qitian Sword Sect?"
Su Wanyi raised her head, her expression calm. Facing the enraged Elder Luo without any fear, she stated blandly, "The Dragon God Sect is great. I’ve never contemplated shifting my allegiance."
"Good! Good! Good!" Elder Luo repeated "good" three times, his face ashen. He was infuriated by Su Wanyi.
What an obstinate fool! What good could come from sticking to a tiny, third-rate Sect?
"Su Wanyi!" Furiously glaring, Elder Luo demanded, "Then why did you participate in the Tri-element Martial Meeting? Wasn’t it to join a stronger Sect?"
Su Wanyi ignored Elder Luo, looked around, and said indifferently, "Now that I’ve secured a Heavenly Yuan spot, shouldn’t there be a reward?"
"..."
The surroundings fell completely silent. Nobody expected that, after rejecting Elder Luo’s kind offer, Su Wanyi would still demand the reward for the Tri-element Martial Meeting.
Shouldn’t she be hurrying to leave Silver Moon City at this point? After all, offending a Divine Bridge Realm Elder of the Qitian Sword Sect was no joking matter.
"You!" Seeing Su Wanyi’s lack of appreciation, Elder Luo trembled in anger. If it weren’t for his esteemed status and high cultivation base, he would have slapped Su Wanyi to death long ago.
Xiong Yinghao assessed the situation and knew it was time for him to step in and manage things. Stepping out from the spectator’s canopy, he looked down from his vantage point and coldly said, "Su Wanyi, you are ungrateful and have provoked the Qitian Sword Sect. Do you still expect a reward? Ridiculous! Guards, arrest Su Wanyi immediately and lock her in the dungeon!"
Xiong Yinghao’s words shocked the entire audience. Nobody expected the City Lord of Silver Moon City to suddenly resort to such ruthless tactics against a Cultivator who had just secured a Heavenly Yuan spot. But upon reflection, they understood. Even the City Lord of Silver Moon City dared not offend Elder Luo of the Qitian Sword Sect. A mere Su Wanyi—what qualifications did she possess to dare offend Elder Luo? In the Shenfeng Dynasty, a single whim from the Qitian Sword Sect could annihilate any Sect.
The surrounding spectators, their faces pale with terror, began to back away.
