At this moment, a dozen figures dashed forward, landing on the arena platform. These Cultivators drew their Longswords and slowly surrounded her.
"Su Wanyi, if you don’t want to die, drop your weapon immediately," a middle-aged Cultivator ordered coldly.
Su Wanyi looked at these Cultivators, her pupils constricting slightly. There were twelve of them in total, all at the Origin Sea Realm. The lowest cultivation base among them was the Third Layer of the Origin Sea Realm, while the highest had reached the Sixth Layer. Despite being surrounded by formidable enemies, Su Wanyi remained calm.
"Is this the Tri-element Martial Meeting? What a disappointment! And Xiong Yinghao, as the City Lord of Silver Moon City, your shamelessness is truly chilling!" Su Wanyi lifted her chin, her gaze cold as she looked at Xiong Yinghao in the distance, and let out a scoff.
"Impudence!" Xiong Yinghao seethed, his whole body shuddering. "Capture her!" With a wave of his hand, he gave the command to attack.
Twelve Cultivators brandished their Swords in unison, charging towards Su Wanyi.
Seeing this, the redness on Elder Luo’s enraged old face gradually faded. Xiong Yinghao had handled this adequately. If Su Wanyi could not be recruited by the Qitian Sword Sect, then it was better to kill her directly to prevent her from becoming a future threat.
Seeing the shameless expressions of Elder Luo from the Qitian Sword Sect and the despicable actions of Xiong Yinghao, the City Lord of Silver Moon City, the Big Black Cat perched on Su Wanyi’s shoulder suddenly became furious.
"Alright, you little bastards are rotten to the core! Old Cat here is going to eat all of you!" The Big Black Cat was burning with rage, about to leap from Su Wanyi’s shoulder, resume her true form, and unleash a massacre.
Suddenly, Ye Yun’s voice reached her ear. "Don’t be hasty. You can deal with that wolf cub later!"
Hearing her Master’s voice, the Big Black Cat was suddenly jolted.
What did the Master mean by that? Could it be referring to... that peculiar Super Divine Dragon Breath she had perceived earlier?
The Big Black Cat calmed down and abruptly looked up. She noticed that the moon in the sky seemed redder than before.
She seemed to understand who the "wolf cub" her Master was referring to was.
Wow!
The Big Black Cat was incredibly excited at this moment; the Master had entrusted such an important task to her.
This meant the Master was beginning to trust her. If she truly did nothing but laze around on the carriage all day, the Big Black Cat actually felt a bit guilty, fearing that one day her Master might ruthlessly abandon her.
The Big Black Cat contentedly settled back on Su Wanyi’s shoulder, awaiting the appearance of the foretold "wolf cub."
「On the arena stage.」
Su Wanyi was already engaged in combat with the twelve Origin Sea Realm Cultivators. The enemy’s attacks were dense, with streaks of sword light raining down on her. Su Wanyi didn’t meet their attacks head-on. Instead, she relied on her Divine Dragon Nine-Change Body Technique to evade swiftly. She weaved through the tide of attacks, looking for openings to counterattack.
This is great!
Su Wanyi once again felt the immense pressure of battle, and a sense of pleased anticipation rose within her. She had once spoken privately with Luo Li and knew that Luo Li and Jun Moxiao had faced several waves of powerful enemies during their great battle with the Blood Robe Sect Sub-branch. In that battle, both of them had advanced two minor realms consecutively. The current battle situation was remarkably similar to that encounter with the Blood Robe Sect.
Now she understood the Ancestor’s intention. It seemed everything was proceeding according to the Ancestor’s masterful plan.
"This little girl’s movement technique is indeed superb. How about we send a few more Cultivators up?" Elder Luo turned his head, glanced at Xiong Yinghao, and said softly.
Xiong Yinghao nodded quickly. With an immediate wave of his hand, another four or five high-level Origin Sea Realm Cultivators joined the fray.
At this moment, Elder Luo suddenly felt something and looked up at the full moon in the night sky. He squinted, a sense of unease stirring within him.
Strange, why is the moon somewhat red tonight?

chapters.title: Chapter 59: Blood Moon in the Sky, Phenomenon on Earth
chapters.content:
Chapter 59: Chapter 59: Blood Moon in the Sky, Phenomenon on Earth
Witnessing the slightly reddened moon, Elder Luo rubbed his chin in deep thought.
Coming from a well-established power like the Qitian Sword Sect, with its profound knowledge and resources, he also understood a great deal about the history of the Shenfeng Dynasty.
Regarding Silver Moon City, Elder Luo also happened to have studied it.
Ten thousand years ago, this was the royal city of the Silver Moon Wolf Clan. However, after their defeat in the war against humans, Silver Moon City became a city of the Human Race.
"It’s been ten thousand years. Surely, there aren’t any remnants of the Silver Moon Wolf Clan left, right?"
Elder Luo speculated internally.
According to the historical records of that time, the Silver Moon Wolf Clan had been wiped out.
In nearly ten thousand years, not a single werewolf from the Silver Moon Wolf Clan had surfaced.
Elder Luo looked up again at the slightly reddish moon in the night sky.
He remembered that the Silver Moon Wolf Clan seemed to have an extremely ancient and mysterious sacrificial ritual.
During this ritual, the moon would turn blood-red.
The moon in the night sky now was only slightly red, far from that blood-red color...
Elder Luo shook his head with a wry smile.
He felt his previous worry had been a bit excessive.
「...」
Xiong Yinghao’s brow furrowed as he stared intently at the battle on the arena.
At this moment, a total of seventeen Origin Sea Realm masters had joined the fight, attacking Su Wanyi frantically.
Initially, he had wanted to capture Su Wanyi and throw her into the dungeon, subjecting her to various tortures to appease Elder Luo’s anger.
But later, he discovered that Su Wanyi was indeed formidable.
Thus, he resolved to kill her.
This woman must not be left alive. The sooner she was killed, the sooner a hidden threat would be eliminated.
Therefore, once the second wave of high-level Origin Sea Realm cultivators joined the fray, everyone began to launch lethal attacks.
Su Wanyi consecutively faced perilous situations.
Seeing that her defeat was imminent, Elder Luo, who had been observing the intense battle, exhaled softly and finally relaxed.
No matter how good Su Wanyi’s stamina was, she had, after all, endured several major battles.
Now, with seventeen Origin Sea Realm masters fiercely besieging her, she surely couldn’t hold on for much longer.
"Hmph, let this foolish woman disappear from this world forever..."
Elder Luo thought grimly.
Amidst the tide of sword gleams, Su Wanyi’s lips were pressed tightly together, her forehead glistening with fine beads of sweat as she endured the terrifying attacks from seventeen Origin Sea Realm masters. The pressure she was under at this moment was immense.
Now, Su Wanyi could appreciate the tremendous pressure her junior martial brother and junior martial sister had faced when confronting dozens of opponents.
Every moment, she brushed past the line between life and death.
If she were even slightly inattentive, she would be struck by dozens of sword gleams.
And those dozen or so Origin Sea Realm cultivators launched killing blows with every move, all aimed at her vital points.
Su Wanyi focused all her spirit.
At this moment, she pushed the Divine Dragon Nine-Change Body Technique to its absolute limit.
Dozens of Divine Dragon Phantoms danced in the air above the arena, making it difficult to distinguish the real from the illusory.
Even if Sword Qi dispelled half of the Divine Dragon Phantoms, another dozen or so would immediately materialize.
Ever-changing and elusive.
Ye Yun watched this scene from inside the carriage, a faint smile appearing on his serene face.
In terms of the Divine Dragon Nine-Change Body Technique, Su Wanyi... is indeed stronger than Luo Li and Jun Moxiao.
After all, they were currently within the Shenfeng Dynasty’s territory, where Origin Sea Realm cultivators were considerably stronger than those in the Ancient Moon Dynasty.
So the pressure she faced would naturally be greater.
Su Wanyi only needed to persevere a little longer to achieve a breakthrough.
Ye Yun glanced at the celestial phenomena and noticed the round moon growing increasingly crimson.
He then looked towards the earth beneath Silver Moon City.
He found that the underground formation was nearly prepared and had already begun to operate.
Ye Yun raised an eyebrow, then lifted his hand and gently pointed with his index finger.
The entire space above and below Silver Moon City suddenly underwent a wondrous change.
Deep underground, the great formation operated by the Silver Moon Wolf Clan was forcibly suppressed by Ye Yun, its speed unknowingly slowing.
It could be said that whether it was the Tri-element Martial Meeting on the surface or the Silver Moon Wolf Clan’s plans underground, everything was unfolding within Ye Yun’s grand strategy.
The moment Su Wanyi broke through would also be when the blood moon hung high, heralding the resurrection of the Howling Sky Silver Wolf.
And Ye Yun had long made arrangements for this Howling Sky Silver Wolf; it was to be practice for the Big Black Cat.
Time gradually flowed by.
While time seemed to pass very slowly for Ye Yun, for Su Wanyi, it flew by.
Her mind was intensely focused; every minute, every second, she was dealing with all kinds of sword light attacks.
The slightest misstep would lead to a fatal wound.
Xiong Yinghao stood with his hands clasped behind his back, his expression extremely serious as he looked towards the arena.
If not for his status, he would have truly wanted to rush up and join the battle.
So many Origin Sea Realm experts, after attacking for so long, still couldn’t take down a single cultivator at the Yuanhai Realm Second Layer.
"A bunch of trash!"
Xiong Yinghao stomped his foot in anger.
"This Su Wanyi should be nearing her limit!" Elder Luo remarked coolly, his eyes narrowed, emitting a cold glint.
Another half-cup of tea’s time passed.
Xiong Yinghao and Elder Luo exchanged a glance, their expressions extremely grim.
They had repeatedly assumed Su Wanyi would collapse at any moment, but unexpectedly, she kept escaping death by a hair’s breadth, time and time again.
This left both of them incredibly shocked.
How could this Su Wanyi possess such tenacity?
In his entire life, Elder Luo had never seen such a resilient cultivator.
Little did he know that Su Wanyi, ever since childhood, had been fleeing with her Master, experiencing countless life-and-death trials.
She, her Master, and her junior martial siblings had escaped death numerous times thanks to their Sect’s Divine Dragon Nine-Change Body Technique.
"A tiger forced onto flat plains can be bullied by dogs."
The current Dragon God Sect was obscure and barely known. For nearly ten thousand years, it had maintained almost no presence on the Cangnan Continent.
Ninety thousand years ago, any cultivator who witnessed the Divine Dragon Nine-Change Body Technique would have instinctively kept a great distance.
Who would have dared to challenge a disciple of an Eternal Sect?
In the blink of an eye, the time it takes for an incense stick to burn had passed.
BANG!
The invisible shackles within Su Wanyi’s body finally shattered.
Her body trembled slightly, and the Mana within her surged like a great river, rushing through all her meridians.
In this moment, Su Wanyi’s Mana and combat prowess soared once more!
"She broke through again!"
The surrounding crowd couldn’t help but reveal shocked expressions.
Among the crowd, Chang Lu Die also stared wide-eyed, unable to believe what she was witnessing.
This Sister Su... is simply an unparalleled monster!
One must realize, she had just broken through during her match with Xiong Chumo!
Less than two hours had passed, yet she had broken through twice consecutively. This was truly stunning to countless people.
"How did she break through again?!"
Elder Luo abruptly shot to his feet, clenching his fists, the veins on his neck bulging prominently.
"Go!" Elder Luo ordered, his face grim, looking towards Xiong Yinghao at his side.
"Yes!"
The shocked Xiong Yinghao immediately stood up upon hearing Elder Luo’s command.
Suddenly, Xiong Yinghao heard astonished cries from the surrounding crowd.
"Look! Why has the moon turned red?"
Countless people instinctively looked up at the night sky.
At this moment, the celestial phenomena underwent a strange transformation: the originally golden full moon had turned blood-red.
A blood moon now hung in the sky!
That eerie blood moon hung ominously in the sky.
The bloody light it cast down dyed Silver Moon City in a crimson hue.

chapters.title: Chapter 60: Birth of the Silver Moon Wolf Clan, Chaos Begins
chapters.content:
Chapter 60: Chapter 60: Birth of the Silver Moon Wolf Clan, Chaos Begins
The sudden celestial anomaly in Silver Moon City’s sky shocked everyone.
"What is this...?" As Elder Luo looked at the blood moon, his heart and mind suddenly grew heavy.
Could the ancient legends be true?
On the night when the blood moon was in the sky, the Guardian God of the Silver Moon Wolf Clan would once again descend upon the world.
The Silver Moon Wolf Clan, which once lived on this land, were half-human, half-wolf. They possessed the blood of Silver Wolves. Tracing back to their roots, their ancestors were the Howling Sky Silver Wolves.
The Howling Sky Silver Wolf was also one of the Ancient Divine Beasts mentioned in the legends of the Cangnan Continent.
After several seconds, Elder Luo thought,
The Howling Sky Silver Wolf was killed by powerful experts of the Human Race in the battle ten thousand years ago. It couldn’t possibly be resurrected. Besides, for more than nine thousand years, not a single Silver Moon Wolf has appeared here...
Elder Luo shook his head and murmured softly, forcibly dispelling the trace of panic in his heart.
At this moment, Xiong Yinghao also felt a twinge of fear upon seeing this terrifying celestial event.
Suddenly, Elder Luo’s voice echoed in his ears, "City Lord Xiong, what are you still hesitating for?"
"Elder Luo, rest assured, Su Wanyi will undoubtedly die today!"
Xiong Yinghao cast aside all distractions, took a deep breath, and with a single step, leaped from the spectator stand, traversing the void to descend onto the arena.
Now, after Su Wanyi had broken through to the Third Layer of the Origin Sea Realm, she was no longer in such a dire predicament.
The Big Black Cat perched on her shoulder. Its sharp eyes, shooting ferocious light, were fixed on the attacking Xiong Yinghao. It was preparing to intervene.
Suddenly, a familiar sound reached its ears.
THUD!
That was the sound of its master, Uncle Ma’s horse hoof hitting the ground.
Such a soft noise, yet in mid-air, Xiong Yinghao’s mind was filled with an immense roaring sound. As if struck by lightning, he abruptly fainted, plummeting from the sky and crashing to the ground with a thud.
Fortunately, as a Shaping God Realm cultivator, his physique was strong, so he didn’t crack his head open and bleed.
HA HA!
A delighted laugh bubbled up in the Big Black Cat’s heart.
Uncle Ma has made his move! With a simple tap of his hoof... a Shaping God Realm expert was knocked unconscious! Needless to say, Uncle Ma is truly formidable! If it were me, I couldn’t do that. My favorite method is to pounce, pin Xiong Yinghao under my paws like a mouse, and then swallow him whole in one bite.
The Big Black Cat was filled with admiration.
"City Lord!"
A few cultivators rushed over and supported Xiong Yinghao.
Blood trickled from Xiong Yinghao’s nostrils. His eyes were tightly closed, and he remained unconscious.
Seeing this, Elder Luo drew a sharp, cold breath.
Silver Moon City was now enveloped in a crimson glow, emanating an eerie, Hell-like atmosphere.
Recalling the legends of the Silver Moon Wolf Clan, Elder Luo felt an inexplicable dread in his heart and suddenly shivered.
"AWOOO!!"
On a distant street, a pedestrian suddenly threw their head back and let out a wolf-like howl.
This sound was like a spark igniting fuel, instantly triggering a chain reaction throughout Silver Moon City.
At this moment, almost all the common folk, as well as cultivators with lower cultivation bases, tilted their heads back and howled at the eerie blood moon in the sky.
Silver Moon City had a population of tens of millions.
At this moment, without exception, all of them howled at the sky like wolves, creating an incredibly sinister atmosphere.
The sound of howling rose and fell, shaking the entirety of Silver Moon City.
The very ground of Silver Moon City began to rumble, as if some ferocious beast was hidden beneath.
"What is happening beneath the ground?"
In the City Lord’s Mansion, the Sect Leaders from various major sects and the Clan Leaders of major factions witnessed Silver Moon City’s shocking transformation, their expressions changing drastically.
They felt an uncontrollable agitation stirring within their bodies.
"AWOOO!"
Finally, a Clan Leader at the First Level of the Origin Sea Realm, his eyes bulging and skin flushing red, threw his head back and let out a wolf howl.
Subsequently, more and more cultivators, unable to suppress the agitation in their hearts, also roared at the sky.
Within Silver Moon City, after many ordinary citizens howled like wolves, their skin began to split open, and blood gushed out.
This blood, upon flowing onto the ground, was absorbed by a strange power.
"This place is no longer safe!"
Sensing the increasingly terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath, Elder Luo’s expression changed drastically. He made his move, preparing to leave.
RUMBLE!
In the plaza ahead, a gigantic fissure suddenly split open in the ground, and hundreds of incredibly powerful figures charged out.
These figures were tall, around three meters each, covered in silver wolf fur. They had human bodies but wolf heads, and each wielded a Wolf Tooth Club.
They flew into the air above the City Lord’s Mansion.
These are the remnants of the Silver Moon Wolf Clan!
Seeing this, Elder Luo of the Qitian Sword Sect finally understood.
The remnants of the Wolf Clan, which hadn’t appeared for over ten thousand years, were actually hidden beneath Silver Moon City! And tonight, they’ve even initiated a large-scale ritual sacrifice! After tonight, all humans in Silver Moon City will die. And the legendary Divine Beast of the Silver Moon Wolf Clan—the Howling Sky Silver Wolf—will descend upon the world once more!
At this moment, Elder Luo’s face was pale, his heart icy cold.
I must return to the Qitian Sword Saint as quickly as possible and report this to the Sect Master!
WHOOSH!
His body transformed into a streak of light, piercing the sky as he tried to escape.
A silver orb of light, like a meteor, suddenly shot forward and collided with him. They clashed in mid-air; Elder Luo grunted and was forced back down.
The one who blocked him was a robust, middle-aged Werewolf.
Holding a gleaming silver Wolf Tooth Club, he looked at Elder Luo and sneered, "Ten thousand years ago, the Qitian Sword Sect was also one of the chief culprits in the siege of Silver Moon City. How could I let you escape?"
Elder Luo pointed his sword at the Werewolf and cursed, "Scum of the Silver Moon Wolf Clan! To think you’ve been cowering underground for nearly ten thousand years!"
"Yes, ninety-nine percent of our Clan Members were slaughtered by your Human Race. Fortunately, we had an underground citadel beneath Silver Moon City, which allowed us to survive! After nearly ten thousand years of recuperation, we’ve only managed to recover some of our Yuan Qi. Today, our clan’s ancestral god, the Howling Sky Silver Wolf, will descend upon the world! From this day forward, the Shenfeng Dynasty will be ruled by our Silver Moon Wolf Clan!"
He then burst into hysterical laughter, looking utterly crazed.
Enraged, Elder Luo flew into the sky and slashed his sword towards the Werewolf.
The two Divine Bridge Realm experts instantly engaged in a fierce battle.
Meanwhile, the other experts from the Silver Moon Wolf Clan were engaged in fierce combat with the Sect Leaders and Clan Leaders who had not been poisoned.
In an instant, the entire City Lord’s Mansion descended into chaos.
On the arena, the Origin Sea Realm cultivators who had been continuously attacking Su Wanyi were inwardly lamenting their misfortune.
They too felt an irrepressible agitation in their hearts.
When they saw some cultivators around them howling like wolves, their bodies splitting open and oozing blood, they knew they must have been afflicted by a special kind of poison.
These cultivators had to suppress this strange poison in their bodies while simultaneously fighting Su Wanyi; it was an extremely arduous struggle.
Seizing the opportunity, Su Wanyi struck several times with her sword, killing a few low-level Origin Sea Realm cultivators.
Su Wanyi fought with increasing valor.
She was not affected by the celestial anomaly.
「Inside the black carriage.」
Ye Yun’s expression was calm and undisturbed.
He suddenly sensed something and lifted his head.
The blood of tens of millions of people in Silver Moon City flowed into the ground. It was then channeled through a large formation deep underground, which refined it.
All the blood essence was now concentrated on that blood moon.
Within the blood moon, the illusory figure of a ferocious Silver Wolf flickered in and out of view.

chapters.title: Chapter 61: Howling Sky Silver Wolf
chapters.content:
Chapter 61: Chapter 61: Howling Sky Silver Wolf
"This little wolf whelp, so long awaited, is finally about to emerge!"
Ye Yun offered a casual smile.
"HOWL!"
The silver wolf phantom within the blood moon suddenly let out a thunderous howl.
At that very moment, Elder Luo, who was in the midst of battle, felt his spirit quake; his hand trembled, and he nearly dropped his sword.
WHOOSH!
A streak of silver light flashed past.
The middle-aged werewolf viciously smashed his Wolf Fang Club right into Elder Luo’s shoulder.
"AH!"
Elder Luo spat out blood and fell from mid-air.
Seeing Elder Luo of Qitian Sword Sect defeated, the sect masters and some clan leaders in the ongoing battle were all utterly astounded.
At this moment, their emotional turmoil made them unable to suppress the strange poison within them any longer. One by one, they roared towards the heavens. Cracks appeared on their skin, and streams of blood flowed into the ground.
This included the cultivators of the Origin Sea Realm on the platform; there were no exceptions.
Not one person was left standing before her.
Gasping for breath, Su Wanyi looked around and noticed that she was the last one standing.
All around her were towering werewolves.
"This Human cultivator must be an outsider. She’s not affected by our poison, Clan Leader!" a young werewolf spoke out loud.
"Deal with her!" the middle-aged werewolf at the Shaping God Realm said indifferently from mid-air.
In an instant, dozens of Origin Sea Realm werewolves pounced toward Su Wanyi.
CLIP-CLOP!
A soft sound of horse hooves rang out.
All those werewolves were shocked unconscious in mid-leap.
"Who’s there, playing such mysterious games?"
The werewolf at the Shaping God Realm was startled.
Space fluctuated. A black carriage suddenly appeared on the stage.
The Big Black Horse pulling the carriage lifted its head and grinned at the middle-aged werewolf, revealing its white, gleaming teeth.
Seeing such a mysterious black carriage suddenly appear, an intense expression washed over the middle-aged werewolf’s face.
"Ancestor!" Su Wanyi promptly bowed in respect.
"Take a breather and enjoy the show... You’ve already done commendably well by advancing two minor realms through relentless battles. Fighting further would be to your detriment," Ye Yun gently suggested.
Su Wanyi revealed a grateful expression.
She tucked her Seven-Star Dragon Abyss Sword behind her back and stood beside the carriage.
There are people in the carriage?
The middle-aged werewolf was taken aback.
He hadn’t sensed anyone’s presence, which meant the other party was also an expert. He dared not act recklessly. This black carriage had a peculiar origin and was not from any of Silver Moon City’s forces.
The grand array was operating at a crucial moment, and the ancestor of the Silver Moon Wolf Clan, the Howling Sky Silver Wolf, was about to be resurrected.
He looked up at the blood moon in the sky.
Within the blood moon, the figure of the silver wolf was becoming clearer.
The wolf blood in the middle-aged werewolf’s body was already boiling.
"HOWL!"
He couldn’t help but release a furious roar towards the sky.
The large array that covered the entire Silver Moon City transferred another huge amount of qi and blood to the blood moon in the sky.
A dazzling silver light suddenly fell from the blood moon. In mid-air, a massive silver wolf formed.
This massive silver wolf, its body shimmering with a silvery glow, was as large as a small hill. Its pair of silver wings emitted a chilling light.
It had a pair of blood-red eyes that exuded a lethal aura.
An unimaginably powerful pressure descended from the sky.
"Respects to our Ancestor!"
Upon seeing the familiar Howling Sky Silver Wolf, everyone from the Silver Moon Wolf Clan dropped to their knees, continuously kowtowing, their faces displaying an intense fervor.
"It was hard on you all to revive me after such a long time..." The Howling Sky Silver Wolf surveyed his surroundings, a domineering aura radiating from his eyes. He slowly spoke, "The Silver Moon Werewolf Clan shall rise from this day forth! In all of heaven and earth, I alone reign supreme!"
This statement ignited the passion in the hearts of the Silver Moon Werewolves.
"In all of heaven and earth, I alone reign supreme!" the crowd roared in agreement.
Their booming voices shook the heavens and the earth; the entire Silver Moon City seemed to quiver with the sound.
"Careful you don’t bite your tongue with all that bluster!"
The Big Black Cat suddenly stood up from Su Wanyi’s shoulder, transformed into a black light, and shot into the sky.
Once in mid-air, it changed into a massive black cat, its size comparable to a small mountain.
From afar, it resembled a giant black leopard.
At this moment, the Big Black Cat’s dark fur shimmered, and its black eyes emitted a chilling light.
It extended its claws, stuck out its blood-red tongue, and gently licked its sharp talons.
"Howling Sky Silver Wolf, Old Cat here will play with you!" the Big Black Cat stated with disdain.
"Hmm?" Just as the Howling Sky Silver Wolf was savoring his moment, he was taken aback when a massive black cat of similar size suddenly appeared before him.
When he noticed that the black cat had three tails, he was immediately stunned.
A Nine-tailed Spirit Cat! A formidable demon beast whose bloodline was not inferior to his own. Moreover, its cultivation base matches his own, both at the Nirvana Realm!
This gave him a sense of crisis.
"Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, we have no past grievances nor recent enmity between us. Why must you be at odds with me?" the Howling Sky Silver Wolf roared indignantly.
"Old Cat just thinks you’re too arrogant and wants to teach you a lesson!" The Big Black Cat smirked, charging toward the Howling Sky Silver Wolf.
The Howling Sky Silver Wolf was also not to be outdone.
The two colossal demon beasts began to fight fiercely in the sky.
In an instant, the massive rumbling sound shook the entire earth.
After all, this was a fight between two mighty demon beasts at the Nirvana Realm.
All the Silver Moon Werewolves looked up at the sky, their faces extremely grim.
They never imagined that just after summoning their ancestor, a black Nine-tailed Spirit Cat of comparable cultivation base would suddenly appear.
The middle-aged werewolf turned his gaze back to the black carriage.
Fear was evident in his eyes.
Who exactly was the person in that carriage? How could they command a Nine-tailed Spirit Cat at the Nirvana Realm to fight for them?!
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
The deafening sound, like toppling mountains and overturning seas, echoed throughout the sky.
The battle between the Howling Sky Silver Wolf and the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat raged on. After the time it took for an incense stick to burn, they had both suffered some wounds.
However, the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat’s injuries were slightly more serious.
Its defensive power was weaker than that of the Howling Sky Silver Wolf, so the same attack caused more damage to it.
"You little wolf whelp, how dare you go for the kill! Let’s see how Old Cat deals with you!" The Big Black Cat’s ferocity erupted, and it attacked the Howling Sky Silver Wolf with reckless abandon.
It was a reckless tactic, trading injury for injury.
"You lunatic! Are you determined for us both to suffer grievous injury?!" The Howling Sky Silver Wolf was provoked into cursing as well.
After all, they were both experts of the same caliber; there was truly no need for such a desperate, life-or-death struggle.
"Master, Little Cat is fighting quite fiercely!" The Big Black Horse turned its head and chuckled towards the carriage.
"This counts as his pledge of loyalty," Ye Yun said with a casual smile, unperturbed.
Watching the blood continually rain down from the sky, Su Wanyi felt somewhat anxious.
After all, this feline senior had once saved her life.

chapters.title: Chapter 62 - Uncle Ma is Too Cruel
chapters.content:
Chapter 62: Chapter 62 - Uncle Ma is Too Cruel
BANG! BANG!
BOOM!
The fight between the Howling Sky Silver Wolf and the Big Black Cat grew more intense.
"Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, don’t push me!" As his injuries mounted, the Howling Sky Silver Wolf couldn’t help but roar in fury.
"You little wolf pup, show this Old Cat everything you’ve got! If this Old Cat so much as frowns, I’ll take your last name!" The Big Black Cat sneered repeatedly and continued to bombard the Howling Sky Silver Wolf relentlessly.
"Fine!" The Howling Sky Silver Wolf trembled with rage.
He opened his mouth wide and swallowed the blood moon in the sky. Instantly, the world plunged into darkness. The Howling Sky Silver Wolf, at the cost of thirty percent of his Essence Blood, then activated his Bloodline Supernatural Power.
BANG!
He lunged like lightning, sending the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat plummeting from the sky with a single swipe. This blow was at least three times his usual strength. The Howling Sky Silver Wolf believed that the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat would definitely be severely injured and lose all ability to fight.
WHOOSH!
A huge figure, like a small black mountain, plummeted from the sky. If it crashed to the ground, the entire City Lord’s Mansion would likely be smashed into a giant crater.
Su Wanyi stared wide-eyed, watching dumbfoundedly as Senior Cat fell from the sky. She was helpless.
「Inside the carriage.」
Ye Yun gently waved his hand in the air.
The Big Black Cat’s huge body immediately shrank and flew back onto the carriage. It lay sprawled on its back, panting indignantly, "Master, don’t mind me! I want to fight this little wolf pup for three hundred rounds!"
"Oh, cut it out! You’re severely injured and can’t even lift a paw, yet you still want to fight for three hundred rounds?" The Big Black Horse, standing nearby, teased with a laugh.
Ye Yun smiled.
"Uncle Ma, don’t make fun of me! I know my own strength, but that little wolf pup is too arrogant! I can’t just let him get his way!" the Big Black Cat complained with a mournful face. It had been severely injured by the Howling Sky Silver Wolf’s Innate Divine Ability and truly had no strength left to fight. All it could do was bluster from the sidelines.
At this moment, high in the void, the Howling Sky Silver Wolf radiated a brilliant silver light. Its enormous wings spread wide, majestic and imposing, like a divine wolf that had strode out of a Mythical Kingdom.
Having eliminated its greatest opponent, the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, the Howling Sky Silver Wolf felt a wave of relief and couldn’t help but throw back its head and howl at the sky.
"Master, this little wolf pup is beyond arrogant now!" The Big Black Horse pawed the ground restlessly.
"Alright, you go then!" Ye Yun smiled lightly and waved his hand.
The Big Black Horse immediately grew excited. Its body trembled once, and it broke free from the reins, soaring into mid-air.
The Howling Sky Silver Wolf was reveling in its triumph when suddenly a streak of black light appeared before its eyes, moving so fast it couldn’t react.
The Howling Sky Silver Wolf stared in shock at the Big Black Horse that had suddenly appeared.
What rotten luck does this lord have today? First a Big Black Cat, now a Big Black Horse, both pitch black!
It shook its sleek, bright silver fur and cursed irritably.
The Big Black Horse’s eyes bulged.
Fuck! This little wolf pup dares to curse me too? Too fucking arrogant!
The Big Black Horse didn’t even have time to release its powerful Super Divine Dragon Breath. It reared up, hoof raised, and charged, bringing it down hard on the Howling Sky Silver Wolf’s head.
BANG!
This single hoof strike was filled with unimaginable power. The Howling Sky Silver Wolf was instantly kicked so hard its head felt like it would split open; it saw stars, let out a miserable shriek, and plummeted downwards.
"Dumbass!" The Big Black Horse stood in mid-air, proudly watching the falling Howling Sky Silver Wolf, a sneer on its face.
Below, the Silver Moon Wolf Clan members turned pale with fright when they saw their ancestor, the Howling Sky Silver Wolf, get sneak-attacked by a Big Black Horse and fall plummeting from the sky.
Inside the carriage, observing the Big Black Horse’s failure to kill the Howling Sky Silver Wolf instantly, Ye Yun couldn’t help but shake his head and laugh.
The Big Black Horse is also a playful demon beast, it seems. It looks like it wants to properly torture that arrogant Howling Sky Silver Wolf!
Ye Yun didn’t interfere.
Just as it was about to crash into the ground, the Howling Sky Silver Wolf suddenly regained consciousness, flapped its wings vigorously, and took flight once more.
"You damn Big Black Horse, you dare attack me, your Grandpa Wolf?!" After roaring this, the Howling Sky Silver Wolf, filled with fury, charged at the Big Black Horse.
Perhaps that kick had muddled his brain, as his way of speaking was quite different from before. This left the Silver Moon Wolf Clan members below utterly dumbfounded.
Why is our ancestor talking like such an arrogant young master...?
Mid-flight, the Howling Sky Silver Wolf and the Big Black Horse faced off distantly.
He carefully sized up the Big Black Horse before him, which looked as tiny as a little black ant. For a moment, he actually couldn’t discern the Big Black Horse’s cultivation base.
While he hesitated, the Big Black Horse shook its formidable body, releasing a wisp of its Super Divine Dragon Breath.
Even though it was just a tiny wisp, when it fell upon the Howling Sky Silver Wolf, his expression changed dramatically.
Is this... the Eternal Realm?
The Howling Sky Silver Wolf knew quality when he saw it and immediately knelt in the void.
"Uncle Ma, please spare this little wolf’s life! A moment ago, this little wolf was blind and failed to recognize your esteemed self!" The Howling Sky Silver Wolf’s tone changed completely as he began to kneel and beg for mercy.
The Big Black Horse grinned. "Little wolf pup, I’m giving you a chance. Escape quickly."
Escape?
The Howling Sky Silver Wolf understood the implied meaning in the Big Black Horse’s words. He hastily got up, and with a flap of his wings, he tore through the air and fled.
His pair of enormous, shimmering silver wings, once they began to beat, could cover millions of miles in an instant, a speed almost too fast to imagine.
The Silver Moon Wolf Clan members were kneeling in the square. At this moment, they were all stunned. They never imagined that their ancestor would suddenly turn tail and run when facing the Big Black Horse.
What will happen to us?
Everyone exchanged confused looks, unsure what to do.
After silently counting for some ten-odd seconds, the Big Black Horse lazily lifted its head. It looked in the direction where the Howling Sky Silver Wolf had disappeared, opened its mouth, and spat out a beam of blue light.
This beam of blue light, like a bolt of lightning, tore across the night sky, vanishing in an instant.
The next moment, the blue light shot back from the distant horizon at incredible speed. Enveloped within its shimmering blue glow was the Howling Sky Silver Wolf, who had fled far away.
WHOOSH!
With a sway of its body, the Big Black Horse suddenly swelled to the size of a massive mountain, casting the entirety of Silver Moon City into its shadow.
The Big Black Horse opened its terrifyingly large mouth. The blue light shot in, dragging the Howling Sky Silver Wolf with it. Then, the Big Black Horse began to chew with loud CRUNCH, CRUNCH sounds.
Streams of fresh blood continuously dripped from the corners of its mouth.
The Howling Sky Silver Wolf let out miserable shrieks, but he was completely unable to move.
That blue radiance—it was impossible to tell what it was. He had fled tens of thousands of li away, yet was still dragged back in an instant.
The Big Black Horse ate with great relish, its mouth dripping with blood.
The Big Black Cat, sprawled on the carriage, stared at the scene in horror.
Uncle Ma is too savage!
It was so terrified that its eyes rolled back, and it fainted on the spot.

chapters.title: Chapter 63: In a Single Breath, Silver Moon City was Reduced to Ashes
chapters.content:
Chapter 63: Chapter 63: In a Single Breath, Silver Moon City was Reduced to Ashes
Seeing the Big Black Cat faint in fear and lie sprawled out on the carriage in a rather indecent pose, Ye Yun gently tapped it, and a strand of Divine Power entered its body.
The Big Black Cat’s eyes shot open as if it had taken an aphrodisiac. The Magical Force in its body invigorated it, and a green light emanated from its eyes.
"Master, what on earth is this?" the Big Black Cat knelt on the carriage, joining its paws in supplication, looking excited.
"You don’t need to ask. Just slowly refine it," Ye Yun said casually.
Given the Big Black Cat’s current Realm, even if he told it, it would not understand the intricacies of Divine Power.
The strand of Divine Power Ye Yun had separated was insignificant to him, like scooping a single drop of seawater from the ocean.
But this drop of Divine Power, to the Big Black Cat, was like an endless ocean. If it continuously comprehended while refining this Divine Power, it could gain unimaginable benefits, perhaps even growing nine tails.
At this moment, the Big Black Horse, having already devoured the Howling Sky Silver Wolf, shrank to its normal size and landed. The people of the Silver Moon Wolf Clan on the ground had long fainted in terror.
THUMP!
The Big Black Horse put the reins on itself again, licking the blood from its mouth.
Seeing Uncle Ma so brutal, the Big Black Cat cowered behind him, shivering with a terrified expression, too scared to make a sound.
"Little Cat, I’m not going to eat you. Why are you so frightened?" the Big Black Horse grinned.
The Big Black Cat quickly raised its paws to cover its head, not daring to look at the cruel smile on Uncle Ma’s face.
Even Su Wanyi, facing the Big Black Horse at this moment, felt an indescribable fear. She would never have thought that the always gentle Big Black Horse could be so horrifying. It had simply eaten the Howling Sky Silver Wolf, which was the size of a small hill. Devoured it in crisp bites. Unimaginable indeed!
The carriage curtain lifted, and Ye Yun suddenly stepped out, standing on the carriage. He looked around, his expression extremely indifferent.
Su Wanyi looked at her Ancestor’s handsome side profile in amazement.
Ancestor, why did you suddenly appear?
During the intense battle earlier, the Ancestor had remained seated steadily within the carriage. At this moment, the Ancestor gently exhaled a breath of clear air. This breath of clear air spread out in all directions.
Then, a scene that astounded Su Wanyi unfolded.
Anything touched by this clear air—be it corpses, the unconscious members of the Silver Moon Wolf Clan, flowers, trees, or buildings—instantly turned into wisps of green smoke and vanished into thin air. The clear air spread with extreme speed. Under Su Wanyi’s astonished gaze, everything around her was disappearing rapidly.
In the span of just two or three breaths, looking at the surroundings, Su Wanyi’s eyes widened again. The entire, vast Silver Moon City had disappeared! Where they stood was now a flat, open field, barren of any trace of what had been there before.
Ancestor... he’s too terrifying! Is this the power of a True God?
Su Wanyi’s eyes were wide, and she swallowed hard. She found it difficult to describe her shock at that moment. With a single breath of clear air, the entirety of Silver Moon City had vanished, without leaving a single trace behind. This was too horrifying!
The Big Black Cat craned its neck, staring dumbly at the vanished Silver Moon City, nearly wetting itself again in fear.
Master... he’s too terrifying! With just one breath, the entire Silver Moon City disappeared. Even experts of the Eternal Realm probably couldn’t do that, right? Master must be a god, perhaps even the most powerful among them...
the Big Black Cat thought to itself. It lifted its head, gazing at the majestic, god-like figure. An overwhelming sense of awe washed over it, and it quickly prostrated itself on the carriage, too scared to rise.The Big Black Horse blinked.
The Master is indeed the Master. Such powerful Divine Skills have long surpassed the True God Realm.
"Little girl, you can come out now." Ye Yun suddenly pointed ahead. To everyone’s surprise, a small girl in green clothing crawled out of the churning dirt.
Su Wanyi’s eyes widened in shock.
Isn’t that Chang Lu Die? Unexpectedly, the Ancestor had spared her life.
Chang Lu Die emerged from the earth, dirt smeared all over her face. She looked around and was immediately dumbfounded.
"Where am I? Where has Silver Moon City gone?" she muttered in bewilderment.
Then, she saw the black carriage and, standing beside it, Su Wanyi clad in a dazzling golden Robe.
"Sister Su, you’re alive! That’s wonderful!" Chang Lu Die cried, running over to embrace Su Wanyi and bursting into tears.
At this moment, Su Wanyi didn’t know whether to laugh or cry. She felt that the girl might have been scared out of her wits. She continuously patted Chang Lu Die’s back, whispering comforting words.
Ye Yun remained standing on the carriage, watching this little girl in green with a slight smile on his face. This little girl was someone he had purposely protected because he had seen a familiar sign on her.
"Sister Su, I’m sorry for making a scene!" After venting her emotions, Chang Lu Die stepped back from Su Wanyi’s embrace, her apple-red face flushed.
"It’s no problem," Su Wanyi smiled and shook her head.
"Sister Su, what exactly happened just now? Where has Silver Moon City gone?" Chang Lu Die asked curiously.
Su Wanyi’s expression faltered slightly as she glanced towards her Ancestor. The fact that the Ancestor had obliterated Silver Moon City with a single breath of clear air was too momentous; she dared not speak of it casually.
Ye Yun chuckled. "Little girl, it’s best you keep this matter to yourself and don’t ask about it again."
"Okay!" Chang Lu Die nodded, seeming to somewhat understand.
Ye Yun then asked, "Does your family have an Ancestor named Chang Yuchun?"
Chang Lu Die’s eyes widened; she was instantly shocked. The Chang Family had an ancestral hall with tablets. Ever since she was little, she had gone there every year to offer incense to her ancestors. And the one ranked first was this very Ancestor Chang Yuchun.
"Big Brother, how did you know my family’s Ancestor’s name?" Chang Lu Die stammered.
Hearing this, the Big Black Cat rolled over and said irritably, "You impolite little girl! How dare you call the Old Master ’Big Brother’? Are you trying to take advantage of your Sister Su?"
"Ah!" Chang Lu Die exclaimed, startled by the sight of the talking Big Black Cat.
"Then... what should I call him, Sister Su?" Chang Lu Die turned a pleading gaze towards Su Wanyi.
Before Su Wanyi could speak, Ye Yun smiled faintly. "Just call me Old Master. After all, you’re not a member of my Sect..."
Chang Lu Die understood immediately and bowed respectfully.
"Greetings, Old Master!"
"Let’s go. Sit in the carriage and guide us from the front. We’ll go to your home and take a look," Ye Yun said, then entered the carriage.
"Going to my home?" Chang Lu Die was baffled for a moment. But she quickly recovered. She could tell that this white-robed Old Master was no ordinary person.
She hastily jumped onto the carriage and sat down. Su Wanyi sat on the other side.
Chang Lu Die pointed in a direction, her face flushing red as she said guiltily, "Sister Su, my home is in that direction... it’s just a bit far..."
"How far is it exactly?" Su Wanyi asked with a soft laugh.
"About... over 20,000 miles..." After saying this, Chang Lu Die lowered her head in embarrassment.
"Sister Green Butterfly, you traveled so far to Silver Moon City for the Tri-element Martial Meeting?" Su Wanyi exclaimed in surprise. Over 20,000 miles was no small distance. This young girl, at the Second Layer of the Origin Sea Realm, had traveled over 20,000 miles alone to Silver Moon City. The hardships she must have endured on such a journey were truly considerable.

chapters.title: Chapter 64: The Power of a Fart
chapters.content:
Chapter 64: Chapter 64: The Power of a Fart
"Sister Su, I really don’t have any other options..."
"Our Chang Family resides in a remote area with limited family resources. We can only afford to cultivate my brother. The Tri-element Martial Meeting was my only chance to succeed, so I set out a few months ago..."
Chang Lu Die’s eyes reddened slightly as she sighed gently.
"It must have been very difficult for you!"
Su Wanyi also sighed, deeply sympathetic. She had endured many hardships with her master since childhood, living a life of displacement and struggle with scarce cultivation resources, so she understood Chang Lu Die very well.
Chang Lu Die was still young, yet she was very sensible. To avoid using her family’s cultivation resources, she had traveled thousands of miles to Silver Moon City, hoping to gain an opportunity to join a first-rate sect through the Tri-element Martial Meeting. Unexpectedly, a disaster struck Silver Moon City. This shattered the young girl’s dreams.
However, it seems the Old Ancestor shares an old connection with an ancestor of the Chang Family. He’s rushing there now; perhaps the Chang Family’s crisis will be resolved soon.
Such thoughts flashed through Su Wanyi’s mind.
"Wow, this carriage is so fast!"
Even though the Big Black Horse was deliberately slowing its pace, it was still incredibly fast—so fast that the surrounding scenery blurred. Chang Lu Die couldn’t help but exclaim. This unremarkable Big Black Horse was truly extraordinary. When it ran, it was as fast as the famed Dragon Colts of the Shenfeng Dynasty. Despite the Big Black Horse’s incredible speed, the carriage remained perfectly stable.
Su Wanyi kept her eyes slightly closed, her mind free of distractions. She circulated the unique Cultivation Technique of the Dragon God Sect, stabilizing her newly attained Third Layer of the Origin Sea Realm.
To avoid startling the young girl, Ye Yun had specifically instructed the Big Black Horse to reduce its speed. Even so, the Big Black Horse covered the twenty thousand-mile journey in just three days.
"So fast! We arrived in just three days!"
Gazing at the familiar Xuan Yang County, an expression of utter shock appeared on Chang Lu Die’s small, apple-round face. Her initial journey had taken several months.
Inside the carriage, Ye Yun, who had been resting with his eyes closed, suddenly opened them. He glanced towards Xuan Yang County, his expression thoughtful.
Xuan Yang County was a small territory on the frontier of the Shenfeng Dynasty. The Chang Family’s influence in Xuan Yang County was not prominent; they barely qualified as a second-rate family.
At this moment, a black carriage slowly approached, stopping before the Chang Mansion.
"Haha, we’re home!"
Chang Lu Die leaped from the carriage, ran to the large, vermillion-lacquered door, and gently tapped the iron knocker twice.
"That’s odd. Why is the door closed?" Chang Lu Die wondered, her eyes darting around. Usually, her family’s main gate was open, with guards posted at the entrance.
After a moment, the sound of footsteps approached from within, and the door slowly creaked open. An elderly man in a black robe emerged, wearing a small skullcap.
"Ah, the Young Miss has returned!" Recognizing the visitor through the crack in the door, the old man forced a smile and pulled the door fully open.
"Uncle Zhao, has something happened at home?" Seeing the old man’s sorrowful expression and the desolate courtyard, Chang Lu Die felt a sense of foreboding.
"Young Miss, it’s best if you speak with the Master about this..." The elderly man sighed. He looked up and saw a black carriage parked outside, upon which sat a beautiful woman in a golden robe.
"Young Miss, is this your friend?" Uncle Zhao couldn’t help but ask.
Chang Lu Die quickly nodded with a smile, "Uncle Zhao, this is my Sister Su!"
The carriage curtain was lifted. Ye Yun stepped out of the carriage, his feet landing on the ground.
Seeing the Old Ancestor emerge, Su Wanyi’s heart skipped a beat. She also quickly alighted from the carriage, standing respectfully behind the Old Ancestor.
Ye Yun stood with his hands clasped behind his back. Gazing at the plaque above the mansion gate, he became lost in brief contemplation.
"Sir, please come in with me!" Chang Lu Die stepped forward and said respectfully.
Ye Yun nodded.
Chang Lu Die led the way, while Ye Yun followed, his hands clasped behind his back. Su Wanyi followed closely behind the Old Ancestor.
The Big Black Cat remained sprawled on top of the carriage.
"Uncle Ma, the atmosphere in this Chang Family residence feels off, almost like someone has died..." the Big Black Cat remarked quietly, glancing up at the Chang Mansion.
"Nonsense!" The Big Black Horse turned its head and retorted irritably.
WHOOSH!
Its rear trembled as it suddenly expelled a stream of air. This fierce current of air enveloped the Big Black Cat, pressing down on it like a great mountain, making its internal organs feel as if they were shrinking into a ball.
"Uncle Ma, spare me!" The Big Black Cat covered its nose and quickly begged for mercy. It hadn’t expected that a casual remark would provoke such a strong retaliation from Uncle Ma. This retaliation not only stank but also carried immense pressure.
"Little Cat, you’d better watch your mouth in the future. The Master himself entered this place; do you think it could be ordinary?" Uncle Ma said irritably, and with a flick of his tail, the current of air instantly vanished.
"Uncle Ma, you’re right!" The Big Black Cat was thoroughly startled and nodded repeatedly, sighing in relief. The Big Black Cat truly hadn’t expected that Uncle Ma’s flatulence could be so powerful; its small body seemed unable to bear it.
So terrifying.
Chang Lu Die led Ye Yun through the estate to the main hall. As soon as she entered, she saw her father slumped in a chair, his face pale and his complexion extremely poor. He looked frail.
"Father, what’s wrong?" Chang Lu Die rushed forward and quickly supported her father.
"Little Die, you’re back so soon? Has the Tri-element Martial Meeting concluded?" Chang Feng coughed twice and asked in return.
"Father, your daughter didn’t achieve a ranking..." Chang Lu Die said, lowering her head in shame.
Chang Feng looked sorrowful but forced a faint smile. "It’s alright. You’re still young." Then, his gaze shifted to Ye Yun and Su Wanyi, who were standing nearby. A hint of surprise flashed in his eyes. The young man in white robes was spotless, exuding an otherworldly aura, like a transcendent immortal stepped out of a painting. The other young woman, around eighteen or nineteen years old, was exceptionally beautiful. She wore a dazzling golden robe and carried a conspicuous red longsword on her back. Seeing this pair, both as elegant as jade, Chang Feng knew instantly that they were no ordinary individuals.
"Father, where is my older brother?" Chang Lu Die asked from the side.
"He’s resting in the back..." Chang Feng coughed again, not telling his daughter the truth.
Chang Lu Die, young and naive, didn’t think too much about it. She leaned close to Chang Feng’s ear and whispered, "Father, I’m going to take this Sir to the ancestral hall first. He says he knows one of our ancestors!"
"Oh... Alright, alright!" Chang Feng was startled but agreed immediately without much thought. Although his cultivation base was not high, only at the tenth layer of the Origin Sea Realm, his experienced eyes could tell that this otherworldly young man in white was no ordinary person.
Perhaps he’s a peerless expert.
It was precisely for this reason that Chang Feng had agreed without hesitation.
Overjoyed, Chang Lu Die walked to Ye Yun’s side and said respectfully, "Sir, I’ll take you there!"
"I can go by myself." Ye Yun shook his head gently. His gaze flickered as he glanced at Su Wanyi. "You stay here."
"Yes, Old Ancestor!" Su Wanyi’s spirits lifted, and she quickly responded with respect.
Old Ancestor? When Chang Feng realized this young man in white was actually the Old Ancestor of this stunningly beautiful woman, he was even more astounded. This person’s true age must be immense. No wonder... he would know an ancestor of our family.
Ye Yun, hands clasped behind his back, departed alone, heading straight for the ancestral hall in the rear courtyard.
Chang Lu Die smiled and was about to pour Su Wanyi a cup of hot tea when, suddenly, several powerful Super Divine Dragon Breaths descended from the sky.
"Chang Feng, the three-day limit is up! If you don’t hand over your Chang Family’s ancestral Cultivation Technique, I will annihilate your entire clan today!"
A furious roar, like a thunderclap, suddenly resounded over the entire Chang Mansion.

chapters.title: Chapter 65 Want Both the Beauty and the Sword
chapters.content:
Chapter 65: Chapter 65 Want Both the Beauty and the Sword
The backyard of the Shen Family.
A figure in white robes passed through the tightly closed doors and mysteriously appeared in the ancestral shrine.
The light in the shrine was dim. Rows of dark red Spirit Plaques stood there; some carried an ancient, weathered aura, while others were as new as ever.
Ye Yun’s gaze moved slowly.
Finally, in a dark corner, he found a Spirit Plaque that carried a profound sense of age.
"Spirit Plaque of Ancestor Chang Yuchun!"
Ye Yun silently walked over and lit a stick of incense.
"My dear friend, I didn’t expect that after one hundred thousand years, I could come to the Chang Family to see you..." Ye Yun said softly, his eyes filled with nostalgia.
「One hundred thousand years ago.」
Ye Yun took the position of Dragon God Sect Sect Master at the age of eighteen. At that time, Chang Yuchun was a good friend he had met when he was fifteen.
Coming from the Dragon God Sect, with superior talent, unparalleled combat power, and an unrestrained and unconventional demeanor, Ye Yun was not only renowned across the Cangnan Continent but was also the notorious bully of that era. And Chang Yuchun was one of his followers.
In those days, this fellow was cultivating the Yuan Yang Domineering Body Divine Skill, and his physical body was exceptionally strong. He was one of Ye Yun’s most capable followers back then.
When Chang Yuchun met Ye Yun, he was also considered a young prodigy and was already a great cultivator of the Destiny Realm. Later, Ye Yun helped him deduce the Yuan Yang Domineering Body Technique, which helped him successfully break through to the Life and Death Realm. As for whether he ultimately broke through from the Life and Death Realm to the Eternal Realm, Ye Yun didn’t know.
A hundred thousand years... the seas have changed into mulberry fields.
I also didn’t expect that in the remote Xuan Yang County of the Shenfeng Dynasty, I would encounter the descendants of the Chang Family. After all, the Chang Family of the past lived in the most prosperous central area of the Cangnan Continent.
However, for a family to have such a long lineage that it still persists after one hundred thousand years is indeed remarkable.
Ye Yun looked at the dark red Spirit Plaque and gently brushed off the dust that had gathered on it.
At this moment, with deep affection in his gaze, he whispered, "Brother, I’ll take care of your descendants today!"
Having said that, Ye Yun returned to his calm. He stood quietly in the dark shadows, adorned in snow-white robes.
The booming roar that echoed in the sky over Chang Mansion like a clap of thunder also reached Ye Yun’s ears.
Ye Yun gave a faint smile. When he had reached the outskirts of Xuan Yang County, he had already sensed the crisis facing Chang Mansion.
The Chang Family’s ancestral Cultivation Technique, the Yuan Yang Domineering Body Technique, was a peerless skill that led directly to the Life and Death Realm. But for this technique to be successfully cultivated, one must possess a large amount of Yuan Yang Stones. Yet, observing the current state of the Chang Family, they couldn’t produce even a single Yuan Yang Stone.
This indicated that for many generations, no one in the Chang Family had successfully cultivated the Yuan Yang Domineering Body Technique.
However, now that I am here, I will naturally help resolve this crisis facing the Chang Family and also deal with the problem of their lack of cultivation resources. All this isn’t difficult for me at all.
Ye Yun looked up lightly, gazing towards a certain direction.
「At this time, in the main hall of the Chang Mansion.」
Upon hearing that roar, Chang Feng’s face grew even paler.
The Shen Family has arrived after all.
"Father, what is going on?" Chang Lu Die was trembling with apprehension.
The auras descending from the sky belonged to Shapers.
When did our Chang Family provoke a Shaper?
In Xuan Yang County, the Chang Family was just a second-rate noble family. The highest cultivation base belonged to her father, Chang Feng, at the peak of the Tenth Layer of the Origin Sea Realm. They were simply no match for Shapers. Moreover, the Chang Family had always been low-key, never causing trouble.
Chang Feng stood up, gathered his spirits, looked at Chang Lu Die, and said with a bitter smile, "These are people from the Shen Family. They learned from somewhere that our Chang Family possesses the Yuan Yang Domineering Body Technique, and they want to obtain it."
Chang Lu Die, extremely angry, glared and said loudly, "This is our family’s ancestral technique! It has been passed down for one hundred thousand years! It absolutely can’t be leaked!"
"My daughter, you’re right! Even if we die, we can’t let down the generations of our ancestors who have defended it!" Chang Feng said determinedly.
Although descendants of the Chang Family who mastered the Yuan Yang Domineering Body Technique were rare in later generations, they had never allowed the technique to fall into outside hands in these one hundred thousand years. Thus, Chang Feng had long been prepared to fight to the death.
He strode into the courtyard and saw six Shapers hovering in mid-air.
"Shen Wei, does my little Chang Family really warrant your Shen Family sending all six of your Shapers?" Chang Feng shouted, looking at the six powerful figures without a trace of fear.
At this moment, Chang Lu Die also stood beside her father.
Some other Chang Clan Members had also gathered in the courtyard from all directions, each with a face full of grief and indignation.
Su Wanyi also followed Chang Lu Die out. Her eyes, half-lidded, quickly surveyed the air.
There were six Shapers in total. Two were First Level Shaping God Realm Experts. One was a Second Level Shaping God Realm Expert. Two were Third Level Shaping God Realm Experts. The robust middle-aged man in the middle had already reached the Fourth Level of the Shaping God Realm.
Su Wanyi suddenly seemed thoughtful. She finally understood the profound meaning behind the Ancestor wanting her to stay here. The Chang Family’s crisis... The Ancestor needed her to take action and resolve it. Thinking of the upcoming battle with Shaping God Realm Experts, Su Wanyi’s delicate body trembled slightly, her heart filled with excitement.
「Mid-air.」
Shen Wei, with his hands behind his back, looked down at the frail people of the Chang Family and laughed coldly, "Originally, we gave you a three-day limit because we didn’t want to bully the small and weak Chang Family. Now that three days have passed, if your Chang Family still doesn’t hand over the Cultivation Technique, then don’t blame me for being ruthless!"
"Shen Wei, keep dreaming! Even if we die, even if our Chang Family is exterminated, we will never hand over our ancestral Cultivation Technique!" Chang Feng declared, his hands behind his back, his face taut, ready to meet death head-on.
"My dad is right! Even if our Chang Family fights to the last person, we will absolutely not hand over our ancestral Cultivation Technique!" Chang Lu Die also drew her sword, its tip pointing at Shen Wei, her teeth clenched.
She spoke firmly and decisively, but Chang Lu Die was young, after all. Faced with the pressure from the Shapers, her body couldn’t help trembling.
The Shen Family was a colossal power in Xuan Yang County, one that no one ever dared to provoke. The Shen Family also had backing; disciples of the family had once entered the Yu Mo Sect. There were three major powers in the Shenfeng Dynasty, all at the level of great Sects, and the Yu Mo Sect was one of them. The Shen Family was powerful and had strong support. It could be said that all the families of Xuan Yang County combined would not dare to provoke the Shen Family.
With the arrival of even one Shaper, the entire Chang Family was destined to be reduced to ashes.
"You little girl, you must be Chang Feng’s precious daughter, right? It’s good you’re back. Your Chang Family can now reunite underground!" Shen Wei sneered.
A middle-aged Cultivator beside him, a First Level Shaping God Realm Expert, suddenly thrust out his hand, grasping downwards.
In mid-air, a Mana Hand suddenly appeared, howling as it shot towards them.
A flash of blood-red light streaked past.
SMACK!
The Mana Hand was instantly shattered.
This stunned the six experts from the Shen Family.
In the Chang Family’s square, a stunningly beautiful woman dressed in a golden Robe, holding a blood-red Longsword, was staring coldly up at the sky.
"You’re an unfamiliar face, little girl. Where did you pop out from? And the Swordsmanship you’re using—it’s not the Chang Family’s Swordsmanship either!" Shen Wei’s gaze fixed intently on Su Wanyi, giving her an appraising look from head to toe, a hint of greed appearing in his eyes.
This young woman was beautiful and vibrant, her skills extraordinary, and the Longsword in her hand was of Heavenly Quality. He wanted the sword. And he wanted the beauty too.

chapters.title: Chapter 66: Seal Release, Battle in the Shaping God Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 66: Chapter 66: Seal Release, Battle in the Shaping God Realm
Shen Wei was known for his lust and greed, maintaining a large harem that was famous throughout Xuan Yang County.
There were rumors that his harem contained as many as three thousand beauties.
Shen Wei, however, had apparently learned a Yin harvesting and Yang supplement technique somewhere. Despite his indulgences, his cultivation base did not falter, and he remained the cultivator with the highest cultivation base within the Shen Family.
So, when he laid his eyes on Su Wanyi, he was immediately enchanted.
His heart fluttered. He would definitely capture Su Wanyi! Her and her sword—he wanted them all!
"Shen Ting, go and capture that girl!" Shen Wei ordered proudly, waving his hand dismissively.
"Alright!" Shen Ting, who was at the First Level of the Origin Sea Realm, nodded and descended.
SMACK!
At that moment, a restriction within Su Wanyi was shattered.
Her Super Divine Dragon Breath surged dramatically.
Instantaneously, it rose from the Third Layer of the Origin Sea Realm to God Creation Realm Level 3!
Hehe... Ancestor has lifted the seal on my body!
Su Wanyi rejoiced internally.
Indeed... ever since entering the Chang Mansion, all the changes that occurred were orchestrated by the Ancestor. Just like in Silver Moon City.
Witnessing Su Wanyi’s sudden leap from the Origin Sea Realm to God Creation Realm Level 3, Shen Ting was so shocked that he took several steps back.
"You... you’re at the Shaping God Realm?" Shen Ting exclaimed, shocked.
Inside the courtyard, all the members of the Chang Family were equally stunned.
Every one of them was rooted to the spot.
This...
Clenching his fist, Chang Feng stared dumbfounded at Su Wanyi.
This incredibly beautiful young woman is actually a Shaper at God Creation Realm Level 3?
Chang Feng was shocked to his core; a whirlwind of emotions stormed in his heart.
To reach God Creation Realm Level 3 at such a young age, roughly twenty, was unheard of in the entire Xuan Yang County.
Probably only the super sects would have such prodigious Disciples of Heaven’s Pride.
Recalling the refined and immortal-like white-robed youth, who emanated an aura seemingly divine, Chang Feng knew that his cultivation base was likely even more astonishing!
It seems... this time, we’re saved.
At this thought, Chang Feng’s eyes filled with tears of excitement.
It truly was the ancestors’ spirits protecting them, helping the Chang Family survive this calamity of annihilation...
Chang Feng was so excited he could hardly contain himself.
Among all the people in the Chang Family, the most shocked was undoubtedly Chang Lu Die.
She had entered the City Lord’s Mansion of Silver Moon City together with Su Wanyi.
Initially, I thought Sister Su’s cultivation base was slightly lower than mine, not as powerful. Who would have thought Sister Su emitted golden light from the Power-measuring stone! After Sister Su participated in the Tri-element Martial Meeting, she fought numerous Origin Sea Realm masters, continuously breaking through to the Third Layer of the Origin Sea Realm in battle, leaving me far behind! However, what was even more unthinkable was that Sister Su’s cultivation base had been suppressed! Her true cultivation base is God Creation Realm Level 3, making her a Level Three Grand Practitioner!
"Sister Su, are you really a Grand Practitioner of the Shaping God Realm?" Chang Lu Die, still in shock, could hardly believe it.
Her eyes were wide, her mouth gaping, and her cute apple-shaped face looked incredibly animated and interesting.
"Yes, little sister..." Su Wanyi turned to look at her, a faint smile appearing on her stunning face.
"How can this be?" At this moment, in mid-air, the faces of Shen Wei and the other five powerful cultivators of the Shen Family all changed.
This little girl was actually a Shaper at God Creation Realm Level 3!
This was completely unexpected.
However, Shen Wei thought that if he could add this girl to his harem, it would undoubtedly be the greatest achievement of his life. A desire burned within his heart.
With a sweep of his hand, everyone landed.
Shen Wei was very confident.
His Shen Family had two cultivators at God Creation Realm Level 3, plus himself at the Fourth Level of the Sculpting God Realm. Six of them against one young woman at God Creation Realm Level 3 was more than enough.
"Haha, so what if you’re in the Shaping God Realm? In Xuan Yang County, on my territory, you can’t make any waves. I think you’d better surrender obediently!" Shen Wei laughed arrogantly.
"Wild fantasies! Shameless villain!" Su Wanyi’s eyebrows knitted together. She yelled angrily and initiated the opening stance of the Dragon God Sword Technique.
In an instant, a golden dragon phantom tens of meters in size coiled behind her.
The golden dragon phantom looked down from above, its pair of golden dragon eyes shooting out a cold gaze, exerting tremendous pressure on everyone.
"What kind of sword technique is this?"
For a moment, the six powerhouses of the Shen Family stepped back half a step in unison, their faces reflecting shock.
This sword technique hadn’t even officially begun; just the opening stance had already exerted great pressure on them.
"Go! Let’s take her down together!" Shen Wei’s face was icy. He suddenly drew his sword and rushed forward first.
Seeing six men ganging up on Sister Su, Chang Lu Die’s eyebrows raised, and she scoffed coldly, "Six grown men from the Shen Family bullying my Sister Su alone, you’re truly shameless!"
"Courting death!" Shen Ting was furious upon hearing this and turned towards Chang Lu Die to attack.
WHOOSH!
A golden dragon phantom flashed by.
It suddenly appeared in front of Shen Ting, and Su Wanyi lashed out with her sword.
Shen Ting was shocked.
He hadn’t expected Su Wanyi to be so fast.
And the difference in their realm levels was too great; he was no match for her.
BOOM!
Su Wanyi’s sword strike, as fast as a lightning bolt, deflected Shen Ting’s sword and chopped off half of his arm.
"AH!" Shen Ting screamed and was thrown backward.
"You’re courting death!" Witnessing this sudden turn of events, Shen Wei was enraged. His sword flashed like lightning as he thrust it repeatedly at Su Wanyi.
The other Shapers, coordinating perfectly, launched fierce attacks from different angles.
At this moment, blood poured from the injured Shen Ting’s severed arm. Gritting his teeth, he quickly pressed a few acupoints on his body, and the blood flow slowed.
Shen Ting swallowed a pill, picked up his severed arm from the ground, and fled in a panic.
He no longer had the strength to fight and couldn’t help. If he brought his severed arm back, it might be possible to reattach it.
In the Shen Family’s Treasure Pavilion, there was a precious medicinal paste that was miraculously effective in reattaching severed limbs.
SWISH! SWISH! SWISH!
The sword lights of the Shen Family’s five powerhouses fell like a tide, while Su Wanyi remained composed. She unleashed the Dragon God Sword Technique and counterattacked, engaging the five men in a fierce battle.
For a time, the battle was extremely intense. It was hard to tell who would gain the upper hand.
Seeing Su Wanyi holding her ground against five Shapers without losing momentum, instead fighting freely and unencumbered, Chang Lu Die excitedly stomped her feet.
This Sister Su is terrifyingly powerful!
"My girl, this time, our Chang Family is saved..." Chang Feng walked over, tears streaming down his aged face, sobbing uncontrollably.
Seeing her father crying so heartbrokenly, Chang Lu Die also started crying.
At this moment, she suddenly thought of her elder brother.
Wiping away her tears, Chang Lu Die asked mournfully, "Dad, elder brother hasn’t appeared yet. Was he also harmed by the Shen Family?"
"Three days ago, people from the Shen Family came and beat your elder brother until he was critically injured..." Chang Feng wiped his tears, his heart anguished. He finally stopped holding back and recounted the misfortune that had befallen the Chang Mansion that day.
「...」
Within the ancestral shrine, Ye Yun still stood calmly before Chang Yuchun’s Ancestral Spirit Plaque.
After a hundred thousand years, today, he was keeping his old friend company.
The door creaked open.
A pale-faced, grey-clothed old man walked in.

chapters.title: Chapter 67: A drop of Divine Power, Clearing the Meridians
chapters.content:
Chapter 67: Chapter 67: A drop of Divine Power, Clearing the Meridians
Ye Yun turned to take another look.
The old man appeared to be around eighty years old; his face was pale and dull, his body withered. He had no cultivation base; he was just an ordinary old man.
The old man’s eyes widened. He hadn’t expected a young man in white to be standing in the gloomy shadows of the ancestral hall.
He was suddenly taken aback.
Is it my old eyes playing tricks on me?
The gray-robed old man suddenly rubbed his eyes and laughed bitterly in self-deprecation.
After rubbing his eyes, he took a closer look, only to find that the young man in white still stood not far away.
At this moment, his vision became sharp.
The young man in white possessed an extraordinary temperament. Standing there like an Immortal, he seemed to make the entire ancestral hall glow with light.
In that instant, the old man felt as if he had seen a God.
"May I ask who sir is?"
Although the gray-robed old man had no cultivation base, he was evidently experienced and quickly composed himself. He clasped his fists and asked tremblingly.
"I am an old acquaintance of Chang Yuchun."
Ye Yun spoke softly.
What? He had relations with their ancestor? And not just any ancestor, but the very first ancestor of their Chang Family’s ancestral hall!
The gray-robed old man struggled to conceal the tempest raging in his heart. He scrutinized the young man in white once more but was unable to perceive any connection between him and the Chang Family ancestral records.
"Too much time has passed, and many things have vanished into the mists of time. You need not trouble yourself with my origins..."
Ye Yun said with a light smile.
He looked at the gray-robed old man and asked softly, "What’s your relationship with Chang Feng, the Family Head of the Chang Family?"
"I am Chang Feng’s second uncle. I suffered a cultivation deviation, which blocked my meridians and rendered me a cripple!"
The gray-robed old man sighed.
Ye Yun remained silent, merely watching him.
The gray-robed old man shrugged and laughed self-deprecatingly. "With the Chang Family on the verge of annihilation, a cripple like me is useless. I might as well stay here in the ancestral hall, accompany our ancestors in my final moments, and then join them in the netherworld..."
Hearing the old man’s desolate words, Ye Yun sighed softly.
「A hundred thousand years ago.」
Under Chang Yuchun’s leadership, the Chang Family had been incredibly glorious.
Who would have expected that a hundred thousand years later, the Chang Family would have fallen to the point of facing annihilation?
Thinking this, Ye Yun gently raised a finger. A brilliant gleam shot from his fingertip and landed on the crown of the old man’s head.
The gray-robed old man only saw a sudden flash of light. Before he could react, a potent surge of energy had poured into the top of his head.
Then, the gray-robed old man’s eyes widened.
This unique energy, entering from the Baihui acupoint on his head, was like an invincible army, fiercely scouring the meridians that had been blocked for decades.
One by one, his meridians began to open. Gradually, he could once again sense the Spiritual Energy between heaven and earth.
In just a few breaths, that potent energy had completely unblocked all his meridians. It then descended into his Dantian, transforming into abundant Mana.
Instantly, his aura surged dramatically.
From the Qi Refining Realm to the Mysterious Pill Realm, then to the Origin Sea Realm, his cultivation soared, finally stopping at the Third Layer of the Shaping God Realm.
What...what on earth is going on?
The gray-robed old man was so shocked he was like a stone sculpture, unable to move.
The young man in white opposite him had merely pointed a finger. A ray of light shot into his body, and just like that, the meridians blocked for so many years due to his cultivation deviation were cleared.
In the end, that energy hadn’t dissipated. It then settled into his Dantian, transforming into vast Mana, not only restoring his cultivation to the Shaping God Realm but even advancing him from the Shaping God Realm First Level to the Third Layer.
The gray-robed old man fell to his knees with a THUD and kowtowed repeatedly to Ye Yun.
"Chang Qingsong was blind and failed to recognize Senior! Please forgive my disrespect!"
Chang Qingsong kowtowed forcefully, his head striking the ground with resounding THUDS.
Although the young man in white had said he was an old acquaintance of his ancestor, he hadn’t taken it seriously.
Given that his ancestor, Chang Yuchun, lived a hundred thousand years ago, how could anyone live so long?
But now, to his utter astonishment, this God-like young man in white had merely touched him, and his meridians, blocked due to his cultivation deviation, had instantly cleared! His cultivation base was even restored to the Shaping God Realm!
At this thought, Chang Qingsong was overwhelmed with shame and kowtowed continuously, expressing his profound remorse.
"Get up."
Ye Yun gave a quiet smile.
Chang Qingsong’s reaction was understandable. After all, individuals who could live for a hundred thousand years on the Cangnan Continent were exceedingly rare.
Therefore, it was only natural that Chang Qingsong hadn’t believed Ye Yun’s claim of being an old acquaintance of Ancestor Chang Yuchun. Ye Yun didn’t blame him.
For Ye Yun, curing the meridians Chang Qingsong had blocked due to cultivation deviation was a trivial matter.
A single drop of Divine Power entering Chang Qingsong’s body had resolved all his issues.
"Senior, your seniority is truly immense. I... I really don’t know how I should address you!"
Chang Qingsong still knelt on the ground, not daring to stand up.
"Just call me Senior."
Ye Yun gave a faint smile.
He couldn’t have Chang Qingsong call him Senior Ancestor, could he? That would sound too strange. It wouldn’t be a normal way to address someone.
A surge of Mana swept out from Ye Yun’s wide sleeve, lifting Chang Qingsong to his feet.
Ye Yun disliked such excessive ceremony. He always felt uncomfortable seeing people kneel before him.
Chang Qingsong stood respectfully before Ye Yun, his hands clasped tightly, at a loss for words.
"Disciples of My Dragon God Sect are outside dealing with the Shen Family members. You don’t need to go out. Stay here and tell me about your Chang Family."
Ye Yun said indifferently.
Hearing Ye Yun suddenly mention the Dragon God Sect, a flash of realization struck Chang Qingsong’s mind, and countless fragmented memories seemed to connect.
He stammered, "Senior, you... you’re that person from the Dragon God Sect...?"
"Yes."
Ye Yun nodded.
Upon receiving an affirmative reply, Chang Qingsong’s old face flushed with excitement.
He had never imagined that the senior before him was the youngest Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect from a hundred thousand years ago—an Eternal Sect! The very same legendary figure who was hailed as the Cangnan Continent’s foremost expert, with the potential to reach the True God Realm!
His own Ancestor Chang Yuchun had left behind family records detailing some anecdotes involving this very Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect.
"Senior, I... I’m too excited..."
Chang Qingsong was at a loss, his blood boiled, and he found it impossible to control his surging emotions.
A hundred thousand years ago, this senior had been unmatched across the entire Cangnan Continent.
Little did he know... He is still alive today.
Chang Qingsong could scarcely fathom the heaven-defying level of cultivation this senior before him must have attained by now.
Ye Yun remained silent, not speaking a word.
