It took a considerable while for Chang Qingsong’s emotions to settle. He then began to recount matters concerning his ancestor, Chang Yuchun.
Regarding his ancestor Chang Yuchun, too much time had passed, and Chang Qingsong knew little. Thus, he finished his account in less time than it takes to smoke half a pipe of tobacco.
Ye Yun sighed, his gaze returning to the dark red Spirit Plaque.
His good friend, in the end, had failed to break through to the Eternal Mirror. He had been stuck at the Life and Death Realm.
A thought flickered in Ye Yun’s mind, and he suddenly looked into the distance.
「Over the Shen Family’s estate in Xuan Yang County.」
An old man in a black robe abruptly descended.
On the back of this old man’s black robe was embroidered a large, red character for ’Control,’ and beneath it, a smaller character for ’Demonic.’
This old man’s cultivation base had reached the Fourth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm.
The moment he appeared, everyone in the Shen Family felt the immense pressure of the Divine Bridge Realm. Their expressions changed drastically, and they found it difficult to breathe.

chapters.title: Chapter 68: The Yu Mo Sect, A Strong Divine Bridge Realm Fighter Arrives
chapters.content:
Chapter 68: Chapter 68: The Yu Mo Sect, A Strong Divine Bridge Realm Fighter Arrives
Feeling the powerful presence, all the members of the Shen Family rushed out into the courtyard, knelt, and kowtowed respectfully.
"We respectfully welcome Elder Zhu!"
Countless voices roared, shaking the heavens and the earth.
The visitor was Elder Zhu of the Yu Mo Sect.
The Yu Mo Sect was one of the three most formidable "major Sects."
In the entire Shenfeng Dynasty, it was considered a titan among forces.
This Elder Zhu was an unparalleled expert at the fourth level of the Divine Bridge Realm. To the members of the Shen Family, he was almost a god-like existence.
From mid-air, Elder Zhu observed the Shen Family’s respectful demeanor, and a faint smile touched his cold, handsome face.
"All of you, rise."
Elder Zhu descended from the sky. With a wave of his hand, a surge of Mana swept out, lifting everyone from the ground.
He glanced around and asked indifferently, "Where is Shen Wei? How is the matter I entrusted to him progressing?"
An elderly man in black hurriedly bowed, ran forward, and explained, "Elder Zhu, our Clan Leader went to the Chang Family to retrieve that Cultivation Technique and has not yet returned."
"Very well, I shall wait for him for a while."
Elder Zhu flicked his wide sleeves, preparing to enter the main hall to wait.
Just then, a streak of light suddenly descended from the sky.
"Second Uncle, quickly open the Treasure Pavilion and bring out the Black Lotus Continuation Ointment!" Shen Ting yelled as soon as he landed, his face contorted in agony.
He had not yet noticed Elder Zhu standing nearby.
Elder Zhu’s eyes flickered. Seeing Shen Ting clutching a severed arm, he frowned and asked, "A distinguished Shaping God Realm Cultivator like yourself, how did you manage to get your arm severed on your own territory here in Xuan Yang County?"
Shen Ting focused his gaze and, upon recognizing Elder Zhu of the Yu Mo Sect, was greatly alarmed. He quickly knelt and said in a trembling voice, "Shen Ting was unaware of Elder Zhu’s esteemed presence. Please forgive my offense."
"I do not hold it against you," Elder Zhu said with a faint smile. "Just tell me... who injured you."
"It was a third-level Shaping God Realm Cultivator from the Chang Family..." Shen Ting hesitated for a moment, then recounted the events, mixing truth with falsehood.
Elder Zhu frowned. "Since when did the Chang Family have a Shaping God Realm Cultivator?"
Shen Ting shook his head. "Elder Zhu, I am not clear on that either. It seems to be an outside Cultivator. Right now, the Clan Leader and the others are fighting her. They should be able to kill that woman soon."
Elder Zhu gazed towards a certain direction in the sky, a sense of unease stirring within him.
He did not entirely trust the Shen Family. He wanted to seize the Chang Family’s Yuan Yang Tempering Body Technique. It was rumored that this Cultivation Technique could lead directly to the Destiny Realm. Five years ago, he had fortuitously discovered a small Yuan Yang Stone mine and had since been searching everywhere for a Yuan Yang cultivation method. Unexpectedly, through a stroke of luck, he received astonishing news: the Chang Family of Xuan Yang County possessed an ancestral Cultivation Technique. This technique, if aided by Yuan Yang Stones, could supposedly allow one to cultivate all the way to the Destiny Realm.
This news immediately piqued Elder Zhu’s interest.
Recalling his established connection with the Shen Family of Xuan Yang County, he had written a letter and dispatched it via Flying Sword, instructing the Shen Family to acquire the Cultivation Technique in advance. He too had then set out from the Yu Mo Sect, heading straight for the Shen Family.
Elder Zhu had only heard rumors about the Yuan Yang Tempering Body Technique and did not understand it thoroughly.
In reality, the Yuan Yang Tempering Body Technique could not only lead to the Destiny Realm but even to the Life and Death Realm. After all, this Cultivation Technique had once been refined by the most powerful expert on the Cangnan Continent.
「」
With his mind made up,
Elder Zhu immediately tore through the air, heading straight for the Chang Family.
Meanwhile, at the Chang Family’s estate, Su Wanyi and Shen Wei’s group were still locked in a fierce battle.
Although Shen Wei’s side had superior numbers, they had already fallen into a disadvantageous position. They were being thoroughly suppressed by Su Wanyi, and members of their group were continually sustaining injuries.
Shen Wei lamented inwardly. He had never imagined that this stunningly beautiful woman, with her divine swordsmanship, would be so terrifyingly powerful. Their five experts were attacking her together, yet they were still no match for her. If this dragged on, they would likely be completely annihilated. However, withdrawing now was also practically impossible. If they tried to disengage, Su Wanyi would likely pick them off one by one, leading to the same disastrous outcome of total annihilation.
Just as they found themselves in this predicament, a voice familiar to Shen Wei suddenly echoed through the sky above the Chang Family estate.
"Shen Wei, you lot are truly pathetic! To be bullied to this extent by a little girl at the third level of the Shaping God Realm! No wonder Xuan Yang County never produces any talents!"
As his voice fell, an immense pressure, characteristic of a Divine Bridge Realm expert, descended from the sky.
All the members of the Chang Family felt their knees buckle; they could no longer remain standing. Some collapsed to their knees, while others fell prone on the ground.
Chang Feng looked up, his expression changing drastically. He saw an elderly man in a black robe standing in mid-air—a Divine Bridge Realm expert.
Recognizing him more clearly, Chang Feng was horrified to realize that the newcomer was from the Yu Mo Sect!
The crushing pressure of the Divine Bridge Realm expert bore down.
At this moment, Su Wanyi’s movements also became somewhat sluggish.
Elder Zhu stood in the void, his hands clasped behind his back, exuding a faint luminescence, like a deity surveying the mortal realm.
He did not intervene directly. After all, as a Divine Bridge Realm expert, he had his pride. Simply releasing his oppressive might would be enough to greatly hinder that insignificant female Shaping God Realm Cultivator below. This, in turn, would create an advantageous opening for Shen Wei and his men.
「Inside the ancestral hall.」
Ye Yun smiled faintly.
The black carriage parked outside the Chang Family’s residence suddenly emitted a glow and swiftly descended into the main courtyard. The light dissipated, revealing a youth of about fourteen or fifteen.
"Junior Brother!" Su Wanyi exclaimed, both surprised and overjoyed at Jun Moxiao’s sudden appearance.
Her Junior Brother was a powerful Divine Bridge Realm expert! His strength was immense, and he could fight those of higher cultivation levels with ease. Su Wanyi was confident that the old man at the fourth level of the Divine Bridge Realm would be no match for her Junior Brother.
Jun Moxiao quickly assessed the scene, his understanding clear. He drew his Chaos Element Unlimited Sword and declared with a hearty laugh, "Senior Sister, I’ve come to lend you a hand!"
With that, Jun Moxiao soared into the air, positioning himself in the void directly opposite Elder Zhu.
A Divine Bridge Realm youth?
Elder Zhu stared at the suddenly appeared Jun Moxiao. Sensing the latter’s aura, he couldn’t help but be greatly astonished.
To reach the Divine Bridge Realm at the age of fourteen or fifteen—even in the Yu Mo Sect, such a person would be considered a top-tier prodigy!
"Old fogey, how dare you bully my Senior Sister! This young master will teach you a proper lesson today!" Jun Moxiao proclaimed. He flicked his Chaos Element Unlimited Sword, producing a clear, crisp ringing sound. Instantly, an enormous Divine Dragon Phantom materialized behind him.
This Divine Dragon Phantom was even larger and more solid than Su Wanyi’s.
The Golden Giant Dragon coiled in the void, its pair of golden eyes radiating an icy gaze that made Elder Zhu’s heart pound with trepidation. His expression turned grave, and he quickly drew his sword.
Despite this youth only being at the first level of the Divine Bridge Realm, he exuded an intense sense of danger.

chapters.title: Chapter 69: Complete Failure, The Tide has Turned
chapters.content:
Chapter 69: Chapter 69: Complete Failure, The Tide has Turned
「In the ancestral shrine.」
Chang Qingsong was also using his Divine Sense to probe the situation in the courtyard ahead. When the Divine Bridge Realm Level 4 Expert of the Yu Mo Sect appeared, he was taken aback.
However, he didn’t expect a Divine Bridge Realm youth to descend from the sky. This youth was surprisingly that young woman’s junior brother! That would mean both of them were disciples of the Senior’s Dragon God Sect.
Seeing the youth, who was only fourteen or fifteen years old and already at the Divine Bridge Realm for his cultivation base, Chang Qingsong felt an immense sense of envy in his heart.
The strength of the Dragon God Sect is unimaginable. Especially this Senior before me; he has lived for a hundred thousand years and his cultivation is unfathomable. Perhaps he has already become a god-like being.
Ye Yun watched the scene outside calmly, a faint smile appearing in his eyes. In the air, Sword Qi flared. At this moment, Jun Moxiao was engaged in battle with the Elder of the Yu Mo Sect. As soon as he made his move, Jun Moxiao gained an absolute advantage, completely suppressing his opponent. Ye Yun nodded secretly.
Jun Moxiao’s previous training has clearly paid off. Now, with a single move, he demonstrates his ability to fight opponents of a higher level. Facing a Divine Bridge Realm Level 4 expert, not only holding his own but even gaining the upper hand, shows that Jun Moxiao’s potential is steadily being unleashed. But this is far from enough. After all, this is just the Shenfeng Dynasty. At the same cultivation level, the cultivators here can’t be considered truly strong. If Jun Moxiao could maintain this kind of advantage against a Divine Bridge Realm expert from a Sky-Level Sect, then he would barely pass.
BANG! BANG!
In mid-air, the two Divine Bridge Realm powerhouses clashed fiercely. Elder Zhu was both astonished and deeply aggrieved.
To think that I, a powerful Divine Bridge Realm Level 4 expert, am being suppressed and beaten by a boy of only fourteen or fifteen! He’s crushing me in swordsmanship, speed, and strength!
Meanwhile, down in the courtyard, without Elder Zhu’s support, Shen Wei and his men were once again at a disadvantage. Su Wanyi unleashed her power, attacking with a barrage of dense Sword Light, and soon Shen Wei was bleeding. The lives of the five Shaping divinity realm cultivators of the Shen Family hung by a thread. With the pressure from the Divine Bridge Realm expert gone, everyone from the Chang Family managed to stand up.
"Our ancestors are showing their power! Heaven blesses our Chang Family; we will not be extinguished!" Watching the two battles, one in the sky and one on the ground, tears streamed down Chang Feng’s aged face as he laughed with excitement.
"Father, Sister Su’s junior brother... I never expected him to be a Divine Bridge Realm powerhouse!" Chang Lu Die exclaimed from nearby, wiping her tears, a mix of crying and laughing.
When the Divine Bridge Realm Elder of the Yu Mo Sect first descended, Chang Lu Die had felt as if the sky itself was falling. Unexpectedly, the situation took a sharp turn. Sister Su’s junior brother descended from the heavens and resolved the Chang Mansion’s crisis. Neither the five experts from the Shen Family nor the Yu Mo Sect’s Elder in the sky were any match for Su Wanyi and Jun Moxiao.
If the disciples under Master are all this ridiculously strong, then Master himself... how powerful must he be?
Chang Lu Die stood rooted to the spot, staring blankly, lost in thought. She suddenly remembered everything that had happened that day in Silver Moon City. From the great upheaval with the Silver Moon Werewolves to the subsequent disappearance of the entire Silver Moon City, it was as if it had simply evaporated from the face of the earth.
Now that I think about it, I understand. It must have been Master’s doing!
At this realization, her heart filled with shock.
Such a large city, Silver Moon City, vanished just like that! What kind of immense, heaven-defying power would that require? It’s not difficult for an expert to destroy a city. But to make an entire city vanish without a trace... Even a Destiny Realm powerhouse couldn’t do that, right?
With Chang Lu Die’s limited knowledge, the Destiny Realm was the highest she could comprehend.
SPURT!
Jun Moxiao fought with increasing valor. A lightning-fast sword thrust pierced Elder Zhu’s shoulder, instantly creating a bloody hole. Elder Zhu screamed in pain and turned to flee. Jun Moxiao pursued relentlessly, and within a few breaths, he caught up to Elder Zhu and slashed with his sword again. In his haste, Elder Zhu quickly raised his sword to parry but was still struck on the arm.
"Just you wait! Our Yu Mo Sect will not let you off!" Elder Zhu, struck twice and utterly humiliated, his face flushed crimson. He hastily pulled out two talismans, slapped them onto his legs, activated his movement technique, and instantly vanished. These were two extremely high-grade Godspeed Talismans, capable of at least doubling his speed.
"Even if you flee to the ends of the earth, this young master will hunt you down!" Jun Moxiao sneered. He immediately activated the Divine Dragon Nine-Change Body Technique and frantically chased after Elder Zhu.
「Meanwhile, in the Chang Mansion courtyard.」
"AH!" A Shen Family cultivator at God Creation Realm Level 3 screamed as Su Wanyi cut him down with a single sword strike.
Elder Zhu’s defeat and escape dealt a severe psychological blow to the five Shaping divinity realm cultivators of the Shen Family. Their minds in turmoil, their swordsmanship became flawed. Seizing the opportunity, Su Wanyi successively killed four Shapers. In the end, only Shen Wei remained.
Seeing the situation was hopeless, Shen Wei tried to retreat and escape. But how could his movement technique compare to Su Wanyi’s Divine Dragon Nine-Change Body Technique? A Dragon Shadow appeared in mid-air; descending from above, a piercing Sword Light slashed down towards Shen Wei. With a miserable scream, Shen Wei died on the spot, his head severed from his body.
Seeing that Su Wanyi had killed all five powerhouses of the Shen Family, Chang Lu Die rushed over and excitedly hugged her.
"Sister Su, thank you so much! Without you, our Chang Family would have been annihilated today..." Chang Lu Die suddenly burst into tears, which streamed down her face.
"It’s all over now. Everything will be alright," Su Wanyi said with a smile, gently patting the young girl’s back.
「Inside the ancestral shrine.」
Ye Yun looked at Chang Qingsong and said calmly, "You should pay a visit to the Shen Family."
"Yes, Senior!"
Chang Qingsong was shrewd and instantly understood what he needed to do. Excited, he walked out of the ancestral shrine, transformed into a streak of light, and soared into the sky.
There’s still Shen Ting, a Shaping divinity realm cultivator, who slipped through the net. I must eliminate him to prevent future trouble. At the same time, there’s no need for the entire Shen Family to remain. After all, such deep hatred has been sown between us. If they are left, the Chang Family will eventually be nurturing a tiger that will bring disaster. And now that I’m a God Creation Realm Level 3 expert, I can wipe out the entire Shen Family by myself.
Ye Yun looked in a certain direction. On a bed lay a young man with a pale face. This was Chang Lu Die’s brother. Three days ago, he had been seriously injured by members of the Shen Family.
Ye Yun took out a small vial, poured out a single drop of liquid, and with a flick of his finger, sent the droplet through the air and into Chang Yizhou’s mouth. Chang Yizhou, who was unconscious, instantly absorbed this mysterious green liquid. Immediately, his entire body was enveloped in layers of green light. This verdant light radiated vigorous life energy; his damaged internal organs, meridians, and bones began to heal rapidly. In just a few breaths, Chang Yizhou’s injuries completely recovered.
He opened his eyes and abruptly sat up. "What happened? Why are all my injuries healed?" Chang Yizhou jumped off the bed and onto the ground, looking around in shock.
Suddenly, he heard commotion outside and quickly walked out. He found several corpses lying on the ground, and most of the Chang Family members were gathered together.
"Father, what... what on earth happened?" Chang Yizhou hurried to Chang Feng’s side and asked in a low voice.
Chang Feng turned his head and saw Chang Yizhou standing beside him in high spirits, showing no sign of serious injury. His eyes widened, and he said in a trembling voice, "Zhou’er, your injuries... are they all healed?"

chapters.title: Chapter 70 Farewell Gift, Saying Goodbye to Brothers
chapters.content:
Chapter 70: Chapter 70 Farewell Gift, Saying Goodbye to Brothers
"Father, my injuries are all healed."
Chang Yi Zhou looked around, his face filled with confusion. Until now, he still didn’t know what had happened.
Chang Feng looked at his son in shock, feeling that everything that happened today was beyond belief. His son’s serious injuries had miraculously healed in an instant.
What on earth happened? Could this be the work of that young man in white? Heavens! This is simply a miracle!
Chang Feng was incredibly shocked.
He couldn’t even imagine what kind of God-level medicine in this world could make a critically injured person, on the verge of death, instantly stand before him, full of life.
"Father, hurry up and tell me!" Chang Yi Zhou urged, seeing his father in a daze.
"It’s like this..." Chang Feng quickly recounted what had happened after the Shen Family’s arrival.
Just then, Chang Lu Die noticed her big brother had arrived. She quickly ran over and helped fill in the parts of the story their father had missed.
After understanding what had happened, Chang Yi Zhou looked around, his face etched with shock. One of the six Shaping God Realm powerhouses from the Shen Family had escaped, while five had died at their Chang Family estate! The Shen Family’s Clan Leader, Shen Wei, was also dead! And the Divine Bridge Realm powerhouse from the Yu Mo Sect had actually been injured by a young man and forced to flee!
All of this... felt like a dream.
A figure suddenly descended from the sky, landing in the courtyard. It was Chang Qingsong, who had returned. He had easily dispatched the Shen Family members and made a swift return.
"Uncle, your cultivation base... how has it recovered too?" Chang Feng stared in shock at his Uncle, Chang Qingsong, his eyes wide with astonishment.
All the Chang Family members present were equally astonished when they saw Chang Qingsong. Their uncle had suffered from cultivation deviation for decades, living as an ordinary person. How had he suddenly recovered to the God Creation Realm Third Layer after just a short while?
Seeing the astonished gazes of his clan members, Chang Qingsong smiled faintly and walked over.
"It was the Senior who saved our Chang Family..." he said with a smile.
Chang Feng understood immediately and couldn’t help but weep with joy.
Chang Yi Zhou, however, still looked utterly confused. He hurriedly tugged Chang Qingsong’s sleeve and pressed, "Granduncle, what exactly happened?"
Chang Qingsong smiled and shook his head.
The Senior’s identity is too sensitive; it’s best if the discussion ends with me.
At this moment, Ye Yun slowly walked out.
"Ancestor." Su Wanyi quickly put away the Seven-Star Dragon Abyss Sword, then obediently walked over and bowed respectfully.
Ye Yun nodded.
"Senior, you’ve come out!" Chang Qingsong also hurried over and bowed respectfully.
Ye Yun smiled and lightly tapped the ground with his hand. A ray of mysterious yellow light shot up, enclosing the entire Chang Mansion. A grand Formation took shape in an instant.
Ye Yun took out a formation disk, handed it to Chang Qingsong, and said with a smile, "Keep this safe. This Formation cannot be broken by anyone below the Destiny Realm!"
"Thank you, Senior!" Chang Qingsong took the formation disk, extremely excited, and with a PLOP, knelt on the ground.
"Thank you, Senior, for giving our Chang Family a new lease on life!" As Clan Leader, Chang Feng also knelt excitedly. Behind him, all the Chang Family clan members also knelt.
The Chang clan members now understood. Today’s crisis was averted entirely because this mysterious, immortal-like young man in white had intervened.
"Your Chang Family’s Spirit Sun Domineering Body Technique, without Spirit Sun Stones, has almost no chance of successful cultivation..."
Suddenly, Ye Yun glanced around and pointed a finger to the sky. Instantly, a cyan vortex appeared, emitting powerful spatial fluctuations.
"What is this?" Chang Qingsong stared, his eyes fixed on the vortex, his heart suddenly pounding with excitement.
Could this be a Secret Realm? The Senior created a Secret Realm with a simple gesture—this is too incredible!
Ye Yun touched his wrist, then flicked his finger. A crimson light shot into the cyan vortex.
He said slowly, "This is a small Secret Realm. Only those with Chang Family blood can enter. The Spirit Sun Stones inside should be sufficient for your cultivation needs."
"Thank you, Senior..." At this moment, Chang Qingsong could no longer hold back; tears streamed down his face.
All because of a brotherhood from one hundred thousand years ago, the Senior... is treating us, the descendants of the Chang Family, with such profound care and effort. He set up a powerful Formation, created a Secret Realm, stocked it with a vast amount of Spirit Sun Stones, and solved our age-old problem of being unable to cultivate the Spirit Sun Domineering Body Technique. This debt of gratitude... even if we were to be ground to dust, we could never repay it.
Tears streamed down Chang Qingsong’s face, and the other Chang Family members, including Chang Lu Die, Chang Yi Zhou, and the rest of the younger generation, also began to weep. Their hearts overflowed with immense gratitude and excitement.
「Meanwhile, outside the Chang Mansion, in the black carriage.」
The Big Black Cat sighed, its eyes teary, and said, "So touching! The Master is truly too kind-hearted!"
The Big Black Horse also shed tears. It said with a smile, "Master’s friend from one hundred thousand years ago can now rest in peace, smiling in the netherworld!"
...
Ye Yun’s expression remained calm, as if he were oblivious to it all.
He said calmly, "This Secret Realm will open once every five years. Each opening will last for one month. You must make the most of this time to mine the Spirit Sun Stones."
"Yes, Senior, we will remember!" Chang Qingsong hurriedly replied with gratitude.
"Alright, we should be going..." Ye Yun glanced at Su Wanyi, then turned and walked towards the door.
He didn’t teleport but walked very slowly.
One step.
Two steps.
Three steps...
It seemed he was bidding his good brother, Chang Yuchun, a final farewell in this manner.
Su Wanyi followed closely behind the Ancestor. Reaching the gate, she waved to Chang Lu Die. Her lips moved, mouthing, "Goodbye."
The black carriage slowly pulled away from the Chang Mansion’s entrance, its pace seemingly unhurried. But after a hundred meters, it suddenly vanished into the distance.
"The Senior has left..." Chang Qingsong wiped the tears from the corners of his eyes and stood up.
"Sister Su..." Chang Lu Die was still lost in sorrow at Su Wanyi’s departure, tears streaming endlessly.
"Uncle, what is the origin of this Senior?" Chang Feng leaned in and asked curiously.
"Don’t ask. The Senior’s identity is not for us to speculate!" Chang Qingsong finished, his eyes narrowing slightly as he looked up at the Secret Realm’s entrance above them. "The Secret Realm entrance is now open! We must seize this time to mine Spirit Sun Stones! All Chang Family members, enter at once!"
With a wave of his hand, Chang Qingsong gave the order to mobilize the clan. All the Chang Family clan members soared into the sky, one after another, entering the cyan vortex.
Light flashed before their eyes. When they regained their sight and felt solid ground beneath their feet, they were stunned by the scene before them.
This was a small Secret Realm. The Spiritual Energy was rich, the grass lush and green, a river babbled nearby, and in the distance, a large mountain stretched for miles, radiating an astonishing fire-attribute aura.
A figure flashed, and Chang Qingsong was the first to arrive near this crimson mountain. He touched the mountainside, felt that unique aura, and suddenly fell to his knees, prostrating himself as he sobbed uncontrollably.
Hearing his sobs, all the Chang Family clan members hurried over. They examined the mountain carefully, each one’s face reflecting utter shock.
This entire mountain... was made of Spirit Sun Stones!
"The Senior... he actually gave us an entire mountain..." Chang Qingsong wept and laughed, appearing utterly delirious.
At this moment, all the Chang Family members fell to their knees, prostrating themselves respectfully before the crimson mountain and kowtowing deeply three times.
With this mountain of Spirit Sun Stones, their Chang Family could once again achieve the glory of their ancestors from one hundred thousand years ago!

chapters.title: Chapter 71: Imperial Sect and Demon Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 71: Chapter 71: Imperial Sect and Demon Sect
Cloud Dream Mountain is located in the western region of the Shenfeng Dynasty, thousands of miles away from Xuan Yang County. The mountain range stretches endlessly, with over a thousand large and small lakes, all naturally formed, nestled within it. Looking down from a high altitude, they resemble pieces of emerald embedded among the towering mountains and lofty ridges.
"Quick, activate the array! Don’t let it escape!"
With a loud shout, a dazzling light suddenly rose from the natural lake atop a mountain, forming a transparent cover that enveloped the entire lake.
CRASH!
A huge, multicolored figure surged out from the roiling lake water, collided with the transparent golden light barrier, and was bounced back.
"HEH HEH, once the great array is activated, this Five-Colored Dragon Carp will have nowhere to run. Junior brothers, how about we enjoy a game of catching fish in a barrel?"
Encircling the lake stood eight black-robed young men. Each of them was handsome with a powerful aura. All of them were in the Divine Bridge Realm. The one with the highest cultivation among them had reached the Fifth Level of the Divine Bridge Realm, while even the one with the lowest cultivation was at the First Level of the Divine Bridge Realm. Their black Robes were rather peculiar, with two blood-red characters embroidered on the back: Yu and Mo. The character ’Yu’ was small, while the character ’Mo’ was large.
If there were Cultivators from the Shenfeng Dynasty here, they would definitely recognize that these young men were from the Demon Sect of the Yu Mo Sect. The Yu Mo Sect was divided into two factions: the Imperial Sect and the Demon Sect. The Imperial Sect had relatively fewer members and was the weaker faction. In contrast, the Demon Sect boasted numerous members, extraordinary combat power, and a reputation as bloodthirsty killers—a formidable name that shook the entire Shenfeng Dynasty. Therefore, ordinary Cultivators would steer clear whenever they encountered members of the Yu Mo Sect’s Demon Sect to avoid inviting unnecessary calamity.
"Fellow sect members—" A black figure tore through the air, shouting loudly from mid-flight. The group, who had been about to act, suddenly halted and looked up. They saw an elderly man, covered in blood, descending from the sky.
"HEH... Isn’t this an Elder in Charge from the Imperial Sect?" The leader, a young man of about twenty-four or twenty-five, squinted as he watched Elder Zhu descend. The Demon Sect always looked down on the Imperial Sect because they believed the Imperial Sect’s combat power was far too weak.
"Elder Zhu, you’re covered in wounds. Did you encounter a powerful Demon Beast?" the leading youth asked, his face cold.
"I’m being pursued by a Cultivator of the Divine Bridge Realm! I implore you, for the sake of our shared sect, please lend me a hand!" Elder Zhu’s old face flushed red, then he clasped his fists in a salute, his attitude extremely earnest.
He was merely an Elder in Charge of the Imperial Sect. In the eyes of these Demon Sect’s Disciples of Heaven’s Pride, he carried no weight. These Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Demon Sect were known for their arrogance, always doing as they pleased, lawless and aggressive. If a Disciple from the Imperial Sect dared to offend them, they would suppress and kill them on the spot without mercy.
But at this moment, Elder Zhu had no other choice. The prowess of his Godspeed Talisman was exhausted, and the terrifying youth behind him was still in hot pursuit. If these Demon Sect Disciples didn’t help, he truly wouldn’t be able to escape the youth’s pursuit.
"Strange... In the Shenfeng Dynasty, who would dare to attack people from our Yu Mo Sect?" The leading youth stroked his chin, a cruel smirk playing on his lips. "What’s their cultivation realm? How many levels higher than yours?" he questioned.
"Well, that..." Elder Zhu hesitated.
"Elder Zhu, you dawdler! If you truly want our help, why not reveal the actual situation?" The leading youth glared, his eyes flashing with ferocity as he abruptly pointed his Sword at Elder Zhu’s chest. His expression was ruthless, his killing intent overflowing, as if this Elder Zhu from the Imperial Sect was no fellow disciple at all.
Elder Zhu shuddered. In an instant, cold sweat drenched him. In the history of the Yu Mo Sect, it wasn’t uncommon for the Demon Sect lineage to kill members of the Imperial Sect lineage.
"It... It’s a young Cultivator... at the First Level of the Divine Bridge Realm!" Elder Zhu stammered.
"HAHAHA... The First Level of the Divine Bridge Realm? Elder Zhu, your Imperial Sect is truly a disgrace!" The youth laughed heartily, raised his Sword, and smacked the flat of it against Elder Zhu’s face, creating sharp slapping sounds.
The other young members of the Demon Sect also burst into laughter. The people of the Imperial Sect were indeed too weak, to be hounded into such a pathetic state by a mere youth at the First Level of the Divine Bridge Realm. It was truly hilarious.
While everyone was laughing, an illusory Dragon Shadow suddenly shot over from the distance, landing before them. The Dragon Shadow dissipated, transforming into a handsome youth of about fourteen or fifteen.
"OH? So he’s really at the First Level of the Divine Bridge Realm?" The leading youth sized up Jun Moxiao from head to toe and spoke disdainfully, an utterly arrogant expression on his face.
Elder Zhu looked at Jun Moxiao, his eyes filled with extreme fear.
This youth... he’s truly terrifying. His stamina is incredible, his physique astonishing. He chased me at high speed all this way, and now that he’s landed, he isn’t even out of breath!
Seeing Elder Zhu’s cowering expression, the leading youth became enraged. A vicious glint flashed in his eyes as he abruptly raised his Sword and slapped it across Elder Zhu’s face.
SMACK!
The blow was so powerful it sent Elder Zhu flying. When he scrambled back to his feet, a bloody welt was already visible on the left side of his face.
"Useless trash! You bring shame to our Yu Mo Sect!" the youth said coldly.
Elder Zhu didn’t dare to retort. He lowered his head and said timidly, "I still implore you all to help."
"Relax. Killing a Cultivator at the First Level of the Divine Bridge Realm is as easy as lifting a finger!" He turned, fixing his gaze on Jun Moxiao, a bloodthirsty light glinting in his eyes as killing intent billowed from him.
Jun Moxiao observed these black-robed youths. Seeing their arrogant bearing and ferocious expressions, he frowned. The Robes they wore were very similar to Elder Zhu’s; they were likely all from the Yu Mo Sect.
"You’re all from the Yu Mo Sect, right? Good, you’ve arrived just in time. Since you’re all at the Divine Bridge Realm, why don’t you all come at me together?" Jun Moxiao casually shook his Chaos Element Unlimited Sword, glanced carelessly at the black-robed youths, and said with a smile.
He had recently been in the carriage, refining Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood. After completing the refinement, although his cultivation base hadn’t changed, the concentration of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood in his body had increased. Even though the increase in concentration was minuscule, it had significantly boosted his combat strength. So today, Jun Moxiao planned to use these disciples of the Yu Mo Sect for some practice.
"All attack together?"
"HAHA..."
The leading youth froze for a moment, then burst into wild laughter. It was said that members of the Demon Sect were wild and arrogant, but he hadn’t expected this young whelp before them, who hadn’t even fully matured, to be even more arrogant than they were!
Another black-robed youth laughed and shouted, "Kid, we don’t kill nobodies! Which sect are you from?"
"The Dragon God Sect!" Jun Moxiao declared proudly. With a flick of his Sword, a massive Divine Dragon Phantom materialized behind him.
"Dragon God Sect? Never heard of it! What kind of third-rate sect is that?"
"Disciples from such obscure, unpresentable little sects are just as worthless!"
"Kill him!!"
Several black-robed youths from the Yu Mo Sect instantly drew their Swords. Brimming with killing intent, they manipulated streams of sword light and charged forward to attack.
"PHEW..." Elder Zhu exhaled, wiping the cold sweat from his forehead.
These Demon Sect’s Disciples of Heaven’s Pride have finally been provoked. As long as they make a move, my life will be safe.

chapters.title: Chapter 72: The Creation Demon God Art
chapters.content:
Chapter 72: Chapter 72: The Creation Demon God Art
High up in a certain area of Cloud Dream Mountain, a black carriage hovered silently in the void. Ye Yun gazed at the scene unfolding in the distance. A gentle flicker passed through his eyes, and a hint of a smile touched the corners of his mouth.
After a hundred thousand years, he once again saw the Five-Colored Dragon Carp.
However, this Five-Colored Dragon Carp was not the one from his past. But, nonetheless, seeing the Five-Colored Dragon Carp now stirred some of his old memories.
Just as Ye Yun was reminiscing, Jun Moxiao had already engaged in battle with the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Yu Mo Sect. The fight was extremely intense.
After several rounds, Jun Moxiao was surprisingly suppressed by these eight disciples from the Yu Mo Sect. This utterly shocked him.
It seems... the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from major sects indeed possess outstanding personal combat prowess, far surpassing that found in the Ancient Moon Dynasty.
However, even more shocked than Jun Moxiao were the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride of the Yu Mo Sect. They had never dreamed that their eight Divine Bridge Realm experts, most of whom had higher cultivation bases than the young man before them, would be unable to kill him with a single blow. Nothing like this had ever happened before.
No Disciple of Heaven’s Pride from any of the three major sects could possibly possess such formidable combat strength. A one-on-one fight might have been understandable. But this was eight of them against one person, and six of them were at a much higher realm than that young man. Yet, they had only managed to suppress him, not kill him.
How can this young man be so strong?
Elder Zhu, hiding in the distance and observing the battle, stared wide-eyed at the intense fighting, his heart pounding heavily. For one man to fight eight, especially when at a disadvantage in cultivation, and hold on for so long was truly rare.
Elder Zhu was injured and had not participated in the battle. He watched Jun Moxiao, stroking his chin, deep in thought.
What kind of sect is this Dragon God Sect? Why have I never heard of it in the Shenfeng Dynasty? Even in the more powerful dynasties nearby, I’ve never heard of this sect!
The more Elder Zhu pondered, the more confused he became.
SPLASH! SPLASH!
From the lake behind him, the sound of water breaking echoed as a gigantic Five-Colored Dragon Carp leaped out, repeatedly slamming into a golden protective shield. Elder Zhu turned, and the moment he saw the vibrant Five-Colored Dragon Carp, his eyes immediately lit up with a fervent gaze.
This Five-Colored Dragon Carp had reached the Sixth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm. Its cultivation base even surpassed everyone present. However, due to the Formation, this Five-Colored Dragon Carp was firmly trapped and couldn’t escape for the moment.
Elder Zhu was well aware of the great renown of the Five-Colored Dragon Carp. The Five-Colored Dragon Carp held significant benefits for cultivators. Its meat had miraculous effects on strengthening one’s Soul and physical body. The carp’s blood was also a primary ingredient in refining a sacred healing medicine. The Demon Core of a Five-Colored Dragon Carp at the Divine Bridge Realm was especially valuable. Once refined into a Breakthrough Pill, it could provide crucial assistance to a Divine Bridge Realm cultivator attempting to break through to the Nirvana Realm.
One could say that the Five-Colored Dragon Carp, which contained the Ancient Divine Dragon Bloodline, was a treasure through and through.
Elder Zhu sighed again, his expression turning despondent.
The Five-Colored Dragon Carp is the destined opportunity for these Disciples of Heaven’s Pride of the Demon Sect; I shouldn’t get my hopes up. I have a Yuan Yang Stone Mine. If I could acquire the Yuan Yang Tyrant Body Technique from the Chang Family, I could directly cultivate to the Destiny Realm. Compared to this Five-Colored Dragon Carp, my own opportunity is far superior.
Unfortunately, this had been forcefully interrupted by the young man before him. A hint of hatred flashed in Elder Zhu’s eyes.
After resting for a while, he felt somewhat better. Gritting his teeth, he picked up his sword and joined the battle.
Jun Moxiao now faced nine opponents alone, and the pressure on him intensified immensely.
「In the distant void.」
Su Wanyi squinted her eyes, watching the intense battle from afar. She was quite worried about her junior brother, Jun Moxiao. The Yu Mo Sect was a major sect, and these young Divine Bridge Realm cultivators were all exceptionally talented with extraordinary combat prowess. A tide of devastating attacks, like a force capable of destroying heaven and earth, pushed her junior brother back repeatedly. If not for his Divine Dragon Nine Transformations Technique, her junior brother would have been in grave danger.
「In the carriage.」
Ye Yun wore a calm expression, quietly watching the battle unfold.
"Luo Li, you go too!"
At this moment, a voice echoed through a certain space.
Then, a beam of light shot up into the sky, heading towards the battlefield on the mountaintop below. Luo Li appeared, descending from mid-air. She drew her sword and launched a fierce rain of sword light down at them.
The disciples of the Yu Mo Sect were caught off guard and hastily raised their swords to defend, thrown into momentary disarray. Seizing the opportunity, Jun Moxiao launched a powerful counterattack, slightly regaining his footing.
"Junior Brother, the Ancestor sent me to help you!" Luo Li landed beside Jun Moxiao.
"Senior Sister, be careful! These disciples from the major sects are all formidable opponents!" Jun Moxiao cautioned, his expression grave as he looked at their nine opponents.
"Got it!" Luo Li nodded solemnly.
The leading youth from the Yu Mo Sect, seeing a beautiful young woman in a bright yellow robe descend from the sky, showed a look of shock. The young woman’s speed was so incredible that she was upon them before they could even react. From their conversation, it was clear they were fellow disciples from the same sect.
This is getting interesting.
"Kill them all! Leave no one alive!!!" the leading youth roared angrily. His eyes suddenly turned blood-red, and a raging bloody aura erupted from him, making him resemble a Demon King emerging from Hell.
"Kill!" the other disciples of the Yu Mo Sect roared. A bloody aura also erupted from their bodies, their eyes turning red and muscles bulging.
They’ve undergone Demonization?
Elder Zhu, standing to the side, felt his heart pound with fear.
The reason the Yu Mo Sect’s disciples were so formidable was their unique cultivation technique: The Creation Demon God Art. Once this technique was unleashed, their bodies would burn with a raging bloody aura, their combat power would multiply, and they would become bloodthirsty, not resting until their opponents were slaughtered. The disciples of the Demon Sect dared not use this Creation Demon God Art lightly. After all, this cultivation technique severely consumed their blood and qi.
But unexpectedly, with the appearance of another young girl at the First Level of the Divine Bridge Realm, the increased pressure had pushed these Disciples of Heaven’s Pride of the Demon Sect to use The Creation Demon God Art.
It seemed that in their earlier exchange, they had already found that young man to be a tough opponent. This girl and the young man were fellow disciples, and she was also at the First Level of the Divine Bridge Realm; her combat strength was likely not to be underestimated either. If they continued to fight normally, there was no telling how long it would take. Moreover, the Five-Colored Dragon Carp was still trapped in the nearby Formation. If the fight dragged on too long and the Five-Colored Dragon Carp escaped, all their previous efforts would be wasted.
Seeing that the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Yu Mo Sect had utilized The Creation Demon God Art, Ye Yun, seated in the carriage, still maintained an incredibly calm demeanor. He had long foreseen all of this. That was why he had Luo Li join Jun Moxiao in the fight. If the two of them could endure this battle, it would be immensely beneficial for their future cultivation.
The Big Black Cat yawned. "Tsk! These little demon spawn, once they undergo Demonization, probably wouldn’t even recognize their own fathers, would they?"
The Big Black Horse bared its large white teeth and chuckled, "Little Cat, why don’t you go be their father? Teach those little whelps how to conduct themselves?"
The Big Black Cat covered its head, complaining forlornly, "Uncle Ma, please spare Little Cat! I’m a bachelor cat, single for thousands of years. I have no experience being a father!"
"Haha!" The Big Black Horse burst into hearty laughter.
Hearing this, Ye Yun, sitting in the carriage, couldn’t help but chuckle.

chapters.title: Chapter 73: Reverse Dragon Technique, 5 Times the Combat Power!
chapters.content:
Chapter 73: Chapter 73: Reverse Dragon Technique, 5 Times the Combat Power!
During a light moment of banter, the black-robed youths of the Yu Mo Sect launched into battle with Jun Moxiao and Luo Li.
The battle began with an earth-shattering force, blocking the light from the sun and moon. The demonized Disciples of Heaven’s Pride were, as expected, fierce and unmatched, forcing Jun Moxiao and Luo Li to retreat step by step. Fortunately, the two cooperated tacitly, supporting each other and avoiding any injuries.
At this moment, Elder Zhu stood afar and did not take action. The demonized Disciples of Heaven’s Pride didn’t recognize their own kin. If he were to rush into the battle, he would undoubtedly be caught in the crossfire and might even be instantly cleaved by a sword. His death would then be entirely unjust.
Ye Yun observed quietly for a while and sighed lightly.
After the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Yu Mo Sect were demonized, their power doubled. They were fighting in a life-threatening manner. If the battle continued, the threat Luo Li and Jun Moxiao faced would not merely be defeat, but the danger of losing their lives.
"It seems it’s time to pass on some new techniques to them..."
Ye Yun thought to himself.
With a light touch of his hand, two rays of light broke through the void, falling on the heads of Luo Li and Jun Moxiao. In an instant, the inheritance of a supreme cultivation technique appeared in their minds.
The voice of the ancient Ancestor faintly resonated in the hearts of Jun Moxiao and Luo Li. "They used The Creation Demon God Art, and after Demonization, their combat power doubles... But my Dragon God Sect is an Eternal Sect; how could we not have a suppressive cultivation technique?"
Ye Yun continued, "This is the first level of the Reverse Dragon Technique! Once you use it, you will burn your own Blood Qi, and your fighting power will be able to increase five-fold!"
Five-fold increase?
This is too terrifying.
Jun Moxiao and Luo Li were both surprised and delighted at this moment. They quickly assimilated the memory of this cultivation technique in their minds. The Reverse Dragon Technique was directly taught to them by the ancient Ancestor, and with the use of a special Divine Skill, the two instantly grasped it.
BOOM...
Two booming sounds erupted from their bodies, as if a Divine Dragon awakened within them at this moment.
"ROAR!"
Jun Moxiao and Luo Li threw their heads back and laughed, their voices like dragon roars. At this moment, they both unleashed the Reverse Dragon Technique and began burning the abundant Blood Qi within their bodies. They hailed from the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline, their Blood Qi already powerful beyond compare; this violent burning of Blood Qi brought an extremely terrifying rise in their combat power. Their cultivation base remained the same, but the Super Divine Dragon Breath that emanated from them was even more terrifying.
Seeing this scene from his distant watching spot, Elder Zhu immediately widened his eyes in disbelief. At this moment, the young man and woman were surrounded by their Blood Qi, which swirled around them like a rolling mist, flowing endlessly with a grand momentum. Within their Blood Qi, a Divine Dragon Phantom seemed to swim. Their Super Divine Dragon Breath became overpowering; even he, watching from a distance, felt an immense pressure.
Elder Zhu knew that things were not looking good. He abruptly turned and fled. At this point, he cared little for camaraderie with his fellow sect members. With the Demon Sect’s crazed disciples to block the young man and woman for him, he needed to seize the moment and escape.
Just as Elder Zhu started to move, a Big Black Cat suddenly appeared before him, startling him.
Where had it come from?
He hurriedly tried to sense the Big Black Cat’s cultivation base. The next moment, his eyes nearly popped out. He couldn’t sense it! That meant the Big Black Cat’s cultivation base far exceeded his own!
"Stop running."
The Big Black Cat lifted its black paw and lightly patted down. Elder Zhu only felt a darkness before his eyes and instantly fell to the ground. The Big Black Cat pounced, adding another swipe of its claws, and only returned after confirming Elder Zhu was completely dead.
Big Black Horse glared at the cat indignantly. "Little Cat, your killing technique is too sloppy." He then opened his mouth, and a bolt of lightning shot out, striking Elder Zhu’s body. Instantly, the Elder disintegrated into a wisp of bluish smoke.
The Big Black Cat stuck out its tongue and said with an embarrassed grin, "Uncle Ma, I don’t have your skill."
Big Black Horse pursed his lips, ignoring it further, and instead returned his attention to the fierce battle ahead.
After deploying the Reverse Dragon Technique, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao had reversed their losing situation and launched a ferocious counterattack. The demonized Demon Sect’s Disciples on the other side were also fighting like madmen, like wild beasts, roaring angrily and attacking the two without regard for their own lives. Even if Luo Li’s sword cut through a Demon Sect disciple’s chest, that disciple would still disregard his own life to stab at her with his sword. It was an entirely life-for-life battle tactic.
Left with no choice, Luo Li had to use the Divine Dragon Nine-Change Body Technique, transforming into a Divine Dragon Phantom and vanishing.
Right now, these Demon Sect’s Disciples could only rely on such desperate tactics to barely maintain a sliver of an advantage. But this advantage was also constantly slipping away. After all, under the powerful and sharp attacks of Luo Li and Jun Moxiao, their opponents were continuously injured, and their overall fighting power was rapidly diminishing.
Approximately two incense sticks’ worth of time went by.
SWISH! SWISH!
As two startling beams of sword light descended, all the Demon Sect’s Disciples fell into pools of blood.
Taking a shallow breath, Jun Moxiao shook the fresh blood from his sword, looked at Luo Li, and said, "Senior Sister, I never expected our Dragon God Sect’s Reverse Dragon Technique to be so powerful."
"Haha, yes! I didn’t expect that burning Blood Qi would increase combat power five-fold," Luo Li laughed heartily.
Jun Moxiao walked over, delivered a final sword thrust to each fallen disciple, then collected all the storage rings from their bodies, giving half to Luo Li.
"Senior Sister, the Ancestor said this is only the first level of the Reverse Dragon Technique. Perhaps in the future, we’ll have a chance to master the second layer, the third layer... Our combat power will keep increasing!" Jun Moxiao said, his face beaming with pride.
Luo Li gave him an annoyed glare. Then she pointed at Jun Moxiao’s body and said, "This Blood Qi-burning cultivation technique can’t be used lightly. Although our physiques are strong, we can’t withstand this kind of consumption."
Jun Moxiao sheepishly lowered his head.
"Luo Li is right," Ye Yun’s voice sounded casually as the black carriage suddenly appeared. "I didn’t give you this cultivation technique before because I feared it would affect your foundation."
"Ancestor, I understand," Jun Moxiao said, his head lowered, his face full of sincere remorse.
Seeing Jun Moxiao’s sincere admission of his mistake, Ye Yun nodded.
Su Wanyi jumped down from the carriage. She took out a handkerchief and gently wiped the blood from Luo Li’s face. "Little Junior Sister, are you okay? You’ve been burning Blood Qi for so long; you need to rest well!" Su Wanyi said with concern.
"Hmm, Eldest Senior Sister, I do need to rest well..." Luo Li admitted, feeling a bit weak as well.
Remembering the Ancestor’s earlier instructions, Luo Li felt a chill in her heart. It seemed this technique should only be used at crucial times. Frequent use would definitely be detrimental to cultivation.
"Little Horse, go and break the Formation in the lake," Ye Yun suddenly instructed.
Big Black Horse opened his mouth wide, and a blue bolt of lightning shot out, striking the golden light barrier.
With a thunderous CRASH, the golden light barrier shattered.
SPLASH!
A giant, multi-colored figure broke out of the water and rushed towards everyone.
"Watch out!" Jun Moxiao’s expression changed, and he raised his sword, positioning himself in front of Su Wanyi to protect her.

chapters.title: Chapter 74: Five-Colored Dragon Carp, Snatching Ancestors?
chapters.content:
Chapter 74: Chapter 74: Five-Colored Dragon Carp, Snatching Ancestors?
THUMP!
A huge, multicolored figure suddenly fell in front of Big Black Horse, lay down on the ground, and spoke in human tones, "Thank you for your help, kind sir!"
"Don’t thank me; it’s what the Master ordered!"
Big Black Horse quickly shook his head, grinning with his big white teeth.
"Is that a carp?"
Everyone took a closer look and realized that the creature lying on the ground was a multicolored carp measuring twenty to thirty meters long.
This giant carp was golden yellow, enveloped in a shimmering, multicolored glow. Two golden whiskers, each about three to seven meters long, grew from its mouth, gleaming brightly.
"Is... is this a carp that’s reached the Sixth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm?"
Jun Moxiao stared wide-eyed, a look of disbelief plastered on his childish face.
"Which of you is the Master?"
The massive Five-Colored Dragon Carp rolled about on the ground, its big eyes darting back and forth between Luo Li, Jun Moxiao, and Su Wanyi.
These three humans... They must also possess the Dragon God Bloodline, giving it a feeling of particular closeness. But it didn’t dare get too close. Because the Dragon God Bloodlines of these three were even nobler than its own, instilling in it a sense of submission.
"Don’t look at me. The Ancestor is in the carriage!"
Seeing that the giant fish was staring at him, Jun Moxiao quickly gestured, his face somewhat embarrassed.
A fish measuring dozens of meters writhing on the ground... The scene was quite bizarre. It wouldn’t have seemed so out of place if it were swimming in water.
Carriage?
The Five-Colored Dragon Carp heard what Jun Moxiao said, twisted its body, and looked at the carriage.
It had scanned the black carriage with its Divine Sense earlier and found no one inside. Could there really be someone in there?
Though skeptical, it contemplated for a few seconds before twisting its body and crawling towards the carriage.
The ever-ostentatious Big Black Cat finally couldn’t help but say, "Hey, big fish, you should be able to take on human form, right? Hurry up and transform! The ground is about to be rubbed bald by you!"
"HAHA, big fish, you better transform quickly! Otherwise, there won’t be any hair left on Lord Earth’s head!"
Big Black Horse snorted in agreement, perfectly in sync with Big Black Cat.
Truly a pair of living treasures...
Ye Yun thought, watching them with a slight smile.
He lifted the carriage curtain and stepped out.
"This..."
The Five-Colored Dragon Carp was suddenly taken aback by the sight of Ye Yun, dressed in white like an ethereal immortal, and its mind erupted as if a volcano had awakened.
At that very instant, it felt an unparalleled suppression from his bloodline. It was as if... it wasn’t a human standing before it, but a true Divine Dragon. And not just any ordinary Divine Dragon, but one of the most formidable Super Divine Dragons of ancient times!
The Five-Colored Dragon Carp lineage was a collateral branch of the Divine Dragons. The Dragon God Bloodline within its body was exceedingly thin, and its inherited memories were scarce. Therefore, it truly couldn’t connect Ye Yun with the Ancestor Dragon. It could only guess he was one of the Ten Super Divine Dragons beneath the Ancestor Dragon.
WHOOSH!
With a sudden twist of its body and a flash of light, it transformed into a young man.
Dressed in a multicolored dragon robe, with refined features and an extraordinary bearing, he was remarkably imposing.
THUD. The young man knelt on the ground, his face filled with excitement, and began kowtowing repeatedly, "Greetings, Ancestor!"
Ancestor?
Jun Moxiao, Luo Li, and the others exchanged bewildered glances.
Has this big fish lost its mind? How dare it try to snatch away their Dragon God Sect’s Ancestor? This is simply too outrageous!
The three of them fumed internally, their gazes towards the Five-Colored Dragon Carp turning unfriendly.
"Big fish! You can’t just claim anyone as your ancestor!"
The Big Black Cat also abruptly stood up, glaring at the youth with annoyance as it spoke.
Master— That’s a god! And this youth is merely a Five-Colored Dragon Carp, possessing only a diluted bloodline of the ancient Five-Colored Divine Dragon. With such mediocre aptitude, he wants to acknowledge Master, a divine being, as his ancestor? Where in the world could one find such a good deal? The Big Black Cat had always considered itself shameless, but even it felt its hide wasn’t nearly as thick as this Five-Colored Dragon Carp’s! Otherwise, it wouldn’t have clung to Uncle Ma’s sturdy leg back then; it should have aimed for Master’s leg. But how could it dare? The leg of a god wasn’t something one could simply embrace. It wasn’t qualified.
"Ancestors shouldn’t be carelessly acknowledged. I am a Human Cultivator, and you are of the Demon Clan..."
Ye Yun smiled faintly and waved his sleeve. A surge of mana promptly lifted the youth from the ground.
His body carried the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline. The concentration of the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline had reached more than 99% and was infinitely close to the Body of the Ancestral Dragon.
Any member of the Dragon Clan, or any lifeform possessing Dragon Clan Bloodline, would feel an intense bloodline suppression upon seeing him.
Under this bloodline suppression, they couldn’t harbor the slightest thought of resistance.
In ancient times, when the Ancestor Dragon appeared, it suppressed all eras and commanded the world. None of the scaled races dared to disobey.
"You must be our Ancestor; I feel I cannot be wrong..."
The youth stood on the ground, a miserable expression on his face, constantly wiping his tears with his sleeve.
He felt incredibly wronged at this moment. He, too, possessed a trace of the Five-Colored Divine Dragon’s bloodline; the bloodline resonance between Divine Dragons couldn’t be mistaken... For someone like him, who possessed the Five-Colored Divine Dragon bloodline, to feel such an urge to submit—aside from the legendary Ten Super Divine Dragons, the youth truly couldn’t imagine who else it could be. In his heart, the white-robed Master before him might be one of the Ten Super Divine Dragons. But in the ancient war, all Ten Super Divine Dragons had perished. Thus, he had no idea of the true identity of the white-robed Master before him.
...
Ye Yun looked at the youth and asked with a smile, "There shouldn’t be many Five-Colored Dragon Carp left on the Cangnan Continent now, should there?"
Upon hearing these words, the youth felt even more grief-stricken, and his tears flowed even faster.
"Master..."
Emulating the Big Black Cat’s address, the youth called out to Ye Yun and cried as he said, "Our lineage of Five-Colored Dragon Carp has dwindled from tens of thousands to just twenty or thirty..."
"You still have clan members?"
Ye Yun’s eyebrows twitched slightly as he asked casually.
"Yes, Master!"
The youth continued to lament, "We now all live at the bottom of the Canglan River. The remnants of an ancient formation, left behind by an ancient sect, afford us sanctuary there..."
Hearing this, Ye Yun nodded.
He had initially thought this was a lone Five-Colored Dragon Carp. He hadn’t expected it to have an entire clan living at the bottom of the Canglan River.
The Canglan River was not far from here, approximately twenty to thirty thousand miles away.
Ye Yun, looking at the distant lake, calmly said, "There is a Seven-Colored Golden Lotus at the bottom of this lake. Has someone from your Five-Colored Dragon Carp clan been injured?"
The youth was momentarily stunned.
However, he quickly came to his senses. This god-like, white-robed Master had an incredibly sharp gaze. He had seen at once that this Seven-Colored Golden Lotus was not something *he* lacked.
Thinking this, the youth quickly said, "Master, our Clan Leader has been seriously injured for many years and has always lacked the sacred medicine needed for healing. I searched for a hundred years and finally discovered a Seven-Colored Golden Lotus at the bottom of the lake on Cloud Dream Mountain. I didn’t expect that before it could even mature, I would encounter these members of the Yu Mo Sect..."
As he finished speaking, the youth looked at the corpses lying on the ground, a strong hatred showing in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 75: Infiltrating the Canglan River, the Strangeness Begins to Appear
chapters.content:
Chapter 75: Chapter 75: Infiltrating the Canglan River, the Strangeness Begins to Appear
Ye Yun smiled gently. He walked down from the carriage mid-air to the edge of the lake, standing with his hands behind his back and quietly looking at the bottom of the lake. At the deepest part grew a Seven-Colored Golden Lotus, about three feet high, emitting astonishing spiritual energy fluctuations. Unfortunately, this Seven-Colored Golden Lotus still needed several more years to mature.
"Master..."
The young man followed, standing behind Ye Yun, somewhat timid and not daring to speak.
Ye Yun gently pointed a finger. The lake water rolled back, coiling up in mid-air. At this moment, it seemed as if time and space were reversing, which shocked everyone present.
Ye Yun took out a small bottle and poured out a light green droplet of water. He flicked it gently, and the droplet landed on the Seven-Colored Golden Lotus. Immediately, the Seven-Colored Golden Lotus began to grow rapidly, blossoming into a Seven-Color Lotus, its exotic fragrance overwhelming. Everyone felt as if their Souls had been cleansed, an extremely refreshing sensation.
Ye Yun reached out his hand again, and the Seven-Colored Golden Lotus instantly flew into his palm.
"Keep it safe; this Seven-Colored Golden Lotus has matured!"
Ye Yun smiled slightly, handing the Seven-Colored Golden Lotus to the young man beside him. The young man was instantly stupefied.
This gentleman in white is too powerful! Using that mysterious green droplet, he managed to accelerate the maturation of the Seven-Colored Golden Lotus. Too shocking!
Ye Yun stood with his hands behind his back, gazing into the distance as if he had seen something. He turned around and smiled softly at the young man.
"Lead the way. Let’s go to the Canglan River to see your Clan Leader."
"Yes, Master!" the young man hurriedly nodded, flustered.
The three disciples of the Dragon God Sect had all returned to the interior of the carriage. Meanwhile, the one sitting at the front of the carriage, guiding them, was the young Five-Colored Dragon Carp.
Ye Yun sat in the carriage. Watching the distant scenery, he felt a mix of emotions.
The lineage of Five-Colored Dragon Carp at the bottom of the Canglan River actually originated from the Dragon Lake of the Dragon God Sect. They are the descendants of some Five-Colored Dragon Carp from that lake. This is indeed an uncanny coincidence.
The Big Black Horse, under Ye Yun’s instruction, displayed terrifying speed. The journey of tens of thousands of miles took only about the time it takes to drink half a cup of tea.
The Canglan River was the largest river in the territory of the Shenfeng Dynasty, a hundred miles wide and unfathomably deep. The Ancient Sect Ruins where the Five-Colored Dragon Carp clan resided underwater were situated at the deepest part of a certain stretch of the Canglan River.
"Master, we are here!" the young man said cheerfully, pointing towards the roaring river water.
Ye Yun smiled, his gaze sweeping down into the depths of the water. After scanning the Ancient Sect Ruins, he raised an eyebrow, a smile playing on his lips. "Well, let’s go down. Your Clan Leader is not doing well; he should take the Seven-Colored Golden Lotus as soon as possible."
The Big Black Horse plunged into the Canglan River with the carriage. A luminous barrier surrounded the carriage, preventing a single drop of water from penetrating. The young man greatly admired the Big Black Horse. In the blink of an eye, the carriage reached the riverbed.
An ancient ruin of an old Sect appeared before them. The Big Black Horse looked at it and merely smacked its lips, not uttering a word. The Big Black Cat, however, was quite alert, its nose twitching as if it had caught a whiff of something suspicious.
"Uncle Ma, there seems to be something odd about this place," the Big Black Cat stated vehemently, swaying from side to side.
"Watch your mouth! Stop spouting nonsense!" the Big Black Horse retorted grumpily.
The conversation between the horse and cat reached the young man’s ears, making his heart pound with fear.
These Ancient Relics, where they had resided for decades, were home to frequent bizarre occurrences. For instance, late at night, they would often witness battles between ancient Cultivators or see visions of Cultivators active within the Sect. Sometimes, while someone was meditating in a secret chamber, a ghostly figure might suddenly appear before their eyes.
However, the Clan Leader had once told everyone that these were residual consciousnesses of ancient Cultivators that clung to the Relic. They would manifest as illusory images at night.
There’s no big deal about it.
The Clan Members of the Five-Colored Dragon Carp had tried using their Divine Skills to attack them over the years, but to no effect, like striking at air. Over time, everyone got used to the strange occurrences.
"Who’s there?"
Seeing a black carriage suddenly descend from above, a giant Five-Colored Dragon Carp promptly darted out, blocking the way.
"Big brother, it’s me!" The young man hastily stood up from the carriage, waving towards the Five-Colored Dragon Carp.
"Oh, it’s you, Little Sixth! How did you get a carriage?" The Five-Colored Dragon Carp transformed, taking on the form of a young man.
When standing guard underwater, they normally reverted to their true forms. This allowed for free mobility and was also their most potent combat state.
"Clan Leader, how is he now? I’ve found the Seven-Colored Golden Lotus..." the young man said, holding up the Seven-Colored Golden Lotus.
The other young man sighed and opened a corner of the Formation on the Relic, urging, "The Clan Leader’s condition is worsening. Quickly, come in!"
The young man was startled. He hurriedly climbed off the carriage and flew swiftly inside. The Big Black Horse followed closely behind. As it moved, it scanned the surroundings. Its snout twitched non-stop, and its large, bell-like eyes flickered with tiny blue sparks of electricity.
Uncle Ma, what do you see? It’s a pity my cultivation base is far too weak; I still can’t see it...
the Big Black Cat sighed to himself. He then suddenly remembered the incredible Divine Beasts stored in the Master’s warehouse and couldn’t help but feel extraordinarily envious once again. Seemingly stimulated, the Big Black Cat closed his eyes and began to assimilate the Mysterious energy the Master had injected into his body.
Beyond the ruins of the outermost layer, some well-preserved great halls remained within. Ye Yun stepped out of the carriage. He also wanted to check on the condition of the Clan Leader of the Five-Colored Dragon Carp. The young man led the way, with Ye Yun following. Occasionally, Ye Yun glanced around, a faint smile flickering in his eyes.
This relic of an ancient Sect indeed holds some interest.
Upon entering a secret chamber, Ye Yun quickly noticed the Clan Leader of the Five-Colored Dragon Carp lying on the ground, barely breathing. The Clan Leader was in its true form as a Five-Colored Dragon Carp, its body over a dozen meters long. The scales on its body had lost their luster, turning a grayish white.
"Clan Leader, I’ve found the Seven-Colored Golden Lotus!"
Seeing the Clan Leader’s worsening condition, the young man rushed forward, knelt, and held the Seven-Colored Golden Lotus from his hand to the Clan Leader’s mouth.
The Seven-Colored Golden Lotus emitted an exotic scent, causing the Clan Leader, who was on the brink of death, to open his eyes. He took a sniff of its aroma, and his spirits lifted slightly. Suddenly, he glanced a few meters away and noticed the young man in white robes standing there.
Gazing at the strikingly familiar face, the Clan Leader of the Five-Colored Dragon Carp blinked rapidly and yelled at the young man, "Little Sixth, quickly retrieve the rectangular red wooden box from the next room!"
The young man didn’t quite understand but rushed to the next room and returned with a red wooden box.
"Quickly, open it!" the old Clan Leader’s voice trembled. At that moment, fueled by some unknown strength, his body shifted, and he transformed into an elderly man.
When the young man opened the box, he found an ancient painting. He glanced at it and was astonished. The person in the painting looked exactly like the white-robed gentleman standing beside him.

chapters.title: Chapter 76: Tear Apart the Void, Indulge in Revenge and Grudges
chapters.content:
Chapter 76: Chapter 76: Tear Apart the Void, Indulge in Revenge and Grudges
This painting was incredibly ancient, imbued with a profound sense of history, as if it had soaked in the river of time for tens of thousands of years.
In the painting, a young man in white stood alone amidst thousands of mountains. His features were deep-set, his eyes like stars, and his demeanor extraordinary.
His bearing, resembling that of a banished immortal, seemed to emanate faintly from the yellowed ancient paper.
This young man in white, his robes fluttering, stood upon the peak of a high mountain, like a Wushang Divine King reigning over all heavens and earth. A mere glance was enough to etch his unparalleled image into one’s memory forever.
The young man in white in the ancient painting was, surprisingly, as if carved from the same mold as the Master in white before him. Whether in appearance or disposition, they were entirely identical.
The boy was stunned. Holding the ancient painting in both hands, his body trembled uncontrollably.
Seeing the painting, the old Clan Leader’s eyes instantly welled with tears.
He had never dreamed of this. One hundred thousand years! A full one hundred thousand years! This foremost expert of the Cangnan Continent, the Sect Master of the Eternal Level Dragon God Sect, was actually still alive!
With a THUD, he fell to his knees, kowtowing repeatedly, weeping as he cried out, "Dragon Qing, of the fifty-fourth generation of Dragon Lake, pays his respects to the Sect Master!"
Seeing the old Clan Leader kneeling, the boy was stunned as well and subconsciously knelt.
Ye Yun smiled faintly as he saw the old man kneeling at his feet.
He had long wished to meet this lineage of the Five-Colored Dragon Carp, so on the way, Ye Yun had suppressed the bloodline aura within him. After entering the Canglan River, no one could detect his Ancestral Dragon Bloodline aura.
"Rise!"
With a serene expression, Ye Yun waved his great sleeve. A surge of Mana swept out, instantly lifting both the old man and the boy to their feet.
"The Five-Colored Dragon Carp lineage of Dragon Lake has been passed down for fifty-four generations. This has not been easy for you all..." Ye Yun said gently.
"Indeed, Sect Master!" The old Clan Leader’s face was still streaked with tears, his heart too overwhelmed with emotion to speak.
The young man in white before them was none other than Ye Yun, the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect from one hundred thousand years ago. He was the youngest Eternal Realm Strong Person on the Cangnan Continent, an expert who had dominated an era. Even older Eternal Realm Cultivators could not hold their heads high before him.
The progenitor of their lineage hailed from Dragon Lake within the Dragon God Sect. Back then, this Sect Master had placed a total of one hundred Five-Colored Dragon Carps into Dragon Lake.
Ye Yun looked at the old man, raised an eyebrow, and said with a faint smile, "I am no longer the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect. The title of Sect Master now belongs to another."
The old man was dumbstruck. For all these years, he had led his clan members in their wanderings across the Cangnan Continent, yet he had heard no news of the Dragon God Sect. Too much time had passed. One hundred thousand years—the Dragon God Sect had long since vanished into the river of history.
"From now on, just call me ’Old Master’!" Ye Yun looked at Dragon Qing and said lightly.
"Yes, Old Master!" Dragon Qing nodded quickly, wiping the tears from the corners of his eyes.
Ye Yun glanced at Dragon Qing, his brow slightly furrowed, and asked softly, "Your body was hacked into several pieces long ago, and you are only forcibly holding it together. Who could have been so vicious?"
Upon hearing the Old Master’s words, the boy beside him, still holding the ancient painting, was instantly dumbstruck.
So, the old Clan Leader’s injuries were that severe; his body had already been hacked apart by others... It was hard for him to imagine the incredible hardship of forcibly maintaining a fragmented body with Mana and enduring for so many years.
Dragon Qing’s eyes reddened as he said with hatred, "In the past, when we fled from the Plough Heaven Dynasty to the Shenfeng Dynasty seeking refuge, we encountered an expert from the Qitian Sword Sect. He was one realm stronger than me, and his swordsmanship was superb. I was no match for him..."
"So it was the Qitian Sword Sect..." Ye Yun nodded silently.
The Dragon Qing before him had also been an expert at the First Level of the Nirvana Realm before his cultivation base degenerated. Now, he had fallen to the Peak of the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm.
Someone at the Second Level of the Nirvana Realm in the Qitian Sword Sect would hold a rank equivalent to at least a Deputy Sect Master or a Supreme Elder.
In the Ancient Moon Dynasty, a Divine Bridge Realm Elder from the Qitian Sword Sect had meddled in their affairs and was killed by Luo Li and Jun Moxiao. They had also encountered an Elder from the Qitian Sword Sect in Silver Moon City.
Even the descendants of the Five-Colored Dragon Carp he had once nurtured in the waters of the Canglan River bore scars from the Qitian Sword Sect’s oppression. This stirred a flicker of anger in Ye Yun’s heart.
When a True God is angered, blood must be spilled!
Ye Yun cast a glance at Dragon Qing, his pupils contracting slightly.
In that instant, Dragon Qing felt as if an unimaginable power had violently upended his entire mind, only for it to return to normal a moment later. He was profoundly startled.
The next moment, Dragon Qing was astonished to see a mysterious white light emanating from the Old Master’s forearm, a light filled with an indescribable, sacred brilliance.
The front half of Ye Yun’s forearm plunged into the void.
"This..." Dragon Qing stared wide-eyed at the scene, so shocked he was like a statue.
Could it be... the Old Master has already become a god?
This astonishing possibility suddenly leaped into Dragon Qing’s mind.
One hundred thousand years ago, the Old Master was already the foremost expert in the Eternal Realm. One hundred thousand years later, the Old Master still existed in this world, undying and immortal—he must have stepped into the realm of gods! A True God!
Thinking of this, Dragon Qing’s body began to tremble uncontrollably.
Ever since the decline of the Dragon God Sect, Dragon Lake had been destroyed in a great Sect war. Few Dragon Carps had managed to escape, and over tens of thousands of years, they had formed different branches. In various parts of the Cangnan Continent, they lived miserable lives, hunted by everyone. Many cultivators sought to capture the Five-Colored Dragon Carp.
Despite this, their lineage had experienced a period of glory tens of thousands of years ago. Their population had once proliferated to over ten thousand.
...
「In the blink of an eye.」
Ye Yun withdrew his arm, a person grasped in his hand, whom he then tossed to the ground.
This was a middle-aged man with a square face, graying temples, sword-like eyebrows, and star-like eyes, possessing a rather heroic and distinguished air.
He scrambled up from the ground, looking around in utter shock. He had been cultivating in the rear mountains of the Qitian Sword Sect when a powerful force had suddenly seized him, and then he had appeared here.
"Gongsun Li, you old scoundrel! You never thought you’d see this day, did you?" Dragon Qing’s face lit up with a gratified smile as he looked at the astonished Gongsun Li.
The Old Master is simply too formidable! The Qitian Sword Sect is at least a hundred thousand miles from here, yet with a casual grasp, he tore through the void and brought Gongsun Li here.
"Dragon Qing, is that you?" Gongsun Li’s expression changed drastically upon seeing Dragon Qing, and he immediately prepared to attack.
"How arrogant, for someone from the Qitian Sword Sect to dare act presumptuously here?" a detached voice sounded.
But the next second, Gongsun Li was horrified to find his cultivation base completely sealed; the sword in his hand clattered to the ground.
Gongsun Li turned his head and saw the young man in white. His pupils instantly widened.
In that moment, he felt as if he were seeing a Wushang God. Bright light radiated from this being, illuminating the Myriad Worlds, and made him lose any will to resist.
"Dragon Qing, do it!" Ye Yun said calmly, standing with his hands clasped behind his back.
Seeing the enemy who had once hacked him into several pieces, Dragon Qing gnashed his teeth in hatred. If it weren’t for the astonishing resilience of his Five-Colored Dragon Carp physique and its extremely strong recovery ability, he probably wouldn’t have survived to this day. The accumulated pain and suffering of so many years instantly made Dragon Qing’s eyes turn red with fury.
He drew a sword, strode forward, and unleashed a furious storm of attacks upon Gongsun Li.
Gongsun Li was utterly powerless to resist. Amidst agonizing howls, Gongsun Li was dismembered, dying a gruesome death on the spot.
"Many thanks, Old Master!" After killing Gongsun Li, Dragon Qing, his face streaked with tears, dropped his sword and knelt once more at Ye Yun’s feet.
"Get up! Quickly consume the Seven-Colored Golden Lotus and mend your shattered body..." Ye Yun said with a calm smile. A wave of Mana swept out, helping Dragon Qing up.
The teenager standing nearby was completely stupefied.
This... Just what cultivation realm has the Old Master reached? With a single wave of his hand, he tore through the void and snatched a Nirvana Realm expert from a hundred thousand miles away! If he hadn’t seen it with his own eyes, the boy would never have believed someone so powerful could exist in this world!

chapters.title: Chapter 77: The Shocking Change of the Ancient Relic
chapters.content:
Chapter 77: Chapter 77: The Shocking Change of the Ancient Relic
