After Dragon Qing consumed the Seven-Colored Golden Lotus, the old injuries in his body began to heal rapidly, and a healthy flush gradually appeared on his face.
Ye Yun observed silently for a moment. He found that this Seven-Colored Golden Lotus had only healed half of Dragon Qing’s injuries; after all, they had persisted for far too long.
Thinking of this, Ye Yun took out a small vial.
A drop of emerald-green, mysterious liquid flew towards Dragon Qing. In an instant, the entire secret chamber was suddenly filled with a vigorous, life-giving energy.
"What is this?"
The young man beside him greedily gulped the air. He felt as if his very soul was being elevated.
"Swallow it!"
Ye Yun’s voice echoed faintly in Dragon Qing’s ears.
Dragon Qing opened his eyes. Staring at the drop of mysterious green liquid, his mind reeled in shock, and he hurriedly swallowed it.
BOOM!
An unimaginable life force exploded like a thunderclap within his body, surging through every inch of his meridians and seeping into every fiber of his flesh and blood.
A shimmering green light enveloped Dragon Qing’s entire body, making him appear even more sacred.
In the span of a few breaths, all of Dragon Qing’s injuries and hidden ailments from the past decades completely healed.
He scrambled up from his seated position and knelt at Ye Yun’s feet.
"Thank you, Master!"
Dragon Qing was overcome with emotion and burst into tears once more. He hadn’t expected that after 100,000 years, he, the Clan Leader of the Dragon Lake Five-Coloured Dragon Koi lineage, could once again receive the Master’s grace.
The young man beside him stared blankly at all of this. A single drop of mysterious emerald-green liquid had allowed the old Clan Leader to recover in an instant, and his cultivation base had also returned to the First Level Nirvana Realm. Moreover, there were signs that he was about to break through to Level two Nirvana Realm.
The young man licked his lips. Looking at the white-clad Master, an extremely fanatical look filled his eyes.
"Clan Leader, this is bad! A large number of Ancient Monk phantoms have gathered in the square. It seems they’re conducting some kind of ceremony!" a young man suddenly rushed in, speaking in a panic.
Ye Yun merely smiled faintly.
This Ancient Relic hides some strange things. Now... they’re finally about to show themselves.
Dragon Qing stood up, looked respectfully at Ye Yun, and whispered, "Master, I’ll go and check things out first..."
"Let’s go together."
Ye Yun smiled faintly.
These demons, slumbering for so many years, are not something these Five-Colored Dragon Carp can handle.
The group walked out.
Back in the secret chamber, the shattered flesh and blood of Gongsun Li on the floor were suddenly enveloped by a grey mist that billowed up from beneath the ground, then vanished.
Ye Yun, already halfway down the passage, merely turned his head back slightly, giving the spot a meaningful glance.
At this moment, Big Black Horse also seemed to have noticed the various peculiarities of this place, for it grinned several times.
"Uncle Ma, have you discovered something, old fellow? Your laugh is terrifying..."
Big Black Cat shivered all over, continuously glancing around, the black fur on its spine standing on end. This underwater Ancient Relic gave it an indescribably strange feeling.
"I’m not like you, Little Cat, always chattering. When it’s time for Uncle Ma to work, I never slack off. As for all this confusing business, your Uncle Ma won’t go blabbing about it!"
Big Black Horse turned its head and laughed. Its duster-like tail, with a PAP! sound, lightly slapped Big Black Cat.
Big Black Cat screamed as it was slapped onto the carriage, nearly flattened into a Big Black Pancake.
"Uncle Ma, have mercy! My little body can’t bear that tail of yours, old timer..." Big Black Cat pleaded repeatedly for mercy, feeling thoroughly wronged.
"Just you wait. I reckon the Master will have you deal with someone..." Big Black Horse grinned, baring its teeth.
"Another chance for me to take action?"
Big Black Cat shot up, its eyes twinkling and glowing with a green light. The last time it took action, it was rewarded by the Master. If it got another chance to act this time, Big Black Cat would go all out. The more grievous its injuries, the more generous the reward it would receive.
Seeing Big Black Cat’s spirited appearance, devoid of its earlier fear, Big Black Horse snorted disdainfully and ignored it.
Ye Yun followed Dragon Qing to the square.
Around them, some Clan Members of the Five-Colored Dragon Carp stood, all having transformed into humanoid shapes, looking with surprise at the phantasmal figures of the Cultivators before them.
Dragon Qing cast his gaze toward the square and was immediately taken aback. Thousands of phantasmal images of Ancient Monks had gathered on the square—something that had never happened before. Even when there had been wars between Cultivators in the past, only a few hundred had ever appeared.
These Cultivators, like specters, assembled in the center of the square, continuously raising their arms as if worshipping something in the air.
Dragon Qing frowned. This Ancient Relic had protected their Five-Colored Dragon Carp clan for decades. It had never been as bizarre as it was today. He had once told his Clan Members that these were all illusory phantoms formed by will. But today, he suddenly felt that his previous words might have been wrong. What was happening before them could no longer be explained away as mere illusions of will.
"Dragon Qing, what Sect used to be here?" Ye Yun asked with a light laugh.
"It seems it was called the Tai Xuan Door. There was once a fragment of a plaque, but it was later destroyed..." Dragon Qing replied respectfully.
Ye Yun’s gaze flickered for a moment.
He suddenly recalled the origins of this Tai Xuan Door. Approximately 120,000 years ago, on the Cangnan Continent, there was indeed a Super Sect named Tai Xuan Door. This Sect expanded too quickly at the time, annexing many other Sects. Later, it was jointly destroyed by its numerous enemies. This was recorded in the history of the Cangnan Continent. However, only someone as ancient as him would remember events from 120,000 years ago.
"Hm?" Ye Yun glanced, seemingly unintentionally, towards a certain spot beneath the ground, a mysterious smile playing on his lips.
Suddenly, a change occurred on the square.
The phantasmal images of those thousands of Ancient Monks suddenly soared into the air and converged. Ultimately, they merged, forming the figure of a middle-aged man clad in green Battle Armor. The middle-aged man’s body existed in a state between illusory and corporeal. However, his Super Divine Dragon Breath was extremely powerful. It had already reached the Seventh Level of Nirvanic Realm.
The oppressive might from the powerful Nirvana Realm expert surged out like a tide, sweeping in all directions. The weaker Five-Colored Dragon Carp Clan Members swayed and stumbled back repeatedly.
Seeing this, Dragon Qing rushed forward, spread his arms wide, and blocked the incoming pressure from the Super Divine Dragon Breath.
The middle-aged man in green Battle Armor slightly opened his eyes, his voice deep and raspy as he uttered, "All of you, come to me! What are you waiting for?!"
At that moment, the eyes of the Five-Colored Dragon Carp Clan Members behind Dragon Qing, old and young alike, flashed with a crazed look. As if summoned, they all transformed into streaks of light, rushing toward the center of the square.
"What exactly is happening?!" Dragon Qing was horrified.
He turned his head and saw that, of his Clan Members, only Little Sixth remained by his side. His other Clan Members, those who had always lived within the Ancient Relic, all seemed to have gone mad at this moment.
The Novel will be updated first on this website. Come back and continue reading tomorrow, everyone!

chapters.title: Chapter 78: Master Cat Battles the Heart Demon
chapters.content:
Chapter 78: Chapter 78: Master Cat Battles the Heart Demon
The clan members of the Five-Colored Dragon Carp rushed to the center of the square. They knelt around the middle-aged man in blue Battle Armor, each with an expression of extreme fanaticism, like devout believers.
"Come back!" Dragon Qing roared, seeing his clansmen behaving in such a manner.
Unfortunately, none of those clansmen paid any heed, remaining in a state of fervor, unable to extricate themselves.
"This..." The young man stared in shock at the scene unfolding before him.
He couldn’t believe that one day his clan members would become like this.
Could it be... that the strangeness of the Ancient Relic had affected these clan members over the years?
And he, who was usually outside searching for the Seven-Colored Golden Lotus, wasn’t affected precisely because of this?
Could it be that the reason the old Clan Leader was clear-headed was because he was blessed with a drop of mysterious green liquid by the Master, which expelled the strangeness?
The young man’s mind was filled with doubts.
Ye Yun watched everything calmly, appearing unbothered.
Just then, the man in the blue Battle Armor in the square suddenly opened his eyes wide. Two beams of light shot out from his eyes, landing like lightning on Dragon Qing.
"Dare you fight?"
As he spoke, the middle-aged man waved his hand, and a large Longsword suddenly appeared in it.
The Sword was three times wider than a normal sword and twice as long.
Its bright blade shimmered, emitting wisps of chilling air.
In an instant, a thin layer of ice formed on the bodies of the Five-Colored Dragon Carp members kneeling on the ground.
Seeing the man in blue Battle Armor acting so brazenly, Dragon Qing seethed with rage, his blood boiling, ready to charge.
Ye Yun’s brow twitched slightly.
Dragon Qing was immediately restrained on the spot.
Dragon Qing was only at Level two Nirvana Realm, while that inhuman fellow was already at the Seventh Level of Nirvanic Realm. If Dragon Qing charged forward now, he would just be throwing his life away.
Ye Yun turned his head and glanced lightly in a certain direction.
The Big Black Horse sensed something.
"Little Cat, it’s your time to shine; don’t come back until you’re half dead!" the Big Black Horse smirked.
"Uncle Ma, rest assured! I, Little Cat, have nine lives, and I’m prepared to put them all on the line today! I swear I’ll fight that thing—neither ghost nor human—to the death!" the Big Black Cat declared, suddenly standing erect and patting its chest with its paws.
Though its words were ferocious, its eyes glowed green, as if it had spotted a rare treasure.
"Haha, go on then! Don’t keep the Master waiting!" the Big Black Horse said, laughing heartily as it saw how eager the Big Black Cat was.
Its tail coiled gently, and it tossed the Big Black Cat out like a beanbag.
SWOOSH!
A dark shadow broke through the current, quickly advancing from a distance, heavily striking the middle-aged man in the blue Battle Armor.
"What is this?" The middle-aged man was surprised.
The black shadow moved so quickly that he could only raise his Sword to block.
BANG!
The Big Black Cat’s forepaws struck the Sword. An unimaginable force surged through the blade into him.
The middle-aged man couldn’t keep his footing and was forced to retreat repeatedly.
The Big Black Cat was also sent tumbling backward through the water by a huge counterforce, rolling several times before it managed to stabilize itself.
"Haha, that was exhilarating! Thanks for the boost from your tail, Uncle Ma!" the Big Black Cat exclaimed, hovering in the air and making a bowing gesture with its front paws towards a certain direction.
With a shimmer, it transformed. Its body suddenly grew immense, like a small mountain, revealing its true form as a Nine-tailed Spirit Cat.
"It’s actually a Nine-tailed Spirit Cat at the Seventh Level of Nirvanic Realm!"
Dragon Qing stood in place, staring at the Big Black Cat, his eyes widening.
Where did this cat come from?
Why would it help their Five-Colored Dragon Carp clan?
While Dragon Qing was shocked, the young man was even more astonished. His eyes widened like saucers, and he stood frozen like a statue, unable to move.
Wasn’t this the Big Black Cat that always lay on the cart?
Who would have thought it was such a powerful demon in the Nirvana Realm?
Revealing its true form, it’s truly terrifying!
The young man couldn’t help but recall the Big Black Horse that had aided him in breaking the Formation at Cloud Dream Mountain.
If a Big Black Cat could be this strong...
Then wouldn’t that Big Black Horse, who the Big Black Cat had obeyed throughout their journey, be even more formidable?
The young man dared not imagine further.
...
At that moment, he stood behind Ye Yun, gazing at that godlike back. The look in his eyes grew even more fanatical.
The man in the blue Battle Armor was now swaying, his form appearing somewhat insubstantial.
He sized up the Big Black Cat, a cold light glinting in his eyes.
"An impressive demon, but you are no match for me!"
Saying this, the middle-aged man charged at the Big Black Cat, Sword in hand.
In an instant, dazzling sword-light filled the entire square, assaulting the Big Black Cat from all directions.
The sword-light was astonishing, infused with the immense power of a Nirvana Realm expert.
The Big Black Cat, full of fighting spirit, swiped its enormous paws at the middle-aged man.
BOOM BOOM!
Its massive paws shattered countless beams of sword-light.
However, the sword-light was sharp and imbued with icy coldness, injuring the Big Black Cat’s paws.
Nevertheless, being a great demon, its physical body was naturally robust.
Even minor injuries were not a significant issue.
The two of them engaged in fierce combat in mid-air.
Perhaps because the man in the blue Battle Armor did not wish to harm the Five-Colored Dragon Carp clan members in the square, he kept all his attacks confined to the airspace above it.
Despite this, the aftershocks of their battle still rippled across the square below.
Ye Yun’s expression changed.
In mid-air, an invisible protective light shield materialized, safeguarding all the Five-Colored Dragon Carp clan members.
RUMBLE!
The battle grew fiercer. The middle-aged man seemed inhuman; he didn’t bleed or show signs of injury even when the Big Black Cat’s claws struck his body—it only made his form grow a little more insubstantial.
After the two battled for a while, the middle-aged man, seeing the ferocity of the Big Black Cat, let out a long roar and swiftly retreated a hundred meters.
Then, with a sweeping gesture of his hand, dozens of gray-black lights suddenly emerged from the heads of the Five-Colored Dragon Carp clan members.
These eerie lights emitted chilling wails and howls, morphing into giant demonic heads that then flew into the man’s body.
At this moment, his cultivation base surged once again, astonishingly reaching the Eighth Layer of Nirvana Realm!
Is this the Heart Demon?!
Dragon Qing exclaimed in shock, his face paling as he saw those gray-black demonic heads.
So, Heart Demons had somehow been born inside the clan members; no wonder they all went insane earlier.
These Heart Demons didn’t seem very formidable; they appeared to be mere strands of splintered consciousness.
Dragon Qing then turned his eyes to the middle-aged man.
This fellow can absorb Heart Demons... Does that mean he is the true Heart Demon?
Dragon Qing’s breathing became ragged.
Legends of the Heart Demon had long circulated on the Cangnan Continent.
The Heart Demon was always mysterious—formless, traceless, its origins unknown.
Once a Heart Demon controlled a Cultivator, the blood and Qi within the Cultivator’s body would be constantly eroded, thereby strengthening the Heart Demon.
Heart Demons are difficult to detect; only exceptionally powerful experts can perceive their existence.
There are many types of Heart Demons, but all excel at creating avatars.
They can instantaneously create thousands of avatars that secretly infiltrate a Cultivator’s body.
These avatars devour Qi and blood to strengthen themselves. When they return to the main body, the Heart Demon’s true form becomes even more powerful.
No wonder the clan members have made such slow progress in their cultivation these past few years... They’ve been possessed by this Heart Demon!
Dragon Qing murmured to himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 79: The Will of the Strong, Ancient Heroes
chapters.content:
Chapter 79: Chapter 79: The Will of the Strong, Ancient Heroes
"This is not a Heart Demon."
Ye Yun’s gaze flickered slightly as he spoke in a calm tone.
"Master, then what is it?"
Dragon Qing turned around and asked respectfully.
Ye Yun looked at the man in the green battle armor and said gently, "This is an Ancient Hero."
"An Ancient Hero?"
Dragon Qing was slightly stunned. He had never heard of ’Ancient Heroes’ before.
Ye Yun explained with a smile, "These Ancient Relics are from the Tai Xuan Door, 120,000 years ago. At that time, while the sect was expanding its territory and at the height of its ambition, its entire membership was obliterated. Many of the powerful warriors who died were powerhouses of the Destiny Realm and the Life and Death Realm. Their wills didn’t dissipate after death but remained attached to the sect’s relics."
"This underwater area is an extremely yin-cold place, with a Mysterious Yin Spirit Vein beneath it. The wills of these powerhouses have continuously absorbed the yin energy from the Mysterious Yin Spirit Vein, gradually growing stronger. They not only began to manifest various illusions but also started to influence your Clan Members."
Oh...
Dragon Qing nodded, seeming to somewhat understand.
Ye Yun continued, "This man was likely the most powerful within the Supreme Sect, so his willpower is the most intense. To survive in this world as an Ancient Hero, he used some Secret Technique to implant the Mysterious Yin Demon Seed into the bodies of your Clan Members, absorbing the abundant blood energy of the Five-Colored Dragon Carp."
"But that alone was not enough. In the end, he absorbed the will of all the powerhouses of the Supreme Sect and transformed into the semi-corporeal form he has now..."
"Master, is this Ancient Hero a ghost or a demon then?" Dragon Qing scratched his head and asked.
"Neither a ghost nor a demon; it’s a special state formed by the will of the strong. This was not common even in the Ancient Era..." Ye Yun explained with a smile.
Only then did Dragon Qing finally understand.
He turned his gaze to the sky, where the sound of rumbling was continuous.
A massive black figure and countless sword lights were clashing repeatedly. The fight between the two powerhouses was extremely intense.
After absorbing the Mysterious Yin Demon Seed, the middle-aged man’s strength had skyrocketed to the Eighth Layer of the Nirvana Realm, steadily suppressing the great demon in terms of power.
This caused Dragon Qing some concern. After all, this great demon that had descended from the sky was here to help them.
"Master, should I go and lend the great demon a hand?" Dragon Qing clasped his fists, asking Ye Yun for permission to fight.
"No need!" Ye Yun smiled faintly and directly refused.
Although the Big Black Cat was injured, it was fighting with increasing ferocity and showed no signs of impending defeat. Moreover, in a battle of this level, the strand of Divine Power stored within the Big Black Cat was rapidly dissolving, continuously enhancing its strength.
From a distance, the Big Black Horse watched the battle intently. Suddenly, it blurted out with a grin, revealing its large white teeth, "Hehe, the Little Cat is about to break through!"
Not long after it spoke, the blood-covered Big Black Cat suddenly trembled, and its Super Divine Dragon Breath abruptly surged. At this moment, it actually managed to break through to the Eighth Layer of the Nirvana Realm.
I broke through?
The Big Black Cat abruptly retreated hundreds of meters in mid-air, raised its huge cat paws, and shouted excitedly.
It never imagined that after being stuck at the Seventh Level of Nirvanic Realm for so many years, it would suddenly break through in the middle of a battle.
This is just like a cat version of Su Wanyi!
The Big Black Cat was extremely excited. Suddenly turning its head, it discovered another tail had grown. This astonishing discovery left it dumbfounded.
It suddenly recalled what the Master had said and hurriedly sensed the mysterious power within its body, only to find that more than half of it had disappeared. The Big Black Cat instantly understood.
This battle had benefited it greatly: a large part of the mysterious power had been digested, its realm had advanced, and most importantly, it had grown another tail. It was a Nine-tailed Spirit Cat. Each additional tail signified a rapid surge in its power.
"Haha, I have an extra tail!" The Big Black Cat was suddenly so excited it got a bit carried away, vigorously wiggling its round, chubby rear and swishing its four tails back and forth.
"Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, I didn’t expect you would also break through." The middle-aged man looked at the great demon before him, a grave expression in his eyes. After all, in life, he was an unparalleled powerhouse; this Ancient Hero form was merely condensed from his remnant consciousness using his surviving will. His current consciousness had inherited few memories. But he still recognized the great demon before him as the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat.
"Not injured enough yet?" The Big Black Cat licked a wound on its paw, its mouth filling with blood. It lifted its gaze to the man in green battle armor opposite it, its two enormous cat eyes once again glowing green.
The injuries it sustained this time were far less severe than those inflicted by the Howling Sky Silver Wolf.
Therefore, the Big Black Cat worried that the anticipated reward might be in jeopardy. With this thought in mind,
it charged ferociously towards the man, attacking with desperate recklessness.
In the Big Black Cat’s mind, it either had to kill the man completely, without needing Uncle Ma to intervene, or it had to sustain more severe injuries to earn its master’s reward. For the sake of the reward, the Big Black Cat was truly giving its all.
Ye Yun observed the Big Black Cat’s performance and nodded slightly.
After all, it was a pet he had adopted along the way. If it wasn’t even willing to risk its life, what use would such a pet be to him? Fortunately, the Big Black Cat didn’t disappoint him. Not only was it extremely desperate in battle, but it was also quite amusing in its usual demeanor. It and the Big Black Horse made a good pair.
Ye Yun then shifted his gaze in another direction.
「Deep underground, tens of thousands of meters below.」
A silver coffin floated quietly within the Mysterious Yin Spirit Vein, slowly absorbing the Spiritual Energy from it. On the coffin, faint traces of lingering blood qi could be seen. That blood qi was precisely from Gongsun Li’s flesh and blood. The pile of flesh and blood that disappeared from Gongsun Li’s secret chamber had been stealthily absorbed by the being inside this coffin.
Ye Yun smiled faintly.
The being inside the coffin is almost ready to emerge. I just don’t know if it will have the courage to do so. In contrast, this Ancient Hero on the surface, who had been one of that being’s pawns, was now out of control and no longer obeyed its commands.
Interesting...
Ye Yun mused, his hands behind his back, watching the battle above with keen interest.
One was an Ancient Hero, the other a ten-thousand-year-old Corpse Demon. Both these entities had their own foundations; it would be difficult for either to control the other. Especially this Ancient Hero, a Life-Death Realm Powerhouse from 120,000 years ago, was at least one Major Realm stronger than the Corpse Demon’s previous incarnation.
So, Ye Yun was waiting with anticipation to see how the upcoming drama would unfold.
RUMBLE!
The intense battle was nearing its end. The Big Black Cat, employing a reckless, all-out fighting style, was covered in injuries, while the man’s body had become almost completely ethereal. It seemed he had lost the ability to fight on.
Just then—
BOOM!
The entire Ancient Relic suddenly trembled, as if some colossal entity underground had abruptly turned over.

chapters.title: Chapter 80: The Heroic Spirit is Defeated, The Thousand-Year Corpse Demon Emerges
chapters.content:
Chapter 80: Chapter 80: The Heroic Spirit is Defeated, The Thousand-Year Corpse Demon Emerges
"What happened?"
Dragon Qing stabilized himself and cast his Divine Sense towards the earth, but it returned without success, discovering no clues whatsoever.
"Master, what’s going on?" Dragon Qing finally asked Ye Yun helplessly.
"Don’t worry, just watch patiently," Ye Yun replied with a calm smile.
Dragon Qing’s cultivation base was not high enough, preventing him from seeing the Silver Coffin deep within the Mysterious Yin Spirit Vein.
Seeing that the Master wasn’t telling him, Dragon Qing could only smile bitterly, restraining his impatience as he looked at the Ancient Hero in the distance.
「In mid-air」
The specter-like figure of the man in teal Battle Armor suddenly spun like a whirlwind. It transformed into a beam of teal light that dove into the ground beneath, disappearing without a hint.
He actually escaped?
The Big Black Cat was nonplussed as its rival suddenly vanished.
It hurriedly sent its Divine Sense into the earth to search but was surprised to find that its opponent had completely vanished. This left it feeling utterly deflated. It originally wanted to eliminate this man clad in teal Battle Armor in one go, but who would have thought... he eventually escaped.
The Big Black Cat swiftly shrunk itself, turning into a streak of black light that fell to Ye Yun’s feet. Dropping to its knees, it sobbed, "Master, I didn’t mean to let him escape!"
"I know. You can go back first," Ye Yun said with a faint smile, waved his large sleeve, and the Big Black Cat vanished.
So, this Wushang Demon Cat was also raised by the Master.
Recognition dawned on Dragon Qing, and his face showed sudden understanding. He suddenly felt useless.
The cat raised by the Master is so much stronger than me.
Ye Yun stood with his hands behind his back, his expression calm, his gaze penetrating through the ages as he observed the changes happening within the Mysterious Yin Spirit Vein underground.
At this moment, the Ancient Hero had already entered the Mysterious Yin Spirit Vein and was rapidly approaching the Silver Coffin.
Meanwhile, the Silver Coffin released billowing gray smoke, attacking the Ancient Hero.
The Ancient Hero performed some Secret Technique and astonishingly broke through the obstructing gray smoke, diving headfirst into the Silver Coffin.
Then, the Coffin began to tremble.
"So you’re not a fool!" a roar of rage emanated from inside the Coffin.
The ten-thousand-year-old Corpse Demon lying within the Coffin trembled violently, as if an external force had invaded its body.
Seeing this, Ye Yun silently nodded.
So, this Ancient Hero has been hiding his true self all along; he had actually obtained quite a few memory inheritances. He had always been disguising himself. Earlier, he willingly let this ten-thousand-year-old Corpse Demon manipulate him. He performed all kinds of tricks in the Ancient Relic, successfully implanting the Heart Demon in the Multicolored Dragon Carp’s clan members. All of this was the machination of the ten-thousand-year-old Corpse Demon behind the scenes. This Corpse Demon ultimately wanted to devour the Ancient Hero to enhance his divine skill and break through to the Destiny Realm in one fell swoop. A Corpse Demon of the Destiny Realm could then dominate the world, becoming nearly invincible, undying and imperishable.
However, this ten-thousand-year-old Corpse Demon also miscalculated. This Ancient Hero, skilled in calculation, had also been disguising himself; even I hadn’t seen through it. In my calculations, the ten-thousand-year-old Corpse Demon should be on the verge of emerging. After it does, it could devour the Ancient Hero—this pawn—to break through to the Destiny Realm.
Ye Yun sighed softly.
This Ancient Hero is also one of those who feign foolishness while being wise, managing to endure the ten-thousand-year-old Corpse Demon for so long. However, defeating the ten-thousand-year-old Corpse Demon will still be immensely difficult. After all, that creature has been scheming all along. It had chosen its burial spot while still alive and, right before death, buried itself within the Mysterious Yin Spirit Vein, even if its soul was annihilated. However, if this body could successfully transform into a Corpse Demon, it might even recover some residual memories from its past life. In a way, it would be a form of continued existence in this world.
One could say that both the ten-thousand-year-old Corpse Demon and the Ancient Hero were once deceased individuals. These two entities, neither human nor ghost, had been pitting their wits against each other for so many years, and the moment of truth was now at hand.
BUZZ! BUZZ!
The Silver Coffin vibrated violently.
Inside the ten-thousand-year-old Corpse Demon, two forces collided fiercely, each vying for control of the body.
A layer of green qi appeared on the Corpse Demon’s body, indicating that the Ancient Hero was momentarily gaining the upper hand.
The next moment, the green qi vanished, replaced by a layer of gray-white qi.
This continued, alternating back and forth, for roughly the time it takes an incense stick to burn.
Finally, the gray-white qi completely overcame the green qi, reclaiming control of the body.
WHOOSH!
This ten-thousand-year-old Corpse Demon suddenly opened its eyes. It exhaled a fierce gust of wind, sending the silver lid of the Coffin flying.
Then he sat up. He completely devoured the Super Divine Dragon Breath of that Ancient Hero, and his strength began to skyrocket. Spiritual Energy from deep within the Mysterious Yin Spirit Vein surged and was absorbed into his body.
"Destiny Realm, open!"
His Super Divine Dragon Breath grew stronger and stronger. The Corpse Demon roared fiercely. The Silver Coffin instantly shattered, and he advanced from the Nirvana Realm Tenth Level Peak to the Destiny Realm in that moment!
He absorbed all the Spiritual Energy in the Mysterious Yin Spirit Vein, leaving it completely empty.
The Corpse Demon stood underground, looking around, a maniacal smile spreading across his face. He was clad in a gray-white robe and possessed a towering figure. His skin had a greenish-black hue, and his two eyes were blood-red, making him look extremely eerie. The nails on his ten fingers were long, white, and gleamed with a silver luster. His hair was disheveled, and a ferocious expression was on his face.
"Li Guding, you almost took my body! You are truly patient!" the Corpse Demon said. Looking up towards the area above him, his eyes suddenly filled with fanaticism.
He muttered to himself, "These Five-Colored Dragon Carps, I’ve nurtured them for so long. If I eat them all now, my cultivation base will surely rise again!"
Saying this, he shook his body violently, transformed into a gray mist, and rapidly rushed towards the surface.
Spider web-like fractures appeared on the square, and a grayish mist gushed out from them. The mist reformed in the air into a tall Corpse Demon.
Dragon Qing watched all this, dumbfounded. He could, of course, tell that the old man with greenish-black skin and Blood Eyes was a Corpse Demon. And this Corpse Demon’s cultivation level was too high! It had actually reached the Destiny Realm!
Dragon Qing had lived in this underwater ruin for decades but never knew that a Destiny Realm Corpse Demon was hidden beneath.
My blood runs cold,
Dragon Qing thought.
Previously, I thought this Ancient Relic was very safe. But I never expected that, after the trouble caused by the Ancient Hero, a ten-thousand-year-old Corpse Demon was also buried deep underground. This place is truly bizarre. If the Master hadn’t suddenly appeared, the entire Five-Colored Dragon Carp clan would probably have been annihilated here.
The Corpse Demon glanced at Dragon Qing, paying him no mind, and fixed his gaze on the dozens of Five-Colored Dragon Carp Clan Members in the square. These people were closest to him. The Five-Colored Dragon Carp Clan Members were full of vitality. The sweet scent of their vigorous blood and qi was tempting, making him eager to devour these Five-Colored Dragon Carps. As for the Level Two Nirvana Realm Five-Colored Dragon Carp in the distance, it was naturally also his for the taking. He would first eat these Divine Bridge Realm Five-Colored Dragon Carps, and then he would eat that Level Two Nirvana Realm Five-Colored Dragon Carp.
As for Ye Yun, standing to the side, he completely ignored him.

chapters.title: Chapter 81: Destroy the Corpse Demon, Adopt the Descendants of Dragon Lake
chapters.content:
Chapter 81: Chapter 81: Destroy the Corpse Demon, Adopt the Descendants of Dragon Lake
Perhaps it’s because he had been lying in the coffin for too long.
The new consciousness born within the 10,000-year-old Corpse Demon’s body varied greatly from his previous life. This explained why, when he looked at Ye Yun, he judged his cultivation base solely on his Super Divine Dragon Breath. In the Corpse Demon’s eyes, Ye Yun seemed to have no cultivation base, so he was disregarded at the time.
Ye Yun smiled faintly.
This fellow’s consciousness, having been reborn from the corpse, is vastly different from that of a normal human. Most of the time, his body is driven by ferocious instinct.
The Corpse Demon cast his gaze downward. On the square, a group of the Five-Colored Dragon Carp clan members knelt, their bodies covered with a thin layer of ice. They looked fresh, sweet, and delectable.
He licked his lips.
These Five-Colored Dragon Carp had been kept for so long. They had not only provided the Ancient Heroes with embryos for nurturing the Mysterious Yin Demon Seed, but their own vital energy hadn’t diminished much either. Now, they were about to become his great nourishment, enough to allow him to break through to the Destiny Realm Second Layer at least.
He reached out a hand, intending to grab and eat one of the Five-Colored Dragon Carp.
Suddenly, his hand stopped mid-air.
The Corpse Demon stared wide-eyed. He discovered a mysterious Big Black Horse had appeared out of nowhere, floating opposite him.
"Boy, you’re pretty arrogant, huh?"
The Big Black Horse smacked his lips, revealing a set of white teeth in a brilliant smile. He sniffed with his nose, then huffed irritably, "Damn it, you stink!"
The Big Black Cat, lying on the distant carriage, heard these familiar words. He stretched his neck and burst out laughing, "Yes, yes! Uncle Ma has spoken! You’d better go take a bath, quick!"
The Big Black Horse laughed heartily. He seemed to recall that scene from the past in the misty valley when he had sent the Big Black Cat flying into the pool with a single kick of his hoof.
Ye Yun smiled.
This Big Black Horse is very fond of cleanliness. And the foul stench emanating from this 10,000-year-old Corpse Demon is truly unbearable for him.
"You’re looking for death!"
Although the 10,000-year-old Corpse Demon wasn’t very bright, he still sensed the Big Black Horse’s ridicule. He thrust out his hand, clawing towards the Big Black Horse. His long fingernails, shimmering with a sharp glint, were like peerless Divine Weapons at this moment.
"You’re too weak!"
The Big Black Horse sneered, and a blue bolt of lightning spat from his mouth. This bolt of lightning, moving too fast to react, struck the 10,000-year-old Corpse Demon’s hand.
BOOM!
Half of the Corpse Demon’s arm instantly exploded.
He was instantly terrified, paling as he retreated continuously, his body trembling uncontrollably. That blue bolt of lightning moments ago had made him feel an unimaginable destructive will. It seemed as if, at that moment, he was facing a Heavenly Tribulation.
ZAP!
The Big Black Horse opened his mouth, and another blue bolt of lightning shot out. The 10,000-year-old Corpse Demon turned and fled. But how could he possibly escape this blue lightning? This bolt was even fiercer than the last. It struck the Corpse Demon’s body and exploded with a deafening roar, instantly blasting him to smithereens.
Dragon Qing stared, flabbergasted.
What is the Big Black Horse’s cultivation base? He’s too strong, isn’t he? The Big Black Cat earlier already gave me a huge shock, but this Big Black Horse... he’s left me completely dumbstruck! A Corpse Demon of the Destiny Realm possesses an unimaginably tough physical body. Yet, just two bolts of lightning spat out by the Big Black Horse completely obliterated it. It’s clear just how high the Big Black Horse’s cultivation base is!
The Big Black Horse wagged his tail, transformed into a streak of black light, and returned to the carriage, fastening the reins to himself again.
"That’s Uncle Ma for you! Just by opening his mouth, the 10,000-year-old Corpse Demon was reduced to ashes!" the Big Black Cat said, cupping his paws in a salute with a fawning expression.
"Enough with the flattery!" the Big Black Horse grumbled, feigning nonchalance.
A mere Destiny Realm Corpse Demon. Nothing more than an ant before me, easily crushed. On this continent, apart from the Eternal Mirror, which I can’t easily crush, everything else is fair game.
Ye Yun waved his hand. The thin layer of ice covering the Five-Colored Dragon Carp clan members on the square instantly vanished. They became fully conscious.
"What just happened?"
They exchanged bewildered glances, seemingly still unaware of the events that had just transpired around them.
Little Sixth, the young boy from behind Dragon Qing, rushed over and hurriedly recounted the two harrowing battles that had just occurred. Upon hearing his account, everyone’s expression changed dramatically, and cold sweat broke out on their bodies.
To think that while we were in a daze, we hovered at death’s door twice and nearly lost our lives!
The young boy led the clan members before Ye Yun, and they all knelt.
"Thank you, Sir, for saving our lives!" they exclaimed, their expressions fervent, tears of gratitude streaming down their faces.
Ye Yun gently waved his hand, and a current of Mana lifted the Five-Colored Dragon Carp clan members.
"You don’t need to stay here any longer. Pack your things and gather back here."
Ye Yun looked at Dragon Qing and said calmly.
"Yes, Sir!" Dragon Qing replied respectfully. He waved to the clan members, and they all instantly vanished from the spot.
「A short while later.」
Everyone had reassembled at the same spot.
Ye Yun looked at the crowd and slowly began to speak.
"You are the descendants of the Five-Colored Dragon Carp from Dragon Lake of the Dragon God Sect. The Dragon God Sect will be rebuilt, and Dragon Lake will also be restored. So, for now..."
Reaching this point, Ye Yun took out a small white bottle. He smiled faintly and said, "This bottle contains a world of its own, with a vast ocean inside. You may rest and recuperate there for the time being!"
"Thank you, Sir!"
Hearing that their master would allow them to return to their ancestral home, Dragon Lake, Dragon Qing was overcome with emotion, old tears streaming down his face as he sobbed uncontrollably. Seeing their old Clan Leader cry, the other Five-Colored Dragon Carp clan members also covered their faces and wept.
WHOOSH...
Ye Yun raised the small bottle. It generated a suction force, instantly pulling all the Five-Colored Dragon Carp inside.
After stowing the bottle away, he looked at the ruins in the water and blew a gentle breath. Instantly, the massive Great Mysterious Gate Ruins completely disintegrated into fine particles and vanished.
Since his rebirth, Ye Yun had mastered countless Divine Techniques and Cultivation Techniques. The rewards related to Cultivation Techniques, gathered over one hundred thousand years of sign-ins, filled an entire warehouse, yet Ye Yun had only learned a tiny fraction of them.
Since leaving the ruins of the Dragon God Sect in the Shenfeng Dynasty, he had been constantly cultivating and seeking enlightenment in his carriage along the way. His current cultivation base was now only a single step away from the True God Realm Tenth Layer.
Ye Yun appeared on the carriage. His brow smoothed as he looked at the Big Black Cat, who was covered in wounds and lying pitifully on the carriage.
The Big Black Cat gave an embarrassed smile.
Although I really want a reward from the Master, I don’t dare ask for it.
"Little Cat, you performed well this time!"
Ye Yun raised his hand, and a black cloth pouch landed in front of the Big Black Cat. He then lifted the carriage curtain and entered the compartment.
The Big Black Cat’s expression was ecstatic. With trembling paws, he picked up the black cloth pouch and carefully opened it.
"This is...?"
When the Big Black Cat saw the contents of the pouch, his eyes rolled back, and he fainted from sheer excitement.

chapters.title: Chapter 82 - Sword King Stone, Two Sword Marks
chapters.content:
Chapter 82: Chapter 82 - Sword King Stone, Two Sword Marks
Shenfeng Dynasty, Ancient Elephant Country.
Beside a rapidly flowing river, a black carriage proceeded slowly along an ancient road. Luo Li and Jun Moxiao sat near the front of the carriage. Inside, their Eldest Senior Sister, Su Wanyi, was absorbing the Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood.
"Old Ancestor, I estimate we’ll be out of the Ancient Elephant Country in less than three days," Jun Moxiao said, holding a map and observing the surrounding terrain. This map, obtained from the storage rings of the Yu Mo Sect disciples, was quite complete, covering the geography and culture of the entire Shenfeng Dynasty.
"Mm," Ye Yun acknowledged with a slight nod, his eyes still closed. Ever since leaving the Canglan River, Ye Yun had been comprehending a supreme divine skill and was now approaching a state of mastery. His cultivation base had also surged, breaking into the True God Realm Tenth Layer. His next step was to break through to the Divine Monarch Realm. Ye Yun wasn’t consciously cultivating, yet his strength was still escalating at a terrifying speed.
The carriage pressed on slowly.
SWISH, SWISH... Figures continuously flew on swords high in the sky, streaking across like beams of light.
At first, Jun Moxiao and Luo Li paid little attention. However, they soon noticed more and more people rushing hastily in the same direction.
"Senior Sister, could some treasure have appeared up ahead?" Jun Moxiao turned his head to ask Luo Li.
Luo Li laughed. "Possibly. What else would cause such a crowd?"
"You two should go and check it out..." the Old Ancestor’s voice suddenly came from within the carriage.
Ye Yun had long seen what was happening up ahead, a faint, painful regret flickered deep in his eyes.
"Thank you, Old Ancestor!" Jun Moxiao and Luo Li promptly rose, bid farewell to the Old Ancestor, and soared into the sky, flying on their swords towards the southeast.
The black carriage continued slowly along the riverbank. Ye Yun let out a soft sigh.
Some things from a hundred thousand years ago, suddenly reappearing before him, still pained his heart.
He slowly stepped out of the carriage and sat beside the Big Black Cat, silently gazing at the rushing river, lost in thought. As the river surged, his vision blurred, as if he had returned to that time one hundred thousand years ago.
"Little Junior Brother, look! There are so many people gathered in the distance," Luo Li called out as they flew. She gazed into the distance and saw a massive cliff, with a large crowd already gathered at its base.
"Does it seem like there’s really a treasure?" Jun Moxiao grew excited. The Old Ancestor had sent them here for training and likely also intended for them to seize any opportunities for treasure. Although the treasures might not be extraordinary, they were certainly better than nothing. They needed to accumulate more resources for the future reconstruction of the Dragon God Sect.
"Are you two also heading to the Sword King Stone?" a voice suddenly asked from nearby.
Luo Li turned to see a young man in red robes.
"’You could say that,’ Luo Li nodded, feeling a bit uncertain.
The Sword King Stone... What is it?
"
Jun Moxiao noticed his senior sister’s hesitance and turned to the young man. "Friend, we’re from out of town and aren’t familiar with this place. Could you tell us what exactly the Sword King Stone is?"
"So, you’re from out of town." The young man’s face lit with understanding. He laughed and said, "The Sword King Stone is a relic from ancient times. It’s said that two Life-Death Realm Powerhouses left two sword impressions, filled with Wushang Sword Intent, on a great stone. Legend has it that if one can comprehend its secrets, their swordsmanship will improve significantly. With luck, one might even obtain a set of peerless sword techniques!"
"So, these sword marks were left by Life-Death Realm Powerhouses..." Jun Moxiao nodded, a flicker of disappointment in his eyes.
He had assumed some incredible treasure was about to appear. So, it wasn’t that after all.
However, these two sword marks are still quite remarkable. If I could comprehend them, I might even gain a set of peerless sword techniques by chance.
Thinking this, Jun Moxiao felt a stir of excitement.
"The Sword King Stone appears in the world only once every ten years, and you’ve both arrived right on time," the young man said, touching his brow and chuckling again.
"Our luck is incredible!" Jun Moxiao exclaimed, scratching his head. He looked at the young man and cupped his fists. "Thank you for clearing that up for us!"
"You’re welcome. We are all fellow cultivators. My name is Li Shaobai. May I ask your names?" Li Shaobai asked courteously, looking at the young man and woman before him. He was particularly polite because their cultivation bases were a realm higher than his. He was at the tenth layer of the Origin Sea Realm, while they were already at the Shaping God Realm.
Since leaving the Canglan River, Ye Yun had once again suppressed Luo Li’s and Jun Moxiao’s cultivation bases to the Shaping God Realm. Their training had to continue. Especially in the Shenfeng Dynasty, they would face even stronger opponents. Thus, it was not yet suitable for them to travel at the Divine Bridge Realm.
"I am Jun Moxiao."
"Luo Li."
Jun Moxiao and Luo Li introduced themselves. Since no one in the Shenfeng Dynasty knew them, and with the Old Ancestor backing them, revealing their identities didn’t seem to matter.
After getting acquainted, the three traveled together and soon arrived near the cliff. Two intersecting sword marks were carved into the middle of the cliff, stretching from top to bottom, spanning its entire face.
"What powerful Sword Intent!" Jun Moxiao’s pupils constricted as he gazed at the massive sword marks. Even though the sword marks were several hundred zhang away, he could still feel the astonishing Sword Intent radiating from them. It struck him, creating an almost irresistible pressure.
"Quick, we need to land! We can’t fly any further," Li Shaobai urged, pulling Jun Moxiao down towards the ground. "Otherwise, the powerful Sword Intent will suppress and kill us!" Luo Li followed them, landing as well.
Opposite the Sword King Stone was a vast, flat area where thousands of people had already gathered. They stood or sat in various postures, all intently staring at the two sword marks. The three of them had arrived a bit late; the positions at the front were all taken, so they could only stand at the back.
"This flat area is called Enlightenment Square," Li Shaobai said with a smile, pointing to the ground beneath their feet. "Over tens of thousands of years, countless cultivators have successfully comprehended the Wushang Sword Dao here and become renowned masters!"
Jun Moxiao laughed heartily. "Haha, let’s hope we gain something too!"
Luo Li glanced around and noticed that most of the cultivators on Enlightenment Square were at the Shaping God Realm or Origin Sea Realm. There wasn’t a single Divine Bridge Realm expert in sight. A puzzled look appeared on her face.
Li Shaobai glanced at Luo Li and explained with a smile, "The Sword King Stone has been passed down from ancient times. The prowess of the two sword marks has weakened considerably over such a long time. They now hold virtually no reference value for Divine Bridge Realm powerhouses. Consequently, for the past several hundred years, no experts from that realm have come to participate."
"I see. Thank you for the explanation, Senior Brother Li," Luo Li said with a slight smile.
WHOOSH!
Just then, the sound of objects tearing through the air was heard. Dozens of sword lights suddenly flew over from the distance and landed. The light dissipated, revealing several dozen young men in black robes. Upon their appearance, everyone nearby instinctively made way for them.
The leading young man snorted coldly, his gaze sweeping contemptuously over the crowd. He strode to the lead, heading for the foremost position on Enlightenment Square.

chapters.title: Chapter 83: Challenge the Shaoyang Sword Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 83: Chapter 83: Challenge the Shaoyang Sword Sect
"This kid is pretty arrogant!"
Jun Moxiao stared at the young man’s retreating figure, his eyes narrowing slightly as he let out a disgruntled huff.
Everyone else was lining up, but this young man had decided to throw his weight around. On one hand, he had numbers on his side; on the other, his cultivation base had reached the Molding God Realm Tenth Layer. Among the thousands in the square, his cultivation was at an elite level. After all, there was no one here at the Divine Bridge Realm.
Upon hearing Jun Moxiao’s words, Li Shaobai looked forward and let out a wry smile, saying, "This is an unwritten rule on Enlightenment Square. The stronger one is, the better their position for enlightenment... That guy is Lin Ye, a Disciple of Heaven’s Pride from the Shaoyang Sword Sect. He’s very powerful, and most people wouldn’t dare to offend them."
Jun Moxiao furrowed his brows and scoffed, "Aren’t there three major sects in the Shenfeng Dynasty? Don’t tell me that disciples from those three major sects don’t dare to offend them?"
"The three major sects won’t come." Li Shaobai shook his head with a smile. "Their own legacies are extremely powerful. They used to come here thousands of years ago, but after the sword marks on the Sword King Stone began to fade, they stopped."
"Why is that? Don’t these three major sects have disciples in the Origin Sea Realm and the Shaping God Realm?" Jun Moxiao asked, raising an eyebrow.
Li Shaobai explained with a smile, "Well, the people from the three major sects are mindful of their sect’s reputation. They wouldn’t send their disciples to compete with those second and third-rate sects and powers for these enlightenment opportunities."
"I see." Jun Moxiao nodded silently.
The three major sects...
He had already crossed blades with a Disciple of Heaven’s Pride from the Yu Mo Sect. The opponent was indeed very strong, but not overwhelmingly so.
At least, he and Senior Sister Luo Li could kill him using the Reverse Dragon Technique.
Jun Moxiao glanced at Luo Li.
A hint of wildness flickered in Luo Li’s eyes as she said cheerfully, "Junior Brother, shall we charge up too?"
"Alright, Senior Sister. That’s precisely what I was thinking." A domineering glint flashed in Jun Moxiao’s eyes.
This Senior Sister and Junior Brother duo, from their beginnings in the Ancient Moon Dynasty to their journey in the Shenfeng Dynasty, had always been perfectly in sync. At this moment, too, they understood each other perfectly.
"What are you two trying to do? Are you also planning to rush forward and snatch a spot?" Li Shaobai was dumbfounded.
These two were merely at the Shaping God Realm First Level.
Aren’t they seeking death by rushing up there?
Jun Moxiao patted Li Shaobai’s shoulder, gave a mysterious smile, and then strode boldly towards the front.
"Make way!"
Jun Moxiao drew the Chaos Element Unlimited Sword from his back and led the charge. If anyone blocked his path, he simply tapped them lightly with the flat of his blade. The people standing further back were all at the Origin Sea Realm. So, a light tap from his sword was more than they could handle, sending them stumbling backward. Jun Moxiao’s sword moved like the wind. As he advanced, an unknown number of people were sent flying by his Divine Sword.
Luo Li followed closely, her own sword in hand, vigilantly scanning their surroundings. If anyone dared to attack Jun Moxiao, she would unsheathe her sword without hesitation.
With imposing momentum, the two of them quickly broke through the crowd and advanced rapidly.
Li Shaobai’s eyes widened as he watched this scene in shocked disbelief.
Suddenly, an idea struck him. He quickly darted forward, following them before the crowd could close ranks again.
These two young people from out of town were uncommonly strong!
Since he knew them, why not take advantage of this opportunity to slip through to the front in the confusion?
The closer one was to the Sword King Stone, the more astonishing the Sword Intent emanating from the sword marks, and the better the results of comprehension. That was why, in the entire Enlightenment Square, those seated at the very front were typically from the most powerful factions or were the cultivators with the highest cultivation bases.
The entire crowd was in an uproar.
Initially, Jun Moxiao and Luo Li were able to advance quickly. After all, they were at the Shaping God Realm, so cultivators of the Origin Sea Realm dared not provoke them.
But by the time they reached the halfway point, they began to encounter cultivators at the Shaping God Realm. Seeing that the pair’s cultivation level wasn’t high and that they were unfamiliar faces, these cultivators attacked without reservation.
But why would Luo Li and Jun Moxiao pay any mind to these cultivators at the first, second, or third level of the Shaping God Realm?
SWISH! SWISH!
They unleashed their swordsmanship, and waves of sword light swept towards their opponents, instantly sending them sprawling in disarray.
Seeing this young man and woman bulldozing their way through with such formidable strength, many people, for a moment, dared not provoke them.
After a short while, Jun Moxiao had fought his way to the very front.
The foremost area of Enlightenment Square was divided into several hundred sections, occupied by perhaps over a hundred different powers. Of course, some cultivators came alone; due to their high cultivation levels, others generally dared not provoke them.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao headed straight for the area occupied by the Shaoyang Sword Sect.
All eyes converged on this spot. They hadn’t expected this young man and woman to actually target the Shaoyang Sword Sect.
The others watched from the sidelines with mixed expressions. After all, this pair hadn’t encroached on their territory. Moreover, there were only two of them; they didn’t need much space.
"Make way! We’re taking this spot!" Jun Moxiao squeezed to the front, pointing his sword at the prodigious young disciple of the Shaoyang Sword Sect. His eyebrows were raised, his gaze dominant, and his expression utterly arrogant, as if he were deliberately mirroring the previous behavior of the Shaoyang Sword Sect’s prodigious disciple.
Li Shaobai scurried over from behind and stood behind Jun Moxiao, whispering, "Brother, they have superior numbers. Maybe we should let it go and find a weaker group..."
Jun Moxiao shook his head coolly.
He found the Shaoyang Sword Sect’s bullying behavior extremely distasteful and decided to use this opportunity to teach them a lesson, while also securing a good spot for himself.
With a WHOOSH, the entire group from the Shaoyang Sword Sect surged forward, surrounding them and pointing their swords at Jun Moxiao.
The young disciple looked at Jun Moxiao and said coldly, "You two look unfamiliar; you must be from outside. Haven’t you heard the great name of our Shaoyang Sword Sect?"
"Never heard of it!" Jun Moxiao shook his head indifferently. He pointed his sword at the young man and said disdainfully, "We’re taking this spot! If you’re not convinced, let’s settle it with our skills!"
Lin Ye was both incensed and amused.
He couldn’t believe that anyone in the Shenfeng Dynasty would dare to be so rude to their Shaoyang Sword Sect.
Especially two mere Shaping God Realm First Level cultivators.
"Fine, then I’ll play with you!" Lin Ye stepped forward slowly, sword in hand, emanating a powerful Super Divine Dragon Breath of the Molding God Realm Tenth Layer.
Seeing that a battle was imminent, everyone around craned their necks to watch.
As the saying goes, even a mighty dragon cannot suppress a local snake. This unfamiliar young man and woman were actually challenging a top Disciple of Heaven’s Pride from the Shaoyang Sword Sect, a top-tier sect in the Shenfeng Dynasty.
Truly, they were like newborn calves, unafraid of tigers.
Although the Shaoyang Sword Sect couldn’t compare to the three major sects, it was still an exceptionally powerful sect. Lin Ye was ranked among the top twenty on the Shaping God Realm’s List of Disciples of Heaven’s Pride. Moreover, his cultivation was nine minor realms higher than the young man from out of town. He held every advantage, whether it was favorable timing, geographical advantage, or popular support.
For a moment, the surrounding onlookers burst into discussion, and almost no one favored Jun Moxiao.

chapters.title: Chapter 84: Lin Ye Loses, 1 Sword Lotus
chapters.content:
Chapter 84: Chapter 84: Lin Ye Loses, 1 Sword Lotus
"These two outsiders are really foolish. At the Shaping God Realm First Level, they dare to challenge someone at the Molding God Realm Tenth Layer? They’ve clearly lost their minds!"
"Lin Ye of the Shaoyang Sword Sect is one of the top twenty prodigies on the Shaping God List. He has few rivals at his cultivation level—the Molding God Realm Tenth Layer—so what chance does an opponent nine minor realms below him stand?"
"That outsider youth will definitely lose!"
"..."
Discussions erupted all around; not a single person favored Jun Moxiao.
This included Li Shaobai, who stood behind Jun Moxiao, his lips pressed tightly together, unsure of what to say.
The Shaoyang Sword Sect was simply too strong; he didn’t think Jun Moxiao’s actions were wise.
If he failed, he would likely become everyone’s laughingstock.
Jun Moxiao slowly took two steps forward, pointed his sword at Lin Ye, and said with a calm smile, "Come on, let me see what you’re capable of."
Lin Ye also stepped forward, a mocking glint in his eyes, as if he were looking at a fool.
Without a word, he thrust his sword toward Jun Moxiao.
The sword strike was as fast as lightning; those with a weak cultivation base barely saw the flash of the blade.
Jun Moxiao reacted extremely quickly, his body abruptly vanishing from its original spot.
The next moment, he reappeared tens of feet away and activated the Dragon God Sword Technique.
A giant, golden Divine Dragon Phantom materialized behind him.
This gave Jun Moxiao an imposing aura.
However, it was met with ridicule from the onlookers.
"This swordsmanship looks intimidating, but it’s a pity it’s useless. It definitely can’t beat Lin Ye of the Shaoyang Sword Sect!"
The crowd immediately burst into uproarious laughter.
When Lin Ye saw that his sword strike had missed Jun Moxiao, he was momentarily stunned.
It seemed this fellow before him was no ordinary Shaping God Realm First Level cultivator; he actually had some hidden depth.
WHOOSH!
His entire body instantly erupted in a raging inferno as he unleashed the Shaoyang Sword Sect’s Shaoyang Burning Sky Sword.
This was a Fire-attribute swordsmanship. Once executed, it would envelop a hundred-meter radius in raging flames, its power immense.
An unending torrent of sword light filled the air, and in an instant, a sea of blazing fire ignited all around.
PFFT!
Jun Moxiao cleaved through the wall of fire with a single sword strike and strode forward.
At that moment, he resembled a supreme god of slaughter. Several Divine Dragons emerged from his sword, roaring as they charged toward Lin Ye.
This guy is really strong!
Lin Ye was greatly startled. His Shaoyang Burning Sky Sword had been broken with a single strike! It seemed the opponent’s true combat strength was no weaker than his own.
"Three Thousand Burning Sky!"
Lin Ye roared furiously and unleashed the most powerful technique of the Shaoyang Burning Sky Sword.
Instantly, three thousand sword beams, all burning with flames, crashed into the Divine Dragons.
The collision produced a deafening RUMBLE.
The shockwave from the battle, carrying fiery sparks, blasted outwards, startling the nearby cultivators who scrambled to defend themselves.
Both the sword beams and the Divine Dragons vanished simultaneously.
Seeing this, a frosty sneer touched Jun Moxiao’s lips.
This Lin Ye of the Shaoyang Sword Sect does have some skill, but regrettably, he’s still not my match.
With this thought, Jun Moxiao strode through the flames, ascending like a deity wreathed in fire.
SWISH!
With a single downward slash of his sword, hundreds of Divine Dragon Phantoms flew out.
"ROAR!"
These ferocious Divine Dragons roared and charged toward Lin Ye.
Seeing the immense power of this attack, Lin Ye grew flustered. With no other choice, he hastily unleashed his strongest sword technique once more.
But this time, he wasn’t so lucky.
His sword technique was instantly shattered by the Divine Dragons.
The Divine Dragons roared furiously and charged savagely at Lin Ye.
At this critical moment, his fellow sect members standing behind Lin Ye simultaneously raised their swords, managing to block the incoming Divine Dragons.
"What? Are you planning to gang up on me now?"
Jun Moxiao stood with his hands clasped behind his back, looking at these disciples of the Shaoyang Sword Sect with a sneer.
Lin Ye was unharmed, but his expression shifted rapidly between pale and flushed. After hesitating for two or three seconds, he waved his hand decisively and said, "We’re leaving."
With that, he led his fellow junior disciples in another direction.
A weaker sect, seeing Lin Ye and his group approach, quickly vacated an area for them.
Lin Ye nodded and settled down there with his junior disciples.
They all sat on the ground, their faces extremely grim.
"Who would have thought this young man was so formidable! His swordsmanship is profound, his combat strength astonishing..."
The onlookers, witnessing Jun Moxiao’s victory, all drew in sharp breaths, their faces etched with shock.
"Junior Brother, well done."
Luo Li chuckled, sheathing his sword.
"Brother Jun, I never expected you to be this strong!"
Li Shaobai took a deep breath, finally recovering from his shock.
Jun Moxiao patted him on the shoulder and said with a grin, "It was alright, I guess."
Within the Sword King Stone Cliff, there was a mysterious space.
This space was concealed by a Formation, so those outside could not see in, but those inside could observe the outside.
A man wearing a silver mask stood at the entrance to this space, his hands clasped behind his back, calmly watching the battle that had just unfolded below.
A few men wearing Bronze Masks stood beside him.
「 」
On Enlightenment Square, the recent commotion quickly subsided.
Although some people had been watching the battle, most were now quietly contemplating the two sword marks on the Sword King Stone.
After all, these two sword marks only appeared for a limited time—just three days.
If one couldn’t gain any insights within these three days, they would have to wait another ten years.
A youth in a blue robe sat at the very front of Enlightenment Square.
Suddenly, a golden lotus materialized above his head.
This lotus, formed entirely of minuscule Sword Qi, hovered and rotated above his head, appearing exceedingly mysterious.
Many people nearby immediately cast envious glances.
It was a Sword Lotus.
From ancient times until now, there had been supreme prodigies who, while contemplating here at the Sword King Stone, had managed to form nine Sword Lotuses.
Later, such a prodigy would go on to become a powerhouse in the Destiny Realm.
"What is that lotus?"
Jun Moxiao was about to begin his own contemplation when he noticed the golden Sword Lotus above the youth’s head. He turned to Li Shaobai and asked,
"That’s a Sword Lotus. One can comprehend up to nine of them at most..."
Li Shaobai explained with a smile, then he too sat down cross-legged, gazed at the two sword marks before him, and slowly closed his eyes.
Jun Moxiao nodded.
He also sat cross-legged, fixed his gaze on the Sword King Stone, and began to contemplate.
Luo Li did likewise.
Although their eyes were closed, the two sword marks seemed to be etched into their minds, radiating an infinite glow and constantly emitting a surging Sword Intent.
If one’s sword heart was not resolute, it would be difficult to persist.
This Sword Intent... it seems somewhat familiar...
At that very moment, both Luo Li and Jun Moxiao experienced this same feeling.
While parts of it felt familiar, other aspects were distinctly unfamiliar.
Especially the Sword Intent emanating from the second sword mark; that felt utterly foreign.
They had only just closed their eyes and begun to contemplate, for less than the time it takes an incense stick to burn, when golden Sword Lotuses materialized above the heads of both Luo Li and Jun Moxiao.
The Novel will be updated first on this website. Come back and continue reading tomorrow, everyone!

chapters.title: Chapter 85: Eight Sword Lotuses, Shocking the Entire Field
chapters.content:
Chapter 85: Chapter 85: Eight Sword Lotuses, Shocking the Entire Field
"These two foreign youngsters are indeed extraordinary; they had comprehended a Sword Lotus in such a short time..."
In the Enlightenment Square.
The cultivators near the distant Yuanhai Mirror watched as Jun Moxiao and Luo Li manifested a golden Sword Lotus above their heads. Envy filled their eyes.
The comprehension time on the Sword King Stone was only three days. Even if one could only comprehend a single Sword Lotus, it would bring immense benefits to their future Sword Dao cultivation.
Amidst the exclamations of the Origin Sea Realm cultivators, golden Sword Lotuses began to constantly manifest above the heads of people in the forefront area of the Enlightenment Square.
The first three Sword Lotuses were not too difficult; any cultivator with a certain talent could comprehend them. Starting from the fourth Sword Lotus, it became increasingly difficult. Most of the powerful Disciples of Heaven’s Pride who generally occupied the front row of the Enlightenment Square could comprehend two or three Sword Lotuses. If they could comprehend four or more, their future breakthroughs in Sword Dao would be astonishing.
「Ten Time Units later.」
Three golden Sword Lotuses appeared above Jun Moxiao’s and Luo Li’s heads. At this point, among the two to three hundred people in the front row, no more than five possessed three golden Sword Lotuses.
Lin Ye of the Shaoyang Sword Sect opened one eye and glanced coldly at Jun Moxiao. Seeing that two people, like himself, also had three Sword Lotuses, he couldn’t help but sneer.
"Senior Brother Lin, keep it up! You are the most outstanding Disciple of Heaven’s Pride in our Shaoyang Sword Sect; you will definitely be able to comprehend six golden Sword Lotuses!" a young man next to him cheered encouragingly.
"Hmm!" Lin Ye closed his eyes and continued his comprehension.
In the past several centuries, anyone who could comprehend six golden Sword Lotuses on the Sword King Stone could rank first. After all, the two sword marks on the Sword King Stone had been passed down from ancient times to the present, and its prowess had already weakened considerably. Thus, Lin Ye’s goal this time was to aim for six golden Sword Lotuses.
「Another five Time Units had passed.」
At this point, silence permeated the surroundings. Dawn had not yet arrived, and the world was plunged into darkness. However, some cultivators took out Luminous Pearls and placed them in front of themselves, bathing the area in light.
WHOOSH!
Above Lin Ye’s head, a fourth Sword Lotus suddenly emerged. He opened his eyes again, his gaze fixed on Jun Moxiao.
The next moment, his eyes widened, a look of utter disbelief on his face.
What?
That fellow has already comprehended his fifth Sword Lotus?
Lin Ye couldn’t believe it. Their progress had initially been neck and neck. Unexpectedly, after the same five Time Units, Jun Moxiao had comprehended his fifth Sword Lotus, while he had only just comprehended his fourth.
Lin Ye scanned the others again and found that nearly ten people had also comprehended five golden Sword Lotuses. This realization instantly put immense pressure on him. Once again, he closed his eyes, immersing himself completely in comprehending Sword Intent.
「After a few more Time Units.」
Lin Ye comprehended his fifth golden Sword Lotus. He opened his eyes and looked at Jun Moxiao again, only to be shocked once more!
Jun Moxiao had actually comprehended seven golden Sword Lotuses!
Damn!
At that moment, Lin Ye was so angry he wanted to curse.
This kid from out of town, how is his talent so astonishing?
His comprehension speed is far too fast, isn’t it?
In the past several centuries, not a single person had managed to comprehend seven golden Sword Lotuses.
When he turned his gaze to the young girl beside Jun Moxiao, his eyes nearly bulged out of their sockets. The incredibly beautiful young girl also had seven golden Sword Lotuses floating above her head. The two of them were perfectly matched, progressing neck and neck; their comprehension speeds were indistinguishable.
Lin Ye glanced at the others again; not one of them had yet comprehended six golden Sword Lotuses. This infuriated him; he couldn’t believe these two outsiders had stolen all the limelight.
At that moment, the seventh golden Sword Lotus above both Jun Moxiao’s and Luo Li’s heads had only just appeared. However, many cultivators had already noticed. Everyone’s expression changed drastically, their shock indescribable.
For five hundred years, no one in the Shenfeng Dynasty had comprehended seven golden Sword Lotuses. And now, just a day and a half had passed. Perhaps these two young cultivators could achieve even greater breakthroughs.
Many Origin Sea Realm cultivators from weaker factions felt a glimmer of anticipation as they watched the two. However, some Divine Bridge Realm cultivators in the front rows glared at Jun Moxiao and Luo Li, their eyes blazing with jealous fury. They were jealous of these two because they were a pair of outsiders who had stolen the limelight from all the sects of the Shenfeng Dynasty.
At this time, Jun Moxiao also opened his eyes. Looking around, he found that apart from Senior Sister Luo Li and himself, the others had reached a maximum of only five golden Sword Lotuses! This made him breathe a sigh of relief. Initially, when comprehending the first three lotuses, his pace had matched everyone else’s. This had filled Jun Moxiao with anxiety, fearing he would be left behind. But now, he and his Senior Sister had left everyone else far behind.
Li Shaobai, sitting beside him, also opened his eyes. He stared at Jun Moxiao in shock and said blankly, "You guys are so strong. Even though the markings on the Sword King Stone have weakened, you could still comprehend seven golden Sword Lotuses. That’s amazing!"
"Brother Li, you’re not bad either..." Jun Moxiao smiled. Li Shaobai had four golden Sword Lotuses floating above his head, placing him significantly ahead of most Origin Sea Realm cultivators.
"Junior brother, don’t get distracted, let’s continue our comprehension!" At this moment, Luo Li, her eyes still closed, sent a telepathic message to Jun Moxiao.
"Alright, Senior Sister!" Jun Moxiao’s expression turned serious. He immediately closed his eyes and continued to comprehend the Sword Intent.
「Several more Time Units passed.」
The sky had brightened. A rising sun ascended in the east, its brilliant golden rays bathing every cultivator in the Enlightenment Square.
"Quick, take a look!"
"That pair of young outsiders—they’ve comprehended their eighth golden Sword Lotus!"
A sharp-eyed cultivator was the first to spot an eighth golden Sword Lotus appearing above both Luo Li’s and Jun Moxiao’s heads.
BUZZ!
This instantly sent a wave of commotion through the crowd. Everyone began to discuss animatedly, their gazes fixed on Jun Moxiao and Luo Li, a mixture of envy, jealousy, and resentment on their faces.
Some cultivators had simply given up comprehending the Sword King Stone. The third day was fast approaching. They had reached their limits; no matter how hard they focused, they couldn’t comprehend another Sword Lotus.
"Damn it, are these two guys even human?" Lin Ye opened his eyes, looking at Jun Moxiao and gritting his teeth as he spoke. He was still on his fifth golden Sword Lotus, a long way from the sixth. He wasn’t even sure if he could make the breakthrough himself.
Lin Ye glanced at those around him. Apart from Luo Li and Jun Moxiao, no one else had managed to comprehend six golden Sword Lotuses.
What a couple of monsters!
Even Lin Ye had to admit at this moment that the pair of outsiders possessed talent in the Sword Dao far superior to his own. Less than three days had passed. Judging by their progress, these two might even challenge the historical record of nine Sword Lotuses.
「Inside that secret space on the Sword King Stone Cliff.」
"Master, those two youngsters are incredible!" a young man wearing a Bronze Mask remarked in awe.
"These two youngsters have unparalleled talent in Sword Dao; they might even have the potential to challenge the ninth Sword Lotus..." the man wearing the Silver mask said, a faint, calm smile in his eyes.
At that moment, he resolved to recruit these two youngsters to his side, no matter the cost.

chapters.title: Chapter 86: Light Shines 3000 Miles Away
chapters.content:
Chapter 86: Chapter 86: Light Shines 3000 Miles Away
By the surging river.
A black carriage remained stationary, with Ye Yun sitting inside, quietly lost in thought as he gazed upon the river water.
He suddenly sensed something and looked in a certain direction.
Eight Sword Lotuses, how could that be enough? At minimum, there must be nine. If there could be ten, that would be even better...
Ye Yun gave a slight smile.
Among the two sword marks, one of them was his own.
As disciples of the Dragon God Sect, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao naturally had an inherent advantage in comprehending Ye Yun’s Sword Dao.
And among the two sword marks, the other one was primarily based on Ye Yun’s sword mark, as if one was the emperor and the other an imperial consort.
A hundred thousand years have passed. The world has changed tremendously, from the Ancient Era until now, some people are no longer present, but there still exist some traces in this world...
Ye Yun lightly sighed, his eyes filled with an air of desolation.
Walking the Great Dao alone.
At this moment, no one could understand the loneliness in Ye Yun’s heart.
Perhaps only continuous Cultivation and growing stronger could alleviate this loneliness.
He gently closed his eyes.
「On the third day, at noon.」
Under the gaze of the crowd, two golden Sword Lotuses once again appeared above the heads of Jun Moxiao and Luo Li.
"Impossible! What kind of monsters are these two? They can simultaneously comprehend the ninth golden Sword Lotus?"
"This is unbelievable! For five hundred years, the prowess of the two sword marks has been declining severely. Yet, these two foreign youngsters could comprehend nine golden Sword Lotuses. This is beyond imagination!"
"If only our Shenfeng Dynasty had Cultivators like them..."
In an instant, the entire Enlightenment Square was like a pot of boiling water, with everyone buzzing with excitement.
From the Ancient Era to the present, a full 100,000 years had passed.
People who had comprehended nine Sword Lotuses could be counted on one hand.
But now.
These two unknown foreign youngsters achieved it at the same time.
The Sword Dao Talent of these two was too terrifying.
They were simply monsters.
Lin Ye of the Shaoyang Sword Sect, seeing the nine golden Sword Lotuses atop Jun Moxiao’s head, his face turned instantly pale.
He muttered to himself, "Are they... even human?"
At this moment, he finally admitted his defeat.
He was just a bit short of the sixth golden Sword Lotus, but Jun Moxiao... had already comprehended nine Sword Lotuses.
This is what a gap looks like.
Those prodigies in the front row of Enlightenment Square watched this, each shaking their heads and sighing.
In front of Jun Moxiao and Luo Li, they felt insignificant. None among them had even managed to comprehend six Sword Lotuses.
The many of them had been completely outperformed by Luo Li and Jun Moxiao.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao seemed to have entered a marvelous state. They kept their eyes closed, comprehending the two sword marks of the Sword King Stone.
Above each of their heads, the nine golden Sword Lotuses rotated gently, emitting golden light, giving an exceptionally sacred feeling.
"They’re still continuing to comprehend..."
"My God, what on earth do they want to do?"
"Nine Sword Lotuses is already the limit!"
Countless people widened their eyes, staring intently at the two figures before them.
At this moment, Li Shaobai also stopped his comprehension; he sensed he had reached his limit.
But when he saw Jun Moxiao and Luo Li’s backs, his breathing quickened, and he fell into a state of immense shock.
It’s clear... their state of comprehension isn’t over yet.
Could it be they can still break through?
But, in 100,000 years, no one has ever broken through to the tenth golden Sword Lotus, have they?
Li Shaobai was extremely agitated. He held his breath, silently anticipating a miracle.
「And at this moment.」
Within the Mystical Space inside the Sword King Stone Cliff, the man wearing the silver mask was trembling slightly out of sheer excitement.
It had been a full 10,000 years, had it not?
And now, another two aberrations with nine Sword Lotuses had emerged!
As a Guardian of the Sword King Stone, he had guarded it for a full thousand years, all in the hope that such aberrations with nine Sword Lotuses would appear again.
These Guardians had passed the mantle from generation to generation since the Ancient Era, spanning a full 100,000 years.
However, with the continuous weakening of the sword marks on the Sword King Stone in the last few thousand years, these Guardians also sensed a crisis.
Perhaps in another hundred years, the sword marks on the Sword King Stone might be gone.
As Guardians, they would then have nothing to guard.
Hence this time, this Guardian resolved to seek an heir among those comprehending the Sword King Stone, someone to inherit the Sword King Palace established by the Guardians.
Their Sword King Palace didn’t belong to the forces of the Shenfeng Dynasty. It was an obscure underground force with only a few dozen members.
Despite that, he, as the first master of the Sword King Palace, had a cultivation base at the Peak of the Tenth Level of Destiny Realm.
With such a cultivation base, even in the Plough Heaven Dynasty, he was a formidable figure.
Time was slowly passing by.
At this time, everyone in Enlightenment Square was watching Luo Li and Jun Moxiao, awaiting their next performance.
「By nightfall.」
