The two sword marks on the Sword King Stone suddenly shone brilliantly, illuminating the surrounding thousands of miles, making everything bright as day.
This astonishing phenomenon instantly stupefied everyone.
The Sword King Stone emanated bright light, illuminating thousands of miles.
Everyone squinted, looking towards the Sword King Stone, where a shocking scene unfolded.
Within this radiant light, two figures emerged.
A man adorned in white robes, his back turned to all sentient beings.
He had an extraordinary aura, appearing like an unparalleled Divine King, standing high atop the Nine Heavens’ Peak, gazing down on all mortal beings.
And beside him, stood an incomparably beautiful woman. Even just a fleeting glimpse of her back was enough to suggest her unparalleled beauty.
"The Ancestor... That’s the Ancestor..."
The man in the silver mask in the Cliff Space suddenly looked agitated, knelt, and tears of excitement streamed down his face.
That incomparably beautiful woman was the founder of their Guardian lineage.
It was this founder who had commanded them to guard the Sword King Stone for eternity, until the day the sword marks disappeared, marking the completion of their guardianship.
And generation after generation of Guardians, adhering to the founder’s ancient teachings, had silently guarded the Sword King Stone, never leaving it throughout their lives.
The disciples wearing Bronze Masks behind him, seeing their master suddenly kneel and weep profusely, were all deeply shaken and also knelt behind him.
"What on earth is this?"
"Could these be the Life-Death Realm Powerhouses who left the two sword marks on the Sword King Stone in the first place?"
"These ancient Great Mystical Power Users were too powerful. They left two sword marks that have endured for 100,000 years..."
On Enlightenment Square.
All the Cultivators, utterly shocked, stood up, staring in stunned silence at the two supreme figures. In that moment, they seemed to have turned into stone statues.
Just then.
Above Jun Moxiao and Luo Li’s heads, light flashed once more, and their respective tenth golden Sword Lotus appeared.
Ten Sword Lotuses!
They had broken the 100,000-year record for all Cultivators who had comprehended the Sword King Stone!
The Novel will be updated first on this website. Come back and continue reading tomorrow, everyone!

chapters.title: Chapter 87 Mysterious Guardian Appears
chapters.content:
Chapter 87: Chapter 87 Mysterious Guardian Appears
"I must be seeing things! Has the tenth Sword Lotus actually appeared?"
On Enlightenment Square, all the cultivators stared wide-eyed and incredulously at the two figures before them. Ten golden Sword Lotuses floated above each person’s head, every one of them emanating an astonishing Sword Qi.
"This must be an illusion! It’s been a hundred thousand years since ancient times, and no one has ever comprehended the tenth golden Sword Lotus!"
Some cultivators shook their heads repeatedly, rubbing their eyes furiously, unable to believe what was unfolding before them. Nine was already the limit; how could there now be ten?
"Oh my God, Brother Jun isn’t just a prodigy; he’s like a god among prodigies!" Li Shaobai screamed. When he saw the tenth golden Sword Lotus appear, his expression changed dramatically, and he plopped onto the ground in fright. He was closest to Jun Moxiao and Luo Li, no more than ten feet away, so he could clearly feel the astonishing Sword Intent emitted by the tenth golden Sword Lotus. It far surpassed the previous nine.
This was simply unbelievable, utterly shocking! After an initial burst of noise, the entire Enlightenment Square fell silent as if by common accord. Everyone stared blankly at the ten golden Sword Lotuses spinning above Luo Li’s and Jun Moxiao’s heads. For a moment, they still couldn’t believe that all this was real!
At this moment, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao also awoke from their state of comprehension. In an instant, they both saw the brilliantly glowing Sword King Stone. They also saw the two Wushang figures on the Sword King Stone, who resembled Nine Heavens Divine Kings.
Luo Li’s eyes widened, and her heart suddenly began to pound uncontrollably.
That majestic figure before me... why does it look so much like our Founder? It’s too similar.
She was in a daze, almost blurting it out.
"Senior Sister, do... do you see... isn’t that man our Founder?" Jun Moxiao stammered.
"I... I think it is..." Luo Li also began to stutter, nodding heavily.
The moment their words fell, the two figures on the Sword King Stone suddenly transformed into two dazzling beams of light, which entered Luo Li’s and Jun Moxiao’s bodies respectively. In an instant, the brilliance that had illuminated three thousand miles vanished. The two sword marks on the Sword King Stone also lost all their prowess, no longer emanating even a shred of Sword Intent.
The two beams of light shot into their bodies, transforming into an incredibly potent Sword Intent that surged within them like mighty rivers, resonating with the Sword Heart in their cores.
BANG!
Their bodies trembled almost simultaneously, and in an instant, they both advanced to the Shaping God Stage Second Layer.
"Senior Sister, we’ve broken through again!" Jun Moxiao exclaimed joyfully.
"Yes!" Luo Li couldn’t hide her excitement either. Her small face flushed red as she nodded repeatedly.
WHOOSH!
The ten golden Sword Lotuses floating above their heads descended and vanished completely. They both sensed an extremely profound Swordsmanship technique suddenly appear in their minds.
"This is... the Nine Heavens Lotus Sutra!" Jun Moxiao murmured the name of the Swordsmanship, his face a mask of shock.
This Swordsmanship was incredibly powerful when performed alone, but if their swords were combined, it would unleash an unimaginably greater might!
Jun Moxiao and Luo Li stood up together. Their comprehension had now completely ended.
SIGH!
The two glanced towards the Sword King Stone and found that the two sword marks were now devoid of any Sword Intent. Their expressions darkened, and they sighed softly. The remaining Sword Intent of the Sword King Stone had been entirely divided between them.
"Brother Jun, congratulations!" Li Shaobai ran over, his face wreathed in smiles, cupping his fists in respect.
"You’re too kind!" Jun Moxiao replied with a smile.
At this moment, he noticed the surroundings had fallen completely silent. All the cultivators were staring at him with peculiar expressions, as if he had taken their most cherished possession. Jun Moxiao merely smiled faintly, unconcerned. After all, he and his Senior Sister had absorbed all the Sword Intent from the Sword King Stone. As the greatest beneficiaries, they could understand the crowd’s feelings.
"You two absorbed all the Sword Intent from the Sword King Stone! What about the other cultivators of our Shenfeng Dynasty?" one cultivator demanded, glaring angrily at Jun Moxiao.
"Exactly!" another cultivator chimed in indignantly.
With someone taking the lead, a chain reaction occurred. Everyone became enraged, their expressions fiery as they accused Jun Moxiao and Luo Li. After all, these two outsiders had snatched away the opportunities that belonged to the Shenfeng Dynasty.
WHOOSH!
Suddenly, a tremendous pressure descended from the sky, making all the cultivators on Enlightenment Square feel as though they were suffocating, unable to even open their mouths. A light flashed on the Sword King Stone Cliff, and an ancient Bronze Door appeared.
The Bronze Door slowly creaked open.
A middle-aged man wearing a white mask walked out, seemingly treading on the air itself. He stood with his hands clasped behind his back. His eyes were like cosmic stars, constantly cycling through birth and destruction. An indescribably terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath emanated from him.
"It’s a mighty cultivator of the Destiny Realm!" Instantly, the face of a talented youth from a top-tier Sect turned pale.
"Coming out from the Sword King Stone... wearing a silver mask... Could this be the Guardian of the Sword King Stone?" another, older cultivator stammered.
It wasn’t a secret that the Sword King Stone had a Guardian, but he had rarely appeared since ancient times. Only when some shortsighted Sect attempted to seize the Sword King Stone would the Guardian manifest to repel all covetous parties.
Legend had it that the cultivation base of the Sword King Stone Guardian was comparable to that of the Supreme Elders of the three major Sects of the Shenfeng Dynasty. But now, it seemed this Guardian had reached the Destiny Realm Tenth Level, far surpassing those Supreme Elders. After all, it was said that the Supreme Elders of the three major Sects had not yet truly transcended the Destiny Realm.
The Guardian wearing a silver mask lowered his head, looked towards Enlightenment Square, and said impassively, "Your talents are extraordinary, manifesting the unprecedented ten golden Sword Lotuses and thus receiving the legacy of the Sword King Stone. Now... are you willing to join my Sword King Palace and ensure this Swordsmanship is passed down?"
His voice, though calm, boomed like thunder in everyone’s ears. All were stunned. A mighty cultivator of the Destiny Realm... was truly invincible.
"Apologies, Senior Guardian, but my Senior Sister and I will not join any Sect!" Jun Moxiao shook his head, an apologetic look in his eyes.
Rejected?
The Guardian clearly hadn’t expected this. He had already unleashed his Destiny Realm Tenth Level Super Divine Dragon Breath; could these two youths below not perceive it? In the entire Shenfeng Dynasty, the three major Sects were nothing more than ants in his eyes. However, he had long abided by his ancestor’s last instructions, guarding the Sword King Stone, so very few in the world knew of his existence.
Seeing Jun Moxiao’s blunt refusal, everyone on Enlightenment Square revealed expressions of schadenfreude. Daring to offend a mighty cultivator of the Destiny Realm—these two foreign youths were truly audacious!

chapters.title: Chapter 88: The Murderous Intent of a Destiny Realm Powerhouse
chapters.content:
Chapter 88: Chapter 88: The Murderous Intent of a Destiny Realm Powerhouse
"Young ones, you are both still so young, with limitless futures ahead. Won’t you consider this carefully?"
The Guardian, donning a silver mask, stood in the void, his eyes profound, as if reflecting the birth and death of stars.
A brilliant Sword Intent surged around him, as dazzling as a pillar of light that shot towards Yun Xiao.
In that moment, he completely unleashed the powerful Sword Intent of an expert at the peak of the Tenth Level of the Destiny Realm.
The white Sword Intent rocketed towards Yun Xiao, shredding the dark clouds for thousands of li around. Its momentum was vast and utterly astounding.
Everyone on Enlightenment Square broke out in a cold sweat, feeling as if the Sword Intent could slice their throats at any moment.
These two outsiders really don’t know what’s good for them! They’ve dragged us into their mess too... How inconsiderate!
The cultivators from the Shenfeng Dynasty on Enlightenment Square were all cursing furiously in their hearts.
The powerful Guardian established the Sword King Palace and is a great cultivator of the Heavenly Mandate Realm Tenth Level. How wonderful would it be to join him? Such a rare and wonderful opportunity is hard to come by, even if one searched with a lantern.
Many people wanted to call these two young outsiders idiots.
However, under the suppression of the Sword Intent in the sky, no one could move a muscle, let alone open their mouths to speak.
They could only curse silently in their hearts.
"Elder Guardian, we’ve considered it, and we will not be joining any sect!" Jun Moxiao declared, cupping his fists, his tone respectful yet firm.
The Guardian suddenly laughed, a booming sound that reverberated, causing the ground to quake.
"Young lady, are you... willing?" His voice was exceedingly gentle as he tried his best to sound like a kind and approachable elder.
Since the young man was obstinate, he hoped the young woman might be intimidated by his display of power and thus agree to join his Sword King Palace.
In his experience, girls were generally more timid.
"Elder Guardian, I’m afraid I will disappoint you. I also will not be joining any sect," Luo Li replied with a faint smile.
I am the current Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect; how could I possibly join another Sect? I wouldn’t join even if it meant death.
Luo Li was accustomed to a life of walking on a knife’s edge; threats were the last thing that could intimidate her.
"You..." The Guardian was so angered by Luo Li that his face turned ashen. His body quivered slightly, and he was rendered speechless.
He hadn’t expected all his painstaking efforts to be for naught.
These two young outsiders were utterly unyielding, impervious to his attempts at both persuasion and pressure.
Does this mean that I, a peak expert of the Tenth Level of the Destiny Realm, am not qualified to be their master?
He sighed softly, and the enormous Sword Intent behind him was immediately withdrawn, returning to his body.
Everyone on Enlightenment Square felt the oppressive force dissipate, and they all gasped for breath.
"Elder Guardian, these two fools have no appreciation of your kindness!"
"Elder, please retract the Sword King Stone inheritance you bestowed upon them!"
"This is a fortuitous opportunity belonging to our Shenfeng Dynasty; how can it be taken by outsiders? Elder, please retract the inheritance..."
In an instant, everyone on Enlightenment Square knelt down.
Li Shaobai was also kneeling, his heart in turmoil. After all, he knew Luo Li and Jun Moxiao and couldn’t bring himself to say such shameless words.
Why on earth would these two forsake such an incredible opportunity?
He couldn’t understand it.
Li Shaobai felt a deep sense of exasperation, like one watching potential go to waste.
"Senior Sister..." Jun Moxiao looked at Luo Li, a bitter smile forming on his face.
I never expected things to develop like this.
The ten Sword Lotuses had already integrated into their bodies, and the peerless swordsmanship was rooted in their minds. How could it possibly be retrieved?
Unless they kill us both.
"Don’t be afraid," Luo Li said, her eyes firm. "We will confront whatever comes our way." She fixed her gaze on the Guardian in the sky, curious as to his next move.
"I’ll ask once more: are you truly not prepared to join my Sword King Palace?" the Guardian, still unreconciled, pressed further.
"Senior, we appreciate your kind intentions, but we will not join any sect!" Luo Li and Jun Moxiao replied almost in unison.
"Alright then!" A look of despair came over the Guardian’s face. He extended a trembling hand, slowly lowering it.
In mid-air, his hand transformed into a colossal hand of mana that descended from the sky. It blotted out the sun, its sheer scale and power heralding what seemed like the arrival of doomsday.
Witnessing this spectacle, everyone else on Enlightenment Square was so terrified they collapsed to the ground.
An expert of the Heavenly Mandate Realm Tenth Level was truly terrifying.
The terrifying palm descended slowly, its speed deliberate.
It still seemed to offer the young man and woman below a chance to reconsider.
However, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao stood ramrod straight, their bright eyes fixed on the sky, their expressions devoid of fear.
Seeing that the pair would rather face death than join his Sword King Palace, the Guardian snorted, "HMPH!" His eyes flashed with anger. He pressed his palm downwards, preparing to obliterate the young man and woman beneath him.
Suddenly, his expression changed dramatically.
The massive hand formed of mana froze in mid-air.
A figure in white had appeared above Enlightenment Square, seemingly out of nowhere.
"We pay our respects to the Ancestor!" Luo Li and Jun Moxiao’s faces immediately lit up with joy, and they quickly knelt.
"Stand up," Ye Yun said with a calm smile. "You both did well and didn’t disappoint me." A wave of mana swept out, gently helping the two to their feet.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao had comprehended ten golden Sword Lotuses.
This was something Ye Yun had planned one hundred thousand years ago on this very cliff.
Nine was not the limit.
Ten was.
Comprehending ten golden Sword Lotuses would allow them to activate the swordsmanship hidden within the two sword marks.
This swordsmanship was not created by Ye Yun alone; he had developed it together with a cherished female confidante from his past, born from a shared moment of sudden inspiration.
"Who might you be?" The Guardian stared at the white-robed youth on Enlightenment Square, his pupils contracting. He couldn’t hide the shock in his heart.
Although his palm strike contained only a tenth of his full power, it was not something an ordinary person could withstand.
Yet this white-robed youth, whose cultivation base he couldn’t fathom, had effortlessly neutralized it.
Could it be that this youth’s cultivation base is even higher than mine? But how could that be possible? In the Shenfeng Dynasty, let alone the Plough Heaven Dynasty, there are few whose cultivation base surpasses mine...
Ye Yun glanced at the Guardian, his expression impassive.
He took a step forward, crossing the distance in an instant to appear in the void opposite the Guardian.
"Which generation of Guardian are you?" Ye Yun gazed at the two sword marks on the Sword King Stone, now devoid of any Sword Intent. His expression was calm, his voice tinged with a profound weariness as he asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 89: Suppression for 500 Years
chapters.content:
Chapter 89: Chapter 89: Suppression for 500 Years
"Who are you?"
Instead of answering Ye Yun’s question, the Guardian’s eyelids narrowed slightly, and an astonishing sword gleam flashed from the depths of his eyes. He was ready to attack. The white-robed youth before him instilled a profound sense of fear, unsettling his heart. Only by drawing his sword could he find peace of mind.
Ye Yun looked at the masked man before him and said indifferently, "You are not worthy to know my name..."
"How arrogant!"
The Guardian’s inner fury erupted like a volcano. Perhaps he could no longer endure this unknown threat and, without hesitation, brought his sword down in a slash. This sword light seemed born from the vast galaxy. As it descended, it shook the heavens.
"What a powerful sword!"
"Indeed, a great Cultivator of the Destiny Realm, with half a foot already in the Life and Death Realm!"
At this moment, countless cultivators in Enlightenment Square looked up at the sky, their faces filled with disbelief.
This astonishing sword light was suddenly frozen in mid-air.
"You’re bold, daring to attack even me!"
A chilling voice suddenly echoed through the void.
Ye Yun gazed at the sword light suspended in mid-air, a faint, sarcastic smile touching his lips.
If not for the sake of an old friend’s descendant, would this Guardian still be alive?
"That’s impossible!"
The Guardian, seeing his sword light frozen mid-air, unable to descend an inch, was so terrified his soul nearly scattered. At this moment, a sudden thought struck him: the expert before him had to be at least in the Life and Death Realm.
Ye Yun gently blew a breath. This soft puff of air landed on the brilliant and chilling sword light, which instantly dissipated into wisps of green smoke.
"How amusing, Liu Yiyi. Your descendant actually dared to attack me. I bet you never expected that, did you?"
With his hands clasped behind his back, Ye Yun leisurely walked towards the Guardian.
"You... How could you know our Ancestor’s name?"
The Guardian instantly paled upon hearing the name Liu Yiyi. Only successive generations of Guardians knew the Ancestor’s name. No one else in the world knew it. Yet this white-robed youth knew the Ancestor’s name.
How could that be?
Tumultuous waves surged in the Guardian’s heart as he watched the white-robed youth approach step by step. He found his body completely immobilized. He couldn’t even move a single finger.
"A Guardian at the Tenth Level of the Destiny Realm was defeated just like that?"
Many cultivators in Enlightenment Square, witnessing this, were scared out of their wits. Some even turned to flee.
Ye Yun glanced down indifferently. Everyone was instantly immobilized by a mysterious force, as if a binding spell had been cast upon them. Everyone stared in shock at the white-robed youth in the sky. They couldn’t imagine what terrifying level of cultivation this person had reached!
Ye Yun walked up to the Guardian, raised his hand, and SLAP! It landed on the Guardian’s face. The silver mask shattered instantly, revealing an aged face. This aged face was now filled with terror, his eyes revealing indescribable despair.
"Who exactly are you?" The Guardian managed to ask, his voice strained.
"Ye Yun." Ye Yun softly uttered the two words.
"Ye Yun?" The Guardian’s brows tightened as he slowly mulled over this name. Suddenly, a flash of realization struck him. His expression twisted instantly. "This... H-how can this be?" he stammered. "How can you possibly still be alive?" His tone had completely changed by the end of his words.
Because this name, too, was passed down through generations of Guardians. Ye Yun and Liu Yiyi. They were the creators of the two sword marks on the Sword King Stone. Until now, only the successive generations of Guardians knew these two names.
"It seems you remember..." Ye Yun smiled calmly.
"This is impossible! Absolutely impossible! Our Ancestor has been dead for nearly one hundred thousand years! How could you possibly still be alive?" The Guardian’s mind collapsed, and he began to mutter frantically to himself. He found it utterly inconceivable that this white-robed youth before him was the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, an Eternal Sect from one hundred thousand years ago, renowned as the Cangnan Continent’s foremost expert of the Eternal Realm.
But how did he survive?
Let alone an expert of the Eternal Realm, not even a legendary True God Realm expert could live for one hundred thousand years!"Nothing is impossible!" Ye Yun smiled faintly and suddenly pointed a finger into the air. Before him, a stunningly beautiful woman in red materialized.
"This is... our Ancestor..." Upon seeing the woman’s face, the Guardian’s mind reeled in shock. His knees buckled, and he instinctively tried to kneel, but he was immobilized, unable to lift even a finger.
Suddenly, Ye Yun withdrew his Mana. The image of the woman vanished. When he had conjured this image, he had already isolated the scene, ensuring only he and the Guardian could witness it.
Perhaps the sight had stirred painful memories. Ye Yun’s expression grew sorrowful. He took a deep breath. After a few seconds, Ye Yun’s expression became tranquil again, as still as an ancient well, without a single ripple. The earlier trace of sorrow had vanished completely. Ye Yun had ’signed in’ in this space for one hundred thousand years; his Dao Heart had long since become incomparably firm.
He looked at the Guardian and said dispassionately, "Your death penalty may be waived, but you cannot escape punishment. You shall be suppressed for five hundred years!"
After speaking, Ye Yun lightly tapped the Guardian. Before him, the Guardian instantly turned into a stone statue. Ye Yun flicked the stone statue towards the Mystical Space. The moment the statue entered, all the disciples of the Sword King Palace also turned into stone statues.
Ye Yun gently gestured with his hand. The entire mountain range immediately rumbled and sank deep into the earth. He wrote a single word in the air.
"Seal!"
This large character shone with a sacred light before descending into the ground and vanishing completely.
Witnessing this white-robed youth, who seemed like a veritable God, all the cultivators in Enlightenment Square felt a chill seep into their bones, as if they had been plunged into an icy cavern. A Cultivator at the Tenth Level of the Destiny Realm was so easily suppressed, and for five hundred years at that. Such a miraculous suppression technique was something they had never even heard of.
"All of you... deserve to die as well..." Ye Yun looked down indifferently at the thousands of cultivators below.
In his eyes, these cultivators were like ants, utterly insignificant.
With a single breath from him, all those thousands of cultivators, their faces etched with terror, turned into wisps of blue smoke and dissipated. This included Li Shaobai.
In Ye Yun’s heart, such cultivators were no different from ants. Beneath a True God, all are ants. Ye Yun would not spare Li Shaobai merely because he had a passing acquaintance with Jun Moxiao. This Li Shaobai, who had thoroughly taken advantage of Jun Moxiao, was no good person either.
However, as for the Guardian, Ye Yun still showed mercy on account of a former confidante, merely suppressing him for five hundred years.
...
Watching the massive mountain sink into the ground in the blink of an eye, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao couldn’t help but recall the Eighteen Layers of Hell that had suddenly erupted from beneath the Sword God Sect in the Ancient Moon Dynasty. A chill involuntarily ran down their spines. When their Ancestor acted, he always eradicated all threats completely, leaving no loose ends.
"Ancestor," Jun Moxiao stammered, "that figure who appeared on the Sword King Stone... was that truly you?"
Ye Yun nodded, then vanished abruptly into the void.
Jun Moxiao and Luo Li exchanged a look, indescribable shock filling their eyes. At the same time, a single question arose in both their hearts.
Just who was that stunningly beautiful woman to their Ancestor?

chapters.title: Chapter 90: The Big Black Cat with a Tough Exterior but Soft Interior
chapters.content:
Chapter 90: Chapter 90: The Big Black Cat with a Tough Exterior but Soft Interior
「One month later.」
A black carriage gradually approached from a distance. Inside the carriage, Ye Yun opened his eyes.
In that instant, it was as if countless universes and stars were being born and dying within his eyes, worlds endlessly cycling through unimaginable destruction and rebirth.
After leaving the Sword King Stone, Ye Yun had not urged Big Black Horse to hasten their journey. Instead, he gave Luo Li and Jun Moxiao an opportunity to comprehend and advance their cultivation.
His cultivation base had also improved steadily during this month, reaching the True God Realm Tenth Layer Peak.
He was only a paper-thin margin away from the Divine Monarch Realm.
If Ye Yun wished, he could break through to that realm at any time. However, such a breakthrough would trigger tremendous celestial phenomena, unleashing unimaginable destructive power.
The entire Cangnan Continent would likely be unable to withstand it. Therefore, Ye Yun had been suppressing his cultivation, choosing not to break through.
"How strange! This carriage doesn’t have a coachman, and there’s a huge black cat lying on the coachbox..."
"Can this big black cat actually drive the carriage?"
"Truly bizarre..."
"This must be an unclaimed item..."
A few cultivators passing by whispered amongst themselves as they circled the black carriage.
"Scram!" Big Black Cat raised its head and snarled.
The cultivators, terrified by the talking black cat, nearly fell on their backsides. Their cultivation was not high; they were merely Origin Sea Realm cultivators.
Intimidated by Big Black Cat, they nearly had their Three Souls and Seven Spirits scared out of them.
The cultivators scrambled away from the black carriage. Calm immediately returned to the surroundings.
"Little Cat, you’ve gained quite a lot this past month, haven’t you? After eating the pills Master rewarded you with, you should be close to the Destiny Realm, right?"
"Uncle Ma, I’m not that quick. Right now, I’m only at the Tenth Layer of the Nirvana Realm!"
Big Black Cat smiled sheepishly and licked its paw.
Unexpectedly, Master had gifted it a bag of Emperor-level Spiritual Pills. There were a full 1,000 pills in that bag! Over the month, it had eaten one every day, and its cultivation base had been soaring. This brought extreme bliss to Big Black Cat. Never in its thousands of years of cultivation had leveling up felt so satisfying. Eating Emperor-level Spiritual Pills like candy was something it couldn’t have even dreamed of before. Not to mention Emperor-level pills, it had barely eaten two or three Emperor-level ones its whole life. Big Black Cat now felt even more convinced it had made the right choice. The more grievous the injury, the richer the reward! This only strengthened its conviction. If Master needed it to fight next time, Big Black Cat vowed, it would definitely sustain an even heavier injury! Perhaps then, the quantity of Spiritual Pills bestowed upon it would double! The thought of rapidly improving its cultivation base by swallowing pills, eventually becoming a peerless great demon of the Destiny Realm and surpassing its previous master, made Big Black Cat ecstatic. It was now at the Tenth Layer of the Nirvana Realm, not far from the Destiny Realm. One had to admit, these Emperor-level pills were truly potent. In the Plough Heaven Dynasty, the appearance of a single Emperor-level pill would likely cause a frantic scramble. Yet now, it was eating them like candy. Big Black Cat felt that ever since following Master, its life had been getting increasingly comfortable.
"Tenth Layer of the Nirvana Realm already? Isn’t that also close to the Destiny Realm?" Big Black Horse gave it a disdainful look.
WHOOSH!
The thick horsetail swept over, slapping Big Black Cat across the face.
The horsetail seemed light, yet when it struck Big Black Cat’s head, it felt as heavy as a mountain, making the cat see stars.
"Uncle Ma, spare me! My little body isn’t that sturdy," Big Black Cat wailed, holding its paws over its head.
Big Black Horse chuckled and ignored it. Suddenly, he raised his head.
A streak of green lightning flashed swiftly across the sky.
Big Black Horse narrowed his eyes and saw that within the green lightning was a large, green bird.
So, it’s a Thunder Lake bird...
Big Black Horse pursed his lips and shook his head dismissively.
That Thunder Lake bird’s bloodline wasn’t pure, and its cultivation base was pathetically low—only at the peak of the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm. What’s more, it was injured and fleeing in a hurry.
Some time after the Thunder Lake bird disappeared, human figures were seen speeding through the sky, apparently chasing the demon beast.
At this moment, Big Black Cat also looked up at the sky. Upon spotting disciples from the Qitian Sword Sect and the Yu Mo Sect among the figures, it couldn’t help but shout, "Master, it looks like disciples from the three major Sects are chasing that Thunder Lake bird!"
"Little Cat, you talk too much. Don’t you think Master isn’t already aware of all this?"
Big Black Horse turned his head and glared fiercely at Big Black Cat. A bolt of lightning shot from his eyes, striking the cat instantly.
SIZZLE!
Big Black Cat was almost charred black. Its fur looked scorched.
Ye Yun couldn’t help but laugh.
What a pair of live treasures! Big Black Horse truly showed no mercy when bullying Big Black Cat. Fortunately, he had held back somewhat; otherwise, Big Black Cat would have been thoroughly cooked.
"Uncle Ma, you’re too cruel! My fur is almost all burned off..." Big Black Cat wailed, on the verge of tears.
Its once silky smooth and glossy black fur now had a large patch burned away, revealing the brown skin underneath. It looked incredibly unsightly.
Ye Yun suddenly stepped out of the carriage and looked around. Finally, his gaze landed on Big Black Cat, and he chuckled softly.
With a light flick of his finger, a drop of green liquid landed on Big Black Cat.
"MRROOW~PURR..." Big Black Cat let out a cry of pure bliss.
"Little Cat, are you in heat? Can’t you hold it in a little?" Big Black Horse said irritably.
Big Black Cat promptly shut its mouth, terrified that Uncle Ma would strike it with another lightning bolt.
After absorbing the drop of mysterious green liquid, Big Black Cat was suffused with an overwhelming vitality, and its black fur rapidly grew back.
"Thank you, Master..." Big Black Cat knelt, weeping tears of gratitude.
The return of its black fur filled it with both shock and immense joy.
Just then, two rays of light flew out from the carriage and landed on the ground, revealing Luo Li and Jun Moxiao.
"Greetings, Ancestor!" Seeing Ye Yun standing on the carriage, the two quickly bowed.
Ye Yun looked at the two and smiled faintly.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao, after a month of diligent cultivation—continuously nurturing the ten golden Sword Lotuses and consuming Dragon Tiger Pills—had further elevated their cultivation bases.
They had now reached the Third Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm.
Seeing these two, who were once mere Qi Refinement cultivators, now transformed into formidable Divine Bridge Realm cultivators with entirely changed temperaments, Ye Yun felt quite gratified.
"The three major Sects of the Shenfeng Dynasty, along with some first-rate Sects, have sent their disciples to the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range to capture that Thunder Lake bird," Ye Yun said casually. "You two should also go and gain some experience."
"Yes, Ancestor!" Jun Moxiao and Luo Li promptly agreed.
"By the way, I will be leaving the Cangnan Continent for a period of time," Ye Yun looked at the two and suddenly announced, his words like a thunderclap.

chapters.title: Chapter 91: The Ancestors Are Leaving the Cangnan Continent?
chapters.content:
Chapter 91: Chapter 91: The Ancestors Are Leaving the Cangnan Continent?
What? The Ancestor is leaving the Cangnan Continent?
Upon hearing this news, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao’s faces turned pale with fright. In that instant, they felt as though they had become orphans. It seemed as if the Ancestor was about to leave them, no longer wanting them, no longer caring for them.
Luo Li immediately burst into tears, her eyes brimming as she asked, "Ancestor, are you really going to abandon us?"
Jun Moxiao, always emotional, was also wiping away his tears, sobbing as he said, "Ancestor, is it because I’m so useless?"
Seeing how devastated these two children were, Ye Yun couldn’t help but smile. He just wanted to leave the Cangnan Continent to find a suitable place to break through to the Divine Monarch Realm.
How could I abandon these three little rascals?
After all, he had to cultivate the only three remaining disciples of the Dragon God Sect to the strength of an Eternal Level powerhouse before he could leave with peace of mind.
"Master, you mustn’t leave! We can’t live without you!" Big Black Cat also collapsed, crying pitifully.
If the Master leaves, my cultivation resources will be cut off!
Even Big Black Horse, who was usually calm, became nervous. Its eyes grew misty as it turned to look at Ye Yun, asking softly, "Master, can I go with you?"
Seeing everyone had misunderstood, Ye Yun found it amusing and shook his head lightly. "I need to break through to the next realm, which is likely to cause terrifying anomalies in the world. So, I need to find a suitable place..." he explained with a smile.
"Congratulations, Master!" Big Black Horse, being an Eternal Realm great demon, knew more and immediately began to laugh.
Big Black Cat blinked.
The Master is already a True God. Could he... continue to break through?
It suddenly realized its own laughable ignorance; it didn’t even know the realm beyond the True God Realm.
Jun Moxiao and Luo Li exchanged glances and quickly wiped the tears from their eyes. The Ancestor was so powerful, ready to break through from the True God Realm to the next. Although they didn’t know what the next realm was, they were happy for their Ancestor’s breakthrough.
Ye Yun, his expression calm, said no more and suddenly vanished from the spot. No one knew where he had gone, not even Big Black Horse with its superior cultivation base.
Even though they knew the Ancestor would return, his sudden absence left Jun Moxiao and Luo Li struggling to accept it for a moment, their spirits sinking.
"Senior Sister is still in closed-door cultivation; she probably hasn’t heard the news, right?" Jun Moxiao whispered.
Luo Li nodded, a smile appearing on her face as she said, "Maybe the Ancestor will return soon, and by then, Senior Sister might not have even finished her seclusion."
"Mmm!" Jun Moxiao nodded.
"Oh no, I forgot to ask the Ancestor what kind of demon beast the Leize is! I’ve never heard of it!" A look of annoyance appeared on Luo Li’s exquisite face. She had, in fact, never heard of Leize.
The Ancestor sent us to the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range for training. Besides competing with the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from various major sects, perhaps he also intended for us to capture that Leize.
"This is Leize..." Big Black Horse gently exhaled, conjuring an image of Leize in the air. It was a massive azure bird, somewhat similar to the Azure Luan, but its entire body crackled with astonishing lightning, emanating an explosive aura. Its eyes, in particular, were filled with intense murderous intent, leaving a deep impression.
"So this is Leize..." Jun Moxiao nodded. Then, he and Senior Sister Luo Li took to the skies, heading towards the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range.
Big Black Cat raised its paw, looking towards Accumulated Thunder Mountain, and bravely volunteered, "Uncle Ma, why don’t I go and protect the two young masters?"
"You just stay put and watch the carriage. With the Master away, it’s a good opportunity for me to stretch my legs..." Big Black Horse grinned, and the reins on its body suddenly fell away. It then took two steps forward, shook itself, and transformed into a middle-aged man in a black robe.
"HEHEHE, what do you think of Uncle Ma’s dashing appearance? Isn’t it strikingly handsome?" Big Black Horse grinned widely, revealing a row of white teeth, and chuckled, "HEHEHE."
"Uncle Ma, you truly are the cream of the crop, possessing an unparalleled demeanor! Besides the Master, no one can outshine you!" Seeing Uncle Ma transform into a human, Big Black Cat impulsively shook its body, turning into a black-clad youth. He sat on the carriage and gave Big Black Horse a thumbs-up.
"HAHAHA! Little Cat, Uncle Ma loves to hear such words!" Big Black Horse laughed heartily. Ever since leaving the Master’s warehouse, it had been tirelessly pulling the carriage. While it never complained, it always felt a bit bored. Now that the Master was gone, it was determined to get some activity. Firstly, to protect the two young masters. Secondly, to search for some heavenly materials and earthly treasures to fill its belly. Thirdly, if it happened to encounter a compatible mare... it wouldn’t mind leaving some offspring in this world, lest it be teased by Sister Feng every time it returned.
"Little Cat, take good care of the carriage. Uncle Ma is off!" Big Black Horse roared with laughter as it strode away.
Big Black Cat, transformed into a black-robed youth, sat bored on the carriage, blankly gazing at the sky. "The Master is already a True God, yet he can break through once more. What’s the next realm?" Big Black Cat muttered to itself.
After thinking for a while, he also began to feel bored. He jumped off the carriage and tried to move it, but no matter how hard he tried, using all his might, he couldn’t budge the carriage an inch.
"My goodness! This carriage is extraordinary. Even I, Old Cat, can’t move it!" Big Black Cat’s face fell, utterly dejected.
Thinking back to how Uncle Ma effortlessly pulled the carriage at lightning speed, even across the void, Big Black Cat truly realized how formidable Uncle Ma was.
"All I can do is wait here..." it sighed. In the end, Big Black Cat had no choice but to jump back onto the carriage, sit cross-legged, and close its eyes to cultivate.
「Several figures tore through the air, arriving.」
"Is this the black carriage you mentioned?"
"Yes, Senior. There’s a powerful demon here that can talk. It seems quite strong. If we kill it, its Demon Core will definitely sell for a good price!"
A few young Origin Sea Realm Cultivators led an elderly Cultivator at the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm as they flew from afar to the carriage.
"Where’s the Demon Cat you mentioned? There’s clearly only a black-robed young man!" the elderly Cultivator at the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm angrily questioned the Cultivators beside him. These guys had insisted that there was an unmanned carriage with a Demon Cat of no low cultivation base sitting on top. But when he arrived, he saw only a mundane carriage with nothing impressive about it, and the Demon Cat was nowhere to be found.
"I remember there was also a big black horse in front of this carriage! Where did the horse go? Did someone steal it?!" one Cultivator exclaimed in shock.
"Senior, perhaps we were too late, and someone beat us to it!" another young Origin Sea Realm Cultivator said with a gloomy face.
Before the elder from the Divine Bridge Realm could vent his anger, the black-robed young man sitting on the carriage suddenly opened his eyes and looked at the crowd. The youth, who had initially appeared quite ordinary, suddenly transformed at this moment, reverting to a giant, mountain-like black cat.
"Old Cat is right here!"

chapters.title: Chapter 92: Tearing through the Void, Spanning a Hundred Million Miles
chapters.content:
Chapter 92: Chapter 92: Tearing through the Void, Spanning a Hundred Million Miles
"A Nirvana Realm demonic beast!"
Gazing at the black cat as large as a small mountain, the elderly Divine Bridge Realm cultivator’s vision blurred, and he immediately fainted from fright.
As for the other young Origin Sea Realm cultivators, they had been so frightened that they had collapsed to the ground, as limp as mud.
None of them could have ever dreamed that the unassuming black cat on the carriage was actually a Nirvana Realm demonic beast.
"You greedy humans always have to pay a price for your avarice. Today, your Grandpa Cat will represent the cycle of the Heavenly Dao and deliver your final judgment!"
The Big Black Cat deliberately put on a stern face. It gently blew a breath that landed on those incapacitated Origin Sea Realm cultivators, instantly rendering them unconscious.
I’m still not quite able to emulate the Master’s breath technique...
The Big Black Cat chuckled helplessly, then grabbed the people from the ground and unceremoniously devoured them.
After eating these few individuals, the Big Black Cat reverted to its human form and sat on the carriage, closing its eyes to rest and recuperate.
He didn’t mind if more people came to disturb him.
The Big Black Cat had made up its mind: anyone who dared to harbor designs on the Master’s carriage would be eaten without mercy.
High above the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range, a middle-aged man in a black robe suddenly looked towards a certain spot and cursed irritably, "You little whelp of a cat! You’re not very capable, yet you love to put on airs! Do you think you can learn the Master’s breath technique? Even I, your Uncle Ma, can’t do it..."
His voice seemed to possess a strange power, piercing through the vast distance and reaching the ears of the Big Black Cat, thousands of miles away.
"Uncle Ma, I won’t dare to imitate the Master like that again..." the Big Black Cat hastily pleaded for mercy.
"Little Cat, guard the carriage well. That is your most important task..."
The black-robed middle-aged man chuckled, then swaggered off towards the depths of the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range.
Above an azure sea, space rippled, and suddenly a figure in white appeared.
Hmm, I’ve already left that island of the Cangnan Continent...
Ye Yun surveyed his surroundings and smiled faintly.
Just moments ago, he had continuously torn through the void, traversing hundreds of millions of miles, crossing directly from the Shenfeng Dynasty out of the Cangnan Continent.
He had arrived in this sea region on the outskirts of the Cangnan Continent.
This sea region was likely tens of millions of miles from the Cangnan Continent, a place rarely visited by people.
From the Cangnan Continent, one would have to fly another tens of millions of miles in any direction to reach the forbidden land of death.
In the minds of ordinary cultivators, the ocean surrounding the Cangnan Continent was boundless, and few cultivators could fly tens of millions of miles out.
This wasn’t merely due to the distance.
More importantly, the depths of this sea were filled with various terrifying Ferocious Beasts.
Flying directly over it, one could easily be attacked by these Ferocious Beasts.
Tens of millions of miles further out was where the real nightmare began.
Without an Eternal Realm cultivation base, once one reached that land of death, they couldn’t hope to take another step.
In that place, violent gales raged, and heavenly thunder and earthly fire rolled ceaselessly. Even Eternal Realm cultivators couldn’t last seven days there.
Back then, Ye Yun, as the foremost expert of the Cangnan Continent, relying on his Divine Dragon Body, had flown for a full three months without finding an end.
However, using his Great Divine Powers, he had vaguely glimpsed a continent on the other side.
SPLASH!
The azure seawater erupted with a loud noise, sending spray high into the air. A colossal figure leaped from the sea, its gaping, bloody maw opened wide as it lunged towards Ye Yun.
Ye Yun smiled faintly and, with a flick of his finger, the gigantic sea demon vanished into a wisp of blue smoke.
This was a sea demon at the tenth level of the Destiny Realm.
But to Ye Yun, it was a trivial matter, dealt with in an instant.
He strolled leisurely, flying slowly through the mid-air.
The continuous tearing of the void to span hundreds of millions of miles just now had consumed a great deal of Ye Yun’s energy.
Therefore, he needed to restore his mana first.
Ye Yun took out several pills and tossed them into his mouth, riding the wind.
His current cultivation base was at the peak of the True God Realm’s Tenth Layer, placing him at the apex of combat strength on the Cangnan Continent.
However, continuously tearing the void to traverse hundreds of millions of miles placed an extreme physical burden on Ye Yun.
Fortunately, he possessed the Ancestral Dragon Body, which allowed him to withstand the oppressive pressure from continuously tearing space.
The True God realm is still somewhat weak. If I could one day advance to the Divine King Realm, continuously tearing the void to traverse hundreds of millions of miles would be as easy as eating or drinking...
Ye Yun smiled faintly.
Above the True God Realm is the Divine Monarch Realm, then the Divine Sovereign Realm, and after that comes the Divine King Realm.
Reaching the Divine King Realm was still a long way off for Ye Yun.
Nevertheless, Ye Yun wasn’t worried.
The hundred thousand years of signing in had granted him an unimaginable wealth of resources, ensuring his cultivation would progress smoothly and without hindrance.
After consuming a few pills, Ye Yun quickly restored his mana.
He tore through the void again, several times in succession, appearing tens of millions of miles away.
Here I am again...
Gazing at the familiar scene ahead, Ye Yun was filled with emotion.
It had been a hundred thousand years since he was last here.
In the hundred thousand years, the Cangnan Continent had seen people and things change, seas turn into mulberry fields, but the sky-reaching barrier over this sea had remained unchanged.
Before Ye Yun now was a yellow barrier connecting the sea to the dome of the sky.
Within the yellow barrier, the constant roars of violent winds could be heard, and flashes of lightning occasionally illuminated the interior.
Peculiarly, outside this barrier, the weather was calm and sunny, completely tranquil.
But within the barrier, it was like the end of the world.
Just as Ye Yun was preparing to head towards this Gale Region, he suddenly saw two figures flying out of the barrier in a wretched state.
Ye Yun’s pupils contracted slightly.
Recognizing them as two Eternal Realm cultivators, he couldn’t help but offer a faint smile.
It had been a long time since he had seen Eternal Realm cultivators, and the sight made him feel a touch of nostalgia.
The two cultivators flew out from the Gale Region, disheveled and with lingering fear on their faces.
"This Road to Heaven isn’t easy to cross; our cultivation base is still too weak..." an old man in a blue Daoist robe said, his face dejected as he shook his head.
"Yes, from ancient times until now, not many Eternal Realm cultivators have been able to pass through successfully..." the other red-robed old man remarked with a sigh.
Someone managed to pass through the barrier?
Ye Yun found this somewhat incredible. He took a step forward and instantly appeared before the two men.
"Greetings to you both, fellow Daoists!" Ye Yun cupped his fists and said with a calm smile.
"Who are you?"
The two elderly Eternal Realm cultivators were startled by the sudden appearance of a young man dressed in white.
This white-robed young man had appeared beside them like a phantom.
If he harbored ill intentions and launched a sneak attack, they would likely have no chance of survival.
After all, being Eternal Realm cultivators themselves, they hadn’t even detected the white-robed young man’s approach, which spoke volumes about his profound cultivation base.
"I am a Loose Cultivator from overseas..." Ye Yun said with a smile.
His gaze fixed intently on the two elders as he asked, "What is this Road to Heaven you were speaking of?"

chapters.title: Chapter 93: Road to Heaven
chapters.content:
Chapter 93: Chapter 93: Road to Heaven
"You don’t know about the Road to Heaven?"
The two old men looked at the young man in white before them, their faces shocked, finding it hard to believe.
This young man in white had profound features and an extraordinary temperament, bearing an unearthly quality as if he were an exiled immortal. He exuded an indescribable Super Divine Dragon Breath that masked his cultivation base.
In the minds of the two Eternal Realm powerhouses, they speculated that this youth might possess some Secret Technique to conceal his Super Divine Dragon Breath. That was why they could not deduce his cultivation base.
The two of them did not treat Ye Yun as a common Cultivator, but as a Cultivator of their own level in the Eternal Realm.
Therefore, neither dared to show the slightest disrespect.
"May I ask, have you been in seclusion all this while?" the blue-robed old man asked with a smile.
"Sort of!" Ye Yun replied with a light smile.
Lying in a coffin for a hundred thousand years could also be considered seclusion, right?
A hundred thousand years had transformed the world. Things had significantly changed outside.
Even Ye Yun had not expected that the Cangnan Continent could have undergone such changes.
Within this age-old barrier, which had remained unchanged for ten thousand years, there had appeared a so-called Ancient Road to Heaven.
What surprised him the most was that people had actually made it through this Road to Heaven, overcoming the barrier and entering the new continent.
"That explains it..." The two Eternal Realm old men showed comprehension simultaneously.
"Approximately ninety thousand years ago, the Sect Master of the Ice Phoenix Sect advanced to the Tenth Layer Peak of the Eternal Realm. She entered this Gale Region and found an extremely ancient road. Following this road, one could actually leave the Cangnan Continent..." the blue-robed old man explained.
"This road was named the Ancient Road to Heaven by later generations. This road is far less dangerous. If one’s cultivation base is strong enough, like that Sect Master of the Ice Phoenix Sect, one can leave via this Ancient Road to Heaven and enter an even broader world outside..." the other red-robed old man added.
Ye Yun nodded solemnly. He had not expected that within this barrier, there would be such a long-established ancient road. He had never heard of it a hundred thousand years ago.
It seems this ancient road existed for a very long time and was simply undiscovered.
However, due to the vast size of the Gale Region within the barrier, it was unrealistic for anyone to find this ancient road all at once.
Ye Yun had only explored it once. He had focused on vertical exploration, not horizontal, so naturally, he wouldn’t have discovered this so-called Ancient Road to Heaven.
"So, according to what you two fellow Daoists have said, the Sect Master of the Ice Phoenix Sect was the first to leave. May I know her name?" Ye Yun asked with a smile.
The Ice Phoenix Sect was as powerful as the Dragon God Sect back then; both were Eternal Level Sects.
The two Sects had endless grievances.
Of course, it all started when I provoked the Saintess of the Ice Phoenix Sect, which led to several wars between the two Sects.
In those days, I was the number one rogue on the Cangnan Continent, surrounded by numerous female companions. Otherwise, the Sect Master of the Frost Seal Sect—she even wanted to play matchmaker and try to pair me with the Saintess of the Ice Phoenix Sect.
But this matter was eventually dropped.
"Her name... well, the name of that Sect Master of the Ice Phoenix Sect is unknown to most people now. Perhaps only the current Sect Master of the Ice Phoenix Sect knows it?" the blue-robed old man said, shaking his head.
"I see..." Ye Yun felt somewhat disappointed.
He was eager to know if the person he knew had successfully passed through the Ancient Road to Heaven and entered another world.
It seemed he would have to visit the Ice Phoenix Sect to verify this when he had the chance.
"So, how many people have passed through this Ancient Road to Heaven over these tens of thousands of years?" Ye Yun asked again.
"This Ancient Road to Heaven is extremely dangerous. In total, only three individuals have managed to pass through it..." the blue-robed old man sighed softly.
"Yes, it’s said that over these tens of thousands of years, countless Eternal Realm powerhouses have attempted to force their way through this Ancient Road to Heaven. In the end, they all perished on the ancient road and never returned..." the red-robed old man lamented, wringing his hands.
The blue-robed old man looked at Ye Yun with a bitter smile. "Fellow Daoist, we two also overestimated ourselves and tried it. We only managed to walk for a few days before we were forced to return..."
Ye Yun nodded silently.
Although there was an Ancient Road to Heaven, it wasn’t something just anyone could pass through.
In a hundred thousand years, only three people successfully passed. That’s a terrifyingly low success rate.
But he currently had a True God-stage cultivation base and was about to step into the Divine Monarch Realm. For him, traversing this ancient road wouldn’t be difficult at all.
"Thank you both for your candor..." Ye Yun clasped his fists, offering a faint smile. Then, he turned and stepped into the Gale Region.
"This person’s cultivation base is unfathomable. I wonder if he can make it through..." the blue-robed old man mused, frowning slightly as he watched Ye Yun’s white silhouette disappear into the gales.
"Let’s not worry about others for now!" The red-robed old man waved his large sleeves and said with a bitter laugh, "Our injuries are quite severe. We should find a place to heal quickly..."
The blue-robed old man nodded. The two of them vanished in an instant.
Ye Yun walked through the raging gales, his body emitting a faint white glow, making him resemble a God descended to the mortal realm.
The violent gales brushing against his body felt as inconsequential as a gentle breeze, not even enough to make him itch.
Occasionally, bolts of lightning would fall, only to explode completely about thirty feet above Ye Yun’s head.
Nothing here could harm Ye Yun.
Ye Yun released his Divine Sense, searching for the Ancient Road to Heaven.
Although the gales exerted immense pressure on Divine Sense, Ye Yun’s Divine Sense was extraordinarily powerful and could extend for tens of thousands of miles.
Ye Yun quickly found the Ancient Road to Heaven. He tried to tear open the void with his bare hands but was surprised to find this space exceptionally stable, making it difficult to rip.
"Interesting..."
Ye Yun smiled, unconcerned. He didn’t attempt to tear the void further but instead controlled his body and flew swiftly towards the Ancient Road to Heaven.
Within a few breaths, Ye Yun reached the entrance of the Ancient Road to Heaven.
This Ancient Road to Heaven emitted a faint yellow glow, floating in the void and exuding an indescribable, ancient, and desolate Super Divine Dragon Breath.
Countless gales blew against this Ancient Road to Heaven, yet they could not destroy it.
"What a grand undertaking!"
Seeing this Ancient Road to Heaven, Ye Yun couldn’t help but feel slightly shocked and nodded in approval.
This Ancient Road to Heaven was actually condensed from a God level Formation.
That was why it could withstand the endless ravages of the gales.
Ye Yun stood quietly before the Ancient Road to Heaven for a while before turning to leave.
He wasn’t in a hurry to go to that other world at the moment.
For him, he lacked neither cultivation resources nor Cultivation Techniques.
So, it made no difference to him which world he was in.
Besides, there were still those three young ones from the Dragon God Sect whom he needed to continue nurturing.
Ye Yun stretched a hand towards the void. A layer of crimson Dragon Qi, like fire, ignited on the surface of his body.
At this moment, Ye Yun mobilized the power of his Ancestral Dragon Body, preparing to forcibly tear open the void within this barrier.
RIIIP!
Despite the incredible stability of this space, Ye Yun still forcefully tore an opening.
A faint smile touched Ye Yun’s lips. He stepped into the spatial passage and vanished in the blink of an eye.

chapters.title: Chapter 94: Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range, First Encounter with Shen Heng Sect Disciple
chapters.content:
Chapter 94: Chapter 94: Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range, First Encounter with Shen Heng Sect Disciple
"Senior Sister, the lightning aura in this Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range is so dense!"
Two figures flew swiftly from afar, coming to a stop in the sky just outside the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range.
It was Luo Li and Jun Moxiao.
"Yes, the Ancestor sent us here for training, but we have no idea where the Lei Ze is hidden. Even the disciples of the three major sects don’t know where it is..."
Luo Li gazed at the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range. In the distance, the endless chain of mountains was covered by layers of black clouds, from which lightning constantly crashed down.
The lightning was extremely dense, showing no signs of ceasing whatsoever.
The deeper into the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range, the denser the lightning.
"Senior Sister, let’s go inside and take a look..."
Jun Moxiao took the lead and charged into the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range.
Luo Li followed closely behind him.
Upon entering the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range, they discovered that the air was filled with tiny lightning bolts. When these lightning bolts struck their bodies, they had a body-tempering effect.
This was a delightful surprise for them.
If just being on the periphery of the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range had such an effect, wouldn’t the body-tempering effect be even more remarkable in the inner parts?
Shortly after they entered, they saw quite a few cultivators.
Luo Li scanned the area but did not find any disciples from the three major sects. These were probably disciples from other powers in the Shenfeng Dynasty, here to gain experience in the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range.
There were cultivators from the Origin Sea Realm, the Shaping God Realm, and the Divine Bridge Realm.
The arrival of Luo Li and Jun Moxiao attracted the attention of some of the cultivators.
Seeing the handsome young pair flying rapidly through the sky, many people wore shocked expressions.
The cultivation base of the two was already at the Divine Bridge Realm third level.
To possess such a cultivation base at such a young age, they were definitely considered top prodigies in the Shenfeng Dynasty.
For a moment, everyone was speculating about their origins.
If there were still survivors among the cultivators from the Sword King Stone, someone would naturally recognize Luo Li and Jun Moxiao.
However, all the cultivators from that place had been turned into wisps of green smoke by the Ancestor in a single breath; not one had escaped.
So, to this day, any cultivator who had seen Luo Li and Jun Moxiao was no longer in this world.
The two did not linger, heading straight into the depths of the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range.
Their goals were clear: one was to find the Lei Ze, and the other was to spar with the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the three major sects.
Especially the disciples of the Shen Heng Sect; they absolutely must not be spared. If seen, they must be killed.
This was because the Ancestor had already told them that the Shen Heng Sect was the mastermind manipulating the Old Sword Saint of the Ancient Moon Dynasty.
Thinking about the tragic suffering endured by generations of Dragon God Sect disciples over the years, both Luo Li and Jun Moxiao were filled with overwhelming hatred.
This time, out for training, they would definitely not let any disciple from the Shen Heng Sect escape.
"Junior Brother, look! What’s that?"
Luo Li, flying through the air, suddenly spotted a small blue tree growing on a cliff. Its branches bore seven or eight blue fruits.
Each fruit was about the size of a fist and emitted tiny arcs of lightning.
"Senior Sister, I don’t know..."
Jun Moxiao scratched his head.
Although his current cultivation base was high, his knowledge had not kept pace.
"I don’t know either... It seems we need to read more books in the future..." Luo Li admitted, looking embarrassed.
The three of them, senior sister and junior brothers, had been constantly on the move for years, always fleeing. They didn’t know much about various heavenly materials and earthly treasures.
Therefore, Luo Li decided that in the future, she shouldn’t just focus on cultivation but also read more books to increase her knowledge. Otherwise, even if a Spirit Grass or a Spirit Fruit was placed right in front of her, she wouldn’t be able to recognize it.
The two quickly descended, landing beside the Little Tree.
Jun Moxiao reached out and plucked a blue fruit.
He held it to his nose and sniffed. A peculiar, pleasant fragrance wafted out, suggesting it was no ordinary item.
"Senior Sister, this should be edible, right?" Jun Moxiao asked, holding the blue fruit.
"I suppose so..." Luo Li stuttered.
However, when she saw Jun Moxiao about to put the fruit into his mouth, she immediately grabbed his arm.
"Junior Brother, don’t eat these fruits yet! What if they’re poisonous? It’s better to store them for now," Luo Li said earnestly.
"Alright, Senior Sister!"
Jun Moxiao nodded resignedly. Just as he was about to store the fruit, he suddenly heard a loud shout from high up in the distance.
"You two, get away from there! We saw that Thunder Pulp Fruit Tree first!"
Two figures descended from the sky. They were two young men in their early twenties.
The aura emanating from them was extremely powerful; one was at the Fifth Level of the Divine Bridge Realm, and the other was at the Sixth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm.
These two wore blue Daoist Robes, with a distinctive emblem of a blue sun on their chests.
Seeing this emblem, Luo Li’s and Jun Moxiao’s eyes instantly turned red with fury.
The newcomers were unexpectedly disciples of the Shen Heng Sect.
As the saying goes, when enemies meet, their eyes blaze with exceptional fury.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao, as if by a shared understanding, simultaneously drew their swords and charged towards the two arrivals.
Without a word, they launched a ferocious assault.
SWOOSH!
Tidal waves of sword light descended, each beam containing the illusory image of a Divine Dragon, pulsing with formidable power.
In an instant, countless beams of sword light, like a torrential downpour, engulfed the two Shen Heng Sect disciples.
"You two lunatics! Why are you attacking us on sight?"
The two Shen Heng Sect disciples never dreamed that this young man and woman would be so savage, drawing swords to kill without uttering a single word.
Their swordsmanship was exceedingly sharp, each attack backed by the illusory image of a Divine Dragon, and terrifyingly powerful.
Even though their cultivation bases were higher than this young pair, they were still forced onto the defensive, almost completely unable to retaliate.
They retreated continuously in mid-air, and after a few exchanges, both were wounded.
"You two whelps, do you know who we are?" one of the young men roared angrily as he struggled to parry an attack.
"We are from the Shen Heng Sect!" the other young man shouted, announcing his affiliation as he slashed out with his sword.
Throughout the Shenfeng Dynasty, the Shen Heng Sect, as a major sect, was a superpower. Apart from disciples of the other two major sects, hardly anyone dared to provoke them.
Seeing that Luo Li’s and Jun Moxiao’s Robes were not those of the Qitian Sword Sect or the Yu Mo Sect, and bore no other special markings, the two youths tried to intimidate them by revealing their identities.
But their calculations were wrong.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao were specifically hunting disciples of the Shen Heng Sect!
"Haha! It’s precisely your Shen Heng Sect disciples I’m here to kill!" Jun Moxiao laughed, his demeanor growing even more frenzied.
SLASH!
He unleashed a massive beam of sword light, as thick as a barrel. One of the youths failed to dodge in time, and his arm was severed.
"AH!" the young man screamed in agony.
Jun Moxiao gave him no quarter. Seeing the youth was now Swordless, he lunged forward in a furious assault and, within a few breaths, cut the young man down with his sword.
The other youth, witnessing Jun Moxiao’s ruthlessness—so unlike an ordinary Divine Bridge Realm third level cultivator—was terrified and turned to flee.
SWISH!
Jun Moxiao executed the Nine Changes of the God Dragon, instantly blocking his escape route.
Luo Li immediately followed up with a sword strike from behind.
The sword pierced the young man’s shoulder. He cried out in pain and was sent flying sideways.

chapters.title: Chapter 95 Thunder Pool, Thunder Marsh
chapters.content:
Chapter 95: Chapter 95 Thunder Pool, Thunder Marsh
SWISH!
A stunning sword light imbued with the phantom of a golden dragon swooped down from thesky, cleaving the young man in two.
Blood splashed, falling from mid-air.
The young man didn’t even have time to scream before Jun Moxiao’s sword killed him.
After slaying these two disciples of the Shen Heng Sect, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao looked at each other, their expressions excited, their bodies trembling slightly.
This was their first major victory since entering the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range to seek revenge against the Shen Heng Sect.
Jun Moxiao’s eyes glistened. "Senior Sister," he said excitedly, "every time I kill a disciple of the Shen Heng Sect, I feel like I’ve avenged our deceased master a little more!"
"Yes!"
Luo Li nodded emphatically, tears welling in the corners of her eyes.
Their master had been killed step by step through the Shen Heng Sect’s insidious schemes. Decades ago, their master’s martial brothers and sisters had also been successively eliminated by the Shen Heng Sect.
It could be said that the hatred between their Dragon God Sect and the Shen Heng Sect had become irreconcilably deep.
The two returned to the small green tree. Jun Moxiao then picked the fruit from it and placed it into his storage ring.
The two set out once more.
Along the way, they searched for disciples of the Shen Heng Sect as well as various heavenly materials and earthly treasures.
However, after flying for an hour, the two had not encountered any disciples from the Shen Heng Sect, nor even from the Qitian Sword Sect or the Yu Mo Sect.
Jun Moxiao spotted a few Cultivators ahead who seemed to be searching the ground for something. He quickly flew over and descended before them.
"Fellow Daoists, have you seen any disciples of the three major Sects?" Jun Moxiao asked, cupping his fists in a salute.
Those Cultivators glanced at Jun Moxiao and burst into laughter when they realized he was only at the third level of the Divine Bridge Realm.
"Why would a Loose Cultivator like you be looking for disciples of the major Sects? Don’t you know they’ve already gone deep into the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range to pursue that Leize?"
A middle-aged Cultivator at the Fifth Level of the Divine Bridge Realm sneered.
"Haha!"
Another red-faced Cultivator scoffed, "You’re overestimating yourself! Kid, your cultivation base is too low. Deep in the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range, it’s teeming with lightning and Thunderbolt-attribute Behemoths. You’d better go back!"
"Hahaha..." As the two chimed in, their words triggered a burst of laughter from the others.
Jun Moxiao’s face instantly turned red. He hadn’t expected these people to be so crass.
Luo Li flew over from a distance, landing beside Jun Moxiao.
"Well now, this little girl is quite pretty. How about becoming my Dao companion?"
The red-faced Cultivator laughed lewdly, his face full of vulgarity.
Luo Li’s face turned ashen with anger. She never expected these Cultivators to be so morally bankrupt.
"You dare insult my Senior Sister? All of you will die!"
Jun Moxiao’s eyes glinted with a beast-like, crimson light.
He directly brandished his sword and attacked.
"Persistent brat, you dare to fight back? Kill him!"
Seeing Jun Moxiao’s ferocious charge, the red-faced Cultivator didn’t dare to be careless. He roared and drew his sword to meet the attack.
The others also drew their swords and joined the fray.
"You pieces of trash!" Luo Li shouted, attacking the group of Cultivators.
Sword light surged and Divine Dragons roared. With their formidable combat power and unparalleled Swordsmanship, they wounded several opponents in their opening exchange.
After just two or three exchanges, almost all of them were knocked to the ground, unable to rise.
Is that all they have? And they were still so arrogant?
Contempt filled Jun Moxiao’s eyes.
Although these people appeared to have high cultivation bases, they were far inferior to the two Shen Heng Sect disciples from earlier.
He and his Senior Sister had crushed them with overwhelming ease.
"Young heroes, please spare our lives!"
Lying in pools of their own blood, the Cultivators begged repeatedly for mercy, terrified by the murderous expression on Jun Moxiao’s face as he approached, sword in hand.
How could Jun Moxiao spare them? He delivered a finishing blow to each one and collected their storage rings.
"Senior Sister, let’s go!" Jun Moxiao said with a smile after giving half of the storage rings to Luo Li.
Luo Li nodded.
The two resumed their journey, flying deeper into the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range.
「Meanwhile.」
High in the sky above the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range, the Big Black Horse watched all this with a smile.
These two young masters possessed impressive combat prowess. The disciples of the three major Sects wouldn’t stand a chance unless they attacked in unison.
It released two tendrils of its Divine Sense, which landed on Jun Moxiao and Luo Li. Then, it swaggered deeper into the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range.
That place was filled with intense thunder and lightning—just the way it liked.
Besides, it had seen three young ones hiding there, cultivating. The Big Black Horse felt like stopping by for a chat.
As a high-ranking Thunderbolt-attribute Behemoth, meeting a few juniors was a rare opportunity. Being a creature that enjoyed company, it naturally wouldn’t miss out.
For the Eternal Realm Big Black Horse, its speed was incredible.
With a single stride, it reached the deepest part of the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range.
Overhead, dark clouds filled the sky. Bucket-thick bolts of lightning constantly descended, striking the mountain range and being absorbed by it.
More of the lightning, however, fell into a particular valley.
Having absorbed a vast amount of lightning, this valley had formed a gigantic Thunder Pool.
The Thunder Pool emitted an unimaginably terrifying aura; even high-level Cultivators in the Destiny Realm wouldn’t dare to venture here lightly.
This place is really comfortable. I could go for a soak in there...
The Big Black Horse, now in the form of a black-robed middle-aged man, hovered in mid-air with his arms crossed. His eyes gleamed as he looked down at the Thunder Pool crackling with lightning below.
He shed his clothes and, completely naked, plunged from the sky.
SPLASH!
He landed in the Thunder Pool, sending up huge sprays of lightning-infused water.
"Ah, this is so comfortable!"
The Big Black Horse thrashed about within, rolling, somersaulting, and swimming in various playful styles, thoroughly enjoying himself.
「Meanwhile.」
Thousands of miles from the Thunder Pool, a large, azure bird struggled in its flight.
The closer it flew to the Thunder Pool, the stronger the oppressive might became. Even for it, a Thunderbolt-attribute Behemoth, approaching the Thunder Pool was exceedingly difficult.
I wonder if I can even get close to the Thunder Pool. After all, that place is guarded by three seniors...
Leize mused.
Although it was also a Thunderbolt-attribute Behemoth, the Thunder Pool had always been monopolized by those three seniors. Lesser demon beasts like itself only had a chance to approach the pool once every hundred years.
This was a rule established by the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain.
"Leize! I see it! It’s just ahead!" someone shouted excitedly from hundreds of miles away.
Immediately, dozens of figures rapidly pursued in Leize’s direction.
"Damn humans!" Leize cursed inwardly, abruptly changing direction.
It plunged into the dense forest, vanishing in the blink of an eye.

chapters.title: Chapter 96: Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 96: Chapter 96: Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain
SPLASH!
The Big Black Horse, in the form of a middle-aged man, was frolicking in the Thunder Pool, causing a series of splashes.
Three enormous figures who were cultivating in a palace at the bottom of the Thunder Pool suddenly opened their eyes.
"Big Brother, someone has entered the Thunder Pool!" a shadowy figure exclaimed, standing up in a huff.
"It looks like a human. Which human from the Shenfeng Dynasty dares to enter our Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain’s exclusive Thunder Pool?" another figure also stood up, fuming with rage.
"Second Brother, let’s go and meet this human!"
The three shadows immediately disappeared from the palace.
「The next moment.」
They appeared above the Thunder Pool.
Looking at the naked middle-aged man floating in the pool, anger flared in each of the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain’s eyes.
"Where did this savage come from to cause trouble in our Accumulated Thunder Mountain Thunder Pool?" the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain roared, their voices booming in all directions.
Instantly, thunderbolts wreaked havoc across the heavens and earth, crashing down with MIGHTY RUMBLES.
"Are you—talking to your Uncle Ma?" Big Black Horse declared. With a wave of his hand, he donned his clothes. Then he grinned, flashing a row of white teeth at the three colossal figures opposite him.
The three demon beasts, despite revealing their original forms, didn’t magnify in size.
The one in the middle was an Azure Dragon, wreathed in lightning, emanating the Super Divine Dragon Breath of the First Layer of Heaven’s Will Realm.
On the left was a green bull, completely hairless, its muscles glistening. Its body would occasionally emit bolts of lightning. This green bull’s cultivation base was not low, reaching the Nirvana Realm Tenth Level Peak.
On the far right was a green tiger with wings sprouting from its back. Bolts of lightning would occasionally dart from its wings. Its cultivation base was also at the Nirvana Tenth Level.
Seeing his own kind, the Big Black Horse was in quite a good mood, giggling incessantly.
Then, he leisurely walked over through the void.
With each step he took, his imposing presence grew stronger. After just a few steps, his Super Divine Dragon Breath had already surpassed the Destiny Realm.
Is this a Life and Death Realm senior?
The Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain stared at the approaching middle-aged man, shuddering in fear.
This was indeed a senior from the Life and Death Realm. His cultivation base was terrifyingly profound. In front of this senior, they felt as insignificant as ants.
"All of you, stand still and line up. Let Uncle Ma have a good look at you..."
With his hands clasped behind his back, Big Black Horse strolled over. His intimidating presence was like dozens of mountains pressing down on the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain, leaving them immobilized.
"Hmm, this little dragon of yours is a Thunder Dragon, and your cultivation base is decent, but your bloodline is too impure..." the Big Black Horse commented, pointing at the Azure Dragon.
He then turned to the green bull on the left. He actually walked over and patted the bull’s solid muscles, grinning. "It’s been a while since Uncle Ma had Kui Bull meat. How about you contribute a few pounds?"
The green Kui Bull almost fainted with fright upon hearing these words.
"Senior, please don’t joke like this..." the Kui Bull said, caught between laughter and tears.
"And you!"
In a flash, Big Black Horse was in front of the green tiger. He said with a sly smile, "The meat on this Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger of yours isn’t bad either. Uncle Ma hasn’t had tiger meat for a long time, so why not... cut off a few pounds for Uncle Ma to pair with some wine, eh?"
"Senior, if you want tiger meat, I can find some other sources for you. Please don’t take it out on me!" the Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger stammered, trembling.
In front of this Life and Death Realm powerhouse, how could they, the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain, dare to say no?
Seeing these three demon beasts terrified, the Big Black Horse laughed heartily, instantly releasing his Demonic Aura.
Previously, he had hidden it very well, so these three hadn’t recognized that he too was a mighty demon.
Once he released this Demonic Aura, the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain widened their eyes in disbelief, staring at the middle-aged, black-robed man before them.
This was actually a great demon elder of the Life and Death Realm!
"Heh heh, do you understand now? We’re all family here, more or less. How could I possibly bully little ones like you?" Big Black Horse raised his head triumphantly, laughing merrily.
The reason he released the Super Divine Dragon Breath of his Life and Death Realm cultivation base was also to avoid scaring these three to death by accidentally releasing the Super Divine Dragon Breath of the Eternal Realm. After all, Eternal Realm powerhouses were rare throughout the entire Cangnan Continent. Each and every one of them was renowned.
After he finished laughing, he withdrew his Super Divine Dragon Breath, and the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain immediately relaxed.
"So you are a senior of the Demon Clan..."
