The Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain transformed into three humans, approached with smiles plastered on their faces, and greeted the Big Black Horse.
"Big Dragon, Second Bull, Third Tiger, this old man was just passing by. I saw this Thunder Pool looked nice and came over to take a bath. I also wanted to see you youngsters..." Big Black Horse said casually.
Being suddenly crowned with nicknames by this elder, the Three Saints each had their own bitter complaints but couldn’t voice them. But they had no choice. In the Demon Clan, strength was respected. This Life and Death Realm great demon elder before them was far beyond their ability to match. They would just have to accept the nicknames; it didn’t really matter as long as they weren’t going to die.
"Senior, since you’ve come such a long way, please don’t be in a hurry to leave. We must entertain you properly..." Big Dragon stepped forward, greeted him with clasped fists, and spoke with a broad grin.
This was a Life and Death Realm demon elder. They happened to have many cultivation questions they wished to ask. Normally, an opportunity like this was hard to find even with a lantern. Now, a Life and Death Realm elder had actually taken the initiative to come to Accumulated Thunder Mountain! This truly was a blessing accumulated from their past lives.
Big Black Horse nodded.
Laughing, he patted Big Dragon on the shoulder and said cheerfully, "The youngster is teachable!"
No sooner had he finished speaking than Big Black Horse’s brows furrowed slightly, as if he had noticed something.
Big Dragon quickly approached and asked, "Senior, has something happened on our Accumulated Thunder Mountain?"
"A Thunder Dragon has come running over," Big Black Horse responded casually with a slight smile.
"Oh, so it’s that little Thunder Dragon. It’s somewhat acquainted with us. But it seems to be chased by cultivators from the three great Sects. Since you’ve spoken, Senior, should we let it in here?" Big Dragon said, rubbing his nose.
"When did I say to let it in?" Big Black Horse’s eyes widened as he once again released his powerful presence.
The three great demons felt a heavy weight on their shoulders, as though another great mountain had pressed down on them.
Big Dragon’s face fell as he asked, "Senior, what do you mean then?"
"Just don’t let it into this Thunder Pool. Let that little Thunder Dragon whelp take some damage. Let it keep running all over Accumulated Thunder Mountain..." Big Black Horse said with a smile after some thought.
If that Thunder Dragon ran into the Thunder Pool and healed its injuries, how would his two young masters continue their trials? He must ensure that the Thunder Dragon keeps the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the three great Sects on a wild goose chase around the mountain, allowing his two young masters to have a better trial.
Seeing the Thunder Dragon’s Super Divine Dragon Breath seemed a little unstable, Big Black Horse grabbed a handful of Thunder Pool Water and tossed it.
This handful of Thunder Pool Water instantly disappeared from sight, as if it had teleported.

chapters.title: Chapter 97: Breaking Through the Divine Monarch Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 97: Chapter 97: Breaking Through the Divine Monarch Realm
"We’re almost at the Thunder Pool!"
Leize’s eyes were gleaming with a fervent desire as he watched the lightning bolts, thick as water buckets, striking a distant mountain peak.
He just needed to reach the Thunder Pool. He believed that the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain would definitely not stand by and watch him die. After all, they were all part of the Demon Clan. Besides, they had met once in the past.
He glanced back at the cultivators from the three sects chasing him relentlessly.
He was still hundreds of miles away from the Thunder Pool. The sky was heavily clouded, and the frequency of thunderstorms was extremely high. If he took to the air, he was likely to be struck by lightning. As a Thunderbolt-attribute Behemoth, Leize wasn’t afraid of lightning. However, he couldn’t handle being continuously and extensively attacked by it.
SPLAT!
Before Leize could react, a water ball suddenly slammed into him, drenching him with a bone-chilling coldness.
"Who the hell is ambushing me?" Leize cursed in anger.
But the next moment, something surprising happened. His mouth opened involuntarily, and a waterfall of green thunder water gushed in, flowing into his mouth like a stream. Then his mouth closed on its own. And then, Leize’s mouth was completely and utterly shut.
It’s over... the Three Saints sent me Thunder Pool Water, and I was so rude... this is their punishment for me...
Leize felt like crying but had no tears. At that moment, he repeatedly slapped his own mouth with his wings.
The large clump of Thunder Pool Water that he swallowed entered his body and immediately radiated a powerful life force, rapidly improving his injuries.
Leize’s heart immediately livened up.
The Three Saints still remembered him, their junior. With this Thunder Pool Water, even if he couldn’t enter the Thunder Pool, he could still hold his own against the disciples of the three sects for a while.
With this thought, Leize, still keeping his mouth shut, wheeled around, dodged the lightning from the sky, and flew into a dense forest.
「...」
Meanwhile, Big Black Horse had already entered the Accumulated Thunder Palace. To entertain this senior demon from the Life and Death Realm, the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder had brought out all the treasures they had gathered over the years. All sorts of rare heavenly materials and earth treasures, delicacies, and wine were laid out on the table.
Big Black Horse was having a great feast. He didn’t really care for any of these things. However, having pulled the Master’s carriage for some time, he hadn’t eaten anything substantial. So even if he was eating things he used to snub, he was still extremely happy at heart.
Just then, an indescribable, dreadful Super Divine Dragon Breath spontaneously originated from a very distant place.
Big Black Horse’s face instantly fell. He quickly stood up, went to the center of the great hall, and stared in a certain direction, his eyes emitting rays of divine light.
My cultivation base is still too weak to sense places further away...
Big Black Horse let out a sigh. He had just used his Wushang Divine Skill to investigate the source of the terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath from afar. However, his cultivation base was too weak for the investigation to reach far enough.
Just then, Big Black Horse inadvertently revealed his Eternal Realm Great Demon Super Divine Dragon Breath while using this Divine Skill.
The three Great Demons in the palace were instantly stunned.
"Elder, could it be that you are..."
The three Great Demons immediately fell to their knees, bowing in worship, overwhelmed with excitement. At this moment, they could already recognize that the senior demon in front of them was actually an Eternal Realm Great Demon.
It was simply beyond their wildest imagination. They had never thought that they would one day be able to drink and converse happily with an Eternal Realm Great Demon.
"Shush, knowing is enough..." Big Black Horse turned his head and looked at the three little demons kneeling on the ground, breaking into a broad grin. Then he turned back around, continuing to gaze in a particular direction.
At this exact moment, all the Eternal Realm Strong Persons on the Cangnan Continent, at this moment, felt an indescribable terror emanating from somewhere. Even the Eternal Realm Strong Persons immersed in their cultivation opened their eyes in an instant and stood up abruptly. Everyone turned their gaze in a certain direction.
The Super Divine Dragon Breath from that direction was becoming more terrifying. All the Eternal Realm Strong Persons even started to experience their bodies trembling involuntarily. It was a form of natural suppression, a force so powerful that they felt compelled to worship it from the depths of their souls.
My God, what on earth is happening?
an Eternal Realm Strong Person, trembling all over, murmured to himself.
What is happening inside the barrier?
another Eternal Realm Strong Person, staring at a certain place, exclaimed with a beating heart.
Somewhere in another space stood a duo of old men, one in blue and the other in red, both possessing Eternal Realm Cultivation. These two people were the same two old men that Ye Yun had previously seen outside the safezone.
"It seems like it came from inside the barrier. Does it mean that the outside world is planning to invade our world?" the old man in the blue robe said with anxiety.
"Absolutely not!" The old man in the red robe shook his head and replied in a soft voice, "If the outside world wanted to invade us, they would have done so long ago. Why would they wait until now?"
Then could it be...
A figure in white appeared in the mind of the old man in the blue robe.
Could it be that white-clothed youth? The white-clothed youth was extremely mysterious; even the two of them couldn’t discern his cultivation base. They had once thought that his cultivation base might have been concealed by some Secret Technique.
"I suspect that the youth is breaking through from the Eternal Realm to the True God Realm..." the old man in the blue robe spoke out his inner thoughts.
"What? You’re saying he’s a True God Realm Strong Person?" The old man in the red robe was shocked.
For hundreds of thousands of years, never has there been a True God Realm Strong Person on the Cangnan Continent. This seemed to be a realm that only existed in legends. Or rather, only by passing through the barrier and reaching the outside world could one possibly break through from the Eternal Realm to the True God Realm.
When the two of them thought about this, recalling the actions of that youth, they suddenly felt that this speculation was very likely.
Who would have thought, we just missed the chance to meet a predecessor from the True God Realm...
The two of them exchanged glances, sighing helplessly.
That terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath from a distance was becoming stronger and stronger. These two Eternal Realm Strong Persons had no choice but to harness their tremendous cultivation base to resist the mighty oppression.
But, strangely enough, this strong and terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath could only be sensed by Eternal Realm Strong Persons. Below the Eternal Realm, nothing seemed out of the ordinary to any cultivator.
BOOM!
At this moment, all the Eternal Realm Strong Persons suddenly realized that the entire Cangnan Continent seemed to quiver. Then, a more terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath swept over, causing all the Eternal Realm Strong Persons to lose their footing and sit on the ground.
"Someone has broken through to the True God Realm!" an Eternal Realm ancestor from a prestigious sect, suddenly thinking of a possibility, immediately exclaimed.
"Someone has broken through to the True God Realm!" More and more Eternal Realm Cultivators came to this realization.
On the Cangnan Continent, a True God Realm Strong Person had actually appeared! This had completely shattered the convention of the Cultivation World that had held for hundreds of thousands of years!
Meanwhile, in the far-off Shenfeng Dynasty, deep within the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range, inside the Accumulated Thunder Palace, a greatly moved Big Black Horse kneeled on the ground, muttering: "Congratulations, Master, on breaking through to the Divine Monarch Realm!"

chapters.title: Chapter 98: Ye Yun Returns, Thunder Pool Body Tempering
chapters.content:
Chapter 98: Chapter 98: Ye Yun Returns, Thunder Pool Body Tempering
Master?
This senior is already a great demon of the Eternal Realm... And he still has a master above him? And this master is in the Divine Monarch Realm? What kind of realm is this?
The Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain exchanged glances, their eyes wide with shock, unable to hide the tempest raging in their hearts. They had never even heard of the Divine Monarch Realm. However, considering this senior was already in the Eternal Realm, wouldn’t his master be at least in the True God Realm?
The more the three thought about it, the more terrified they became. They hastily stood up, scrambled behind the Big Black Horse, and knelt on the ground. The three great demons didn’t even dare to breathe heavily. The entire hall was so quiet you could hear a pin drop.
Suddenly, space rippled, and a young man in white robes walked out.
The Big Black Horse, which had been muttering to itself with its head down, abruptly looked up, its face etched with astonishment.
Master broke through to the Divine Monarch Realm! It’s only been such a short time, yet he’s already returned so quickly! The Divine Monarch Realm is truly terrifying.
"Little Horse, you’ve been living quite comfortably here, haven’t you?" Ye Yun said with a faint smile, his hands clasped behind his back.
"Master, Little Horse knows his mistake..." The Big Black Horse rolled on the ground and instantly transformed back into a large black horse.
This scene left the Three Saints, who were watching from behind, utterly dumbfounded.
This divinely handsome young man in white is the master of this Eternal Realm senior, the horse? Could he... possibly be a True God-level expert?
The three secretly extended their Divine Sense to probe him but found they couldn’t detect any cultivation base from the man before them at all.
Ye Yun lifted his eyelids slightly. Instantly, an invisible force flooded into the minds of the three. Their eyes glazed over for a moment, as if something was missing from their minds. In that instant, Ye Yun had directly erased some of their memories. He didn’t want these three little ones to know about his breakthrough to the Divine Monarch Realm.
Ye Yun patted the Big Black Horse’s smooth back and said with a smile, "Since you’re here, just relax. You must be tired from pulling the carriage all this time. We can also take a break here for a while..."
"Master, I..." The Big Black Horse knelt on its front hooves, so moved it almost cried.
Ye Yun smiled faintly and reached out. The void rippled, and the black carriage, a thousand li away, was drawn by him into the main hall.
"Who? Who dares to steal my Master’s carriage?" The black-robed youth, the Big Black Cat’s transformation, stood alertly on the carriage, his eyes fiercely scanning the surroundings.
When it saw its white-robed Master standing in the main hall, with Uncle Ma beside him, the Big Black Cat immediately changed shape, transforming back into a little black cat. It pounced over nimbly.
"Master, I didn’t expect you back so soon! I thought someone had stolen the carriage..." The Big Black Cat didn’t dare to hug Ye Yun’s legs, so it knelt on the ground and kowtowed repeatedly. Its voice was mournful, as if it were on the verge of tears.
Ye Yun smiled.
This Big Black Cat is quite an actor.
Without a word, he released a trace of Mana, lifting the Big Black Cat from the ground.
"Little Horse, Little Cat, while you’re here, you can take human form. It’s a good opportunity to interact with these fellow cultivators from the Demon Clan!" Ye Yun said with a smile, and then his body vanished instantly.
Hearing their master’s words, the Big Black Horse and the Big Black Cat were overjoyed, their faces beaming with delight. They both changed shape, one becoming a middle-aged man in a black robe, and the other a black-robed youth.
The Big Black Cat ran over to the Big Black Horse, pointed to the three figures nearby, and asked with a chuckle, "Uncle Ma, are these the three monsters from Accumulated Thunder Mountain?"
"That’s right!" The Big Black Horse clapped the Big Black Cat on the shoulder and laughed heartily. "Your cultivation bases are all similar, so it’s a perfect chance to exchange some insights!"
Saying this, the Big Black Horse beckoned with his hand.
The Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain promptly ran over. The three of them cupped their fists and said with a smile, "You must be the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, right? We have long heard of your great name!"
"You’re too kind, too kind!" The Big Black Cat chuckled. He sized up the three, quickly discerning their true origins, then cupped his fists in a gesture of respect.
These three had slightly weaker bloodlines than him, but their cultivation bases were roughly similar. Especially the Thunder Dragon, who was already at the First Layer of the Destiny Realm. This ignited a fire in the Big Black Cat’s heart. He wished he could break through from the Nirvana Realm Tenth Level Peak to the Destiny Realm at that very moment.
「Above the Thunder Pool.」
Ye Yun appeared. He glanced lightly at the Thunder Pool, a faint smile touching his lips. The water in this Thunder Pool wasn’t of high quality, but it was perfectly adequate. It would be excellent for tempering the bodies of the three disciples of the Dragon God Sect. Especially after they absorbed the Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood, using the Thunder Pool Water to temper their bodies would greatly increase the absorption speed.
With a thought from Ye Yun, a ray of light descended before him. As the light dissipated, Su Wanyi, who had been cultivating, appeared. Feeling the shift in space and time, she immediately opened her eyes from her cultivation state, only to find herself sitting cross-legged above a green Thunder Pool.
"Greetings, Master Ancestor!" Su Wanyi hurriedly rose and bowed to Ye Yun.
RUMBLE!
Just as she finished speaking, from the dense clouds above, thunderbolts as thick as water buckets rained down.
Ye Yun glanced at the lightning. These barrel-thick thunderbolts surprisingly and obediently veered off in other directions, bypassing Su Wanyi and Ye Yun.
"This..." Su Wanyi was greatly startled as she looked up at the dense, barrel-thick lightning bolts descending from the sky.
"The Thunder Pool Water here is suitable for tempering the body and can also help you quickly refine the Ancestral Dragon Blood. For the coming days, you will all refine it here..." Ye Yun said softly.
He pointed a finger, and a white halo about seven or eight zhang across instantly appeared above the Thunder Pool. This halo emitted an indescribable, sacred aura, completely isolating a section of the Thunder Pool. The lightning bolts in the sky, upon encountering the halo, obediently detoured around it.
"Yes, Master Ancestor!" Su Wanyi replied.
However, as she prepared to jump into the Thunder Pool Water to cultivate, she still felt her heart pound at the terrifying aura it emanated. After all, she was only at the Shaping God Realm Level 3.
"Don’t worry. I’ve set up a Formation in this area. The power of the Thunder Pool Water has been greatly reduced, perfectly matching your current cultivation base..." Ye Yun said with a smile.
"That’s wonderful!" Su Wanyi cheered.
Her body flickered, and in the next second, she plunged into the Thunder Pool Water. Countless streams of lightning energy surged into her body, causing a tingling, numbing, and itching sensation, but it caused no actual harm. Su Wanyi relaxed, closed her eyes, and continued to refine the Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood within her body that she had not yet fully processed.
"Take this drop as well!" Ye Yun flicked his finger, and another drop of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood landed by Su Wanyi’s lips.
She quickly opened her mouth and swallowed this drop of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood.
The Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood transformed into an unimaginably potent life force, immediately surging through her body like a great, flooding river. The surging lightning energy and the energy of the Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood converged, washing through Su Wanyi’s physical body together, causing her refinement speed to accelerate dramatically.
So fast!
Su Wanyi was astonished. This refinement speed was more than three times faster!
Seeing Su Wanyi proceeding methodically and everything going as it should, Ye Yun nodded.
Actually, he also had Thunder Pools in his storage. Not just one, but at least tens of thousands. However, even the lowest-quality Thunder Pool could not be used unless one’s cultivation base reached the Eternal Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 99: Thunderbolt Spirit Fruit, Start Snatching
chapters.content:
Chapter 99: Chapter 99: Thunderbolt Spirit Fruit, Start Snatching
One hundred thousand years of check-ins.
The rewards Ye Yun had accumulated were extraordinary, not only surpassing this world but transcending all the Ten Thousand Realms.
They weren’t just Emperor Level, God Level, or Super God Level...
But also Supreme Level, Dao Patriarch Level, Immortal Level, and Epoch Level...
There were some items he couldn’t even reveal yet; if he did, this world might not be able to withstand them.
Therefore, for Ye Yun, he lacked nothing.
Ye Yun’s gaze pierced through layers of earth veins, landing within the Accumulated Thunder Palace.
The Big Black Horse and the Big Black Cat had already transformed into human forms, becoming honored guests of the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain, feasting and reveling with great joy.
Ye Yun smiled faintly. He paid no heed to these two.
After all, they were just two demon beasts, usually quite diligent. He would let them relax for a while.
Ye Yun then looked into the distance. Seeing Luo Li and Jun Moxiao, the corners of his mouth lifted into a slight smile.
Those two little ones were still traversing the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range, searching for disciples from the three great Sects. Occasionally, when they encountered a genius earth treasure, they would quickly dig it up and store it safely.
Seeing that everything was proceeding in an orderly fashion, Ye Yun was quite satisfied and prepared to cultivate. After all, having just broken through to the Divine Monarch Realm, he needed to stabilize his cultivation base.
With a flash, Ye Yun concealed himself in the void above the Thunder Pool.
RUMBLE!
From the rolling dark clouds, thick bolts of lightning descended, but they only struck the periphery of the Thunder Pool. Not a single bolt dared to fall upon the Thunder Pool itself.
Since Ye Yun’s breakthrough to the Divine Monarch Realm, his cultivation base had become even more terrifying.
He had torn through the void from a barrier countless miles away to return to the Shenfeng Dynasty, a journey that now took him mere breaths.
This speed far surpassed his previous capabilities.
Upon entering the Divine Monarch Realm, Ye Yun’s understanding of this world had naturally deepened.
「Deep in Accumulated Thunder Mountain.」
Two figures flew through the dense forest at an extremely low altitude.
Dark clouds billowed, and thunder boomed.
RUMBLE...
Thick bolts of lightning continuously fell from the sky.
The two figures moved erratically, constantly evading the lightning.
"Elder Sister, there’s too much lightning here!" Jun Moxiao shouted.
"Yes, we need to be extra careful!" Luo Li replied, her tone grave.
They had ventured deep into Accumulated Thunder Mountain, where lightning strikes were increasingly frequent.
Flying at high altitudes was no longer an option, as it would attract even more lightning.
They could only skim close to the ground.
After flying for the time it takes an incense stick to burn, they had found nothing.
They hadn’t spotted any cultivators, nor had they found any genius earth treasures.
This left Jun Moxiao somewhat disheartened.
"Elder Sister, I wonder where all the disciples from the three major Sects have gone!" Jun Moxiao exclaimed in frustration, slamming his fist against a nearby black tree.
Strangely, despite his powerful physique, he failed to break the large tree.
"This tree is so tough!" he exclaimed, his face a mask of shock.
"Constantly baptized by massive amounts of lightning, the trees here are naturally different from ordinary ones outside," Luo Li chuckled, covering her mouth.
"Elder Sister, if that’s the case, could these trees be treasures? Why don’t we chop some down and put them in our storage rings?" Jun Moxiao suggested, his eyes lighting up.
"Alright!" Luo Li’s eyes instantly sparkled.
Both had a particular fondness for collecting all sorts of genius earth treasures.
Realizing these trees might also be treasures, they immediately decided to target them.
SWISH!
Jun Moxiao drew his Chaos Element Unlimited Sword and swung it at a large tree.
The tree was incredibly thick, requiring three or four people to encircle it with their arms.
He swung with great force, yet he didn’t manage to cut through the tree, only leaving a shallow gash on its trunk.
ZAP!
A streak of blue lightning erupted from the shallow gash, instantly traveling up the Chaos Element Unlimited Sword and into Jun Moxiao’s body.
Jun Moxiao convulsed and nearly collapsed.
"Elder Sister, there’s actually lightning in this tree..." Jun Moxiao said, embarrassed.
He raised his arm, finding it numb and powerless from the electric shock.
Luo Li walked over and examined the gash on the tree. Drawing her Supreme Golden Dragon Sword, she mused aloud, "Junior Brother, perhaps lightning is only released on the first cut. Now that it’s open, a second attempt shouldn’t trigger anything. Let me try!"
With that, Luo Li fiercely slashed at the existing cut.
SIZZLE!
An even thicker bolt of lightning shot up the Supreme Golden Dragon Sword.
The lightning was so powerful that Luo Li went numb all over, barely able to keep her grip on her sword.
"Elder Sister, are you alright?" Jun Moxiao rushed over to check on her.
Her face was pale, and her lips were trembling. She had clearly received quite a jolt.
"I’m fine, it’s nothing serious..." Luo Li said, recovering her composure after a moment. She then put away her Supreme Golden Dragon Sword.
"Junior Brother, it seems these trees of Accumulated Thunder Mountain are not fated for us..." Luo Li lamented, a pained expression on her perfect face.
It was as if she were looking at a mountain of treasures she couldn’t claim, her heart aching at the missed opportunity.
Jun Moxiao also sighed in disappointment.
The dejected pair calmed themselves and set off once more.
After crossing a mountain peak, they finally spotted several cultivators in a dense forest ahead.
"Little Brother, those are people from the Qitian Sword Sect!" Luo Li said in a low voice, squinting into the distance.
"The Qitian Sword Sect members are no saints either. Elder Sister, we can’t let them get away!" Jun Moxiao declared, drawing his sword, a murderous glint in his eyes.
Luo Li nodded.
The Qitian Sword Sect had clashed with them a few times before, but their Ancestor had always intervened to resolve matters. This time, however, their Ancestor wasn’t present.
This time, it would be up to them, disciples of the Dragon God Sect, to deal with these cultivators from the Qitian Sword Sect!
The two quickly flew towards them.
Approaching, they found three or four Qitian Sword Sect disciples gathered around a small green tree, discussing how to divide the Spirit Fruit.
This small tree resembled the Thunderbolt Fruit Tree they had encountered earlier, though it was about half a meter taller. Its branches were laden with a considerable number of fruits.
Each green fruit was crystal clear, its surface shimmering with a layer of lightning. They were also noticeably larger than the Thunderbolt Spirit Fruit they had previously obtained.
"Junior Brothers, there are four of us. As your Senior Brother, I’ll take three extra. Let’s not argue about it, alright?" a youth with a mole between his eyebrows was bargaining with the three junior disciples beside him.
"Enough discussion. All the fruits on this Thunderbolt Fruit Tree are ours now!" an indifferent voice suddenly declared.
Jun Moxiao and Luo Li strode out from the dense forest.
The youth with the mole between his eyebrows looked up. Upon seeing the cultivation level of the young man and woman, a sneer touched his lips.
He couldn’t help but sneer, "Such arrogance! In the Shenfeng Dynasty, not even disciples from the Yu Mo Sect or the Shen Heng Sect would dare speak to us Qitian Sword Sect disciples in such a manner!"
"Haha! Senior Brother, where did these two fools crawl out from? Only at the Divine Bridge Realm third level, yet they dare to covet the Thunderbolt Spirit Fruit that we, the Qitian Sword Sect, have laid claim to?" the three youths beside him roared with laughter.
But in the next moment, their laughter died abruptly.
A torrent of sword light surged towards them from two directions.
The four Qitian Sword Sect disciples barely managed to defend against a few attacks before, amidst terrified screams, they were slain on the spot by Luo Li and Jun Moxiao!

chapters.title: Chapter 100 - Battle with Leize!
chapters.content:
Chapter 100: Chapter 100 - Battle with Leize!
The Longsword returned to its sheath.
As the Divine Dragon Phantom vanished, Jun Moxiao stood his ground. A sneer touched his lips as he gazed at the four corpses.
These four disciples of the Qitian Sword Sect possessed cultivation bases of varying levels; the strongest was at the Sixth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm, while the weakest was at the Divine Bridge Realm second level.
How could they possibly be a match for him and his Senior Sister?
Jun Moxiao retrieved the storage rings from the four bodies, gave two to his Senior Sister, and then the pair continued on their journey.
Neither of them knew the location of the Thunder Pool, nor the whereabouts of the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the three major Sects. The Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range was vast and boundless, offering them only uncertainty. They had no choice but to venture deeper, hoping to try their luck.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
One after another, massive lightning bolts crashed down from the low-hanging clouds, their frequency growing increasingly dense.
While flying at low altitudes, they had to constantly be wary of these lightning bolts.
These lightning bolts struck without any discernible pattern.
Sometimes an area would be sparsely struck, while at other times, a small region would be incredibly dense with lightning.
The density was such that within a radius of about ten zhang, hundreds of lightning bolts could strike.
Each bolt was at least a chi thick, an awe-inspiring spectacle that made one feel insignificant before the overwhelming might of nature.
Jun Moxiao and Luo Li had to utilize the Divine Dragon Nine-Change Body Technique, navigating through the relentless barrage of lightning in a rather harried state.
"Senior Sister, I fear the disciples from those three Sects are not faring much better..."
After traversing a densely lightning-stricken area, they paused to catch their breath. Jun Moxiao stood atop a massive boulder, surveying his surroundings, and spoke softly.
"I don’t know where those people have gone, and there’s still no sign of the Thunder Pool..." Luo Li said, vexed.
She leaped onto the giant stone as well, gazing into the distance for any clues.
Their current location was already considered deep within the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range.
Few Cultivators ever ventured this far.
Thus, despite scanning their surroundings for a long time, they didn’t spot a single soul.
A flash of lightning suddenly shot out from the dense forest, hovering in mid-air. Leize stared at the young man and woman before it, a ruthless glint in its eyes.
So, it’s just two lone young Cultivators, both at the mere Divine Bridge Realm third level.
Even injured, dealing with these two youngsters will be no problem at all.
Hundreds of zhang separated them. Leize’s nose twitched; it quickly smelled a special Super Divine Dragon Breath emanating from the two young Cultivators.
These two young Cultivators actually possess the Dragon God Bloodline?
Leize was astonished.
Avarice then gleamed in its eyes.
If I devour these two young Cultivators, the benefits to my recovery and cultivation base growth will be immeasurable!
Leize was consumed by greed at this moment.
Its massive wings beat fiercely, transforming it into a streak of lightning. Dodging the ceaseless barrage of falling bolts, it sped towards the two young Cultivators.
"Senior Sister, what if the Cultivators from the three major Sects caught that Leize and have already taken it from here?" Jun Moxiao mused, gazing into the distance, a wry smile on his face as he considered the possibility.
"That’s unlikely. Junior Brother, the Ancestor sent us here for training. If the three major Sects had captured Leize and left, the Ancestor would have informed us immediately," Luo Li shook her head and replied.
"The Ancestor has already left. Can he still manage affairs here?" Jun Moxiao smiled wryly.
"Junior Brother, don’t forget about the Big Black Horse. It’s incredibly powerful. If there were any issues, it would surely inform us. It wouldn’t let us run around like headless chickens." Luo Li’s eyes sparkled, and she gave a sly smile.
That Big Black Horse has an immeasurably profound cultivation base.
Now that the Ancestor is gone, the Big Black Horse will definitely help us in secret.
After all, back at the Blood Robe Sect, it was the Big Black Horse who protected us juniors.
Just as they were speaking, a sinister laugh suddenly echoed from behind them.
"HAHA, no need to search any further! I, Leize, have arrived!"
Jun Moxiao and Luo Li spun around at the sound.
Perched on a high tree branch, a massive azure bird stared down at them.
The bird was enormous, tiny sparks of lightning crackling across its azure feathers. Its aura was incredibly powerful, having reached the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm.
"Leize, you’ve certainly made us search hard for you!" Jun Moxiao exclaimed, his excitement palpable as he instantly drew his Sword.
The Ancestor didn’t give specific instructions for their training, but he and Senior Sister had long since agreed: they would capture this Leize.
At this, Luo Li also drew her Sword.
The Senior Sister and Junior Brother shared a tacit understanding, attacking Leize simultaneously.
SWISH! SWISH!
Streaks of Sword Qi shot towards the heavens, Divine Dragon Phantoms weaving amongst them, radiating immense power.
"You two insignificant Cultivators, merely at the Divine Bridge Realm third level, dare to attack me? Hilarious!" Leize shrieked, its voice filled with rage and disbelief.
It hadn’t expected these two unknown young Cultivators to attack on sight.
This isn’t how it’s supposed to go!
Wasn’t I supposed to be hunting these two Human Race youngsters?
How have the tables turned?
These two don’t look like they’re from the three major Sects. How can they be so audacious?
The more Leize pondered, the more enraged it became. It opened its maw, and a torrent of lightning bolts erupted forth.
These lightning bolts coalesced into broad Thunderbolt Swords, CRACKLING as they surged violently towards the brilliant Sword Light unleashed by Luo Li and Jun Moxiao.
BOOM!
The Divine Dragon Sword Light clashed with the Thunderbolt Swords. After an earth-shattering explosion, both attacks dissipated simultaneously.
Leize was aghast.
How could these two youngsters’ Swordsmanship be so powerful?
Even the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the three major Sects, at this cultivation realm, wouldn’t possess such formidable individual combat strength, would they?
SWOOSH!
Leize beat its wings, soaring into the air. It hovered, unleashing a frenzied barrage of Thunderbolt Swords downwards.
Although I was severely injured before, after consuming that mass of Thunder Pool Water, my injuries have mostly healed. I can sustain combat for a while longer.
I must devour these two Human Race youths.
Once I absorb their Dragon God Bloodline, my injuries will heal rapidly! Perhaps... I might even break through to the Nirvana Realm!
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao easily evaded Leize’s attacks.
Employing the Divine Dragon Nine-Change Body Technique, their movements were unpredictable, a myriad of phantoms crisscrossing the air as they launched a ferocious assault on Leize.
This direct close-quarters engagement immediately had Leize crying out in distress.
I never imagined that a pair of youths so young would be this troublesome, even more formidable than those Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the three major Sects!
After several exchanges, Leize was already planning its escape.
If I don’t flee now, my old injuries might relapse, and I could very well be trapped here by these two youngsters.
WHOOSH!
A glint flashed in Leize’s eyes. It opened its great maw once more, and a veritable ocean of lightning instantly erupted, surging madly towards the duo.
"Senior Sister, this is bad! Leize... it looks like it’s trying to escape!" Jun Moxiao exclaimed, his gaze sharp. Having instantly discerned Leize’s intention, he unleashed the Nine Changes of the God Dragon. Countless Divine Dragon Phantoms streaked past the sea of lightning, pouncing towards Leize.

chapters.title: Chapter 101: Ancestral Guidance, Collecting Thunder Pools
chapters.content:
Chapter 101: Chapter 101: Ancestral Guidance, Collecting Thunder Pools
"Escape? How could that be possible? If you run away, how are we going to explain things to our Ancestor?" Luo Li sneered, her body suddenly turning ethereal. A golden dragon’s phantasm flickered past, and in an instant, she reappeared in a different direction. Luo Li’s aura transformed as her Super Divine Dragon Breath surged differently, and the huge golden dragon previously on her back vanished.
SWOOSH, SWOOSH, SWOOSH... The Supreme Golden Dragon Sword vibrated, and from its tip, golden lotus flowers bloomed one after another. These golden lotuses, varying in size, filled the void, sealing off all of Leize’s potential escape routes.
When Leize saw the golden lotuses, its expression changed. It discovered that these golden lotuses were entirely composed of Sword Qi. It dared not confront them head-on. It had no choice but to turn and attack Jun Moxiao instead. As long as it could repel the young man before it, it could escape with ease.
However, to its surprise, Jun Moxiao’s sword also vibrated, and golden Sword Qi lotuses bloomed forth one after another. The golden Sword Qi lotuses expanded, swirling through the void and completely sealing off the area.
At this moment, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao unleashed the supreme swordsmanship they had comprehended from the Sword King Stone: the Nine Heavens Lotus Sutra. This technique was co-created by Ye Yun and his close confidante, Liu Yiyi. It excelled in both offense and defense, perfect for trapping and eliminating foes. It was considerably more versatile than the grandiose Dragon God Sword Technique.
Now that Leize intended to escape, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao naturally used the Nine Heavens Lotus Sutra to trap it. Otherwise, if a thunder-attributed avian demon beast like this decided to flee, its speed would be astonishing, and the two of them would genuinely be unable to catch it.
Golden Sword Lotuses spun, forming a three-dimensional net that continuously tightened, pressing inward. Leize, unable to evade, had to constantly spew bolts of lightning, frantically attacking the golden Sword Lotuses.
SIZZLE... SIZZLE... Yet, the golden Sword Lotuses kept spinning, surprisingly neutralizing most of the lightning attacks. Some of the golden Sword Lotuses, guided by their control, suddenly accelerated and slammed viciously into Leize’s body.
BOOM! BOOM! The Sword Lotuses shattered upon impact! Leize shrieked in pain as its tough feathers were blasted apart. Flesh and blood flew, and its wounds gushed fresh blood.
This was also the first time Luo Li and Jun Moxiao had combined their swords in such a way, executing this swordsmanship flawlessly. The void above and below was saturated with golden Sword Lotuses, sealing every inch of space.
BOOM! BOOM! The pair launched their attacks, continuously inflicting heavy damage on Leize.
"Junior Brother, at this rate, it seems we’re going to kill this Leize!" Luo Li remarked suddenly, observing Leize’s pitiful state.
"Yes, Senior Sister. Should we spare its life?" Jun Moxiao asked, raising an eyebrow. After all, their Ancestor had only instructed them to gain experience; he hadn’t specified any particular requirements. If they killed Leize, they feared they wouldn’t be able to account for it to their Ancestor.
"Let’s severely injure it first, then we can decide. Just leave it barely alive," Luo Li said after a moment’s thought.
"Alright!" Jun Moxiao nodded.
What? Leave it barely alive?
Leize, overhearing their conversation, felt a sudden glimmer of hope ignite within its heart.
It seemed these two didn’t intend to kill it...
Thinking this, Leize quickly cried out, "Great ones, please show mercy!" Saying this, it abandoned all resistance, hovering motionlessly in mid-air. A few golden Sword Lotuses drifted unhurriedly towards it, blasting away its azure feathers, inflicting several new wounds, and drawing fresh blood. Leize forced itself to remain still. It knew that if it didn’t show some goodwill and beg for its life from these two, it might perish today.
Luo Li stayed her hand. The tip of her sword trembled gently, and the golden Sword Lotuses continued to spin in the void but ceased their attack. Jun Moxiao likewise controlled his golden Sword Lotuses, halting his assault. Witnessing this, Leize was overcome with a mixture of surprise and joy; its life was saved. It heaved a sigh of relief, a look of remorse surfacing in its eyes. If it hadn’t coveted these two young monks, it wouldn’t have taken such a risk. Who could have imagined that these two youths, a young man and woman possessing the Dragon God Bloodline and merely at the Divine Bridge Realm third level, would wield such terrifying power?
"We can spare you. But if you run away, we won’t be able to explain it to our Ancestor!" Luo Li said, looking at Leize with a frown.
"I won’t run! My life was granted by you two great ones. I’ll do whatever you say, without the slightest defiance!" Leize hastily replied. At this moment, many of its feathers had been blasted off. Its numerous bloody wounds were a shocking sight, and an unimaginable pain wracked its body. Leize endured the pain; to survive, it had no other choice. As long as those golden Sword Lotuses disappeared, it believed it could escape. Leize could also see that this young pair was not as fast as it; they had only managed to trap it by relying on this unexpected swordsmanship.
"Senior Sister, we don’t really have a good way to control such a powerful demon beast..." Jun Moxiao transmitted mentally, frowning.
Hearing her Junior Brother’s words, Luo Li also felt somewhat helpless. Among them—the three disciples—aside from their considerable skill in the three major Cultivation Techniques of the Dragon God Sect, they were clueless about subduing demon beasts.
In her mind, the simplest solution was to injure the demon beast so severely that it couldn’t possibly escape.
The words of a cultivation technique’s incantation suddenly appeared in Luo Li’s mind. Simultaneously, a Mysterious Green Bracelet materialized on Luo Li’s wrist.
"Use this bracelet to capture it. From now on, Leize’s life will be entirely at your whim..." The Ancestor’s calm voice echoed in Luo Li’s mind.
The Ancestor is still here!
Luo Li was so overjoyed she almost cried out. She quickly clasped her hands, bowed towards the empty air, and silently said, "Thank you, Ancestor!"
"Senior Sister, has the Ancestor returned after his breakthrough?" Jun Moxiao asked anxiously.
"I don’t know..." Luo Li shook her head, then smiled. "But the Ancestor is always looking out for us juniors..." At this, her eyes moistened, tears welling within them. Jun Moxiao was also deeply moved.
Luo Li wiped her tears, raised the green bracelet on her wrist, and began to activate the spell. The Mysterious Green Bracelet suddenly emitted a soft, glowing light. This brilliance intensified, forming a green thread that shot directly towards Leize. The moment Leize saw this green thread, it was instinctively overcome with immense terror. Just as it turned to flee, the green thread abruptly accelerated, striking Leize and drawing it into the bracelet.
"Senior Sister, what is this?" Jun Moxiao asked, curiously examining the Mysterious Green Bracelet.
"The Ancestor just gave this to me. He taught me a spell, and I used it to capture Leize inside this bracelet," Luo Li said with delight. Now, with Leize inside, she had it completely under her control.
Indeed, she could decide Leize’s life or death with a single thought.
"Wow, this bracelet is amazing! We can collect so many demon beasts now. In the future, they can guard the Dragon God Sect for us or serve as mounts for the disciples..." Jun Moxiao mused aloud. Finally, he slapped his thigh and exclaimed with a woeful expression, "Senior Sister, I want to ask the Ancestor for a bracelet too!"
WHOOSH! A streak of green light flashed through the air and settled onto Jun Moxiao’s wrist. Jun Moxiao stared, stunned. On his wrist was a bracelet identical to his Senior Sister’s.

chapters.title: Chapter 102: Leize Leads the Way, Battle with the Leader
chapters.content:
Chapter 102: Chapter 102: Leize Leads the Way, Battle with the Leader
"Thank you, Elder Ancestor!"
Jun Moxiao’s previously mournful face suddenly lit up with joy. He ecstatically raised his wrist and said triumphantly to Luo Li, "Senior Sister, look, I got one too."
"You little rascal..." Luo Li laughed heartily.
Although her little Junior Brother looked quite tall and sturdy, in reality, he was only about thirteen or fourteen years old. Essentially, he still had the disposition of a youth. So sometimes, he couldn’t help but act a bit childish.
Luo Li guessed the Elder Ancestor had also noticed this, which was why he had given Jun Moxiao a bracelet too.
It had to be said. The Elder Ancestor had truly put a lot of thought and care into them, the three juniors.
"Junior Brother... this is great! In the future, not only can we collect various natural treasures, but if we encounter suitable demon beasts, we can also bring them into the bracelet," Luo Li said with a smile.
"Yes," Jun Moxiao also nodded and smiled.
He recalled the incantation in his mind and manipulated the bracelet, finding that it indeed lit up. He quickly stopped the incantation, as there were no demon beasts around for him to capture at the moment.
Luo Li’s expression turned serious as a thought struck her. "We must cultivate diligently. Although this bracelet can theoretically capture all kinds of demon beasts, its effectiveness is also related to the owner’s cultivation base."
Recalling the cultivation incantation, Jun Moxiao also nodded and said, "Yes, Senior Sister. To capture a demon beast, one must be able to defeat it first..."
At this point, he suddenly scratched his head and chuckled in embarrassment. "When I first saw the bracelet on your hand, Senior Sister, I actually thought any demon beast could be captured by it!"
"Dream on," Luo Li said, exasperated. "Do you really think just any bracelet could capture a Wushang Great Demon like the Big Black Horse?"
"Haha, Senior Sister, I guess I was being too fanciful," Jun Moxiao laughed awkwardly.
With a thought from Luo Li, a green light shot out from the bracelet, enveloping Lei Ze. The green light faded, and Lei Ze returned to its normal size.
At this moment, Lei Ze looked at the two youths before it, its eyes filled with utter terror. Especially that green bracelet on the young girl’s wrist—it had no idea what kind of Divine Artifact it was, but it had been effortlessly captured by it.
Upon entering the wondrous space within that bracelet, Lei Ze was shocked to realize its very life was now controlled by it. A mere thought from the bracelet’s master, and it would instantly perish without a trace.
"Lei Ze greets you, Master!" Lei Ze prostrated respectfully on the ground, kowtowing to Luo Li.
"Get up," Luo Li said indifferently.
Lei Ze scrambled to its feet, standing very timidly and not daring to even breathe too loudly.
It finally understood. These two young individuals definitely had a formidable background. They were certainly not mere Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Shenfeng Dynasty; perhaps... they were from the Plough Heaven Dynasty. They were absolutely not beings it could afford to provoke.
"Lei Ze, we entered the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range primarily to find disciples from the three major sects for combat training. They’ve been chasing you; do you know their current whereabouts?" Luo Li asked seriously.
"Master, I managed to shake them off temporarily. I know their approximate location!" Lei Ze replied hastily.
"Then take us to them quickly." Luo Li’s face immediately lit up with joy.
They had been searching for the disciples of the three major sects for a long time. So far, they had only found a few scattered normal disciples who had come to the Accumulated Thunder Mountain for training, but not their main forces.
Lei Ze prostrated on the ground and said respectfully, "Master, please sit on my back. I will take you to them."
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao were momentarily stunned, then their faces lit up with elation. This Lei Ze was a flying demon beast, and its speed was considerable. Now that it was subdued, they had a mount for transportation. This was truly an unexpected boon.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao leaped onto Lei Ze’s back.
WHOOSH!
Lei Ze’s wings beat, and it immediately took flight, soaring at a low altitude. During the flight, it had to constantly dodge the dense bolts of lightning striking down from the dark clouds. However, being a thunder-elemental demon beast, it was extremely sensitive to lightning. Thus, even as the lightning grew increasingly dense, it could generally anticipate and accurately evade the strikes. This caused Luo Li and Jun Moxiao to exclaim in amazement.
Lei Ze flew with intense concentration, not daring to let any lightning from the clouds strike its back and harm its two young masters. After all, its life was in the hands of that young girl. And the boy was the young girl’s Junior Brother; their relationship was clearly not shallow, so Lei Ze dared not risk any mishap.
They flew for the time it takes for an entire incense stick to burn. From a distance, they flew straight into a group of young men clad in distinctive black robes.
Those are people from the Yu Mo Sect...
Seeing these familiar robe designs, a grave expression touched the eyes of Luo Li and Jun Moxiao.
These people from the Yu Mo Sect fight with extreme ferocity. Last time, if they hadn’t used the Reverse Dragon Technique, they truly would have been unable to defeat those ruthless and savage individuals.
And now, there were about twenty Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Yu Mo Sect, more than double the number they had encountered at Cloud Dream Mountain. Last time, there had only been eight of them.
"Senior Sister, our training opponents are finally strong enough..." Jun Moxiao licked his lips, a sharp glint flashing in his eyes, revealing his intense desire for victory.
"Mm," Luo Li nodded.
The group of Yu Mo Sect disciples before them was numerous. The one with the highest cultivation base had reached the ninth level of the Divine Bridge Realm, while the lowest was at the fourth level of the Divine Bridge Realm. This was a far cry from the group they had encountered at Cloud Dream Mountain.
However... After this period of cultivation, both her and her Junior Brother’s cultivation had advanced to the third level of the Divine Bridge Realm. Naturally, their current strength couldn’t be compared to when they were at the first level of the Divine Bridge Realm.
The sound of something slicing through the air arose, rapidly approaching from a distance. The Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Yu Mo Sect flew out swiftly from the depths of the dense forest, all while dodging the frequent lightning strikes.
"This blasted place! There’s way too much lightning!" one disciple grumbled, cursing under his breath.
"Yeah, trying to kill that Lei Ze ourselves really isn’t easy... In this leadership contest among the three major sects, it all comes down to who’s lucky enough to find that injured Lei Ze first!"
At the head of the group, a dark-faced youth, whose cultivation was at the ninth level of the Divine Bridge Realm, frowned and sighed.
This Lei Ze was, indeed, the ultimate prize in the leadership contest of the three major sects. Whichever sect managed to kill Lei Ze would emerge victorious in this leadership battle and receive unimaginable rewards.
「After entering the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range,」
the disciples of the three major sects had pursued it relentlessly, never falling far behind. Later, for some unknown reason, Lei Ze seemed to have ingested some sort of elixir; its physique had largely recovered, its speed increased, and it vanished into the depths of the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range. The disciples from the three major sects were left with no other option. Thus, they had split into three groups to search for Lei Ze everywhere.
Suddenly, the dark-faced youth’s senses tingled. He looked up and saw a large, azure bird flying rapidly from the distance.
"It’s Lei Ze!"
He was overjoyed. Quickly drawing his Sword, he laughed loudly and exclaimed, "Lei Ze has appeared! Everyone, join me in slaying this demon beast!"

chapters.title: Chapter 103: Battle Against the Demon Sect’s Pride
chapters.content:
Chapter 103: Chapter 103: Battle Against the Demon Sect’s Pride
"Alright, Senior Brother!"
The disciples of the Yu Mo Sect shouted enthusiastically, eyes blazing with fanaticism as they unsheathed their swords and followed their dark-faced senior brother into battle.
They had been chasing this Thunder Beast for several days, a joint effort among the three major sects.
Some time ago, due to the three sects hindering each other, no one had successfully killed the Thunder Beast. As a result, the title of the strongest had not yet been claimed. After the Thunder Beast escaped, the members of the three sects could no longer keep up with it. It had ventured deep into the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range. With the advantage of its natural affinity for lightning, the Thunder Beast thrived, leaving the three sects far behind. Especially in the last half-day, the Thunder Beast had vanished without a trace.
Thus, the three sects decided to separate and search individually. Whichever sect found the Thunder Beast first would claim the title of strongest. Each major sect had dispatched a formidable group of their Disciples of Heaven’s Pride, more than capable of slaying this Thunder Beast.
The Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Yu Mo Sect had only rushed out for a few hundred yards when they suddenly discovered a young boy and girl standing on the back of the Thunder Beast.
The pair were very young; the girl was probably only fifteen or sixteen, and the boy thirteen or fourteen. Yet, their cultivation base was not low, having already reached the third level of the Divine Bridge Realm.
"Senior Brother, this Thunder Beast is defiant and untamed. How could these two youngsters have subdued it?" a tall, wiry youth beside him asked, furrowing his brow.
"Perhaps it’s a pet these two youngsters have been raising for a long time?" The dark-faced youth’s eyes were indifferent, a hint of killing intent visible as he said coldly, "Their robes don’t belong to any notable power; they must be Loose Cultivators... Tell them to scram. If they refuse, kill them!"
Upon hearing the order to kill, the eyes of the young Yu Mo Sect disciples behind him turned slightly red. They were the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Demon Sect lineage of the Yu Mo Sect, each cruel by nature, fond of killing, and extremely radical. Within the Yu Mo Sect, they were all lawless individuals.
WHOOSH!
The Thunder Beast vanished in a flash and quickly reappeared nearby. The distance between the two sides was only about sixty to ninety yards.
Luo Li controlled the Thunder Beast, making it halt in mid-air. She drew her Supreme Golden Dragon Sword, pointing its tip at the Yu Mo Sect disciples. Her young face turned frosty, her eyes growing cold.
"You two brats, hand over the Thunder Beast and scram, or today will be your last!" the tall, thin youth shouted, his face bearing a haughty expression.
"The people of the Yu Mo Sect are indeed arrogant!" Jun Moxiao said, his face stern. He unsheathed his sword, initiating the Dragon God Sword Technique, and a Divine Dragon Phantom erupted behind him. The appearance of the gigantic Divine Dragon Phantom instantly caused his aura to soar.
Luo Li, on the other hand, gently flicked her wrist, and a flash of green light enveloped the Thunder Beast, storing it away.
This battle doesn’t need the Thunder Beast.
She and her junior brother need to make full use of this training opportunity to improve themselves.
Their goal is to elevate their cultivation base from the third level of the Divine Bridge Realm to the fourth level during this training in the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range.
"If you think you can take it, come and fight!" Luo Li shouted coldly, her body instantly transforming into a Divine Dragon Phantom as she launched the first attack.
Jun Moxiao did the same. They had fought side by side countless times and had developed a formidable tacit understanding.
"Damn it, they dare to be more arrogant than us? Kill them!"
Finding the two youngsters’ audacity intolerable, the dark-faced youth flew into a rage. His eyes spewed bloodthirsty killing intent as he immediately brandished his sword, unleashing a swarm of sword light to meet their attack. The youths behind him also unleashed chillingly harsh sword lights, converging on Luo Li and Jun Moxiao.
In the blink of an eye, the forest was filled with brimming Sword Qi.
BANG! BANG!
Bursts of sword light surged out like tidal waves, colliding with each other and creating a series of thunderous roars.
ZIZZ! ZIZZ!
Countless intense sword lights struck the trees, gashing them deeply. Streaks of lightning reflected from the wounds on the trees.
Both Luo Li and Jun Moxiao, as well as the Yu Mo Sect disciples, had to dodge this lightning in time.
BOOM! BOOM!
From the clouds overhead, bucket-thick bolts of lightning continuously descended, their power astonishing. This added many variables to the conflict. If one’s movement technique wasn’t proficient enough, they would be struck by this lightning.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao had excellent mastery over the Divine Dragon Nine-Change Body Technique, allowing them to dodge the lightning strikes at every turn. The Yu Mo Sect disciples, however, were not so fortunate. Frequently, someone would fail to dodge in time and be struck. But their bodies were extremely strong; although being struck by lightning affected their combat power to some extent, it caused no significant losses.
The Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Yu Mo Sect also coordinated exceptionally well. Even if someone was struck by lightning and temporarily immobilized, another would quickly fill their position, creating a window for their companion to recover.
Both sides fought fiercely in this chaotic state. Surging sword lights collided ceaselessly, creating thunderous booms that resonated in all directions.
After a short while, the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride of the Yu Mo Sect were surprised to find that although the young boy and girl’s cultivation base was not high, their individual combat power was terrifying. Despite their superior numbers, they were only able to suppress the young pair and could not achieve a decisive kill.
"Kill!" the dark-faced youth suddenly roared, his eyes turning bloodshot. His muscles swelled, his blood and qi surging powerfully. His Super Divine Dragon Breath suddenly became stronger, and his combat power grew even more terrifying, at least doubling.
Seeing their senior brother perform The Creation Demon God Art, the others also roared, their eyes blood-red, their vitality burning, as they also activated this Cultivation Technique.
In that brief instant, all twenty Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Yu Mo Sect entered a state of Demonization, their combat strength at least doubling.
The demonized crowd surrounded Luo Li and Jun Moxiao, launching a tidal wave of frenzied attacks. The two instantly felt tremendous pressure.
However, to maximize the benefits of the training, hoping to achieve a breakthrough under this pressure, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao did not use the Nine Heavens Lotus Sutra, which was both offensive and defensive.
WHOOSH! WHOOSH!
Both of them pushed the Divine Dragon Nine-Change Body Technique to its limits. Divine Dragon Phantoms flickered unpredictably with each breath as they continuously dodged various dangerous attacks. At this moment, they were severely suppressed, with hardly any strength left to retaliate. The incoming sword lights were ferocious and sharp, each strike capable of taking their lives. One could only imagine the pressure they were under.
Both understood that the greater the pressure, the higher the efficiency of the Dragon Tiger Pill’s conversion within their bodies, and the greater the chance of a breakthrough.
The medicinal power of the Dragon Tiger Pill they had ingested earlier was being rapidly digested.
The sound of tearing air was heard as another group of people flew in from a distance. There were also about twenty of them, and their robes were remarkably uniform; they were disciples of the Qitian Sword Sect.
"Senior Brother, why are these lunatics fighting with a pair of youngsters?" one of them asked, as the group watched the battle from afar.
A burly young man, after observing the battle for a few seconds, posed this question to his handsome-looking senior brother standing beside him.
"Have any of you seen this young boy and girl before?" the handsome senior brother asked, turning his head to address his junior brothers in a serious tone.
"No, we haven’t. They’re completely unfamiliar. They shouldn’t be Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from any major power..." the young men behind him replied, shaking their heads.
"Then it’s strange,"
the handsome young man looked puzzled, rubbing his chin.
"Our competition for the leadership position hasn’t concluded, so why are these lunatics fighting a pair of unknown Loose Cultivators?"
In his star-like eyes, a glimmer of deductive light emerged.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 104: Siege by the Arrogant, Double Breakthrough!
chapters.content:
Chapter 104: Chapter 104: Siege by the Arrogant, Double Breakthrough!
The twenty Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Qitian Sword Sect were so far away that neither the already demonized Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Yu Mo Sect, nor Luo Li and Jun Moxiao, had noticed them. After all, the battle had already reached a fever pitch. Everyone still had to contend with the lightning striking down from the sky and the trees.
It could be said that the battle was incredibly chaotic. The Cultivators who had undergone Demonization experienced a surge in power, their physical strength becoming astonishing. Even when struck by lightning, their bodies merely swayed for a moment before they resumed their assault.
In the void above the Thunder Pool, Ye Yun slowly opened his eyes. He had been keenly observing this battle from start to finish. After all, Ye Yun hoped this trial would enable the two youngsters to achieve another breakthrough. This chaotic battlefield had already placed tremendous pressure on Luo Li and Jun Moxiao, far more so than any previous battle.
Ye Yun’s gaze flickered as he clearly perceived the rate at which the Dragon Tiger Pills within Luo Li and Jun Moxiao’s bodies were being consumed. Suddenly, he gently flicked his finger. Two God-level Dragon and Tiger Pills instantly transformed into two clouds of medicinal essence, disappearing before Ye Yun’s eyes. The next moment, these two clouds of medicinal essence descended above Luo Li and Jun Moxiao’s heads.
At this moment, the two were executing the Divine Dragon Nine-Change Body Technique, desperately evading the relentless barrage from the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride of the Yu Mo Sect. But they never expected that from directly above, the potent medicinal essence of a Dragon Tiger Pill would descend upon them. The medicinal essence flowed into their bodies through their Baihui acupoints.
Their spirits were instantly uplifted. This cloud of medicinal essence shrouding their heads moved in sync with them, not hindering their movement technique in the slightest. Ye Yun continuously channeled the medicinal essence downward, ensuring it was neither too much nor too little. The constant infusion kept their bodies in a heightened state of absorption and transformation.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao knew in their hearts this had to be the Old Ancestor’s doing. Their confidence bolstered, they managed to dodge wave after wave of attacks from the Yu Mo Sect’s Disciples of Heaven’s Pride.
A full hour passed. These Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Yu Mo Sect had still failed to kill Luo Li and Jun Moxiao, or even inflict the slightest injury upon them.
The observing Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Qitian Sword Sect, watching from a distance, were stunned by this sight.
This young man and woman are far too strong!
To think that at the third level of the Divine Bridge Realm, they could withstand the onslaught of twenty demonized Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Yu Mo Sect for so long without a scratch—it was truly unbelievable!"Senior Brother, should we assist them?" the burly youth beside him asked, squinting.
"Although our three sects have some disagreements, most of the time, we should stand united against external threats," the handsome youth replied, his hands clasped behind his back as he pondered. "As far as I know, their Demonization state lasts no longer than two hours. Once it lifts, their combat strength will plummet. At that point, those youngsters will likely counterattack."
"Senior Brother, let’s go help them then," the burly youth said, brandishing his sword and preparing to charge, but the handsome youth held him back.
"Those demonized maniacs don’t distinguish friend from foe. Let’s keep our distance and attack from afar," the handsome youth said with a hint of annoyance.
Then, he took the lead, charging forward and stopping a full fifty feet from the battlefield. With a wave of his hand, streams of sword-light shot towards Luo Li and Jun Moxiao. The other disciples of the Qitian Sword Sect followed suit. In an instant, a dense barrage of sword-light swarmed them. Fearful of injuring the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Yu Mo Sect, they didn’t use their full strength, each unleashing only seven or eight beams of sword-light. Even so, some sword-light inevitably struck the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Yu Mo Sect.
However, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao also found themselves in a dire crisis. Neither had expected the Qitian Sword Sect to attack them at such a moment. Left with no choice, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao executed the Nine Heavens Lotus Sutra.
WHOOSH...
Golden Sword Lotuses bloomed one after another, suddenly rising to fill the void and block the incoming attacks. This Swordsmanship was inherently a dual-sword combination technique; when performed by two people simultaneously, its power was immense. Therefore, once they unleashed this Swordsmanship, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao’s situation immediately became less precarious. However, facing the attacks from forty Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from two major sects, they could only manage a temporary defense.
Above them, two clouds of medicinal essence were still continuously being infused into their bodies, transforming into surging Mana, only to be expended again. This process repeated over and over. Gradually, Jun Moxiao felt the barrier within his body begin to loosen. He knew that under this immense pressure, the Old Ancestor had timely supplemented them with the medicinal power of the Dragon Tiger Pill. They were on the verge of a breakthrough—the moment was imminent.
What? How can they still hold on? What kind of Swordsmanship is this?
The handsome youth from the Qitian Sword Sect, positioned on the periphery, abruptly ceased his attacks, his face dark as he stared at their Swordsmanship. Their Qitian Sword Sect possessed profound attainments in the Sword Dao, yet they had never witnessed such a powerful Swordsmanship. That young man and woman fought in perfect concert with their dual-sword technique. Each thrust of their swords conjured golden Sword Lotuses. These golden Sword Lotuses, capable of both offense and defense, filled the void, preventing any attacks from breaking through."Intensify the assault! We absolutely cannot let this young man and woman escape alive!" A look of envy and jealousy contorted the handsome youth’s face. He knew these two were undoubtedly monstrous geniuses in the Cultivation World. If they were allowed to leave alive today, there would be no future for the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride of their three great sects.
So they moved closer, each of them increasing their offensive output. For a moment, sword-light crisscrossed, falling like rain.
The battle raged on.
After the time it takes for an incense stick to burn...
BOOM!
Jun Moxiao’s body suddenly trembled, a thunderous sound resonating from within. At this moment, he broke through to the fourth level of the Divine Bridge Realm.
"Haha, I’ve finally broken through!" Jun Moxiao was overjoyed. The Mana within his body was now countless times more potent than before. With a flick of his sword tip, enormous golden Sword Lotuses drifted out. This increased the power of their Swordsmanship even more.
What? This fellow actually broke through?
All the disciples of the Qitian Sword Sect stared wide-eyed, their faces etched with disbelief. To break through amidst such a battle was truly hard to imagine. Just how monstrous was this young man? In that instant, they became even more determined not to let these two leave alive.
Meanwhile, the demonized Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Yu Mo Sect, though muddled and dazed, also noticed Jun Moxiao’s breakthrough. They became even more frenzied, charging recklessly with complete disregard for their own lives and focusing their attacks on Jun Moxiao. The pressure on Jun Moxiao suddenly increased.
Fortunately, however, their Swordsmanship was a dual-sword technique. With Senior Sister Luo Li helping him bear the brunt of the pressure, he could just barely hold his ground.
After another period equivalent to an incense stick burning...
BOOM!
Luo Li’s body quaked, and a deafening rumble echoed from within her.
At this moment, she too stepped into the fourth level of the Divine Bridge Realm!

chapters.title: Chapter 105: Mysterious Blue Liquid, Breakthrough Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 105: Chapter 105: Mysterious Blue Liquid, Breakthrough Again
Feeling her body become extraordinarily powerful again, Luo Li’s spirit surged, and she couldn’t help but throw her head back and let out a long howl.
This long howl sounded like a dragon’s roar, echoing deep within Accumulated Thunder Mountain.
WHOOSH!
With a flick of Luo Li’s sword tip, hundreds of golden Sword Lotuses instantly materialized, sealing the surrounding void.
Damn it, how on earth have both of them broken through!
The handsome youth from the Qitian Sword Sect was instantly enraged and charged forward, sword in hand.
We absolutely cannot leave any hidden dangers!
No matter what, we must kill these two youngsters today!
He was willing to accept it, even if his side had to pay a certain price.
Seeing their senior charge in first, the other disciples of the Qitian Sword Sect also followed.
In a flash, all twenty of them swarmed forward, their swordsmanship unfolding as they launched a frenzied wave of attacks against Luo Li and Jun Moxiao.
RUMBLE!
At this moment, bolts of lightning continuously descended from the clouds above.
PSSSH... The dense sword light attacks also reflected onto the trees. From every gash on the trunks, bolts of lightning would shoot out.
Added to this were the golden Sword Lotuses filling the sky. There were also the torrential sword light attacks from the Yu Mo Sect and the Qitian Sword Sect, plunging the battlefield into an extremely chaotic yet magnificent spectacle.
Although Luo Li and Jun Moxiao had just broken through, their combat power soaring, the Qitian Sword Sect’s direct entry into the battle still put pressure on them.
However, the two sides were merely evenly matched.
Even with forty people fighting just Luo Li and Jun Moxiao, they still couldn’t gain the upper hand.
After fighting for the time it takes for an incense stick to burn, they hadn’t managed to harm a single hair on the pair.
At this point, a chilling sensation crept into the hearts of everyone from the Qitian Sword Sect.
This young pair... are they even human?
How can their movement technique be so powerful?
Under the relentless bombardment of forty people, amidst a chaotic flurry of lightning strikes, they actually remained unscathed.
What exactly is this movement technique that transforms them into Divine Dragon Phantoms?
How have we never heard of it within the Shenfeng Dynasty?
With a soft *pfft*, the two clouds of medicinal aura hovering above their heads suddenly depleted and vanished.
Seeing this, Ye Yun, after a few seconds of contemplation, took out another small bottle and poured out two drops of mysterious blue liquid.
WHOOSH!
With a light flick of his fingers, the drops pierced the void and, in the blink of an eye, landed above Luo Li and Jun Moxiao’s heads.
These two drops of blue liquid were tiny, but as soon as they appeared above their heads, they instantly transformed into basin-sized blue orbs of light.
Emitting an indescribably brilliant radiance, they floated above the pair, continuously shedding streams of blue light.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao looked on in shock.
What on earth is this?
they wondered.
The blue light descended, enveloping their entire bodies.
Finally, it slowly seeped in through their pores, bringing an unimaginably vast and vigorous life force to their bodies.
"Senior Sister, I feel like I can break through again..." Jun Moxiao said, his voice trembling.
"Yes, I feel it too! What kind of treasure did the Old Ancestor use on us?" Luo Li exclaimed, tears of excitement streaming down her face.
Seeing the two youngsters so thrilled, Ye Yun smiled faintly and resumed his closed-eye meditation.
To Ye Yun, this mysterious blue liquid was merely a drop in the ocean from his private reserves. He possessed treasures even more potent than this mysterious blue liquid for enhancing cultivation bases.
However, their grade was too high, making them unsuitable for these two youngsters to use at their current stage.
Cultivation cannot solely rely on genius earth treasures; doing so prevents one’s combat power from achieving its full potential.
It was because Ye Yun had high hopes for these three youngsters that he hadn’t used the genius earth treasures and sacred pills from his stores to forcibly raise their cultivation.
The handsome youth from the Qitian Sword Sect’s face twisted, his eyes burning with furious flames.
Damn it! How did two blue orbs of light appear above those two? And their combat power seems even stronger than before...
These two are too monstrous, their methods endless! If we don’t kill them today, I’m afraid all forty Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from our two sects will perish here!
The demonized Yu Mo Sect disciples also sensed something amiss at this moment, even feeling the threat of death drawing inexorably closer.
"Even if it costs us our lives, we must kill these two with all our might!" the handsome youth roared, leaping high into the air and launching an all-out assault on Luo Li and Jun Moxiao.
"Senior Sister, they’re getting desperate..." Jun Moxiao said with a frown.
At that moment, he felt an urge to activate the Reverse Dragon Technique, boost his combat power fivefold, and slaughter everyone. But recalling the Old Ancestor’s instructions, he forcefully suppressed the idea.
It’s best to do such things as burning Essence Blood sparingly.
He and his Senior Sister just needed to hold on a little longer, and that mysterious blue light would allow them to break through another minor realm.
As expected, the time it took for an incense stick to burn passed.
BANG! BANG!
Almost simultaneously, one after the other, their bodies jolted violently. A booming sound emanated from within them, and then Mana, like a great surging river, coursed through their meridians.
At that moment, both of them once again advanced a minor realm, reaching the Fifth Level of the Divine Bridge Realm!
They had advanced two minor realms in a single battle!
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao were incredibly ecstatic! They knew these mysterious blue orbs bestowed by the Old Ancestor were undoubtedly the most potent elixirs in the world.
Just as Luo Li and Jun Moxiao broke through, the blue orbs of light above their heads slowly vanished, their energy completely depleted.
The handsome youth from the Qitian Sword Sect roared in fury again and again, his expression twisting further, resembling a malevolent demon.
How did they break through again?!
At this moment, suddenly, from the distant forest, a series of sounds of something tearing through the air could be heard.
The handsome youth looked over, a flicker of joy on his face, and he hurriedly shouted, "Senior and Junior Brothers of the Shen Heng Sect, quickly come and help! We can’t hold out much longer!"
The twenty Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Shen Heng Sect, who were rapidly approaching from a distance, were suddenly dumbstruck by the vast battle scene before them.
Forty people were besieging two.
Lightning rained down madly from the clouds, trees continuously spat out bolts of electricity, and the battle was utter chaos.
Yet, that young man and woman were actually suppressing all forty of them.
"KILL!"
At this moment, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao launched a ferocious assault in perfect unison.
If the Shen Heng Sect disciples join the fight, we probably won’t be able to hold on,
they both realized.
The best plan now is to strike first and eliminate the Qitian Sword Sect disciples. As for those demonized Yu Mo Sect disciples, they are less of a concern. They’ve held on for too long. The duration of The Creation Demon God Art should be up soon.
At this critical, do-or-die moment, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao surprisingly abandoned the Nine Heavens Lotus Sutra and once again employed the fierce and domineering Dragon God Sword Technique.
BOOM! BOOM!
Countless Divine Dragon Phantoms filled the sky, interwoven with endless sword light, surging towards the Qitian Sword Sect disciples like a torrent of mercury.
Now that both had reached the Fifth Level of the Divine Bridge Realm, their execution of this Swordsmanship was already overwhelming the Qitian Sword Sect disciples.
Instantly, some disciples with weaker cultivation bases were struck by swords and fell.
By the time the Shen Heng Sect disciples reacted and rushed closer, more than ten of the twenty Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Qitian Sword Sect had already been killed or wounded.
Only a few Disciples of Heaven’s Pride at the Eighth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm or higher remained alive...

chapters.title: Chapter 106: The Enemy of the Big Black Cat
chapters.content:
Chapter 106: Chapter 106: The Enemy of the Big Black Cat
"How could these two unfamiliar youngsters be so strong?!"
When the twenty Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Shen Heng Sect arrived, they found that a dozen Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Qitian Sword Sect had already been killed. This sight greatly changed their expressions.
