It was all done in the blink of an eye. The Qitian Sword Sect was wiped out like a landslide, slain by two youngsters who were at the Fifth Level of the Divine Bridge Realm, leaving their Sect in utter chaos.
"Three Sects, connected in spirit, unite against the enemy!"
A cultivator from the Shen Heng Sect, a youth at the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm, was burning with anger, his blood boiling. He raised his sword and roared.
He led his fellow Sect members to attack Luo Li and Jun Moxiao.
Sword light, like a violent storm, rolled over them.
Seeing the disciples of the Shen Heng Sect approaching, the remaining Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Qitian Sword Sect immediately regained their spirits. As if injected with chicken blood, they launched a counterattack.
In an instant, the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the three large Sects, numbering over forty, launched a ferocious attack on Luo Li and Jun Moxiao!
SWOOSH, SWOOSH...
Sword light billowed like mountains, like thousands of stars exploding.
BOOM, BOOM, BOOM!
Bolts of lightning kept falling from the sky.
ZIZZLING...
The surrounding black trees also continuously reflected lightning bolts.
The scene was extremely chaotic.
WHOOSH, WHOOSH...
Divine Dragon Phantoms kept shuttling back and forth amid the chaos.
At this moment, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao were again facing tremendous pressure.
These disciples of the Shen Heng Sect were frighteningly powerful. Surprisingly, they were even stronger than the disciples of the Yu Mo Sect and Qitian Sword Sect.
In the Shenfeng Dynasty, the Qitian Sword Sect ranked third, the Yu Mo Sect second, and the Shen Heng Sect first. The overall combat power of the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Shen Heng Sect surpassed the other two Sects.
The Shen Heng Sect excelled at the Seven Star Swordsmanship. As long as more than seven people practiced it, they could form a Sword Array. And right now, there were twenty people, which was enough to form two Seven-Star Sword Arrays.
The disciples from the Yu Mo Sect also regained consciousness one after another. Seeing the young man and woman still in high spirits, these Yu Mo Sect disciples couldn’t help but become furious. One by one, they pulled out a red bottle and swallowed the red liquid inside. This was the life-saving medicine that every Disciple of Heaven’s Pride from the Yu Mo Sect carried. If Demonization failed to kill the enemy, swallowing this rescue medicine could instantly replenish their vitality. This allowed their bodies to return to normal in a short period of time. But they couldn’t Demonize again because their bodies couldn’t take it anymore.
"Thank you all for your help, my fellow brothers!" a young man from the Yu Mo Sect shouted, clasping his fists, then coldly resumed the fight.
Although they didn’t undergo Demonization and their combat power had decreased, in reality, being in a clear-headed state, they could cooperate with the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the other two Sects. This actually increased the combat power of the three major Sects.
Ye Yun, off in the distance, was quietly observing Luo Li and Jun Moxiao. Although they were heavily suppressed, due to the elimination of over a dozen disciples from the Qitian Sword Sect earlier, the two of them were still able to hold their ground for the time being.
Ye Yun heaved a sigh of relief. Right now, it was a competition of endurance. As cultivators of the Dragon God Sect, they possessed the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline, granting them extended endurance. The longer the battle lasted, the more beneficial it would be for them.
「...」
On the outskirts of the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range, two figures flew over. They were extremely powerful. Any thunderbolts descending from the sky that reached within ten feet of them would strangely curve and strike elsewhere. These were two elderly men. One was clad in a gold robe, the other in silver. One had gold eyes, while the other had silver eyes. The two radiated an aura of pure terror, their power connecting heaven and earth, having already reached the Destiny Realm.
"Is this the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range?" the silver-eyed elder gazed into the distance, his eyes slightly narrowed, and spoke softly.
"Indeed, it is. This is one of the most famous places in the Shenfeng Dynasty. Deep within the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range, there’s a Thunder Pool. The Thunder Pool Water contains enormous destructive power, but it also possesses an immense power of rebirth..." the gold-eyed elder said with a smile.
"Brother, I’ve heard this Thunder Pool also has an owner. A palace known as the Accumulated Thunder Palace is said to be at the bottom of the pool. Three Monster Kings, known as the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain, reside within. How about we pay them a visit first?" the silver-eyed elder suggested, his hands clasped behind him.
"Very well!" The gold-eyed elder nodded.
Immediately, the two sped up, transforming into an unimaginable streak of light and vanished on the spot instantaneously.
「In another location within the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range.」
A black-haired elder was strolling leisurely through the air, accompanying two young people. They disregarded the thick thunderbolts pouring down from the sky. Above his head hung a black umbrella. As it turned ceaselessly, it redirected all the thunderbolts away. The two youths next to him, a boy and a girl, were both around sixteen or seventeen years old. Despite their young age, they had already reached the Tenth Layer peak of the Divine Bridge Realm. The three of them proceeded deeper into the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range.
In just a few breaths’ time, the gold-eyed elder and the silver-eyed elder arrived on the outskirts of the Thunder Pool. There was a huge entrance outside the Thunder Pool. Upon the Bronze Door were engraved three golden characters: "Accumulated Thunder Palace".
"Here we are!" The silver-eyed elder chuckled and then shouted towards the palace, "Is this place... the territory of the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain?"
Inside the palace, the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain, who were accompanying Big Black Horse and Big Black Cat eating and drinking, suddenly heard the voice from outside. Immediately, their brows furrowed. At that instant, they sensed two high-level cultivators in the Destiny Realm had arrived.
GULP! GULP!
Big Black Horse, holding a jug of wine, had just downed an entire jug. Suddenly spotting the two figures outside, he dismissed them with a disdainful curl of his lips. Two little Destiny Realm Monsters were not worth his attention.
"Senior, there are visitors outside. We shall go out and take a look!" the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain said, rising to their feet and clasping their fists towards the Big Black Horse.
"Go ahead!" Big Black Horse didn’t even lift his head, responding vaguely and continued drinking.
"Uncle Ma, there’s still one jug of wine left..." The young man transformed from the Big Black Cat sat next to him. He hurriedly passed over a fresh jug of wine.
Big Black Horse took the jug, tilted back his head, and poured the wine down his throat.
The Big Black Cat cast a glance towards the distance. When he saw the two elders, his eyes immediately filled with a look of hatred.
"Little Cat, what’s wrong?" Although Big Black Horse was busy drinking, how could the Big Black Cat’s every move escape his notice?
"Uncle Ma, those two Monsters outside, one is the Golden Ring Snake, and the other is the Silver Ring Snake, who possess deep cultivation. I’ve had troubles with them before. To my surprise, their cultivation has now surpassed mine..." Big Black Cat sighed, his fists clenching so hard they creaked.
"So they’re your enemies, huh? Good. Watch how I deal with them later..." Big Black Horse put down his wine and grinned, revealing a set of large white teeth.
He swayed a bit. His aura instantly dropped from the Life and Death Realm all the way to the Nirvana Realm Tenth Level Peak, matching the Big Black Cat’s exact cultivation base.
"Uncle Ma, what are you doing?" Big Black Cat’s eyes widened in surprise, asking in delight.

chapters.title: Chapter 107 Tempting the Gold and Silver Saint
chapters.content:
Chapter 107: Chapter 107 Tempting the Gold and Silver Saint
"Heh, just sit tight and enjoy the show. Let’s see how Uncle Ma teases these two little snakes!" the Big Black Horse said with a toothy grin.
The Big Black Cat also chuckled.
Uncle Ma is planning to play the fool to catch the wise!
He was clearly a ridiculously powerful Eternal Realm Great Demon who could easily crush those two little snakes outside with a single finger, but he insisted on having some cruel fun. He planned to feign weakness, thoroughly tease the two little snakes, and then finish them off.
The Big Black Cat was filled with anticipation. It also wanted to see how Uncle Ma would deal with those two.
At that moment, the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain appeared at the entrance. Seeing the two unfamiliar old men, they came forward with a cupped fist salute. "May we know where our friends are from?"
"We come from the Heavenly Star Dynasty. I am Golden Eye Saint from Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge, and he is Silver Eye Saint!" the Golden Eye Saint said arrogantly.
What? The Golden and Silver Saints from the Heavenly Star Dynasty have actually come!
The Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain looked at each other, their hearts filled with shock. The Heavenly Star Dynasty bordered the Shenfeng Dynasty. If Accumulated Thunder Mountain could be said to be the Holy Land of the Demonic Clan in the entire Shenfeng Dynasty, then Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge was the Holy Land of the Demonic Clan in the Heavenly Star Dynasty. As for these Golden Eye and Silver Eye Saints, the three of them had heard of the formidable reputation of these two Great Demons. These two were Cultivators of the Destiny Realm. In terms of strength, they were indeed more powerful than the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain.
"My apologies for not realizing the two Saints had arrived and for failing to greet you properly. Please, come in and take a seat!" Thunder Dragon hurriedly saluted, speaking very politely.
"Hmph! Then we shall impose!" The two Saints, Golden Eye and Silver Eye, strutted towards the palace.
The Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain followed closely behind. The Kui Bull and Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger, following Thunder Dragon, exchanged troubled looks.
Inside the palace was an Eternal Realm Great Demon senior. Now that the two Golden and Silver Saints from the Heavenly Star Dynasty had arrived, how were they all supposed to get along?
Once everyone had entered the main hall, the Golden Eye and Silver Eye Saints saw two Nirvana Realm Great Demons sitting in the main seats, casually drinking from wine jars, and they were immediately filled with rage.
"Are you Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain no longer the masters of this palace? Why would you let two Nirvana Realm fellows take the main seats?" the Golden Eye Saint asked with a cold face.
"Well..." Thunder Dragon stammered, not knowing how to explain.
Of course, he dared not reveal the details about that Eternal Realm Great Demon senior. After all, his own life was more important. But... how was he supposed to explain this situation?
THUD!
The Big Black Cat tossed its wine jar aside. Gazing at the Golden Eye and Silver Eye Saints with blurry, drunken eyes, it chuckled, "Why do you two look so familiar? Have we met before?"
"You are... the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat?" Golden Eye Saint squinted, sizing up the Big Black Cat from top to bottom. Realizing it was merely at the Nirvana Tenth Level, he couldn’t help but scoff. "You old cat! Nearly a thousand years have passed, and you still haven’t broken through to the Destiny Realm? What a waste. You’re an embarrassment to your Nine-tailed Spirit Cat Clan!"
"Damn you! You think you’re invincible just because you reached the Destiny Realm?" the Big Black Cat retorted lazily. It seemed it wasn’t angered by Golden Eye Saint’s words. It picked up a Spirit Fruit from the table, placed it in its mouth, and began to chew slowly.
At this moment, the Big Black Horse also put his wine jar on the table. He looked at the two old men in golden and silver robes across from him and gave them a wide, toothy grin.
The moment Thunder Dragon saw the Big Black Horse’s expression, he instantly panicked.
"Sen—"
Just as Thunder Dragon was about to speak, his words were cut off by the Big Black Horse. "No one will call you mute if you keep your mouth shut!"
The Big Black Horse snorted coldly.
Thunder Dragon immediately shut his mouth. Kui Bull and Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger didn’t even dare to breathe heavily at this moment.
This was an Eternal Realm Great Demon! Across the entire Cangnan Continent, very few could be his match.
"You two Nirvana Realm monsters, get down from there! That’s not a place for you!" the Golden Eye Saint roared.
"Oh, really?" The Big Black Horse suddenly stood up and slowly walked down with his hands behind his back. He beckoned to the Golden Eye Saint with a finger and chuckled, "So what if I’m overestimating my abilities? If you’re not convinced, why don’t we have a go?"
When the Big Black Cat saw Uncle Ma make his move, looking so outrageously arrogant while playing the pig to eat the tiger, it couldn’t help but laugh heartily inwardly. Back when it was in the Divine Bridge Realm, it had made enemies of these two Snake Demons. It was no match for them in a two-against-one fight. After suffering severe injuries, it fled and hadn’t had the power to seek revenge for all these years. Who would have thought... that today, in the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range, it would encounter these two sworn enemies! Although it was no match for them, Uncle Ma was about to step in and help it get its revenge.
「In the void above the Thunder Pool.」
Ye Yun shook his head and smiled as he saw the Big Black Horse playing the pig to eat the tiger. The Big Black Horse had quite the mischievous streak. But it was hardworking and uncomplaining, usually quiet, so Ye Yun decided to let it have its fun today. At this moment, Ye Yun also looked in another direction. A black-haired old man holding a large black umbrella, leading two young men, was gradually approaching the battle scene of Jun Moxiao and Luo Li.
"This is getting interesting..." Ye Yun smiled faintly.
The black-haired old man’s cultivation base was not low; he was a Destiny Realm Cultivator. And the two youths beside him possessed extremely high talent; at only sixteen or seventeen, they were already Half-Step Nirvana Powerhouses.
「Within the Accumulated Thunder Palace.」
The Big Black Horse’s arrogance successfully ignited the rage of the Golden Eye Saint and Silver Eye Saint.
"Die!" The Silver Eye Saint, having a fiery temper, lunged towards the Big Black Horse.
The Big Black Horse also threw a punch, plain and straightforward.
BANG!
Fist and palm collided with a muffled sound. The two were surprisingly evenly matched.
"Oof, what strength!" The Big Black Horse pretended his fist hurt, shaking his hand and grinning, baring his teeth.
"What kind of monster are you? Your physical body is quite strong!" The Silver Eye Saint took two steps forward and eyed him up and down. His eyes flickered with silver light, but he couldn’t discern the Big Black Horse’s true nature. He took a deep breath, his body transformed into an afterimage, and he attacked the Big Black Horse once more.
The Big Black Horse again raised a punch and struck out, plain and straightforward.
BANG!
Another muffled sound. This time, the Silver Eye Saint was forced to retreat two steps, while the Big Black Horse remained completely still.
This greatly surprised the Golden Eye Saint, who had been watching from the side.
What on earth were the origins of this swarthy middle-aged man? Why was his physical body so formidable?
"Come at me, both of you. Today, this old man will indulge you both in a good fight!" The Big Black Horse clenched his fists, the knuckles cracking loudly. CRACK! CRACK! Yet, his face wore a nonchalant smile.
Seeing the black-robed man act so arrogantly, the Golden Eye Saint and Silver Eye Saint couldn’t help but roar as they both charged forward.
The Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain, standing to the side, wore expressions caught between amusement and exasperation.
This senior was already in the Eternal Realm, yet he still had the mind to tease two mere Destiny Realm monsters. He truly loved a lively scene...
BANG! BANG! BANG!
Inside the palace, three figures continuously intersected, engaged in fierce combat. The power of their clashes was immense, and the sounds of their battle were tremendous. Shockwaves blasted outwards one after another.
"SETTLE!" Thunder Dragon spread his hands and immediately blocked all the shockwaves. He certainly didn’t want the palace to be destroyed.

chapters.title: Chapter 108: Comparing Life’s Treasure Talismans
chapters.content:
Chapter 108: Chapter 108: Comparing Life’s Treasure Talismans
"Eldest Brother, both these sides are figures that our Accumulated Thunder Mountain cannot afford to provoke. What should we do?"
Standing behind the Thunder Dragon, the Kui Bull looked panicked, sending a message through sound transmission. The message split in two, sent to both the Thunder Dragon and the Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger.
For thousands of years, the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain had never involved themselves in the murky affairs of any faction. They were always in closed-door cultivation, seeking the supreme Dao, hardly ever venturing into the world. But they never expected that Accumulated Thunder Mountain would provoke two such powerful forces this time.
One was an Eternal Realm Great Demon. The other two were the Golden Eye Saint and Silver Eye Saint from the Heavenly Star Dynasty’s Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge.
Although these two Saints are somewhat weaker, they are still figures we cannot afford to offend!
the Kui Bull thought anxiously.
It’s said that Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge also has a Dragon Lord whose cultivation base is terrifyingly high. He had already stepped into the Destiny Realm a thousand years ago.
"The current situation is beyond our control..." the Thunder Dragon sighed, sending two messages. "Brothers, our Accumulated Thunder Mountain is but a small temple; we can’t afford to offend anyone..."
The Kui Bull sighed, "Eldest Brother, if this Eternal Realm Great Demon leaves Accumulated Thunder Mountain, what should we do if the Dragon Lord from Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge comes to our door in the future?"
"There’s no choice. We can only tell the truth. Besides, we didn’t participate in this matter..." the Thunder Dragon said with a bitter smile. After a few seconds of silence, he added, "This Dragon Lord and I share the same origin, both belonging to the Dragon Clan. He should give me some face..."
Hearing their Eldest Brother, Thunder Dragon, say this, the Kui Bull and the Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger relaxed slightly.
"Ha, you two are really something! You’ve beaten me so much I’m aching all over! Keep it up, maybe you’ll actually knock me down!" the Big Black Horse shouted while fighting, a look of "panic" on his face. He showed no demeanor of a senior expert whatsoever. At this moment, he seemed to be at a disadvantage. Although he hadn’t made many moves, he was wincing and yelping in feigned pain.
It was a different story for the Golden Eye Saint and Silver Eye Saint.
"Eldest Brother, what in the world is this fellow? His body is too hard!" the Silver Eye Saint transmitted, his face slightly contorted as he traded blows, panting hard. Even when he managed to land a surprise punch on the black-robed man, it felt like striking the hardest treasure in the world. His fist rebounded, his knuckles throbbing with pain.
"Could this be a Black Stone Demon?" the Golden Eye Saint gritted his teeth, hazarding a guess. He too had suffered greatly; every attack he landed on the fellow only resulted in his own limbs aching terribly.
On the surface, it looked like the two of them had the upper hand. But in reality, only they knew how much they were suffering. The man in the black robe seemed to have an invulnerable body; no matter how hard they hit him, they couldn’t injure him. Thankfully, his attacks weren’t very strong, or they wouldn’t be standing here exchanging sound transmissions.
"HEH HEH!"
Watching the battle from afar, the Big Black Cat revealed a wicked smile.
Uncle Ma is truly Uncle Ma,
he thought.
Always my, Big Black Cat’s, Uncle Ma, full of a master’s demeanor. His current display seems to put him at a disadvantage, but in fact, he holds the upper hand.
The Big Black Cat recalled Uncle Ma’s powerful, rippling muscles. He estimated that even potent Emperor Level weapons couldn’t pierce that hide, let alone the soft fists of these two little Destiny Realm Snake Demons.
"You two, can’t you hit harder? With such feeble strength, you still call yourselves Heaven-Destined Great Demons? What a disgrace to the Demon Clan!" the Big Black Horse jeered, baring his white teeth as he threw a punch, clashing directly with one from the Golden Eye Saint.
BANG!
The Golden Eye Saint was sent flying by the impact. He was then seen shaking his hand repeatedly, wincing as if in great pain.
Just then, the Silver Eye Saint ambushed from behind like a ghost.
Instead of advancing, the Big Black Horse retreated, delivering a powerful shoulder strike against the Silver Eye Saint’s fist, instantly sending him flying as well. The Silver Eye Saint’s knuckles felt like they were about to shatter. He winced in pain, almost rolling on the ground.
"You freak! What is your true form?!" the Silver Eye Saint yelled, standing his ground and swinging his aching hand, too incensed to continue attacking.
These two Heaven-Destined Great Demons had originally thought they could easily dispatch this "little demon" at the Nirvana Realm. Unexpectedly, after fighting for a while, they still hadn’t succeeded.
"HA..."
The Kui Bull, being rather carefree, couldn’t help but let out a chuckle. But he stopped abruptly after just that single sound, quickly covering his mouth.
Nevertheless, that one chuckle reached the ears of the two Saints.
The two great Saints immediately felt deeply humiliated. With their noble status and formidable strength, to be unable to subdue a mere Nirvana Realm cultivator in front of the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain was utterly disgraceful!
The Golden Eye Saint glared fiercely at the Kui Bull. With a wave of his hand, two golden rings suddenly appeared.
In the Silver Eye Saint’s hand, two Silver Rings also materialized.
"Oh? You two little snakes are resorting to your intrinsic treasures now? Seems you’re quite concerned about this ’little demon’ in the Nirvana Realm, eh?" the Big Black Horse said sarcastically. He reached a hand into his robe, fumbling around as he mumbled, "This Lord must also find an intrinsic treasure to fight you properly. Fighting bare-handed puts me at too much of a disadvantage!"
Uncle Ma has an intrinsic treasure?
The Big Black Cat craned his neck, staring unblinkingly at Uncle Ma’s hand.
High above the Thunder Pool, Ye Yun, who had witnessed the Big Black Horse’s antics, couldn’t help but smile.
What intrinsic treasure could the Big Black Horse possibly have? He’s just reaching into his robe to pull off one of his own scales. As an Eternal Realm Great Demon, the scales on his body are comparable to Divine Weapons. This Little Horse... he could easily crush those two little demons with a single finger, yet he insists on making such a fuss. It seems he’s truly dying of boredom...
Ye Yun raised an eyebrow and smiled helplessly.
His warehouse is teeming with terrifying demon beasts, too many to count. Even the Big Black Horse is this desperate for entertainment. One can only imagine how bored the other great demons in the warehouse must be. But Ye Yun can’t possibly let them all out. These terrifying demon beasts are utterly lawless. If they were to appear in the world, they would likely cause an apocalyptic catastrophe across the entire Cangnan Continent.
"HEH HEH, I finally found it!"
The Big Black Horse’s hand retracted from his robe. Black light swirled around it, and a Black Shield instantly appeared. This Black Shield gleamed with a dark luster, its surface covered with mysterious patterns, giving off an ancient, profound aura.
"This shield is too powerful..."
the Big Black Cat thought, GULP. He wished he could kneel before Uncle Ma and beg him to bestow this shield upon him.
"A shield?"
The Golden Eye Saint and Silver Eye Saint were stunned for a moment. They hadn’t expected this dark-faced man to still be thinking of defense, thus taking out a shield. However, what they saw was different from what the Big Black Cat perceived. In their eyes, the Black Shield was perfectly ordinary, without any radiance or patterns—as plain as could be.
GULP!
The Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain nearby also gulped, their eyes burning with desire.
This shield, shimmering with a black luster, was mysterious and powerful, emitting a formidable and terrifying aura—truly comparable to an Emperor Level treasure!

chapters.title: Chapter 109: The Pupil Skills of the Two Great Saints
chapters.content:
Chapter 109: Chapter 109: The Pupil Skills of the Two Great Saints
Big Black Horse had naturally employed the Blindfold Method on this shield. This method only worked on outsiders and had no effect on his own people.
The Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain had always been well-fed and well-treated, so in Big Black Horse’s eyes, they were practically family.
"Come on, show me what you Heaven-Destined Great Demons are capable of!" Big Black Horse sneered, baring his white teeth as he shook the shield in his hand.
He had countless scales on his body, far too many to count. Only one of them was truly precious; the others were expendable.
Besides, if one was torn off, it would just grow back.
The shield in his hand was formed from one such ordinary scale.
Against these lesser monsters of the Destiny Realm, this shield was more than enough to entertain them for a good while.
"This..." Thunder Dragon’s face turned ashen as he saw that a major battle was imminent, with both sides bringing out their magic weapons. He had no choice but to release his Mana, forming a barrier around the main hall. If he didn’t, the shockwaves from the colliding magic weapons would likely destroy the entire edifice. Kui Bull and Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger also took action, adding two more layers of protection outside the first barrier. Only then did the three of them breathe a sigh of relief.
As for whether the barriers would hold, that was entirely up to fate.
Big Black Horse merely pursed his lips.
He felt nothing but disdain for the actions of these three minor monsters from Accumulated Thunder Mountain.
His Master had decided they would stay here for a while.
Naturally, he intended to enjoy their hospitality and freeload in this palace for some time, so he certainly couldn’t let it be damaged.
Thus, he had already used his Divine Skills to reinforce this palace. Never mind Destiny Realm cultivators; even a Life and Death Realm expert wouldn’t be able to break it with an attack.
Seeing that the Golden Eye Saint and Silver Eye Saint still hadn’t made a move, Big Black Horse urged, "What are you hesitating for? Aren’t you going to strike to kill? You’re Heaven-Destined Great Demons, after all. If you can’t even kill a little Nirvana Realm monster like me, and word of this gets out, Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge will be utterly disgraced!"
After speaking, Big Black Horse raised his Black Shield and grinned, revealing a set of perfectly white and even teeth that gleamed like jade.
"You’re courting death!" Enraged by the black-robed man’s provocation, the Golden Eye Saint and Silver Eye Saint simultaneously raised their Golden Rings and Silver Rings. They advanced a few steps, their bodies suffused with overwhelming killing intent, exuding the terrifying aura of Destiny Realm cultivators.
With a flicker of movement, the two of them were instantly upon him. Raising their Golden Rings and Silver Rings high, they channeled all their strength and smashed down viciously.
WHOOSH!
Big Black Horse spun like a gyroscope, his Black Shield completely enveloping him. The Golden Rings and the Silver Rings slammed into the shield.
BOOM!
A tremendous force recoiled, sending the Golden Rings and Silver Rings flying back. In that instant, both the Golden Eye Saint and Silver Eye Saint cried out in shock as a searing pain shot through the webbing of their thumbs; their respective Rings had nearly been torn from their grasp.
The Golden Eye Saint and Silver Eye Saint were aghast.
These Golden Rings and Silver Rings!
They were the most powerful treasures they had spent millennia refining!
To think that their all-out physical strike had still failed to breach the black-robed man’s defense!
"HUMPH!" The Golden Eye Saint’s expression turned grim. He suddenly opened his mouth and violently spewed out a dense black smoke. This was the Deadly Poison Fog he had spent many years cultivating. Even a Destiny Realm cultivator would be instantly poisoned to death upon inhaling the slightest trace of it.
Simultaneously, the Silver Eye Saint’s eyes flashed with a captivating silver light. It was as if countless stars had suddenly materialized around Big Black Horse, spinning ceaselessly. This was the Silver Eye Saint’s Pupil Skill: Star Eye. Once this Pupil Skill was activated, it would trap the opponent in an illusory world of stars.
Now, with his elder brother Golden Eye Saint’s Deadly Poison Fog added to the mix, even a mighty Destiny Realm cultivator would have no chance of escape.
A supreme Pupil Skill combined with a lethal poison—it was an almost indefensible assault! The Silver Eye Saint refused to believe that fellow could still block it with just a shield.
"Those two shameless Snake Demons, using that despicable trick again!" Watching the battle from afar, the Big Black Cat seethed, its teeth clenched in anger.
It was precisely this combination of Divine Skills that had led to its defeat years ago.
The Silver Eye Saint had employed his bizarre Pupil Skill, trapping it in an Illusory Realm.
Then, the Golden Eye Saint had unleashed his Deadly Poison Fog. It had inhaled some and nearly lost its old life.
Fortunately, as a Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, it possessed nine lives. By resorting to an ancient secret technique and sacrificing one of its lives, it managed to expel the poison and flee.
That battle had left the Big Black Cat severely depleted in Yuan Qi, and it had never since sought revenge against those two.
It was after that ordeal that it encountered its current master...
"Haha, bring it on!" Big Black Horse boomed with laughter, raising the shield in his hand. A mysterious light emanated from the shield, revealing ancient, primitive patterns within. As if summoned, all the surrounding stars were drawn into it and absorbed.
"What? He actually broke my Pupil Skill!" The Silver Eye Saint was stunned.
Over all these years, extremely few had ever managed to break his Pupil Skill.
The Golden Eye Saint beside him was also astonished. The next moment, his own eyes began to radiate a brilliant golden light. Instantly, the entire world seemed to transform, submerged in an endless golden ocean, making one wonder if they had been transported to some bizarre, alternate dimension.
Caught completely off guard, the nearby Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain were instantly trapped within this Illusory Realm. The Mana barrier they had previously erected vanished abruptly. All three stared blankly, their spirits utterly crushed.
"MEOW!" All the fur on the Big Black Cat bristled. Its four tails erupted with glows of four different colors, enveloping its entire body. From a distance, it resembled a radiant, multicolored sphere of light.
This Golden Ring Snake! His Pupil Skill is so formidable, far more terrifying than that Silver Ring Snake’s!
The Big Black Cat was inwardly astounded.
Observing the reactions of those around him, the Golden Eye Saint felt a surge of smug satisfaction.
His Golden Eye Pupil Skill was a rare sight in the world.
Even within the Heavenly Star Dynasty, no more than three individuals were aware of its existence.
This Pupil Skill was immensely powerful; he had once relied on his Golden Eye to contend with a peak Heavenly Mandate Realm Tenth Level cultivator for several Time Units, ultimately retreating unscathed.
"Mere parlor tricks! How could such a minor Pupil Skill possibly affect Uncle Ma?" Big Black Horse roared with laughter as the mysterious light on his shield flared once more. This time, it completely absorbed the golden Ocean Illusion Technique that filled the sky.
"How is this possible?" The Golden Eye Saint’s eyes widened in utter disbelief, his mind reeling as if struck by colossal waves.
How could this dark-faced, middle-aged man’s shield be so incredibly potent?
It had effortlessly broken two different Pupil Skills!
Big Black Horse casually moved the shield behind his back. Gazing at the black poison fog still permeating the air, he opened his mouth wide and took a deep breath, inhaling every last wisp of the Deadly Poison Fog.
"Rather bland!" Big Black Horse commented, sticking out his blood-red tongue to lick his lips, then curled them in a disdainful sneer.
"What?!"
That fiend actually swallowed all the Deadly Poison Fog and is still alive?!
The Golden Eye Saint and Silver Eye Saint were beyond horrified.
At that very moment, they finally understood. The being before them was undoubtedly a supreme Great Demon!
To swallow the Deadly Poison Fog and remain unharmed...
He had to be a Great Demon of the Life and Death Realm!
Realization struck them like a thunderbolt. The hearts of the Golden Eye Saint and Silver Eye Saint pounded with sheer terror, and cold sweat beaded on their skin. Exchanging a horrified glance, they instantly transformed into streaks of golden and silver light, turned, and fled for their lives.

chapters.title: Chapter 110: Uncle Ma Bestows a Treasure
chapters.content:
Chapter 110: Chapter 110: Uncle Ma Bestows a Treasure
"Trying to run?"
Big Black Horse gave a toothy grin and threw the Black Shield in his hand.
WHOOSH!
The Black Shield transformed into a beam of dark light, instantly intercepting the gold and silver beams of light.
The shield emitted a quaint and strange light, sweeping up the two beams.
In a flash, the shield reappeared in Big Black Horse’s hand.
Big Black Horse lifted the shield, laughing loudly, "You two are Heaven-Destined Great Demons, after all. Uncle Ma hasn’t even had enough fun yet; how can you just run off?"
Golden Eye Saint and Silver Eye Saint were now sealed by a strange force. They couldn’t move at all, their faces etched with despair. They deeply regretted coming to the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range.
It seems we might lose our lives here now.
"Little Cat, didn’t you want revenge? Just kill them!" Big Black Horse chuckled and handed the shield to Big Black Cat.
"Thank you, Uncle Ma, for making this happen!" Big Black Cat delightedly took the shield. He saw a small golden snake and a small silver snake appear on its surface; they seemed to be adsorbed to it, unable to move.
Big Black Cat thought of past events, gritting his teeth in hatred.
He suddenly thrust out his claws and struck the shield.
On the shield, Golden Eye Saint and Silver Eye Saint appeared incredibly small. They watched helplessly as a black claw descended upon them.
Both immediately closed their eyes.
A huge force slammed into their bodies, causing the two Great Saints, Gold and Silver, to vomit blood!
"Little Cat, with your meager strength, you really can’t kill them!" Big Black Horse smirked. Beckoning with his hand, the Gold and Silver Great Saints transformed into two beams of light and landed in his palm.
They were forced to reveal their true forms but were suppressed by Big Black Horse’s mana, shrinking until they were only about three meters long.
CRUNCH!
Big Black Horse directly lifted Golden Eye Saint to his mouth, bit off half his body, chewed a few times, and swallowed.
Fresh blood dripped from his mouth as Golden Eye Saint died on the spot.
"The taste isn’t bad, though it’s a bit poisonous..." Big Black Horse commented while eating.
CRUNCH! CRUNCH!
Then, Big Black Horse devoured the remaining half of Golden Eye Saint’s body as if it were a sausage.
The nearby Silver Eye Saint fainted from fright.
After finishing Golden Eye Saint, Big Black Horse started on Silver Eye Saint.
The sounds of crunching echoed continuously in the hall.
The Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain watched, dumbfounded. Their hearts pounded, and they trembled with fear.
Two Heaven-Destined Great Demons had just been eaten by this senior demon beast.
This senior is truly savage!
The three of them trembled even more as the thought settled.
Fortunately, we treated this senior well back then. Otherwise, we probably would have been eaten long ago!
"Uncle Ma, leave a piece for me..." Like a gust of black wind, Big Black Cat rushed down and grabbed Silver Eye Saint, who only had a third of his body left.
"Well now, Little Cat, you actually dare to eat this poisonous snake!" Big Black Horse glanced at him, a mischievous grin on his face.
"Uncle Ma, these two are my mortal enemies! I won’t be satisfied until I’ve had a bite of them!"
Saying this, Big Black Cat fiercely took a bite.
He bit off a quarter of Silver Eye Saint’s remaining body.
CRUNCH! CRUNCH!
Big Black Cat deliberately made loud chewing sounds, gritting his teeth before swallowing.
"If you get poisoned, I’m not taking responsibility..." Big Black Horse laughed heartily and tossed the small remaining piece of Silver Eye Saint to Thunder Dragon.
"Big Dragon, this piece is for you. If you can eat it, it will definitely benefit your cultivation base!" Big Black Horse said nonchalantly. Then, holding his Black Shield, he strolled back to the stone table and sat down to drink.
Big Black Cat continuously used his mana to suppress the toxicity in the segment of Silver Eye Saint’s body.
Fortunately, he was now at the half-step Destiny Realm. With his abundant mana and unique innate talent, he could suppress the toxicity in Silver Eye Saint’s flesh.
As long as he slowly refined this poison, it wouldn’t have any adverse effects on him.
Furthermore, by absorbing the essence of Silver Eye Saint’s physical body, his cultivation base could also advance rapidly.
"Senior, I... I wouldn’t dare eat this!" Thunder Dragon was startled. Looking at the bloody, mangled body, he didn’t dare to accept it and hastily retreated two steps.
Setting aside the risk of poisoning, if the Dragon Lord of Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge came looking for trouble later, he wouldn’t be able to explain himself even if he was in the right.
"Eat it or don’t. In any case, consider this payment for my stay here these past few days!" Big Black Horse chuckled, ignoring him and continuing to drink.
The Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain looked on, wanting to cry but having no tears.
Gazing at the Silver Ring Snake’s corpse before them, they were utterly at a loss.
Big Black Cat sidled over. Staring at the gleaming Black Shield on the table, his mouth nearly watering, he asked with a grin, "Uncle Ma, can I take a look at this treasure of yours?"
"Look at what? Uncle Ma is in a good mood today. This shield is yours!" Big Black Horse laughed heartily.
He had long since digested Golden Eye Saint and Silver Eye Saint after devouring them.
The life force he gained had even caused a new scale to grow on his chest.
Thus, Big Black Horse hadn’t suffered any loss.
Besides, he’d always found this young fellow, Big Black Cat, quite agreeable, and the cat didn’t possess any decent weapons. So, Big Black Horse decided to give the shield to him.
"To me? Uncle Ma, you’re not joking, are you?" Big Black Cat was so excited he was almost in tears.
This treasure was clearly extraordinary. Its functions were unfathomable—it could be used for both offense and defense, and it could even break such a powerful Pupil Skill.
He had always dreamed of possessing such a treasure.
He never imagined Uncle Ma would so generously gift it to him. This made Big Black Cat wonder,
Am I dreaming?
SLAP!
Big Black Cat suddenly slapped himself.
"Haha, so I’m not dreaming!" After slapping himself, Big Black Cat laughed. He then hurriedly knelt and kowtowed three times to Big Black Horse.
"Thank you, Uncle Ma, for bestowing this treasure! Little Cat will never forget this kindness and will eternally remember Uncle Ma’s grace!" Big Black Cat declared with a solemn expression.
"To hell with that! If you kneel to me again, Uncle Ma will wring your neck!" Big Black Horse sent Big Black Cat flying with a kick.
He grumbled, "From now on, you only kneel to the Master. Got it, Little Cat?!"
"Got it! Got it!" Big Black Cat was on the verge of tears, never expecting his attempt to curry favor to backfire so spectacularly.
Witnessing this scene, Ye Yun couldn’t help but chuckle.
These two are truly a couple of jesters!
However, Big Black Horse did well this time. He not only avenged Little Cat but also gave him a shield for protection.
This shows that although these two demon beasts are always bickering, their bond has actually deepened.
Should I give Little Cat a treasure too?
Ye Yun whispered to himself.
I have innumerable treasures in my repository, but Big Black Cat’s recent performance warrants further observation. After all, the shield Big Black Horse gave him is already an incredible treasure.
A man’s heart is never satisfied, just like a snake trying to swallow an elephant. Sometimes, things that come too easily are not cherished.
As Ye Yun pondered this, a slight glint flickered in his eyes.
He then turned his gaze in another direction.
The black-haired elder of unknown origin, leading a young boy and girl, was now approaching the battle site.

chapters.title: Chapter 111: The Mysterious Elderly and Two Youngsters
chapters.content:
Chapter 111: Chapter 111: The Mysterious Elderly and Two Youngsters
"Master, who are these people? How could they be fighting so fiercely in such harsh conditions?"
One old and two young figures floated in mid-air, a large black umbrella hovering above them. The umbrella constantly rotated, deflecting all lightning strikes to the side.
The youth looked at the intense battle in the distance, a serious expression on his face.
Why are so many people ganging up on that young man and woman?
he wondered.
What deep-seated grudge could there be?
What surprised him was that the cultivation bases of the young man and woman were not high, yet they could withstand the siege from so many people.
The current battle was incredibly intense, but the pair resisted all attacks, dragging the fight into a stalemate.
The black-robed elder’s eyes glinted as he said lightly, "The larger group should be from the three great Sects of the Shenfeng Dynasty: the Yu Mo Sect, the Shen Heng Sect, and the Qitian Sword Sect. Judging by the age of these youths, they should all be the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from these three great Sects."
"Bullying the few with numbers! They don’t have the slightest bit of heroic spirit!" the beautiful young woman beside him huffed angrily.
"That’s not necessarily true. Perhaps this pair of young prodigies initiated the provocation?" the black-haired elder chuckled, a playful look in his eyes.
The young woman pouted and said, "How could that be possible, Master? Who in the Shenfeng Dynasty would dare provoke the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from these three great Sects? This young pair couldn’t possibly be so unwise, could they?"
"Hmm, let me see if their elders are around..."
The black-haired elder, with his hands behind his back, surveyed the surroundings. He released his Divine Sense, and within a thousand-li radius, he found no experts.
This is strange. This young man and woman are, by rights, remarkable prodigies. Could their elders be so unconcerned as to let them fight to the death here?
the elder muttered to himself, a flicker of suspicion on his face.
He was a Cultivator at the Tenth Level of the Destiny Realm, and his Divine Sense was terrifyingly powerful.
He scanned the surroundings again but found no Protector for the young man and woman.
This was somewhat contrary to convention.
But how could such an outstanding young man and woman appear in this tiny Shenfeng Dynasty? They’re almost comparable to the two monstrous disciples I’ve taught.
"Observe their battle carefully. If the two of you were to fight the two of them, what are your chances of winning?" the black-haired elder suddenly asked with a smile.
The youth and the young woman remained silent, carefully observing the fierce battle in the distance.
As geniuses at the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm, they had naturally experienced many battles.
However, they had never witnessed such a fierce and chaotic battle scene.
Lightning bolts rained down densely from the sky, the surrounding trees also continuously shot out bolts of lightning, and sword lights, dense as a tide, swept through.
Yet, the movement technique of the young man and woman was extremely skillful. They transformed into Divine Dragon Phantoms, making it difficult to distinguish the real from the illusory. No attack could touch them.
"Such powerful movement techniques!" the young woman exclaimed, shock filling her eyes.
They had seen many prodigies, but in terms of movement techniques, only this young man and woman, at the Fifth Level of the Divine Bridge Realm, had reached such a level of perfection.
"Master, that young man and woman should be no match for us!"
After observing for a moment, the youth came to this conclusion. As he stated it, a hint of arrogance unknowingly surfaced deep in his eyes.
"Heh." The black-haired elder chuckled and nodded in agreement. After all, these were the two monstrous disciples he had poured countless efforts into nurturing.
In terms of cultivation base or individual strength, they far surpassed the young man and woman on the battlefield.
He gazed at the distant battlefield and smiled. "That young man and woman also have the bloodline of a Divine Beast flowing within them—it should be the Dragon God Bloodline, similar to our Xuan bird lineage. However, this pair of young talents is quite good, yet they don’t even have a Protector. If they were to fall here, it would truly be a pity!"
"Master, that just shows those two are too conceited. They’re just a couple of fools!" the youth snorted coldly, his gaze as sharp as two swords. A powerful Sword Intent naturally emanated from him.
The three of them silently observed the battle.
「Meanwhile, at the heart of the battle.」
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao fought with increasing valor. Their bodies, reformed by the Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood, granted them enduring strength and astonishing stamina; they seemed to never know fatigue.
In contrast, the people from the three great Sects were already showing signs of faltering. Their Mana and stamina were severely depleted. Although they could consume pills to replenish their Mana, the rate of replenishment was far slower than the rate of Mana consumption.
These Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the three great Sects were extremely frustrated; no matter how they attacked, they simply couldn’t touch the two.
「Two hours later.」
The people from the three great Sects began to show signs of fatigue.
The three people observing from afar finally showed surprise on their faces.
"Master, is the Dragon God Bloodline truly that powerful? To enable them to fight for so long without any sign of fatigue?" the youth asked, frowning.
If Junior Sister and I were to fight the members of those three great Sects simultaneously, even with our Profound Bird Bloodline, we couldn’t possibly last this long without showing any signs of fatigue.
"Theoretically, it shouldn’t be. Currently, the Cultivators on the continent who possess the Dragon God Bloodline all have extremely diluted bloodlines; they definitely couldn’t last this long," the black-haired elder mused.
"Then why can they?" the young woman pressed.
"I’m not entirely sure about that. Perhaps they possess some kind of treasure," the black-haired elder smiled.
"A treasure?"
The youth’s eyes instantly lit up. When he looked at the battle again, his gaze was completely different.
What Cultivator in this world wouldn’t covet a treasure that could continuously replenish Mana and stamina during battle?
he thought.
Especially since Junior Sister and I are about to participate in a major battle; we need precisely such treasures to enhance our combat power.
"Master, why don’t I go kill them both!" the youth suddenly drew his sword, a sharp aura emanating from him.
"No need to rush. Let’s observe the situation first," the black-haired elder replied with a faint smile.
The young woman beside him giggled. "Senior Brother, Master means for you to ’sit on the mountain and watch the tigers fight,’ to ’reap the fisherman’s profit.’ Don’t you even understand that?"
"Understood! Understood!" The youth shook his head helplessly and slung the sword behind his back.
The three continued to observe the battle’s development, ready to act according to the situation at any time.
「Another hour later.」
The state of the battle underwent a fundamental reversal.
The Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the three great Sects were all sweating profusely, exhausted to the point of collapse, and were defeated one by one by Luo Li and Jun Moxiao.
In the blink of an eye, they suffered a crushing defeat.
In a mere instant, astonishing sword lights flashed, striking countless Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the three great Sects.
"Run!" The Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the three great Sects who had reached the Ninth and Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm were scared out of their wits. Their fighting spirit completely gone, they turned and fled.
"Trying to run?" Jun Moxiao sneered, and a swath of sword light swept out.
SHIING!
A sword light like a long rainbow suddenly descended from the sky, forcefully shattering Jun Moxiao’s attack.
A youth stood arrogantly on the ground, gazing at Jun Moxiao with a cold, cruel smile playing on his lips.

chapters.title: Chapter 112: Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird
chapters.content:
Chapter 112: Chapter 112: Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird
"You’re quite arrogant. Why don’t I keep you company?"
Sword intent surged from the arrogant young man. His gaze, seemingly as gentle as water, was in fact pressing, with hidden undercurrents swirling within.
BOOM!
A bolt of lightning suddenly exploded beside him, but his expression remained calm, as if he hadn’t noticed it at all.
On the other side, Luo Li was preparing to chase the fleeing disciples from the three great sects.
WHOOSH!
Suddenly, a beam of sword light descended from the sky, transforming into a young girl. This girl was about Luo Li’s age and also very beautiful.
She stood with her hands behind her back, chest puffed out, a haughty expression on her delicate face as she mocked Luo Li, "Stop chasing. Quickly bring out your treasures, won’t you?"
Luo Li stopped. "Treasures?" she asked, looking somewhat baffled at the haughty young girl who had suddenly appeared, her expression puzzled.
The girl squinted, scanning Luo Li and Jun Moxiao. "You two," she said coldly, "after battling the disciples of the three great sects for so long, what kind of treasure are you using to endlessly replenish your mana and stamina?"
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao exchanged a glance. "You guys... HAHA!" They burst into laughter.
What treasures could they possibly have?
They possessed 2% Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood in their bodies, naturally granting them far superior stamina and mana than ordinary cultivators.
The amusing part was that this young man and woman, who had appeared out of nowhere, actually believed they possessed some kind of treasure.
"What are you laughing at?" A blush suddenly rose on the young man’s handsome, jade-like face. He abruptly drew his sword, its tip pointed at Luo Li and Jun Moxiao, his aura growing increasingly formidable.
"Senior Brother, these two are too arrogant! Let’s teach them a lesson on behalf of the three great sects of the Shenfeng Dynasty and deflate their pride!" the exquisite young girl declared, also drawing her sword, her expression haughty and stern.
Looking at these two and their swords, Jun Moxiao frowned.
Where did these two strangers pop up from?
They definitely weren’t from the three great sects.
Could they be... Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from other dynasties?
Although these two had descended from the sky, they had seemingly been observing the battle from nearby, which was how they had noticed the astonishing stamina of him and his Senior Sister.
This young man and woman possessed uncommon cultivation, having reached the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm. Given their boldness in challenging him and his Senior Sister, their combat strength must be extraordinarily high.
Jun Moxiao narrowed his eyes, his expression gradually turning grave. They had just endured several time units of fierce battle, consuming a great deal of physical strength and mana. If they were to fight another battle now, the outcome would be uncertain.
Unless they used the Reverse Dragon Technique again and burned their Essence Blood...
Thinking of this, Jun Moxiao and Luo Li exchanged a meaningful look. In that instant, a silent understanding passed between them, and they made their decision.
"My sword never slays the nameless," Jun Moxiao said coolly, holding his sword across his chest. "May I ask where you two hail from?"
Before they crossed swords,
he wanted to ascertain their origins. In the future, when his and his Senior Sister’s strength grew, they would march upon the enemy’s sect and plunder their Treasure Pavilion to avenge this day’s confrontation.
The young man and woman were pampered and arrogant.
How could they fathom Jun Moxiao’s cunning intentions?
After all, they had been Heaven’s favored since childhood, growing up under their sect’s protection without experiencing the world’s dangers. In terms of emotional intelligence, Jun Moxiao completely outclassed them.
"Since you’re both about to die anyway, remember this well: we are from the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird of the Heavenly Moon Dynasty!" the young man sneered.
Heavenly Moon Dynasty? Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird?
Jun Moxiao looked somewhat bewildered.
He hadn’t even figured out the Shenfeng Dynasty yet, so where did this Heavenly Moon Dynasty come from?
Jun Moxiao glanced at Luo Li.
Luo Li shrugged, indicating she didn’t know either. The three of them had followed their Ancestor from the Ancient Moon Dynasty to the Shenfeng Dynasty, with no opportunity to learn about the history and culture of the Cangnan Continent. In this respect, they were complete novices.
A mocking glint appeared in the delicate young girl’s eyes.
She could tell that the pair opposite her were like country bumpkins; they hadn’t even heard of the Heavenly Moon Dynasty.
The girl’s eyes darted about as she taunted, "The puny Shenfeng Dynasty you inhabit is merely average under the Plough Heaven Dynasty. Above it are the Three Great Dynasties of Sun, Moon, and Star: the Heavenly Star Dynasty, the Heavenly Moon Dynasty, and the Heavenly Sun Dynasty! Our Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird is one of the Four Great Sects of the Heavenly Moon Dynasty. Understand now?"
Jun Moxiao nodded. "Understood!" A brilliant smile lit his face. "Thank you both for the explanation. We won’t hold back now. Who knows... this day next year might be the anniversary of your deaths!"
Saying this, Jun Moxiao transformed into a Divine Dragon Phantom and, sword in hand, charged at the young man. An unending torrent of Divine Dragon Sword Light surged forward like a great river.
Luo Li also transformed into a Divine Dragon Phantom, attacking the young girl.
Although the pair of youths were arrogant, they were top talents. Seeing the sword light approach, they both moved, instantly retreating dozens of meters.
Instantly, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao’s attacks missed.
Both were inwardly startled. It was the first time they had encountered cultivators with such astonishing movement techniques.
"Our Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird’s Nine Heavens Mysterious Bird Body Technique is renowned as the foremost movement technique in the Heavenly Moon Dynasty. How could you possibly comprehend it?" the young man sneered, his voice clear and resonant, piercing the clouds.
After his laughter, he and the girl swayed slightly and vanished in an instant.
SWISH SWISH...
A sea of sword light swept in from a distance like a vast, turbulent ocean, overwhelmingly powerful, instantly surrounding Luo Li and Jun Moxiao.
"Such speed! Such swordsmanship!" Luo Li and Jun Moxiao exclaimed in shock, watching the roiling sword light.
The strength of this young man and woman seemed to be a cut above their own!
Both immediately transformed into dozens of Divine Dragon Phantoms, weaving through the attacks while unleashing the Dragon God Sword Technique.
The four of them clashed in an instant. This battle was even more intense and ferocious than the previous one. The young couple’s swordsmanship was extremely fast; it seemed they could unleash hundreds of sword lights in an instant, completely suppressing Luo Li and Jun Moxiao.
In the distant void, the black-haired old man who had been observing the battle wore a gratified smile. These two were his most prized disciples, also ranked in the top three on the Divine Bridge Realm Heavenly List of the Heavenly Moon Dynasty. Their combat power was naturally extraordinary. If not for their goal of breaking through to the Nirvana Realm, they would not have traveled thousands of miles to the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range in the Shenfeng Dynasty.
Deep within the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range lay a Thunder Pool with incredibly potent lightning energy. If his two disciples cultivated there for a time, they would surely break through to the Nirvana Realm. This way, in the Heavenly Moon Dynasty’s upcoming War of the Secret Realm, his two disciples could enter as cultivators of the Nirvana Realm.
At this moment, Ye Yun was also observing the battle.
When he saw the movement techniques and swordsmanship displayed by the young man and girl, a look of recognition flickered in his eyes.
Who would have thought... The insignificant Mysterious Bird Sect, once a vassal of the Dragon God Sect for ten thousand years, had not only endured for a hundred thousand years but also gained such a resounding name: the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird...
Ye Yun’s face was calm, but a hint of faint, derisive amusement surfaced in the depths of his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 113: Five-fold Combat Power, Shocking Strike
chapters.content:
Chapter 113: Chapter 113: Five-fold Combat Power, Shocking Strike
A hundred thousand years ago.
The Eternal Level Dragon God Sect stood towering over the Cangnan Continent like a colossal entity.
Countless sects were subordinate to the Dragon God Sect.
These subordinate sects included Sky-Level Sects, Super Sects, Great Sects, and Ordinary Sects.
The number of subordinate sects was vast, scattered across the entire continent, too numerous to count.
These sects were all arranged in tiers.
As for this so-called Xuan Bird Sect, Ye Yun happened to have some impression of it, considering it a Great Sect at the time.
The reason he remembered it was because their founding ancestor had once presented Ye Yun with ten stunningly beautiful women.
But after taking a look, Ye Yun didn’t fancy any of them, so he sent them all back.
This event wasn’t exactly major, nor was it insignificant, but it was enough for Ye Yun to remember the name of the Xuan Bird Sect.
Because over the years, very few sects had gifted beautiful women to Ye Yun. Only the Xuan Bird Sect, adept at currying favor, knew of his reputation as the foremost tyrant of the Cangnan Continent and his fondness for beautiful women.
Thinking of this, a faint smile touched Ye Yun’s lips.
Indeed, he did like beautiful women back then. But he often just appreciated their beauty; very seldom did he actually lay hands on them. What he liked more was fighting.
Therefore, this number one expert of the Eternal Realm had, back in those days, decapitated countless people and slapped numerous faces, becoming the worst nightmare for many.
Reflecting on these past events, Ye Yun felt a wave of nostalgia.
He never expected to encounter successors of the Xuan Bird Sect here in the Shenfeng Dynasty. But the Xuan Bird Sect of today has undergone a complete transformation, becoming the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, its standing significantly elevated. It seems they are doing quite well in the Heavenly Moon Dynasty. However, this Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird has long since forgotten its allegiance to the Dragon God Sect from a hundred thousand years ago. So much so that they failed to recognize either the Dragon God Sword Technique or the Dragon God Body Technique.
At this thought, a faint trace of killing intent flickered in Ye Yun’s eyes.
Back in the day, any disciple of the Dragon God Sect would be received with utmost courtesy even by a Sky-Level Sect, let alone by the insignificant Xuan Bird Sect. Now, these successors of the Xuan Bird Sect, such trash, dare to bully my disciples! In my mind, these three are already as good as dead.
However, this current battle could serve as a good trial for Luo Li and Jun Moxiao. After all, the two of them haven’t fought prodigies like these before. This experience will undoubtedly broaden their horizons and be quite beneficial.
As for them burning their Essence Blood and using the Reverse Dragon Technique later, Ye Yun decided to let them be.
As their old ancestor, I have plenty of ways to replenish their losses. For someone like me, who has obtained unimaginable resources from signing in for a hundred thousand years, nothing in this world is difficult.
「Inside the Accumulated Thunder Palace.」
The Big Black Horse, currently sipping wine, naturally noticed the distant battle as its eyes glinted.
"HEH HEH!" It sneered, baring its white teeth.
Daring to bully Master’s disciples and even intending to kill them for their treasures! This Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird truly has no reason to exist anymore. With a single command from Master, I would immediately cross the void, head straight for the Heavenly Moon Dynasty, and obliterate this Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird with a single slap!
"Uncle Ma, what happened?"
The Big Black Cat, having spent a long time with the Big Black Horse, sensed Uncle Ma’s emotional shift and quickly sent a telepathic inquiry.
"It’s nothing. The two young masters are just gaining some experience. Everything is under Master’s control," the Big Black Horse replied with a faint smile, then continued drinking.
The Big Black Cat looked serious, thumping its chest as it vowed, "Yes! If Master needs Little Cat to step in, Little Cat will go through fire and water without hesitation!"
"TSK!" The Big Black Horse shot it a displeased glance and said with a laugh, "Your cultivation base is inadequate. Those humans are already at the Destiny Realm Tenth Level."
"Oh..." The Big Black Cat’s face instantly turned beet red.
It had wanted to show off, but its attempt to curry favor had failed.
It immediately became disheartened.
"Go work hard on your cultivation. Don’t stay here drinking with me anymore," the Big Black Horse said, suddenly grabbing the Big Black Cat and tossing it out.
The void before them tore open, and the Big Black Cat vanished in a flash.
The next moment, the Big Black Cat appeared above the Thunder Pool.
"Cultivate there, Little Cat," Ye Yun’s voice instructed.
He pointed, and a circle suddenly materialized in a region of the Thunder Pool.
"Thank you, Master!" The Big Black Cat immediately prostrated itself, weeping with gratitude.
Even though I can’t see where Master is, I can hear his voice. This must be an incredibly powerful spatial technique! At my current level, I can’t comprehend it at all.
It transformed into a streak of black light, dived into the Thunder Pool, and began to temper its body with the Thunder Pool Water, commencing its cultivation.
「Inside the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range.」
The battle between the four youths had reached a life-or-death moment.
"UNLEASH!" Jun Moxiao suddenly roared. His blood energy seethed, and his aura instantly became terrifying.
At this moment, Jun Moxiao finally activated the Reverse Dragon Technique, enhancing his combat power fivefold.
Luo Li, also burning her Essence Blood, let out a long howl and activated the Reverse Dragon Technique as well.
Seeing the auras of the young man and woman suddenly surge in power, the expressions of the two Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird changed drastically.
The young man’s sword light faltered, a look of shock on his face.
"How is this possible?" he thought. "We were clearly suppressing them and about to win! Why would their combat power suddenly increase severalfold? What kind of secret technique is this?"
The delicate-featured young woman said with a grim expression, "Senior Brother, we must use the Yin Yang Xuan Bird Technique!"
"Alright!" The young man nodded.
Their sword lights immediately began to intertwine, forming a colossal black Xuan bird composed of sword light in mid-air.
WHOOSH!
The massive black Xuan bird blotted out the sky as it roared and lunged towards Luo Li and Jun Moxiao.
The black-haired elder standing beneath the large black umbrella watched the battle intently, his eyes flickering.
I never expected this young pair could force my disciples to use the Yin Yang Xuan Bird Technique. The Yin Yang Xuan Bird Technique is one of the three supreme secret codices of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird. These two Disciples of Heaven’s Pride under me have only learned two forms of it.
Gazing at the colossal black Xuan bird that blotted out the sky as it approached, Jun Moxiao and Luo Li roared in unison, "KILL!"
Their blood energy surged like that of Giant Dragons, their bodies filled with boundless Divine Power. SWISH! Both shot into the sky.
In that instant, they unleashed thousands of strands of Divine Dragon Sword Light.
Countless Divine Dragons roared, rampaging between heaven and earth.
Each Divine Dragon within the sword light was astonishingly lifelike, its pair of dragon eyes radiating an icy, merciless glint.
Reverse Dragon Technique—fivefold attack power!
At this moment, Jun Moxiao and Luo Li held nothing back, exerting their utmost might to deliver a heaven-shattering strike!
The offensive power from both sides was immense.
At this critical juncture, even the lightning in the clouds was disrupted by the potent clash, and not a single bolt descended.
BOOM!
A thousand surging streams of Divine Dragon Sword Light collided with the black Xuan Bird, erupting in a cataclysmic explosion.
A massive shockwave, carrying countless shattered fragments of sword light, spread out in all directions.
RUMBLE...
In that instant, the sturdy surrounding trees were all blasted into innumerable pieces.
Four figures shot backward, each hurtling in a different direction.
Jun Moxiao and Luo Li landed steadily, swords in hand, their expressions unchanged, cold and merciless.
In contrast, the young man and woman of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird were blood-soaked, their auras weak; they were clearly heavily injured.

chapters.title: Chapter 114: A Huge Fall in Status, Immense Fear
chapters.content:
Chapter 114: Chapter 114: A Huge Fall in Status, Immense Fear
"How could this be possible?"
In the distant void, the black-haired elder let out a loud roar.
His two direct disciples, who were a full five realms higher than those two youngsters, were only half a step away from the Nirvana Realm.
Two peerless prodigies on the brink of the Nirvana Realm, they even unleashed one of the three secret scriptures of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, the Yin Yang Xuan Bird Technique.
Yet they were still defeated by those two teenagers.
At a critical moment, the two teenagers somehow resorted to some Secret Technique, and their combat power surged severalfold.
"How... how are you so strong?"
The proud young man coughed up a mouthful of blood, his face twisted in a ghastly grin.
He stared at Jun Moxiao and Luo Li opposite him, his eyes filled with astonishment.
During that fierce exchange, he and his junior female disciple had unleashed their Yin Yang Xuan Bird Technique together... Yet those two on the other side remained perfectly fine. Have their bodies really reached this level of strength? Such a phenomenon is beyond comprehension!
"COUGH! COUGH!"
The delicate young girl also coughed, quickly covering her mouth with her hand.
However, crimson blood streamed through her fingers.
She was injured, and severely at that; all her vital organs were damaged.
"Senior brother, we lost." The girl said despondently, her eyes revealing deep disappointment.
To think that they, the peerless prodigies of the Heavenly Moon Dynasty, would lose to two nobodies. The blow to their confidence was immense.
Jun Moxiao’s chest heaved as he fought to control his chaotic breathing.
After calming down, he raised his Sword, coldly watching the pair opposite him.
There was no sign of arrogance left in the proud young man and girl, as if they had indeed been frightened by them.
But was merely scaring them enough? After all, these two had vowed to kill them and seize the treasures on him and his senior sister. Murder and robbery! He would not tolerate such behavior from his opponents; he had to kill them, and quickly!
At this moment, Jun Moxiao was filled with a murderous intent. He was determined not to let these two live.
"Junior, let’s go!" Luo Li took a deep breath and said coldly.
If no one attacks me, I won’t attack them. If someone does attack me, I will put them to death.
Consistently on the same wavelength, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao charged toward the young pair almost simultaneously.
"You brats, how dare you?!"
A furious roar rolled over them like thunder from a distance.
With a flash, the black-haired elder descended from the sky, releasing an overwhelming pressure that stalled Luo Li and Jun Moxiao.
Against the mighty Heaven Mandate Realm Great Cultivator, they couldn’t advance an inch.
Confronted with the descending Heaven Mandate Realm Great Cultivator, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao’s expressions remained tranquil, though their brows furrowed slightly.
So, it seemed these proud young prodigies had a Protector; that’s why they were so fearless.
"You two children are rather ruthless, aren’t you? Do you intend to kill them after winning the contest?" With his hands behind his back, the black-haired elder asked coldly, the air about him that of a superior.
He was still hesitating, unsure whether or not to kill the two youngsters himself.
After all, his status in the Heavenly Moon Dynasty was high and his cultivation base profound. Killing two Divine Bridge Realm Cultivators would indeed compromise his reputation.
"Senior, are you joking? Your disciples were the ones trying to kill us. Should we just sit and wait for our deaths? Now that we’ve won this contest, is it not right that we should kill them?" Luo Li retorted coldly.
In the face of the Heaven Mandate Realm Great Cultivator’s crushing Super Divine Dragon Breath, she and Jun Moxiao stood as straight as spears.
The black-haired elder narrowed his eyes.
What sort of people were these two calm youngsters? Who gave them such courage? Could it be... Are there Protectors around? In the small Shenfeng Dynasty, who else could possibly have a cultivation base stronger than his?
"Master, we must kill them, so their treasures will be ours," said the proud young man standing behind him, wiping the blood from the corner of his mouth, a cruel sneer in his eyes.
They had already shed all pretense of cordiality; it was now a case of kill or be killed. He was no longer acting arrogantly.
"Master, please make your move! We believe that you can crush them with a single finger!" the delicate young girl said resentfully.
Her gaze was extremely sharp, like two piercing swords, fiercely stabbing towards the pair opposite them.
"..."
The black-haired elder was lost in contemplation. After all, at his age, his thought processes were far more complex than those of his two young disciples.
"You two losers!" Jun Moxiao scoffed coldly. "If you have any guts, fight us yourselves! What kind of heroes are you, letting your elder fight your battles? What a pair of cowards!"
Jun Moxiao’s words made the young man and girl flush crimson.
They were rendered speechless.
After all, both were extremely proud prodigies. Taunted by Jun Moxiao in this manner, they were truly left without a comeback.
After all, they had lost earlier.
They lost fair and square, without a shred of doubt.
"You two kids are so arrogant. Surely, you must be relying on someone. Call your elder out!" the black-haired elder sneered.
"Elder?" Jun Moxiao and Luo Li exchanged a look, a peculiar smile touching their lips.
This old man is merely a Destiny Realm Cultivator; is he even qualified to meet our Ancestral Master? Our Ancestral Master has reached the Divine Monarch Realm; why would he bother meeting these insignificant Destiny Realm Cultivators? To be blunt, our Ancestral Master alone could destroy the entire Cangnan Continent. After all, the Divine Monarch Realm is countless times more powerful than the True God Realm! And the strongest on the Cangnan Continent are merely at the Eternal Realm!
"Old man, your words are genuinely ridiculous; I don’t even know how to respond to you..." Jun Moxiao chuckled, a contemptuous look in his eyes.
He, of course, wouldn’t reveal their Ancestral Master. After all, their Ancestral Master’s status was far too lofty. One hundred thousand years ago, he was the number one Eternal Realm expert on the Cangnan Continent. At that time, it’s debatable whether this old man’s ancestors, going back two hundred generations, had even been born!
"You!"
The black-haired elder was infuriated by Jun Moxiao’s words, particularly his disdainful gaze.
He took a deep breath, hands behind his back, releasing a powerful aura as he slowly stepped forward.
He didn’t launch an attack directly.
Instead, he advanced cautiously towards Luo Li and Jun Moxiao, which showed that this black-haired elder was an extremely careful person.
Just as he took his first step, the black-haired elder’s expression changed drastically.
His cultivation base abruptly dropped from the Heavenly Mandate Realm Tenth Level to the Nirvana Tenth Level, a fall of an entire Major Realm!
Amidst his enormous shock, before he could completely react, he unwittingly took a second step.
The next moment, the elder’s eyes bulged, his mouth fell agape, and his face filled with horror, as if he had witnessed the most terrifying thing imaginable.
"AAAH!"
He let out a bloodcurdling scream.
The black-haired elder was terrified to realize that his cultivation base had plummeted from the Nirvana Tenth Level to the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm!
His cultivation base was now identical to that of his two direct disciples!
"Master, what’s wrong with you?"
Seeing their Master suddenly scream like a madman, the young pair behind him immediately tensed up.
Then, they saw their Master suddenly whirl around. His eyes bulged, bloodshot, his face contorted, baring his teeth and clawing the air like a madman.

chapters.title: Chapter 115: Ancestor Takes Action, Turned into a Mortal
chapters.content:
Chapter 115: Chapter 115: Ancestor Takes Action, Turned into a Mortal
"Aaaaah!"
"Where has my cultivation base gone?"
"Who is it? Who has stolen my cultivation base?!"
The dark-haired old man looked down, fiercely rubbing his hair with both hands. His face contorted with rage as he let out a series of roars towards the sky.
It took him untold years to painstakingly cultivate up to the Tenth Level of the Destiny Realm.
For so many years, he had held a high status in the Heavenly Moon Dynasty, enjoying countless glory!
But now, his cultivation base had suddenly plummeted to the Divine Bridge Realm, the same realm as his two disciples.
In this instant, the dark-haired old man became incapacitated, his mind slipping into hysteria.
"Master’s realm... how could it be..."
The delicate-looking girl’s eyes widened as she realized her master’s realm was now the same as hers.
Also at the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm.
How could this be possible? Her master was clearly a great cultivator at the Tenth Level of the Destiny Realm. How could he suddenly have fallen to the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm?
"Master, what’s wrong with your body? Why did your realm suddenly drop?"
The boy looked at his crazed master, his heart filled with terror, and asked, his voice trembling.
"I..."
The dark-haired old man’s expression froze for a moment, as if he had suddenly become lucid again.
He abruptly realized that he must have been schemed against, which was why his realm had been so suddenly suppressed!
However, he quickly checked every part of his body but found nothing out of the ordinary. He was a perfectly healthy man, yet his realm had inexplicably fallen!
Why is this happening? Could it be... the punishment of Heavenly Dao? Besides Heavenly Dao, he couldn’t think of anything else that could cause him to plummet two Major Realms without any warning. Not even an Eternity Realm cultivator could do that!
As the dark-haired old man considered this possibility, his demeanor became even more delirious.
This is ridiculous! Could it be that Heavenly Dao is punishing me just because I wanted to kill this young man and woman? I won’t accept it! How could this young pair possibly be the Children of Destiny?!
"Haha..."
The dark-haired old man suddenly let out a grim chuckle.
Looking at the dark grey clouds in the sky, he viciously raised his middle finger and cursed, "Damn Heavenly Dao, if you have the guts, lower my realm once more!"
BOOM!
A bolt of lightning flashed and struck nearby, causing a loud sound.
The light from the thunderbolt made the dark-haired old man’s face freeze yet again.
His realm, at that moment, actually tumbled from the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm down to the Molding God Realm Tenth Layer!
"Hahaha..."
The dark-haired old man suddenly erupted in hysterical laughter.
He spun in place, gesticulating wildly, and shouted, "God, you’re too unfair! You are so biased! Just because of them, you weaken my realm? I will not accept it!"
"Unconvinced?" A flat and indifferent voice suddenly echoed around. "You will accept it, whether you want to or not!"
Upon hearing this voice, the frenzied dark-haired old man’s face twisted further.
He knew he was utterly defeated, defeated by the Heavenly Dao.
Yet, he was still unreconciled.
"Damn Heavenly Dao, if you dare, erase all of my cultivation!" he roared maliciously.
Suddenly, his body quivered gently.
In the blink of an eye, his realm plummeted from the Molding God Realm down to the Tenth Layer of the Body Refining Realm.
And it kept falling: Tenth Layer of the Body Refining Realm, Ninth Layer, Eighth Layer...
Finally, it completely disappeared.
He had become a mere mortal, a powerless mortal.
"Ahh!"
