The dark-haired old man let out a scream. Unable to accept this brutal reality, he fainted on the spot.
The young man and woman, who had been standing motionless to the side, now had faces filled with terror. They stared blankly at their fainted master.
Their bodies felt as if they had plunged into an ice cellar, freezing to the bone, unable to move.
Their master, simply because he wanted to kill that other young man and woman, had provoked the wrath of Heavenly Dao. His cultivation base had been reduced from the Tenth Level of the Destiny Realm all the way down to that of an ordinary mortal.
It was too terrifying. Truly, too terrifying. If they hadn’t seen it with their own eyes, it would be impossible to imagine that everything happening before them was real. That the lofty Heavenly Dao would do such a thing... It was truly unbelievable.
Jun Moxiao and Luo Li, who had been standing across, motionless, took a deep breath, their faces full of smiles.
The Ancestor has acted! This time, he was truly ruthless, forcibly turning a Tenth Level Destiny Realm cultivator into an ordinary mortal. They too had their realms suppressed by the Ancestor before, but it was only by one Major Realm. But this dark-haired old man had been demoted directly from the Destiny Realm to an ordinary mortal, a drop of a full eight Major Realms! For such a great cultivator to be reduced to an ordinary mortal... that’s even more agonizing than killing him. This is a terrifying form of spiritual torture.
BOOM!
A bolt of lightning flashed from the clouds, striking the dark-haired old man squarely. The thick bolt instantly obliterated him, leaving nothing but dust.
WHOOSH!
Jun Moxiao quickly moved, rushing to the nearby jungle to pick up a storage ring.
This storage ring was not damaged by the lightning.
Jun Moxiao smirked.
A Destiny Realm great cultivator, this ring must contain plenty of treasures...
He then sent his Divine Sense into the storage ring but found it was protected by a seal that his Divine Sense could not penetrate.
Indeed, a Destiny Realm great cultivator’s personal storage ring would have its own seal; thus, with Jun Moxiao’s current abilities, he could not yet open it.
Further away, Ye Yun, seeing this, smiled slightly.
"Wait until your cultivation reaches the Destiny Realm, then you can open it yourselves..." he murmured softly.
His voice echoed in Jun Moxiao’s ear, and he quickly bowed, "Alright, Ancestor!"
Then he returned and handed the ring to Senior Sister Luo Li.
This was the first storage ring they had obtained from a Destiny Realm great cultivator. It would be better to entrust it to Senior Sister, the Sect Leader, for safekeeping. After all, Senior Sister would have to decide on the future development of the Dragon God Sect and the distribution of cultivation resources for the sect disciples. Jun Moxiao didn’t want to get involved in the tedious affairs of sect management. He just wanted to cultivate peacefully.
"Master!"
Seeing their master blasted into oblivion, the arrogant young man and woman finally lost control of their emotions, collapsing to the ground and bursting into tears.
Jun Moxiao raised an eyebrow and asked, "Senior Sister, should we kill them now?"
Luo Li said coldly, "Kill them. Then we’ll go after the disciples of the three major sects who fled!"
Jun Moxiao nodded.
The two of them, swords in hand, advanced towards the young man and woman.
"We’ll fight you to the death!"
The young man and woman abruptly stood up. Their swords joined, and they once again executed the Yin Yang Xuan Bird Technique.
However, this time its power was not great; the black Xuan bird woven from sword light in mid-air was only one-third its usual size.
SWISH!
Streaks of Divine Dragon Sword Light swept out, covering the sky and earth, imposing.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao simultaneously launched the Dragon God Sword Technique.
BOOM!
The black Xuan bird was blown to pieces!
The young man and woman were struck by multiple sword attacks. They screamed as they fell from mid-air, dying on the spot.
The elder and two juniors from the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird of the Heavenly Moon Dynasty probably never dreamed they would perish deep within the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range.
Two figures flashed by.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao collected the pair’s weapons and storage rings. They then summoned Lei Ze and prepared to pursue the fleeing disciples from the three major sects.
So powerful!
Lei Ze thought, its heart filled with utter shock as it surveyed the devastated battlefield before taking flight.

chapters.title: Chapter 116: One Word Dispels the Heavenly Tribulation
chapters.content:
Chapter 116: Chapter 116: One Word Dispels the Heavenly Tribulation
Within the vast Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range.
A disciple of the Shen Heng Sect was fleeing at full speed. He was drenched in sweat, his eyes filled with terror. His stamina was clearly almost depleted, yet he gritted his teeth and desperately continued to flee.
That young duo was too terrifying. Just the two of them had nearly wiped out all the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from their three major sects.
He absolutely had to report this news to the Sect. He needed to have the Nirvana Realm experts of the Sect rush to the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range as quickly as possible to encircle and annihilate these two youths. They absolutely could not be allowed to escape the Shenfeng Dynasty.
While fleeing, the young man also had to constantly be on guard against lightning striking down from the sky, making his escape exceptionally difficult.
Suddenly, a dazzling sword light shot out from the distance. With a soft thud, it struck him squarely in the back, near his heart.
The young man turned to look and saw that very pair of young man and woman standing on a Leize.
"You still pursued me!"
The young man’s eyes dimmed, and a bitter smile appeared on his face. He had fled for an hour, yet he still hadn’t escaped the pursuit of these two youths.
"HUMPH! Not a single disciple of the Shen Heng Sect shall be left alive!" Jun Moxiao fixed the young man with a murderous gaze and snorted coldly.
"Why? When did our Shen Heng Sect... offend you?" The young man clutched his chest, blood flowing out from between his fingers. After asking this question, he could no longer hold on and collapsed to the ground, dead.
Jun Moxiao flew closer and picked up the longsword and storage ring. His eyes were slightly red as he stated indifferently, "Your Shen Heng Sect has been slaughtering my Divine Dragon Sect for who knows how many years! Generation after generation of our ancestors have been murdered by you! Now, the hatred between our two sects is so deep it’s irreconcilable. It’s either you die, or we perish!"
Luo Li stood on the Leize’s back, scanning the distance.
She voiced her concerns, saying, "Junior Brother, why don’t we split up? Those guys are running too fast!"
"Good idea!" Jun Moxiao nodded, immediately picked a direction, and flew off at extreme speed.
"Let’s go!" Luo Li gave an order to the Leize, and the Leize flapped its wings and immediately flew in pursuit.
Now that they had split into two groups, the chances of catching those fugitives were even greater.
Along the way, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao killed several disciples from the three major sects. But that wasn’t nearly enough.
By a rough estimate, at least seventeen or eighteen people had escaped this time. So far, they had only killed seven or eight, and about ten others had vanished, their whereabouts unknown.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao chased them all the way to the outskirts of the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range but still couldn’t find those ten disciples.
"Both of you, come back!"
In different areas along the outer edge of the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao simultaneously heard their Ancestor’s voice in their minds.
"Ancestor, those few got away!" Luo Li said, unwilling to accept it, her eyes turning a little red with frustration.
She vaguely remembered that among the fleeing Shen Heng Sect disciples, there were at least three or four. She felt extremely aggrieved that they hadn’t managed to kill all the Shen Heng Sect disciples this time.
"There will be plenty of opportunities in the future..."
Above the Thunder Pool, Ye Yun smiled faintly. He reached out his arm, delving into the void. In an instant, he had snatched Luo Li and Jun Moxiao back.
They appeared above the Thunder Pool, both somewhat dumbfounded. They didn’t know how, but suddenly, as if the stars had shifted and space-time had warped, they found themselves in an unfamiliar place.
Below them was a lake. The water was a vivid, deep blue, emanating a Super Divine Dragon Breath rich with the essence of lightning.
"Could this be the Thunder Pool?" Jun Moxiao stared wide-eyed, exclaiming as he looked at the Thunder Pool below.
In the void, a figure clad in white suddenly appeared.
"Greetings, Ancestor." Luo Li and Jun Moxiao hastily bowed in respect.
They immediately understood. Their Ancestor must have used his Supreme Divine Power to transport them across such a vast expanse of the void.
Ye Yun nodded faintly and said softly, "Your Senior Sister is here tempering her physique. For the next few days, you will also temper yourselves here."
As Ye Yun spoke, he gently pointed, and two circles suddenly appeared on the lake’s surface.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao’s figures abruptly vanished from their original positions. The next moment, they reappeared inside those two circles.
"Use this Thunder Pool Water to temper your physical bodies. It can accelerate the fusion speed of your Ancestral Dragon Bloodline," Ye Yun said with a faint smile.
He took out a small vial and, with a light flick of his finger, sent two drops of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood flying towards them.
"Take them," Ye Yun instructed.
Jun Moxiao and Luo Li felt a chill in their hearts and immediately opened their mouths, each swallowing their drop of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood.
Their bodies sank into the Thunder Pool, and they began to refine their drops of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood according to the Dragon God Sect’s unique cultivation technique.
Seeing that the Dragon God Sect’s only three remaining disciples were all quietly cultivating in the Thunder Pool, Ye Yun’s figure flashed, and he re-entered the void. After breaking through to the Divine Monarch Realm, he still needed some time to consolidate his cultivation base.
「Three days later.」
From the Thunder Pool, a heaven-shattering Super Divine Dragon Breath suddenly erupted.
The figure of an enormous Nine-Tailed Spirit Cat suddenly shot up from the pool’s water, materializing in mid-air.
At this moment, the Nine-Tailed Spirit Cat had already grown its fifth tail. Its Super Divine Dragon Breath was also extremely powerful; it had broken through the Nirvana Realm and reached the Destiny Realm.
The Big Black Cat had its eyes closed, its usual playful expression completely gone. It had just achieved a breakthrough and was about to face the baptism of the Heavenly Tribulation.
Upon breaking through from the Nirvana Realm to the Destiny Realm, a Cultivator begins to gain a deeper and more profound understanding of the Heavenly Dao. The more profound this understanding, the stronger their control over the powers between Heaven and Earth. Therefore, this is why a Destiny Realm Cultivator—even one at the First Layer of Heaven’s Will Realm—far surpasses a Nirvana Realm Cultivator.
The dark clouds in the sky grew denser, resembling a colossal black fortress suspended in mid-air. Dazzling bolts of lightning brewed within, seeming to conceal the immense wrath of the Heavenly Dao.
Ye Yun remained seated in the void, calmly observing everything before him.
As a Nine-Tailed Spirit Cat, with each new tail the Big Black Cat grew, not only would its Divine Skills increase significantly, but it would also gain an extra life. The Will of Heaven would naturally not allow it to obtain this extra life so easily.
RUMBLE! RUMBLE!
One massive bolt of lightning after another descended from the sky, slamming down heavily onto the Big Black Cat.
The Big Black Cat thrust out its paws, fiercely swatting at those bolts of lightning, causing a tremendous explosive sound. It managed to withstand this first wave of lightning through sheer force, but the Big Black Cat also spat out a mouthful of blood.
How can this Heavenly Tribulation be so strong?
The Big Black Cat was extremely perplexed.
RUMBLE! RUMBLE!
Just as this thought crossed its mind, the second wave of lightning, even more ferocious, crashed down. It didn’t dare hesitate and immediately raised its paws to strike at this second wave.
RUMBLE! RUMBLE!
The colossal explosions shook the entire Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range. At this moment, all the lightning-attributed demon beasts in the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range scattered in terror.
「Meanwhile, in the Accumulated Thunder Palace.」
The Big Black Horse, who was drinking, saw the scene outside, grinned, but said nothing.
"Senior, congratulations to that Daoist friend for being on the verge of breaking through to the Destiny Realm!" Thunder Dragon clasped his hands and said to the Big Black Horse with a smile.
"Don’t worry about it. Let’s continue drinking!" The Big Black Horse waved his hand dismissively.
The second wave of lightning caused the Big Black Cat to spit out another large mouthful of blood.
Immediately following were the third, fourth, and fifth waves of lightning, arriving in quick succession.
The Big Black Cat only managed to endure up to the fifth wave of the Heavenly Tribulation before its strength gave out. Its body was blasted into a bloody, mangled mess, a truly horrific sight.
RUMBLE! RUMBLE!
The sixth wave of lightning then arrived. This sixth wave of lightning astonishingly contained more bolts than the previous five waves combined. If the Big Black Cat were to be struck by this, it would undoubtedly be blasted into nothingness, not even dregs remaining.
"Retreat!" Ye Yun uttered a single word.
In an instant, all the menacing bolts of lightning abruptly recoiled, retreating back into the dark clouds.

chapters.title: Chapter 117: A Thread of Lightning from the Rebirth Lightning Pool
chapters.content:
Chapter 117: Chapter 117: A Thread of Lightning from the Rebirth Lightning Pool
Below the Thunder Pool, within the Accumulated Thunder Palace.
Despite being busy drinking with the Eternal Realm Great Demon senior, the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain had also released their Divine Senses, keenly observing the tribulation the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat Great Demon was undergoing above.
The sixth wave of lightning arrived with menacing force, its power equivalent to the sum of the previous five waves. The Nine-tailed Spirit Cat seemed on the brink of perishing.
Unexpectedly, a voice suddenly resounded from the void.
A simple, clear "Retreat" echoed between heaven and earth.
Amazingly, the surging sixth wave of lightning completely reversed its course, retracting back into the clouds.
How powerful! What level of cultivation could achieve this?
Seeing this, the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain turned pale, their eyes wide and mouths agape, struggling to comprehend the shock they felt. All three had their memories erased, so they were unaware of Ye Yun’s current cultivation base. After all, the Three Saints were also peerless Great Demons, so they could vaguely guess that this Master likely possessed a cultivation base at least at the Tenth-Layer Peak of the Eternal Realm. He was just half a step away from becoming a True God.
The Big Black Cat hovered in mid-air, barely clinging to life. It had already resigned itself to death, but unexpectedly, the Master had spoken, uttering a single word that sent the menacing Heavenly Tribulation retreating. The Big Black Cat was both stunned and overjoyed; the Master had once again saved its life.
The dark clouds in the sky still lingered, layered and piled up like a colossal black city. Thunder serpents continued to coil and swirl within this black city, as if still brewing something.
Ye Yun glanced up at the void, his expression suddenly turning frosty.
With him present, did this Heavenly Tribulation still intend to continue?
"Scram!" Ye Yun roared.
This roar formed an unimaginably massive storm, shooting skyward.
BOOM!
The black city formed by the dark clouds was blasted apart in an instant. The dispersed clouds scattered in all directions, vanishing almost instantaneously. Not a shred of cloud remained in the sky above Accumulated Thunder Mountain.
Long-absent sunlight returned, its brilliant glow shining down on the Big Black Cat and the surface of the Thunder Pool. Under the sun, the Thunder Pool emitted a dazzling blue luster, like a sapphire.
"Thank you, Master, for saving my life!"
The Big Black Cat was in no mood to appreciate the beautiful scenery. It struggled to its feet and kowtowed towards the direction in the void from where the voice had come.
Looking at the severely injured Big Black Cat, Ye Yun gently furrowed his brow.
Under normal circumstances, as long as a cultivator survived several waves of Heavenly Tribulation, those in the Destiny Realm could absorb its energy to temper their physical bodies, further refining themselves. However, Ye Yun had forcibly dispersed the Heavenly Tribulation clouds, causing the Big Black Cat to miss this step.
Thinking of this, Ye Yun fumbled at his wrist and drew out a bolt of golden lightning. This golden lightning bolt also emanated the terrifying aura of a Heavenly Tribulation. Ye Yun gently kneaded the golden lightning in his hand a few times, and its terrifying aura began to diminish rapidly.
With a light tap, the golden lightning flew through the void and entered between the Big Black Cat’s eyebrows.
The Big Black Cat was instantly invigorated, its body trembling. Strands of golden light permeated its black fur. Enveloped in the golden light, the Big Black Cat radiated a sacred aura. Its injuries began to heal at an unimaginable speed, and its physical body was also being tempered by this mysterious golden lightning, growing increasingly stronger. Even more astonishingly, the Big Black Cat’s cultivation base began to rapidly escalate at this moment!
This is incredible! What kind of lightning tempering did that white-robed Master provide for the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat?
The Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain watched, wide-eyed and mouths agape in disbelief. The three of them, being Thunderbolt-attribute Behemoths, were naturally extremely sensitive to lightning. They sensed an unimaginable divine power within that golden bolt of lightning, seemingly of an even higher quality than the Heavenly Tribulation.
But how could they know? This bolt of lightning, after Ye Yun had processed it, had its quality significantly reduced. Otherwise, the Big Black Cat would not have been able to withstand it; it would have instantly exploded and perished.
「About the time it takes for an incense stick to burn,」
The golden light enveloping the Big Black Cat slowly dissipated, and its aura grew increasingly powerful. At this moment, it had actually advanced to the Destiny Realm Second Level.
The Big Black Cat opened its eyes. It appeared energized and refreshed, every black hair on its body gleamed. Within its eyes, a faint glint of golden lightning now flickered.
Tears suddenly streamed from the Big Black Cat’s eyes.
The Master not only saved my life but also bestowed upon me a mysterious bolt of lightning, helping me temper my body and advance my cultivation!
"Master, thank you so much!" The Big Black Cat knelt in the void, wailing loudly.
"Alright, alright, stop crying. Hurry up and go stabilize your realm!" Ye Yun smiled helplessly, rubbing his brow. With a flick of his little finger, the Big Black Cat immediately fell back into the Thunder Pool.
The Big Black Cat’s body shrank as it sank into the Thunder Pool. It closed its eyes and began to stabilize its realm.
Seeing this, Ye Yun nodded silently. This golden lightning of his was a strand he had taken from the Rebirth Lightning Pool. This Rebirth Lightning Pool was of an incredibly high grade, surpassing even the God level. Thus, even this single strand of Rebirth Thunder contained a mighty, mysterious energy potent enough to surpass the Heavenly Tribulation.
「Inside the Accumulated Thunder Palace.」
The Big Black Horse bared its teeth, its blood-red tongue darting out to lick its lips, a fervent gleam in its eyes. That bolt of golden lightning was an irresistible temptation for him as well. He put down his wine jar, then plucked up his courage and carefully sent Ye Yun a voice transmission.
"Master, could I also have a bolt of that lightning?"
After saying this, the Big Black Horse instantly regretted it.
Was it not too shameless of me to directly ask the Master for something?
"Certainly!" Ye Yun smiled faintly.
He reached out, plucked a strand of Rebirth Thunder from his storage, and sent it through the void directly into the crown of the Big Black Horse’s head.
"Thank you, Master!"
The Big Black Horse’s entire body shuddered, a joyful expression spreading across its face. He quickly closed his eyes and began to refine the golden lightning. Even though he was an Eternal Realm Great Demon standing at the pinnacle of the Cangnan Continent, he still coveted this bolt of lightning immensely.
As the Big Black Horse began refining it, he suddenly discovered that this mysterious lightning was hundreds of times more powerful than the one the Big Black Cat had received. A chill ran down the Big Black Horse’s spine.
Only then did he realize that the golden lightning absorbed by the Little Cat had been processed by the Master.
He sat upright and focused all his effort on refining it.
"This..."
Seeing the Eternal Realm Great Demon senior close his eyes to cultivate, the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain couldn’t help but exchange glances, feeling somewhat restless.
At this moment, the three of them wished they could also become the white-robed Master’s demon beasts.
"Big Brother," the Kui Bull said with naive earnestness, "why don’t we discuss with this Demon Clan senior about following the Master from now on? Then we wouldn’t have to cultivate on this Accumulated Thunder Mountain anymore!"
"That might not be appropriate, right? The three of us aren’t qualified. Look at the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat; its cultivation base is already a whole level higher than mine..." the Thunder Dragon lamented.
He was at the Destiny Realm First Level, while the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat was now at the Destiny Realm Second Level.

chapters.title: Chapter 118: Letter of Intent
chapters.content:
Chapter 118: Chapter 118: Letter of Intent
After hearing Thunder Dragon’s words, Kui Bull and Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger both felt a pang of disappointment. They were merely at the Nirvana Realm, not even the Destiny Realm.
With such a meager cultivation base, how could they possibly qualify to follow this Eternal Realm Elder?
The three of them hung their heads, sinking into despondent silence.
The great hall was eerily quiet.
CRACKLE...
The Big Black Horse closed its eyes, and its body suddenly emitted tiny golden lightning flashes. These flashes resembled countless tiny golden snakes, giving off an extremely terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath.
The Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain trembled with fear.
"This golden lightning is so terrifying! Thankfully, the Elder is an Eternal Realm Great Demon; otherwise, beings like us would have been blasted to pieces by this lightning..." Thunder Dragon remarked, still shaken.
"Big brother, we can’t hold on anymore!" Unable to endure any longer, Kui Bull and Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger hurriedly flew out of the hall. They sat cross-legged at the entrance, circulating their cultivation techniques to resist the encroaching golden lightning.
Thunder Dragon, however, did not leave. As a Destiny Realm Great Demon, he could still hold out for a while longer.
After the time it took for an incense stick to burn, Thunder Dragon was surprised to discover that by unintentionally absorbing a tiny amount of the golden lightning’s Super Divine Dragon Breath, his Thunder and lightning ability had actually strengthened somewhat.
"My two virtuous brothers, hurry back! Don’t miss such a wonderful opportunity!" Thunder Dragon quickly sent a mental message, forcefully summoning Kui Bull and Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger back.
The three great demons sat cross-legged, electrical currents flowing across their bodies, and began to absorb the faint golden lightning Super Divine Dragon Breath emanating from the Big Black Horse.
The Big Black Horse was fully aware of what was happening outside but did not intervene.
This tiny bit of Super Divine Dragon Breath it leaked wouldn’t affect it in the slightest. The strand of mysterious golden lightning bestowed upon it by the Master was simply too precious. The Big Black Horse estimated that after it refined this lightning, not only would its cultivation realm greatly increase, but its Thunder and lightning ability would also become incomparably stronger than before.
「...」
Seeing his disciples and Divine Pet all enter a state of cultivation, Ye Yun, observing from the void, allowed himself a faint smile.
Things will be quiet for a few days. Those disciples who escaped from the three major Sects will definitely report back to their Sects. At that point, the three major Sects will likely dispatch experts at least at the Nirvana Realm to the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range. Ye Yun didn’t plan to intervene. Such minor matters could be handled by the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain. After all, this place is also a sacred ground for the Demon Clan. No matter how powerful the three major Sects are, they wouldn’t dare to act recklessly here.
Now, Ye Yun had his three disciples cultivate in the Thunder Pool for a period. Once their Ancestral Dragon Bloodline had improved to a certain degree, they would leave the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range and continue their training.
「...」
「The Qitian Sword Sect.」
Three heavily injured disciples staggered back to the Sect in a wretched state. They met with the Sect Master of the Qitian Sword Sect and reported everything that had happened in the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range.
The Sect Master of the Qitian Sword Sect was enraged. He immediately dispatched several Nirvana Realm Cultivators to the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range to find that young pair.
The sole surviving disciple from the Yu Mo Sect also made his way back to his Sect. When the Sect Master of the Yu Mo Sect learned that all nineteen Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from his sect had perished, he flew into a terrible rage. He immediately sent more than a dozen Nirvana Realm Cultivators to the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range to hunt down the young boy and girl.
The Shen Heng Sect reacted similarly.
At this moment, all three major Sects dispatched their Nirvana Realm experts, totaling twenty to thirty individuals. In the eyes of the three major Sects, dealing with two Divine Bridge Realm Cultivators with such a formidable and numerous lineup was considered effortless. They believed that as long as the pair was found, they could be killed on the spot.
Over twenty Nirvana Realm experts from the three major Sects met coincidentally at the periphery of the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range. This time, the three major Sects, united by a common enemy and burning with aggressive momentum, stormed into the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range together.
They employed various tracking-type magical artifacts, searching deep into the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range for the whereabouts of that young pair. After traveling thousands of miles along the mountain range for several days, they still hadn’t found them.
"Could that young pair have gone to the Thunder Pool?" an Elder from the Qitian Sword Sect, a Nirvana Realm expert, said with furrowed brows.
"Unlikely. The Thunder Pool is the territory of the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain. Even ordinary Demon Clan members wouldn’t dare to trespass, let alone two Human Race Cultivators!" an Elder from the Shen Heng Sect replied, shaking his head.
"Keep searching! Even if we have to turn the entire Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range upside down, we must find the murderers who killed our Yu Mo Sect’s Disciples of Heaven’s Pride!" an Elder from the Yu Mo Sect roared angrily, leading the Demon Sect members and charging deeper into the range.
The Nirvana Realm experts from the three major Sects searched for several more days. They were now within a hundred miles of the Thunder Pool, yet there was still no trace of the young boy and girl.
「Meanwhile.」
They had already contacted their Sects, mobilizing all their forces to search for that young pair throughout the entire Shenfeng Dynasty. However, no news came from the outside either. It was as if the young pair had vanished from the face of the earth.
"If all else fails, should we pay a visit to the Thunder Pool?" an Elder from the Qitian Sword Sect suggested.
"Very well!" The Nirvana Realm experts from the other two Sects nodded in agreement.
At that moment, they had no other choice. They wouldn’t rest until they had thoroughly searched the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range. They believed that with all three major Sects arriving together, the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain would have to take them seriously. After all, this tragic incident had occurred within the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range. As the masters of Accumulated Thunder Mountain, the three Demon Saints also had an obligation to assist in their investigation.
More than twenty Nirvana Realm experts quickly arrived outside the Accumulated Thunder Palace.
"The three major Sects of the Shenfeng Dynasty request an audience with the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain!" an Elder from the Shen Heng Sect stood at the palace gate, cupped his fists, and shouted loudly.
The Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain, who were in the midst of their cultivation, were abruptly interrupted by the shout and felt a surge of annoyance.
The Big Black Horse, its eyes closed, emitted a majestic voice, "You should know what to do, right?" It sat upright, its entire body radiating fine arcs of lightning, exuding an aura of profound sanctity and inviolability.
The Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain were startled. They exchanged glances, and suddenly, a flash of inspiration struck them; they instantly knew what to do.
That young pair of Heaven’s Chosen are disciples of the Master! They killed the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the three major Sects, and now those Sects’ Nirvana Realm Cultivators have come knocking. Isn’t this a perfect opportunity for us, the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain, to prove ourselves? We were just wondering how to present our pledge of fealty, and now the chance has arrived! What better pledge of fealty could there be than to directly kill these Nirvana Realm Cultivators from the three major Sects?
A look of excitement spread across Thunder Dragon’s face. With a wave of his hand, he led Kui Bull and Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger out, their demeanor imposing.
The waiting Nirvana Realm Cultivators from the three major Sects saw the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain emerge and quickly cupped their fists in salute. "Greetings to the Three Saints!"
Thunder Dragon walked at the forefront, his expression cold as he looked at these Nirvana Realm Cultivators.
Kui Bull, beside him, asked loudly, "Why have so many of you from the three major Sects come here, causing such a ruckus in our Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range? Do you have no respect for us, the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain?"
Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger also roared angrily, "I think you’ve all grown audacious, daring to cause trouble right under our noses! Are you all tired of living?"

chapters.title: Chapter 119: Nirvana Realm, Total Annihilation
chapters.content:
Chapter 119: Chapter 119: Nirvana Realm, Total Annihilation
"This..."
The expressions of the Nirvana Realm cultivators from the three great sects suddenly turned ugly. They never dreamed that the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain would immediately put them in their place upon appearing.
"Three Demon Saints, more than forty of our Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the three great sects have died! This grudge cannot go unanswered. The murderer is still in the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range, and we must find them. Otherwise, our three great sects will never let this matter rest!" an Elder from the Shen Heng Sect declared unapologetically, his eyes flashing. As the foremost of the three great sects, the Shen Heng Sect was the most powerful and also had Destiny Realm cultivators within its ranks. When it came to true strength, the overall power of the Shen Heng Sect absolutely surpassed that of Accumulated Thunder Mountain.
"Never let it rest?" Thunder Dragon took a step forward, his hands behind his back, and looked at the crowd coldly. His vertical pupils emitted a startling killing intent. "You three great sects are quite audacious, daring to threaten me. I think you’re seeking death!"
With that, Thunder Dragon reached out and gripped the throat of the Shen Heng Sect Elder. A tremendous pressure from the Destiny Realm instantly descended. The Elder, who was at the fourth level of the Nirvana Realm, found himself unable to move. He watched helplessly as Thunder Dragon seized his neck and brutally twisted it.
CRACK!
His entire head was wrenched off. Blood gushed skyward from the stump of his neck. Although the Elder was dead, as a powerful figure in the Nirvana Realm, his strong body still stood firmly on the ground, blood continuously spurting out. The sight was incredibly terrifying.
All the Nirvana Realm powerhouses from the three great sects were stunned. They hadn’t expected Thunder Dragon, a great demon of the Destiny Realm, to actually dare to kill. They were the three great sects! Combined, they could completely crush Accumulated Thunder Mountain.
"Damn you, Thunder Dragon! How dare you kill someone from our three great sects! You must be looking to die!" an Elder from the Qitian Sword Sect roared, angrily drawing his sword.
Seeing the Elder’s threatening words, Thunder Dragon’s face darkened further. Accumulated Thunder Mountain might have been insignificant in the past, but things were different now.
"I’ve had enough of you three great sects for a long time! Today is the perfect day to settle old scores and new!" the Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger, known for its volatile temper, roared in anger and dashed toward the Qitian Sword Sect Elder. In mid-air, it transformed into its true form, its massive body whipping up a raging wind. With a single slap, it shattered the Elder, who was at the Nirvana Realm Third Level.
Only then did the other Nirvana Realm powerhouses realize what was happening. They finally understood that the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain had no regard for the dignity of the three great sects and had begun a reckless slaughter. They immediately scattered and fled in all directions. The Kui Bull also revealed its true form and chased after them.
Thunder Dragon sneered, his hands still behind his back, as bolts of lightning shot from his eyes. These lightning bolts were incredibly powerful and moved at an unbelievable speed. Many Nirvana Realm cultivators were instantly obliterated upon being struck.
The battle ended quickly. None of the twenty-odd Nirvana Realm cultivators from the three great sects managed to escape; all of them perished there.
The Kui Bull and Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger flew back and reverted to their human forms.
"Thank you for your hard work, brothers!" Thunder Dragon smiled and nodded, then turned and walked back into the main hall.
"Senior, are you satisfied with this outcome?" Thunder Dragon asked respectfully, his hands clasped.
"It’s acceptable, I suppose..." The Big Black Horse opened its eyes, glanced at the three of them, and grinned.
These three are quite clever, understanding my intentions. They obliterated the people from the three great sects as soon as they acted. Not a bad job at all.
A look of unease crossed Thunder Dragon’s face. He took a deep breath and plucked up the courage to ask, "Senior, do you happen to need a young demon by your side to serve tea and run errands?"
"Serve tea and run errands?" The Big Black Horse flashed a grin and laughed heartily. Slapping its chest, it said, "I’m just an old horse pulling a carriage. How could I be qualified to have you serve tea and run errands?"
"Senior..." Thunder Dragon, Kui Bull, and Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger were all startled and hastily dropped to their knees. They thought their words might have offended the senior.
"Don’t be afraid. What I said is true. I just pull a carriage for the Master; there’s no doubt about that. I’m sure you’ve seen the black carriage before..." the Big Black Horse chuckled dismissively.
Hearing the senior’s words, the faces of Thunder Dragon and the others turned ashen. The thought of pledging allegiance vanished instantly.
Even this senior-level demon of the Eternal Realm is resigned to pulling a carriage, what use could three little demons like us be?
The Big Black Horse looked at their depressed faces and laughed heartily. "Don’t forget, there are also the three young masters! They just received the Master’s Beast Control Bracelets and are planning to gather some demon beasts. When the time comes, I’ll talk to them and have them take you three in as well!"
Thunder Dragon and the others were overjoyed. "Thank you, Senior..." The three of them kowtowed repeatedly, their faces filled with profound joy.
All three of them knew about Leize’s situation. If they could be taken under the young masters’ wings, it would be their supreme honor. As long as they fought bravely and diligently protected the young masters, they would eventually receive rewards from the Master.
The more Thunder Dragon, Kui Bull, and Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger thought about it, the happier they became.
"Having drunk so much of your wine, don’t blame Uncle Ma for not warning you!" The Big Black Horse chuckled mischievously.
"Senior, please enlighten us!" Thunder Dragon and the others immediately cupped their fists and bowed deeply.
Picking its teeth, the Big Black Horse sneered, "Don’t get too ahead of yourselves. Have you seen that Big Black Cat? It fought life-and-death battles to achieve what it has today!"
"We understand, Senior!" The three great demon beasts took a deep breath, their expressions turning solemn.
In this world, there was no such thing as a free lunch. Although they would temporarily gain a powerful backer, they had to strive desperately to obtain better resources.
Seeing that the three had understood, the Big Black Horse glared. "The wine is all gone! Hurry up and bring more!"
"Senior, please wait a moment!" Wiping the sweat from his forehead, Thunder Dragon disappeared in a flash. He returned within a few breaths, holding a pile of wine jars. These wine jars had been sealed deep underground, preserved for hundreds of years. All of them contained exquisite wine. The Big Black Horse uncorked a wine jar, took a sip, and a look of intoxication spread across its face.
Everything that transpired within the Accumulated Thunder Palace had long been observed by Ye Yun. He was quite pleased with the Big Black Horse’s actions. Back then, when he granted the Beast Control Bracelets to Luo Li and Jun Moxiao, it was with the hope that they would gather more demon beasts in the future. After all, ten thousand years ago, the Dragon God Sect was a place where countless demon beasts came to pay homage—a scene too magnificent to be adequately described by any words.
Although the Nirvana Realm experts from the three great sects had perished in the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range, some cultivators managed to send news back to their sects before dying. The Sect Masters of the three great sects were all enraged!
「For a moment.」
The entire Shenfeng Dynasty was beset by storms and thundering gales. The three great sects mobilized their forces, summoning their Supreme Elders from reclusive cultivation one by one.
「This time.」
The Shen Heng Sect dispatched two Supreme Elders at the First Layer of Heaven’s Will Realm. The Qitian Sword Sect and the Yu Mo Sect each dispatched one Supreme Elder from the Destiny Realm. These Supreme Elders had cultivated painstakingly for nearly a thousand years.

chapters.title: Chapter 120: The Four Great Destiny Realms, Gathering at Accumulated Thunder Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 120: Chapter 120: The Four Great Destiny Realms, Gathering at Accumulated Thunder Mountain
The Three Great Sects.
Four Supreme Elders at the Destiny Realm, carrying furious rage, all gathered at Accumulated Thunder Mountain.
As Heaven Mandate Realm Great Cultivators, the four of them, at all times, emanated a terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath. The lightning that fell from the sky seemed to develop a fear, instantly rerouting its course.
"Those mere Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain are audacious! This time, with our three Sects joining forces, we must annihilate these three demon beasts!" the Supreme Elder of the Qitian Sword Sect coldly snorted.
"Indeed!" The Supreme Elder of the Yu Mo Sect nodded and sneered, "I will kill the Kui Bull and the Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger. The three of you shall work together to deal with that Thunder Dragon."
"Very well. After all, that Thunder Dragon has been cultivating in Accumulated Thunder Mountain for so long. Its thunder-related Divine Skills are extremely astonishing. The three of us combining our forces can certainly execute it promptly!" a Supreme Elder from the Shen Heng Sect nodded.
They had already cultivated to the Destiny Realm. It had been no easy task to achieve this level in their long cultivation careers.
However, their opponent this time was a Thunder Dragon at the First Layer of Destiny Realm.
This great demon beast had been cultivating in the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range for too long, and its thunder-related Divine Skills were extremely astonishing.
Both parties were cultivators at the Destiny Realm. If they engaged in a battle to the death, the fighting would be extremely fierce.
Although their Swordsmanship was profound and each possessed supreme Divine Skills, they could not overlook the fact that members of the Demon Clan possessed powerful physical bodies.
If we truly fight it, we’ll likely have to pay a price to kill the Thunder Dragon.
If we are severely wounded, it might severely affect our future cultivation in unimaginable ways.
Therefore, these three cultivators at the First Layer of Destiny Realm would jointly face the Thunder Dragon first, suppress it as much as possible, and buy time.
The Supreme Elder from the Yu Mo Sect, dealing alone with the Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger and the Kui Bull, shouldn’t take too long.
After he eliminated the two demon beasts, he could come and provide them assistance.
In this way, it’s four against one. Four Heaven Mandate Realm Great Cultivators dealing with one great demon beast of the Destiny Realm... the price should be smaller.
WHOOSH! WHOOSH...
Four streaks of light pierced the sky and sped off.
In the time it took to brew half a cup of tea, the four of them had arrived at the entrance of the Accumulated Thunder Palace.
"Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain, get out here at once and accept your deaths!" the Supreme Elder from the Yu Mo Sect roared loudly.
Hearing this, the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain immediately stood up and walked out, their expressions excited.
This is our second battle. That senior also said that as long as we fight conscientiously, we will surely receive our Master’s reward. Therefore, this time, we are determined to perform well in front of our Master.
One could say... we’ve been waiting for these Destiny Realm Supreme Elders from the three great Sects for a long time now.
Three great demon beasts stepped outside.
Seeing four Destiny Realm cultivators, each holding a treasured sword and looking murderous, the Thunder Dragon immediately sneered.
"Are you lot here to seek your deaths?"
"Thunder Dragon, don’t be arrogant! Today is the day you die!" The Supreme Elder from the Shen Heng Sect’s face turned stern, and he let out a roar.
"Come, come, let me play with you all for a bit!" The Thunder Dragon soared from the ground, materializing in mid-air, and beckoned to the four Destiny Realm Supreme Elders down below.
Although the palace has a protective Formation outside, it can’t withstand the aftershocks of a nearby battle. Fighting in mid-air not only avoids impacting the Accumulated Thunder Palace, but I can also draw upon the lightning from the sky to attack my enemies.
Three figures soared into the air. Two Supreme Elders from the Shen Heng Sect and one Supreme Elder from the Qitian Sword Sect tightly surrounded the Thunder Dragon.
Although it spoke arrogantly, the Thunder Dragon didn’t dare to be careless at all. After all, these were Destiny Realm powerhouses of the Three Great Sects, whose cultivation bases shook heaven and earth.
It transformed instantly, revealing its enormous true body.
When its colossal form appeared in mid-air, the surging lightning in the clouds poured towards it.
"Go to hell!" the Thunder Dragon roared.
The thick lightning bolts instantly attacked the three individuals.
Immediately after, its tail swept across, swinging towards one of the Supreme Elders from the Shen Heng Sect.
The three Supreme Elders did not dare to be negligent, promptly unleashing their powerful Sword Dao Divine Skills to battle the Thunder Dragon.
BOOM! BOOM!
Massive vibrations echoed from the sky; the reverberations from the clash between the four Destiny Realm powerhouses were exceedingly formidable.
A beam of light suddenly erupted from the Accumulated Thunder Palace as the Formation activated at this moment, completely blocking the shockwaves outside.
The Kui Bull glanced at the remaining Supreme Elder of the Yu Mo Sect, saying with a sneer, "So, you’re prepared to play with us two brothers, huh?"
"Yes! You two minor demons of the Nirvana Realm, I can kill you with a single sword strike," the Supreme Elder of the Yu Mo Sect sneered.
"Shameless boasting!" the Kui Bull roared in anger. Together with the Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger, they both transformed into their true forms, rising into the air on the other side.
BOOM!
Opening their massive mouths, a deluge of thunderbolts poured down like a mighty river.
The Supreme Elder of the Yu Mo Sect sneered. A shocking sword light slashed out, immediately splitting the river of thunderbolts. Stepping on the rolling thunder light, he advanced with a stride.
"Mere Nirvana Realm creatures, daring to battle me, a Heaven Mandate Realm Great Cultivator?" the Supreme Elder of the Yu Mo Sect mocked loudly.
SWISH!
A sword descended, and myriad sword lights manifested like a net of swords, completely ensnaring the Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger and the Kui Bull.
"ROAR!" The Kui Bull roared vehemently, and a powerful lightning bolt spewed from its mouth, forming a massive axe in mid-air that fiercely slashed through the sword lights.
The Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger roared furiously, thunder light bursting all over its body, incredibly dazzling.
These bursts of thunder light transformed into countless Little Swords, merging into a torrent that surged towards the overwhelming sword light.
BOOM! BOOM!
A series of massive sounds echoed. The enormous axe formed from lightning and the myriad Thunderbolt Swords shattered upon meeting the Swordsmanship of the Supreme Elder of the Yu Mo Sect.
The Kui Bull dropped its head ferociously, its horns shimmering with lightning, and rammed fiercely towards the Supreme Elder of the Yu Mo Sect.
The Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger also flapped its wings, flying forward. It swung its massive paw with a whistling sound, smacking down fiercely.
These two demon beasts do have some skill...
The face of the Supreme Elder of the Yu Mo Sect darkened. His Swordsmanship shifted, and instantly, a torrent of sword light like a great river burst forth once again.
BOOM!
The tsunami-like sword light crashed onto the Kui Bull’s horns but was mostly shattered by their sheer toughness.
The Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger’s massive paw also shattered much of the sword light at that moment.
The Supreme Elder of the Yu Mo Sect was slightly taken aback by this.
These two great demon beasts are very close to reaching the Destiny Realm; their physical bodies are truly formidable!
BOOM! BOOM...
One man and two demon beasts clashed in a fierce battle. The fighting was unprecedentedly intense.
However, as there was a Major Realm difference, the Supreme Elder of the Yu Mo Sect still held a significant advantage.
His sword light was pervasive, and soon, both the Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger and the Kui Bull were injured.
Exhilarating!
The Kui Bull felt traces of pain from its body, which, paradoxically, made it even more excited.
The more injuries it sustained, the more it showed its dedication to the fight.
On the other side, the Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger’s cultivation base was weaker than the Kui Bull’s, and its injuries were somewhat heavier, but it still fought with extreme ferocity.
The Supreme Elder of the Yu Mo Sect was rather shocked seeing these two great demon beasts fighting so recklessly.
Although he could currently use The Creation Demon God Art to instantly kill these two great demon beasts, he chose not to.
After all, it wasn’t a life-or-death crisis at the moment.
And once he fell into a state of Demonization... he would recognize no one, not even his own kin.
At that point, he might even unintentionally negatively affect the battle of the three Supreme Elders from the Shen Heng Sect and Qitian Sword Sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 121: The Big Black Horse Strikes Brutally
chapters.content:
Chapter 121: Chapter 121: The Big Black Horse Strikes Brutally
「In mid-air.」
The Thunder Dragon faced three enemies. Despite being at a temporary disadvantage and sustaining injuries, it remained extremely ferocious, frequently deploying various methods. After a bout of fierce bombardment, even the three Destiny Realm Great Cultivators on the opposing side sustained minor injuries. The more they fought, the more frightened they became. This giant demon beast, the Thunder Dragon, truly possessed a shocking Innate Divine Ability. Its physical body was incredibly strong, and ordinary attacks had no effect. If one was not careful, they would be struck by the Thunder Dragon’s powerful lightning. The three Destiny Realm Supreme Elders, having sustained minor injuries, became even more cautious in their battle. They just continued to suppress the Thunder Dragon.
「In the void above the Thunder Pool.」
Ye Yun was still in Cultivation with his eyes closed, but he was acutely aware of the situation outside. He could naturally see through the plans of these three demon beasts.
This is their second pledge of loyalty,
Ye Yun thought. Ye Yun was quite appreciative of such devoted demon beasts. Therefore, after this battle, Ye Yun would naturally reward them.
「Inside the Accumulated Thunder Palace.」
"Hmm..." Big Black Horse was drinking his wine, frequently nodding as he watched the fierce battle outside. "These three little guys are quite promising; they’re the same type as Little Cat..."
Big Black Horse grinned, baring his teeth. He tossed the wine jug onto the table, then slowly walked out with his hands behind his back.
Seeing my juniors being bullied, it’s natural for me as an elder not to sit idly by,
he thought.
Big Black Horse stepped outside, looked up at the Supreme Elder of the Yu Mo Sect, and grinned. "Old man," he said, "bullying others by relying on your superior cultivation, that’s not right!"
While the Supreme Elder from the Yu Mo Sect was in battle, a thunderous sound suddenly echoed in his ears that almost made him stumble and fall. Aghast, he looked down and saw a middle-aged man in a black robe standing on the ground below, grinning at him with bared teeth. The middle-aged man was also emitting a strong Demonic Aura at this moment. However, when he saw the middle-aged man’s cultivation base, he couldn’t help but scoff.
It’s just a demon beast at the Nirvana Realm. Nothing to be afraid of. Where did this Nirvana Realm demon beast come from? Could it be... the fourth Demon Saint who recently joined Accumulated Thunder Mountain?
he wondered.
SWISH!
With a slight movement, Big Black Horse appeared in mid-air in the next instant.
The Kui Bull and the Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger were heavily injured and vomiting large mouthfuls of blood, truly a pitiful sight. However, when they suddenly saw their great demon beast senior appear, they couldn’t help but feel elated. Seeing their senior reveal only a Nirvana Realm cultivation base, the two great demon beasts looked at each other, not knowing whether to laugh or cry.
This is an Eternal Realm great demon beast senior. He plans to use the same trick he used against the Gold and Silver Holy Lords,
they thought, speechless.
For some reason, this senior loves to play tricks on others. As an Eternal Realm entity, couldn’t he easily crush this Destiny Realm Supreme Elder from the Yu Mo Sect with a casual flick of his finger?
"You showed up just in time! The three of you can go to Hell together!" The Supreme Elder of the Yu Mo Sect stared at the middle-aged man in the black robe, a cruel smile creeping onto his face. He slashed with his sword, and a torrent of sword light, like a raging river, poured down towards Big Black Horse.
"Oh, what kind of Swordsmanship is this? It’s so fierce!" Big Black Horse feigned alarm and astonishingly dodged it with a swift movement. His body vibrated in the void according to a peculiar rhythm, and the countless sword lights couldn’t even touch the hem of his clothes.
The Supreme Elder from the Yu Mo Sect was shocked.
What mysterious movement technique is this? A mere Nirvana Realm Cultivator can easily dodge my killing sword strike? This movement technique is too formidable!
Big Black Horse’s body drifted, and then, somehow, he was suddenly right in front of him.
"So fast!" The Supreme Elder of the Yu Mo Sect’s pupils constricted. He saw the black-robed man grin, revealing large white teeth, as he reached out a hand towards him. The Supreme Elder hurriedly swung his sword, aiming to cut the man’s arm.
BANG!
The sword struck the arm but was deflected. A tremendous force surged through, causing the sword to fly from his grasp. At this moment, the Supreme Elder of the Yu Mo Sect was filled with dread, almost scared to death.
My full-strength strike as a Destiny Realm Great Cultivator failed to pierce the arm of a Nirvana Realm Cultivator? What is the origin of this mighty demon beast?
Before he could figure it out, his neck was seized by that enormous hand.
CRACK!
With a crisp sound, his neck was snapped.
Big Black Horse opened its mouth, and a blue light enveloped the Supreme Elder from the Yu Mo Sect, pulling him directly into its maw and swallowing him.
"Senior, thank you for your assistance!" The Kui Bull and Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger approached, expressing their gratitude.
"You two performed quite well, though your strength is a bit lacking. If Uncle Ma hadn’t stepped in, you both would have been goners by now!" Big Black Horse chuckled and took a step forward.
「The next moment.」
He arrived in another part of the void. Staring at the three Human Cultivators, a chilling killing intent gleamed in his eyes.
Among the Shenfeng Dynasty’s three major Sects, the Shen Heng Sect and the Dragon God Sect have a blood feud spanning generations. Those two Supreme Elders definitely cannot be allowed to live,
Big Black Horse mused.
As for the Qitian Sword Sect and the Yu Mo Sect, they also have grievances with our Dragon God Sect. Therefore, I won’t let any of these people survive. It’s a good opportunity for me to eliminate the high-level combat power of these three Sects, thereby reducing future resistance for my three little masters’ training.
"What?" one of the Shen Heng Sect Supreme Elders exclaimed.
"Elder Qi is dead?" the other Shen Heng Sect Supreme Elder chimed in, referring to a Supreme Elder from the Qitian Sword Sect they had just seen this newcomer kill.
"Who is this man? And how is he so powerful?" the first one continued.
The three Supreme Elders (two from Shen Heng Sect, one from Qitian Sword Sect) battling the Thunder Dragon were terrified; they had discovered that the middle-aged man who suddenly emerged from the Accumulated Thunder Palace had, with a single move, killed a Supreme Elder of the Qitian Sword Sect. An unimaginable terror surged through their hearts.
At that moment, the black-robed middle-aged man suddenly appeared before them.
"Three against one, is this the despicable way all three of your great Sects behave?" Big Black Horse sneered coldly. His gaze fell on the two Supreme Elders from the Shen Heng Sect, his eyes turning blood-red.
The Dragon God Sect has lost countless Disciples over the generations due to the schemes of the Shen Heng Sect,
Big Black Horse thought, his anger palpable.
As the Master’s Divine Pet, I’ve long considered myself a member of the Dragon God Sect. So, I deeply feel this blood feud passed down through generations.
"Who are you? Why do you dare interfere in the affairs of our three great Sects?" one of the Shen Heng Sect Supreme Elders demanded, his brow furrowed and his face grim.
The other Supreme Elder, the one from the Qitian Sword Sect, seeing the situation shift, cautiously took two steps back.
This black-robed man is an enigma,
he thought.
Although he’s only at the Nirvana Realm cultivation base, he was able to kill an Elder of the Yu Mo Sect. Add the Thunder Dragon to the equation... if these two mighty demon beasts attack simultaneously, our chances of winning would plummet. If these two fight to the death, at least one of us three Destiny Realm Cultivators will likely perish. I am the Qitian Sword Sect’s only Destiny Realm Cultivator. My path of Cultivation has been incredibly arduous; I don’t want to die here.
"Trying to escape?" Big Black Horse detected his intentions, grinned to reveal his large white teeth, and sneered, "Uncle Ma despises deserters!"
With that, he opened his mouth wide. A dazzling blue light swept out, engulfing the Supreme Elder of the Qitian Sword Sect and pulling him into his mouth.
CRUNCH! CRUNCH!
After a few chews, Big Black Horse swallowed him. Then, he spat out several storage rings.
"Oh, I almost forgot!" Big Black Horse slapped his forehead, looking regretful. "My little masters will establish their Sect in the future, and they’re currently lacking resources. How could I swallow these storage rings?"
Witnessing the Supreme Elder of the Qitian Sword Sect being devoured by this terrifying demon beast without any chance to resist, the two Supreme Elders of the Shen Heng Sect trembled violently, their courage utterly shattered. Driven by a primal urge to survive, they immediately turned and fled in two different directions.

chapters.title: Chapter 122: Rewards for Everyone
chapters.content:
Chapter 122: Chapter 122: Rewards for Everyone
"Come back!"
Big Black Horse grinned, displaying a set of pearly white teeth.
Two streaks of blue light burst forth, reining in the two fleeing Shen Heng Sect Supreme Elders.
Both men were bound by the blue glow, struggling in vain, their foreheads instantly covered in sweat.
Big Black Horse strolled towards them, hands behind his back, and sneered coldly, "You two old geezers still fancy running?"
"Just who are you? Your cultivation base is definitely not the Nirvana Realm!"
A Supreme Elder stared at the cloaked middle-aged man before him, his eyes revealing a look of terror.
In his understanding, this cloaked man standing before him had astonishing divine skills. He must be a formidable person in the Life and Death Realm.
"You two insignificant ants, Uncle Ma will show you his realm today."
Grinning slyly, Big Black Horse’s body vibrated slightly.
In a flash, his original cultivation base was restored.
A powerful Super Divine Dragon Breath of the Eternal Realm instantly swept out.
But Big Black Horse intentionally controlled it; this Super Divine Dragon Breath from his cultivation base was confined to a radius of thirty feet.
"This... this wouldn’t be the Eternal Realm, would it?"
After sensing this Super Divine Dragon Breath, the two Supreme Elders were so frightened their eyes nearly bulged from their sockets. After uttering these words in a trembling voice, they were promptly overwhelmed by the powerful Super Divine Dragon Breath and fainted.
Big Black Horse withdrew his Super Divine Dragon Breath, a cold smile on his face as he watched the two unconscious old men.
The Thunder Dragon on the side was silent.
The kind of Super Divine Dragon Breath that this Eternal Realm Great Demon senior had revealed just now, although not intentionally directed at it, still made it feel suffocated.
It had to be said, the power of the Eternal Realm was too formidable.
Those at this realm occupied the pinnacle of the Cultivation World across the Cangnan Continent.
Dominating the entire continent.
With one in each hand, Big Black Horse seized the two Supreme Elders of the Shen Heng Sect and vanished into thin air.
The next moment, he appeared above the Thunder Pool.
"Master, I brought these two. Check them out to see if they’re the culprits who victimized our Dragon God Sect..."
Big Black Horse respectfully tossed the two men into the air before bowing and speaking.
A ripple in the void.
Ye Yun walked out from it.
With a slight lift of his fingers, two beams of light descended upon the heads of the two Supreme Elders.
After the span of a few breaths, the beams of light were recalled.
"These two Supreme Elders of the Shen Heng Sect were merely aware of the persecution carried out against the Dragon God Sect. The real masterminds are the successive Sect Masters of the Shen Heng Sect..." Ye Yun spoke in a casual tone.
His face remained calm as could be, his demeanor extremely composed.
Big Black Horse’s face twitched slightly. In his Master’s indifferent voice, he sensed an imposing will akin to the Heavenly Dao.
This imposing will filled his heart with fear.
"Master, should I go to the Shen Heng Sect?" Big Black Horse respectfully suggested.
"No rush, this matter is not as simple as it seems..." Ye Yun shook his head, calmly stating, "Anyone who dares to harm my Dragon God Sect must belong to a very powerful force. Having carefully plotted for tens of thousands of years, they’ve operated through layers of proxies with utmost prudence. Surely, they harbor some unknown secrets..."
"Oh..." Upon hearing his Master’s words, Big Black Horse fell into deep contemplation.
He didn’t quite understand.
Why would such a powerhouse treat the Dragon God Sect with such caution?
Could it be that this force somehow foresaw the day of the Master’s revival?
At the thought of this possibility, Big Black Horse’s eyelids twitched. It seemed as if a flash of enlightenment swept across his vision, and he began to understand something.
He had to admit, this force was impressive for predicting an event a hundred thousand years ahead.
Such forethought was unimaginable in its divine skill.
In Big Black Horse’s understanding, for a grand sect to attempt to foresee something a hundred thousand years into the future, the price to pay was unimaginable.
"It’s not what you think..."
Ye Yun looked at Big Black Horse, his gaze flickered as though he could see everything that was being thought in the Divine Pet’s mind.
"Take these two away and deal with them as you see fit."
Ye Yun waved his hand.
Big Black Horse immediately grabbed the two Supreme Elders from the Shen Heng Sect and, in a blink, disappeared.
Ye Yun looked to some point in the void, a look of interest on his face.
The reason he could afford to be patient was because he was already invincible in the world.
Once a person becomes invincible, if they handle situations too quickly, they lose a lot of the enjoyment that comes with the process.
For instance, he could obliterate all Eternal-level forces on the continent with a single thought right now.
But what would be the purpose of that?
After the massacre, wouldn’t he just be left with a feeling of emptiness?
In the dark, sunless void, he had signed in for a hundred thousand years, enduring unimaginable boredom and loneliness. What he lacked now was fun.
Right now, he was leading three youngsters on a journey of experience, allowing them to grow continually. Meanwhile, he would pull out and kill all the enemies behind the Dragon God Sect one by one.
That would be interesting.
And he would also groom these three youngsters.
He would make them become powerful experts in the Eternal Realm so that the Dragon God Sect could return to being an Eternal Sect and stand once again on the Cangnan Continent.
Big Black Horse did not understand this because it was merely a demon beast.
In Ye Yun’s storage, its grade did not even make the list.
It was at too low a level; its perspective was too narrow; it could not see far enough.
Ye Yun took out a small bottle and poured out three drops of mysterious green liquid. With a flick of his fingers, he sent them piercing through the void, dropping towards three different directions.
Big Black Horse returned and landed at the entrance of the Accumulated Thunder Palace. At this time, the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain had also gathered around.
Before the three great demons could say anything, a drop of green liquid suddenly fell from the sky, directly entering an acupoint at the crown of each of their heads and flowing down into their bodies.
Their injuries healed at an unimaginable speed.
Shock was written all over the faces of these three demon beasts. They had no idea what had just happened.
Seeing this, Big Black Horse chuckled and said, "You three lucky little fellows, this is your reward from the Master."
"Thank you, Master!"
These three great demons immediately knelt on the ground, facing the direction of the Thunder Pool, bowing their heads repeatedly.
By the time they stood up, all their injuries had healed.
In particular, the Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger, which had the lowest cultivation base and was the most severely injured, was now as good as new.
Suddenly, three streaks of golden lightning fell from the sky, each striking one of the three.
"It’s that kind of golden lightning..."
The Thunder Dragon reacted quickly, its eyes nearly popping out, so excited it almost roared.
It had coveted this mysterious lightning for a long time, and after fighting bravely this time, it had finally received a reward from the Master.
Without hesitation, the Thunder Dragon immediately sat down and began refining the streak of lightning.
The Kui Bull and the Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger did the same.
Watching this, Big Black Horse nodded, a hint of envy in his eyes.
It didn’t know what this mysterious golden lightning was either.
But, it too yearned to obtain another streak of this golden, mysterious lightning.
WHOOSH!
A thick golden lightning bolt tore open the void, appearing like a golden dragon, hovering in front of Big Black Horse.
"Little Horse, I give you this Rebirth Thunder!"
Ye Yun’s voice echoed in Big Black Horse’s ear.
"Thank you, Master!"
Seeing the robust golden lightning, Big Black Horse was so excited it almost cried.
But the next moment, it really did cry.
"Master, last time you only gave me a wisp, and I spent several days refining it. Now this thick Rebirth Thunder... I, I’m afraid I can’t handle it..." Big Black Horse wailed, his face crestfallen.

chapters.title: Chapter 123: The Three Great Sects, A State of Alarm
chapters.content:
Chapter 123: Chapter 123: The Three Great Sects, A State of Alarm
In the void above the Thunder Pool.
Ye Yun saw the mournful expression on Big Black Horse’s face and smiled faintly.
"Isn’t lightning your Innate Divine Ability? Given your current cultivation base, shouldn’t you be able to refine it?" he asked aloud.
"I can’t, Master. This is my first time hearing about the Rebirth Thunder. Its energy is too domineering; I can only refine one strand at a time. I estimate that I can’t refine such a large piece of Rebirth Thunder. If I forcibly refine it, I fear my body would not be able to withstand it..." Big Black Horse complained.
He knew his impression in his Master’s eyes had dropped this time.
But there was no way around it; his abilities were limited...
Even though he was a demon beast from the Eternal Realm and seemed powerful in front of the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain, he was keenly aware of his own limitations.
This mysterious Rebirth Thunder was indeed something Big Black Horse could not refine.
Only the more formidable demon beasts in the Master’s warehouse could refine it.
"All right."
Ye Yun nodded.
A glimmer appeared in his eyes as several faint golden symbols flew out, filled with an unimaginable aura of the great Dao. These symbols broke through the void and landed on the golden lightning.
The golden lightning instantly shrank, finally transforming into a small golden sword.
"You keep it. Save it for gradual refinement in the future..." Ye Yun said with a smile.
"Thank you, Master!" Big Black Horse happily picked up the small golden sword, his face filled with extreme excitement.
Ye Yun flickered and returned to the void to continue his cultivation.
Big Black Horse, holding the small sword, played with it affectionately for an entire day before he carefully absorbed a strand of lightning from it for refinement.
The entire Accumulated Thunder Mountain fell silent.
At this moment, the three major sects had already descended into chaos. The Supreme Elders in the Destiny Realm all had life plaques left in their sects, and now the plaques were shattered. This meant that these four Supreme Elders in the Destiny Realm had all perished in Accumulated Thunder Mountain.
The sudden loss of the sects’ top combat power left the Sect Masters of the three major sects extremely alarmed. They feared that the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain would suddenly descend and declare war on them.
However, after waiting for a few days, they found that Accumulated Thunder Mountain remained quiet, with no changes. Only then did they sigh in relief.
Perhaps the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain were also severely injured in this battle and wouldn’t be able to leave the mountain anytime soon.
「Another month passed.」
All was calm, and the Sect Masters of the three major sects finally calmed down.
The three Sect Masters gathered and, after deliberating for an entire day, decided to report the incident to the forces behind them. The three major sects of the Shenfeng Dynasty had some dependent relationships with certain sects of the Heavenly Star Dynasty.
Those sects were greatly shocked when they heard the news. However, they didn’t send anyone over. Clearly, they were also apprehensive of the Three Saints of Accumulated Thunder Mountain. Until it was a last resort, they would not easily provoke these three great demon beasts.
The power of the Demon Clan was also very strong in every dynasty. Perhaps the Three Saints from Accumulated Thunder Mountain also had backing in the Sun, Moon, and Star Dynasties. If those forces took action, it would break the rules and very likely trigger a war between the Human Race and the Demon Clan. Such wars had occurred many times over thousands of years. The final outcome was always a loss for both sides; neither the Human Race nor the Demon Clan obtained any advantage.
「After a while.」
Seeing that the three great demon beasts of Accumulated Thunder Mountain didn’t appear, the sects of the Heavenly Star Dynasty finally felt relieved.
The performance of the three major sects elicited much debate and considerable disapproval within the dominant forces of the Heavenly Star Dynasty. This time, the three major sects of the Shenfeng Dynasty had acted rashly. Going to provoke the Three Great Demon Beasts of Accumulated Thunder Mountain just to find two human youths was not a wise move. As a result, the three major sects not only lost twenty to thirty powerful cultivators in the Nirvana Realm but also four great cultivators in the Destiny Realm. The losses were severe.
However, the profound heritage of the three great sects remained. Other first-class sects in the Shenfeng Dynasty were not yet capable of replacing them.
「Three months passed.」
The Shenfeng Dynasty regained its peace, and the three great sects also returned to normal.
Deep within the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range, above the Thunder Pool, three rays of light suddenly shot into the sky, and three silhouettes emerged in the void.
"The refinement of your bodies this time has reached its limit. We should continue our journey..." Ye Yun stood in the void, his hands clasped behind his back. He looked at the three juniors before him with a gratified smile.
Apart from Su Wanyi’s eight percent, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao now had an Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood concentration of ten percent within their bodies. The trio had reached their limits.
During these three months of body refinement, their cultivation progress had not fallen behind. Su Wanyi was now at the eighth layer of the Shaping God Realm. Luo Li and Jun Moxiao had reached the seventh layer of the Divine Bridge Realm.
"Old Patriarch, where are we going next?" Gazing at the Old Patriarch clad in white, who looked like a banished immortal, Luo Li asked with a smile, her eyes filled with admiration.
"Let’s go to the Shen Heng Sect..." Ye Yun said serenely.
First, I’ll deal with the Shen Heng Sect. Then, the other two sects definitely can’t be spared.
Once these three sects are dealt with, we can leave the Shenfeng Dynasty.
SWOOSH!
The Thunder Pool churned, and a black figure emerged. It was the Big Black Cat, who had been in secluded cultivation all this time.
"Wow, Little Cat, your cultivation has reached the third layer of the Destiny Realm?" Luo Li exclaimed, her small face showing shock upon seeing the Big Black Cat’s cultivation.
"Haha, yes, I’ve finally reached the Destiny Realm..." The Big Black Cat chuckled shyly.
With a flash of light, Big Black Horse appeared above the void, pulling a black carriage. Thunder Dragon, Kui Bull, and the Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger also flew over.
"Little Masters, aren’t you going to collect some demon beasts for the sect? These three... what do you think?" Big Black Horse looked at Luo Li and the others, giving his customary grin.
After discovering their cultivation bases, Luo Li shook her head with difficulty. "They are all Demon Clan creatures in the Destiny Realm..."
"Little Masters, please accept us..." Thunder Dragon and the others immediately knelt, looking sincere.
Luo Li looked conflicted. It would be one thing for her to accept a demon beast in the Divine Bridge Realm, but these three were all in the Destiny Realm; she truly felt unqualified.
"Accept them," Ye Yun said. "However, do not use them unless it is absolutely necessary. Just let them cultivate in the bracelets..."
"Alright... Old Patriarch!" Luo Li nodded, raised her bracelet, and collected the Dark Lightning Thunder Tiger into it.
"Senior Sister, Junior Brother, let’s each take one..." Luo Li turned, retreated a few steps, and looked at Su Wanyi and Jun Moxiao, proposing with a smile.
Seeing this, Ye Yun nodded approvingly.
Luo Li is doing well, treating everyone equally.
He reached out, and a ray of light appeared on Su Wanyi’s wrist, forming a bracelet.
"This is..." Su Wanyi was a bit dazed.
Luo Li ran over and whispered in Su Wanyi’s ear for a moment.
Only then did Su Wanyi understand.
So this was a special bracelet bestowed by the Old Patriarch for disciples to collect demon beasts.
"Senior Sister, let me demonstrate for you..." Jun Moxiao, standing beside her, also raised his bracelet. A green light flew out, collecting the Kui Bull into it.

chapters.title: Chapter 124: Pointing the Sword at Shen Heng Sect, The Revenge Begins
chapters.content:
Chapter 124: Chapter 124: Pointing the Sword at Shen Heng Sect, The Revenge Begins
Su Wanyi raised her bracelet. Staring at the Thunder Dragon Destiny Realm Great Demon kneeling before her, her heart still felt somewhat tense.
After all, she was just a minor Shaping God Realm cultivator, and now she was about to capture this Second-Layer Destiny Realm demon under everyone’s watchful eyes. She couldn’t help but feel a bit apprehensive.
"Sis, you can do this!" Luo Li and Jun Moxiao encouraged her from the side.
The Big Black Horse cracked a grin. "Young Master, just be bold and claim them. These three little ones can now be considered demons of our Dragon God Sect..."
In front of so many people, the Thunder Dragon remained kneeling silently in mid-air, looking at Su Wanyi’s bracelet with hopeful eyes.
Summoning her courage, Su Wanyi channeled Mana into her bracelet.
WHOOSH!
A beam of green light unfurled, landing on the Thunder Dragon. The green light then retracted, returning into the bracelet.
At that moment, even with her eyes open, Su Wanyi could clearly sense the changes occurring inside her bracelet. The Destiny Realm Great Demon she had just captured appeared within it.
PHEW...
She let out a sigh of relief.
"Let’s go!"
Ye Yun chuckled casually and stepped into the carriage.
Luo Li, Jun Moxiao, and Su Wanyi quickly boarded the carriage.
The three of them sat at the front of the carriage, with Luo Li and Su Wanyi on one side and Jun Moxiao on the other.
In the middle, the Big Black Cat lay there, head buried in his belly. A hint of triumph gleamed in his pitch-black eyes.
As expected, I, Old Cat, am impressive! Not only have I surpassed those three from Accumulated Thunder Mountain in cultivation, but I also avoided being captured into the bracelet, thus remaining a free cat, hehe...
The Big Black Cat laughed smugly in his heart."Let’s go!"
The Big Black Horse exhaled lightly. Its hooves moved swiftly, pulling the carriage, and in an instant, it vanished above the Thunder Pool.
Travelling at full speed, they arrived at the foot of the mountain housing the Shen Heng Sect in the span of a few breaths.
The Big Black Horse slowed its pace.
"Ha, we’ve arrived at the Shen Heng Sect!"
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao had smiles on their faces, feeling excited. They were about to enter a new battle.
They could only wonder... how would their Ancestor arrange this battle?
Although they could defeat the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride of the Shen Heng Sect at the Divine Bridge Realm, and even fight above their level, capable of dealing even with first and second-layer Nirvana Realm cultivators, if there were too many Nirvana Realm cultivators, they still wouldn’t be able to cope.
"Sigh..." Su Wanyi lowered her head, burdened by worries.
She quietly stared at the grand gates of the Shen Heng Sect as they drew closer, contemplating how they should fight.
After all, among the three of them, she was the only one at the eighth layer of the Shaping God Realm.
Her junior brother and sister were both at the seventh layer of the Divine Bridge Realm.
The gap was significant.
"Are you all worried that you won’t be able to defeat them?"
The Ancestor’s voice suddenly echoed in the ears of the three, who were lost in their own thoughts.
The three of them nodded immediately.
