The Shen Heng Sect of the Shenfeng Dynasty was not comparable to sects from the Ancient Moon Dynasty.
This place bred prodigies and brimmed with talent. Even though they had lost two Destiny Realm Supreme Elders and about ten powerful Nirvana Realm cultivators, it was undeniable that the Shen Heng Sect still had a large number of Nirvana Realm cultivators.
Therefore, for the three of them, this battle was tantamount to confronting a major sect of tens of thousands.
The pressure on the three was immense.
"Rest assured and just fight. If anyone whose realm surpasses yours tries to attack, their realm will also be reduced to the Divine Bridge or Shaping God Realm..."
Inside the carriage, Ye Yun gave a casual smile. With his profound Divine Monarch Realm cultivation base, controlling this battle was an easy task for him.
"Great, Ancestor!"
The three nodded repeatedly. At this moment, all fear had vanished from their hearts; they were excited, their blood boiling.
The carriage approached the mountain gate.
Two Shen Heng Sect disciples guarding the mountain gate saw a black carriage slowly approaching.
They moved to block the carriage immediately.
"Where are you from? Do you have an invitation?" a disciple of the Shen Heng Sect asked loudly, an arrogant expression on his face.
The carriage carried three people, the highest cultivation base among them merely the seventh layer of the Divine Bridge Realm. Such a cultivation base was insignificant in the Shen Heng Sect.
Therefore, even though these two disciples were at the Shaping God Realm, they didn’t take the three newcomers seriously.
Jun Moxiao stood up abruptly, glaring coldly at these two Shaping God Realm disciples of the Shen Heng Sect, a cold glint flashing in his eyes.
"We are from the Dragon God Sect, and we are here for revenge today!" he exclaimed loudly.
A chilling sword light, like a divine dragon emerging from water, swept out and instantly severed the necks of the two disciples.
The two disciples stared wide-eyed at Jun Moxiao in disbelief.
They lasted only a few seconds before their bodies collapsed to the ground.
Killing these two men seemed to light the fuse of their hatred. The eyes of Jun Moxiao, Luo Li, and Su Wanyi instantly turned blood red.
The Shen Heng Sect had persecuted the Dragon God Sect for hundreds of generations, slaughtering countless disciples. This blood feud was irreconcilable!
Today, with the Ancestor present, they were determined to unleash a massacre and annihilate the entire Shen Heng Sect!
The Big Black Horse, as if sensing their intent, suddenly charged forward.
BOOM!
The huge mountain gate was instantly knocked down by the Big Black Horse. The gate crashed to the ground with a tremendous noise, sending up clouds of dust.
"Someone is attacking the mountain gate!" a disciple in one of the Shen Heng Sect’s lookout towers suddenly shouted at the top of his lungs!
He quickly rang the alarm bell.
DANG! DANG! DANG!
Loud clangs echoed throughout the entire Shen Heng Sect.
In an instant, a large number of Shen Heng Sect disciples poured out from various halls.
A flash of black light, and the Big Black Horse pulled the carriage onto the square before the main hall.
Countless Shen Heng Sect disciples surged out, completely surrounding the black carriage, leaving no way through.
"So many people!"
The Big Black Cat tilted his head, surveyed the surrounding crowd, then stretched out his blood-red tongue to lick his paw.
He really wanted to take action. But without the Master’s command, he dared not. After all, this battle of revenge was also a form of trial.
「Inside the carriage.」
Ye Yun’s eyes flashed as he calmly said, "Judging by your current physical strength, you can take at least three Dragon Tiger Pills at once. Take them before the battle begins..."
The three began to breathe heavily. They had long been accustomed to taking one Dragon Tiger Pill a month.
But this time, the Ancestor told them to take three Dragon Tiger Pills before the great battle.
If this had been before, their bodies would likely have burst.
Each of them had quite a few God-level Dragon and Tiger Pills in their storage rings. They each took out three and swallowed them.
The medicinal power of the Dragon and Tiger Pills dissolved within them, creating a loud rumbling sound, as if countless giant dragons and tigers were battling inside their bodies.
However, such terrifying medicinal power was forcefully suppressed by their powerful physiques.
Surprised expressions appeared on all three of their faces.
They hadn’t expected their bodies to become so strong after the significant improvement of their Ancestral Dragon Bloodline.
"Today’s battle will be extremely difficult. The three of you will face attacks from tens of thousands of people..."
Ye Yun smiled calmly and continued, "I hope each of you can advance at least one minor realm!"

chapters.title: Chapter 125 One Force Breaks Everything
chapters.content:
Chapter 125: Chapter 125 One Force Breaks Everything
"We will surely not disappoint the high hopes of our Ancestors!"
Su Wanyi, Luo Li, and Jun Moxiao, their faces full of reverence, bowed towards the carriage and then turned around.
The three youngsters, robes fluttering, exuded youthful energy and high spirits. They held supreme Divine Swords, from which astonishing Sword Intents emanated.
"Hehe, I wondered which sacred figures dared to demolish the mountain gate of our Shen Heng Sect. Turns out, it’s just a bunch of wet-behind-the-ears brats!"
A Nirvana Elder from the Shen Heng Sect, hands clasped behind his back, stood before the crowd. He looked at the black carriage, a cold, arrogant smile on his face.
"Men, kill these three!"
This Nirvana Elder waved his hand. Figures flickered, and more than a dozen Divine Bridge Realm disciples immediately lunged forward.
"Come back!"
Suddenly, a figure flew over, letting out an angry roar. He forcefully called back the dozen or so figures who had leaped forward.
This young man glared at Luo Li and Jun Moxiao, his eyes filled with bitter hatred.
"Elder Liu, that young man and woman are the ones who killed the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the three major sects at Accumulated Thunder Mountain!" this young man growled through gritted teeth.
"So, it’s them? They’ve got some nerve, daring to barge into our Shen Heng Sect!"
A figure descended from the sky, transforming into an elder dressed in blue. This elder exuded a formidable Super Divine Dragon Breath, both powerful and terrifying. His cultivation base had reached the Nirvana Realm Tenth Level Peak.
He was Ren Tianxing, the Sect Master of the Shen Heng Sect.
A great cultivator, merely half a step from the Destiny Realm.
Now that the two Supreme Elders of the Shen Heng Sect had perished, he was the strongest expert in the Shen Heng Sect.
"Sect Master, it was these two! They killed so many of our martial brothers, which in turn led to the great battle between our three major sects and Accumulated Thunder Mountain! They are the main culprits!" the young man exclaimed, pointing at Jun Moxiao as he loudly accused the pair of their crimes.
"Kill them!"
The surrounding Shen Heng Sect disciples, numbering in the tens of thousands, erupted in fury. Their roars were deafening. Among them were hundreds at the Divine Bridge Realm, thousands at the Shaping God Realm, and another two to three thousand at the Origin Sea Realm.
The sheer momentum was immense. Waves of furious shouts rose and fell, sending shivers down the spines of onlookers.
Jun Moxiao leaped down from the carriage into the center of the square. His Sword Intent seethed, and a colossal Divine Dragon Phantom materialized behind him.
He was ready for battle.
Luo Li and Su Wanyi also jumped down, positioning themselves to Jun Moxiao’s left and right.
Jun Moxiao’s eyes were cold. He sneered, "We came here this time specifically to challenge the Shen Heng Sect. If any of you object, you can all come at us together!"
As soon as he finished speaking, derisive laughter erupted from the surrounding Shen Heng Sect disciples.
Looking at these three youths—though all were strikingly handsome and beautiful, truly exceptional individuals, veritable paragons—Ren Tianxing couldn’t help but find it amusing.
These three... Had their brains been kicked by a mule? Even if they once managed to defeat the Divine Bridge Realm Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the three major sects in the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range... could they really challenge the entire Shen Heng Sect? Truly overestimating their own strength.
Ren Tianxing had just used his Divine Sense to investigate the black carriage; it was completely empty. The Shen Heng Sect possessed a Mountain Protection Array. If a Destiny Realm cultivator were to intrude, the array would automatically activate. However, the array showed no signs of activation. Therefore, Ren Tianxing was quite certain that these three youngsters had no one else with them.
Ren Tianxing glanced at Jun Moxiao, his gaze lingering on the Divine Dragon Phantom for a few moments, but he didn’t notice anything particularly unusual about it. Many cultivators in this world manifested unique phenomena with their swordsmanship—dragons, phoenixes, black turtles... all sorts of Divine Beasts imaginable.
Ren Tianxing hadn’t made any connection between Jun Moxiao and the others to the Dragon God Sect. After all, the Shen Heng Sect had endured for tens of thousands of years, through countless generations of Sect Masters. He was merely a figurehead, responsible only for relaying orders. Thus, he wasn’t very familiar with the currently obscure Dragon God Sect.
As the Sect Master, Ren Tianxing knew of an ancient, secret mission passed down within the sect. It was one that he, as Sect Master, needed to periodically monitor. However, the execution of this task fell to the Sword King Sect. He himself had never met a cultivator from the Dragon God Sect, let alone any specific cultivation techniques the Dragon God Sect was renowned for.
Ren Tianxing stood with his hands behind his back, a mocking smile playing on his lips as he faced the three. "Interesting... Two at the Divine Bridge Realm, and one at the Shaping God Realm. Who gave you the audacity to come to our Shen Heng Sect and cause trouble?"
"Hmph!" Jun Moxiao flourished his Chaos Element Unlimited Sword, sneering, "Enough pointless talk! Let’s see true skill in action!"
Ren Tianxing’s mind stirred, and he sent out a voice transmission.
Instantly, two Fifth Level Nirvana Realm Elders leaped from the crowd, landing in the center of the square.
Ren Tianxing knew that this pair of youngsters possessed extreme combat strength within the Divine Bridge Realm. They had once single-handedly faced sixty Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the three major sects. Therefore, he didn’t dare to be complacent. He didn’t send out Divine Bridge Realm disciples, to avoid unnecessary casualties.
So, Ren Tianxing directly dispatched two Fifth Level Nirvana Realm Elders to conclude the battle swiftly and decisively. Killing this young man and woman under everyone’s watchful eyes would not only avenge the fallen Sect Disciples but also bolster the Shen Heng Sect’s prestige.
Fifth Level of Nirvana Realm?
Jun Moxiao’s eyes narrowed slightly, his hand gripping his sword trembling faintly with excitement.
"Kill!"
With a grim expression, Jun Moxiao instantly unleashed his Dragon God Sword Technique, charging towards the two elders.
Luo Li and Jun Moxiao always had a tacit understanding in battle; at this moment, she also launched her attack.
A smirk touched the corners of Ren Tianxing’s mouth.
Truly, like a mantis trying to stop a chariot—overestimating their own strength! In his view, the swordsmanship demonstrated by the two was feeble. With two Nirvana Elders taking action, they would likely kill the pair of youngsters with their swords in a single exchange. As for the remaining Shaping God Realm girl, she could be handed over to the Divine Bridge Realm disciples to be dealt with later.
The two Nirvana Elders, witnessing the vast and surging Divine Dragon Sword Light, had expressions of intense mockery. They drew their swords and executed a casual slash.
One force breaks everything.
No matter how exquisite the opponents’ swordsmanship might be, the disparity in their cultivation realms was immense. They held a colossal advantage in terms of power. Thus, a single strike from each should be enough to shatter their opponents’ sword moves.
They had just raised their arms.
Suddenly, their expressions changed drastically, their eyes nearly bulging from their sockets. In that instant, they discovered to their utter astonishment that their cultivation bases had plummeted from the Fifth Level of the Nirvana Realm to the First Level!
What’s going on?
Why did our cultivation realms suddenly drop?
The two Nirvana Elders stared at each other, their hearts pounded by tumultuous waves of shock.
The overwhelming sword light surged towards them. They hastily swung their swords to defend.
BOOM! BOOM!
Two consecutive deafening sounds erupted.
The Nirvana Elders felt an unimaginably vast power transmitted through their swords, shocking their internal organs and causing them to violently spit out mouthfuls of blood.
Such immense power!
After coughing up blood, the two Nirvana Elders retreated several steps consecutively. In that moment, both lost their will to fight.
"What happened?" Ren Tianxing was aghast.
How could dignified Fifth Level Nirvana Realm Elders be incapable of withstanding even a single move from their opponents, to the point of vomiting blood?
All around, the spectating Shen Heng Sect disciples were dead silent.
Everyone was utterly dumbstruck, thoroughly stunned by the scene unfolding before their eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 126: The Killing Begins, Searching for Memories
chapters.content:
Chapter 126: Chapter 126: The Killing Begins, Searching for Memories
"How is this possible?"
"A cultivator at the Seventh layer of the Divine Bridge Realm actually made two Nirvana Elders cough up blood with a single sword strike? Am I seeing things?"
"They’re a Major Realm and six or seven minor realms apart! How did those two... pull that off?"
Upon regaining their senses, the disciples of the Shen Heng Sect began discussing animatedly, unable to hide their shock.
The two Nirvana Elders retreated rapidly by dozens of feet, wiping the blood from their lips.
Then, they stared at the young man and woman opposite them, their faces etched with shock.
What in the world just happened? Why did our cultivation realms suddenly plummet to the First Level of the Nirvana Realm at that moment? Even if our realms had fallen, we are still mighty Nirvana Realm cultivators! Yet we couldn’t even block a single sword strike imbued with such vast power. This is simply too unbelievable. The more we think about it, the more terrifying it becomes.
"Elders, what happened just now?" Ren Woxing asked with an indifferent expression, his hands clasped behind his back.
These two Elders, under the watchful eyes of all, had been forced to cough up blood by two young Divine Bridge Realm cultivators. This was a massive disgrace to the Shen Heng Sect.
It made him, the Sect Master, lose face as well.
The two Nirvana Realm Elders looked at each other, lingering fear in their eyes.
One of the Elders took a deep breath, a terrified expression on his face as he transmitted his voice, "Sect Master, the moment we moved, our cultivation bases shockingly plummeted to the First Level of the Nirvana Realm!"
"They did?"
Ren Tianxing was startled and quickly appraised the two Elders’ cultivation realms.
They were still at the Fifth Level of Nirvana Realm.
"Aren’t your cultivation bases at the Fifth Level of the Nirvana Realm? When did they fall?" Ren Tianxing asked with a frown.
As a mighty cultivator at the Half-Step Destiny Realm, he had been paying close attention to the battle but hadn’t noticed any change in the two Sect Elders’ realms.
Fifth Level of the Nirvana Realm?
The two Nirvana Realm Elders’ expressions changed drastically.
At that moment, they realized their fallen cultivation bases had, at some unknown point, returned.
"How strange. How did our cultivation bases return?" one Nirvana Elder mused, stroking his chin, a doubtful look in his eyes.
Ren Tianxing snorted coldly.
He turned to look at the three youths, his eyelids narrowing slightly.
Logically, these two Fifth Level Nirvana Realm Elders, whom he knew very well, wouldn’t lie.
However, the cultivation realms of the three youths before him were clearly displayed; they absolutely lacked the strength to suppress Nirvana Realm cultivators.
Could there be someone else?
Ren Tianxing released his Divine Sense once more.
The Big Black Horse looked remarkably majestic, but in reality, it was just an ordinary black horse.
And the carriage interior was empty.
The Shen Heng Sect was an ancient sect, and Ren Tianxing, as its Sect Master, was exceptionally experienced.
He frowned, pondering. Even experts of the Life and Death Realm couldn’t arbitrarily suppress the cultivation realm of a Nirvana Realm cultivator.
Perhaps only cultivators from the Eternal Realm could do that.
However, the Cangnan Continent was a vast and limitless expanse. Eternal Realm experts were as rare as morning stars; how could one possibly appear in a small place like the Shenfeng Dynasty?
While Ren Tianxing was deep in thought, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao were also standing in place, recalling the recent battle.
The moment they had drawn their swords, the cultivation realms of the two Shen Heng Sect Nirvana Elders had plummeted directly to the First Level of the Nirvana Realm.
And they had only used a single move to make the two Elders cough up blood.
This both surprised and delighted them.
We never expected... that after our Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood concentration reached 10%, our physical bodies would become so incredibly strong. This power is simply unimaginably mighty! If we hadn’t battled others, we would never have known just how terrifyingly strong our physical bodies have become.
"Senior Sister!" Jun Moxiao glanced at Luo Li, his eyes glinting with killing intent.
"Kill!" Luo Li uttered a single word.
The two acted simultaneously, transforming into Divine Dragon Phantoms and charging towards the surrounding Shen Heng Sect disciples.
"Kill!"
Su Wanyi felt her blood boil with excitement.
Although her cultivation base was the lowest, at this moment, she too charged without hesitation towards the Shen Heng Sect disciples on another flank.
Her bloodline concentration was only 2% lower than that of her junior brother and junior sister.
Su Wanyi believed her physical strength shouldn’t be too much weaker than theirs.
Furthermore, with their Old Ancestor present, she feared nothing.
Right now, she had only one conviction in her heart: to wipe out the Shen Heng Sect and avenge the generations of Dragon God Sect seniors who had perished over the last ten thousand years!
Seeing the three youths actually take the initiative to attack, Ren Tianxing’s face immediately turned somber.
Too arrogant! What did they take the Shen Heng Sect for?
He waved his hand and shouted coldly, "Kill!"
Instantly, tens of thousands of Shen Heng Sect disciples sprang into action.
Among them were Origin Sea Realm disciples, Divine Bridge Realm disciples, and numerous Nirvana Realm Elders.
The Nirvana Realm Elders, with the highest combat strength, were at the forefront of the battle.
The Divine Bridge Realm Disciples of Heaven’s Pride formed the second line.
Meanwhile, the Origin Sea Realm disciples constantly moved around the periphery, launching long-range sword light attacks.
Instantly, an unprecedented large-scale melee erupted in the square.
Boundless sword light flooded the entire square.
At this moment, human forms became indistinct; only Divine Dragon Phantoms could be seen, continuously weaving through the tide of sword light.
Many Nirvana Realm Elders pouncing on Luo Li and Jun Moxiao were shocked to find their cultivation bases plummeting wildly even before they could attack.
Some dropped to the First Level Nirvana Realm, some to Level two Nirvana Realm, and others to the Nirvana Realm Third Level.
The extent of their realm collapse varied.
What happened?
These Nirvana Realm Elders were so shocked they momentarily forgot to attack.
Inside the carriage, Ye Yun watched. An obscure glint suddenly flashed in his profound eyes.
That obscure glint, like a bottomless black hole, teemed with unimaginable mystical runes.
At that moment, all the Nirvana Realm Elders whose cultivation realms had been weakened completely forgot about their realms falling. With bloodshot eyes, they charged madly at Luo Li and Jun Moxiao.
What on earth happened?
Ren Tianxing clenched his fists, watching the scene in shock.
All the Nirvana Realm Elders had indeed paused for a moment before falling into a frenzy.
"Because their cultivation realms have fallen..." a gentle voice suddenly echoed in Ren Tianxing’s mind.
Who?
Ren Tianxing was startled.
Immediately after, Ren Tianxing’s eyes bulged. He was horrified to find that his cultivation base had plummeted from the Nirvana Realm Tenth Level Peak all the way down to the First Level Nirvana Realm.
The next moment, he found that he couldn’t move his body at all; he couldn’t even open his mouth.
Inside the carriage, Ye Yun lightly tapped a finger, and a ray of light entered Ren Tianxing’s mind. He began to search Ren Tianxing’s memories.
In the span of a single breath, the ray of light refracted, returning to Ye Yun’s fingertip.
Interesting...
Ye Yun’s expression was calm. He chuckled softly, and his body suddenly vanished from the carriage.
The next moment, ripples appeared in the void, and Ye Yun stepped out, finding himself before an ancient tower.
This was a nine-story ancient tower located in the rear courtyard of the Shen Heng Sect’s Sect Leader’s Main Hall. The ancient tower was exceptionally timeworn, looking as if it had been passed down for millennia.
This was the Legacy Tower of the Shen Heng Sect.
All the legacies of successive Sect Masters were completely preserved within this Legacy Tower.
Outside the Legacy Tower, a blind old man with a black cloth wrapped around his head sat cross-legged on the ground, seemingly guarding this ancient tower in silence.

chapters.title: Chapter 127 Mysterious Wooden Box, Concealing Secrets
chapters.content:
Chapter 127: Chapter 127 Mysterious Wooden Box, Concealing Secrets
"Kill!"
On the plaza of the Shen Heng Sect, battle cries shook the heavens. Luo Li, Jun Moxiao, and Su Wanyi were already engulfed by a tide of sword light.
However, their strength was far greater than before. Coupled with the suppression of the cultivation bases of the Shen Heng Sect’s Nirvana Realm Elders, the three managed to hold their ground.
Su Wanyi’s experience was the most miraculous. If any Nirvana Realm expert tried to kill her, their cultivation base would instantly plummet from the Nirvana Realm to the First Level of the Divine Bridge Realm. Even high-level Divine Bridge Realm experts targeting her experienced a similar sharp drop in their cultivation base.
These Divine Bridge Realm and Nirvana Realm disciples and Elders had all been firmly controlled by a type of mental Secret Technique cast by Ye Yun. Therefore, even though their cultivation bases dropped so drastically, none of them were aware of it. All they knew was that they had to kill the three youths before them at any cost.
However, when Divine Bridge Realm cultivators faced Luo Li and Jun Moxiao, their cultivation bases did not drop.
All tens of thousands of disciples of the Shen Heng Sect were controlled by Ye Yun’s mental Secret Technique. Their faces contorted with madness, they launched wave after wave of suicidal attacks. The tsunami-like onslaught placed immense pressure on the three.
Although sword light rained down across the plaza, any that came within a ten-meter radius of the carriage instantly vanished.
"The Young Master has become even more terrifying after reaching the Divine Monarch Realm..." the Big Black Horse said, its eyes wide as it surveyed the surrounding battle, clicking its tongue in awe.
"Uncle Ma, what on earth is happening here? I still don’t get it..." the Big Black Cat asked, blinking. It truly hadn’t understood the current state of the battle. Being only at the Destiny Realm, the Big Black Cat was simply unable to sense the aura of the Elders’ demoted cultivation bases. The Big Black Horse, having reached the Eternal Realm, could just barely perceive some clues, allowing it to vaguely deduce the heaven-defying methods Ye Yun had employed.
WHAP!
A massive horse tail suddenly struck the Big Black Cat, almost flattening it into a pancake.
"You don’t understand a thing! How dare a mere Destiny Realm cultivator like you speculate about the Master’s Divine Skills? It seems you’ve gotten rather arrogant since your advancement, haven’t you?" the Big Black Horse turned its head and glared irritably at the Big Black Cat.
"Ouch! Uncle Ma, I was just talking casually, don’t take it seriously, esteemed elder! Even though I’ve advanced to the Destiny Realm, in your eyes, I’m still hopelessly weak..." the Big Black Cat howled, struggling to get up while clutching its head.
"Haha!" The Big Black Horse grinned. "Little Cat, don’t just stand there. Hurry up and collect the storage rings. We can give them to the young masters later!"
"You got it!" The Big Black Cat was instantly energized. It leaped agilely from the carriage, transforming into a streak of black light, weaving through the chaotic sword light.
Disciples of the Shen Heng Sect fell one after another. Those at the Origin Sea Realm were especially vulnerable; the slightest carelessness meant death by the overwhelming sword light.
"There’s one here..."
"And another one over there..."
The Big Black Cat was having a field day collecting them. After gathering the storage rings, it tossed them above its head, securing them firmly in place with Mana.
Behind the Sect Grand Hall, outside the imposing Nine-Level Ancient Tower, Ye Yun walked forward slowly, his hands clasped behind his back. At this moment, he had retracted all his aura, appearing like an ordinary person.
Clear footsteps suddenly echoed.
The blind old man seated on the ground abruptly stood up. Drawing his sword, he pointed it in a certain direction and coldly asked, "Who goes there?"
Ye Yun smiled faintly.
Under the gaze of his demonic pupils, the blind old man turned to ash and vanished.
A mere half-step Destiny Realm cultivator. In Ye Yun’s eyes, they weren’t even considered ants. Now, even an Eternal Realm cultivator was less than an ant before Ye Yun. With a single thought, Ye Yun could annihilate an Eternal Realm cultivator.
As his realm advanced, Ye Yun’s cultivation base grew increasingly terrifying. After three months of secluded cultivation in the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range, he had not only solidified his cultivation base but had also advanced to the Second Layer of the Divine Monarch Realm!
During these three months, Ye Yun had also comprehended several unimaginably powerful Divine Skills. His pair of demonic eyes, for example, were a manifestation of a God-level Pupil Technique Divine Power: the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye.
A myriad of illusions; life and death decided by a single thought. A single glance could turn countless powerful beings to ash, preventing them from ever entering the Six Paths of Reincarnation.
This was a potent Pupil Technique, its power incredibly formidable. Though Ye Yun was exceptionally talented, he had only cultivated this Divine Skill to the Great Achievement Realm, still some distance from the pinnacle. Ye Yun estimated that once he entered the Divine King Realm, this Divine Skill would reach its absolute pinnacle. At that time, with a single look, the entire world would undergo creation and destruction within his eyes.
Ye Yun stepped forward and walked in. The great doors of the ancient tower opened automatically, and he entered the first level.
"Who’s there?"
Another guardian of the tower, an old man, was startled to see a strange white-robed young man walk in. He immediately drew his sword and lunged. He was a cultivator at the Nirvana Tenth Level, so this strike was exceedingly powerful.
Ye Yun glanced up at him. A peculiar light flickered in Ye Yun’s demonic eyes.
The sword light instantly vanished. Then, the old man was horrified to discover his arm had vanished. Next, he found he couldn’t make a sound. Finally, his entire body disappeared. He had vanished without a trace.
Ye Yun smiled faintly. The tower guardian was not yet dead; he had merely been banished into a spatial counter-current. How long he could survive depended on his own abilities. A mere Nirvana Realm cultivator could never escape such a spatial counter-current.
Ye Yun scanned the first level but didn’t find what he was looking for. He then ascended the stairs to the second level.
The second level had no guardian, but it was protected by a Formation. Upon sensing an unfamiliar presence, the Formation activated, emitting a blinding light, attempting to bar Ye Yun’s entry.
Ye Yun glanced at the Formation. Countless star-like runes flickered within his eyes. In an instant, the Formation disintegrated into countless particles and vanished into thin air.
The second level, too, did not hold what Ye Yun sought.
Next, he proceeded from the third level up to the ninth level, breaking seven Formations in succession. Finally, on the ninth level, he found what he was looking for.
This ninth level was the most secret place in the entire Shen Heng Sect. Its importance surpassed even that of the Shen Heng Sect’s Treasure Pavilion. The Sect’s most guarded secrets were kept here.
The ninth level was entirely different from the others. It contained only a single altar, upon which rested a box exuding an ancient aura. It was extremely ancient and bore numerous seals.
Seeing these seals, Ye Yun’s expression remained indifferent.
How overly cautious,
he thought.
It seems every measure was taken to prevent anyone from prying.
Ye Yun walked over to the box and looked down. Instantly, the seals melted away like spring snow under the sun.
Ye Yun opened the box.
Inside, there was a letter and a Jade Tablet.
Ye Yun did not open the letter. With a slight flash in his eyes, he had already seen its contents. The Jade Tablet was a token.
This was a handwritten letter left by the first-generation Patriarch of the Shen Heng Sect ten thousand years ago. The reason it was named the Shen Heng Sect was precisely to counterbalance the Dragon God Sect. To keep the Dragon God Sect in check for ten thousand years, ensuring its lineage, which had spanned three hundred generations, would come to an abrupt end. Once that was done, the mission would be considered complete.
After the mission’s completion, the succeeding Sect Masters of the Shen Heng Sect could use this Jade Tablet to enter the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, find the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree, and hang the Jade Tablet upon it.
Then... they would receive an astonishing reward.

chapters.title: Chapter 128: Speculating the Planner, Wanyi Breaks Through
chapters.content:
Chapter 128: Chapter 128: Speculating the Planner, Wanyi Breaks Through
"This is becoming more and more interesting..."
Ye Yun placed his hands behind his back. As his calm eyes gazed at the letter and Jade Tablet in the wooden box, a momentary, almost imperceptible smile flickered across his face.
The other party was extremely careful, even leading all the clues this time to a Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree deep within the Secret Realm. The force behind this must be unimaginably large; even a Sky-Level Sect couldn’t achieve this. Only an Eternal Sect could possess such astounding power. The planner was astute, meticulously arranging each step. Every potential clue could be severed, making it impossible for future generations to discern anything.
Having signed in for a hundred thousand years, I am now invincible. It’s just the right time to have some fun with you...
Ye Yun smiled faintly.
The wooden box before him suddenly vanished, stored away by him.
Although he hadn’t obtained any direct clues, acquiring a letter and a Jade Tablet was quite satisfactory for Ye Yun. He enjoyed the feeling of unraveling a mystery. It relieved him of the loneliness he had felt from being unbeatable for the past one hundred thousand years.
Now, he could follow these clues. Accompanied by the three young members of the Dragon God Sect, he would lead them to continuously gain experience and head toward the Heavenly Moon Dynasty. Then, he would see what mysteries truly lay hidden within the Secret Realm.
Space tore open, and Ye Yun stepped through. The next moment, he appeared in the air above the Shen Heng Sect Square.
The battle was still ongoing. Battle cries shook the heavens, swords clashed, and continuous loud booms resounded.
Luo Li, Jun Moxiao, and Su Wanyi, under the siege of tens of thousands, faced unimaginable pressure. This was particularly true since all the Shen Heng Sect disciples had been controlled by Ye Yun using a Secret Technique; they were all attacking with suicidal abandon. One could only imagine the intensity of such pressure.
Only one person in the square wasn’t participating in the battle: Ren Tianxing, the Sect Master of the Shen Heng Sect. He had been controlled by Ye Yun earlier and still couldn’t move.
You should join them too!
A flicker of movement in Ye Yun’s expression, a profound light flashed in his eyes, and Ren Tianxing, still in a daze, also joined the battle.
Watching the battle below, Ye Yun’s gaze flickered as he began to ponder.
The Shen Heng Sect had kept the Dragon God Sect in check for at least ten thousand years. Before that, other sects must have been secretly plotting, making quiet moves against the Dragon God Sect. The true decline of the Dragon God Sect likely occurred tens of thousands of years ago. And the group that orchestrated and executed this shocking plan, after tens of thousands of years, it was believed they had long since vanished from this world. That generation had toppled the Dragon God Sect from its zenith, causing its power to continuously wane. Ultimately, it fell to a ninth-rate sect like the Shen Heng Sect to handle the aftermath.
On the Cangnan Continent, for a sect to ultimately become an Eternal Sect, it naturally had to possess the profound destiny of the continent. These Eternal Sects had deep foundations and were by no means easily toppled. Back then, I was tricked by the System into entering a mystical space to ’sign in.’ No one knows what happened to the Dragon God Sect during the subsequent one hundred thousand years. The Dragon God Sect had endured hardship for tens of thousands of years, and records from that distant past were long lost. To put it bluntly, its main lineage of inheritance had been severed.
Fortunately, successive generations of the Dragon God Sect were exceptionally tenacious. Coupled with the lingering protection from the Eternal Sect’s destiny, they had managed to endure down to Luo Li, the 298th generation. It had truly been an arduous journey.
A hundred thousand years. Oceans can turn into mulberry fields, and people and things change with time. Back when I was active, the Dragon God Sect teemed with Eternal Realm masters. But in Luo Li’s generation, her master only reached the Origin Sea Realm.
Ye Yun was deeply moved by these recollections.
Therefore, I am determined to train these three unfortunate children to become undisputed masters of the Eternal Realm. I aim to increase the concentration of the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline in their bodies to over 90%. This would truly enable a single Eternal Realm expert from their ranks to overwhelm dozens of ordinary Eternal Realm cultivators. In the future, with these three Eternal Realm powerhouses stationed in the Dragon God Sect, they could dominate the entire Cangnan Continent for at least tens of thousands of years. That way, I can leave without any worries.
Time continued to pass slowly. 「In the blink of an eye, five to six Time Units had passed.」
The battle on the square had reached an extremely brutal stage. People kept falling one after another. Only five to six thousand combatants remained on the vast square.
Luo Li, Jun Moxiao, and Su Wanyi were still as vigorous as ever, showing no signs of fatigue.
The three were utterly astounded.
We never expected the Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood to make our bodies so powerful! Unbelievably so! After fighting for five to six Time Units, we still don’t feel any fatigue!
On the square now, with the Shen Heng Sect’s numbers drastically reduced, the pressure on the trio lessened considerably, and the forces on both sides reached a tentative equilibrium.
"Senior Sister, I can’t believe we haven’t had a breakthrough yet!" Jun Moxiao said in annoyance after executing a sword strike.
"Yes, perhaps our talent isn’t strong enough. Despite this level of pressure, we still haven’t broken through!" Luo Li also felt somewhat upset.
Their Ancestor had hoped they could achieve another minor breakthrough in this battle. However, despite fighting for so long and having matched their opponents, they still hadn’t achieved a breakthrough in their realms.
The medicinal efficacy of the three Dragon Tiger Pills they had consumed earlier was still continuously converting into Mana. This potent energy surged through their meridians like a great river, steadily transforming into their cultivation base. Even so, a small gap still remained to their breakthrough.
By now, the Shen Heng Sect disciples at the Origin Sea and Divine Bridge Realms were utterly exhausted. Only a few Nirvana Realm Elders were still bitterly holding on.
Ye Yun sat inside the carriage, watching the battle and making silent calculations.
Currently, among these three youngsters, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao are at the Divine Bridge Realm, so they still need some time to break through. However, Su Wanyi, at the Shaping God Realm, is on the verge of a breakthrough after this arduous battle.
As Ye Yun made this calculation, countless minute, star-like runes flickered and transformed within his unfathomably deep, demonic eyes, emitting an indescribable glimmer.
On the square below, at that very instant, the cultivation base of all the embattled Shen Heng Sect disciples rose by an entire level.
As a result, the pressure on Luo Li, Jun Moxiao, and Su Wanyi increased dramatically.
"Senior Sister, the Ancestor is giving us special treatment again!" Jun Moxiao exclaimed, overjoyed. He burst into laughter, his spirits incredibly high, and the sword light from his hand flowed like a torrential river.
Luo Li also smiled.
BANG!
Su Wanyi, who had manifested as a Divine Dragon Phantom in mid-air, suddenly shuddered and her true form was revealed. At this moment, her aura surged dramatically, and she broke through to the Ninth Layer of the Phase of God.
Finally, I’ve broken through!
Su Wanyi was both surprised and overjoyed, the delight on her beautiful face impossible to hide.
Upon reaching the Ninth Layer of the Phase of God, her Mana was now dozens of times more potent than before, and her combat strength had once again increased astonishingly.
A Shen Heng Sect Disciple of Heaven’s Pride at the Divine Bridge Realm, whose cultivation had also been boosted, was momentarily stunned seeing Su Wanyi. Then, he suddenly launched a sneak attack. A dazzling sword light tore through the air, slashing toward Su Wanyi.
"Senior Sister, watch out!" Jun Moxiao shouted a warning. He was too far away, and it was too late to provide aid.
Su Wanyi snapped back to her senses. Just as she was about to use the Dragon God Body Technique to dodge the attack from behind, her peripheral vision caught a black shadow hurtling over.
BANG!
That Disciple of Heaven’s Pride from the Shen Heng Sect was struck by the black shadow and instantly exploded into a mist of blood.
"With Old Cat here, no one gets to harm the little master!" the Big Black Cat declared smugly, appearing in mid-air. It licked its paws with its blood-red tongue, its dark eyes gleaming.

chapters.title: Chapter 129: The Shock of the Destiny Realm Cultivator
chapters.content:
Chapter 129: Chapter 129: The Shock of the Destiny Realm Cultivator
ZAP!
A tiny bolt of lightning suddenly descended from the sky, frying the Big Black Cat inside and out.
Its black fur stood on end, revealing skin and flesh in some places.
"Uncle Ma, have mercy!"
The Big Black Cat didn’t need to think twice to know that this was Uncle Ma’s doing.
So it immediately prostrated itself on the ground, covering its head and adopting a pleading expression.
"Do you think Uncle Ma is just here for show? I’m protecting the three young masters. Your job is to pick up the storage rings, understand?"
The Big Black Horse glared.
"I understand, Uncle Ma..." the Big Black Cat said, its face mournful.
It promptly perked up and began searching for the storage rings of the fallen Shen Heng Sect disciples, piling them on its head for safekeeping.
"..."
Seeing the Big Black Cat being tormented so miserably by the Big Black Horse, Su Wanyi didn’t know what to say. She could only smile bitterly before throwing herself back into the fight.
The Big Black Horse licked his lips and chuckled, "Protecting the three young masters is this Old Ma’s responsibility! No one else should even think of snatching it away!"
「Inside the carriage.」
A small smile touched Ye Yun’s lips.
What a hilarious pair, always squabbling when they have nothing else to do. Especially the Big Black Horse, who loves to bully the Big Black Cat.
This Big Black Horse probably picked up the habit of bullying other demon beasts from spending too much time in the warehouse, where it was frequently bullied by those terrifying divine pets.
Ye Yun didn’t mind at all.
Back at Accumulated Thunder Mountain, the Big Black Horse had stepped in to avenge the Big Black Cat and even gave away one of his precious scales.
Evidently, the bond between the cat and the horse ran very deep. It was just that on the surface, they still appeared to be a pair of bickering companions.
Ye Yun shook his head and turned his attention back to the battlefield.
After Ye Yun adjusted their cultivation levels, the Divine Bridge Realm and Nirvana Realm disciples of the Shen Heng Sect found their combat power significantly increased, allowing them to regain the upper hand.
Ye Yun was quite satisfied. At this rate, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao would soon achieve their breakthroughs.
His method of training disciples was, in truth, extremely brutal.
No other sect, not even those at the Eternal Level, could achieve this.
After all, not even an Eternal Realm cultivator could control each cultivator’s cultivation level with Ye Yun’s precision.
Someone’s coming?
Suddenly, Ye Yun looked in a certain direction, a smirk playing on his lips.
「A thousand miles away from the Shen Heng Sect.」
Two middle-aged cultivators stood atop a giant Azure Luan.
The two cultivators had an extraordinary, almost ethereal demeanor. They wore matching deep-blue Daoist robes, and their cultivation bases had already reached the Destiny Realm.
Every move they made constantly emanated a terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath.
At this moment, a red-faced middle-aged cultivator chuckled as he gazed into the distance, "Senior Brother, we’re almost at the Shen Heng Sect!"
The other, a white-faced middle-aged cultivator, nodded.
His eyes were profound as he gazed placidly into the distant void. "Lately," he said, "the Demon Clan has been restless, with some forces showing signs of mobilization. I suspect those three monsters from Accumulated Thunder Mountain are trying to stir up trouble! Now that we brothers are here in the Shenfeng Dynasty, stationed at the Shen Heng Sect, it is precisely to prevent the Demon Clan from causing chaos!"
"Understood, Senior Brother! I will follow your lead on this trip!" the red-faced cultivator said with a chuckle.
He was naturally of a tranquil temperament and preferred to avoid trouble. As long as his Senior Brother was present, he would simply follow whatever arrangements his Senior Brother made.
His Senior Brother’s cultivation was a whole realm higher than his; he was already a grand cultivator at Destiny Realm Level 5.
He himself had only recently broken through to the Fourth Level of the Destiny Realm.
WHOOSH!
The giant Azure Luan’s wings flapped, propelling it forward with incredible speed. The thousand-mile distance was instantly reduced to just a few hundred.
The red-faced cultivator glanced casually in the direction of the Shen Heng Sect, but then sensed something was amiss.
He quickly focused his vision. The Shen Heng Sect was in chaos! Swords flashed like a tide across the plaza, and the ground was strewn with bloody corpses, one after another.
"This is bad, Senior Brother! The Shen Heng Sect is under attack!" he exclaimed urgently.
Could the Demon Clan have already made their move?
The white-faced cultivator also immediately focused his vision, his pupils shimmering with light as he peered into the distance.
Sure enough, a heaven-shaking, earth-shattering battle was taking place at the Shen Heng Sect.
He fiercely tapped the Azure Luan’s head with his foot. The Azure Luan immediately accelerated, covering the several hundred-mile distance in just a few breaths.
The Azure Luan circled in the sky above the Shen Heng Sect. The two cultivators’ faces were solemn, and they refrained from acting rashly for the moment.
Instead, they observed the battle situation below.
If this was a Demon Clan rebellion, they would have to assess the situation before deciding whether to intervene. If the attacking Demon Clan members were stronger than the two of them, then there would be no need for them to stick their necks out. Instead, they would immediately turn back to the Heavenly Star Dynasty and report the matter to their Sect Master.
However, when they got a clear view of the battle below, they were both utterly shocked.
There was no sign of the so-called Demon Clan.
The ones attacking the entire Shen Heng Sect were merely three youths.
Two young women and one young man.
Among them, two were at the Seventh Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm, and one was at the Ninth Layer of the Phase of God.
In their eyes, the attackers’ cultivation bases were all very low—pitifully so.
But the bizarre thing was that cultivators of such meager levels were actually fighting against the thousands from the Shen Heng Sect.
This included Ren Tianxing, the Sect Master of the Shen Heng Sect.
"Senior Brother, am I dreaming? Those three youngsters’ cultivation bases aren’t high at all, are they?!" the red-faced cultivator stammered.
He wore a baffled expression, constantly rubbing his eyes, suspecting he had fallen into an illusion.
The Shen Heng Sect was the largest sect in the Shenfeng Dynasty, boasting a thousand Divine Bridge Realm cultivators and over a hundred in the Nirvana Realm. Such a powerful force... yet they were locked in a fierce battle with three youngsters who seemed as weak as fledgling chicks! And all those bodies lying on the ground—clearly, they had all been killed by those three youngsters. This was too inconceivable! If he hadn’t seen it with his own eyes, he would find it utterly impossible to believe that any of this was real.
The white-faced cultivator’s brow furrowed. He secretly dug his fingernails fiercely into his palm. The sharp pain told him he wasn’t dreaming.
But he was completely baffled. Why was such a bizarre scene unfolding before his very eyes?
Just then, his gaze fell upon a solitary black carriage parked in the square.
He released his powerful Divine Sense to scan it, only to find the carriage empty.
The white-faced cultivator sighed. "How very strange. I’ve lived for so long, yet I’ve never encountered anything like this!"
He, too, was unable to make sense of the bizarre battle unfolding below.
"Senior Brother, what should we do? Should we lend them a hand?" the red-faced cultivator asked from his side.
"No need to rush," the white-faced cultivator said after a moment’s thought. "For now, the Shen Heng Sect appears to have the upper hand. Let’s observe for a while longer."
After all, as a Destiny Realm cultivator, he naturally chose a conservative approach when faced with such a bizarre situation.
The higher one’s cultivation, the more one treasures one’s life.
It was no easy feat to cultivate to the Destiny Realm and comprehend Destiny itself.
「Two hours passed.」
The two powerful Destiny Realm cultivators were shocked to find that the three youths were still fighting persistently, their bodies showing no signs of fatigue.
In contrast, many Shen Heng Sect cultivators were now drenched in sweat, their stamina clearly depleted. Yet, for some unknown reason, they continued to fight with frenzied intensity.
"Junior Brother, let’s make our move!" the white-faced cultivator said, his brow furrowed as he finally made his decision.
SHING!
An astonishing Sword Intent erupted from both of them, powerful enough to disperse the clouds in the sky.
Then, the two astonishing Sword Intents condensed into two slender beams of sword light. They descended silently from the sky, covertly stabbing towards the two Divine Bridge Realm youths!

chapters.title: Chapter 130: Breakthrough, Annihilate Shen Heng Sect!
chapters.content:
Chapter 130: Chapter 130: Breakthrough, Annihilate Shen Heng Sect!
The two faint sword lights silently descended.
The Big Black Horse, who had been faithfully guarding his three little masters, suddenly raised his head. He bared his teeth in a wide grin, revealing a row of gleaming white teeth. "ACHOO!" The Big Black Horse sneezed.
An invisible wave instantly erupted from the carriage, surging back towards the void. Even the two Destiny Realm Cultivators in mid-air were unable to sense this sound wave with their Divine Sense.
When those two faint sword lights encountered this sound wave, they melted away like spring snow.
What is this?
In the void, the two Destiny Realm Cultivators watched this scene, their hearts pounding in shock. Despite it being a casual attack, those two faint sword lights could not have been blocked even by a Cultivator at the Nirvana Tenth Level.
But why... why would the sword light melt away?
Could it be...are there stronger beings guarding the surroundings?
The moment this possibility crossed their minds, an unimaginable, colossal fear instantly engulfed them. Cold sweat broke out all over their bodies.
If they, Destiny Realm Cultivators, couldn’t even sense the other party’s presence... This meant the opponent’s cultivation base far surpassed theirs.
A Life and Death Realm Cultivator?
The moment this possibility struck him, the white-faced Cultivator tapped his foot. The Azure Luan immediately flapped its wings in a frenzy and turned to flee.
The path of Cultivation, from the Destiny Realm to the Life and Death Realm, was an enormous chasm. Countless Cultivators, perhaps blessed with good fortune, stepped into the Destiny Realm only to find themselves forever stalled before the Life and Death Realm. However, once one broke through from the Destiny Realm to the Life and Death Realm, they would gain immense longevity and a chance to challenge the Eternal Realm on their Cultivation path.
To them, two Destiny Realm Cultivators, a Life and Death Realm powerhouse was like a celestial force. Before a Life and Death Realm expert, they were as insignificant as ants.
"Trying to run?"
The Big Black Horse chuckled and, in a flash, disappeared from the square. The next moment, he transformed into a middle-aged man in a black robe, blocking the massive Azure Luan’s path.
"Where did you two... come from? Confess honestly, or I’ll make you wish you had!"
The Big Black Horse picked at his teeth, casually observing the two Cultivators.
A Life and Death Realm Great Demon?
Sensing the terrifying aura emanating from the black-robed middle-aged man, the red-faced Cultivator’s expression changed drastically. His face went from pale to red, then to an ashen green. Finally, overcome by fright, he tumbled and landed on the Azure Luan’s head.
Compared to the Shenfeng Dynasty, while the Heavenly Star Dynasty was powerful, it didn’t even possess a single Cultivator in the Life and Death Realm. They only had one human expert at the Half-Step Life-Death Realm. Yet, the Great Demon standing before them had actually reached the Life and Death Realm! All the Human Race forces in the entire Heavenly Star Dynasty combined would be no match for this Life and Death Realm Great Demon.
The white-faced Cultivator felt a deep unease, but he managed to maintain a composed exterior. He clasped his hands together and said respectfully, "Honorable Demon Elder, a hundred years ago, the Human Race and the Demon Clan forged a peace treaty, vowing to cease all hostilities. I wonder why you are making things difficult for the humble Shen Heng Sect?"
"What bullshit treaty? Uncle Ma doesn’t give a damn about that! The insignificant Shen Heng Sect deserves to die! And since you dared to disrespect my little masters, you all deserve to die too!"
The Big Black Horse rolled his eyes, a terrifying killing intent flickering in their depths. This killing intent descended instantly. The massive Azure Luan couldn’t withstand such a tangible killing intent. Its heart ruptured, and with a mournful cry, it plummeted from the sky.
The two Destiny Realm Cultivators stood in the void, their faces ashen, their bodies trembling uncontrollably. They knew that facing such an unreasonably brutal Life and Death Realm Great Demon, they were doomed today.
Little masters?
The white-faced Cultivator still clung to a final shred of consciousness. He never could have imagined that the three young people who were on a killing spree in the Shen Heng Sect were actually addressed as ’little masters’ by this Life and Death Realm Great Demon. This was too terrifying! For a moment, his mind reeled, waves of shock crashing through him.
Just what kind of a force had the Shen Heng Sect provoked?
A power that could assign a Life and Death Realm Great Demon as a guardian had to be at least a Super Sect!
"Hehe! That’s right, those three youngsters are Uncle Ma’s little masters. You dared to ambush them. You should know the consequences, right?"
A proud expression appeared on the Big Black Horse’s face.
Suddenly, its pupils shot out two bolts of lightning that instantly descended upon the heads of the two Destiny Realm Cultivators.
BOOM!
The two Cultivators screamed in terror as they were instantly obliterated, not even dregs remaining.
Two storage rings floated in mid-air.
The Big Black Horse snatched the two rings, his eyes gleaming with excitement as he chuckled, "Two more rings for me."
He tossed the two rings far away, and they landed on the square. The next instant, he reappeared on the square, reverted to his Big Black Horse form, draped the reins over himself, and continued to pull the carriage.
"Master, I’ve killed those two despicable fellows!" the Big Black Horse sent a voice transmission into the carriage.
"Mm."
Ye Yun nodded subtly. He had already scanned the memories of the two Destiny Realm Cultivators with a single glance; their deaths were inconsequential. In Ye Yun’s eyes, they weren’t even considered ants.
The Tian Heng Sect of the Heavenly Star Dynasty and the Shen Heng Sect differed by only one character in their names, but the two had no connection in terms of lineage. The name Shen Heng Sect had been given by someone orchestrating things from the shadows. This Sect’s name also invisibly diminished the karmic fortune of the Dragon God Sect. This concept of karmic fortune could only be vaguely perceived by those whose cultivation base reached the Eternal Realm. Ordinary Cultivators couldn’t comprehend how simply choosing a name could suppress another Sect that held sway over the continent’s karmic fortune.
Ye Yun smiled faintly. He temporarily set this matter aside. After all, he would have to visit the Heavenly Star Dynasty on his way to the Heavenly Moon Dynasty. It would also serve as a chance to give the three youngsters some training.
At this moment, Ye Yun glanced at the battle on the square. After a silent calculation, he realized it would still take some time for Luo Li and Jun Moxiao to achieve their breakthrough. So, he simply closed his eyes and began to comprehend a new Divine Skill.
Ye Yun’s repository contained countless Divine Techniques. Some were of an exceedingly high grade, surpassing the God level and touching the limits of this plane of existence—far beyond his current ability to grasp. However, there were also numerous Cultivation Techniques that he could comprehend at his present level. Ye Yun was extremely interested in any Divine Technique or Cultivation Technique. In his previous life, he had been a Cultivation fanatic. It was just that his Cultivation time had been short, and he had only managed to cultivate the Dragon God Sect’s several great Ultimate Techniques to their peak.
Now, 100,000 years later, he had reappeared in this world, already unparalleled. When boredom struck, he naturally used the comprehension of Divine Techniques and Cultivation Techniques to alleviate his solitude. Every time he fully grasped a Divine Technique or Cultivation Technique, Ye Yun felt a profound sense of accomplishment.
「Three time units later.」
Even though the Shen Heng Sect’s Cultivators were controlled by a mental Secret Technique, their physical strength and Mana had reached their limits.
BANG! BANG!
Following two soft thuds, Luo Li and Jun Moxiao, who had been in mid-air, suddenly reappeared. At that moment, their auras surged as they finally broke through from the Seventh layer of the Divine Bridge Realm to the Eighth Layer of the Divine Bridge Stage.
"Senior Sister, we finally broke through!" Jun Moxiao roared with laughter. To achieve this minor realm breakthrough, they had fought for nearly ten time units. Even with their exceptionally strong physiques, they both felt a touch of exhaustion.
Luo Li also laughed heartily. Brimming with energy, the two of them charged forth like a whirlwind, beginning their slaughter of the Shen Heng Sect Disciples.
「After the time it takes for an incense stick to burn.」
All the Shen Heng Sect Disciples lay dead in pools of blood.
"MEOW~"
The Big Black Cat abruptly stopped and landed beside Luo Li. Seeing the now enormous Big Black Cat with a dense pile of storage rings balanced on its head, Luo Li couldn’t help but be astonished.
"Little Cat, are you trying to open a pawnshop?" Luo Li covered her mouth, unable to suppress her laughter.

chapters.title: Chapter 131: Ancestor’s Teaching, Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye
chapters.content:
Chapter 131: Chapter 131: Ancestor’s Teaching, Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye
"HEH HEH!"
The Big Black Cat smiled shyly.
"Little Master, I just wanted to save you the trouble. During the battle, I gathered all these rings!"
"Thank you for that!"
Luo Li walked forward, gently stroking the soft fur on the Big Black Cat’s forehead. The Big Black Cat was immensely flattered.
This young girl in front of it was the future Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect! And it was just a Divine Pet of the Dragon God Sect.
The Big Black Cat immediately lay down on the ground, acting quite obediently, just like a pet cat.
Ye Yun, inside the carriage, witnessed this scene and couldn’t help but smile slightly.
Before he transmigrated to this world, he too had once had a pet cat.
Time flies so fast. It’s been one hundred thousand years. I wonder what Earth is like now...
Ye Yun sighed softly in his heart.
「...」
The storage rings on the Big Black Cat’s head numbered well over ten thousand. Following Luo Li’s suggestion, they were divided into three shares. The three of them placed all these storage rings into the God-level storage ring gifted by their Ancestor.
"Mission accomplished! We finally annihilated the Shen Heng Sect!"
Luo Li raised her fist, her delicate little face flushed red with excitement.
"Yes, Senior Sister, we’ve finally eradicated the root of all evil!" Jun Moxiao said through gritted teeth, looking at the corpses littering the ground.
Now, after a bitter battle, they had finally avenged their predecessors from the Dragon God Sect.
The three of them stood there for a moment, a mixture of sorrow and joy in their hearts. After a while, they finally turned around.
"Let’s go, Senior Sisters," Jun Moxiao said softly.
Luo Li and Su Wanyi nodded. Even though they had exacted their revenge and their mission was a great success, they still felt somewhat empty inside.
"Are you... forgetting something?" Ye Yun suddenly asked, standing on the carriage and looking at the three youngsters in the square with an interested expression.
"Ancestor!" The three of them quickly bowed in salutation.
Luo Li scratched her head, pondering the meaning of what the Ancestor had just said.
Suddenly, an idea flashed through her mind. She lowered her head, looking a little vexed, and said, "Senior Sister, Junior Brother, we forgot about the Shen Heng Sect’s Treasure Pavilion."
"And their Cultivation Technique manuals!" Jun Moxiao exclaimed, slapping his forehead as he also realized.
They had been too overwhelmed by the joy of their revenge just now and had overlooked such an important matter.
The Shen Heng Sect, as the number one Sect of the Shenfeng Dynasty, was a major Sect. With so many years of accumulation, its cultivation resources were undoubtedly unimaginably rich. They absolutely could not miss out.
Looting the Shen Heng Sect’s Treasure Pavilion and all their Cultivation Techniques would also lay a solid foundation for the future revival of the Dragon God Sect.
Ye Yun looked at the young girl’s vexed expression and said lightly, "There’s no need for you to trouble yourselves. Those places all have restrictions, and you wouldn’t be able to open them..."
After he spoke, within Ye Yun’s pair of mesmerizing eyes, countless tiny, star-like runes once again shone brilliantly, undergoing a mystical transformation.
Then, an astounding scene occurred.
All the Seals and Formations outside the Shen Heng Sect’s Treasure Pavilion were opened.
All the treasures, as if coming alive, surged out of the Treasure Pavilion. They formed a long stream resembling a dragon and flew over from the distance.
The restrictions on the Cultivation Technique Hall were also broken, and volumes of Cultivation Techniques, like swift swallows, also floated over.
All sorts of heavenly materials and earthly treasures, along with the Cultivation Technique manuals, descended from the sky. Just as they were about to land in the square, Ye Yun’s gaze shifted again.
An unimaginable power spread out in an instant.
All the corpses in the square turned into wisps of green smoke and dissipated in a flash.
And in the distance, the buildings of the Shen Heng Sect also turned into green smoke and vanished at this moment.
"This..."
Luo Li, Jun Moxiao, and Su Wanyi stared dumbfounded at the scene before them, their eyes wide with shock, unable to utter a word.
Previously, the Ancestor would just gently blow a breath.
Now, he didn’t even need to blow a breath; a single glance was enough to eliminate all the people and buildings.
He had also broken through all the restrictions in the Treasure Pavilion and the Cultivation Technique Hall, bringing out all the heavenly materials and earthly treasures, along with the Cultivation Technique manuals.
This...
What kind of Divine Skill was this?!
Could this be the manifestation of a Divine Monarch Realm expert’s formidable power?
The three of them stood dumbstruck, like stone statues, and it took them a long time to recover their senses.
The Big Black Cat beside them was also stunned speechless.
Master’s... this Divine Skill is too powerful, isn’t it? He can kill someone with just a look! Who would dare to fight Master in the future?
The more the Big Black Cat thought about it, the more frightened it became. But after the fear, excitement surged through it.
From now on, it would serve the Master and the three Little Masters well, striving to learn a supreme Divine Skill from the Master in the future.
The Big Black Horse in the distance watched this scene, equally astounded.
Even with its Eternal Realm cultivation base, it couldn’t comprehend the profundity of Master’s Divine Skill. It felt as if the entire world was contained within Master’s gaze. With a single look, the whole world seemed to cycle through creation and destruction within his eyes. Truly terrifying.
The expressions and mental states of everyone were laid bare under Ye Yun’s gaze.
He simply smiled faintly.
The Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye was one of several powerful Divine Skills he had comprehended. It wasn’t necessarily the most outstanding, but it was one of the more stunning ones.
"Ancestor... you... what exactly is this Divine Skill?" Luo Li asked, her face flushed as she stammered.
"This is the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye. It’s not one of the original Divine Skills of My Dragon God Sect, but if you wish to learn, I can teach you..." Ye Yun said with a smile.
"Thank you so much, Ancestor!" Luo Li exclaimed, jumping up in excitement. After landing, she grabbed Su Wanyi’s hand and started shaking it vigorously.
Looking at her lively junior sister, Su Wanyi pursed her lips, a happy smile appearing on her flawless, jade-like face.
The Big Black Cat beside them mustered its courage and asked, "Master, could I also learn a little bit?"
Ye Yun nodded.
Seeing the Master agree, the Big Black Cat was ecstatic but, fearing it might lose its composure, quickly tucked its head down, its body trembling slightly.
The Big Black Horse nearby grinned, showing its white teeth, thoroughly pleased.
Actually... this was what the Big Black Horse had wanted to say for a long time, but it didn’t have the courage. After all, it wasn’t as shameless as the Big Black Cat. However, thankfully, the Big Black Cat, with its thick skin, had voiced the question it was most concerned about, and the Master had nodded in agreement. So, the Big Black Horse was also extremely happy. It also wanted to learn the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye.
The Big Black Horse even started planning.
Once it learned this Divine Skill, it wouldn’t need to use low-level attacks like lightning bolts to kill people anymore. Just glaring at someone to make them die—wouldn’t that be incredibly satisfying?
The more the Big Black Horse thought about it, the more excited it became, and it couldn’t help but sneeze several times in a row.
「...」
"The Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye is divided into three parts: initial, intermediate, and advanced. The initial part is suitable for cultivators below the True God Realm to practice."
Ye Yun smiled faintly. From his mesmerizing pupils, several runes shimmering with rainbow light floated out, vanishing in mid-air before entering everyone’s minds.
"The initial part is divided into nine layers. You just need to diligently comprehend them in your daily practice..." Ye Yun said with a grin.
"Ancestor, if this technique is divided into initial, intermediate, and advanced parts, then... have you already cultivated it to the most advanced part?" Jun Moxiao asked, his face full of envy.
Ye Yun shook his head. "I have only completed the intermediate part of the technique. I am currently at the Great Achievement Realm."
"Ancestor, your cultivation base is already at the Divine Monarch Realm, yet you’ve only completed the intermediate part. Then the advanced part of the technique, when can one complete its cultivation?" Luo Li, ever outspoken, quickly asked from the side.
"Upon reaching the Divine King Realm, one can attain the absolute peak of the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye..." Ye Yun said with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 132: The Arrival of Red Dust Fairyland
chapters.content:
Chapter 132: Chapter 132: The Arrival of Red Dust Fairyland
The Divine King Realm?
Upon hearing the Ancestor’s words, the three young members of the Dragon God Sect were all shocked.
This realm sounds so powerful! Just how invincible must an absolute Divine King be in this world? I’m afraid that the Heavenly Dao of the Cangnan Continent can no longer accommodate it, right?
"The Divine King Realm..." The Big Black Cat was so shocked its jaw almost dropped to the ground.
It hadn’t expected that the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye would need to be cultivated to the Divine King Realm to reach its peak. It thought about it, realizing it was only at the Destiny Realm now. How long would it take to cultivate to the Divine King Realm?
The Big Black Cat seemed a bit disheartened.
But soon, it got excited again.
Although cultivation would be incredibly challenging, this also shows how extraordinarily terrifying the power of the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye is. As long as it continues to cultivate, there will always be a glimmer of hope.
The Big Black Horse, watching from a distance, was also tremendously shocked at this moment.
The Divine King Realm! Even as a great demon of the Eternal Realm, it dared not imagine such a realm. That realm is way too terrifying. Above the Eternal Realm is the True God Realm, the Divine Monarch Realm, and the Divine Sovereign Realm, and only then comes the Divine King Realm. It is also very far from the Divine King Realm. If it wants to cultivate to that realm, it has no idea if its current aptitude is sufficient.
"Ancestor, you are truly too powerful..." Luo Li stammered, having come back to her senses. She looked at the Ancestor’s handsome face, her eyes revealing an idolizing light of worship, a light densely filled with fanaticism!
At this moment, Jun Moxiao was also staring fixedly at the Ancestor, his blood boiling with excitement. The only one who remained relatively calm was Su Wanyi, but she too was breathing rapidly, her heart extremely unquiet.
With such a powerful Ancestor, the Dragon God Sect will surely stand at the pinnacle of the world!
"Alright, no need to be so astonished," Ye Yun said gently with a smile. "The path of cultivation is long and arduous. As long as you are willing to make an effort, you will all have the chance to go further on the Grand Dao. I will naturally support you for a while..."
At this moment, the flat square was already piled high with various heavenly materials, earthly treasures, and Cultivation Technique manuals.
With a light tap of his right hand, Ye Yun vanished into the carriage in a flash.
The three understood his meaning and began to divide these treasures and Cultivation Technique manuals. After all, the Ancestor had previously given them a task: the three of them were to fill three God-level storage rings completely. Therefore, the spoils of this battle were also divided evenly among them.
「Ten thousand li away from the Shen Heng Sect.」
A tall mountain range stretched for several thousand li. On its highest peak, there was a quasi-first-class Sect. This Sect was called the Red Flame Sword Sect. It was a relatively powerful Sect specializing in cultivating fire-attribute Swordsmanship and held some renown within the Shenfeng Dynasty.
About a hundred li south of the Red Flame Sword Sect, powerful and strange fluctuations suddenly emanated from the void. Everyone in the Red Flame Sword Sect, from the Disciples to the Sect Master and Supreme Elders, was shocked by these fluctuations.
"What happened over there?"
"Why are there such strange fluctuations?"
In an instant, dozens of Cultivators with powerful auras soared into the sky, gazing at the distant southern void.
The fluctuations from that void grew increasingly intense. Under everyone’s watchful eyes, a huge rift slowly tore open. This rift was crimson like blood, as if the very sky was bleeding.
WHOOSH!
A crimson pillar of light suddenly descended from the sky, striking the ground.
An indescribable bloody stench instantly spread from the crimson pillar, diffusing throughout the Red Flame Sword Sect in the span of a breath. In an instant, the experts of the Red Flame Sword Sect in mid-air all grunted; their vital blood roiled within them, making them extremely uncomfortable. However, that discomfort vanished within moments.
Staring at this bizarre celestial phenomenon, a Supreme Elder in a green robe fixed his eyes on it. After several tens of seconds, his face suddenly lit up with ecstasy.
"Senior Martial Uncle, what on earth is this?" the Sect Master of the Red Flame Sword Sect hurriedly asked.
"This is the Red Dust Fairyland..." The green-robed Supreme Elder was thrilled, his face flushed, and he began to dance with joy. "Haha! Who could have imagined that such a renowned Immortal Land Secret Realm on the Cangnan Continent would suddenly appear in the outer mountain ranges of our Red Flame Sword Sect? This is surely Heaven’s Will, decreeing the rise of our Red Flame Sword Sect!"
"Red Dust Fairyland?" The Sect Master of the Red Flame Sword Sect was taken aback. He knitted his brow and pondered for a moment, then suddenly, a vague piece of information surfaced in his mind. He was startled.
This Red Dust Fairyland is an extremely famous Secret Realm throughout the entire Cangnan Continent, specifically for Cultivators at the Shaping God Realm. Countless Blood Demons reside within this Red Dust Fairyland. Slaying Blood Demons and consuming their inner cores can rapidly increase one’s cultivation base. The Red Dust Fairyland has a mysterious origin, perennially hidden within turbulent void currents. No one knows where it will appear next, nor is there a fixed time for its appearance. However, each time it manifests, it can produce a large number of experts. Many talented young Cultivators at the Shaping God Realm enter the Red Dust Fairyland and emerge a month later with a cultivation base at the Divine Bridge Realm. The inner cores of the Blood Demons contain a peculiar, extremely pure energy, an unimaginable boon for Cultivators seeking to enhance their cultivation base. The Red Dust Fairyland is listed by countless experts on the Cangnan Continent as one of the Ten Great Immortal Land Secret Realms. It is an incredibly wondrous and magical place.
"Quick! Quick! It’s a rare occurrence for the Red Dust Fairyland to appear near our Red Flame Sword Sect! All Disciples at the Shaping God Realm, enter the Red Dust Fairyland immediately!" the green-robed Supreme Elder exclaimed, waving his hand impatiently.
They had to seize this initial opportunity, as the first wave in would face the least competition. This was because every time the Red Dust Fairyland appeared, many powerful factions from various places would send their disciples in. Although the Blood Demons inside were inexhaustible, the competition was also extremely fierce.
At his command, the thousands of Shaping God Realm Disciples of the Red Flame Sword Sect, led by the Supreme Elder and the Sect Master, immediately flew towards the crimson beam of light.
As they flew closer to the pillar of light, they looked upon the enormous crimson column descending from the massive, blood-red rift in the sky to the ground. Each of them felt an indescribable shock. This light pillar had a diameter of several hundred zhang. From a distance, it didn’t seem particularly striking, but up close, they discovered this heaven-reaching crimson pillar was as incredible as if crafted by gods and demons.
"So magnificent! This is the Red Dust Fairyland, appearing on the Cangnan Continent only once every few thousand years..." the green-robed Supreme Elder exclaimed, his expression fervent. He couldn’t resist reaching out to gently touch the enormous crimson pillar of light.
"AH!"
A powerful force fiercely repelled him from his fingertip. This Supreme Elder, at the Ninth Layer of the Nirvana Realm, was thrown back rapidly, spurting a mouthful of blood.
"Hahaha! So strong! Indeed, those above the Shaping God Realm cannot enter!" Though injured, the Supreme Elder was extremely excited. He waved his hand and shouted, "All Disciples of the Shaping God Realm, enter the Red Dust Fairyland swiftly and slay the Blood Demons!"
"Yes, Supreme Elder!"
All the Shaping God Realm Disciples of the Red Flame Sword Sect erupted in cheers. One by one, they soared into the air, transforming into streaks of sword light and flying into the towering crimson column. When these Shaping God Realm Disciples’ bodies entered the crimson light pillar, they met no resistance and vanished instantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 133: Secret Realm of the Immortal Land, Ancient Coffin
chapters.content:
Chapter 133: Chapter 133: Secret Realm of the Immortal Land, Ancient Coffin
The Red Dust Fairyland suddenly emerged from the chaotic streams of the void, casting down a crimson teleportation light pillar. The peculiar bloody aura emitted from this light pillar was like an unstoppable tide of destruction, soon permeating the entire Shenfeng Dynasty.
At this moment, countless powerful beings recognized the Red Dust Fairyland. This eerie bloody aura, spreading from the Shenfeng Dynasty to other regions, seemed poised to sweep across the entire continent.
Countless sects caught wind of this and rushed over at their fastest speed. The Red Dust Fairyland was known for its ephemeral appearances. They had to seize this opportunity to allow the Shaping God Realm Disciples within their sect to ascend in a single step, directly leapfrogging to the Divine Bridge Realm.
Moreover, some ancient sects even knew secrets unknown to others: Shaping divinity realm cultivators who hunted enough Blood Demons within the Red Dust Fairyland would be automatically teleported to a palace called the Blood Linglong Palace. Once inside, incredibly tempting opportunities awaited them.
Twenty thousand years ago, a Shaping God Realm cultivator had obtained an extremely ancient inheritance within the Blood Linglong Palace. Eventually, this person became a Life and Death Realm powerhouse, his name shaking the world.
「...」
Far away in the Shen Heng Sect, thousands of miles distant, Ye Yun had already noticed the signs from that location when an unusual fluctuation appeared in the void. He didn’t know about the Red Dust Fairyland, but he used his Divine Skills to extract some useful information from the memories of the Red Flame Sword Sect Elder. Ye Yun immediately became interested in this Red Dust Fairyland. This was because a hundred thousand years ago, there were no so-called Ten Great Immortal Lands on the Cangnan Continent; all of them had appeared later. And this Red Dust Fairyland was famous because it could quickly produce Divine Bridge Realm cultivators.
Ye Yun turned to Su Wanyi. Su Wanyi was currently at the Ninth Layer of the Phase of God and on the verge of breaking through to the Divine Bridge Realm.
Perhaps I should take this opportunity to let her gain some experience inside,
Ye Yun thought.
As for Jun Moxiao and Luo Li, Ye Yun also planned to suppress their cultivation bases to the Shaping God Realm to see if they too could gain some benefits inside.
As for the Qitian Sword Sect and Yu Mo Sect...
I’m bound to visit those two places sooner or later, so there’s no rush.
Now that the Shen Heng Sect, the strongest of the three major sects, had been wiped out by three juniors, those other two sects would eventually face disaster.
「Tens of seconds later.」
The bloody aura from the crimson light pillar marking the Red Dust Fairyland’s descent swept over to the Shen Heng Sect’s location.
"What is this?" Jun Moxiao struggled to breathe, looking in a certain direction with a bewildered expression on his face.
