"There’s a hint of a bloody scent that makes one feel a bit uncomfortable, but it’s quite faint," Luo Li muttered to herself.
While they were speaking, the three of them had already finished dividing all the natural treasures and secret cultivation manuals in the square.
"The Red Dust Fairyland has opened, follow me!" Ye Yun’s voice suddenly sounded in their ears.
Immediately after, the three vanished from their spot and appeared within the carriage’s interior.
The Big Black Cat, noticing the situation, quickly flew onto the carriage and lay down on it.
The Big Black Horse pulled the carriage, speeding towards the Red Dust Fairyland.
A distance of thousands of miles, for the Big Black Horse, was merely a journey of two or three breaths. However, Ye Yun didn’t let the Big Black Horse travel at full speed, as he explained some matters concerning the Red Dust Fairyland en route. Despite this, after the time it takes for an incense stick to burn, the Big Black Horse still pulled the carriage to the periphery of the crimson light pillar.
"Someone’s coming!" The Red Flame Sword Sect Elder suddenly saw a carriage rushing from the void, his pupils contracting slightly. He was actually unable to discern the Big Black Horse’s cultivation base. This meant that the individual inside the carriage also possessed a terrifyingly powerful cultivation base.
The Big Black Horse drew the carriage down to the ground, its eyes wide with interest as it observed the huge, crimson light pillar.
The carriage curtain was lifted, and Luo Li, Jun Moxiao, and Su Wanyi stepped out one after another, pausing momentarily.
Not too far away, the Supreme Elder of the Red Flame Sword Sect saw these three youths, all so handsome and strikingly beautiful, truly in their prime, and couldn’t help but exclaim, "Which power do these disciples belong to?"
"Go. Experiencing more tempering will be good for you." In their ears, the Old Ancestor’s voice resounded.
The three quickly bowed to the carriage in respect, then headed towards the nearby crimson light pillar.
Su Wanyi was the first to step inside, disappearing into the light pillar in an instant.
Luo Li was second. When her body touched the crimson light pillar, she was unexpectedly flung back by a powerful force. This surprised Jun Moxiao, who was standing nearby.
Luo Li executed the Dragon God Body Technique in mid-air and, with a swift movement, landed back on the ground. Her robust body ensured that she suffered no injuries.
"Why can’t I enter?" Luo Li frowned, looking at the crimson light pillar, her exquisite face showing confusion.
Interesting,
Ye Yun couldn’t help but smile slightly upon seeing this.
The Red Dust Fairyland indeed has its peculiarities; it actually identified the true cultivation realms of the two.
"You two young ones seem to be suppressing your cultivation bases," the Supreme Elder of the Red Flame Sword Sect said with a laugh. "If you want to enter the Red Dust Fairyland, you absolutely cannot suppress your cultivation, otherwise, you will be repelled."
"So that’s how it is!" Luo Li stomped her foot in vexation, her face showing some frustration.
Jun Moxiao approached her and said with a smile, "Senior Sister, if you can’t get in, then so be it. After all, Eldest Senior Sister has entered. When she comes out, she’ll be a Divine Bridge Realm cultivator."
"Alright!" Luo Li began to laugh. Since their Eldest Senior Sister had entered the Red Dust Fairyland to gain experience and break through to the Divine Bridge Realm, they were also delighted for her.
Ye Yun gazed at the Red Dust Fairyland, tiny star-like runes momentarily flickering within his profound eyes. He carefully studied the crimson light pillar for a few moments, then the corners of his mouth curled into a faint smile.
It wouldn’t be difficult to send Luo Li and Jun Moxiao into that Secret Realm within the Red Dust Fairyland,
Ye Yun mused.
But if I did, the two of them would cause this Secret Realm to collapse. I wouldn’t allow such a thing to happen. After all, the main purpose of this trip is Su Wanyi’s training. As long as she can swiftly advance to the Divine Bridge Realm, that will be enough.
Within Su Wanyi’s mind still resided a wisp of Ye Yun’s Divine Sense. This wisp of Divine Sense would help Su Wanyi overcome any crisis she couldn’t withstand.
"Then, you two should return and continue cultivating in the carriage..." Ye Yun said softly.
"Okay, Old Ancestor!" Luo Li became excited again. The Old Ancestor had just imparted to them a wondrous Pupil Technique Divine Power, and this period would be perfect for comprehending it.
The two returned to the carriage, where Ye Yun arranged for them to be in two separate spaces.
Seeing the two youngsters so eager to comprehend the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye, Ye Yun merely smiled faintly.
Everyone was young once,
he mused.
Wasn’t I the same in my youth?
「...」
「Within a certain Mystical Space in the Red Dust Fairyland.」
Blood energy permeated the air. Inside a vermillion Ancient Coffin, a woman’s voice suddenly echoed softly.
"Is this a hallucination? Why do I sense Ye Yun’s Super Divine Dragon Breath?"

chapters.title: Chapter 134: Seven-star Dragon Abyss Sword Slays Blood Demon
chapters.content:
Chapter 134: Chapter 134: Seven-star Dragon Abyss Sword Slays Blood Demon
After Su Wanyi entered the crimson light pillar of the Red Dust Fairyland, her vision blurred, and she was instantly transported to a desolate small world.
This desolate small world was awash in shades of deep red. A faint stench of blood permeated the air, and the earth was scarred with crisscrossing fissures. The distant mountains were also the same scarlet hue.
Not a single plant or animal could be found in this wasteland. It was extremely desolate, devoid of any trace that life had ever existed here.
Su Wanyi glanced behind her. The land was empty and vast, with not a single Human Cultivator in sight.
It appears that teleportation here is random; everyone ends up in different locations...
she thought to herself.
She was currently at the Ninth Layer of the Phase of God, still a minor and a major realm—two realms in total—away from the First Level of the Divine Bridge Realm.
Considering her current strength, she was definitely among the most powerful group of Shaping God Realm cultivators within the Red Dust Fairyland.
Su Wanyi drew her Seven-star Dragon Abyss Sword and cautiously advanced.
The Red Dust Fairyland teemed with numerous Blood Demons, but she had no idea what these creatures looked like.
She had only taken a dozen steps or so when, suddenly, a ball of blood-red light shot out from a fissure in the cracked earth, hurtling towards her. Su Wanyi’s heart lurched. Her cautious nature prompted her to instantly transform into a Divine Dragon Phantom, evading the ball of light.
She paused in mid-air, observing the ball of blood-red light. It landed on the ground, revealing itself to be nothing more than a lump of red soil. This lump of red soil, however, looked like congealed, dried blood.
Even from a distance, the thick stench of blood was overpowering.
Could the Blood Demons be hiding in these fissures?
Su Wanyi soared through the air, looking down from her vantage point at the fissures below.
The fissures were pitch-black, with no sign of movement within.
SWISH! SWISH!
Suddenly, two more balls of blood-red light flew out from a fissure behind her.
The two balls of blood-red light came whistling through the air, launching a sneak attack at Su Wanyi’s back.
Once again, Su Wanyi transformed into a Divine Dragon Phantom, swiftly dodging to the side to evade their attack.
WHOOSH!
One of the balls of blood-red light abruptly spun around in mid-air and shot towards Su Wanyi.
A crimson sword light flashed. Su Wanyi had split the ball of blood-red light in half with a single stroke. It fell from the sky, turning into two piles of bloody flesh.
They resembled red, rotting meat, writhing on the ground and emitting a thick, horrifying stench of blood.
This must be a Blood Demon, then? Its vitality is exceptionally tenacious!
Su Wanyi landed, her expression wary as she stared at the two lumps of red, rotting meat.
Each lump of rotting flesh was about a meter in diameter, and blood oozed from them incessantly.
Su Wanyi found it hard to believe that such repugnant Blood Demons could possess an inner core capable of allowing a Shaping God Realm cultivator like herself to rapidly advance her cultivation base.
The rotting flesh twitched for a few seconds before stopping, seemingly dead.
Blood Demons were known for their cunning Divine Nature, so Su Wanyi waited a while longer. Only when she was sure the Blood Demon had truly stopped moving did she slowly approach.
She approached cautiously, wary that the Blood Demon might suddenly lash out if she got too close.
When she reached the Blood Demon’s side, she confirmed it was indeed dead.
She breathed a sigh of relief.
Then, she used her sword to pry open one half of the Blood Demon’s corpse, searching for its inner core. It wasn’t in that half.
Su Wanyi moved to the other half and continued searching with her sword. After some probing, she finally located an inner core.
This crimson inner core was almond-sized, crystal clear, pure, and flawless, radiating a rich life force.
It was a stark contrast to the grotesque appearance of the Blood Demon.
Su Wanyi held the Blood Demon Inner Alchemy to her nose and sniffed gently. It had no particular smell. Instead, a refreshing sensation spread through her internal organs.
She placed the inner core in her mouth and swallowed it.
As soon as the inner core entered her body, it immediately transformed into pure energy, slightly increasing her cultivation base.
Feeling the advancement in her cultivation, an expression of delighted surprise appeared on Su Wanyi’s face.
Consuming a single Blood Demon Inner Alchemy was equivalent to ten days of her cultivation.
This Red Dust Fairyland...
It was said to be teeming with countless Blood Demons. If she killed more of them and consumed their inner cores, her cultivation base would surely soar like a rocket.
The magical property of the Blood Demon Inner Alchemy was that it had no upper limit and no side effects. No spiritual elixir in the world could compare to it.
Therefore, every time the Red Dust Fairyland manifested somewhere on the Cangnan Continent, it caused great turmoil.
Countless Sects would rush over at the earliest opportunity, sending all their Shaping God Realm Disciples inside.
After killing a Blood Demon, Su Wanyi’s confidence surged, and she headed towards the desolate mountain range ahead.
The place had no landmarks, and the sky held no sun, moon, or stars. She picked a direction and started walking, intending to see if there were Blood Demons in that area.
As she rounded a small hill, she saw a young man besieged by two beams of blood-red light.
This young man’s cultivation base was only at the Fifth Layer of Spirit Formation Realm. Facing the attacks of the two beams of blood-red light, he was already overwhelmed and defenseless.
Su Wanyi observed quietly for a few seconds.
She could sense the cultivation level of the entities within these two beams of blood-red light. She hadn’t had time to sense the cultivation of the Blood Demon she’d killed earlier due to the haste of the encounter.
Now, observing from a distance, she could tell that the two Blood Demons had cultivation at the Fourth Level of Sculpting God Realm.
Two Blood Demons at the Fourth Level of Sculpting God Realm could push a Human Cultivator into such a desperate situation. This demonstrated that Blood Demons were incredibly powerful.
"Fairy, please save me!"
The young man was in dire straits, but out of the corner of his eye, he spotted a beautiful woman in a golden robe and hurriedly ran in her direction. As he ran, he also gauged the woman’s cultivation base.
When he discovered her cultivation base was at the Ninth Layer of the Phase of God, his face instantly lit up with delighted surprise. With such a high cultivation level, killing those two Blood Demons would be a piece of cake for her.
The two Blood Demons, as two beams of blood-red light, pursued him relentlessly.
Without hesitation, Su Wanyi rushed forward. She swung her sword, and a blood-red arc of light flashed past. Instantly, a scream echoed.
One of the Blood Demons was immediately bisected.
The other Blood Demon, however, reacted with astonishing speed. It executed a one-hundred-and-eighty-degree turn in mid-air and dived into a fissure in the earth, vanishing in an instant.
"Thank you for saving me, Fairy!" The young man, still shaken, cupped his fists, his face etched with gratitude.
Although he seemed older than the young woman before him, his words were sweet.
Su Wanyi nodded indifferently, saying nothing. Her main objective was to kill Blood Demons; saving the young man was merely incidental.
The two severed halves of the slain Blood Demon wriggled a few times, then stilled completely, dead.
The young man stared, his eyes wide with disbelief at the scene. He had encountered only one Blood Demon before. At that time, his strength surpassed the Blood Demon’s, and he had once managed to cleave its body in two with a single sword strike. But, astonishingly, that Blood Demon had miraculously reformed.
He hadn’t expected that after this beautiful woman cut the Blood Demon’s body open with a single sword strike, the Blood Demon would struggle for a few moments and then die.
His puzzled gaze shifted to her blood-colored longsword.
What kind of sword is that?
Immense shock filled the young man’s eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 135: Big Black Cat Strikes Fiercely
chapters.content:
Chapter 135: Chapter 135: Big Black Cat Strikes Fiercely
This sword was entirely blood-red, with a few specks on its blade, giving off an extremely peculiar feeling.
This sword is absolutely extraordinary...
the young man thought.
The Blood Demon had no fixed body and possessed incredibly strong regenerative abilities. If it was not dismembered, it would reassemble itself.
However, the sword in this woman’s hand seemed to be the Blood Demon’s nemesis.
A glimmer of fervor flashed through the young man’s eyes, but he quickly lowered his head, concealing his emotion.
Su Wanyi rummaged through the Blood Demon’s corpse, found an inner core, and swallowed it directly.
Her Super Divine Dragon Breath grew stronger once again.
Su Wanyi glanced around and noticed that the Blood Demon that had escaped did not attack her again.
This Blood Demon was extremely cunning. Unless Su Wanyi initiated an attack, she was not going to enter the fissure in the ground to find it. After all, the fissure was narrow and pitch-black, its depth unknown. It was not a place fit for humans.
Su Wanyi remained silent, ignoring the young man. After all, they were strangers who had met by chance, and she had no desire to interact with him.
With a flicker, Su Wanyi moved swiftly forward.
The young man stood in place for a long while, cautiously watching his surroundings. There was still a Blood Demon underground that might suddenly attack him.
After waiting for a moment, the Blood Demon did not appear.
He then took out a new storage ring and collected the two halves of the dead Blood Demon’s corpse.
The Red Dust Fairyland was vast, and many people from his Red Flame Sword Sect had also entered. Sooner or later, he would have the chance to encounter fellow sect members. By then, these two halves of the Blood Demon’s corpse would prove the extraordinary nature of that red sword.
Greed flickered in the young man’s heart.
「...」
The crimson beam of light, piercing the heavens and the earth, was a shocking sight.
The Supreme Elder of the Red Flame Sword Sect was currently seated on a huge rock, awaiting the triumphant return of the sect’s disciples. As for the black carriage not far away, he did not dare to even glance in its direction. He knew that he absolutely could not afford to offend the owner of that carriage.
The Big Black Horse currently had its eyes closed, digesting the symbol in its mind. This vibrant symbol contained the cultivation method for the first part of the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye. As an expert of the Eternity Realm, the Big Black Horse also coveted this Divine Skill. Taking advantage of the current lull, it secretly began to comprehend and cultivate it.
The Big Black Cat lay on the carriage, its head tucked into its belly, also secretly comprehending and cultivating.
Ye Yun observed how dedicated both the cat and the horse were, as well as the two juniors in the carriage, all intently comprehending the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye. He could not help but smile faintly. This Divine Skill, although dazzling, was just that to him. His repository held countless Great Divine Powers. Ye Yun reckoned he would never be able to comprehend them all in his lifetime. Fortunately, he was currently invincible and had ample time. When bored, he could amuse himself by comprehending these cultivation methods.
About half an incense stick’s worth of time had passed since Su Wanyi had entered the Red Dust Fairyland when, suddenly, a huge golden magic boat tore through the air from a distance with an overwhelming presence. As it neared the crimson beam of light, it abruptly stopped.
"The Qitian Sword Sect has arrived!"
The Supreme Elder of the Red Flame Sword Sect gazed at the golden magic boat with its distinctive emblem, his pupils constricting slightly. The Qitian Sword Sect was a major sect, one of the three great sects of the Shenfeng Dynasty, and its strength far exceeded that of the Red Flame Sword Sect. On the golden magic boat were several thousand disciples at the Shaping God Realm.
Aboard the golden magic boat, Du Yu, the Sect Master of the Qitian Sword Sect, looked at the crimson beam of light, his eyes filled with wild joy.
The Red Dust Fairyland... has unexpectedly appeared in the Shenfeng Dynasty! This is a heaven-sent opportunity! It provides our Qitian Sword Sect with an excellent chance to rapidly enhance our disciples’ cultivation bases! I must seize this chance before anyone else!
"All disciples, enter the Red Dust Fairyland immediately!" Du Yu commanded excitedly with a wave of his hand.
WHOOSH! WHOOSH! Numerous sword lights soared into the sky, flying towards the crimson beam before vanishing.
Now, only Du Yu and a sect Elder remained on the entire magic boat. The Elder piloting the golden magic boat descended from mid-air.
"The Yu Mo Sect hasn’t arrived, nor has the Shen Heng Sect. This Red Flame Sword Sect merely lucked out!" Du Yu chuckled casually, his hands behind his back.
By rights, the Shen Heng Sect, being the closest, should have arrived first. However, I didn’t expect our Qitian Sword Sect to be the first on the scene. As for the Red Flame Sword Sect, they are beneath my notice.
Du Yu knew that if they seized this opportunity, their sect’s overall strength could ascend to a new level. After all, the other major powers were still en route to the Shenfeng Dynasty. His disciples had a window of opportunity.
"Red Flame Sword Sect, clear out! This place is ours now!" the Qitian Sword Sect Elder piloting the golden magic boat roared when they were several tens of feet from the ground, glaring at the Red Flame Sword Sect’s Supreme Elder.
"There’s a first-come, first-served basis for everything, isn’t there? This is clearly our Red Flame Sword Sect’s territory!" the Supreme Elder of the Red Flame Sword Sect shouted towards the sky, his face flushed crimson.
The Sect Master of the Red Flame Sword Sect standing beside him also wore an aggrieved expression.
The Qitian Sword Sect is too tyrannical! Do these two think they can just land their golden magic boat here and claim this entire area?
"Insignificant Red Flame Sword Sect, what qualifications do you have to be compared with my Qitian Sword Sect? Scram, or don’t blame me for taking action!" Du Yu declared coldly from the prow of the boat, his gaze indifferent and his expression icy.
"You..." The Supreme Elder and Sect Master of the Red Flame Sword Sect flushed a ghastly crimson, their shoulders heaving violently, their emotions in turmoil. Nevertheless, the two still flew to the side.
The Qitian Sword Sect... we truly cannot afford to offend them.
Now that they had finally made it to the opening of the Red Dust Fairyland, and all their disciples had already entered for training, they could not afford to provoke such a powerful enemy as the Qitian Sword Sect during this prime opportunity. Otherwise, this entire training expedition would be wasted.
Watching the two from the Red Flame Sword Sect fly away dejectedly, a smirk touched Du Yu’s lips. As a major sect, apart from the Shen Heng Sect and the Yu Mo Sect, no one else dared to offend their Qitian Sword Sect. If anyone dared to offend them, they would be killed outright!
"Whose carriage is that? Get it out of here at once, or don’t blame this old man for being discourteous!" the Qitian Sword Sect Elder roared irritably upon spotting a black carriage conspicuously parked on the ground.
Hmm? The Big Black Horse suddenly opened its eyes, blinking several times as if still savoring the little human’s words.
The Big Black Cat stood up, all traces of laziness vanishing from its demeanor.
"Uncle Ma, shall I take care of them?" the Big Black Cat volunteered, looking eager and ready for a fight. It was now a Destiny Realm Level 3 great demon; dealing with two Nirvana Realm cultivators was child’s play for it.
The Big Black Horse scanned the surroundings, noticing several other groups rapidly approaching. Then it grinned, baring its teeth. "Make it quick!"
"Alright!"
With Uncle Ma’s approval, the Big Black Cat, with a SWISH, transformed into a streak of black light and shot into mid-air. A colossal, mountain-like black shadow instantly loomed over the golden magic boat.
"It’s a Nine-tailed Spirit Cat!"
"A Destiny Realm Level 3 Great Demon!"
Atop the golden magic boat, Du Yu and the sect Elder saw this immense shadow and immediately turned deathly pale, trembling like leaves in the wind.
WHOOSH! The Big Black Cat stretched out its paw, swiping down from the air. The very air trembled, and under the Big Black Cat’s massive paw, Du Yu and the Elder were frozen in place, unable to move a muscle.
SPLAT! With a sickening sound, the two men exploded into clouds of blood mist.
WHOOSH! The Big Black Cat opened its cavernous, blood-stained mouth and, with a gentle inhalation, sucked the two clouds of blood mist into it.
It smacked its lips and chuckled. "Truly disgusting!"
Witnessing the mountain-sized Destiny Realm Great Demon acting so savagely in the sky above, the Sect Master and Supreme Elder of the Red Flame Sword Sect were overcome with such terror that they fainted dead away on the spot.

chapters.title: Chapter 136: Uncle Ma, please spare my life
chapters.content:
Chapter 136: Chapter 136: Uncle Ma, please spare my life
"Haha!"
The Big Black Cat watched as the two Human Cultivators were scared senseless by him. He was filled with pride, his large black eyes sparkling, and all five of his fluffy tails perked up.
A Destiny Realm Great Demon truly is badass! Cultivators at the Nirvana Tenth Level are scared unconscious by me! This would have been absolutely impossible before.
"You damn cat... get down here!" the Big Black Horse grumbled.
Ever since this cat had advanced to the Destiny Realm Third Layer, his confidence had skyrocketed. He was always trying to show off, thinking he was superior to others. This behavior irked Uncle Ma.
I’m a Great Demon of the Eternal Realm, yet I remain so low-key. This Little Cat, merely at the Destiny Realm, is already getting so arrogant he thinks he can touch the skies! He needs some serious discipline!
So, after the Big Black Horse cursed, a bolt of lightning descended instantly.
ZAP!
This lightning bolt zapped the Big Black Cat until he was crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, and he lost another large patch of fur.
"OUCH!" The Big Black Cat was scared out of his wits. He immediately transformed into a streak of black light and returned to the carriage, where he knelt, clasping his paws together and repeatedly kowtowing. "Uncle Ma, please spare me..."
"Do you know what mistake you made?" the Big Black Horse asked, turning his head and baring his teeth.
"You... Your Lordship wanted a swift conclusion, and I was a bit slow," the Big Black Cat replied in a low voice, his eyes darting around.
"Bullshit!"
The Big Black Horse’s tail came crashing down like a mountain, flattening the cowering Big Black Cat on the carriage into a meat patty.
The Big Black Cat struggled painfully. Having been disciplined by Uncle Ma once again, he was on the verge of tears.
The Big Black Horse bared his teeth and said coldly, "Don’t be so high-profile in the future. You’re only at the Destiny Realm Third Layer; that’s nothing. Have you forgotten about the Master’s warehouse..."
He deliberately let out a few cold laughs at this point.
Remembering the tragic experiences in the warehouse, the Big Black Cat felt a cold dread and almost wet himself. He quickly kowtowed and begged, "Uncle Ma, I was wrong! I’ll never do it again! Please forgive me! Please, Your Lordship, let me off this time!"
"Little Cat, I hope you truly understand your mistake. If this happens again, Uncle Ma won’t let you off so easily!"
With that stern threat, the Big Black Horse turned away.
His gaze returned to the golden Magic Boat floating in mid-air.
This Magic Boat is quite good. I must keep it for the Young Master.
The Big Black Horse opened his mouth. A ray of light shot out, wrapped around the golden Magic Boat, and caused it to shrink rapidly before he swallowed it. Afterward, he closed his eyes again and resumed cultivating his Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye.
The Big Black Cat, seeing that Uncle Ma had finally calmed down, cautiously got up. He released his Divine Sense and scanned the surroundings. Seeing Magic Boats constantly streaking through the air from afar, he too said nothing, closed his eyes, and began to cultivate.
At this moment, the unconscious Supreme Elder and Sect Master of the Red Flame Sword Sect both regained consciousness.
The Supreme Elder looked at the Big Black Cat lying on the carriage and swallowed nervously. He hadn’t paid much attention to this Little Black Cat earlier. He’d never imagined it would turn out to be a Destiny Realm Third Layer Great Demon!
Truly terrifying!
Next, he turned his gaze to the ordinary-looking Big Black Horse, examining him from head to hoof. The shock in his heart grew even stronger.
If a mere cat is so powerful, this Big Black Horse must be even more terrifying.
He quickly signaled to the Sect Master. The two of them leaped into the air, putting distance between themselves and the black horse-drawn carriage.
Just then, a black Magic Boat flew over. Onboard were all members of the Yu Mo Sect.
"Go!"
As they drew near, the Sect Master of the Yu Mo Sect waved his hand. All his Shaping God Realm Disciples swarmed towards the crimson pillar of light like locusts, disappearing in the blink of an eye.
Soon after, several more Magic Boats of different colors flew over, and many more Shaping God Realm Cultivators entered. These Magic Boats were mostly led by their respective Sect Masters.
When these Sect Masters saw the Sect Master of the Yu Mo Sect, they hurriedly clasped their fists in salute and greeted him. The Sect Master of the Yu Mo Sect stood with his hands behind his back and merely nodded indifferently.
He scanned the surroundings, searching for any sign of the other two major sects, but he was disappointed. Neither the Shen Heng Sect nor the Qitian Sword Sect, the two major sects located closer to this area, had appeared. He found this very strange.
Could it be that those sects sent their disciples in and then immediately returned?
After some thought, he steered his Magic Boat to land on a distant mountain peak.
I’ll wait here for a while and see when the other two major sects arrive. As for the valley, I didn’t even consider it; the terrain is too low. I prefer the mountaintop, the feeling of looking down on all the other peaks.
Only half an incense stick’s worth of time passed before a golden, dragon-shaped Magic Boat swiftly flew over.
The Sect Master of the Yu Mo Sect looked at this Magic Boat, his expression tinged with surprise. The Tian Heng Sect of the Heavenly Star Dynasty had arrived.
The Tian Heng Sect was also led by a Deputy Sect Master and had brought nearly 10,000 Shaping God Realm Disciples. Witnessing the profound heritage of the Tian Heng Sect, having brought so many people, the Sect Master of the Yu Mo Sect couldn’t help but sigh.
Although both were considered major sects, the major sects of the Shenfeng Dynasty were merely of the Inferior grade. Major sects were also divided into different grades: Supreme, Superior, Medium, and Inferior. The Tian Heng Sect of the Heavenly Star Dynasty had already reached the Medium grade, a full grade higher than theirs.
After all their disciples had entered the Red Dust Fairyland, the Sect Master of the Tian Heng Sect steered their Magic Boat to a distant mountaintop to land.
"Sect Master, why aren’t we staying near the Red Dust Fairyland?" an Elder beside him asked in a low voice.
The Sect Master of the Tian Heng Sect smiled faintly and said, "The appearance of the Red Dust Fairyland this time isn’t just for disciples from our Heavenly Star Dynasty. Stronger forces will also be entering. Therefore, our small major sect is truly insignificant."
"Are you saying... Super Sects and Sky-Level Sects will also send disciples here?" the Elder asked, his face a mask of shock.
"Yes, Super Sects will definitely send people. Sky-Level Sects will likely do the same. Perhaps... even an Eternal Sect might appear?" the Sect Master replied with a smile.
The Elder was aghast, cold sweat beading on his forehead.
Super Sects and Sky-Level Sects are already terrifying enough. If an Eternal Sect were to arrive, our little Tian Heng Sect would truly be nothing in comparison.
The two of them stored their Magic Boat, then found two rocks on the mountaintop to sit on. They closed their eyes and began to cultivate, waiting quietly.
Just as expected, one powerful group after another came rushing from all directions, sending their disciples into the Red Dust Fairyland.
"This is too terrifying! Let’s return to our Sect first. This place... isn’t for the likes of us!"
The Supreme Elder of the Red Flame Sword Sect saw one formidable sect after another appearing, and his heart grew increasingly terrified. He grabbed his Sect Master, and they hastily flew back.
In any case, the mountain gate of the Red Flame Sword Sect isn’t far from the entrance to the Red Dust Fairyland. When those disciples eventually emerge, they can fly back to the Sect themselves. Staying here is too oppressive for us. We might accidentally offend some powerful figure and face dire consequences we can’t handle.
On the valley floor, only a solitary black carriage remained. Quite a few people had already landed on the surrounding mountain peaks.
Suddenly, a brilliant pillar of light appeared in the sky, descending like a keen sword. Intense fluctuations rippled through the void. At this moment, a stir of shock went through the onlookers.
"Could it be... a Super Sect is arriving?"
A Sect Master from one of the major sects murmured, his eyes wide with terror and astonishment as he gazed at the terrifying celestial phenomenon caused by the immense pillar of light.

chapters.title: Chapter 137: Void Throw, Super Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 137: Chapter 137: Void Throw, Super Sect
On the Cangnan Continent, Sects were divided into Ordinary Sects, Major Sects, Super Sects, Sky-Level Sects, and Eternal Sects.
Currently, a multitude of forces had arrived in the Red Dust Fairyland. Most of them were concentrated around the Major Sects; Super Sects had yet to appear. However, the emergence of Super Sects was merely a matter of time, as no one wanted to miss such a crucial opportunity. Regarding Super Sects, even some of the weaker Major Sects didn’t fully understand them. Only Superior Major Sects might possess some knowledge about Super Sects. Super Sects were garrisoned by Life-Death Realm Powerhouses and possessed overwhelming strength; even several Supreme Major Sects combined could not compare.
"Sect Master, is this Void Throw?" a Cultivator from a Major Sect exclaimed, his heart trembling as he observed the brilliant radiance and sensed the terrifying fluctuations in the void.
"Exactly! That is Void Throw! Only Super Sects possess such a powerful technique!" The Sect Master’s eyes widened as he gazed at the distant pillar of light, his face filled with fervor. Even though he was the Sect Master of a Major Sect, this was the first time he had witnessed Void Throw. After all, for a Super Sect to utilize such a Void Throw, the resources consumed would be unimaginable.
Under the watchful eyes of the crowd, the brilliant light finally dissipated, and tens of thousands of figures materialized out of thin air.
"So many people!" The surrounding Sect Masters who were observing all gasped.
As expected of a Super Sect! The number of Shaping God Realm Disciples they transported via Void Throw reached tens of thousands—truly terrifying.
WHOOSH! WHOOSH!
Streaks of sword light soared as all tens of thousands of Shaping God Realm Disciples were projected into the crimson pillar of light.
Only a white-robed old man remained in the void. The keen-eyed old man stood suspended there, hands clasped behind his back. As he surveyed his surroundings, a slight tremor ran through him, and in that instant, he released his cultivation presence.
Instantly, an immense pressure, like heavenly might descending, bore down on everyone, making it difficult for them to breathe.
"A Life-Death Realm powerhouse!"
Seeing the old man reveal his cultivation level, everyone present bowed deeply, expressing their profound admiration.
The white-robed old man nodded indifferently, retracted his aura, and in a flash, appeared on a mountaintop. He sat down cross-legged and closed his eyes to meditate.
"
Hmph, just a Life-Death Realm cultivator? He’s far too inferior compared to my Uncle Ma!
" the Big Black Cat licked its lips, glancing in a certain direction, and muttered disdainfully.
The Big Black Horse grinned.
That flattery was perfectly timed, making it feel extremely satisfied. A Life-Death Realm cultivator was indeed nothing in its eyes. Besides, that fellow was merely at the First Level of the Life and Death Realm; to it, he was just an ant. Such an insignificant character, in the eyes of the Master, probably wouldn’t even qualify as an ant.
"Little Cat, you’re getting better and better at talking. Uncle Ma is quite fond of you," the Big Black Horse turned its head and chuckled.
The Big Black Cat gave an embarrassed smile.
It had deliberately flattered Uncle Ma. Though it was rather blatant, it was also the truth. Uncle Ma was an Eternal Realm Great Demon, after all. Naturally, that insignificant Life-Death Realm cultivator couldn’t compare.
The Big Black Horse turned its head away and closed its eyes again.
It didn’t care if any Super Sects came or not, as long as they didn’t provoke it. It needed to seize the time to comprehend the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye and strive for some initial success soon.
The Big Black Cat also retracted its aura and began to meditate on the carriage, and the entire carriage became exceedingly quiet.
"That carriage is quite strange. It’s been motionless beneath the Red Dust Fairyland’s teleportation pillar of light all this time. I wonder which force it belongs to..." a Cultivator from a Major Sect muttered to himself from a distance. They had all arrived via Magic Boats after the Big Black Cat had slain the Sect Master of the Qitian Sword Sect, so they hadn’t witnessed that earlier scene. Consequently, these newcomers knew nothing about the Big Black Cat.
Another Sect Master remarked with a casual laugh, "That carriage looks unremarkable, just an ordinary black horse, with a large black cat lounging on it. I wonder about the origins of the master inside the carriage?"
"Yes, it is rather peculiar..." That Cultivator nodded. He stared at the black carriage, extended his Divine Sense to investigate, and then exclaimed in shock, "There’s actually no one in the carriage!"
"No way!" That Sect Master also immediately investigated, his face mirroring the same shocked expression.
An empty carriage. Where had its owner gone? Could it be that they also entered the Red Dust Fairyland to train?
This thought actually made the situation seem quite ordinary. A Shaping God Realm cultivator arriving in an ordinary carriage and entering the Red Dust Fairyland just as it opened—there was nothing particularly startling about that.
Almost at that very moment, many people came to this conclusion and stopped paying attention to the black carriage.
Silence descended upon the surrounding mountains once more.
BOOM...
Once again, intense fluctuations emanated from the void. This time, seven or eight pillars of light shot down consecutively from the sky. The initially quiet surroundings erupted into a clamor once more.
"So many Super Sects have arrived! The allure of the Red Dust Fairyland is truly immense!" The cultivators stared at those dazzling pillars of light, their eyes filled with awe. The celestial phenomenon produced by this supreme method of Void Throw was simply too astounding.
Transporting tens of thousands of people from locations so distant they spanned hundreds of thousands, even millions, of units, all the way to the Shenfeng Dynasty—such a method was truly heaven-defying. This kind of one-way transportation, delivering tens of thousands of individuals at once, was something only Super Sects could achieve.
The dazzling pillars of light extinguished one after another, and hundreds of thousands of figures appeared in mid-air. The leader of each contingent was a Life-Death Realm powerhouse. They exchanged glances, nodded slightly, and then with a wave of their hands, all the Shaping God Realm Disciples from their sects surged towards the crimson pillar of light, vanishing in an instant.
These seven or eight Life-Death Realm powerhouses surveyed their surroundings before flying off towards different mountaintops.
However, one middle-aged Life-Death Realm cultivator, his hands clasped behind his back, let his indifferent gaze fall upon the black carriage.
That spot is quiet, and there’s even a carriage I can use to rest. Since the carriage is empty anyway, I’ll just go inside and rest.
With a leisurely expression, he slowly descended from mid-air.
When the Sect Masters of the nearby Major Sects saw that the Life-Death Realm powerhouse was descending from the void towards the black carriage, they couldn’t help but smirk.
Life-Death Realm powerhouses are indeed willful, ignoring any rules...
The Big Black Horse turned its head, baring its teeth in a grin at the Big Black Cat. "Little Cat, get up and greet our guest! Someone’s trying to snatch the Master’s carriage!"
"Coming!" The Big Black Cat jolted to its feet. It stared blankly at the middle-aged Life-Death Realm expert slowly drifting down from the sky, its entire body beginning to tremble.
Uncle Ma is too cruel! He actually expects me, a mere little demon at the Heavenly Order Realm Third Layer, to face a great cultivator at the First Level of the Life and Death Realm! Can I even win?

chapters.title: Chapter 138: Don’t Be Afraid, I, Uncle Ma, Don’t Eat People
chapters.content:
Chapter 138: Chapter 138: Don’t Be Afraid, I, Uncle Ma, Don’t Eat People
The Big Black Cat shivered.
Although afraid deep down, it knew that it couldn’t show a hint of cowardice in front of Uncle Ma right now.
Especially when its Master... was still watching from inside the carriage!
Even if it couldn’t win, it had to project an imposing aura.
With a sudden boost of courage, it shook its body, leaped majestically from the carriage into the air, and intercepted the middle-aged Life and Death Realm cultivator.
"A mere little demon at the Third Layer of the Destiny Realm dares to block my path?"
The middle-aged cultivator stood with his hands behind his back, looking disdainfully at the Big Black Cat, a hint of derision in his eyes.
It seems the owner of this black carriage is somewhat significant.
At worst, he was a Disciple of Heaven’s Pride from a Super Sect, thus able to possess a Demonic Pet of the Destiny Realm.
"Stop right there, or Old Cat will never let you off easy!" the Big Black Cat roared furiously.
With a flourish, its true form, a figure as large as a small hill, materialized in mid-air.
In front of it, a black shield appeared. This Black Shield glowed with a black sheen and exuded an extremely ancient and mysterious aura.
To bolster its courage, the Big Black Cat also brought out the Black Shield Uncle Ma had given it.
"Well, now this is a fine treasure."
The middle-aged Life and Death Realm cultivator raised an eyebrow at the sight of the Black Shield, admiration lighting up his eyes. He scrutinized it repeatedly, and eventually, a fervent desire ignited in his eyes.
WHOOSH! WHOOSH!
Suddenly, several figures emerged from the void behind them.
They were Life-Death Realm Powerhouses from other Super Sects. They all stared fervently at the Black Shield, unconcealed greed in their eyes.
The middle-aged cultivator turned and said coldly, "What, are you all going to contend with me for this shield?"
"Treasures in this world go to those destined to have them," an elderly Life and Death Realm cultivator stated plainly.
Another Life and Death Realm cultivator clenched his fist and laughed heartily, saying, "Let’s settle it with our skills! Whoever has the ability will take this Black Shield."
"So be it." The middle-aged cultivator nodded indifferently.
This Black Shield’s quality is extremely high, at least Emperor Level. How could Life-Death Realm Powerhouses not be tempted by it?
The Big Black Cat chuckled, gloating, "You guys hurry up and fight. Then you can face Old Cat!"
It fervently hoped these cultivators would fight, allowing it to reap the rewards like an opportunistic fisherman. Of course, its wishful thinking might not pan out, but the Big Black Cat was still happy to see them squabble. After all, it had Uncle Ma backing it up. With an Eternal Realm Great Demon as its backer, it definitely had the courage to deal with these Life-Death Realm cultivators.
「Inside the carriage.」
Ye Yun’s calm gaze swept over these human cultivators of the Life and Death Realm. His eyes held a contemplative look.
These Life-Death Realm Powerhouses from Super Sects will be training targets for the Dragon God Sect’s younger Disciples in the future. I can’t let them perish here prematurely.
Instantly, he sent a Divine Thought to the Big Black Horse.
"Master, rest assured. I’ll handle this!" the Big Black Horse replied solemnly.
It transformed into a streak of black light, soared into the sky, and entered the void where the Life-Death Realm cultivators were about to clash.
The Life-Death Realm Powerhouses looked with slight surprise at this ordinary-looking Black Horse that suddenly soared into the sky. But the next moment, they were horrified to discover that this Black Horse was emitting a powerful pressure that even they couldn’t resist.
"An Eternal Realm Great Demon?" The elderly Life and Death Realm cultivator’s lips trembled as he stammered.
"Eternal Realm..." The other Life-Death Realm Powerhouses also turned pale.
At this moment, it felt as if death was about to descend upon them.
Before an Eternal Realm Great Demon, cultivators like them, merely at the First Level or Second Level of the Life and Death Realm, were completely outmatched. They could be said to be as insignificant as ants.
The Big Black Horse smacked its thick lips, revealed a mouthful of large white teeth, and said amiably with a wide smile, "Hehe! Don’t be afraid, you little ones. I, Uncle Ma, don’t eat people. Besides, the Human Race and demonkind have always coexisted peacefully, each keeping to their own. I won’t eat you!"
It gave off an extremely friendly vibe.
The Big Black Horse faithfully remembered its Master’s instructions to spare these cultivators, as they were to be training partners for the Young Masters later. To avoid scaring these young Life and Death Realm cultivators, he had to put on a ’sincere and kind’ face.
"Thank you, Senior!" The Life-Death Realm Powerhouses let out a long sigh of relief, cupping their fists with respectful expressions.
"Go back," the Big Black Horse smacked its lips and said. At the same time, it retracted the isolation Formation it had laid out around them. Its release of the Eternal Realm aura had even concealed their entire interaction. No one in the surroundings knew what had transpired.
The Life-Death Realm Powerhouses evidently understood this. They turned and returned to their respective mountaintops, sitting down.
The false alarm thus ended.
The cultivators from the various large Sects watching from afar were all dumbfounded, their expressions utterly confused.
Why... after that Black Horse flew into mid-air, did those Life and Death Realm cultivators all turn back? Could the owner of this carriage also belong to an incredibly powerful faction? To make Life-Death Realm Powerhouses retreat, they must also be a Super Sect.
Everyone was puzzled, but no one dared to question those Life-Death Realm Powerhouses. However, they could see that the Big Black Cat was at the Third Layer of the Destiny Realm. To have such a Demonic Pet implied that the carriage owner’s strength was also definitely profound.
PHEW...
The Big Black Cat sighed in relief seeing the crisis averted. It recalled its Black Shield, transformed back into a Little Black Cat, and returned to the carriage.
Having completed the task entrusted by its Master, the Big Black Horse glanced around, chuckled smugly, and descended with an air of triumph.
「Half an incense stick’s burning time later.」
BOOM...
Violent tremors once again emanated from the void.
One after another, dazzling beams of light descended from the sky, creating an incredibly shocking visual impact.
This time, over a dozen brilliant pillars of light appeared!
This meant... at least a dozen more Super Sects had arrived in the Shenfeng Dynasty.
The Sect Masters of those large Sects all held their breath, not daring to even exhale.
As more and more powerhouses arrived, their own sense of presence diminished.
As the lights faded, dense throngs of cultivators appeared in mid-air. These were all Disciples of the Super Sects.
Each Sect had brought tens of thousands of Disciples at the Shaping God Realm to participate in the trials of the Red Dust Fairyland.
After the Disciples under their command vanished into the crimson pillars of light, the leading Life-Death Realm Powerhouses surveyed their surroundings. They noted that everyone else was calmly stationed on the nearby mountaintops. Nodding slightly, they too found an empty spot on a mountaintop and landed.
As for the area beneath the crimson pillars of light, no one went there. After all, many Life-Death Realm Powerhouses were already stationed around, and it seemed an unspoken rule had formed. Thus, these later-arriving Super Sect Life-Death Realm Powerhouses also tacitly abided by it.
Over the next two days, many more forces from Super Sects arrived. One after another, brilliant pillars of light descended from the sky, illuminating the entire Shenfeng Dynasty. The scene was magnificent and vast.
The Supreme Elder and Sect Master of the Red Flame Sword Sect watched these pillars of light descend, their hearts filled with an indescribable shock and unease.

chapters.title: Chapter 139: The Arrival of the Sky-Level Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 139: Chapter 139: The Arrival of the Sky-Level Sect
"Martial Uncle, it’s hard to believe so many Super Sects are here, along with Life-Death Realm Powerhouses. It’s truly terrifying!"
The Sect Master of the Red Flame Sword Sect peered into the distance, his face pale, uttering these words with a palpable sense of lingering fear.
At this moment, the two stood atop the highest peak of the Red Flame Sword Sect, gazing at the radiant pillars of light cast down from the heavens. Their hearts were filled with both awe and dread.
Facing these formidable Super Sects, they felt utterly insignificant, like mere ants.
"To be fortunate enough to witness these stalwarts from the Super Sects in my lifetime... even death would hold no regrets..." The Supreme Elder’s face was somber as he spoke, a deep sigh escaping his lips.
While the Red Flame Sword Sect held a modest reputation within the Shenfeng Dynasty, they were insignificant in the grand scheme of the Cangnan Continent. Normally, he would never have the chance to witness Powerhouses of the Life-Death Realm. But the emergence of the Red Dust Fairyland this time had allowed him to witness such a vast number of Life-Death Realm powerhouses from the Super Sects. This was indeed an honor.
"Master, it seems that no Sky-Level Sects have arrived yet..." the Sect Master of the Red Flame Sword Sect blinked as he spoke.
"By rights... they might come. Let’s wait patiently. After all, they are very far from here. Even a Void Throw would consume an enormous amount of resources and require time to prepare..." the Supreme Elder responded, smiling.
No sooner had he finished speaking—
BOOM!
A thunderous noise echoed from deep within the void, as if something colossal were about to emerge.
Then, a rift formed in the void, and an incredibly dazzling pillar of light descended from the heavens.
At this moment, even the sun, moon, and stars seemed to lose their radiance.
"Is this...?"
Their eyes widened, and their breath hitched in their throats. The pillar of light before them was far larger than those from the Super Sects. Could it be... a Sky-Level Sect had arrived?
It wasn’t just them; at this moment, all cultivators in the surrounding mountains, including the Life-Death Realm cultivators from the Super Sects, opened their eyes wide, staring intently at the magnificent, radiant pillar of light.
"The Sky-Level Sect has arrived!"
Just then, a Life-Death Realm cultivator suddenly stood up, murmuring to himself.
Although Super Sects dominated their own territories, they were insignificant compared to Sky-Level Sects. There was simply no comparison.
With the light fading, nearly 100,000 figures, vast and imposing, appeared suspended in mid-air.
All eyes were drawn to that point in the void, expressions of shock etched on their faces.
Indeed, it was a Sky-Level Sect. This time, they had brought nearly 10,000 Shaping God Realm Disciples!
Truly terrifying! Transporting so many people via a single Void Throw made it difficult to fathom the true depth of a Sky-Level Sect’s foundations!
"Such power! There’s even a great cultivator at the Peak of ten layers of life-death realm, a Half-Step Eternity Realm Cultivator..."
A Life-Death Realm cultivator turned pale instantly after sensing the cultivation base and Super Divine Dragon Breath of the terrifying figure in the void.
"The strength of Sky-Level Sects is indeed formidable. Rumor has it that an Eternal Realm Strong Person presides there..." a Life-Death Realm cultivator whispered, his eyes aflame with fervor.
On the Cangnan Continent, Major Sects and Super Sects were divided into four tiers: Peak, Superior, Medium Grade, and Inferior. However, above Sky-Level, including Eternal Level, there were no such subdivisions. The Sky Level was simply the Sky Level, and the Eternal Level was the Eternal Level. Both were unique classifications in their own right. This was why Sky-Level and Eternal Level Sects were so rare, with each such force being incredibly powerful. A single Sky-Level Sect could nominally command over a thousand Super Sects. Therefore, one could only imagine how much more fearsome Eternal Realm Sects would be!
「In the void.」
The middle-aged cultivator, at the Half-Step Eternity Realm, stood with his hands clasped behind his back. He watched as his Sect’s disciples entered the crimson pillar of light one by one, a faint smile on his face. He turned, scanned his surroundings, and noted the arrival of many Super Sects. However, not a single other Sky-Level Sect was present.
He nodded and smiled, a hint of faint arrogance in his eyes. Sky-Level Sects resided high above the clouds, far beyond the reach of any Sect below them.
This Half-Step Eternity Realm expert intended to find a place to rest. Surveying the area, he observed that every surrounding mountaintop was teeming with people. Although he could have easily secured a spot, as no one would dare refuse him, he felt it would be bullying the smaller Sects. As an expert from a Sky-Level Sect, he possessed his own dignity and disdained exploiting the weak with his strength.
Eventually, his gaze fell upon the center of the valley. Beneath the crimson pillar of light where the Red Dust Fairyland had descended, the valley floor was quite spacious, occupied by only a single black carriage. And at this moment, the black carriage was empty. The carriage’s owner, he inferred, must have ventured into the Red Dust Fairyland.
He casually glanced at the Big Black Cat lounging on the carriage.
Heavenly Order Realm Third Layer, that’s all...
In his eyes—the eyes of a great cultivator at the Half-Step Eternity Realm—a Destiny Realm cultivation base was as insignificant as an ant, easily dismissed and utterly trivial.
He then glanced at the ordinary-looking Big Black Horse. A sharp light flashed in his eyes as he scanned it a few times before gently shaking his head. The Big Black Horse’s cultivation base wasn’t high, similar to the Big Black Cat’s. However, its true level was concealed, so at first glance, it appeared to be an ordinary Big Black Horse.
The owner of this carriage is somewhat interesting...
a faint, dismissive smile touched the lips of the Half-Step Eternity Realm expert.
COUGH!
The Big Black Cat coughed, standing up. He showed not the slightest hint of fear before this Half-Step Eternity Realm expert. However, under the pressure of the expert’s imposing aura, his body trembled uncontrollably, as if the force had penetrated his very bones and seeped into his soul.
"’This Old Cat will not bow to anyone...’" the Big Black Cat murmured, then fiercely glared at the Half-Step Eternity Realm expert.
At that moment, he actually activated the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye, of which he had only grasped a rudimentary understanding.
"Hmm?"
The Half-Step Eternity Realm expert’s brows knitted. He actually felt a power emanating from the Big Black Cat’s eyes that could interfere with his spirit. Although it didn’t daze him, it still caused a moment of discomfort.
"’This little demon cat dares to launch a sneak attack on me!’"
The Half-Step Eternity Realm expert flew into a rage. He raised his hand, and a palm strike descended from the sky. This palm strike transformed in mid-air into a colossal Mana palm, its shadow eclipsing the sun, its Super Divine Dragon Breath imposing and terrifying.
"So strong!"
"’That Half-Step Eternity Realm expert of the Sky-Level Sect has made his move!’"
Many of the observing cultivators were greatly shocked.
However, cold smirks appeared on the faces of several Life-Death Realm cultivators in the crowd. They were the few Life-Death Realm cultivators who had previously crossed paths with the Big Black Horse. At this moment, they felt a twinge of pity for that Half-Step Eternity Realm expert.
That Big Black Horse was an Eternal Realm great demon! It was not something a Half-Step Eternity Realm cultivator like him could handle.
Although "Half-Step Eternity Realm" sounded close to "Eternal Realm," there was, in reality, the gap of an entire Major Realm between them. This Major Realm represented a colossal, natural divide. The disparity in strength was immense.

chapters.title: Chapter 140: Six Eternal Realm Titans, Brought Together with a Simple Grasp
chapters.content:
Chapter 140: Chapter 140: Six Eternal Realm Titans, Brought Together with a Simple Grasp
WHOOSH!
Big Black Horse opened its chilling eyes.
Staring at the colossal palm descending from the sky, it bared its white teeth and snickered.
It truly wished to kill this guy. But, recalling that its master hadn’t allowed it to kill those cultivators from the Life and Death Realm earlier, Big Black Horse figured it couldn’t kill this Half-Step Eternity Realm fellow yet. Although this guy was rather arrogant, its three young masters still needed some whetstones for their future growth...
Big Black Horse instantly knew what to do.
Although it was prepared to spare him, Big Black Horse still found him incredibly grating to look at, so...
"HACK!"
Big Black Horse spat out a glob of phlegm.
This thick glob of phlegm surprisingly contained faint sparks of lightning. It shot out of its mouth, heading straight for the giant palm in mid-air.
BOOM!
This phlegm, laden with lightning, shattered the giant palm, and a massive shockwave blasted outwards.
The Sect Masters of the major sects were sent reeling.
Only a few Life-Death Realm Powerhouses barely managed to withstand this wave of impact.
"Impossible?"
"How can this Black Horse’s phlegm block my attack?"
The Half-Step Eternity Realm Cultivator stared at the large black horse, his eyes filled with disbelief and horror.
In the next moment, he was even more astounded to discover that the Black Horse had suddenly released its Super Divine Dragon Breath.
This Super Divine Dragon Breath...
It was actually an Eternal Realm Super Divine Dragon Breath!
The Half-Step Eternity Realm Cultivator found his breathing quicken.
How could such a formidable Eternal Realm Great Demon appear in this small Shenfeng Dynasty? Could his eyes be playing tricks on him? This Red Dust Fairyland has always been a supreme place for Human Cultivators, a place the Demon Clan has never set foot in. Why would such a powerful Eternal Realm Great Demon descend here?
As these thoughts rapidly raced through his mind, the Half-Step Eternity Realm Cultivator’s expression grew increasingly grim.
In front of so many sects, this Eternal Realm Great Demon had shattered his mana-construct hand with a glob of phlegm, making him lose face on the spot.
This is a blatant insult to the honor of my Sky-Level Sect!
He was contemplating how to deal with this Black Horse when, suddenly, he saw Big Black Horse raise its head, reveal a mouthful of snow-white teeth, and say with a grin, "I say, you Human Cultivator, you’re being far too reckless! Our Human Race and Demon Clan have always coexisted peacefully, each minding our own business. Why the need for such a big confrontation? Don’t you agree?"
Big Black Horse grinned, deliberately putting on an amiable facade.
It hoped, just like last time, that a few friendly words would smooth things over.
Hearing this Great Demon speak in such a manner, the Half-Step Eternity Realm Cultivator’s expression turned even grimmer.
Peace between the Demon Clan and the Human Race? What a joke! For tens of thousands of years, there has been no shortage of wars between our two races. The current tranquility is merely a superficial illusion. The Demon Clan has always been savage, and the feud between Human Cultivators and the Demon Clan is absolutely irreconcilable.
"Sir, I am of the Human Race, and you are of the Demon Clan. We have always minded our own business. The Red Dust Fairyland, one of the Ten Great Immortal Lands of the Human Race, has descended upon the Shenfeng Dynasty. May I ask what business your Demon Clan has here?" the Half-Step Eternity Realm Cultivator demanded coldly, his hands clasped behind his back.
He was, after all, representing a Sky-Level Sect.
The Sky-Level Sect possesses a profound heritage; even if their opponent is an Eternal Realm Great Demon, our Sky-Level Sect has nothing to fear.
Hearing the Cultivator’s unpleasant words, Big Black Horse’s eyelids narrowed slightly.
It took a deep breath, suppressed the anger in its heart, and said calmly, "It’s true, this Old Horse is of the Demon Clan. But my young masters are of the Human Race and are currently training inside!"
"In that case, retreat quickly and wait from a distance!" the Half-Step Eternity Realm Cultivator said dismissively, waving his large sleeve.
Seeing the other party dismiss it like a common beggar, Big Black Horse flew into a towering rage. Its savage nature almost flared, making it want to devour the fellow right there and then.
"You, a mere Half-Step Eternity Realm Human Cultivator! What qualifications do you have to speak to your Uncle Ma of the Eternal Realm in such a manner?"
Big Black Horse had had enough. It reared up, its forelegs in the air, pointing a hoof tip at the Human Cultivator.
"On what grounds?! On the grounds that I am from a Sky-Level Sect! Our Sect has several Eternal Realm Cultivators presiding over it—not something a mere Eternal Realm Great Demon like you can even compare to! If you know what’s good for you, retreat at once!" the Half-Step Eternity Realm Cultivator declared arrogantly.
Hearing this, Big Black Horse was so furious it felt like smoke was pouring from its head.
"Oh? Have even minor Sky-Level Sects become so arrogant these days? Just because you have a few Eternal Realm Cultivators presiding, you think you can look down on everyone else?"
「Inside the carriage.」
Ye Yun watched this scene with a calm expression, though a hint of amusement flickered in the depths of his eyes.
This Human Cultivator from the Sky-Level Sect is indeed exceedingly arrogant. Practically more arrogant than I was, back when I was the foremost Eternal Realm expert on the Cangnan Continent.
Ye Yun decided it was time to properly meet this Sky-Level Sect.
"Little Horse, calm yourself..." Ye Yun sent via voice transmission.
Big Black Horse jolted, instantly falling silent, lowering its head and saying no more.
The carriage curtain was lifted, and Ye Yun stepped out.
He stood upon the carriage, glancing indifferently at the Half-Step Eternity Realm Cultivator above.
The Cultivator immediately felt his body slip from his control, forcibly dragged down to the ground by an immense power.
He desperately tried to circulate his Mana but found his body utterly immobile, as if nailed to the earth.
This astounded him.
Just who is this young man in white, who resembles a banished immortal? I didn’t see him use any Divine Skills; he merely glanced at me, and I lost all control over my body! What level of cultivation base is this?!
It wasn’t just him who was greatly shocked; all the surrounding Sect Masters and various Elders were also dumbstruck, too stunned to utter a word.
There was someone in the carriage?
In that instant, an utterly absurd thought surfaced in the minds of many Life-Death Realm Powerhouses.
Quite a few of us had scanned this carriage before, yet no one detected anyone inside. But who would have thought that a young man in white, resembling a banished immortal, would emerge from it! This young man in white wasn’t seen using any Divine Skill techniques, yet the Half-Step Eternity Realm Cultivator in mid-air was slammed from the sky to the ground, struggling futilely. What on earth just happened?
The people around exchanged glances, their faces etched with utter bewilderment.
"Sir, you are also of the Human Race! Why must we harm our own kind?" the Half-Step Eternity Realm Cultivator shouted at Ye Yun, his face flushed crimson.
"It’s true we are both of the Human Race," Ye Yun said, his hands clasped behind his back, a nonchalant smile playing on his lips as he gazed at the sky. "But your attitude... it’s truly insufferable. You think having a few Eternal Realm Cultivators makes your Sky-Level Sect so remarkable?"
After he finished speaking, Ye Yun extended an arm.
At that instant, an indescribable, sacred white light emanated from it.
Then, his arm reached into the void and abruptly vanished.
The Big Black Cat, crouched at Ye Yun’s feet, watched its Master use this Divine Skill again and couldn’t help but gulp.
Could it be that Master intends to capture all the Eternal Realm Cultivators from that Sky-Level Sect?
Just as this thought flashed through its mind, Ye Yun’s arm retracted. A streak of white light then flashed from the sky and landed on the ground.
When the white light dissipated, six Eternal Realm Cultivators appeared.
"Sect Master... How did all of you get here?"
The Half-Step Eternity Realm Cultivator stared at these six familiar titans from his Sect, his body trembling uncontrollably. Cold sweat beaded on his forehead; he was so shocked it felt as if he were in a dream.

chapters.title: Chapter 141: Eighteen Layers of Hell
chapters.content:
Chapter 141: Chapter 141: Eighteen Layers of Hell
"Where are we now?"
A white-haired elder looked around, his face a mask of confusion. He had been in secluded Cultivation within his Sect when, in the blink of an eye, he found himself in this unfamiliar place. The transition had been so swift, occurring in the span of a single breath, that he had no time to react.
"Why... are all of you here?" The elder stared at the five fellow Sect members beside him, his expression one of utter shock. The six of them, all Eternal Realm magnates and the pillars of their Sky-Level Sect, had converged in this strange location.
Who could be so terrifying as to manipulate Eternal Realm Cultivators like puppets?
The elder quickly scanned his surroundings, his gaze falling upon a Big Black Horse that possessed an Eternal Realm cultivation base.
But a mere Eternal Realm demonic beast isn’t much of a threat to me,
he thought.
However, his eyes then shifted to the carriage, where a young man in white stood with his hands clasped behind his back. The youth exuded an extraordinary, almost transcendent aura.
I can’t sense any cultivation base from him at all. Yet, for some reason, he feels like a God radiating boundless divine light, compelling me to worship him.
Seeing the Sect Master and several Supreme Elders looking bewildered, the Half-Step Eternity Realm powerhouse who had been brought along hurriedly said, "Sect Master, this is the Shenfeng Dynasty! The Red Dust Fairyland is right nearby!"
"What? This is the Red Dust Fairyland?" the elder exclaimed, his face paling. "Does that mean we traversed nearly ten million miles in an instant?" His heart pounded, and his eyes nearly bulged from their sockets.
The other Eternal Realm powerhouses were equally dumbfounded, the shock they felt beyond words.
To cross ten million miles in a single moment... is that comparable to Void Transmission? But we are six Eternal Realm magnates! Who could have possibly transported us here so stealthily, without any of us noticing?
Their gazes, too, fell upon the young man in white on the carriage, and their eyes filled with unconcealed astonishment. This youth emitted no discernible aura of cultivation, yet in their perception, he shone with a dazzling light, like a God. The six Eternal Realm Cultivators were rendered speechless. As the saying goes, an expert’s skill is evident from a single gesture.
Just how terrifying must this god-like young man in white be, to have captured six Eternal Realm Cultivators without their knowledge? It’s simply unimaginable! Could he be a Demi-god Level Powerhouse, approaching the True God Realm?
While these six Eternal Realm powerhouses were reeling from the colossal shock, the numerous Sect Masters in the surrounding mountain ranges were in an uproar.
"My heavens! Six Eternal Realm Cultivators appearing all at once! This is terrifying!"
"How did they get here? Did they also use some method similar to Void Transmission, projecting themselves from millions of miles away?"
"Absolutely not! Didn’t you see how bewildered they all look? It seems they were forcibly brought here, space torn asunder by some miraculous power!"
"Could it be that young man in white?"
Whispers and discussions erupted all around, faces etched with shock. The mystery and terrifying nature of the black carriage were becoming increasingly apparent to everyone.
SLAP! SLAP! SLAP!
Ye Yun, from his position on the carriage, raised his hand and delivered several resounding slaps across space. Each of the six Eternal Realm Cultivators received two slaps, their faces immediately swelling and turning red. Yet, in that moment, these six formidable cultivators stood frozen, not even attempting to dodge. It was as if they had resigned themselves to the fact that evasion was impossible and could only accept the punishment.
"Your esteemed Sky-Level Sect has disciples who are ill-disciplined and intolerably arrogant. What do you propose should be done?" Ye Yun asked, his hands behind his back, his gaze calm as he stared at the men before him.
"Senior," the white-haired elder said, clasping his fists and bowing, his eyes betraying a hint of fear as he looked at Ye Yun. He had never imagined that the arrogance of his Deputy Sect Master would lead to offending such an unfathomable expert.
The Half-Step Eternity Realm powerhouse, the Deputy Sect Master in question, finally grasped the direness of his situation. The young man in white before him was a Demigod, infinitely close to the True God Realm! His power was heaven-defying, unstoppable, far beyond what the six Eternal Realm magnates of his Sect could ever hope to contend with. Cold sweat drenched him as immense terror gripped his heart.
I offended a Demigod! A mere Half-Step Eternity Realm Cultivator like me offended a Demigod! The Sect will surely not let me off easily!
The Eternal Realm elder, after a moment of thought, decided he had to make a painful choice to ensure his own survival. "Senior," he began, clasping his fists and bowing deeply, "since he has offended you, we will confine him to our Sect’s prison for life!"
"Is that so? There’s no need for your prison. I’ll send him to Hell right now!" Ye Tian said with an indifferent smile.
He pointed a finger at the ground beside them. RUMBLE! A massive fissure tore open the earth. From its depths, ghostly wails and wolfish howls echoed, accompanied by all sorts of terrifying sounds.
The six Eternal Realm Cultivators peered into the chasm and were instantly confronted by the horrifying vistas of the Eighteen Layers of Hell. Their faces turned ashen, and they were too petrified to speak.
What kind of Divine Skill is this? This Demigod Senior is far too terrifying!
Ye Yun glanced in a certain direction and said nonchalantly, "Go on in."
"Senior, please spare me...!" The Half-Step Eternity Realm powerhouse dropped to his knees, tears streaming down his face as he kowtowed. He was truly terrified now.
The scenes within those Eighteen Layers of Hell are too horrific to behold. A single glance made me feel like I was about to die!
You, a puny insect, relying on your Sky-Level Sect, dared to disrespect even Eternal Realm powerhouses. If someone like you doesn’t descend into Hell, who does?
Ye Yun thought, then waved his hand with a faint smile.
The Half-Step Eternity Realm powerhouse’s body immediately flew upwards, then arced through the air before plummeting into the Eighteen Layers of Hell. A final, bloodcurdling scream tore from his lips as he traced a parabola and vanished completely.
RUMBLE!
The unfathomable chasm sealed itself shut, the ground becoming smooth and unbroken as if nothing had ever happened.
A dead silence fell upon all the mountain peaks. Everyone stared, eyes wide, not daring to make the slightest sound. They, too, had been thoroughly petrified by the vision of the Eighteen Layers of Hell. It was simply too horrifying.
The six Eternal Realm Cultivators exchanged glances, each swallowing hard. Such an inconceivable, heaven-defying method was utterly astounding. They had never witnessed anything like it.
Nearby, the Big Black Cat had squeezed its eyes shut in terror. The Eighteen Layers of Hell had dealt a significant shock to its psyche; this was its first time witnessing such a thing. The Big Black Cat hadn’t yet joined their group during the events at the Sword King Palace in the Ancient Moon Dynasty.
The Big Black Horse twitched its lips but remained silent.
I didn’t expect Master to actually suppress this Half-Step Eternity Realm Cultivator. It seems that fellow’s arrogance truly infuriated Master. To conjure such a terrifying Eighteen Layers of Hell and condemn him to eternal suppression, never to be reincarnated...
Ye Yun’s expression was tranquil as he surveyed the surrounding Cultivators. Within his mesmerizing eyes, countless tiny, star-like runes flickered into existence, as if the birth, demise, and transformation of three thousand worlds were playing out within his gaze.
Then, the Big Black Horse was surprised to observe that all the onlookers who had witnessed the scene suddenly wore dazed expressions, as if they had collectively fallen into a dream.

chapters.title: Chapter 142: Erasing Memory
chapters.content:
Chapter 142: Chapter 142: Erasing Memory
Is this also the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye?
The Big Black Horse swallowed hard, thinking. With just a glance from the Master, everyone entered a strange dreamlike state.
This Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye is too terrifying.
In the blink of an eye, the star-like tiny runes in Ye Yun’s eyes disappeared, and his gaze returned to its usual calm demeanor.
WHOOSH!
Ye Yun waved his hand. He grabbed the six Eternal Realm Cultivators before him and thrust them back into the void.
"Return to where you came from..."
Ye Yun wouldn’t kill these insignificant Eternal Realm Cultivators; they could serve as practice for the three juniors of the Dragon God Sect. These six individuals would become their sharpening stones in the future.
A strange ripple appeared. The space around Ye Yun twisted instantly, and the black carriage vanished into the void. Having done all this, Ye Yun’s figure flickered, and he returned to the carriage.
At this moment, all the cultivators around them jolted as if waking from a dream.
"What just happened?"
"It felt like my brain suddenly short-circuited..." a Sect Master from one of the major sects said with a frown.
He slapped his forehead hard, but couldn’t remember what had happened. The same thing occurred to everyone; no one could recall what transpired during that moment of trance.
Someone inadvertently glanced towards the crimson light pillar of the Red Dust Fairyland and noticed the valley below it was empty. But no one’s expression changed. In their eyes, it seemed as if the valley had been empty all along.
Just moments ago, Ye Yun had utilized the Supreme Divine Power, the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye, to draw everyone into the Annihilation Region and directly erase a part of their memories. Ye Yun erased their memories because he didn’t want anyone to be aware of his presence.
Throughout his journey from the Ancient Moon Dynasty, anyone who had seen him had either been killed by Ye Yun or had their memories altered.
This time, the Big Black Horse had revealed his Eternal Realm cultivation base. Furthermore, Ye Yun had snatched six Eternal Realm Cultivators from a Sky-Level Sect across a vast distance, bringing them back over millions of miles. All of this was too shocking. Therefore, Ye Yun had obliterated not only the memories of the surrounding cultivators but also those of the six Eternal Realm Cultivators.
BOOM!
Another tremendous roar echoed from the void as space fluctuated, and a massive whirlpool materialized. A brilliant beam of light descended from the whirlpool. This beam of light stirred up a furious wind, emanating immeasurable radiance that seemingly illuminated the entire vast land of the Shenfeng Dynasty.
"Another Sky-Level Sect!" a Sect Master from a prominent sect exclaimed, gazing at the scene in disbelief.
Instantly, everyone’s breathing grew heavy. A Sky-Level Sect had just arrived, and now... another one had appeared! It had to be said, the influence of the Red Dust Fairyland was truly immense.
As the light faded, over a hundred thousand cultivator figures materialized in the void. Transforming into streaks of sword light, they plunged into the crimson light pillar and vanished in an instant.
A Half-Step Eternity Realm Cultivator turned, his gaze sweeping indifferently over the crowd, before he landed alone beside the crimson light pillar. His position was about a hundred feet away from where the black carriage had been. However, the black carriage was already concealed within the void, completely undetectable to him.
From within the void, the Big Black Horse could clearly see everything outside. However, his Master had instructed him to remain still, so the Big Black Horse could only close his eyes and quietly begin his cultivation.
What a rare opportunity! Finally, no one to interfere...
The Big Black Cat smirked inwardly. He then took a deep breath, quickly composed himself, and focused on comprehending the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye.
This Divine Skill is too powerful! I’ve seen the Master use it a few times, and I’m so envious!
The arrival of the second Sky-Level Sect wasn’t the end.
「In the following days.」
Large and small Super Sects continued to use long-distance Void Throws, sending in wave after wave of Shaping divinity realm cultivators. Several million Shaping divinity realm cultivators had already entered the Red Dust Fairyland.
Upon entering the vast Red Dust Fairyland, these cultivators were randomly teleported to various locations. At first, everyone was placed in a desolate and empty region. Then, they began to hunt Blood Demons.
As one of the Ten Great Immortal Lands, the Red Dust Fairyland had a temporal flow completely different from the outside world. One day within the Red Dust Fairyland equated to ten days in the outside world. Therefore, for all the cultivators entering the Red Dust Fairyland, the difference in their arrival times did not exceed one day relative to the Fairyland’s time. Everyone’s starting point was almost the same.
Ye Yun’s true body sat quietly in the carriage, comprehending a powerful Divine Skill. However, a strand of his Primordial Spirit was hidden in Su Wanyi’s mind.
The different rate of time flow... this place is quite interesting...
Ye Yun’s Primordial Spirit glanced over his surroundings and then returned to silence.
The Seven-star Dragon Abyss Sword had an unpredictable power to slay Blood Demons. The Blood Demons in the Red Dust Fairyland were incredibly tenacious, possessing strong regenerative and merging abilities. Typically, Cultivators had to dismember a Blood Demon into several pieces to kill it. But Su Wanyi didn’t need to; a single strike from her sword was enough to kill a Blood Demon.
Truly worthy of a God-level Sword! Within this Red Dust Fairyland, with this sword, no Blood Demon will be my match...
At this moment, Su Wanyi stood atop a desolate hill. A joyful smile graced her exquisite face as she looked at the two or three dead Blood Demons at her feet.
「On her journey so far,」
she had killed over thirty Blood Demons. From killing them one by one initially, to now dispatching two or three simultaneously, she had gradually figured out the Blood Demons’ patterns of activity. Blood Demons were extraordinarily cunning, but they had a weakness: their insatiable desire for Cultivators. By exploiting this, Su Wanyi could easily kill them with a decisive strike.
Human Cultivators could kill Blood Demons, devouring their inner core; Blood Demons, in turn, could also devour Human Cultivators. It was a fair process.
