Along the way, Su Wanyi had seen a few disciples from unknown sects who, unable to resist, were enveloped by a blood net conjured by Blood Demons. In the blink of an eye, not even bone fragments remained. Only some clothes were left floating down.
Blood Demons were interested in the flesh of Human Cultivators, not their robes, swords, or storage rings. Su Wanyi had already collected several storage rings, relics left behind by Shaping divinity realm cultivators who had fallen to Blood Demons.
"It’s her!"
Just as Su Wanyi was about to dissect the Blood Demon corpse to retrieve its inner core, several streaks of sword light suddenly shot over from the distance. These sword-lights landed on the ground, transforming into five or six young men. They all wore the same red robe, held longswords, and surrounded Su Wanyi.
Hmm?
Su Wanyi frowned. She recognized one of the young men very well; he was the cultivator at the Fifth Layer of Spirit Formation Realm whom she had saved when they first entered the Red Dust Fairyland.

chapters.title: Chapter 143: The Second Step of the Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 143: Chapter 143: The Second Step of the Plan
Su Wanyi’s face was icy as she silently used her sword to pry open the Blood Demon’s body and extract its inner core.
The entire process was swift and smooth, seemingly disregarding the several young Cultivators of the Shaping God Realm standing opposite her.
"Senior Brother, do you see that sword? As long as it strikes the Blood Demon, the Blood Demon will instantly die!" the young man from the Red Flame Sword Sect at the Fifth Layer of Spirit Formation Realm, whom Su Wanyi had once saved, stood among the crowd, pointing ahead and said.
"What a great sword!" a thick-browed young man at the Ninth Layer of the Phase of God clicked his tongue in admiration. Staring at the Seven-star Dragon Abyss Sword in Su Wanyi’s hand, his eyes lit up with a fervent glow.
If he had that sword, wouldn’t he be unstoppable in the Red Dust Fairyland? No Blood Demon would ever be his match.
"I saved your life, yet you repay kindness with malice. Which Sect do you belong to?" Su Wanyi raised her brow, her icy gaze sweeping over them.
"You still want to know which Sect we’re from? So you can seek revenge?" the young man laughed loudly.
"Haha!" The others joined in, bursting into raucous laughter. They included three Cultivators at the Eighth layer of the Shaping Divinity Realm, and two at the Ninth Layer of the Phase of God. With such potent strength, they were more than capable of overwhelming this solitary woman.
"What’s the matter? Aren’t you going to say?" A mocking smile touched the corners of Su Wanyi’s lips.
"I am from the Red Flame Sword Sect!" the young man at the Ninth Layer of the Phase of God roared, his face contorting. He waved his hand, giving the order to attack.
SWISH SWISH SWISH!
Numerous rays of sword light, burning with raging fire, shot out from all directions.
"A bunch of rats!" Su Wanyi snorted and slashed out with her sword.
CLANG! CLANG! CLANG!
A series of metallic clashes resounded. The precious swords of these young men shattered on impact.
A surge of power rushed through their sword hilts.
The young men screamed and were sent flying, vomiting mouthfuls of blood in mid-air.
THUD! THUD! These people fell heavily to the ground. They struggled to rise for a few moments but no longer had the strength.
All of them were severely injured, their internal organs nearly shattered by the immense power.
Su Wanyi’s figure flickered, appearing ghost-like beside the young man from the Red Flame Sword Sect who had given the order.
She pointed her sword at the young man’s chest and said coolly, "Is this... all you’ve got?"
"..." The young man’s face turned ashen.
He had never dreamed that the woman before him could be so monstrously powerful. Just one strike was enough to break all their swords and send their bodies flying from an unimaginably vast force. With their internal organs shattered, they didn’t even have the strength to stand.
SWISH!
Sword light flashed past. Su Wanyi ended the young man’s life.
She turned around and walked toward the young man whom she had once saved.
The young man, covered in blood, watched Su Wanyi, terror in his eyes. He could never have imagined that this girl... could be so formidable.
SWISH!
The sword light crossed again. Su Wanyi didn’t give him a chance to say anything and killed him with one stroke.
The remaining young men, naturally, also couldn’t escape death.
After killing these people, Su Wanyi sighed softly.
Su Wanyi collected all the storage rings. She then returned to her previous location, cut open the remaining Blood Demon corpse, took out its inner core, and left the place.
In this way, Su Wanyi continued deeper into the Red Dust Fairyland, continuously slaying Blood Demons and harvesting a large quantity of Blood Demon Inner Alchemy.
After consuming these Blood Demon Inner Alchemy, Su Wanyi’s cultivation realm finally broke through to the Molding God Realm Tenth Layer.
"So fast!" A look of delight appeared on Su Wanyi’s exquisitely beautiful face.
She had entered the Red Dust Fairyland probably no more than three days ago, and she had already broken through to the Molding God Realm Tenth Layer. If this continued, she would soon catch up with her junior martial brothers and sisters.
In a Mystical Space within the Red Dust Fairyland, the air was thick with the scent of blood, surrounding a blood-red palace that floated mid-air.
Inside the palace, a vermilion coffin lay quietly in the great hall.
A pale-faced man in red robes walked in from the entrance of the hall.
"My lord, the number of people entering the Red Dust Fairyland this time is the highest in history. Should we... proceed with the second phase of the plan?" the man in red robes knelt by the coffin, speaking respectfully.
"If that is so, let’s commence the second phase of the plan!" a deep, hoarse voice spoke from within the vermilion coffin.
"As you command, my lord!" Getting to his feet, the man in red robes strode out.
On the plaza of this Blood-Red Great Hall sat a giant Blood Sphere, its surface emitting a faint bloody light. Countless tiny points of light could be seen moving about within.
Taking a deep breath, the man in red robes quickly formed several hand seals, which transformed into rays of light and shot into the blood-red sphere.
As the blood-red sphere absorbed these rays of light, miraculous changes began to occur within it. Almost simultaneously, a line of blood-red words suddenly appeared in the void above the heads of all the Cultivators in the Red Dust Fairyland.
"Any Cultivator who advances to the Divine Bridge Realm will be immediately transported to the Slaughter Blood Origin! The one who slays the most Blood Demons will receive the complete inheritance of the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall and become the Master of the Red Dust Fairyland!"
Throughout the vast and boundless Red Dust Fairyland, all Cultivators who saw this line of text felt their blood boil with excitement, their breathing becoming ragged.
For tens of thousands of years, such a phenomenon had never occurred within the Red Dust Fairyland.
Although some had received inheritances before, they were merely fragments of a whole.
But this time was entirely different.
Not only could they receive the complete Blood Linglong inheritance, but they could also become the Master of the Red Dust Fairyland.
The temptation was simply too immense.
At that instant, all Cultivators within the Red Dust Fairyland sprang into action, frantically searching for Blood Demons.
Meanwhile, a Cultivator who had just advanced to the Divine Bridge Realm was suddenly enveloped by a beam of bloody light descending from the sky. He was immediately teleported to the Slaughter Blood Origin.
"Haha, I’m among the first to enter the Slaughter Blood Origin! I have the advantage! I must obtain the complete Blood Linglong inheritance!" With a fanatical look, this Cultivator charged into the depths of the Blood Origin.
There were many other Cultivators like him. The first batch of Divine Bridge Realm Cultivators teleported in numbered in the thousands.
As a trial-taker, Su Wanyi naturally also saw the line of text that had suddenly appeared in the sky.
A sense of urgency welled up within her.
With a flicker of her figure, Su Wanyi increased her flight speed, charging towards the majestic mountain range ahead.
There, she seemed to sense the presence of Blood Demons.
Within Su Wanyi’s mind, Ye Yun saw this and only smiled nonchalantly.
In his eyes, the "God," it was all just a farce. One line of text, and they had everyone spinning in circles. The mastermind behind the Red Dust Fairyland was certainly no simple character.
Ye Yun took no action. He simply waited calmly for the moment Su Wanyi would receive the inheritance.
At that moment, the truth would be revealed. Ye Yun was convinced that with Su Wanyi’s strength, she would undoubtedly come out on top.
「Inside the Blood-Red Palace.」
From within the vermilion coffin, a man’s hoarse voice echoed without warning.
"Damned wench! This time, you absolutely won’t be able to stop me!"
The vermilion coffin suddenly trembled, and a cold, female voice emanated from within, reverberating throughout the great hall.
"Hmph! Even if your second plan succeeds, this wisp of my obsession will not vanish from your body until that person is found!"

chapters.title: Chapter 144: Sky-Level Sect, Flying Dragon Academy
chapters.content:
Chapter 144: Chapter 144: Sky-Level Sect, Flying Dragon Academy
SWISH!
A sword light flashed, slicing a Blood Demon in two.
The two halves of the sliced Blood Demon struggled for a few seconds, then swiftly died.
Su Wanyi stepped forward, used her sword to pry open the corpse, found the Blood Demon Inner Alchemy, pinched it with her fingers, and then ingested it.
The Super Divine Dragon Breath emanating from her body strengthened slightly.
During this period, she had slain a large number of Blood Demons, and her cultivation base was rapidly increasing. Now, she had reached the Shaping God Realm Tenth Layer, and it looked like she was on the verge of breaking through to the Divine Bridge Realm.
She estimated that after slaying a few more Blood Demons, Su Wanyi would be able to break through to the Divine Bridge Realm.
「Three days had already passed.」
Su Wanyi was a bit anxious, uncertain if she could catch up with the progress of those who entered the Slaughter Blood Origin before her.
"Hm?"
Someone’s coming?
Su Wanyi was preparing to leave this place and hunt Blood Demons elsewhere.
Suddenly, her expression changed slightly; she halted and looked up.
A young man in white, with an extraordinary demeanor, descended leisurely from mid-air.
This person’s cultivation base was the same as hers, also at the Pinnacle of Shaping God Realm.
The white-clothed young man was casual and free-spirited. He stood with his hands behind his back, looking Su Wanyi up and down.
Finally, his gaze fell on the blood-red Seven-star Dragon Abyss Sword she carried.
"Miss, your sword is quite good. Why don’t you sell it to me?" he suggested cheerfully.
The white-clothed young man had a relaxed expression. Although a warm smile appeared on his face, a hint of arrogance flashed in the depths of his eyes.
"Not selling!" Su Wanyi bluntly refused him.
This sword was a God-tiered Sword given to her by her ancestor! In the entire Cangnan Continent, there are only a few God-tiered Swords. Su Wanyi would protect this Divine Sword with her life. She would never sell it.
During this time, even though millions of cultivators had entered the Red Dust Fairyland, the space within was vast and limitless, so Su Wanyi had encountered very few cultivators along the way.
Therefore, apart from the impudent young men from the Red Flame Sword Sect who tried to snatch her sword, no one else had shown interest in her Seven-star Dragon Abyss Sword.
Unexpectedly, just as she was about to enter the Slaughter Blood Origin, a young man whose cultivation base was almost the same as hers showed interest in her Seven-star Dragon Abyss Sword.
Moreover, this young man wanted to buy it as soon as he opened his mouth.
This made Su Wanyi feel a strong sense of revulsion. Her eyes turned icy cold, like ancient ice, as she quietly gazed at the young man opposite her.
Seeing the sudden icy coldness in her eyes, the white-clothed young man was not at all bothered. He smiled faintly. "Miss, this humble one comes from the Flying Dragon Academy. I wonder if you have heard of it?"
"Flying Dragon Academy?"
Su Wanyi was slightly startled; she had never heard of this name before.
Although she had traveled to many places with her Master, they mainly moved around the Ancient Moon Dynasty and its surroundings and had not gone to the outside world. The outside world posed much higher risks, and their cultivation bases were too low to venture there.
Su Wanyi, with a cold face, said, "I’ve never heard of it. But no matter what sect you come from, I will not sell my sword!"
Looking at Su Wanyi’s coldness, the white-clothed young man laughed. "Miss, regardless of your origins, I want to inform you that my Flying Dragon Academy is a Sky-Level Sect. Few forces in this world surpass my Flying Dragon Academy. So, you need to think carefully..."
After finishing his speech, the white-clothed young man shook his head slightly, his smile becoming even more friendly and radiant.
The strength of a Sky-Level Sect was unquestionable.
There weren’t many in this world who dared to disrespect a Sky-Level Sect.
It turns out to be a Sky-Level Sect?
Su Wanyi narrowed her eyes, carefully scrutinizing the young man in front of her.
She was always cautious by nature, so she wouldn’t underestimate any opponent.
If this young man in white is a disciple of a Sky-Level Sect, then his combat power is undoubtedly extremely high.
Along the way, since Su Wanyi came from the Ancient Moon Dynasty to the Shenfeng Dynasty and after exchanging blows with the Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Shen Heng Sect, she realized that the higher the level of the Sect, the more outstanding the strength of its disciples.
Even if cultivators were at the same Shaping God Realm, disciples from major Sects surpassed those from Ordinary Sects. Similarly, disciples from Super Sects naturally surpassed those from major Sects.
Since this young man in white was a disciple of a Sky-Level Sect, this meant that his strength was extremely powerful, far surpassing the disciples of the Shen Heng Sect.
Thinking of this, the hand Su Wanyi held her sword with began to tremble slightly.
At this moment, she was extremely excited.
She wasn’t sure whether her current strength would be able to compete with this young man.
Su Wanyi wanted to challenge this disciple from the Sky-Level Sect.
"As a Sky-Level Sect, we don’t arbitrarily bully the weak. Therefore, I’d like to buy this sword of yours. Name your price," the young man in white said lightly, his hands clasped behind his back.
He had sword-like eyebrows and shining eyes, and a commanding presence. Dressed all in white, he possessed a natural and unforced elegance.
From head to toe, he exuded an air of superiority, as if he did not even consider Su Wanyi worth his attention.
After all, this girl had never even heard of the Flying Dragon Academy. At most, she was a disciple from a Low-grade Major Sect.
The gap between her status and his was too great.
Although his cultivation base was only at the Shaping God Realm, his status was such that he could sit on par with the Sect Master of any major Sect.
Sky-Level Sects were just that terrifying.
After all, a Super Sect still stood between a Sky-Level Sect and a major Sect. Major Sects and Super Sects are each divided into four grades. If this girl indeed came from a Low-grade Major Sect, then she would be eight grades below him.
So, the sense of superiority in his heart was extremely strong.
This sense of superiority made him refrain from snatching the sword immediately. Instead, he attempted to use the name of the Sky-Level Sect to intimidate Su Wanyi, waiting for her to be shocked enough to present the sword to him.
He had observed from the void that when this blood-red sword cut a Blood Demon, the demon died instantly.
This left him quite shocked.
Even when he killed Blood Demons, he had to chop them into countless pieces to ensure they were completely dead.
If he had this sword, then he would certainly surpass many others in the Slaughter Blood Origin.
Perhaps he would have a chance to obtain the inheritance of the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall.
"If you can beat me, then it won’t be too late to name your price!"
Su Wanyi was invigorated, her fighting spirit boiling.
She stepped forward, grasping the Seven-star Dragon Abyss Sword. Suddenly, a Divine Dragon Phantom appeared behind her. This Divine Dragon was lifelike, its large dragon eyes constantly emanating a profound majesty.
"Oh? What kind of Swordsmanship is this?"
The young man in white wore a slightly surprised expression as he saw the Divine Dragon Phantom.
"If you can defeat me, then I’ll tell you the name of this Swordsmanship!"
Su Wanyi sneered, then suddenly rushed forward, thrusting her sword at the white-clothed young man.
A sword light blazed into existence, and a roaring Divine Dragon Phantom materialized in the void.
The white-clothed young man leaped into the air, evading this deadly attack.
BUZZ!
His body swayed slightly.
Behind him, a giant Divine Dragon Phantom also appeared.
This Divine Dragon was almost the same size as Su Wanyi’s Divine Dragon Phantom.
The only difference was that the white-clothed young man’s Divine Dragon was a Black Dragon.
Su Wanyi was momentarily stunned.
This was the first time she had encountered an opponent who also possessed a Divine Dragon Phantom.
At this moment, in her mind,
Ye Yun also saw this Black Dragon Phantom. His eyebrows twitched slightly as a past event seemingly came to his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 145: Reverse Dragon Technique, annihilating the young man in white
chapters.content:
Chapter 145: Chapter 145: Reverse Dragon Technique, annihilating the young man in white
「A hundred thousand years ago.」
The Dragon God Sect, an Eternal Sect, was renowned for its continuous emergence of prodigious talents and countless capable individuals.
Ye Yun had once personally formed a group named The Black Dragon Guards. This group was the most mysterious force within the entire Dragon God Sect, answering directly to Sect Master Ye Yun. The Black Dragon Guards had been created due to Ye Yun’s cautious nature, primarily to guard against unknown risks. As a transmigrator, Ye Yun knew that some risks could materialize unexpectedly. Even though the Dragon God Sect was an Eternal Sect, he believed it should still possess a strong, hidden force to silently protect it at all times. Thus, he quietly established The Black Dragon Guards.
This contingent of The Black Dragon Guards consisted of ten Cultivators from the Eternal Realm of the Dragon God Sect, with a hundred Cultivators from the Life and Death Realm serving beneath them. Ye Yun made an exception and imparted the first seven layers of the Reverse Dragon Technique to them. After their establishment, The Black Dragon Guards cultivated in secret, never revealing themselves to the world. Apart from Ye Yun, almost no one knew of their existence.
They were called The Black Dragon Guards because the Swordsmanship they practiced differed from that of the Dragon God Sect. When The Black Dragon Guards deployed their Black Dragon Swordsmanship, a Black Dragon Phantom would manifest behind them. The Black Dragon Swordsmanship was exceedingly deadly, its combat power far surpassing that of normal disciples using the Dragon God Sword Technique. This set of Swordsmanship was also a new creation, deduced by Ye Yun himself from the Dragon God Sword Technique. As a transmigrator, even without an activated System at the time, his talent was unparalleled. For him, the foremost expert in the Cangnan Continent’s Eternal Realm, deducing a new Swordsmanship was not a difficult task.
Just as Ye Yun was reminiscing about the past,
BANG! BANG!
Su Wanyi had already engaged in battle with the white-robed young man from the Flying Dragon Academy.
Ye Yun shifted his gaze, observing the unfolding battle. He also wanted to ascertain if the Swordsmanship wielded by this young man in white was indeed the Black Dragon Swordsmanship.
It’s not the Black Dragon Swordsmanship...
After a few glances, Ye Yun silently shook his head and sighed softly. The Swordsmanship used by the young man in white was completely different from the Black Dragon Swordsmanship, poles apart with not the slightest trace of similarity. The only resemblance was the Black Dragon Phantom itself.
However, what brought Ye Yun some relief was that the present-day Su Wanyi, when fighting a disciple from another Sky-Level Sect, was not at a disadvantage; the two were evenly matched. And Su Wanyi had not yet utilized the Reverse Dragon Technique.
If she were to use that Cultivation Technique, she could surely defeat the young man in white.
"Alas!" Ye Yun sighed suddenly. Finding no connection between the young man in white and The Black Dragon Guards he had personally established, Ye Yun felt a measure of disappointment. He closed his eyes and fell into silence.
BANG! BANG!
In mid-air, two blurs of sword light clashed fiercely.
How can this woman be so strong?
The young man in white stared at Su Wanyi in shock, a tempest raging in his heart. He, a distinguished Shaping God Realm Disciple from a Sky-Level Sect, was actually fighting on par with a disciple from an obscure Major Sect. This filled him with a profound sense of humiliation! As a disciple of a Sky-Level Sect, his status was comparable to that of a Major Sect’s sect master, yet now he couldn’t even defeat a mere disciple from a Major Sect. This was unacceptable to him.
"ROAR!" The young man in white suddenly bellowed, unleashing his full strength as he charged at Su Wanyi.
Su Wanyi remained calm and composed. Faced with his deadly assault, she didn’t meet it head-on but deftly evaded each strike.
A figure flew over from a distance. It was a young man dressed in black, his cultivation base also at the Pinnacle of Shaping God Realm, merely half a step from the Divine Bridge Realm. He concealed himself about three hundred meters away, watching the thrilling battle with an astonished expression. Both combatants were incredibly strong; either one of them was far more powerful than he.
Are you a disciple from a Major Sect or a Super Sect?
A voice suddenly transmitted into the black-robed young man’s ear. He paused, startled, and looked towards the young man in white fighting in the distance. He didn’t recognize him, but the other, despite being at the same cultivation realm, was clearly stronger. Not daring to cause offense, the black-robed young man quickly transmitted his reply: "I am from the Star Cloud Sword Sect, a Supreme Major Sect."
Hearing this, the young man in white was overjoyed and hastily transmitted back: "I am a disciple from the Sky-Level Sect, the Flying Dragon Academy! Quickly, help me kill this woman, and I shall reward you handsomely in the future!"
What? Flying Dragon Academy?
The black-robed young man’s face registered his shock. As a disciple of a Supreme Major Sect, he had indeed heard of the Flying Dragon Academy. The Flying Dragon Academy was a Sky-Level Sect. However, it existed on the Cangnan Continent in the form of an actual academy, advocating Confucianism and promoting propriety, virtue, and benevolence. Many high-ranking officials in the cultivation dynasties of the Cangnan Continent were graduates of the Flying Dragon Academy. It was, one could say, an extremely powerful force with a widespread reputation; virtually every Major Sect of any standing knew of the Flying Dragon Academy.
Although their Star Cloud Sword Sect had reached the highest tier among Major Sects, the disparity when compared to a Sky-Level Sect like the Flying Dragon Academy was still vast; the four distinct tiers of Super Sects still lay between their respective ranks. Therefore, when the disciple from the Flying Dragon Academy requested his assistance, the black-robed young man dared not refuse, fearing future repercussions for his sect.
SWISH!
The black-robed young man drew his sword and immediately joined the fray. The Star Cloud Sword Sect was most famous for its Star Cloud Sword Technique. His Swordsmanship manifested a sky full of stellar clouds, his techniques broad and sweeping, imbued with immense power, instantly altering the tide of battle.
Originally, Su Wanyi and the young man in white had been evenly matched. With the black-robed young man’s intervention, she immediately found herself at a disadvantage.
Under these circumstances, if I don’t use the Reverse Dragon Technique, victory will be difficult...
Su Wanyi mused inwardly as she fought. Although these two couldn’t inflict fatal harm on her just yet, she truly couldn’t afford to waste any more time. She was already three days behind the first group. If she continued to be entangled with these two, even if she ultimately won, she would lose precious time.
At this thought, Su Wanyi steeled her resolve, her blood and vital energy surging. At that moment, she activated the Reverse Dragon Technique.
Five-fold Combat Power!
BANG!
With a single sword strike, Su Wanyi sent the black-robed young man from the Star Cloud Sword Sect flying.
How is this possible? How did your strength suddenly increase so much?
The young man in white from the Flying Dragon Academy, who was still fighting, saw this, and his eyes nearly bulged out in terror.
This unknown woman had been concealing her true strength all along!
"Die!"
In the void, a woman’s sharp cry echoed.
WHOOSH!
A brilliant sword light, suffused with a Divine Dragon Phantom, slashed towards the young man in white.
Seeing the ferocious momentum of this strike, which contained incredible prowess, the young man in white’s expression changed drastically. His fighting spirit completely vanished, and, terrified, he turned to flee.
SHINK!
The lightning-fast sword light arrived in an instant, piercing through the young man in white’s chest.
How could this be...
The young man in white looked down at the gleaming tip of the sword protruding from his chest, blood gushing from the wound. He gave a wretched laugh and plummeted from mid-air.
This Disciple of a Sky-Level Sect thus perished in the Red Dust Fairyland.
How terrifying!
The severely injured black-robed young man hastily formed hand seals, his Essence Blood burning. He activated a highly specialized escape technique, transforming into a streak of blood and vanishing without a trace.

chapters.title: Chapter 146: Advancing to Divine Bridge Realm, Ascending to Slaughter Blood Origin
chapters.content:
Chapter 146: Chapter 146: Advancing to Divine Bridge Realm, Ascending to Slaughter Blood Origin
"Still trying to escape?"
Su Wanyi sneered, transformed into a Divine Dragon Phantom, and gave chase.
At that moment, she activated the Reverse Dragon Technique, boosting her combat power fivefold. Even her flying speed increased five times.
Combined with her use of the Dragon God Body Technique, her speed was unbelievably fast, and she quickly caught up with the youth in black.
SWISH!
A distant sword light descended.
The youth in black was unable to dodge and was brutally cleaved in two. Blood sprayed everywhere.
Su Wanyi walked over, collected the youth’s sword and storage ring, and placed them into her own storage ring.
Then, she returned to her previous location and collected the storage ring and sword of the young man in white from Flying Dragon Academy.
These individuals all hailed from influential backgrounds—one was a disciple of the Supreme Major Sect, and the other, a disciple of a Sky-Level Sect. Their storage rings surely contained many valuable items.
After doing all this, Su Wanyi continued towards the mountain range ahead.
After about the time it takes for a joss stick to burn, she finally discovered another Blood Demon.
Upon seeing Su Wanyi, this Blood Demon quickly burrowed into a crevice in the ground and vanished completely.
Su Wanyi felt helpless.
Currently, she was at the Pinnacle of Shaping God Realm, and ordinary Blood Demons dared not attack her.
Only when she encountered large hordes of Blood Demons with exceptionally high cultivation bases would they possibly attack her.
As for the Blood Demon that escaped, she had no way to track it down. After all, these crevices were extremely deep and narrow, unsuitable for humans to traverse.
If only Old Ancestor were here,
Su Wanyi mumbled to herself.
If he were to suppress my cultivation base, I could lure those Blood Demons out and kill them.
A nostalgic smile touched her beautiful face.
Ye Yun, hearing these words in her mind, couldn’t help but chuckle.
These children... they’re truly addicted to suppressing their cultivation.
After chuckling to himself, Ye Yun didn’t act. He didn’t want Su Wanyi to know he was hidden within her mind.
This was a trial. For safety reasons, Ye Yun, as the Old Ancestor, had split off a sliver of his Primordial Spirit to reside within Su Wanyi’s mind.
The three remaining young disciples of the Dragon God Sect were all precious; none could afford to be lost.
After a self-deprecating smile, Su Wanyi turned and left, continuing her search for Blood Demons.
In the initial space of Red Dust Fairyland where she currently was, there were no Divine Bridge Realm Blood Demons; most were of the Shaping God Realm. Blood Demons at the Molding God Realm Tenth Layer were scarce.
After Su Wanyi had traveled for a while longer, she had a stroke of good luck and discovered a small group of Blood Demons.
The cultivation bases of these Blood Demons were not low; the lowest was at the Molding God Realm Seventh Layer, and the highest had reached the Molding God Realm Tenth Layer.
Seeing a lone human, Su Wanyi, the Blood Demons’ ferocity flared, and they pounced at her, howling.
Delight flashed in Su Wanyi’s eyes as she charged forward.
Streaks of brilliant sword light flashed through the air. The Blood Demons, unable to dodge in time, were struck by the light and fell from the sky.
Their mangled bodies twitched on the ground for a few moments before they perished.
Su Wanyi landed. One by one, she cut open the Blood Demons’ corpses and retrieved their inner cores.
Without hesitation, she swallowed all the Blood Demon Inner Alchemy.
Instantly, Su Wanyi’s aura began to surge.
BOOM!
A thunderous sound erupted from within her body, as if some shackles had been shattered.
Vast rivers of Mana surged through her body, cleansing her organs and meridians.
At this moment, Su Wanyi finally broke through to the Divine Bridge Realm.
Sensing the Divine Bridge Realm aura, the dark red clouds above roiled, and a crimson beam of light suddenly descended.
The crimson beam instantly engulfed Su Wanyi, lifting her into the sky and through the clouds, where she vanished.
When Su Wanyi landed, she found herself in a new world.
This world was an endless grassland, where unfamiliar red weeds grew as tall as a person. The sky was blood-red, and a faint, metallic scent of blood hung in the air.
On the distant horizon, nine colossal pillars of blood descended from the sky, standing majestically between heaven and earth, emitting an endless, sanguine radiance.
Regardless of the distance, any Cultivator could see these nine blood pillars. They towered with an overwhelming and awe-inspiring grandeur that instilled reverence.
Is this the Slaughter Blood Origin?
Su Wanyi stared at the nine blood pillars in the distance, her delicate face frozen, her eyes filled with shock.
WHOOSH!
A stream of crimson light surged from the ground, and another Cultivator at the First Level of Divine Bridge Realm appeared beside Su Wanyi.
This Cultivator was dumbstruck by the magnificent scene before him. He had never imagined the Slaughter Blood Origin to be so shocking and spectacular.
Stream after stream of crimson light surged from the ground, each transforming into a Divine Bridge Realm Cultivator from various major sects.
These Cultivators, having just entered the Slaughter Blood Origin, recovered from their awe and immediately rushed towards the nine blood pillars.
But they hadn’t flown far
when dozens of Blood Demons suddenly flew out from the dense grass.
Each Blood Demon’s cultivation base had reached the Divine Bridge Realm.
Some Blood Demons even had cultivation bases at the Divine Bridge State second and third levels.
These newly-advanced Divine Bridge Realm Cultivators were caught off guard by the Blood Demons’ assault.
Although the Cultivators slightly outnumbered the Blood Demons, they were still at a disadvantage.
Su Wanyi drew her sword and flew over.
With so many Blood Demons present, she naturally wouldn’t miss this opportunity.
In the Slaughter Blood Origin, obtaining Blood Linglong’s inheritance and becoming the master of Red Dust Fairyland depended on who killed the most Blood Demons.
Su Wanyi was particularly interested in the so-called Blood Linglong Fairy Hall inheritance primarily because she wanted to further strengthen the Dragon God Sect’s foundation, much like her habit of collecting storage rings.
To Su Wanyi, the Dragon God Sect is an Eternal Sect. No inheritance on the Cangnan Continent can compare.
Even if she were to obtain the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall’s inheritance, it would merely add another Cultivation Technique to the Dragon God Sect’s Scripture Repository.
Ye Yun sensed Su Wanyi’s thoughts and smiled with satisfaction.
One hundred thousand years ago, no sect in the entire Cangnan Continent could compare to the Dragon God Sect; not even the few other Eternal Sects of that era were its match.
This so-called Slaughter Blood Origin was, in Ye Yun’s view, insignificant.
To him, the nine distant blood pillars were no different from nine matchsticks.
The world Su Wanyi was in previously should be the first layer of this Red Dust Fairyland,
Ye Yun mused.
The Slaughter Blood Origin must be the second layer. And the sky supported by those nine blood pillars is likely the third layer.
Ye Yun did not reveal himself or his power, because if he were to appear in the first or second layers, these small worlds would collapse.
To allow Su Wanyi to elevate her realm as quickly as possible, Ye Yun wouldn’t interfere with her actions unless it was a critical moment.
SLASH!
A sword light blazed across the sky, fiercely slashing at a Blood Demon.
The Blood Demon shrieked as it was instantly decapitated.
It plummeted from mid-air, crashed to the ground, twitched a few times, and swiftly died.
"Thank you, young lady!" A young man, who had been in dire straits under the Blood Demon’s assault, hastily cupped his fists and said gratefully.
Su Wanyi nodded, her expression cool.
She was here to kill Blood Demons; saving others was merely incidental.
Then, she turned and charged towards another group of Blood Demons.
SWISH! SWISH!
With each flash of her sword, another Blood Demon fell.
Any Blood Demon struck by the Seven-star Dragon Abyss Sword perished swiftly.
Only a dozen Blood Demons remained. Seeing that the situation was hopeless, terror seized them, and they fled, howling.
The nearby Cultivators stared at Su Wanyi, their faces etched with disbelief.
This beautiful woman’s cultivation base was the same as theirs, yet they hadn’t imagined... her combat power could be so terrifying!

chapters.title: Chapter 147: Crimson Coffin, Exquisitely Beautiful Woman
chapters.content:
Chapter 147: Chapter 147: Crimson Coffin, Exquisitely Beautiful Woman
"This girl is terrifying. So many Blood Demons have fallen under her sword!"
"Her Blood Sword is extraordinary. Any Blood Demon struck by it dies instantly!"
Such a Divine Sword...
Shock and envy were written across the faces of the surrounding cultivators as they watched Su Wanyi. Ignoring their whispers and comments, Su Wanyi moved through the crowd with an indifferent expression. She pushed aside the corpses of the Blood Demons she had slain and extracted their inner cores.
No one dared to act rashly as they watched Su Wanyi’s actions. The Blood Sword in this girl’s hand was strangely intimidating. Any one of them could potentially meet the same end as the Blood Demons if struck by it.
BANG! BANG!
Without warning, the bodies of these Blood Demons exploded one after another. After the explosion, they transformed into a red mist of blood-qi, which merged with the pervasive blood-qi of this Miniature World, making them impossible to distinguish clearly.
As the cultivators inhaled the blood-laden air, their eyes, when they looked in a particular direction, flashed with a touch of crimson, and their breathing quickened.
Su Wanyi noted the crowd’s odd behavior, her eyebrows furrowing slightly. She spotted the savage, beast-like glint in everyone’s eyes.
Sensing that something was amiss, she immediately transformed into a Divine Dragon Phantom and turned to flee.
These cultivators were behaving unusually. If they attacked her, she would be drawn into a tough battle.
Although she was formidable when killing Blood Demons, facing an assault from so many cultivators at once would require a long time to achieve victory.
After entering the Slaughter Blood Origin, the key to obtaining the inheritance of the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall was the number of Blood Demons one had killed.
Su Wanyi didn’t want to waste time, so relying on the marvels of her Dragon God Body Technique, she swiftly departed.
After Su Wanyi disappeared, the cultivators’ expressions were no longer as fierce. It seemed Su Wanyi’s appearance had intensely provoked them.
Ye Yun observed all this coldly, taking everything in.
After Su Wanyi slaughtered those Blood Demons, a blood-red halo appeared above her head. Within the halo, a few numbers were displayed: twenty-three. This was precisely the number of Blood Demons Su Wanyi had killed in one go since entering the Slaughter Blood Origin.
And after the corpses of the slain Blood Demons exploded, transforming into blood-qi that merged with the air, any cultivator who inhaled even a breath of it would have their mind affected.
At that moment, Ye Yun realized they harbored murderous intent toward Su Wanyi.
If Su Wanyi hadn’t left promptly, these cultivators would have attacked her mere moments later.
Can the number of Blood Demons killed be transferred?
Ye Yun mumbled to himself.
His interest in this Red Dust Fairyland was growing.
「In a mysterious space.」
Inside the Blood-Red Palace, a vermilion coffin lid slowly rose, and a stunningly beautiful woman in red sat up.
She looked around, her pitch-black eyes reflecting infinite sorrow and reluctance.
The stunningly beautiful woman sighed. She suddenly levitated and flew towards the plaza outside.
"How is the second phase of the plan progressing?" the beautiful woman asked indifferently as she neared the Blood Light Sphere, addressing the red-robed man beside her.
"Greetings, My Lady!" The man looked stunned upon seeing the beautiful woman.
So, after all this time, this lady is in control again.
But no matter which ’My Lady’ it was, she was an existence he could not defy.
He bowed respectfully and said, "My Lady, the second phase of the plan is progressing smoothly. Currently, many cultivators from the First Level of the Shaping God Realm have quickly advanced to the Divine Bridge Realm and entered the Slaughter Blood Origin..."
"Mm." The beautiful woman nodded gently. She brushed a few strands of black silk—her hair—from her forehead with her hand and looked expectantly at the Blood Light Sphere.
A strange power emanated from her eyes. Countless tiny, blood-red lines of light appeared in the Blood Light Sphere and streamed into her eyes. At this moment, the stunningly beautiful woman remained motionless, like an ice sculpture. The red-robed man beside her watched, unfazed, as if he had witnessed this countless times.
「The time it takes for an incense stick to burn passed.」
All the fine threads of blood-light vanished. The beautiful woman lowered her head, a look of disappointment and loss on her face.
"Still no sign..." the beautiful woman murmured to herself, her voice filled with desolation.
The red-robed man hesitated before speaking, "My Lady, you have been searching for tens of thousands of years. I believe that person... has likely long ceased to exist."
SLAP!
The stunningly beautiful woman suddenly reached out and harshly slapped the red-robed man across the face from a distance.
"Impudent!" The beautiful woman’s willow-leaf eyebrows arched, her almond-shaped eyes widened, radiating killing intent.
The red-robed man, terrified, immediately knelt on the ground.
The red-robed man kowtowed and pleaded, "Please spare my life, My Lady, considering my many years of diligent service!"
After several tens of seconds, the stunningly beautiful woman casually waved her hand and said indifferently, "Get up."
There are still matters that require this red-robed man. I can’t kill him yet.
"Thank you, My Lady!" The red-robed man, drenched in sweat, rose from the ground.
The beautiful woman pointed at the Blood Light Sphere. An image of a young girl clad in a golden Robe appeared on its surface. She said indifferently, "Ensure this girl does not perish in the Slaughter Blood Origin."
The red-robed man was momentarily taken aback but quickly nodded in agreement.
Having finished speaking, the stunningly beautiful woman turned and left.
「The next moment, she appeared at the entrance to the plaza.」
This was a long, narrow mountain path, its end point being the plaza entrance. At the entrance to the path, an ancient, weather-beaten Stele stood quietly.
The beautiful woman brushed her hand over the Stele, her eyes revealing an indescribable depth of emotion.
"One hundred thousand years ago, he was the foremost expert of the Eternal Realm in the Cangnan Continent! Countless people prophesied that within a century, he would break through to the True God Realm... How could such an unparalleled genius possibly have died?" the beautiful woman murmured. A silent tear traced a path down her cheek, dripping onto the ancient Stele.
A gust of fragrant wind swept by. The beautiful woman transformed into a red shadow and reappeared in the great hall.
"Ugh..." Her face contorted, and she let out a low sound as her features twisted, becoming grotesque.
A man’s face replaced her previously stunning features.
"Go rest quietly, you damn woman!" The man’s facial muscles twitched continuously. Opening his mouth, he let out a cold, hoarse laugh.
After laughing, his entire form changed, and he transformed into a robust man.
He wore a bright red robe and emanated an ocean-like blood-qi, giving him an extremely powerful presence.
"That damn woman has fought me for tens of thousands of years. That lingering obsession of hers can’t hold on much longer. Therefore, she absolutely cannot stop the second phase of this plan this time..." The red-robed man sneered, casting a profound look at the Blood Light Sphere outside. After staring at it for a few seconds, a look of satisfaction appeared on his face.
His body swayed, and he returned to the vermilion coffin. He lay down silently, closed his eyes, and fell into a deep slumber.
That woman is still within my body. This coffin helps to suppress her.
Although I currently have a slight advantage, during the critical moments of executing the second phase of the plan, I cannot be careless. I must constantly guard against her.
「High in the clouds above the Blood-Red Palace, a blood shadow silently appeared.」
Within the blood shadow, figures flickered indistinctly. A mysterious man’s figure, cloaked in overwhelming blood light, faintly materialized.
"Two mere ants..." He sneered, then turned and vanished.
No one had detected his presence.

chapters.title: Chapter 148: The Meaning of Numbers
chapters.content:
Chapter 148: Chapter 148: The Meaning of Numbers
A Divine Dragon Phantom swiftly streaked across the sky, pausing momentarily in midair before transforming into a chilling sword light that descended from the heavens.
A Blood Demon leisurely flying through the grass was instantly cleaved in two by the sword light.
As this Blood Demon was only at the First Level of Divine Bridge Realm, Su Wanyi easily killed it.
After extracting the Blood Demon’s Inner Alchemy, Su Wanyi immediately consumed it.
As the Inner Alchemy dissolved, her Super Divine Dragon Breath faintly strengthened once more.
This Blood Demon was the first she had killed after shaking off that group of people.
Up until now, Su Wanyi was not aware that a blood-colored ring existed in the void above her head. Inside the ring was a numerical mark indicating the number of Blood Demons she had killed.
It had been twenty-three. Now, it was twenty-four.
Su Wanyi, who had devoured twenty-four Blood Demon Inner Alchemies, did not notice any signs of a breakthrough in her cultivation base.
Her brow furrowed.
If this trend continues, I’ll need to slaughter a vast number of Blood Demons to make even a few minor breakthroughs in the Divine Bridge Realm.
Su Wanyi continued onward.
Along the way, she encountered several more Blood Demons, all of which fell to her sword.
These Blood Demons were all at least at the First Level of Divine Bridge Realm. Seeing that Su Wanyi’s Cultivation Stage wasn’t high, they unhesitatingly rushed towards her, only to be instantly slain by her sword.
The terrain of the Slaughter Blood Origin was uneven, with undulations like waves.
Some Blood Demons hid in the dense grass, roaming about. Flying high in the sky made them easy to spot.
However, only by flying just above the grass, giving the Blood Demons an opportunity to attack, would the cunning creatures emerge to ambush humans.
Su Wanyi only slowly figured out this pattern after several battles.
Therefore, she had no choice but to hover just above the grass and fly forward slowly.
From time to time, Blood Demons launched attacks on her.
But without exception, Su Wanyi slew them all on the spot.
It’s still too slow...
「Two hours later.」
After Su Wanyi devoured another Blood Demon Inner Alchemy, she found that while her cultivation base had increased slightly, it was still far from enough.
A look of disappointment crossed her face.
On this journey, she hadn’t encountered large groups of Blood Demons, so her gains were scant.
It would likely be very difficult to quickly catch up to those ahead in terms of kill count.
Su Wanyi sighed.
She gazed into the distance and saw that the Sky-reaching Bloody Pillars were still remote, as if she could never reach their end in her lifetime.
"This place is vast and endless. The red flora in the distance is even more lush, and it’s growing taller and taller," Su Wanyi murmured to herself.
Suddenly, her figure flashed, and in the blink of an eye, she departed from that area.
The red grass in the initial area of the Slaughter Blood Origin was already person-high. As she flew closer to the Sky-reaching Bloody Pillars, the grass grew even taller.
Through gaps in the red grass, she could see that the soil was also red.
In the red soil, there were many blood-holes of various sizes.
These appeared to be the entrances and exits used by the Blood Demons.
Is the Blood Demons’ nest deep underground?
Su Wanyi wondered.
Su Wanyi hovered in midair, releasing her Divine Sense to scan the surroundings.
She found the caverns to be extremely deep, with narrow entrances—far too small for an ordinary person to enter.
Much like the fissures she had seen earlier, the terrain the Blood Demons inhabited was not easily traversable by humans.
"Haha, there’s someone over there!"
Two figures rapidly approached from a distance. They were two young men dressed in green, both at the Third Level of the Divine Bridge Realm.
As Su Wanyi watched the two rapidly approaching, a shocked expression appeared on her face.
To her surprise, a blood-colored halo containing a number hovered above each man’s head.
What on earth is this?
Su Wanyi was momentarily dumbfounded.
The two young men in green robes flew closer.
One of them, looking toward Su Wanyi’s head, sighed, "Only twenty-nine Blood Demons killed? That’s rather few..."
Hearing this, Su Wanyi’s expression filled with surprise.
She had indeed killed twenty-nine Blood Demons so far, all at the Divine Bridge Realm.
But how did he know?
Following his gaze, Su Wanyi tilted her head back and looked up.
In that instant, she was stunned.
Above her own head was a blood-red halo, and the number within it was indeed twenty-nine.
Twenty-nine!
In that moment, Su Wanyi finally understood.
After entering the Slaughter Blood Origin, the number above one’s head updated in real-time each time a Blood Demon was killed.
One of the youths opposite her had the number eighty-five above his head, while the other had one hundred and nine.
Both of their Blood Demon kill counts far exceeded her own.
"You poor girl, such bad luck running into us brothers. Surrender obediently, and we’ll give you a swift end!" one of the youths said, looking at Su Wanyi with an arrogant laugh.
Both of them were at the Third Level of the Divine Bridge Realm, their cultivation far exceeding hers.
If I kill them, can I obtain their numbers?
A thought flashed through Su Wanyi’s mind. Pointing her sword at the two youths, she asked with a sly smile, "If I kill you, will I get your numbers?""Correct! It seems you’re not as foolish as you look. However, most newcomers are already reporting to Hell by the time they figure this out!" The two youths burst into laughter.
With that, they moved, one to the left and one to the right. Two streaks of sword light, like twin dragons, shot towards Su Wanyi.
So that’s how it is...
Su Wanyi’s expression remained calm, but joy surged in her heart.
I arrived late. If killing other Cultivators lets me obtain their Blood Demon kill counts, doesn’t that offer a shortcut?
WHOOSH!
Instantly, Su Wanyi transformed into a Divine Dragon Phantom, leaping into the air to evade the two sword lights. Then, she unleashed her Dragon God Sword Technique.
SWISH! SWISH!
One after another, beams of sword light transformed into Divine Dragons, descending from the sky.
Although her cultivation base was two minor realms lower than the youths’, her individual combat prowess was extremely powerful. Right from the start, she pressed them back.
The two youths were greatly surprised.
They hadn’t anticipated that this stunningly beautiful woman would be so powerful.
After they fought for the time it takes an incense stick to burn, both youths were lightly wounded and showed signs of faltering.
Seeing this, Su Wanyi’s spirits soared, and she intensified her attacks.
After another period of fighting, about the length of an incense stick burning, Su Wanyi’s sword slash severed an entire arm from one of the youths. He screamed and plummeted from midair.
The other youth, seeing the dire situation, turned and fled.
Transforming into a Divine Dragon Phantom, Su Wanyi immediately gave chase.
She cut off his escape route.
An astonishing streak of sword light flashed out instantly.
The youth raised his sword to meet it.
BANG!
A tremendous force knocked his treasured sword from his grasp, and the relentless sword light struck his body.
The youth screamed as his head was instantly severed from his body.
His headless corpse spurted a column of blood into the air before plummeting from the sky.
The youth whose arm had been severed earlier was terrified and immediately dove into the dense grass nearby.
He spotted a pitch-black hole and, heedless of whether a Blood Demon was inside, scrambled into it.
Compared to a Blood Demon, this woman... she’s far more terrifying!

chapters.title: Chapter 149: Fourth Level of the Divine Bridge, Hundred Thousand Slaughter
chapters.content:
Chapter 149: Chapter 149: Fourth Level of the Divine Bridge, Hundred Thousand Slaughter
Su Wanyi picked up the storage ring and the sword from the slain youth and stored them away.
She frowned slightly, glancing at the hole beneath the blood-red grass.
The youth, in his panic, had scrambled into the Blood Demons’ nest; he would most likely die in there.
The space was too narrow. If one encountered a Blood Demon, escape would be impossible.
After some thought, Su Wanyi abandoned the idea of pursuing the youth.
She glanced behind her. The number within the blood-red halo at the back of her head had changed; her count was now 138.
"It’s increasing so fast!"
Surprise flickered across Su Wanyi’s exquisite face.
Killing and plundering numbers—it really is a shortcut!
WHOOSH!
She soared into the air, flying forward.
Su Wanyi knew that if everyone had a number behind their head, then cultivators’ enemies wouldn’t just be Blood Demons... but also other cultivators.
To obtain the inheritance, she had to kill even more cultivators to increase her own count.
Thus, in the Slaughter Blood Origin, everyone became dangerous.
Su Wanyi surveyed her surroundings. The grass grew increasingly tall, yet people were extremely scarce.
As far as she could see, not a single person was in sight.
Could they all be hiding?
Su Wanyi quietly speculated. She flew low, skimming the tops of the grass, simultaneously attracting Blood Demons and watching out for cultivators hiding in ambush.
She continued onward in this manner.
Su Wanyi indeed attracted many Blood Demons, probably more than 100, but she killed them all.
By consuming the Blood Demons’ inner cores, her cultivation base steadily grew.
Witnessing this, a thoughtful expression flashed in Ye Yun’s eyes.
Inside the Slaughter Blood Origin, killing Blood Demons is secondary. It seems the mastermind’s primary goal is to make Human cultivators kill each other.
Along the way, he had rarely seen the corpses of dead Human cultivators.
The young man Su Wanyi had killed earlier... After she left, numerous tendrils emerged from the red soil. They enveloped the young man’s corpse, rapidly decomposing it and apparently turning it into nutrients.
It seems the mastermind’s cultivation base isn’t high. They can only use the Red Dust Fairyland as a pretense to secretly manipulate Human cultivators into killing each other, all to replenish this world’s energy...
Ye Yun smiled indifferently.
He held no extreme views regarding such despicable acts.
In his eyes as a Divine Monarch, concepts like good and evil were insignificant.
Having ascended to the God Realm, one’s level of existence was entirely different, hence one’s perspective on matters also differed.
It was like cultivators finding the squabbles among mortals uninteresting.
For instance, in the eyes of a cultivator, how could the throne of a small secular kingdom compare to the pursuit of longevity and Cultivation?
Ye Yun did not interfere with Su Wanyi’s trials.
He believed that given enough time, she would undoubtedly come out on top.
Even if she couldn’t... Besides, wouldn’t the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall’s inheritance be his for the taking with a mere thought?
So, Ye Yun wasn’t worried at all.
In fact, his storage contained all sorts of Divine Soldier Techniques. Many were God level or Super God Level, and some even surpassed this world’s Heavenly Dao.
Ye Yun had never brought these items out; even he himself wasn’t sure exactly how many he possessed.
In Ye Yun’s heart, he couldn’t endlessly provide resources, turning the three juniors from the Dragon God Sect into useless "second generations."
If he did, the Dragon God Sect would rapidly decline after his departure.
It was best for these three juniors to strive for resources themselves; only then would they truly cherish them.
Before leaving, Ye Yun also planned to set up some safeguards to ensure the Dragon God Sect would endure for at least 100,000 years.
「In the Mystical Space.」
On the square of the Blood-Red Palace.
The red-robed man stood before the Blood Sphere, his expression intensely focused as he watched a point of light moving within it.
The Lady had instructed him that he absolutely must not let anything happen to that girl.
Therefore, he constantly adjusted the Blood Sphere, trying to steer as much potential danger away from the girl as possible.
This Blood Sphere was the control center of the entire Red Dust Fairyland.
He possessed certain permissions, but not all of them.
Did the Lady spare her life because she intends for her to become one of the official Heavenly Chosen Ones?
the red-robed man mused, muttering to himself.
The one with the most kills would obtain the complete inheritance of the Red Dust Fairyland.
In reality, however, he would ultimately select ten Heavenly Chosen Ones to walk the Immortal Path leading to the Immortal Palace.
Whoever managed to reach the end of that path would be qualified to enter the Immortal Palace and receive the final inheritance.
As far as he knew, even those two great figures had only obtained a partial inheritance from the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall.
The final inheritance... it had to be inherited by an exceptionally outstanding Human cultivator.
A wisp of Ye Yun’s Primordial Spirit resided in Su Wanyi’s mind. He didn’t probe this world, so he remained unaware of the events unfolding on the square of the Blood-Red Palace.
To him, no matter what variables arose, they were insignificant.
This wisp of his Primordial Spirit was more than enough to handle any crisis.
Even a True God-stage expert would be no match for this wisp of his Primordial Spirit.
Given the Red Dust Fairyland’s current furtive methods, how could there possibly be any True God-stage experts involved?
As Su Wanyi journeyed, she continuously hunted Blood Demons. She also encountered cultivators whose cultivation realms were not significantly different from her own; after a battle, she killed them all.
The number in her blood-red ring steadily increased.
「Three days later.」
The number had already surpassed 3,000.
「Five days later.」
Su Wanyi successfully broke through to the Divine Bridge State’s second level, and the number in her blood ring reached 10,000.
This filled Su Wanyi with exhilaration.
Throughout her journey, she hadn’t encountered anyone with a count exceeding 1,000. Yet, her own blood ring’s count had already reached 10,000. This signified that she had far surpassed many other cultivators.
Too bad there isn’t a leaderboard; I wonder what rank my current count would achieve?
Su Wanyi thought with some apprehension.
Time flew by.
「Seven days later.」
Su Wanyi had slain a vast number of Blood Demons and numerous cultivators.
The count in her blood ring reached 30,000, and her cultivation base also advanced to the Divine Bridge Realm’s third level.
The moment many cultivators saw Su Wanyi, their eyes turned red with greed.
They swarmed towards her, desperate to kill her on the spot.
That was a count of 30,000! Whoever killed her would instantly acquire those 30,000 points and skyrocket in standing.
「Half a month later.」
Su Wanyi’s cultivation reached the Divine Bridge Realm’s fourth level, and the count in her blood ring hit 100,000.
By now, she had grown somewhat numb to this number.
I wonder if a count of 100,000 gives me a chance to obtain the inheritance?
Just as this thought crossed her mind, the clouds above suddenly churned, and a dazzling beam of blood-red light descended.
The blood-red light enveloped Su Wanyi, carrying her skyward. In an instant, she vanished.
Simultaneously, nine other individuals from various locations also vanished.

chapters.title: Chapter 150: Heavenly Chosen One, Ascend to Immortality Path
chapters.content:
Chapter 150: Chapter 150: Heavenly Chosen One, Ascend to Immortality Path
Nine towering pillars of blood, grand and vast, pierced straight into the sky.
In the depths of the cloud layer, they supported a vast expanse of land.
Upon this land, a majestic mountain range stood at the edge of the horizon.
Below the mountain range, a winding mountain path, extremely rugged, snaked its way.
WHOOSH! WHOOSH! WHOOSH!
Ten rays of crimson light descended from the sky.
The crimson light quickly vanished, transforming into ten figures that stood at the foot of the mountain.
These ten figures consisted of men and women, some imposing and others alluring.
These Cultivators were all at the Divine Bridge Realm.
The lowest was at the Fourth Level of the Divine Bridge Realm, while most of the others were at the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm.
In total, there were three women and seven men.
"What kind of place is this?"
After the ten individuals discerned their surroundings, expressions of bewilderment appeared on their faces.
They looked at each other and discovered a huge, blood-red halo above each of their heads.
Within these halos, the count of Blood Demons each had slain exceeded one hundred thousand.
The more Blood Demons one had slain, the larger the blood-red halo above their head, and the denser the blood-light it emitted; the visual effect was increasingly astonishing.
"Why are all of them over one hundred thousand?"
A proud-looking young man squinted, observing the blood-red halos above the others’ heads. A hint of ruthlessness surfaced in his hawk-like, sinister eyes.
Among the ten people present, every count was over one hundred thousand.
The highest one had already reached one hundred and thirty thousand.
Even the lowest was one hundred thousand.
A young man in a white robe, with a handsome face and his hands clasped behind his back, looked at the crowd with indifference and said, "You don’t have to compete with me. My number is the highest! The right to inherit the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall is mine!"
"Not necessarily."
The sinister youth sneered, squinting as he retorted, "Since all ten of us were teleported here, it means we’re all back on the same starting line!"
"That’s right! Each of us is qualified!"
The other young men and women snorted coldly, chiming in their agreement.
Su Wanyi remained silent, quietly observing her surroundings, appearing exceptionally composed and observant.
"If you’re not convinced, why don’t we have a contest right now? Among the ten of us, only the last one alive will be the final victor. How about it?!"
The youth in the white robe drew his Sword, his body radiating a powerful aura.
The others retreated two steps, drew their Swords to face him, showing no fear whatsoever.
Instantly, the atmosphere among the nine became as taut as a drawn bow, like a powder keg about to explode.
Facing the impending bloody battle, Su Wanyi also drew her Sword, standing her ground vigilantly.
These people were all monstrously talented experts with Blood Demon kill counts over one hundred thousand. Each had likely killed countless people to amass such a high number.
Not only was each of them at a higher cultivation base than her, but their combat strength was also absurdly greater.
I’m probably not a match for these people.
After all, she was only at the Fourth Level of the Divine Bridge Realm, while these people were all at the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm.
The youth in the white robe glanced arrogantly at Su Wanyi and remarked with an air of indifference, "That little girl has the lowest cultivation base; best to leave her be for now!"
In the eyes of this Disciple of Heaven’s Pride from a Sky-Level Sect, an obscure female Cultivator at the Fourth Level of the Divine Bridge Realm was pathetically weak, unable to withstand a single blow.
The other eight clearly thought the same.
Because, whoever attacked the gold-robed young woman at the Fourth Level of the Divine Bridge Realm first would likely face a combined assault from the other eight.
After all, in everyone’s eyes, someone with Su Wanyi’s cultivation base could essentially be killed in a single move.
"Humph! A bunch of idiots!"
The red-robed man in the square, witnessing this scene through the Blood Light Sphere, wore a grim expression and snorted coldly.
Anyone can die, but this girl was personally chosen by the Lord. She absolutely cannot die within the Red Dust Fairyland; otherwise, I wouldn’t be able to withstand the Lord’s fury!
Moreover, these ten Heavenly Chosen Ones, before they embarked on the Ascending Immortal Road, were forbidden from killing each other.
As for the Cultivators who had perished on the First and Second Levels of the Red Dust Fairyland, they had all been absorbed by Blood Linglong’s Divine Skills.
Although he had absorbed tens of thousands and traced the Primordial Spirit memories of tens of thousands of people, the red-robed man still hadn’t found the slightest trace of the person the Lord had instructed him to find.
The red-robed man was already adept at using the Blood Light Sphere to search the memories within the minds of deceased Cultivators.
He had done this many times over tens of thousands of years.
However, the outcome was always the same.
He had never found the man his Lady Master spoke of.
Having tried so many times, the red-robed man had long since lost hope.
Each time, he merely carried out the Lord’s orders mechanically.
And this time, the second phase of the plan had been initiated.
The number of Cultivator casualties will increase more than tenfold. To provide a plausible explanation, I will offer the complete inheritance of the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall.
This inheritance was indeed real.
But it was also the first time in tens of thousands of years it had appeared in this world.
The Blood Linglong Fairy Hall would select the strongest among these ten Heavenly Chosen Ones to be its successor.
This penultimate trial.
Was to pass the test of the Ascending Immortal Road.
This trial tested the strength of one’s physique.
Without a powerful physique, one was not qualified to inherit the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall.
WHOOSH!
The red-robed man waved his large hand, and a ray of light shot into the Blood Light Sphere.
At that moment, a thunderclap-like tremor suddenly erupted from the void at the foot of the mountain, instantly stunning the youths who were about to fight.
BUZZ!
The void bloomed with resplendent light, and a line of large, golden characters materialized.
"Step onto the Ascending Immortal Road, and you will be eligible for the inheritance of the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall!"
Seeing this line of golden text that had suddenly appeared, the young men and women were all thrilled.
"It’s true! We’re all qualified, as long as we step onto the Ascending Immortal Road!"
A young man laughed heartily, leaped forward, and immediately landed on the ancient path.
He was about to charge up in one go when he suddenly felt an unimaginable, immense pressure bearing down on him, rendering him unable to use any Mana or Divine Skills.
"This road is strange!"
The young man frowned. With some effort, he lifted his feet and began to walk up the mountain path, neither quickly nor slowly.
The others also leaped up. Their figures paused for a moment before landing on the mountain path. Then, everyone felt that inexplicable suppression, their hearts trembling with shock.
However, having already stepped onto the Ascending Immortal Road, they could only brace themselves and continue upwards.
Everyone trudged onward, their steps uneven, slowly advancing along the mountain path.
This mountain path was rugged and stretched far, disappearing into the clouds and mist, its total length unknown.
And with every step they took, they felt the pressure on their bodies intensify.
Only after seeing everyone else start walking on the mountain path did Su Wanyi slowly make her way over.
She was not in a hurry.
This Ascending Immortal Road definitely has something strange about it. Once on it, no one can fly; it seems they’re constrained by some kind of power.
Su Wanyi surmised.
What we’re competing in now isn’t speed, but endurance.
When it comes to endurance, with my Ancestral Dragon Bloodline, I don’t believe I’m inferior to anyone present!
Such a powerful restrictive force...
The moment Su Wanyi stepped onto the stone stairs, she felt that powerful restrictive force.
Her Mana and Divine Skills were unusable; now, all she could rely on was the strength of her physical body.
WHOOSH!
Su Wanyi gently exhaled.
Everything was just as she had surmised.
If it’s a contest of physical strength, I’m confident I can contend with these Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the super-forces!

chapters.title: Chapter 151: One Thought Drifts across the Earthly World, Forever Ineradicable
chapters.content:
Chapter 151: Chapter 151: One Thought Drifts across the Earthly World, Forever Ineradicable
The last young man on the Path of Immortal Ascension sensed something and turned around. Seeing the beautiful young woman in the golden robe also ascending, a mocking smile appeared on his face.
"You foolish girl, don’t overestimate yourself! At only the fourth layer of the Divine Bridge Realm, you dare to attempt the Path of Immortal Ascension? Stop dreaming and go back!"
Upon hearing the young man’s words, the others walking ahead turned to look at Su Wanyi, the female cultivator at the fourth layer of the Divine Bridge Realm. Seeing that she too intended to walk this Path of Immortal Ascension, their faces filled with scorn.
"Go back! This opportunity isn’t for someone like you to compete for!"
"Exactly! If your strength doesn’t reach the level of a Super Sect or a Sky-Level Sect, don’t even think about it!"
"Little sister, hurry back. The forces on this path are too strong; they might crush your delicate body!"
One by one, they tried to dissuade her. The last to speak was a female cultivator in her early twenties, dressed in a light yellow robe, strikingly beautiful.
"Thank you all for your kind intentions. I appreciate the sentiment!" Su Wanyi responded, her face calm and her expression indifferent.
Her Ancestral Dragon Bloodline surged within her, filling her with boundless confidence. Her delicate form shifted, and she suddenly quickened her pace, swiftly ascending the steps of the Path of Immortal Ascension, TAP, TAP, TAP.
"What...?"
The others were instantly shocked. Under the immense oppressive force, they could barely move. Each step was incredibly difficult. Yet, this beautiful woman in the golden robe moved with astonishing speed, leaving them dumbfounded.
Su Wanyi quickly surpassed the last young man. She strode upward confidently.
"How... how is this possible?" The young man stared, his jaw almost on the ground, as he could only watch Su Wanyi pass him by. He, a dignified cultivator at the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm, found the Path of Immortal Ascension so arduous. How could this delicate-looking girl, merely at the fourth layer, move so quickly?
HISS... The others on the Path of Immortal Ascension let out a collective GASP. They watched as Su Wanyi advanced step by step, soon overtaking several of them.
One young man, his face contorted with a sinister expression, grew furious. As Su Wanyi passed, he suddenly reached out, attempting to grab her and pull her down.
"Hmph!" Su Wanyi sneered. She reacted instantly, seizing the young man’s wrist and yanking him backward. The young man lost his footing and tumbled down the stone steps, rolling for seven or eight meters before coming to a stop.
"How is this woman so strong?" The others were astounded, a question dawning in their minds.
Could it be that this woman isn’t affected by the suppressive force?
Su Wanyi continued forward. She, too, felt the tremendous oppressive force. However, possessing the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline, her physical body was far superior to those of the other nine cultivators. Even if the pressure was like a mountain bearing down on her, she could withstand it.
She seems to be doing alright,
Ye Yun, who had been observing Su Wanyi, thought, a faint smile playing on his lips as he watched her advance with such ease. A body transformed by the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline was naturally unimaginably powerful. Throughout the entire Cangnan Continent, no other bloodline could compare. Even though Su Wanyi’s Ancestral Dragon Bloodline was only at 8%, her physique far surpassed that of her peers. Ye Yun, having reached 99%, could tear through the solid void within the barrier simply by activating his Ancestral Dragon Body. This demonstrated the terrifying might of the Ancestral Dragon Body.
However, Ye Yun rarely needed to use it anymore. His various Divine Techniques and Divine Soldier Magical Treasures had already rendered him invincible in the world. There was hardly any occasion for the Ancestral Dragon Body to make an appearance. Having signed in for 100,000 years, the benefits Ye Yun had accumulated far exceeded the standards of this world.
The Heavenly Chosen One must reach the mountaintop to qualify for the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall’s inheritance. What then is the next step?
Ye Yun mused to himself, his interest in the person behind the scenes growing.
「At this moment, inside the vermilion coffin.」
The red-robed man’s face twisted, and he unexpectedly transformed back into a stunningly beautiful woman. Her captivating eyes, bright as stars, gazed gently in a certain direction, a knowing smile on her face.
That young girl possesses the bloodline of the Divine Dragon, making me feel incredibly close to her. If this little girl could ultimately obtain the inheritance of the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall, that would be for the best. Although I haven’t found him... seeing a Human cultivator with the same Divine Dragon bloodline still gives me an inexplicable sense of kinship.
"Damn woman, get lost!" The breathtakingly beautiful face contorted again, instantly morphing into a man’s ferocious visage. He bared his teeth and snarled angrily.
"You cannot eliminate this wisp of my obsession! You might as well give up that idea!" the stunning woman’s voice resonated in his mind.
"You wretched woman! Aren’t you just relying on the Nail of Killing Immortals? If not for that, I would have driven you out long ago!" the red-robed man retorted furiously.
Beneath his robe, at the very center of his chest, a long, blood-colored nail was embedded. This blood nail exuded a terrifying aura, pinning his heart firmly. For tens of thousands of years, the red-robed man had tried every conceivable method but could not remove this Nail of Killing Immortals.
"Hmph!" the stunning woman sneered from within his mind, "Stop wasting your efforts. Once the Nail of Killing Immortals is driven into the heart, not even a True God can escape. Furthermore, my obsession has already fused with this Nail of Killing Immortals. You can forget about escaping in this lifetime!"
"Hmph!" The red-robed man grunted, saying no more. This time, he pinned all his hopes on the second phase of his plan. As soon as a Human cultivator inherited the complete legacy of the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall, he planned to abandon this physical body and seize that cultivator’s.
...
Su Wanyi gradually progressed along the Path of Immortal Ascension. Eventually, she surpassed even the arrogant young man in white robes, taking the lead. The remaining nine cultivators could only watch Su Wanyi’s departing figure with a mixture of anger and frustration, but they were powerless to do anything. Fortunately, it wasn’t only the first to set foot on the Path of Immortal Ascension who qualified; everyone who embarked on it was eligible. Thus, being fast didn’t inherently grant a greater advantage at this stage.
As she walked deeper into the mist-shrouded Path of Immortal Ascension, Su Wanyi began to feel even greater pressure. Her steps were no longer as light as before.
「Two hours later.」
Su Wanyi’s qi and blood surged, and sweat drenched her body, but she gritted her teeth and persevered. Through the mist, she could already glimpse the end of the mountain path. Only a few hundred more steps, and she would complete this segment of the Path of Immortal Ascension.
One step, two steps, three steps...
With each of these hundreds of steps, the pressure she endured was unimaginable. At this point, Su Wanyi’s joints began to creak audibly. Clenching her teeth, she walked for another two hours and finally completed this section of the Path of Immortal Ascension.
At the exit of the Path of Immortal Ascension, an ancient stele stood upon the ground. Su Wanyi gazed at it.
"A single thought of the Red Dust, never to fade through eternity."
Two lines of exceedingly ancient, weathered characters were carved upon the stele. Su Wanyi took a deep breath. Looking at these eight characters, she felt an indescribable emotion stir within her heart.
This is...
Within Ye Yun’s mind, upon seeing these eight characters, his expression underwent a subtle change. He actually sensed a familiar style in these eight characters. However, only half of the characters on the stele bore a resemblance to what he knew. The other half was different. For a moment, Ye Yun couldn’t be certain.
Could these... truly be the words of my old friend from 100,000 years ago?

chapters.title: Chapter 152: Ancestral Dragon Bloodline, overwhelming for eternity
chapters.content:
Chapter 152: Chapter 152: Ancestral Dragon Bloodline, overwhelming for eternity
A beautiful figure suddenly appeared in Ye Yun’s mind.
One hundred thousand years ago.
As the top expert of the Cangnan Continent’s Eternal Realm, Ye Yun was an absolute tyrant.
Although he had been involved in many acts of injustice, he had many confidantes.
There were several reasons for his popularity with women. First, Ye Yun was handsome. Second, his strength was immense; if gentleness didn’t work, he resorted to force. Third, Ye Yun was generous and righteous, so many young women enjoyed his company.
The words on the stele in front of him resembled the style of one of his confidantes.
But only half of it was like hers.
At most, it’s just similar. After all, it’s been one hundred thousand years; they’re all long gone...
Ye Yun sighed softly.
After signing in for one hundred thousand years, his spirit had collapsed several times in that mysterious and boring space, only to be forcefully cured by the System.
Solitude for one hundred thousand years had reaped more than just countless Divine Skill and Weapon Arts and various resources. Most importantly, it had enabled his Dao Heart to endure through the ages.
His various tyrannical habits from before had gradually disappeared without him realizing it as his Dao Heart became stronger.
It could be said that the current Ye Yun was completely different from the Ye Yun of the past.
Su Wanyi silently walked towards the stele. For some reason, she felt a strange spiritual connection to it. She gently touched the text on the stele, her eyes moistening.
What’s wrong with me?
Su Wanyi gave a puzzled smile and wiped away the two teardrops from the corners of her eyes.
That a mere stele could move her so much surprised Su Wanyi.
She had been raised by her master, experiencing many hardships and facing the dangers of the world. Consequently, her character was particularly calm, and she possessed a very stable mindset.
Usually, very few things could make her lose her composure.
But to her surprise, the eight words on this stele caused Su Wanyi to experience an inexplicable surge of emotion.
PHEW!
She let out a long breath, slowly calming her emotions.
Subsequently, Su Wanyi looked into the distance.
There was a plaza up ahead, with a Blood Light Sphere in its center, where a red-robed man was standing.
Behind the plaza was a grand, Blood-Red Palace.
Could this be the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall?
Su Wanyi’s heart pounded with excitement. She quickened her pace, walking towards the Blood Light Sphere.
The red-robed man was somewhat shocked to see Su Wanyi as the first one to approach.
