He hadn’t expected the young woman with the lowest Cultivation Stage to be the first to complete the Immortal Ascension Route.
It seemed the inheritance of the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall would most likely fall into this young woman’s hands.
However, he needed to wait a little longer.
The red-robed man formed a hand seal, and a ray of light shot into the Blood Light Sphere. Instantly, a blood-red wall of light appeared in front of the plaza, blocking Su Wanyi’s path.
"You must wait here!" the red-robed man said softly.
"Oh!" Su Wanyi was momentarily stunned. Then, she complied with the rule and dutifully stood in her place.
Meanwhile, the several young men on the Immortal Ascension Route were drenched in sweat, their expressions pained as they struggled forward.
Although all of them were at the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm, the strength of their physical bodies varied.
Some had focused on Mana or Divine Skills, which seemed rather useless here.
However, some, with formidable physical bodies, managed to push forward tenaciously.
How can a mere Immortal Ascension Route possibly stop me?
The young man in white, who had been leading, reached the stele, drenched in sweat.
He wiped the sweat from his face, his eyes once again revealing an arrogant and aloof expression.
He glanced over and saw a beautiful young woman in a golden robe standing motionless before a red light wall in the distant plaza.
"Hmph!" The young man in white snorted and strode towards the light wall.
While walking, he stuffed a few pills into his mouth to restore his stamina.
"I didn’t expect that you, a young lady, would be the first to complete the Immortal Ascension Route. You’re quite extraordinary!"
The young man in white walked straight to Su Wanyi’s side, stood with his hands behind his back, gazed at the blood-red light wall, and spoke in an indifferent tone.
Su Wanyi remained silent, merely turning her head to glance at the young man in white.
This young man in white was the most powerful among the nine of them.
He had been the second to ascend the Immortal Ascension Route.
The overall strength of the young man in white was much greater than hers.
Su Wanyi speculated that even if she were to use the Reverse Dragon Technique to achieve five-fold combat power, the gap in their cultivation realms would make it impossible for her to defeat him.
"What kind of physique do you have? Why was it so easy for you to walk the Immortal Ascension Route?"
The young man in white looked at Su Wanyi with interest, seemingly trying to discern something.
"No comment!" Su Wanyi sneered.
Rebuffed, the young man in white chuckled but did not speak further.
Although he was the second to finish the Immortal Ascension Route, deep down, he was still filled with immense confidence.
The young man in white gazed at the Blood-Red Palace on the other side of the blood-red light wall and muttered to himself,
This should be the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall, and the inheritance... it’s probably inside.
After a while, his emotions calmed.
The young man in white turned his attention to the red-robed man in front of the Blood Light Sphere and scrutinized him a few times but was unable to discern his cultivation base.
He could only sigh.
He turned again, walked to the entrance of the plaza, and looked down upon the Immortal Ascension Route.
At this moment, a few other young men were slowly making their way over.
These guys really are persistent, but they don’t have the ability to make it up here...
A smirk appeared on the corner of the white-robed young man’s mouth.
After observing at the entrance for a while, he found it dull.
So, he turned and walked back to the blood-red light wall, standing there quietly to wait.
Two or three time units passed.
Finally, a young man in black made his way up.
The moment this young man reached the entrance, his body swayed, and he unsteadily plopped onto the ground.
It’s too hard! This Immortal Ascension Route is simply too difficult!
The young man in black panted heavily, continuously stuffing pills into his mouth to restore his stamina.
Just now on the Immortal Ascension Route, a powerful restrictive force had prevented him from using his Mana, so he couldn’t open his storage ring.
Throughout the journey, he had relied solely on his strong willpower and powerful physique to make it.
Now, he didn’t have an ounce of strength left in his body.
After consuming a few pills, he recovered some strength, then stood up and walked towards the light wall.
Blood Linglong Fairy Hall!
He walked up to the blood-red light wall, peered inside a few times, and a fervent gleam appeared in his eyes.
The red-robed man near the Blood Light Sphere saw that the other few individuals on the Immortal Ascension Route had already fainted.
With a wave of his large sleeve, those individuals were enveloped by a beam of blood-red light that descended from the sky, and they vanished from the Immortal Ascension Route.
The blood-red light wall suddenly disappeared.
The red-robed man, with his hands behind his back, slowly said, "The three of you have finally earned the qualification to enter the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall. However, who will ultimately obtain the inheritance will depend on your respective opportunities!"
Saying this, the red-robed man pointed towards the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall and nodded slightly.
"Go!"
Although the young man in black was weak, he was the first to stride towards the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall.
Fool!
The young man in white watched the back of the young man in black, a mocking smile playing on his lips.
At the final moment, it wasn’t about who entered first.
With his hands behind his back, he began walking towards the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall at a leisurely pace.
Su Wanyi was the last to act.
She was accustomed to this approach; in her heart, the inheritance of the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall was, nine times out of ten, going to be hers.
After all, her physical body was the strongest, and she possessed the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline.
The Ancestral Dragon Bloodline, overpowering all ages, stood above all other bloodlines on the entire Cangnan Continent!

chapters.title: Chapter 153: Evil Artifact Spirit, Breath of True God
chapters.content:
Chapter 153: Chapter 153: Evil Artifact Spirit, Breath of True God
The black-clad youth was the first to enter the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall. The white-clad youth was second, and Su Wanyi was third. The three of them entered one after another.
The interior of this Immortal Palace was now vastly different than before. The original vermilion coffin had vanished, its whereabouts unknown. The entire grand hall was bathed in a blood-red light, and floating in mid-air, dozens of zhang away, was a small blood-red tower. This Blood-coloured Small Tower seemed to be made of no tangible material; it was entirely condensed from red, bloody light. The entire gloomy hall was brightly illuminated by this one-foot-sized small tower, as bright as day.
Is this the final inheritance?
Su Wanyi stood in the center of the grand hall, gazing at the Blood-coloured Small Tower blooming with blood-light, a hint of excitement in her eyes. After experiencing countless hardships in the Red Dust Fairyland, they had finally reached this moment to receive the full inheritance of the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall.
Suddenly, a phantom figure rose from within the Blood-coloured Small Tower. This figure was shrouded in a layer of blood-mist, its features unclear, yet it emitted an unimaginably powerful aura.
Is it time to receive the inheritance?
The three youths’ eyes lit up, all excited.
The indistinct figure spoke faintly, "I am the Artifact Spirit of the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall, about to administer the final test to you all! This test will assess the strength of your Primordial Spirit. The stronger your Primordial Spirit, the greater your chance of receiving the inheritance!"
"Senior!" The black-clad youth stepped forward, his expression resolute as he said, "Proceed! I am willing to be the first to take the test!"
"Good, then you shall be the first!" The blurry, blood-colored figure suddenly transformed into a beam of light and dived into the black-clad youth’s mind.
The black-clad youth’s eyes widened abruptly, and blood began to leak from his pupils. His fists clenched tightly, veins bulging on them as he seemed to endure unimaginable pain.
This inheritance... is actually so terrifying?
The white-clad youth and Su Wanyi, standing nearby, were stunned by this sight.
The white-clad youth glanced at Su Wanyi and said casually, "If you’re scared, you can leave the grand hall now and withdraw from this test."
Su Wanyi shot the white-clad youth a disdainful glance.
This fellow is too arrogant. If I weren’t outmatched, I’d truly want to teach him a harsh lesson.
"AH!" The black-clad youth suddenly screamed and fell to the ground, unconscious. A streak of red light flew out, reappearing in mid-air.
The indistinct figure sighed and said, "This Heavenly Chosen One has lost the qualification to inherit the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall!" After he spoke, a beam of blood-red light descended from the sky, enveloping the black-clad youth. Instantly, the black-clad youth vanished.
"Senior, let it be me. No one is more suitable than I am!" The white-clad youth took a step forward and cupped his fists, his arrogance palpable.
"I hope you will not disappoint me..." the indistinct figure said softly, once again transforming into a beam of red light and entering the white-clad youth’s mind.
"URGH..." The white-clad youth instantly clenched his fists, his muscles tensed, and his eyes bulged from their sockets. At that moment, he experienced unimaginable pain.
"Senior, what are you doing?" The white-clad youth, after all, was a disciple of a Sky-Level Sect and possessed extensive knowledge, far surpassing the black-clad youth. He immediately sensed something was wrong.
"Nothing much, this is a test for your Primordial Spirit!" the indistinct figure chuckled coldly.
"No, you definitely harbor ill intentions! You’re trying to—!" the white-clad youth shouted, trying with all his might to expel the Artifact Spirit, but it was already too late.
The next moment, blood flowed from his eyes, his entire body trembled, and he immediately fainted. The blood-red light coalesced in mid-air again, forming a hazy, indistinct human figure.
All a bunch of trash...
The figure sighed, then turned its gaze toward Su Wanyi, the one with the lowest cultivation base.
This young girl... Although her cultivation realm is low, her physique is the most astounding.
Among the three Heavenly Chosen Ones, she was the one he thought most highly of. So, he had left Su Wanyi for last. In his judgment and calculations, even if this young girl couldn’t succeed, she at least wouldn’t fail too miserably. His possession had a certain chance of success.
This...
Seeing the white-clad youth and the black-clad youth successively faint and then vanish without a trace, Su Wanyi’s heart turned cold. Especially the words the white-clad youth had uttered before fainting. They made Su Wanyi feel as if she were facing a formidable enemy. She suddenly realized that this Artifact Spirit before her harbored ill intentions. Once that red light entered one’s body, it would definitely cause unimaginable damage.
Su Wanyi regretted it. At this moment, she no longer wanted to accept the inheritance.
This inheritance... it’s simply fatal!
She turned, wanting to leave. But her cultivation base was simply insufficient before the Artifact Spirit. Moreover, Su Wanyi was inside the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall; it could be said that everything was under the other party’s control.
Just then, the indistinct blood-red shadow transformed into a beam of light and shot into Su Wanyi’s mind.
Sigh...
Su Wanyi sighed and closed her eyes. She knew she was doomed this time.
"AH!" Suddenly, a miserable scream came from her mind. Immediately after, a blood-red light soared up and, in mid-air, once again transformed into that indistinct figure. An expression of immense shock appeared on this figure’s face. He stared intently at the girl before him and questioned loudly, "You... who are you exactly?"
"..." Su Wanyi was rather puzzled, not understanding what this Artifact Spirit meant.
WHOOSH! A white light suddenly shot out from between her eyebrows, coalescing into a white-robed figure in mid-air.
My heavens, it’s actually the Old Ancestor!
Looking at the familiar back, Su Wanyi was overcome with surprise and joy, so happy she almost fainted.
So the Old Ancestor had been in her mind all along, protecting her.
Crystal tears immediately welled up in Su Wanyi’s beautiful, excited eyes. She was incredibly moved. This time, if not for the Old Ancestor’s protection, she reckoned she would have been secretly harmed by this Artifact Spirit.
Ye Yun stood with his hands clasped behind him, calmly gazing at the indistinct figure, a faint smile playing on his lips. His body was almost illusory now, yet it exuded a sacred white light. Yet, oddly, no one could discern any cultivation base from him.
"I am her Old Ancestor," Ye Yun said with a smile. "You bullied a disciple of my sect; did you ask this Old Ancestor for permission?"
So, it’s just a wisp of a Primordial Spirit left behind by an ancestor from the sect?
the indistinct figure sneered inwardly. WHOOSH! He made a grabbing motion with his large hand, and the Blood-coloured Small Tower immediately flew over, merging with his body. In the next moment, he transformed into the illusory image of a middle-aged man. He wore a grand red robe, his face pale and ferocious. His entire being emanated endless blood-light, giving the impression of a Demon King who had slaughtered his way out of a sea of blood.
This cultivation level...
Ye Yun gazed at the body formed by this wisp of a remnant Primordial Spirit, a slight surprise in his expression. The red-robed man before him was actually exuding the aura of the True God Realm!

chapters.title: Chapter 154: What? You’re also in the True God Realm?
chapters.content:
Chapter 154: Chapter 154: What? You’re also in the True God Realm?
True God Realm?!
This was truly astounding for Ye Yun.
On the Cangnan Continent, the Eternal Realm was already the pinnacle of experts. As for True God Realm Cultivators, merely two or three had emerged in the last hundred thousand years.
In the primeval, prehistoric, and Ancient Eras, some True God Realm Cultivators were born, but they were as rare as phoenix feathers and unicorn horns.
In Ye Yun’s time, there were no True God Realm Cultivators in existence.
The True God Realm, during his era, was merely a legendary realm.
What surprised Ye Yun was that in the Secret Realm of the Red Dust Fairyland, a Primordial Spirit was emanating the Super Divine Dragon Breath of a True God Realm powerhouse.
Although this Primordial Spirit appeared rather shattered, the emitted True God-stage Super Divine Dragon Breath was genuinely authentic.
However, the True God-stage Super Divine Dragon Breath it released was extremely faint.
If it had been any other person, they would definitely have difficulty sensing it. Or, even if someone could sense it, they wouldn’t necessarily be able to identify it. After all, even Eternal Realm Strong Persons had never seen a True God Realm.
Ye Yun’s interest was immediately piqued. He was keen to learn more about this shattered Primordial Spirit.
The red-robed man looked at Ye Yun arrogantly and sneered, "It seems you have some insight to be able to sense my Super Divine Dragon Breath."
"Are you at the True God Realm?" Ye Yun feigned a shocked expression.
"Indeed, I am a True God!" The red-robed man began to laugh haughtily, his voice reverberating throughout the entire hall.
"It is this junior of your family’s honor to be chosen by me. As for you, Old Ancestor, just wait for your rise to glory!" the red-robed man sneered.
"Your way of thinking is rather peculiar. As a man intending to invade a woman’s body, don’t you feel uncomfortable?" Ye Yun responded with a casual smile.
The True God-stage Primordial Spirit before him was already shattered and weak, which was why it wanted to possess Su Wanyi.
Among all the cultivators, Su Wanyi had the strongest physique; there was a high chance she could withstand the oppressive power of a True God’s Primordial Spirit.
Even though that wisp of Primordial Spirit appeared weak to Ye Yun, in reality, even a Life and Death Realm cultivator would struggle to receive this True God-stage Primordial Spirit.
As for Eternal Realm Strong Persons... Naturally, they couldn’t accept its possession either. This wisp of shattered Primordial Spirit could, at most, display the prowess of an Eternal Realm Cultivator.
In Ye Yun’s eyes, all of this was less than an ant. After all, he already possessed the cultivation base of the Divine Monarch Realm—a genuine Divine Monarch Realm—surpassing the other party by thousands of times.
"I have waited for tens of thousands of years. Now that I have finally found a suitable vessel, I must make do!" the red-robed man cackled.
Su Wanyi, who was beside them, found her breathing becoming labored, and goosebumps rose all over her skin.
She truly couldn’t imagine how disgusting it would be if this guy possessed her.
"You, a mere shattered True God-stage Primordial Spirit, believe you can be my opponent?" Ye Yun stood with his hands behind his back, calm and unperturbed, a faint smile playing on his lips.
The red-robed man was taken aback. He hadn’t expected the white-robed young man before him to provoke him so brazenly. Fury ignited within his heart.
The red-robed man sneered, "You’re just the Old Ancestor of some Sect. Even if your cultivation base has reached the Eternal Realm, this wisp of Primordial Spirit residing in this girl’s mind is no match for me!"
Saying this, he unexpectedly extended his hand, attempting to seize Ye Yun.
Inside the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall, he was almost invincible. Not only could he utilize his own strong cultivation, but he could also command all the power of the Blood Linglong Pagoda. Even an Eternal Realm Cultivator wouldn’t be able to cause a ripple in his presence.
Ye Yun just smiled. At this moment, he also released a wisp of his Super Divine Dragon Breath.
"What? You are also at the True God Realm?" Greatly shocked, the red-robed man’s outstretched hand froze abruptly in mid-air.
He had never imagined that the white-robed young man before him was also a True God Realm powerhouse! This was utterly inconceivable. Judging by the strength of the other’s Primordial Spirit, it was even stronger than his own. If they were to clash head-on, he feared he wouldn’t be his opponent.
"If you know what’s good for you, kneel obediently and state your origins. I might still spare your worthless life!" Ye Yun stated calmly.
"Don’t dream! With an Emperor artifact in my hand, why should I fear a mere True God-stage Primordial Spirit like you?" The red-robed man scoffed. His arms spread wide, and the blood-red energy in the air around him began to violently surge.
In that instant, within the blood light, it seemed a great array had activated, emitting a deafening, rumbling sound. A formidable force surged towards Ye Yun, attempting to shred him to pieces.
As for Su Wanyi, she was not attacked at all. After all, the red-robed man still intended to possess Su Wanyi. Having waited for tens of thousands of years, he would not allow any harm to befall her.
Hearing the thunderous rumbling echoing all around, Su Wanyi’s expression changed slightly. At this moment, she looked at her Ancestor with concern. After all, this was just a strand of her Ancestor’s Primordial Spirit. Yet, this red-robed man controlled the entire Blood Linglong Immortal Palace and was operating a great array in an attempt to exterminate her Ancestor.
The power of the array, like a massive grindstone, unleashed an unimaginable annihilating force! Even an Eternal Realm Strong Person would be annihilated at this moment.
However, when the array’s power descended before Ye Yun, it strangely vanished.
Ye Yun gave a faint smile, "Can this trashy Blood Linglong Pagoda of yours increase its offensive prowess even a little?"
"What?" The red-robed man was aghast, his body trembling slightly.
How could this strand of True God-stage Primordial Spirit be so powerful? Even when he deployed the full power of the Blood Linglong Pagoda’s great array in an attempt to annihilate him, he failed to inflict the slightest harm on the young man! Such terrifying annihilating force had swept past, only to vanish like a gentle breeze! What exactly is his cultivation base? Or... does he possess an unbelievably powerful defensive treasure?
The thought that the other party possessed a treasure capable of resisting his Blood Linglong Pagoda instantly thrilled the red-robed man, his eyes gleaming with fanaticism. His Blood Linglong Pagoda was already an Emperor artifact. Could it be that the other party possessed a God-level defensive treasure?
A God-level item! The mere thought made the red-robed man’s breath catch in his throat. In his world, even Divine Kings would fight to the death over a God-level magic treasure!
"Very well, then taste the true power of my Blood Linglong Pagoda!" the red-robed man roared with rage, his entire body radiating crimson divine light as he threw himself into the void and vanished.
From within the great array, even more terrifying rumbling sounds erupted. Blood-red gales swirled around, laced with countless bolts of heavenly lightning and tongues of earthly fire. At this moment, it was as if the apocalypse had descended.
The red-robed man’s eyes glinted with madness; this time, his attack even enveloped Su Wanyi.
To seize that defensive-grade Divine Artifact, he was even willing to abandon the vessel he had finally obtained. That white-robed young man opposite him would surely be distracted trying to protect Su Wanyi. When that happened, he would be caught off guard and overwhelmed! He would surely be utterly annihilated by my Blood Linglong Pagoda’s great array!
How boring...
Ye Yun merely offered a gentle smile.
Gazing at the frenzied onslaught of earth, water, fire, and wind from all directions, his eyes suddenly took on an uncanny glint. Countless star-like, minuscule runes floated and shifted within his eyes, unleashing an unimaginably terrifying might.

chapters.title: Chapter 155: Sir, I’m Willing to Surrender
chapters.content:
Chapter 155: Chapter 155: Sir, I’m Willing to Surrender
The surrounding space was dreamlike and illusory.
Those terrifying elements of earth, water, fire, and wind, thunder, and fire, melted away like the early spring snow at this moment.
Without the slightest warning.
The man in the red robe nearly dropped his eyeballs when he saw this.
What was going on? The Blood Linglong Pagoda was an Emperor artifact, wasn’t it? The guy opposite had not even used any magical treasures, yet with a weird Pupil Technique Divine Power, he easily destroyed the great array’s prowess within his Emperor artifact. This was truly terrifying!
"What...What is your cultivation base?"
The man in the red robe looked at Ye Yun in shock, his mind churning with shockwaves.
The other party was merely a strand of Primordial Spirit, yet he could easily break the attack of the Blood Linglong Pagoda’s great array. He was definitely more than just at the True God Realm.
Su Wanyi saw the horrifying scenes of roaring thunder and fire reminiscent of the apocalypse vanish like blue smoke around them.
She was secretly astounded. The ancestor was indeed very powerful, and immensely so! A simple strand of Primordial Spirit could casually neutralize the great array attack of the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall; such power was truly against the heavens!
...
Ye Yun stood with his hands behind his back, his expression light and breezy.
"Not too stupid!"
He chuckled lightly, radiating a trace of the Divine Monarch Realm’s Super Divine Dragon Breath.
"What?"
"You’re at the Divine Monarch Realm?"
"How can this be possible?"
"On the Cangnan Continent, even True Gods are pitifully few. How can there be a Divine Monarch?"
"This world absolutely cannot produce a Divine Monarch. Could it be... you also come from the Divine Land?"
The man in the red robe screamed out, his face filled with horror.
He was trembling all over, no longer retaining any fighting will.
He was just a partial Primordial Spirit at the True God Realm, completely relying on the prowess of the Blood Linglong Pagoda. He initially thought he could easily suppress the opposing True God Realm Primordial Spirit that was comparable to an Eternal Realm Cultivator. But surprisingly, the opponent’s Primordial Spirit had already reached the Divine Monarch Realm! The Divine Monarch Realm, even in the Divine Land, was a majestic and unrivaled existence! Far beyond what his lowly True God could contest.
"Master, I am willing to surrender!"
The man in the red robe immediately knelt on the ground, kowtowing, and appearing extremely respectful.
"What use do I have for a fragment of a True God Realm Primordial Spirit?"
Ye Yun gave a light laugh, his expression slightly somber.
The red-robed man’s expression turned frantic. He quickly patted his chest and solemnly declared, "Master, I am willing to hand over this Blood Linglong Pagoda to you. Also, I know many secrets about the Divine Land, and I can tell you all of them..."
"Divine Land..."
Ye Yun gave a faint smile; the two words seemed to evoke some of his memories.
It seemed that outside the Cangnan Continent and its islands lay this so-called Divine Land.
"Master, the Divine Land is the world beyond Cangnan Continent. To tell the truth, I came from there. I fled to Cangnan Continent to escape the pursuit of my enemies..."
The man in the red robe hurriedly explained.
Ye Yun nodded slightly.
He had already suspected that the True God Realm Primordial Spirit in front of him was not a native Cultivator of Cangnan Continent. Now, his suspicions were confirmed. However, Ye Yun did not have a good impression of the man in the red robe. As for the secrets of the Divine Land he mentioned, they were of no significance to him.
「Several seconds later.」
Ye Yun’s pupils constricted slightly as the tiny star runes constantly flared and faded in his eyes.
The man in the red robe stared in shock as his body gradually dissolved into thin wisps of smoke and vanished.
"You have such a cruel heart!"
The man in the red robe roared furiously before he disappeared.
"Why would I need a useless creature like you?"
Ye Yun smiled indifferently.
He activated the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye, having already plundered the man’s memories.
For Ye Yun, he didn’t need seemingly loyal followers. Acquiring information directly from memory extraction was faster.
This guy, his name is Blood Robe Ancestor. He stole someone’s Emperor artifact, risked his life to pass through the Ancient Road to Heaven. Unfortunately, his physical body perished there. He only managed to scrape by until now by hiding his Primordial Spirit inside the Blood Linglong Pagoda...
Ye Yun muttered to himself.
He now had a new understanding of the Blood Robe Ancestor’s origins.
Ye Yun’s gaze shifted in another direction.
According to the Blood Robe Ancestor’s memories, a part of the Blood Linglong Pagoda’s legacy had been inherited by a ten-thousand-year-old corpse. This ten-thousand-year-old corpse, which had cultivated Spirit Wisdom, masterminded the Red Dust Fairyland. And in the body of this ten-thousand-year-old corpse, there was even the obsession of a woman. This intrigued me.
Regardless, Ye Yun was not in a rush. He wanted to resolve the issue of the Blood Linglong Pagoda’s Artifact Spirit first.
"Girl, this is the Blood Linglong Pagoda’s Artifact Spirit. The entire Red Dust Fairyland was transformed from the Blood Linglong Pagoda. The space within it is incredibly profound. Once a person is drawn into it and the formation is activated, that person can be annihilated!"
Ye Yun pointed at the Blood-coloured Small Tower and said calmly.
The Blood-coloured Small Tower spun around and flew in front of Su Wanyi.
Su Wanyi was extremely excited.
She had been in the Red Dust Fairyland for so long and suffered so much for the legacy of the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall. And this Blood Linglong Fairy Hall was also transformed from a part of the Blood Linglong Pagoda.
"Ancestor, can I really control this treasure?"
Su Wanyi hesitated.
The white-clothed youth and the black-clothed youth before her had been rendered unconscious by this Artifact Spirit. She was now somewhat nervous.
"I’ll help you refine a part of it. Once your cultivation has improved, you can slowly refine it further!"
Ye Yun smiled lightly and pointed his finger.
The Blood-coloured Small Tower immediately let out a mournful wail, flying into Su Wanyi’s mind.
In the sea of her consciousness, a Blood-coloured Small Tower burst into red light, quietly floating there, appearing exceedingly obedient.
The Artifact Spirit only had basic Spirit Wisdom. Under the strong suppression of Divine Monarch Ye Yun, it dared not resist nor fight back. It obediently entered Su Wanyi’s body.
「Next.」
Ye Yun taught Su Wanyi a Cultivation Technique to refine magical treasures.
After pondering for a while, Su Wanyi finally managed to initially refine the Artifact Spirit.
Now she could completely pack up the Red Dust Fairyland and end this round of trials.
Looking at Su Wanyi, Ye Yun seemed to have seen through her thoughts, and he casually smiled, "Now that you have initial control of the Blood Linglong Pagoda, drive all the Cultivators out of here..."
Su Wanyi’s beautiful face turned red.
She did indeed have that idea, to drive all the Cultivators out.
That way, the number of Blood Demons would no longer decrease, and she would be able to swallow the Blood Demons to continuously improve her cultivation base.
Su Wanyi, after all, had a composed temperament. After a brief moment of shyness, her mind quickly stabilized.
She summoned the Blood-coloured Small Tower and cast a spell. The Blood-coloured Small Tower immediately burst into a splendid light.
The Red Dust Fairyland began to tremble, as winds rose and clouds surged.
All Cultivators in the First Level and second levels, at this moment, were enveloped by red light and forcefully teleported out one after another.

chapters.title: Chapter 156: Corpse Venerable Appears on the Eighth Layer of the Divine Bridge
chapters.content:
Chapter 156: Chapter 156: Corpse Venerable Appears on the Eighth Layer of the Divine Bridge
"What happened?"
"Why were we teleported out?"
"Could it be that someone has received the legacy of the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall?"
The millions of Cultivators floating mid-air looked befuddled. Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from the Sky-Level Sects were particularly crestfallen, regretting their missed opportunity for the elusive legacy.
BOOM!
The void reverberated with rumbling sounds and began to fluctuate intensely.
The intense red light column unexpectedly retracted from within the valley beneath, receding back into the spatial aperture before vanishing completely.
The next moment, the massive aperture in the void also slowly sealed.
"The Red Dust Fairyland trial has ended..."
An old cultivator in the Life and Death Realm shook his head gently and immediately gathered his disciples together in the void.
The old man retrieved a Mysterious Yellow Array Disk and channeled his Mana into it.
A brilliant pillar of light soared into the sky. An instant later, the void vibrated as a colossal pillar of light descended, enveloping all of them.
The colossal light column rose from the ground and vanished into the depths of the sky in the blink of an eye.
This Sky-Level Sect used reverse Void Throw to return to their own Sect.
The other major Sky-Level Sects followed suit. One radiant pillar of light after another descended from the heavens, teleporting everyone away.
After all the Sky-Level Sects had departed, the remaining Super Sects also initiated Void Throw and left the area.
Finally, the Sect Masters of the remaining large Sects summoned various flying Dharma treasures and departed with their disciples.
The Sects from the Shenfeng Dynasty also led their disciples away.
This time, every Sect participating in the trial had made significant advancements. Although there were some casualties and a few disciples perished, all disciples at the Shaping God Realm had advanced to the Divine Bridge Realm. This gain was more than enough to compensate for the losses.
「Inside the Red Dust Fairyland.」
On the plaza of the Mystical Space, the man in red sensed the vast changes within the entire Red Dust Fairyland, a hint of delight appearing on his face.
That young lady truly inherited the complete legacy of the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall.
It seems the Lord’s judgment is truly exceptional.
「Within the Blood Linglong Fairy Hall at the moment.」
Su Wanyi, controlling the Blood-coloured Small Tower, hunted down numerous Blood Demons and teleported their Inner Alchemy over.
A small, mountain-like pile of Blood Demon Inner Alchemy had accumulated before her.
Ye Yun let out a chuckle.
Su Wanyi immediately turned beet red at the Old Ancestor’s chuckle.
"Old Ancestor, wouldn’t this be considered cheating?" Su Wanyi whispered.
"It would, I suppose!" Ye Yun chuckled, then added, "While this method of cultivation enhancement has no side effects, it does mean you’ve missed out on many life-and-death experiences. How about this: you advance to the Eighth Layer of Divine Bridge Stage, the same as Luo Li and Jun Moxiao..."
"Alright, Old Ancestor!" Su Wanyi’s face turned red as she quickly nodded in agreement.
Ye Yun transformed into a beam of white light and returned to Su Wanyi’s mind.
Su Wanyi began to absorb the Blood Demon Inner Alchemy.
She absorbed them incredibly quickly; her Super Divine Dragon Breath surged, visibly strengthening at an incredible rate.
Fifth Level of Divine Bridge Realm!
Sixth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm!
Seventh Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm!
Eighth Layer of Divine Bridge Stage!
After reaching the Eighth Layer of Divine Bridge Stage, Su Wanyi stopped absorbing the Blood Demon Inner Alchemy.
She looked at the remaining Blood Demon Inner Alchemy and stored them in her storage ring.
Now, at least my cultivation base is finally the same as my junior brother and junior sister...
A hint of joy touched Su Wanyi’s exquisitely beautiful face.
For a long time, she, the eldest senior sister, had been at the bottom, which was quite awkward.
Unexpectedly, the opening of the Red Dust Fairyland this time had actually been her great opportunity.
Now, the three of them—siblings in cultivation—were at the same realm, advancing side by side. In future battles, she could finally coordinate with her junior brother and sister.
"Go to the First Level of the main hall. Someone will be waiting for you there..." the Old Ancestor’s voice echoed in her mind.
Su Wanyi quickly manipulated the Blood-coloured Small Tower. In an instant, as if stars had shifted and constellations turned, the surrounding space transformed.
She reappeared in a great hall. In its depths floated a crimson coffin, densely covered with intricate runes, exuding an extremely mysterious aura.
Could this be the person the Old Ancestor said was waiting for me?
Su Wanyi stood still, the Blood-coloured Small Tower resting in her palm, silently observing the crimson coffin.
Suddenly, the coffin lid levitated. A red-robed man with a vicious appearance floated out from within.
"HAHA... Indeed, everything went according to my plan! You successfully obtained the complete legacy of Blood Linglong!"
The red-robed man laughed heartily, his voice booming, causing the surrounding space to hum.
"Who on earth are you?" Su Wanyi asked, watching the man before her with a vigilant expression.
The man was hideous, his features twisted, not resembling a normal human. A dense aura of death emanated from him, like that of an ancient corpse dead for millennia.
"I can’t quite recall my title from my previous life, but in this one, I do have a name. You may call me Lord Corpse Venerable!" the red-robed man boomed, his expression filled with immense pride.
"What exactly do you want?" Su Wanyi asked, frowning. This Corpse Venerable before her seemed extremely unhinged, giving her a strong sense of impending crisis.
However, with the Old Ancestor in her mind, Su Wanyi felt no fear.
"This body of yours, I’m planning to take it. I’m going to possess you!" the red-robed man cackled.
As he finished speaking, his body began to sway. A thick sanguineous aura, suffused with corpse qi, spilled out from him.
"Dream on! As if I’d let you possess her!" a woman’s voice suddenly echoed through the hall without warning.
Ye Yun was momentarily stunned.
This voice is so familiar... It has been a hundred thousand years since I last heard it.
Connecting this to the eight words on the Stele earlier...
Ye Yun instantly understood.
The lingering obsession of the female cultivator within this Corpse Demon... it’s actually my confidante... Qin Yao!
As the woman’s voice faded, Su Wanyi saw one side of the red-robed man’s face contort, revealing an ethereally beautiful countenance. The two faces, one on each side, were starkly different, creating a truly hair-raising sight.
Su Wanyi gasped. She hadn’t imagined that a woman was hidden within this Corpse Demon, and this woman was clearly trying to stop Corpse Venerable.
"Damn bitch, you dare to stop me? Fine, I’ll drag you down to hell with me this time!" the red-robed man snarled, humiliated and enraged.
"Drag her down with you? You dare to bully my woman like this, and you didn’t even ask me?" a gentle voice suddenly resonated through the void.
A beam of white light shot out from between Su Wanyi’s eyebrows. In mid-air, it coalesced into a sacred, white figure.

chapters.title: Chapter 157: Trusted Female Friend, A Secret from One Hundred Thousand Years Ago
chapters.content:
Chapter 157: Chapter 157: Trusted Female Friend, A Secret from One Hundred Thousand Years Ago
"Who? Who’s speaking?"
"Who are you?"
The man in the red robe was quite startled upon suddenly seeing the illusory silhouette emanating a holy radiance across from him. His ugly face betrayed immense shock. He could never have imagined that a Divine Sense was hidden within the mind of this weak female cultivator.
Only an expert who had reached the Life and Death Realm could possess such a formidable Divine Sense.
"You... you..."
Her half-beautiful face turned towards the handsome white figure bathed in holy light. Her eyes reddened and welled with tears, her voice trembling.
Wasn’t this the Ye Yun that she, Qin Yao, had been searching for tens of thousands of years?
「One hundred thousand years ago.」
They were deeply in love, inseparable like a pair of birds flying wing to wing, akin to a celestial couple.
"Qin Yao, it’s been 100,000 years. Who would have thought... we would have another chance to meet..." Ye Yun said calmly.
Yet, unbeknownst to him, tears began to well up at the corners of his eyes.
Although his Dao Heart was immutable, Ye Yun was still human. Moreover, being a transmigrator, his experiences were complex. So, at this moment, Ye Yun found it hard to conceal his inner turmoil.
"Brother Yun, I’ve been searching for you for 100,000 years! I knew... I knew you wouldn’t die!" Qin Yao choked out, her voice filled with emotion.
At these words, the hardships and grievances of the past 100,000 years erupted in her mind all at once, and her half-beautiful face was soon completely covered with tears.
Su Wanyi watched all of this, stunned, like a stone statue.
She could never have imagined! The woman within this Corpse Demon was actually the girlfriend of her Ancestor from 100,000 years ago! Another figure who had lived for 100,000 years!
Su Wanyi felt her mind buzzing.
At this moment, she was moved, excited, and shocked all at once; her emotions were extremely complex.
Seeing both her Ancestor and the exquisite woman with tears in their eyes, Su Wanyi was also deeply moved, and tears streamed down her face.
One hundred thousand years. For two lovers, separated for 100,000 years, to meet again... this is truly touching.
Seeing this, the man in the red robe could no longer contain himself. He roared, "So, you wretched pair, you’re old acquaintances after all?!"
Ye Yun’s expression turned cold. He glanced at the man in the red robe.
In an instant, the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye activated.
The man in the red robe screamed as his Primordial Spirit instantly turned into a wisp of green smoke and dispersed.
Qin Yao was slightly startled.
She hadn’t expected Ye Yun to be so powerful now. Just a glance, and an expert comparable to the Life and Death Realm was reduced to ashes. But this was the man she once loved! One hundred thousand years ago, Ye Yun was the strongest in the Eternal Realm on the Cangnan Continent, outclassing all his opponents. Now, 100,000 years later, Ye Yun’s cultivation base had reached an unimaginable level. But what about her...
A twinge of sadness touched Qin Yao’s heart, but she quickly pushed it away.
Her body shimmered and transformed. In the blink of an eye, she became a breathtakingly beautiful woman.
"So beautiful!" Su Wanyi exclaimed, visibly stunned at the sight of the gorgeous woman in the red dress.
This confidante of the Ancestor was so beautiful that terms like ’nation-toppling beauty’ or ’peerless elegance’ could hardly describe her. She was like a celestial fairy descended from the Ninth Heaven, beautiful beyond description.
Ye Yun moved, appearing before Qin Yao.
He reached out, gently caressing Qin Yao’s face, his eyes filled with boundless tenderness.
"Brother Yun, I’ve been looking for you for 100,000 years..." Qin Yao murmured, tears streaming down her face.
"This form of yours is a wisp of lingering obsession," Ye Yun said in a low voice, his heart heavy. "Why did you insist on finding me? What exactly happened?"
The real Qin Yao was long dead; the woman before him was merely her lingering obsession.
Ye Yun also noticed a Nail of Killing Immortals deeply embedded in Qin Yao’s heart.
This Nail of Killing Immortals was something he and Qin Yao had accidentally obtained during their trials in the Ancient Demon Abyss. He had given it to Qin Yao back then.
This wisp of Qin Yao’s obsession had merged with the Nail of Killing Immortals. Furthermore, by pinning this Corpse Demon and constantly battling it for tens of thousands of years, her obsession had become severely depleted.
Qin Yao said softly, her eyes welling with tears, "Brother Yun, I always felt your demise back then was rather suspicious. So, I investigated secretly and discovered that someone could actually command Ancient Giant Demons to attack the Dragon God Sect. Brother Yun, I believe you might recall something about this?"
"Commanding Ancient Giant Demons?"
Ye Yun’s heart skipped a beat.
During their training trip to the Ancient Demon Ape, there were three of them: Ye Yun and his two confidantes, Qin Yao and Nangong Jade. That time, Ye Yun acquired an Ancient Demon Violin that could command certain Ancient Giant Demons. He had given the violin to Nangong Jade at the time because Nangong Jade’s strength was somewhat less than Qin Yao’s. And he had given the Nail of Killing Immortals to Qin Yao.
Could Nangong Jade have used the Ancient Demon Violin to command Ancient Giant Demons to attack the Dragon God Sect?
Thinking of this, Ye Yun shook his head, finding Qin Yao’s words somewhat doubtful.
Nangong Jade was also one of his confidantes. Why... why would she attack the Dragon God Sect after his death? This was truly difficult to believe.
"Brother Yun, while I was investigating, I was discovered by a hidden power. Then, several Ancient Giant Demons appeared and killed my true body..." Qin Yao’s expression darkened, her tears falling unstoppably. "Later, a remnant of my Primordial Spirit attached itself to the Nail of Killing Immortals and flew into the turbulent void currents, thus escaping the pursuit of the Ancient Giant Demons. However, due to my struggle against the void turbulence, my Primordial Spirit almost completely disintegrated."
"But, to find you, I forcibly burned my Primordial Spirit, transforming it into a lingering obsession hidden within the Nail of Killing Immortals. Later, I happened upon this Corpse Demon drifting in the void and attached myself to it..."
"After more than 10,000 years, we inadvertently received the inheritance of the Blood Linglong Pagoda. The Corpse Demon’s consciousness wanted to be rid of me, while I wished to contact Human Race cultivators to find your whereabouts. So, we joined forces to open the Red Dust Fairyland, allowing Human Race cultivators to enter for trials."
"This way, on one hand, we could replenish the energy of the Blood Linglong Pagoda. On the other hand, by extracting the memories of deceased Human Race cultivators, I was also searching for your whereabouts, Brother Yun... My hard work finally paid off, and I found you, Brother Yun!"
Reaching this point, Qin Yao could no longer suppress her emotions. She threw herself into Ye Yun’s arms, hugging him tightly and bursting into tears, crying uncontrollably.
Her tears gushed out like a river, drenching Ye Yun’s clothes before silently sliding off.
Ye Yun sighed.
What a silly girl, to have endured so much hardship over these 100,000 years. Among all his confidantes, Ye Yun had never expected Qin Yao to be the one most deeply devoted to him. This made him feel somewhat ashamed.
「One hundred thousand years later.」
Ye Yun had once thought that with the passage of time, all would be different, that his former confidantes, like Liu Yiyi of the Sword King Stone, would have long turned to dust. However, Ye Yun had never imagined... that even after 100,000 years, he would see Qin Yao again, alive.

chapters.title: Chapter 158: For the Beauty, Fight the Heavenly Dao
chapters.content:
Chapter 158: Chapter 158: For the Beauty, Fight the Heavenly Dao
"From now on... you will never be wronged again. In this world, no one will dare to bully you. Anyone who dares to harm you, I will ensure they never reincarnate!" Ye Yun said softly, gently stroking Qin Yao’s shoulder.
Listening to these crude and domineering words, a blissful smile appeared on Qin Yao’s beautiful face.
Suddenly, she broke free from Ye Yun’s embrace.
Qin Yao gently touched Ye Yun’s face with her hand, a satisfied smile on her face as she whispered, "Brother Yun, this obsession of mine... when I swore an oath to the Heavenly Dao, it was a thought in my heart that wouldn’t dissipate for eternity. Now that I have seen you, my obsession has been resolved. I have no more attachments and can leave in peace..."
"What are you talking about? Silly girl, how could I let you leave me?"
Tears welled up in Ye Yun’s eyes.
Although he had already guessed that her obsession would change like this, when he faced Qin Yao, he still couldn’t control the sorrow in his heart.
"Brother Yun, my Three Souls and Seven Spirits dissipated a hundred thousand years ago. This strand of my obsession is like a drifting duckweed."
"Now that I have seen you, that will has dissipated. Even though I am reluctant, I have no choice but to leave you..." Qin Yao said, sobbing.
At this point, the stunningly beautiful woman in red began to change, transforming into the figure of the ugly man.
Then, an illusory figure flew up from above her head, smiling at Ye Yun in the void.
Her body started transforming into particles, on the verge of dissipating into the world.
"ARGH!"
Seeing this scene, Su Wanyi couldn’t hold back anymore and burst into uncontrollable tears.
She could not accept such an outcome.
This woman named Qin Yao, who had been searching for the Ancestor for a hundred thousand years, was now unexpectedly going to leave this world at the final moment.
This was completely different from what she had imagined.
"Qin Yao, don’t worry. I will resurrect you and give you a perfect body..."
Ye Yun looked up at the fading figure. He fiercely reached out his hand, and with unimaginable power, caught Qin Yao in his grip.
The next moment, the stars revolved, and both Su Wanyi and Ye Yun reappeared inside the black carriage.
Ye Yun opened his eyes.
In his hands, divine light blossomed, boundless Divine Power enveloping Qin Yao’s illusory body, forcibly interrupting the dissipation of this strand of obsession.
What a joke!
Ye Yun, who had become invincible after signing in for a hundred thousand years, how could he accept such an outcome?
RUMBLE!
Dark clouds suddenly gushed out in the high sky; within the cloud layers, frequent flashes of lightning soared around like giant dragons, producing loud rumbles.
In the distance, the Supreme Elder of the Red Flame Sword Sect, seeing the terrifyingly abnormal change in the sky, was shocked beyond words.
In the next moment, he shouted aloud swiftly, "Everyone, leave the Red Flame Sword Sect immediately!"
After saying that, he made every effort to sweep up some disciples and made a quick exit from this location.
The terrifying phenomenon in the sky seemed to signal that some powerful figure was undergoing a Heavenly Tribulation.
The Red Flame Sword Sect would not be able to withstand the impact of the aftermath of the Heavenly Tribulation.
「The entire Shenfeng Dynasty.」
All the Sects at this moment felt the terrifying changes between heaven and earth; many cultivators were so terrified they trembled uncontrollably.
The Sect Master of the Yu Mo Sect looked up at the sky in shock. He could not imagine what kind of terrifying figure was undergoing the tribulation.
"Quickly, activate the Mountain Protection Array!" he suddenly roared towards the inside of the Sect.
CLANG!
A Sword Array surged into the sky, protecting the entire Yu Mo Sect.
Almost all the Sects in the entire Dragon Emperor Dynasty activated their Mountain Protection Array.
Everyone lived in fear, not knowing when this terrifying spectacle would pass.
Ye Yun’s body moved, and in an instant, he appeared in the void.
He looked up at the dark clouds looming overhead as if to crush a city, lightning continuously converging within them.
Ye Yun’s face was cold, and he let out a cold laugh.
"Heavenly Dao, you dare to obstruct me?"
RUMBLE!
Huge peals of thunder rolled within the dark clouds, as if the Heavenly Dao was expressing its inner rage.
Ye Yun’s face was plastered with a cold smirk.
Qin Yao’s Primordial Spirit had burned as she swore an oath to the Heavenly Dao, transforming into a strand of obsession.
Now that this heart-knot was untied, it naturally had to return to Heaven and Earth.
All of this was witnessed by the Heavenly Dao.
But now, Ye Yun wanted to forcefully break the shackles of the Heavenly Dao, which antagonized it.
"Master, is he going to challenge the Heavenly Dao?" Big Black Horse stared at the sky, its face filled with terror.
At this moment, facing this phenomenon of Heaven and Earth, it instinctively felt an indescribable fear.
Even though it had reached the Eternal Realm, it still didn’t have the guts to challenge the Heavenly Dao.
"Uncle Ma, I can’t breathe..."
Facing the overwhelming Heavenly Might, the Big Black Cat curled up into a ball, its body constantly shivering.
It was merely a small demon beast of the Destiny Realm. Faced with such a horrifying phenomenon, it was as insignificant as an ant, utterly trivial.
A terrifying wave of lightning energy swept down from the sky, about to land on the Big Black Cat and reduce it to ashes.
At this moment, Big Black Horse immediately released a Super Divine Dragon Breath, enveloping the Big Black Cat.
"Don’t be afraid! We are the Master’s Divine Pets; we can’t succumb to the Heavenly Dao!" Big Black Horse said hoarsely.
At this point, a streak of ruthlessness flashed in Big Black Horse’s eyes.
It glared fiercely at the sky, also expressing its own defiance.
Influenced by Uncle Ma, the Big Black Cat also struggled to stand up, faced the sky, and fiercely spat a mouthful of saliva.
Seeing Big Black Horse and Big Black Cat behaving like this, Ye Yun felt very gratified.
With such an unyielding spirit in the face of the Heavenly Dao, these two small demon beasts were well worth cultivating.
RUMBLE!
A massive Thunderbolt Mountain suddenly condensed from the dark clouds and smashed towards Ye Yun.
Ye Yun sneered, radiating an immeasurable Divine Light from his body.
At this moment, he released his powerful Divine Monarch Realm cultivation base.
He raised his fist and smashed downwards heavily.
RUMBLE!
That enormous Thunderbolt Mountain, stretching for thousands of miles, was forcefully pulverized by Ye Yun.
ROAR!
An angry roar resounded from the sky.
It seemed the Heavenly Dao was also enraged by Ye Yun’s arrogance.
"Heavenly Dao, don’t even think of obstructing me today! Otherwise, I will make you regret it!"
Ye Yun’s face was indifferent, and the murderous intent in his eyes burst out as if it were tangible.
Qin Yao, who had been held in Ye Yun’s hands, felt a mixture of emotions at this moment.
She never dreamed that Brother Yun would dare to oppose the Heavenly Dao for her sake.
Brother Yun... Can he defeat the Heavenly Dao?
Qin Yao started to worry again in her heart.
Although in her heart, Ye Yun had always been an invincible existence, this time, the enemy he faced was the Heavenly Dao!
In the heart of any cultivator, the Heavenly Dao is an undefeatable, powerful existence.
Qin Yao was no exception. This concept was deeply ingrained in her heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 159: One Sword Cuts the Sky, Heavenly Dao Retreats
chapters.content:
Chapter 159: Chapter 159: One Sword Cuts the Sky, Heavenly Dao Retreats
RUMBLE!
High above in the sky, the sound of furious thunder resonated abruptly.
The Heavenly Dao became even more furious.
The black clouds surged rapidly.
Huge Thunderbolt Mountains, like snowflakes, fell down one after another.
"Hmph!"
Ye Yun snorted coldly, his entire body radiating light. At this moment, like an invincible Spirit, his body was crystalline, and a terrifying fluctuation emanated from him.
Ye Yun, bare-fisted, threw a punch upwards.
This punch triggered a tremor in the vast void, and countless Thunderbolt Mountains shattered in an instant.
After Ye Yun threw this punch, he delivered several more in succession, forcefully smashing all the Thunderbolt Mountains to pieces.
The shattered remnants of the Thunderbolt Mountains surged outwards in all directions.
The numerous Mountain Protection Arrays of the Shenfeng Dynasty’s countless powers, both large and small, instantly disintegrated. Innumerable Cultivators screamed as they were swallowed by the lightning.
All the Sects in the entire Shenfeng Dynasty had fallen.
Even the most powerful Yu Mo Sect disintegrated at this moment, leaving nothing behind.
Ye Yun’s expression was indifferent.
In his Divine Monarch Realm eyes, all living beings were like ants.
And in the eyes of the Heavenly Dao, all living beings were less than ants.
The Heavenly Dao simply wouldn’t care about the life or death of any being below.
RUMBLE!
In the violently churning ink-colored clouds, a gigantic face suddenly appeared. Its two cold eyes stared intently at Ye Yun, as if wanting to dismember him.
"Still want to fight?" Ye Yun looked at the huge face and said coldly.
"Die!"
The huge face suddenly uttered a single word.
Its cold, merciless eyes condensed two sharp beams of light that shot towards Ye Yun.
In an instant, all the Cultivators on the Cangnan Continent felt an immense terror descend. They all lost their footing and collapsed to the ground.
Even those Eternal Realm Cultivators knelt on the ground, not daring to move.
"My heavens! Who exactly is opposing the Heavenly Dao? Could it be a True God who has broken through?"
"It’s too terrifying!"
"..."
The experts of the Eternal Realm and Life and Death Realm silently speculated about various possibilities.
Especially those Eternal Realm Cultivators, who recalled the terrifying fluctuations that had appeared a while ago.
Thus, everyone connected these two events.
It seemed a True God Realm Cultivator had indeed appeared on the Cangnan Continent.
But who exactly was this True God Realm Cultivator?
Currently, no one from the Eternal Level Sects had stepped forward to announce this news.
...
Watching the two beams of sword light shot out by the Heavenly Dao, Ye Yun’s pupils contracted slightly. He sensed an unimaginable destructive energy contained within them.
Ye Yun touched his wrist, and his Primordial Spirit immediately entered the repository where he stored his Divine Soldier Magical Treasures.
This repository was extraordinarily massive, boundless.
Terrifying Divine Soldier Magical Treasures, one after another, emanated various kinds of light as they floated in the void.
Their numbers were as vast as a sea of smoke, truly incalculable.
However, these Divine Weapons were arranged according to some unknown rule.
The higher the grade of the Divine Weapons and magical treasures, the deeper they were within the repository.
When a wisp of Ye Yun’s Divine Sense suddenly flowed in, all the Divine Soldiers and magical treasures instantly began to stir, radiating brilliant light that illuminated the entire repository.
Some Divine Soldier Magical Treasures had not yet fully birthed complete Spirit Wisdom, but they too quivered frequently, trying to get Ye Yun to choose them.
And from some of the Divine Soldier Magical Treasures in the deeper recesses, illusory figures emerged, continuously beckoning to Ye Yun.
"Master, please take me out! It’s so incredibly boring here!"
"Yes, Master! Let me out to help you conquer the world! We’ll kill everyone who dares to defy you, not even sparing the Heavenly Dao!"
"Master, I can shatter an entire epoch! Just let me out to cause a little destruction, please? HA HA HA..."
The Artifact Spirits within the various Divine Soldier Magical Treasures excitedly roared.
Ye Yun shook his head helplessly.
Some Divine Soldiers and magical treasures absolutely could not be released.
If they were let out, the Super Divine Dragon Breath emanating from their unattainable grades would cause this world to collapse.
Then, the entire Cangnan Continent would cease to exist.
Just then, Ye Yun’s gaze swept across and landed on a Silver Longsword.
This Longsword emitted a terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath, yet it eagerly vibrated its form before Ye Yun, like an excited puppy wagging its tail.
"It’s you, then! This time, you will accompany me to slay the heavens!"
Ye Yun recalled the origin of this Sword, reached out, and took it in hand.
This Sword was called the Heaven-Slaying Sword.
It had once slain a Heavenly Dao in a certain universe.
Quality: Super God Level.
This Sword perfectly suited Ye Yun’s current needs.
With the Sword in hand, Ye Yun prepared to leave.
"Master, you’re leaving so soon? We haven’t seen you visit in so long. Let’s sit down and chat for a bit..."
A small child in red robes, grinning, floated over and actually reached out to grab Ye Yun’s arm.
"Next time!"
Ye Yun reached out and patted the little red-robed child’s head, a gentle smile on his face.
This little fellow was also extraordinary.
He wasn’t a sword, but a furnace.
The Real Sun Furnace.
Once unleashed, its blazing True Sun Fire was enough to destroy an entire universe; it belonged to the extremely dangerous category.
Therefore, Ye Yun would absolutely not take it out.
When Ye Yun exited the repository and his Primordial Spirit returned to his body, the silver Heaven-Slaying Sword was in his hand.
The entire process seemed long, but in reality, it took only an instant.
At that moment, the Heavenly Dao’s attack descended.
Ye Yun slashed out with his Sword.
A heaven-shattering beam of sword light erupted brilliantly from the Heaven-Slaying Sword.
The Heavenly Dao’s attack instantly shattered.
The heaven-shattering silver sword light, now radiating an incomparably terrifying glow, cleaved towards the enormous face in the sky.
The Heavenly Dao’s pupils instantly widened; it actually sensed a lethal threat.
The Heavenly Dao turned to flee without hesitation.
The astonishing sword light flashed past.
Suddenly, the Heavenly Dao shrieked miserably as half of its face was sliced off. A small piece of the severed face plummeted from the sky, while the Heavenly Dao itself, now grievously wounded, burrowed into the clouds and vanished.
CRASH!
A huge crater was blasted into a large part of the Shenfeng Dynasty. This small fragment of the Heavenly Dao crashed directly into the depths of the earth.
It plunged to a depth of tens of millions of feet.
Watching the Heavenly Dao flee in disarray, Ye Yun smiled nonchalantly.
The Heaven-Slaying Sword truly lived up to its name.
That one strike had consumed nearly two-thirds of his Mana.
In addition, one-fifth of Ye Yun’s vast vital energy and blood was also depleted.
That was why this one sword strike was so earth-shattering, capable of injuring even the Heavenly Dao.
The black carriage was already hovering in mid-air.
Beneath the carriage, an unimaginably vast Abyss had now been formed.
The Big Black Cat, perched on the edge of the carriage, gazed at the Abyss—which resembled the maw of a world-ending beast—and exclaimed in awe, "Terrifying! Master’s sword strike actually cut down a part of the Heavenly Dao!"
"Yes! Truly terrifying... horrifying..."
Even the Big Black Horse, despite having weathered many great storms, trembled all over at this moment, a palpable chill emanating from its body.

chapters.title: Chapter 160: Rebirth Lightning Pool, Soul Nurturing Wood
chapters.content:
Chapter 160: Chapter 160: Rebirth Lightning Pool, Soul Nurturing Wood
The Master’s power... He can even defeat the Heavenly Dao; this is truly terrifying.
Big Black Horse and Big Black Cat were shaking uncontrollably. This earth-shattering duel had truly frightened both these demon beasts.
In mid-air, Ye Yun retracted the Heaven-Slaying Sword. In this battle, the Heaven-Slaying Sword’s performance was exceptional. He liked this sword a lot. However, Ye Yun typically didn’t use swords, so he returned the sword to the warehouse. After he had put the sword away, Ye Yun looked around to find that the entire Shenfeng Dynasty had been utterly destroyed.
All signs of life were gone; the tens of millions of miles of the Shenfeng Dynasty’s territory had turned into a massive Abyss. Inside the Abyss, the fragments of the Heavenly Dao were scattered and broken. Ye Yun stared quietly at the fragments of the Heavenly Dao. Suddenly, he reached out, and with an unimaginable force, he immediately gathered all the fragments of the Heavenly Dao. These fragments of the Heavenly Dao possessed a certain amount of will, and they continued to struggle in his hand.
"Die!"
Ye Yun’s black hair fluttered, his entire body translucent, his vitality like a vast ocean. He activated his Ancestral Dragon Bloodline and, using all his strength, forcibly turned the fragments of the Heavenly Dao into a small sphere. He then forcibly obliterated the Will of Heaven within it.
"Brother Yun, you’re really too strong. Where have you been all these years?" Qin Yao was in Ye Yun’s palm. She had just seen him display his power, repel the Heavenly Dao, and then crush the fragments containing the Will of Heaven into a small sphere. She was absolutely shocked.
"During these years, I’ve been living a life worse than death..." Ye Yun sighed.
Only the System knows how hard his life was. Signing in for 100,000 years was simply inhuman torture.
However, he only gave a brief description of these things and didn’t plan on telling Qin Yao the details.
"Brother Yun, this lingering attachment of mine won’t last much longer; it will disperse in less than a thousand years..." Qin Yao spoke in a mournful tone.
"Don’t worry, I will surely resurrect you..." Ye Yun said earnestly.
At this point, Ye Yun looked at the Heavenly Path Sphere in his hand, and a thought suddenly emerged in his mind.
Perhaps I could shape a Heavenly Path Body for Qin Yao... Then, this Heavenly Path Sphere would be of use. However, shaping a Heavenly Path Body isn’t easy.
I now need to help Qin Yao re-establish her Three Souls and Seven Spirits, to have a powerful Primordial Spirit, to inhabit the Heavenly Path Sphere with a soul cultivation body, and then with my help, recreate a Heavenly Path physical body. If successful, the benefits Qin Yao would receive would be unimaginable.
At this thought, Ye Yun’s eyes suddenly lit up.
A wisp of his Primordial Spirit carried Qin Yao into the warehouse. This warehouse contained various kinds of heavenly materials and earthly treasures. Thus, the warehouse was filled with an unimaginable amount of vibrant life force and vitality.
"Brother Yun, what place is this?"
Bathed in the overwhelming vitality, Qin Yao felt as if she were filled with energy again. She was utterly shocked as she gazed at the indistinguishable heavenly treasures one after another.
"This is my warehouse." Ye Yun smiled without giving too much explanation.
Then, he materialized in front of a golden Thunder Pool in a flash. This Thunder Pool emitted a terrifying aura beyond imagination.
If Big Black Horse were here, he would certainly recognize it. This is the Rebirth Lightning Pool from which I once bestowed mysterious lightning upon him.
The Rebirth Lightning Pool possessed earth-shattering prowess but also harbored unimaginable vitality. Here, devastation and rebirth had achieved a dynamic balance.
"Greetings to the Master!" A little girl in a gold dress suddenly rose into the air above the Thunder Pool, gracefully kneeling before Ye Yun.
"Arise!" Ye Yun chuckled.
This little girl was the embodiment of the Rebirth Lightning Pool. Her consciousness had long been awakened, far exceeding that of an ordinary Thunder Pool. Qin Yao’s eyes widened, staring incredulously at the young girl before her.
At this moment, she guessed the girl’s origin.
"This is my girlfriend. Now, only a wisp of her lingering attachment remains. You have to take good care of her; let her slowly regenerate her Three Souls and Seven Spirits in the Rebirth Lightning Pool..." Ye Yun looked at the little girl, speaking with a gentle smile.
"Master, rest assured, I will wholeheartedly take good care of this beautiful big sister!" the little girl said obediently.
"Good!" Ye Yun nodded in satisfaction.
One hundred thousand years of sign-ins had given him countless benefits from the System. Whether Divine Pets, Divine Weapons, Magical Treasures, or heavenly materials and earthly treasures—anything sentient—all heeded his commands, loyal and unwavering, without a trace of rebelliousness. So, he was very relieved.
Ye Yun released his hand, allowing Qin Yao to appear beside the Thunder Pool. Then, with a wave of his hand, a golden piece of wood immediately flew over from the distance.
"This is Soul Nurturing Wood. You just need to reside on it, and it will constantly nourish and strengthen your Soul..." Ye Yun said with a smile.
"Brother Yun..." Qin Yao managed to say only these two words before bursting into tears again.
"Silly girl, you searched for me for nearly 100,000 years. I must resurrect you. Rest assured, from now on, you will never be wronged again!" Ye Yun gently raised his hand, stroking Qin Yao’s ethereal body, his own eyes shimmering with unshed tears.
Qin Yao nodded firmly.
She could also see that Brother Yun, who had been missing for 100,000 years, was now incomparably powerful. His foundation was outrageously strong. Of all the heavenly materials and earthly treasures in this warehouse, she couldn’t recognize a single one.
WHOOSH!
Qin Yao transformed into a ray of light, taking up residence in the Soul Nurturing Wood. The little girl in the golden dress, cautiously holding the Soul Nurturing Wood, submerged it into the golden waters of the Rebirth Lightning Pool. Ye Yun silently stood by for a while.
After ensuring there were no problems, he felt at ease. With a flash, he left the warehouse.
Qin Yao will awaken sooner or later. For now, it’s best to let her be nurtured in the Rebirth Lightning Pool, slowly nourishing that wisp of lingering attachment until she regenerates her Three Souls and Seven Spirits. This process might take a long time. However, time is the least valuable thing to me; I am willing to wait.
Ye Yun landed back on the carriage.
"Master..." Big Black Cat trembled, calling out in a fear-stricken voice.
"What are you scared of? I remember you were daring enough to spit on the Heavenly Dao just now, weren’t you?" Ye Yun laughed.
This Big Black Cat was frightened by me into such a state. It seems my earlier Heaven-Slaying strike left a terrifying and indelible impression on these ordinary Demon Clan members.
Ye Yun glanced at Big Black Horse again.
Big Black Horse is behaving quite normally. After all, he has been influenced by the warehouse over the years, has seen the world, and his mentality is relatively stable.
At that moment, Ye Yun’s strange pupils brightened. Big Black Cat slowly closed its eyes and fell asleep. In that instant, a certain part of his memory vanished without a trace.

chapters.title: Chapter 161: Arrival at the Ancient Demon Abyss
chapters.content:
Chapter 161: Chapter 161: Arrival at the Ancient Demon Abyss
"Little Horse!"
Ye Yun’s expression changed as he suddenly spoke.
"My Lord, please give your instructions!"
The Big Black Horse instantly perked up.
"I have to leave for a while, but I will be back soon. For now, you take the carriage and wait for me at the Heavenly Star Dynasty..."
Ye Yun instructed calmly.
"Alright, My Lord!"
The Big Black Horse promptly nodded.
Ye Yun glanced at the emptiness before him.
The void suddenly split open. He stepped in and vanished in the twinkling of an eye.
Its hooves a blur, the Big Black Horse pulled the black carriage at lightning speed, leaving behind the Shenfeng Dynasty, which now showed no signs of life.
「...」
Ye Yun tore through the void, traversed a distance of hundreds of billions of miles, and arrived near an abyss enveloped in black qi. Standing in the void, he gazed at the distant Ancient Demon Abyss. Its gaping, pitch-black entrance resembled that of a colossal beast, and a familiar sensation washed over him.
A hundred thousand years ago, Ye Yun, Qin Yao, and Nangong Jade had formed a team to explore the Ancient Demon Abyss.
The Cangnan Continent has a long history, its vast territories holding many mysterious places inherited from ancient times. Few knew of these locations; only those at or above the level of a Super Sect were privy to information about these places, designated as Mysterious Forbidden Lands. The Ancient Demon Abyss was one of them. It was one such Mysterious Forbidden Land, passed down from the ancient era to the present day.
Within the Ancient Demon Abyss, there were numerous corpses of Ancient Giant Demons, though it was unknown who had slain them. And in the deepest part of the Ancient Demon Abyss, where the Demonic Qi was most concentrated, a few Ancient Giant Demons still lived.
On the periphery of the Ancient Demon Abyss stood the Eighteen Heavenly Iron Pillars. Their surfaces were covered in various mysterious runes that forcefully sealed the Ancient Giant Demons and the Demonic Qi within.
Even Cultivators of the Life and Death Realm faced a slim chance of survival if they rashly entered this place. Cultivators of the Eternal Realm could perish if they were not careful. The scattered corpses of slain Ancient Giant Demons had long since undergone various grotesque transformations. Furthermore, the living Ancient Giant Demons, comparable to great Cultivators of the Eternal Realm, possessed terrifying strength.
Ye Yun had once fought an Ancient Giant Demon, but the demon was no match for him and fled after being injured. The Ancient Giant Demons, as their name implied, stood up to a hundred zhang tall, possessed immense strength, and had formidable physical defenses. Whether by Divine Weapon or Divine Skill, it was challenging to inflict serious harm upon them. Fortunately, these Ancient Giant Demons had not broken through the seal of the Eighteen Heavenly Iron Pillars; otherwise, the entire Cangnan Continent would have suffered a catastrophe.
This place was rarely trodden by humans. Even Eternal Level Sects would not allow their Disciples to train here. Back then, Ye Yun, exceptionally skilled and daring, and finding himself bored at the time, had brought two female confidantes to explore this Ancient Demon Abyss. And their exploration had yielded some minor gains.
Ye Yun flipped his palm, and a Nail of Killing Immortals appeared. This blood-red nail was one of the gains from the Ancient Demon Abyss. He had gifted it to Qin Yao back then. Unexpectedly, it was because of this small Nail of Killing Immortals that a wisp of Qin Yao’s lingering obsession had endured for a full hundred thousand years.
Ye Yun sighed endlessly.
If not for that expedition to the Ancient Demon Abyss, he wouldn’t have obtained the Nail of Killing Immortals. Qin Yao would likely have perished long ago, soon after his own death. A deep question troubled Ye Yun’s mind. Qin Yao and Nangong Jade were like sisters, and his relationship with both of them had been excellent. So why would Nangong Jade attack the Dragon God Sect? And Qin Yao’s eventual demise was also due to the appearance of an Ancient Giant Demon. These thoughts filled Ye Yun with suspicion.
"A hundred thousand years have passed. Nangong Jade must surely be long gone from this world?" Ye Yun murmured quietly to himself.
To be certain, Ye Yun ingested a few medicinal pills to restore his Mana. Then, he unleashed his formidable Divine Sense and began to scan the entire Cangnan Continent.
A hundred thousand years ago, Nangong Jade was at the peak of the Tenth Layer of the Life and Death Realm. If she were still alive today, she would undoubtedly be a great Cultivator in the Eternal Realm. But it was simply impossible for Cultivators of the Eternal Realm to live for so long.
To dispel the doubt in his heart, Ye Yun’s formidable Divine Sense swept over every Eternal Realm Cultivator on the Cangnan Continent. After a moment, he opened his eyes, a faint trace of confusion appearing on his face.
Nangong Jade was not among any of the Eternal Realm Cultivators. This could only mean... Nangong Jade was no longer of this world. Why, then, did she attack the Dragon God Sect all those years ago? Could it be that Qin Yao discovered something, prompting Nangong Jade to act, sending an Ancient Giant Demon to eliminate her?
"But the two of them were always as close as sisters. What deep-seated hatred could have driven her to such a cruel act?"
As this thought crossed his mind, Ye Yun directed his gaze towards the Ancient Demon Abyss.
To unravel this mystery, I must find those Ancient Giant Demons.
With a single step, he vanished from his spot, and in the next moment, he entered the Ancient Demon Abyss, a place swirling with Demonic Qi. The Black Demonic Qi, like thick black serpents, writhed around him, radiating a terrifying killing intent. It would desperately lunge at any suspicious lifeform it encountered. A faint white light emanated from Ye Yun. Upon seeing him, the Black Demonic Qi shrieked and scattered in terror.
Ye Yun nodded.
When he first entered the Ancient Demon Abyss back then, his cultivation base was only at the Eternal Realm; it was far from being as effortless as it was now. Now, he was in the Divine Monarch Realm. For him, flattening the entire Ancient Demon Abyss would be a simple matter. However, his main purpose this time was to find clues, so he naturally wouldn’t raze the Ancient Demon Abyss to the ground.
Reflecting on the events Qin Yao had described, Ye Yun quickly came to a new realization. It was said that the two hundred fiftieth Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect had once offended a formidable power, leading to the Sect’s continuous suppression. But in truth, it seemed that after his own demise, an unseen mastermind had already begun to exact revenge on the Dragon God Sect and those close to him.
Back then, Ye Yun had offended so many people; he couldn’t immediately pinpoint who would have such audacity. If even Qin Yao was a target of revenge, then it was highly probable that his other confidantes had also been eliminated by this hidden mastermind. At this thought, a blaze of fury ignited within Ye Yun’s heart.
However, too much time had passed—a full hundred thousand years. Most people from that era were long gone. Ye Yun knew that uncovering the truth from so far in the past would be incredibly difficult. This was far more challenging than identifying the mastermind who had been suppressing the Dragon God Sect for the past nearly ten thousand years.
"How interesting. Two masterminds..."
Ye Yun gave a faint smile, then broke through the surging Demonic Qi and flew deeper into the abyss.
The Ancient Demon Abyss was perpetually shrouded in dense Demonic Qi. The surroundings were a scene of chaos. Gleaming white bones lay scattered everywhere, alongside fragments of broken weapons and remnants of Dharma treasures. No ancient Sect on the Cangnan Continent possessed detailed records about the Ancient Demon Abyss.
Having been here once, Ye Yun naturally knew that an indescribably ferocious battle had once taken place here. Not only had many human Cultivators perished here, but there were also colossal skeletons belonging to fallen members of the Demon Clan. Others belonged to Ancient Giant Demons; these beings had been brutally dismembered, with severed limbs strewn about.
However, after an Ancient Giant Demon died, its corpse would be enveloped in Demonic Qi, causing its decay process to slow considerably. As a result, these fragments of Giant Demon corpses would give birth to numerous bizarre consciousnesses. Severed arms, disembodied heads, or even single legs could often be seen flying about within the Black Demonic Qi of the Ancient Demon Abyss.

chapters.title: Chapter 162: Tracing Causes and Effects, Destroying Ancient Giant Demon
chapters.content:
Chapter 162: Chapter 162: Tracing Causes and Effects, Destroying Ancient Giant Demon
Ye Yun flew through the black Demonic Qi. The Demonic Qi, upon encountering him, would scatter and keep its distance.
However, the fragments of Giant Demon corpses, foolish and unthinking, still furiously pounced toward Ye Yun.
Ye Yun glanced indifferently. Activating the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye, those severed limbs and broken arms turned into wisps of ash and dissipated.
He had only just flown in when Ye Yun was surprised to discover a few figures ahead, tremulously navigating the Demonic Qi.
His gaze focused slightly. Through the Demonic Qi, he saw three cultivators at the Peak of ten layers of life-death realm, probing for something.
So bold, coming to train in this place even though they are only at the Life and Death Realm...
Ye Yun shook his head and chuckled, a helpless expression on his face.
However, when he noticed that those three cultivators weren’t in immediate danger, he quickly slipped past them.
"Did I just see something? Did you all see it?"
Among the three cultivators—two men and one woman—the middle-aged woman stared in a certain direction, her face etched with shock.
She was certain she had seen a flash of white light flicker through the Demonic Qi.
"Didn’t see anything. Are your eyes playing tricks on you, sister?" another middle-aged man asked, frowning.
"I can’t be mistaken. That white light flew past quickly, and it seemed to contain a human figure..." the comely middle-aged woman recalled.
