"In the Ancient Demon Abyss, if one flies too fast, it will attract attacks from those bizarre Ancient Giant Demon corpse fragments. That’s a very dangerous thing to do..." another, slightly older middle-aged man said dismissively.
He simply couldn’t believe anyone would come to this ghastly place; it was just too horrifying.
"Forget it, let’s continue our search..."
The comely middle-aged woman shook her head and walked forward.
The three of them proceeded cautiously, dispersing the Demonic Qi while remaining vigilant against sneak attacks from the Ancient Giant Demon corpse fragments.
Their journey was fraught with hardship.
Ye Yun paid no mind to these three minor Human cultivators; he flew directly towards the deepest part of the Ancient Demon Abyss.
He moved so swiftly that, within a few breaths, he arrived in a valley thick with Demonic Qi.
A splendid divine light radiated from Ye Yun’s entire body, and the dense Demonic Qi gave him a wide berth upon sensing his presence.
With his hands clasped behind his back, Ye Yun carefully examined the valley and spotted a thousand-foot-tall Ancient Giant Demon lying there, deep asleep.
"Time to wake up!"
Ye Yun flicked his finger, and a ray of light shot towards the Ancient Giant Demon’s body.
WHOOSH!
The Ancient Giant Demon abruptly awoke and immediately lurched to its feet.
Its enormous, blood-red eyes were as large as two or three millstones, and its cavernous, bloody maw looked as if it could swallow a small mountain when opened.
This Ancient Giant Demon was covered in dense black fur, with two long horns protruding from its head, exuding a black luster.
"Who dares awaken me?"
The Ancient Giant Demon roared skyward in fury, Demonic Qi churning around it as massive sound waves spread in all directions.
Ye Yun’s eyes flickered slightly, and the sound waves vanished in an instant.
The Ancient Giant Demon froze, its eyes widening. Only then did it spot a man in white, radiating divine light, not far away.
This man in white instilled in it a feeling of profound terror.
"Do you recognize this woman?"
Ye Yun lightly gestured in the air, and an image of Nangong Jade immediately appeared.
"I’ll kill you!"
Upon seeing Nangong Jade’s image, the Ancient Giant Demon immediately lunged at Ye Yun.
Its fist, as large as a small mountain, came whistling through the air.
Ye Yun raised his fist and gently parried upwards.
The two fists, utterly disproportionate in size, met in mid-air.
BOOM!
The surface of the Ancient Giant Demon’s fist instantly shattered, and its massive body was sent flying by an immense force.
Crashing through a mountain peak, the Ancient Giant Demon’s massive body finally skidded to a halt.
However, the Ancient Giant Demon, now in a frenzy, continued to charge recklessly at Ye Yun.
Ye Yun was slightly taken aback.
Why did this creature go berserk at the sight of Nangong Jade’s image?
In his experience, Ancient Giant Demons, though brutal, were also extremely cunning. Under normal circumstances, if it knew it was outmatched, it would never attack so recklessly. But now... this Ancient Giant Demon seemed to have lost its mind, completely berserk.
At this moment, star-like runes flickered in Ye Yun’s demonic eyes. Instantly, the Ancient Giant Demon froze on the spot, falling into a trance-like state.
Ye Yun began to browse the Ancient Giant Demon’s memories.
「A few seconds later.」
Ye Yun’s expression turned grim.
This Ancient Giant Demon had actually participated in the attack on the Dragon God Sect and the killing of Qin Yao.
And the one who had driven the Ancient Giant Demon was Nangong Jade.
She had used the Ancient Demon Violin.
Why would Nangong Jade do such a thing? What was her motive?
Ye Yun frowned, lost in deep thought.
Nangong Jade had perished long ago, yet the clues now pointed to her. All of this seemed illusory, completely useless. Instead, it only made the entire incident more convoluted and baffling.
Qin Yao was right.
There was indeed a vast, hidden power that had been plotting against the Dragon God Sect all along.
At this moment, Ye Yun wished he could turn back time one hundred thousand years. He wanted to see just who had dared to orchestrate such a dark scheme from the shadows.
A glimmer of light flashed in Ye Yun’s eyes.
The Ancient Giant Demon, comparable in strength to an Eternal Realm Cultivator, suddenly turned into a wisp of green smoke and vanished.
Having read its memories, this Ancient Giant Demon no longer had any reason to exist.
Ye Yun then looked towards other directions.
In the mountain ranges within the deepest parts of the Ancient Demon Abyss, some Ancient Giant Demons always lay dormant.
These Ancient Giant Demons possessed lifespans far exceeding those of Human Cultivators. Especially nourished by the dense Demonic Qi, they usually lived for an exceptionally long time.
Ye Yun glanced around and noticed a familiar Ancient Giant Demon.
One hundred thousand years ago, Ye Yun had fought a great battle with that Ancient Giant Demon.
Of course, he had won that battle.
However, Ye Yun had ultimately chosen not to kill this Ancient Giant Demon.
「One hundred thousand years later.」
This Ancient Giant Demon was remarkably still alive, though currently in a state of deep slumber.
Ye Yun quickly flew over.
Within the Ancient Demon Abyss, he did not use his Divine Skills to tear through the void.
The eighteen Heaven-Connecting Pillars were inscribed with mysterious runes, suppressing the Ancient Demon Abyss.
The space here was incredibly stable. Unless Ye Yun used the Reverse Dragon Technique, only by relying on his Ancestral Dragon Body could he forcibly tear through the void here.
However, Ye Yun saw no need for that now. Flying there would only take a few breaths’ time anyway.
Ye Yun planned to thoroughly study those eighteen Sky-Connecting Iron Pillars after leaving this time.
From his experiences in the Red Dust Fairyland, Ye Yun now had an inkling.
It was possible... that those eighteen Sky-Connecting Iron Pillars had been forged by some mighty figure from the Divine Land.
「In the blink of an eye.」
Ye Yun arrived at the edge of a cliff. Below it lay a colossal black Ancient Giant Demon.
A large sword scar was visible on the shoulder of this black Ancient Giant Demon.
This was the mark Ye Yun had left on this Ancient Giant Demon one hundred thousand years ago, and it had yet to fade.

chapters.title: Chapter 163: Confusing, Lending a Helping Hand
chapters.content:
Chapter 163: Chapter 163: Confusing, Lending a Helping Hand
This time, Ye Yun landed unceremoniously on the forehead of this Ancient Giant Demon.
He gently stomped his foot.
HUM!
The Ancient Giant Demon was stunned and stood up abruptly. "Who attacked me?"
It quickly stood up, looking around but found nothing; only dense Demonic Qi was rolling around it. It didn’t realize that a person was standing above its head at this moment.
"Long time no see. It’s been 100,000 years, and you haven’t died yet. I must say, your Ancient Giant Demon clan truly has a long lifespan..." Ye Yun remarked with a chuckle, standing atop the Ancient Giant Demon’s head with his hands behind his back.
"It’s you?" Upon hearing the familiar voice, the Ancient Giant Demon immediately gnashed its teeth.
One hundred thousand years ago, I was severely injured by this guy. One hundred thousand years later, he’s unexpectedly still alive!
The Ancient Giant Demon reflexively reached out and grabbed towards its head, but unexpectedly, it grabbed at air.
With a flicker, Ye Yun appeared in front of the Ancient Giant Demon. At this moment, he was radiant, emitting strands of divine light, giving off a Spirit-like aura.
The Ancient Giant Demon widened its eyes, unable to believe what it was seeing. "Your cultivation base... it has reached the Divine Monarch Realm?" it exclaimed in shock.
Ye Yun nodded. He looked at this familiar Ancient Giant Demon and asked with a smile, "Do you remember her?" As he spoke, Ye Yun used his Mana to conjure up the image of Nangong Jade.
"How could I not remember? Isn’t she your accomplice?" the Ancient Giant Demon coldly retorted. Although it admitted that it could not defeat Ye Yun now, the arrogance of the Ancient Giant Demon clan stopped it from backing down.
"Afterwards, were you ever manipulated by her using that Ancient Demon Violin, attacking the Dragon God Sect or others?" Ye Yun asked again.
"At that time, I was injured and didn’t participate in that action. It was a few other Giant Demons from our clan that followed that girl..." the Ancient Giant Demon said gruffly.
"There are Eighteen Heavenly Iron Pillars suppressing the outside. How did your fellow Giant Demons get out?" Ye Yun asked, his eyes narrowed.
He hadn’t realized this issue before. Just a moment ago, a crucial point had flashed through his mind. Even if Nangong Jade had the Ancient Demon Violin to manipulate some Giant Demons, how could she have taken the Ancient Giant Demons away from this place? For nearly a million years, he had never heard of Ancient Giant Demons being able to leave the Ancient Demon Abyss. How did Nangong Jade manage to do that? The memory of another Ancient Giant Demon contained no recollection of them leaving the Ancient Demon Abyss. It seemed to have been erased.
Upon thinking about this, Ye Yun immediately felt that the situation was becoming more complicated.
"I don’t know either. You Human Race are always scheming against each other; how would we know?" the Ancient Giant Demon coldly snorted in annoyance.
Ye Yun smiled faintly, a strange light flickering in his eyes. Once again, he activated the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye, pulling the Ancient Giant Demon into an Illusory Realm and beginning to read its memory.
This Ancient Giant Demon had not lied. Due to the severity of its injuries, it had not participated in that action, and as a result, there were many things it didn’t know.
Ye Yun retracted the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye, waking the Ancient Giant Demon once again.
"What did you do to me?" The Ancient Giant Demon swayed its enormous head, gazing at Ye Yun with wide eyes. Just earlier, it had felt a brief moment of stupor and instinctively sensed that something wasn’t right.
Ye Yun chuckled, shaking his head. "You should continue with your sleep. I’ll go ask the others..." Saying this, Ye Yun left.
The Ancient Giant Demon watched Ye Yun disappearing in the distance, shuddering all over.
Terrifying! This man has reached the Divine Monarch Realm. I’m afraid he could kill me with a flick of his finger!
The Ancient Giant Demon’s black, furry face showed an expression of lingering fear as it hastily lay flat on the ground, closing its eyes and refraining from speaking anymore.
It was shrewd this time, telling him everything it knew and thereby sparing its life. Otherwise... I reckon I would have met a calamitous end this time.
Ye Yun traversed ceaselessly through the thick Demonic Qi in the Ancient Demon Abyss. He read the memories of every single Ancient Giant Demon. All who had participated in that disturbance were immediately killed by him on the spot.
Sorting through all these memories, Ye Yun discovered that Nangong Jade had orchestrated all of this. As for how Nangong Jade was able to lead the Ancient Giant Demons out of the Ancient Demon Abyss, that remained a mystery.
Could it be that Nangong Jade deciphered the runes on the Eighteen Heavenly Iron Pillars?
Ye Yun suddenly thought of this possibility. His figure flickered, and he flew towards the outside. He intended to examine these runes, to study them seriously, hoping to find some sort of lead.
Just when he was not far from the exit of the Ancient Demon Abyss, Ye Yun suddenly heard tremendous sounds of fighting from a particular direction, interspersed with screams of agony.
Could it be that those three Human Cultivators are being attacked by the remains of an Ancient Giant Demon?
Ye Yun looked in that direction.
Sure enough, two enormous Ancient Giant Demon skulls, three arms, and a huge leg were launching a crazed attack on these three cultivators at the tenth layer of the Life and Death Realm. Whether it was the skulls, arms, or the leg, these fragments of the Giant Demon’s corpse had changed entirely from before. The grotesquely altered remains had now become bizarre and terrifying.
These three Human Cultivators desperately battled these eerie corpse fragments, finding themselves in critical danger.
"Sister, I’ll hold them back! You two escape quickly!" a middle-aged man shouted, manipulating a splendid sword light to ward off the attack of the Giant Demon’s fragments.
Another man took out several magic treasures, which radiated a terrifying light as he hurled them from afar. A middle-aged beautiful woman nearby showed a hesitant expression on her face.
If she seized this opportunity, she could escape and save her life, but her two brothers would probably perish in the Ancient Demon Abyss.
"Sister, don’t forget our ancestors’ teachings! Only if you survive is there hope for us!" the middle-aged man wielding the sword light shouted anxiously.
The middle-aged woman struggled internally for a moment. The next second, she whirled around and flew towards the exit of the Ancient Demon Abyss.
"You bizarre Giant Demon fragments, I’ll take you down with me today!" the middle-aged man holding the Sword yelled out, charging bravely.
Suddenly, there was a flash of white light. A young man in a white robe appeared in front of him, causing the middle-aged man to jump in fright and stop abruptly in his tracks.
Next, his eyes widened, and his jaw almost hit the ground. The young man in white was enveloped in a faint white glow.
He waved his hand casually, and the ferocious Giant Demon corpse fragments instantly turned into ashes, disappearing without a trace.
What kind of cultivation base is this? Th-this is too horrifying...
The two middle-aged men looked at each other, shocked to the point of being petrified like statues.

chapters.title: Chapter 164: Nangong Jade and the Ancient Demon Violin
chapters.content:
Chapter 164: Chapter 164: Nangong Jade and the Ancient Demon Violin
"Thank you for saving our lives, respected Elder!"
The two middle-aged men hastily fell to their knees, kowtowing sincerely to express their deep gratitude.
Ye Yun turned to face them, his expression calm.
He had intervened to save these two for two main reasons.
First, he was touched by the deep bond of affection among the three siblings.
Second, Ye Yun was curious about their ancestral teachings and what the three of them were searching for in the Ancient Demon Abyss.
"All of you, rise!"
Ye Yun glanced at the ever-churning Demonic Qi around them. With a wave of his great sleeves, a force effortlessly lifted the two men to their feet.
Then, looking into the distance, he saw that the middle-aged woman had already reached the exit of the Ancient Demon Abyss. He grabbed the two men before him and instantly vanished from that spot.
「Outside the Ancient Demon Abyss.」
Ye Yun placed the two men on the ground and waited quietly for the middle-aged woman to join them.
After a few deep breaths, the middle-aged woman, pale and panting, finally emerged from the Ancient Demon Abyss.
When she saw her two brothers unharmed before her, she was utterly astonished and momentarily speechless.
"Little Sister, this benefactor saved us!"
One of the middle-aged men quickly stepped forward to explain what had happened to the middle-aged woman.
"Thank you, Elder!"
The middle-aged woman was deeply moved, tears welling in her eyes. She immediately fell to her knees and kowtowed three times resoundingly to Ye Yun.
"Please, rise."
Ye Yun offered a gentle smile.
Although he could directly read the memories of these three people, he generally chose not to do so. After all, as a transmigrator, Ye Yun understood the importance of individual privacy. And he had always been uninterested in and disinclined to intrude upon others’ privacy.
Then, Ye Yun asked with a smile, "What were you looking for in the Ancient Demon Abyss?"
The middle-aged woman, hearing this question from the Elder, found herself in a dilemma.
The middle-aged man sent a serious telepathic message to her,
Sister, the Elder before us is a peerless master. It has been almost a hundred thousand years since that incident; there’s no need to conceal anything anymore. Just tell him...
He had formed a shocking suspicion from the moment the Elder, wreathed in divine white light, had so effortlessly saved them. The Super Divine Dragon Breath emanating from this Elder was definitely not from the Eternal Realm. As a cultivator at the Peak of the Ten Layers of Life and Death Realm, he was no stranger to the Super Divine Dragon Breath of the Eternal Realm, so he could judge this. This Elder might actually be a True God—the very True God who countered the terrifying celestial phenomena today! Such an extraordinary figure, capable of suppressing the entire Cangnan Continent. If this Elder harbored malicious intentions, would the three of them even be alive? Besides, cultivators of the True God Realm were legendary beings, possessing heaven-defying methods. Searching the memories of the three of them would be a mere trifle for such an existence.
The middle-aged woman also came to her senses. She immediately cupped her fists and bowed, saying softly, "Respected Elder, we were searching for an ancient violin."
"An ancient violin?"
Ye Yun was slightly taken aback.
The mention of an ancient violin immediately made him think of Nangong Jade’s Ancient Demon Violin.
"Yes, an ancient violin. Our ancestor used it tens of thousands of years ago. However, just before her passing, she threw this violin into the Ancient Demon Abyss..." the middle-aged woman explained in detail.
Ye Yun blinked, scrutinizing the three of them once again.
It seemed he had grasped something.
He then asked, "Does this ancient violin have a name?"
The middle-aged woman replied, "Respected Elder, this violin is known as the Ancient Demon Violin. It is said to have originated from the Ancient Demon Abyss. Just before our ancestor’s passing, she returned it to the Ancient Demon Abyss..."
Ye Yun’s breathing hitched. Looking at the three people before him, he felt an indescribable excitement welling in his heart.
These three people are actually descendants of Nangong Jade! This is utterly inconceivable! After a hundred thousand years, on his first return to the Ancient Demon Abyss, he has unexpectedly encountered descendants of Nangong Jade!
"The ancestor you mentioned... must be Nangong Jade, right?"
Having regained his composure, Ye Yun asked calmly.
The three of them were instantly shocked.
Their ancestor had been dead for more than ninety thousand years, and virtually no one outside their family knew of her. How could this Elder possibly know?
"Elder, could it be that you knew our ancestor?" the middle-aged woman asked, mustering her courage.
"Yes." Ye Yun nodded.
He suddenly felt a wave of disinterest and decided not to inquire further.
With his hands behind his back, Ye Yun gazed towards the distant Ancient Demon Abyss. Tiny, star-like runes began to shift within his eyes.
He began searching for the Ancient Demon Violin.
The three siblings standing nearby were filled with unease. They watched this Elder keep his gaze fixed on the Ancient Demon Abyss without uttering a word, and they couldn’t help but wonder if something they had said earlier had offended him.
After several tens of seconds, Ye Yun retracted his gaze and shook his head. "The Ancient Demon Violin is not within the Ancient Demon Abyss. You don’t need to come looking for it anymore. Someone must have already taken it."
The three of them were immediately stunned.
To think that the relic left by their ancestor had been claimed by someone else first!
Their spirits instantly plummeted.
The middle-aged woman’s eyes, in particular, turned red, tears threatening to fall.
Ye Yun suddenly sighed.
At that moment, his Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye activated once more.
The three descendants of Nangong Jade before him were instantly drawn into the Annihilation Region.
Ye Yun read their memories.
The matter concerning Qin Yao was of great importance, and currently, all clues pointed towards Nangong Jade. Ye Yun didn’t want to overlook anything. Therefore, he read through the memories of these three individuals completely, solely in search of new clues.
After reading their memories, Ye Yun felt both joy and sorrow; a maelstrom of emotions churned within him.
One pleasant surprise was that Nangong Jade had never married in her life. Instead, she had adopted a child who took her surname. This child was the true progenitor of these three siblings. When this child grew up, he also became a powerful cultivator of the Life and Death Realm. He established a tradition: his adoptive mother, Nangong Jade, was to be revered as the founding ancestor of the Nangong Family. This tradition was then passed down through the generations, for nearly a hundred thousand years.
What saddened Ye Yun was that, at some point, Nangong Jade had inexplicably gone mad. Her sanity would come and go, and she would often mutter incomprehensible things. Later, during a moment of lucidity, Nangong Jade sealed herself away. This self-imposed seal lasted for the rest of her life. When her life neared its end, she left behind her last words, departed from the Nangong Family, and journeyed alone to the Ancient Demon Abyss to cast the Ancient Demon Violin into its depths. Afterwards, she vanished completely. Her last words did not mention where she went. She only instructed her descendants that, after ten thousand years, if they had the opportunity to enter the Ancient Demon Abyss again, they should retrieve the Ancient Demon Violin, for within it lay her final messages.
The Nangong Family passed down this directive through generations: only those who reached the Peak of the Ten Layers of the Life and Death Realm were permitted to venture into the Ancient Demon Abyss to search for the Ancient Demon Violin. This current generation of the Nangong Family was particularly strong, producing three cultivators who had reached the Peak of the Ten Layers of the Life and Death Realm. Thus, the three of them had journeyed together, hoping to find their ancestor’s Ancient Demon Violin, only to unexpectedly encounter Ye Yun.

chapters.title: Chapter 165: Ye Yun’s Speculation, Arriving at the Heavenly Star Dynasty
chapters.content:
Chapter 165: Chapter 165: Ye Yun’s Speculation, Arriving at the Heavenly Star Dynasty
Having gleaned some past events from the memories of the three individuals, Ye Yun couldn’t help but sigh. There were indeed major problems with Nangong Jade. However, it seemed that she was merely a puppet, and the real mastermind was still hiding beneath the proverbial ice. The only important clue—the Ancient Demon Violin—was now missing.
Ye Yun sighed. Although his capabilities were vast, over 90,000 years had passed. Time had flown, and the Cangnan Continent was no longer what it once was. The difficulty of investigating further was incredibly high. The shadowy figure behind the scenes was always cautious, proficient in tactics, and took each step with utmost vigilance. Consequently, many clues had been erased after the fact.
Ye Yun withdrew the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye. With a single step, he flew before the Eighteen Heavenly Iron Pillars.
WHOOSH!
The three individuals seemed to awaken from a dream, exchanging glances. After a brief discussion, they concluded that since the senior of the True God Realm had already searched the Ancient Demon Abyss and confirmed the Ancient Demon Violin wasn’t there, there was no reason for them to remain. The three respectfully saluted in Ye Yun’s direction, then turned and departed.
Ye Yun merely offered an indifferent smile as he watched them leave. They were acquaintances met by chance. Although they were Nangong Jade’s descendants, they had no real connection to him; saving them had been purely coincidental. Barring any special circumstances, he would likely have no further dealings with them.
Ye Yun’s gaze fell on the Sky-Connecting Iron Pillars, keenly observing the runes etched upon them. Now that he had entered the Divine Monarch Realm, his perspective was far more advanced than before. As he looked at these runes, a faint glow gradually emanated from his eyes. These runes, which recorded the laws of the great Heavenly Dao, were exceptionally profound.
Ye Yun stood quietly in place, comprehending for three days, finally gaining an understanding of these runes. After comprehending the runes on the first Sky-Connecting Iron Pillar, understanding those on the remaining seventeen Sky-Connecting Iron Pillars became much easier. In merely four more days, Ye Yun had completely understood them all.
Hehe, this turned out to be a Sky-Connecting Iron Pillar personally crafted by a God King Expert to suppress the Ancient Demon Abyss...
His gaze flickered as he murmured to himself. These runes faintly contained the aura of a God King Expert.
The Cangnan Continent had never seen an expert of the God King Realm before. Thus, Ye Yun speculated that the Eighteen Heavenly Iron Pillars must have come from the Divine Land.
Interesting. Why didn’t they imprison the Ancient Giant Demon in the Divine Land? Why did they imprison it on the remote Cangnan Continent?
Ye Yun smirked coldly. People are innately selfish; even when they reach the level of Gods, it’s hard to change the selfishness within their hearts. The Ancient Giant Demon must have caused a great disturbance in the Divine Land in the past, which was why a Divine King had sealed the Giant Demon here.
The power of the Eighteen Heavenly Iron Pillars had diminished significantly over nearly 1,000,000 years. Luckily, most of the current Ancient Giant Demons were at the Eternal Realm Cultivation level. If one were to break into the True God Realm, these Eighteen Heavenly Iron Pillars would likely no longer be able to stop it.
True God Realm?
The thought sent a jolt through Ye Yun’s heart, as if he had identified a critical clue.
Could it be... that an expert of the True God Realm helped Nangong Jade take the Ancient Giant Demon out from the seal of the Eighteen Heavenly Iron Pillars in the past?
The thought made Ye Yun furrow his brow. No one in his era had reached the True God Realm.
Could this expert of the True God Realm have also come from the Divine Land? If that were the case, then the shadowy figure behind the scenes could possibly be from the Divine Land.
Ye Yun was somewhat at a loss. If someone from the Divine Land had indeed taken action, why would they target the Dragon God Sect, which didn’t even have a cultivator at the True God Realm? What was their motive?
Ye Yun turned his gaze back to the Ancient Demon Abyss, only to be confronted with layers upon layers of fog, creating a most confusing sight.
This is good too. Since I am now unmatched in the world, I might as well play along with those people to avoid boredom...
Thinking this, Ye Yun, hands behind his back, began to chuckle softly. Releasing an Unparallelled Fierce Beast from his storage or wielding a Divine Weapon that surpassed the Heavenly Dao could obliterate this world. But what good would that do? Destroying the entire world with absolute power would be satisfying at the moment, but where would he go afterward? For Ye Yun, who possessed infinite resources, feared loneliness more than anything else. Invincibility often led to loneliness. So, he didn’t want to continue down that desolate path. Now that he had a few opponents hiding in the dark, it was a good opportunity to have some fun with them.
With this thought, Ye Yun tore open the void and left the Ancient Demon Abyss.
「On a mountain path in the Heavenly Star Dynasty.」
A black carriage was parked by a gushing stream, a Big Black Horse lowered its head, idly swishing its tail. On the carriage lay a Big Black Cat.
"Uncle Ma, the Master has been away for several days. Why hasn’t he returned yet?" the Big Black Cat asked, lifting its head and yawning. It had been concentrating on comprehending the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye recently. This Divine Skill greatly consumed Divine Sense, often causing the Big Black Cat to feel sleepy after half a day of cultivation. It had to take a nap before it had the energy to continue.
The Big Black Horse, however, was doing much better, tirelessly cultivating every day, its spirit showing no signs of weakening.
Six or seven days passed in a blink. Both demon beasts were starting to become impatient. In their minds, their Master was invincible, capable of tearing through the void at will; he shouldn’t take this long. For him to be delayed six or seven days was already an extremely long time.
Suddenly, the space fluctuated. A figure in white stepped out and landed on top of the carriage.
"Master, you’re back!" the Big Black Cat jumped up excitedly, circling around Ye Yun’s legs.
"Let’s go," Ye Yun glanced at the Big Black Horse and instructed faintly.
"Yes, Master!" the Big Black Horse replied, overjoyed, and pulled the carriage away from the riverbank.
Ye Yun flashed into the carriage and sat down. This trip to the Heavenly Star Dynasty was also an opportunity for the three juniors of the Dragon God Sect to gain experience. Back in the Shenfeng Dynasty, he had initially planned to visit the Yu Mo Sect and the Qitian Sword Sect. However, after Ye Yun’s battle with the Heavenly Dao, the entire Shenfeng Dynasty was gone, so he changed the training location to the Heavenly Star Dynasty.
The Heavenly Star Dynasty was stronger than the Shenfeng Dynasty. The major sects here had reached the Medium grade, far stronger than the three Low-grade major sects of the Shenfeng Dynasty.
As Ye Yun was not in a hurry, the Big Black Horse did not move too quickly, instead traveling slowly along the mountain road. Ye Yun wanted to give the three juniors more time to cultivate, and he himself also began to focus on his own cultivation. When comprehending the Eighteen Heavenly Iron Pillars in the Ancient Demon Abyss, Ye Yun had detected the aura of a Divine King, which instilled a sense of urgency in his heart. He was eager to break through to that realm. With his unlimited resources and extraordinary talent, reaching that realm was not a difficult task.
「Half a month flashed by in the blink of an eye.」
「On this day.」
The Big Black Horse pulled the carriage slowly along the lush green mountain path. Suddenly, a burst of extremely noisy sounds erupted from the dense forest far away.
"The disciples of your Dragon God Sect are too overbearing! We spotted this Thousand-Year Dragon Blood Ginseng first, but you still want to snatch it away!" an indignant young man’s voice rang out.

chapters.title: Chapter 166: The Heavenly Star Dynasty has a Dragon God Sect?
chapters.content:
Chapter 166: Chapter 166: The Heavenly Star Dynasty has a Dragon God Sect?
"Haha, this world prizes strength above all. Our Dragon God Sect is, after all, a low-grade major sect. Your White Tiger Sword Sect, on the other hand, isn’t even a major sect. How can you compare to us?"
Another young man burst into arrogant laughter.
"Persistently committing injustice will lead to your own ruin! Your Dragon God Sect is so arrogant; you’ll face retribution one day!"
The youth from the White Tiger Sword Sect retorted coldly.
Shortly after, the sound of someone swiftly cutting through the air echoed from the dense forest; he had apparently left the area.
"Dragon God Sect?" The Big Black Cat, lying on the carriage, scratched his ear. He looked baffled in a particular direction and exclaimed, "Uncle Ma, did I hear that right? There’s another sect in this world called Dragon God Sect?"
Big Black Horse pursed his lips, knitting his brows as he replied, "You heard right. Indeed, there’s a Dragon God Sect in the Heavenly Star Dynasty!"
"They must be a pack of fakes!" the Big Black Cat cursed grumpily, his heart filled with an indignation he could hardly suppress.
He was, after all, a demon beast of the Dragon God Sect; hearing someone impersonate his sect made him extremely displeased.
"Don’t act rashly; the Master hasn’t given any orders yet..." Seeing the Big Black Cat looking like he was about to fly off the handle, Big Black Horse quickly interjected, managing to calm him down.
The Big Black Cat nodded silently. The one he feared most was his Master. Upon hearing Big Black Horse’s words, he obediently lay down on the carriage, remaining perfectly still.
「Inside the carriage.」
Ye Yun revealed a faint smile.
Who would have thought there would be another sect named Dragon God Sect in this world? Could this just be a coincidence?
"Little Horse, let’s stop here!" Ye Yun suddenly instructed.
Big Black Horse promptly brought the carriage to a halt by the roadside.
"This Dragon God Sect seems interesting; you two go investigate it," Ye Yun cheerfully suggested from inside the carriage.
He was on the verge of breaking through to the Second Layer of God Monarch Stage and needed to enter closed-door cultivation for a few days.
The three juniors of his Dragon God Sect were also cultivating. Therefore, it seemed appropriate to assign this lively duo to investigate the background of this other Dragon God Sect, giving them a little break as well.
After all, Big Black Horse had been working tirelessly to pull the carriage for over half a month. It was very hard work, and he certainly deserved a respite.
Master... expects us to investigate this Dragon God Sect?
Big Black Horse was stunned.
This was the first time their Master had given him such an interesting task. Moreover, this time he could go with Little Cat.
He quickly recovered from his surprise and said joyously, "Master, rest assured, I will definitely find out everything there is to know about this Dragon God Sect!"
"Hmm!" Ye Yun nodded and then, thinking of something, added, "All you need to do is investigate discreetly."
"Yes, Master!" Big Black Horse cheerfully agreed, giving a knowing look to the Big Black Cat before both transformed into streaks of black light and left the carriage.
They flew towards the nearby dense forest.
Big Black Horse and Big Black Cat took human form and hid behind the canopy of a large tree.
Through the gaps in the leaves, they peered into the distance.
A youth donned in a blue robe squatted down and dug a Thousand-Year Dragon Blood Ginseng from the ground.
"What a treasure! After consuming this Thousand-Year Dragon Blood Ginseng, I’m sure my cultivation base will break through to the Divine Bridge Realm!" the blue-robed youth said gleefully.
He glanced warily around and, finding no one in sight, carefully placed the Thousand-Year Dragon Blood Ginseng in a jade box.
After consuming this Thousand-Year Dragon Blood Ginseng, he would have to immediately enter closed-door cultivation to attempt a breakthrough to the Divine Bridge Realm. All of this would have to be done back within his sect.
"Little Cat, does he look like he belongs to the Dragon God Sect?" Narrowing his eyes, Big Black Horse sent a message telepathically in a quiet voice.
"Uncle Ma, how would I know?" the Big Black Cat returned with a mournful look on his face.
"It seems we need to test him, see if he knows the Dragon God Sword Technique..." Big Black Horse’s eyes lit up. He had suddenly thought of a good idea.
"Uncle Ma, leave this to me! I’ll test this kid!" the Big Black Cat eagerly volunteered.
"Your cultivation base is too high; don’t accidentally kill him. Remember what the Master said: we should investigate secretly..." Big Black Horse glanced at the Big Black Cat and scolded him grumpily.
The Big Black Cat blinked.
What did Uncle Ma mean by that? Even though my cultivation base is high, it’s not like I don’t know restraint, right? It’s just the two of us here. If Uncle Ma won’t let me go, does that mean he wants to go himself?
A shiver went through the Big Black Cat as understanding suddenly dawned on him.
Back when they were on Accumulated Thunder Mountain, Uncle Ma loved to pretend to be weak. It seems he’s still the same. Looks like Uncle Ma himself will have to take this chance to test the waters. I can only stand by and watch helplessly.
"Uncle Ma, I’m afraid I am not up to this task. Perhaps you should undertake it..." the Big Black Cat said with feigned sorrow.
"Young fellow, you have a bright future!" Big Black Horse patted the Big Black Cat on the shoulder, flashing a set of brilliant white teeth.
Just as he was about to rush off, he suddenly thought of something. He turned his head and asked the Big Black Cat, "Do you think I might scare the kid with my appearance?"
The Big Black Cat quickly shook his head.
Even though this dark-faced, sturdy man isn’t particularly handsome, he’s robust and imposing. I can’t possibly bad-mouth Uncle Ma to his face.
So, the Big Black Cat could only shake his head.
"You know, your current appearance looks quite good, young fellow," Big Black Horse chuckled. "Since I’m following the Master’s orders to investigate secretly, it seems I’ll need a handsome appearance too!" With a shake of his body, he transformed into a handsome young man clad in black.
"Uncle Ma, your appearance is splendid! I bet you’re going to attract many young girls!" the Big Black Cat’s eyes lit up as he hastily flattered.
"Get outta here with that nonsense! Your Uncle Ma here only fancies mares... though female dragons might do too..." Big Black Horse laughed heartily and, in high spirits, disappeared from the treetop.
The blue-robed youth was about to leave the place when he caught sight of a black streak of light appearing and landing in front of him.
"How come I smell the scent of Dragon Blood Ginseng, Brother? Could it be that you’ve dug it up?" Big Black Horse looked at the small pit on the ground and intentionally let out a disapproving laugh.
"Who are you?" The blue-robed youth regarded the unfamiliar man with caution in his eyes.
The other party’s cultivation base, like his own, was also at the Molding God Realm Tenth Layer.
"I am from the Iron Sword Sect. And you, brother... where are you from?" Big Black Horse cupped his fists, displaying the air of a martial artist, and said with a smile.
"I am from the Dragon God Sect!" the blue-robed youth replied, his face exuding pride.
He had never heard of an Iron Sword Sect, therefore he didn’t think much of the black-robed youth before him.
Within the entire Heavenly Star Dynasty, their Dragon God Sect belonged to the top echelon of sects. A typical quasi-first-rate sect was in no position to equal the Dragon God Sect.
"So you’re from the Dragon God Sect..." Big Black Horse feigned surprise.
"Since you know I’m from the Dragon God Sect, then don’t go sticking your nose into this matter of the Dragon Blood Ginseng!" the blue-robed youth sneered.

chapters.title: Chapter 168: Sneaking into the Scripture Hall, Discovering the Three Ultimate Techniques
chapters.content:
Chapter 168: Chapter 168: Sneaking into the Scripture Hall, Discovering the Three Ultimate Techniques
"We shouldn’t startle the snake by hitting the grass..."
The Big Black Horse chuckled leisurely, shook his head, a look of disapproval appearing in his bright black eyes.
He naturally grasped the Big Black Cat’s meaning.
It was to rough up the young man in blue and directly force out the whereabouts of the Dragon God Sect.
This was indeed the quickest and most effective method.
But the Big Black Horse had his own ideas.
The Master had finally given him some time off, and only a few days had passed?
If he completed the task so swiftly, wouldn’t that eliminate much of the fun?
He usually pulled the carriage diligently, and his life, as placid as still water, truly held no joy.
The Master probably assigned him this task of investigating the Dragon God Sect because he saw how lonely he was.
Therefore, the Big Black Horse vowed in his heart that he absolutely could not disappoint the Master’s solemn trust.
This mission must not be completed crudely and swiftly.
After all, for an Eternal Realm Great Demon like him, investigating a sect in a small place like the Heavenly Star Dynasty was far too easy.
It could be done in minutes.
The Master had entrusted such an easy task to him, surely wanting him to enjoy himself for a while longer.
"Uncle Ma, then we... should we keep waiting?" the Big Black Cat said helplessly, lowering his head in dejection.
He really couldn’t understand Uncle Ma’s mentality.
SMACK!
The Big Black Horse rapped the Big Black Cat on the head.
"Little Cat, look at your lack of spirit! You’re like a shrew all day long! A mere low-grade major sect—if I were to investigate it, wouldn’t it be child’s play? Why don’t you properly ponder the Master’s intentions?"
The Big Black Horse lectured him for a moment.
"Oh!" The Big Black Cat blinked, carefully savoring Uncle Ma’s words and gradually coming to understand.
Then, the two of them sat cross-legged behind a large tree and began cultivating the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye.
「The next day, early in the morning.」
The young man in blue set off on his journey again, with the two following closely behind.
By noon, a majestic mountain, resembling a giant dragon, loomed into their view.
The young man in blue descended, heading towards one of the mountain peaks.
"We finally made it!"
The Big Black Cat shielded his eyes with his hand, gazing at the terraced pavilions and buildings on the distant mountain range, an excited smile spreading across his face.
The plaque above the mountain gate bore the three ancient characters for "Dragon God Sect."
"Uncle Ma, what should we do next?" the Big Black Cat asked hurriedly.
"We’ll go to the Scripture Hall first and see what kind of Cultivation Techniques they have..."
The Big Black Horse’s eyes darted around, an idea immediately forming in his mind.
"Uncle Ma, this sect has cultivators of the Destiny Realm. My cultivation base isn’t high enough. How about... you take me in?"
The Big Black Cat wore a troubled expression, scratching his head.
The Dragon God Sect before them was a low-grade major sect, but it also had great cultivators of the Destiny Realm presiding over it.
He himself was only at the Heavenly Order Realm Third Layer.
He was afraid he would be discovered the moment he landed within the Dragon God Sect.
"Alright, I’ll take you there!"
The Big Black Horse readily agreed. He concealed his Super Divine Dragon Breath, enveloped them in a ray of light, and with lightning speed, shot towards the Dragon God Sect opposite them.
As an Eternal Realm Great Demon, the Big Black Horse was naturally formidable.
The Mountain Protection Array showed no reaction as he entered the Dragon God Sect.
None of the Destiny Realm cultivators could sense his presence.
The Big Black Horse scanned his surroundings and descended directly at the entrance of the Scripture Hall.
There was no one at the entrance at that moment. The Big Black Horse blew lightly on the door, and it swung open. He grabbed the Big Black Cat and darted inside in a flash.
The door closed again.
Just then, an old man looked up and suddenly saw two young men in black barging in. His eyes widened instantly.
"You are..."
Before he could finish his sentence, his head suddenly tilted, and he fainted completely.
This old man guarding the Scripture Repository was merely a cultivator at the Heavenly Order Realm Third Layer, far from being a match for the Big Black Horse, a Heaven-Destined Great Demon.
Thus, the Big Black Horse’s mediocre Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye had directly knocked the old man unconscious.
"We’re finally in!"
The Big Black Horse grinned slyly and set the Big Black Cat down on the ground.
"There are many Cultivation Techniques here. We should split up to look for them. If we find any similar ones, we’ll take them all..." the Big Black Horse said with a smile.
"Uncle Ma, why don’t we just take all the Cultivation Technique manuals in the entire Scripture Hall!" the Big Black Cat exclaimed excitedly.
"Are you looking to die?"
The Big Black Horse immediately gave him a rap on the head, scolding loudly, "What would we do with all of them? Did you intend for the Master to see them?"
"That’s not what I meant..."
The Big Black Cat looked sheepish and shook his head, muttering.
"The Master sent us to investigate, so we should act like investigators. There are many Cultivation Techniques here; we’re only looking for the useful ones. As for the useless ones—even if you fancy them, I, Uncle Ma, wouldn’t give them a second glance!" the Big Black Horse stated arrogantly, then gave the Big Black Cat another rap on the head.
The Big Black Cat rubbed his head, wincing.
But he recovered quickly, darting over to a nearby bookshelf and beginning to flip through the books.
The Big Black Horse didn’t stay idle either. He casually picked up a Cultivation Technique manual and began to flip through it rapidly.
The sound of rustling pages echoed through the Scripture Hall.
Both of them moved with incredible speed.
The Big Black Horse, in particular, flipped through pages at least ten times faster than the Big Black Cat.
"Found it! This movement technique seems somewhat similar to the Dragon God Body Technique..."
The Big Black Cat held up a book, a slightly yellowed, ancient manual.
"Put it away for now!" the Big Black Horse ordered.
He continued to browse through other Cultivation Techniques, and soon, they had reviewed every technique on the first level of the Scripture Hall.
The Big Black Horse also found a swordsmanship technique that bore a thirty percent resemblance to the swordsmanship used by the young man in blue.
Several words were written on this manual.
"Flying Dragon Sword Art."
This can be called Flying Dragon Sword Art? What a pretentious name!
The Big Black Horse sneered dismissively and tucked the manual away.
The two of them advanced to the second floor.
The Dragon God Sect’s Scripture Repository had a total of three levels.
On the second floor, they also found two or three manuals similar to the Dragon God Sect’s swordsmanship.
Of course, the resemblance was less than ten percent.
It still wasn’t the kind of Clan Sealing Sword Techniques that the young man in blue possessed.
It seems it must be on the third floor...
The Big Black Horse smiled hopefully and led the Big Black Cat to the third floor.
Upon reaching the third floor, there weren’t as many Cultivation Techniques; only three were displayed on a table.
The Big Black Horse’s keen gaze swept over them.
"Dragon’s Heart Method!"
"Dragon God Body Technique!"
"Dragon God Sword Technique!"
After clearly seeing the words on these few manuals, the Big Black Horse was stunned.
What the hell... How are these named exactly the same as the Dragon God Sect’s Three Ultimate Techniques?

chapters.title: Chapter 169: Testing the Divine Dragon Bloodline
chapters.content:
Chapter 169: Chapter 169: Testing the Divine Dragon Bloodline
"Uncle Ma, this... this..."
The Big Black Cat’s eyes widened, too shocked to speak.
Unexpectedly, on the Third Layer of the Dragon God Sect’s Scripture Palace, three Ultimate Techniques of the Dragon God Sect were enshrined.
They were identical to their own sect’s Ultimate Techniques.
This was truly astounding.
At this moment, a thought flashed through the Big Black Cat’s mind; he thought he might have found another lineage of the Dragon God Sect.
The Big Black Horse also stared, eyes wide, stroking his chin, rendered speechless.
Fortunately, we didn’t kill that guy, nor did we beat him half to death. Otherwise, I really wouldn’t know how to face the Sect Leader...
the Big Black Cat muttered guiltily to himself on the side.
This was truly a case of ’the floodwaters sweeping through the Dragon King Temple’—family failing to recognize family!
"Let’s look at these three Ultimate Techniques first!"
The Big Black Horse took a deep breath. Ignoring the Big Black Cat’s words, he stepped forward and picked up the second book, the Dragon God Body Technique.
He didn’t understand the first book, the Dragon God Sect Heart Method. However, he had seen the second and third books, the Dragon God Body Technique and Dragon God Sword Technique, many times, so he could still distinguish them.
After flipping through a few pages, the expression on the Big Black Horse’s face changed slightly.
The movement techniques within were about thirty to forty percent similar to the genuine Dragon God Body Technique.
He quickly placed the book in his hand on the table and promptly picked up the Dragon God Sword Technique.
After flipping through a few pages, the Big Black Horse also placed this book on the table.
The Big Black Cat, now standing beside him, picked up the Dragon God Body Technique and began to examine it.
"This is really strange."
"The Cultivation Techniques here share similarities with the genuine Dragon God Sect Cultivation Techniques, but there are also many differences."
Could it be... is this really another branch of the Dragon God Sect?
the Big Black Horse mused to himself.
After flipping through the two Cultivation Techniques, the Big Black Cat also grew serious. He frowned and said, "Uncle Ma, these two Cultivation Techniques seem to share the same origin as the Dragon God Sect’s techniques."
"I know."
The Big Black Horse nodded, clutching the three Cultivation Technique manuals in his hand and putting them away.
He planned to take these three Cultivation Techniques back to the Old Master for further scrutiny.
After all, as the Sect Master of *their* Dragon God Sect, the Old Master’s comprehension of these three Ultimate Techniques was much more profound. It was far beyond what these two laymen could discern.
"Uncle Ma, should we report back to the Old Master now?" the Big Black Cat asked with some delight, seeing their mission was completed.
"What’s the rush?"
The Big Black Horse glared at him, gave the Big Black Cat a thump on the head, and chuckled, "There’s something odd about this Dragon God Sect. We have to investigate it thoroughly."
"Uncle Ma, with these three Ultimate Techniques, isn’t that enough to explain the situation?" the Big Black Cat said aggrievedly, rubbing his head.
"No! This place still feels strange. We must investigate carefully and not miss any clues. If we report back so recklessly, the Old Master might scold us for being unreliable," the Big Black Horse said, his expression pensive.
Since the Old Master had let them investigate covertly, there must have been a deeper meaning; perhaps the Old Master already knew everything. Therefore, the Big Black Horse would not return to report so hastily. Instead, he planned to turn this Dragon God Sect completely upside down.
The Big Black Horse grabbed the Big Black Cat, and they vanished from the Scripture Palace in a flash.
"Uncle Ma, where are we going next?" the Big Black Cat asked quietly.
"Let’s first check if any other disciples have the Dragon God Bloodline..." the Big Black Horse said after a moment of thought.
Then, he led the Big Black Cat, and they silently infiltrated a mountain peak.
The Dragon God Sect was situated on a sprawling mountain range. There were many peaks, each housing a considerable number of disciples.
The Big Black Horse, a great demon of the Eternal Realm, moved through this place completely undetected.
After all, each mountain peak only had a single Destiny Realm Cultivator.
"This Dragon God Sect is truly strange. Little Cat, did you notice anything suspicious?" the Big Black Horse asked, stroking his chin, his eyes glinting thoughtfully after investigating one mountain peak.
"Uncle Ma, there doesn’t seem to be anyone with the Dragon God Bloodline here..." the Big Black Cat said in surprise.
"Correct. This peak has about four to five thousand people, yet not a single one has the Dragon God Bloodline. That really doesn’t add up!"
The Big Black Horse mused, "According to the Old Master, most Cultivators in the Dragon God Sect possess the Dragon God Bloodline. And only those with the Dragon God Bloodline can unleash the full power of the sect’s Ultimate Techniques. This bloodline is the very foundation that allows the Dragon God Sect to be an Eternal Sect. Yet, this current Dragon God Sect... everything about it feels fake."
"Uncle Ma, could it be that after so many years, Cultivators with the Dragon God Bloodline have become nearly extinct on the Cangnan Continent? Is that why this Dragon God Sect can’t find any disciples with the bloodline?" the Big Black Cat hypothesized after some thought.
"’That speculation isn’t impossible,’ the Big Black Horse said, his eyes glinting. ’Let’s go check the other peaks.’ With that, he led the Big Black Cat away from there."
They then quickly scoured dozens of other mountain peaks, attempting to find Cultivators with the Dragon God Bloodline.
But to their surprise, after searching all the peaks of the Dragon God Sect, among tens of thousands of people, they didn’t find a single person possessing the Dragon God Bloodline.
This left both the Big Black Horse and the Big Black Cat feeling rather dejected.
They had initially thought this might be a collateral branch of *their* Dragon God Sect. But without a single Cultivator possessing the Dragon God Bloodline, such a kinship... was simply too far-fetched, wasn’t it?
The two of them stood on a mountain peak.
The Big Black Cat stared blankly at the high and low buildings scattered in the distance.
The Big Black Horse’s eyes, however, were constantly darting around.
After all, he was the main one responsible for this mission; the Big Black Cat was just tagging along.
So he absolutely couldn’t return to the Old Master and report failure like this.
He and the Big Black Cat had only quickly scanned the Cultivators on all the peaks of the Dragon God Sect. There were still many places within the sect they hadn’t been to.
The Big Black Horse decided his next step was to thoroughly search these other places. He would turn this Dragon God Sect upside down to see if any new clues could be found.
His gaze swept into the distance, and suddenly, a hint of delight appeared on his face when he spotted a particular place.
Every sect has a Treasure Pavilion. Perhaps there are some clues there!
Thinking of this, the Big Black Horse grabbed the Big Black Cat and departed from that spot.
The Dragon God Sect’s Treasure Pavilion was situated within a large mountain.
It was protected by powerful Formations.
In front of the Formations, three Destiny Realm Cultivators were stationed as guards.
A black light descended from the sky.
The three Destiny Realm Cultivators collapsed, falling unconscious without any warning.
"Uncle Ma, your Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye has reached a level of true mastery, hasn’t it...?" the Big Black Cat exclaimed admiringly.
"’I’ve merely reached initial proficiency. It’s just about enough to handle these small fry...’" the Big Black Horse laughed heartily. He walked up to the great Formation and, with a light poke of his hand, a damaged opening appeared in it.

chapters.title: Chapter 170: The Treasure Pavilion, Divine Dragon Essence Blood and Ancient Paintings
chapters.content:
Chapter 170: Chapter 170: The Treasure Pavilion, Divine Dragon Essence Blood and Ancient Paintings
After breaking the grand array formation of the Treasure Pavilion, Big Black Horse walked to the front of its grand door. The ancient door was covered with layers of seals, hundreds of them, all glowing with a divine golden radiance.
Big Black Horse stared at them for a few seconds. Noticing the seals hadn’t been undone, he couldn’t help but sigh.
His Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye is still not strong enough,
he thought.
If Master were here, he could open it with just a glance.
Since he had no other option, Big Black Horse was compelled to break the seals one by one by poking them with his fingers.
After pushing the door open and walking in, Big Black Cat followed closely behind. Upon entering the Treasure Pavilion, Big Black Cat’s eyes widened with astonishment, almost blinded by the various heavenly materials and earthly treasures emitting sparkling radiance all around.
This really is a major Sect!
he marveled.
So many precious items hidden in this pavilion!
Big Black Cat’s eyes gleamed with desire, wishing he could take all the treasures in the pavilion at that very moment.
"Little Cat, don’t act rashly," Big Black Horse warned cautiously. "These could be the belongings of a distant relative of our Dragon God Sect. We cannot touch anything."
"Don’t worry, Uncle Ma, I know my limits," Big Black Cat grinned sheepishly, lowering his head in embarrassment.
The two slowly walked further in, observing their surroundings. Although there were many heavenly materials and earthly treasures, they weren’t anything special in Big Black Horse’s eyes.
He was only interested in finding things related to the Dragon God Sect.
Along the way, he found a few precious Swords with a faint Divine Dragon’s Breath on them. It appeared that some Divine Dragon Essence Blood had been used in their forging, giving them this characteristic breath. These Swords didn’t prove much, and Big Black Horse didn’t bother collecting them.
The two made their way to the depths of the Treasure Pavilion without finding any heavenly materials or earthly treasures particularly worth noting.
"Uncle Ma, it seems we haven’t found anything of importance in this place?" Big Black Cat said, shaking his head.
What is that? Could it be a hidden mechanism?
Big Black Horse’s eyes lit up as he found a keyhole on the wall at the deepest part of the pavilion. From this keyhole, he sensed the subtle aura of a restrictive spell. He instantly became interested.
Perhaps... there are even more precious treasures hidden here.
He walked to the keyhole, inserted his finger, and jiggled it a few times, but there was no response. His facial muscles twitched; then, with a sudden exertion, he poked forcefully. The wall creaked, and a secret door opened.
Could there be a secret door?
Big Black Cat’s eyes widened. He instantly thought there might be treasures hidden behind this secret door.
SWISH!
Big Black Cat quickly squeezed himself through the secret entrance.
Big Black Horse also walked in, unhurriedly, his steps steady.
Upon entering, instead of the expected heavenly materials and earthly treasures, all they saw was a stone desk with a small red bottle on top.
"What is this?" Big Black Cat curiously picked up the bottle. He shook it in front of his eyes and peered closely at it, but couldn’t make out anything.
Big Black Horse snatched the bottle, opened the cork, and sniffed. A look of astonishment spread over his face.
This is actually Divine Dragon Essence Blood!
However, the vial didn’t contain much—only about twenty or thirty drops.
"Uncle Ma, could this be the Essence Blood of a Divine Dragon?" Big Black Cat asked in surprise, his nose wrinkling as he sniffed the distinct scent.
Big Black Horse solemnly nodded and capped the bottle again.
This Dragon God Sect is quite something,
he thought.
To actually have a small bottle of Divine Dragon Essence Blood hidden away. Nowadays, it’s incredibly difficult to find any Divine Dragon Essence Blood on the Cangnan Continent.
I should take this to Master for his decision...
Big Black Horse mused. After some consideration, he carefully pocketed the small bottle of Divine Dragon Essence Blood.
"Let’s go," Big Black Horse said, turning to leave.
Suddenly, Big Black Cat called out from behind, "Uncle Ma, look! There’s a painting hanging on the wall behind the table."
Big Black Horse turned around, his gaze falling upon the painting. It seemed quite old; the paper had yellowed, and it depicted the back of a young man. This young man was dressed in a black Robe and carried a Sword on his back. His Robe fluttered, giving him a rather ethereal air.
However, compared to the painting treasured by the Five-Colored Dragon Carp, this one was significantly inferior. The protagonist of the painting cherished by the Five-Colored Dragon Carp was none other than Master himself. That figure in white, standing on a cliff, showcased unparalleled charisma and an indomitable presence, exuding a supreme, invincible aura that seemed to dominate all ages and heavens.
Big Black Horse had noticed this painting when they entered, but he hadn’t paid it much mind.
Big Black Cat’s eyes darted around. He grinned and said, "Uncle Ma, since this painting was placed here, perhaps it has some collection value. Why don’t we take it too?"
"What’s so significant about a painting?" Big Black Horse shook his head dismissively. "If it were truly important, it would have been enshrined, not just hung on a wall."
"Uncle Ma," Big Black Cat suggested, "the figure in this painting might be an elder of the Dragon God Sect. It could have some reference value. Why don’t we take it back?"
Big Black Horse thought for a moment and felt there was some truth to that. So, he reached out, rolled up the painting, and took it.
As the two left the Treasure Pavilion, Big Black Cat asked, "Uncle Ma, where are we going next?"
Big Black Horse glanced around, contemplated for a moment, then said, "Let’s go check out the ancestral shrine..."
"The ancestral shrine?" Big Black Cat’s eyes suddenly lit up.
Ancestral shrines usually house the spirit plaques of past generations. That place might reveal the origins of this Dragon God Sect!
"We’ll go to the ancestral shrine now and see if there’s an Ancestral Spirit Plaque for Master..." Big Black Horse chuckled slyly, then grabbed Big Black Cat and departed.
The ancestral shrine of the Dragon God Sect was located in a valley. The place was protected by a large array formation. Outside the formation stood a thatched cottage where an old man resided. This old man was also an important figure in the Dragon God Sect, solely responsible for guarding the ancestral shrine.
A streak of black light descended from the sky, transforming into two youths in black robes. Big Black Horse glanced at the old man in the thatched cottage. The elder, who possessed a cultivation base at the Fourth Level of the Destiny Realm, immediately fainted.
Big Black Horse walked up to the array formation, breached it with a single poke, and swaggered inside. Big Black Cat followed, his eyes gleaming with fanaticism.
When will I reach the Eternal Realm?
he wondered.
If I could cultivate to the Eternal Realm, I could be as imposing and direct as Uncle Ma, doing as I please, and no one could stop me...
Big Black Horse pushed open the grand doors of the ancestral shrine and walked in. The shrine was dimly lit, with rows of Spirit Plaques enshrined within.
Big Black Horse didn’t recognize any of the Dragon God Sect’s ancestors.
All he cared about was Master.
So, he began his search, starting with the foremost Ancestral Spirit Plaque.
When he reached the thirteenth Ancestral Spirit Plaque, his eyes instantly widened. "This..." His mind went momentarily blank.

chapters.title: Chapter 171: Ancestral Spirit Position, The Strangeness in The Night
chapters.content:
Chapter 171: Chapter 171: Ancestral Spirit Position, The Strangeness in The Night
The thirteenth Ancestral Spirit Plaque had a clear line of text written on it.
"The Spirit Plaque of Ye Yun, the Thirteenth Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect."
This Ancestral Spirit Plaque appeared extremely old, as though it had survived for quite a long time.
The writing was incredibly clear.
But as Big Black Horse looked at it, he felt a sense of dizziness, seemingly unable to fully make out the words.
"Little Cat... Quick, tell me if the name on that Ancestral Spirit Plaque is the Old Master’s?" Big Black Horse said in a trembling voice, pointing in a direction.
Big Black Cat, still busy observing the other Ancestral Spirit Plaques, immediately turned his attention to where Big Black Horse was pointing upon hearing his call.
When he clearly saw the words on the Ancestral Spirit Plaque, he was instantly shocked.
The Old Master’s name was actually written on it.
This was simply unbelievable.
Could it be that this place was truly another branch of the Dragon God Sect’s lineage? Why else would it have the Old Master’s name?
In this ancestral shrine, hundreds of Ancestral Spirit Plaques were nestled tightly together. They were possibly for all the past Sect Masters of the Dragon God Sect.
"Uncle Ma, we’ve made a major discovery this time! This Dragon God Sect is definitely another branch of our Dragon God Sect!" Big Black Cat’s eyes beamed as he spoke with excitement.
Big Black Horse nodded emphatically. He took a deep breath, and his inner emotions finally calmed.
Their clandestine investigation of this Dragon God Sect had yielded a truly immense reward.
If this low-grade major sect was indeed another branch of the Dragon God Sect, it would be an overwhelmingly joyous event for their Dragon God Sect.
Big Black Horse quickly fetched three incense sticks from a nearby stand, lit them, and bowed deeply towards these Ancestral Spirit Plaques with a very solemn expression.
Then he inserted the three incense sticks into the incense burner.
As a member of the Dragon God Sect himself, it was only natural for him to burn incense and express his heartfelt respect for these ancestors.
Big Black Cat followed suit and quickly did the same.
After burning the three incense sticks, he looked at Big Black Horse and asked, "Uncle Ma, should we head back now?"
"What’s the rush?"
Big Black Horse didn’t seem to be in a hurry.
It was now a certainty: this place was another branch of the Dragon God Sect’s lineage. But there was still plenty of time. He wasn’t keen on returning so quickly. Considering their three young masters were in Cultivation and the Old Master was in seclusion for a breakthrough, it was better to stay and see if they could find anything else.
After carefully exiting the ancestral shrine, Big Black Horse led Big Black Cat away.
Although this trip had yielded significant findings, Big Black Horse still decided to stay in this Dragon God Sect for a few more days.
Big Black Cat had no choice but to accompany his Uncle Ma.
Over the following days, the two of them turned this Dragon God Sect upside down but didn’t stumble upon any new clues.
By now, night had fallen, and darkness enveloped everything.
Big Black Horse stood on a mountain peak, gazing at the rolling mountain range, silently contemplating his next move.
He could actually return now. He and Big Black Cat had thoroughly combed every inch of this Dragon God Sect. But Big Black Horse felt a little unwilling to leave just yet. After all, his efficiency was too high; he had investigated the entire Dragon God Sect in less than a day.
"Uncle Ma, what are you looking at?" Big Black Cat stood beside him, noticing Uncle Ma’s furrowed brow, and asked softly.
"I’m looking at..."
Just as Big Black Horse spoke, his pupils suddenly constricted slightly, as if he had spotted something extraordinary.
His pale golden pupils could perceive things ordinary people couldn’t.
As night enveloped the land and the world plunged into pitch darkness, Big Black Horse was stunned to discover a faint black vapor slowly drifting out from along the mountain range.
This black vapor shrouded the entire sprawling mountain range of this Dragon God Sect.
"What is this?" Big Black Horse was shocked.
This black vapor seemed inexplicable. If not for his special pupils, particularly their unusual sensitivity to demonic and evil things, even an ordinary Eternal Realm Cultivator might not have been able to detect it.
"Uncle Ma, what did you see?" Big Black Cat stared around with wide eyes, but found nothing.
"I don’t know what it is either. I’ve never seen this thing before..." Big Black Horse muttered.
"Uncle Ma, then what should we do?" Big Black Cat looked bewildered, a hint of nervousness on his face.
Uncle Ma was already a great demon of the Eternal Realm. The fact that he said he’d never seen this thing meant it had to be extraordinary.
"Let’s not be hasty. We’ll observe the situation first," Big Black Horse said in a deep voice, frowning as he gazed at the black vapor.
Big Black Cat nodded repeatedly.
The two of them stood on the mountain peak for the entire night, observing.
Only when the first hint of dawn appeared, like fish-belly white on the horizon, did Big Black Horse discover that the black vapor had naturally dispersed, seemingly returning underground.
"Interesting. Could there be something underground?"
Big Black Horse mused to himself.
"Little Cat, let’s go underground and investigate..."
Big Black Horse gritted his teeth, grabbed Big Black Cat, transformed into a streak of black light, and plunged directly into the depths beneath the mountain range.
After descending tens of thousands of zhang underground, Big Black Horse discovered a massive formation emitting black light, blocking his path.
"So there really is something strange underground, huh?" Big Black Cat’s eyes widened as he stared at the great formation before them, feeling a sense of dread.
Suddenly, Big Black Horse punched towards the great formation.
BOOM!
The great formation boomed loudly and repelled Big Black Horse’s fist.
Big Black Horse was astonished. His punch hadn’t broken the great formation, which showed its considerable power.
Big Black Horse thought for a moment, and a small golden Sword suddenly appeared in his hand.
"This Sword..."
Big Black Cat, beside him, suddenly gasped.
He had once heard Uncle Ma mention it. The Old Master had once bestowed upon Uncle Ma a powerful strand of Rebirth Thunder, which had been transformed into this small golden Sword. This had to be it.
This small golden Sword was indeed terrifying. As Big Black Horse took it out, an indescribable aura emanated from it.
Big Black Cat felt his entire body tremble, as if he couldn’t bear to face the Sword.
Big Black Horse directly thrust the Little Sword into the great formation.
SHINK!
A small hole was immediately pierced through the great formation.
"HAHAHA!" Big Black Horse laughed, put away the small golden Sword, and taking Big Black Cat, transformed into a black ray of light, slipping through the small hole.
This small golden Sword, transformed from Rebirth Thunder, was truly formidable—hundreds of times stronger than his physical punch. He almost didn’t want to continue refining this small golden Sword. If used as a combat weapon, no one in the Eternal Realm would be his match.
After passing through the black great formation, the two entered a massive space.
It was dim all around, with only faint specks of starlight flickering.
A colossal Black Dragon lay sprawled on the ground, seemingly in a deep sleep.

chapters.title: Chapter 172: Black Dragon in the Earth’s Depth, 7 Small Arrows
chapters.content:
Chapter 172: Chapter 172: Black Dragon in the Earth’s Depth, 7 Small Arrows
"It’s actually a dragon!" Big Black Cat’s eyes widened when he saw the enormous black dragon. His breath grew rapid, and a surge of excitement rushed through his body.
"What’s so amazing about a dragon? You see them every day, aren’t you tired of looking yet?" Big Black Horse snorted dismissively, baring a row of large white teeth, and flicked Big Black Cat on the forehead.
Big Black Cat blinked rapidly.
Uncle Ma, what does he mean by that? What does he mean, ’see them every day’? Could it be...
As this thought occurred to him, Big Black Cat turned to Uncle Ma and asked in a trembling voice, "Uncle Ma, could it be that you’re not a horse, but a dragon?"
"Let’s not talk about that. I’ll leave a little mystery for you!" Big Black Horse chuckled, appearing unconcerned as he descended from mid-air.
Big Black Cat scratched at his ears in frustration; not getting the answer he wanted made him feel extremely uncomfortable. However, since Uncle Ma hadn’t said anything, he couldn’t very well force him to speak; after all, he didn’t have the strength to do so, did he?
Big Black Cat also quickly descended from mid-air.
The two of them examined this black dragon.
"Uncle Ma, this black dragon seems to have been dead for a very long time," Big Black Cat concluded after observing for a moment.
Big Black Horse nodded in agreement but remained silent. Indeed, the black dragon before them had been dead for many years.
But why was there a large formation, and within that formation, a black dragon, beneath the mountain range of the Dragon God Sect?
What exactly is their intention?
Big Black Horse’s gaze continuously scanned the black dragon’s body. Suddenly, his eyes flickered; he discovered a small black arrow embedded above the black dragon’s head.
Could it be this small arrow... that killed the black dragon?
Big Black Horse mulled this over.
With his hands clasped behind his back, he began to walk slowly around the black dragon. Although he walked very slowly, each step spanned several hundred zhang. This was also a type of distance-shortening divine skill.
Big Black Cat didn’t know this divine skill, so he could only fly quickly, following close behind Big Black Horse.
After circling once, Big Black Horse was surprised to discover that there were actually seven small black arrows embedded in this black dragon’s body. It seemed these seven small arrows were the true culprits behind the black dragon’s death.
Big Black Cat, following beside Uncle Ma, also discovered these seven little swords. He tsked and said, "Uncle Ma, this black dragon met a miserable end! After being killed, these seven small arrows weren’t even pulled out."
"Things are probably not that simple..." Big Black Horse’s expression was grim. He once again rose into the air, looking down from above.
Only then did he notice that the black dragon’s body was contorted, and the positions of the seven small arrows seemed to follow the curve of its body, forming the shape of the Big Dipper.
Is this a formation?
Big Black Horse muttered to himself. He now suspected that these seven small arrows had been inserted only after the black dragon had died.
Big Black Cat, standing beside him, was also shocked when he heard Uncle Ma’s words. Indeed, just as Uncle Ma said, these seven small arrows actually formed a Seven Stars formation.
"Uncle Ma, this place is too bizarre! Should we pull out those seven small arrows?" Big Black Cat asked, his eyes shining brightly.
"Let’s not rush. We’ll observe after dark and then decide!" Big Black Horse said, shaking his head.
He had a guess, but he still needed time to verify it.
Big Black Cat quickly nodded, and so the two of them sat cross-legged in the void, waiting quietly.
The day passed quickly.
When night fell, a black qi suddenly emanated from the dead black dragon’s body. It drifted through the large formation and floated up towards the Dragon God Sect above.
It really is like this...
A solemn expression appeared on Big Black Horse’s face.
Although he still couldn’t quite understand it, he knew this matter was no small thing. It seemed he would have to go back and report to the Master.
Big Black Cat looked around at this moment but couldn’t see that wisp of black qi.
"Uncle Ma, did you see that thing?" he asked hurriedly.
"I saw it. Its source is this black dragon..." Big Black Horse nodded with a grave expression, grabbed Big Black Cat, and swiftly flew upwards.
To his surprise, the opening in the large formation had already automatically repaired itself.
Big Black Horse had no choice but to take out that golden Little Sword again, pierce an opening, and then fly out.
After flying out from underground, Big Black Horse didn’t pause. In a single breath, he was back beside the carriage.
He gently sensed his surroundings and found that the Master still showed no signs of activity. Not daring to disturb him, he sat on the ground to wait.
When Big Black Cat saw the carriage, he also transformed, reverting to his cat form. He then landed on the carriage and began to cultivate.
「Seven days later.」
A very faint ripple emanated from within the carriage.
Ye Yun opened his eyes, a slight smile on his face. He had broken through to the Second Layer of God Monarch Stage.
Seeing that the cat and the horse had both returned, Ye Yun smiled, lifted the carriage curtain, and stepped out.
"Master!" Big Black Horse quickly stood up and bowed respectfully. He was still in his human form and hadn’t changed back into a black horse.
"How did the investigation go?" Ye Yun asked with a relaxed smile.
"Master, that place is very strange..." Big Black Horse promptly recounted everything he had investigated in full detail. Then, he took out the few cultivation technique manuals and the scroll.
Ye Yun’s expression changed slightly. He hadn’t expected that the Dragon God Sect in the Heavenly Star Dynasty would have such a significant connection to him.
Could it be that this really is a branch established by disciples of the Dragon God Sect from a later generation?
Ye Yun opened the few cultivation technique manuals. After a few glances, he understood everything. These cultivation technique manuals were all very crude. Only the three cultivation techniques from the Third Layer of the Scripture Palace were somewhat acceptable to his discerning eye. If one were to cultivate according to these three cultivation techniques, they would indeed be much stronger than ordinary cultivators. However, compared to the three great Ultimate Techniques of the orthodox Dragon God Sect, they were still far too lacking.
This situation was understandable to Ye Yun. After all, a hundred thousand years had passed. The inheritance Luo Li and the others had obtained wasn’t entirely complete, so how could this branch of the Dragon God Sect be any different?
However, Ye Yun also found the black dragon beneath the Dragon God Sect’s mountain range, which Big Black Horse had described, somewhat strange.
"Little Cat, you wait here for now..." Ye Yun instructed. Then, taking Big Black Horse, he tore open the void and descended directly upon the Dragon God Sect.
Ye Yun’s first stop was, naturally, the ancestral shrine.
Big Black Horse employed his old trick again. He first used the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye to render the old man guarding the ancestral shrine unconscious. Then, he landed on the ground and opened the main doors of the ancestral shrine.
Ye Yun smiled faintly.
Big Black Horse’s aptitude is good; he’s using this Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye quite proficiently.
With his hands clasped behind his back, Ye Yun strode inside. What immediately met his eyes were the rows upon rows of Ancestral Spirit Plaques on the offering table.
Ye Yun’s gaze narrowed slightly. He did indeed see some familiar names.

chapters.title: Chapter 173: Seven-Star Dragon Kill Array, Devouring Luck
chapters.content:
Chapter 173: Chapter 173: Seven-Star Dragon Kill Array, Devouring Luck
For Ye Yun, the most ancient ancestor of the Dragon God Sect from a hundred thousand years ago, he barely recognized anyone from the younger generations, aside from Luo Li and a few others. However, Ye Yun was intimately familiar with the previous Sect Masters of the Dragon God Sect, remembering them with vivid clarity.
First, he found his own Ancestral Spirit Plaque. With a slight flicker of his gaze, the plaque dissolved into light smoke and vanished. Being very much alive, he had no need for incense offerings from any descendants. Ye Yun then examined the twelve Ancestral Spirit Plaques before him; they indeed belonged to former Sect Masters of the Dragon God Sect, and all the names were correct.
"Master, is this a branch lineage of our Dragon God Sect?" the Big Black Horse asked softly from the side.
"Let’s observe further..." Ye Yun just smiled, not giving the Big Black Horse a definitive answer.
Luo Li’s branch of the Dragon God Sect had been so tragically persecuted by the mastermind that its lineage was nearly severed.
