Yet, this branch of the Dragon God Sect was flourishing and well-organized. This seemed to deviate significantly from the mastermind’s intentions. How could this mastermind, possessing such incredible power, idly watch the Heavenly Star Dynasty’s branch of the Dragon God Sect develop? It clearly defied logic.
Ye Yun was filled with doubts, so he decided to investigate underground.
As his gaze swept over the Ancestral Spirit Plaques one by one, Ye Yun discovered they were incomplete, only going up to the two hundred and fifty-first generation, with none following. Ye Yun focused on the plaque of the two hundred and fiftieth generation Sect Master. He recalled Luo Li mentioning that the two hundred and fiftieth Sect Master had offended a powerful faction, after which the Dragon God Sect began to be relentlessly hunted.
The Ancestral Spirit Plaque read: "The position of Dragon Xuan, 250th Generation Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect."
Ye Yun nodded faintly. So, this man was named Dragon Xuan. The name was respectable enough, especially his surname, Long, which suited the Dragon God Sect perfectly. Ye Yun committed not only Dragon Xuan to memory but also the names of all the Sect Masters who preceded him.
Then he exited the ancestral hall. The Big Black Horse carefully closed the hall doors and stood behind Ye Yun.
"Let’s go, we’ll take a look underground," Ye Yun said.
He tore open the void once more, arriving directly in the depths of the earth. Seeing the large black formation barring his path, Ye Yun observed it silently for a moment before stepping forward. The large black formation naturally parted, creating an opening.
Ye Yun stepped in, the Big Black Horse following closely.
As expected of the Master, effortlessly breaking through this great formation...
the Big Black Horse thought, filled with envy.
Standing in the dim void, Ye Yun looked down at the colossal Black Dragon below, a faint light flickering in his eyes. This Black Dragon’s bloodline wasn’t pure; it had been cultivated from a Black Flood Dragon that had been dead for well over ten thousand years. Seven small arrows were embedded in the Black Dragon’s body, fixed there like the Big Dipper Sword Array.
Ye Yun reached out, made a gentle grasping motion in the void, and a wisp of faint black qi appeared in his hand. He examined it, and a sudden, baleful glint flashed in his eyes.
"Such a vicious method!" Ye Yun said gravely.
"Master, what is this?" the Big Black Horse asked nervously.
"This is a malevolent qi used to plunder fortune..." Ye Yun stated calmly. "My Dragon God Sect is an Eternal Level sect, bearing the great fortune of the Cangnan Continent. When its fortune prospers, its purple qi of destiny, spanning a hundred billion li, is like a Divine Dragon, anchoring the continent."
"Oh..." The Big Black Horse nodded, seeming to grasp a little of what the Master had said.
The Dragon God Sect is an Eternal Level sect, carrying immense fortune. To completely annihilate it must be incredibly difficult. Not only must the disciples of the Dragon God Sect be eliminated, but its intangible fortune must also be continuously suppressed and plundered. The Black Dragon before us seems to be plundering the Dragon God Sect’s fortune,
the Big Black Horse mused.
As the Big Black Horse was lost in thought, Ye Yun pointed his finger.
WHOOSH!
The colossal Black Dragon suddenly flipped over, revealing seven deep black holes beneath its body, each exuding a faint, dark aura.
"These are..." the Big Black Horse stared at the seven black holes in astonishment, finding them unfathomably deep, as if they reached into the very core of the earth.
"This Black Dragon has had a Divine Skill tied to its fate cast upon it, representing the fortune of the Dragon God Sect here. And those Seven-Star small arrows form a formation called the Seven-Star Dragon Kill Array... Every night, the great formation activates automatically, emitting an invisible malevolent aura that permeates the Dragon God Sect above, plundering its fortune. And those seven black holes channel the plundered fortune back into the earth pulses of the Cangnan Continent..." Ye Yun explained calmly, looking at the black openings.
Hearing this explanation, a chill ran down the Big Black Horse’s spine.
Just what kind of person could possess such formidable methods? An ordinary Eternal Realm Cultivator definitely couldn’t achieve this. This even involved the manipulation of fortune. It would require a great Cultivator, proficient in Divine Skills related to fate and numerology, to execute such a grand design.
"What kind of an enemy did our Dragon God Sect provoke," Ye Yun’s faint voice echoed through the void, "to be hated so intensely, to the point they wish to annihilate us completely?"
The Big Black Horse shuddered. In a daze, he too sensed the power of that invisible, hidden hand, as if it originated from the highest heavens, manipulating events in this world from across dimensions.
"Master, I’ll go destroy this Black Dragon and shatter the Seven-Star Dragon Kill Array!" the Big Black Horse declared indignantly.
"Breaking it is useless!" Ye Yun suddenly said with a mysterious smile, his expression enigmatic.
The Big Black Horse was stunned, unable to comprehend his Master’s words.
This Black Dragon represents the Dragon God Sect on the surface. The Seven-Star Dragon Kill Array draws a malevolent aura from it daily, absorbing the Dragon God Sect’s fortune, which then flows into the depths of the earth through seven openings beneath its body. Day after day, year after year, it continuously depletes the Dragon God Sect’s fortune. Shouldn’t it be destroyed?
Ye Yun turned to look at the Big Black Horse and chuckled, "Actually, what truly needs to be destroyed is the Dragon God Sect on the surface."
These words were earth-shattering. The Big Black Horse felt as if a heavy mallet had struck his head, leaving it ringing. He was utterly bewildered.
What did the Master mean? Why was it more imperative to destroy the Dragon God Sect on the surface? Isn’t the surface Dragon God Sect a branch of our Dragon God Sect’s lineage? Why destroy it? Is it just to prevent the Seven-Star Dragon Kill Array from continuing to devour the Dragon God Sect’s fortune?
Ye Yun looked at the Big Black Horse’s expression and merely offered a faint smile. He could understand the Big Black Horse’s current turmoil.
If Ye Yun hadn’t personally descended into this subterranean world today, even he could not have imagined the depths of the mastermind’s treachery. The Dragon God Sect on the surface, a Low-grade Major Sect numbering seventy to eighty thousand disciples, was actually a cobbled-together False Dragon God Sect. Based on the Dragon God Sect’s authentic Three Ultimate Techniques, they had pieced together a hodgepodge of three new, inferior ones. These were the techniques used to perpetuate its lineage.
The mastermind allowed this Dragon God Sect to survive in the Heavenly Star Dynasty because the true Dragon God Sect’s fortune was vast and unending. It couldn’t be easily severed by mortal means; a single misstep could allow the dragon to rise again. To prevent this, the mastermind, while continuously suppressing the true Dragon God Sect, simultaneously created this False Dragon God Sect, allowing it to ’inherit’ the Dragon God Sect’s fortune.

chapters.title: Chapter 174: The Arrogant Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 174: Chapter 174: The Arrogant Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect
On one hand, they allowed the False Dragon God Sect to inherit the luck. On the other, they arranged a large formation underground, exercising Destiny Manipulating Divine Arts and consuming the luck every day.
This hidden puppet master’s malicious intent was truly infuriating!
Ye Yun was also very angry.
However, his Dao Heart, unchanging for one hundred thousand years, quickly suppressed this emotion.
This hidden puppet master... is not simple at all.
They had been plotting for tens of thousands of years, never revealing a single flaw.
They had been using various proxies to appear in this world.
This Seven-Star Dragon Kill Array here involved extremely profound Destiny Manipulating Divine Arts, which was certainly not something an ordinary cultivator of the Eternity Realm could achieve.
Perhaps all targets point towards the Divine Land.
Ye Yun smiled faintly.
Things are getting more and more interesting.
Since returning from the Ancient Demon Abyss, he had already sensed that some clues were coming from the Divine Land.
This Seven-Star Dragon Kill Array now further deepened his suspicion.
However, Ye Yun was not in a hurry.
All he needed to do was rise to power with the younger generation of the Dragon God Sect, which would eventually draw the attention of the hidden puppet master.
That hidden puppet master would never stand by and watch.
Ye Yun’s invincible return after signing in for one hundred thousand years meant he naturally needed to revitalize the Dragon God Sect. He had to continue its glory and regain control of the Cangnan Continent’s luck.
In this process, he would inevitably eliminate all the puppet master’s front-line proxies and have a proper confrontation with this hidden puppet master.
At this thought, a satisfied smile appeared on Ye Yun’s face.
Finally, there is something more interesting to do.
Having such an opponent made Ye Yun feel very interested.
A life of invincibility is no longer lonely.
"Master, what should we do next?" Big Black Horse asked softly beside him.
"Let’s go up and take a seat..." Ye Yun smiled faintly.
Big Black Horse was stunned for a moment, pointed at the Black Dragon’s corpse, and said, "Master, what about this Black Dragon and the Seven-Star Dragon Kill Array?"
"Put them away for now!" Ye Yun smiled and waved his hand. The giant black dragon on the ground disappeared in an instant.
Even the seven deep holes were sealed.
There was a small rune on each hole, which flashed a few times before disappearing.
Ye Yun tore through the void again and returned to the sky above the Dragon God Sect.
Surveying the densely packed palaces below, he finally fixed his gaze on one of them, an ancient hall.
In the next moment, Ye Yun and Big Black Horse appeared in the center of the hall.
An old man with black hair, dressed in a red dragon robe, sat quietly in the center, cultivating.
A faint Golden Divine Dragon Phantom emerged behind him.
Ye Yun did not speak, merely observing with interest.
Big Black Horse chuckled beside him, not daring to make a sound.
"Little Horse, this man is the current Dragon God Sect Sect Master. Go and spar with him, and see how well he has mastered the three Ultimate Techniques of the Dragon God Sect," Ye Yun said casually.
"Right away, Master!" Big Black Horse walked over excitedly.
He liked playing the weakling role the most.
At this moment, Ye Yun had concealed his entire Super Divine Dragon Breath, standing indifferently in the center of the great hall, looking up at the exquisite carvings on the ceiling beams.
Big Black Horse slowly took a few steps forward, and his Super Divine Dragon Breath began to rapidly diminish. By the time he was three zhang away from the red-robed elder, his cultivation base had descended to the Heavenly Order Realm Third Layer.
His opponent, the red-robed elder, was at the Fourth Level of the Heavenly Fate Realm.
One small realm lower than him; this shouldn’t frighten him...
Big Black Horse grinned, then chuckled aloud.
His laughter was not loud, but it reverberated throughout the entire grand hall.
The red-robed elder jumped in shock, hastily opening his eyes.
"Who goes there, daring to intrude into my Dragon God Sect?"
"Don’t be scared, I mean no harm. I’m just here to exchange some pointers with you!" Big Black Horse stood his ground, waved his hand, and revealed a gentle smile.
What is...
The red-robed elder was suddenly taken aback.
He studied the black-robed youth before him, who was only one small realm lower than himself yet had inexplicably infiltrated the Sect’s grand hall.
Such Divine Skills were truly astonishing.
If the youth had launched a sudden attack, I might already be dead.
Thinking this, the red-robed elder felt less hostility towards the black-robed youth before him.
"What do you wish to compare? May I ask your name?" he asked, his eyebrows furrowed.
Big Black Horse’s eyes twinkled as he smiled and said, "I’ve heard that the Dragon God Sect has three Ultimate Techniques, famous throughout the Heavenly Star Dynasty. I have come to learn from you!"
"Not just the Heavenly Star Dynasty?" Upon hearing the black-robed youth’s praise for the Dragon God Sect’s three Ultimate Techniques, the red-robed elder snorted coldly and said, "My Dragon God Sect was an Eternal Level Sect tens of thousands of years ago, and our three Ultimate Techniques were unrivaled throughout the Cangnan Continent!"
"..." Upon hearing this, Big Black Horse nearly choked.
If Master hadn’t said this was a fake Dragon God Sect, I’d find it incredibly hard to believe this wasn’t the real Dragon God Sect.
"’HEHE!’" Ye Yun, at the side, also gently stroked between his brows, a rare, wry smile on his face.
In the next moment, something happened that shocked Ye Yun.
The red-robed elder stood with his hands behind his back, looking at Big Black Horse with a smug expression, saying arrogantly, "There’s no need for a showdown. If we were to fight head-on, you would definitely be no match for me!"
"What makes you say so?" Big Black Horse was stunned.
This Dragon God Sect Sect Master is a bit too confident, isn’t he?
Is it because the Dragon God Sect was an Eternal Level Sect one hundred thousand years ago?
"You... you’re a member of the Demon Clan..." Suddenly, the red-robed elder’s gaze fell on Big Black Horse. He observed him keenly for a moment, then said with great confidence, "No wonder you’re so ill-informed. To tell you the truth, one hundred thousand years ago, Ye Yun, the Sect Master of my Dragon God Sect, was the strongest in the Eternal Realm on the Cangnan Continent. He swept through all ages, peerless and invincible, suppressing an entire era!"
"’UH...’" Big Black Horse was so shocked he was rendered speechless.
"’HAHA!’" Ye Yun, standing nearby, finally could not help but turn around and laugh.
However, Ye Yun used his Divine Skills to isolate the sound.
Although Ye Yun had not exhibited any Super Divine Dragon Breath, he was positioned to one side, so the red-robed elder had not noticed him.
Big Black Horse remained stunned for a long while. Remembering the task his Master had given him, he slowly drew his Sword and said deliberately, "You’re right about everything, but I still want to exchange some moves with you!"
"Sparring is not an issue. However, I intend for you to recognize the challenge and withdraw! Fellow Daoist, reflect carefully on your Sect. If it possesses an Eternal Level foundation, then it won’t be too late to consider sparring with me!" The red-robed elder sneered, a mocking look on his face.
A Nameless Little Pawn daring to challenge him, the Dragon God Sect Sect Master? Does he really not take an Eternal Level Sect seriously?
Big Black Horse lowered his head, pretending to consider this very seriously for a few seconds, then raised his head again.
He looked earnestly at the red-robed elder, grinned, revealing a set of bright white teeth.
"
I remember now! My lineage is also from an Eternal Sect...
" Big Black Horse said with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 175: Vanish into Thin Air
chapters.content:
Chapter 175: Chapter 175: Vanish into Thin Air
"Are you also from an Eternal Realm Sect?"
The old man in red robes suddenly sprung up as if his backside was on fire before swiftly landing again, standing ramrod straight like a steel spear. He stared fixedly at the black-robed youth before him.
After watching for a moment, he shook his head and sneered, "An Eternal Level Sect wouldn’t have a piece of trash like you! Coming to a major Sect to compare skills? You’re obviously lying!"
"I..." Big Black Horse was rendered speechless with rage. As fury erupted within him, he charged forward, swinging his sword at the old man. He simply couldn’t communicate with the red-robed old man any longer; it was better to just attack.
"You’re no match for me in a head-on confrontation!" The old man in red laughed coldly. Behind him, a magnificent golden Divine Dragon Phantom appeared, as thick as a barrel and stretching thirty feet long. Its golden head was held high, its tail coiling around his waist. He slashed out with his sword, the sword light imbued with the Divine Dragon Phantom.
BOOM!
The two swords collided mid-air with a deafening crash.
Big Black Horse retreated two steps, feigning shock. "The Dragon God Sword Technique! Truly as amazing as its reputation!"
"You’re just finding out now? Don’t forget, my Divine Dragon Sect was also an Eternal Level Sect a hundred thousand years ago!" The old man in red, immensely pleased with himself, roared excitedly and charged forward with his sword again.
BANG! BANG!
Sword light crisscrossed as the two battled once more. For a while, the fight was a complete stalemate.
Naturally, Big Black Horse was deliberately suppressing his strength, keeping it just a notch below his opponent’s, all to complete his mission. This way, the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect could display his true level of skill.
Ye Yun watched quietly from the side. He said nothing, nor did he interrupt the ongoing match. The fight lasted for about the time it takes an incense stick to burn.
"The sparring ends here!" Suddenly, the old man in red voluntarily leaped out of the combat circle, resting his sword behind his back as he spoke calmly.
He realized he couldn’t defeat his opponent. And his opponent... seemed unable to defeat him either. It was better to call it quits and give each other a graceful way out.
"Many thanks, fellow Daoist!" Big Black Horse also sheathed his sword and glanced in a certain direction. He noticed his Master, Ye Yun, was slowly walking their way.
"Master!" Big Black Horse immediately bowed respectfully.
Ye Yun nodded, his gaze turning to the red-robed old man.
"There’s another person?" The old man in red was greatly alarmed. As a high-ranking Cultivator at the Fourth Level of the Destiny Realm, he hadn’t even noticed another young man in white within the hall.
"Who are you?" the old man in red demanded loudly.
"I am Ye Yun," Ye Yun replied with a smile.
"Ye Yun?" The old man in red robes was stunned. He blinked, then immediately bellowed, "How can you have that name?"
"Is my Master’s name something you can slander?" Big Black Horse glared at him angrily from the side.
"Why can’t I?" Ye Yun lightly patted Big Black Horse’s shoulder, gazing calmly at the red-robed old man.
Big Black Horse was taken aback.
He hadn’t expected his Master to be so patient; he couldn’t help but admire him inwardly.
The old man in red looked at Ye Yun and said with a smirk, "The thirteenth Sect Master of our Dragon God Sect was also named Ye Yun. He was a supreme figure who dominated an era. By using that name, you risk inviting divine punishment."
Hearing the old man’s words, Ye Yun chuckled. "It’s amusing how highly you all think of yourselves. Do you genuinely believe you’re the successors of the Dragon God Sect?"
As he spoke, starlike runes began to flicker incessantly in Ye Yun’s eyes, constantly morphing and evolving. The old man in red opposite him was instantly dumbstruck.
It wasn’t just him; every single person in the Dragon God Sect was affected by Ye Yun’s Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye at that moment. Ye Yun completely read the memories of all Cultivators in the Dragon God Sect at or above the Destiny Realm. This process was incredibly swift, lasting only a few breaths.
The red-robed old man suddenly dissolved into a wisp of green smoke and vanished. Subsequently, everyone else in the Dragon God Sect also turned into wisps of green smoke and disappeared.
Ye Yun chuckled again as he glanced around the grand hall. The grand hall itself then dissolved into a plume of smoke and vanished. Every building on all the mountain peaks met the same fate.
The vast Dragon God Sect disintegrated in an instant. In the blink of an eye, only bare mountain ranges remained.
Big Black Horse, watching from the side, found it utterly exhilarating. Master’s Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye was truly formidable! Such a large Sect, with seventy to eighty thousand people, all gone in an instant. All the buildings too. Such a potent Divine Pupil Skill was simply terrifying!
Gazing at the now-barren mountains, Big Black Horse suddenly asked softly, "Master, did we gain anything?"
Ye Yun shook his head. Although he had read many memories, he hadn’t found any of the information he sought. This Dragon God Sect’s lineage had also persisted for over ten thousand years, and the current generation’s Sect Master merely clung to the Cultivation Techniques passed down by their ancestors.
Ye Yun had annihilated this Dragon God Sect because they had stolen a massive amount of the true Dragon God Sect’s destiny and luck. Such a sect had no reason to continue existing. Even if these people were innocent in their own minds, they had unknowingly acted as accomplices. From Ye Yun’s perspective, this was absolutely unforgivable.
"Let’s go." Ye Yun tore open the void and, with a single step, brought Big Black Horse beside the carriage. He entered the carriage, and Big Black Horse began to pull it along the road.
On the way, Ye Yun fumbled at his wrist for a moment, then suddenly produced some small silver insects. He took out a small vial and placed all but one of the insects inside. He then gently flicked the remaining one with his finger. That small insect vanished into the void.
The silver insect quickly reappeared near the original mountain gate of the Dragon God Sect, quietly concealing itself amidst the grass and trees. Ye Yun had left this one insect behind because he suspected the mastermind pulling the strings might send someone to investigate. If they did, he would have a chance to capture and interrogate them. This silver insect was exceptionally skilled at concealing its aura and form; not even an Eternal Realm Cultivator could detect its presence.
"Master, where are we headed next?" Big Black Horse asked from the front.
Ye Yun pondered for a moment. A sect called the Tian Heng Sect came to mind, and he said with a smile, "Let’s go to the Tian Heng Sect then."
Big Black Horse acknowledged and slowly began to pull the carriage onward. Ye Yun was in no hurry.
「A month later, they arrived at the foot of the mountain where the Tian Heng Sect was located.」
By then, Ye Yun’s cultivation realm had broken through again, reaching the Fourth Tier of the Divine Monarch Realm. Breaking through two minor realms in just one month—such astonishing cultivation speed would be considered unparalleled throughout the ages, even if word of it reached the Divine Land.
For Ye Yun, realm progression was as simple as drinking water and eating food. Coupled with the vast amounts of heavenly treasures he had to aid his cultivation, achieving such a terrifyingly fast rate of advancement was only to be expected.
During this time, although the three young disciples of the Dragon God Sect had not formally broken through, they were now only a step away from reaching the Ninth Tier of the Divine Bridge Realm. For this trip to the Tian Heng Sect, Ye Yun planned to help them break through one minor realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 176: Seven-star Peak, Dragon God Monument
chapters.content:
Chapter 176: Chapter 176: Seven-star Peak, Dragon God Monument
「At the foot of Tian Heng Sect’s mountain.」
Big Black Horse glanced at Tian Heng Sect, blinking. It muttered curiously, "How strange. Why are there only seven peaks in this place?"
Big Black Cat also perked up, looked in the direction Big Black Horse indicated, and saw that it was indeed so. There were seven peaks in total. Each peak was considerable in size, and atop each one stood countless pavilions, towers, and various other buildings.
"Uncle Ma, Tian Heng Sect has a domineering name, but with only seven peaks, it’s quite stingy!" Big Black Cat said with a pout.
"Little Cat, when will your insight ever improve?" Big Black Horse glanced at it with disdain.
"Uncle Ma, have you discovered something?" The Big Black Cat’s heart skipped a beat, and it hurriedly asked.
"Look closely at those seven peaks. Don’t they resemble the arrangement of the Big Dipper?" Big Black Horse said solemnly.
Big Black Cat took a closer look, and an expression of shock immediately appeared on its face. It exclaimed, "It really is! A complete Big Dipper formation, just like..." At this point, it abruptly shut its mouth. Big Black Cat recalled the seven small arrows on the Black Giant Dragon deep beneath the Divine Dragon Sect. Back then, that too was a Seven-star formation. Could the Tian Heng Sect before them be the same?
"You’re right. This is also a formation," Big Black Horse muttered to itself. "But there are many formations based on the Big Dipper, so it can’t be said that this was definitely intentional..."
"You’re right, Uncle Ma!" Big Black Cat quickly flattered with a smile.
At this moment, although Ye Yun’s eyes were closed inside the carriage, he had already thoroughly surveyed the seven peaks of Tian Heng Sect. Big Black Horse was correct; this was indeed a Seven Star Grand Array. Ye Yun had even specifically probed the depths beneath the seven peaks but had found no special spaces.
However, Ye Yun did see something familiar in the square of Tian Heng Sect. There stood a massive azure stone, 20 to 30 meters tall. Etched onto its surface was a lifelike, vividly depicted gigantic dragon.
This is quite interesting! To think that this minor Tian Heng Sect also wants to constrain my Divine Dragon Sect...
Ye Yun muttered softly, a faint flicker of anger in his eyes.
This stone monument, if it were 100,000 years ago, bore a name that shook the entire Cangnan Continent: the Dragon God Monument. The Divine Dragon Sect had a total of thirteen Dragon God Monuments. The one before him in Tian Heng Sect was the thirteenth, personally carved by Ye Yun himself.
This held no particular significance. The founding patriarch of the Dragon God Sect had crafted one Dragon God Monument. The second, third, and subsequent generations, all the way up to Ye Yun of the thirteenth generation, continued this tradition, with each generation crafting a new monument. Previously, Ye Yun hadn’t understood why every Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect would craft a Dragon God Monument. However, now he understood.
Every Dragon God Monument carried the destiny of the Dragon God Sect. The more Dragon God Monuments there were, the stronger the Dragon God Sect’s destiny became. Of course, the Dragon God Monuments were not the only things that carried the Dragon God Sect’s destiny; many other items did as well. The Dragon God Monument was merely one such symbol.
The original thirteen Dragon God Monuments were located on the grand path before the Dragon God Sect’s mountain gate, arranged in descending order. Anyone visiting the Dragon God Sect would pass by them. Since Ye Yun was the foremost master in the Eternal Realm of the Cangnan Continent, the Dragon God Monument he carved contained his spirit and will. At that time, all Cultivators who passed by this Dragon God Monument would feel their hearts pound and their breath destabilize.
However, the Dragon God Monument in Tian Heng Sect, after 100,000 years, had long lost its original spirit and will. It was now just an ordinary, massive rock. Yet, this particular stele still carried some of the Dragon God Sect’s former destiny. But now, the Dragon God Monument was suppressed by the Seven Star Grand Array formed by those seven mountain peaks. These seven mountain peaks were not naturally formed but had been reshaped by Great Mystical Power Users who altered the heavens and earth, recreating the seven peaks. They used this natural formation to suppress the Dragon God Monument.
Ye Yun smiled faintly again. He suddenly realized his previous line of thinking had been somewhat shortsighted. Over the past 100,000 years, it was likely that many artifacts of the Dragon God Sect had been suppressed by various powers. Never mind other items. Just considering these thirteen Dragon God Monuments, at least thirteen sects were suppressing them.
Ye Yun touched his chin, pondering a question.
A minor sect like the Dragon God Sect is merely at the Eternal Level in the eyes of the God Men from the Divine Land. Is it truly worth such meticulous suppression? Could it be that the Dragon God Sect holds secrets even I am unaware of?
Ye Yun laughed at this thought.
I, the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, am unaware that the sect possesses even greater secrets. How utterly ridiculous!
"Master, oh Master... why didn’t you tell me the secrets of the Dragon God Sect? Could it be that you didn’t know either?" Ye Yun said with a laugh. His master had been the twelfth-generation Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect. He had treated Ye Yun exceedingly well, like a father and a teacher, so logically, he wouldn’t have kept secrets from him. Yet, the reality seemed to be the opposite.
Now, 100,000 years later, after all he had seen and heard on this journey, Ye Yun realized the Dragon God Sect was definitely concealing a monumental secret. This secret... perhaps only the founding patriarch of the Dragon God Sect had some inkling of it. Everyone in the Dragon God Sect who came after knew nothing. However, the hidden mastermind lurking in the darkness knew it all too well.
Interesting, very interesting...
Ye Yun chuckled again, then summoned the three juniors of the Dragon God Sect into the carriage. Their training was still the priority. As for the Dragon God Monument, it could be dealt with later.
"Greetings, Ancestor!" Luo Li, Jun Moxiao, and Su Wanyi hurriedly greeted Ye Yun.
"This time, your target is the Tian Heng Sect of the Heavenly Star Dynasty. Feel free to kill them all; no need to leave a single one alive..." Ye Yun said lightly.
The three of them were somewhat taken aback upon hearing this. Jun Moxiao hurriedly asked, "Ancestor, is this Tian Heng Sect the main culprit responsible for persecuting our Dragon God Sect?"
Ye Yun shook his head. Next, he informed the three juniors about the Dragon God Monument. There was no need to conceal this matter. Especially since Luo Li was the current Sect Master, she had to be made aware of more of the Dragon God Sect’s affairs. Ye Yun didn’t want to repeat the mistake of the first-generation Sect Leader of the Dragon God Sect, who had hidden such a crucial secret, leading to the great calamity that later befell the sect.
"Ancestor, to think that this Tian Heng Sect actually possesses a Dragon God Monument from our sect! We must reclaim it!" Luo Li stood up, flames of fury blazing in her eyes.
"We must reclaim what belongs to our Dragon God Sect!" Jun Moxiao’s eyes were also brimming with killing intent.

chapters.title: Chapter 177: Heading toward the Tian Heng Sect to Kill
chapters.content:
Chapter 177: Chapter 177: Heading toward the Tian Heng Sect to Kill
"You only need to kill them."
Ye Yun gave a calm smile. "As for that Dragon God Monument, we’ll take it last."
"Alright, Ancestor!"
The three quickly nodded.
"Go now!"
With a wave of Ye Yun’s hand, the three teenagers before him disappeared instantly.
「On the square of the Tian Heng Sect.」
Three rays of light flashed, revealing three figures. They were Luo Li, Jun Moxiao, and Su Wanyi.
The sudden spatial shift left the three somewhat stunned. However, the moment they saw the large stone in the square engraved with a Divine Dragon, they immediately understood. They were now standing in the square of the Tian Heng Sect’s main hall.
The blue-green boulder was the Dragon God Monument, engraved by their Ancestor’s own hands a hundred thousand years ago.
Looking at the lifelike Divine Dragon, Luo Li’s eyes filled with tears.
Her thoughts were tumultuous, the pain unbearable. This Dragon God Monument, meant to consolidate the sect’s fortune, had been suppressed for a hundred thousand years! It made her, the 298th Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, feel an indescribable pain.
"Senior Sister, Junior Brother, let’s kill them!"
Luo Li gritted her teeth, withdrew her sword, and a giant Divine Dragon Phantom instantly emerged behind her.
**ROAR!**
The Divine Dragon Phantom roared to the heavens, causing the entire Tian Heng Sect to shake.
Jun Moxiao also drew his sword, his body brimming with Sword Intent, its sharp edge seemingly piercing the heavens.
Su Wanyi did the same. She now also had a cultivation base at the Eighth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm, just like her martial brothers. Moreover, she had received the inheritance of the Blood Linglong Pagoda, which possessed incredible prowess. But the Ancestor had once warned her not to use it under normal circumstances; it could only be used if her life was in danger.
**WHOOSH!**
At this moment, a group of Tian Heng Sect disciples rushed in from all directions. Each of them exuded a powerful aura; all were cultivators at the Divine Bridge Realm. There were over a hundred of them.
"Who dares to trespass in our Tian Heng Sect?" a young man pointed his sword at the three and shouted.
"Your doom!" Luo Li sneered and darted forward, unleashing a wave of sword light. This strike, born of hatred, contained countless Divine Dragon Phantoms and possessed unimaginable power. The Tian Heng Sect disciples in the Divine Bridge Realm were caught off guard and could only mount a hasty defense.
**BANG! BANG!**
Sword lights intertwined, accompanied by deafening clashes. In an instant, more than a dozen people were injured. One was even sliced in half, blood splattering everywhere—a gruesome sight.
These Divine Bridge Realm disciples of the Tian Heng Sect were considered elites. In all their years in the Tian Heng Sect, they had never seen anyone so audacious as to openly slaughter people in front of the sect’s main hall. They were all momentarily stunned.
"Kill!" Jun Moxiao and Su Wanyi also lunged into the fray.
In just a few breaths, the Divine Bridge Realm disciples were routed, suffering heavy casualties. The three, like three Divine Dragons, plunged into the crowd, initiating a frenzied slaughter. By the time others realized something was amiss and rushed to the square to provide support, less than half of the initial hundred-plus disciples remained.
「In the main hall of the Tian Heng Sect.」
Several Destiny Realm Great Cultivators stood there. The leader was a middle-aged man—the Sect Master of the Tian Heng Sect. Standing beside him were the seven Peak Masters of the Tian Heng Sect, all of whom had cultivation bases at Destiny Realm Level 5 or higher. The Sect Master of the Tian Heng Sect himself had reached Destiny Realm Level 7.
Where did these three brats come from? How can they be so ferocious at the Divine Bridge Realm?
one of them thought.
Of course, the Destiny Realm Cultivators in the Tian Heng Sect were not limited to these eight. Many other Destiny Realm Cultivators below Destiny Realm Level 5 were in secluded cultivation in various residences across the seven peaks.
"Judging by the swordsmanship these three youths are using, it appears to be from the Dragon God Sect," a Destiny Realm Cultivator remarked.
"The Dragon God Sect? They’re just an Inferior Sect. Even if they had an exceptionally rare prodigy, they would absolutely not dare to provoke our Tian Heng Sect!" another Destiny Realm Cultivator scoffed.
Then who could they be?
"For three youngsters to dare so blatantly to barge into our Tian Heng Sect, who could possibly be backing them?"
"Regardless of who it is, they must be severely punished!"
The various Peak Masters, all Destiny Realm experts, began to discuss, their faces filled with extreme anger. The Sect Master of the Tian Heng Sect also frowned.
The Cultivation Techniques these three youths are using indeed seem to originate from the Dragon God Sect. But the Dragon God Sect is merely an Inferior Sect and has always been deferential to our Tian Heng Sect. They would never dare to do something like this. So why would these three youths dare to directly attack the Tian Heng Sect? Our Tian Heng Sect hasn’t offended any major powers in recent years, have we?
"Let’s go out and see," the Sect Master of the Tian Heng Sect declared, waving his hand. "These three youths have killed so many of our sect’s members; they must be eliminated!" He then led the way out.
「Meanwhile, in the square.」
Jun Moxiao, Luo Li, and Su Wanyi were now surrounded by many Nirvana Realm Cultivators. The tension between the two sides was palpable; a battle was imminent.
"Kill them! Avenge our martial brothers!" a Nirvana Realm disciple, his eyes bloodshot, roared and was the first to charge furiously at Luo Li.
Inspired by him, eighty to ninety Nirvana Realm disciples all unleashed their sword lights and attacked. Instantly, the entire square was enveloped in a torrential rain of sword light.
Faced with such a ferocious assault, Luo Li and her companions did not meet it head-on. Instead, they relied on the Dragon God Body Technique to weave and dodge, evading wave after wave of attacks. Now fighting as one, the three were even more coordinated than before. Having grown up together in the Dragon God Sect and frequently experienced life-or-death pursuits, their rapport was naturally profound. Furthermore, their cultivation bases had all synchronized.
Thus, after evading that deluge of sword light, the three, as if by telepathy, simultaneously launched a fierce counterattack against the Tian Heng Sect disciples in one specific direction.
In that direction stood about ten Nirvana Realm disciples, their cultivation bases only at the First or Second Level of the Nirvana Realm. This was undoubtedly the weakest point in their formation. The trio, with their extremely rich combat experience, immediately identified this vulnerability and launched a tidal wave of attacks.
Terrifying sword lights, accompanied by the roars of Divine Dragon Phantoms, vibrated the void as they descended mercilessly. These dozen or so Tian Heng Sect Nirvana Realm disciples had not anticipated such a sudden, ferocious assault from the three. They scrambled to defend themselves but were unable to withstand the combined attack.
**AARGH!**
A series of agonized cries rang out. Each of these dozen disciples was struck by a sword, blood flowing freely as they stumbled backward.
Such formidable combat instincts!
The Destiny Realm Great Cultivators observing from the side couldn’t help their eyelids from twitching as they watched this.
These three youngsters are truly adept at seizing opportunities! To be able to counterattack at a weak point immediately after evading such a powerful barrage, and to succeed with one strike—truly impressive...
The Sect Master of the Tian Heng Sect, seeing things were going awry, immediately sent out a sound transmission. At once, many more Nirvana Realm disciples flew over from the seven peaks. These Nirvana Realm disciples all possessed extremely high cultivation bases, having reached the Seventh, Eighth, Ninth, and even Tenth Level of the Nirvana Realm. They immediately joined the battle upon arriving at the square.
But what no one could have expected was that as soon as these highly cultivated Nirvana Realm disciples joined the attack, they seemed to fall under some kind of control, their minds descending into a state of frenzy. And their strength was inexplicably suppressed to the First Level of the Nirvana Realm.
The entire square and its surroundings now swarmed with two to three thousand Nirvana Realm disciples. This massive crowd began to launch a deluge of attacks at the three. The sky was so filled with sword light that the figures of the three were completely obscured. However, occasionally, in the gaps between the sword lights, Divine Dragon Phantoms would flash and disappear, proving that the three youngsters were still alive.
Initially, the Destiny Realm Great Cultivators hadn’t noticed anything particularly strange about the three youths. But after two or three breaths, they all became aware that something was very odd. Logically, even if these three Divine Bridge Realm youths were exceptionally strong, facing an encirclement by over two thousand Nirvana Realm disciples, they shouldn’t have lasted a single exchange. Yet, unbelievably, these three youths were somehow withstanding such a ferocious barrage.
"Sect Master, something isn’t right here," a Destiny Realm elder stated with a frown.
"Indeed, it’s not right. The combat strength of my Tian Heng Sect’s Nirvana Realm disciples should absolutely not be this low!" the Sect Master of the Tian Heng Sect scoffed. Then he said to the elder beside him, "Senior Brother, please make a move and eliminate those three youths directly!"
"Alright." The elder nodded and, in a flash, shot towards the center of the square.
However, before he even reached the center of the square, he suddenly felt his mind go blank, and then he knew nothing at all. Although he was still wielding his sword and attacking Jun Moxiao, in reality, his cultivation base had been forcibly suppressed from Destiny Realm Level 5 down to the First Level of the Nirvana Realm. But he himself was completely unaware of this, and no one else could perceive it either.
The elder roared and launched a ferocious attack at Jun Moxiao.
Facing a multitude of enemies, Jun Moxiao didn’t engage in direct combat with this elder; with a flicker of his body, he dodged the attack.
What’s going on?
The Sect Master of the Tian Heng Sect was utterly astounded.
His Senior Brother, a Destiny Realm Level 5 expert, had launched a sword strike... and that youth actually dodged it? This was simply inconceivable! His Senior Brother was a Destiny Realm Level 5 Great Cultivator, while that youth was merely at the Eighth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm!
Just as the Sect Master of the Tian Heng Sect was reeling from this immense shock, a mysterious power suddenly invaded his mind.
"Kill!" The Sect Master of the Tian Heng Sect’s eyes turned bloodshot. He drew his sword, let out a furious roar, and also joined the battle. At this same moment, the other Destiny Realm Great Cultivators similarly went berserk, roaring as they charged into the fray.
The Tian Heng Sect had numerous disciples, numbering as many as one hundred thousand. Currently, a large number of these disciples were hovering in mid-air, observing the battle.
"Our venerable Sect Master himself has joined the fight! He’ll definitely kill those three youths easily!"
"It’s not just the Sect Master! Even the seven Peak Masters have all made their move!"
The surrounding disciples discussed animatedly. The cultivation bases of these disciples varied greatly; there were those in the Origin Sea Realm, Divine Bridge Realm, and Nirvana Realm. Even some Destiny Realm experts who were usually in secluded cultivation had emerged and were now observing the battle from mid-air. After all, the square below was now packed solid; no one else could squeeze in. They could only watch the fight from above.

chapters.title: Chapter 178: Shen Heng Sect’s Annihilation, Evil Spirits Suppressed under the Dragon God Monument
chapters.content:
Chapter 178: Chapter 178: Shen Heng Sect’s Annihilation, Evil Spirits Suppressed under the Dragon God Monument
At the foot of Tian Heng Sect’s mountain, a seemingly ordinary black carriage sat quietly.
The Big Black Cat on the carriage was restless, constantly standing up and craning its neck to look towards the square in the direction of the Heaven Balancing Sect’s main hall. The Big Black Horse, however, had its eyes closed, seemingly resting to conserve energy.
"Little Cat, why are you so anxious? Are you hoping to go collect storage rings?" the Big Black Horse said sagely.
The Big Black Cat quickly nodded. "Yes, Uncle Ma! Last time the young masters fought, I was responsible for cleaning up the storage rings on the battlefield. I’d like to do my small part again this time."
"Alright, you can go," the Big Black Horse said with a laugh.
The Big Black Cat was overjoyed, immediately transforming into a streak of black light and flying towards the mountain. However, it had only flown a few dozen meters when a strong force pulled it back.
"Little Cat, my word doesn’t count. You have to ask the Master for permission," the Big Black Horse snickered.
"..." The Big Black Cat was on the verge of tears. It quickly returned to the carriage. Kneeling on it, it whispered, "Master, may I go and help the three young masters collect storage rings?"
Inside the carriage, Ye Yun gave a faint smile.
These two are quite the jokers!
He waved his hand dismissively. "Go on."
Only then did the Big Black Cat transform into a black light again and disappear from the carriage.
"Master, there are far too many disciples in Tian Heng Sect—at least a hundred thousand of them. It will probably take the three young masters many days to kill them all!" the Big Black Horse said, worried.
"The cultivators currently in the square are sufficient for them to break through to the Ninth-tier of the Divine Bridge Realm. As for the rest... let them return whence they came..." Ye Yun said with a casual smile.
At that moment, his peculiar eyes twinkled with countless minuscule symbols that emerged and faded like innumerable small worlds. In an instant, every single onlooking cultivator in the sky turned into blue smoke and dissipated into the air.
The Big Black Horse, watching from the side, gaped in astonishment.
That was nearly a hundred thousand people! The Master just casually activated the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye and effortlessly vaporized those hundred thousand people. This divine ability is truly terrifying!
The Big Black Horse’s own Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye was only at the rudimentary stage. This Pupil Skill’s effectiveness varied from person to person. The more targets it was used on, and the higher their cultivation levels, the greater the mana consumption.
The Big Black Horse analyzed internally. If its Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye were to reach great accomplishment one day, it feared its mana reserves would be far from sufficient to vaporize one hundred thousand cultivators simultaneously... The Master is becoming more and more terrifying. He’s already at the Fourth-tier of the Divine Monarch Realm, and it won’t be long before he reaches the Divine King Realm. I truly don’t know to what terrifying extent the Master’s power will reach when he ascends to the Divine King Realm!
It had recently made a breakthrough in its own cultivation and was now at the fourth level of the Eternal Realm. Although its cultivation speed wasn’t slow, compared to the Master, the difference was still immense.
"Little Horse, if you absorb all the lightning in that Rebirth Lightning Pool, you can break through to the True God Realm." As if seeing through the Big Black Horse’s thoughts, Ye Yun’s voice suddenly rang out softly from within the carriage.
Upon hearing the Master’s words, the Big Black Horse wore a wry expression. It said in distress, "Master, this little golden sword is just too powerful! It would be an excellent weapon; I truly can’t bear to refine it!"
Ye Yun simply smiled in response. He drew a strand of Rebirth Thunder from the Rebirth Lightning Pool, condensed it into a golden axe, and tossed it out through the void. A rift tore open in the void, and a golden axe dropped down, floating before the Big Black Horse.
"I’ll give you another. Decide for yourself whether you want the sword or the axe," Ye Yun said with a gentle smile.
The Big Black Horse was ecstatic. It hesitated for a moment, and after a few seconds of silence, it finally said, "I... I still choose to refine the little golden sword."
Ye Yun nodded. He closed his eyes and continued his cultivation.
The Big Black Horse opened its mouth and spat out the little golden sword, which hovered in mid-air alongside the golden axe. One was a little golden sword, the other a little golden axe; both were condensed from Rebirth Thunder. But comparatively, the Big Black Horse preferred this little golden axe.
"I’ve placed a few symbols on this little golden axe. If you comprehend and refine it properly, this weapon can be on par with a God-level weapon!" Ye Yun sent another voice transmission.
"Thank you, Master, for your gracious gift! I will refine it immediately..." the Big Black Horse replied joyfully.
It opened its mouth and swallowed both the little golden sword and the axe, then closed its eyes and began refining the little golden axe. As its mana flowed into the little golden axe, the Big Black Horse noticed three purple symbols glowing upon it. These symbols were mysterious, ancient, and oddly styled. Each symbol was only the size of a fingernail, yet it seemed as vast and boundless as an entire world.
So powerful!
The Big Black Horse was secretly astonished. It quickly composed itself and began to wholeheartedly comprehend the three purple symbols.
Time flew by. Several Time Units passed quickly, and the battle on the square still raged fiercely. Although Ye Yun was cultivating with his eyes closed, he was continuously observing the battle in the square. His Primordial Spirit was precisely controlling everyone’s cultivation state.
When night fell, the three juniors of the Dragon God Sect almost simultaneously broke through to the Ninth-tier of the Divine Bridge Realm.
Ye Yun nodded in satisfaction. His goal this time had been for the three of them to break through to the Ninth-tier of the Divine Bridge Realm. It was now extremely difficult to advance two minor realms in a single battle. After all, the aptitude of these three juniors wasn’t that of top-tier, monstrous geniuses. They had merely had their bloodlines forcibly converted to the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline, which allowed them to gradually surpass other prodigies.
...
After their breakthrough, the combat strength of the three Dragon God Sect juniors skyrocketed. They began to reverse the tide of battle and launch a counterattack. One after another, the disciples of Tian Heng Sect fell. And the Sect Master of Tian Heng Sect was actually slain by Jun Moxiao with a single sword strike. After his cultivation base was suppressed to the First Level of the Nirvana Realm, the gap in combat strength between him and the other disciples had narrowed. Following his breakthrough, Jun Moxiao seized an opportunity, his eyes sharp and hands quick, directly killing the Sect Master.
"There are so many storage rings..." The Big Black Cat flew continuously around the square, collecting numerous storage rings. It piled them all in a corner of the square until they formed a small mountain.
Of course, these storage rings weren’t solely from the fallen Tian Heng Sect disciples on the square; 99% of them came from the Shen Heng Sect disciples whom the Master had annihilated from mid-air with a single glance. After those nearly one hundred thousand people had turned into wisps of blue smoke and dispersed, their storage rings rained down from the sky. The Big Black Cat collected them all and piled them in the corner of the square. There were too many storage rings; the Big Black Cat couldn’t possibly carry them all on its head.
「The next day.」
By the time daylight broke, everyone from Tian Heng Sect lay in pools of blood; not a single one survived.
"Senior Sister, we finally killed them all!" Jun Moxiao gasped for breath. Even with the support of the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline, their exertion this time far exceeded the last. After all, their opponents were completely different. Tian Heng Sect was a Medium-grade Major Sect, and its disciples possessed formidable combat strength.
"Yes!" Luo Li, too, was now covered in blood. Her beautiful little face was also spattered with it. She wiped the corner of her mouth and suddenly saw the mountain-like pile of storage rings in the corner of the square, her eyes widening in shock. "Little Cat, how are there so many storage rings? I remember we didn’t kill that many people, did we?"
The Big Black Cat flew over, landed on the ground, and said with a grin, "Sect Leader, the others were all killed by the Master."
Luo Li gasped.
Nearby, Su Wanyi walked over and asked with a smile, "Little Cat, roughly how many people did the Old Ancestor kill?"
"Almost a hundred thousand," the Big Black Cat said, smiling.
A hundred thousand? The faces of the three Dragon God Sect juniors turned somewhat pale, and a bitter feeling welled up inside them. They had fought for a whole day and night, yet had only managed to kill just over two thousand people. The Old Ancestor, with a single look, had killed nearly one hundred thousand.
This was truly terrifying.
...
After a while, Luo Li walked towards the Dragon God Monument. Looking at the lifelike Divine Dragon on the massive bluestone, Luo Li reached out and gently stroked the great dragon’s tail, an indescribable expression on her face.
"Let’s go. Come home with me. You’ve drifted outside for so many years," Luo Li said emotionally. She raised her hand, preparing to place the Dragon God Monument into her storage ring for safekeeping. However, to her surprise, the Dragon God Monument before her remained completely still, refusing to be drawn into her storage ring.
"What’s happening?" Su Wanyi also came over. She reached out and forcefully pushed the massive bluestone. But the massive bluestone was as if rooted to the spot; it didn’t budge at all.
Jun Moxiao, who was nearby, mused, "Could it be that this Dragon God Monument is still being suppressed by that Seven-star formation?"
"Junior Brother, Senior Sister, let’s try pushing it together and see if we can move it," Luo Li said after a moment’s thought.
"There’s no need to push. This Dragon God Monument is indeed suppressed by that Seven-star formation. You won’t be able to move it with your strength." A white figure flashed, and Ye Yun appeared.
"Old Ancestor." The three of them quickly bowed to Ye Yun.
Ye Yun nodded, then reached out and gently tapped the Dragon God Monument. The massive green stone immediately levitated and hovered in mid-air. On the ground beneath the Dragon God Monument, a huge black hole could be clearly seen, from which black mist continuously billowed out.
Then, a shocking scene unfolded. All the corpses and blood on the square were actually sucked into this black hole.
Is there some kind of monster down there?
Luo Li’s heart tightened.
"Beneath this black hole lies a little creature that has been suppressed for tens of thousands of years. It is now about to awaken and break free..." Ye Yun said with a smile.
After the black hole absorbed all the blood and corpses, brilliant lights suddenly bloomed from the seven mountain peaks. These lights converged in mid-air and descended into the black hole.
BOOM!
The entire mountain range quaked violently, as if some colossal creature was about to break free.
Ye Yun smiled faintly.
The one who orchestrated this is truly ingenious. This Seven-Star Sword Formation didn’t just suppress the Dragon God Monument. Beneath the Dragon God Monument, an evil spirit was also imprisoned. This evil spirit’s cultivation base had already reached the Eternal Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 179: The Ten Thousand Year Old Evil Ghost Suddenly Self-Destructs
chapters.content:
Chapter 179: Chapter 179: The Ten Thousand Year Old Evil Ghost Suddenly Self-Destructs
A thick black smoke suddenly burst from the underground chasm, congregating into a dense mass of blackness in mid-air. It roiled and churned, ultimately forming into the head of an evil ghost.
This evil ghost had no body, only a giant head.
It floated in mid-air, its two blood-red eyes, like millstones, blinking and radiating a crimson glow.
"Hahaha... Suppressed for tens of thousands of years, I’ve finally escaped!"
The evil ghost roared with laughter, its voice so powerful that the surrounding mountains began to tremble. After all, as a ghost of the Eternal Realm, its power was truly earth-shattering.
Seeing this bodiless evil ghost, Luo Li’s eyes widened, and she couldn’t help but swallow nervously. She had encountered ghosts before at the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge, but none of them had seemed as terrifying as this one.
Jun Moxiao’s gaze was electric, fixed intently on the bodiless evil ghost. He had once been subjected to the Sky Lantern torture at the Ten Thousand Ghost Ridge, giving him a deep-seated loathing for ghosts.
Su Wanyi remained calm, her expression unchanged.
Ye Yun appeared indifferent, his hands clasped behind his back as he sized up the evil ghost before him.
This bodiless evil ghost has been sealed for at least several years, yet its cultivation level remains above the Eternal Realm,
he mused.
It’s currently at the First Level of the Eternal Realm. I’d guess its original cultivation was at least at the Third Level of the Eternal Realm, possibly higher.
"Hmph, there are four little humans here?"
The evil ghost, floating in mid-air, suddenly spotted the four tiny figures below. Three of them were young Cultivators at the Divine Bridge Realm. As for the other, a man dressed in white, the ghost couldn’t determine his cultivation base at all; he looked like an ordinary person.
I’ve only eaten the dead so far. Now, how about some living ones to whet my appetite?
The newly freed evil ghost let out a sinister cackle. Opening its massive mouth, a powerful suction force pulled downwards.
Ye Yun’s pupils contracted slightly. In an instant, the evil ghost was frozen in mid-air, unable to move.
"Who suppressed you in this place?" Ye Yun asked lightly.
The evil ghost suddenly found itself unable to move. Its eyes bulged in disbelief as it stared down at the young man in white below. It finally realized that the cultivation base of this young man far exceeded its own.
Could he be a True God?
At this thought, terror surged within the evil ghost.
"I... I don’t know what happened!" the evil ghost stammered, not deliberately hiding anything.
It looked around, a surprised expression suddenly appearing on its face as it murmured to itself, "
Wait, isn’t this the Divine Land?
""Correct. This is the Cangnan Continent," Ye Yun said with a faint smile.
The next moment, he activated his Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye. The evil ghost’s eyes immediately glazed over, and it hung motionless in the air. Ye Yun couldn’t be bothered to question the ghost further and decided to extract its memories directly.
This evil ghost... it truly is from the Divine Land, not a native ghost of the Cangnan Continent.
However, just as Ye Yun attempted to probe who had sealed this evil ghost within the Tian Heng Sect, he suddenly detected a destructive force erupting from the depths of its Primordial Spirit.
BOOM!
The evil ghost’s entire head exploded in an instant. An unimaginably vast destructive force detonated in mid-air.
"Hmph! Such insignificant tricks. How dare you display your incompetence before me?" Ye Yun sneered.
His Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye pulsed rapidly twice. The formidable explosive force was immediately frozen in place before dissipating into nothingness.
Ye Yun’s expression turned somewhat grim. This evil ghost from the Divine Land had a powerful restriction placed within its mind. The moment he tried to access its memories, the restriction would automatically activate, obliterating the evil ghost. Fortunately, he had already reached the Divine Monarch Realm. An ordinary Eternal Realm Cultivator would likely have been killed or severely injured by that.
"Ancestor, what on earth just happened?" Jun Moxiao asked, his face pale, his voice laced with lingering fear from his position nearby. The evil ghost had suddenly exploded, and the unimaginable power unleashed almost scared him to the ground. Fortunately, their Ancestor had intervened and dissipated the aftershocks of the explosion.
Luo Li and Su Wanyi also looked extremely tense. Even the slightest wisp of aura leaking from the Eternal Realm Strong Person’s explosion made their minds tremble, as if an indescribable terror was descending upon them.
"It’s nothing. You don’t need to concern yourselves with this for now," Ye Yun said nonchalantly.
As for the three juniors of the Dragon God Sect, Ye Yun planned to have them remain on the Cangnan Continent. He would deal with the enemies from beyond the Divine Land himself.
At this point, Ye Yun surveyed his surroundings. A star-like glimmer flickered in his eyes.
All the Cultivation Techniques, secret manuals, and celestial and earthly treasures from the Tian Heng Sect’s Treasure Pavilion and Scripture Repository flew towards him, forming a long stream resembling a dragon.
"Go ahead and collect all of these," Ye Yun said with a smile.
Since the Tian Heng Sect had been annihilated, these Cultivation Techniques and celestial and earthly treasures were now ownerless. It was the perfect opportunity for the three juniors to place them into their storage rings. The revival of the Dragon God Sect would require a vast amount of such celestial and earthly treasures. The resources accumulated by the Tian Heng Sect were merely a drop in the bucket.
"I never imagined there would be so much," Luo Li exclaimed, her eyes sparkling as she gazed at the piles of celestial and earthly treasures and martial arts manuals covering the square. Compared to the Shen Heng Sect, the Tian Heng Sect’s foundation was more than a hundred times greater.
"Senior Sister, you’re the Sect Leader. You should distribute them," Jun Moxiao said, rubbing his hands together with a grin.
Luo Li waved her hand dismissively. "It’s no big deal. Let’s just divide them amongst ourselves for now. In any case, when the Dragon God Sect is revived, we’ll have to pool all our resources together anyway."
"Great!" Jun Moxiao nodded repeatedly.
The three of them began to divide the spoils, finishing quickly.
At that moment, Ye Yun took out a small silver insect and gently flicked it onto a large nearby tree. The tiny insect obediently nestled among the dense leaves, remaining perfectly still.
The Tian Heng Sect was a Medium grade Sect. Now that the Dragon God Monument, which the Tian Heng Sect had controlled, had been taken away, and the entire sect was destroyed, such a significant event would surely cause a stir. Ye Yun guessed that the hidden powers behind it might come to investigate. If anyone did come, it would be the perfect chance to catch them all in one swoop.
Ye Yun led the three juniors from the Dragon God Sect back to the carriage. He had arranged for Su Wanyi to absorb the Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood. After all, Su Wanyi’s Ancestral Dragon Bloodline concentration had just reached 8%, still 2% lower than that of Jun Moxiao and Luo Li. This period would be a good opportunity for her to absorb it thoroughly. The goal was for her to catch up to Luo Li and Jun Moxiao.
Sitting in the carriage, Ye Yun gazed in the direction of the Heavenly Moon Dynasty. A quick mental calculation revealed that there was still some time before the Heavenly Moon Secret Region opened, which put his mind at ease. During this time, the three juniors from the Dragon God Sect should all be able to break through to the Nirvana Realm. Once they did, they could enter the Heavenly Moon Secret Region to gain experience.
Ye Yun also wanted to find out who had arranged for the Shen Heng Sect, the Tian Heng Sect, and other sects to continually persecute the Dragon God Sect.
After retracting his gaze, Ye Yun began to scan the territory of the Heavenly Star Dynasty once more. He wanted to see if there were any other items belonging to the Dragon God Sect that were being suppressed there. After a thorough scan, he found nothing.
Ye Yun expanded his scanning range, beginning to survey other areas. After scanning several nearby dynasties, Ye Yun still found nothing.
Could it be that the other twelve Dragon God Monuments have been destroyed?
Ye Yun murmured to himself, this sudden possibility dawning on him.

chapters.title: Chapter 180: The Defender of Cangnan
chapters.content:
Chapter 180: Chapter 180: The Defender of Cangnan
"Heh, even if it is destroyed, so what?"
Ye Yun sat in the carriage, a calm smile on his face.
He didn’t care. The three little ones of the Dragon God Sect would all grow into powerful masters of the Eternal Realm in the future, sweeping across the entire Cangnan Continent. At that time, the luck of the entire Cangnan Continent would madly converge upon the Dragon God Sect. Strength is always paramount. The strong always speak with their strength. With him, the invincible Ancestor, here, the Dragon God Sect would surely rise again.
"Master, where shall we go next?" Big Black Horse, pulling the carriage from the front, twisted its head to ask.
Ye Yun smiled and said, "Look for a place with beautiful mountains and clear waters..."
"Alright, Master." Big Black Horse agreed and started to pull the carriage.
「One day later.」
The carriage stopped in a scenic valley.
"Let’s cultivate here for a while. Once the three little ones break through, we’ll go directly to the Heavenly Moon Dynasty..." Ye Yun’s voice came from inside the carriage.
Big Black Horse quickly agreed, a look of joy on its face.
The Master is giving it time to cultivate again. The three young masters are now at the ninth-tier of the God Bridge Realm. To break through to the tenth tier, it will take at least a month, even at the quickest pace. This gives it a relatively ample amount of time to cultivate.
Ye Yun closed his eyes and began to cultivate seriously.
During this time, he planned to break through to the eighth layer of the God Monarch Realm. At this moment, Ye Yun still felt a sense of urgency. He was currently at the Divine Monarch Realm. To reach the Divine King Realm, he still had to pass through the Divine Sovereign Realm.
While Ye Yun was cultivating, somewhere in a secret realm in the Cangnan Continent, a terrifying figure suddenly opened its eyes.
"Strange, why did the Tian Heng Sect of the Heavenly Star Dynasty encounter a problem?"
Opposite the terrifying figure lay a complete, miniature map of the Cangnan Continent. On the map, a small red dot in a certain place had become completely dim. This place, if located according to the geography of the Cangnan Continent, was precisely the location of the Tian Heng Sect.
"It seems... I need to go out and see what power is so blind as to destroy the great formation of the Tian Heng Sect!" The terrifying figure suddenly retracted its aura and stepped out from layers of light. This was an elder robed in azure, exuding an air of immortal grace and extraordinary temperament.
"That’s not right. Not only the Tian Heng Sect, even the Dragon God Sect is in trouble..." He stared at the map for a while longer. A look of astonishment appeared on the azure-robed elder’s face. With a single step, he vanished from the Secret Realm in an instant.
A pillar of light descended from the sky, revealing the figure of the azure-robed elder. Using the Void Throw technique, he crossed thousands upon thousands of miles, transporting himself directly from the Secret Realm.
Standing in the void, gazing at where the Dragon God Sect had vanished, the azure-robed elder’s expression was extremely grave. The enormous Dragon God Sect had vanished just like that. With a flicker of thought, he immediately vanished from his spot.
The next moment, he appeared deep underground. When he saw that the Black Giant Dragon deep underground had vanished, the azure-robed elder’s expression turned exceedingly grim.
Who could be so audacious as to take away the Black Dragon from beneath the Dragon God Sect? This Black Giant Dragon... He came to check on it once every thousand years, fearing something might go wrong. Unexpectedly, a mishap occurred during his seclusion this time; the Black Dragon from deep underground had been stolen. This Black Dragon had seven small arrows piercing its body, forming a kind of formation.
Although the azure-robed elder didn’t know what kind of formation it was, he knew it was undoubtedly extraordinary.
After searching the Dragon God Sect to no avail, the azure-robed elder vanished in a flash. The next moment, he appeared above the Tian Heng Sect.
The seven peaks of the Tian Heng Sect still stood, undamaged. All the buildings on the seven peaks remained unchanged. Yet, the entire, vast Tian Heng Sect was devoid of people. The azure-robed elder’s eyes flickered as he suddenly noticed that the massive cyan stone in the square had vanished.
This particular cyan stone, in his memory, was indispensable. Yet, unexpectedly, this cyan stone, engraved with a Divine Dragon, had disappeared. The formation wasn’t damaged, yet the cyan stone vanished into thin air. Just who could have done this?
In a large tree nearby, a small silver bell quietly watched him.
「Inside the carriage.」
Ye Yun suddenly opened his eyes. His figure flashed and vanished from the carriage.
The void tore open. Ye Yun stepped out. Gazing at the azure-robed elder’s back, he said nonchalantly, "Sir, you seem quite interested in the Tian Heng Sect, don’t you?"
The azure-robed elder turned around sharply. He stared in shock at the white-robed young man who had suddenly appeared behind him. This white-robed youth wore garments as white as snow, his black hair flowing. His features were deep and well-defined, as if sculpted, and his eyes seemed to hold myriad shifting stars. Every gesture exuded a powerful self-assurance.
It was as if, in his eyes, no one was his equal.
"I know who you are!" The azure-robed elder gave a cold laugh, a look of sudden understanding dawning on his face.
This fellow actually recognizes me?
Ye Yun was slightly startled, then replied with a smile, "When did you ever see me? Why do I have no memory of it?"
"The recent unusual phenomena in the world... it must have been caused by your breakthrough to the True God Realm, right?" the azure-robed elder sneered.
Although the other party was a True God, his aura was extremely well concealed, making him seem like an ordinary person. But he too was a True God, a True God Defender from the Divine Land, secretly guarding the Cangnan Continent.
Ye Yun nodded.
His battle with the Heavenly Dao had caused such a massive disturbance that most Eternal Realm powerhouses likely knew what had happened.
"As far as I know, there are no native True God Realm cultivators in the Cangnan Continent. Might I ask where you hail from? The Divine Land, perhaps?" Ye Yun asked, his eyes lowered slightly.
"Heh, I’m surprised a nobody like you even knows of the Divine Land!" The azure-robed elder was slightly taken aback, then sneered mockingly, "You destroyed both the Dragon God Sect and the Tian Heng Sect, didn’t you? What is your true motive?"
"Destroying these two sects was merely to test the waters and stir things up; I just wanted to draw you out." Ye Yun raised his gaze, looking calmly at the azure-robed elder, a gentle smile spreading across his face.
Seeing Ye Yun’s gentle smile, the azure-robed elder felt a chill crawl up his spine. He shouted, "Who the hell are you?"
"My name... you juniors wouldn’t remember it anyway, so there’s no point in saying it." Ye Yun smiled indifferently. In his mesmerizing eyes, minute star-like runes began to shift, and a wave of annihilating power instantly enveloped the azure-robed elder.
"You... You’re not in the True God Realm?" The azure-robed elder mustered all his mana, trying to resist this power. But it was futile. Before losing consciousness, he roared, voicing the suspicion in his heart.
The opponent’s cultivation base was definitely not just at the True God Realm! To make him lose all power to resist in an instant... That would require at least the Divine Monarch Realm!

chapters.title: Chapter 181: The Mystery of God’s Forsaken Land, Cangnan
chapters.content:
Chapter 181: Chapter 181: The Mystery of God’s Forsaken Land, Cangnan
Looking at the unconscious blue-cloaked elder before him, Ye Yun’s expression gradually turned serious.
He had not, at that moment, read this blue-cloaked elder’s memories.
Given the precedent of that evil spirit self-destructing, Ye Yun now dared not rashly search the other’s memories.
Standing there, he silently contemplated for a moment. Ye Yun decided to abandon the idea of searching memories and opted for a different approach instead.
He released a wisp of Mana, waking the blue-cloaked elder.
The blue-cloaked elder blinked, recovering from his lingering fear.
He hadn’t expected that this terrifying white-robed young man with such a formidable cultivation base wouldn’t kill him.
"I didn’t expect... Your Excellency, you are a Divine Monarch Realm expert! May I ask which sect from the Divine Land you hail from?" the blue-cloaked elder asked, his face solemn.
In the Divine Land, the Divine Monarch Realm was indeed an almost unattainable level of existence.
"Merely a humble Loose Cultivator," Ye Yun smiled faintly, looked at the blue-cloaked elder, and asked, "And you, Fellow Daoist? Which sect might you be from?"
"I am also a Loose Cultivator. I accepted a mission to guard the Cangnan Continent for three thousand years," the blue-cloaked elder said with a smile.
The white-robed young man before him was a Divine Monarch Realm cultivator, far stronger than himself; his life and death were now in the other’s hands. There were some things he felt no need to conceal, especially since, in truth, he didn’t know much anyway.
His station on the Cangnan Continent was merely to guard against certain unknown risks.
"So, it’s a three-thousand-year rotation..." Ye Yun smiled.
He was beginning to understand.
He could also tell that this blue-cloaked elder, a True God Realm cultivator, didn’t know much.
Going by the three-thousand-year rotation, this blue-cloaked elder had been on the Cangnan Continent for two thousand years at most.
It seemed the mastermind behind this was hidden very deeply within the Divine Land.
Recruiting True God-stage Loose Cultivators through missions... truly cautious.
"Fellow Daoist, with your position, you’re considered a Defender of the Cangnan Continent, correct? What are the specific tasks involved? If the remuneration is high, I wouldn’t mind taking on such a mission next time..." Ye Yun looked up and asked with a faint smile.
"Fellow Daoist, you harbor such intentions as well?" A hint of surprise appeared on the blue-cloaked elder’s face.
He quickly cupped his fists and said, "The Cangnan Continent is a place where typically only True God-stage Loose Cultivators come for missions. If a Fellow Daoist of the Divine Monarch Realm were to accept this task, I fear the reward would be at least double!"
"Though the Spiritual Energy on the Cangnan Continent is somewhat lacking, it’s not as terrible as all that, is it?" Ye Yun asked, his eyes glinting.
He was born and raised on the Cangnan Continent and didn’t feel there was anything wrong with it. Why was the Cangnan Continent so disdained in the Divine Land?
"It seems you don’t know much about the Cangnan Continent, Fellow Daoist. This place is the God’s Forsaken Land. It’s said there’s an invisible Curse here that causes cultivation stagnation for cultivators at the True God Realm and above. Therefore, most are unwilling to come, as no one wants to sever their own path of cultivation," the blue-cloaked elder explained with a smile.
As he spoke, an embarrassed expression flickered across his face.
Seeing Ye Yun remain silent, the blue-cloaked elder continued, somewhat self-consciously, "As a Loose Cultivator, resources are scarce. I really had no other choice but to accept this mission..."
"So that’s how it is..." Ye Yun nodded.
It seemed he could still glean a fair bit of information through casual conversation like this.
What he hadn’t expected was that the beautiful Cangnan Continent was considered a God’s Forsaken Land in the eyes of Divine Earth Cultivators.
This so-called Curse... what exactly was it? Why had he never felt it?
Ye Yun’s eyes flickered.
He suddenly realized the Cangnan Continent seemed to harbor profound secrets.
Otherwise, Divine Earth Cultivators wouldn’t fear it to such an extent.
If not for this blue-cloaked elder’s words, Ye Yun would never have imagined this secret about the Cangnan Continent.
Not only he, an old ancestor who had lived for a hundred thousand years, was unaware, but everyone on the Cangnan Continent was kept in the dark. No one even knew the name ’Divine Land’.
"I’ve already destroyed the Dragon God Sect and the Tian Heng Sect. How will you handle this, Fellow Daoist?" Ye Yun asked after a moment’s thought.
"You are a Divine Monarch, Fellow Daoist. What can I possibly do?" The blue-cloaked elder gave a bitter smile, sighed, and said, "My reward will likely be halved, or perhaps I’ll get nothing at all..."
Ye Yun smiled. "Don’t worry about that. When I travel to the Divine Land, I’ll take you along and ensure you receive your due reward."
"Such righteousness, Fellow Daoist! It’s truly moving. For a mere True God Realm Loose Cultivator like myself to receive a promise from a Divine Monarch Realm expert... I am truly fortunate beyond measure!" The blue-cloaked elder clasped his fists again, tears welling in his eyes.
In the Divine Land, the hierarchy between Cultivation Stages was incredibly rigid.
With his meager True God Realm First Level cultivation base, it was impossible for him to establish any connection with Divine Monarch Realm cultivators.
Seeing the blue-cloaked elder’s reaction, Ye Yun chuckled.
This minor True God Realm Loose Cultivator was certainly easy to handle; a small token of goodwill was all it took.
Of course, this was also because he was a Divine Monarch. Bestowing favors from a superior position often yielded unexpectedly good results.
Ye Yun pondered for a moment, then asked tentatively, "Fellow Daoist, as a Defender of the entire Cangnan Continent, are you specifically responsible for guarding particular sects?"
"To be honest, my task is quite simple: to ensure that no sect at or above the level of a major sect has its lineage severed." The blue-cloaked elder sighed, a wry smile on his face. "As for the Black Dragon beneath the Dragon God Sect, it seems to be part of a Formation. I inspect it once every thousand years."
"Are there other sects like the Dragon God Sect, with such profound secrets hidden beneath them?" Ye Yun pressed.
"There are others, but I cannot speak of them, Fellow Daoist. I have sworn a Heavenly Oath. If I were to reveal them, I would suffer annihilation of both body and soul," the blue-cloaked elder said with a helpless air.
"If that’s the case, then say no more, Fellow Daoist," Ye Yun smiled.
He rummaged through his storage space and took out a pill.
"I see you’ve been stuck at the Piece of True God Realm for some years. Consider this Breaking God Pill a small gift for our meeting." As he spoke, Ye Yun tossed the Breaking God Pill in his hand over to the elder.
"A Breaking God Pill?" Hearing these words, the blue-cloaked elder’s eyes widened instantly.
When he caught the Breaking God Pill, his hands trembled.
His face flushed with excitement, he murmured, "Thank you for your magnanimity, Fellow Daoist!"
At this, the blue-cloaked elder actually burst into tears.
Ye Yun was rather taken aback.
This blue-cloaked elder is too easily moved to tears! It seems he’s had a difficult life, full of untold stories.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist!" After a few sobs, the blue-cloaked elder quickly wiped his tears and bowed deeply to Ye Yun.
