"To tell you the truth, Fellow Daoist, the main reason I took this mission and stayed on the Cangnan Continent for over two thousand years was to obtain A God-breaking Pill..." the blue-cloaked elder said, cradling the Breaking God Pill with a sigh, his expression deeply wistful.

chapters.title: Chapter 182: Nine Soul Underground Palace, Eternal Life Immortal Grass
chapters.content:
Chapter 182: Chapter 182: Nine Soul Underground Palace, Eternal Life Immortal Grass
"The task issuer is truly despicable, isn’t he? Guarding the Cangnan Continent for 3,000 years just for a Breaking God Pill? It’s an utterly outrageous demand!"
Ye Yun’s expression changed slightly. "We definitely share the same enemy," he said.
"You can’t say that, my friend. Breaking God Pills are also extremely rare in the Divine Land; they have a price but no market. If I fail to break through to the Second Level of True God Realm soon, I won’t live much longer. Therefore, this mission itself is a gamble. I didn’t expect to encounter such a benevolent friend like you who would take pity on me, a desperate Loose Cultivator..."
As the blue-robed old man spoke, he started to recall sorrowful past events and wiped tears from his eyes.
"My friend, don’t be too disheartened..." Ye Yun said with a smile.
He found this blue-robed old man to be an interesting person, not some kind of vile and desperate villain.
In his warehouse, the number of Breaking God Pills was immense, almost piled up like a mountain.
The Breaking God Pill Ye Yun took out was a Lower-grade Breaking God Pill. As for Top-grade Breaking God Pills, he didn’t bring any out.
He was naturally afraid the old man would be too overwhelmed.
For the blue-robed old man, a single Lower-grade Breaking God Pill was enough for him to break through his realm.
BOOM!
Suddenly, the ground began to shake violently.
It seemed as if something colossal was about to emerge from the depths of the earth in the distance.
Immediately, a dazzling beam of light shot up into the sky.
In mid-air, it formed a gigantic, illusory palace-like structure.
Looking at this illusory palace, Ye Yun’s pupils contracted slightly, as if recalling some past events.
The blue-robed old man glanced at the illusory palace a few times, his expression changing subtly. He exclaimed, "It’s unbelievable! Even the Nine Soul Underground Palace has appeared!"
It really was the Nine Soul Underground Palace...
Ye Yun smiled faintly and nodded slightly.
He had heard about the Nine Soul Underground Palace 100,000 years ago. However, the Nine Soul Underground Palace only emerged once every tens of thousands of years, and Ye Yun had missed it during his lifetime.
"My friend, do you plan to visit the Nine Soul Underground Palace?" the blue-robed old man asked with a smile, looking into the distance.
"I don’t need to go..." Ye Yun shook his head, his tone calm.
He lacked no resources. What was the use of going to the Nine Soul Underground Palace?
A melancholic look immediately appeared on the blue-robed old man’s face.
He gazed into the distance with an envious expression and said, clicking his tongue, "I’ve heard that in the Nine Soul Underground Palace, there’s Eternal Life Immortal Grass. If one is fortunate enough to obtain it, they could potentially increase their lifespan by several thousand years."
"I’ve heard of that..." Ye Yun’s eyes flickered. He smiled and said, "But there’s an intangible restrictive power within the Nine Soul Underground Palace. Any Cultivator who enters will have their realm suppressed to the Divine Bridge Realm..."
The blue-robed old man’s expression changed. He sighed and said, "You’re absolutely right, my friend. The Nine Soul Underground Palace may have the alluring Eternal Life Immortal Grass, but it’s not a place ordinary individuals can enter. The higher a Cultivator’s cultivation base, the greater the risk upon entering. If one perishes there, the loss would far outweigh the gain."
"Precisely." Ye Yun laughed and nodded, a profound meaning in his eyes.
It seems that although the blue-robed old man arrived late, he has a deep understanding of the Cangnan Continent.
The blue-robed old man gave an embarrassed smile and explained, "My friend, I happen to possess a book detailing some secrets of the Cangnan Continent, which is why I know these things. Otherwise, how could a mere Loose Cultivator at the True God Realm like myself know so much about the Cangnan Continent?"
"That’s good then..." Ye Yun nodded with a faint smile, saying no more.
"My friend, I live on Sumeru Mountain. If you have time, please come and visit. We can drink tea and discuss the Dao together. Wouldn’t that be wonderful?" the blue-robed old man invited with a smile.
"Alright. You should head back first then..." Ye Yun replied with a casual smile.
The blue-robed old man had been stuck at the Piece of True God Realm for more than 2,000 years. Now that he had received the Breaking God Pill, he was burning with impatience to return and break through to the Second Level of True God Realm.
Ye Yun didn’t want to delay him, so he prompted him to leave.
Overjoyed, the blue-robed old man expressed his profuse thanks, then turned and departed.
Nine Soul Underground Palace?
Ye Yun gazed at the illusory palace, a faint smile playing on his lips.
As for the so-called Eternal Life Immortal Grass, he had absolutely no interest.
However, he was indeed somewhat interested in this Nine Soul Underground Palace.
After all, 100,000 years ago, Ye Yun hadn’t had the opportunity to enter this place.
He was quite curious.
With a flash of his figure, Ye Yun tore open the void.
The next moment, he arrived beneath the illusory palace.
This illusory palace was merely a projection, an image reflected from the massive Nine Soul Underground Palace situated deep underground.
This type of Heavenly Dao phenomenon manifested, proclaiming to the entire Cangnan Continent the advent of the Nine Soul Underground Palace into the world.
Ye Yun stood on the ground, gazing at the massive mountain gate that stood hundreds of meters tall.
The mountain gate was extremely ancient, its architectural style bearing the marks of great antiquity.
Transparent, water-like ripples undulated across the vertical face of the mountain gate, emanating a potent spatial aura.
Ye Yun didn’t step through. Instead, he approached the mountain gate and lightly touched the center of the watery ripples with his fingertip.
The watery ripples failed to obstruct Ye Yun’s finger.
When his finger passed into the space behind the ripples, Ye Yun’s expression changed. He discovered that the space within the Nine Soul Underground Palace seemed to be growing unstable.
Ye Yun withdrew his finger.
He shook his head and sighed.
It seemed his cultivation base was still too high; he couldn’t enter this place.
Perhaps... I should let Jun Moxiao make the trip instead?
Ye Yun suppressed his smile, tore open the void, and returned to his carriage.
He closed his eyes and did not summon Jun Moxiao immediately.
This was because the appearance of the Nine Soul Underground Palace, accompanied by the heavenly phenomenon, was merely a precursor.
The illusory palace, materializing in the sky, announced to the entire Cangnan Continent that the Nine Soul Underground Palace had emerged somewhere within the Heavenly Star Dynasty.
Its official opening was still several days away.
「As time passed,」
Various forces began to arrive before the mountain gate of the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
It wasn’t just the various Sects and major families of the Heavenly Star Dynasty; even several nearby dynasties were alerted.
However, this opening of the Nine Soul Underground Palace did not attract forces on the same scale as those that had flocked to the Red Dust Fairyland.
Each power sent one person at most.
This was an unwritten rule of the Nine Soul Underground Palace, one that had been passed down for nearly hundreds of thousands of years.
This was also to ensure a degree of fairness.
After all, if powerful factions sent in many Cultivators, others would have no opportunity.
Therefore, each power was permitted to send only one person inside.
The Nine Soul Underground Palace employed a strict screening method, and anyone attempting to cheat would be punished with the annihilation of both body and soul.
Thus, for hundreds of thousands of years, nearly everyone had respectfully abided by the rules of the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
「On the eighth day,」
"It is said that nine days after the Nine Soul Underground Palace manifests in the world, its teleportation gate will officially open, and only then can one truly enter..." Ye Yun remarked with a smile, looking in the direction of the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
With a thought, Ye Yun summoned Jun Moxiao and then told him about the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
"Ancestor, rest assured! I will definitely find the Eternal Life Immortal Grass and present it to you, esteemed elder!" Jun Moxiao declared, his voice both solemn and excited.

chapters.title: Chapter 183: Sudden Changes, The Demon Clan Takes Over
chapters.content:
Chapter 183: Chapter 183: Sudden Changes, The Demon Clan Takes Over
"What do I need your Eternal Life Immortal Grass for? Keep it once you get it. If there’s any surplus, give it to your two senior sisters. This time, I’m sending you to the Nine Soul Underground Palace for training..." Ye Yun waved his hand dismissively as he spoke with a grin.
As such an Old Ancestor, he lacked no resources. If he were to display the resources within his warehouse, it would shock every cultivator under the heavens to death, sending even the Heavenly Dao into collapse.
He intended to send Jun Moxiao to the Nine Soul Underground Palace for a reason. Firstly, he wanted Jun Moxiao to compete with the prodigies from all major Sects while he was there. Secondly, he intended to do as he had done before: place a strand of his Primordial Spirit within Jun Moxiao’s mind to see the true situation within the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
A hundred thousand years ago, Ye Yun had a certain curiosity about the Nine Soul Underground Palace. This time, by placing a strand of his Primordial Spirit within Jun Moxiao’s mind, he could satisfy the curiosity he once held.
"Alright, Old Ancestor..." Jun Moxiao nodded somewhat awkwardly.
With a wave of his hand, Ye Yun sent Jun Moxiao out of the carriage.
The next moment, Jun Moxiao appeared on a mountaintop, over a hundred li from the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
"Hey, the training begins!" Jun Moxiao took a deep breath, his small face instantly brimming with excitement.
Deep down, he was thrilled that the Old Ancestor had tasked him with training in the Nine Soul Underground Palace. After all, at the Dragon God Sect, he was the youngest junior apprentice brother. Previously, he always had to follow his senior sisters in every action. Now, he finally had the chance to strike out on his own.
After Jun Moxiao figured out the direction, he flew quickly towards the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
「Back in the carriage.」
This little guy...
Seeing Jun Moxiao’s expression, Ye Yun couldn’t help but chuckle.
It seemed that the Emperor Level Sword he had given Jun Moxiao was indeed necessary. Boys... they need to go through some hardships.
Before transmigrating, although Ye Yun was an unmarried young man with no children, he was aware of a popular saying on Earth: Boys should be raised in hardship, girls in comfort. Raising a girl in comfort would ensure she wouldn’t be easily swayed by minor favors. Raising a boy in hardship would encourage a competitive spirit, which would benefit him in his future endeavors. If a boy were raised in comfort, he would often become a hedonistic, second-generation rich kid—something Ye Yun didn’t want to see.
Having experienced much and lived two lives, he naturally would not raise Jun Moxiao in such a way. So, Ye Yun planned to put Jun Moxiao through more challenges to accelerate his growth. After all, among the younger generation of the Dragon God Sect, he was the only male.
...
Without stopping, Jun Moxiao flew straight to the area near the Nine Soul Underground Palace, where he found it already crowded with people. Many Ancient Families, major Sects, and even some Imperial Families had sent people here. This testified to the irresistible allure the Eternal Life Immortal Grass held for all the major powers.
Jun Moxiao chose a less populated area, descended from the sky, and stood there, quietly waiting.
Not long after, Jun Moxiao saw a golden ray of light emanate from the Nine Soul Underground Palace. This ray formed a golden scroll in midair.
What was that?
The crowd grew restless, with everyone looking up. Everyone wanted to know what was written on that scroll. Never before, in all the times the Nine Soul Underground Palace had manifested, had such a thing occurred.
At that moment, under the expectant gaze of the crowd, the scroll slowly unfurled. It bore a line of large characters:
"This time, the Nine Soul Underground Palace will no longer admit members of the Human Race."
Everyone present felt their minds go blank as they absorbed this statement.
What was going on?
The Nine Soul Underground Palace had existed on the Cangnan Continent for hundreds of thousands of years. Previously, it had always been open only to the Human Race, with other races being prohibited from entry. Why would such an exception occur this time?
"This time, our Human Race has no hope..."
"It’s too tragic! Is the Demon Clan going to rule from now on?"
"Let’s all go back. Our trip this time was in vain..."
A look of intense despair appeared on everyone’s faces. Some were even unable to accept this reality, stomping their feet and pounding their chests in sorrow. This was especially true for those cultivators who had traveled from distant places; their Sects had expended massive resources to deliver them here via Void Throw.
But unexpectedly... the Nine Soul Underground Palace had played a cruel joke on the entire Human Race.
The Human Race could no longer enter.
Many cultivators were unconvinced and cursed at the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
SWISH!
A burst of sharp light fell from the illusory palace of the Nine Soul Underground Palace. In the blink of an eye, those cultivators were blasted into a mist of blood.
Everyone fell silent. No one dared to curse the Nine Soul Underground Palace anymore.
Jun Moxiao also sighed. He had come here happily, hoping for some training, but a sudden change had occurred: this time, the Nine Soul Underground Palace was not welcoming the Human Race.
"Sigh..." Jun Moxiao, dispirited, flew back.
People began to leave one after another. Before long, the area before the gates of the Nine Soul Underground Palace was deserted.
News of the change at the Nine Soul Underground Palace spread throughout the entire Cangnan Continent via various channels.
「The Demon Clan was abuzz.」
Countless members of the Demon Clan, upon hearing the news, began to move, rushing towards the Nine Soul Underground Palace. Some Devilish Practitioners and Ghost Cultivators were also extremely excited upon hearing the news. Rubbing their hands in eagerness, they rushed towards the Nine Soul Underground Palace at top speed.
As Jun Moxiao was on his way back, he was suddenly swallowed by a powerful Spatial Power, and the next moment he appeared in the carriage.
"Old Ancestor, the Nine Soul Underground Palace isn’t letting the Human Race in..." Jun Moxiao said despondently.
"If they don’t let you in, just go back and focus on your Cultivation. It’s not a big deal." Ye Yun smiled and sent Jun Moxiao away.
He looked towards the direction of the Nine Soul Underground Palace again, his eyes flickering a few times. This sudden change at the Nine Soul Underground Palace had caught him off guard. After all, it had followed the rules for hundreds of thousands of years. Unexpectedly, this time, the rules had changed.
Could it be that because Human cultivators have been favored before, the master of the Nine Soul Underground Palace wants to favor the Demon Clan and other races this time?
Ye Yun pondered and felt it was quite understandable.
The Demon Clan was also very powerful on the Cangnan Continent, yet they hadn’t enjoyed such a wide variety of resources. Therefore, it was understandable that the Nine Soul Underground Palace would favor the Demon Clan and other races this time.
He was quiet for a few seconds. Still, Ye Yun wanted to visit the Nine Soul Underground Palace to satisfy his inner yearning.
He looked outside the carriage at the Big Black Horse and Big Black Cat.
The Big Black Horse already possessed an Eternal Realm cultivation base, so it wouldn’t be quite appropriate for it to enter. If there were dangers inside, it might even perish. How about letting Big Black Cat go?
Thinking this, Ye Yun went out.
He looked at the Big Black Cat and told it his thoughts.
What? Going for training?
The Big Black Cat was instantly shocked.
The Master was actually sending it to the Nine Soul Underground Palace for training, to find the Eternal Life Immortal Grass! Moreover, after finding the Eternal Life Immortal Grass, it could consume it on the spot and wouldn’t need to hand it over! This was simply an enormous stroke of good fortune!
"Thank you for your kindness, Master!" The Big Black Cat was extremely excited and immediately prostrated itself on the ground, kowtowing to Ye Yun.
The Big Black Horse turned its head, its lips twitching, and said grumpily, "Little Cat, if you find the Eternal Life Immortal Grass in there, don’t forget to bring one for your Uncle Ma!"

chapters.title: Chapter 184: Black Cat’s Training, Rewarding Emperor Artifact
chapters.content:
Chapter 184: Chapter 184: Black Cat’s Training, Rewarding Emperor Artifact
The Big Black Cat suddenly jolted awake, snapping out of his self-satisfied state.
"Uncle Ma, rest assured, if I only get one Eternal Life Immortal Grass, I’ll definitely give it to you first!"
The Big Black Cat said sheepishly, grinning.
"Heh heh!" The Big Black Horse nodded in satisfaction.
Helplessly watching this pair of jokers, Ye Yun could only shake his head.
Although Ye Yun planned to house a strand of his Primordial Spirit within the Big Black Cat’s mind, he didn’t plan to constantly help the Big Black Cat deal with unknown risks.
Ye Yun thought for a moment and decided to give the Big Black Cat a life-saving treasure. He couldn’t let him risk his life, after all.
Ye Yun reached into his inventory and pulled out a pair of red boots.
"This is for you. See if it fits..."
Ye Yun threw the pair of red boots to the Big Black Cat.
These were Teleportation Boots, of Emperor Level quality.
Once infused with Mana, they provided unbelievable speed for escaping.
The red leather on the Teleportation Boots was said to be crafted from the skin of an extremely powerful Divine Beast in a certain universe, known for its gifted Spatial Divinities.
"Thank you for the gift, Master!"
The Big Black Cat was overjoyed, quickly standing up and transforming into a young man in a black robe.
He tried on the two red boots, and they fit perfectly!
"Master, what kind of treasure is this?"
The Big Black Cat asked joyfully.
"These are the Teleportation Boots, Emperor Level quality. Once infused with Mana, they provide unimaginable speed..."
Ye Yun said with a smile.
"Wow, it’s actually an Emperor artifact!"
The Big Black Cat widened his eyes, suddenly squatting down and gingerly touching the boots on his feet.
After infusing a bit of Mana and feeling the power, a look of astonishment crossed his face.
This was an Emperor artifact for divine speed! In the entire Cangnan Continent, he had never heard of anyone possessing such a treasure.
The Big Black Cat was over the moon.
He hadn’t expected to receive such a powerful treasure from the Master even before entering the Nine Soul Underground Palace. The gains from this trip were enormous.
"There are a few days until the Nine Soul Underground Palace opens; refine it well in that time..."
Ye Yun instructed, then returned to the carriage.
The Big Black Horse watched the pair of red Teleportation Boots on the Big Black Cat’s feet, his eyes filled with envy and jealousy.
"Little Cat, take them off and let your Uncle Ma wear them for a couple of days?"
The Big Black Horse flashed his teeth in a grin.
The Big Black Cat immediately jumped away and crouched down defensively like a frightened rabbit, guarding the Teleportation Boots. Sheepishly, he said, "Uncle Ma, these are my life-saving treasures!"
"Look at you, can’t even lend them to me for a few days? I won’t keep them, you know."
The Big Black Horse grumbled annoyedly.
"This is an Emperor artifact; I need to refine it properly so it will perform at its full strength at the critical moment! Uncle Ma, I’ll take my leave. You keep cultivating; I won’t bother you anymore."
The Big Black Cat laughed and immediately flew off.
"Such an ungrateful fellow. Just you wait and see how your Uncle Ma deals with you when you return."
The Big Black Horse grumbled and then started his Cultivation.
Although he was a bit jealous, he knew well enough not to mess around with the Master’s orders, so he was just joking with the Big Black Cat.
Watching this pair of jokers quarrel again, Ye Yun just laughed without saying a word.
The Big Black Horse still knew his boundaries, and Ye Yun had full confidence in him.
The Big Black Cat dashed all the way to the vicinity of the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
There were already some Cultivators from the Demon Clan gathered there.
Most of the Cultivators from the Demon Clan were in the Divine Bridge Realm, with a very small number in the Nirvana Realm and Destiny Realm.
As for Great Demons in the Life and Death Realm, the Big Black Cat didn’t see a single one.
The higher the cultivation base, the more one cherishes their life! The Nine Soul Underground Palace has powerful prohibitions; it’s easy to perish there. Hence, sending younger generations to seek the Eternal Life Immortal Grass is a more prudent approach...
The Big Black Cat gave a smirk, quickly finding a less crowded spot to sit down.
He was currently at the Heavenly Order Realm Third Layer, and among the Demon Clan present, he was considered a top-notch great demon.
So no one dared to provoke him.
The Big Black Cat was also relieved to find that his Teleportation Boots, given to him by the Master, seemed to have been treated in some way, not leaking any Super Divine Dragon Breath.
This way, he could comfortably refine them here.
「A few Time Units passed.」
"A big shot has arrived!"
"I didn’t expect the Dragon Lord of the Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge to come in person!"
"He didn’t bring any followers. Could it be he wants to enter the Nine Soul Underground Palace himself?"
The surrounding Demon Clan Cultivators were in an uproar.
Everyone’s eyes were blazing as they watched a man in a yellow dragon robe flying from a distance.
The man had a pair of golden dragon horns on his head, a robust figure, a cold gaze, and radiated the Super Divine Dragon Breath of the Destiny Realm.
Among the present Demon Clan Cultivators, quite a few were from the Heavenly Star Dynasty, so they naturally recognized this Dragon Lord, a great demon from the Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge.
The Dragon Lord descended from the sky, and the smaller demons nearby quickly made way for him.
With hands behind his back, standing indifferently like a crane amongst chickens, the Dragon Lord gazed at the mountain gate of the Nine Soul Underground Palace in the distance.
No one dared to speak.
There weren’t many Cultivators in the Destiny Realm venturing into the Nine Soul Underground Palace this time. After all, those who cultivated to the Destiny Realm cherished their lives dearly.
Although there was Eternal Life Immortal Grass in the Nine Soul Underground Palace, it was fraught with danger; the risks would outweigh the benefits in case of death.
However, some Cultivators of the Destiny Realm didn’t care, like this Dragon Lord, for instance.
As time passed, more of the Demon Clan gathered outside the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
The number of Demon Clan Cultivators in the Divine Bridge Realm was countless. Those in the Nirvana Realm were also extremely numerous. Even the number of Destiny Realm demons reached hundreds.
But no Life and Death Realm demons appeared.
As for Cultivators from the Eternity Realm, none appeared at all.
Eternity Realm great demons would not be willing to face the unknown risks in the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
The Big Black Cat sat on the ground, like an old monk meditating, quietly refining his Teleportation Boots.
Although he noticed the arrival of the Dragon Lord, he didn’t even open his eyes.
This Dragon Lord was not his enemy, and the two he did hold a grudge against, the revered Golden Eye and Silver Eye, were already dead.
「Seven days later.」
The Big Black Cat had refined more than half of the Teleportation Boots.
He heard a loud RUMBLE echo in his ears.
Then, someone shouted, "The Nine Soul Underground Palace has opened!"
The Big Black Cat opened his eyes.
He saw countless figures frantically rushing into the transparent, water-wave-like ripples within the mountain gate.
The Big Black Cat stood up, walking leisurely forward.
Finding the Eternal Life Immortal Grass is a matter of luck. Inside the Nine Soul Underground Palace, dangers lurk everywhere. Entering early is akin to an early death. With his Teleportation Boots, even if he is the last one to enter, he could easily outrun everyone else.
"Big brother, can I accompany you?"
The Big Black Cat had just taken a few steps when he heard a charming voice behind him.
He turned around, only to find a breathtaking beauty in a red dress.
She appeared to be around eighteen or nineteen, with alluring eyes and an enchantingly smouldering beauty.
"Are you talking to me?"
The Big Black Cat was taken aback.
In all these years, no one had ever called him Big Brother, especially not an attractive woman.

chapters.title: Chapter 185: Sky Spirit Cat, Fiancée
chapters.content:
Chapter 185: Chapter 185: Sky Spirit Cat, Fiancée
"Big brother, I sense a familiar Super Divine Dragon Breath from you. Could we be from the same tribe?"
The beautiful and charming girl swayed slightly as she walked over, her watery big eyes radiating an indescribable allure.
What’s going on here?
Even the battle-hardened Big Black Cat was taken aback.
His pupils contracted as he studied the girl in front of him carefully.
Although she was beautiful, she radiated a Demonic Aura typical of the Demon Clan.
Her cultivation base was low, only at the Fifth Level of the Divine Bridge Realm, completely incomparable to a great demon like himself, who was in the Destiny Realm.
Which Demon Clan does she belong to?
Big Black Cat knitted his brows.
In her human form, he had no special Divine Skills to identify her true form.
His cultivation of the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye hadn’t even officially begun.
But his sense of smell was good. He sniffed.
On this beautiful girl, he detected a scent characteristic of a feline species.
"I never thought you were from the Sky Spirit Cat Clan..."
Big Black Cat licked his lips, his eyes shining brightly, looking rather surprised.
The Sky Spirit Cat, like the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, is an extremely rare feline species.
Although the fame of the Sky Spirit Cat is slightly less than that of the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, the cultivation potential of the Sky Spirit Cat Clan should not be underestimated.
Unless, one day, the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat could evolve to have nine tails, it would be hard for it to surpass the Sky Spirit Cats.
"Senior, you are also a Sky Spirit Cat, aren’t you?"
The girl, with her captivating eyes, smiled coyly.
As her cultivation was shallow and her experience was not deep, she could not determine the true form of this senior by his appearance or Super Divine Dragon Breath.
"I’m not a Sky Spirit Cat..."
Big Black Cat shook his head but did not reveal his origins.
The provocative girl brushed her hair from her forehead, shook her other hand slightly, and a knowing look spread across her face. She smiled, "Big brother, stop pretending. I know you’re a Nine-tailed Spirit Cat!"
"Then you’re mistaken!"
Big Black Cat denied it with a stern expression, fear gripping his heart.
This young lass...
She has quite some skill, huh?
Members of the Sky Spirit Cat Clan are indeed all more cunning than foxes.
In the world of the Demon Clan, the saying about beings as cunning as demons, comparable to the Nine-tailed Fox, refers to the Sky Spirit Cats.
At the start, Big Black Cat was very cautious and did not intend to engage in deep conversation with this young girl.
But unexpectedly, this young girl recognized his true form at first glance.
"I won’t be wrong, big brother. Although my cultivation is weak, my ancestor gave me a treasure when I left home. I secretly activated it just now, so I was able to identify your origins..."
The charming girl smiled sweetly, raising a Little Mirror.
"Oh..." Big Black Cat glanced at it, seemingly recognizing the mirror. He sighed helplessly.
This is the Heavenly Spirit Mirror.
It’s a treasure of the Sky Spirit Cat Clan, famous among the Demon Clan. It has many functions, like exploration, breaking illusions, and attacking.
If this Emperor Level Treasure is used, it wouldn’t be hard to reveal my true identity as a Nine-tailed Spirit Cat.
"Lass, your Heavenly Spirit Mirror is quite good. If you lend it to me for a few days, I’ll agree to travel with you..."
Big Black Cat chuckled.
He wasn’t one to suffer a loss silently, and his eyes glinted as he immediately took an interest in the Heavenly Spirit Mirror.
"Big brother, you can borrow me, but not this mirror..."
The charming girl smiled sweetly, her body carrying a hint of fragrance as she surprisingly rubbed up against Big Black Cat.
Big Black Cat jumped in fright.
Is she trying to tarnish my reputation?
I’ve been wandering the Cangnan Continent for so long, always maintained a chaste lifestyle, and never harbored any inappropriate thoughts towards female members of the Demon Clan.
I can’t believe that today’s training expedition ended up attracting the attention of a Sky Spirit Cat.
Just as Big Black Cat was preparing to push away the girl in front of him, he suddenly noticed a dark ray of light flying over rapidly from a distance.
"Kitty, you slut, daring to flirt with other men! I’m furious!"
The dark light fell, revealing a burly man clad in black armor.
He was powerfully built, with a brutish, fleshy face, and a formidable Demonic Aura radiated from him.
Indeed, he was also a powerful demon in the Destiny Realm.
"Brother! Sorry, it seems we can’t team up anymore. I have to go ahead!"
This Sky Spirit Cat named Kitty shot Big Black Cat an apologetic look, giggled, and turned into a beam of light that whizzed into the mountain gate.
She passed through the water-like ripples and vanished in the blink of an eye.
What’s going on here?
Big Black Cat blinked, feeling that he’d been unfairly dragged into this.
This Sky Spirit Cat is a real troublemaker, just as bad as a Nine-tailed Fox!
With the Sky Spirit Cat’s departure, the man in black armor approached. He looked Big Black Cat up and down. "TSK TSK," he said, "So it’s a pretty boy, daring to covet my fiancée. Do you know the consequences?"
"Stop your nonsense! I don’t know her; she approached me first!"
Big Black Cat sneered.
He glanced at this man in black armor. His cultivation base was at Heavenly Mandate Realm Level Six, three levels higher than his own.
Big Black Cat’s eyes darted about as he secretly calculated the potential repercussions if he ended up fighting this guy.
He wasn’t afraid of a fight.
But this black-armored man before me is likely no ordinary member of the Demon Clan.
Anyone daring enough to provoke the Sky Spirit Cat Clan is definitely not someone to be trifled with.
I’m worried that fighting will delay my training and affect the mission the Master assigned me.
While he was considering the pros and cons, he suddenly heard the black-armored man burst out laughing, "Anyway, I have to teach you a lesson!"
With that, he let out an evil laugh, raising his beefy fist, and aimed it straight at Big Black Cat.
Big Black Cat quickly retreated.
But that fist traveled at an alarmingly fast speed, closing in quickly.
With no other option, Big Black Cat threw a punch. The two fists collided mid-air.
BANG!
Big Black Cat felt a surge of massive force washing over him.
His body was actually sent flying towards the mountain gate.
Initially, he was just a few yards away from the gate, but the punch sent him crashing right into the watery ripples of the gate.
This brute is so strong!
Big Black Cat was greatly surprised.
If I actually fought this guy head-on, I might not be his opponent.
Though at a disadvantage, Big Black Cat didn’t mince words.
As he was about to enter the watery ripples, he taunted, sneering, "I’m going in to court your fiancée. That’ll piss you off, you bastard!"
As soon as he had finished his sentence, Big Black Cat’s body vanished.
"You brat, you’re too cocky! Sooner or later, I’m going to kill you!"
The black-armored man watched helplessly as the "pretty boy" disappeared into the watery ripples, stomping his feet in frustration and bellowing.
He paced back and forth on the spot, casting a glance at the gate of the Nine Soul Underground Palace, a complicated expression on his face.
He was already a great demon at the Heavenly Mandate Realm Level Six. It had taken immense effort to reach this stage; it truly hadn’t been easy.
Although the Nine Soul Underground Palace contained the enticing Eternal Life Immortal Grass, he also feared getting his cultivation base suppressed and perishing inside.

chapters.title: Chapter 186: The Mysterious Creature Appears for the First Time
chapters.content:
Chapter 186: Chapter 186: The Mysterious Creature Appears for the First Time
He thought long and hard.
The black-armored warrior could feel a surge of anger, difficult to suppress, growing inside him.
If this Fourth Level of the Destiny Realm guy isn’t scared, why should I be?
Although the Nine Soul Underground Palace is perilous, my fiancée is still inside. I cannot just abandon her...
Especially that pretty boy! If he dares to harm my fiancée, I won’t hesitate to strike him down!
After some contemplation, the black-armored warrior finally made his decision.
He soared into the air and dived headfirst into the water-like ripples, disappearing without a trace.
After he disappeared, members of the Demon Clan entered the Nine Soul Underground Palace one after another.
The Nine Soul Underground Palace would only be open for one day before closing again.
It had been this way for hundreds of thousands of years, as if the master of the Nine Soul Underground Palace did not want too many people to enter.
This is going to be interesting...
Residing in Big Black Cat’s mind, a strand of Ye Yun’s Primordial Spirit suddenly chuckled.
His Primordial Spirit had witnessed the entire incident, while his true body inside the carriage had seen the black-armored warrior plunge into the mountain gate of the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
That cunning Sky Spirit Cat had borrowed Big Black Cat’s power to escape her arranged marriage, but the relentless black-armored warrior had given chase and also entered the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
This black-armored warrior was merely a young black tiger, one of the Golden Striped Black Tigers from the Cangnan Continent.
This demon clan, also renowned among the Demon Clans, dominated a territory comparable to that of Supreme Major Sects.
What Ye Yun found interesting was his knowledge of Big Black Cat’s character: a creature that refused to be taken advantage of, often employing rather absurd logic.
He wanted to see how Big Black Cat would react when facing the Sky Spirit Cat and this Golden Striped Black Tiger.
「...」
I finally made it in! I hope that big black brute didn’t follow me...
After the Power of Spatial Teleportation faded, Big Black Cat appeared in a dark passage within the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
He looked back and, noticing that the black-armored warrior hadn’t followed, felt a wave of relief wash over him.
Big Black Cat quickly sensed his cultivation base and found that, indeed, it had been restricted by some strange prohibitive force.
His cultivation base had been suppressed to the Seventh Level of the Divine Bridge Realm.
This force is strong, but the Seventh Level of the Divine Bridge Realm is enough to survive in this place...
Big Black Cat chuckled proudly.
He wore the Teleportation Boots bestowed upon him by his Master and also carried the Black Shield given to him by Uncle Ma. With these, he possessed both speed and defense.
Surviving in this place, he thought, should not be difficult.
The prohibitive power of the Nine Soul Underground Palace forcibly suppressed a Great Demon of the Third Level of the Destiny Realm all the way down to the Seventh Level of the Divine Bridge Realm. What would happen to someone at the Sixth Level of the Destiny Realm?
Big Black Cat murmured to himself as he slowly walked forward.
This prohibitive power was strange. Big Black Cat found it hard to imagine: if a cultivator at the Peak of the Tenth Level of the Destiny Realm were to come, to what realm would they be suppressed?
At this moment, the strand of Ye Yun’s Primordial Spirit flickered slightly.
He sensed this prohibitive power and instantly understood.
This kind of suppression was similar to what he himself had deployed before; it seemed to be controlled by an invisible hand.
The extent of suppression depended entirely on the controller’s whim. It was even possible for a cultivator at the Peak of the Tenth Level of the Destiny Realm to be suppressed to the First Level of the Divine Bridge Realm.
Such an extreme possibility did exist.
What kind of existence could be here, capable of living for hundreds of thousands of years? It must surpass a True God...
Ye Yun’s heart skipped a beat.
An enigmatic smile touched his ethereal, phantom-like face.
There certainly are some oddities on the Cangnan Continent. It’s called the God’s Forsaken Land, and it even has a strange Curse, rumored to be able to obstruct the cultivation realms of cultivators from the Divine Land. Yet Ye Yun, a native of the Cangnan Continent, was completely unaware of these things. The fact that some beings inside the Nine Soul Underground Palace had already surpassed the True God Realm was also beyond Ye Yun’s expectations. His interest was piqued even further. There must be some sort of connection between the Divine Land and the Cangnan Continent. Now, he intended to uncover this mysterious connection step by step. Ye Yun had a gut feeling that the destruction of the Dragon God Sect was perhaps closely tied to this connection. Ye Yun also knew that one must proceed one step at a time; slowly but surely, he would unveil the mysteries of the Cangnan Continent. There was no need for him to rush.
So Ye Yun closed his eyes once again, and this strand of his Primordial Spirit began to cultivate quietly.
He began cultivating a Great Divine Power for his Primordial Spirit.
「...」
Big Black Cat wandered alone through the passages of the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
He glanced around but could see no one else.
It was as if all the demons who had entered previously had vanished; he didn’t know where they had gone.
Could it be that everyone enters at a different location?
Big Black Cat speculated silently.
The passages in the Nine Soul Underground Palace were incredibly vast, hundreds of feet high and wide. The walls were constructed from black stones etched with tiny runes.
He observed them for a moment but couldn’t comprehend the runes.
The light here was extremely dim; it was so dark you couldn’t see your hand in front of your face.
However, this didn’t pose a problem for Big Black Cat.
Or, to put it another way, demons were generally unaffected by such darkness.
The passages of the Nine Soul Underground Palace were not straight; they twisted and turned, forming a complex maze leading to unknown destinations.
Having just rounded a corner, Big Black Cat suddenly discovered a thick black fog seeping from an opposing passage.
This black fog slowly drifted towards him.
Could this fog be poisonous?
Blinking, Big Black Cat took out the Black Shield given to him by Uncle Ma, held it defensively in front of him, and carefully took a few steps forward.
The fog slowly surged past him. Big Black Cat sighed in relief.
The fog looked eerie, but it wasn’t poisonous.
Holding his Black Shield aloft, he released his Divine Sense and slowly advanced.
In the Nine Soul Underground Palace, Divine Sense was somewhat suppressed but not entirely negated.
What is that?
Big Black Cat halted abruptly. In the fog sat a colossal object.
This colossal object resembled a gigantic white flower. Its huge bud bloomed and swayed in the fog, and much of the mist seemed to emanate from it.
What on earth is this thing?
Big Black Cat stared wide-eyed, refraining from acting rashly.
Scanning it with his Divine Sense, he was surprised to find he couldn’t determine the cultivation realm of this colossal flower.
Could this be one of those strange creatures of the Nine Soul Underground Palace? It has no cultivation realm, but its combat strength is not to be underestimated—capable of dealing a lethal blow to a Divine Bridge Realm cultivator...
Big Black Cat muttered to himself. He had heard this information from his Master.
Although he had lived for thousands of years, Big Black Cat knew little about the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
After all, the Nine Soul Underground Palace only appeared once every ten thousand years, and many people didn’t live long enough to witness its opening.
The extremely faint sound of footsteps reached him.
Big Black Cat swept his gaze through the fog.
A slender figure clad in red slowly emerged from the fog in another passage.
Cat Jewel?
A red light suddenly gleamed in Big Black Cat’s jewel-like eyes.
Damn it! That fiancé of yours just punched me outside! I swore an oath that I’d make you mine. Isn’t this the perfect opportunity?

chapters.title: Chapter 187: Big Black Cat Wreaks Havoc
chapters.content:
Chapter 187: Chapter 187: Big Black Cat Wreaks Havoc
Big Black Cat was known for holding grudges.
At the entrance of the Nine Soul Underground Palace, he had been set up by this engaged couple, and the burning anger inside him had not yet dissipated. Upon seeing Cat Bao, Big Black Cat naturally wouldn’t let her slide.
For this type of woman, a beating first!
A sinister smile stretched across Big Black Cat’s face. He slowly crept towards Cat Bao.
"Big Brother, is that you? What a coincidence, we meet again! By the way, did that stupid and naïve guy do anything to you?" Cat Bao exclaimed with both shock and delight.
At this moment, she still held the Heavenly Spirit Mirror in her hand, its surface revealing the surrounding scenery. A young man in a black robe was walking towards her. Since he wasn’t too far, Cat Bao promptly called out.
Discovered?
Big Black Cat’s facial muscle twitched, a frustrated expression appearing. Gritting his teeth, he abruptly charged forward.
Strike first!
Big Black Cat’s Destiny Realm cultivation base, though suppressed, still left him at the Seventh Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm. This was two minor realms higher than Cat Bao. Moreover, he had the Teleportation Boots; once activated, their speed was unimaginably fast.
"Big Brother, you..." Cat Bao was startled by Big Black Cat’s actions. She quickly turned the mirror in her hand to face him.
WHOOSH!
A beam of bright white light shot out like a flash of lightning. Big Black Cat crashed right into it.
BANG!
Unexpectedly, Big Black Cat was sent flying by the Heavenly Spirit Mirror.
"Damn you, little bitch! Attacking so ruthlessly the moment we meet!!" Enraged, Big Black Cat raised his Black Shield and charged forward again.
Cat Bao was momentarily stupefied by the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat’s imposing aura.
Could it be that her fiancé really gave this Big Brother a good beating? However, when she recalled that her fiancé’s cultivation stage was even higher than Big Brother Nine-tailed Spirit Cat’s, she became more convinced of this idea.
Feeling somewhat afraid, Cat Bao’s eyes widened, and she suddenly pointed her mirror towards Big Black Cat again.
WHOOSH!
Another flash of bright light.
BOOM...
The light emitted by the Heavenly Spirit Mirror struck the Black Shield and was completely reflected.
Cat Bao was greatly startled.
What on earth is that shield in the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat’s hand? The Heavenly Spirit Mirror’s attack actually failed!
Before she could react, a dark shadow descended. Big Black Cat fiercely slammed Cat Bao to the ground with his shield, showing no mercy whatsoever.
"Hmph!" Big Black Cat didn’t hold back, plopping himself down on Cat Bao’s back and mercilessly raining punches onto her rear.
BANG! BANG! BANG! BANG!
A flurry of fists like popping beans landed, causing Cat Bao to shriek non-stop.
"You little vixen! Full of nasty tricks! You tricked me once outside the mountain gate, and now you attack me again on sight. You’ve fallen into Old Cat’s hands now, let’s see what you can do!" Big Black Cat smirked, a smug look on his face, but the force of his punches didn’t lessen in the slightest, making Cat Bao cry out repeatedly.
Watching this scene, Ye Yun nodded and chuckled to himself.
Although Cat Bao’s attack with the Heavenly Spirit Mirror had an element of misunderstanding, Big Black Cat’s ability to be so ruthless with a beauty was something most people couldn’t do.
One hundred thousand years ago, when Ye Yun was a tyrant, if pretty young girls dared to act like that towards him, Ye Yun would unhesitatingly spank them. Sometimes, spanking was the lightest punishment. As a transmigrator, Ye Yun could always devise various ways to punish them.
Tender feelings for women didn’t exist in the heart of Ye Yun, once the strongest expert in the Eternal Realm. So, seeing Big Black Cat act this way, Ye Yun still showed an approving gaze.
"Big Brother, please spare me! It was unintentional. Just now, in this mist, you suddenly rushed over and startled me. It was just a reflex..." An intense pain shot through Cat Bao’s bottom. She wailed and begged for mercy, her eyes welling with tears, a truly pitiful sight.
"You little vixen! Your mind is as cunning as a demon, almost like that Nine-tailed Fox! Like hell I believe you!" Big Black Cat licked his lips, his fists still raining down like a thunderstorm.
Poor Cat Bao, a great beauty, was beaten by Big Black Cat until her bottom was swollen high.
The giant flower nearby was still emitting mist. Its bud continued to open, and from the center, many fine tendrils emerged. These tendrils were pale gold, their surfaces densely covered with sharp barbs. Like long serpents, they hid in the mist, coiling towards the two of them.
Big Black Cat, engrossed in the beating, hadn’t yet noticed this sudden change. By the time he did, the golden, serpent-like tendrils had already coiled right in front of him.
In his haste, Big Black Cat could only thrust the Black Shield in front of him. Infused with Mana, the Black Shield immediately expanded to thirty feet in size, firmly protecting him.
BANG... BANG...
Dozens of golden tendrils struck the shield and were immediately repelled. Seeing this, Big Black Cat finally heaved a sigh of relief.
Luckily, this Black Shield Uncle Ma gave him was powerful; otherwise, he would have been caught just now. For a dignified Destiny Realm Third Layer Big Monster like himself to perish in the Nine Soul Underground Palace because of a woman would be a true injustice!
WHOOSH!
A dark shadow flashed. From another passageway, a heavily armored, large man suddenly appeared.
Big Black Cat’s location was surrounded by several passageways, intersecting in all directions. Thus, it was possible that other members of the Demon Clan might wander into this area.
"Cat Bao, is that you crying for help?" the heavily armored man shouted loudly from a great distance.
He was too far away, and his Divine Sense couldn’t yet detect what was happening here. Furthermore, the dense black mist obstructed his vision. However, he did hear a familiar scream.
"That stupid and naïve guy is here! Big Brother, let me go quickly! We need to escape!" Cat Bao immediately twisted her head and said, enduring the pain.
Big Black Cat’s eyes darted. He sneered, "Don’t think you can trick me. I see, you two shameless lovebirds plan to gang up on me, don’t you?"
"Big Brother! I’m telling the truth! I don’t want to marry that stupid and naïve guy at all. He’s forcing me to marry him! That’s why I ran to the Nine Soul Underground Palace to seek opportunities..." Cat Bao said urgently. As she spoke, her eyes reddened, and a few tears streamed down.
"Crying is useless! Old Cat here has a heart of stone and has never been afraid of a woman’s tears!" Big Black Cat smirked dismissively, though his hands did stop.
He gazed in a certain direction. However, the range of his Divine Sense was limited, and he couldn’t see the other person.
The mist churned. The heavily armored man quickly arrived nearby. Releasing his Divine Sense, he soon saw a sight that made his blood boil and fury surge: the black-robed young man was actually sitting on his fiancée’s back!
"RAAARGH! You dare bully my fiancée?! See if I don’t kill you!" The heavily armored man roared in anger and immediately charged over.
That stupid and naïve guy is attacking?
Big Black Cat jumped in fright. He grabbed the Black Shield, leaped off Cat Bao, and quickly seized her by the neck.
"Don’t move if you want to live!" Big Black Cat said in a hushed voice, looking fearlessly into the mist.
Just then, the unknown giant flower, its white bud now blooming, suddenly extended hundreds of golden, serpent-like tendrils, fiercely sweeping towards the heavily armored man.
"Heh, this strange giant flower really attacks anyone..." Seeing this, Big Black Cat curled his lip and laughed smugly.

chapters.title: Chapter 188: Giant Demon Yam Flower
chapters.content:
Chapter 188: Chapter 188: Giant Demon Yam Flower
HISSS!
Hundreds of golden threads, like venomous snakes bursting from their holes, attacked the black-armored man.
Underneath the thick cover of black fog, they were as hard to notice as phantoms...
Fortunately, his Divine Sense wasn’t completely suppressed. The black-armored man’s expression changed abruptly as he quickly registered the sudden attack.
"Get lost!"
He roared furiously, a dense black light surging all over his body.
At this moment, a large silver saber appeared in his hand. The saber had a thick spine, a broad blade, and was impressively long. As he roared, a ferocious saber light swept out.
This torrent of saber light was fierce and swift, like a celestial river cascading down, colliding with the golden threads in the dense fog.
BOOM!
When they met, a massive explosion sounded.
Almost all the golden threads were severed, and the remaining parts quickly retracted.
This ’Stupid and Naïve’ fellow does have some abilities...
Big Black Cat smirked, having unconsciously changed how he referred to the man.
The name ’Stupid and Naïve’ seems very fitting for that black-armored man.
The man was at the sixth level of the Destiny Realm but was suppressed to the ninth-tier of the Divine Bridge Realm after entering the Nine Soul Underground Palace. He’s actually two minor realms above me.
This realization immediately extinguished Big Black Cat’s nascent thought of competing with this ’Stupid and Naïve’.
I have an essential task; I absolutely cannot let a mere Sky Spirit Cat and a ’Stupid and Naïve’ affect my mission in any way.
At this moment, Cat Gem’s expression turned to horror, and she urged him repeatedly, "Big Brother, hurry and leave! Once that guy goes mad, no one can withstand him!"
"Scared of him, my fur?" Big Black Cat retorted grumpily. "You’re just bolstering the enemy’s morale and undermining our own. I really feel like throwing you to that giant flower for it to eat!"
Cat Gem turned as pale as a sheet. Thinking about that terrifying giant flower, she quickly explained, "Big Brother, that flower is a Giant Demon Yam Flower! Once it drags you into its bud, you’ll be corroded by the demonic liquid inside and instantly dissolve without a trace left. You absolutely mustn’t do that..."
The Giant Demon Yam Flower?
Big Black Cat was slightly stunned.
Cat Gem actually knows quite a bit.
However, upon hearing the name ’Giant Demon Yam Flower,’ he shivered.
This is one of the bizarre creatures too...
Just as he was thinking this, the black-armored man charged toward the Giant Demon Yam Flower like a madman.
A heavy blade light suddenly flashed in mid-air, fiercely slashing towards the Giant Demon Yam Flower.
"You dare attack me, you damn thing? Go to hell!" the black-armored man roared angrily. His body was enveloped in an ink-black light, yet his saber light was as bright as silver, illuminating a patch of the thick black fog.
The Giant Demon Yam Flower seemed to understand the danger.
In an instant, countless golden threads surged out from within its bud, like myriad long snakes shooting forth.
BOOM!
The seemingly invincible saber light struck the golden threads, severing an untold number.
SQUIRT!
Just as most of the threads were severed, a copious amount of thick liquid suddenly spewed from inside the bud.
The liquid was an oily black and emitted a nauseatingly pungent smell.
Seeing this, Cat Gem actually clenched her fists and laughed. "Hee hee, this ’Stupid and Naïve’ is going to have a hard time now!"
Big Black Cat narrowed his eyes and coldly asked, "Would you be happy if your fiancé died here?"
"Of course, I’d be happy! I don’t want to marry him at all!" Cat Gem stated confidently.
In the pitch-black environment, her eyes were as bright as sapphires.
And Big Black Cat’s eyes were much the same.
As fellow felines, their eye colors were remarkably similar.
Hearing Cat Gem’s heartless words, Big Black Cat let out a cold chuckle and licked his lips.
"Big Brother, what are you laughing at?" Cat Gem asked sweetly, turning to look at Big Black Cat.
Big Black Cat raised an eyebrow. "I’m laughing at how heartless you are. Such a ’Stupid and Naïve’ guy, and so strong—you don’t find him attractive at all?"
"I don’t like the strong and rugged type," Cat Gem said with a grin. "I prefer those who are handsome with refined features, charming, and intelligent..."
"Are you talking about me? Why do I get the feeling I’m the person you’re describing?" Big Black Cat scratched his head and said, somewhat shamelessly.
After saying this, he chuckled again before Cat Gem could even speak.
Big Black Cat was smug.
After living for so many years, it was a rare occasion for someone of the opposite sex to confess so proactively. Alas, the flower may be willing, but the stream flows on, unheeding.
"I..." Cat Gem hadn’t finished her sentence when, in the dense fog, the black-armored man, who had been suddenly attacked by the black liquid, came rushing toward them.
The jet-black glow around his body dissolved by at least half the instant it came into contact with the black liquid.
The surface of his fists was even burned by the liquid, exposing the bones on the back of his hands.
"Good! You pair of adulterers, daring to flirt right here! I swear I’ll kill you both!" The black-armored man, hearing their conversation as he flew toward them, became enraged, drew his saber, and slashed.
Cat Gem’s face turned pale again.
She knew this ’Stupid and Naïve’ too well.
Once he went berserk, he recognized no one, not even family, and no one could stand against him.
"You ’Stupid and Naïve’ fool! I’m going to steal your girl, just to piss you off, you bastard!" Big Black Cat laughed loudly, grabbed Cat Gem, and activated his Teleportation Boots.
In an instant, he transformed into a streak of black light and darted into another passage.
WHOOSH!
A flash of saber light cut through the void but hit nothing.
The black-armored man landed, his eyes filled with an incredibly sinister look as he watched the spot where the two had disappeared.
That despicable pair, they got together so quickly. Especially that black-robed young man; he’s utterly shameless. No matter what, I have to kill him. As for any Eternal Life Immortal Grass, I have no interest at all.
He glanced back at the Giant Demon Yam Flower and, seeing it wasn’t pursuing him, a flicker of relief appeared in his eyes.
That thing is too damn strange!
Thinking back now, he still felt a lingering fear.
It was as if I’d circled the Ghost Gate Pass and barely made it back.
Everyone says this Nine Soul Underground Palace is filled with countless dangers, and it seems they’re right. I must be extra cautious, keep my distance from these bizarre creatures as much as possible, and not provoke them lightly...
the black-armored man muttered to himself, then flashed towards the direction Big Black Cat had gone.
That guy runs so fast! What on earth is his true form? Could he be from one of the avian clans?
the black-armored man cursed inwardly as he chased, the anger in his heart erupting like a volcano.
My fiancée has always been sharp and eccentric. If she really has taken a liking to some avian type, it’s indeed possible.
Although their Golden Striped Black Tiger clan possessed certain speed-enhancing Divine Skills, they were still somewhat inferior to avian types.
After chasing for the span of a few breaths, he completely lost sight of his targets.
The Nine Soul Underground Palace was a labyrinth of twisting passages; a single entrance could lead to many tunnels. If one didn’t keep up, tracking them again would be incredibly difficult.
HMPH!
He snorted. Just as he was about to punch the black stone wall beside him, he noticed a faint golden light flickering in an inconspicuous corner.
What’s this?
The black-armored man’s eyes widened, and he flew over quickly.
Within the golden light, a small, palm-sized blade of grass swayed, emitting a faint immortal glow.

chapters.title: Chapter 189: Traveling Together, Competing in Wisdom and Courage
chapters.content:
Chapter 189: Chapter 189: Traveling Together, Competing in Wisdom and Courage
"This is Eternal Life Immortal Grass!"
The black-armored man’s breath caught. Beneath his thick, dark eyebrows, a fervent light ignited in his large, leopard-like eyes.
He never would have imagined that he’d accidentally stumble upon a stalk of Eternal Life Immortal Grass here.
Feeling impatient, the black-armored man didn’t hesitate, reaching out and plucking the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
He brought the Eternal Life Immortal Grass to his nose and sniffed lightly. Instantly, he felt an indescribable essence flow from his nostrils straight into his chest, and his entire body felt invigorated.
Truly worthy of being called Eternal Life Immortal Grass...
The black-armored man murmured to himself, his face alight with excitement.
However, Eternal Life Immortal Grass also varies in quality. This one is quite small, so its quality should be lower...
The black-armored man chuckled at the thought, then opened his mouth and swallowed the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
HUM!
An unimaginably vast surge of life force erupted from within his chest, as if exploding, and rushed towards every part of his body.
At that moment, it was as if his physical body had been refined thousands upon thousands of times; every cell within him underwent a change.
His physical strength seemed to have increased!
He could feel that the vitality of his physical body had greatly increased, as if he had gained several hundred more years of lifespan.
"Excellent! Truly worthy of the Eternal Life Immortal Grass! Hehe!"
The black-armored man lifted his hand and saw that the injuries on its back had completely healed, causing him to grin broadly.
Cat Bao’er, oh Cat Bao’er, you actually led me to a good place! Once my strength increases further, I’ll definitely capture you and kill that wretched fellow!
After a sinister laugh, the black-armored man immediately turned and left.
He had now changed his target.
Since the Nine Soul Underground Palace was like a maze and hard to find, he decided he might as well search for Eternal Life Immortal Grass first.
As for Cat Bao’er, there would always be a chance to encounter her.
「...」
「Somewhere in the Nine Soul Underground Palace.」
WHOOSH!
A swift black light descended from mid-air, revealing a young man in black robes and a young woman in a red dress.
Both were exceptionally handsome and beautiful, of similar age, looking like a well-matched celestial couple. However, their expressions were different; they seemed more like squabbling rivals.
"That big oaf should be unable to catch up now!"
Looking back and sensing the situation, Big Black Cat let out a long sigh of relief, his expression relaxing.
He didn’t want to fight that guy head-on just yet.
He had a mission from his Master. He hadn’t even touched a single stalk of Eternal Life Immortal Grass yet, so he absolutely couldn’t get into a fierce fight with someone here.
Best to avoid any accidents.
Big Black Cat looked down at the Teleportation Boots on his feet, and his brow twitched.
This Emperor artifact consumes a lot of Mana.
To be safe, Big Black Cat immediately tossed a pill into his mouth.
This pill was given to him by his Master; its quality was unimaginably high.
"Big Brother, what are you eating?" Cat Bao’er’s small, jade-like nose twitched, as if she had smelled something.
"Just a pill to replenish some Mana..." Big Black Cat replied casually.
As he spoke, he released his Divine Sense and began to scan the surroundings.
A thick black mist permeated the surroundings. Big Black Cat scanned carefully, afraid there might still be those terrifying Giant Demon Yam Flowers nearby.
To be honest, he was also somewhat afraid of the Giant Demon Yam Flower’s black liquid.
Its corrosiveness was too high, and Big Black Cat didn’t want to use his Black Shield to block it head-on.
If his Black Shield were damaged, it would be a very regrettable loss.
"Big Brother, the aroma of your pill is like nothing I’ve ever smelled before. Can I take a look?" Cat Bao’er’s eyes darted around, shining brightly as she spoke sweetly.
Her shifting gaze was captivating, like that of a peerless beauty. Her expression was enchanting.
There was no hint of resentment. It seemed she had completely forgotten about the time Big Black Cat had spanked her bottom.
"Absolutely not. This was given to me by my Master..." Big Black Cat shook his head repeatedly.
Cat Bao’er chuckled lightly. "Master? Big Brother, do you mean you have elders in your family?"
"Of course, I do. Just stop asking..." Big Black Cat turned away and said impatiently.
He didn’t believe a single word Cat Bao’er said.
If he believed even one sentence, he’d probably be led astray.
Cat Bao’er, having been gently rebuffed, wasn’t discouraged. She walked over with a smile. "Big Brother, look, since we’ve had the good fortune to meet, why don’t we travel together?" She then extended a slender, jade-like hand towards Big Black Cat.
What is she trying to do? Does she want to hold hands?
Big Black Cat’s eyes widened, and he retreated several steps.
"I’m looking for Eternal Life Immortal Grass, don’t delay my important business..." Big Black Cat gritted his teeth and waved his hand, unceremoniously giving her the brush-off.
"Big Brother, I have no interest in Eternal Life Immortal Grass at all. Besides, I can help you find it. Don’t forget, I have the Heavenly Spirit Mirror, and its detection range is even greater than Divine Sense..." Cat Bao’er smiled bewitchingly, raising the Heavenly Spirit Mirror in her hand with a trace of a smug smile on her face.
"..."
Big Black Cat was suddenly speechless.
This damn Sky Spirit Cat! It’s like she can read my mind! She knew he was looking for Eternal Life Immortal Grass and was using the Heavenly Spirit Mirror to tempt him.
At this moment, Big Black Cat even felt like resorting to violence and directly snatching the Heavenly Spirit Mirror.
But this thought was quickly suppressed by him as soon as it arose.
The Heavenly Spirit Mirror was a treasure of the Sky Spirit Cat Clan, and only the Sky Spirit Cat Clan could activate its prowess.
Even if he snatched it, it would be of no use at all.
"Big Brother, I’m really just trying to avoid that big oaf. Honestly, I have no interest in Eternal Life Immortal Grass. Why don’t we travel together? You fly so fast; even if we encounter danger, you can quickly take me away. We’re truly a match made in heaven..." Cat Bao’er smiled sweetly, her gaze as captivating as a siren’s call.
Big Black Cat sighed.
The Heavenly Spirit Mirror was, to him, extremely tempting.
"Alright then, let’s team up temporarily. I need your Heavenly Spirit Mirror, and you need my..." Big Black Cat trailed off, abruptly closing his mouth.
He had almost blurted out about the Teleportation Boots.
This Emperor artifact’s aura had been concealed by his Master’s methods; ordinary people would never imagine this was an Emperor artifact.
He absolutely couldn’t reveal the slightest hint.
Otherwise, if word got out, he feared all the Demon Clan members here would attack him.
After all, the allure of an Emperor artifact far surpassed that of Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
Hmm?
Cat Bao’er’s pupils constricted slightly. She sensed a hidden meaning in the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat’s words.
Her charming eyes scanned him up and down a couple of times, but she didn’t detect anything unusual.
"Big Brother, I recall that speed isn’t an Innate Divine Ability of your Nine-tailed Spirit Cat Clan, is it?" An idea struck Cat Bao’er, and she asked with a smile.
"Of course, it is! What do you know? Our Nine-tailed Spirit Cat Clan has nine tails, and one of those tails possesses a speed-related Divine Skill..." Big Black Cat said with lowered eyelids, boasting animatedly.
As soon as his words fell, "KEKEKE..." A woman’s charming laugh suddenly came from a dark passage nearby.
"Who is it?" Big Black Cat’s brow furrowed, and he immediately became vigilant.
That woman could detect him from so far away; it seems she also possesses some kind of Divine Sense-detecting treasure.
"To think that the dignified Nine-tailed Spirit Cat would be clinging to the tender, white thigh of a Sky Spirit Cat. Truly unexpected..." The woman’s voice, seeming both near and far, drifted out ethereally from the depths of the passage.
"Hmm?" Big Black Cat and Cat Bao’er exchanged a look, their faces paling in alarm.

chapters.title: Chapter 190: Nine-tailed Fox Demon
chapters.content:
Chapter 190: Chapter 190: Nine-tailed Fox Demon
The Big Black Cat had not expected this. The woman, invisible in the mist, had somehow seen his true form at a glance.
However, he felt the woman’s voice seemed familiar, as if he had heard it somewhere before.
The Big Black Cat furrowed his brows.
Beside him, Cat Baby nervously shone the Heavenly Spirit Mirror everywhere, but the woman was too far away for the mirror to detect her.
"Cat Baby, you don’t need to search anymore! This lady is here!"
A white shadow swiftly flew over from deep within the dark passage. The white light landed on the ground, transforming into a stunningly seductive woman in a white dress. The woman appeared to be around Cat Baby’s age, with a voluptuous figure and a pair of long, fair legs, radiating youthful allure. Besides her devilish figure, the woman’s features were exceptionally captivating; "nation-toppling beauty" was no overstatement.
"So it’s you?" Looking at the sensual woman in white, a hint of shock appeared on the Big Black Cat’s face.
"Brother, you actually know this vixen?" Cat Baby glanced at the Heavenly Spirit Mirror, a sweet smile on her beautiful little face.
"We’ve met once," the Big Black Cat grunted irritably.
The woman in the white dress before him was none other than the Nine-tailed Fox Demon. A thousand years ago, he and this Nine-tailed Fox Demon had fought over an Immortal Herb. They had both battled fiercely, but his cultivation base was slightly weaker than the Nine-tailed Fox Demon’s, and in the end, she had seized the Immortal Herb. This incident had remained a sore point for the Big Black Cat ever since.
"Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, you’re quite good at latching onto beauties. This Sky Spirit Cat is rather comely. If I were a man, perhaps I’d marry her on the spot..." The Nine-tailed Fox Demon’s gaze was distant as she chuckled.
"Get lost!" The Big Black Cat glared at her, annoyed. A millennium ago, his cultivation base had been a minor realm weaker than the Nine-tailed Fox Demon’s. After a thousand years, he had no idea what level of the Destiny Realm the Nine-tailed Fox Demon had reached. Upon entering the Nine Soul Underground Palace, this Nine-tailed Fox Demon’s cultivation was still a realm higher than his. She had already reached the Eighth Layer of the Divine Bridge Stage.
This fact made the Big Black Cat quite frustrated. Was he destined to be forever suppressed by this Nine-tailed Fox Demon?
However, the thought of the Teleportation Boots and the Black Shield he possessed suddenly filled him with confidence. He felt he had what it took to challenge this Nine-tailed Fox Demon once more.
"Sister, this is actually the first time Big Brother and I have met. We’re simply traveling together. Please don’t misunderstand!" Cat Baby explained with a smile.
The Big Black Cat hurriedly added, "She’s right! Cat Baby is also someone else’s fiancée. It has nothing to do with me!"
"I think you’re trying to seduce someone else’s fiancée, aren’t you?" the Nine-tailed Fox Demon said with a playful smile, her sparkling peach blossom eyes darting between the two of them.
"Nonsense! I, Old Cat, have always marched to my own drum! When have you ever heard any romantic rumors about me?" The Big Black Cat puffed out his chest, glaring fiercely at the Nine-tailed Fox Demon, forcefully suppressing the urge to strike.
He had just entered the Nine Soul Underground Palace and hadn’t seen a single Immortal Herb yet. It wasn’t the right time to make a move. He had a mission to accomplish; it wasn’t advisable to get into a fight with this Nine-tailed Fox Demon now.
The Nine-tailed Fox Demon was renowned on the Cangnan Continent. She was highly proficient in various Pupil Skills and Illusion Techniques, making her a challenging opponent.
"Fine, I’ll believe you for now. I’ll be on my way. Hopefully, we won’t meet again!" The Nine-tailed Fox Demon smiled and turned to leave.
Suddenly, a rustling sound filled the entire passage, like silkworms eating mulberry leaves late at night. The expressions of the three changed slightly. The eerie sound seemed to approach from all directions, like an incoming tide.
Clutching the Heavenly Spirit Mirror, Cat Baby anxiously watched the images reflected on its surface. From beneath the fog at the far end of the passage, countless black, lice-like insects crawled forth. These insects had shimmering carapaces, a fierce appearance, and each was about the size of a fingernail. They scurried quickly across the ground, producing the rustling sound.
"What is this?" The Big Black Cat glanced at the Heavenly Spirit Mirror in Cat Baby’s hand, his expression changing suddenly.
This is definitely not the Demon Clan. If not the Demon Clan, then it must be one of the strange creatures from the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
"These are Ghost Lice!" Cat Baby shrieked, grabbing the Big Black Cat’s robe. She cried out, "Let’s run! These Ghost Lice are extremely difficult to deal with. Once they burrow into your body, they’ll suck all your blood dry and even devour your bone marrow!"
The Big Black Cat was startled.
He had never imagined such tiny creatures could be so formidable.
He felt a chill run down his spine. Grabbing Cat Baby’s arm, the Big Black Cat transformed into a streak of black light and flew towards another passage. The Teleportation Boots on his feet granted him unimaginable speed, and he vanished in an instant.
"It’s been a thousand years. When did the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat get so fast?" The Nine-tailed Fox Demon stared blankly in one direction for a few seconds, utterly dumbfounded. Hearing the rustling sound draw closer, her expression changed. She, too, turned and rapidly flew towards the passage the Big Black Cat had escaped into.
Although she was also a great demon of the Destiny Realm, her cultivation base was currently suppressed to the Eighth Layer of the Divine Bridge Stage. Facing so many Ghost Lice alone, she would have no chance of survival. The Nine Soul Underground Palace teemed with strange creatures; she absolutely had to be careful.
After fleeing for some time, the Big Black Cat reappeared in mid-air. He looked around, saw that it was safe, and couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
"Big Brother, I owe you my life this time! If I had been alone, I probably would have died!" Cat Baby said, deeply moved, looking at the Big Black Cat’s handsome face.
"We’re just using each other, no need to make it sound so noble!" The Big Black Cat chuckled, his expression impervious.
He had no intention of showing any sympathy whatsoever.
Cat Baby frowned in disappointment. She casually raised the Heavenly Spirit Mirror in her hand and scanned the surroundings.
"What is that?" A golden glow suddenly appeared on Cat Baby’s Heavenly Spirit Mirror, standing out conspicuously in the dark passage.
The Big Black Cat looked, and an expression of excitement instantly lit up his face. "Could this be... the Eternal Life Immortal Grass?" The Big Black Cat clapped Cat Baby’s shoulder excitedly and asked loudly, "Which direction?"
"That passage, about two hundred zhang away..." Cat Baby said softly, pointing with a delicate finger.
"You’ve rendered a great service this time, Haha!" The Big Black Cat laughed heartily and flew in that direction.
"Eternal Life Immortal Grass?" Surprisingly, the Nine-tailed Fox Demon’s voice also came from another direction.
The Big Black Cat’s heart tightened. That little vixen was following so closely and had also discovered the Eternal Life Immortal Grass! He had to get it first this time, no matter what.
Thinking this, he pushed the Teleportation Boots on his feet to their maximum speed.
The distance of two hundred zhang was covered in an instant. The Big Black Cat saw a small golden blade of grass growing within a ball of golden light, emitting a faint celestial glow. He shot out his hand and plucked the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
"You audacious Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, how dare you steal my Eternal Life Immortal Grass!" A flash of white light approached from the distance, and a formidable sword light slashed horizontally at the Big Black Cat.
"You think I’m afraid of you?" The Big Black Cat snorted coldly, raising the Black Shield in his hand.
BOOM!
The white sword light was instantly repelled.
In mid-air, the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat’s sparkling eyes flashed, and a rainbow-like, dreamlike light emerged. At this moment, he launched an Illusion Technique Attack.

chapters.title: Chapter 191: The Terrifying Golden Humanoid Creature
chapters.content:
Chapter 191: Chapter 191: The Terrifying Golden Humanoid Creature
"No good, it’s an Illusion Technique!"
Big Black Cat was startled, immediately realizing that the Nine-tailed Fox Demon before him must have deployed her signature Illusion Technique again.
A thousand years ago, he had suffered greatly from such techniques.
Big Black Cat’s eyes flashed. Without hesitation, he activated the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye, a technique he was just beginning to comprehend.
Fight illusion with illusion.
With the operation of this Divine Skill, a peculiar force instantly emanated from the depths of Big Black Cat’s eyes, like a tide extinguishing a roaring flame. The Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye promptly shattered the Nine-tailed Fox Demon’s Illusion Technique.
Haha, a Great Divine Power indeed, as taught by the Master!
Seeing the Nine-tailed Fox Demon’s Illusion Technique crumble, Big Black Cat laughed heartily in his mind, immediately activated the Teleportation Boots, transformed into a black streak of light, and vanished.
"How could this be?"
The Nine-tailed Fox Demon roared in mid-air, her face reflecting utter disbelief. Although her cultivation base was suppressed, she still had deep confidence in her Pupil Technique Divine Power.
But why did that Nine-tailed Spirit Cat break free so easily?
Unwilling to accept this, the Nine-tailed Fox Demon immediately chased after the direction in which the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat had fled. A thousand years ago, the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat had been defeated by her. This time, she would ensure the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat became her defeated foe once more.
Big Black Cat navigated the dark, winding tunnels, flying for about the time it takes for an incense stick to burn before finally stopping.
I should have shaken her off by now!
Grinning, Big Black Cat held up the palm-sized golden Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
"Big Brother!" Cat Bao’er called out affectionately from the side, her eyes fixed on the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
"What are you up to? Is your bottom itching for a spanking again?" Big Black Cat abruptly raised the Eternal Life Immortal Grass high, staring vigilantly at Cat Bao’er.
"Big Brother, don’t misunderstand. I have no designs on the Eternal Life Immortal Grass..." Cat Bao’er quickly shrugged, explaining.
"Then shut your mouth!" Big Black Cat ordered authoritatively, then turned to study the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
The palm-sized Eternal Life Immortal Grass bore four leaves. Each leaf exhibited a faint golden hue and emitted an indescribable celestial radiance. A vigorous life essence wafted from the four leaves; even a light sniff made one feel invigorated and refreshed.
This is the first Eternal Life Immortal Grass. I need to keep it for Uncle Ma first; who knows if we’ll get another chance to find one later?
Big Black Cat muttered to himself.
After speaking, he quickly deposited the Eternal Life Immortal Grass into his Storage Ring. He had already promised Uncle Ma, so he naturally couldn’t go back on his word.
Watching this, Ye Yun silently nodded in approval. Big Black Cat was indeed loyal and principled. That he chose to save the first Eternal Life Immortal Grass was somewhat unexpected for Ye Yun.
Cat Bao’er was also taken aback when she saw Big Black Cat put away the Eternal Life Immortal Grass, but she said nothing. After all, she had already declared she wouldn’t touch the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
RUSTLE, RUSTLE, RUSTLE!
The sound of Ghost Lice rose around them once again.
Big Black Cat’s expression changed instantly. Hastily grabbing Cat Bao’er, they took to the air. Transforming into a black streak of light, they disappeared into another deep tunnel.
A golden humanoid figure suddenly phased out from the wall and, extending its fist towards the black light, smashed down hard.
"What on earth is this?" Big Black Cat was taken aback and hurriedly placed the Black Shield in front of him.
BOOM!
The golden fist slammed onto the Black Shield, issuing a thunderous bang, and Big Black Cat was blasted back by a powerful force. However, the golden figure flickered and vanished back into the wall.
Not daring to stay, Big Black Cat quickly vanished from the corridor, enduring the tumultuous sensation in his guts.
He fled for another moment.
After confirming his surroundings were safe, Big Black Cat finally landed.
"Cat Bao’er, that golden creepy thing that attacked me earlier, did you get a good look at what it was?" Big Black Cat asked, his eyebrows furrowed.
