Cat Bao’er’s delicate body trembled, her face pale. "I saw it, Big Brother. I can’t believe we’ve encountered the most terrifying golden humanoid creature in the Nine Soul Underground Palace..."
Hearing Cat Bao’er’s words, Big Black Cat’s heart skipped a beat. He muttered to himself,
A golden humanoid creature, the most terrifying strange creature in the Nine Soul Underground Palace?
"Yes, Big Brother. This type of golden humanoid creature rarely appears, but it’s incredibly powerful. I heard many Cultivators get killed by a single punch..." Cat Bao’er said, her heart pounding with fear.
"Hm." Big Black Cat grimly nodded. Recalling the might of that punch, he had indeed felt an indescribably vast strength emanating from it. Luckily, he had the Black Shield Uncle Ma had given him. This shield, with its unimaginable defensive power, had blocked the golden humanoid creature’s strange attack. If he hadn’t had this shield, that golden humanoid creature’s punch might have cost him his life.
Thinking about it now, he could feel chills running down his spine, and his face showed the relief of someone who had narrowly escaped. This Nine Soul Underground Palace was truly terrifying. No wonder stronger Cultivators were so reluctant to enter. Those lucky enough to survive must have had the luck of ages.
Cat Bao’er looked at the Black Shield in Big Black Cat’s paw and marveled, "Big Brother, this Black Shield of yours is truly an incredible treasure!"
Of course! That golden humanoid creature must have taken a nasty hit from my shield; that’s why it didn’t chase us!
Big Black Cat puffed out his chest proudly, glanced around, waved his paw, and said loudly, "Let’s go! We continue our search for the Eternal Life Immortal Grass!"
"Okay!" Cat Bao’er hurriedly agreed, and the two continued on their journey.
...
The Nine Soul Underground Palace indeed holds some secrets. I didn’t expect the golden humanoid creature to carry a wisp of decaying Breath of True God. No wonder the stronger one’s cultivation, the more one dares not enter...
Within Big Black Cat’s mind, Ye Yun’s eyes glinted, a faint, composed smile on his face.
Since this wisp of his Primordial Spirit hadn’t ventured out, Ye Yun, based on his current observations, deduced that there was indeed a Cultivator at or above the True God Realm within the Nine Soul Underground Palace. However, Cultivators of the True God Realm generally couldn’t live for so long. The Nine Soul Underground Palace had existed on the Cangnan Continent for hundreds of thousands of years. By this estimation, there should be at least one Divine Sovereign Realm Cultivator inside.
This thought made Ye Yun suspicious. A Cultivator of the Divine Sovereign Realm was considered powerful and respected even in the Divine Land; why would such a being come to a small place like the Cangnan Continent? And why go to the trouble of creating the Nine Soul Underground Palace...?
Could it be that this Divine Sovereign Realm Cultivator is on the brink of death? Or had this Divine Sovereign Realm Cultivator already died by the time they arrived on the Cangnan Continent?
Ye Yun’s curiosity was increasingly piqued.
If this Divine Sovereign Realm Cultivator were still conscious, then I wouldn’t mind having a good chat with them...

chapters.title: Chapter 192: Fight Over Immortal Herbs, Beat Up the Nine-tailed Fox Demon
chapters.content:
Chapter 192: Chapter 192: Fight Over Immortal Herbs, Beat Up the Nine-tailed Fox Demon
「A day quickly passed.」
The Big Black Cat didn’t find a second Eternal Life Immortal Grass while roaming the Nine Soul Underground Palace. Instead, he encountered several waves of Ghost Lice, managing to evade them after some close calls.
"There’s a Giant Demon Yam Flower ahead!" Little Cat, holding the Heavenly Spirit Mirror, suddenly pointed in a certain direction.
"Then let’s take a different passage..." The Big Black Cat quickly shook his head, preparing to head down another passage.
Little Cat, however, pulled him back.
"What is it?" The Big Black Cat raised an eyebrow.
"Big Brother, there’s an Eternal Life Immortal Grass behind that Giant Demon Yam Flower!" Little Cat smiled sweetly.
"Really?" The Big Black Cat instantly perked up as if he’d had a shot of adrenaline, his excitement surging.
However, the thought of the corrosive liquid the Giant Demon Yam Flower could spew still made him a little fearful. But, lured by the Eternal Life Immortal Grass, the Big Black Cat decided to risk it.
"You wait here for me..." Gritting his teeth, the Big Black Cat instructed Little Cat, then rapidly transformed into a streak of black light and flew towards the Giant Demon Yam Flower.
"Good luck, and be careful..." Little Cat shouted from behind him.
Her life was now tied to the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat. If anything happened to him, it would be very difficult for her to escape this place.
Although the Big Black Cat was very fast, the moment his entire body plunged into the black mist, he still alerted the Giant Demon Yam Flower. It was as if this mist acted as the Giant Demon Yam Flower’s tendrils.
HISS! HISS!
Countless golden filaments, like agile serpents, shot towards the black light to capture it. But the streak of black light was simply too fast; the golden threads couldn’t catch up at all.
Just as the Big Black Cat was about to pass the Giant Demon Yam Flower, its bud suddenly burst open, spewing out an overwhelming torrent of black liquid. The Big Black Cat had been wary of this. He rapidly changed direction in mid-air, swooping low and hugging the ground as he sped towards the hazy golden glow in the distance.
The black liquid missed its target, splattering onto the ground with a sizzling, corrosive sound.
WHOOSH! WHOOSH!
The Giant Demon Yam Flower’s countless golden filaments thrashed wildly in the air, as if expressing its inner fury.
"HAHA!" The Big Black Cat glanced back in mid-air. Seeing that the Giant Demon Yam Flower hadn’t pursued him, he couldn’t help but laugh triumphantly twice.
He’d figured it out too.
The Giant Demon Yam Flower couldn’t move; it could only attack from its fixed position. Once he was beyond its range, the Giant Demon Yam Flower was powerless to attack him.On the ground in the distance, a hazy golden light enveloped an Eternal Life Immortal Grass. This Eternal Life Immortal Grass had six leaves and was twice as tall as the one he’d found before. Seeing this, the Big Black Cat was ecstatic. The quality of this Eternal Life Immortal Grass surpassed that of the previous one.
"Haha, I found an Eternal Life Immortal Grass!"
Just then, two figures flew in from another passage, also lunging for this Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
The Big Black Cat was furious.
They think they can snatch my Eternal Life Immortal Grass?
He fully activated his Teleportation Boots, transforming into a beam of light and landing in front of the Eternal Life Immortal Grass first. He reached out, plucked the Eternal Life Immortal Grass, and stored it in his storage ring.
Just then, two figures descended from the sky, landing before the Big Black Cat.
"Hand over the Eternal Life Immortal Grass at once, or you’ll forfeit your life!" Seeing that the Eternal Life Immortal Grass had been taken, one of the men spoke with extreme arrogance.
The Big Black Cat looked at the two men. One was at the Seventh Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm, the same as his cultivation level, while the other was at the Eighth Layer of the Divine Bridge Stage.
"Are you two looking to die?" the Big Black Cat said coldly.
"Don’t think you’re so great just because you’re a Destiny Realm cultivator out there. In here, you’re just at the Divine Bridge Realm like us! What’s there to be arrogant about?" One of the men burst out laughing. He had, of course, recognized the black-robed young man before him at a glance. They had arrived relatively early and, while waiting outside the mountain gate, had seen this Fate Realm Level 3 Big Monster meditating on the ground. Outside, this Fate Realm Level 3 Big Monster was an absolute behemoth to minor demons like them, who were only at the Divine Bridge Realm. However, inside the Nine Soul Underground Palace, everyone’s cultivation was suppressed to the Divine Bridge Realm, so they no longer felt any fear. Now, being two against one, they felt even more emboldened.
Seeing these two arrogant Divine Bridge Realm Demon Clan men, the Big Black Cat fumed with rage. He raised his Black Shield and immediately smashed it down towards the pair. One of the men drew a sword, meeting the Black Shield. The other man drew a Silver Knife and slashed at the Big Black Cat’s back. The two attacked him from front and back. For a moment, flashes of saber light and sword shadows filled the entire deep, dark passage.
BANG!
A shocking murderous intent flashed in the Big Black Cat’s eyes. His Black Shield suddenly accelerated, whistling through the air, and sent the Longsword flying. Then he spun around quickly and brought his Black Shield crashing down on the man wielding the Silver Knife.
BOOM!
The Black Shield collided with the Silver Knife, producing a massive crash. An immense force surged through the blade, and the Silver Knife was instantly ripped from the man’s grasp.
"Die!" The Big Black Cat snarled, raising the Black Shield and smashing it down.
SPLAT!
This Demon Clan man was instantly smashed into a bloody mist by the Black Shield.
Seeing things turn dire, the other man turned to flee. The Big Black Cat lunged forward at extreme speed and killed the man with his Black Shield.
"Damn it! You take Old Cat for a pushover just because I don’t show my claws?" The Big Black Cat grinned triumphantly, turning to go back and meet up with Little Cat.
Suddenly, a beam of white light descended from the sky.
"Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, it’s been a thousand years! You’ve really made something of yourself. And that treasure in your hand isn’t bad at all!"
The white light dissipated, revealing the graceful figure of the Nine-tailed Fox Demon.
"Nine-tailed Fox Demon, you’re like a persistent ghost! Why do you show up everywhere?" The Big Black Cat brandished his Black Shield, his face full of killing intent, and said, "Don’t try to provoke me, or you’ll regret it!"
"Is that so?" The Nine-tailed Fox Demon’s watery eyes landed on the Big Black Cat, a peculiar light dancing within them.
"Here we go again..." the Big Black Cat cursed. This Nine-tailed Fox Demon had, without him noticing, launched another Illusion Technique attack.
Layers upon layers of illusions flooded the Big Black Cat’s vision. Knowing this was bad, he immediately activated his Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye. The last time, he had broken the Nine-tailed Fox Demon’s Illusion Technique using the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye. So, this time he intended to use the same trick. Tiny, star-like rune phantoms flashed in his eyes, and a Magical Force instantly surged forth. It began to counteract the Illusion Technique assailing him from all sides.
But what the Big Black Cat hadn’t expected was that this time, the Nine-tailed Fox Demon seemed to be prepared. The Illusion Technique she cast this time was even more powerful than before. The power of his Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye was utterly overwhelmed in an instant. The Big Black Cat was on the verge of falling into the Illusory Realm.
「Ye Yun smiled.」
This Nine-tailed Fox Demon is truly shameless, pushing her luck after being shown such leniency. The Big Black Cat has already put up with her so many times. Yet this little Monster is still relentlessly pursuing him, determined to snatch the Eternal Life Immortal Grass from the Big Black Cat’s hands.
Ye Yun’s gaze flickered. A tiny, star-like rune suddenly appeared in the Big Black Cat’s eye. This rune, a faint purple, radiated a terrifying light. An indescribable Magical Force surged out, shattering all the surrounding illusory scenes.
The Nine-tailed Fox Demon was greatly astonished.
How is this possible? She clearly had the upper hand just moments ago and had successfully trapped the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat in the Illusory Realm. How could the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat suddenly turn the tables?
Her vision swam, the world spinning around her. Layers of illusions washed over her like a tide, and the Nine-tailed Fox Demon was instantly lost in their depths.
"Huh?" The Big Black Cat snapped back to alertness. He shook his head, suddenly realizing he had broken free from the Nine-tailed Fox Demon’s Illusion Technique.
What just happened? Could it be that my Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye has finally reached the initial stage of mastery?
The Big Black Cat blinked and suddenly discovered a tiny, faint purple, star-like rune deep within his left eye. An expression of utter shock appeared on the Big Black Cat’s face. He distinctly remembered cultivating the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye for so long, yet never before had such a clear rune appeared. But now, a distinct rune had actually appeared.
"HAHAHA! It seems I’ve truly reached the initial stage! A rune has finally appeared..." The Big Black Cat laughed uproariously, his expression almost manic with excitement. He was utterly obsessed with this Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye. After all, he remembered the Old Master saying that this Divine Skill could be cultivated all the way to the God King Mirror.
Seeing the Big Black Cat getting carried away in his excitement, Ye Yun casually flicked his finger, and the purple rune immediately vanished.
The Big Black Cat suddenly noticed this change, and his expression instantly shifted from elation to dejection.
"ALAS! My Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye is still unstable. That rune vanished again..." he said, dismayed. The Big Black Cat then took a couple of steps forward. He saw the Nine-tailed Fox Demon still standing motionless, her eyes staring blankly at a point in the void, apparently trapped deep within an Illusory Realm and unable to break free.
The Big Black Cat gave a sinister chuckle. "Nine-tailed Fox Demon, I never thought you’d see a day like this! Old Cat definitely won’t spare you today!"
Remembering old scores and fresh grievances, the Big Black Cat charged forward, raised his Black Shield, and brutally slammed the Nine-tailed Fox Demon to the ground.
BAM!
The blow was extremely heavy. It struck the Nine-tailed Fox Demon so hard that she saw stars, her insides churned, and blood trickled from the corner of her mouth. In that instant, she was jolted out of the illusion.
But now, the Big Black Cat was sitting on her back, raising his Black Shield over her rear and bringing it down hard.
SMACK!
A crisp sound echoed through the dark passage.
"AH!" A woman’s shrill cry followed, like the howl of a vixen in the dead of night—utterly miserable and earth-shatteringly loud.
「Elsewhere, Little Cat heard this sound, a bewildered expression on her face.」
Isn’t that the Nine-tailed Fox Demon?
She raised her Heavenly Spirit Mirror, pouring Mana into it, but couldn’t see the scene she was looking for.
It seems the distance is still too great...
She cautiously edged towards the Giant Demon Yam Flower. After covering roughly a hundred feet, an image finally appeared on the Heavenly Spirit Mirror. On it, a black-robed young man was sitting on a white-clad woman, repeatedly striking her rear with the Black Shield in his hand. Each strike made a crisp sound, accompanied by a piercing shriek.
Big Brother... he’s so savage! He actually managed to subdue the Nine-tailed Fox Demon!
Little Cat, seeing this familiar scene, couldn’t help but rub her own backside. Her plump rear still throbbed with a burning pain.
It seems I really can’t afford to offend Big Brother in the future, or my backside will pay the price...
Little Cat’s face paled slightly as she thought with lingering fear.
"Bao’er! I didn’t expect to find you here! You’ve certainly made me search hard for you..." Just as Little Cat was somewhat lost in thought, a deep male voice suddenly sounded from behind her. The voice was filled with immense surprise and delight.
Little Cat turned her head and saw a burly man in black armor standing not far off. It was her fiancé, the man known as Stupid and Naïve.
"How did you follow me here again? You’re truly like a persistent shadow!" Little Cat frowned, but her body slowly retreated, drawing ever closer to the Giant Demon Yam Flower.
"You are my fiancée, and I am your fiancé! Our parents have already agreed to this. How can you go back on your word?" The black-armored man chuckled and walked over, his eyes filled with a fervent look.
"Let me think about this some more. I’ll give you an answer in a year, alright?" Little Cat said calmly. She continued to retreat slowly, getting nearer and nearer to the Giant Demon Yam Flower.
"Bao’er, don’t retreat any further! That Giant Demon Yam Flower will kill you!" The black-armored man immediately reached out to grab Little Cat.
Little Cat abruptly flew up and sped towards the Giant Demon Yam Flower.
"Are you really trying to get yourself killed?" The black-armored man stomped his foot hard and immediately chased after her.
Just then, countless golden filaments suddenly shot out from the Giant Demon Yam Flower’s bud like agile vipers. Some flew towards Little Cat, while others targeted the black-armored man. Little Cat flashed her Heavenly Spirit Mirror. A beam of light shot out, instantly immobilizing some of the golden filaments in mid-air! She didn’t dare to linger for even a moment and quickly flew towards the Big Black Cat.
The black-armored man drew his saber and slashed down hard, instantly severing countless golden threads.
"Bao’er, come back! Are you really trying to die?" Seeing Little Cat’s body pass by the Giant Demon Yam Flower, the black-armored man remembered the terrifying black liquid and hurriedly shouted a warning.
WHOOSH!
The Giant Demon Yam Flower’s white bud suddenly burst open, and a jet of black liquid shot out from within. It spread out like a vast black net, blanketing the sky as it descended upon Little Cat.
In her desperation, Little Cat raised the Heavenly Spirit Mirror in her hands and poured all her Mana into it. Instantly, a colossal, dazzling beam of light shot skyward, meeting the sheet of black, corrosive liquid. Amazingly, this beam of light managed to block the corrosive black liquid. Seizing this hair’s breadth opportunity, Little Cat desperately fled in the Big Black Cat’s direction.
"Damn it!" The black-armored man stomped his foot fiercely, drew his saber, and chased after Little Cat. Having finally found his fiancée alone, he was determined to capture her and bring her back. This Nine Soul Underground Palace was simply too bizarre and fraught with danger; he really didn’t want to stay here any longer.
「Meanwhile...」
"Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, you actually dared to strike me today! Sooner or later, I will repay this tenfold, no, a hundredfold!!" The Nine-tailed Fox Demon turned her head. After letting out another wretched scream, her almond-shaped eyes widened as she glared viciously at the Big Black Cat and uttered a threat.
"Old Cat has never feared threats! Hehe, the flesh on your little bottom is quite soft. Even after spanking you for so long, it hasn’t swollen up like a small hill..." The Big Black Cat grinned wickedly. He raised his Black Shield again, preparing to bring it smashing down.

chapters.title: Chapter 193: At the End of the Underground Palace, The Bronze Giant Door
chapters.content:
Chapter 193: Chapter 193: At the End of the Underground Palace, The Bronze Giant Door
"Big Brother, run, the Iron Fool is coming!"
Just as Big Black Cat was about to raise the Black Shield again to strike the Nine-tailed Fox Demon’s rear, he suddenly heard Cat Bao’er’s cry of alarm from behind him.
He turned his head.
He saw Cat Bao’er flying swiftly towards him, pursued by a black-armored man wreathed in dark light and wielding a knife.
"This damn Iron Fool is here again."
Big Black Cat cursed, but his Black Shield still fell, and the Nine-tailed Fox Demon let out another piercing scream.
Suddenly, he leaped up, grabbed Cat Bao’er, and instantly transformed into a streak of black light, vanishing.
His Teleportation Boots gave Big Black Cat the means to ensure his survival.
He had escaped once more.
In any case, he had already obtained the Eternal Life Immortal Grass and given the Nine-tailed Fox Demon a sound thrashing. The resentment simmering in his heart had mostly dissipated.
PHEW!
The black-armored man descended from mid-air.
He saw a beautiful woman lying on the ground, her shapely, fair legs exposed. She turned over with an unhurried grace and gazed at him with a look of deep resentment.
This young woman is so beautiful...
The black-armored man’s gaze fixed on her, and he stared blankly at the white-robed young woman before him, nearly drooling.
No, this is a Bewitching Technique!
He shook his head violently, forcibly expelling the desire from his heart.
"Little brother," the Nine-tailed Fox Demon began, her rear aching. She propped herself up on an elbow, her watery, alluring eyes fixed on the black-armored man as she spoke in a sweet, coquettish voice, "that detestable Nine-tailed Spirit Cat beat me up. Could you... come over and help me up?"
She was a fox spirit through and through.
Moreover, she was a Nine-tailed Fox Demon, possessing the purest bloodline among fox spirits. Born with a naturally bewitching physique, her every word and gesture carried an immense seductive power.
Most men found it hard to resist.
Only an oddity like Big Black Cat, who seemed to have no interest in women, would be impervious to her charm.
Big Black Cat was this way because he and the Nine-tailed Fox Demon shared a common ancestry, in a manner of speaking.
Upon reaching the highest realm of cultivation, both would grow nine tails. Consequently, the Nine-tailed Fox Demon’s Bewitching Technique had a markedly diminished effect on him.
I...
A look of infatuation appeared in the black-armored man’s eyes.
At that moment, he was once again captivated by the Nine-tailed Fox Demon’s Bewitching Technique.
He quickly walked over, about to help the Nine-tailed Fox Demon up.
Suddenly, a Jade Pendant hanging on his chest flared with light.
In the void behind him, a massive, spectral head of a Black Tiger appeared. The Black Tiger let out a sudden, furious roar, shocking him back to his senses in an instant.
That was close! I almost fell for it again!
The black-armored man raised his knife and said solemnly, "If you dare use your Bewitching Technique on me again, don’t blame me for being merciless!"
The Nine-tailed Fox Demon was momentarily stunned by the spectral tiger head behind the black-armored man.
At this, she abruptly stood up and popped a medicinal pill into her mouth.
Casually dusting off her hands as if nothing had happened, the Nine-tailed Fox Demon’s eyes flickered. She spoke slowly, "So, you’re from the Golden Striped Black Tiger Clan. I recall that long ago, our Nine-tailed Fox Clan showed great kindness to your Golden Striped Black Tiger Clan. You haven’t forgotten that, have you?"
You’re a Nine-tailed Fox Demon? Damn it, I should have guessed!
The black-armored man thumped his forehead, speaking with some annoyance.
His expression immediately changed.
"Of course, I remember!"
The black-armored man nodded emphatically, his face growing solemn.
The Nine-tailed Fox Clan was exceedingly powerful on the Cangnan Continent, even stronger than the Golden Striped Tiger Clan.
Three thousand years ago, they had provided immense aid to the Golden Striped Tiger Clan.
"I’ve heard that the Nine-tailed Fox Clan has seven princesses. May I inquire which one you are, Your Highness?" the black-armored man asked respectfully.
"I am the Seventh Princess!"
A look of pride appeared on the Nine-tailed Fox Demon’s small, jade-white face.
"Greetings, Seventh Princess!"
Shock registered on the black-armored man’s face. According to his information, this Seventh Princess’s true cultivation base should have reached the Seventh Level of the Destiny Realm.
Her true strength surpassed his own.
However, to his surprise, after entering the Nine Soul Underground Palace, her cultivation base had actually been suppressed to the Eighth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm.
That was a minor realm lower than his own.
Truly, fate plays cruel tricks.
"That fellow in the black robe is a Nine-tailed Spirit Cat! Come with me, and we’ll kill him together!"
A potent killing intent instantly flared across the Nine-tailed Fox Demon’s jade-white face.
In all her years, she had never once been spanked.
This was, undoubtedly, the greatest humiliation of her life.
She vowed to kill the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat.
"Very well, Seventh Princess! That Nine-tailed Spirit Cat did the same to my fiancée. I’ve been wanting to kill him too!" the Golden Striped Black Tiger declared, grinding his teeth.
"Let’s go!"
With a taut expression, the Nine-tailed Fox Demon waved her small hand and transformed into a streak of white light, giving chase.
The Golden Striped Black Tiger transformed into a black streak of light and followed closely.
These two great demons, both formerly of the Destiny Realm, now joined forces, preparing to deal with the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat together.
...
The dark, deep tunnel twisted and turned like an endless labyrinth.
Big Black Cat couldn’t get his bearings either. After flying for some time, he encountered some members of the Demon Clan as well as some bizarre creatures.
Such as the Giant Demon Yam Flower, Ghost Lice, and the Nine Soul Earth Python...
This Nine Soul Earth Python was immense, a full forty to fifty zhang in length. As it moved through the tunnels, it created a thunderous, terrifying din.
According to Cat Bao’er, it could spew forth a dark, black light that was extremely poisonous. The slightest contact would inflict severe damage to one’s physical body.
Big Black Cat only glimpsed this Nine Soul Earth Python from afar.
At the time, this giant python was pursuing a member of the Demon Clan and hadn’t noticed Big Black Cat or Cat Bao’er.
As for that terrifying golden humanoid creature, Big Black Cat did not encounter it again.
This time, in his effort to shake off the Nine-tailed Fox Demon and the Golden Striped Black Tiger, he flew for a full two hours. Just as he was preparing to stop, Big Black Cat suddenly realized that this passage actually had an end.
And at the end of the passage stood an immense Bronze Door.
This Bronze Door, a hundred zhang high, exuded an air of ancient simplicity and the vicissitudes of time. Its surface was densely covered with peculiar patterns.
Why is there a Bronze Door here in the Nine Soul Underground Palace?
Big Black Cat frowned, glancing at Cat Bao’er beside him.
"I’ve never heard of such a thing..." Cat Bao’er shook her head, her gaze fixed on the Bronze Door in astonishment. In a low voice, she continued, "In the past, within the Nine Soul Underground Palace, everyone always searched for the Eternal Life Immortal Grass within the tunnels. No one has ever seen a Bronze Door. Could it be that something new has changed this time?"
"Let’s go and take a look!"
Big Black Cat quickly flew over, with Cat Bao’er following closely behind.
Standing beneath this Bronze Door, Big Black Cat instantly felt as insignificant as an ant.
The patterns on the Bronze Door glowed with a faint cyan light.
This light exuded a mystical power, seemingly enticing anyone who saw it to push the great Bronze Door open.
At this moment, a change came over Cat Bao’er’s eyes. She extended a fair, delicate hand and gently pressed it against the Bronze Door.
CREEEAAAK!
The immense Bronze Door, incredibly, began to slowly swing open at her touch.
Big Black Cat was startled.
He had a peculiar feeling then—it wasn’t that Cat Bao’er had pushed the Bronze Door open, but rather that it had opened of its own accord.
What lies beyond this door...?
Intensely curious, Big Black Cat immediately poked his head through the opening, peering into the darkness beyond.

chapters.title: Chapter 194: Evil Phantom Dragon, Dragon Lord arrives
chapters.content:
Chapter 194: Chapter 194: Evil Phantom Dragon, Dragon Lord arrives
Wherever eyes could see, there was a dark, starry sky.
Stars filled the sky like countless gems adorning the night, constantly flickering with light.
Through the faint starlight, one could see in the distance a black mountain range resembling a giant dragon, standing tall upon the boundless land.
The majestic mountain range seemed to stretch for tens of thousands of miles.
It twisted and wound, with varying heights and dips.
In the deep valleys of the mountains, golden orbs of light were everywhere, illuminating the surrounding small, dark worlds.
Within these golden orbs, Eternal Life Immortal Grass grew, radiating a divine glow.
Some had six leaves, others seven, and some even had nine leaves...
These golden orbs were hidden within the twisting mountain range and were invisible from the front of the Bronze Door.
After all, within the Nine Soul Underground Palace, one’s Divine Sense was compressed to a limited range.
「At the same time.」
Not only did a Bronze Giant Door appear where Big Black Cat was, but at this moment, a Bronze Giant Door also appeared at each of the countless tunnel exits in the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
Many Cultivators, intentionally or unintentionally, pushed open the Bronze Giant Doors, witnessing the endless Black Mountain Range under the vast starry sky.
Everyone was extremely shocked.
The scene before them was completely beyond everyone’s expectations.
"What... where exactly is this?"
Big Black Cat stared straight at the Black Mountain Range in the distance, an unspeakable fear rising in his heart.
In my mind, that Black Mountain Range is like a Black Dragon,
he thought.
It’s very similar to the Black Dragon I saw back at the Dragon God Sect.
No, there can’t be such a large Black Dragon...
Big Black Cat shook his head, quickly dismissing this thought.
"This..." Cat Baor also poked her head out from the side, her face etched with shock as she looked at the newly emerged starry world.
"A Bronze Giant Door suddenly appeared. Could it be hinting that we should enter a new world to continue searching for the Eternal Life Immortal Grass?" Cat Baor said shakily.
"It’s highly possible!" Big Black Cat’s eyebrows shot up, and he responded, his face somewhat gloomy.
As soon as his words fell, he saw shadowy figures flying out from an unknown location, swiftly heading towards the Black Mountain in the distance.
Seeing this, Big Black Cat immediately understood.
It wasn’t just him who had encountered a Bronze Giant Door; many others must have reached the end of the tunnels in the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
Some, driven by curiosity, had already ventured into the Black Mountain Range to seek their fortunes.
"Let’s go! We can’t fall behind!"
Big Black Cat gritted his teeth and, pulling Cat Baor along, rushed forward.
A step ahead is to be ahead at every step,
he thought.
At this moment, Big Black Cat unhesitatingly activated the Teleportation Boots.
Fortunately, he had Divine Pills given by his Master to maintain his Mana; otherwise, with his current cultivation base, continuously using this flight-type Emperor Artifact would be unbearable.
After flying into the Black Mountain Range for some distance, the two of them stopped in mid-air.
Big Black Cat surveyed the towering, undulating mountain range in the distance.
Cat Baor also took out the Heavenly Spirit Mirror and began to scan the surroundings.
The more I look at this mountain range, the more it resembles a dragon,
Big Black Cat mused.
But... where in the world could there be such a massive dragon...
Big Black Cat sighed softly. He looked at Cat Baor and urged, "Have you found anything yet?"
Cat Baor continuously infused Mana, activating the Heavenly Spirit Mirror’s search ability, and projected it towards the depths of the mountain range.
After a few seconds, beneath a large boulder in a valley, a golden orb of light appeared.
"I’ve found Eternal Life Immortal Grass!" Cat Baor exclaimed joyfully.
"Haha, then let’s hurry!"
Big Black Cat quickly grabbed Cat Baor and, under her guidance, they immediately flew towards the golden light.
This time, Big Black Cat did not use the Teleportation Boots. Having flown from the Bronze Door, he had already gained a significant lead over many others.
He also needed to conserve some energy now.
After all, to evade the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat and that stupid and naïve guy, he had flown for a full two hours, consuming an enormous amount of Mana.
As Big Black Cat flew towards the Eternal Life Immortal Grass, Ye Yun, residing in his mind, suddenly opened his eyes.
A trace of surprise flickered within his pair of illusory eyes.
This mountain range, stretching for tens of thousands of miles, is actually the corpse of a dead giant dragon!
Ye Yun realized.
To possess such a colossal body, this dragon must have been at least at the Divine Dragon level.
Ye Yun’s gaze flickered, tiny runes within his eyes appearing and vanishing like stars.
He meticulously observed the Black Dragon’s enormous corpse, searching for any clues.
The Black Dragon had a peculiar appearance. Its tail was positioned towards the Bronze Giant Door, the closest point, while its entire body sprawled towards the distant horizon.
In the farthest reaches, its gigantic head was raised towards the sky, its eyes wide open as if it had died with grievances.
Ye Yun carefully examined the exterior of this Black Giant Dragon, not even overlooking the patterns on its scales.
Slowly, the name of a Divine Dragon surfaced in his mind.
Evil Phantom Dragon!
Why is there an Evil Phantom Dragon within the Nine Soul Underground Palace? This is clearly one of the Divine Dragons from ancient mythology...
Ye Yun whispered to himself, his face etched with disbelief.
As the thirteenth Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, Ye Yun possessed extensive knowledge about the Divine Dragons that had once roamed the Cangnan Continent.
After all, the Dragon God Sect housed many secret codices that recorded ancient, primordial, and archaic secrets.
Ye Yun had read them all.
That was why he could identify the origin of this Black Dragon based on its form.
The Evil Phantom Dragon belonged to an exceedingly rare race among Divine Dragons. Inherently malevolent, it had always been ostracized by the God Dragon Clan.
One of the Dragon God Sect’s secret codices described an Evil Phantom Dragon that had wreaked havoc, harming many members of the Dragon Clan, before being imprisoned in the Ten Directions Dragon Prison.
The Ten Directions Dragon Prison was a jail specifically designed to punish the most heinous members of the Dragon Clan.
Both the Evil Phantom Dragon and the Ten Directions Dragon Prison were extremely well-kept secrets.
Now, a hundred thousand years later, it was likely that no one in the world still knew these two names.
Ye Yun then recalled the golden humanoid creature.
That creature had remnants of decaying Divine Nature within it, a Divine Nature that did not originate from this Evil Phantom Dragon.
This place is rather interesting...
Ye Yun muttered to himself, a look of keen interest on his face.
This trip to the Nine Soul Underground Palace was not in vain. I believe that after a while longer, the truth of the matter will surface.
Big Black Cat flew above the valley, gazing at the hazy golden light below, a frenzied look on his face.
Cat Baor held the Heavenly Spirit Mirror, constantly scanning their surroundings.
"Big Brother, there’s something strange about this place," Cat Baor said, pointing. "Look, there’s a deep cave entrance over there in the valley..."
Big Black Cat looked over and only then noticed a dark cave at the bottom of the valley, southwest of the golden light. Cold air continuously seeped out from the pitch-black cave entrance.
The cave was tall and wide, with some kind of winding tracks outside it.
All of this indicated that a serpentine creature still lived in this cave.
"I see. Could it be the Nine Soul Earth Python in this cave?" Big Black Cat said, his expression grave.
If he wanted to seize the Eternal Life Immortal Grass, he would undoubtedly have to pass that cave entrance. Heaven knew if a Nine Soul Earth Python might suddenly thrust its head out to attack.
Just as he was hesitating, a streak of golden light suddenly shot from afar, landing directly before the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
This was a man dressed in a dragon robe, with a pair of dragon horns on his head. He was burly, with a dignified demeanor and a powerful aura.
"Dragon Lord?"
Upon seeing this person, Big Black Cat’s eyes widened.
He had seen this Dragon Lord of the Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge outside the Nine Soul Underground Palace before.
This fellow had a prestigious reputation in the Heavenly Star Dynasty and was also a ruthless character.
Big Black Cat had not expected the Dragon Lord to appear at this moment and actually try to seize the Eternal Life Immortal Grass that he had discovered first.
This enraged him instantly.
"You wait for me here. I will go seize the Eternal Life Immortal Grass..." Big Black Cat turned around, his face gloomy as he instructed Cat Baor.
"Big Brother, Dragon Lord is already at the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm! You must be extra careful!" Cat Baor said, terrified.
Big Black Cat nodded.
He was well aware that the Dragon Lord’s cultivation base was far superior to his own.
Whether in the Destiny Realm or the Divine Bridge Realm, this Dragon Lord far surpassed him. Trying to seize the Eternal Life Immortal Grass from the Dragon Lord was like snatching food from a tiger’s mouth.
At this moment, Big Black Cat fervently hoped that a Nine Soul Earth Python would suddenly leap out from the depths of the cave and ambush the Dragon Lord.
That way, he might be able to fish in troubled waters.
Without hesitation, Big Black Cat activated his Teleportation Boots, transformed into a streak of black light, and flew toward the Dragon Lord at an unbelievable speed.
The Dragon Lord looked at the immortal herb before him, a surprised look in his eyes.
This stalk of Eternal Life Immortal Grass in the golden light had a full seven leaves.
This was the highest quality Eternal Life Immortal Grass he had ever seen in the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
The Dragon Lord was just about to pluck this stalk of Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
Suddenly, he felt a violent gust of wind from the side, and a huge black snake head abruptly protruded from the cave.
The black snake’s head was as large as a small hill, an astonishing sight. Its twin blood-red eyes were like two enormous lanterns, illuminating the dark space.
WHOOSH!
The Nine Soul Earth Python opened its mouth and spat a beam of black light that swept towards the Dragon Lord.
The Dragon Lord knew how powerful this black beam was, but he couldn’t dodge it; otherwise, this stalk of Eternal Life Immortal Grass might be destroyed.
"Nine Soul Earth Python, let’s see just how powerful you really are!"
The Dragon Lord hesitated slightly. A flash of golden light appeared on his hand, and immediately a golden Longsword materialized in his grip.
He held this golden Longsword and fiercely slashed out.
SWISH!
An earth-shattering sword light whistled through the air.
It collided with the huge black beam in mid-air.
RUMBLE!
The sword light forcibly split the black beam and descended towards the Nine Soul Earth Python.
The Nine Soul Earth Python was not afraid at all; it even used its enormous snake head to fiercely ram the incoming attack.
CRASH!
The Nine Soul Earth Python smashed the sword light to pieces, and a deep gash appeared on its head.
The appearance of this gash, however, only provoked the Nine Soul Earth Python’s ferocity. It immediately flew out of the cave and lunged at the Dragon Lord.
Heaven is indeed helping me!
Big Black Cat thought, overjoyed as he had just flown nearby and witnessed the Nine Soul Earth Python attacking the Dragon Lord.
He descended towards the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
If not now, when would be a better time to seize the Eternal Life Immortal Grass?
The Dragon Lord furrowed his brows. He had also noticed the streak of black light that suddenly flew towards him and, without hesitation, slashed with his sword.
Faced with the Nine Soul Earth Python’s attack, he fiercely extended his left hand, his arm radiating a golden light.
In that instant, his arm transformed into a dragon claw, fiercely reaching for the Nine Soul Earth Python.
It could be said that the Dragon Lord was now fighting one against two, demonstrating the grandeur of a supreme demonic beast.
Big Black Cat saw how incredibly sharp the sword light was. Even from a distance, he felt a chill crawl up his scalp and was secretly astonished.
This Dragon Lord is indeed worthy of being the master of the Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge,
he thought.
His strength far surpasses those two Saints, Golden Eye and Silver Eye.
Without hesitating, he channeled his Mana into the Black Shield in his hand and thrust it towards the sword light.
The Black Shield instantly swelled in size, becoming about thirty feet wide and completely covering Big Black Cat.
CLANG!
The golden sword light struck heavily onto the Black Shield, emitting a series of deafening CLANGS as the powerful rebound shattered the sword light.
Big Black Cat tumbled continuously in mid-air, forced back by the powerful impact.
Just then, a red streak of light shot from the distance—it was Cat Baor, flying at lightning speed towards the golden glow.
This one wants to steal it too?
Enraged, Big Black Cat channeled all his Mana, surging it into his Teleportation Boots.
His tumbling body lunged forward swiftly, transforming into a streak of black light, and landed before the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
In an instant, he landed before the Eternal Life Immortal Grass first.
Cat Baor swiftly turned the Heavenly Spirit Mirror, aimed it towards Big Black Cat, and the mirror flashed with a layer of light.
"You dare?" Big Black Cat roared.
I can’t believe Cat Baor harbored such ill intentions, actually trying to attack me with the Heavenly Spirit Mirror!
he fumed internally.
And after I brought her all this way!
"Big Brother, dodge quickly!" Cat Baor stared at Big Black Cat in panic and screamed at the same time.
Big Black Cat immediately sensed something was amiss. Turning back, he found the Dragon Lord already standing behind him, a golden dragon claw reaching out for him.
This guy is too treacherous!
Big Black Cat thought.
He actually snuck up behind me without a sound!
WHOOSH!
The Heavenly Spirit Mirror in Cat Baor’s paw emitted a brilliant light, and a beam of light shot violently towards the Dragon Lord.
Big Black Cat hastily dodged, evading the Heavenly Spirit Mirror’s line of attack.
"Overestimating your abilities!" The Dragon Lord sneered. His golden dragon claw fiercely grabbed at the beam of light and, with a BANG, crushed it instantly.
Watching this scene, Big Black Cat gasped.
This Dragon Lord’s physical strength is monstrous!
he thought.
As expected of the Dragon Clan, their physical prowess is truly too formidable. If it came to a direct confrontation, I’d probably lose my life to the Dragon Lord in a single blow.
Seeing the Dragon Lord drawing closer, Big Black Cat activated the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye without hesitation.
Deep within his eyes, a faint purple, tiny rune sparkled again, emitting an unimaginable mysterious power.
This mysterious power instantly descended upon the Dragon Lord.
The Dragon Lord was immediately dazed, frozen in his walking posture, standing rigidly on the spot.
Great opportunity!
Seeing this, Big Black Cat immediately grabbed the Eternal Life Immortal Grass, stashed it in his storage ring, then grabbed Cat Baor, activated the Teleportation Boots, and vanished in a streak of black light.
Big Black Cat never expected that at such a critical moment, his half-baked Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye would end up saving his life again.
As expected of a Supreme Divine Power cultivated by a ’God’, this Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye is truly too powerful...
Big Black Cat lamented internally as he fled rapidly through the air.

chapters.title: Chapter 195: Golden Divine Dragon, Nine-Leaf Immortal Herbs
chapters.content:
Chapter 195: Chapter 195: Golden Divine Dragon, Nine-Leaf Immortal Herbs
It could be said that once again, the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye had saved Big Black Cat’s life.
The last time, when facing the Nine-tailed Fox Demon, the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye had performed a remarkable service. Otherwise, how could Big Black Cat have gotten the chance to spank the Nine-tailed Fox Demon? He had spanked it countless times, until he had vented all the fury accumulated over a thousand years.
This time, facing the mighty Dragon Lord, Big Black Cat still relied on the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye to snatch the Eternal Life Immortal Grass and escape to safety.
「...」
WHOOSH!
Seeing Dragon Lord in a daze, the Nine Soul Earth Python’s tail swept towards him ferociously. That thick tail, covered in black scales, slammed heavily toward Dragon Lord.
BOOM!
Dragon Lord, completely unaware, was instantly swept aside by this tail, his entire body slamming into the cliff like a cannonball. This impact, however, unexpectedly jolted Dragon Lord out of the Illusory Realm.
He shook his body, causing the surrounding mountain rocks to fall, then with a powerful struggle, he flew out from the depression in the cliff.
When the Nine Soul Earth Python saw that Dragon Lord was, astonishingly, still alive, it became livid. It opened its mouth and shot out another jet of black light.
"Hmm?" Dragon Lord narrowed his eyes, looking towards the direction where the Eternal Life Immortal Grass had been, only to find it was already gone.
That shameless black-robed youth and the red-robed young woman had also vanished.
A nameless fury abruptly blazed up from his chest.
Someone had actually dared to steal the Eternal Life Immortal Grass from right under his nose, and they had also ambushed him, using a bizarre Illusion Technique to trap him in a hallucination, followed by the Nine Soul Earth Python’s attack.
Fortunately, his body was extremely tough; even after being struck by the Nine Soul Earth Python, he was still largely unharmed.
Dragon Lord possessed the bloodline of the Golden Divine Dragon. Although it was extremely diluted, this bloodline made his physical defense extraordinarily strong.
Trying to run? Not so easy!
Dragon Lord sneered, a cruel smile appearing on his face.
WHOOSH...
His body suddenly erupted with golden light, making him look like a golden War God. With a slight movement, he vanished from his spot in an instant.
A streak of golden light, like a meteor, suddenly descended upon the Nine Soul Earth Python.
Dragon Lord’s fist landed on the Nine Soul Earth Python’s head.
BOOM!
The Nine Soul Earth Python’s entire head was instantly smashed deep into the ground. Its head, covered with black scales, cracked extensively, and blood gushed out. The Nine Soul Earth Python’s body struggled continuously, but its strength waned with each effort, and after a while, it stopped moving.
After finishing off this Nine Soul Earth Python, the layer of golden, flame-like light on Dragon Lord’s body instantly vanished.
He panted lightly.
Just now, to achieve a quick victory, he had unleashed his bloodline power to directly kill this abominable Nine Soul Earth Python.
He glanced in a certain direction, and his figure flashed, disappearing.
「Not much time had passed.」
Dragon Lord’s body abruptly stopped.
He discovered a cluster of golden light deep in the valley ahead, with several Demon Clan members fighting fiercely nearby.
His face immediately lit up with joy.
He hadn’t expected Eternal Life Immortal Grass to be so common in this Black Mountain Range.
His desire to chase those two instantly faded; he flew towards the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
After all, his main purpose for entering the Nine Soul Underground Palace was the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
Dragon Lord descended before the golden light; the faint immortal light illuminated his stern face, making it appear golden.
The few Demon Clan members who were fighting saw someone suddenly land before the Eternal Life Immortal Grass. They simultaneously stopped their battle and immediately lunged towards Dragon Lord.
"Get lost!" Dragon Lord turned, his eyes cold and emotionless as he snorted.
"It’s... Dragon Lord!"
Those few Demon Clan members also recognized Dragon Lord; their faces changed drastically, and they turned to flee.
Even if they joined forces, they were no match for Dragon Lord. They could only reluctantly give up this stalk of Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
Seeing these people flee, a cold, smug smile appeared on Dragon Lord’s face.
In the entire Heavenly Star Dynasty, who would dare disrespect Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge?
Dragon Lord reached out his large hand, grabbed that stalk of Eternal Life Immortal Grass, and immediately stuffed it into his mouth, consuming it.
A surging vitality immediately flowed through his body like a great river, constantly washing over every part of him.
After the baptism of the Eternal Life Immortal Grass, Dragon Lord’s body began to become even more terrifying.
"This feels really good!"
Dragon Lord grinned, unable to resist letting out a long howl towards the sky.
In the Nine Soul Underground Palace, he had obtained five or six stalks of Eternal Life Immortal Grass. However, the quality of those Eternal Life Immortal Grasses was relatively low.
After consuming some Eternal Life Immortal Grass like this, Dragon Lord’s lifespan increased by a good thousand years, and his physical body also became stronger than before.
This time, entering the Nine Soul Underground Palace, Dragon Lord felt somewhat apprehensive, fearing he might perish here. But unexpectedly, his luck was truly excellent; his cultivation level was actually suppressed to the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm.
His physical body was already exceptionally strong, and with his cultivation reaching the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm, ordinary Demon Clan members were no match for him. Even those bizarre creatures couldn’t do anything to him.
Especially after consuming several stalks of Eternal Life Immortal Grass, his physical body strengthened further, greatly boosting Dragon Lord’s confidence. He became even more confident about competing for Eternal Life Immortal Grass later on.
But Dragon Lord also knew that far too many Demon Clan members had entered this time. From the Destiny Realm alone, there were a full thousand individuals. Perhaps some of them were also fortunate enough to have their cultivation levels suppressed to the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm; these people would all be his competitors.
Dragon Lord’s figure flashed and vanished from the spot in an instant.
He wanted to continue searching for Eternal Life Immortal Grass. As for revenge, he had temporarily pushed that matter to the back of his mind.
「...」
Under the star-dappled sky, this Black Mountain Range was incredibly vast, both in length and width. Therefore, if someone managed to escape, tracking them down would be extremely difficult.
「In another direction.」
Big Black Cat landed on a hilltop and glanced back a few times.
Seeing that Dragon Lord hadn’t pursued him, he couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
"Good heavens! This Old Cat just escaped from the Nine-tailed Fox Demon, and now I’ve provoked Dragon Lord!"
Big Black Cat felt his nerve was getting bigger and bigger.
However, snatching food from the tiger’s mouth twice and obtaining two stalks of Eternal Life Immortal Grass made Big Black Cat exceptionally happy.
He placed this stalk of Seven-leaf Immortal Grass into his storage ring.
This one is for Uncle Ma...
Big Black Cat smiled, then took out the smallest stalk of Eternal Life Immortal Grass and swallowed it on the spot.
An indescribably surging vitality instantly swept through his entire body.
Big Black Cat couldn’t help but stare wide-eyed. At this moment, he felt his body was incredibly comfortable. A powerful force was boiling within his body, making him feel an irresistible urge to roar.
「...」
Little Cat stood beside him, watching blankly, a look of envy actually appearing in her eyes. She also hadn’t expected the Eternal Life Immortal Grass to be so miraculous.
Unfortunately, she had already declared she would no longer touch Eternal Life Immortal Grass, so now she could only stare helplessly.
This place was fraught with hidden dangers, and she currently relied entirely on the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat’s help to escape with her life.
「A while later.」
Big Black Cat stretched comfortably, an intoxicated expression on his face.
This Eternal Life Immortal Grass really is good stuff! Not only can it increase lifespan, but it can also temper the physical body. It’s truly a rare Immortal Herb.
On the Cangnan Continent, such Immortal Herbs were extremely rare. Every time one appeared, the major powers would fight to the death for it.
"Big Brother, your mana is truly abundant! I never thought the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat Clan’s innate talent would be so good. How many tails do you have?" Little Cat suddenly asked with a sweet smile, her darting eyes continuously scanning Big Black Cat’s rear.
Big Black Cat instantly felt his backside clench and quickly covered it with his hand.
"Don’t look around! Men and women should maintain a respectful distance. How many tails I have is none of your business! Ask fewer such personal questions in the future!" Big Black Cat said, his face stern.
A wronged expression immediately appeared on Little Cat’s face.
"Big Brother, can’t I even ask? Aren’t you being too harsh?"
"Curiosity killed the cat. I think you should understand this principle, right?" Big Black Cat chuckled.
Then, he stopped paying attention to Little Cat and began to continuously scan the surroundings, trying to find new Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
He now had two stalks of Eternal Life Immortal Grass in his storage ring.
Big Black Cat planned to reserve one stalk for Uncle Ma and another for one of the Sect Leaders, Luo Li.
As a demon beast of the Dragon God Sect, Big Black Cat naturally understood the need to maintain a good relationship with the Sect Leader. So he had prepared the Eternal Life Immortal Grass for them.
Of course, if Big Black Cat found more Eternal Life Immortal Grass later, he would naturally reserve some for his other two young masters.
As for the Old Master... Big Black Cat didn’t plan to reserve any. He knew the Old Master’s foundation was profound and unfathomable, and he was about to break through from the Divine Monarch Realm to the Divine Sovereign Realm; he wouldn’t care about this mere Eternal Life Immortal Grass at all. According to his understanding, upon reaching the God realm, one’s lifespan would likely be unimaginably long. If he reached the Divine Sovereign Realm or Divine King Realm, the Old Master would probably achieve immortality, right?
"Hehe," Ye Yun sensed Big Black Cat’s thoughts and couldn’t help but smile knowingly.
This little cat is quite resourceful with his thoughts. However, Big Black Cat’s line of thinking was not unreasonable. It would be enough as long as he prepared one Eternal Life Immortal Grass for each of the three young disciples of the Dragon God Sect.
Ye Yun’s eyes flashed as he recalled the earlier Dragon Lord.
What surprised him was that the little fellow actually possessed the bloodline of the Golden Divine Dragon.
The Golden Divine Dragon was one of the Divine Dragons of Ancient Times; its surviving bloodline was extremely scarce and a rare sight. Even when the Dragon Clan roamed rampantly across the Cangnan Continent, the members of the Golden Divine Dragon clan were not numerous.
The Golden Divine Dragon clan possessed unimaginable physical defense and boundless strength, belonging to the combat-type Dragon Clan.
The Golden Divine Dragon bloodline within Dragon Lord was extremely thin. However, on the current Cangnan Continent, a Dragon Clan member possessing such a bloodline was already exceedingly rare.
An idea sparked in Ye Yun’s mind.
When the Dragon God Sect is rebuilt in the future, he intends to unify all Dragon Clan members on the Cangnan Continent, bringing them under the Dragon God Sect. This could also be considered a way to ensure a better continuation for the God Dragon Clan. Otherwise, over these past hundred thousand years, the Dragon Clan has declined more and more. Across the entire Cangnan Continent, the number of Human Race members and Dragon Clan members possessing the Dragon God Bloodline has become increasingly scarce.
「...」
"In this mountain range, there are no Giant Demon Yam Flowers, nor is there any black mist..." Big Black Cat muttered to himself. He scanned the area twice but found no trace of Eternal Life Immortal Grass, so he took Little Cat and left this place.
The God level pill he had consumed earlier was still providing him with an endless stream of mana. However, it also required an absorption process for the mana in Big Black Cat’s Dantian to be fully replenished.
So this time, Big Black Cat flew at a normal speed with Little Cat.
Little Cat behaved very obediently along the way, but Big Black Cat also remained on guard. The Black Shield never left his hand.
Although Little Cat had contributed during the recent battle with Dragon Lord, Big Black Cat still felt it was best to be cautious.
As Little Cat flew, she used the Heavenly Spirit Mirror to search for the whereabouts of Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
「After a period equivalent to the time for burning an incense stick had passed.」
The two of them again discovered an Eternal Life Immortal Grass growing in a mountain hollow not far ahead. And this stalk of Eternal Life Immortal Grass also had seven leaves and was of very high quality.
Big Black Cat’s eyes gleamed with fervent light as he took Little Cat and flew over.
This time, they were extremely lucky.
There were no Demon Clan members around to compete for it, nor were there any bizarre creatures, so Big Black Cat very easily collected this Eternal Life Immortal Grass into his storage ring.
He now had a total of three stalks of Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
Big Black Cat was in high spirits. He needed to find two more stalks of Eternal Life Immortal Grass to consider his mission for entering the Nine Soul Underground Palace complete.
After reaching five stalks of Eternal Life Immortal Grass, he planned to consume some more Eternal Life Immortal Grass to temper his own physical body. The physical body of a Nine-tailed Spirit Cat was not very tough; it couldn’t compare to some Demon Clan members with powerful innate talents.
After collecting this stalk of Eternal Life Immortal Grass, Big Black Cat and Little Cat continued on their way.
Gradually, they discovered that Demon Clan members had suddenly become more numerous. Flying for just a short while, they could see many Demon Clan members searching everywhere in the mountain range for Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
Big Black Cat was secretly astonished.
He roughly counted; it seemed that not too many Demon Clan members had died or been injured within the Nine Soul Underground Palace. At most, counting generously, the casualties were around one-tenth.
The competition is so fierce...
Big Black Cat sighed. Although his Teleportation Boots could save his life, if there were too many enemies, it would still be difficult for him to escape.
The two of them flew forward for a while longer.
Big Black Cat didn’t find any more Eternal Life Immortal Grass, nor did he see Dragon Lord, the Nine-tailed Fox Demon, or that Stupid and naïve fellow. This immediately made him relax considerably.
「A day passed quickly.」
Big Black Cat obtained another stalk of Eternal Life Immortal Grass, but this one was snatched only after a great battle with a group of Demon Clan members. Those few Demon Clan members were also very strong, but their speed was inferior to his.
With Little Cat’s cooperation, Big Black Cat successfully snatched this stalk of Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
"Big Brother, this mountain range is filled with killing everywhere now. The fight for Eternal Life Immortal Grass is incredibly intense. It’s lucky I’m with you, or I would have lost my life..." Little Cat sighed while looking at the Heavenly Spirit Mirror as they flew through the air.
"Don’t worry! With me around, you won’t die!" Big Black Cat said swaggeringly.
These Teleportation Boots gifted by the Old Master could be said to have allowed him to avoid many dangerous encounters. And this was only with half of it refined. If it were fully refined, the flight speed would be even more terrifying.
"Big Brother!" Little Cat suddenly cried out in alarm. "There’s Eternal Life Immortal Grass ahead! So many people... and Ghost Lice..."
Big Black Cat hurriedly looked at the Heavenly Spirit Mirror.
He saw several hundred Demon Clan members gathered in a wide valley. And in the valley, there were countless, densely packed Ghost Lice continuously crawling on the ground, seemingly protecting the Eternal Life Immortal Grass within the golden light.
"Heavens! This stalk of Eternal Life Immortal Grass actually has nine leaves!" Big Black Cat also exclaimed in surprise after clearly seeing the Eternal Life Immortal Grass enveloped in the golden light.
Up to now, the Eternal Life Immortal Grasses he had seen had at most seven leaves. He had never seen an eight-leaf one. But this stalk of Eternal Life Immortal Grass actually had nine leaves!
Its quality was unimaginably high.
"Let’s go! We’ll snatch it!" Big Black Cat said fiercely.
He immediately took Little Cat and flew towards that valley.

chapters.title: Chapter 196: Monsters Gather, Each with Their Own Motives
chapters.content:
Chapter 196: Chapter 196: Monsters Gather, Each with Their Own Motives
Despite his harsh words, when the Big Black Cat landed with Kitten on a huge rock overlooking the valley, he did not make any reckless moves.
Hundreds of Demon Clan members had gathered around.
The demons stared at the Nine-leaf Eternal Life Immortal Grass in the valley with an indescribable fervor in their eyes.
No one had ever seen an Eternal Life Immortal Grass with nine leaves.
Five-leaf and six-leaf Eternal Life Immortal Grasses were commonly seen.
But everyone knew that in the Nine Soul Underground Palace, each additional leaf on an Eternal Life Immortal Grass brought unimaginable improvements.
The valley floor was carpeted with Ghost Lice, dense and seemingly innumerable. They tightly guarded the Eternal Life Immortal Grass, and for a while, nobody dared to move.
Everyone just stared intently at the Eternal Life Immortal Grass, covertly drooling.
Ghost Lice were an extremely frightening type of creature in the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
Along the way, many had died under the razor-sharp maws of the Ghost Lice.
"There are just too many Ghost Lice..."
Standing on the rock, the Big Black Cat looked at the dark, swarming mass of Ghost Lice, and his fair face instantly turned grim.
Although he had Teleportation Boots that could allow him to grab the Eternal Life Immortal Grass in the blink of an eye, and he could even use the Black Shield to block the Ghost Lice’s attacks, the sheer number of Ghost Lice was overwhelming. If they managed to land on him from any direction, he would be instantly drained into a dry corpse.
WHOOSH! WHOOSH!
Several beams of light descended from afar, landing on the high ground around the valley.
More and more demons were gathering.
Everyone adopted a wait-and-see approach; no one acted rashly.
The number of Ghost Lice in the valley far exceeded those in the tunnels of the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
"Are there any Heaven-Destined Great Demon seniors... who can take the lead?" a male demon suddenly shouted.
"If you want to go, then go! With so many Ghost Lice guarding the Eternal Life Immortal Grass down there, whoever dares to charge in first will definitely die!" a man with a dark complexion retorted irritably.
The crowd deeply agreed.
Although they seemed numerous, no Heaven-Destined Great Demon capable of charging through enemy lines had yet appeared.
So-called Heaven-Destined Great Demons were those at the Destiny Realm, whose cultivation bases were suppressed to the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm upon entering the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
Such Great Demons not only possessed high cultivation bases but also formidable physical bodies. If they were to lead the charge, they might be able to withstand the frenzied assault of these Ghost Lice.
The demons discussed animatedly amongst themselves, and the atmosphere was indeed lively.
Fortunately, the Ghost Lice were only guarding the Eternal Life Immortal Grass and had not taken the initiative to attack those on the mountaintop.
The Big Black Cat remained calm, as he too was waiting for an opportunity.
He had already obtained four stalks of Eternal Life Immortal Grass. As long as he acquired one more, he would complete his basic task.
Any Eternal Life Immortal Grass he obtained in the future, he could consume freely to temper his own body and increase his lifespan.
"Big Brother, do you think that Dragon Lord will also come here?" Kitten asked in a hushed voice, looking around.
"Don’t jinx it!"
The Big Black Cat frowned and glared at her, displeased.
That Dragon Lord fellow was freakishly strong. If he came, there would be one more major competitor for the Eternal Life Immortal Grass. Although he had gotten lucky last time using the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye, who knew if the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye would be as effective next time? Besides, the Dragon Lord had already been tricked once; the Big Black Cat didn’t believe he would fall for it again.
At this moment, two more figures swiftly landed at the edge of the valley.
When Kitten saw these two individuals, her heart skipped a beat, and her eyes widened in shock.
"Big Brother, this is bad! That Iron Hunk and the Nine-tailed Fox Demon are together!"
Kitten immediately hid behind the Big Black Cat, her voice trembling with fear.
The Big Black Cat’s heart also jolted.
He quickly turned his head, his gaze passing over the shoulders of the hundreds of Demon Clan members, and saw two figures standing there.
It was the Nine-tailed Fox Demon and Iron Hunk.
Adversaries are destined to meet again, it seems! These two pests just won’t give up...
The Big Black Cat clenched his teeth, his expression darkening.
He was extremely reluctant to leave just like this. But if the Nine-tailed Fox Demon and Iron Hunk joined forces, aside from having a slight advantage in fleeing, he truly wouldn’t be their match.
For a moment, the Big Black Cat’s spirits sank.
The Nine-tailed Fox Demon also spotted the Nine-leaf Eternal Life Immortal Grass, a fervent glint sparking in her beautiful eyes.
The same went for the Golden Striped Black Tiger.
Both great demons were captivated by the Nine-leaf Eternal Life Immortal Grass and had yet to notice the Big Black Cat and Kitten.
The Big Black Cat, pulling Kitten’s arm, quickly jumped off the large rock and blended into the crowd.
He needed to maintain a low profile and stay hidden for as long as possible. Who knew what might happen next? Perhaps someone would be unable to resist rushing into the valley first, igniting the contest for the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
WHOOSH! WHOOSH!
Figures streaked through the air from a distance, landing around the valley.
More and more Demon Clan members continued to arrive.
Among these demons, many were Heaven-Destined Great Demons whose realms had been suppressed to the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm.
Upon arriving and seeing the Nine-leaf Eternal Life Immortal Grass, the eyes of these Heaven-Destined Great Demons turned red.
Nine is the ultimate number. A Nine-leaf Eternal Life Immortal Grass must be the best kind, right?
These Heaven-Destined Great Demons also wanted to contend for it.
At this moment, the Nine-tailed Fox Demon shifted her gaze from the Nine-leaf Eternal Life Immortal Grass. Her beautiful eyes began to scan the surrounding crowd.
Suddenly, her pupils contracted sharply.
In the distant crowd, she actually saw the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat and the Sky Spirit Cat.
What a despicable pair, to think they were hiding here!
The moment the Nine-tailed Fox Demon saw the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, she was reminded of the searing pain on her rump.
Her wound on her rump had actually healed long ago. The Nine-tailed Fox Demon had also acquired two or three stalks of Eternal Life Immortal Grass; after consuming one, her injuries had completely vanished.
"Hmph, Tiger, look who’s over there," the Nine-tailed Fox Demon said, annoyed.
"Huh?" The Golden Striped Black Tiger glanced in that direction, and his eyes nearly bulged out.
Two familiar figures stood there.
One was his fiancée, and the other was that shameless Nine-tailed Spirit Cat who had run off with his fiancée.
Fury ignited in his heart. The Golden Striped Black Tiger immediately drew his saber, preparing to charge.
But the Nine-tailed Fox Demon grabbed his arm.
"Right now, our priority is this Nine-leaf Eternal Life Immortal Grass. As for those two, there’s no rush..." the Nine-tailed Fox Demon whispered.
The Golden Striped Black Tiger was taken aback, then quickly nodded.
The Nine-tailed Fox Demon had shown great kindness to their Golden Striped Black Tiger clan.
Moreover, the Nine-tailed Fox Demon’s status and cultivation base were higher than his; he was more than willing to listen to her.
Seeing the Golden Striped Black Tiger’s anger subside, the Nine-tailed Fox Demon patted his massive shoulder with satisfaction.
"Rest assured, I’ll help you get your revenge. With the two of us, both Heaven-Destined Great Demons, do you think we still need to fear those two?" the Nine-tailed Fox Demon said with a light chuckle.
"You’re right, Seventh Princess!" The Golden Striped Black Tiger grinned foolishly.
Another figure descended from the sky. The light faded, revealing a man in golden robes.
As the man landed on the mountaintop, many Demon Clan members quickly retreated, clearing an open space.
"The Dragon Lord is here!"
Many Demon Clan members cheered excitedly.
The Dragon Lord of the Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge possessed the bloodline of a Divine Dragon. His strength was world-shaking; perhaps he could be the one to take the lead.
The Dragon Lord’s expression was cold and indifferent. With his hands clasped behind his back, he gazed at the Nine-leaf Eternal Life Immortal Grass in the valley, a fervent look in his eyes.
This was also his first time seeing a nine-leaf Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
Therefore, at this moment, he resolved to claim this plant for himself.
He quickly scanned the surroundings and noticed other Heaven-Destined Great Demons among the crowd. However, there were only about a dozen whose cultivation bases were close to his own.
Seeing so many Demon Clan members gathered on the mountaintop yet taking no action, a look of sudden realization crossed the Dragon Lord’s face.
It seems... everyone is waiting for a powerful individual to break the deadlock. After all, the Ghost Lice in the valley are far too numerous; no one dares to be the first to charge.
A cold sneer touched the Dragon Lord’s lips.
Charging in first is certainly highly risky, but it also offers the greatest opportunity.
His mind began to turn.
However, as his gaze swept over a certain spot, it suddenly froze. He saw the black-robed young man who had ambushed him before.
Two clusters of furious flames instantly blazed in the Dragon Lord’s eyes.
That detestable fellow! Later, I must capture him and tear him into a thousand pieces to appease the hatred in my heart!
Damn it, that old geezer Dragon Lord is here too!
Dejection filled the Big Black Cat’s face, and he was ready to activate his Teleportation Boots to flee at any moment.
That Dragon Lord fellow is too strong. I’m definitely not his match. As for my Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye, it’s unreliable; I can’t pin all my hopes on it.
Kitten’s face also turned quite pale at this moment.
The Nine-tailed Fox Demon, Iron Hunk, and the Dragon Lord—all three of their major adversaries were present.
She truly didn’t know how this would end.
However, when Kitten saw that the Dragon Lord only glanced at them before turning his attention back to the Nine-leaf Eternal Life Immortal Grass in the valley, she felt somewhat relieved.
It seemed everyone’s attention was currently focused on the Eternal Life Immortal Grass, and personal grudges were being temporarily set aside.
"Big Brother, should we leave this place first? There are Eternal Life Immortal Grasses elsewhere; maybe we can even find another nine-leaf one!" Kitten said, tugging on the Big Black Cat’s sleeve.
"Are Nine-leaf Eternal Life Immortal Grasses that common?" The Big Black Cat frowned, gritting his teeth. "Since they haven’t attacked us, we don’t need to rush to escape. Let’s observe the situation first. In any case, I have no intention of giving up on this Eternal Life Immortal Grass!"
"Alright then!" Seeing the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat so determined, Kitten reluctantly nodded.
After all, her little life depended on the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat.
Although in Kitten’s eyes, the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat’s combat strength wasn’t very impressive, his escape skills were unparalleled. To have escaped from Iron Hunk, the Nine-tailed Fox Demon, and the Dragon Lord successively—that wasn’t something an ordinary Demon Clan member could achieve.
The Big Black Cat’s expression kept changing. His gaze darted between the Eternal Life Immortal Grass, the Dragon Lord, the Nine-tailed Fox Demon, and Iron Hunk, his eyes filled with complex emotions.
This time, he would truly have to snatch food from the tiger’s mouth. To defeat those Heaven-Destined Great Demons among an army of over a thousand Demon Clan members and evade the terrifying Ghost Lice—the difficulty was simply too immense. However, the thought of the astonishing rewards if he succeeded still made the Big Black Cat’s heart race with excitement. Success or failure would be decided in this one attempt.
BOOM! RUMBLE!
A rumbling sound, like muffled thunder, suddenly came from the valley below.
Surprised expressions appeared on the faces of all the Demon Clan members.
"What’s that?"
"How come more flowers are growing in the valley?"
"Those aren’t flowers! Those are Giant Demon Yam Flowers, bizarre creatures from the Nine Soul Underground Palace!"
The crowd discussed animatedly, looking at the numerous white plants that had suddenly appeared in the valley below, their faces filled with utter shock.
Those white plants burst from the earth and rapidly grew, forming enormous flowers. They were indeed Giant Demon Yam Flowers.
Within the vast valley, hundreds of Giant Demon Yam Flowers had suddenly sprouted.
WHOOSH! WHOOSH!
The Giant Demon Yam Flowers bloomed, and black mist billowed out from their openings, instantly shrouding the entire valley.
Everyone gasped.
Those terrifying Ghost Lice were already extremely difficult to deal with.
Now, hundreds of Giant Demon Yam Flowers had also grown.
These horrifying flowers spewed black mist, completely sealing off the valley.
This made acquiring the Eternal Life Immortal Grass even more difficult.
The obstructing fog would hinder their line of sight.
Moreover, the Giant Demon Yam Flowers possessed extremely strong combat capabilities; their slender tendrils and corrosive liquids were the nightmare of many Demon Clan members.
"This place... it’s truly becoming more and more terrifying..." the Golden Striped Black Tiger said, looking towards the valley with a grave expression.
"These strange creatures are guarding the Eternal Life Immortal Grass. From a certain perspective, this Nine-leaf Eternal Life Immortal Grass is indeed worth risking one’s life for..."
The Nine-tailed Fox Demon extended her pink tongue, gently licking her sensual red lips, yet the light in her eyes burned even hotter.
A Nine-leaf Eternal Life Immortal Grass is definitely extraordinary.
The ever-domineering Dragon Lord now had an extremely grim expression.
He stared intently at the valley, secretly calculating.
He now somewhat regretted not acting sooner; if he had, he wouldn’t have encountered these Giant Demon Yam Flowers. But it was too late now. The sudden appearance of the Giant Demon Yam Flowers had sealed the valley, greatly increasing the difficulty of seizing the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
"What was that?" The Dragon Lord’s pupils constricted slightly as he suddenly saw a golden figure flash past in the mist.
The Dragon Lord’s expression immediately became solemn.
Since entering the Nine Soul Underground Palace, he had encountered several bizarre creatures, but he had never met the legendary, most terrifying golden humanoid creature. To think that a golden humanoid creature was also present in this mist!
It wasn’t just the Dragon Lord; almost every Demon Clan member saw it.
The realization that the most terrifying golden humanoid creature of the Nine Soul Underground Palace was also lurking in the valley made everyone’s breathing quicken.
The golden humanoid terror was too famous; its ferocity ranked among the top three most dangerous entities in the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
Besides the Ghost Lice, Giant Demon Yam Flowers, Nine Soul Earth Pythons, and the golden humanoid terror, there were several other extremely rare and terrifyingly bizarre creatures in the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
However, very few knew of their existence.
Around them, people’s breathing grew heavy. Everyone stared intently at the valley, their minds racing as they calculated their options.
Some of the Demon Clan members with weaker cultivation bases were already considering retreat.

chapters.title: Chapter 197: The Melee Begins, Competing for Immortal Herbs
chapters.content:
Chapter 197: Chapter 197: The Melee Begins, Competing for Immortal Herbs
"This valley is too terrifying. My cultivation base is too low, only at the third level of the Divine Bridge Realm. Maybe I should try my luck somewhere else..."
A young Demon Clan member with a somewhat pale face sighed, turned around, and left.
"I am only at the Fifth Level of the Divine Bridge Realm. Frankly, I don’t have the strength to fight for the Eternal Life Immortal Grass. Maybe it’s best for me to leave..."
Another male from the Demon Clan also turned and left.
"Even though I’m at the Eighth Layer of the Divine Bridge Stage, I am still too weak compared to those Great Demons. I won’t participate in this murky battle!"
Another from the Demon Clan left.
And so, a great deal of the Demon Clan gathered around the mountain peak gradually left.
The remaining Demon Clan members numbered roughly two hundred.
These Demon Clan members had relatively high cultivation bases and considerable strength, preparing to fish in troubled waters.
After all, no one can tell when it comes to matters of fate and chance.
Once those Great Demons start fighting amongst themselves, who knows, someone with a certain Divine Skill might secretly steal the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
With fewer people, Big Black Cat and Kitten stood out in the crowd, drawing noticeable attention.
The Dragon Lord coldly looked at Big Black Cat and chuckled, "Aren’t you leaving?"
Big Black Cat was taken aback. Then he gritted his teeth and snarled, "Why should I leave? The Eternal Life Immortal Grass is up for grabs for whoever sees it; it doesn’t belong exclusively to you, Dragon Lord! Right, everyone?"
After speaking, Big Black Cat looked around.
The other Heaven-Destined Great Demons stared gloomily. None of them spoke, but neither did they object to Big Black Cat.
