The Dragon Lord, upon seeing this, just licked his lips and let out a deeply meaningful smile.
If I were to attack Big Black Cat now, others would probably rush into the valley to seize the Eternal Life Immortal Grass first. So I must bide my time and wait for the perfect moment to act.
The Nine-Tailed Fox Demon was also looking at Big Black Cat at this time. She revealed a coquettish smile and said flirtatiously, "Nine-Tailed Spirit Cat, you shameless thing! Why don’t you leave already? What are you doing lingering here? Careful, or I’ll spank your bottom."
Hearing the Nine-Tailed Fox Demon’s words, the surrounding Heaven-Destined Great Demons, who had all been keeping serious faces, couldn’t help but burst into laughter.
"We’ll see who spanks whom!"
Big Black Cat wasn’t fazed in the slightest. Instead, he puffed out his chest, gave a cold chuckle, and said, "Stupid and Naïve, quickly testify for me! Didn’t I spank the Nine-Tailed Fox Demon’s bottom?"
The Golden Striped Black Tiger’s face instantly turned red. He pointed the broadsword in his hand at Big Black Cat and snarled, "Stop talking nonsense, or I’ll cut your tongue off!"
Seeing Stupid and Naïve daring to threaten him, Big Black Cat’s anger surged.
He raised a hand, a brilliant smile on his face as he said, "Stupid and Naïve, your conscience must have been eaten by a dog! You even forgot that I spanked the Nine-Tailed Fox Demon’s bottom! Alright, since you’ve forgotten, I’ll make you remember."
The Golden Striped Black Tiger was taken aback, and a black glow immediately surged from his body.
He was constantly on guard against an attack from the Nine-Tailed Spirit Cat, but he never expected that the hand of the Nine-Tailed Spirit Cat opposite him would suddenly descend.
SLAP!
A soft slap landed on Kitten’s bottom beside him.
The slap wasn’t strong.
But the sound was extremely crisp, and all the Demon Clan members nearby heard it.
Everyone looked at each other, as if they couldn’t believe their ears.
This Nine-Tailed Spirit Cat is far too arrogant, isn’t he? To actually slap his fiancée’s bottom right in front of the Golden Striped Black Tiger!
"Big Bro, how could you do this?" Kitten whispered.
Her face was now flushed crimson, all the way to the roots of her ears.
She also hadn’t expected the Nine-Tailed Spirit Cat to spank her bottom again.
How am I supposed to face anyone after this?
"Haha!"
In Big Black Cat’s mind, Ye Yun’s strand of Primordial Spirit finally couldn’t help but laugh out loud.
However, due to a restrictive seal, Big Black Cat didn’t hear it.
Ye Yun hadn’t expected Big Black Cat to be so shameless, brazenly slapping Kitten’s bottom in public.
Although the slap was light, it was extremely domineering and impressive.
Approval flashed in Ye Yun’s eyes.
Big Black Cat is increasingly reminiscent of my former self, the number one scoundrel in Cangnan. However, Big Black Cat’s Cultivation Stage is simply too low. If I weren’t backing him from the shadows, Big Black Cat wouldn’t survive three seconds.
"You’re courting death!"
Seeing his fiancée humiliated, the Golden Striped Black Tiger’s fury became uncontrollable, and he lunged fiercely at Big Black Cat.
He couldn’t tolerate it any longer.
Under everyone’s watchful eyes, this shameless fellow had actually slapped his fiancée’s bottom!
Though the slap wasn’t forceful, the insult was immense.
"Now’s the time!"
The Dragon Lord, who had been maintaining a grim expression, remained perfectly calm. When he saw the Golden Striped Black Tiger pounce towards the Nine-Tailed Spirit Cat, everyone’s attention shifted in that instant.
He darted towards the valley in an instant.
"You insidious Dragon Lord, daring to go after the Eternal Life Immortal Grass!"
A Heaven-Destined Great Demon immediately sensed something was amiss. He swiftly turned and also rushed towards the valley.
The two of them, one after the other, disappeared into the mist.
This sudden turn of events stunned everyone.
However, they all reacted quickly, almost simultaneously leaping up and transforming into streaks of light as they rushed towards the valley.
Now was the time to fish in troubled waters.
"Tiger, come back to me!"
The Nine-Tailed Fox Demon stamped her foot in anger and immediately used her Illusion Technique on the Golden Striped Black Tiger.
In mid-air, the Golden Striped Black Tiger’s body suddenly halted. With a somewhat dazed look in his eyes, he turned and flew back.
The Nine-Tailed Fox Demon waved her hand, leading the Golden Striped Black Tiger into the misty valley.
The Golden Striped Black Tiger was incredibly strong, possessed high physical defensive power, and had immense strength. If the two of them cooperated, their chances of obtaining the Eternal Life Immortal Grass would be very high.
The reason the Golden Striped Black Tiger was so easily controlled by her Illusion Technique was because the Nine-Tailed Fox Demon had planted an illusion seed in his heart long ago.
Because the Golden Striped Black Tiger trusted her completely, the Nine-Tailed Fox Demon had quietly prepared this contingency, fearing that some unforeseen situation might arise where she couldn’t control him.
"Sis, follow me!"
Big Black Cat didn’t feel embarrassed at all. He grabbed Kitten’s hand and instantly plunged into the valley.
At that moment, he activated his Teleportation Boots. His speed was extremely fast, allowing him to quickly overtake most of the others and be the first to dive into the black fog.
He held Kitten with one hand and tightly gripped the Black Shield with the other.
Kitten’s Heavenly Spirit Mirror could not only help him block attacks from other directions but also help him observe the surroundings.
She was now Big Black Cat’s trusted aide.
As soon as he entered the fog, Big Black Cat fully extended his Divine Sense, wary of any sudden attacks.
Inside the fog, it was now utter chaos.
The Heaven-Destined Great Demons were fiercely attacking one another, each hindering the others, preventing anyone from getting close to the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
At the same time, they also had to be wary of the attacks from the golden, thread-like tentacles and corrosive liquids launched by the Giant Demon Yam Flower.
However, some Great Demons, relying on their formidable strength, fought while forcefully breaking through towards the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
Many other Demon Clan members who entered the fog were immediately attacked by the fine threads of the Giant Demon Yam Flower, throwing them into disarray.
The Ghost Lice on the ground also leaped up at this moment, joining the fray.
The scene was chaotic beyond description.
Big Black Cat dared not linger in battle. Whenever the Giant Demon Yam Flower or Ghost Lice attacked, he relied on his extreme speed to quickly evade.
He pulled Kitten along, dodging left and right, yet still found it difficult to break through the vast net formed by the Demon Clan members and various strange creatures.
What am I going to do?
Big Black Cat was also extremely anxious.
Thanks to his Teleportation Boots, he was safe for now, but he still couldn’t get close to the Nine-Leaf Longevity Immortal Grass.
The mist constantly roiled, accompanied by thunderous booming sounds.
Nearly two hundred Demon Clan members were fiercely battling within the mist.
The sounds were earth-shattering, and powerful shockwaves continuously radiated outwards in all directions.
Even some of the leaping Ghost Lice were sent tumbling back by these shockwaves.
However, the Ghost Lice had extremely high defenses. These shockwaves couldn’t kill them; on the contrary, their ferocity was stoked, and they lunged forward aggressively once more.
Some Demon Clan members with weaker defenses had Ghost Lice latch onto them.
In an instant, they were sucked into desiccated corpses and fell from mid-air.
Immediately, more Ghost Lice bit through their bodies, burrowed inside, and began to consume their marrow.
The entire valley had become like a living hell.
Just then, a golden light flashed, and a strange humanoid creature suddenly emerged from the mist.
The golden humanoid creature attacked from the front, throwing a vicious punch at Big Black Cat.
Big Black Cat was extremely annoyed.
Why is this guy relentlessly targeting me like a persistent ghost?
Left with no other choice, Big Black Cat raised the Black Shield in his hand and desperately poured Mana into it.
BOOM!
The golden fist slammed into the Black Shield, creating an enormous impact, and was once again repelled.
The terrifying golden humanoid creature vanished into the mist.
A bloodcurdling scream echoed from the distance.
Just then, a young Demon Clan member was obliterated by this terrifying golden humanoid creature.
Kitten saw this scene through the Heavenly Spirit Mirror, her face turning pale as she shivered all over.
This golden humanoid creature is truly terrifying!
Big Black Cat clutched his Black Shield, feeling his internal organs churn.
HISS! HISS!
Countless golden threads from the Giant Demon Yam Flower coiled towards them.
Kitten shot a beam of light from the Heavenly Spirit Mirror, immobilizing those fine threads in mid-air.
Big Black Cat caught his breath and flew off in another direction.
RUSTLE...
Hundreds of Ghost Lice suddenly surged up from the ground, charging towards the two of them.
"These blasted things again!"
Big Black Cat cursed in frustration and quickly held the shield in front of his chest.
He frantically poured his Mana into the shield, which emitted a black light that counterattacked the Ghost Lice.
With a series of BANG! BANG! sounds, all the Ghost Lice were surprisingly repelled.
The offensive power of Uncle Ma’s magic treasure is actually quite potent...
Big Black Cat was pleasantly surprised. It was also the first time he had activated the Black Shield’s inherent offensive Divine Skills.
I didn’t expect the effect to be this good. It’s just that, like the Teleportation Boots, it consumes too much of my Mana.
Big Black Cat didn’t dare to use it continuously.
After all, even the Divine Pills in his body couldn’t rapidly replenish all his Mana.
Little Cat’s cultivation is still too weak...
Ye Yun saw Big Black Cat struggling amidst the mist, facing numerous difficulties, and sighed lightly.
With a light flick of his finger, Ye Yun instantly dispelled a portion of the restrictive seal within Big Black Cat’s body.
Big Black Cat’s cultivation base skyrocketed in that moment.
Eighth Layer of the Divine Bridge Stage.
Ninth-tier of the Divine Bridge Realm.
Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm.
In the span of a single breath, Big Black Cat’s cultivation base leaped from the Seventh Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm to the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm.
After doing all this, Ye Yun closed his eyes again, continuing to cultivate his Great Spirit Method.
Big Black Cat, still struggling left and right under extreme stress, hadn’t yet realized that his cultivation base had broken through to the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm.
Kitten, however, sensed the sudden surge in his aura and was startled.
"Big Bro, your cultivation base... it broke through to the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm?" Kitten exclaimed in pleasant surprise.
"Really? You’re not kidding me, are you?"
Big Black Cat was startled. He quickly sensed his cultivation and found that it had indeed risen from the Seventh Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm to the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm.
This enormous improvement was hard for him to believe.
"The heavens are truly helping me! The restrictive force of the Nine Soul Underground Palace actually weakened at this moment! Haha, my cultivation is also at the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm now! With this, I’m confident!"
Big Black Cat burst out laughing.
Having advanced to the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm, his Mana had increased several hundredfold, and his overall combat strength had risen dozens of times.
Now, when using the Teleportation Boots and the Black Shield, he no longer had to worry about insufficient Mana as before.
Big Black Cat glanced at the Heavenly Spirit Mirror. After confirming the location of the Eternal Life Immortal Grass, he spun around and headed towards the mist deeper in the valley.
The sound of something tearing through the air was heard.
A sword light suddenly shot over, slashing towards Big Black Cat in an extremely insidious manner.
Big Black Cat was instantly enraged.
He immediately raised the Black Shield in his hand and slammed it fiercely forward.
BOOM!
The sword light instantly shattered. Big Black Cat didn’t even bother with his attacker, as he had no time to spare.
The battlefield was extremely chaotic; at any moment, someone could seize the opportunity to snatch the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
He had to race against time, cutting through all obstacles in his path and leaving all rivals behind.
WHOOSH!
Several more Demon Clan members flew over and attacked Big Black Cat.
Big Black Cat unceremoniously poured Mana frantically into the Black Shield, activating its offensive Divine Skills.
A wave of black light swept out, sending all those Demon Clan members reeling back.
Some young Demon Clan members were caught by the golden, thread-like tentacles of the Giant Demon Yam Flower, violently pulled back into its bud, and instantly dissolved by corrosive liquid.
Other Demon Clan members lost control in mid-air and were devoured by the Ghost Lice.
Big Black Cat suddenly felt a wave of overlapping illusions before his eyes; the entire space around him became distorted and strange.
Countless female voices also echoed in his ears, mocking him.
"Nine-Tailed Spirit Cat, give up on the Eternal Life Immortal Grass! You simply don’t have the strength!"
"Get lost!"
Big Black Cat roared angrily and swiftly activated his Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye.
In one of his pupils, the purple rune reappeared, and a mysterious power instantly rebounded.
Not only did it break the illusion before him, but the Nine-Tailed Fox Demon in the distance also let out a muffled groan and then fell silent.
After dealing with the Nine-Tailed Fox Demon, Big Black Cat didn’t pause and continued flying in the direction of the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
A streak of golden light shot out from the fog.
The golden humanoid creature attacked Big Black Cat again.
This time, the golden humanoid creature unexpectedly wielded a golden longsword.

chapters.title: Chapter 198: Golden Winged Roc, Stealing Immortal Herbs
chapters.content:
Chapter 198: Chapter 198: Golden Winged Roc, Stealing Immortal Herbs
"Why is this damn thing targeting me again?"
Big Black Cat watched the golden humanoid creature, holding a gleaming golden longsword, rush towards him and couldn’t help but curse.
His pupils contracted slightly. At this moment, Big Black Cat activated the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye again. However, the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye was not as effective this time. The golden humanoid creature paused momentarily in midair, then charged again. Wielding its sharp golden sword, it fiercely slashed down.
As the golden humanoid creature moved through the fog, the Ghost Lice and the golden, thread-like tentacles of the Giant Demon Yam Flower that had been attacking Big Black Cat simultaneously recoiled.
"Holy crap!" Big Black Cat exclaimed.
This guy can actually scare off other strange creatures?
he marveled inwardly.
At this moment, he couldn’t dodge the creature’s attack and could only desperately pour his mana into the Black Shield.
BUZZ!
The Black Shield emitted a streak of black light, attacking the golden humanoid creature first.
A golden sword light flashed.
BOOM!
The black light was instantly shattered into fragments.
The golden humanoid creature, its facial features indistinct, held a golden longsword like a golden Demon King as it struck again.
Little Cat, standing beside him, was so scared she bit her lip, hardly daring to breathe. Her large eyes stared blankly as the golden humanoid creature slashed down; she didn’t know if the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat could withstand it.
WHOOSH!
The Black Shield suddenly swelled to three zhang in size, completely protecting Big Black Cat and Little Cat.
BOOM!
The golden sword struck the Black Shield, creating a thunderous crash.
Big Black Cat and Little Cat were sent flying backward through the air by this powerful force.
Although Little Cat was flustered, she didn’t forget to continuously use the Heavenly Spirit Mirror to drive away the scattered Ghost Lice flying towards them.
The impact left Big Black Cat’s internal organs feeling like they were boiling, his blood churned, and an indescribable weakness washed over him. Conversely, the golden humanoid creature was also knocked back and vanished into the fog.
Ignoring his own condition, Big Black Cat quickly looked at the Black Shield in his hand. The Black Shield had returned to its normal size, and a thin sword mark had appeared on its surface.
Big Black Cat was immediately heartbroken. This was a treasure Uncle Ma had given him! He hadn’t expected it to be damaged, even slightly, in the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
"The Ghost Lice are coming!" Little Cat’s voice rang in his ears.
Big Black Cat knew he couldn’t afford to be distracted. He quickly activated the Teleportation Boots and vanished. He continued to rush towards the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass. Having already clashed with the golden humanoid creature twice in the fog, Big Black Cat was resolved. He wouldn’t rest until he obtained the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
「Deep within the fog.」
Aided by the Heavenly Spirit Mirror, Big Black Cat saw the Dragon Lord and over a dozen major demons of the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm engaged in a massive brawl. The battle was extremely fierce, shaking the heavens and earth, sending sand and stones flying. All around them, Ghost Lice prowled, attacking at any opportunity. Although these major demons weren’t afraid of the Ghost Lice, they couldn’t allow the creatures to touch them carelessly.
Big Black Cat seized an opportunity and stubbornly pushed his way past these major demons. A streak of black light flashed past at incredible speed.
The battling major demons realized someone had gotten ahead of them. They immediately stopped fighting and directed all their attacks towards Big Black Cat.
"Damn it, they’re after Old Cat’s hide!"
Big Black Cat hurriedly placed the Black Shield behind him, frantically pouring mana into it. The shield expanded wildly, blocking everything behind him.
RUMBLE! RUMBLE!
A series of violent booms erupted. With over a dozen major demons attacking simultaneously, the Black Shield was battered about in the fog, and the immense force made Big Black Cat spit out a mouthful of blood.
He and Little Cat plummeted rapidly towards the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
Little Cat was in a disastrous condition as well. Just moments before, she had also launched an attack with the Heavenly Spirit Mirror to help Big Black Cat relieve some of the pressure. She too suffered a powerful backlash, violently coughing up blood. Her internal organs felt like they were boiling, and she was gravely injured.
The two of them fell like shooting stars towards the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
Near the Eternal Life Immortal Grass, countless Ghost Lice watched covetously. Four Giant Demon Yam Flowers surrounded the Eternal Life Immortal Grass. Seeing the two rapidly approaching, they unhesitatingly sprayed black, corrosive liquid from their buds. The black liquid blotted out the sky, like four overlapping nets closing in from all directions.
We’re done for!
Big Black Cat roared inwardly, but he was helpless. He had no choice but to hold the Black Shield in front of him.
There was no time to feel sorry for the shield now; he could only rely on it to save their lives.
He poured his mana into the Black Shield again. The Black Shield instantly grew in size, shielding the two of them behind it.
「Above them.」
The dozen or so major demons, including the Dragon Lord, were all chasing them. They absolutely could not tolerate anyone getting ahead of them.
Just as the black liquid was about to land on the Black Shield, a streak of golden light suddenly pierced through the mist. It shot past Big Black Cat and descended directly above the Eternal Life Immortal Grass. From within the golden light, a golden claw shot out, grabbing for the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
With everyone’s attention on Big Black Cat, who was busy dodging the black corrosive liquid sprayed by the Giant Demon Yam Flowers, no one anticipated the golden light would dart in at such an incredible speed. The golden claw seized the Eternal Life Immortal Grass and immediately soared into the sky.
PLOP! PLOP!
The black liquid splashed onto the shield, producing clouds of white smoke.
"Someone has stolen the Eternal Life Immortal Grass! It’s the Golden Winged Roc!" Little Cat cried out shrilly.
Someone stole the Eternal Life Immortal Grass?
Big Black Cat was seething with rage. He had fought tooth and nail, dodging countless attacks, just to get this close to the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
He never imagined that while the snipe and clam fought, a third party—the fisherman—would snatch the prize!
He swiftly put away his Black Shield, mustered all his strength, and activated the Teleportation Boots. Transforming into a streak of black light, he chased after the golden light that was the Golden Winged Roc.
The Golden Winged Roc that stole the Eternal Life Immortal Grass was also a Destiny Realm demon. After entering the Nine Soul Underground Palace, its cultivation had been suppressed to the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm. Thus, when it unleashed its Innate Divine Ability of flight, few from the Demon Clan could match its speed.
But Big Black Cat possessed the Emperor Artifact Walking Boots. After frantically pouring mana into them, Big Black Cat firmly locked onto the Golden Winged Roc.
A streak of black light chased a streak of golden light, an intense pursuit unfolding high above the Black Mountain Range.
Big Black Cat took out another Divine pill and, gritting his teeth, swallowed it. The previous pill’s effects were already wearing thin. He took another. Now, both pills released mana simultaneously, and he channeled all the surging power into the Teleportation Boots.
Little Cat, her face taut, watched the rapidly fleeing Golden Winged Roc ahead and cursed resentfully, "How shameless! Stealing our Eternal Life Immortal Grass!"
Big Black Cat remained silent, his expression grim, as he desperately channeled mana into the Teleportation Boots.
He was somewhat regretful now. If he had refined the Teleportation Boots a bit more, he probably would have caught this Golden Winged Roc by now. But for now, all he could do was hang on tight... Now, it was a test of endurance.
PTOO!
At that moment, Big Black Cat suddenly spat out a large mouthful of blood. The previous combined attack from those dozen or so major demons had severely injured him.
As if by contagion, Little Cat also spat out a mouthful of blood.
Big Black Cat looked at Little Cat, a hint of apology in his eyes.
At the critical moment, Little Cat had also helped to block some attacks. And now, like him, she was severely injured. They were truly ill-fated companions.
I’m several hundred zhang away from the Golden Winged Roc now. Can I use the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye to slightly affect its speed?
Big Black Cat silently calculated.
This distance was a bit too far. He had never used the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye from such a considerable distance before; he didn’t know if his half-baked Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye would work this time.
Heavenly spirits, earthly spirits, Old Master, please bless me! The Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye must work this time!
Big Black Cat chanted inwardly, abruptly drawing a portion of his mana and injecting it into his pupils, unleashing the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye.
「In his mind.」
Hearing Big Black Cat’s heartfelt plea, Ye Yun revealed a faint smile. His eyes moved slightly.
The Purple Rune in Big Black Cat’s pupils reappeared, and a mysterious power surged from his eyes. It instantly struck the fleeing Golden Winged Roc.
The Golden Winged Roc was instantly frozen in midair, its golden pupils becoming dull and lifeless.
"Haha... It worked!" Big Black Cat roared with laughter. The distance of several hundred zhang closed in an instant, and he reached the Golden Winged Roc’s side. He snatched the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass from the Golden Winged Roc’s talons.
"Damn you!" Big Black Cat was furious when he saw the Golden Winged Roc. He was about to take out his Black Shield to smash it but suddenly paused in midair.
This blow probably wouldn’t kill this fellow. But it would definitely snap it out of the Illusion Technique instantly.
Big Black Cat shook his head.
He couldn’t do that. The best approach was to stealthily retrieve the Eternal Life Immortal Grass from the Golden Winged Roc, ensuring it couldn’t identify him as the culprit.
With this thought, Big Black Cat put away his Black Shield and darted off in another direction.
The Golden Winged Roc remained suspended and dazed in midair for several seconds before it regained its senses.
What just happened?
The Golden Winged Roc shook its head. Suddenly, it felt something strange about its talons. Looking down, it found that the Eternal Life Immortal Grass it had been clutching was gone.
"AHH! AHH! Who stole my Eternal Life Immortal Grass?!" The Golden Winged Roc roared at the heavens in fury, wishing he could tear a hole in the sky. He had gone through so much trouble to seize such a perfect opportunity, snatching the Eternal Life Immortal Grass from that perilous melee. Yet, he never anticipated that moments ago, he’d been struck by some unknown Divine Skill that left him completely dazed. By the time he came to his senses, the Eternal Life Immortal Grass had vanished without a trace.

chapters.title: Chapter 199: Accidentally Ingested 9 Leaves of Eternal Life Immortal Grass
chapters.content:
Chapter 199: Chapter 199: Accidentally Ingested 9 Leaves of Eternal Life Immortal Grass
"Is it that Nine-tailed Spirit Cat?"
In the void, the Golden Winged Roc’s face was grim, waves of murderous intent radiating from his golden pupils.
He had just been subjected to a Mental Attack.
According to the information he possessed, the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat Clan should not possess such an Innate Divine Ability for Mental Attacks.
If they did, back in the valley, the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat wouldn’t have let me get the Eternal Life Immortal Grass,
he thought.
Could it be... the Nine-tailed Fox Demon?
The Golden Winged Roc shifted his suspicion to the Nine-tailed Fox Demon, but after a moment’s thought, he dismissed the idea. The Nine-tailed Fox Demon had also been in the valley at the time; her Divine Skills in speed could not compare to his, nor could she have tracked him so far.
Then who on earth could it be?
After much consideration, the Golden Winged Roc still couldn’t figure out who had ambushed him.
However, the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat and the Sky Spirit Cat had been following him closely just moments ago. Now that both had disappeared, they must have seen who stole the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
"I’ll go find those two!" The Golden Winged Roc raised his head and, with a slight flap of his wings, prepared to seek out the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat.
Suddenly, his pupils contracted slightly.
He spotted a cluster of golden light in a valley several miles away. In its center grew an Eternal Life Immortal Grass, emitting a faint, ethereal light.
To lose at sunrise but gain at sunset! What a stroke of luck!
A glint of joy appeared in the Golden Winged Roc’s eyes, and in that instant, he changed his mind about finding the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat.
Now that this mountain range was apparently teeming with Eternal Life Immortal Grass... he should prioritize collecting it.
Having cleared his thoughts, the Golden Winged Roc spread his wings and flew over. Descending into the valley, he snatched up the five-leaf Eternal Life Immortal Grass with a single claw.
After swallowing this Eternal Life Immortal Grass, the Golden Winged Roc flapped his wings and flew off towards other locations.
「Deep in the mountains.」
Big Black Cat, pulling Cat Baby along, descended from mid-air and landed in a safe valley.
THUD!
As soon as he landed, Big Black Cat’s body swayed, and he spat out another mouthful of fresh blood. Cat Baby, right behind him, also coughed up a mouthful of blood.
Both were severely injured. Big Black Cat’s condition was particularly grave, exacerbated by his relentless pursuit of the Golden Winged Roc.
Big Black Cat’s face was pale, drained of all color. His breathing was labored, and sharp pains wracked his internal organs.
"Big Brother, are you alright? I have some Healing Pills here. Why don’t you take one..."
Cat Baby took out a white porcelain vial, poured out two pills, swallowed one herself, and then offered the other to him.
Big Black Cat shook his head, refusing.
What if this pill is poison?
he worried. He had finally managed to snatch the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass; he couldn’t afford any mishaps involving Cat Baby now.
Although he and Cat Baby had faced life and death together, fighting their way through chaos, he still couldn’t bring himself to fully trust her.
Struggling, Big Black Cat sat down on a rock to catch his breath, fresh blood trickling from the corner of his mouth.
It’s a pity I don’t have any Healing Pills, but...
Big Black Cat muttered to himself.
He suddenly remembered that Eternal Life Immortal Grass possessed healing properties, and an idea sparked in his mind. He now had five stalks of Eternal Life Immortal Grass, so his task for the Nine Soul Underground Palace trial could be considered initially completed, though he would need to continue searching later.
But he was seriously injured. He had to heal his wounds before he could search for other Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
With this in mind, Big Black Cat retrieved a stalk of Eternal Life Immortal Grass from his storage ring.
It was a Six-Leaf Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
"Heh!" Seeing Big Black Cat take out an Eternal Life Immortal Grass, Ye Yun chuckled dismissively.
At a time like this? He’s actually picking the lowest quality Eternal Life Immortal Grass to consume? The situation is perilous, and Big Black Cat has already offended many. If he’s to consume anything, it should be the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass,
Ye Yun thought.
His eyes glinted, and he sent out an imperceptible mental command.
This command entered Big Black Cat’s mind, beginning to influence his thoughts.
Big Black Cat seemed dazed for a moment.
He shook his head, holding up the Eternal Life Immortal Grass, and muttered to himself, "The effect of this Eternal Life Immortal Grass seems a bit weak... Should I switch to another one?"
Cat Baby’s eyes lit up, and she quickly urged, "That Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass has the most potent effect, Big Brother! Why don’t you consume it right now?"
"What do you know? The Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass is incredibly rare and hard to come by. Wouldn’t it be a waste if I consumed it myself? This best one should be given to the Sect Leader..." Big Black Cat said, shaking his head.
As he spoke, however, a conflicted expression flickered in his eyes. It seemed his subconscious urged him to consume the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass, but his reason compelled him to refuse.
"Sect Leader? Big Brother, have you joined a sect?" Cat Baby asked with a curious smile.
"Naturally. But don’t ask any more questions. Let’s drop the subject!" Big Black Cat retorted, raising an eyebrow sternly.
Seeing Big Black Cat still stubbornly resisting, Ye Yun’s eyes flashed again, and another mental command entered his mind.
A change flickered in Big Black Cat’s eyes.
"The current situation is dangerous; I should consume a better quality Eternal Life Immortal Grass. Yes, that’s what I should do. It’s the best option right now..." Big Black Cat muttered to himself. As he spoke, he returned the Eternal Life Immortal Grass he was holding to his storage ring and took out the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass.
This Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass, with its nine leaves radiating a faint, ethereal light, illuminated the dim surroundings.
"..."
Cat Baby stared blankly at this Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass, her eyes burning with desire, and her breathing became heavy.
It was impossible not to be tempted.
However, Cat Baby knew she couldn’t take advantage of his weakness at a time like this.
Big Black Cat gazed at the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass, a hint of struggle in his eyes, before finally placing the herb into his mouth.
He closed his eyes and began to refine this Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass.
The moment the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass entered his body, an unimaginable surge of vitality and power erupted.
FWOOSH! FWOOSH!
Big Black Cat’s body began to swell, looking as if he was about to burst.
Cat Baby, watching nearby, jumped in fright. She quickly retreated some distance, staring in horror at the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, who now resembled a taut ball.
The medicinal strength of this Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass is indeed potent...
Ye Yun mused with a faint smile.
The star-like sigils in his eyes flickered. A shadowy sigil projection suddenly flew out and landed in Big Black Cat’s Dantian. In an instant, the rampant power of the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass was subdued.
All this energy was gathered by the sigil into his Dantian, from where it then flowed to all parts of his body, continuously scouring his physical form.
That was so close!
Seeing the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat’s ball-like body suddenly return to normal, a look of lingering fear and relief washed over Cat Baby’s face.
It was a good thing I didn’t try to snatch that Nine-leaf Immortal Herb. If I had, that potent surge from earlier would surely have caused me to explode. After all, I’m only at the Divine Bridge Realm! My physical body is far from strong enough to handle the potency of the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass.
At this moment, Big Black Cat’s physical body gradually became crystalline, exuding a sacred radiance, appearing exceptionally solemn.
"This..."
Cat Baby stared blankly at the black-robed young man enveloped in the sacred light. In that moment, she felt as if she were gazing upon a Spirit.
I never thought there would be a trace of Divine Nature within the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass...
Ye Yun smiled.
Using this trace of Divine Nature to temper his physical body would bring enormous, indescribable benefits to Big Black Cat.

chapters.title: Chapter 200: Fighting the Golden Humanoid Creature Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 200: Chapter 200: Fighting the Golden Humanoid Creature Again
The trace of Divine Nature within the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass was extremely strange.
Ye Yun had found no trace of Divine Nature in the soil of that valley.
Yet, this Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass inexplicably possessed such Divine Nature.
This indicated that someone had deliberately infused this Divine Nature into it.
It seems that this entity isn’t dead; everything he’s doing now is part of his scheme. I’m curious to see what his end goal is...
Ye Yun said with a smile.
Unlike the Red Dust Fairyland, not many members of the Demon Clan had fallen in the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
It seemed the sustenance of the Nine Soul Underground Palace didn’t rely solely on fallen Demon Clan members, suggesting a deeper purpose.
Ye Yun was very interested.
He wanted to slowly savor this performance, to discover what other tricks the mastermind had up his sleeve.
The Big Black Cat should have successfully attracted the attention of the mastermind by now.
Presumably, a series of arrangements and designs will follow.
Ye Yun was eager to see what would happen next.
「Two hours had passed.」
After what felt like an eternity of terrified suspense, Cat Treasure was finally relieved to see the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat open its eyes.
PHEW!
She let out a long breath, only to spray a mouthful of fresh blood.
Already severely injured and having frantically guarded the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, fearing anyone approaching, the combined physical and mental strain brought Cat Treasure to the brink of collapse.
She swayed and fell to the ground.
Seeing this, the Big Black Cat immediately flew over and held her in his arms.
"Your injuries are severe..."
The Big Black Cat glanced at Cat Treasure’s ashen face, devoid of all color.
Thinking of how long Cat Treasure had been protecting him, the Big Black Cat gritted his teeth and took out a Six-Leaf Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
"Quickly ingest this!"
The Big Black Cat held the Eternal Life Immortal Grass to Cat Treasure’s mouth.
"This is too precious, I can’t take it!"
Cat Treasure struggled, trying to refuse.
"Quit the chatter! Just take it when I tell you to. No more nonsense!"
The Big Black Cat glared menacingly at her.
Startled into submission, Cat Treasure swiftly swallowed the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
The Big Black Cat set her on the ground to meditate and refine the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
He sat nearby, half-closing his eyes, assessing his physical condition.
This...
Upon inspecting his body’s condition, the Big Black Cat was startled, his face revealing a look of surprised joy.
The Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass had increased the strength of his physical body by several tens of times.
And the Big Black Cat now had seven tails.
This discovery brought him extreme joy. As a member of the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat Clan, each additional tail meant a substantial increase in power.
SIGH! After the initial joy, the Big Black Cat suddenly opened his eyes, his face clouding over with regret.
"I am such a beast! How could I have consumed the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass? I was saving it for the Sect Leader..."
The Big Black Cat felt deeply guilty, smacking himself twice on the face.
SMACK, SMACK...
Two slaps didn’t seem to be enough, so he continued smacking his own face.
"It was your own greed! This Nine-Leaf Longevity Immortal Grass is of the highest quality; it should have been saved for the Sect Leader..."
The Big Black Cat was overcome with self-reproach.
After a while, Cat Treasure opened her eyes.
After refining the Eternal Life Immortal Grass, all her injuries healed, and her physical body was significantly stronger than before.
"Brother, don’t blame yourself anymore. Perhaps there are other Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grasses in this place. Let’s go look for them now!" Feeling sorry for him, Cat Treasure quickly tried to console him.
"Alright!"
The Big Black Cat nodded; he felt Cat Treasure’s words made sense.
He had been a bit tunnel-visioned just now, assuming that the entire Nine Soul Underground Palace contained only that single Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass.
Then, the pair resumed their journey.
They hadn’t flown far when they discovered a glowing golden light in a nearby valley. Within the light thrived a Six-Leaf Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
"Our luck is heaven-defying!" Looking at the golden light reflected in the Heavenly Spirit Mirror, the Big Black Cat chuckled and immediately flew toward it.
After reaching the airspace above the valley, the Big Black Cat paused. He discovered that near the golden light, the golden humanoid creature was present once again.
This!
The Big Black Cat and Cat Treasure exchanged a glance, their eyes filled with shock.
The golden humanoid creature had found them again.
Why was this happening?
"Once is a fluke, twice is a coincidence, but three times is a pattern," as the saying goes. This was now their third encounter.
Looking down from above, the Big Black Cat asked with a cold face, "You again! Why do you keep looking for trouble with me?"
The golden humanoid creature’s facial features were indistinct. It pointed a finger at the Eternal Life Immortal Grass, then at the Big Black Cat.
"So you’re deaf!" The Big Black Cat sneered. "Are you saying I can only get the Eternal Life Immortal Grass if I defeat you?"
The golden humanoid creature nodded.
The Big Black Cat was speechless.
This creature has fought me multiple times, yet no victor was ever decided. What was it after?
The golden humanoid creature flicked its hand, and a golden Longsword materialized. It leaped into the air and slashed its sword towards the Big Black Cat.
Gritting his teeth, the Big Black Cat poured Mana into his Black Shield and met the attack head-on.
BOOM!
The golden Sword struck the shield, creating a thunderous explosion of sound.
The golden humanoid creature was thrown back once more. It didn’t attack again but used the force of the impact to retreat some distance into the air before vanishing into the Black Mountain Range.
"It ran away again?"
The Big Black Cat was truly exasperated.
What was this guy planning, attacking once and then retreating?
The Big Black Cat shook the Black Shield in his hand. Seeing another sword mark on it, his heart ached.
But he had no choice, as this was the only decent weapon he possessed.
Previously, in the valley, he had used the Black Shield to block the corrosive black liquid sprayed by the Giant Demon Yam Flower, worrying it might be corroded.
But his worries had been unnecessary; the liquid from the Giant Demon Yam Flower hadn’t caused any damage to the Black Shield’s surface.
Instead, it was the golden humanoid creature’s golden Sword that inflicted the most damage.
"Brother, could it be trying to destroy your Black Shield?" Cat Treasure asked from nearby.
That’s a possibility!
The Big Black Cat’s heart skipped a beat, and his expression turned cold.
This golden humanoid creature had battled him repeatedly and had likely sustained some injuries itself. Who knew where it had gone to recuperate? It was possible that its golden Sword had also been affected. When it reappeared, both the golden humanoid creature and its golden Sword would be fully restored...
"How despicable!" Big Black Cat spat in frustration. If this happened dozens or hundreds of more times, the Black Shield Uncle Ma had gifted him would surely be destroyed.
BOOM!
BOOM!
Suddenly, violent rumbles echoed from the distant mountain range ahead.
The Big Black Cat was startled. The commotion was significant, comparable in scale to the earlier battle in the valley involving a dozen or so great demons.
"Can the Heavenly Spirit Mirror see anything?" the Big Black Cat quickly asked Cat Treasure.
"I can’t see anything clearly." Cat Treasure injected Mana into the Heavenly Spirit Mirror but couldn’t conjure the desired image.
"Let’s go check it out!" The Big Black Cat grabbed Cat Treasure, transformed into a streak of black light, and shot forward.
A battle of this scale would, at the very least, be triggered over an Eight-Leaf Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
If possible... perhaps... another Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass has appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 201: Red Blood Earthworm, the 2nd Strain of 9 Leaf Immortal Herbs Appears in the World
chapters.content:
Chapter 201: Chapter 201: Red Blood Earthworm, the 2nd Strain of 9 Leaf Immortal Herbs Appears in the World
A streak of black light broke through the sky from afar, descending above a valley.
Big Black Cat looked down at the entire valley, which was shrouded in black mist. Booming sounds echoed in his ears; it seemed that countless individuals were engaged in fierce combat within the mist.
"The Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass really is here!" Big Black Cat turned his head, a look of both shock and joy on his face as he watched the image displayed on the Heavenly Spirit Mirror in Kitten’s hand.
A stalk of Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass stood perfectly intact on the ground, swaying gently with the breeze and casting a faint immortal glow. Surrounding it were not only a large number of Ghost Lice but also eight Giant Demon Yam Flowers, encircling it tightly.
"Huh, what’s that?" Big Black Cat suddenly noticed some red tubes among the Ghost Lice, wriggling continuously like earthworms.
"Those are Red Blood Earthworms!" Kitten’s expression changed upon seeing the red, tube-like creatures.
"Red Blood Earthworms?" Big Black Cat paused, looking at Kitten in confusion.
"Big Brother, don’t underestimate these Red Blood Earthworms. Although they seem harmless, they’re actually ranked among the top three most bizarre creatures in the Nine Soul Underground Palace!" Kitten hastily explained.
"Are they really that formidable?" Big Black Cat furrowed his brow, looking at the image in the Heavenly Spirit Mirror with an expression of disbelief.
The Red Blood Earthworms are only about ten meters long and half a meter thick, smooth all over, without a single fang. How can they be so frightening? Top three most bizarre creatures? Isn’t that an overstatement?
"The Red Blood Earthworms are said to be undying. They resist fire and water, fear no weapons, and even if cut into hundreds of pieces, they can instantly reform. If one gets close to you, it will burrow into your body, drain all your blood, and devour your internal organs..." Kitten said, her face full of terror.
"That formidable?" Upon hearing this, Big Black Cat’s expression turned grim. He stared intently at the Heavenly Spirit Mirror, contemplating how to seize this Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass.
The difficulty this time is hellish.
After thinking for a few seconds, Big Black Cat had an idea.
This time, it’s not just extremely difficult for me, but for the other members of the Demon Clan too. To get this Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass, even if the Golden Winged Roc came, it would be hard to succeed with a sneak attack like last time.
Big Black Cat landed on a rock, pulling Kitten along with him. He sat down cross-legged, his eyes half-closed, watching the Heavenly Spirit Mirror while beginning to refine the Teleportation Boots.
"Big Brother, aren’t we going to fight for the Eternal Life Immortal Grass?" Kitten urged from the side.
"No need to rush. Let them fight for a while..." Big Black Cat shook his head. While refining the Teleportation Boots, he kept a close watch on the Heavenly Spirit Mirror.
I can’t relax now; I must stay vigilant for any unexpected changes.
「Half a day soon passed.」
The battle in the valley was still as intense as before. The booming sounds were incessant, and the great demons fought so fiercely that the heavens themselves seemed to dim.
A golden figure suddenly sped from the distance, stopping above the valley.
"The Dragon Lord is here!" Kitten cautioned.
Big Black Cat glanced upward, his pupils constricting slightly.
I can’t believe the Dragon Lord, the one I least wanted to see, showed up again.
However, he was no longer afraid of the Dragon Lord. He was now at the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm, and his physical body, having been tempered by the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass, had strengthened dozens of times. If he were to fight the Dragon Lord again, even if he wasn’t his match, he wouldn’t be much weaker.
My speed is something the Dragon Lord can’t possibly match.
After half a day of refining, his control over the Teleportation Boots had improved significantly.
This means I’m even faster now. If that Golden Winged Roc shows up again, I can definitely catch it with the Teleportation Boots.
Dragon Lord hovered in mid-air, looking towards the valley. He quickly discovered the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass within it.
"There’s another one!" A hint of a smile touched Dragon Lord’s grim face. He had thought the previous Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass was unique. It seemed there was no shortage of Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass in the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
"Hm..." Dragon Lord suddenly sensed something and looked in a particular direction. He then noticed a black-robed young man and a red-clad young woman sitting on a rock.
It’s the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat!
Seeing the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, a surge of anger welled up in Dragon Lord’s heart once again."Did you obtain that Eternal Life Immortal Grass?" Dragon Lord slowly approached Big Black Cat from mid-air.
"Dragon Lord, don’t spout nonsense! You saw what happened; it was the Golden Winged Roc that took the Eternal Life Immortal Grass!" Big Black Cat stood up and retorted confidently.
"Is that so?" Dragon Lord stopped about ten zhang away, staring coldly at the two of them with a threatening aura. "This Eternal Life Immortal Grass is not fated for you. Get lost!"
"To hell with you! The heavenly treasures in the Nine Soul Underground Palace belong to those destined to find them. Since when did they become your exclusive property, Dragon Lord?" Big Black Cat’s face hardened as he shot back, showing Dragon Lord no deference whatsoever.
"Are you seeking death?" Dragon Lord slowly raised his right hand, revealing golden dragon claws.
"If you want to fight, then let’s fight! Don’t act so high and mighty just because you’re at the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm!" Big Black Cat sneered.
Hearing this, Dragon Lord’s eyes narrowed, a look of shock flashing across his face. Only now did he realize that the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat before him had broken through to the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm. But he clearly remembered him being only at the seventh layer before.
How did this fellow break through to the tenth layer in just half a day?
Dragon Lord stood silently in mid-air.
This Nine-tailed Spirit Cat is extremely bizarre and mysterious. Even if I go all out, I might not be able to kill him on the spot.
While Dragon Lord hesitated, two more streaks of light flew over from the distance, landing nearby. It was the Nine-tailed Fox Demon and the Golden Striped Black Tiger.
"Well, well, if it isn’t the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat! Enemies are truly destined to meet. Where do you think you’re running this time?" Seeing the two figures in the distance, a thrilled expression appeared on the Nine-tailed Fox Demon’s charming face.
Over the past half-day, she and the Golden Striped Black Tiger had been extremely lucky, obtaining several stalks of Seven-leaf Immortal Grass. The two of them consumed these stalks of Seven-leaf Immortal Grass, and their physical bodies were now even stronger. Consequently, the Nine-tailed Fox Demon felt full of confidence facing the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat.
"Nine-tailed Fox Demon, since you also hold a grudge against him, why don’t we team up and kill him?" Dragon Lord said coldly.
The Nine-tailed Fox Demon was stunned. She hadn’t expected the usually arrogant and proud Dragon Lord to suggest an alliance. Naturally, she was more than happy to agree. "Alright, then let’s join forces and eliminate this scoundrel!" she exclaimed joyfully.
The Golden Striped Black Tiger drew his great saber, and a dense black light erupted from his body.
"Big Brother..." Kitten’s face turned pale, and her body trembled uncontrollably.
"Don’t be afraid!" Big Black Cat chuckled coldly. He suddenly grabbed Kitten’s hand, activated the Teleportation Boots at full power, transformed into a streak of black light, and plunged headfirst into the mist within the Black Mountain Valley.
Dragon Lord, the Nine-tailed Fox Demon, and the Golden Striped Black Tiger—the three great demons—were momentarily stunned.
The valley is fraught with peril. If the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat flees there, won’t he just die even faster?

chapters.title: Chapter 202: Bashing the Nine-tailed Fox Demon Away
chapters.content:
Chapter 202: Chapter 202: Bashing the Nine-tailed Fox Demon Away
"Not good! He’s trying to seize the Eternal Life Immortal Grass!"
The Dragon Lord’s expression changed. Without hesitation, he lunged towards the foggy valley.
"This Nine-tailed Spirit Cat is really cunning!"
The Nine-tailed Fox Demon’s expression fluctuated. Gritting her teeth, she made her decision and charged forward with the Golden Striped Black Tiger.
Inside the black fog, Cat Bao’s voice was low as he stared intently at the Heavenly Spirit Mirror. "Not good! Those three are catching up!"
"It’s fine. It will be amusing to deal with them!"
A cold light flickered in the Big Black Cat’s eyes, and his lips curved into a smirk.
Whether he flew outside or rushed back into the valley, his extreme speed provided by the Teleportation Boots left the three others helpless against him.
The reason for entering the valley was simply to pull these three into the quagmire. He knew that in such a large valley, not only were numerous mighty demons fighting, but many ferocious and bizarre creatures were also lurking.
Over the course of the day, the Big Black Cat had further refined the Teleportation Boots—his speed was now so great that not even a Golden Winged Roc could catch him.
Thus, he was confident in fishing in troubled waters amidst this chaos.
RUMBLE!
Within the fog, ferocious demons were locked in fierce combat, shaking heaven and earth and obscuring the sun and moon.
WHOOSH!
The Big Black Cat swiftly flew past the battling demons, like a flash of black lightning, heading straight for the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
His current plan was to activate all the Ghost Lice and Red Blood Earthworms on the ground, drawing them into the battle.
Otherwise, he would have no way to get his hands on the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass.
"Looking for death!"
A few enraged demons, spotting someone trying to sneak past, immediately unleashed attacks on him.
The Big Black Cat didn’t dare to linger in combat.
He controlled the Teleportation Boots and quickly dodged to the side.
Their attacks missed and, continuing their trajectory, flew unintentionally towards the Dragon Lord who was pursuing the Big Black Cat.
"Despicable!" the Dragon Lord roared in anger.
Seeing the unfavorable situation, he quickly waved his hand, which radiated a golden light. With resonating booms, he scattered all the incoming attacks.
The Dragon Lord swayed slightly as his qi and blood roiled.
This Nine-tailed Spirit Cat has schemed well!
The Dragon Lord breathed deeply, finally realizing the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat’s purpose in escaping to the valley.
Chaos reigned everywhere.
It’s simply impossible to kill the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat in such a place.
The Dragon Lord released his Divine Sense and watched helplessly as the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat circled around in the valley before heading towards the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass once more.
Enraged, the Dragon Lord charged forward.
Behind him, the Nine-tailed Fox Demon also pursued relentlessly. However, her speed was evidently slower than the Dragon Lord’s, so all she could do was trail behind him.
Nevertheless, the Nine-tailed Fox Demon was always ready with an Illusion Technique Attack.
If she could just make that detestable creature lose focus for a split second, she believed, the combined assault of the Golden Striped Black Tiger and the Dragon Lord would annihilate the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
The Big Black Cat darted left and right, breaking through the blockade set by the demons engaged in combat, gradually approaching the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass.
His sudden appearance startled the strange creatures on the ground, which were always ready to seize an opportunity.
WHOOSH! WHOOSH!
Eight Giant Demon Yam Flowers shot long, slender, snake-like golden tendrils upwards, their myriad threads interweaving into an impenetrable net that swept towards him.
"Scram!" the Big Black Cat roared.
He poured a great deal of Mana into the Black Shield. Instantly, it glowed with a black light. The light erupted from the shield and rolled back like a wave.
BOOM!
The golden net was instantly shattered by the black radiance, and its remnants quickly retracted.
Just as he broke the Giant Demon Yam Flowers’ attack, slender, tube-like Red Blood Earthworms, crimson as blood, flew towards him like blood snakes, as fast as lightning.
The Big Black Cat felt a chill crawl up his spine.
These were, after all, one of the three great strange creatures of the Nine Soul Underground Palace!
He didn’t confront them head-on.
Instead, he instantly turned and fled back the way he had come.
At that moment, dozens of great demons, including the Dragon Lord, were chasing him.
"You’re just in time! Let’s team up and kill these Red Blood Earthworms!" the Big Black Cat laughed heartily, accelerating towards the great demons.
The Dragon Lord and the other great demons were taken aback when they saw the Red Blood Earthworms chasing after them.
They naturally understood the terrifying nature of the Red Blood Earthworms.
However, everyone was aware that to obtain the Eternal Life Immortal Grass, they first had to deal with the Red Blood Earthworms; otherwise, no one would have a chance to get close.
Therefore, these great demons had no choice but to brace themselves and attack the Red Blood Earthworms.
The Big Black Cat, on the other hand, swerved in an arc and flew to the other side.
"Nine-tailed Spirit Cat?" a crisp voice suddenly called out from the fog.
The Big Black Cat momentarily felt disoriented.
He knew he had fallen into another of the Nine-tailed Fox Demon’s Illusion Techniques.
Without hesitation, he activated the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye.
The tiny, star-like Purple Runes in his eyes lit up, and a mysterious power swept out, instantly breaking the Nine-tailed Fox Demon’s Illusion Technique.
"Seventh Princess!" the Golden Striped Black Tiger’s anxious voice echoed in the fog.
The Big Black Cat sneered and rushed over. He found the Nine-tailed Fox Demon suspended in mid-air, her expression dazed, while the Golden Striped Black Tiger looked somewhat flustered.
The Big Black Cat seized the opportunity and smashed his Black Shield towards her.
The Golden Striped Black Tiger hadn’t expected the Big Black Cat to attack so swiftly. He lifted his blade to counter, but it was too late.
BOOM!
The Black Shield heavily struck the Nine-tailed Fox Demon, knocking her out of the sky.
A flash of blade light streaked past as the Golden Striped Black Tiger’s attack arrived.
"You blockhead! Trying to kill your own wife? You must have a death wish!" the Big Black Cat laughed heartily, blocking the attack with his Black Shield before quickly disappearing in another direction.
The Golden Striped Black Tiger didn’t chase after him but rushed downwards in the direction the Nine-tailed Fox Demon was falling.
At that moment, the Nine-tailed Fox Demon was surrounded by Ghost Lice.
However, a layer of light rose from her body, forming a protective barrier that kept the Ghost Lice out.
The Golden Striped Black Tiger rushed over, dispersed all the Ghost Lice, then grabbed the Nine-tailed Fox Demon and took to the air.
The Nine-tailed Fox Demon awakened at that moment.
Thinking about what had just happened, she broke out in a cold sweat. Fortunately, she had a life-saving talisman hidden on her, which had saved her in the nick of time.
"We should leave. We’re not getting involved in these troubled waters anymore," said the Nine-tailed Fox Demon.
After several confrontations with the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, and having her Illusion Techniques broken multiple times, the Nine-tailed Fox Demon knew she was no match and began to consider retreating.
After all, there were other Eternal Life Immortal Grasses in this mountain range; there was no need to compete here.
The Nine-tailed Fox Demon and the Golden Striped Black Tiger retreated.
But the Dragon Lord, who was deeply obsessed with the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass, continued to battle the Red Blood Earthworms while searching for an opportunity.
BOOM!
BOOM!
The fight in the foggy valley grew increasingly intense.
The Red Blood Earthworms were indeed worthy of their reputation as one of the top three strange creatures.
All kinds of attacks barely affected them. Even if their bodies were cut in two, they could regenerate quickly. It seemed impossible to kill them.
Once the Red Blood Earthworms went berserk, they began to indiscriminately attack all members of the Demon Clan.
By this point, the great demons in the valley were all inwardly lamenting their suffering.

chapters.title: Chapter 203: To rest and wait for fatigue, fist to claw meet
chapters.content:
Chapter 203: Chapter 203: To rest and wait for fatigue, fist to claw meet
The Big Black Cat darted left and right, trying to find an opportunity to break through.
But after several attempts, all ended in failure.
A few times he was very close to the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass, but was blocked by the Giant Demon Yam Flower, Ghost Lice, and Red Blood Earthworms guarding there.
There was always a small contingent of bizarre creatures loyally guarding the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass.
As the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat was too fast and slippery like a loach, the Dragon Lord couldn’t keep up even if he wanted to. Eventually, the Dragon Lord simply gave up on the idea of hunting him down.
After several failed attempts, the Big Black Cat soared into the sky and left the valley.
He finally understood. No one could succeed at the moment. With those bizarre creatures guarding, it was impossible to approach the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass.
The best approach right now... is to conserve strength and continue refining the Teleportation Boots.
The Big Black Cat speculated that the huge commotion here would attract many Demon Clan powerhouses. The stronger the Demon Clan’s forces, the greater the pressure on those bizarre creatures would be.
Once his Teleportation Boots increased his speed, he would have a chance to fish in troubled waters.
The Big Black Cat settled on a huge stone, sat cross-legged, and started refining the Teleportation Boots. The Sky Spirit Cat quietly guarded beside him, asking no questions.
She held the Heavenly Spirit Mirror, keeping a close eye on the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
Then, several figures flew over from a distance.
Some from the Demon Clan saw the intense battle here and plunged in without hesitation, joining the struggle for the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
However, some Demon Clan members whose cultivation stages weren’t high enough took a few glances at the chaotic scene and left the area.
Other members of the Demon Clan stood guard nearby, ready to seize an opportunity at any moment.
Narrowing his eyes, the Big Black Cat stared at the Heavenly Spirit Mirror while continuously refining the Teleportation Boots. At this point, being anxious was useless.
The difficulty of obtaining this Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass was even more complicated and higher than the previous time; it could be considered an epic-level task.
At this moment, a golden light rapidly flew over from a distance.
In mid-air, it transformed into a man in a golden robe, landing in front of the Big Black Cat.
"Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, long time no see! I didn’t expect you to be hiding here!" the man in the golden robe said with a sneer, looking at the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat.
Opening one eye, the Big Black Cat examined the man before him and responded with a light smile, "So it’s the Golden Winged Roc."
"I want to ask you, who exactly ambushed me that day and stole the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass?" the Golden Winged Roc asked with an indifferent expression as soon as he arrived.
"I couldn’t see clearly; the assailant was too fast..." the Big Black Cat answered, smiling slightly.
He would never admit to such a thing.
Besides, there were no outsiders at the scene; no one would know he was the one behind it.
The Golden Winged Roc’s gaze fell on the Big Black Cat. After a few seconds, he slowly said, "It wasn’t you who did it, was it?"
"Don’t make baseless accusations," the Big Black Cat said indifferently, his eyelids lowered. "Golden Winged Roc, if we truly fight, you might not be a match for me!"
"Really?"
The Golden Winged Roc was taken aback. He carefully looked at the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat.
Suddenly, he was surprised to find that the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, who was originally at the Seventh Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm, had actually broken through to the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm.
What on earth was going on?
Why had the restrictive power within the Nine Soul Underground Palace lessened its effect on him?
If the Nine-Tailed Spirit Cat had also reached the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm, the Golden Winged Roc wouldn’t have the confidence to fight him.
At the same level, they were equally matched.
With that thought, the Golden Winged Roc’s desire to fight the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat was extinguished.
He glanced at the tumultuous battle situation in the valley and suddenly laughed, "Friend, how is it that there’s another Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass below? Aren’t you going to try and snatch it?"
"I tried, but I didn’t succeed," the Big Black Cat shrugged, speaking nonchalantly.
"Hmm..."
The Golden Winged Roc looked again towards the valley. After a good while, he slowly said, "Friend, both of us possess excellent speed and Divine Skills. Why not join forces?"
"Join forces? Are you joking? Do you plan to split that stalk of Eternal Life Immortal Grass and consume it separately?" The Big Black Cat shook his head, a mocking smile on his face.
"If you don’t want to join forces, so be it."
The Golden Winged Roc sneered and suddenly fell silent.
He had only been speaking casually.
This Nine-tailed Spirit Cat was extremely cunning; he wouldn’t trust him.
Now, the battle beneath the valley was extremely intense, with the strange creatures and the great demons fighting each other. He did not want to get involved in this chaos.
「A day passed quickly.」
To seize this Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass, the battle in the valley still raged fiercely.
Some of the Demon Clan had retreated, but some powerful great demons were still fighting.
Although the strange creatures were terrifying, the Demon Clan had a continuous stream of reinforcements joining, and they had killed many of the strange creatures.
As for the Red Blood Earthworms, although they couldn’t be killed for the time being, they were repeatedly cut down, and their healing speed had slowed.
The Golden Winged Roc stood with his hands behind his back, his golden pupils flickering with golden light as he constantly looked for opportunities.
The Big Black Cat had a calm expression, resting with his eyes closed, but secretly, he was desperately refining the Teleportation Boots.
The Sky Spirit Cat beside him was silent, intently watching the Heavenly Spirit Mirror.
This situation is extremely dangerous.
She felt a constant unease, fearing the strange creatures in the valley might rush out.
At this moment, another figure flew over from a distance, transforming in mid-air into a middle-aged man in a grey robe.
He looked around and suddenly spotted the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat and the Sky Spirit Cat sitting on the boulder. As if remembering something, his face turned gloomy.
"Isn’t that the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat?" the middle-aged man stroked his chin and said in a sarcastic tone.
Hearing someone speak, the Big Black Cat opened his eyes and immediately recognized the man.
This person had also been one of those present during the first scramble for the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass.
He was once a great demon of the Destiny Realm, but his current Cultivation Stage was suppressed to the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm.
"What’s your business?" The Big Black Cat’s eyes flashed coldly, his gaze as sharp as two swords as he shot back.
The great demon looked at the Golden Winged Roc again and sneered, "Golden Winged Roc, you snatched a stalk of Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass last time. Are you planning to repeat your old tricks this time?"
"The Eternal Life Immortal Grass in the Nine Soul Underground Palace has always been ownerless. Anyone can snatch it!" the Golden Winged Roc, displeased, stated emphatically.
"Well said!" The great demon sneered relentlessly. Although he was slightly stronger, he was far slower than the Golden Winged Roc.
He was even slower than the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat.
If he wanted to contend for this opportunity, he had to venture into the valley; only then might there be a slim chance for him to grasp it.
Composing himself, the great demon took a deep breath, gave the two a cold stare, and then, with a flash, dashed into the mist.
"Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, it seems many people consider us allies!" The Golden Winged Roc chuckled.
"Who the hell wants to ally with you?" the Big Black Cat retorted grumpily. "Get away from me!"
Seeing the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat acting so arrogantly, the Golden Winged Roc was immediately enraged. He stretched out his arm to grab the Big Black Cat.
His palm suddenly transformed into a golden claw in mid-air, the fine scales on it shining with a golden luster.
WHOOSH!
It swooped down, howling as it approached.
Seeing the Golden Winged Roc actually dare to attack him, rage surged in the Big Black Cat’s heart. He immediately leaped up, swinging a fist to meet the attack.
His physical body had been enhanced dozens of times; he was definitely not weaker than the Golden Winged Roc.
BOOM!
The golden claw and the fist collided in mid-air, producing a massive roar.
The Golden Winged Roc was thrown back dozens of feet before he stopped. Grimacing, he raised his injured hand, watching as blood dripped continuously.
His hand was a mangled mess of flesh, with stark white bone showing through.

chapters.title: Chapter 204: Drawing a Chestnut from the Fire, Acquiring 9 More Immortal Herbs
chapters.content:
Chapter 204: Chapter 204: Drawing a Chestnut from the Fire, Acquiring 9 More Immortal Herbs
"How has the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat’s physical body become so abnormally strong?"
The Golden Winged Roc grimaced in pain. Hovering in mid-air, it looked towards the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, a deep sense of apprehension in its eyes.
Big Black Cat withdrew his fist. Placing his hands behind his back, adopting his master’s demeanor, he looked indifferently at the Golden Winged Roc in mid-air.
After refining his physical body with the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass, Big Black Cat realized that his body had indeed become freakishly strong.
His punch just now had not revealed his true form, yet it had managed to overpower the Golden Winged Roc, which had partially revealed its own.
If he were to reveal his true form as the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, he could perhaps make the Golden Winged Roc’s entire arm vanish with a single slap.
Thinking about this made Big Black Cat immensely pleased with himself.
"Big brother, you’re so powerful now!"
Seeing the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat send the Golden Winged Roc flying with just one punch, a look of admiration appeared in Cat Bao’s eyes.
The Golden Winged Roc Clan was famous on the Cangnan Continent.
They had powerful physical bodies and were proficient in speed Divine Skills.
Its pair of golden claws were comparable to Divine Weapons.
Yet, despite all this, the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat’s punch had managed to injure the Golden Winged Roc’s claw.
This showed just how powerful the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat’s physical body had become.
"I get it, Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, could it be that you’ve stolen the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass?"
The Golden Winged Roc’s eyes bulged as it shrieked hysterically.
It knew what the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat Clan’s physical bodies were like; they definitely could not possess such horrifying strength.
If it hadn’t consumed the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass, this Nine-tailed Spirit Cat could never have developed such a terrifying physical body.
"It seems you’re not that dumb..."
Big Black Cat leisurely walked forward a few steps and arrogantly said, "That Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass was indeed obtained by me. Moreover, I’ve already successfully refined it. Golden Winged Roc, do you still wish to compete with me?"
"I..."
Faced with the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat’s aggressive stance, the Golden Winged Roc was struck speechless.
It wasn’t a fool. Knowing it was no match for the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, it certainly wouldn’t act rashly again.
The Golden Winged Roc recalled the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass, obtained after countless hardships, only for it to have benefited this Nine-tailed Spirit Cat. The thought made it exceptionally furious.
Its heart in turmoil, it coughed up a mouthful of blood.
Big Black Cat just shook his head and sneered at the Golden Winged Roc’s loss of composure.
At this moment, he once again turned his gaze towards the Heavenly Spirit Mirror.
The battle below had now reached a fever pitch, entering a tense stalemate.
Most of the Red Blood Earthworms had been suppressed, and great demons had begun attempting to descend towards the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass.
However, the Eternal Life Immortal Grass was guarded by several bizarre creatures. Coupled with the infighting among the Demon Clan, no one had succeeded yet.
"It’s about time!"
A resolute look appeared on Big Black Cat’s face. He grabbed Cat Bao’s hand, activated the Teleportation Boots, and plunged into the valley’s mist.
When the Golden Winged Roc saw the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat once again making a move for the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass, its expression turned grim. Its body flickered as it began to reveal its true form.
It circled high above the valley, its golden pupils fixed on the unfolding situation below, prepared to launch a sudden attack at any moment to snatch the Eternal Life Immortal Grass again.
The situation was currently too chaotic; it might still have a chance to snatch victory from the jaws of chaos.
This time, it had to seize the Eternal Life Immortal Grass, no matter the cost. Even if it meant burning its Essence Blood, it would shake off all the great demons, find a safe place, and consume the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass.
The Golden Winged Roc believed that once it consumed this Eternal Life Immortal Grass, no one in the entire Nine Soul Underground Palace would be its match.
Big Black Cat, relying on the extreme speed of his Teleportation Boots, charged in. Many of the great demons failed to react in time.
By the time the great demons reacted, Big Black Cat had already neared the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
The bizarre creatures guarding this Eternal Life Immortal Grass immediately pounced on him the moment they sensed an intruder.
Seven or eight Red Blood Earthworms, several thousand Ghost Lice, and golden, thread-like tentacles shot out by eight Giant Demon Yam Flowers.
"Begone!"
Seeing the overwhelming attacks, Big Black Cat let out a heaven-shaking roar of fury, pouring his Mana into the Black Shield in his hand like an ocean.
The Black Shield abruptly swelled, this time expanding to four zhang in size. A fierce black radiance shot out from the shield, sweeping outwards like a black tide.
Now’s the time!
High above the valley, the Golden Winged Roc, which had been circling and soaring, suddenly dived.
With the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat drawing all the fire, it was the perfect opportunity for it to steal the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass.
BOOM!
The wave of black light crashed into those bizarre creatures, emitting a series of deafening rumbles.
The golden, thread-like tentacles were snapped one after another.
The tube-like Red Blood Earthworms were sent flying back, while the Ghost Lice rained down.
Suddenly, a streak of gold light flashed and vanished.
The Golden Winged Roc seized this extremely rare opportunity, burned its full Essence Blood, and lunged fiercely for the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass.
"Kill him!"
In mid-air, Dragon Lord and the other great demons charged towards Big Black Cat.
Is this Golden Winged Roc insane? It’s actually burning its Essence Blood!
Big Black Cat cursed in anger and immediately activated his Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye.
His only hope to stop the Golden Winged Roc now was the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye.
Within his eyes, purple runes surfaced.
Instantly, a mysterious power enveloped the Golden Winged Roc.
At this moment, the Golden Winged Roc was less than ten zhang from the Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
Now in its true form, a full hundred zhang in size, this distance of less than ten zhang was but an instant for the Golden Winged Roc.
Just as the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass was about to be in its grasp, the Golden Winged Roc’s body suddenly froze in mid-air.
Big Black Cat seized the chance, flew over, snatched the Eternal Life Immortal Grass, and stuffed it into his Storage Ring.
"The Nine-tailed Spirit Cat snatched the Eternal Life Immortal Grass?!"
Seeing this, the pursuing great demons were enraged to their core.
Dragon Lord, in particular, began to radiate a golden brilliance.
This time, he even activated his bloodline power as he chased after Big Black Cat.
The fury in Dragon Lord’s heart surged like a monstrous wave.
The Nine-tailed Spirit Cat was far too cunning; it had once again exploited a loophole!
"HAHA... HAHA..."
Big Black Cat let out a maniacal laugh, pushed his Teleportation Boots to their limit, and vanished in an instant.
A Red Blood Earthworm immediately coiled around the Golden Winged Roc’s body, about to suck its blood, when Dragon Lord, who had just arrived, swatted it away with a wave of his hand.
The Golden Winged Roc abruptly regained consciousness.
"What happened?"
The Golden Winged Roc hurriedly looked towards a certain spot, only to find it empty; the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass had vanished without a trace.
Dragon Lord stood beside the Golden Winged Roc, shimmering with golden light like a Spirit, exuding a terrifying pressure.
His fury uncontainable, he roared, "The Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass was stolen by the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat!"
The other great demons also charged over, beating back the Ghost Lice and Red Blood Earthworms that flew at them.
All the demons had grim, unsightly expressions, radiating an extreme gloom.

chapters.title: Chapter 205: Reaping the Rewards, Arriving at Dragon Head
chapters.content:
Chapter 205: Chapter 205: Reaping the Rewards, Arriving at Dragon Head
"This Nine-tailed Spirit Cat is too cunning."
With a gloomy face, the Golden Winged Roc uttered with resentment, "Although I stole the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass last time, the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat ultimately ambushed me and snatched it. Now, after consuming the grass, this creature is even stronger."
Upon hearing the Golden Winged Roc, all the major demons were brimming with righteous indignation.
They could not stomach the fact that the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat had obtained two Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grasses.
At that moment, the undying Red Blood Earthworms again started to gather around, and the Ghost Lice, covering the sky, swooped in.
BOOM! BOOM!
All the major demons struck with hatred, repelling these bizarre creatures once again.
"We have to join forces and kill it!" Dragon Lord was livid and blurted out angrily.
"Okay!" The Golden Winged Roc was the first to respond.
"Let’s go; let’s find the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat!" At that moment, another major demon also announced, full of fury.
Several rays of light rose and promptly left the mist-covered valley.
All these major demons were originally Destiny Realm demons, but their cultivation bases were suppressed to the ninth or tenth tier of the Divine Bridge Realm.
There were several dozen of them.
Under the leadership of Dragon Lord, they set off in a mighty contingent.
However, this team disbanded after just two hours.
Along the way, they again spotted Longevity Immortal Grass.
There were Six-leaf and Seven-leaf varieties, and every demon’s eyes turned red as they started to fight for them.
Even though they didn’t snatch a Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass, seizing Six-leaf or Seven-leaf Longevity Immortal Grasses would greatly aid in tempering their bodies and increasing their lifespans.
