After a fierce clash, the demons gave up on the idea of hunting down the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat.
In any case, the mountain range was vast, and Longevity Immortal Grass lay everywhere—why should they obstinately chase the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat?
Besides, the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat’s speed was astonishing, making it difficult to catch. If they wasted too much time on it, they might even lose the ordinary Longevity Immortal Grasses to others.
All the major demons shared this view, including Dragon Lord.
Eventually, everyone dispersed and started looking for Longevity Immortal Grass individually.
The most vexed was the Golden Winged Roc.
Having been schemed against by the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat twice in a row, he felt an urge to go on a rampage.
"Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, once we get out, I will make sure to kill you!" the Golden Winged Roc coldly declared, then, flapping his wings, vanished into mid-air.
After obtaining the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass, the Big Black Cat flew furiously for four hours before finally stopping in mid-air.
"HAHA..." Catching his breath, he couldn’t help but laugh heartily.
"That was too close! The Golden Winged Roc almost snatched the Longevity Immortal Grass away." Recalling the thrilling battle earlier, Treasure Cat commented, still shaken, from his side.
"That Golden Winged Roc is no match for me! I knew he would try something like that," the Big Black Cat grinned proudly.
"Big brother, your Divine Skills are truly formidable! The Golden Winged Roc fell for your tricks twice!" Treasure Cat smiled sweetly, her voice full of admiration.
After facing life-and-death situations together these past few days, she found the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat increasingly unfathomable.
Especially his mysterious mental attack, which was impossible to defend against.
Snatching two Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grasses from numerous major demons was no coincidence; it symbolized strength.
"The Golden Winged Roc? He’s nothing! If Dragon Lord hadn’t run away so quickly this time, I would have definitely taught him a lesson," the Big Black Cat laughed.
Now, he planned to keep this new Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass securely in his storage ring and never take it out again.
As a demon beast of the Dragon God Sect, he naturally had to curry favor with the Sect Leader.
Seeing Treasure Cat’s admiring gaze, the Big Black Cat was elated. He patted her on the shoulder and said gallantly, "Next time that naive fool comes, I’ll help you teach him a harsh lesson and make him personally call off your marriage arrangement!"
"Really? Oh, thank you so much, Big brother!" Treasure Cat was both surprised and delighted when she heard this.
"HMM!" The Big Black Cat chuckled twice and started to look around again.
Treasure Cat understood and hurriedly took out the Heavenly Spirit Mirror, infused it with Mana, and started searching everywhere.
Suddenly, she spotted a cluster of golden light.
"Big brother, there’s more over there!" Treasure Cat pointed excitedly in a certain direction.
"Let’s go!" The Big Black Cat laughed heartily, grabbed Treasure Cat, and immediately left the area.
In a valley, he found another Six-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass.
Over the next few days, the Big Black Cat and Treasure Cat moved like phantoms, appearing and disappearing throughout the mountain range.
In the end, he had found a dozen or so Longevity Immortal Grasses.
To thank Treasure Cat for her efforts, the Big Black Cat generously gave her one Longevity Immortal Grass.
At this moment, he had nearly twenty Longevity Immortal Grasses in his storage ring.
However, only one was a Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass; the rest were Five-leaf, Six-leaf, and Seven-leaf varieties.
An Eight-Leaf Longevity Immortal Grass was still nowhere to be found.
The Big Black Cat didn’t care much about that. Given his current physical strength, he wasn’t in a rush to consume the Longevity Immortal Grasses.
Initially, his plan was to consume any Longevity Immortal Grasses he obtained after acquiring more than five of them.
However, because he had swallowed a Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass, his physical strength had increased by dozens of times.
The Big Black Cat felt he didn’t need those Longevity Immortal Grasses for the time being.
He thought it better to leave them all for the Sect Leader to handle.
After all, Longevity Immortal Grass was extremely rare and not found anywhere else on the Cangnan Continent. If the Dragon God Sect stored some of these Longevity Immortal Grasses, it would be extremely beneficial to the Sect.
Such a teachable child...
In the Big Black Cat’s mind, Ye Yun sighed in admiration.
Ye Yun had initially intervened to get the Big Black Cat to ingest the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass.
He hadn’t expected the Big Black Cat to refrain from consuming the numerous Longevity Immortal Grasses he obtained later, instead saving them all to hand over to the Sect.
Ye Yun was thoroughly pleased by this.
The strength of a Sect should not be concentrated in one person.
Only with united will can a fortress be built; only then could an Eternal Level Sect be forged once more.
While the Big Black Cat was harvesting Longevity Immortal Grass, the various Demon Clans within the mountain range also made their fair share of gains.
Many Demon Clans lost members to the lethal claws and fangs of the bizarre creatures in the process of harvesting Longevity Immortal Grass.
Though the mountain range was vast, it was not endless.
Slowly, many Demon Clans began to approach the end of the mountain range.
Among all the Demon Clans, the Big Black Cat was the fastest. Hence, he and Treasure Cat were the first to reach the vicinity of the mountain range’s end.
"The mountain range ends here. It seems our trial is coming to an end..." the Big Black Cat sighed, standing in mid-air and looking at the dark, grim mountain peak and the distant ground.
"Big brother, don’t you think this mountain peak looks like a dragon? Especially those two pillars in front—they look just like dragon horns!" Gazing at the black mountain peak from afar, Treasure Cat was suddenly enveloped by a sense of inexplicable dread.
"Yes, I have the same feeling," the Big Black Cat nodded gravely.
Ever since he entered through the Bronze Door, he had felt that these mountains resembled a Black Dragon. Now, having reached the end, the peak before them looked even more like a black dragon’s head.
He grabbed Treasure Cat and flew rapidly forward.
After flying past this mountain peak, the Big Black Cat stopped at a height of ten thousand meters, turned around, and looked back at the menacing peak.
As his vision cleared, his breathing hitched.
This... isn’t this a Black Dragon’s head?

chapters.title: Chapter 206: Ten Golden Terrifying Creatures
chapters.content:
Chapter 206: Chapter 206: Ten Golden Terrifying Creatures
"Indeed, it’s a dragon, a black dragon that has been dead for who knows how many years..."
The Big Black Cat muttered to himself, his demeanor somewhat out of control for a moment.
Once he stepped past the Bronze Giant Door, he had this magical feeling.
Now that he had reached the end of the mountain range, this feeling had actually become a reality.
This incredibly massive Black Dragon Head, gazing up at the sky, its eyes wide open, seemed filled with indignant unwillingness.
It was as if, before death, the Black Dragon wanted to resist something.
"Big Brother, I think this Black Dragon is terrifying...," Kitten Bao stammered, her eyes wide with fear as she trembled beside him.
The Big Black Cat nodded solemnly.
This massive Black Dragon Head, although petrified, still showed scales as black as ink, shimmering with a cold, dark light.
Its expression was majestic, exuding a murderous aura that seemed capable of devouring everything, engulfing all life. Anyone standing before it would feel their heart pound in terror.
"Such an immense size... this dragon was definitely at the Divine Dragon Level when alive. Its cultivation base was unimaginably high..." the Big Black Cat muttered to himself, his expression grave.
"But with such a high cultivation base, why would a Divine Dragon still die?" Kitten Bao asked, her heart pounding with fear.
"How would I know? Anyway, it’s said that a great war occurred in the Ancient Times, and most Divine Dragons perished in that battle," the Big Black Cat snapped, glaring at her. Regarding matters of the Ancient Times, he too had only heard rumors and didn’t know if they were true.
"Big Brother, what should we do next?" Kitten Bao inquired.
"Let’s wait here for a while. I have a feeling this place isn’t so simple; there should be some opportunities here," the Big Black Cat suddenly whispered, a thought flashing through his mind.
Kitten Bao nodded. She also had a strange feeling and was reluctant to leave this place.
The Big Black Cat sat cross-legged, floating in mid-air. He closed his eyes and resumed refining the Teleportation Boots.
Kitten Bao stood beside him, holding the Heavenly Spirit Mirror in one hand and looking around vigilantly, while also helping to guard him.
Ye Yun, in his mind, naturally also sensed that subtle will. He smiled faintly, seeming to understand something. The test wasn’t over yet. He wasn’t in a hurry, nor did he use any Divine Skills to alter this will. He also wanted to see just what kind of tricks the mastermind behind the scenes ultimately intended to play.
「Another day passed.」
Members of the Demon Clan began to arrive one after another. Each Demon Clan member, upon seeing the giant Black Dragon Head, couldn’t help but feel an inexplicable shock.
While shocked, they were also terrified by the murderous aura emanating from the Dragon Head, finding it difficult to control themselves.
However, after arriving, none of the Demon Clan cultivators left.
Everyone felt an imperceptible will in their hearts, seemingly intending for them to wait here quietly for other opportunities to appear.
In short, it was an incredibly profound and mysterious feeling.
Therefore, many members of the Demon Clan also found places to settle down and wait quietly.
A streak of golden light flew over from the distance.
The golden light dissipated, revealing the stalwart figure of Dragon Lord.
"This...?" Seeing the giant Black Dragon Head, Dragon Lord’s eyes were filled not only with shock but also an indescribable awe.
It was a Divine Dragon!
His bloodline throbbed with profound reverence for this Divine Dragon.
Without hesitation, Dragon Lord knelt on the ground and kowtowed three times respectfully towards the giant Black Dragon Head.
A faint light suddenly shot out from the dragon’s eyes, landing on Dragon Lord.
Dragon Lord’s Super Divine Dragon Breath immediately grew stronger.
"What’s this?"
"Why can Dragon Lord receive the baptism of light from the dragon’s eyes?"
"Could it be because he also possesses the Dragon God Bloodline?"
The surrounding Demon Clan members discussed animatedly, their eyes filled with envy.
"Have you noticed? Dragon Lord’s cultivation base has reached the peak of the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm and is just half a step away from the Destiny Realm!" one young Demon Clan member exclaimed in shock.
"It’s true! What on earth was that ray of light just now? It actually elevated Dragon Lord’s cultivation base from the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm to a half-step into the Destiny Realm in an instant?!" another male Demon Clan member said in astonishment.
Everyone discussed animatedly, finding it hard to believe what they had just witnessed.
Another Demon Clan cultivator emulated Dragon Lord, kneeling and kowtowing three times to the Black Giant Dragon, but no light appeared for him.
"Stop dreaming. You don’t possess the Dragon God Bloodline," Dragon Lord said, standing nearby with his hands clasped behind his back, looking coldly at this person.
"Sigh..." The young Demon Clan member sighed and sheepishly retreated to the side.
"HAHA!" The other Demon Clan members roared with laughter.
After this little episode, no one else harbored any covetous thoughts towards the Black Dragon’s skull.
The Nine-tailed Spirit Cat should have arrived by now, right?
Dragon Lord turned, his gaze sweeping the surroundings, and noticed two familiar figures in the distant void.
Who else could it be but the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat?
A sharp, cold light flickered in Dragon Lord’s eyes.
He was pondering... should he fight the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat now? He was now a greater demon at the half-step Destiny Realm, while the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat might have also consumed the second Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass, its physical body further tempered. If he were to fight it now, the outcome would likely be uncertain.
Dragon Lord considered for a moment and decided to temporarily abandon this idea.
This place gave off a mysterious sensation, as if some earth-shattering opportunities were about to appear.
There was no need for him to engage in a life-or-death struggle with the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat just yet.
At this moment, as streaks of light descended one after another, more and more powerful greater demons arrived at this location.
Many of these greater demons had previously contended with the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat for the Eternal Life Immortal Grass, but at this moment, none of them took action.
These greater demons each had their own calculations.
The Nine-tailed Spirit Cat had obtained two Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grasses; its physical body had likely been tempered to a terrifying degree.
Furthermore, the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat’s current cultivation base was also at the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm, and it possessed terrifying speed-related Divine Skills.
If they were to truly fight, they would only be the ones to suffer.
Almost all the greater demons seemed to have a tacit understanding not to seek revenge on the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, treating him as if he were air.
Although he was refining the Teleportation Boots, the Big Black Cat also extended a wisp of his Divine Sense to observe the surroundings.
Seeing that none of the greater demons came looking for trouble with him after arriving, the Big Black Cat felt quite smug.
These fellows think I consumed two Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grasses, which is why they don’t dare to act rashly. HAHA! Truly ridiculous!
One figure after another descended, and the number of Demon Clan members grew steadily.
「Three days passed.」
Beneath the Black Dragon’s head and in the surrounding void, tens of thousands of Demon Clan members had already gathered.
The Big Black Cat was also startled by this scale.
It seemed all the Demon Clan members within the Nine Soul Underground Palace had now gathered here.
At this moment, a faint golden light suddenly erupted from the top of the Black Dragon’s head. Within the golden light, ten golden figures appeared.
"Golden humanoids?!" the Demon Clan cultivators exclaimed aloud.
Many members of the Demon Clan had never seen the golden humanoids before, but the legendary image of these beings was deeply ingrained in their minds.
After all, it was one of the top three most powerful and bizarre existences in the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
But what was unexpected was that ten golden humanoid bizarre creatures had appeared above the dragon’s head.
This was truly terrifying!

chapters.title: Chapter 207: Combined as One, Greatly Enhanced Strength
chapters.content:
Chapter 207: Chapter 207: Combined as One, Greatly Enhanced Strength
"My heavens! How can there be so many?"
Big Black Cat’s heart pounded, a horrified look in his eyes.
One golden humanoid creature was already more than enough to handle. If ten of them appeared, he would have no choice but to flee for his life.
BOOM!
A loud noise suddenly echoed from afar. A huge light shield abruptly engulfed the entire head of the Black Dragon and all the Demon Clan members surrounding it. This sudden turn of events terrified everyone.
Are they trying to trap us like fish in a barrel?
Just when everyone was still reeling from the shock, they suddenly saw the huge mouth of the Black Giant Dragon open. This startled everyone again.
"Is... is the Giant Dragon coming back to life?"
Everyone was scared out of their wits. Even those who were once powerful demons of the Destiny Realm seemed utterly at a loss.
After the Dragon Mouth opened, it suddenly stopped moving.
Then, everyone was stunned to see a massive golden light rising from within the Dragon Mouth. This golden light stretched as high as one hundred feet. A towering Immortal Herb, fifty to sixty feet tall, grew within the golden light. This Immortal Herb was many times larger than any they had seen before, crystal clear, and glowing with a dazzling immortal light.
Surprisingly, this Immortal Herb had grown ten leaves!
The Decenary Eternal Life Immortal Grass!
As soon as they recognized this Decenary Eternal Life Immortal Grass, all the Demon Clan members erupted with excitement. Many powerful demons had seen the Nine-leaf Eternal Life Immortal Grass before.
They thought that was the limit. Who could have imagined a Decenary Eternal Life Immortal Grass would be found inside the Dragon Mouth?
"How powerful would one become after consuming the Decenary Eternal Life Immortal Grass? The increase in lifespan... it’s unimaginable..." Dragon Lord muttered to himself, his eyes burning with frenzy.
「In mid-air.」
Big Black Cat looked at the Decenary Eternal Life Immortal Grass, his breathing becoming increasingly rapid.
Having eaten the Nine-leaf Eternal Life Immortal Grass, he knew what kind of immense benefits it could bring. The Decenary Eternal Life Immortal Grass was a hundred times taller than the Nine-leaf one. That meant its potency had to be at least a hundred times stronger!
Big Black Cat was also tempted. Even though ten terrifying golden humanoid creatures were staring covetously from atop the dragon’s head, he resolved to seize the Decenary Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
RUSTLE...
A familiar sound came from deep within the Dragon Mouth. As soon as the Demon Clan members heard it, their expressions changed.
Ghost Lice? There were actually hordes of Ghost Lice deep inside the Dragon Mouth!
The rustling sound grew louder and louder, starting like a small stream but eventually roaring like a fierce tide. A black torrent erupted violently from the Dragon Mouth, cascading down from mid-air to the ground, and then crawled towards the surrounding Demon Clan members.
"These aren’t ordinary Ghost Lice!" a young demon exclaimed.
These Ghost Lice were a dark red, with horns on their heads. They were larger and looked even more fearsome than the previous ones.
WHOOSH!
Five golden humanoid creatures instantly leaped from the dragon’s head, rushing towards the Demon Clan members.
BANG!
The golden humanoid creatures moved with incredible speed. One of them shattered a young demon with a single punch, and then the five began to wreak havoc among the Demon Clan.
"Kill!"
The powerful demons of the Destiny Realm, who had been observing, could no longer bear it and finally all took action. With these formidable demons leading the charge, the rest of the Demon Clan also joined the battle. Now trapped in the center by a large formation with nowhere to retreat, and facing both the Ghost Lice and the golden humanoid creatures, the Demon Clan could only fight with their backs against the wall. Fortunately, the Demon Clan numbered in the tens of thousands, so they were not necessarily outmatched by those eerie creatures in terms of sheer numbers.
From atop the dragon’s head, one of the golden humanoid creatures once again rushed towards Big Black Cat.
"So, it’s you?" Big Black Cat sneered.
Although the golden humanoids generally looked similar, this one wielded a golden Longsword. It was the same golden humanoid creature that had battled Big Black Cat for several rounds in the past.
Big Black Cat held Kitty in one hand and his Black Shield in the other, bracing himself as he charged forward.
His current cultivation base and physical body were much stronger now; he no longer feared these golden humanoid creatures as he once did.
Mana flooded into the Black Shield, causing it to rapidly enlarge.
BOOM!
The golden Longsword clashed against the Black Shield, producing a thunderous sound. The golden humanoid creature was sent flying backward, but Big Black Cat stood firm and unwavering.
"Haha! You’re no longer a match for me!" Big Black Cat declared, brimming with confidence, as he charged towards the golden humanoid creature with his Black Shield.
This thing ambushed me several times! Now it’s payback time!
WHOOSH!
Relying on his incredible speed, he reached the golden humanoid creature in an instant, raised his Black Shield, and smashed it down hard. The golden humanoid hurriedly raised its Sword to block but was still sent flying back.
BOOM!
The golden humanoid creature crashed into one of the horns on the Giant Dragon’s head. The horn, incredibly robust, deflected the creature, sending it bouncing back.
Big Black Cat pressed his assault, repeatedly swinging his Black Shield and pounding the golden humanoid creature. Seeing Big Black Cat’s ferocity, some nearby Demon Clan members were so terrified that they instinctively moved even further away from him.
「In another direction.」
Dragon Lord unleashed his might, his body radiating golden light as he forced a golden humanoid creature into a steady retreat.
SWOOSH! SWOOSH!
Two more golden humanoid creatures rapidly flew through the air from atop the dragon’s head. One of them fused with the golden humanoid creature Dragon Lord was fighting. The other merged with the one Big Black Cat had been pursuing.
What is happening? These golden humanoid creatures can merge?
Big Black Cat was startled. He immediately smashed forward with his shield without hesitation.
A brilliant sword light suddenly flared.
BOOM!
It struck the Black Shield. Big Black Cat felt an indescribably immense force assault him, and his body was involuntarily knocked back over one hundred feet. The merged golden humanoid creature, however, only retreated a few tens of feet.
"How did it become so strong after merging?" Big Black Cat was aghast. He quickly examined his Black Shield and discovered a large crack had formed on it.
Damn it all!
Big Black Cat was furious.
It looked like his Black Shield was going to be destroyed by these golden humanoid creatures.
With a flash of golden light, the merged golden humanoid creature attacked again. Big Black Cat hastily met the attack, once again using his Black Shield to block the creature’s Sword.
BOOM!
He was sent flying backward once more.
Realizing how formidable the merged creature was, Big Black Cat decided against a direct confrontation and instead turned to flee towards a different area. The golden humanoid creature pursued relentlessly.
As Big Black Cat flew, he observed his surroundings, realizing the area enclosed by the light shield had become a veritable Hell. The Ghost Lice emerging from the Dragon Mouth were incredibly brutal, their combat power exponentially greater than before. Many Demon Clan members with lower Cultivation Stages had fallen prey to the Ghost Lice’s sharp mandibles and fangs. They weren’t just drained into desiccated corpses; the dark-red Ghost Lice were actually devouring the Demon Clan members’ bodies entirely.
Observing this, Big Black Cat felt a chill crawl up his spine.

chapters.title: Chapter 208 Nine Soul Emperor
chapters.content:
Chapter 208: Chapter 208 Nine Soul Emperor
Most of the Demon Clan will die here today...
The Big Black Cat’s face turned incredibly grim at this thought.
If the formation creating the light shield outside remains active, no one can escape.
If they wish to survive, they must annihilate all these terrifying creatures. But, would it be that easy?
That golden humanoid creature was horrifying. It possessed incredibly high defensive power, boundless strength, moved as swift as lightning, and could even merge.
If ten golden humanoid creatures were to combine, wouldn’t they be unbeatable?
The moment the Big Black Cat considered this, his heart grew even heavier.
His body moved like lightning, continuously weaving through the surroundings to lure the golden humanoid creature into chasing him.
His current goal was to lure this golden humanoid creature as far away as possible, then return to the Dragon Mouth and attempt to seize the Decenary Longevity Immortal Grass.
In terms of speed, the golden humanoid creature certainly couldn’t match the Big Black Cat. Therefore, the Big Black Cat intentionally slowed his pace at first.
By the time he traversed the chaotic battlefield and reached its periphery, the golden humanoid creature was still closely pursuing him.
The Big Black Cat turned, raised his Black Shield, and charged, once again engaging the golden humanoid creature in a fierce battle.
Cat Bao’er looked tense. She periodically raised the Heavenly Spirit Mirror, loosing attacks at the golden humanoid creature.
Even with their combined efforts, they were still no match for the golden humanoid creature.
Seeing the situation was unfavorable, the Big Black Cat immediately turned and fled.
This time, he directly utilized his Teleportation Boots at their maximum speed. Like a streak of light, he shot from the distant spot towards the Dragon Mouth.
The golden humanoid creature pursued relentlessly from behind, but it was already too late.
The Big Black Cat saw the Decenary Longevity Immortal Grass in the Dragon Mouth drawing ever closer, and a fervent light flashed in his eyes.
On the dragon’s head, three golden humanoid creatures still stood guard over the Decenary Longevity Immortal Grass.
Seeing the Big Black Cat charge over, two of the golden humanoid creatures immediately moved, one to the left and one to the right, launching a pincer attack.
Haha!
The Big Black Cat laughed inwardly.
It seems these golden humanoid creatures each have independent consciousness. The two in front of me have never fought me; they don’t know how formidable I am. If they were to merge, I naturally wouldn’t be able to break through. But if they don’t merge, I can send them flying!
Victory or defeat hinges on this one move!
The Big Black Cat poured all his Mana into the Black Shield, which instantly swelled against the wind to a size of fifty feet.
The shield, now covered in a layer of black light, smashed towards the two golden humanoid creatures.
The golden humanoid creatures’ fists fiercely hammered down on the black light of the shield.
Following two deafening booms, the black light was instantly repelled.
The two golden humanoid creatures were sent flying by an immense force.
Now is the time!
Without hesitation, the Big Black Cat rushed towards the Decenary Longevity Immortal Grass.
"Such a despicable Nine-tailed Spirit Cat!" the Dragon Lord, who had been observing the Decenary Longevity Immortal Grass from afar, roared angrily and launched a long-range attack.
Seeing this, Cat Bao’er immediately poured all her Mana into the Heavenly Spirit Mirror without hesitation.
A brilliant white pillar of light shot towards the Dragon Lord’s attack.
BOOM!
The white pillar of light was instantly shattered, and the Dragon Lord’s attack continued towards the Big Black Cat.
However, it was slightly off-target, and the Big Black Cat dodged it with a swift movement.
This beam of light struck the Dragon Mouth, emitting a deafening roar before vanishing.
At this moment, the Big Black Cat finally neared the Decenary Longevity Immortal Grass.
He decisively reached out his large hand, grabbing for the Decenary Longevity Immortal Grass within the golden light.
The moment he touched the Decenary Longevity Immortal Grass, it suddenly erupted with a blinding golden light, enveloping both him and Cat Bao’er.
Not good!
The Big Black Cat’s heart skipped a beat.
Seizing the Nine-leaf Longevity Immortal Grass wasn’t like this before. Could this Decenary Longevity Immortal Grass be a fake?
A wave of dizziness washed over him, as if he had experienced spatial travel.
「The next moment.」
The Big Black Cat found himself in a gloomy grand hall.
"Big Brother, there’s no Decenary Longevity Immortal Grass. I think we’ve been tricked..." Cat Bao’er said nervously, looking around the cold, grand hall.
The air in this place was permeated with a cold, decaying aura, making her extremely uncomfortable.
"Damn it! We’ve really been tricked! I knew I shouldn’t have competed for this Decenary Longevity Immortal Grass..." the Big Black Cat said with annoyance, slapping his forehead.
From the gloomy grand hall, a golden figure slowly walked out.
"Although there’s no Decenary Longevity Immortal Grass, a better inheritance awaits you, Nine-tailed Spirit Cat!" The golden figure walked out from the darkness, its entire body radiating immense light, dispelling the boundless darkness. In an instant, the entire grand hall became magnificently brilliant.
The Big Black Cat was startled. This golden figure opposite him was enveloped in golden light, making its appearance unclear, extremely similar to the golden humanoid creatures. Yet, there was a slight difference. This golden figure could speak human words; the previous ones could not.
「In his mind.」
Ye Yun opened his eyes and smiled faintly, remaining composed. He didn’t act, wanting to see what this fellow planned to do...
Just as the golden figure uttered the first word of its sentence, the Big Black Cat suddenly sensed something strange beside him.
He turned his body and found that Cat Bao’er had fainted. The Big Black Cat was alarmed and quickly supported Cat Bao’er’s body with his other hand.
"Sir, what exactly do you intend to do?" the Big Black Cat asked, mustering his courage.
He knew he was no match for this mysterious golden figure. But things having come to this, he absolutely could not show weakness.
"She is merely an unrelated passerby. It’s better she doesn’t know about the matters I am about to discuss with you," the golden figure said with a faint smile.
"Very well!" The Big Black Cat took a deep breath, staring intently at the golden figure, and said in a deep voice, "Who exactly are you, sir?"
"I am the Nine Soul Emperor, master of the Nine Soul Underground Palace!" the golden figure announced proudly.
"The Nine Soul Emperor?" The Big Black Cat blinked. He had never heard of such a figure.
"If you accept my inheritance, I will naturally tell you about many mysteries..." the golden figure said with a smile.
The Big Black Cat, feigning composure, asked, "Why offer me an inheritance? Your esteemed self is already so powerful; why must you find an inheritor?"
"Because I am about to die, and I need you to make a trip to the Divine Land..." the golden figure said nonchalantly.
Divine Land?
The Big Black Cat’s heart skipped a beat.
Where is that? How come I’ve never heard of it?
"Before you accept my inheritance, let me ask you one thing: do you belong to a Sect?" the golden figure asked solemnly.
"Naturally, I do," the Big Black Cat replied without hesitation.
"On the Cangnan Continent, which sect or faction?" the golden figure asked again, its gaze fixed on the black-robed Demon Clan youth before it.
"I am from the Dragon God Sect!" the Big Black Cat declared proudly.
"What? The Dragon God Sect?" The golden figure’s voice suddenly changed, laced with a heaven-shaking fury.

chapters.title: Chapter 209: The 250th Sect Master, Dragon Xuan
chapters.content:
Chapter 209: Chapter 209: The 250th Sect Master, Dragon Xuan
At that moment, Big Black Cat was completely dumbfounded. He didn’t understand why his mention of the Dragon God Sect would enrage the Nine Soul Emperor to such an extent.
Ye Yun was also slightly taken aback. He hadn’t expected that the Nine Soul Emperor, reputed to be a God Man, would have such a strong reaction after hearing the name Dragon God Sect.
Logically, the Dragon God Sect should never have had any contact with this Nine Soul Emperor. At least Ye Yun, the thirteenth Sect Master, was completely unaware of this Nine Soul Emperor.
In his memory, even the founder of the Dragon God Sect had no connections with the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
It seems that there’s a secret hidden here unknown to outsiders...
Ye Yun smiled faintly and immediately took action.
Big Black Cat’s consciousness vanished instantly. His wisp of Primordial Spirit took control of Big Black Cat’s body. Big Black Cat’s own consciousness fell into a deep slumber.
Regarding the secrets of the Dragon God Sect, Ye Yun didn’t want Big Black Cat to know too much; the more he knew, the heavier the burden he would carry. These younger members were far from capable of shouldering such a heavy responsibility.
So, Ye Yun took control of Big Black Cat to converse with the Nine Soul Emperor before him.
"Excuse me, is there anything wrong with the Dragon God Sect?" Ye Yun said softly.
The Nine Soul Emperor, agitated, failed to notice the subtle change in Big Black Cat’s tone of speech.
"Anyone from the entire Cangnan Continent is acceptable, except for someone from the Dragon God Sect! You are disqualified. I will find a new successor from the Demon Clan outside," the Nine Soul Emperor said angrily.
"Why?" Ye Yun shrugged, feigning unwilling complaint. "I’ve endured so much to get here; surely I deserve a reason?"
The Nine Soul Emperor fell silent. After a few moments of thought, he finally seemed to decide and slowly said, "There’s no harm in telling you."
"I’m all ears," Ye Yun said in a deep voice.
"Ten thousand years ago, when the Nine Soul Underground Palace opened, do you know who it was that ultimately triumphed and received my inheritance?" the Nine Soul Emperor asked in anger.
"I don’t know. Does it have anything to do with the Dragon God Sect?" Ye Yun blinked innocently.
He suddenly found this intriguing—could it be that a successor of the Dragon God Sect had won when the Nine Soul Underground Palace opened ten thousand years ago? But Luo Li and the others didn’t know about it.
Ye Yun looked at the Nine Soul Emperor with keen anticipation, waiting for him to continue.
"Correct. That man was from the Dragon God Sect. He was an insidious and cunning fellow who deceived me and betrayed my trust, leaving me to wait in vain for tens of thousands of years," the Nine Soul Emperor said indignantly.
As he spoke, his Super Divine Dragon Breath became unstable, the golden light emanating from him pulsed, causing the entire hall to flicker in brightness.
"You must be mistaken, Sir. People of My Divine Dragon Sect are always forthright and honorable, true to our word. We would never deceive you."
Hearing the Nine Soul Emperor disparage a descendant of the Dragon God Sect in such a way, Ye Yun, this old ancestor, felt his own face flush. He couldn’t help but retort.
"I don’t care about the others from the Dragon God Sect, but this fellow Long Xuan is definitely no good! You are from the Dragon God Sect; do you have no recollection of this Long Xuan? What position does he hold in the Dragon God Sect?" The Nine Soul Emperor stared at Ye Yun and fired off a series of questions.
He also hoped to learn more about Long Xuan’s actions through this descendant of the Dragon God Sect.
Hearing the Nine Soul Emperor’s words, Ye Yun was momentarily stunned.
The name ’Long Xuan’ suddenly surfaced in his mind.
The 250th Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect.
He once offended an incredibly powerful faction, causing the descendants of the Dragon God Sect to be hunted for over forty generations.
One could say he was a pariah in the annals of the Dragon God Sect.
What Ye Yun hadn’t expected was that, tens of thousands of years ago, Long Xuan had actually entered the Nine Soul Underground Palace and, by some fortuitous coincidence, obtained the Nine Soul Emperor’s inheritance. However, according to Luo Li, Long Xuan had already died. Having obtained the Nine Soul Emperor’s inheritance, how could Long Xuan have perished so easily? Who in the world was his opponent?...
A moment of silence followed.
Ye Yun thought for a moment and said, "Long Xuan was the 250th Sect Master of My Divine Dragon Sect. He once offended a formidable power and has long since perished."
"What?"
"You said he perished? How is that possible?"
"That fellow Long Xuan was devious and exceptionally talented. Ten thousand years ago, he endured unimaginable bloody battles within the Nine Soul Underground Palace to emerge victorious and ultimately qualify for the inheritance. How could such a person die so easily!"
The Nine Soul Emperor roared angrily, repeatedly waving his fists in mid-air.
He seemed unable to accept the news of the death of his successor, Long Xuan.
In his impression, Long Xuan was a peerless prodigy, exceptionally gifted and possessing a mind as sharp as a demon’s. It was inconceivable that such an individual, especially after receiving his inheritance, could die so easily.
On the Cangnan Continent, no one should have been Long Xuan’s match.
"He has indeed perished. I have no need to deceive you. It is precisely because he provoked a powerful enemy that the successive Sect Masters of My Divine Dragon Sect have been relentlessly hunted..." Ye Yun sighed softly.
That blasted Long Xuan! The Dragon God Sect’s own inheritance was already exceedingly formidable, and he then obtained the Nine Soul Emperor’s inheritance as well. Long Xuan should have soared to prominence. How on earth did he die?
The Nine Soul Emperor fell silent. He was silently processing the information Ye Yun had given him.
Impossible... That fellow Long Xuan absolutely cannot be dead...
After a moment, the Nine Soul Emperor lifted his head again, his voice laced with a hint of madness.
With a wave of his hand, seven points of light descended from the void above him, each resembling a star.
These seven points of light instantly formed the shape of the Big Dipper.
"What are you going to do?" Ye Yun asked in a deep voice.
This Big Dipper arrangement felt somewhat familiar, yet it was entirely different from the Seven-star formations he had encountered before.
"I am going to divine whether Long Xuan is still alive or not," the Nine Soul Emperor said solemnly.
Ye Yun said no more.
This Nine Soul Emperor’s Divine Nature had already decayed to such a state, yet he still intended to perform such a heaven-defying fate-calculation Divine Skill. Isn’t he courting death? He probably won’t live much longer after this divination.
Ye Yun didn’t intervene. If this fellow wanted to perform the divination, then let him.
Ye Yun was also eager to know the result.
That Long Xuan... having received the dual inheritances of the Dragon God Sect and the Nine Soul Emperor, Ye Yun too felt he shouldn’t have perished so easily.
The mysterious Big Dipper formation began to operate.
The Nine Soul Emperor continuously infused golden divine energy, and the Big Dipper formation started to emit a faint golden light.
Ye Yun nodded to himself.
This Nine Soul Emperor was truly worthy of once being a God-like figure.
This Great Divine Power of divination was truly astounding.
As time slowly passed.
WHOOSH!
A dazzling light erupted from the Seven-star formation, coalescing into an illusory figure in mid-air.
It was an indistinct figure, only its back visible.
His face was obscured by a mask, making it impossible to discern his true appearance.

chapters.title: Chapter 210: Dragon Xuan is not Dead, Nine You Collapses
chapters.content:
Chapter 210: Chapter 210: Dragon Xuan is not Dead, Nine You Collapses
Ye Yun squinted slightly, eyeing the figure of the man.
He suddenly found the figure to be incredibly familiar. When the dim-witted pair of the Big Black Horse and Big Black Cat went to the Dragon God Sect to explore, they found an ancient painting in the deepest part of the Treasure Pavilion. A man’s silhouette was depicted in that painting. The silhouette of the man in the painting unexpectedly bore a striking resemblance—nine-tenths similar—to the silhouette of the man standing before him.
Could the man in the painting be the 205th Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, Dragon Xuan?
Just as that thought crossed his mind, he saw the silhouetted figure abruptly turn around, his merciless, cold eyes locking onto the Nine Soul Emperor.
"You’re still alive, Dragon Xuan?" the Nine Soul Emperor gasped, staring at the man before him.
BANG!
The next moment, the Nine Soul Emperor’s rotting, golden body, under the masked man’s gaze, suddenly exploded, scattering like fireworks throughout the entire hall.
The light of the Seven Star Grand Array began to dim. The masked man bowed his head and, as the light weakened, he suddenly disappeared.
Witnessing this sudden and utterly unexpected event, Ye Yun struggled to believe what he was seeing.
Without a doubt, according to the Nine Soul Emperor’s dying words, the masked man was indeed the 205th Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, Dragon Xuan.
「Ten thousand years had passed.」
This guy was actually still alive! Just one glance from his phantom image, and the Nine Soul Emperor’s body had exploded. So powerful!
Ye Yun mentally tagged Dragon Xuan with this description.He could not discern Dragon Xuan’s cultivation base from the phantom image. But Dragon Xuan had inherited the legacy of the Nine Soul Emperor and, surprisingly, could use the same Divine Skills to attack him.
It had to be said: the 205th Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, Dragon Xuan... was truly formidable. The student had indeed surpassed the master.
Gazing at the vast hall plunging back into darkness, Ye Yun, standing in the shadows, contemplated everything, a spark of light flickering in his eyes.
Dragon Xuan was actually still alive. This was clearly different from what Luo Li and the others knew. Not only was he still alive, but his Divine Skills seemed earth-shattering. If he were to show up in the Cangnan Continent, even the Eternal Level sects would not dare to trouble him.
But why didn’t he dare to return? Could it be that he provoked an unfathomable enemy?
Thinking of the mastermind targeting the Dragon God Sect, Ye Yun’s face turned grim. For that mastermind to make Dragon Xuan so wary, his backing was unimaginably formidable.
"Regardless, Dragon Xuan, your performance leaves much to be desired. As the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, you are perfidious. You inherited the Nine Soul Emperor’s legacy but never returned, allowing the disciples of later generations of the Dragon God Sect to be displaced and live wandering lives. You are not a qualified Sect Master..." Ye Yun chuckled lightly, muttering to himself.
As the thirteenth-generation Ancestor, Ye Yun would not forgive this traitor, Dragon Xuan.
Although the Nine Soul Emperor was dead and Ye Yun hadn’t obtained more information, the Nine Soul Emperor had once said that after Dragon Xuan inherited his legacy, he promised to make a trip to the Divine Land.
It seems Dragon Xuan must be living a carefree life in the Divine Land. After ten thousand years, given Dragon Xuan’s monstrous talent and the resources he commands, his current cultivation base might not be inferior to what the Nine Soul Emperor’s was in his prime.
This meant Dragon Xuan’s cultivation base might have already reached the Divine Sovereign Realm—a bit higher than my own.
Interesting. The figures appearing around the Dragon God Sect are becoming more and more intriguing. Once I’ve settled things here in the Cangnan Continent, I will head to the Divine Land to take a look...
With his decision made, Ye Yun felt a weight lift from his heart.
He glanced outside. With the death of the Nine Soul Emperor, those golden, human-shaped creatures had long since vanished.
The golden human figures in the hall were condensations of the Nine Soul Emperor’s residual Divine Nature. As for the Nine Soul Emperor’s true body, it had already transformed into this Secret Realm.
And this Evil Phantom Dragon from the Ancient Times, residing within the Secret Realm, was akin to being inside the Nine Soul Emperor’s body. It was as if the Nine Soul Emperor had used a supreme Secret Technique to forcefully trap this Evil Phantom Dragon within his own body.
The Eternal Life Immortal Grass growing within the Nine Soul Underground Palace was simply a condensation of the life essence from the Evil Phantom Dragon’s body after its death. As for the two unique Nine-Leaf Longevity Immortal Grass, they were infused with energy from his Divine Nature by the Nine Soul Emperor for the purpose of selecting an heir. The other Eternal Life Immortal Herbs, however, did not possess such energy from Divine Nature.
When the Dragon Lord had kowtowed to the Evil Phantom Dragon, a ray of light had significantly weakened the restrictive power on him. At that time, Ye Yun had noticed that this Evil Phantom Dragon still retained a slight trace of consciousness.
Now that the Nine Soul Emperor was completely dead, the Evil Phantom Dragon was the only remaining source for potential clues. A divine white light suddenly emerged in the dim hall, forming Ye Yun’s illusory Prime Soul Body.
The Big Black Cat stood rooted to the spot, while Little Gem lay on the ground. Ye Yun paid them no heed.
He raised his gaze, his eyes sparkling with a strange light as he scanned his surroundings. He was searching for that tiny remnant of the Evil Phantom Dragon’s consciousness.
After a few seconds, Ye Yun’s form abruptly vanished. The next moment, he appeared within the internal space of the black dragon’s head.
Within this space was a black, light-radiating sphere. Its surface was also engraved with runes, seemingly sealing something within.
Ye Yun activated his Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye. The layers of sealing runes peeled off one by one, eventually vanishing completely. He took a step forward and, in the next instant, appeared inside the sphere.
A weak black Dragon Shadow lay on the ground, impaled by a Little Sword. Ye Yun stood beside the Dragon Shadow, his gaze fixed on the Little Sword.
The Little Sword was as black as ink and of extraordinary quality, having reached the Lower Emperor-grade. It was this very sword that had pinned the Evil Phantom Dragon’s Primordial Spirit, causing it to grow increasingly weak. After hundreds of thousands of years, only a trace of consciousness remained, on the verge of collapse.
Ye Yun reached out and pulled the Little Sword free. The black Dragon Shadow suddenly stirred, coiling and circling around Ye Yun.
"You... you saved me?" the Evil Phantom Dragon asked, looking at the spiritual projection before it, its eyes wide with disbelief. The outer Seal had been personally placed by the Nine Soul Divine Sovereign; without a Divine Sovereign Realm cultivation base, it was impossible to break. Yet, this young man had broken it. To do so with merely a projection of his Prime Soul Body... his strength was truly terrifying.
"It seems you don’t have much longer to live either. I have a few questions for you..." Ye Yun said, his gaze sweeping over the Evil Phantom Dragon’s weakened form, a slight sigh escaping him. Once this Little Sword was removed, the wisp of the Evil Phantom Dragon’s remaining Primordial Spirit would soon dissipate.

chapters.title: Chapter 211: The Ancient Mystery of Cangnan Continent
chapters.content:
Chapter 211: Chapter 211: The Ancient Mystery of Cangnan Continent
"I don’t know much. My memory, because of this sword, is already fragmented..."
The Evil Phantom Dragon sighed, its gaze fixed on the sword in Ye Yun’s hand, deeply melancholic.
Ye Yun nodded.
This sword was not ordinary. The one wielding it was the Nine Soul Emperor. It not only pinned the Evil Phantom Dragon’s Primordial Spirit but also shattered its memory.
Ye Yun had seen such methods many times.
This indicated that an invisible hand was attempting to conceal something behind the scenes.
But the Evil Phantom Dragon was a Divine Dragon from the Ancient Times; the time separating it from the Dragon God Sect was too vast. Could the mastermind behind it all truly be the same person?
Many thoughts flashed through Ye Yun’s mind. He looked at the Evil Phantom Dragon, sighed, and said, "The Nine Soul Underground Palace appeared on the Cangnan Continent hundreds of thousands of years ago. This means you’ve been dead for hundreds of thousands of years. Tell me everything you know..."
"Has it really been hundreds of thousands of years?"
The Evil Phantom Dragon was shocked. Sealed in this place, it had lost all perception of time’s passage.
Ye Yun nodded.
The Evil Phantom Dragon, appearing somewhat desolate, spoke in a deep voice, "The Cangnan Continent you mentioned was actually called the Dragon Hidden Continent in the Ancient Times. Back then, the continent was inhabited by countless Divine Dragons, all led by the Ancestor Dragon, residing on this continent..."
"Did a thrilling battle occur afterward, leading to the extinction of all the Divine Dragons?" Ye Yun asked, his heart skipping a beat.
"The Dragon Clan on the Dragon Hidden Continent was incredibly powerful. The cultivators from outside the Divine Land, to some extent, dared not engage us in battle. Our two great powers coexisted peacefully."
"However, one day the Ancestor Dragon suddenly disappeared, and no one knew where it had gone. The Ten Super Divine Dragons began to infight, sparking a war among the Divine Dragons."
"I was still young at the time; many specific events are unclear. Later, because I committed an error, I was imprisoned in the Ten Directions Dragon Prison."
"After a million years, the restrictions of the Ten Directions Dragon Prison vanished, and I escaped. Only then did I discover that almost all Divine Dragons were extinct. Heartbroken, I began a rampage of wanton killing across the continent, causing life to wither..." the Evil Phantom Dragon said faintly.
"So, the Nine Soul Emperor descended to the Dragon Hidden Continent to kill you?" Ye Yun asked.
"Yes, the Nine Soul Emperor descended to the Dragon Hidden Continent from outside the Divine Land. We fought for ten thousand years, with no clear victor. Later, he somehow found this Dragon Slaying Sword, pinned my Primordial Spirit, and cast an unimaginable Divine Skill. He sealed me within his own body, and we were fated to perish together..."
The Evil Phantom Dragon paused, looked at Ye Yun, sighed, and said, "That’s all I know. Many secrets seem to have disappeared. But I have a feeling that the Ancestor Dragon’s disappearance is connected to a shocking secret..."
"I see!"
Ye Yun nodded.
Suddenly, he reached out with his other hand and grabbed the Evil Phantom Dragon.
"What are you doing?" the Evil Phantom Dragon asked in horror.
Its fragmented Primordial Spirit was so weak that it was definitely no match for this mysterious young man before it.
"Letting you live a little longer..."
Ye Yun took out a piece of Soul Nurturing Wood and attached the strand of Primordial Spirit to it.
The Evil Phantom Dragon’s nearly dispersed Primordial Spirit immediately stabilized.
Within Ye Yun’s demonic eyes, tiny, rune-like constellations began to appear again, resembling the birth and death of stars in the cosmos.
At this moment, he activated the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye once more, putting the Evil Phantom Dragon directly into a deep sleep. Simultaneously, Ye Yun accessed the Evil Phantom Dragon’s memories.
Everything was indeed as the Evil Phantom Dragon had said – it hadn’t lied.
In the Evil Phantom Dragon’s fragmented memories, Ye Yun witnessed the magnificent and vast spectacle of the Ancient Times.
The Dragon Hidden Continent of the Ancient Times was vastly larger than the current Cangnan Continent—countless times so. Numerous Divine Dragons inhabited different regions of the continent.
Some dwelled high above the sky, others atop mountain peaks, some lurked in the depths of the sea, and still others resided in the centers of great lakes.
The Ancestor Dragon’s cultivation base had reached God Emperor’s Peak.
Beneath the Ancestor Dragon, each of the Ten Super Divine Dragons possessed astounding cultivation bases, all having reached the Divine King Realm.
As for other powerful Divine Dragons, most had nearly reached the Divine Sovereign Realm.
Before the Evil Phantom Dragon was imprisoned in the Ten Directions Dragon Prison, its cultivation level had also reached the Divine Sovereign Realm.
It could be said that the God Dragon Clan of the Ancient Times was unimaginably strong.
The Dragon Hidden Continent of that era also possessed an unimaginable abundance of Spiritual Energy.
But all of this changed due to the Ancestor Dragon’s disappearance and the infighting among the Ten Super Divine Dragons, ultimately leading to a world-shattering war.
This caused the entire Dragon Hidden Continent to shrink by a factor of millions, and its Spiritual Energy was no longer as rich as before.
It’s a pity. The Evil Phantom Dragon was locked in the Ten Directions Killing Prison and didn’t know much. Otherwise, I could have learned more secrets about the cataclysmic event of that year...
Ye Yun sighed and placed the piece of Soul Nurturing Wood back into his storage space.
This remnant strand of the Evil Phantom Dragon’s Primordial Spirit might be useful later, so he decided to keep it for now.
As for its body, it had already petrified and was of no use.
At this moment, Ye Yun looked outside.
With the death of the Nine Soul Divine Sovereign, the Secret Realm of the Nine Soul Underground Palace also underwent a sudden change.
The members of the Demon Clan who were fighting were all suddenly transported out.
A series of deafening booms followed.
This space began to destabilize, threatening to collapse at any moment.
The strange creatures within the space darted about chaotically, attempting to break out of this Miniature World.
Ye Yun waved his hand, and the entire space immediately stabilized again.
He couldn’t allow the bizarre creatures from the Nine Soul Underground Palace to escape into the Cangnan Continent; otherwise, it would trigger an unimaginable catastrophe.
In a flash, Ye Yun returned to the main hall and re-entered the Big Black Cat’s body.
Controlling the Big Black Cat’s body, he grabbed the Spirit Cat and left the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
When he emerged outside the Nine Soul Underground Palace, many members of the Demon Clan were standing around, gazing at the Nine Soul Underground Palace in shock.
「In the carriage.」
Ye Yun formed a spell with his hands, sending it into the void.
This spell landed upon the Nine Soul Underground Palace, immediately forming a seal.
The projection of the Nine Soul Underground Palace in the sky vanished.
With a thunderous rumble, the Nine Soul Underground Palace sank deep into the earth.
Henceforth, it was sealed for eternity, never to appear in this world again.
Ye Yun’s Primordial Spirit once again fell silent.
The Big Black Cat regained its own consciousness. Looking at the familiar surroundings, it was stunned.
"What happened?"
MEOW. The Spirit Cat also slowly woke up at this time.
"Big Brother, weren’t we in a large hall? How were we suddenly transported outside?" the Spirit Cat asked, bewildered.
"How would I know?"
The Big Black Cat also felt helpless. It felt as if it had just had a long dream, in which it went somewhere and saw a vague, golden figure.
That golden figure seemed to have said something to it, but the Big Black Cat couldn’t recall what.
"Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, did you obtain that stalk of Decenary Longevity Immortal Grass?"
At this moment, the Dragon Lord strode over, gazing coldly at the Big Black Cat as he questioned it.

chapters.title: Chapter 212: Surrounded by Monsters, Master Save Me
chapters.content:
Chapter 212: Chapter 212: Surrounded by Monsters, Master Save Me
The Dragon Lord had barely spoken when, with a sudden stir, all the Demon Clan members cast their gazes down.
That’s right!
Back then, most of the Demon Clan had seen the Decenary Eternal Life Immortal Grass in the Dragon Lord’s mouth, but it had been snatched away by the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat.
It then vanished in a flash of light, its whereabouts unknown to anyone.
The Dragon Lord’s words were like a stone dropped into a calm lake, stirring indignation among everyone present.
All the Demon Clan members stared intently at the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, as if trying to discern the truth.
Not long after the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat disappeared, some unforeseen event suddenly occurred in the Nine Soul Underground Palace, and they were all teleported out.
Could it be... the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat obtained the inheritance?
The Nine-tailed Spirit Cat was currently merely at the Third Layer of the Heavenly Order Realm. If he had indeed received the inheritance from the Nine Soul Underground Palace, wouldn’t that mean they too could contend for it?
In an instant, the way all the Demon Clan members looked at the Big Black Cat underwent an astonishing change.
Some were panting heavily, while others had bloodshot eyes. They were practically on the verge of making a move, ready to secretly snatch the inheritance of the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
"Bloody hell..."
The predatory gazes of tens of thousands of Demon Clan members were fixed on the Big Black Cat.
The Big Black Cat couldn’t help but shiver.
That conniving old Dragon Lord... he’s truly a piece of work! He immediately drew all the heat onto me the moment we got out. Absolutely outrageous!
"Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, still thinking of running?"
"Hurry up and confess! Did you consume that Decenary Eternal Life Immortal Grass or not?"
"Where did you go just now? Did you obtain the inheritance of the Nine Soul Underground Palace?"
The Nine-tailed Fox Demon also approached, arms crossed, a cold sneer on her beautiful face.
There were countless Demon Clan members around, many of them Heaven-Destined Great Demons.
Now that the level suppression was gone, the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, merely at the Third Layer of the Heavenly Order Realm, was no match for them at all.
The Golden Striped Black Tiger raised his gleaming broadsword and roared, "Kitten, get over here, quickly! Otherwise, no one will be able to protect you when the fighting starts."
Kitten shook her head, her face pale.
Seeing so many Heaven-Destined Great Demons around her, she also felt deeply uneasy.
After all, this was not the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
Without the suppression of their cultivation levels, these powerful demons had all reverted to their original cultivation stages.
Escaping would be as difficult as ascending to the heavens.
At this moment, the Golden Winged Roc also strode over, hands clasped behind his back, and sneered, "Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, you stole two of my Nine-leaf Eternal Life Immortal Grasses. It’s time we settled this account properly."
"Settle what? Your Old Cat has already eaten the Eternal Life Immortal Grass. If you still want some, you’ll only get a chance when Old Cat poops it out!"
The Big Black Cat grinned cheekily.
His eyes darted around frantically, searching for any possibility of breaking through.
There were too many great demons around, all restored to their Destiny Realm cultivation bases.
Someone like the Golden Winged Roc was already at the Eighth Level of the Heavenly Fate Realm; with such a cultivation base, even with his Emperor Artifact Walking Boots, the Big Black Cat would find it hard to escape.
The Nine-tailed Spirit Fox’s cultivation stage was also higher than his, as was that big oaf’s.
The Dragon Lord was even more terrifying, having reached the Tenth Level of the Heavenly Mandate Realm.
Although the Big Black Cat talked tough, inwardly he was in a complete panic.
He desperately wished Uncle Ma would hurry over and save his little life right now.
Heavens, that Decenary Eternal Life Immortal Grass was a fake! The moment I touched it, I was teleported to a grand hall. Then, after what felt like a dream in that hall, I was teleported out. I didn’t get a thing! And these Demon Clan members all think I stumbled upon some incredible opportunity. What rotten luck! I know that no matter what I say, none of these Demon Clan members will believe me. It’s better not to explain and just tough it out to the end.
Witnessing this scene from the carriage, Ye Yun couldn’t help but chuckle.
Surrounded by a horde of demons, the Big Black Cat was clearly no match for them.
Ye Yun extended a hand, tore open the void, and yanked the Big Black Cat over.
Kitten was also pulled over with him.
The Big Black Cat, suddenly finding himself in the carriage, was gasping for breath.
Upon seeing his Master before him, he quickly knelt down and kowtowed. "Thank you, Master, for saving my life..." the Big Black Cat exclaimed fervently.
Kitten, beside him, was stunned. In that instant of shifting stars and changing space-time, she found herself in this carriage.
What on earth just happened? This young man in white... so handsome and suave, with such a transcendent air, like a god from a painting, exuding an ethereal aura. One look and I can’t tear my eyes away.
When the Big Black Cat saw Kitten staring blankly, he quickly tugged at her. "Why are you just standing there in a daze? Hurry up, kneel and kowtow!"
Kitten then snapped out of her daze, quickly knelt on the ground, and also kowtowed to Ye Yun. "Kitten pays her respects to Master."
"Both of you, rise."
Ye Yun released a stream of Mana, lifting them both to their feet.
He looked at the Big Black Cat, an expression of approval in his eyes. "You performed well on this trip..."
Receiving his Master’s praise, the Big Black Cat immediately beamed.
He quickly took all the Eternal Life Immortal Grasses out from his storage ring, leaving just one stalk for Uncle Ma.
The Big Black Cat smiled, "Master, these are my spoils of war. I’m handing them over to the Sect now."
Ye Yun shook his head and said with a smile, "No need to give them to me. Give them to Luo Li."
As he spoke, he waved his large hand. A ray of light flashed, and Luo Li suddenly appeared in the carriage.
"Greetings, Sect Leader!" The Big Black Cat bowed respectfully again and presented the Eternal Life Immortal Grasses in his hand.
"What are these?"
Luo Li looked somewhat bewildered at the Eternal Life Immortal Grasses, which emanated an immortal glow.
"Sect Leader, these are the Eternal Life Immortal Grasses I obtained through my trials in the Nine Soul Underground Palace. I am now handing them over to the Sect..." the Big Black Cat quickly explained.
Luo Li glanced at Ye Yun. Seeing the Ancestor nod with a smile and say, "Take them," she finally accepted them and placed them into her storage ring.
"Little Cat, you’ve done well this time and made a great contribution. I will record it for you..." Luo Li said with a beaming smile.
Then she actually took out a small notebook and began to write it down.
The Big Black Cat’s eyes shone brightly.
The Sect Leader herself said so! It seems I’ve truly made a great contribution this time. In the future, apart from Uncle Ma, I’ll be the Dragon God Sect’s number one Divine Pet!
After Luo Li finished her notes, Ye Yun had her return to her cultivation.
"Go find Little Horse. He’s been waiting for you for a long time..." Ye Yun said to the Big Black Cat, waving his hand.
The next moment, the Big Black Cat and Kitten left the carriage, appearing outside.
As soon as he saw the Big Black Horse, the Big Black Cat’s expression became ecstatic. He quickly took out the last stalk of Eternal Life Immortal Grass from his storage ring.
"Uncle Ma, this is a token of this Little Cat’s filial respect for you, old sir." The Big Black Cat respectfully offered it with both hands.
He still had one Seven-leaf Eternal Life Immortal Grass in his storage ring, which he hadn’t handed over to the Sect Leader.
After all, before he went to the Nine Soul Underground Palace, he had promised Uncle Ma. Moreover, the Master was right there at the time and knew about it. That’s why the Big Black Cat had hidden this stalk of Eternal Life Immortal Grass.
This horse?
Kitten thought, her pupils shrinking slightly as she looked at the Big Black Horse. She found she couldn’t see through this Big Black Horse’s cultivation base at all.
The Big Black Horse’s gaze fell upon the Eternal Life Immortal Grass. He glanced at it a couple of times and said with a chuckle, "Little Cat, not bad at all. You still remembered your Uncle Ma. How were your gains from this trip to the Nine Soul Underground Palace?"
"The gains were pretty good. I got several stalks of Eternal Life Immortal Grass," the Big Black Cat said with a smile.
Immediately after, his expression turned dejected. With a wave of his hand, he took out the Black Shield. "Uncle Ma, look! This shield is almost broken..." the Big Black Cat said, on the verge of tears.

chapters.title: Chapter 213: The Bad Idea of the Big Black Horse
chapters.content:
Chapter 213: Chapter 213: The Bad Idea of the Big Black Horse
Outside the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
All the members of the Demon Clan stared at each other in disbelief, witnessing the sudden disappearance of the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat and the Sky Spirit Cat.
"Where did they go?"
Under the very eyes of tens of thousands of great demons, the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat and the Sky Spirit Cat had suddenly, miraculously vanished into the void, leaving no trace behind.
"Someone rescued them," the Dragon Lord said grimly.
"Hmph! Don’t let me find you, Nine-tailed Spirit Cat! Our score will be settled sooner or later!" the Golden Winged Roc roared beside him.
The Nine-tailed Fox Demon also looked exceedingly gloomy, a chilling aura emanating from her. She had originally planned to seize the fortuitous opportunity on the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, but unexpectedly, the two had been spirited away without her noticing. The other party’s methods were too profound; it must have been a powerhouse from the Life and Death Realm who intervened.
"Let’s go! Let’s go!" Some of the Divine Bridge Realm demons saw this, shook their heads, and left.
And some great demons of the Destiny Realm also suddenly found it dull and, one after another, tore through the void and departed.
The Dragon Lord, helpless, his face ashen, grunted in frustration and also departed.
The last to leave was the Golden Striped Black Tiger. Before leaving, he viciously slashed his saber into the ground, carving out a deep trench to vent his anger.
...
Over by the carriage.
The Big Black Horse noticed several cracks on the Black Shield and couldn’t help but pout. "Little Cat, it seems it was quite perilous in there, for the shield I gave you to be damaged to this extent."
Upon hearing Uncle Ma’s words, the Big Black Cat immediately wailed, "Yes! Uncle Ma, it was incredibly dangerous in there! There was a strange golden humanoid creature that was terrifyingly powerful."
At this point, the Big Black Cat recounted everything that had happened inside the Nine Soul Underground Palace from beginning to end.
Hearing this, the Big Black Horse also felt his heart pound with alarm. Based on his cultivation base and knowledge, the Big Black Horse knew there had to be an entity at the True God Realm inside. He later learned that the Big Black Cat seemed to have no memory of what had transpired in the main hall. The Big Black Horse then knew the Master must have intervened—though this was something he wouldn’t tell the Big Black Cat. If the Master hadn’t intervened, the Big Black Cat would likely have perished within the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
The Big Black Horse opened his mouth, sucked the Eternal Life Immortal Grass in, smacked his lips a few times, chewed it with relish, and then swallowed it. This Eternal Life Immortal Grass was a good thing; he definitely wouldn’t miss out.
WHOOSH!
As the Eternal Life Immortal Grass entered his stomach, a surging wave of vitality erupted from within him, rushing towards his vital organs and meridians.
"BURP!"
The Big Black Horse let out a contented burp, feeling that the taste of this Eternal Life Immortal Grass was simply wonderful.
"Little Cat, give me the shield. Uncle Ma will repair it for you," the Big Black Horse said with a grin.
The Big Black Cat promptly handed over the Black Shield. The Big Black Horse sucked the Black Shield into his mouth, chewed it a few times, and then spat it out. The moment it was spat out, the Black Shield was as good as new, all the cracks on it having vanished completely.
Receiving the shield, the Big Black Cat was overjoyed and thanked him profusely.
The Big Black Horse smacked his lips, flashing a set of big white teeth. He glanced sideways at the pretty Sky Spirit Cat nearby and chuckled teasingly, "Little Cat, you’re quite something, even managed to bring a wife back."
The Big Black Cat immediately shook his head and said awkwardly, "Uncle Ma, please don’t misunderstand. This isn’t my wife; she’s someone else’s wife."
"Someone else’s wife, what did you bring her here for? You’re really skilled at poaching, aren’t you?" The Big Black Horse chuckled.
Cat Bao’er, standing beside them, blushed crimson and lowered her head, too shy to speak. Seeing how respectfully the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat treated this Big Black Horse, she knew this Senior Big Black Horse must possess an astonishingly high cultivation base.
In that moment, Cat Bao’er couldn’t help but become intensely curious about the identity of the Master in white within the carriage.
Who on earth were these people? Not only were their origins shrouded in mystery, but each of them also possessed an unimaginably powerful cultivation base.
"Hehe!" The Big Black Cat, who was being continuously teased by Uncle Ma, gave an embarrassed laugh this time. He explained, "Uncle Ma, Cat Bao’er is the Golden Striped Black Tiger’s fiancée, but she doesn’t want to marry him, so she ran away. Unexpectedly, she ran right into me."
The Big Black Horse squinted, chuckling. "I think you two are a good match. Both cat folk, a pair made in heaven, eh?"
The Big Black Cat shook his head repeatedly and declared loudly, "Uncle Ma, I’m not looking for any Dao companion! If I were to find one, they’d have to at least cultivate to your realm!"
"HAHA!" At that, the Big Black Horse burst out laughing, pursed his lips, and said no more.
The Big Black Cat put away the Black Shield, then pulled Cat Bao’er onto the carriage. With a shake of his body, he transformed back into a large black cat, lazily sprawling on top of the carriage.
Cat Bao’er stared at the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, completely bewildered.
The Big Black Cat hastily urged her, "Hurry up and transform! Are you planning to stay in human form?"
Cat Bao’er was stunned for a moment, then asked somewhat naively, "Big Brother, why do we have to turn into cats?"
The Big Black Cat was taken aback by the question and retorted, flustered and exasperated, "Those are the rules! Hurry up and stop wasting time with nonsense!"
Left with no choice, Cat Bao’er transformed. A flash of light passed, and she turned into a large white cat, also sprawling on the carriage, less than a foot away from the Big Black Cat.
The Big Black Horse turned his head to look. Seeing a black and a white cat lounging on the carriage was indeed a very pleasing sight. He couldn’t help but smack his lips and chuckle a couple of times.
"TSK TSK... Such a perfect match. If you two don’t become Dao companions, then becoming sworn siblings would also be fine." The Big Black Horse chimed in with another bad idea.
The Big Black Cat kept shaking his head. "Uncle Ma, Cat Bao’er is engaged. I wouldn’t dare touch a single hair on her."
"So, if she weren’t engaged, you’d dare to touch her then?" The Big Black Horse immediately put the Big Black Cat on the spot.
"Engaged or not, I wouldn’t touch her! Until I’ve cultivated to Uncle Ma’s realm, I won’t consider romantic entanglements," the Big Black Cat said with a solemn expression.
Cat Bao’er, blushing beside him, her heart thumping wildly, didn’t know what to say.
After a short while, she suddenly remembered something and asked softly, "Big Brother, didn’t you promise me you’d get Stupid and Naïve to call off the engagement? Did you forget?"
The Big Black Cat raised his cat paw and slapped his forehead, exclaiming in realization, "Oh dear, I completely forgot! Things were a bit hectic back then, and it totally slipped my mind."
"In that case, Big Brother, why don’t we pay a visit to the Golden Striped Black Tiger clan to call off this engagement? What do you think?" Cat Bao’er asked, her face full of hope.
"Call off the engagement... Well, that’s not really a problem. But Cat Bao’er, you should know that without the Master’s permission, I can’t just go out as I please," the Big Black Cat said, shaking his head awkwardly.
"Oh, is that so!" Disappointment clouded Cat Bao’er’s face.
Inside the carriage, Ye Yun watched the two cats and the horse bickering playfully, a relaxed smile gracing his lips.
The top of the carriage is quite spacious. Adding another white cat would indeed make for a very pleasing sight.
At this moment, Ye Yun decided to take this little Sky Spirit Cat in.
He lifted the door curtain and stepped out.
"Master!" Hearing the movement, the Big Black Cat quickly greeted him respectfully.
Cat Bao’er, knowing how incredibly powerful this Master in white was, also hurriedly greeted him respectfully.
"Little White Cat, dissolving your engagement isn’t difficult. Are you willing to join our Dragon God Sect?" Ye Yun asked, standing with his hands behind his back, a gentle smile on his face as he looked at the Sky Spirit Cat.
"Join the Dragon God Sect?" Cat Bao’er was stunned.
She had heard of a Dragon God Sect in the Heavenly Star Dynasty, but it was merely a low-grade major sect, far, far inferior to her Sky Spirit Cat Clan. If she were to join the Dragon God Sect, would she be expelled from her clan by the clan ancestors?

chapters.title: Chapter 214: Join the Dragon God Sect and Head to Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge
chapters.content:
Chapter 214: Chapter 214: Join the Dragon God Sect and Head to Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge
Upon seeing the baffled expression on Kitty’s face, the Big Black Cat got impatient.
The Master had actually suggested Kitty join the Dragon God Sect. What a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity this was! And Kitty was still too clueless to agree immediately.
SMACK!
The Big Black Cat swiftly extended his claw, smacking Kitty’s forehead hard.
The blow was heavy. It made Kitty see stars, and she nearly passed out.
"Big Brother, why did you hit me?" Kitty asked in confusion.
"Just agree to it!" the Big Black Cat stared at her and said fiercely.
Kitty was completely stunned now. She blinked her big eyes a few times and nodded in a daze, saying, "Master, I agree to join the Dragon God Sect."
Ye Yun smiled, looked at the rolling mountain ranges in the distance, and said softly, "Let’s go. We’ll head to Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge first, then Shenhu Mountain..."
"Alright, Master," the Big Black Horse quickly responded and then started pulling the carriage forward.
Ye Yun flashed back into the carriage.
Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge was the Dragon Lord’s old lair. Ye Yun had seen some interesting things at Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge and thought he might as well recruit the Dragon Lord along the way. After experiencing certain events in the Nine Soul Underground Palace, Ye Yun felt it would be best to gather all descendants of the God Dragon Clan and humans with the Dragon God Bloodline on the Cangnan Continent into the Dragon God Sect. This would also provide better protection for the descendants of the God Dragon Clan.
"Go to Shenhu Mountain?"
Upon hearing this, Kitty immediately got excited, unable to stop herself from letting out a MEOW!
The Big Black Cat beside her was grinning.
"The Master has already agreed," the Big Black Cat said with a gleeful laugh. "After Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge, we’ll go to Shenhu Mountain and have your marriage engagement with the Golden Striped Black Tiger Clan called off. From then on, you’ll be a demon beast of the Dragon God Sect. HA-HA! This is an incredibly glorious matter!"
Kitty nodded excitedly. Then, as if remembering something, she asked with a mysterious air, "Big Brother, what exactly is the Master’s cultivation base?"
"Don’t ask about that..." the Big Black Cat said with a profound expression. "You’ll understand in time."
Kitty felt rebuffed and shook her head helplessly.
"Little Cat, when are you going to find a wife for me too?" the Big Black Horse turned his head and chuckled as he continued forward.
"Uncle Ma, with your cultivation base, ordinary individuals wouldn’t be a match for you," the Big Black Cat said with a woeful expression. "My cultivation base is only at the Destiny Realm; where am I supposed to find an Eternal Realm great demon for you?"
"What? Eternal Realm?" Kitty was stunned.
The Nine-tailed Spirit Cat had unintentionally let something slip earlier, and now a frightening question struck her.
Could this black horse pulling the carriage actually be a great demon of the Eternal Realm?
"Big Brother, is Uncle Ma an Eternal Realm great demon senior?" Kitty asked quietly.
The Big Black Cat nodded, then extended a paw to pat Kitty’s head twice, affecting the air of a senior as he said earnestly, "Our Dragon God Sect has a profound foundation; it’s the foremost Eternal-level sect on the Cangnan Continent. After you’ve been here for a while and become familiar with it, you’ll be deeply proud."
"Oh..." Kitty nodded in astonishment.
So this Big Black Horse really was an Eternal Realm great demon. This was too terrifying, truly unbelievable. If even the horse pulling the carriage was an Eternal Realm great demon, wouldn’t the Master in white be at an even higher cultivation base? A True God? The Master must be a True God!
Thinking of this, Kitty’s body couldn’t help but tremble.
There’s actually a True God in the Dragon God Sect? This is utterly terrifying.
Kitty finally understood why the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat had been so anxious for her to agree earlier.
If she joined the Dragon God Sect, which had a True God Realm existence, wouldn’t that marriage contract be easily resolved?
"Little Cat, they don’t necessarily have to be at the Eternal Realm; the Life and Death Realm would be fine too," the Big Black Horse mumbled.
"Uncle Ma, please just wait a bit longer! Once I reach the Life and Death Realm, I’ll look for a suitable match for you!" The Big Black Cat raised its two paws as if begging for mercy.
The Big Black Horse laughed heartily, turned his head, and focused on the journey.
The Big Black Horse didn’t travel quickly. This was something Ye Yun had secretly instructed. If they went too fast, the Dragon Lord might not have returned to Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge yet.
「Three days later.」
The Big Black Horse, pulling the carriage, finally arrived at the foot of Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge.
"Master, we’ve arrived at Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge," the Big Black Horse said softly.
Ye Yun glanced out from the carriage and said meaningfully, "Let’s go up and take a look!"
The Big Black Horse responded and pulled the carriage up the mountain.
As they approached the mountain gate, several Nirvana Realm great demons immediately rushed out.
"Who goes there?" These Nirvana Realm demons blocked the mountain gate, looking aggressive.
The Big Black Horse merely glanced up, and those few demons fainted on the spot.
"Uncle Ma, your Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye is becoming more and more formidable!" the Big Black Cat looked up and said with an envious expression.
"Average, average. Just barely usable," the Big Black Horse chuckled and continued forward.
Along the way, any demons who tried to block them were knocked unconscious by a single glance from the Big Black Horse.
After the carriage reached the mountain top, Ye Yun suddenly stepped out.
The Big Black Horse was startled.
For a mere Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge, did the Master intend to act personally?
Ye Yun looked around, his expression calm.
