"Little Horse, come with me..." With his hands behind his back, Ye Yun walked slowly along the mountain ridge towards the deeper parts of the range.
The Big Black Horse transformed into a black-robed man and followed closely behind Ye Yun, step for step.
After the two figures disappeared, the Big Black Cat’s eyes revealed a look of terror.
"Big Brother, what’s wrong?" Kitty asked in surprise.
The Big Black Cat scanned the surroundings and said warily, "There’s something odd about this place; otherwise, the Master wouldn’t have asked Uncle Ma to go with him..."
"What’s so odd? The Dragon Lord of Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge is only at the Destiny Realm Tenth Level; his cultivation base can’t compare to Uncle Ma’s..." Kitty said thoughtfully.
Perhaps there’s an Eternal Realm great demon here, so the Master asked Uncle Ma to go along...
The Big Black Cat suddenly thought of something, and his eyes gleamed.
"The Master is so powerful, why not just deal with it directly..." Kitty said, shaking her head.
"If you keep spouting nonsense, I’ll smack you dead!" The Big Black Cat slapped Kitty’s forehead again, causing her head to hit the carriage, leaving her dizzy and seeing stars.
Tears welled up in Kitty’s large, sapphire-like eyes. The Nine-tailed Spirit Cat was bullying her again! Since she became a cat, he had hit her several times.
"What kind of existence is the Master? Can He act so easily? Don’t you ever think about who in this world is worthy of the Master making a move? Use your brain more in the future, silly cat," the Big Black Cat said disdainfully. He didn’t have the slightest tender feeling for her.
"Oh..." Kitty lowered her head helplessly, but a thought surfaced in her mind.
Could the Master be a True God?
The two figures walked slowly along the mountain ridge. Though they seemed slow, their actual speed was extremely fast, and they soon arrived near a deep abyss.
Gazing at the pitch-black entrance of the abyss, Ye Yun stopped at the edge and looked inside pensively. The Big Black Horse stood beside him.
"Feel anything?" Ye Yun smiled faintly and casually asked the Big Black Horse behind him.
"Master, there’s a dense Dragon Qi coming from below the abyss..." the Big Black Horse said, his face filled with shock.

chapters.title: Chapter 215: Infiltrating the Abyss, the Evil Buddha Old Monk
chapters.content:
Chapter 215: Chapter 215: Infiltrating the Abyss, the Evil Buddha Old Monk
"Indeed, there’s not only Dragon Qi above the Abyss, but many other unexpected things..." Ye Yun gave a poker-faced smile. He took a light leap and gracefully descended.
Upon hearing that there were unexpected things below, Big Black Horse immediately became excited.
The Master is calling for him; it’s time to contribute his strength! Big Black Horse was always pulling carts, which bored him. Now, at last, his strength could be put to use.
He hurriedly followed, jumping down and descending towards the Abyss along with Ye Yun.
Their descent wasn’t fast; they fell like drifting leaves. Ye Yun moved without haste; such a small place did not warrant tearing the void.
After descending a thousand feet, a soft glow of light blocked their path.
"There’s even a Formation..." Big Black Horse grinned, preparing to smash this Formation with a single punch.
However, Ye Yun shook his head. In his monstrous eyes, small, star-like runes rose. Powers of life and death transformed, and in no time, the large Formation disintegrated like smoke.
Big Black Horse retrieved his punch in disappointment.
The Master is so strong! He demolished the large Formation in a blink, causing not even the slightest turbulence. The Master’s strength had already surpassed his imagination.
The two descended towards the Abyss once more. This drifting took a long time. Only after an hour did Big Black Horse witness the shocking sight below the Abyss.
Eight towering black Buddhist Pagodas stood erect on the ground, each one a thousand feet high, appearing ancient and weathered, their aura stunning. On the pillars were carved numerous Buddhist Secret Texts. Between the eight Pagodas, there was a giant Stone Buddha, about two to three hundred feet tall, firmly fixed on the ground. The Buddha figure on the Stone Buddha had its hands crossed into a Buddha Seal. Its countenance was grave, giving off a vague feeling of being both Buddha and Demon.
The Dragon Qi in the depths of the Abyss was extremely dense, at least a hundred times denser than on the mountain peak. Big Black Horse had sharp eyes. To his surprise, he found that all the Dragon Qi was actually emanating from beneath the Stone Buddha.
Is this Stone Buddha suppressing the Dragon Qi?
Such a possibility suddenly flashed across Big Black Horse’s mind, but it seemed unbelievable.
At this moment, his gaze shifted, and he found the Dragon Lord sitting calmly with his eyes closed on one of the Stone Buddha’s palms, cultivating. The Dragon Lord hadn’t noticed any intruders. After all, he was only at the Tenth Level of the Heavenly Mandate Realm. Since there had been no warnings from the outer Formation, it was impossible for him to know that two figures had appeared not far above his head.
Ye Yun looked at the Dragon Lord, sensed the Golden Divine Dragon Bloodline within him, and said with an indifferent smile, "Little Horse, go negotiate with the Dragon Lord. Find a way to get him to join My Divine Dragon Sect."
Big Black Horse nodded and quickly agreed. With one step, he arrived in front of the Dragon Lord in the blink of an eye. He now stood on the other palm of the Stone Buddha. Ye Yun looked at the giant Stone Buddha and the eight black Pagodas, a faint smile on his face. Then, he blended into the void, his presence undetectable.
Big Black Horse intentionally released a wisp of his aura, allowing the Dragon Lord to sense his presence. He chuckled lightly, "Dragon Lord, wake up."
Startled by the voice near his ear, the Dragon Lord hurriedly opened his eyes. A stranger was standing opposite him, smiling.
Who is this man?
The Dragon Lord was shocked.
To be able to penetrate the outer Formation so stealthily and reach him... this person’s cultivation base must far surpass his own!
"Who exactly are you?" The Dragon Lord abruptly stood, warily watching the black-robed man across from him. "What is the meaning of this intrusion?"
"I come from the Dragon God Sect," Big Black Horse got straight to the point, smiling faintly. "I’d like to invite you to join our Dragon God Sect. What do you think?"
"Dragon God Sect? Isn’t that a low-grade major sect?" The Dragon Lord scoffed dismissively. "Are you joking? A Tenth Level Heavenly Mandate Realm Great Demon like me, join such a low-grade sect?"
"This Dragon God Sect is not that Dragon God Sect." Big Black Horse chuckled and continued, "The Dragon God Sect you’re referring to was an imposter and has been destroyed. I am now a genuine representative of the Dragon God Sect. Our Sect wishes to recruit members of the Dragon Clan who possess the Dragon God Bloodline. What do you say?"
"Impossible! The Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge offers such uniquely favorable conditions. Why should I join your Dragon God Sect? You’d better leave quickly!" The Dragon Lord curtly rejected the offer. The Dragon Qi in this Abyss was so abundant, allowing his cultivation to flourish like a fish in water. Did he need to go anywhere else? Here, breaking through to the Life and Death Realm would be quite easy for him. He had zero interest in what this black-robed man was saying about his so-called Dragon God Sect.
"If you won’t agree, then I’m afraid I’ll have to use force." Big Black Horse rolled up his sleeves, ready to make his move.
The Dragon Lord tensed, as if facing a formidable enemy. He carefully watched the black-robed man, formed a spell with both hands, and infused it into the Stone Buddha.
"Hmm?" Big Black Horse’s pupils contracted slightly.
Is the Dragon Lord activating some kind of formation?
The thought had just surfaced when he felt the ground shake beneath his feet, as if some colossal creature was attempting to claw its way out from the depths. A potent aura erupted from beneath the ground. Simultaneously, the giant Stone Buddha at his feet began to rock lightly.
A golden Buddhist light shot out from between the Stone Buddha’s eyebrows, coalescing in mid-air to reveal an old Monk in crimson robes. The old monk was emaciated, skeletal even, and radiated a faint red bloodlight. Within this radiance, tiny Dragon Shadows could be seen swimming.
"The Eternal Realm?" Upon seeing the red-robed old Monk, Big Black Horse was taken aback. The old monk’s cultivation level actually matched his own!
Ye Yun found this amusing. The sudden appearance of the red-robed old monk brought a dismissive smile to his face.
Evil Buddha Sect! He found the old Monk’s aura extremely bizarre, completely different from orthodox Buddhist Cultivators. The Monk belonged to the infamous Evil Buddha Sect. The Evil Buddha Sect had a mysterious heritage and very few Successors. One hundred thousand years ago, Ye Yun himself had killed a Successor of the Evil Buddha Sect. Therefore, he was quite familiar with the unique aura emanating from Evil Buddha Sect Cultivators.
"Amitabha! To think a Great Demon of the Eternal Realm has graced us. What an honor for the Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge..." the old Monk said softly, pressing his palms together, his eyes downcast.
Big Black Horse looked at the red-robed old monk with interest. He wasn’t a native demon beast of the Cangnan Continent and thus didn’t recognize him. He only found the monk’s aura extremely strange, exuding an intense air of malevolence.
The Dragon Lord, encouraged by the sight of the old monk, promptly bowed respectfully and said, "This person insists on forcing me to join their Dragon God Sect. Master, please decide for me."
"Rest assured. With me here, no one will lay a finger on you," the red-robed old monk said with a faint smile, dismissing Big Black Horse entirely.
As his words fell, the surrounding eight black Pagodas flickered with a faint black light. Within the black light, the phantoms of numerous Divine Dragons flashed briefly before disappearing.

chapters.title: Chapter 216: Buddha and Demon, Two Eternal Realm Beings
chapters.content:
Chapter 216: Chapter 216: Buddha and Demon, Two Eternal Realm Beings
Big Black Horse bared his teeth and rolled his eyes. He felt the subtle change emanating from the eight black Buddhist Pagodas that had suddenly risen, but he was indifferent.
He sized up the red-robed old monk and asked with a smile, "You are a Human Cultivator, so why have you become a master to the Demon Clan? There must be some unspeakable secret, right?"
"Nonsense."
The red-robed old monk’s eyes snapped open, emitting two sharp rays of light. With a wave of his hand, a blood-red Buddha ring appeared, which he smashed towards Big Black Horse.
The blood-red Buddha ring radiated layers of blood-light. In an instant, the entire Abyss below was enveloped by the red blood-light, a terrifying scene, as if an apocalypse was descending.
"Good!"
Big Black Horse sneered, dazzling light erupted from his entire body, and he threw a fierce punch.
BOOM!
His fierce fist slammed into the blood-red Buddha ring, and the impact sent Big Black Horse recoiling. He retreated two steps in mid-air before stabilizing his figure. Just then, the blood-red Buddha ring spun in mid-air and smashed towards him once more.
"I didn’t expect your treasure to be so tough."
Big Black Horse smiled recklessly and punched out again. A faint layer of black Dragon Scales suddenly appeared on the surface of his fist.
BOOM!
With an earth-shattering sound, this time, Big Black Horse stood firm, while the blood-red Buddha ring was sent flying back.
The red-robed old monk grasped the Buddha ring, glanced at it, then looked at the black-robed man opposite him in shock. He licked his lips, and a bloodthirsty killing intent glinted in his eyes. "I never expected you to be an Eternal Realm demon dragon."
"You old monk actually have some skill, being able to see through some of your Uncle Ma’s true capabilities. Come... come... let’s battle for three hundred rounds!"
Big Black Horse roared, and layers of fine Dragon Scales suddenly rippled across his body. In an instant, he looked more like a dragon-shaped warrior clad in armor.
Such strong bloodline power!
Nearby, the Dragon Lord was secretly astounded. The sheer concentration of the Dragon God Bloodline emanating from the black-robed man opposite him filled him with an indescribable terror—it was a blatant bloodline suppression.
"Don’t be afraid. Watch how your master captures him."
The red-robed old monk seemed to notice the Dragon Lord’s unease. He glanced back at the Dragon Lord, smiled, said a few words, then turned and vanished.
He held the Buddha ring in one hand and a golden Buddha Staff in the other. The golden Buddha Staff was wreathed in blood energy, within which a Divine Dragon Phantom, imbued with devastating prowess, smashed rapidly towards Big Black Horse.
Big Black Horse was fearless, fighting barehanded against the red-robed old monk.
BOOM! BOOM!
A series of earth-shattering sounds echoed from mid-air, with powerful shockwaves rippling out. However, layers of light suddenly gushed forth from the eight surrounding Buddhist Pagodas, completely blocking these shockwaves.
Dragon Lord breathed a sigh of relief. The formation his master had laid was unimaginably powerful. Otherwise, with his mere Destiny Realm cultivation base, he would never have survived at such close range.
They’re too fast!
Dragon Lord stared at the sky, his face a mask of shock.
He couldn’t see a thing!
A battle between two Eternal Realm experts was simply beyond what someone with his Destiny Realm cultivation base could clearly perceive.BOOM! BOOM!
The tremendous sounds were incessant. The battle was extremely fierce.
A sense of unease crept into the Dragon Lord’s heart. The black-robed man’s origins were unknown. He possessed the Dragon God Bloodline and far surpassed ordinary Human Race Eternal Realm Cultivators.
He wondered if his master was a match for this fellow. After all, he had never seen his master fight personally.
"Old monk, hurry up and use all your skills, or you’ll be no match for me!" Big Black Horse laughed wildly.
Clad in Dragon Scales, he was in a semi-transformed state; his defense and strength at that moment were unimaginably formidable. Big Black Horse wasn’t even using his most potent thunder-based Divine Skills. He was currently engaged in a brawl with the red-robed old monk using only his physical strength.
The red-robed old monk’s face was ashen with rage.
He hadn’t expected this Demon Dragon before him to be so powerful. On the Cangnan Continent today, the Dragon God Bloodline has become extremely diluted. Why is this Demon Dragon’s bloodline so potent? It even surpasses the Dragon Lord’s by many times! One must understand, the Dragon Lord was a member of the Dragon Clan possessing the Golden Divine Dragon Bloodline, whom he had painstakingly nurtured in this place. His original plan was to cultivate him to the Eternal Realm, then use the Evil Buddha Sect’s secret technique to sacrifice him. This way, he could break through to the True God Realm. But this plan required an immense amount of time. Fortunately, in the Ten Thousand Dragon Pit of Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge, tens of thousands of Divine Dragons were buried during the Ancient Times. They continuously released Dragon Qi, which accelerated the Dragon Lord’s cultivation.
Seeing the red-robed old monk’s livid face and silence, Big Black Horse taunted him loudly while unleashing a furious barrage of attacks. He quickly forced the red-robed old monk into a steady retreat.
"Eight Heavenly Dragon Formation, arise!"
Driven to desperation, the red-robed old monk finally activated the Eight Heavenly Dragon Formation that suppressed the Ten Thousand Dragon Pit.
VMMMM!
The eight Buddhist Pagodas suddenly emitted dazzling black light, instantly enveloping the Abyss.
RUMBLE!
A world-shaking grand formation materialized. Immense pressure instantly bore down from the formation, and Big Black Horse felt his strength being suppressed. Countless Divine Dragons roared in the air around him, relentlessly attacking.
Big Black Horse was also starting to get angry.
He could tell that these Divine Dragons at the bottom of the Abyss were not simple; they seemed to have significant origins.
As a quasi-member of the Dragon Clan, Big Black Horse was aggrieved to see that deceased Dragon Clan members had been refined into parts of this formation.
He abruptly drew out a golden axe and raised it high. As he channeled his energy into the golden axe, golden sparks of lightning began to scintillate on its surface. Brilliant golden lightning flared outwards, instantly preventing the Divine Dragon phantoms from drawing any closer.
"What kind of treasure is this?"
Seeing this, the red-robed old monk was greatly alarmed. While he was still in shock, Big Black Horse swung the golden axe, smashing it fiercely towards him.
The red-robed old monk hastily raised his Buddha ring and golden Buddha Staff to block.
BOOM!
A tremendous force instantly sent him flying backwards. Golden lightning instantly coursed through the two treasures and into his body.
SIZZLE! SIZZLE!
The protective layer of red blood-light around the red-robed monk’s body was instantly diminished by more than half.
PFFT!
The red-robed old monk suddenly spat out a mouthful of fresh blood in mid-air. He stared at the golden axe, a look of terror in his eyes.
"Old monk, you’re no match for me," Big Black Horse said with a cold sneer, brandishing the golden axe.
This axe, you see, was condensed by the Master using Rebirth Thunder. He knew very well how terrifying Rebirth Thunder was. Even an Eternal Realm Great Demon of the lightning element like himself could only refine a mere sliver of Rebirth Thunder into his body each time.
"Hmm, your axe isn’t bad. I’m claiming this treasure..."
The red-robed old monk licked his lips, and a layer of blood-light suddenly suffused his withered old face. Under the blood-light’s illumination, his old face appeared extremely horrifying.
Hmm?
Big Black Horse was slightly shocked.
Does this old monk still have some trump card he hasn’t revealed?

chapters.title: Chapter 217: Ancestral Dragon’s Breath, Dragon Lord Submits
chapters.content:
Chapter 217: Chapter 217: Ancestral Dragon’s Breath, Dragon Lord Submits
"Do you even have the ability?"
Upon hearing the red-robed old monk’s words, Big Black Horse scoffed contemptuously and lifted his small golden axe. Streaks of electricity flickered on the axe, emitting a terrifyingly dreadful aura. Those Divine Dragon Phantoms steered clear from afar.
At the same time, the red-robed old monk roared, "Evil Buddha Descends!" His body suddenly began to rupture, skin splitting and blood gushing out. The spurting blood was like a great river, sprawling across the entire void.
SPLASH!
It formed a vast Sea of Blood, accompanied by the sound of crashing waves.
Seeing this, Big Black Horse was slightly taken aback. The red-robed old monk’s methods were indeed too bizarre.
Witnessing this familiar scene, Ye Yun inadvertently shook his head.
This move again.
The Evil Buddha Sect was so named because it followed the path of Truth-seeking through slaughter. Thus, every successor of the Evil Buddha Sect had killed countless people in their lifetime. Because of this particular cultivation method, all major sects of the entire Cangnan Continent scorned the Evil Buddha Sect. Whenever they appeared, they would be besieged and attacked by all. Nevertheless, the Evil Buddha Sect managed to survive through generations. With each generation of successors, every deceased Sect Master of the Evil Buddha Sect would leave behind a Blood Relic. This Blood Relic was left for the disciples to continue their cultivation.
「...」
The void echoed with the sounds of surging waves; blood tides tumbled dramatically, creating an awe-inspiring scene like a blood-colored Hell. Amidst the churning blood waves, a furious Buddha with a thousand hands and a thousand eyes suddenly appeared.
"This really is interesting. It seems I underestimated you before, didn’t I?" Big Black Horse grinned, laughed nonchalantly, and fiercely charged forward. The golden axe traced a golden arc in mid-air, powerfully swinging towards the extremely sinister-looking, thousand-handed, thousand-eyed Buddha.
This thousand-handed, thousand-eyed Buddha was, of course, the red-robed old monk from before. At this moment, he had revealed his Evil Buddha Dharma Form. The so-called thousand hands and thousand eyes manifested as ten additional heads growing atop his original one, each head bearing many eyes. The ten heads were stacked like a pagoda, each eye emitting a malevolent glow. Countless arms had also sprouted from his shoulders, each wielding a different magical instrument.
"Kill!" The red-robed old monk’s body radiated boundless blood-light. The surrounding Sea of Blood roared continuously, making him look like an extraordinarily evil Demon God. Stepping on the rolling waves of blood, the red-robed old monk waved his thousand hands and attacked Big Black Horse. At this moment, his thousand eyes simultaneously shot out rays of blood-colored light, like sharp swords aimed at Big Black Horse. Simultaneously, the various magical instruments in his hands blazed with brilliant light; as his arms moved, they crashed down like rumbling wheels of fire and wind.
ZZZT!
The golden axe conjured countless golden bolts of lightning, all of them terrifying Rebirth Thunder.
BANG! BANG!
The Rebirth Thunder collided with the red-robed old monk’s attacks, creating earth-shattering, deafening explosions. With irresistible force, the golden axe split open the Sea of Blood, severed the blood-light, and cleaved through all the attacks.
"This... This axe is too powerful, isn’t it?" The red-robed old monk was greatly shocked. His body quickly shrank, and he retreated back into the Sea of Blood. Unexpectedly, his first attack had failed.
Below, Dragon Lord, standing on the stone Buddha’s palm, trembled all over, momentarily at a loss. He had never imagined that his master, whom he considered invincible, would be forced into a retreat.
A white figure suddenly appeared by his side.
"Who are you?" Dragon Lord stared at the suddenly materialized young man in white, an indescribable terror filling his eyes. The other party seemed to have no cultivation base, yet he had appeared silently in front of him like a ghost, his cultivation far superior to Dragon Lord’s own.
Could it be another Great Demon of the Eternal Realm?
As Dragon Lord was feeling uneasy, Ye Yun gazed at the battlefield above, smiled faintly, and said, "You carry the bloodline of the Golden Divine Dragon in your body..."
Dragon Lord’s breathing quickened, and his face instantly paled.
Does this person intend to kill me and seize my Divine Dragon’s bloodline?
A layer of golden light instantly burst forth from Dragon Lord’s body, making him look like a golden Demon God. He raised his arm, which had already transformed into a golden Dragon Claw. Although he knew he was no match, Dragon Lord absolutely could not resign himself to death.
Ye Yun turned his head, glanced indifferently at Dragon Lord, and said with a light smile, "A mere little Golden Divine Dragon wants to fight me?"
Dragon Lord braced himself and said stubbornly, "I would rather be shattered jade than an intact tile."
"You’re overthinking it." Ye Yun smiled gently, shaking his head. "I don’t want your life."
Dragon Lord was stunned for a moment, then quickly asked, "Then, what do you mean, Your Excellency?"
Ye Yun smiled. "I just want you to join the Dragon God Sect."
"The Dragon God Sect is nothing more than a low-grade major sect. Their Sect Master is only at the Fourth Level of the Destiny Realm. How could a Great Demon like me, at the Tenth Level of the Destiny Realm, possibly join the Dragon God Sect?" Dragon Lord argued stubbornly.
"That Dragon God Sect in the Heavenly Star Dynasty was an imposter and has already been destroyed by me. The real Dragon God Sect is not what you imagine," Ye Yun said with a slight smile.
In an instant, a wisp of Ancestral Dragon’s Breath emanated from him. This wisp of Ancestral Dragon’s Breath was incomparably powerful. Even though it was just a wisp, Dragon Lord’s expression changed completely the moment he sensed it.
THUD!
He fell to his knees. The immense power of the bloodline instantly rendered him unable to resist. Dragon Lord prostrated himself fully, lying prone on the stone Buddha’s palm, daring not to move an inch. His body trembled continuously, but in his heart, he was roaring,
What kind of Dragon God Bloodline is this?!
Seeing Dragon Lord prostrate himself, Ye Yun nodded faintly. The Ancestral Dragon Bloodline reigns supreme through the ages; all Dragon Clans in the world dare not disobey. Even if he only released a wisp of Ancestral Dragon’s Breath. The legendary Ten Super Divine Dragons would have to kneel and kowtow before him!
That is the Ancestor Dragon!
Ye Yun possessed 99% Ancestral Dragon Bloodline. To put it bluntly, he could transform into a colossal Ancestor Dragon’s True Body at any moment. Once transformed into the Ancestor Dragon’s True Body, he would be even more terrifying. However, Ye Yun was already powerful enough; he had no need to transform into the Ancestor Dragon’s True Body. He released a wisp of Ancestral Dragon’s Breath merely to make Dragon Lord submit.
"Are you willing to join my Dragon God Sect now?" Ye Yun asked again.
"I... I am willing..." Dragon Lord said, his heart trembling uncontrollably.
"Whether you are willing or not, you must be. As a member of the Dragon Clan, this is an order you must obey," Ye Yun suddenly said, his expression turning stern and serious.
In an instant, Dragon Lord was drenched in cold sweat, feeling an indescribable terror.
Ye Yun took out a bracelet and, with a wave of his hand, drew Dragon Lord into it. He would first imprison him for a few days and release Dragon Lord when the Dragon God Sect was rebuilt.
Ye Yun then turned his gaze to the mid-air battle. At this moment, Big Black Horse, wielding the golden axe formed from Rebirth Thunder, was chasing the red-robed old monk of the Evil Buddha Sect, making him flee in utter terror. However, the red-robed old monk’s Divine Skills were strange and varied, and by relying on that Sea of Blood, he was still able to hold on.
Ye Yun then looked towards the ground below, his eyebrows raised slightly, and the corners of his lips curled up.
Heh, rather interesting...

chapters.title: Chapter 218: Divine Dragon Hidden in Ten Thousand Dragon Pit
chapters.content:
Chapter 218: Chapter 218: Divine Dragon Hidden in Ten Thousand Dragon Pit
In the depths of the Abyss.
Ye Yun’s eyes shimmered, piercing through eons.
He saw the bones of tens of thousands of giant dragons, crisscrossed and scattered across the abyss floor.
Even after a million years had passed, these dragon bones still remained undestroyed by time.
Especially those dragon bones, as white as new, still constantly emanating sacred light.
The Dragon Qi released by these bones, even when suppressed by the Eight Heavenly Dragon Formation, still managed to seep out a little.
The Dragon Lord cultivated by absorbing these small amounts of Dragon Qi.
This Dragon Qi was somewhat helpful for any cultivator.
But the risks were also extremely high.
The energy contained within the Dragon Qi was exceedingly aggressive and volatile, making it easy for one to deviate in their cultivation.
Only those of the Dragon Clan or descendants of the Human Race possessing the Dragon God Bloodline could cultivate using the Dragon Qi. They could do so without experiencing any side effects, relying on the power of their own bloodline.
"This place shouldn’t be called Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge; perhaps Ten Thousand Dragon Pit would be more appropriate..." Ye Yun sighed.
Tens of thousands of Divine Dragons lay buried here, most likely victims of a great war in the Ancient Era, interred deep beneath the earth.
A seal had been placed on top.
As time passed, the seal gradually weakened.
Large amounts of Dragon Qi began to disperse from it.
Fortunately, the Eight Heavenly Dragon Formation of the Evil Buddha Sect above suppressed it, preventing it from drifting outside.
The red-robed old monk of the Evil Buddha Sect also cultivated using Dragon Qi.
Of course, he didn’t just cultivate with Dragon Qi; he had also used a secret technique to collect fragments of residual Divine Dragon Souls. Consequently, strands of Dragon Souls could be seen moving within the blood-red energy surrounding his body.
These Dragon Souls were naturally not true Divine Dragon Souls.
They were just fragments of Dragon Souls pieced together; in Ye Yun’s eyes, their power was almost negligible.
If it were a true Dragon Soul, even a single wisp of its spiritual essence, Big Black Horse would have been utterly no match for it.
Ye Yun’s eyes flickered, continually probing the depths as he muttered to himself, "Interesting. What kind of Divine Dragon is this?"
After thinking it over and over, he still couldn’t come up with an answer.
"It’s about to come out. I’ll ask it then..." Ye Yun smiled softly.
Any Divine Dragon, whether living or dead, had to prostrate themselves in worship upon seeing the Ancestor Dragon.
Even if that entity in the depths had transformed, it would still kowtow and worship Ye Yun.
BOOM!
Big Black Horse’s golden ax struck fiercely, once again sending the red-robed old monk flying.
Dozens of his many hands had already been severed.
Even two layers of his pagoda-like stacked head had been cut off.
It could be said that the red-robed old monk was in an exceptionally miserable state.
At this moment, Big Black Horse seemed like a god descended to earth, on a rampage and reveling in the slaughter.
"Old monk, didn’t you want my ax? Where have all your abilities gone?" Big Black Horse taunted loudly, striking with his ax.
The red-robed old monk’s expression turned incredibly grim.
He hadn’t expected that even after revealing his Thousand-Handed, Thousand-Eyed Buddha’s true body, he was still no match for the fellow opposite him.
He could also tell that their strengths were comparable; his opponent relied entirely on that golden ax.
Although he coveted the treasure, he knew he was no match even if he used all his strength.
At this moment, the red-robed old monk considered retreating.
WHOOSH!
A monstrous sea of blood instantly engulfed his body.
He then turned swiftly, preparing to rush towards the Stone Buddha’s location to escape with the Dragon Lord.
However, he quickly discovered that the Dragon Lord was no longer in his original position, having disappeared at some unknown time.
In the Dragon Lord’s original spot, a young man in white now stood.
The white-clothed young man was handsome with well-defined features. His eyes seemed like galaxies, and his body exuded an indescribably ethereal aura.
At first glance, the young man looked as if he had stepped out of a painting.
Who exactly is he?
A feeling of extreme danger surged up from the depths of his heart.
When the red-robed old monk of the Evil Buddha Sect saw Ye Yun, terror filled his heart, and he immediately turned to flee.
Ye Yun found this rather amusing.
At that moment, he activated the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye.
The red-robed old monk found that a grand formation had risen around him, trapping him securely.
Despite his vigorous attacks, he couldn’t break free, which sent him into a panic.
"The boss is intervening again..." Big Black Horse chuckled from the side, not making another move.
The red-robed old monk opposite him was continuously making various attacking motions in the void.
His flustered and exasperated appearance made it clear he was trapped in an Illusory Realm.
"Boss, do we kill him?" Big Black Horse hollered from mid-air.
"No need for now. He’s just a chess piece..." Ye Yun replied with a faint smile.
"A chess piece?" Big Black Horse was startled and quickly looked towards the depths below.
However, he found his Divine Sense was repelled, unable to penetrate the depths.
Is there an even more powerful existence beneath the ground?
As this thought occurred to him, Big Black Horse’s leisurely expression vanished.
He tightly gripped his golden ax, looking as if facing a formidable enemy.
Ye Yun laughed inwardly.
It seems my words just now unnerved Big Black Horse.
"Boss, what exactly is down there?" Big Black Horse asked, growing impatient after waiting for a while with no activity.
"A Divine Dragon," Ye Yun said, touching his nose with a chuckle.
"A Divine Dragon?" Big Black Horse was greatly taken aback.
As a half-dragon possessing the Dragon Clan Bloodline, he was well aware of the power and terror of a Divine Dragon.
If this Divine Dragon was even more formidable than the red-robed old monk, he feared he was about to face an unimaginably fierce battle, the likes of which he had never experienced.
RUMBLE!
A series of muffled rumbles echoed from underground, shaking the surrounding mountain ranges as if some behemoth was about to emerge.
Big Black Horse immediately tensed up, gripping his ax, ready to launch an attack at any moment.
"No need to be hasty. Let’s wait for it to emerge," Ye Yun said with a smile.
"Understood, Boss." Big Black Horse quickly agreed, then took a deep breath, trying his best to calm himself.
He sensed a terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath rising from the ground.
Within this Super Divine Dragon Breath, he recognized the familiar Divine Dragon’s Breath.
However, this Divine Dragon’s Breath seemed somewhat malevolent, causing an extremely uncomfortable sensation throughout his body.
Blue lightning flickered across the fine scales on Big Black Horse’s body.
ZAP! ZAP!
The sounds crackled continuously.
Having autonomously activated his thunder and lightning ability, the uncomfortable feeling in Big Black Horse lessened.
「On the carriage.」
Hearing the rumbling sounds, Big Black Cat craned his neck, looking in a certain direction with a shocked expression.
"Good heavens, is some terrifying monster about to emerge?" Big Black Cat exclaimed in shock.
"Big Brother, with Uncle Ma there, it should be fine, right?" Kitty said with a smile.
"I also hope nothing goes wrong, but this time the enemy is unexpectedly strong..." Big Black Cat sighed. His cat paws scratched fiercely at the carriage twice as he said in a deep voice, "I reckon only the boss can resolve this."

chapters.title: Chapter 219: Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 219: Chapter 219: Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon
「Deep within the abyss of Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge.」
Accompanied by a massive thunderous boom, a stream of ten-thousand-feet-long blood light broke the Seal, abruptly gushing out from the depths of the ground.
What is this?
Big Black Horse stared at the ten-thousand-feet-long blood light, his pupils suddenly constricting.
He trembled, suddenly struck by an indescribable terror.
This turned out to be a Blood Dragon!
Drenched in an all-encompassing crimson glow, it emanated endless murderous auras.
This energy was sharp and ferocious, as if capable of devouring everything in the world.
"JIEH HEH HEH!"
Upon the appearance of this colossal Blood Dragon, it immediately emitted a strange cackle, the kind only humans could make.
Spotting the sea of blood in the void, it opened its mouth wide and swallowed it voraciously.
The elder monk in red robes beside them jolted awake at this moment.
What’s this?
The elder monk gazed in horror at the Blood Dragon before him, his eyes nearly popping out.
Having spent such a long time at Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge, he had never seen this Blood Dragon before.
Glancing towards the ground, he noticed a large hole that had cracked open.
The muscles on the monk’s face twitched uncontrollably. He immediately recognized the origin of this Blood Dragon.
Buried deep within the ground lay a Divine Dragon from the Ancient Times.
Unbelievably, it was still alive.
Yet he had failed to notice the existence of this Blood Dragon all this time.
"That bald human, we’ve been neighbors for many years. You wouldn’t have guessed, would you?"
The Blood Dragon circled in the sky, its savage eyes fixed on them. Its voice was cold and wild, its cold eyes revealing a bloodthirsty killing intent, making it seem as if the red-robed elder monk was about to become a tasty morsel in its view.
"What exactly are you?" the elder monk asked in terror.
"I am a Divine Dragon, a bona fide Divine Dragon," the Blood Dragon broke into a hearty laugh.
The next moment, it lunged at the elder monk.
Horror filled the monk’s face.
He turned to flee, but he was no match for the Blood Dragon’s speed.
In an instant, a streak of blood light swept through space, and the red-robed elder monk vanished into the void.
Seconds later, the Blood Dragon reappeared mid-air.
The Blood Dragon chewed a couple of times, then laughed and said, "It’s been a long time since I’ve eaten a real human. This flavor is truly exquisite."
"You sure are ruthless!" Big Black Horse gave a wicked grin.
He raised his golden axe, ready for battle.
"You’re from the Dragon Clan too, right?"
The savage eyes of the Blood Dragon swept across Big Black Horse, revealing a hint of bewildered uncertainty.
"Why have I never seen your kind in the Dragon Clan?"
Big Black Horse felt slightly awkward at the Blood Dragon’s question.
He only had half of the Dragon God Bloodline.
"Enough chatter. Show me what skills you possess to act so arrogantly," Big Black Horse raised his axe, issuing a challenge.
"A mere Eternal Realm Third Layer, you’re still no match for me. Considering you’re also from the Dragon Clan, why not serve under me?" the Blood Dragon laughed arrogantly.
"Get lost!" Big Black Horse felt insulted by those words and abruptly lunged at the Blood Dragon.
Big Black Horse couldn’t discern this Blood Dragon’s cultivation base either.
Because its Super Divine Dragon Breath was constantly undergoing all sorts of peculiar transformations, making it hard to distinguish.
The Blood Dragon lunged fiercely, extending its blood-red claws towards the golden axe.
BOOM!
The moment the claws touched the axe, golden lightning exploded from it.
The Blood Dragon was instantly blasted away by the golden lightning.
However, Big Black Horse wasn’t faring any better. He too was struck by a ferocious force and sent tumbling backward.
What kind of axe is this? The lightning on it is even stronger than a Thunder Dragon’s?
the Blood Dragon thought in surprise, glancing at its own claw.
That bolt of lightning possessed unimaginable destructive power, and half of its claw had even been blasted off.
It shook its claw, and in the next moment, it was back to normal.
"I’ve got my eyes on this treasure of yours, fellow."
A greedy glint appeared in the Blood Dragon’s eyes. It laughed heartily and charged at Big Black Horse again.
「Mid-air.」
A white figure flashed and suddenly appeared before the Blood Dragon.
The Blood Dragon, taken aback by the sudden appearance of the white figure, immediately halted mid-air.
There was someone here, and it hadn’t noticed their presence at all!
Where did he spring out from?
"Master, I can handle him! Let me have a proper fight with him!" Big Black Horse flew over from behind, standing beside Ye Yun, raising his axe as he spoke.
Despite his recent setback, Big Black Horse was still unwilling to admit defeat.
"For now, you’re not its match. No need to exhaust yourself," Ye Yun smiled faintly.
This Blood Dragon’s cultivation base was higher than Big Black Horse’s, and it had remarkable Innate Divine Ability. Big Black Horse was not its match yet.
However, if one day Big Black Horse managed to cultivate the Reincarnation Thunder Divine Skill, he might be able to compete with it.
Hearing his Master say this, Big Black Horse’s face flushed red.
He too was aware of the formidable opponent he had encountered.
Being half of the Dragon Clan, he understood how dreadful the Dragon Clan could be.
And this time, he had come across a mysterious one from the Dragon Clan.
This Blood Dragon was quite strange; even he couldn’t discern from which dragon lineage it belonged.
"Who are you?" the Blood Dragon watched Ye Yun warily, not attempting an attack.
"I am the thirteenth Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect," Ye Yun said with a smile.
"The Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect?"
The Blood Dragon shook its massive head, seemingly unable to recall any information related to this Dragon God Sect.
"No need to think. The Dragon God Sect did not exist during the Ancient Times," Ye Yun laughed.
"You’ve intercepted me. Do you intend to wage war against my God Dragon Clan?" the Blood Dragon asked in a solemn voice.
It had only just been revived, and its Cultivation Stage was still relatively low; it really didn’t want to fight this mysterious white-robed youth.
"Dare to battle the Master? I think you’re out of your mind! Come on, come on, let Uncle Ma exchange a few blows with you!"
Seeing the Blood Dragon’s arrogance, Big Black Horse lifted his golden axe once again.
Ye Yun reached out and held Big Black Horse back. Looking at the Blood Dragon, he calmly asked, "What Dragon God Bloodline are you exactly?"
"Only if you defeat me will you have the right to know about my bloodline," the Blood Dragon chuckled coldly.
"And what’s so difficult about defeating you?" Ye Yun laughed softly, lightly pointing his finger.
Instantly, the surrounding void felt as if countless great mountains were pressing in on the Blood Dragon.
The Blood Dragon’s body suddenly couldn’t move.
It felt an indescribably vast power pressing down on its body, making it difficult to even breathe.
Divine Sovereign Realm? How is this possible?
The Blood Dragon stared at the youth in white, a look of shock in its eyes.
The white-robed youth had suppressed it with a casual wave of his hand, giving it a sense of powerlessness one would only feel when facing Mighty ones in God-honored realm.
In the Ancient Times, powerful Divine Dragons had all reached the Divine Sovereign Realm.
"Heh heh..."
Ye Yun shook his head, a faint smile surfacing on his face.
Even a Divine Dragon of the Divine Sovereign Realm... was still insignificant before him.
"Speak. What Divine Dragon Bloodline is within you?" Ye Yun asked, his eyes glinting.
"I am the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon," the immobilized Blood Dragon said, a look of pride flashing in its eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 220: Is this the Bloodline of the Ancestor Dragon?
chapters.content:
Chapter 220: Chapter 220: Is this the Bloodline of the Ancestor Dragon?
"Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon?"
Ye Yun moved his lips slightly, mumbling these words.
Suddenly, his eyes seemed to become abstruse, with rays of light dramatically increasing within them.
In an instant, it seemed that the entirety of the Abyss was illuminated.
He finally remembered.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was ranked among the Ten Super Divine Dragons beneath the Ancestor Dragon, once a formidable existence in the Divine King Realm.
Ye Yun looked at the Blood Dragon in front of him and said lightly, "The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon is one of the Ten Super Divine Dragons. Its bloodline is pure and noble, far superior to the mingled and crude bloodline within you. You are a hybrid dragon, aren’t you?"
"So what if I am?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon responded defiantly.
It detested more than anything when people called it a hybrid dragon.
Indeed, the bloodline within its body was mixed, but it also contained the Blood Fiend Demon Dragon’s Bloodline, albeit very diluted.
"I see..."
Ye Yun started laughing.
No wonder he had a hard time discerning the origins of the Blood Dragon at first. It was indeed a hybrid dragon.
There were plenty of hybrid dragons in Ancient Times.
Due to the promiscuous nature of the Dragon Clan, many dragons became hybrids.
These dragons passed on their mixed bloodline from generation to generation through interbreeding, and their bloodlines became progressively more diluted and impure.
The Blood Dragon before him had a highly mixed and disordered bloodline.
Luckily, it possessed the Blood Fiend Demon Dragon’s Bloodline, a type of Super Divine Dragon bloodline, which suppressed the other bloodlines within its body.
It was this bloodline that allowed it to resurrect after its death in the Ancient Era.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was also known as the Undying Dragon.
With just a single drop of blood, they could be reborn, undoubtedly an undying, super-being.
Among the Ten Super Divine Dragons of the Ancient Era, it was one of the most powerful.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was naturally combative.
In Ancient Times, it was said to have even issued a challenge to the Ancestor Dragon.
This showed just how reckless and Lawless it was.
"
It was a Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, after all. I don’t feel ashamed about losing...
" Big Black Horse muttered to itself.
At that moment, it finally conceded that it stood no chance against the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon before it.
Even though the hybrid dragon’s bloodline was chaotic, it still contained the Blood Fiend Demon Dragon’s Bloodline.
It was the power of this undying bloodline that allowed it to resurrect after a million years.
The thought thrilled Big Black Horse in ways it could hardly express.
Ye Yun looked at the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon before him, his profound eyes twinkling.
With a light laugh, he said, "You little hybrid, even with such a thin trace of the Blood Fiend Demon Dragon’s Bloodline, you were able to resurrect after a million years. I wonder if your ancestor, the real Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, might still be alive?"
"How should I know?"
It was as if Ye Yun’s question had touched upon some pain. The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon then hung its head low, its mood obviously dampened.
Its ancestor, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, was one of the Ten Super Divine Dragons and was notorious and terrifically powerful. Even among those ten, it was ranked among the first few. During the internal conflict among the Ten Ancient Super Divine Dragons, its fate remained unknown, leaving everyone to wonder if it had fallen. It was among the earliest dragons to fall and wasn’t clear about many things that happened later. Upon its death, the diluted Blood Fiend Demon Dragon’s Bloodline within it allowed it to continually absorb the life energy of other Divine Dragons. After an extremely long period, it finally metamorphosed, and a second life was bestowed upon it. When it was first reborn, it was still very weak and spent its time cultivating in the Abyss, until it saw the red-robed Monk. Although the Monk didn’t notice it, it had already targeted the Monk as its future prey, jealously guarding its Seal, anticipating the day it would break free and consume the Monk.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was lost in thought. Unaware, in just a blink of an eye, the white-clothed youth in front of it had accessed its memories.
Ye Yun was silent.
In the memory of the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, he once again witnessed the countless majestic Dragon Clans inhabiting the Dragon Hidden Continent.
Their magnificence and vastness were beyond description.
However, the battles between the dragons were extremely brutal.
This little hybrid dragon had only been at the True God Realm back then.
It ultimately died in a Dragon Clan battle.
"Are you willing to join my Dragon God Sect?" Ye Yun asked, his eyes intensely fixed on the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon.
"Dragon God Sect?"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon blinked, subconsciously responding, "What kind of Sect is that? Was it established by the Human Race?"
Ye Yun nodded.
"How could I, a mere Divine Dragon, join a minor Human Race Sect? That’s absolutely impossible! Even if you kill me, I will not agree!"
As if a raw nerve had been touched, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon roared emotionally.
Ye Yun did not take offense; he just smiled a little.
He understood very well that every member of the Dragon Clan is a proud being, especially those Divine Dragons from Ancient Times. The Human Race was insignificant during the Ancient Times, especially on the Dragon Hidden Continent. In the eyes of a Divine Dragon, humans were all inferior beings. But time had changed everything; everything was different now. Even though this Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon in front of him had some abilities, it stood no chance against the formidable forces of the Human Race in the Divine Land. Ye Yun did not want this Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon to die for nothing. After all, its bloodline was extremely rare and needed to be preserved. Being a transmigrator, Ye Yun was familiar with news about wildlife preservation often broadcast in the media. What he was doing now... was saving the God Dragon Clan from extinction.
Seeing how stubborn the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was, Big Black Horse showed an expression of disappointment and coldly said, "You really don’t know what’s good for you."
"So what if I don’t know? There is absolutely no way I would join a Human cultivator’s Sect!" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon growled in reply.
"Is that so?"
Ye Yun laughed instead of getting angry, his face calm and serene.
His body trembled slightly, and a strand of the Ancestor Dragon’s Super Divine Dragon Breath swept over like a tidal wave.
Ancestral Dragon Bloodline, the ultimate power throughout the ages. All Divine Dragons of the world, none can defy.
A massive wave of pure bloodline power rolled forth. It was so overwhelming that the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was taken aback.
"This is...?"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon hesitated for a beat before it suddenly exclaimed, "Is this the bloodline of the Ancestor Dragon?"
At this moment, it stared hard at Ye Yun, its eyes nearly bulging out of their sockets.
In its wildest dreams, it would never have imagined that this seemingly ordinary human would possess the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline. How was this even possible? The Ancestor Dragon was high above and had never intermarried with the Human Race. How could this human have such a pure and powerful Ancestral Dragon Bloodline in his body?
"Impossible! The Ancestor Dragon disappeared long ago! There’s no way the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline can still exist in this world, much less a Human cultivator with the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline! You... you must have cast an Illusion Technique on me!" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon roared in grief and indignation.
At this moment, its emotions were running extremely high.
Even if it was an Illusion Technique, it could clearly feel the rich aura of the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline after all these years, causing its emotions to spiral out of control.
"Master, I think this fellow’s brain must be fried..." Big Black Horse smacked its lips at the side, shaking its head and sighing in frustration.

chapters.title: Chapter 221: Ancestral Dragon Power, Suppressing the Universe
chapters.content:
Chapter 221: Chapter 221: Ancestral Dragon Power, Suppressing the Universe
"It’s not that it’s unintelligent; it’s just that its inner pride prevents it from bowing its noble head."
Ye Yun smiled faintly.
He waved his hand gently, dispelling the immense Spatial Power pressing down on the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon.
Regaining control of its body, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon shuddered. It keenly sensed that it hadn’t been ensnared by any Illusion Technique.
How could this be possible?
How could this white-robed youth possess... the Ancestral Dragon’s Breath?
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s eyes widened as it suddenly charged towards Ye Yun.
"What do you think you’re doing?"
Big Black Horse immediately raised his axe, stepping in front of Ye Yun to protect him. He feared the demonic dragon might lose control and attack the Master.
"Don’t be afraid. It merely wishes to sense the Ancestral Dragon’s Breath up close."
Ye Yun gently pushed Big Black Horse aside.
Just then, a streak of blood-red light shot from the distance. It stopped about seven or eight zhang (roughly seventy to eighty feet) from Ye Yun and prostrated itself.
It kowtowed, touching its forehead to the ground at Ye Yun’s feet.
"Unbelievable! This is truly the Ancestral Dragon’s Breath! How... how did you manage this?"
Could it be... the Ancestor Dragon and the Human Race produced descendants?
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon murmured to itself.
Its tone had lost all its previous arrogance. Prostrate at Ye Yun’s feet, its body trembled uncontrollably.
It was just a lowly mixed-blood dragon. Although it carried the Blood Fiend Demon Dragon’s Bloodline—one of the Ten Super Divine Dragons—the lineage was extremely diluted. How could it withstand the pressure of the Ancestral Dragon’s Breath?
"My possession of the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline is not for you to question!" Ye Yun’s eyes narrowed, emitting two cold glints of light.
At that instant, he increased the output of his Ancestral Dragon’s Breath.
Instantly, an even more ferocious and supremely powerful Ancestral Dragon’s Breath washed over it, stunning the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon.
So pure! It was as if the Ancestor Dragon Itself had appeared before it!
"Greetings, Ancestor Dragon!"
Having come to its senses, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon transformed into a youth in a blood robe. He knelt respectfully on the ground and kowtowed repeatedly without hesitation.
"Arise."
Ye Yun smiled faintly.
This Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon has finally made the correct choice under the pressure of my Ancestral Dragon Bloodline.
Any member of the Dragon Clan, upon sensing the Ancestral Dragon’s Breath, would submit.
This was a rule deeply ingrained within their bloodline.
"From now on, you will address me as Old Master," Ye Yun added after a moment’s thought.
"Yes, Old Master!"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon nodded eagerly. When he looked up at Ye Yun, his eyes shone with fervent adoration.
He had never dreamed that one day he would be able to stand beside a Successor of the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline!
Back in the Ancient Times, he was merely a mixed-blood dragon of far too low a rank. Forget the Ancestor Dragon; among the Ten Super Divine Dragons, the only one he had ever seen was the original Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon.
That was at a pre-battle mobilization meeting when his ancestor, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, appeared and gave them a few instructions.
That was the extent of it.
As for the Ancestor Dragon, even the Ten Super Divine Dragons rarely had the chance to meet Him.
Thus, ordinary beings could not possibly comprehend the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s current state of mind.
His body trembled unceasingly, the excitement in his heart surging like a relentless tsunami.
"I am the thirteenth Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect. Henceforth, you shall be a demon beast of the Dragon God Sect. Understood?"
Ye Yun looked at the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, his voice laced with an undeniable authority.
"Understood, Old Master!"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s eyes grew moist. He wiped a tear from the corner of his eye and said with emotion, "I was ignorant earlier. Please forgive me, Old Master."
Ye Yun nodded.
He then looked towards the depths of the earth, where ten thousand Divine Dragons were buried. That place still possessed an incredibly dense Dragon Qi.
Ye Yun’s eyes flickered as a thought occurred to him.
If I were to collect Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge, it would make an excellent Secret Realm for the disciples of the Dragon God Sect to use for their Cultivation.
He began to search his storage. He needed a treasure capable of holding the entirety of Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge so he could take it with him.
Seeing that the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon had also taken human form, Big Black Horse walked over cheerfully, clapped him on the shoulder, and said with a grin, "Senior, from now on, we’re fellow disciples of the same Sect!"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon glanced at Big Black Horse and, sensing the aura of the Dragon Clan Bloodline within him, felt a sense of kinship.
"Indeed! From now on, I’ll be with you," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said with a laugh.
Big Black Horse quickly shook his head, a look of apprehension on his face. "Senior, you’ve lived for ages! I’m just a junior. It’s better if you take the lead."
"No, no, no..." the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon chuckled, "I’ve only just been reborn. In terms of age, I’m much younger than you. You should be the leader; I’ll be second-in-command."
His tension gradually eased.
Listening to their exchange, Ye Yun inwardly shook his head.
According to the information in my mind, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon is known for being fierce and brave in battle, but also cunning—these traits are determined by its bloodline.
The reason this Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon is acting so chummy with Big Black Horse is likely due to that cunning nature still being at play.
But Ye Yun wasn’t concerned.
In the Ancient Era, there were countless dragons, each with different personalities, yet all lived harmoniously under the rule of the Ancestor Dragon.
Even if this Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon has some unsavory tendencies, it won’t be able to stir up any trouble under my nose.
After a few moments, Ye Yun finally found a treasure capable of holding the entire Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge.
A green Bead appeared in his hand.
Big Black Horse’s eyes widened instantly, his gaze drawn to it with curiosity.
He sensed that this Bead was extraordinary, containing a dense Spatial Power.
"Let’s go up first," Ye Yun said, looking at the two of them. His body then shot upwards, towards the top of the Abyss.
Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon hastily followed.
They flew out of the Abyss and hovered in mid-air.
With a wave of Ye Yun’s hand, the black carriage resting on Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge instantly levitated and, in a flash, appeared before him.
This sudden development startled Big Black Cat and Kitty inside the carriage; they thought they were under some mysterious attack.
However, upon seeing their Master and Uncle Ma nearby, the two cats’ hearts, which had leaped into their throats, finally settled.
Ye Yun held the green Bead in his left hand and gently tossed it into the air.
The green Bead floated in mid-air, emitting mystical rays of green light.
"What kind of treasure is this?" Big Black Cat’s eyes widened, staring intently at the green Bead.
Ye Yun extended his right hand and made a gentle grasping motion towards Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge.
BOOM!
At that moment, Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge, which stretched for tens of thousands of miles, was violently uprooted in its entirety!
The colossal mountain range ascended into the sky, flying towards the green Bead.
This mountain...
Kitty stared, her eyes wide with disbelief at the incredible scene before her. She was so shocked she felt almost petrified.
Not only was the entire mountain range uprooted, but its roots, extending tens of thousands of miles deep, were also pulled out along with it.
What immense power... to accomplish such a feat!
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s breathing grew ragged, his blood boiling with excitement.
He sensed the trace of Ancestral Dragon Power emanating from the Old Master.
It was this very power that had so effortlessly uprooted the massive mountain.
Ancestral Dragon Power, suppressing the entire cosmos! Truly terrifying!

chapters.title: Chapter 223: Shenhu Mountain Divorce
chapters.content:
Chapter 223: Chapter 223: Shenhu Mountain Divorce
The Big Black Horse pulled the carriage, slowly heading towards Shenhu Mountain. As it moved along, it chuckled inwardly.
This time, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon has truly been thoroughly suppressed by the Lord! A perfectly good Blood Dragon, actually turned into a little red cat by the Lord... How amusing!
In a stuttering voice, Little Cat said, "Senior, actually, being a cat isn’t so bad. Look at me; I’ve grown used to it."
"Is that so?" The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon lay moodily on the carriage, its eyes lifeless as it stared at the sky outside.
At this point, the Big Black Cat collected itself. Realizing it was a good time to curry favor with the senior, it quickly chimed in with a laugh, "Senior, being a cat is actually not bad. Why don’t you try it for now? After a while, maybe the Lord will change you back."
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon desperately wanted to say,
It’s still better to be a dragon!
But the thought of the Lord sitting inside the carriage made it suppress its frustration and swallow those words.
"Being a cat is quite nice," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon suddenly said with a laugh.
The Big Black Cat scrutinized its face suspiciously. Finding the laugh to be genuine, it couldn’t help but mutter to itself,
Could it be that this senior from the Dragon Clan before me is really so willing to be a cat?
it wondered.
"Senior, where did you come from?" Seeing the little red cat before her, Little Cat felt a great sense of closeness. She actually mustered the courage to ask about the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s origins.
"I..." The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was about to speak but suddenly closed its mouth. Now that it had become a cat, it was better not to speak of matters from the Ancient Times. "I was in secluded cultivation in Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge. I happened to meet the Lord and followed him back," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon explained feebly.
"Oh, so that’s how it is!" Little Cat nodded quickly.
Looking at Little Cat’s dazed and cute expression, Big Black Cat wished it could reach out and smack her on the forehead.
This girl is truly audacious, daring to say anything in front of an Eternal Realm senior. A newborn calf truly doesn’t fear a tiger.
Suddenly, an idea seemed to strike Little Cat, and her face lit up with joy as she looked at the Big Black Horse ahead and asked, "Uncle Ma, is our next stop Shenhu Mountain?"
The Big Black Horse chuckled. "Yes, we’re headed to Shenhu Mountain. Didn’t the Lord promise to help you annul your engagement?"
Hearing this, Little Cat broke into an excited laugh.
Having left the territory of Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge, the Big Black Horse guided the carriage down from the sky. After all, the original Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge had become an unfathomable abyss, which was why the Big Black Horse had taken to the air.
As they traveled leisurely along the mountain path, cultivators who saw the black carriage pass by couldn’t help but marvel.
"Look! There are three cats lounging on that carriage. You can tell how much the owner loves cats!"
"Indeed..."
"..."
Being pointed at and commented on throughout the journey made the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon a bit uncomfortable, but it dared not show the slightest anger. The Lord possessed the Ancestral Dragon Body and was, in its heart, as sacred as the Ancestor Dragon itself. It was now pondering what could have happened after Lord Ancestor Dragon disappeared back in the Ancient Times to make the white-robed Lord before it so similar to the Ancestor Dragon.
The very thought made its head feel like it was about to explode. Anyway, I’m a cat now; no one will say anything about how I behave.
So, it simply burrowed its head into its soft belly and fell asleep.Seeing the senior fall asleep, the Big Black Cat couldn’t help but curl its lip. "Little Cat, how far is it from here to Shenhu Mountain?" Big Black Cat asked quietly.
"Probably about a two to three-day journey," Little Cat replied, gauging the carriage’s speed and making a quick mental calculation.
"That’s perfect. I can get some more cultivation in," the Big Black Cat said with a laugh. So, it closed its eyes and resumed cultivating the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye. This Divine Skill had saved its life several times in the Nine Soul Underground Palace, so the Big Black Cat was now intensely focused on mastering it. It practiced tirelessly day and night, striving to achieve initial mastery as soon as possible.
Little Cat also felt quite bored, so she too began to cultivate where she sat.
The Big Black Horse traveled with his eyes slightly closed, secretly practicing the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye as he went. He was also extremely dedicated to this Divine Skill, having personally witnessed the power the Lord wielded when using it.
The journey continued smoothly, with no cultivators disturbing them.
「Three days later.」
The black carriage arrived at the foot of Shenhu Mountain.
"We’re finally here!" Little Cat exclaimed, standing up excitedly as she gazed at the familiar black mountain.
The Big Black Cat also stood up. It had promised Little Cat to help her annul this engagement.
This time, I have to take the lead. If my strength isn’t enough, then I’ll ask Uncle Ma to step in.
Shenhu Mountain stretched for thousands of miles, its range resembling a colossal tiger lying prostrate upon the earth, its aura overwhelmingly powerful. The Big Black Horse pulled the carriage deeper into the mountain range.
「Two hours later.」
They saw the settlement of the Golden Striped Tiger Clan.
"Who goes there?" Two young men from the Demon Clan, both Golden Striped Black Tigers, suddenly appeared and blocked their path.
Little Cat transformed, assuming the appearance of a charming young woman in red. "It’s me!" Little Cat said coldly. "I’m here to see your Clan Leader. Go and inform him."
The two young men instantly recognized the stunningly beautiful Little Cat and knew where she came from. The newcomer was none other than the fiancée of their young master, from the Sky Spirit Cat Clan.
"Alright!" Neither of them dared to delay. One of the young men immediately turned and hurried off to report.
The Big Black Horse continued to pull the carriage forward without stopping. The other young man didn’t dare to obstruct them.
The Big Black Cat also transformed, taking on the guise of a young man in a black robe.
"If you need my help, just give a shout!" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon called out, looking up at Big Black Cat. He had been bored stiff on this journey and, finding the rare excitement of an engagement annulment, wanted to get involved.
Big Black Cat turned its head, smiled, and said, "Senior, why don’t you come in with me?"
"Alright!" The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon perked up instantly and, with a leap, landed on Big Black Cat’s shoulder. Its body shifted, shrinking even smaller than before. Like a miniature red kitten, it perched on Big Black Cat’s shoulder, small and exquisite, looking utterly adorable.
"Don’t call me Senior anymore; it makes me sound too old. Why don’t you just call me Second Brother?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon suggested, shaking its head.
"Second Brother?" Big Black Cat was startled and hastily shook his head. "That won’t do, Senior! We mustn’t break the rules of propriety."
"Fine, fine!" The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon sighed and shook its head helplessly.
The carriage proceeded inward, finally stopping in a large plaza. Little Cat and Big Black Cat jumped down from the carriage and walked towards the grand hall up ahead.
At this moment, a burly man clad in black armor strode quickly out from the hall.
Big Black Cat was delighted the moment it saw this person.
Ah, it’s this lovable oaf again!
The Golden Striped Black Tiger’s eyes lit up when he saw Little Cat. He grinned and said, "Little Cat, you’re back just in time! Otherwise, I would have had to go to your Sky Spirit Cat Clan to see your parents."
"See my parents?" Little Cat’s expression instantly turned icy.

chapters.title: Chapter 224: What Should Have Happened Has Happened
chapters.content:
Chapter 224: Chapter 224: What Should Have Happened Has Happened
"By our parents’ command and the matchmaker’s word, we are already betrothed. All that’s left is the wedding ceremony and to share the bridal chamber," the Golden Striped Black Tiger said with his arms crossed, chuckling.
He completely ignored the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat standing beside him.
In his eyes, there was a gap of three minor realms separating the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat from him; it surely stood no chance.
They were surrounded by their clan members and Elders. Each of them possessed an astounding cultivation base; the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat was certainly no match for them.
The Golden Striped Black Tiger casually glanced at the black carriage parked in the distance.
The carriage was ordinary, and the Big Black Horse pulling it was also unremarkable, failing to arouse his interest in the slightest.
Instead, his gaze fell on a tiny red cat lying on the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat’s shoulder; it was miniature, exquisite, and extremely cute.
The Golden Striped Black Tiger pursed his lips, thinking:
The Nine-tailed Spirit Cat has truly peculiar taste.
Seeing the absolute certainty in the Golden Striped Black Tiger’s words, and that he even intended to involve their parents, infuriated Mao Bao’er.
"I came to see you this time to annul our engagement!" she yelled angrily, hands akimbo.
"Annul our engagement? That’s impossible! Call your parents over and let’s see if they dare utter such words," he laughed arrogantly.
A group of robust young men, each with a cultivation base at the Destiny Realm, immediately appeared, menacingly surrounding the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat and Mao Bao’er in the center.
The Golden Striped Black Tiger became even more brazen, a cold sneer constantly on his face.
On his own turf, he feared nothing. Whoever dared to make trouble, he would eliminate them.
The Big Black Cat stood with his hands behind his back. Recalling the dignity of his Master, he calmly said, "Stupid and naïve, you have to annul this marriage whether you want to or not."
"Who do you think you are, daring to talk to my big brother like that?"
At this, a bulky young man suddenly charged toward the Big Black Cat and threw a punch.
The wind from the punch whistled.
BOOM!
The Big Black Cat retaliated with a punch. Their fists collided in mid-air, producing a deafening boom.
From this single exchange, the robust young man was sent flying backward.
Why is this guy’s physical strength so formidable?
the robust young man cursed inwardly, glaring fiercely at the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat.
"Little bro, you two may be on the same cultivation level," the Golden Striped Black Tiger whispered, patting his shoulder. "But this guy consumed a lot of Eternal Life Immortal Grass in the Nine Soul Underground Palace. His physical strength is extremely high now."
A look of sudden realization flashed across the robust young man’s face.
"Don’t worry, little bro. Big bro will avenge you," the Golden Striped Black Tiger said, stepping forward two paces, his joints emitting a series of cracking sounds.
He glared at the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat and gave a sinister smile. "Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, you want to annul the engagement? Come on, let’s exchange a few blows. If you can defeat me, I might just agree!"
"Is that so?"
The Big Black Cat also gave a cold smile and fearlessly stepped forward.
"Big Brother, be careful!" Mao Bao’er whispered from behind.
"Rest assured."
The Big Black Cat smiled confidently.
Would he be in danger? Absolutely not! He has an Eternal Realm Great Demon squatting on his shoulder. And this isn’t just any ordinary Eternal Realm Great Demon, but one from the Dragon Clan, three parts more formidable than even Uncle Ma. What in the world does he have to fear? Taking a step back, Uncle Ma is still watching intently from the rear, and there’s an even more powerful Master waiting in the carriage. His current backing is unimaginably profound.
Although the Big Black Cat knew his own strength was lacking, he was currently representing the Dragon God Sect to handle this matter of annulling the engagement.
Therefore, he absolutely could not show the slightest hint of cowardice.
Upon hearing Mao Bao’er’s words from behind, the Golden Striped Black Tiger burned with jealousy and roared, "Mao Bao’er, whose fiancée are you exactly? How did you get so chummy with the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat?"
"Whose fiancée she is... is none of your damn business," the Big Black Cat chuckled coldly.
"Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, what exactly happened between you and Mao Bao’er during this time?" the Golden Striped Black Tiger roared furiously.
At this moment, his bones were crackling, and a thick layer of black light surged around his body, ready to attack the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat at any moment.
"Everything went as you wished; whatever should have happened, happened," the Big Black Cat chuckled shamelessly.
"I... I’ll kill you!" the Golden Striped Black Tiger roared angrily, immediately drawing his gleaming, large saber and slashing down.
The Big Black Cat took out his Black Shield, infusing it with Mana to meet the attack.
BANG!
The saber crashed onto the shield. A massive force struck him, sending the Big Black Cat reeling backward several steps.
The Golden Striped Black Tiger, however, stood his ground, completely motionless.
The Big Black Cat was greatly startled. His physical body was so formidable now, yet he was still no match for his opponent. It seemed the gap of three minor realms still created a considerable distance between him and this ’Stupid and naïve’ fellow.
"Little Black, throw me over there," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon transmitted.
Throw Senior over there?
The Big Black Cat was momentarily bewildered.
Throwing him over seems like a bad idea. This is an Eternal Realm dragon, isn’t it?
WHOOSH!
The light of the saber flashed.
The Golden Striped Black Tiger once again savagely slashed over.
This time, a sky-filling torrent of saber light, like a tsunami, rushed down.
The Big Black Cat, unable to dodge, held the shield before him. Then, with his other hand, he snatched the little red cat from his shoulder and flung it out.
The little red cat seemed to transform into a red ball in mid-air, fiercely crashing into the overwhelming saber light.
BOOM!
A crimson shadow shattered the sky-filling saber light, forcefully breaking through and slamming straight into the Golden Striped Black Tiger’s chest.
PFFT!
The Golden Striped Black Tiger spat out a mouthful of fresh blood on the spot, his body suddenly flying backward.
The young men watching the battle from the side witnessed this scene and were immediately startled. Several of them quickly flew over to catch the Golden Striped Black Tiger.
The Golden Striped Black Tiger stared wide-eyed in disbelief as a crimson blur flew back towards the Big Black Cat.
What kind of cat is this? How can its body be so incredibly hard?
"Big brother, are you okay?" a young man beside him quickly asked.
"I’ve just suffered some injuries."
The Golden Striped Black Tiger took out a medicinal pill, swallowed it immediately, then struggled to stand up.
He had sustained some injuries that weren’t too severe, but they impacted his combat strength.
Just as he was preparing to continue the fight, an aged voice suddenly called out from above.
"Who dares to intrude upon my Golden Striped Black Tiger Clan and injure my clansmen?"
Upon hearing these words, the Golden Striped Black Tiger immediately froze.
Several black-robed old men descended from the sky.
"Greetings, Clan Leader! Greetings, Elders!" the surrounding young men hurriedly bowed in respect.
These old men were indeed the Elders and the Clan Leader of the Golden Striped Black Tiger Clan.
The Golden Striped Black Tiger looked at the black-robed elder in the middle, who had three golden stripes on his face, and said with vexation, "Father, someone is bullying your son!"
The black-robed elder’s gaze, as sharp as two swords, shot towards the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat not far away.
"You’re the one who hurt my son?"
The elder was wreathed in black light, his aura profound and heavy, like a towering mountain.
The oppressive aura of a peak expert of the Tenth Level of the Destiny Realm rolled down upon them.

chapters.title: Chapter 225: Red Cat Strikes, Cang Token
chapters.content:
Chapter 225: Chapter 225: Red Cat Strikes, Cang Token
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon raised its tiny red paw and gently scratched Big Black Cat’s shoulder, instantly dispelling the overwhelming pressure.
Big Black Cat stood in place unfazed, his gaze sharp as he stared at the Black Robed Elder, a mocking laugh escaping his lips.
"So what if I injured him? Are you old geezer planning on ganging up on me?"
Big Black Cat laughed heartily.
"You underestimate our Golden Striped Black Tiger Clan too much, Clan Leader! Let me teach this arrogant fool a lesson."
An Elder leaped out, a formidable demon at the Heavenly Fate Realm Level Eight.
"Very well!"
The Black Robed Elder nodded.
He too wanted to see what the black-robed youth across from him was capable of to injure his son.
That guy was merely at the Heavenly Order Realm Third Layer, at least three minor realms below his son.
"Dad, be careful of that red Little Cat on his shoulder; that’s what injured me earlier," the Golden Striped Black Tiger hastily warned.
"Really?"
The Black Robed Elder narrowed his eyes, studying the red Little Cat.
He found that the red Little Cat was just an ordinary little cat, nothing extraordinary about it.
While he was pondering in confusion, the Elder by his side had already charged.
The Elder who entered the fray wielded a longsword.
In an instant, a shower of sword shadows poured down, the sword light terrifyingly sharp, as it cut through everything, falling in a flurry.
Big Black Cat, having a keen eye, naturally recognized the Elder’s strength. Knowing he was outmatched, he had the self-awareness to admit his disadvantage this time.
Without hesitation, he grabbed the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon on his shoulder and forcefully threw it.
A ball of blood-red light immediately crashed into the sword shadows.
BOOM!
The sky full of sword shadows instantly vanished. A red ball of light then rapidly smashed towards the Elder’s shoulder.
SPLAT!
The Elder spurted a mouthful of blood, his body suddenly blown backward.
The Black Robed Elder watched this scene, his eyes wide in disbelief.
What kind of monster was this red Little Cat? Why was it more formidable than a magical treasure?
Someone immediately caught the wounded Elder.
After two consecutive victories, Big Black Cat laughed triumphantly. "You must be Stupid and Naïve’s dad, right? I’m here on Cat Bao’er’s behalf to cancel the engagement."
"Can a marriage contract be canceled just because you say so? Besides, this matter was decided by Cat Bao’er’s parents and me. It’s not your place as an outsider to interfere," the Black Robed Elder responded coldly.
He didn’t act impulsively for the time being but kept scrutinizing the tiny red Little Cat perched on the black-robed youth’s shoulder.
Other than its cuteness, this Little Cat didn’t seem threatening at all. If it really were a supreme demon, he should at least feel a hint of Demonic Aura, but there was none. This kept him confused.
"I decide my own marriage! Whatever you say counts for nothing!" Cat Bao’er felt aggrieved, her eyes turning red. She stared at the Black Robed Elder across from her and shouted with clenched fists.
"Cat Bao’er, don’t be so stubborn. If your parents find out, they will be heartbroken..." the Black Robed Elder tried to persuade her gently.
"Stop talking nonsense!" Seeing Cat Bao’er getting emotional, Big Black Cat quickly stood in front of her, staring fiercely at the Black Robed Elder. "The marriage is off. We are already together; everything that should have happened has happened."
"What did you say?"
