Upon hearing the black-robed youth so brazenly utter such words, the Black Robed Elder was immediately enraged.
He abruptly raised his palm and slapped it towards Big Black Cat.
He was a Half-Step Life-Death Realm powerhouse.
This slap blotted out the sky, pressing down like a dark cloud.
Without the slightest hesitation, Big Black Cat threw the red Little Cat from his shoulder.
As he threw it, Big Black Cat even sent a telepathic message to the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, "Senior, I’m really sorry, but I have to use you again..."
He feared that this senior would hold a grudge against him and seek retaliation in the future.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon laughed heartily and replied telepathically, "Fear not, Little black boy. As a senior, it’s only right that I help you break off this marriage."
"’Then thank you very much, Senior,’ Big Black Cat replied telepathically, full of gratitude.
BOOM!
The red sphere collided with the palm and was instantly sent flying.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon did not press its advantage but instead performed a mid-air somersault, bouncing back to land on Big Black Cat’s shoulder.
The Black Robed Elder felt a burning pain in his palm. He looked at it and saw that it was completely red.
He was instantly stunned.
What kind of monster was this little red cat? Even he, a Half-Step Life-Death Realm powerhouse, could not repel it?
The other Elders of the Golden Striped Black Tiger Clan turned pale when they saw this. The little red cat was too bizarre. In all their long lives, they had never encountered such a strange feline race.
Big Black Cat glanced at the Black Robed Elder and chuckled, "Old man, you can’t even defeat me, yet you still refuse to cancel the marriage? Don’t provoke me, or I’ll flatten your Shenhu Mountain!"
Big Black Cat’s gallant words, paired with his imposing demeanor, frightened the surrounding youths, causing them to retreat repeatedly.
The Black Robed Elder’s eyes narrowed, his gaze growing intensely cold. A few seconds later, he drew a deep breath and fiercely pulled out a token.
It was a blackish-green token.
The token was extremely ancient, engraved with archaic runes.
The Golden Striped Black Tiger was astonished when he saw his father produce this token.
"Father, are you planning to use the Cang Token?" the Golden Striped Black Tiger asked.
"Exactly. That little red cat is too strange. I have no choice but to use the Cang Token," the Black Robed Elder said with a grave expression.
Upon seeing the Cang Token, looks of reverence appeared on the faces of the other Golden Striped Black Tiger clan members.
「Inside the carriage.」
Ye Yun looked at the token with interest.
What could a small token like this do? Could it summon powerful experts?
Ye Yun couldn’t help but feel a sense of anticipation.
The Black Robed Elder placed the Cang Token on his forehead and said reverently, "I beseech the Shang God of the Cang Spirit Realm to descend and lend this humble one your aid!"
After he finished speaking, the token suddenly transformed into a ray of light and vanished into thin air.
Big Black Cat watched the Black Robed Elder’s bewildering actions in surprise.
What is he doing? Is he preparing to summon help?
He wasn’t afraid even if they did summon assistance. What kind of help could a minor Golden Striped Black Tiger Clan summon? At most, a Life and Death Realm expert. If they could summon an Eternal Realm demon, then he would acknowledge their strength.
A streak of light disappeared into the void. A few breaths later, another streak of light descended from the void.
However, this light was a dazzling white that entered the Black Robed Elder’s body in the blink of an eye.
In an instant, the Black Robed Elder’s appearance changed dramatically.
He had completely transformed into a man clad in golden armor.
This man wielded a long spear, his aura majestic. He exuded a potent demeanor, as if he could single-handedly hold off ten thousand foes.
"What is this?" Big Black Cat was dumbstruck.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon beside him licked its lips, looking curiously at the golden-armored man opposite them.
This technique was very mysterious; he couldn’t figure it out for a moment. Was it one of the Black Robed Elder’s own Divine Skills, or had someone forcibly possessed him?

chapters.title: Chapter 226: The Qin Family’s Tyrant Spear
chapters.content:
Chapter 226: Chapter 226: The Qin Family’s Tyrant Spear
The Big Black Cat quickly took stock of the armored man’s cultivation base and discovered that he had reached Level Three of Life and Death.
This left him even more stupefied.
As the light descended, the man underwent a complete transformation. Not only did his appearance drastically change, but his Cultivation Stage ascended as well.
What kind of Divine Skill was this?
Suddenly, the Big Black Cat tentatively asked, "Old man, are you still yourself?"
"Nonsense!" the armored man abruptly roared, pointing his spear at the Big Black Cat.
So it’s still the original him after all.
The Big Black Cat was somewhat puzzled.
Immediately after, the armored man’s expression changed, becoming incredibly authoritative and exceedingly domineering. He bellowed, "Take this spear!"
As he spoke, a brilliant golden light shot out fiercely.
BOOM!
The void shattered.
The power of this spear was clearly unimaginable.
The Big Black Cat was shocked.
That voice was clearly different from the robed elder’s. Could it be that there’s another soul residing in this body right now?
The spear was so incredibly fast that the Big Black Cat couldn’t react in time.
At that moment, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon abruptly shot up from him, hurtling towards the spearhead.
BOOM!
The invincible silver spear struck the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and was instantly repelled.
"How is this possible?" The armored man stared at the repelled red Little Cat, his face etched with astonishment.
All the nearby Clan Members of the Golden Striped Black Tiger Clan were also stunned, an indescribable fear surging within their hearts.
This red Little Cat... What on earth is its origin?
Even their clan’s most mysterious Spirit Invocation Art couldn’t handle this red Little Cat.
After their Spirit Invocation Art took effect, their Clan Leader’s Cultivation Stage had soared to Level Three of Life and Death.
At this cultivation base, no one in the entire Heavenly Star Dynasty was his match.
At this moment, Ye Yun, who was inside the carriage, felt his pupils contract sharply.
He actually recognized familiar traces within the armored man’s spear technique.
The Qin Family’s Tyrant Spear!
The Qin Family possessed three great ultimate arts, and the Tyrant Spear was one of them.
Once the Tyrant Spear was utilized, it was said to have the staggering power for a single person to hold off an entire army.
This is truly strange. How would the armored man know the Qin Family’s Tyrant Spear?
Ye Yun murmured to himself.
Suddenly, the light in his eyes grew increasingly brighter.
The man before him isn’t a physical entity, but a spiritual body!
With a flash of his will, Ye Yun instantly entered the storehouse, arriving beside the Rebirth Lightning Pool.
He sent out a mental command, and a piece of Soul Nurturing Wood floated out.
An ethereal image of a beautiful woman emerged from the Soul Nurturing Wood.
It was Qin Yao.
"Qin Yao, I actually saw the Qin Family’s Tyrant Spear technique outside!" Ye Yun said directly.
"What? Brother Yun, you saw the Qin Family’s Tyrant Spear? Does this mean that after one hundred thousand years, descendants of the Qin Family are still alive in this world?" Qin Yao exclaimed, both surprised and overjoyed.
"He doesn’t exist in a true physical form. He’s a spiritual body that descended into a member of the Golden Striped Black Tiger Demon Clan to utilize the Tyrant Spear," Ye Yun explained.
Qin Yao’s eyes darted around for a moment. After a brief thought, she said, "Brother Yun, I died young. I don’t know if the Qin Family faced retaliation from enemies after my death. So, I’m also unsure if, after one hundred thousand years, the Qin Family still has any Successors remaining in this world."
Ye Yun nodded slightly.
Then, with a flicker, his form appeared beside Qin Yao.
He gently caressed the forehead of the ethereal Qin Yao, his smile warm and affectionate. "Continue to rest and cultivate peacefully here," he said tenderly. "I’ll figure things out and come back to tell you."
"Alright, Brother Yun." Qin Yao smiled gently and thoughtfully. She obediently transformed into a beam of light and re-entered the Soul Nurturing Wood.
The Soul Nurturing Wood once again submerged into the waters of the Rebirth Lightning Pool.
With another flicker of his will, Ye Yun returned to his body.
At this moment, the Big Black Cat was looking smugly at the armored man, and said with a grin, "You’re no match for me either. You might as well call off this marriage."
The armored man’s expression was now a mixture of shock and uncertainty. He glanced at the red Little Cat, hesitating for a moment.
Suddenly, he transformed into a beam of light and shot skyward.
As the beam of light vanished, the armored man’s form also disappeared, replaced by the black-robed elder.
The black-robed elder’s Super Divine Dragon Breath was somewhat weak at this moment.
His expression was also extremely grim.
He had never imagined that even after unleashing his most powerful Spirit Invocation Spell, he still couldn’t do anything about the red Little Cat.
This was simply too unbelievable.
"Old man, if you don’t call off this marriage, I’ll beat you to death!" the Big Black Cat threatened viciously.
He had to press his advantage now and settle the matter of calling off the marriage.
"Very well, this marriage is called off." The black-robed elder contemplated for a long moment, then sighed deeply.
All his efforts had been futile; he might as well give up on this marriage entirely.
The Golden Striped Black Tiger standing nearby was stomping his foot in frustration, but he too was helpless.
Although he was somewhat simple-minded, he wasn’t ignorant of the bigger picture.
This time, the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat had brought over a mysterious red Little Cat that had defeated the entire Golden Striped Black Tiger clan.
If they didn’t call off the marriage, their clan would likely face the danger of annihilation.
He would absolutely not tie his own marriage to the peril of his clan.
"Kitty, the marriage is off. You’re a free woman now," the Big Black Cat said, turning to her and gently patting her shoulder.
"Thank you, Big Brother." Kitty’s eyes were red-rimmed, with tears shimmering at the corners.
"What are you crying for?!" the Big Black Cat said irritably. "The marriage is off! Shouldn’t you be laughing now?"
"Yes, yes, yes, I should be laughing." Kitty’s tears turned into laughter, her face as radiant as a summer flower.
Seeing Kitty laugh through her tears, the Big Black Cat also felt inexplicably pleased.
He turned and walked towards the carriage.
Since the Golden Striped Black Tiger Clan had called off the marriage and admitted defeat, he would let the matter rest.
There was no need for him to push the Golden Striped Black Tiger Clan to their deaths.
Kitty followed closely behind him.
When the two of them reached the carriage, they transformed, instantly reverting to a black and a white Little Cat, and hopped onto the carriage roof.
The red Little Cat landed nearby.
CLIP-CLOP!
The Big Black Horse whickered, then lifted its hooves and pulled the carriage down the mountain.
It soon disappeared from sight.
The black-robed elder watched the carriage recede into the distance, feeling as if everything that had just happened was a dream.
He suddenly realized that the Big Black Horse was probably no ordinary creature.
And the person in the carriage... their power was even more terrifying, so strong it was unimaginable.
「The carriage left Shenhu Mountain.」
Ye Yun suddenly stepped out of the carriage.
He gazed towards a certain direction in the void, a mysterious smile playing on his lips.
"Come, I’ll take you all to a mysterious place."

chapters.title: Chapter 227: The Peach Blossom Paradise-like Small World
chapters.content:
Chapter 227: Chapter 227: The Peach Blossom Paradise-like Small World
Going to a mysterious place?
Upon hearing these words from the Master, not only was the restless Big Black Cat excited, but even the ordinarily taciturn Big Black Horse was thrilled.
"Master, where are we going?"
The Big Black Cat was the first to speak, craning its neck and grinning.
Ye Yun remained silent, his face focused.
He just stared at a certain place in the sky. Tiny runes, like stars, continually shone in his pupils.
At the same time, the entire carriage soared up and flew towards a certain place in the void.
"Chatterbox!"
THWACK!
The Big Black Horse’s tail whipped over, smacking the Big Black Cat onto the carriage.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon marveled at this sight.
He had not expected this horse up front to be so merciless, completely disregarding the dignity of the Little Black Cat.
"Uncle Ma, please spare me! I will never carelessly make a remark again!"
The Big Black Cat lay on the carriage, covering its head with both paws, begging for mercy repeatedly.
The Big Black Horse smacked his lips and chuckled, "As long as you’re aware of the rules."
Having said this, he also looked in a certain direction in the sky.
The Big Black Horse released his powerful Divine Sense, scanning the void ahead, but found nothing.
The runes in Ye Yun’s eyes kept changing, as if he were calculating something.
The Big Black Horse raised his head and quietly waited.
"Big Brother, control that mouth of yours in the future..." Cat Bao’er chuckled, suddenly extending a paw and lightly patting the Big Black Cat’s head.
The Big Black Cat slapped Cat Bao’er’s head forcefully.
THWACK!
"Cat Bao’er, you dare teach me a lesson? Just keep your mouth shut!" the Big Black Cat sent a voice transmission in annoyance, then pretended to lie down again.
Having been slapped by the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, stars appeared in Cat Bao’er’s eyes, and the corners of her eyes reddened with grievance.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon couldn’t stand it anymore.
No matter how one looked at it, the Little Black Cat was still a Fate Realm Level 3 Big Monster, yet he keeps bullying a little kitten of the Divine Bridge Realm. This made him, an old creature, quite uncomfortable.
"Little Black, don’t bully the girl. I remember you said something happened between you two; you’re practically a married couple, aren’t you?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon transmitted via voice.
"Senior, I was light-handed, I didn’t hurt her at all," the Big Black Cat transmitted back with a careless laugh.
"Anyway, don’t bully girls," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon reaffirmed his stance.
"Senior, rest assured. As the saying goes, ’to hit is to cherish, to scold is to love.’ I’ll take good care of Cat Bao’er," the Big Black Cat smiled, thick-skinned as ever, and brushed the matter off.
Since this senior arrived late, he doesn’t know about the messy history between me and Cat Bao’er. It’s best to just brush it off.
...
Suddenly, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon sensed an unusual aura and swiftly looked up into the void.
He saw a faint shadow appear within the void.
This shadow was like a thin film, radiating a peculiar power.
It was this power that allowed the film to remain hidden within the void.
"Master, what is this?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon quickly asked.
Ye Yun glanced at him and smiled faintly. "Do you sense any familiar aura?"
"I don’t sense anything." The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon thought for a moment, then shook his head repeatedly.
He didn’t understand what the Master’s words were hinting at.
Ye Yun nodded calmly. His mesmerizing eyes gleamed brighter than ever.
It was as if, at this moment, all the stars in the universe were pouring their radiance out through his eyes.
Unusually brilliant, dazzling.
"Master, this is...?" The Big Black Horse, having seen the Master unleash the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye before, was startled by this scene.
The Master had never unleashed the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye with such intensity before.
What exactly is the Master doing? Is he trying to break through that membrane? What exactly is that membrane?
All sorts of thoughts flooded the Big Black Horse’s mind.
"Open," Ye Yun uttered a low command. Suddenly, an extremely small fissure appeared in the membrane.
At this moment, Ye Yun’s entire body emitted a sacred white light, enveloping the whole carriage. It then transformed into a streak of light and shot violently through the fissure.
The fissure swiftly closed right after. The membrane trembled slightly in the void before disappearing once again, as if nothing had happened.
We’ve entered a small world...
As the stars seemed to shift and turn, the Big Black Horse finally realized.
Behind that membrane was a small world!
A streak of white light descended from the sky, eventually stopping suspended in the void, revealing a black carriage.
Ye Yun scrutinized the idyllic small world before him.
Distant green mountains and clear waters complemented the luscious nearby grass.
The air was fresh and pleasant, and the Spiritual Energy was extremely dense.
A few red birds flashed by in the sky.
Below, a grand river flowed, with fish constantly leaping from its surface.
On the opposite bank, rows of trees stretched towards a distant mountain range.
"Wow, this really is a small world!" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon exclaimed in admiration, craning his neck to look around.
Ye Yun stood in place, silently sensing the energies around him.
Suddenly, he glanced at the Big Black Cat and said indifferently, "Little Cat, do you feel any changes in your body?"
Hearing the Master’s words, the Big Black Cat instantly became alert.
After sensing for a moment, he widened his eyes in shock and said, "Master, I feel like my body is being affected by some energy, as if it’s gradually disappearing!"
Ye Yun nodded.
At this moment, Cat Bao’er also exclaimed in alarm, "Master, me too! I feel this disappearance is happening very quickly. My body might vanish in less than a day!"
"Both of you should return to the carriage first."
With a light wave of his hand, Ye Yun sent Cat Bao’er and the Big Black Cat, who had the lowest cultivation levels, into a designated space within the carriage.
This Peach Blossom Secret Realm indeed contained a strange energy that could make a physical body disappear.
It was a kind of disappearance almost akin to virtualization, as if the body was eroded by this power and then virtualized.
If the physical body is gone, can the Primordial Spirit still be retained?
A faint smile appeared on Ye Yun’s face.
His gaze swept into the distance, revealing a small village at the foot of a mountain.
A stone Stele stood at the entrance of the village.
The Stele was engraved with a single large character: Qin.
Are they truly descendants of the Qin Family?
A faint stirring moved Ye Yun’s heart; he felt somewhat excited.
If he could find descendants of the Qin Family, it would also be a comfort for Qin Yao.
"Master, I also feel that power of virtualization! It’s truly terrifying!" As Ye Yun contemplated, the Big Black Horse also cried out in alarm.
Even as a great demon of the Eternal Realm possessing the bloodline of the Dragon Clan, he could hardly resist this virtualizing power.
He even felt that before long, his physical body would rapidly weaken, then virtualize, and ultimately turn to nothingness.
"Me too, Master! What kind of power is this?" The Big Black Horse’s voice had barely faded when the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon also cried out in shock.
"I don’t know what kind of power this is either, but it gives me a familiar feeling..." Ye Yun smiled slightly and pointed into the distance. "Let’s go check it out ahead!"

chapters.title: Chapter 228: The Descendants of the Qin Family, The Trace of Nangong Jade
chapters.content:
Chapter 228: Chapter 228: The Descendants of the Qin Family, The Trace of Nangong Jade
After Ye Yun finished speaking, he gently pointed with his hand.
Two white rays shot out from his fingertips, landing on the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and Big Black Horse.
The two demon beasts trembled, instantly feeling a formidable force standing tall within them, like a large mountain. This power was filled with a sacred Super Divine Dragon Breath, preventing the power that was dematerializing their physical forms from advancing any further.
At this moment, Big Black Horse let out a sigh of relief.
Master is truly formidable! This strange power of virtualization has no effect on him whatsoever.
Ye Yun turned back and glanced at the carriage next to him, finding that the carriage also seemed to have been slightly affected by the power of virtualization.
What in the world is this power? How can it be so bizarre and potent...?
Ye Yun was slightly startled. He waved his large hand and immediately returned the black carriage to the warehouse.
"You two, transform into human forms and walk in with me," Ye Yun ordered after dealing with the carriage.
"Yes, Master."
Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon quickly shapeshifted, immediately turning into human forms.
Ye Yun descended from mid-air and leisurely walked towards the village at the foot of the distant mountain. The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and Big Black Horse followed closely behind.
Ye Yun did not walk quickly, admiring the beautiful scenery within the Mirror of Peach Blossom Spring as he went, repeatedly exclaiming in admiration. This place was truly ideal for seclusion. It was just that this power of virtualization was too bizarre; no one could endure staying here. However, even though this power was peculiar, it had no effect on Ye Yun. He didn’t even need to use the supreme Divine Power within his body. The moment the power of virtualization invaded his body, it was instantly neutralized by his Ancestral Dragon Bloodline.
The whole process was quite miraculous. It made Ye Yun marvel, and a doubt arose in his heart.
Could it be related to...
he vaguely guessed.
This guess might be related to the Dragon Clan, so Ye Yun planned to go deeper into the Secret Realm to investigate. Firstly, he wanted to see the descendants of the Qin Family. Secondly, he wanted to thoroughly understand the secrets within the Secret Realm and find the source of the power of virtualization.
「An hour later.」
Ye Yun, leading Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, finally arrived at the entrance of the village manor. A small river flowed joyfully at the village entrance. A wooden bridge spanned the river, stretching from one side to the other.
Ye Yun stood at the head of the bridge for a few seconds, glanced at a Stele and gently shook his head, then stepped onto the wooden bridge and leisurely walked to the other side.
A young man walked out of his house and was suddenly taken aback when he saw Ye Yun and the other two.
"Who are you? Why do you look so unfamiliar?" the young man asked, staring at Ye Yun in shock.
Ye Yun did not answer his question. His gaze drifted towards the inner part of the village, and he said with a light laugh, "Is your Clan Leader present? Go tell him he has visitors."
"Wait here..." the young man replied before hastily turning to flee.
Watching the young man’s retreating figure, Ye Yun pondered.
This youth’s physical body has long ceased to exist. It was utterly destroyed by that power of nothingness. What stands here now is merely a spirit body. It’s just that, under the influence of this Secret Realm’s Magical Force, this spirit body manifests a form nearly identical to that of a normal human.
"Have you two noticed anything different about this young man compared to normal people?" Ye Yun thought of this and asked in a low voice.
Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon looked at the young man’s vanishing figure in the distance but couldn’t discern anything unusual.
"Master, we didn’t notice anything. The young man’s cultivation base isn’t high, only at the Nirvana Realm..." the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said.
Ye Yun smiled and said no more. Even the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, with his superior cultivation base, couldn’t discern anything peculiar about the youth.
It seems the power of nothingness here is truly profound and mysterious.
With his hands clasped behind his back, Ye Yun continued to walk slowly inwards.
Soon, an old man, leading many clan members, quickly approached from a distance, blocking the entire path. The moment the old man saw Ye Yun, a shocked expression appeared on his face.
"Sir, could your surname be Ye...?" the old man asked excitedly, as if recalling something.
"I am Ye Yun," Ye Yun nodded and said, without any concealment.
It appeared these people were indeed from the Qin Family, as someone recognized him.
It really is him...
The old man stared intently at the white-robed youth, who looked like an immortal descended to the mortal realm, and a tempest of shock and disbelief raged in his heart.
In a secret chamber of the Qin Family, two ancient paintings hung. One depicted a female ancestor of the Qin Family. The other was of the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect from one hundred thousand years ago, renowned as the Cangnan Continent’s foremost expert in the Eternal Realm. As a descendant of the Qin Family and its current Clan Leader, he naturally knew many of the ancestral secrets. These two portraits represented two extremely powerful figures. The female ancestor was Qin Yao; she and Ye Yun, the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, were once an immortal couple.
One hundred thousand years ago, the matter of Ye Yun and Qin Yao was no secret within the Qin Family. Ye Yun had also visited the Qin Family before. At that time, everyone in the Qin Family was very familiar with him.
"Elder, weren’t you... already gone? How is it that you’re alive?" the old man asked, his excitement uncontainable.
"Merely secluded in cultivation..." Ye Yun said softly. He surveyed the clusters of spirit bodies before him, his brow furrowing slightly. "Since Qin Yao’s disappearance, how many generations has the Qin Family passed down?"
Upon hearing Ye Yun suddenly mention Qin Yao’s name, the old man immediately dropped to his knees. He knew that the white-robed youth before him was the paramount expert of the Eternal Realm in the Cangnan Continent, a legendary figure from one hundred thousand years ago. He was also the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, an Eternal Sect, and was hailed as the prodigy most likely to reach the True God Realm before the age of thirty.
Seeing the old Clan Leader suddenly kneel, the other clan members also hurriedly knelt.
WHOOSH!
Suddenly, a large swathe of people was kneeling.
Ye Yun remained indifferent. These were all juniors; as their ancestor, it was only right for them to kneel before him.
"Elder, we, the Qin Family, have endured for nearly fifty generations since our ancestor Qin Yao..." the old man said.
Ye Yun was slightly taken aback. "Only fifty generations?"
The Dragon God Sect outside has already seen 298 generations pass. Does this mean that in this Secret Realm, after becoming spirit bodies, their lifespans have also been extended severalfold?
"Elder, this Secret Realm has greatly extended our lifespans, so even though one hundred thousand years have passed, only fifty generations have been passed down..." perhaps noticing the doubt in Ye Yun’s eyes, the old man hurriedly explained.
Ye Yun said calmly, "Are you aware that this Secret Realm has dematerialized you to the point where you no longer possess physical bodies?"
"Elder, after the first generation of the Qin Family entered this Secret Realm, we discovered this situation. At that time, most of our clan members were affected by that power, but we couldn’t leave..." Speaking up to this point, the old man’s expression darkened slightly.
Ye Yun looked around and asked again, "This Secret Realm is so peculiar; how did your Qin Family come upon it?"
"Reporting to Elder, one hundred thousand years ago, after our ancestor Qin Yao disappeared, her good sister, Nangong Jade, visited and gave our Qin Family a bead. Later, we unintentionally activated this bead. A ray of light descended, and then all our clan members were transported into this bead..." the old man explained softly.
What? Nangong Jade?
Even Ye Yun, known for his profound composure, was visibly moved at this moment.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 229: The So-called Spirit Summoning Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 229: Chapter 229: The So-called Spirit Summoning Technique
Nangong Jade... Why would she come to the Qin Family? She drove the Ancient Giant Demon to kill Qin Yao, so why would she leave a mysterious bead for the Qin Family afterward? What exactly was her reason? Could it be that Nangong Jade, feeling remorseful, gave the Qin Family a bead to help them avoid danger?
After numerous thoughts flashed through his mind, Ye Yun came to believe that the Qin Family unintentionally activating that bead was likely all part of Nangong Jade’s calculations.
Once this bead was activated, it transported the entire Qin Family into a mysterious Secret Realm, thereby preventing their complete annihilation. Where did Nangong Jade obtain this bead? Why had he never heard of it a hundred thousand years ago? After his own fall back then, what exactly happened to that young woman? Why did her personality change so drastically?
Ye Yun felt that matters were becoming increasingly peculiar, and layers of suspicion shrouded Nangong Jade.
"Senior, how did you find this Secret Realm?" the elder asked in a low voice.
This Secret Realm of theirs had been hidden within the void for a full hundred thousand years, undiscovered by anyone. It was noticed only once by an expert from the Eternal Realm. However, when that individual attempted to breach the outer layer of the Secret Realm, mysterious energy erupted from it and instantly vaporized their physical body. The expert’s Primordial Spirit escaped and never dared to make designs on this Secret Realm again.
The Clan Leader of the Qin Family was extremely curious: how had the senior before him discovered this Secret Realm, and how had he entered?
In his understanding, it was likely that not even a True God Realm expert could enter it.
"I saw a descended spirit body on the Clan Leader of the Golden Striped Black Tiger clan. By tracking that spirit body all the way, I discovered this marvelous little world hidden in the void," Ye Yun said with a smile.
"So that’s how it is! Senior, you are truly formidable, just as expected of the foremost expert of the Eternal Realm on the Cangnan Continent back in the day," the elder exclaimed in sudden realization, his face filled with admiration.
Big Black Horse furrowed his brows, glared, and snorted coldly, "Old man, don’t spout nonsense. A hundred thousand years have passed; my master is no longer in the Eternal Realm."
"Oh, my apologies, Senior!" The elder was startled and quickly apologized.
Ye Yun waved his hand nonchalantly and said with a smile, "One who does not know is not blamed."
After speaking, Ye Yun looked at the elder and asked casually, "What’s the story with the Cang Token then?"
Seeing Ye Yun ask about the Cang Token, the elder hurriedly explained, "Senior, we are trapped in this Secret Realm. Although there’s no danger, it is exceedingly dull."
"Tens of thousands of years ago, we chanced upon a secret art of spirit descent deep within the mountains. This granted us the opportunity to have our spirit bodies descend upon living beings in the outside world, enabling us to learn about external affairs and also acquire some material resources from the outside to sustain our entire family’s operations."
Hearing the elder’s explanation, Ye Yun nodded.
He raised an eyebrow and then asked, "The resources you obtain are physical. Can your spirit bodies consume them?"
A trace of embarrassment appeared on the elder’s face as he explained, "Initially, we couldn’t. We must wait for the resources to virtualize before our spirit bodies can absorb them."
"I see."
Ye Yun nodded again, his interest in this Secret Realm growing. This power of virtualization was truly magical and exceedingly potent.
"Senior, we didn’t just find the Golden Striped Black Tiger clan; we also found several other factions to serve as targets for our spirit descents. We have a cooperative, mutually beneficial relationship. If their strength is insufficient, they can use the Cang Token to summon our spirit bodies, and we help them deal with powerful enemies," the elder stated.
Ye Yun nodded and smiled faintly.
This so-called art of spirit descent the Qin Family elder spoke of was simply about finding some Demon Clan or Human cultivators with relatively low cultivation bases. This way, a foundation for mutual cooperation could be established between the two parties. The Qin Family had a considerable number of members, but the highest cultivation among them was only at the peak of the Ten Layers of Life and Death Realm. Not a single one had broken through to the Eternal Realm. Even so, with their level of cultivation, if they used the Cang Token to promise assistance to cultivators from major Sects of the Demon Clan or Human Race, it... would be an incredibly tempting offer. After all, once a spirit body descended upon them, their cultivation realm would increase severalfold, leading to an unimaginable surge in combat power.
At this moment, Ye Yun looked again towards the depths of the mountains. His expression shifted slightly, his eyes fixed as he began to observe intently.
In the depths of the mountain range ahead, he noticed some interesting things.
Big Black Horse also craned his neck to look in that direction but saw nothing.
"Second Brother, have you discovered anything?" Big Black Horse asked in a low voice.
"I haven’t found anything," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said rather dejectedly after observing.
The two of them were communicating via telepathic transmission, unheard by any of the Qin Family.
Seeing Ye Yun engrossed in his observation, after a while, the elder couldn’t help but say, "Senior, there’s something strange about the depths of those mountains. Even after a hundred thousand years, we still don’t dare to venture casually into that place."
"Is that so? Weren’t the divine skills for your spirit descents obtained from this very place back then?" Ye Yun responded with a casual smile.
"Senior, the virtualizing power in the depths of those mountains is exceptionally strong," the elder said, gazing into the deep mountains with a look of terror. "If our spirit bodies rashly venture too deep, we risk annihilation. Once annihilated, we will be utterly reduced to nothingness; even this cluster of spirit energy that constitutes our spirit body will vanish."
"Hmm!"
Ye Yun nodded and said with a smile, "Since it’s so perilous, that suits me just fine."
With that, he began to walk leisurely towards the mountains.
"Senior, it’s too dangerous in there! Please, don’t go!" the elder cried out hastily from behind.
Ye Yun waved his hand dismissively and laughed heartily, "There is no place under Heaven that I cannot go. You all just wait here."
Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon followed closely behind Ye Yun.
The elder stared at Ye Yun’s receding figure, utterly shocked and speechless.
This senior cultivated in seclusion for a hundred thousand years; what earth-shattering level has his cultivation reached now? Not only did he effortlessly break the restriction of this world, but he even intends to venture into the depths of the mountains to find the source of that virtualizing power. Truly admirable! He is indeed worthy of being the foremost expert who dominated all Eternal Realm cultivators on the Cangnan Continent back then. Such boldness is truly unparalleled in this world, invincible!
After Ye Yun disappeared, all the clan members present took a deep breath.
Apart from the old Clan Leader, the others were not very clear about Ye Yun’s identity. The clan members gathered around, chattering and asking questions. The old Clan Leader didn’t hide anything and recounted Ye Yun’s identity and that of their ancestor, Qin Yao.
"My heavens! This senior in white has actually lived for a hundred thousand years?" a middle-aged man exclaimed in shock, his mouth agape for a long moment.
"Clan Leader, a hundred thousand years ago, this senior was already the foremost expert of the Eternal Realm. Now that another hundred thousand years have passed, Senior has likely already become a True God, right?" a young man beside him asked.
"Indeed! Senior must be a True God!"
The elder’s eyes shone with a brilliant light, within which flickered an intense fanaticism.

chapters.title: Chapter 230: Primordial Void Dragon, is that you?
chapters.content:
Chapter 230: Chapter 230: Primordial Void Dragon, is that you?
"Master, this spirit descent technique is truly miraculous..."
The Big Black Horse, following behind Ye Yun, looked at the distant mountain range and exclaimed in admiration, "These spirit bodies of the Qin Family, through the Cang Token, can descend onto the bodies of creatures outside, instantly raising their power levels by several minor realms. This technique is truly profound!"
"Indeed, it has its merits. However, the creatures possessed by the spirits also suffer a loss of vitality and Mana and need a long period of recuperation. The longer the spirit descent lasts, the more severe the damage to the body. Hence, only when the Golden Striped Black Tiger Clan faces a life-or-death situation will their Clan Leader use the Cang Token to save lives..."
Ye Yun walked slowly with his hands behind his back, speaking with a smile.
"Master..."
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon gazed into the depths of the mountain range, flashes of blood lighting up his eyes.
He voiced his worries, "I feel that the power of virtualization is stronger than before."
"Naturally. The closer we get to the depths of the mountain range, the stronger the power of virtualization becomes."
Ye Yun nodded. He didn’t seem to mind, as this power had no effect on him. Once the power of virtualization entered his body, it would be neutralized by his Ancestral Dragon Bloodline. This process was exceptionally mysterious. However, the two demon beasts beside him were about to face some hardships.
The trio continued forward. Ye Yun wasn’t moving fast; he observed the lay of the surrounding mountains as he walked, looking here and there as if searching for something. The Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon were clueless, but neither dared to ask questions.
After about an hour, the Big Black Horse started to struggle. The strong power of virtualization had shaken the God Mountain that the Master had established within him.
"The power of virtualization is too strong, Master! I fear I won’t be able to hold on!" The Big Black Horse was breaking out in a cold sweat.
Ye Yun glanced at him and gently patted him. Once Divinity Power was infused, the divine God Mountain within him stabilized again. With this God Mountain securely in the Big Black Horse’s body, he no longer suffered the intrusion of the power of virtualization.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, due to his higher realm and his bloodline, was able to hold on for the time being.
They walked deeper into the mountain range for a while, and then the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon also began to struggle.
SMACK!
Ye Yun also gave him a pat.
"This place is too strange," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said, looking at the surrounding mountains with amazement after his body stabilized. The mountains around them were now showing layers of virtualization. Although not completely virtualized, they seemed hidden by countless voids, creating an extremely dreamlike sensation.
Ye Yun continued to walk slowly with his hands behind his back. Along the way, he saw no sign of any living beings, but the power of virtualization was growing ever stronger. This Illusory energy, released from the depths of the mountains, intensified to the point that the surrounding mountainscape was virtualizing into a dreamlike state. This power, in Ye Yun’s view, had touched upon some kind of rule.
ROAR!
Suddenly, a sound like a dragon’s roar came from the depths of the mountain range.
The Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon looked at each other, their faces etched with shock.
Could there be dragons in this mountain range?
How could this be possible?
Ye Yun, looking ahead, walked slowly and said with a smile, "Little Dragon, you also survived from the Ancient Era. Based on that roar, can you discern which Dragon Clan it belongs to?"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon pondered the dragon’s roar for a moment, then shook his head, an embarrassed expression on his face.
"Master, I am unable to determine."
"Mm."
Ye Yun smiled and continued onward. The emerging signs aligned more and more with his suspicions. Ye Yun felt a surge of excitement; the moment of revelation was upon them.
The Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon followed closely behind. At this moment, both were apprehensive, not expecting to find a dragon’s existence deep within these mountains.
How powerful must a Dragon Clan be to live amidst such an illusory force?
After walking for a while, the distant roar of a dragon echoed once again. This time, the sound was even clearer than before. However, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon still couldn’t discern what kind of Divine Dragon it was.
As the power of virtualization grew stronger, all the mountains before them disappeared. In the space ahead, a dreamlike energy flowed slowly through the void like water. Others couldn’t perceive this Illusory energy, but in Ye Yun’s eyes, it emanated a seven-colored light. This light was beautiful but extremely deadly. Ye Yun guessed that even a true God King Level Cultivator would struggle to survive here.
"Master, I can’t hold on!" the Big Black Horse suddenly cried out, unable to move. The powerful Illusory energy was causing the divine God Mountain within him to crumble.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was faring no better. He too was motionless, the divine God Mountain within him also beginning to collapse. The Illusory energy here was too potent! If it weren’t for the divine God Mountain Ye Yun had placed within them to suppress the power, they would have long since been virtualized into nothingness.
Ye Yun turned to see the two demon beasts’ pained and fearful expressions. He gave a casual laugh and gently tapped each of them on the head. An unimaginably ancient and immense power flowed from his fingertips into their Dantian, forming an indistinct Divine Dragon within each. This Divine Dragon coiled around their God Mountain, immediately solidifying it. Upon seeing this Divine Dragon, the rampant Illusory energy retreated rapidly, like a receding tide. It seemed to have met its nemesis.
The Big Black Horse heaved a sigh of relief. He stared in shock at the indistinct Divine Dragon within him. At this moment, he felt an urge to prostrate himself in worship.
What on earth is this?
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon also stared at the Divine Dragon coiling around the God Mountain within him, his expression dazed, not understanding what had happened.
Ye Yun chuckled. Those were two Little Dragons formed from Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood; he had concealed their Super Divine Dragon Breath. These two Little Dragons, coiled around the God Mountain, directly dispelled the power of virtualization.
As for the two Little Dragons, Ye Yun had no intention of taking them back. After all, to him, they were akin to two drops of Ancestral Dragon Blood. These two Little Dragons, safeguarding the two demon beasts from within, would serve as their greatest trump card in the future.
SWISH, SWISH...
A sound like rushing water echoed.
Hearing this sound, Ye Yun’s heart stirred.
That fellow is finally coming out,
he thought. He looked into the distance with anticipation. At this moment, his demonic eyes became incredibly profound.
From the void, a virtualized dragon, a thousand zhang in length, slowly emerged. Emanating a terrifying divine might, baring its fangs and brandishing its claws, it swam out. Only Ye Yun could see this virtualized dragon. As for the two demon beasts beside him, they could see nothing. Before their eyes, there was only emptiness.
The virtualized dragon appeared slow but was, in fact, quite swift. In the blink of an eye, it swam to a position a hundred zhang away. Staring with wide eyes, the dragon fixated on Ye Yun, seemingly unable to believe that such a terrifying power of virtualization had failed to obliterate the three of them.
"Who are you?" it issued an ancient voice, altered by the power of virtualization, making it different from a normal voice. It was barely audible yet present, indistinct yet perceptible.
At this moment, only Ye Yun, by virtue of his Ancestral Dragon’s supreme bloodline, could hear it clearly.
"Heh..." Ye Yun said, his hands behind his back, his gaze imperious, his expression unperturbed. "Taixu Ancient Dragon, one of the Ten Ancient Super Divine Dragons—is that you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 231: Source of Illusion, Mysterious Black Sphere
chapters.content:
Chapter 231: Chapter 231: Source of Illusion, Mysterious Black Sphere
What? The Taixu Ancient Dragon?
At Ye Yun’s words, both the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and the Big Black Horse beside him were stunned. Especially the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon; its eyes widened, and its breathing grew hurried.
Hidden within this illusory energy, there’s actually a Taixu Ancient Dragon?
Although born in the Ancient Era, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon had never seen the Taixu Ancient Dragon, one of the Ten Super Divine Dragons.
The Taixu Ancient Dragon was exceptionally mysterious among the Ten Super Divine Dragons. Aside from the Ancestor Dragon, very few, even among the Ten Super Divine Dragons themselves, had ever seen its true face.
It was born in illusion and cultivated in illusion. From the very moment of its birth, it rarely manifested its true body in the world. Even on the rare occasions it revealed its Dragon Body, those whose cultivation base was below the Divine King Realm could not see it clearly.
Such a mysterious Super Divine Dragon was a legendary existence among all Dragon Clan. Being a lesser dragon, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon had never had the chance to see it and had only heard vague, unsubstantiated rumors.
Despite its extreme mystery, this did not diminish the Taixu Ancient Dragon’s renowned status, its power causing tremors throughout the entire Dragon Clan. The Ten Super Divine Dragons had all reached the Divine King Realm; they were unfathomable, and their combat power was unimaginable.
It was said that in Ancient Times, when the Ancestor Dragon was not present, the Dragon Hidden Continent was the domain of the Ten Super Divine Dragons.
...
The Big Black Horse stood like a stone sculpture, barely able to conceal the shock in its heart. As a half-dragon, it had naturally heard of the Taixu Ancient Dragon. But it had never expected to find a Taixu Ancient Dragon in the Secret Realm of this small world.
Could it be that the Taixu Ancient Dragon hadn’t truly fallen in Ancient Times but had been hiding in this small Secret Realm all along?
This thought suddenly surfaced in the Big Black Horse’s mind.
Its eyes widened, staring fixedly into the distance, but it still couldn’t find any trace of the Taixu Ancient Dragon in the illusory space.
"Second Bro, can you see anything?" the Big Black Horse quietly sent a voice transmission.
"I can’t see anything either..." the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon replied in dismay.
Just as these two demon beasts were desperately searching for the Taixu Ancient Dragon, the swimming Taixu Ancient Dragon, within the tide-like illusory energy, suddenly stopped. It had never expected this white-robed youth before it to see it at a glance, a realization that shocked it immensely.
At this moment, the Taixu Ancient Dragon roared, "Human, why can you see me? Who exactly are you?"
Ye Yun said nothing. His gaze was constantly scanning the Taixu Ancient Dragon.
After a few seconds, he suddenly smiled, "You’re not quite as the legends describe. A Taixu Ancient Dragon of the Divine Monarch Realm... where exactly did you come from?"
"What? You can also see my cultivation base?"
The Taixu Ancient Dragon was shocked again, its huge dragon eyes almost bulging out of their sockets. The strangeness and mystery of this man were beyond its expectations.
As a Taixu Ancient Dragon, it possessed unimaginable illusory Divine Skills. If it deliberately hid its cultivation base, not even other Super Divine Dragons could perceive it. Aside from the Ancestor Dragon, extremely few within the Dragon Clan could perceive its true cultivation base.
Ye Yun stood with his hands behind his back, his gaze cold, "Reveal your origin, you incomplete Taixu Ancient Dragon..."
He had already discerned that the Taixu Ancient Dragon before him was vastly different from the true Super Divine Dragon of legend—the Taixu Ancient Dragon of Ancient Times. Although this Taixu Ancient Dragon before him also possessed illusory Divine Skills, it felt incomplete to Ye Yun. This feeling naturally stemmed from a certain memory within the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline deep inside him.
"Impudent! You lowly human, daring to insult me so! You are courting death!"
With that, the Taixu Ancient Dragon roared in fury and abruptly thrust its illusory claw towards Ye Yun.
"You overestimate yourself!" A hint of mockery flashed in Ye Yun’s eyes.
WHOOSH!
He suddenly lashed out with one hand. In mid-air, his palm collided with the Taixu Ancient Dragon’s claw. His palm was solid, but the dragon’s claw was illusory. Nevertheless, their collision produced a deafening roar.
An immense wave of power surged forth, sending the Taixu Ancient Dragon flying from Ye Yun’s slap.
The Master is fighting the Taixu Ancient Dragon?
The Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon exchanged glances. Standing on the sidelines, they could see nothing, as if they were blind. But the earth-shattering sound they had just heard had truly startled them both.
With the tremendous noise, the illusory energy grew even more unstable, becoming increasingly dream-like.
This human is so strong!
Sent flying by the slap, the Taixu Ancient Dragon was terrified. It didn’t dare to linger, turning and fleeing into the depths.
Ye Yun merely smiled lightly. He fixed his gaze on a point deep within. Tiny, star-like runes flashed in his eyes, continuously appearing, vanishing, and transforming. After observing for a moment, he chuckled, "Let’s go deeper and see. It seems there’s an unexpected surprise in store!"
"Surprises?"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and the Big Black Horse were taken aback but quickly followed Ye Yun, flying deeper.
Ye Yun was not in a hurry. He moved slowly through the river-like illusory energy, as if strolling through the currents of time itself. Everything was dream-like, neither truly real nor entirely false.
At this moment, the Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon were left speechless. Under the influence of the illusory power, the surrounding scenery was completely distorted, twisted beyond the norms of the known world. It sent shivers down their spines and made their hearts pound. If not for their Master’s presence, they would never have dared to enter such a terrifying place, not even if it cost them their lives.
「An hour later.」
Ye Yun suddenly stopped, looking around with keen interest.
"Master, what exactly is here?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon asked curiously.
"This is the source," Ye Yun simply smiled, "the origin of all the illusory energy in this Secret Realm..."
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon looked dejected and murmured, "Our cultivation base is too low; we can’t see a thing..."
"Do you want to see?" Ye Yun asked with a smile.
"We want to see, Master!" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and the Big Black Horse answered in unison.
"Very well," Ye Yun said, "I’ll let you broaden your horizons and see what kind of world this truly is..."
As he spoke, two purple runes drifted from Ye Yun’s mesmerizing eyes. With a gentle tap of his finger, he infused them with divine energy. The runes then floated into the eyes of the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and the Big Black Horse respectively.
In an instant, the world before the two demon beasts underwent a heaven-and-earth-shattering transformation.
Before them, ten thousand feet away, lay a colossal black sphere. The black sphere was ancient and time-worn, covered in runes. It existed in a warped state between illusion and reality, ceaselessly releasing waves of illusory energy like ripples in water.
"What is this?" The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s eyes widened as it blurted out in shock. This black sphere gave it a sensation that was both familiar and alien.
"The Taixu Ancient Dragon? I see the Taixu Ancient Dragon!" Suddenly, the Big Black Horse also exclaimed, its voice filled with excitement.
It stared intently at the center of the black sphere, where a semi-illusory Divine Dragon lay coiled deep within. Its enormous dragon eyes stared out from within, emitting sharp glints of menacing light.
Ye Yun regarded the Taixu Ancient Dragon within the black sphere with composure and stated faintly, "Hiding in there is useless. Before me, you have no right to refuse."
As his words fell.
RUMBLE!
A series of tremendous rumbles suddenly echoed, as if some colossal behemoth was about to burst forth from the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 232: The Trap Set 100,000 Years Ago
chapters.content:
Chapter 232: Chapter 232: The Trap Set 100,000 Years Ago
Huh?
Ye Yun’s face shifted slightly.
He had assumed that the Taixu Ancient Dragon was hiding within the black sphere, ready to strike at him at any moment. But to his surprise, there was a grand mystery hidden deep beneath the ground.
Before Ye Yun could look in the direction of the ground...
BOOM!
Seven colossal bronze pillars, shimmering with a faint black light, suddenly erupted from deep underground, abruptly surrounding the black sphere.
The seven bronze pillars were incredibly huge, reaching from the ground to the sky of the entire Secret Realm, creating a magnificent spectacle.
Each pillar was teeming with mysterious black energy.
Ye Yun took a glance.
He discovered that the seven bronze pillars were arranged in the form of the Big Dipper.
They had an uncanny resemblance to the Seven-star formation beneath the Dragon God Sect and the Nine Soul Emperor’s Seven-star formation in the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
Seeing a Seven-star formation again, Ye Yun’s face darkened.
Has the hand behind the scenes reached into this Secret Realm? Could it be that 100,000 years ago, this killing array was set up, creating a dead end?
"Sir, is it the Seven-star formation again?"
Big Black Horse looked at the Seven-star formation made of seven colossal bronze pillars, his face turning a different color for a moment.
Ye Yun nodded in agreement.
This Seven-star formation seemed somewhat different from the previous ones. This time, the black sphere was at the heart of the formation, having undergone some sort of transformation.
The appearance of the seven bronze pillars outside caused the Taixu Ancient Dragon to reveal a look of shock in its eyes.
Its expression was instantly caught by Ye Yun.
It seems that this damaged Taixu Ancient Dragon didn’t know that a Seven-star formation was concealed deep underground.
WHOOSH.
The seven bronze pillars suddenly emitted a black radiance, forming a black sphere in mid-air.
After a moment of writhing, the black sphere finally transformed into a black human figure.
The details of this black figure’s face could not be discerned, but ever since it appeared, the figure was continually twisting its body, seemingly adapting to the transformation process.
Ye Yun stood with his hands behind his back, his face cold.
He coldly observed everything, not rushing to make his move.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and Big Black Horse grew tense. The powerful Super Divine Dragon Breath emanating from the black figure made it difficult for them to breathe.
"What the hell! That guy is on the Peak of the God Monarch Realm tenth layer..." the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said with a shocked face.
Big Black Horse scoffed, glaring at him and said, "So what about being at the Peak of the God Monarch Realm tenth layer? Don’t amplify other people’s imposing presence."
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon finally understood, nodding repeatedly and saying, "Correct, correct, I misspoke, I’m sorry!"
After finishing, he even slapped himself in the face a few times.
Ye Yun smiled in exasperation.
At such a serious moment, these two still had the mood to joke around.
A chilling laughter suddenly resonated from the black figure.
"HAHA... I’ve been waiting for the rightful owner in this ghostly place for 100,000 years! I thought that the one who would come would be an incredibly powerful figure, but it turns out it’s just a minor Divine Monarch Realm cultivator."
The black figure stood with his hands behind his back, his face still indistinguishable, and laughed wildly with each motion of his body.
BOOM!
His laughter caused the entire Secret Realm to shake.
「Meanwhile, in the village of the Qin Family.」
Everyone felt an indescribable heavenly authority descend. They were horrified and stumbled, unable to stand steadily.
Some of those with weaker cultivation bases were forcibly pushed to the ground by the overwhelming presence, unable to move.
"Clan Leader, what on earth is happening?" a middle-aged man hurriedly asked the old man.
"Dramatic changes are afoot! That senior is no ordinary person!"
A frenzied look appeared in the old man’s eyes.
Even if the depths of the mountains often contain unknown forbidden powers, he believed they would be no match for that senior. One hundred thousand years ago, at the age of twenty-four, that senior had already fought across the entire Cangnan Continent without any adversaries. Now, after 100,000 years, he was even more invincible.
"Huh?"
With his hands behind him, Ye Yun looked at the black silhouette in the distant void and said with an indifferent smile, "And from where does this little insect hail?"
"Given that you’re on the brink of death, you still dare to be so arrogant."
The black silhouette stared fixedly at the white-robed young man below and let out an arrogant sneer, "Once I kill you, our Master will no longer have that inexplicable apprehension, and from then on, there will never again be any destabilizing factors on the Dragon Hidden Continent."
Hearing the black silhouette’s words, Ye Yun’s eyes glinted; it seemed he had gleaned a lot of information in that instant.
"Your Master does indeed have some skill. Did he predict events 100,000 years into the future, all the way back then?" Ye Yun replied with an indifferent smile.
"Correct! Now that things have come this far, I’ll let you die understanding the reasons."
The black silhouette’s features remained indistinct, its body appearing as a phantasmal form composed of black light.
He burst into laughter, "One hundred thousand years ago, during a profound cultivation session, our Master foresaw that after 100,000 years, a formidable and dangerous individual would appear on the Dragon Hidden Continent. This person would not only bring chaos to this continent but also impact the Divine Land! That is why he laid a hidden hand in advance, waiting for an unknown figure like you to appear. Initially, I was skeptical, but after waiting for 100,000 years, you have indeed emerged."
Saying this, the black silhouette paused, then declared arrogantly, "You should know, not just anyone can enter this place. The only one who can enter here is the dangerous individual our Master predicted."
"Dangerous individual?"
Ye Yun was momentarily stunned, then burst out laughing, "What right does your Master have to pass such judgment on me?"
"Impudent!"
The black silhouette seethed with rage.
"A mere Divine Monarch Realm cultivator on the brink of death, and you still dare to be so stubborn! This Seven Stars Illusory Killing Array, with the eyeball of a Taixu Ancient Dragon as its formation core, wields power so immense it’s beyond imagination. Even if your cultivation base reached the Divine Sovereign Realm, you would still be turned to ash!"
"This is an eyeball of the Taixu Ancient Dragon?"
Ye Yun nodded, a faint smile playing on his lips.
What the black silhouette said was almost identical to his own judgment. Ever since he saw that membrane outside the void, he realized it was an eye membrane. After entering deep into this Secret Realm and seeing the Taixu Ancient Dragon hiding within the massive black sphere, Ye Yun deduced that this Secret Realm was one of the Taixu Ancient Dragon’s eyeballs. However, this mastermind behind the scenes was indeed formidable. To think they could find a Taixu Ancient Dragon’s eyeball to use as the core of the Seven Star Grand Array; in that case, this grand array could indeed annihilate experts of the Divine Sovereign Realm.
"My God, it’s actually an eyeball of the Taixu Ancient Dragon..." the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon muttered to itself, seemingly in disbelief.
HISS!
Big Black Horse also took a sharp breath.
He had heard every word the black silhouette in the sky afar had said. He hadn’t expected that this setup had been put in place as long as 100,000 years ago, which was truly terrifying. That Master... what was his cultivation base? How could he have sensed that Ye Yun would appear on this continent 100,000 years later?
"HEHE, I’ve said all that needs to be said. You dangerous element, you can now depart in peace. Once you’re dead, the Dragon Hidden Continent will finally be tranquil."
The black silhouette let out a fiendish laugh and fiercely swept its large hand.
The seven bronze pillars released waves of black light uniformly, converging into the black eyeball.
HUM! HUM!
The huge black eyeball began to vibrate powerfully.

chapters.title: Chapter 233: The Little Ant, No Match at All
chapters.content:
Chapter 233: Chapter 233: The Little Ant, No Match at All
Seeing the black eyeball about to launch an attack, Ye Yun still stood with his hands behind his back, cool and composed, a slight sneer flashing in his eyes.
If it planned to use the illusory power of the Taixu Ancient Dragon against him, it would have no effect. This Seven-Star Formation uses the Taixu Ancient Dragon’s eyeball as its core, merely amplifying the Taixu Ancient Dragon’s Innate Divine Ability. But now, this Innate Divine Ability is suppressed by the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline and won’t cause any harm to Ye Yun.
BUZZ!
The black eyeball suddenly shuddered violently. A strong beam of illusory light flashed out from the eye, shooting fiercely towards Ye Yun.
Ye Yun remained emotionless. He extended his palm and pushed it upwards. At the same time, a light barrier appeared before him, enveloping him and the other two demon beasts.
The fierce illusory beam of light struck the light barrier and vanished in an instant, like a stone sinking into the sea, leaving no trace.
How... how is this possible?
the black figure thought, utterly astonished by this sight.
What kind of Divine Skill is this young man in white using? His light barrier could withstand an attack from the Taixu Ancient Dragon’s illusory Divine Skills? This is incomprehensible!
"Just an insignificant ant, lacking in experience," Ye Yun remarked with a light laugh. He took a step forward, exiting the transparent light barrier, and instantly arrived before the black figure.
"You..." The black figure was startled, his face paling. He suddenly transformed; his body split into seven black lights that fell onto the seven Bronze Pillars, vanishing from sight in an instant.
"Oh?" Ye Yun made a soft sound of surprise.
This fellow is quite interesting. This body is neither his true form nor an avatar in the conventional sense; it seems to be an avatar that has merged with the seven Bronze Pillars of the Seven-Star Formation.
RUMBLE!
At this moment, the entire grand array began to operate violently. In an instant, black light filled the area. Rolling black mist, like dark gathering clouds, enveloped the space, making it dim and chaotic.
The black eyeball also floated up, constantly rotating and radiating intense, illusory light.
Its power seems to have increased significantly.
The Taixu Ancient Dragon still lurked in the depths of the eyeball, appearing panic-stricken. It moved constantly, yet seemed shackled, unable to escape.
"Die!" A thunderous roar suddenly echoed from within the Seven-Star Grand Array.
BUZZ!
The black eyeball suddenly shrank, once again releasing a beam of illusory light. This beam was at least ten times larger than before, its power clearly formidable. The attack had reached a terrifying level. Even a cultivator at the Divine Sovereign Realm standing here would find it difficult to withstand this terrifying illusory power.
Oh my god, this grand array is truly terrifying! In the Ancient Times, I’m afraid only Super Divine Dragons could have withstood it...
Within the light barrier, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s complexion turned pale. It watched the illusory pillar of light shooting towards Ye Yun, a trace of terror flashing in its eyes. As a member of the Dragon Clan from the Ancient Era, it had witnessed many strange sights. It could feel the power now emanating from the grand array.
Facing the grand array’s strength, which has suddenly increased tenfold, how will Master withstand it...?
The Big Black Horse’s expression flickered slightly, but it remained relatively calm.
Master will definitely be able to handle this.
"Bring it on!" Ye Yun laughed heartily, his black hair fluttering and his eyes blazing. His entire body was enveloped in a faint layer of white divine light. He then threw a punch.
BOOM!
The enormous pillar composed of illusory energy was instantly shattered by Ye Yun’s punch.
BOOM!
With a backhand strike from Ye Yun, the seven Bronze Pillars shattered, exploding into countless fragments that flew in all directions. However, they only flew for a few thousand feet before the immense illusory energy in this place reduced them to nothingness.
Suddenly, streams of black light gushed out from the fragments, eventually coalescing into a black figure.
The black figure stared intently at Ye Yun, roaring in disbelief, "Impossible! How can a Human Cultivator from one hundred thousand years in the future be this powerful?"
"What’s so impossible about it?" Ye Yun retorted with a cold smirk. The next moment, he vanished from his spot and reappeared instantly before the black figure. Ye Yun reached out and immediately seized him.
"Who exactly is the ’Great One’ backing you? Confess honestly, and I might spare your life," Ye Yun said indifferently.
Grabbed in Ye Yun’s hand, the black figure’s Mana was completely restrained, rendering him unable to move at all. His face paled in fright, yet he remained tight-lipped, glaring ferociously at Ye Yun without uttering a word.
"Not talking, are you?" Ye Yun’s grip suddenly tightened. In that instant, the black figure felt death’s approach.
"Even if you kill me, I won’t say anything! You can give up on that idea!" the black figure cackled defiantly, seemingly unfazed by Ye Yun’s threat.
"Insignificant little ant..." Ye Yun smiled, his eyes turning illusory. In an instant, he activated the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye.
BANG!
As the Power of Annihilation affected the black figure’s Primordial Spirit, a strange force suddenly erupted within it. The black figure’s head instantly turned to ash and disintegrated. Without a head, his body also immediately broke apart, vanishing completely.
Witnessing this, Ye Yun merely nodded, unfazed.
I saw this once before at the Shen Heng Sect. The mastermind behind the scenes had laid down countermeasures in every pawn. Once a pawn falls into enemy hands, it self-destructs, leaving no opportunity for soul-searching.
Ye Yun turned and approached the giant black eyeball. He looked at the Taixu Ancient Dragon deep within the pupil and smiled faintly. "Come out."
Feeling the Seven-Star Grand Array outside disappear, the Taixu Ancient Dragon’s expression calmed considerably. It undulated its body and swam out. However, it did not leave the black eyeball, merely swimming to its vicinity before facing Ye Yun.
"Thank you, esteemed sir, for dismantling this grand array and granting me my freedom," the Taixu Ancient Dragon said gratefully.
"Is the true Taixu Ancient Dragon dead?" Ye Yun asked, his eyelids lowered, as beams of divine light from his eyes fell upon the Taixu Ancient Dragon, seemingly having noticed something.
The Taixu Ancient Dragon sighed. "I don’t know if my true self is still alive. This residual form of mine was merely born from one of my true self’s eyeballs as an avatar, and currently has no connection to it..."
So that’s how it is...
Ye Yun nodded silently.
According to later legends, all Ten Super Divine Dragons perished. However, looking at it now, those legends might not be entirely true. For an avatar to be born from a mere eyeball of the Taixu Ancient Dragon shows just how heaven-defying those Super Divine Dragons of the Divine King Realm were. They likely each possessed methods of rebirth.
A thought stirred in Ye Yun’s mind. He asked in a deep voice, "Who was it that gave this eyeball to Nangong Jade?"
"Nangong Jade?" the Taixu Ancient Dragon repeated, taken aback.
Ye Yun waved his hand, and his Mana surged out, projecting the image of an exquisitely beautiful woman before the dragon.
"Ah, it was this young woman. I remember her. She was the one who brought me to the Qin Family..." the Taixu Ancient Dragon murmured, its gaze fixed on a distant point in the void as it reminisced. "This eyeball had been separated from my true body for a very long time. It circulated throughout the Divine Land, passing through many hands, and eventually fell into the possession of a Divine King..."

chapters.title: Chapter 234: A Familiar Silhouette, Could it be Dragon Xuan?
chapters.content:
Chapter 234: Chapter 234: A Familiar Silhouette, Could it be Dragon Xuan?
Hearing what the Taixu Ancient Dragon had said, a thought struck Ye Yun, and his tone bore a hint of excitement as he asked, full of hope, "Do you have any information about this Divine King?"
The Taixu Ancient Dragon sighed, dropping his head, and said with some annoyance, "I don’t even know which Divine King he is from the Divine Land. The man always wears a mask and never says a word. I don’t even know his name..."
Wearing a mask?
A thought struck Ye Yun, and he asked, "With your current memory, can you draw his likeness?"
"I..." The Taixu Ancient Dragon hesitated, then fell silent for a few seconds before finally speaking slowly, "It’s strange... I can’t seem to recall his front appearance. At best, I can only draw his silhouette from behind."
"Then draw his silhouette."
Ye Yun nodded, a trace of gloom flashing in his eyes.
The manipulator behind the scenes indeed always operated very carefully. He had even tampered with the Taixu Ancient Dragon’s memory.
WHOOSH!
The Taixu Ancient Dragon’s eyes emitted two rays of light that converged in mid-air, quickly forming a faint silhouette.
Upon seeing this familiar figure, Ye Yun’s pupils constricted sharply, and he exclaimed, "Dragon Xuan?!"
The silhouette of the man conjured by the Taixu Ancient Dragon bore an eighty to ninety percent resemblance to Dragon Xuan.
Even with his excellent control over his emotions, Ye Yun was greatly shaken at this moment.
The mastermind behind the scenes could be Dragon Xuan... But how is that possible? Dragon Xuan is the two hundred and fiftieth Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect. At most, he’s only a little over ten thousand years old. It’s impossible for him to have plotted against me a hundred thousand years ago. What’s more, Dragon Xuan had no grudges with me; there was simply no motive.
Ye Yun’s eyes flickered like flames as he constantly observed the silhouette. The more he looked, the more it bore an eighty to ninety percent resemblance to Dragon Xuan.
A peculiar expression emerged on Ye Yun’s face. He found this matter was becoming more and more intriguing.
Did the mastermind deliberately leave a false clue for the Taixu Ancient Dragon? Was it to make me, the thirteenth-generation Ancestor, believe Dragon Xuan was behind it? If that’s the case, they’re sorely underestimating me, Ye Yun.
Ye Yun’s lips curved into a faint sneer.
Once he’s finished with matters on the Cangnan Continent, he will head to the Divine Land to drag out this Divine King operating behind the scenes. He wants to see just what kind of extraordinary individual this person is. Their methods are truly too insidious.
After being invincible in the world for a hundred thousand years, the current Ye Yun suddenly had such an opponent; life had indeed become much more interesting. If he truly had no opponents, Ye Yun figured he might go insane at any moment. The loneliness derived from being truly invincible and steamrolling everyone with his presence was not much different from the loneliness felt in his Check-in Space, possessing infinite top-tier resources. People should always find some hobbies and things to do while alive.
Now that there was such a mastermind continually causing trouble for him, Ye Yun found it rather amusing.
His gaze once again fell upon the Taixu Ancient Dragon as he casually said, "Your avatar might be incomplete, but you were once a Taixu Ancient Dragon, after all. Why not join my Dragon God Sect? I’ll take your Miniature World away with me, and you’ll no longer have to hide in this void."
After finishing his words, Ye Yun immediately released a wisp of Ancestor Dragon’s breath. This breath suppressed the universe, its immense pressure overpowering the Taixu Ancient Dragon, who couldn’t even raise his head.
"Ancestral Dragon Bloodline... My God, it’s actually the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline!" The Taixu Ancient Dragon prostrated on the ground, his expression excited, murmuring to himself. He never expected that the man before him possessed the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline.
A thought flashed across his mind. The Taixu Ancient Dragon finally understood why his Illusion Power had no effect on the youth in white. It was because of the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline, which could neutralize his Illusion Power.
In the Ancient Times, not just the Ten Super Divine Dragons, but all Dragon Clan members were powerless against the Ancestor Dragon’s attacks. The Ancestor Dragon was naturally able to neutralize any attack from the Dragon Clan. That’s why, in the Ancient Times, the Ancestor Dragon could suppress the entire Dragon Clan, and no member of the Dragon Clan dared to harbor thoughts of rebellion.
"I am willing, Lord Ancestor Dragon!" The Taixu Ancient Dragon was extremely excited, bowing his head repeatedly on the ground.
"You can just call me Master in the future." Ye Yun smiled gently. He looked down, reached out his hand, and the translucent light shield immediately disappeared.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and Big Black Horse sprang into the air, flying to Ye Yun’s side.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon looked at the Taixu Ancient Dragon in the black pupil, rubbed its hands, and said with an envious laugh, "Greetings, Elder Taixu Ancient Dragon!"
"Hello! You should possess the bloodline of the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, right?" The Taixu Ancient Dragon looked at the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and showed a kind smile.
"Yes, but it’s only a little and quite diluted," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon laughed with a bit of embarrassment.
The Taixu Ancient Dragon nodded, then he looked at Big Black Horse next to him and found that his bloodline was very special, possessing half of the Dragon Clan Bloodline. But he couldn’t identify this half of the Dragon Clan Bloodline. For a while, the Taixu Ancient Dragon had a thoughtful expression on his face as he looked at Big Black Horse.
Ye Yun laughed softly and said, "You don’t need to guess his origin; you’ll never figure it out."
Big Black Horse was one of the Divine Pets he had obtained from check-ins. He was not a demon beast from this world at all. He came from a world among the Ten Thousand Realms where the Dragon Clan also existed. He was a demon beast born from the union of the Dragon Clan and another powerful race, and his bloodline was also very noble.
"Alright, Master." The Taixu Ancient Dragon quickly nodded and retracted his gaze.
Big Black Horse quickly cupped his fists, bowed to the Taixu Ancient Dragon, and said with a laugh, "Greetings, Elder!"
"No need to be polite," the Taixu Ancient Dragon said with a laugh.
Ye Yun looked around and said calmly, "Taixu Ancient Dragon, you can continue to cultivate in this black pupil. After I leave, I will find a quiet place for you."
"Thank you, Master!" The Taixu Ancient Dragon was overjoyed. Following the example of the other two, he transformed into a man and bowed respectfully to Ye Yun.
Ye Yun nodded, turned around, and left with the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and Big Black Horse.
This time, Ye Yun directly broke through the void and appeared in the village where the Qin Family lived.
Seeing Ye Yun descending from the sky, the old Clan Leader of the Qin Family was inexplicably excited. He knew that this Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, who was invincible in the world a hundred thousand years ago, would definitely be able to flatten the forbidden power in the depths of the mountains.
"There’s nothing to worry about now. You can live and cultivate in peace here..." Ye Yun laughed.
"Thank you, Elder!" The old man led the Clan Members to kneel on the ground, kowtowing repeatedly to express their thanks.
Ye Yun waved his hand, indicating for everyone to rise. Then, raising his eyebrows, he said with a smile, "There is a Taixu Ancient Dragon in the depths of the mountains cultivating. After a while, once it has truly comprehended Illusion Power, it will be able to reverse your spirit bodies and return you to your human forms..."
"Wow, really? Elder, that would be wonderful!"
Hearing that they could return from spirit bodies to their human forms, all the members of the Qin Family were excited, even ignoring the Taixu Ancient Dragon, one of the Ten Super Divine Dragons of the Ancient Times. The faces of the Qin Family members were all glowing red, their hearts incredibly excited.
Ye Yun saw this, shook his head with a light laugh, and then gave a few more instructions before leaving this Miniature World.
This time, he didn’t need to forcefully break through the Taixu Ancient Dragon’s pupil membrane. The Taixu Ancient Dragon, hiding in the black pupil, could naturally control the entire world inside the eyeball. He directly opened a passage, allowing Ye Yun and the other two to fly out.
Standing in the void, Ye Yun looked at the huge illusory world above him, smiled, and said, "Return to your original form."

chapters.title: Chapter 235: Big Black Cat Showcases Elixir, Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon is Shocked
chapters.content:
Chapter 235: Chapter 235: Big Black Cat Showcases Elixir, Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon is Shocked
As Ye Yun finished speaking, the voice of the Taixu Ancient Dragon echoed from within the illusory world.
"Okay, Master!"
BUZZ...
