A humming sound, like that of a swarm of bees, vibrated through the void.
The immense illusory world began to shrink violently. Within a mere few breaths, it had contracted into a sphere the size of a walnut, which then rapidly dropped from the air.
This semi-transparent sphere contained a black, pupil-like sphere within. The Taixu Ancient Dragon was concealed in the depths of this black sphere, utterly undetectable from the outside.
Ye Yun reached out and grabbed the black sphere.
After examining it for a moment, he stored the sphere away in his warehouse.
"Master, that ancient battle was truly horrific. Even the Taixu Ancient Dragon’s eyeball, one of the Super Divine Dragons, was gouged out..." the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said from the side, fear still lingering in his voice.
"If the Ten Super Divine Dragons hadn’t fought among themselves, the Divine Land wouldn’t have had the chance to initiate a dragon-slaying war..." Ye Yun responded with a faint smile.
Regarding the extinction of the ancient Divine Dragons, though he felt somewhat regretful, he didn’t feel much sympathy.
After all, Ye Yun was a transmigrator who had lived two different lives.
Concerning events that happened millions of years ago in the Ancient Times, Ye Yun always considered himself an observer.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon heaved a sigh. "Master, since the Taixu Ancient Dragon’s eyeball still exists in this world, I’m afraid there are still many organs of Super Divine Dragons present on this continent or in the Divine Land..."
"Hmm." Ye Yun nodded, looking at the distant void, his expression relaxed.
He slowly declared, "Rest assured. If we encounter anything related to the Dragon Clan—whether it be organs, remains, beings like you or the Taixu Ancient Dragon, or members of the Human Race bearing the Dragon God Bloodline—I will find a way to deal with each one appropriately..."
As Ye Yun, a holder of the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline, facing the Dragon Clan’s gradual approach to extinction, he naturally wanted to find a way to better preserve their heritage.
It was just like how humans protected wildlife on Earth in his previous life.
Therefore, Ye Yun deeply agreed with the well-meaning reminder from the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon.
Even if the organs left behind on deceased dragons had been refined into artifacts, he would collect them all for the Dragon God Sect if he had the opportunity.
As for organs from Super Divine Dragons, like the Taixu Ancient Dragon’s eyeball which could produce a wisp of an avatar, these were Ye Yun’s prime focus for collection.
Through this journey to the Secret Realm, Ye Yun also realized that the Ten Super Divine Dragons each likely had contingency measures to gradually resurrect themselves over the long eons.
The same might hold true for various other types of powerful Divine Dragons.
This continent still concealed many secrets, awaiting his gradual discovery.
"Let’s go," Ye Yun said.
He took a step forward, walking through the void, and flew towards the distant black carriage.
Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon followed closely.
Ye Yun landed on the black carriage, pulled aside the curtain, and entered the carriage by himself.
At this moment, Big Black Horse transformed back into his original form and resumed pulling the carriage.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon also transformed, becoming a fiery red beam of light that landed on the carriage, reverting to his cute, little, red cat form.
What kind of Divine Skill is Master using? My original form has been changed, and this time I can’t change back...
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, in the form of a small red cat, was on the verge of tears. With no one to confide in, he could only grit his teeth and swallow his despair.
"Master, where are we going?" Big Black Horse turned his head and asked, full of enthusiasm.
"Let’s head to the Heavenly Moon Dynasty..." Ye Yun replied after a moment of thought.
There was nothing left in the Heavenly Star Dynasty to hold his interest any longer.
Having finished all his business there, his next step was to travel to the Heavenly Moon Dynasty and wait for the opening of the Heavenly Moon Secret Region.
Big Black Horse acknowledged and began pulling the carriage, heading slowly southeast.
"Senior, where did you all go earlier?" Cat Baoer was somewhat curious. She nudged closer to the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and asked in a low voice, her large, sapphire-like eyes blinking.
"We went to a..." Just as the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was about to reply, he suddenly clamped his mouth shut.
That paradise-like Secret Realm is related to the Taixu Ancient Dragon. Such a major, sensitive matter... it’s best to say as little as possible.
WHACK!
Just then, Big Black Cat slapped Cat Baoer on the head, leaving her seeing stars.
"You hit me again?" Cat Baoer said, her eyes welling with tears.
"There are some things you shouldn’t ask, so don’t ask. Is Master’s destination something you can inquire about?" Big Black Cat raised a paw, threatening her arrogantly.
"Oh..." As soon as "Master" was mentioned, Cat Baoer’s indignation vanished; she immediately deflated. She could only obediently rest her head on the carriage, motionless.
This time, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon did not comfort Cat Baoer.
It also felt that Cat Baoer was a bit too curious, so it decided to let Little Black Cat teach her a good lesson, so she would learn from it.
Seeing Big Black Cat bluffing again, Ye Yun gave a wry smile.
This fellow just loves to abuse his minor authority.
However, these three Demonic Pets had their own way of getting along, and Ye Yun didn’t want to interfere.
After a moment’s thought, he suddenly asked, "Cat Baoer, where is your home?"
"Master, my home is near Wu Kun Mountain, on the border of the Heavenly Star Dynasty and the Heavenly Moon Dynasty..." Cat Baoer quickly answered respectfully.
"Hmm, when we get there, make a trip home and tell them about your annulment and about joining the Dragon God Sect..." Ye Yun instructed.
"Okay, Master!" Cat Baoer replied gratefully.
This powerful and mysterious Master... he’s too good to me, a mere Divine Bridge Realm little demon. Not only did he help me annul the engagement, but he’s also going to help with my family’s affairs. My two stubborn, elderly parents will definitely try to stop me from joining the Dragon God Sect; after all, they don’t understand how powerful the Dragon God Sect is. This matter will ultimately require Master to step in to resolve it. However, Master definitely won’t act personally. If anyone does, it will be Uncle Ma or that Dragon Senior.
"Huh?" Big Black Cat’s eyes suddenly lit up. "Cat Baoer, it turns out your family, the Sky Spirit Cat Clan, lives near Wu Kun Mountain?"
"Yeah, what’s up?" Cat Baoer looked at Big Black Cat with a puzzled expression.
Big Black Cat chuckled, then said with sudden excitement, "I heard there’s a black market at Wu Kun Mountain, very popular. You can buy anything there..."
"Yeah, Wu Kun Mountain’s black market is indeed very bustling, with all kinds of elixirs, treasures, and Divine Skill manuals..." Cat Baoer nodded and smiled.
Seeing the proud look on Cat Baoer’s face, Big Black Cat snorted disdainfully. "As soon as this black market is mentioned, you get more excited than I do. It’s as if the market is so great... Hmph! In the eyes of Old Cat, the elixirs from that black market are nothing compared to the pills given by Master."
"You’re right, Big Brother..." Scratching the back of her head with her paw, Cat Baoer gave an awkward smile.
She knew that when the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat was feeling smug, she shouldn’t rain on his parade.
So, she just went with the flow, praising him a few times.
At this moment, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s eyes lit up.
"Little Black Boy, what kind of elixirs did Master give you? You speak so highly of them, can you show me?"
"This..." Big Black Cat’s face suddenly turned troubled. The elixirs Master had given him were of excellent quality and very suitable for demon beasts.
He was genuinely afraid that if he took them out, this Senior would snatch them away.
"Little Black Boy, you aren’t worried that I’ll snatch your elixirs, are you?" The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s face darkened, a hint of anger in its tone.
"Senior, you must be joking. You’re already in the Eternal Realm, why would you need to take my elixirs?" Big Black Cat chuckled and took a bag out of his Storage Ring.
After fumbling inside for a good while, he very reluctantly pulled out a single pellet.
"Is this a Dragon Spirit Pill?" As soon as the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon saw the pellet in the cat’s paw, its eyes instantly lit up. It brought its face closer, its pink little nose twitching slightly.
The next moment, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was shocked.
This was actually a God Level Dragon Spirit Pill!

chapters.title: Chapter 236: The Divine Dragon Spirit Pill, Generously Given as a Gift
chapters.content:
Chapter 236: Chapter 236: The Divine Dragon Spirit Pill, Generously Given as a Gift
Even though it was a divine dragon from the Ancient Times, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon had never tasted a Dragon Spirit Pill.
The Dragon Spirit Pill is extremely beneficial to the cultivation advancement of any Demon Clan member.
In the Ancient Times, without sufficient power and status, Dragon Clan members couldn’t possibly obtain a Dragon Spirit Pill.
Back then, let alone an Earth Level Dragon Spirit Pill, even a Yellow Grade Dragon Spirit Pill was out of its reach.
After all, very few among the Ancient Dragon Clan could refine pills.
Among the human cultivators in the Dragon Hidden Continent, not many could refine pills either. Most Dragon Spirit Pills were brought over from the Divine Land.
Thus, only high-ranking, dignified Divine Dragons had the chance to enjoy Dragon Spirit Pills to aid their cultivation.
Although the dragon’s physique was extremely powerful and most of the time didn’t require any pills to advance, if they were to consume a Dragon Spirit Pill, their cultivation progression would be incredibly fast. Therefore, no Dragon Clan member would reject Dragon Spirit Pills refined in the Divine Land.
HUFF!
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon licked its lips. It snatched the Dragon Spirit Pill from the Big Black Cat’s paw, sniffed it deeply, and then showed a face of intoxicated delight.
The Big Black Cat immediately grew nervous, stuttering, "Senior, you... you are of venerable status. Please don’t steal my pill."
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon laughed out loud, then suddenly felt its old face flush with a bit of shame.
It continued to examine the Dragon Spirit Pill closely. After a long while, it hesitantly asked, "This... is a Divine Grade Dragon Spirit Pill, isn’t it?"
The Big Black Cat helplessly shrugged, replying, "Yes, Senior, this indeed is a Divine Grade Dragon Spirit Pill!"
"My heavens! Even in the Ancient Times, only the Ten Super Divine Dragons had the privilege to enjoy Divine Grade Dragon Spirit Pills!"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon murmured to itself, a look of immense shock appearing on its face.
Who exactly is this Master?
He’s casually handing out Divine Grade Dragon Spirit Pills?
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s heart was shaken, as if tumultuous waves were crashing within it.
Holding this Divine Grade Dragon Spirit Pill in its hand, it wished it could make it its own immediately.
After a few breaths, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon turned its gaze to the Big Black Cat, letting out a few dry laughs.
The Big Black Cat immediately sensed something was amiss; it seemed this pill was gone for good.
"Senior..."
The Big Black Cat called out weakly.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon coughed a few times, trying to feign composure, but it still held onto the Dragon Spirit Pill, showing no intention of returning it to the Big Black Cat.
It suddenly felt that this little Nine-tailed Spirit Cat was only at the Destiny Realm in its cultivation base. For it to consume a Divine Grade Dragon Spirit Pill was undeniably a reckless waste of such a treasure.
It wanted to seize it but feared losing face in front of the Master.
After all, it was a member of the Dragon Clan and a powerful demon of the Eternal Realm. If it snatched a pill from a Destiny Realm Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, it would be utterly embarrassing.
That would be too humiliating.
"Little Black Boy," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said, smiling, "how about we discuss something? Can you give me one of these pills? It looks like you have quite a few in your bag."
The Big Black Cat looked as if it wanted to cry but had no tears. "Senior, there aren’t many left in here! I still need them for my cultivation. As you can see, my cultivation base is low; I need pills to improve it!"
"How about I help you think of other methods? After all, there are many ways to improve one’s cultivation base," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said, shaking its head back and forth, still unwilling to give up.
Ahead, the Big Black Horse, walking along, shook its head.
This Dragon Senior, revived from the Ancient Times, truly hasn’t seen the world,
it thought.
It’s this astonished over a mere Divine Grade Dragon Spirit Pill.
The Big Black Horse knew that the Little Cat still had many pills left in its bag.
After all, the Little Cat’s cultivation base was very low; it wouldn’t even use two or three pills a month.
Thus, the Big Black Horse remained silent. In its eyes, losing one Dragon Spirit Pill wasn’t a big deal for the Little Cat.
Seeing that the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was not giving up, the Big Black Cat knew the pill was gone for good. However, it was unwilling to give it away for free. So, it feigned a pained expression and asked, "Senior, what method do you have to help me improve my cultivation base then?"
"Right now, I don’t really have any heavenly materials or earthly treasures," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said with a thick-skinned grin, "but, I can promise you this: the next good thing I come across, I’ll give it to you first."
After saying this, even it felt a bit embarrassed.
Fortunately, it was red from the inside out, so others couldn’t see its embarrassed expression.
「Inside the carriage.」
Ye Yun saw this scene and couldn’t help but smile.
Dragon Spirit Pills were piled up like several large mountains in his storage space; he had as many as he wanted, far more than he could ever use.
However, he hadn’t expected that the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon would disregard its old face for a single Dragon Spirit Pill.
Ye Yun contemplated for a moment.
He felt he should provide some pills for these Demonic Pets.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was different from the Big Black Cat. It was a member of the Dragon Clan, inherently close to his Dragon God Sect. Currently, its cultivation base was only at the Eternal Realm, and Ye Yun felt he should lend it a hand.
As for Cat Treasure, the little Sky Spirit Cat Clan member on the carriage.
Ye Yun also planned to give it some Dragon Spirit Pills, though of a slightly lower grade, as this little one’s cultivation base was indeed too low.
The reason Ye Yun decided to give Cat Treasure Dragon Spirit Pills was that he didn’t want Cat Treasure to keep dragging everyone down.
When the three cats were together, their cultivation realms shouldn’t be too far apart.
Seeing the senior about to freeload, the Big Black Cat’s heart was dripping blood, but it knew there was nothing it could do at this moment.
But then again, this senior did help me back on Shenhu Mountain.
So, it put on an expression of making a painful sacrifice and said, "Since Senior has asked, then I shall gift it to you."
"Haha... Little Black Boy, you’re really something!" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon cackled, immediately stuffing the Dragon Spirit Pill into its mouth.
After consuming the pill, it burped and said with satisfaction, "Truly excellent! In the Ancient Times, only the Ten Super Divine Dragons were qualified to enjoy Divine Grade Dragon Spirit Pills."
"None of you need to fight over them."
The curtain was lifted, and Ye Yun suddenly tossed out three bags.
These three bags flew towards the Big Black Horse, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, and Cat Treasure respectively.
"I get a share too?"
The Big Black Horse, which was always monitoring the situation behind, saw a bag flying towards it and was so excited it almost leaped into the air.
It had coveted the Big Black Cat’s Dragon Spirit Pills for a long time, but had refrained from acting due to its status.
Who would have thought that the Master, with a single gesture this time, would bestow a whole bag of Dragon Spirit Pills upon me!
Dragon Spirit Pills would also be of immense help to it.
The Big Black Horse immediately stored the bag away.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon suddenly saw a bag flying over and snatched it.
"Many thanks, Master!"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said joyfully.
It happily opened the bag. When it saw the bag was entirely full of Divine Grade Dragon Spirit Pills, its eyes bulged so much they almost popped out.
My heavens! There are a full thousand Dragon Spirit Pills in here!
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s breathing became ragged, its heart pounding violently.
It had never seen so many Divine Pills in its entire life.
Nearby, Cat Treasure caught the bag, looking completely dumbfounded.
"Many thanks, Master..."
Cat Treasure said, its voice trembling with excitement.
It was so agitated that its two paws fumbled endlessly with the bag’s opening, unable to untie it for quite a while.
"Look at you, so clumsy! Let me," the Big Black Cat huffed, annoyed, and slapped Cat Treasure’s paws away. Then, it untied the bag and peered inside.
The bag also contained a thousand Dragon Spirit Pills, but their grade was one level lower than its own Divine Grade ones; they were all Emperor Level.
The Big Black Cat let out a long sigh of relief, instantly feeling at ease and a sense of balance restored.
At this moment, Cat Treasure hurriedly poked its head towards the bag’s opening, took a look, and its eyes began to sparkle.
After a few moments.
"Hey, that’s not right. Why do my Dragon Spirit Pills feel different from yours?" Cat Treasure asked the Big Black Cat, looking completely baffled.

chapters.title: Chapter 237: Successive Breakthroughs, 7th level of Divine Monarch Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 237: Chapter 237: Successive Breakthroughs, 7th level of Divine Monarch Realm
The Big Black Cat sneered.
"You are merely at the Divine Bridge Realm in your cultivation. It’s already remarkable for you to have an Emperor Level Dragon Spirit Pill. What more could you desire?"
"So mine is an Emperor Level Dragon Spirit Pill..."
A look of realization appeared on Cat baby’s face.
"A man’s greed is insatiable..." The Big Black Cat raised its claw, gave a chuckle, but didn’t drop it, instead spat, "Cat baby, an Emperor Level Dragon Spirit Pill is enough for you. Don’t even think about a God Level Dragon Spirit Pill!"
"Oh... yes."
Cat baby obediently nodded her head.
She did feel a bit resentful at first, but then she considered how her cultivation base was indeed very low, merely in the Divine Bridge Realm. To possess a bag full of Emperor Level Dragon Spirit Pills was already unheard of.
Even in the entire Heavenly Star Dynasty, she had never seen an Emperor Level Dragon Spirit Pill appear.
Even Heavenly-Level Dragon Spirit Pills were extremely scarce.
She had only eaten one Dragon Spirit Pill in her entire life.
Cat baby remembered that Dragon Spirit Pill was just a Profound Level Dragon Spirit Pill.
With this thought, Cat baby’s heart felt at peace.
She carefully took out a Dragon Spirit Pill, savored its aroma for a few moments, hesitated, and then placed it in her mouth.
Once the pill entered her stomach, it immediately transformed into surging mana, which roiled and rushed towards her limbs and meridians.
"Such potent medicinal power..."
Cat baby was shocked, instantly feeling as if she would explode from the sheer force of the medicinal energy.
"I’m going to die!"
A thought flashed through her mind.「In the carriage.」
Seeing this, Ye Yun lightly tapped his finger, and the frenzied medicinal power was immediately suppressed.
Cat baby’s cultivation base was too low; even an Emperor Level Dragon Spirit Pill required its power to be suppressed for her to consume it safely.
Ye Yun had given Cat baby the Emperor Level Dragon Spirit Pill intending for her to quickly advance her realm.
"That scared me to death just now! I almost exploded! This medicinal pill is too terrifying..." Cat baby said, still shaken, quickly placing the small bag into her storage ring.
"HAHA..." The Big Black Cat cackled beside her, somewhat gloating. It reached out its paw, patting Cat baby’s head, and said with a grin, "Luckily the Master intervened. Otherwise, your little body would have been blown to bits."
Cat baby was startled.
Only then did she realize that a force had entered her body and suppressed the pill’s power. It turned out the Master had made a move.
She quickly turned, kowtowed in the direction of the carriage, and said respectfully, "Thank you, Master."
Ye Yun smiled but said nothing.
The Big Black Horse pulled the carriage along slowly, heading towards the Heavenly Moon Dynasty.
Time passed day by day.
「More than a month later.」
The carriage arrived near Wu Kun Mountain.
Here lay a dense valley, and deep within it was the dwelling place of the Sky Spirit Cat Clan.
After this period of cultivation, Ye Yun’s cultivation base had already reached the Seventh Realm of God King.
He was advancing his cultivation base at a terrifying speed.
He was only three minor realms away from the Divine Sovereign Realm.
Jun Moxiao had been the first to break through to the Nirvana Realm and was now consolidating his cultivation base, cultivating peacefully.
Luo Li and Su Wanyi were also on the verge of breaking through.
There was about a week left before the opening of the Heavenly Moon Secret Region.
However, this time Ye Yun planned to let Jun Moxiao go to the Heavenly Moon Secret Region alone to find the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree.
This would also serve to make up for Jun Moxiao’s regret of not being able to go to the Nine Soul Underground Palace last time.
"Master, the valley ahead is where our Sky Spirit Cat Clan lives..." Cat baby stood up, gazed at the distant valley, and said softly.
Her Super Divine Dragon Breath was much stronger now than before.
After consuming one Emperor Level Dragon Spirit Pill, Cat baby had advanced from the Fifth Level of Divine Bridge Realm to the Seventh layer of the Divine Bridge Realm within this month.
She had advanced two minor realms consecutively.
"Mm," Ye Yun nodded.
"Master, may I accompany Cat baby?" the Big Black Cat asked respectfully, looking in the direction the carriage was heading.
"All three of you little cats can go..." Ye Yun said with a laugh.
Hearing Ye Yun’s words, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon raised its claw and cried out weakly, "Master, I’m not a cat, I’m a dragon..."
"Second Bro, whatever the Master says you are, you are! Stop arguing!" the Big Black Horse retorted, turning its head with a toothy grin.
"Master, can I go join in the fun too?" the Big Black Horse asked.
"Certainly, you may go as well," Ye Yun readily agreed.
The Big Black Horse loved to join in on any excitement. It would likely stir up some trouble this time, which would be a good chance for it to show off.
Having received the Master’s affirmation, the Big Black Horse chuckled. With a shake of its body, it transformed into a black light, becoming a black-robed man.
"Little Cat, we can team up again this time!" the Big Black Horse laughed heartily.
"Uncle Ma, it is my honor to go with you, esteemed senior," the Big Black Cat said with a shameless grin. With a shake of its body, it also transformed into a black-robed young man.
At this point, Cat baby also transformed, becoming a charming and alluring young woman.
Seeing everyone transform, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon rolled over in the carriage, then turned into a streak of red light that landed on the ground, morphing into a red-robed young man.
"It feels so good to be in human form again!"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon patted his body, a look of relief on his face.
He had no choice; while in the carriage, he had to maintain the form of a small red cat.
After all, that was the rule.
Only when on missions outside could they assume human form.
"Still, just for that bag of God Level Dragon Spirit Pills the Master gave me, I’d be willing to turn into a little red mouse, let alone a little red cat!"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon chuckled inwardly, carefully stowing away the bag in his hand.
"Seniors, please, after you," Cat baby said, gesturing respectfully towards the Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon.
"No need, no need. This is your home; you should lead the way," the Big Black Horse said, waving his hands repeatedly.
He glanced at the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, stroked his chin, his eyes darting around for a moment before saying, "Second Bro, we need to suppress our Super Divine Dragon Breath, or we might frighten people."
"True." The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon glanced towards the valley, seemingly understanding the situation, and immediately suppressed all his Super Divine Dragon Breath.
The Big Black Horse did the same.
"Seniors, my cultivation base isn’t high, so I won’t suppress my Super Divine Dragon Breath," the Big Black Cat chuckled nearby.
He was only at the Heavenly Order Realm Third Layer.
This cultivation base wasn’t considered high among the Sky Spirit Cat Clan.
However, he had been cultivating diligently recently and was close to breaking through to the Fourth Level of the Heavenly Fate Realm.
The Big Black Cat and Cat baby walked side by side, with the Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon strolling casually behind them, appearing quite carefree.
Both of them were powerful demonic beasts of the Eternal Realm.
In a small place like the Heavenly Star Dynasty, they could naturally act as they pleased, so they had no reservations.
This outing was purely for relaxation and, incidentally, to boost Cat baby’s prestige.
As the group walked deeper into the valley and approached a stone gate, a young man suddenly leaped out from the dense forest beside it.
"Sister Bao’er, you’re finally back!" the young man said with a smile.
"What happened?" Cat baby asked, looking at the youth.
A sense of unease welled up in her heart.
"Oh, nothing much. It’s just that quite a few people have come to propose marriage recently..." the young man said, scratching his head with an embarrassed chuckle.
"Why are people proposing marriage again? Didn’t the Golden Striped Black Tiger Clan agree to call off the engagement?" the Big Black Cat exclaimed, clenching and waving his fist in annoyance.
"Indeed. Surely they wouldn’t dare to go back on their word?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon added, stroking his chin thoughtfully.
Given how things were back then, the Golden Striped Black Tiger Clan was clearly terrified. They couldn’t be that foolish, could they?
"It’s not the Golden Striped Black Tiger Clan. I think you’ve misunderstood..." the young man from the Sky Spirit Cat Clan said, looking at the strangers and scratching his head somewhat sheepishly.

chapters.title: Chapter 238: Nine-tailed Spirit Cat Clan
chapters.content:
Chapter 238: Chapter 238: Nine-tailed Spirit Cat Clan
Upon hearing the young man’s words, Big Black Cat slapped his chest and roared with laughter, saying, "I knew it! The Golden Striped Black Tiger clan wouldn’t be that brainless."
Recalling the day he used the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon as a "cannonball" to smash the father of that endearingly stupid and naïve fellow so miserably,
Big Black Cat was still immensely proud.
This was a glorious moment in his cat life.
Using an Eternal Realm Divine Dragon as a cannonball—that was certainly a first in this world!
Not even his powerful master had ever done something like this.
"If it’s not the Golden Striped Black Tiger clan, then it has nothing to do with me. Are all the suitors who came to propose interested in my second sister?" Cat Bao’er’s brow relaxed slightly, but then she tensed up again and quickly asked.
"Yes, Miss Bao’er," the young man quickly responded.
"So, you have a sister?"
Big Black Cat stroked his chin and chuckled. "You two sisters are quite the pair of beauties, both so lovely. No wonder you’re so popular that suitors have practically worn out your doorstep."
"Not really..." Cat Bao’er nodded awkwardly.
Then she said no more and walked inside, with the others following closely behind.
Just as they reached the entrance of the reception hall, they heard voices from within.
"This time, we have come with utmost sincerity, hoping to establish a closer relationship with the Sky Spirit Cat Clan. We implore you, Clan Leader, to give this matter your serious consideration..." a man’s voice said.
"I will consider it. After all, you are also of the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat Clan and share a common ancestry with our Sky Spirit Cat Clan..." an aged voice replied.
What?
Nine-tailed Spirit Cat?
Hearing this, Big Black Cat’s ears instantly perked up, and he stared wide-eyed towards the main hall.
Why would Nine-tailed Spirit Cats be here?
Unable to contain his curiosity, Big Black Cat zipped over, crouched by the doorway, and peered inside.
Sure enough, quite a few people were standing in the main hall.
Among them were two figures he found very familiar.
An old man in hemp robes sat leisurely on a chair, sipping tea.
Beside him stood a young man in red.
The young man was strikingly handsome and debonair, with deep-set features. His cultivation base was also considerable, having already reached the Heavenly Order Realm Third Layer.
"Little Cat, are these your kinsfolk?" Big Black Horse ambled over and asked.
"Uncle Ma, I suppose you could say we’re of the same clan. We’ve only met a few times, though."
Big Black Cat’s expression darkened; he seemed to recall some unpleasant memories.
That old man and the young man were indeed from the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat Clan.
And so was he.
However, his was not the main branch of the family. Due to a diluted bloodline, his lineage wasn’t highly regarded within the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat Clan.
Especially since his father had made a mistake in his youth and had been expelled from the clan.
Later, when Big Black Cat was little, he had gone back with his father a few times and had seen that old man and young man.
The old man in hemp garments was the Clan Leader of the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat Clan; everyone in the clan called him Ninth Master. He had lived for many years and was a Tenth Layer Destiny Realm Great Demon.
The young man beside him was the most outstanding prodigy of the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat Clan.
"What’s wrong? You look like you have a feud with them," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon also leaned in to ask.
"It’s not exactly a feud. It’s just that they’re from the direct line, and I’m from a collateral branch..."
Big Black Cat wrinkled his nose, gave a wry smile, and briefly explained the history to the two seniors.
"Little black boy, whatever you want to do, I’ll be your strongest backer," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said, pounding his chest.
"Thank you, esteemed senior!" Big Black Cat replied gratefully.
Hearing Big Black Cat’s words, Cat Bao’er seemed lost in thought.
However, she didn’t pause, instead walking directly into the main hall.
Big Black Cat took a deep breath and followed her inside.
As for Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, they ambled in leisurely.
Suddenly, four figures entered through the doorway, instantly drawing the attention of everyone in the main hall.
"Eldest Sister, you’re back?" a young girl in a pink dress rushed out like a butterfly, her face alight with joyful surprise.
"Yes, Little Sister, I’m back!" Cat Bao’er said with a smile.
She reached out and gently patted her younger sister’s back, an indulgent smile on her face.
After a brief hug, Cat Bao’er took two steps forward, bowed, and said to the dignified, golden-robed old man seated above, "Father, I have returned."
"You... you still know how to come back? What on earth did you do to make the Golden Striped Black Tiger Clan call off the marriage?"
The golden-robed old man slammed his hand on his chair, which resounded with a loud BANG, and he spoke, his voice filled with rage.
"I just didn’t want to marry that stupid and naïve man. Now that the marriage has been called off, Father, you don’t need to bring it up again..." Cat Bao’er said, mustering her courage.
Normally, she was quite afraid of her father. But this time, with two Eternal Realm Great Demons standing behind her, she felt more confident.
Moreover, Cat Bao’er had experienced a great deal recently, which had made her bolder.
Hearing Cat Bao’er’s rebuttal, the golden-robed old man was so furious it felt as if his eyeballs would pop out.
He glared fixedly at Cat Bao’er, his chest heaving with rage.
His own daughter was disobedient, rebellious, and willful!
The Golden Striped Black Tiger Clan was so powerful; an alliance with them through marriage would bring immense benefits to their Sky Spirit Cat Clan.
But he never imagined this daughter of his would act so presumptuously and ruin such an important marriage!
Who are these people?
The golden-robed old man’s gaze flickered, landing on the individuals behind Cat Bao’er.
The young man in black robes was at the Heavenly Order Realm Third Layer.
As for the two people behind him, he couldn’t discern their cultivation base at all.
This gave him a jolt, and he didn’t dare to act rashly.
"You... Aren’t you that little mongrel from the branch family? What are you doing here? How dare you associate with the young lady of the Sky Spirit Cat Clan! Don’t tell me you were the one who ruined the previous marriage arrangement?"
The red-robed young man in the hall stared at Big Black Cat, recognizing him after a few scrutinizing glances.
"Who are you calling a mongrel?"
Big Black Cat was incandescent with rage, fury erupting in his chest.
This so-called top prodigy of the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat Clan had sneered at and taunted him thousands of years ago.
Now, after all these millennia, he hadn’t changed one bit.
Previously, on others’ territory, Big Black Cat wouldn’t have dared to make a move. But now? Now, he definitely would.
Having said that, he unceremoniously whipped out his Black Shield and charged at the red-robed young man.
"Such audacity! A mere member of a branch family dares to attack someone from the main lineage? Utterly outrageous!"
The hemp-robed old man’s eyes flashed, his imposing aura flared, and he thrust out a powerful palm strike.
He was a Tenth Layer Destiny Realm Great Demon; the might of this palm strike was immense.
A red shadow flashed.
Suddenly, a young man in red robes appeared before him, effortlessly intercepting the palm strike.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon caught the blow with ease, deflecting the palm, and said with a smirk, "My, you’re quite the imposing Clan Leader, aren’t you? Planning to kill your own clan members now?"
The hemp-robed old man stared at the red-robed young man before him, his face instantly registering shock.
This unknown young man in red had blocked his palm strike so easily; his strength was likely comparable to his own!
When Big Black Cat saw the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon intervene and block the Clan Leader, he inwardly heaved a sigh of relief.
His charge unabated, he continued to lunge at the red-robed young man.
The red-robed young man showed no weakness, wielding a sword and conjuring a torrent of sword light as he engaged Big Black Cat in battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 240: Appearance of the Eternal Realm Great Demon
chapters.content:
Chapter 240: Chapter 240: Appearance of the Eternal Realm Great Demon
The words of the elderly man in the golden robe suddenly made the atmosphere in the great hall heavy. Meow Baoer was slightly startled; even though she was mentally prepared, she hadn’t expected her father to be so resolute.
This old man is really stubborn,
Big Black Cat thought, standing by with a smile, not interrupting immediately. After all, this was a family matter for Meow Baoer’s Sky Spirit Cat Clan. He wanted to see how Meow Baoer would communicate with her father first. If she couldn’t get through to this stubborn old man, Big Black Cat decided he would step in. With two Eternal Realm Great Demons standing behind him, he was confident he could handle the mere Clan Leader of the Sky Spirit Cat Clan.
The old man in the hemp robe on the other side was also somewhat surprised. The Sky Spirit Cat Clan was very powerful, comparable to Mid-Quality Major Sects.
Why would the Clan Leader’s eldest daughter want to join the Human Race’s forces? It’s completely illogical.
This thought flashed through his mind.
The hemp-robed old man stepped forward to help the red-robed youth. Finding that the young man, although injured, had no life-threatening wounds, he couldn’t help but let out a sigh of relief. He quickly took out a few extremely precious pills and deftly placed them into the red-robed youth’s mouth.
This time, their plan to propose marriage to the Sky Spirit Cat Clan...
had utterly failed. The only unexpected thing was that the half-breed from the branch lineage was so strong.
At this moment, the hemp-robed old man was filled with a profound sense of frustration.
However, he had no intention of leaving just yet; he wanted to see how things would develop.
"Father, I have already joined the Dragon God Sect. This cannot be changed," Meow Baoer said stubbornly.
After she spoke, the pink-robed young woman beside her quickly tugged at her arm, whispering, "Elder Sister, how can you speak to Father like that? Our Sky Spirit Cat Clan is incomparably noble, a renowned existence even among the Demon Clan! How could we possibly join a Human Race faction?"
"Little Sister, you don’t understand this matter. You don’t need to persuade me anymore," Meow Baoer said, shaking her head, her expression resolute.
"Humph!" The golden-robed elder’s face flushed red with anger. He waved his large sleeve and roared fiercely, "Meow Baoer, do you truly disregard my words as your father?"
"Father, it’s not that I disregard you, but joining the Dragon God Sect is my own choice." Meow Baoer looked at her furious father, her delicate body trembling slightly, yet her voice remained incredibly firm.
"Good! Good!" The golden-robed elder raised his hand, pointed at Meow Baoer, and after repeating "good" twice, his face became exceedingly gloomy and dejected.
A few breaths later, he declared, enunciating each word clearly, "From this moment on, you are no longer a member of the Sky Spirit Cat Clan! As the Clan Leader, I hereby sever all ties between you and the Sky Spirit Cat Clan!"
"Father, you can’t expel Elder Sister from the clan!" the pink-robed young woman cried out anxiously upon hearing this. She quickly knelt, pleading pitifully for her sister.
"My mind is made up. Say no more," the golden-robed old man stated, his hands clasped behind his back, his expression cold. From the moment he had decided, he was determined to completely sever his father-daughter relationship with Meow Baoer.
"Father..." Meow Baoer was heartbroken, tears streaming down her face like rain.
She never imagined her stubborn father would actually expel her.
Seeing Meow Baoer’s grief and sorrow, an indescribable anger welled up inside Big Black Cat. He took two steps forward, looked at the golden-robed old man, and questioned loudly, "Old man, you’re too heartless! How could you treat your own daughter like this?"
The golden-robed old man snorted coldly, looking at the black-robed young man before him, and said in a deep voice, "This is an internal family matter of our clan. It has nothing to do with you."
"Who says it has nothing to do with me? Meow Baoer is also a disciple of my Dragon God Sect. Seeing her distressed, Old Cat naturally can’t just stand by," Big Black Cat retorted with a cold laugh.
"How will you intervene? Can you retract the order I’ve given?" the golden-robed elder snapped, exasperated.
"You must retract that order! Otherwise, I’ll have to teach you a lesson, you old codger!" Big Black Cat declared, stomping his foot. Although he was only at the Destiny Realm Third Layer and far from a match for Meow Baoer’s father, he absolutely couldn’t back down at this moment.
"Fine! I’d like to see what abilities a genius from the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat Clan like you possesses!" The golden-robed elder slowly walked towards Big Black Cat, looking as if he was about to strike. A powerful Super Divine Dragon Breath emanated from him, a rolling pressure surging forth like a river, instantly making Big Black Cat struggle for breath. After all, the gap between him and Meow Baoer’s father was simply too vast.
"Old man, if you dare lay a single finger on her, Uncle Ma here will take you down!" Big Black Horse also stepped forward two paces, absorbing all of the oppressive Super Divine Dragon Breath.
Big Black Cat gasped for breath, feeling immensely grateful.
At the critical moment, Uncle Ma had to be the one to step in!
"Who might you be, sir? Do you insist on making an enemy of our Sky Spirit Cat Clan?" the golden-robed elder asked, staring coldly at the black-robed man before him, his voice fearless.
"I also belong to the Dragon God Sect... So, tell me, should I meddle in this or not? Old man, for your daughter’s sake, I won’t make things difficult for you. Quickly retract what you just said, and we can all be happy. Otherwise, let’s not let things turn unpleasant," Big Black Horse said patiently in a deep voice. Although the old man was stubborn and ill-tempered, Big Black Horse, for Meow Baoer’s sake, wasn’t pressing the issue too aggressively. Otherwise, with his temperament, anyone acting so arrogantly would have long been swatted to death by Uncle Ma.
The golden-robed elder halted, his face as dark as water.
This fellow is powerful. Not only is he strong, but the red-robed youth by his side... is also very strong. Facing two of them, I probably have little chance of winning.
Just as he was hesitating, he suddenly heard the hemp-robed old man beside him say, "Our Nine-tailed Spirit Cat Clan is willing to stand with the Sky Spirit Cat Clan!"
The golden-robed elder’s heart filled with joy. He cupped his fists and said, "Many thanks, Brother!"
The hemp-robed old man stepped forward, standing shoulder to shoulder with him.
"Father, you mustn’t fight!" Seeing her father about to join forces with the hemp-robed old man against Uncle Ma, Meow Baoer immediately grew anxious and rushed over.
"Stay out of this!" The golden-robed elder waved his arm, and a strong gust of wind swept out, pushing Meow Baoer away.
"Two at the Destiny Realm Tenth Level. Quite strong indeed, but still not enough to impress us," Big Black Cat chuckled. He winked at Big Black Horse and said with a shameless grin, "Uncle Ma, how about you show them what you’re capable of?"
Big Black Horse nodded. With a slight movement of his body, he released a faint trace of an Eternal Realm Great Demon’s Super Divine Dragon Breath.
As this wisp of Super Divine Dragon Breath swept over them, the expressions of both the golden-robed elder and the hemp-robed elder changed dramatically, their eyes filled with terror.
An Eternal Realm Great Demon? How... how is this possible?
The hemp-robed elder reacted extremely quickly, hastily retreating a few steps. He cupped his fists and said, "This junior was unaware of the arrival of an Eternal Realm Great Demon senior! Please forgive my offense!"
Seeing this fellow’s spinelessness and how he was already trying to back out, Big Black Horse became somewhat annoyed.
"Uncle Ma doesn’t like your kind of coward."
He delivered a light slap. The hemp-robed elder screamed as he was sent flying, landing on the ground and struggling incessantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 241: The Heritage of the Sky Spirit Cat Race, Ancient Painting of the Demon Ancestor
chapters.content:
Chapter 241: Chapter 241: The Heritage of the Sky Spirit Cat Race, Ancient Painting of the Demon Ancestor
The Big Black Horse did not kill the old man in hemp clothes, primarily because he was the Clan Leader of the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat Clan. After all, they were of the same clan as the Big Black Cat. It wouldn’t be appropriate to kill the Big Black Cat’s Clan Leader in front of him, no matter how one looked at it. A stern lesson would suffice. That slap was enough to make the hemp-robed elder remember this lesson for the rest of his life.
At this moment, the golden-robed elder trembled, looking at the black-robed man with terror. He felt as if his throat was constricted, rendering him speechless.
How could a minor Dragon God Sect possibly harbor an Eternal Realm Great Demon?
Before an Eternal Realm Great Demon, his cultivation at the Tenth Level of the Destiny Realm was utterly insignificant.
The Big Black Cat was visibly smug, his eyes narrowing in amusement as he said, "Old man, now you see the Dragon God Sect’s true power, don’t you? Hurry up, admit your mistake, and take back your words. You’re still Little Cat’s father, after all. We’re very magnanimous; we won’t fuss over such trivialities."
"You want me to bow my head? Absolutely impossible! Unless I’m dead," the golden-robed elder stated stubbornly.
The pink-robed girl hurried to the golden-robed elder’s side, supporting his arm, and gently persuaded, "Father, my sister and we are all family. There’s no need to create such a deadlock. Please, just take back what you said."
"I will not take them back," the golden-robed elder declared, shaking his head decisively.
Little Cat sighed. In that moment, she felt as if the entire world had lost its color. Her father was just that stubborn. She had deeply understood his obstinacy since childhood. Even when she had vehemently opposed the marriage with the Golden Striped Black Tiger Clan, her father had still agreed to it for the clan’s benefit. Even when she had threatened him with her own life, her father hadn’t relented in the slightest. He was so incredibly stubborn; no one could sway him.
Seeing the old man so unyielding, the Big Black Cat shook his head helplessly.
If a person isn’t even afraid of death, there’s truly nothing more to be done.
He walked over, gently tugged Little Cat’s arm, and advised, "Let’s leave for now. We can always come back after your father has calmed down."
Little Cat nodded dejectedly, preparing to leave with the Big Black Cat.
At this moment, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, who had been silent all this time, suddenly took two steps forward. He scanned his surroundings and sneered, "Old man, if you don’t retract your earlier words, don’t blame me for being impolite. You may not fear death, but don’t forget, your Sky Spirit Cat Clan still has many Clan Members."
Seeing the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon suddenly speak like this, the Big Black Cat was startled, not understanding his intention. The Big Black Horse, after a moment of surprise, instantly understood. He quickly went over and whispered urgently, "Just let it go. Don’t start a massacre."
"No! I insist on a massacre! Otherwise, this old man will never yield!" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon snarled, his voice laced with extreme malice.
The Big Black Horse shrugged, looked at the golden-robed elder, and sighed. "There’s nothing I can do. His cultivation base is higher than mine; I can’t control him."
"That’s right, he can’t control me!" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon interjected, flashing a deliberate, chilling smile, and a trace of the Super Divine Dragon Breath of an Eternal Realm Great Demon began to emanate from him.
Seeing another Eternal Realm Great Demon, the golden-robed elder felt his vision darken, and he nearly collapsed.
This Dragon God Sect... actually has two Eternal Realm Great Demons!
He bowed his head, his body trembling uncontrollably.
「Inside the carriage.」
Seeing the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and the Big Black Horse cooperate so seamlessly, Ye Yun couldn’t help but shake his head and chuckle.
One played the good cop, the other the bad cop.
This tactic is usually very effective, quite useful.
Ye Yun watched with keen interest as events unfolded, moving in the direction he had anticipated.
The Big Black Cat, arms crossed, watched the golden-robed elder with a confident smirk. Now that they had bared their fangs, the presence of two Eternal Realm Great Demons exerted immense pressure on the Sky Spirit Cat Clan.
Little Cat also held her breath, silently awaiting her father’s decision. She knew that the Dragon Senior’s harsh words were merely intended to force her father into submission.
「Several dozen seconds later.」
The golden-robed elder, head still bowed, let out a series of chilling laughs. "Don’t think that just because you’re from the Eternal Realm, you can bully others as you please! The Sky Spirit Cat Clan has a legacy stretching back a million years; naturally, we have our own hidden strengths..."
"Hidden strengths?"
Everyone in the main hall was astonished. Little Cat was aghast. She hadn’t expected her father to speak of ’hidden strengths’ when facing two Eternal Realm Great Demons. She had never heard of the Sky Spirit Cat Clan possessing any hidden strength capable of contending with two Eternal Realm Great Demons.
The Big Black Horse was also rather surprised.
Could it be that this seemingly small Sky Spirit Cat Clan actually has an Eternal Realm Strong Person backing them?
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, however, paid this no mind. He boomed with laughter, "Whatever hidden strengths you have, bring them out! Let this lord see!"
"That’s right, old man! Stop bluffing!" the Big Black Cat chimed in, laughing as well.
This old man must be bluffing out of desperation to save face, probably losing his mind.
He was fairly familiar with the Sky Spirit Cat Clan; they weren’t as formidable as one might imagine.
They don’t even have any Life and Death Realm powerhouses. How could they possibly confront two Eternal Realm Great Demons?
With a tremor in his hand, the golden-robed elder suddenly produced a scroll. This scroll was exceedingly ancient, clearly weathered by countless years.
WHOOSH!
The golden-robed elder tossed the ancient scroll into mid-air and declared with profound respect, "We humbly summon the Demon Ancestor, Empress Yun Xiao!"
The ancient scroll unfurled in mid-air, revealing the image of a woman. The woman appeared to be in her early twenties, her features exquisite, her beauty breathtaking. Dressed in a cyan Daoist robe, she possessed an air of transcendent, ethereal grace. However, her expression was frigid, her eyes filled with an indifferent iciness. A single glance was enough to send a chill deep into one’s bones, like being plunged into a cavern of ice.
This is... the Demon Ancestor, Empress Yun Xiao?
Gazing at the woman in the portrait, the Big Black Cat was utterly dumbstruck. His entire body trembled violently, and he immediately dropped to his knees.
In the distance, the old man in hemp clothes, upon seeing the woman’s image, also fell to his knees, his face overcome with emotion. "We pay our respects to the Demon Ancestor!" the old man in hemp clothes exclaimed, his voice thick with emotion.
"What Demon Ancestor is this, Boss?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon transmitted, raising an eyebrow in confusion.
"I don’t know either! But judging by how agitated Little Cat is, this must be someone extraordinary," the Big Black Horse transmitted back, scratching his head in bewilderment.
Both Little Cat and the pink-robed girl were dumbfounded. The two young women also knelt. Little Cat had never, ever imagined that their Sky Spirit Cat Clan possessed a portrait of a Demon Ancestor.
「Inside the carriage.」
Ye Yun, who had been observing the events in the main hall, suddenly found his expression shifting. The cyan-robed woman on the ancient scroll... her stunningly beautiful face was so familiar, it instantly stirred ancient memories deep within Ye Yun.
Yun Xiao... it’s been a hundred thousand years. I never thought your portrait would still be circulating on the Cangnan Continent...
Ye Yun stood up, a faint, enigmatic smile playing on his lips as he murmured to himself,
Little Yun Xiao, since when did you become a Demon Ancestor?

chapters.title: Chapter 242: Demon Ancestor, The Little Follower from a Hundred Thousand Years Ago
chapters.content:
Chapter 242: Chapter 242: Demon Ancestor, The Little Follower from a Hundred Thousand Years Ago
Ye Yun closed his eyes.
In his mind, an image of a charming and lovely girl suddenly appeared. This lively and waggish girl had two pigtails on her head and loved to wear peach-pink dresses. Every day, she loved to follow him around, trailing closely behind.
Despite her cute and charming appearance, she had an incredibly fiery temper.
She constantly declared her intention to drive away all the beautiful women around Ye Yun. She wanted to monopolize this strongest man on the Cangnan Continent.
Back then, Ye Yun was bossy and domineering. How could he allow Yun Xiao to have her way?
So, most of the time, Ye Yun would discipline Yun Xiao. Sometimes, when irritated, he would grab Yun Xiao and spank her bottom, making the little girl wail.
At that time, Yun Xiao was merely a cultivator at the Life and Death Realm, still a great distance from the Eternal Realm.
However, Yun Xiao was not a cultivator of the Human Race, but a member of the Demon Clan. In Ye Yun’s eyes, she was just an arrogant and unruly little demon.
As a transmigrator, Ye Yun carried no prejudice against the Demon Clan. Having watched dramas such as *The Legend of White Snake*, which featured Xu Xian and Lady White Snake, and *A Chinese Ghost Story*, Ye Yun naturally viewed beautiful women of the Demon Clan no differently than others.
What Ye Yun did not expect was that a hundred thousand years later, the little Yun Xiao had become the Demon Ancestor spoken of by later generations.
He couldn’t help but sigh at the changes wrought by time, which were truly unpredictable.
It seemed that Yun Xiao had later cultivated to the Eternal Realm, and not just an ordinary one.
To become the Demon Ancestor, she must have reached at least the ninth layer of the Eternal Realm.
Although the lifespan of the Demon Clan was extremely long, it was absolutely impossible for them to live for a hundred thousand years.
Ye Yun sighed softly, standing silently in the carriage. An ancient painting brought back memories of events from long ago. He stood there blankly, as if time around him had reversed, and he had returned to a hundred thousand years ago.
...
To tell the truth, a hundred thousand years ago, when I was young and vigorous, I was indeed very arrogant. It was far preferable to the profound loneliness my invincibility brought me a hundred thousand years later.
「In the grand hall.」
The gold-robed man looked at the two great demons of the Eternal Realm in the distance. When he saw they did not kneel before the Demon Ancestor, he grew furious and scolded coldly, "Why don’t you two kneel when you see the Demon Ancestor?"
Big Black Horse paused for a moment, then chuckled, "Why should I kneel? I don’t even know her."
"Yeah, you say she’s some Demon Ancestor, but we don’t know her. Why should we kneel before her? Is your old head waterlogged?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon also chuckled coldly.
"You!" The gold-robed man trembled with anger.
He hadn’t expected these two great demons to play dumb, showing no respect at all for the Demon Ancestor.
It was known that throughout the entire Cangnan Continent, any member of the Demon Clan had to kneel in reverence before this ancient painting once it appeared. After all, tens of thousands of years ago, during the Great War between the Human Race and the Demon Clan, Demon Ancestor Yunxiao Empress single-handedly turned the tide. Her actions preserved many bloodlines of the Demon Clan.
"Truly, the times have changed, and people’s hearts are unfathomable."
The gold-robed man suddenly chuckled coldly. With a series of hand seals, he cast a spell that shot a beam of light into the ancient painting.
The ancient painting suddenly shone brightly. The figure within it seemed to come alive, appearing incredibly vivid.
Then, they saw the woman in the ancient painting gracefully walk out of it.
Upon her appearance, a mighty pressure immediately filled the entire hall.
Big Black Horse was greatly alarmed. He realized the woman before him had reached the tenth layer of the Eternal Realm.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was also stunned. He hadn’t expected the woman in the painting to possess such a high cultivation base.
Her eyes were exceptionally cold, as if everything in the world was merely lifeless to her. She looked down at the two great demons below and said coldly, "You two little demons, why do you not kneel upon seeing this Empress?"
"Why should I kneel?" Big Black Horse said stubbornly, showing not a hint of fear.
"Since you refuse to kneel, then don’t blame this Empress for being impolite," the woman in green said coldly.
She extended a slender finger, which glowed with intense light, and slowly pointed it towards Big Black Horse.
The immense pressure immobilized Big Black Horse; even the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was suppressed at this moment. The two could only watch helplessly as the finger moved towards them.
The gold-robed man watched this scene, his face filled with joyous surprise.
The ancestors were right! The ancient painting indeed contained a wisp of Mother Yunxiao’s will, meant to help their Sky Spirit Cat clan through their most perilous tribulations.
Just as the gold-robed man believed the two Eternal Realm great demons were about to perish, he suddenly found himself frozen in place.
He wasn’t the only one frozen. Everyone around them was trapped in a similar state of dreamlike stillness.
Suddenly, a figure in white appeared.
"Xiao Yunxiao, has it been too long since your bottom was spanked?"
Ye Yun appeared opposite Yun Xiao, raising a hand to block her slender, jade-like finger.
"And who might you be?"
Yun Xiao gazed coldly at the figure in white, her eyes showing no sign of recognition.
"You don’t recognize me?"
Ye Yun was astonished. He hadn’t expected that after a hundred thousand years, Yun Xiao wouldn’t recognize him. What on earth had happened in the meantime?
He stared intently at Yun Xiao’s devastatingly beautiful face. When he saw the hint of extreme heartlessness hidden deep within her eyes, he seemed to understand something.
"Yun Xiao, did you really cultivate the Supreme Forgetting Emotions Path?" Ye Yun asked, his heart aching.
Yun Xiao’s cold eyes narrowed slightly. Staring at the white-robed man before her, she fired off a series of questions: "Who exactly are you? Why do you know my name? And how do you know I cultivate the Supreme Forgetting Emotions Path?"
"I am Ye Yun," he said, his voice tinged with a certain anguish, as he slowly walked towards the illusory body formed from a wisp of will.
"You’re Ye Yun? That name..." Yun Xiao’s eyes glazed over for an instant, a flicker of confusion in them.
She vaguely recalled hearing this name somewhere, sometime. It felt as if this name was hidden away in a corner of her heart.
But then, an instinctive coldness welled up from the depths of her heart, ruthlessly stifling that nascent emotion.
Ye Yun slowly walked until he stood before Yun Xiao, the two facing each other in the air.
Gazing at this familiar face, Ye Yun was filled with a myriad of emotions, sighing inwardly.
He slowly reached out his hand, wanting to gently ruffle her hair.
"Get away from me! Don’t touch me!" Yun Xiao roared, her hand striking out like a knife, slashing mercilessly towards Ye Yun.
Her jade-white palm radiated an astonishingly sharp intent, like a flash of white light, a blade striking for Ye Yun’s chest.
"Still so naughty. It seems I really should spank your bottom..." Ye Yun chuckled.
He smiled and gently blew a breath. This breath, arriving later yet striking first, actually pushed Yun Xiao’s body back into the ancient painting.
Ye Yun reached out and put away the scroll painting.
This Yun Xiao in the scroll was just a wisp of will. He couldn’t let her make a move; he couldn’t waste the energy of this will. It was better to return her to the scroll as quickly as possible. This way, he could allow this wisp of Yun Xiao’s will to last a little longer.

chapters.title: Chapter 243: Nether Ghost King
chapters.content:
Chapter 243: Chapter 243: Nether Ghost King
After retrieving the ancient painting, Ye Yun shimmered slightly and returned to the carriage.
He slowly closed his eyes, his eyelashes trembling subtly.
Having encountered an acquaintance from a hundred thousand years ago who no longer recognized him, Ye Yun’s emotions were somewhat stirred.
Although it did not affect his steadfast Dao Heart, it still left him feeling somewhat melancholic.
Inside the hall, everyone remained in a relatively suspended state.
Ye Yun glanced one last time at Mao Bao’er’s father and instantly extracted all the memories from his mind.
Ye Yun extracted these memories to understand the origin of this ancient painting.
After observing a stream of memories, flowing like water, Ye Yun’s expression darkened further.
He murmured to himself, "So the ancestor of the Sky Spirit Cat Clan was a pet that Xiao Yunxiao had raised in her later years. Therefore, before her departure, she left them an ancient painting to protect them for ten thousand years..."
At this point, Ye Yun once again brought out the ancient painting, slowly unrolling it and carefully scrutinizing the woman in azure depicted on it.
According to the memories in the golden-robed elder’s mind, over ninety thousand years ago, Yun Xiao, having become an Eternal Realm Great Demon, began her Cultivation of the Supreme Forgetting Emotions Path.
Through practicing this unique Divine skill, she broke through to The Tenth Layer Peak of the Eternal Realm, becoming an exceptionally rare and powerful demon.
Such a cultivation base was rare even among the Human Race.
Therefore, at that time, Yun Xiao was the leading figure of the Demon Clan on the Cangnan Continent, and also considered their spiritual leader.
What surprised Ye Yun was that Yun Xiao later established the Ruthless Palace, recruiting numerous followers and Disciples.
Among them were both Demon Clan and Human Race members.
The people of the Ruthless Palace all practiced the Supreme Forgetting Emotions Path; they were all cold-hearted and ruthless, known for their decisiveness in killing.
Throughout the Cangnan Continent, they were renowned, their might shaking the world.
Seventy thousand years ago, the conflict between the Human Race and the Demon Clan on the Cangnan Continent gradually escalated, culminating in a great war.
At the outset of the war, Yun Xiao, who practiced the Supreme Forgetting Emotions Path, did not intervene. However, when the Demon Clan faced a crisis of survival, Yun Xiao could not help but act.
She repelled the Human Race’s powerful Cultivators who were at The Tenth Layer Peak of the Eternal Realm, securing a sliver of hope for the Demon Clan’s survival.
From then on, she was remembered by every member of the Demon Clan and hailed as the Ancestor of ten thousand demons.
The Ruthless Palace, too, became a sacred place for the Demon Clan.
Witnessing these past events, Ye Yun couldn’t help but sigh. He could vaguely guess why Yun Xiao had chosen to cultivate the Supreme Forgetting Emotions Path.
Ye Yun’s fall at that time had been a massive blow to Yun Xiao.
Disheartened, she began to cultivate the Supreme Forgetting Emotions Path, hoping this Divine skill could help her forget the pain in her heart.
Ye Yun sighed.
A hundred thousand years had passed, a time of immense change, and people were different. Yun Xiao was long gone.
An Eternal Realm demon, despite having a very long lifespan, could not possibly live for a hundred thousand years.
He quietly looked at the woman in the picture, his vision blurring for a moment, as if time had returned to a hundred thousand years ago.
...
「Within the hall.」
Suddenly, everyone’s spirits lifted as they awoke from their suspended state.
"What just happened?" The Big Black Horse stared, shaking his head, somewhat perplexed.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was the same.
However, when he saw the terrifying woman in the green dress in mid-air suddenly vanish—along with the ancient painting—he snapped to his senses.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon instantly understood.
It must have been the Lord who acted. When the Lord saw they were no match for the woman in the green dress, He directly intervened to resolve the crisis for them.
PHEW!
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon took a deep breath, feeling the relief of having narrowly escaped death.
The Big Black Horse also understood at this moment, realizing that it was the Lord who had intervened at the crucial moment.
"Where has the revered Demon Ancestor gone?"
At this point, the golden-robed elder also regained his senses. Gazing at the empty space above the hall, he couldn’t help but roar internally.
Just when he was on the verge of success, about to suppress the two Eternal Realm Great Demons, he suddenly experienced a daze, and both the Demon Ancestor’s manifested will and the ancient painting vanished.
What on earth had happened?
The golden-robed elder felt like banging his head against a wall.
This ancient painting had been passed down for tens of thousands of years, and generations of Clan Leaders had never used it.
He had been forced into a corner today, finally deciding to use this ancient painting.
But he never imagined... he would actually lose the ancient painting.
He was truly the greatest sinner in the history of the Sky Spirit Cat Clan!
The golden-robed elder roared to the heavens, tears streaming down like rain, his heart filled with immense guilt.
Seeing her father so distraught, Mao Bao’er didn’t know how to console him.
"Father, don’t be sad. Maybe all of this is fate..."
The pink-clad young woman walked over to support her aging father. She noticed that in that instant, her father seemed to have aged a great deal.
Seeing her father in this state, Mao Bao’er couldn’t stop her tears.
She hadn’t expected so many things to happen after she returned home.
The greatest heirloom of their Sky Spirit Cat Clan had actually been lost by her father.
Mao Bao’er could imagine her father’s feelings at this moment.
The Big Black Cat stood up. Reflecting on what had just happened, he instantly understood and conveyed his thoughts to Mao Bao’er via voice transmission,
It must have been the Old Master who acted...
Mao Bao’er was somewhat excited.
So it was the Old Master who took action! In that case, the ancient painting must be in his hands...
She decided to find the Old Master and ask for the ancient painting back. That way, her father wouldn’t have to blame himself so much.
Just as she was about to leave the main hall, a voice like a clap of thunder boomed from above, "Old scoundrel of the Sky Spirit Cat Clan, get out here and die!"
The voice was incredibly sonorous and highly penetrating, making the entire main hall buzz and tremble.
The golden-robed elder was startled; he immediately recognized the voice.
With a flicker, he was outside the main hall.
Standing on the square in front of the main hall, he looked up into the void and saw a figure.
This figure was enormous, enveloped in dense Ghost Qi, looking sinister and terrifying.
The golden-robed elder shouted angrily, "Nether Ghost King, several thousand years ago, you were my defeated foe! Have you come seeking death again this time?"
The newcomer was none other than the Nether Ghost King from the Ghost King Sect of the Heavenly Moon Dynasty, who held a deep grudge against their Sky Spirit Cat Clan.
Several thousand years ago, the Nether Ghost King had led his disciples to attack the Sky Spirit Cat Clan but was repelled by him.
He hadn’t expected this fellow to return a thousand years later.
The Nether Ghost King waved his large hand, and a black long spear immediately appeared in it. The spear was wreathed in Ghost Qi and emitted waves of gloomy cries, as if the tormented souls of countless beings were howling within it. "This time, I, the Ghost King, have cultivated a Great Divine Power and intend to have a proper battle with you!"
The golden-robed elder turned his head and shouted, "Mao Bao’er, give me the Heavenly Spirit Mirror!"
Mao Bao’er hurriedly ran out. Hearing her father’s call, she immediately tossed out the Heavenly Spirit Mirror.
The Nether Ghost King saw this, and a vicious glint flashed in his eyes. "Aha! So the Heavenly Spirit Mirror wasn’t in your hands after all!"
He swooped down from mid-air, black long spear in hand, and thrust viciously.
His spear aimed straight for the golden-robed elder’s chest.
Forced to react, the golden-robed elder hastily retreated, and the Heavenly Spirit Mirror flashed past him.
The Nether Ghost King made a grasping motion with his large hand and immediately seized the Heavenly Spirit Mirror.
The Nether Ghost King laughed arrogantly, "HAHAHA... Old fool, without the Heavenly Spirit Mirror, let’s see how you’ll fight me!"
The golden-robed elder’s pale face became extremely grim.
The Heavenly Spirit Mirror was the ultimate treasure of their Sky Spirit Cat Clan. In his hands, it could unleash unparalleled prowess.
Without the Heavenly Spirit Mirror, he feared he was no match for the Nether Ghost King before him.

chapters.title: Chapter 244
chapters.content:
Chapter 244: 244
"Old scoundrel, meet your end!"
The Nether Ghost King let out a brash yell, thrusting his spear forward.
HUM!
WOO WOO!
The spear’s thrust vibrated through the air, igniting countless spectral wails and howls, transforming the surroundings into a scene akin to a brutal Hell.
"So powerful!"
The elder in the golden robe gasped.
In his haste, he drew a longsword and barely managed to meet the attack.
Facing the overwhelming Nether Ghost King, without the support of the Sky Spirit Realm, he was unable to block the might of the King’s spear.
BANG!
His longsword was instantly knocked away.
The spear’s shadow flickered, and it immediately pierced his shoulder.
"Haha, old scoundrel, without the Heavenly Spirit Mirror, you’re no match for me! Today, I will kill you!"
The Nether Ghost King laughed boisterously, swiftly thrusting his spear toward the elder’s forehead.
This attack sealed off the surrounding space. The wailing and howling grew louder, turning the surroundings into a terrifying scene, like Hell itself.
The elder in the golden robe knew he could not escape this attack and simply closed his eyes.
"Father!"
Seeing her father struck by the Nether Ghost King with no way to fight back, Cat Bao’er rushed over.
However, she only managed to cover several meters before the dense black qi repelled her, preventing her from getting any closer.
From all directions, some Great Demons of the Sky Spirit Cat Clan at the Destiny Realm also rushed forward.
Their cultivation was not high, only between the Third and Sixth Layers of the Heavenly Order Realm, making them completely unable to stop the Nether Ghost King, a Ghost Cultivator at the Tenth Level of the Heavenly Mandate Realm.
Just as the spear’s tip was about to strike the elder’s forehead, a large hand suddenly and firmly grasped it, halting the black spear’s advance completely.
"Who is it? Who dares interfere with the affairs of my Ghost King Sect?"
The Nether Ghost King cried out in alarm and looked up.
He discovered a black-robed man, who had appeared out of nowhere, standing beside the golden-robed elder.
This man grinned widely, baring a mouthful of large white teeth, and chuckled, "Young Ghost, you’ve taken this joke too far."
The Nether Ghost King paused, stunned. He had never seen this black-robed man before.
Who in the world is this person?
He tried to wrench his spear back but found it wouldn’t budge at all.
The black-robed man had effortlessly gripped the spear tip, his hold like a great mountain pressing down on the black spear, making it impossible for the King to pull it free.
Overcome with terror, the Nether Ghost King flicked his wrist, dropped the spear, and rapidly retreated.
Big Black Horse licked his lips and grinned. "Young Ghost, you’re not getting away."
The next moment, Big Black Horse vanished from the elder’s side and reappeared behind the Nether Ghost King.
He extended a finger and slammed the Nether Ghost King from mid-air down to the ground.
BOOM!
The Nether Ghost King smashed into the earth, gouging out a large crater.
Dust plumed into the air.
"Uncle Ma, we can’t let such a vile ghost live! Kill him!"
At this moment, Big Black Cat ran into the square and shouted.
"Rest assured. This little ghost is full of tricks; I won’t let him live."
Big Black Horse chuckled and slowly descended from mid-air.
The Nether Ghost King crawled out of the deep pit, coughing incessantly. He felt as if his internal organs had been severely damaged.
He couldn’t help but stare in horror at the black-robed man before him.
This man... he’s probably a Great Demon of the Life and Death Realm, isn’t he? How could the Sky Spirit Cat Clan have a Great Demon of the Life and Death Realm watching over them?
Sensing the commotion outside, the golden-robed elder opened his eyes. He was astonished to find the Nether Ghost King struck down to the ground by the black-robed man and severely injured.
I never expected that on the brink of my death, this Great Demon of the Eternal Realm would actually intervene to save me. This isn’t just saving me; it’s saving the entire Sky Spirit Cat Clan! If I had died, none of the remaining clan members would have been a match for the Nether Ghost King. He would have slaughtered the entire Sky Spirit Cat Clan.
"Thank you, Senior, for saving my life!"
He clasped his fists, bowed deeply, and said.
Big Black Horse waved his hand and said with a smile, "No need for formalities. You’re a stubborn little old man, but you don’t harbor any ill intentions."
Saying this, Big Black Horse pointed a finger in the air, and a bolt of lightning shot from his fingertip.
It instantly struck the Nether Ghost King.
With a loud BOOM, the Nether Ghost King shrieked as his entire body suddenly exploded.
Big Black Horse excelled in the Thunder and Lightning Ability, which was the nemesis of all ghostly creatures. Therefore, dealing with the Nether Ghost King was incredibly easy for him.
Seeing the crisis of her clan’s annihilation averted just like that, Cat Bao’er was overwhelmingly touched.
She also quickly clasped her fists and bowed to Big Black Horse. "Thank you, Uncle Ma, for saving our lives!"
"Little Cat, no need for such politeness with me. We’re all from the Dragon God Sect."
Big Black Horse waved his hand and burst into hearty laughter.
The golden-robed elder turned, walked over to Cat Bao’er, and said with a face full of shame, "My dear daughter, Father was wrong. I shouldn’t have banished you from the clan. I formally retract what I said before, and I also apologize to you. If you wish to join the Dragon God Sect, go ahead. Father will no longer stand in your way."
Hearing her father’s words, Cat Bao’er burst into tears, which flowed like rain.
She said in a trembling voice, "Father, the ancient painting probably hasn’t disappeared. I suspect the Master has put it away."
"The Master?"
The golden-robed elder paused for a moment, slightly stunned.
Who in the world is this ’Master’?
"The Master is the Master of our Dragon God Sect."
Cat Bao’er smiled through her tears. Just as she was about to turn and go outside to look for the black carriage, a white light suddenly flashed, and Ye Yun appeared beside her.
"No need to look. I’ve already put the ancient painting away."
Ye Yun said with a calm smile.
The golden-robed elder looked at the suddenly appeared white-robed youth, scrutinizing him from head to toe, and was inwardly astounded.
The white-robed youth showed no trace of a cultivation base, yet he exuded an incomparable sanctity, standing before him like a God, radiating boundless light, inspiring awe.
What kind of cultivation base is this?
The golden-robed elder groaned inwardly in helplessness; he couldn’t imagine what level of cultivation the white-robed youth before him possessed.
"Greetings, Master."
Big Black Horse, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, and Big Black Cat hurriedly bowed in salute, their attitude extremely respectful.
Seeing this, the golden-robed elder was so shocked he resembled a statue.
Even a Great Demon of the Eternal Realm is so respectful. Then... then how terrifying must this white-robed youth’s cultivation base be? Such a cultivation base... it must be at the Tenth Layer Peak of the Eternal Realm, at the very least, right?
Meanwhile, confirming that the Master had indeed put the ancient painting away, Cat Bao’er felt a little flustered.
"Master, is this painting useful to you?" she stammered.
Ye Yun nodded. "This ancient painting belonged to an old acquaintance of mine from the past. Seeing it stirs memories, so I put it away. However, I will compensate the Sky Spirit Cat Clan for your loss."
When Ye Yun finished speaking, the golden-robed elder’s eyes widened, and tumultuous waves surged in his heart.
If the white-robed youth knew the Demon Ancestor from the ancient painting... then who on earth is he?
He looked at the handsome, white-robed youth before him and said respectfully, "Senior, you saved our Sky Spirit Cat Clan. Such a great kindness is something we could never ask for repayment for. Although this ancient painting is precious, if Senior needs it, please, feel free to take it."
"I don’t take advantage of others for free."
Ye Yun shook his head, a faint smile gracing his lips.
He glanced around and said with a smile, "The ancestors of your Sky Spirit Cat Clan once served Yun Xiao as Demonic Pets. Tens of thousands of years ago, they must have been boundlessly glorious, but now they’ve fallen on hard times. How about this: why don’t you also join the Dragon God Sect?"
