chapters.content:
Chapter 246: Chapter 246 Wu Kun Mountain Black Market, No Fly Zone for 100 Miles
Inside the carriage.
Ye Yun, noticing the astonished expressions of the Sky Spirit Cat Race clan members, felt the corners of his mouth curl up into a slight smile.
He gifted the Sky Spirit Cat Clan those Emperor Level Dragon Spirit Pills because he considered that its members were at various cultivation stages, and Emperor Level Dragon Spirit Pills would be sufficient for their practice.
Although the resources in the warehouse were endless, Ye Yun was well aware that some resources shouldn’t be freely given to others.
As the saying goes, a bowl of rice nurtures kindness, while a bushel nurtures resentment—this was exactly the rationale.
Moderation is key in everything.
Withdrawing his gaze, Ye Yun closed his eyes again.
The carriage moved along at a slow pace.
After a while, an imposing mountain appeared right in front of the carriage.
Big Black Cat, looking at this mountain, said excitedly, "Cat Baby, this is Wu Kun Mountain, isn’t it?"
Cat Baby glanced at it and nodded. "Yes, this is Wu Kun Mountain. The most famous black market is right up there."
"Having been a demon for so many years, I’ve never been to this place. That’s somewhat regrettable."
Big Black Cat shook his head, sighing a little.
Cat Baby said with a smile, "This black market has everything. Especially recently, I heard that the Heavenly Moon Dynasty is going to open access to the Heavenly Moon Secret Realm soon... and the critical Heavenly Moon Order to enter the Secret Realm is being sold by many people in the black market."
"Really? You need an Order to enter the Secret Realm?"
Big Black Cat was slightly taken aback. Even though he had no idea that the Heavenly Moon Secret Realm was the destination Ye Yun was preparing to visit, he simply pursed his lips and didn’t continue the conversation.
If the Master doesn’t command them to go to Wu Kun Mountain, he naturally wouldn’t dare to make decisions on his own and leave the team.
Inside the carriage.
Ye Yun, who was resting with his eyes closed, heard Cat Baby’s words, and his expression shifted slightly.
He originally planned to forcefully transport Jun Moxiao into the Heavenly Moon Secret Realm by supreme means, but if the Wu Kun Mountain Black Market sold the Heavenly Moon Order, then he could simply purchase one.
Such an approach would be both simple and efficient.
Just as Ye Yun was deep in thought, the Big Black Horse had already arrived at the foot of Wu Kun Mountain.
Ye Yun stood up, lifted the carriage curtain, and stepped out, looking at Big Black Cat with a smile as he spoke.
"Let’s go. We’ll take a look at the black market on Wu Kun Mountain."
"Certainly, Master."
Big Black Cat immediately jumped up, looking spirited.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon also stood up.
Ye Yun glanced at him and said, "This time, you two Eternal Realm juniors don’t need to take action."
"Alright, Master."
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, somewhat despondent, lay back down on the carriage.
"HEH HEH..." Big Black Horse didn’t mind. Anyway, after the recent trip to the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat Clan, he had already shown off enough.
Ye Yun smiled and instructed, "You two watch the carriage properly here."
Having said that, he stepped off the carriage and started to stride slowly towards Wu Kun Mountain.
Big Black Cat and Cat Baby exchanged a glance, and both shape-shifted into human forms to follow behind their Master.
Cat Baby was visibly excited. This was the first time in a long while she was part of a mission with only the Master, so she was naturally overjoyed.
「Above Wu Kun Mountain.」
Streaks of light rushed in from afar, continually landing on the mountaintop.
Seeing those people flying so arrogantly, Big Black Cat couldn’t help but become annoyed, grumbling, "What are they showing off for? None of them have high cultivation bases, yet they still want to fly."
Ye Yun glanced at him, slapped Big Black Cat’s shoulder, and laughed, "Good point."
Big Black Cat was instantly flattered and chuckled hastily twice.
He didn’t know if his words were right or wrong. Feeling somewhat unsure, he dared not continue talking.
Ye Yun looked around, his eyes blinking a couple of times, and suddenly, the surrounding space began to undergo a peculiar transformation.
Within a hundred-mile radius, all the cultivators flying in the air were abruptly slammed down by an immense force.
Everyone fell to the ground; fortunately, they didn’t suffer any injuries.
"What’s going on? Why can’t we fly?"
A cultivator sitting on the ground roared angrily, trying to fly again, but found it impossible.
Helpless, he could only race swiftly along the ground.
While low-altitude flight was still possible, their speed was also somewhat restricted.
This discovery frightened many cultivators.
People began to speculate that a supreme expert must have descended upon Wu Kun Mountain and laid down a flight restriction.
At this point, everyone tacitly kept quiet, sticking close to the ground as they rushed toward Wu Kun Mountain.
As for the people in the Wu Kun Mountain Black Market, they had yet to sense this and were unaware of the astonishing changes taking place outside.
Ye Yun didn’t rush; instead, he ambled along leisurely, as if he were out enjoying the scenery.
Big Black Cat and Cat Baby followed behind Ye Yun on either side.
The Master is so strong, yet he still prefers to stroll leisurely. It seems this is the demeanor a true powerhouse should have...
He began to consciously or unconsciously mimic Ye Yun’s every move.
After one hour, the trio finally reached the summit of Wu Kun Mountain.
The mountaintop was extremely vast, with numerous buildings scattered around.
Many factions had established outposts here, responsible for selling items that couldn’t be sold on the regular market.
Many cultivators also set up cloths on the roadside, displaying various items and selling their wares from these makeshift stalls.
Setting up a stall in the black market incurred no fees.
However, with such a motley crew of cultivators setting up stalls, the quality of items for sale was often dubious, necessitating a keen eye.
A constant stream of people flowed by.
Ye Yun ambled along with the crowd, observing the roadside stalls with keen interest.
Although Ye Yun was already Above God and possessed countless treasures, their quality was all too high.
Here, any single item casually taken out would probably be fought over tooth and nail by the cultivators.
And the reason Ye Yun was interested was that this feeling reminded him of the pleasure of browsing night market stalls in his previous life.
If it were any other cultivator at or above the True God Realm, they would undoubtedly show no interest in the humble Wu Kun Mountain black market.
However, Ye Yun had lived two lives and had complex experiences, so his mindset was completely different from others.
"Cat Baby, you said that there are Heavenly Moon Orders in this black market. Do you know where to find them?"
Ye Yun turned his head and casually glanced at Cat Baby.
Scratching her head, Cat Baby said, "Master, I’ve only heard that they’re here. I don’t specifically know which stall might be selling them. Sometimes it depends on luck. After all, Heavenly Moon Orders are extremely precious, and not many make their way to the black market."
Big Black Cat gave Cat Baby an annoyed glare. "You don’t even know how to seize an opportunity to shine! It’s a waste of your reputation as a local from near Wu Kun Mountain."
Seeing Big Black Cat bullying Cat Baby again, Ye Yun just smiled and said nothing.
"What’s happened with Wu Kun Mountain? Why can’t we even fly anymore? Which big shot descended and set up a flight restriction?"
A cultivator ran over breathlessly from the distance. Seeing the bustling crowd, he let out a complaining voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 247: The Saintess of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird
chapters.content:
Chapter 247: Chapter 247: The Saintess of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird
"Yeah, that’s right. A flight restriction has been placed within a hundred-mile radius of Wu Kun Mountain. Who in the world set up this no-fly zone?"
Another cultivator also voiced his complaint.
More and more cultivators arrived from afar at the summit of Wu Kun Mountain, all voicing their grievances.
At that moment, someone shouted from a distance, "Make way, make way! The Saintess is here!"
The crowd swiftly parted. A strikingly beautiful woman in black, as graceful as a fairy descending to the mortal realm, floated slowly from the distance.
Beside the black-clad woman stood eight elders, each with a cultivation base at Destiny Realm Level 7 or higher.
"Wow, the Saintess of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird has arrived!" someone exclaimed from the crowd.
Ye Yun watched the woman in black and gave a slight nod.
This young lady possessed a timeless beauty. Her countenance was charming, her skin as fair and flawless as jade, and her dark hair flowed like a waterfall. She was indeed a rare beauty.
"Who is this Saintess? What’s her story?" the Big Black Cat asked Mao Bao’er, quirking an eyebrow.
After a moment of thought, Mao Bao’er said, "It’s said that the Wu Kun Mountain Black Market is primarily controlled by the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird from the Heavenly Moon Dynasty."
"So that’s how it is."
The Big Black Cat nodded. His gaze swept over the black-clad woman’s face before turning elsewhere. He had no interest in beauties.
The woman in black floated gently before the clamoring cultivators and asked in a soft voice, "What exactly happened? Explain in detail."
"Your Holiness, the area around Wu Kun Mountain has suddenly been placed under a flight restriction, and we can no longer fly. Could you please tell us what’s going on?" a cultivator asked loudly.
"Has such a thing truly happened?"
The black-clad young woman frowned and looked at the others around her. They all nodded, confirming the fact.
The black-clad young woman channeled her Mana and attempted to fly into the air. She rose merely three meters before abruptly falling back down.
"It’s true," she exclaimed, startled.
Who could have laid down such a powerful no-fly restriction? The Wu Kun Mountain Black Market is under the control of my Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird. For a powerful expert to arrive without my slightest knowledge... this is terrifying. If we provoke this powerhouse, my Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird could be implicated.
"I wonder which esteemed expert has graced this place with their presence? The Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird offers its sincerest apologies for any inadequate hospitality. Please forgive us!"
The black-clad young woman cupped her fists in a salute, bowed to her surroundings, and her voice rolled outwards in all directions.
The surrounding people exchanged glances, none daring to speak, all quietly awaiting the appearance of the legendary figure.
But after a moment, no one appeared.
The black-clad young woman sighed, realizing the formidable individual likely did not wish to reveal themselves.
"Everyone, disperse. Go on about your business," the black-clad young woman instructed, then turned and walked away.
The Big Black Cat watched her, an appreciative look on his face. He whispered to Mao Bao’er, "Little Kitty, look how clever that girl is! She’s much better than a blockhead like you."
Mao Bao’er’s eyes reddened. Puffing her cheeks, she retorted, "Brother, she’s at Destiny Realm Level 7! I’m only at the Seventh Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm. That’s a gap of two Major Realms!"
"That does make some sense," the Big Black Cat muttered, smacking his lips, and said no more.
Ye Yun watched the black-clad young woman from afar, a faint, enigmatic smile playing on his lips.
The Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird... this insignificant little sect stirred some old memories. Back in the Accumulated Thunder Mountain Range, he had dealt with people from the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird. He hadn’t expected to encounter their Saintess here at Wu Kun Mountain. Thinking of the absurd things the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird did one hundred thousand years ago, Ye Yun found it rather amusing. They actually tried to offer him beauties to gain the favor of the Dragon God Sect. Only the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird would resort to such despicable tactics.
The black-clad young woman strolled down the street. As she passed by Ye Yun, she seemed to sense something and suddenly turned her head.
One look, and she was instantly captivated by the unique aura radiating from the young man in white.
The young man before her was like an Immortal who had stepped out of an ancient painting. His demeanor was transcendent, and he radiated a faint, holy white light. He didn’t seem like an ordinary mortal cultivator at all.
The black-clad girl, who had always been proud and aloof, had never seen a man so handsome, dashing, and charming.
In an instant, she felt her heart pound wildly, and her beautiful face flushed slightly.
Unable to control herself, she took a step and walked towards Ye Yun.
Ye Yun was somewhat taken aback to see the black-clad woman approaching him, but he instantly understood.
After all, Ye Yun’s experience with romance was quite extensive. The way this woman was looking at him was highly unusual.
"Greetings, Young Master," the black-clad young woman said gracefully, a smile on her lips. As she finished speaking, a blush deepened on her cheeks.
Ye Yun nodded.
Although he held a certain prejudice against the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, it didn’t mean he disliked everyone from that sect. The young woman before him seemed rather innocent, like someone experiencing the first stirrings of love. It reminded him of a certain confidante from his past.
The Big Black Cat at his side was very excited, continuously shaking Mao Bao’er’s robes.
Mao Bao’er glared at him accusingly.
Why is he even more excited than Master now that this black-clad girl is hitting on him?
However, both knew to keep their mouths shut and merely exchanged looks.
Then, the black-clad young woman looked at Ye Yun and said softly, "Young Master, I was wondering if I could invite you for a cup of tea?" Her voice was sweet, like celestial music.
"There’s no need," Ye Yun replied, shaking his head immediately.
He had bluntly rejected the Saintess of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird.
A mere Saintess from the insignificant Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, no matter how beautiful, could not enter his esteemed sight.
"How audacious! Our Saintess inviting you for tea is an honor! Don’t be ungrateful!" an elder standing nearby stepped forward, glaring angrily at Ye Yun.
"How dare you speak to our Master like that! Do you have a death wish?" The Big Black Cat bristled instantly, raising his Black Shield, poised to strike.
Ye Yun stood with his hands behind his back, silently observing the scene without saying a word.
The black-clad woman hurriedly pulled the elder beside her back, frowning as she said, "Stand down."
The old man’s face flushed crimson, but he dared not disobey the Saintess’s command and quickly retreated.
The black-clad young woman took two steps forward and said apologetically, "Young Master, I apologize for startling you."
Ye Yun stated indifferently, "A mere cultivator at the Seventh Level of the Destiny Realm is beneath my notice."
The black-clad woman paused, reassessing Ye Yun, but still found she could not discern his cultivation base.
Seeing that the girl in black intended to probe his cultivation base, Ye Yun shifted slightly, releasing a wisp of Super Divine Dragon Breath signifying the Peak of the Tenth Level of Destiny Realm.
So he’s a Half-Step Life and Death Realm expert!
The black-clad young woman’s gaze focused slightly upon sensing the young man’s strength, and a faint unease stirred in her heart.
A Half-Step Life and Death Realm expert... Even if all of us present joined forces, we would be no match for him.
Seeing the young man in white’s indifference, the black-clad young woman felt a pang of disappointment. She offered a fist salute to Ye Yun and then turned to leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 249: Mandala Immortal Tea
chapters.content:
Chapter 249: Chapter 249: Mandala Immortal Tea
Inside the elegant room, Ye Yun gave a faint smile. He was indifferent to the unpleasant scene that had just occurred. The few insignificant ants were beneath his notice. His sole goal was a Heavenly Moon Order. As long as there were no issues with it, Ye Yun wouldn’t kill these vile people. At most, he would give them a punishment they would never forget. However, it hadn’t occurred to Ye Yun that Heavenly Moon Orders could be both real and fake.
"Cat Treasure, do you know how much a Heavenly Moon Order is generally worth?" With nothing better to do, Big Black Cat turned to Cat Treasure and asked.
Cat Treasure recalled for a moment. "The price of the Heavenly Moon Order varies each time. The lowest has been at least 100,000 Spirit Stones, and it was reportedly sold for up to a million Spirit Stones at its highest."
"What? A million Spirit Stones? Isn’t that too high? Is such a small Heavenly Moon Order worth so much money?" Big Black Cat exclaimed, his face etched with astonishment.
Just the entry ticket to the Heavenly Moon Secret Region—a place only Nirvana Realm cultivators could enter—cost a million Spirit Stones. The cost was simply too high. As a wandering Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, he found such an exorbitant price unacceptable. Over the years, Big Black Cat hadn’t accumulated many Spirit Stones, only a little over a hundred thousand in total.
At this, Cat Treasure shook her head. "Actually, a million Spirit Stones isn’t much for some prominent families or Sects," she said. "It’s said that the Cassia Trees in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region bear a fruit that can improve a person’s comprehension and aptitude if consumed. If spending a million Spirit Stones can enhance the comprehension and aptitude of a family’s Disciple, it’s quite a worthwhile investment."
Big Black Cat, recalling some legends about the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, snorted coldly. "It’s not that easy. There are indeed many Cassia Trees in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, but not all of them have such magical effects."
"That’s true. Everything depends on luck. Besides, with so many people fighting over it, one might not even make it out alive." Cat Treasure nodded, her expression exceptionally solemn.
Ye Yun looked at the two of them and said with a smile, "Money is a small matter. As long as I can get the Heavenly Moon Order, there’s no need for you two to argue here."
Big Black Cat chuckled, hurriedly picked up the teapot to pour some water into the cup, and then said with a smile, "My lord, please have some tea."
Ye Yun glanced at the tea leaves and shook his head.
These tea leaves are truly terrible.
He poured the tea from the cup onto the ground. Then, with a light wipe of his wrist, he took out a few tender green tea leaves and placed them into the cup. Instantly, an indescribable, exotic fragrance filled the air.
Big Black Cat took a light sniff and immediately felt a sense of profound well-being, as if his very soul was about to ascend.
Big Black Cat stared at the vibrant green tea leaves, asking in disbelief, "My lord, what kind of tea is this?"
He discovered that the surface of the tea leaves was covered with numerous fine Dao patterns. These patterns emanated a sort of Super Divine Dragon Breath of the Great Dao. This discovery left Big Black Cat stunned, frozen like a sculpture.
His lord actually has such good tea!
Ye Yun glanced at Big Black Cat and said, "This is a type of Immortal Tea."
"So it’s Immortal Tea!" Big Black Cat exclaimed in realization and quickly poured more hot water into the cup. The fragrance instantly intensified.
Nearby, Cat Treasure had been so shocked she hadn’t uttered a word, only greedily inhaling the rich aroma. At this moment, she felt she was on the verge of breaking through to the Eighth Layer of the Divine Bridge Stage.
Observing Cat Treasure’s state, Ye Yun gently flicked a drop of tea from the cup with his finger. The droplet flew out, landed on Cat Treasure’s delicate red lips, and flowed past them into her mouth.
The moment the tea entered her body, Cat Treasure trembled. Instantly, her cultivation base surged, reaching the Eighth Layer of the Divine Bridge Stage.
Cat Treasure opened her eyes, her voice filled with joy and amazement. "My lord, I... I’ve broken through!"
"Congratulations," Ye Yun said with a smile.
HISS! Big Black Cat drew a sharp breath. He had clearly seen it all. His lord had merely given Cat Treasure a single drop of tea, and she had broken through an entire realm!
He rubbed his hands together and said fawningly, "My lord, could you perhaps spare a little tea for me as well?"
"Why not?" Ye Yun replied with a faint smile.
Inclined to grant his request, Ye Yun flicked his hand gently. A dozen or so drops of tea formed a thin stream and flew towards Big Black Cat, who hastily opened his mouth and swallowed it all.
After swallowing the tea, his eyes widened in disbelief as he felt an incredible transformation within his body. The next moment, his body trembled slightly.
BOOM!
A colossal sound erupted from within him, and his cultivation realm advanced to the Fourth Level of the Heavenly Fate Realm.
"Haha... I’ve broken through too! Thank you so much, My lord!" Big Black Cat roared with laughter, hastily bowing in gratitude.
Ye Yun simply nodded.
"This Immortal Tea... a small taste is enough for you both. Consuming too much would turn it into a poison," Ye Yun said with a smile, taking a small sip from his teacup.
This Immortal Tea, called Mandala Immortal Tea, was something he had obtained as a sign-in reward. It was one of many such teas he possessed and was not a product of this world. Its quality was exceptionally high, and its medicinal properties were rather peculiar. One had to be at the True God Realm to even drink it.
Just now, Ye Yun had subtly altered it with a flick of his fingers, neutralizing some of the Mandala Immortal Tea’s potent medicinal properties. Otherwise, Big Black Cat and Cat Treasure would have been instantly poisoned to death.
Mandala Immortal Tea is a type of tea that grows in Hell. It possesses immense life force, yet also harbors destructive power. For Big Black Cat and Cat Treasure, a small taste was sufficient; consuming more would be harmful to them.
"Yes, My lord." Big Black Cat glanced reluctantly at the tea in the cup and swallowed hard. But since his lord had spoken, he had no choice but to obey.
A woman’s voice suddenly sounded from outside, as clear and melodious as an oriole emerging from a valley: "The auction for the Heavenly Moon Order begins now! The starting bid is 10,000 Spirit Stones. Ladies and gentlemen, you may begin bidding!"
"20,000!" a voice immediately called out from a private room in one direction.
"50,000!" another person bid.
"80,000!"
"100,000!"
"120,000!"
The bids came one after another, and within a few breaths, the price had already climbed to 200,000 Spirit Stones.
Ye Yun remained calm and unhurried, sipping his tea. He knew this auction house had underhanded tactics prepared. Once the price reached 200,000, the bidding frequency noticeably slowed.
Big Black Cat rubbed his hands, growing a bit anxious. "My lord, when are we going to bid?"
"Let’s bid now," Ye Yun said with a smile after a casual glance in a certain direction.
"300,000!" Big Black Cat bellowed, jumping the bid directly from 250,000.
"400,000!" someone from another private room shouted.
"450,000!" Big Black Cat snorted irritably.
"480,000!" the other private room continued to bid.
"500,000!" Seeing that the occupants of the other private room were determined to compete, Big Black Cat threw out another price.
Once the 500,000 Spirit Stone bid was announced, that private room fell silent.
"Hmph! Trying to compete with Old Cat? You damn fool, you clearly don’t know who you’re dealing with!" Big Black Cat chuckled smugly.

chapters.title: Chapter 251: The Power of the Leftover Tea, the Fool was Poisoned
chapters.content:
Chapter 251: Chapter 251: The Power of the Leftover Tea, the Fool was Poisoned
"Scum like him isn’t worth keeping around."
Ye Yun lightly tossed the Heavenly Moon Order in his hand. It transformed into a beam of light that flew toward the Store Manager’s neck.
SWOOSH!
The ray was extremely sharp, severing the Store Manager’s head instantaneously. Strangely, though his head was cut off, no blood sprayed out. All the blood from the bowl-sized wound was contained.
"Toss this head out."
Ye Yun stood up and walked straight out of the private room.
The young woman who had been sitting next to the Store Manager fainted in fright and collapsed to the floor when he was suddenly decapitated.
Big Black Cat chuckled. He recovered the nineteen Dragon Spirit Pills from the Store Manager, placed them in his storage ring, and then, carrying the Store Manager’s head, walked out of the private room and tossed the head into the main hall.
Kitten was the last one to leave. Seeing three or four bright green tea leaves still in the cup, she quickly scooped them into her storage ring. Though the tea leaves had already been brewed, Kitten believed they still held potent effects.
Big Black Cat was leading the way, too focused on tossing the Store Manager’s head to notice Kitten’s actions.
All the employees in the auction house were shaken when they saw their boss’s head rolling on the ground, his eyes wide open in an unseeing stare. People began to scatter and run in all directions.
"You scum! This is your retribution for running a crooked shop!" Big Black Cat roared furiously.
"You dare to execute the Store Manager! The Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird will not let this go!" a woman dressed in black shouted loudly.
"Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird?" Big Black Cat muttered the name twice, then chuckled. "Come on then, who’s afraid of you?"
Ye Yun merely smiled at the woman’s threats, then slowly made his way out.
The Wu Kun Mountain Black Market did indeed have many stores owned by the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, and there were members of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird stationed in every store. Ye Yun didn’t care about the small commotion in the auction house. Since the Saintess had already identified him as a Half-Step Life-Death Realm expert, he was certain she wouldn’t dare to cross him. As for the properties of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird in the Wu Kun Mountain Black Market, Ye Yun had no interest in eliminating them. After all, there were plenty of black markets in the world.
「One hundred thousand years ago, Ye Yun had also visited many such markets.」
He knew that black markets also served as a kind of normal transaction channel, albeit for items that couldn’t see the light of day. He had no saintly aspirations regarding this. As long as they didn’t provoke him, he didn’t have the leisure to wipe out all the black markets in the world.
After this small interlude, Ye Yun continued to stroll down the street. Big Black Cat and Kitten followed closely behind.
"Hehe, this is great! An extra nineteen Dragon Spirit Pills!" Big Black Cat laughed gleefully, glanced at Kitten, and said, "Want me to share two with you?"
Kitten lowered her head, not saying a word.
"What are you thinking about?" Big Black Cat curiously leaned in, looking at Kitten, and noticed she was actually smiling.
What’s going on?
"Are you hiding something from me?" Big Black Cat immediately grew suspicious. He spent most of his time with Kitten and knew something was off about her demeanor.
"Nothing, nothing," Kitten hurriedly tried to cover it up.
"That’s not right. You’ve definitely done something sneaky. Spit it out, or I’ll beat you until you see stars!" Big Black Cat threatened fiercely.
"Big Brother, it’s really nothing. I just took the tea leaves that Master left behind..." Kitten said, her eyes welling up with tears, sounding wronged.
"What? Master’s leftover tea leaves ended up in your hands?" Big Black Cat jumped up as if his tail were on fire. He said resentfully, "Well, now! Such a wonderful thing fell into your hands, and you didn’t even think of sharing half with your Big Brother Cat? That’s really uncool of you, especially when I even helped you call off your engagement..."
"Big Brother, calm down. I’ll share half with you right now..." Kitten helplessly took out the teacup and separated two leaves from the tea inside.
Big Black Cat’s eyes shone brightly. As if he had found a treasure, he gently pinched the two jade-green tea leaves, brought them before his eyes, and examined them carefully for a long time. Then, he sniffed them lightly, instantly feeling the fragrance penetrate from his nostrils into his lungs.
"Wow, this feels amazing!" Big Black Cat said ecstatically. The next moment, the world spun around him, and he collapsed.
"Big Brother, are you okay?" Seeing Big Black Cat suddenly fall, Kitten hurriedly supported him.
"You silly oaf," Ye Yun, standing nearby, couldn’t help but chuckle.
Although most of the tea leaves’ medicinal effects had been brewed away by the hot water, the remaining medicinal power was far more than Big Black Cat could withstand.
With a light touch from Ye Yun, the destructive force within the medicine was dispelled, and the remaining life force was sealed by him within Big Black Cat’s body. It would gradually be released as he cultivated in the future.
"If you two want to consume these two Immortal Tea leaves, the water from a single brewing needs to be diluted at least ten thousand times before drinking..." Ye Yun instructed with a smile.
"Yes, I understand, Master," Kitten replied respectfully.
Her gaze shifted to the still-unconscious Big Black Cat, and she couldn’t help but giggle.
This Nine-tailed Spirit Cat was truly too clever for his own good! He almost got himself killed by these tea leaves.
「A few seconds later.」
"What happened to me? Why did I suddenly pass out?" Big Black Cat opened his eyes and struggled to stand up.
Kitten quickly recounted what had just happened.
"Sigh, how embarrassing." Big Black Cat scratched his head, his face flushing red, wishing he could find a hole to crawl into.
"Haha, let’s go," Ye Yun laughed loudly and walked forward leisurely, his hands behind his back.
He hadn’t bought the Heavenly Moon Order yet, but he had already scanned the area and found several places selling Heavenly Moon Orders. This time, he would head straight for his destination and buy the Order first.
「Inside the tallest building in Wu Kun Mountain.」
A woman dressed in black knelt in the main hall, tearfully recounting the incident at the auction house.
At the head of the great hall sat the Saintess of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird. On her left and right sat eight Destiny Realm elders.
"Damn it! That fellow, relying on his Half-Step Life-Death Realm cultivation base, is acting with impunity in Wu Kun Mountain!" one elder roared angrily.
"Our Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird holds sway over the entire Heavenly Moon Dynasty! When have we ever suffered such a huge loss? No, this grudge must be avenged!" another elder said with a grim expression.
"Let’s not argue anymore. This incident happened because our subordinates were in the wrong. Trying to secretly use shills to drive up the price naturally couldn’t fool that Half-Step Life-Death Realm expert, which is why they met with such retribution. In my opinion, let’s just let this matter go..." the Saintess said slowly after a moment of thought.
The other elders grunted but said nothing more. Although the Saintess’s cultivation base wasn’t the highest, her status in the Sect was extremely high, and she was also the one secretly in charge of the Wu Kun Mountain Black Market. Her word was law here.
Seeing that the elders beside her had fallen silent, the Saintess suddenly stood up and floated out, skimming close to the ground.
"Saintess, where are you going?" an elder asked in surprise.
"To forge a connection," the Saintess replied with a faint smile, her face as radiant as a peach blossom, captivatingly beautiful. Suddenly, she raised an object in her hand.
The elders looked closely and saw that it was a Heavenly Moon Order.

chapters.title: Chapter 252: The Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, The Deputy Sect Master arrives
chapters.content:
Chapter 252: Chapter 252: The Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, The Deputy Sect Master arrives
Forge a bond with a Heavenly Moon Order?
All the elders in the hall fell silent, their expressions extremely peculiar.
The Saintess’s behavior today is truly baffling. Does that white-robed man possess so much charm? Enough to make the Saintess so utterly smitten that she’d personally offer a Heavenly Moon Order?
However, the Saintess was the Saintess, the second-in-command of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird. As her subordinates, they didn’t feel they could say much.
Just two or three breaths after the Saintess disappeared, a figure suddenly arrived, tearing through the sky.
This was a tall elder in a black robe, with a hooked nose, narrow eyes, a long beard, and a stern face. His Super Divine Dragon Breath was potent, and he radiated the distinctive Super Divine Dragon Breath of a cultivator at the Peak of the Tenth Level of Destiny Realm.
"Greetings, Vice Sect Leader Liu."
Upon seeing the newcomer, the several elders promptly stood up and bowed respectfully.
This tall elder was Liu Feng, the Deputy Sect Master of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird.
"What in the world happened on Wu Kun Mountain? Why was flight suddenly restricted? Who descended upon this place?" Liu Feng looked around, and finding the Saintess absent, he raised an eyebrow slightly before questioning the group.
"Vice Sect Leader Liu, we don’t know which powerhouse from the Eternal Realm descended upon Wu Kun Mountain and imposed a flight restriction. The Saintess has already given instructions on this matter, telling us not to interfere..." one elder summoned his courage and said loudly.
"This Saintess..." Liu Feng snorted coldly and said no more, though his eyes held a hint of ridicule. He and this Saintess of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird had never seen eye to eye. One of his disciples had once made a mistake and was expelled from the Sect by the Saintess, a matter that had always been a thorn in his side.
"The Saintess isn’t here presiding. Where has she gone?" Liu Feng scanned the room and asked casually.
"Reporting, Vice Sect Leader Liu, the Saintess has stepped out on some matter," a red-faced elder said with a smile, a somewhat strange expression on his face.
"What exactly is the matter?" Liu Feng, seeing the elder seemed to be implying something, raised an eyebrow and asked coldly.
"Reporting, Vice Sect Leader Liu, it seems the Saintess is lovesick. She has taken a fancy to a young man in white at the Half-Step Life-Death Realm and has gone to give him a Heavenly Moon Order," the red-faced elder explained with a smile.
"How absurd! The dignified Saintess of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird is forbidden from marrying or taking a Dao companion for life. Has she forgotten this rule?" Liu Feng flicked his wide sleeves and snapped angrily.
The red-faced elder before him was very close to him and was also a pawn he had placed in the Wu Kun Mountain Black Market. Much information about Wu Kun Mountain was conveyed through him.
The other seven elders, hearing the red-faced elder speak this way, didn’t offer any particular rebuttal. After all, they also somewhat disapproved of the Saintess’s actions.
"Vice Sect Leader Liu, today the Store Manager of an auction house was killed," the red-faced elder said, deliberately affecting a tone of deep distress.
"What? The Store Manager of the auction house was killed? Who could be so audacious as to do such a thing in my Wu Kun Mountain?!" Liu Feng was suddenly enraged.
"It’s that white-robed youth the Saintess favors! That fellow, relying on his Half-Step Life-Death Realm cultivation base, acts wantonly in Wu Kun Mountain, committing all sorts of misdeeds! There’s no one left to control him!" the red-faced elder sighed and continued.
"This Saintess is getting more and more out of hand! Such a major incident has occurred, and she still wants to suppress it? It’s fortunate that I, the Sect Master, have come. Otherwise, who knows when this matter would have come to light!" Liu Feng said, his voice chillingly cold.
"Vice Sect Leader Liu, you are also a great cultivator at the Half-Step Life-Death Realm. We can only rely on you to help us take revenge," the red-faced elder said, a look of sorrow on his face.
"Indeed! We can only rely on Vice Sect Leader Liu to avenge this," the other elders echoed.
"Revenge is a trivial matter. All of you, come with me." Liu Feng turned and strode out.
The other elders followed closely behind him, elated expressions appearing on their faces one by one. Deputy Sect Master Liu also possessed a Half-Step Life-Death Realm cultivation base. The Profound Bird Bloodline within him was extremely potent, making his combat prowess exceptionally terrifying. With the assistance of these cultivators, who were around the Seventh Level of Destiny Realm, defeating the white-robed youth should not pose a significant problem.
「As for the Saintess of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird.」
A fragrant breeze trailed her as she quickly made her way to the street and found Ye Yun.
"Greetings, Sir." This beautiful young woman in black spoke with a smile, her limpid, peach-blossom eyes fixed on Ye Yun, radiating an indescribable joy.
"You’re here again?" Ye Yun smiled faintly, his gaze drifting elsewhere.
This girl really is boy-crazy, isn’t she? Does she freeze up whenever she sees a handsome man? Too bad for her; a hundred thousand years of check-ins have long tempered my Dao Heart to be as solid as a rock.
"The Saintess is here again..." Big Black Cat, face alight with excitement, nudged Little Cat’s ear from behind.
Little Cat quickly shook her head with a smile and dodged aside.
The Master truly has endless charisma! This Saintess is renowned throughout the entire Heavenly Moon Dynasty. For so many years, they say the line of men who admire her could stretch for miles, yet not one has ever managed to get within ten feet of her.
"Sir, that auction hall from before is also a property of our Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird. However, that Store Manager was too unscrupulous, which led to him offending you. I have come to apologize and, at the same time, offer a Heavenly Moon Order from our Sect as a token of our sincerity." The Saintess smiled faintly, presenting a Heavenly Moon Order with her fair, jade-like hands.
Ye Yun was slightly taken aback.
I hadn’t expected this Saintess to personally come and deliver a Heavenly Moon Order. This is actually a good thing. It saves me the trouble of having to buy one elsewhere.
Ye Yun accepted the Heavenly Moon Order and inspected it briefly, confirming it was genuine and had no issues.
"I appreciate the sentiment." Ye Yun nodded slightly, put away the Heavenly Moon Order, and continued strolling with his hands clasped behind his back.
The Saintess kept pace beside him, moving gracefully, and asked softly, her face blushing, "Sir, is there anything else you wish to purchase?"
"Nothing special, I’m just browsing." Ye Yun smiled faintly and didn’t send the Black-clothed Saintess away.
This young lady is rather simple-minded; it’s best not to rub salt in her wounds.
SWISH! SWISH! The sound of rushing air echoed.
Just then, several figures rapidly approached from the distance, skimming low over the ground.
Ye Yun halted and looked up. These people all wore black clothing decorated with the unmistakable emblem of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird; they were clearly members. The tall elder at the forefront had a profound cultivation base, having reached the Peak of the Tenth Level of Destiny Realm, effectively a Half-Step Life-Death Realm expert.
Why is Vice Sect Leader Liu here?
Noticing Ye Yun had suddenly halted to look ahead, the Saintess also looked up in that direction. The sight caused a flicker of surprise to appear on her stunningly beautiful face. This Deputy Sect Master Liu had always been at odds with her. Although her status within the Sect was higher than Deputy Sect Master Liu’s, in reality, his influence was also extremely formidable, comparable to her own.
Liu Feng swiftly approached, crossed his arms over his chest, and looked coldly at the white-robed youth. The white-robed youth indeed looked like an immortal stepped out of a painting, with an otherworldly temperament and incomparably handsome features.
"So, you’re the pretty boy! No wonder the Saintess is so smitten with you. Turns out you just have a handsome face," Liu Feng sneered, his face full of ridicule.
"Liu Feng, stop your nonsense!" Hearing these words, the Saintess’s small, previously rosy face instantly turned ice-cold.

chapters.title: Chapter 254: Recruiting a Saintess as a Maid
chapters.content:
Chapter 254: Chapter 254: Recruiting a Saintess as a Maid
The elder was subjugated by the Big Black Cat’s coercion, standing petrified, unable to speak.
Another elder clenched his teeth, looking angrily at the Saintess who still stood by the side of the young man in white. He snarled, "Saintess, all of this is your doing. If it weren’t for you, Vice Sect Leader Liu would still be alive."
"..."
The Saintess was questioned by these elders under her command and was momentarily left speechless.
"Hmph!"
The elder, gaining assertiveness, continued, "I will report this to the Sect. Your position as Saintess will not be spared."
With her head down, the Saintess felt sorrowful, tears flickering at the corners of her eyes.
"Right, you’re no longer the Saintess of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird!"
The other elders, speaking with one voice, concurred, filled with righteous indignation.
The Saintess lowered her head even more, tears welling up and streaming down her face. Her body was shaking uncontrollably.
She never imagined that the situation would spiral out of control so drastically.
One of her subordinates, an Elder of Destiny Realm Level 7, had been killed, and Vice Sect Leader Liu was also dead.
As the one in charge of the Wu Kun Mountain Black Market, she bore an undeniable responsibility.
Not to mention that other promising female disciples from her sect could replace her at any time, she simply couldn’t escape responsibility for Vice Sect Leader Liu’s death on the spot.
This time, her position as Saintess was inevitably going to be revoked.
Ye Yun watched the beautiful girl in black, her body trembling and tears falling unceasingly. He smiled, maintaining an unaffected expression.
Suddenly, he patted her shoulder nonchalantly. "So what if you are not the Saintess?"
Feeling his warm, large hand on her shoulder, an indescribable comforting power flowed through her.
The adorable girl in black lifted her tear-filled eyes to look at Ye Yun and suddenly burst into tears.
It seemed all her grievances exploded with that one sentence from Ye Yun.
"Follow me from now on. I just so happen to need a maidservant to pour tea and water," Ye Yun said with a smile.
"Master, I can pour tea and water too," Little Cat anxiously wrung her hands at the side and hastily said.
Ye Yun glanced at her and laughed. "You have your own duties to perform."
Little Cat uttered an "oh," then lowered her head, looking a bit sullen.
SLAP!
The Big Black Cat, seeing this, walked over and slapped Little Cat on top of her head in annoyance. The slap made Little Cat see stars.
"Is the Master’s business any of your concern? You must be tired of living! The Master treats you so well, yet you’re still not satisfied? Why not hand over that bag to me, along with those two tea leaves?" the Big Black Cat leaned over, speaking in a disgruntled tone.
Hearing about the bag of Dragon Spirit Pills and the two leaves of Immortal Tea, Little Cat shivered. Her eyes suddenly cleared, and she quickly recovered from her earlier despondence.
She realized the Master had been too good to her; she couldn’t be ungrateful.
"Master, I was wrong. Please forgive me," Little Cat spoke in a tearful voice.
"Forget it, forget it. I won’t lower myself to argue with a little cat like you," Ye Yun shook his head, dismissing it with a smile.
He looked at the surrounding terrified cultivators, and star-like runes once again flickered in his eyes.
In an instant, all the cultivators’ minds went momentarily blank.
The next moment, they were all staring at the scene before them in a daze, not knowing what had happened.
Ye Yun wiped away everyone’s memory of what had just transpired.
However, he did not erase the memories of the elders from the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird.
Weren’t these fellows eager to report to the Sect? He would let them. He would just wait here to capture them all in one fell swoop.
The elders turned as white as sheets. Seeing that the young man in white made no move against them, they turned and fled.
They did not flee down the mountain but retreated back to the grand hall.
Inside the grand hall was a Teleportation Array that could transmit information to the Sect.
Such a major incident had occurred on Wu Kun Mountain; they had to report it to the Sect immediately.
Ye Yun turned his gaze back to the girl in black, smiling. "What do you think? Have you made up your mind? Do you want to stay by my side?"
Ye Yun extended his olive branch yet again.
The beautiful girl in black was a mess of tangled emotions, her mind in chaos; she stood there blankly, not saying a word.
Deep down, she truly had indescribable feelings of admiration for this young man in white.
It was this admiration that somehow, as if by divine intervention, allowed her to overcome her mental turmoil and make the greatest decision of her life. Years later, whenever she recalled it, she always felt profoundly fortunate.
She nodded and said softly, "I am willing to serve you, Young Master."
"Don’t call me ’Young Master.’ Just call me ’Master’ from now on," Ye Yun glanced at her and responded indifferently.
"Alright, Master," the beautiful maiden in black hastily replied.
Ye Yun looked at her, smiled faintly, and asked, "What’s your name?"
"Reporting to Master, my name is Mu Qing..." the maiden in black said, her face slightly red under Ye Yun’s gaze.
"Good!"
Ye Yun nodded, clasped his hands behind his back, and walked ahead.
He accepted this girl for two reasons: firstly, he was interested in the rich Profound Bird Bloodline within her, and secondly, he thought she had a decent character.
Coincidentally, the Dragon God Sect would need to recruit in the future, so he decided to take in a disciple with the Profound Bird Bloodline ahead of time.
In the short term, she could serve him tea and handle chores.
When he left Cangnan Continent, he would entrust Mu Qing to Luo Li’s care.
Ye Yun was a man from a hundred thousand years ago, now walking in a world a hundred thousand years later. He tried his best to avoid forming any attachments.
Seeing the Master walk ahead, seemingly lost in thought, Mu Qing quickly followed behind him.
The Big Black Cat and Little Cat exchanged glances and also followed.
"The Master has taken in a maidservant. It seems the chores of serving tea and water won’t fall to me anymore,"
the Big Black Cat thought, a bit dejectedly.
However, he then considered that he was just a demonic pet. The treatment he received was already excellent, and he shouldn’t be greedy for more.
Ye Yun kept strolling around with great interest, sometimes even crouching down to look at the items on the street stalls.
He seemed to be thoroughly enjoying himself.
This made Mu Qing’s brow twitch as she watched from the side.
She didn’t know what the Master was actually looking for here...
In her view, there wasn’t much worth buying from the stalls at the Wu Kun Mountain Black Market. If there was anything, the chances of finding it were extremely low.
Feeling somewhat bored, she looked at the two demon clan members beside her—a male and a female—and asked with a smile, "And how should I address you two?"
"My name is Little Cat, Sister. I’m from the Sky Spirit Cat Clan," Little Cat said with a radiant smile.
So she’s from the famous Sky Spirit Cat Clan!
Mu Qing thought, looking at Little Cat with a hint of surprise on her face.
Then she quickly took Little Cat’s hand and said with a smile, "It’s a pleasure to meet you, Little Cat."
"Sister, you’re too kind," Little Cat shyly replied.
After all, she was just a little demon at the Eighth Layer of Divine Bridge Stage, while this sister was already at Destiny Realm Level 7.
After exchanging a few words, Mu Qing turned to the black-robed young man beside them and asked with a smile, "And what about you?"
The Big Black Cat scratched his head and said with a chuckle, "You can just call me Little Black."
"What a fun name!" Mu Qing giggled.
Little Cat said from the side, "Sister, he’s from the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat Clan."
"
So it’s the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat Clan! I never would have thought both of you were from cat clans,
" Mu Qing said, shocked.
Hearing this, the Big Black Cat said smugly, "That’s nothing! The Master also has a little red cat in his carriage."
"
Really? What cat clan is that from?
" Mu Qing was even more shocked.
"Hehe, I can’t tell you that. You’ll know when you see it," the Big Black Cat said, scratching his head and laughing twice, not revealing the truth to Mu Qing.
Seeing that the Big Black Cat was about to set a trap for Mu Qing again, Little Cat’s expression shifted, and she quickly prepared to explain.
But the Big Black Cat shot her a glare, and she swallowed the words she was about to say.

chapters.title: Chapter 255: Life-Death Realm Powerhouses, Gongsun Changsheng
chapters.content:
Chapter 255: Chapter 255: Life-Death Realm Powerhouses, Gongsun Changsheng
Two blossoms bloomed, each on its own branch.
Now, let’s speak of the few remaining elders of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird on Wu Kun Mountain, who fled back into the main hall like dogs that had lost their homes. Their faces were ashen, their expressions gloomy, and their hearts were filled with shock and fear. However, seeing that the young man in white didn’t pursue them, they couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
"We must report this to the Sect Master immediately and ask him to come to our aid!" an elder frowned, promptly walking to a small Teleportation Array on the west side of the hall. He took out a Jade Slip, infused his message into it, and placed it into the Teleportation Array. A flash of light emanated, and the Jade Slip vanished.
"The Sect Master is a Life and Death Realm powerhouse. Once he arrives, he will undoubtedly kill that young man in white and avenge Vice Sect Leader Liu!" another elder exclaimed, gritting his teeth.
This time, the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird had suffered a major setback, losing not only a Saintess but also a Deputy Sect Master and an Elder in Charge. It was because this Saintess was bewitched by that man that a series of bloody incidents occurred. Now, everyone waited anxiously in the hall.
「Meanwhile, in the Sect Leader’s Main Hall of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird in the Heavenly Moon Dynasty」
A ray of light suddenly flared from the Teleportation Array, and the spatial vibrations caused an elder, who was seated in meditation deep within the hall, to open his eyes.
A Jade Slip via teleportation? What on earth happened?
Seeing the Jade Slip, the elder’s facial muscles twitched slightly. He reached out and caught it. This elder was Gongsun Changsheng, the current Sect Master of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird. He was also one of the two Life-Death Realm Powerhouses in the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird. The other powerhouse was a Supreme Elder of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, but this Supreme Elder had been in secluded cultivation for many years.
"What?!" Gongsun Changsheng roared after reading the Jade Slip’s contents. "How could something like this happen? Mu Qing, you ungrateful wretch! After all the years the sect spent nurturing you!"
He leaped to his feet, his Super Divine Dragon Breath surging overwhelmingly, terrifyingly potent.
He could never have dreamed that someone would dare to openly kill a Deputy Sect Master of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird on Wu Kun Mountain. A Deputy Sect Master, a Half-Step Life-Death Realm powerhouse, was a grievous loss for the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird. What was even more unexpected was that the sect’s Saintess had defected. As a celebrated Saintess, she should have been aloof and detached, yet she was captivated by that man’s appearance and brazenly defected from the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird. This was something Gongsun Changsheng found utterly unacceptable.
The anger in his heart billowed like monstrous waves, one after another, causing the very air in the hall to hum.
"Sect Master, what has happened?" an elder in the Destiny Realm asked in a low voice from outside the main hall.
"The Saintess has defected from the sect, and Vice Sect Master Liu has been killed on Wu Kun Mountain," Gongsun Changsheng replied, walking out with a grim expression.
"What? Vice Sect Master Liu is dead, and the Saintess has defected?" This elder’s face turned extremely pale upon hearing this.
"Sect Master, I will gather our forces immediately! We’ll all charge into Wu Kun Mountain!" the elder declared, gritting his teeth.
"There’s no need for that. More people won’t be of much use. That fellow is merely at the Peak of the Tenth Level of Destiny Realm," Gongsun Changsheng said, a confident smile appearing on his face.
I am a cultivator at Level one of the Life and Death Realm. With my cultivation base, I can easily crush dozens of cultivators at the Half-Step Life-Death Realm. There’s no need for the sect to make a big fuss; it would only make us a laughingstock. I’ll go there by myself and kill that fellow directly.
From the information in the Jade Slip, he had also learned that the white-robed man possessed quite a few Emperor Level Dragon Spirit Pills, which intrigued him.
Although I am also of the Human Race, I possess the Xuan bird’s bloodline, and Dragon Spirit Pills are extremely beneficial for greatly enhancing my physical body. If I could truly obtain a large quantity of Dragon Spirit Pills, then the loss of Vice Sect Leader Liu could be considered somewhat compensated. With a large quantity of Dragon Spirit Pills, I estimate I could break through to the Second Level of Life and Death!
The Life and Death Realm, as its name suggested, meant that every advancement involved a struggle between life and death. Breaking through each minor realm was exceptionally difficult. Precisely because of this difficulty, the gap in power between each level within the Life and Death Realm was enormous.
Gongsun Changsheng suddenly shot into the sky and, with a slight flicker, vanished.
On a mountain peak within the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, there was a large Teleportation Array that could transport directly to Wu Kun Mountain. The small Teleportation Array in the main hall was only used for transmitting routine information.
Using the large Teleportation Array, Gongsun Changsheng arrived at the black market of Wu Kun Mountain within a few breaths. He appeared in the backyard of that main hall, where several elders were already standing by the large Teleportation Array.
"Sect Master, you’ve finally arrived!" When these few elders saw Gongsun Changsheng descend, they were all incredibly moved, some even to the point of being choked with tears.
In this crisis, only a Life-Death Realm powerhouse like the Sect Master could resolve the situation.
"Rest assured, Vice Sect Leader Liu will not have died in vain," Gongsun Changsheng said, clenching his jaw. He scanned his surroundings, his eyes glinting with a cold light, and quickly locked onto a figure in white. When he saw the beautiful young woman in black standing beside the white-robed young man, he trembled with rage.
"You vile wench! How dare you betray the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird! I will kill you!" Gongsun Changsheng roared, his figure flashing as he flew rapidly towards them. He didn’t fly high but skimmed close to the ground. After all, he knew that flying high was forbidden here due to a restriction, and he couldn’t afford to offend the Eternal Realm powerhouse who had set it.
「At this moment」
Ye Yun was leisurely strolling around. Although the items at the street stalls were mostly of poor quality, he found browsing them quite interesting.
Truly, one should never underestimate roadside stalls.
At one stall, Ye Yun even spotted a magic artifact from 100,000 years ago. Although it had lost its prowess, its ancient appearance stirred some memories within him. Ye Yun bought the artifact.
Of course, he only purchased it for sentiment’s sake.
A black shadow streaked over from the distance.
Gongsun Changsheng abruptly halted, coldly observing the white-robed young man before him as he drew the longsword from his back.
"Sir, it’s Gongsun Changsheng, the Sect Master of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird. He’s here," Mu Qing, who had been vigilantly scanning their surroundings, was the first to spot him.
Ye Yun casually glanced at Gongsun Changsheng, noting he was a cultivator at the First Level of the Life and Death Realm. He then lowered his head again, his attention returning to a small green gourd on a stall. The gourd was a crystalline, emerald green, perfectly formed with two even lobes. Its appearance bore some resemblance to the gourd in his warehouse. Ye Yun picked up the small gourd and examined it closely.
The street stall was run by an old man. When he saw the Sect Master of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird standing in the distance, he was so frightened he trembled uncontrollably.
"Young Master, I’m not selling this gourd anymore!" the old man exclaimed, swiftly snatching the gourd from Ye Yun’s hand. He bundled up his wares in a ragged cloth and turned to flee.
He could see that the Sect Master of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird was approaching aggressively, seemingly about to engage in a fierce fight with the white-robed young man before him. As merely a First Level Nirvana Realm cultivator, the best of the thirty-six stratagems was to flee.

chapters.title: Chapter 256: Could the Master be a God?
chapters.content:
Chapter 256: Chapter 256: Could the Master be a God?
"The gourd deal is off now."
Ye Yun smiled, stood up, and turned casually to look at the black-robed elder behind him.
"You are the Sect Master of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird?" Ye Yun asked calmly, looking at Gongsun Changsheng.
"Yes."
Gongsun Changsheng’s gaze was icy, and a terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath radiated from him, causing the countless cultivators nearby to scatter in fear. After all, he was the only Life-Death Realm Powerhouse here. Most cultivators frequenting the Wu Kun Mountain Black Market were at the Nirvana Realm, and those at the Destiny Realm were relatively scarce.
Gongsun Changsheng’s gaze first landed on Ye Yun. His eyelids flickered slightly before his attention shifted to Mu Qing. "You treacherous wench!" Gongsun Changsheng roared angrily. "You betrayed the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird for a man, wasting all the years the Sect poured into nurturing you!"
"People naturally seek better prospects. What’s wrong with her leaving your Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird?" Ye Yun interjected indifferently before Mu Qing could speak. He then looked towards the Big Black Cat by his side.
"Master, let me handle this despicable cur," the Big Black Cat declared, stepping forward bravely under his Master’s gaze and positioning the Black Shield before him.
"Hmph! A mere Fourth Level of the Destiny Realm Demon Clan beast!" Gongsun Changsheng scoffed. "Even if you have some tricks up your sleeve and managed to kill Vice Sect Leader Liu by surprise, you’re still no match for me. Die!"
He roared, his entire being exuding a domineering Sword Intent so dense it seemed to congeal the air. He slashed out with his Sword. The Sword’s light was blindingly sharp, as if it could cleave the world in two.
Facing the overwhelming Sword, the Big Black Cat remained fearless, immediately meeting the attack with the shield in his paw.
RUMBLE!
A colossal force erupted. Gongsun Changsheng’s earth-shattering Sword strike vanished, and he himself was unexpectedly blasted backward.
"Haha, so this is the Life and Death Realm? You’re not my opponent either!" the Big Black Cat roared, his blood boiling with excitement, then transformed into a streak of black light and shot forward.
"What?!" Gongsun Changsheng was utterly shocked.
A Demon Clan youth at the Fourth Level of the Destiny Realm... what kind of bloodline does he possess to be this powerful? Could it be that this fellow was hiding his true cultivation base? Is he also at the Life and Death Realm?
While he hesitated, the black light smashed towards him again. He hastily raised his Sword to block.
BOOM! BOOM!
The two clashed fiercely in mid-air.
Ye Yun’s gaze remained indifferent; he paid no mind to the battle raging above.
Beside him, Mu Qing’s eyes widened in disbelief at the scene unfolding before her.
She could never have imagined that the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, who appeared to be only at the Fourth Level of the Destiny Realm, could be so incredibly strong. Could the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat also be a Life-Death Realm Powerhouse, deliberately displaying his cultivation base as being at the Destiny Realm?
At this thought, Mu Qing couldn’t help but glance at the handsome silhouette of the man beside her.
If Master’s subordinate, the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, is at the Life and Death Realm, then how high is Master’s own cultivation base?
She suddenly recalled the earlier flight restriction, and a flash of understanding lit up her mind.
Mu Qing suddenly realized—the Eternal Realm expert... it had to be Master! At this thought, Mu Qing couldn’t help but tremble all over, intensely excited. The Master she was following was actually a grand cultivator of the Eternal Realm! It was truly unimaginable.
In the entire Heavenly Moon Dynasty, there wasn’t a single Eternal Realm cultivator. It was rare for an Eternal Realm cultivator to even pass through the Heavenly Moon Dynasty, perhaps not even once in millennia. After all, the Heavenly Moon Dynasty was an insignificant place, holding no interest for such grand cultivators.
"Mao Baor, is Master at the Eternal Realm?" Women are naturally curious, and Mu Qing, her mind racing with this thought, couldn’t resist asking Mao Baor beside her.
"Well, um..." Mao Baor hesitated, unsure if she should reveal everything to Mu Qing.
"Master, can I tell her?" Mao Baor glanced towards Ye Yun and asked in a hushed voice.
"Go on, she’ll find out sooner or later anyway," Ye Yun’s voice sounded in her ear.
"Alright, Master!" Mao Baor nodded happily, then looked at Mu Qing with a serious expression and said, "Master’s cultivation base is higher than the Eternal Realm..."
"Higher than the Eternal Realm..." Mu Qing was instantly stunned.
From what she understood, above the Eternal Realm was the God Realm. Could Master be a legendary God?
At this thought, Mu Qing once again looked at Ye Yun’s back.
The more she gazed, the more Master resembled a God radiating infinite divine light, resplendent and awe-inspiring. Her emotions surged like a tsunami, and her entire body trembled with excitement. At this moment, her throat constricted, and she found herself unable to speak.
BOOM!
A loud crash resounded from the sky.
The Black Shield in the Big Black Cat’s paw slammed down, knocking Gongsun Changsheng out of the air. Gongsun Changsheng crashed into a large building, which instantly shattered into a cloud of dust and debris.
Ye Yun smiled.
As soon as their fight began, he had casually lifted the flight restriction over Wu Kun Mountain. Now that he had arrived at Wu Kun Mountain, the restriction served no further purpose.
"Haha, that was incredibly satisfying!" Feeling the surging power within him, the Big Black Cat couldn’t help but let out a triumphant howl. He plummeted from the sky like a meteor, shield raised, and brought it smashing down again.
BOOM!
BOOM!
After a series of brutal impacts, Gongsun Changsheng was smashed to death.
The unfortunate Sect Master of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, a dignified Life-Death Realm Grand Cultivator, met such a tragic end in the Wu Kun Mountain Black Market.
Ye Yun glanced around. The tiny, star-like runes reappeared in his eyes, constantly flickering and transforming. In that instant, all the surrounding Cultivators felt a wave of dizziness, and the scene they had just witnessed inexplicably vanished from their minds.
Of course, Ye Yun did not erase the memories of the few Elders from the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird.
In his view, matters with the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird were not yet concluded. The Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird still had a Life-Death Realm Supreme Elder whose strength was slightly greater than Gongsun Changsheng’s. Now, it remained to be seen if this old fellow would come seeking his own death.
After the memories of the Cultivators on Wu Kun Mountain were erased, everyone returned to their normal state, behaving as if nothing had occurred.
Mao Baor looked at the crowd in shock, somewhat puzzled.
Why did these people seem completely unfazed?
Stall owners continued setting up their stalls. Shoppers continued to wander. Merchants continued their business as if nothing had changed.
WHOOSH!
The Big Black Cat leaped up from the demolished building, a storage ring in his paw, which he cheerfully pocketed.
"Master, rest assured, I will hand this ring over to the Sect Leader," the Big Black Cat said respectfully, stepping forward.
Ye Yun nodded.
On Wu Kun Mountain, the Big Black Cat had already acquired several storage rings. Handing them over to the Sect Leader was a good habit indeed.
The destroyed building was an eyesore. Ye Yun gently waved his hand, and a mysterious force flew out, enveloping the structure. The recently demolished building miraculously restored itself to its original, intact state. Gongsun Changsheng’s corpse within had already disintegrated into particles.
"What incredible Divine Skills!" the Big Black Cat exclaimed internally, gulping as he witnessed his Master’s profound ability to create something from nothing.
This time, his eyes had truly been opened.
The expressions on the faces of Mao Baor and Mu Qing beside him were equally stunned.
Master is so strong... truly like a God, omnipotent...
Mu Qing thought, her gaze fixed on Ye Yun’s back, now filled with an even more fervent adoration.

chapters.title: Chapter 257: Heavenly Treasures Cover, Memories from a Hundred Thousand Years Ago
chapters.content:
Chapter 257: Chapter 257: Heavenly Treasures Cover, Memories from a Hundred Thousand Years Ago
Inside the great hall, the old men from Wu Kun Mountain were trembling all over in fear. They had hidden in the distance and witnessed the whole battle, never imagining that the young man in the black robe was also a powerful cultivator in the Life and Death Realm. With unmatched might, he had smashed Sect Master Gongsun Changsheng from the sky to the ground and then brutally used his shield to crush the Sect Master to death. Recalling this bloody scene, a deep sense of terror surged through the Elders’ hearts, as if the apocalypse had arrived, leaving them terribly uneasy.
"What should we do now?" one Elder voiced his concerns, his voice trembling.
"Although the Sect Master is dead, don’t forget we still have the Supreme Elder," another Elder said slowly, clenching his fists.
The Elders exchanged glances and suddenly felt a glimmer of hope.
"Good. Let’s leave Wu Kun Mountain immediately and return to the Sect using the Teleportation Array. We will then report to the Supreme Elder," an Elder suggested, and led the others out of the great hall.
They quietly left through the backyard and, by means of a Teleportation Array, returned to the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird in the Heavenly Moon Dynasty.
The Sect Master was already dead. Even if they used the small Teleportation Array in the great hall, the Jade Slip wouldn’t be directly transported to the Supreme Elder. Besides, Wu Kun Mountain had become too dangerous, and they didn’t want to stay any longer; it was better to leave sooner rather than later.
A beam of light flashed, and the men vanished.
Ye Yun glanced in the direction of the light, smiled faintly, and thought nothing of it.
"Master, the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird still has a Supreme Elder who is likely on the brink of breaking through to the Second Level of the Life and Death Realm. He is far stronger than Gongsun Changsheng," Mu Qing whispered at his side.
"It doesn’t matter. If he dares to come, I’ll deal with them all at once," Ye Yun said placidly.
After speaking, he squatted down again, picked up the little gourd he had found earlier, and began to toy with it, clearly captivated.
"How much is this?" Big Black Cat asked from the side.
The memory of the old Nirvana Realm cultivator had been erased, so he had no idea how formidable the people standing before him were. He smiled and replied, "Only one hundred Spirit Stones."
Big Black Cat took out one hundred Spirit Stones and handed them to the old man.
At this, Ye Yun smiled faintly and put the little gourd away.
He didn’t put this little gourd into his storage space.
After all, the artifacts in his storage space were of far too high quality. If such a small gourd were placed inside, it would probably be shattered instantly by the overwhelming pressure. In Ye Yun’s storage space, specifically designated for artifacts, many items had long since developed Spirit Wisdom, each one incredibly terrifying. Some were even world-ending artifacts; if released, countless worlds would be annihilated.
...
Ye Yun continued to stroll leisurely.
The black market on Wu Kun Mountain was vast; strolling at his unhurried pace, he couldn’t possibly see everything in a single day. Whenever Ye Yun spotted something amusing or familiar, he would buy it, with Big Black Cat handling the payments.
After walking for a while, Ye Yun spotted a young man in blue robes not far away. He looked to be in his early twenties, with a brawny physique, sharp sword-like eyebrows, and striking star-like eyes. His aura was quite distinguished, and his cultivation base had reached the Fifth Level of the Nirvana Realm.
He had spread a tattered yellow cloth on the ground, upon which lay a treasure resembling a canopy. This canopy-like treasure was rather large, with a diameter of a full meter. Ancient and weathered, it clearly had some age to it. However, upon closer inspection, some parts were visibly damaged.
The young man was squatting on the ground, quietly waiting for someone to purchase his treasure. People bustled by on the street, but no one showed any interest in his dilapidated artifact.
Seeing this canopy, Ye Yun sighed softly, his mind drifting to memories from many years ago.
Was this canopy the same one from back then?
He decided to go over and take a closer look.Just as Ye Yun had taken a couple of steps, a middle-aged man suddenly stopped beside the roadside stall.
"What kind of treasure is this?"
The middle-aged man scrutinized the canopy on the ground. After a moment, he still couldn’t determine its origin.
Seeing a potential customer at his stall, the young man in blue immediately brightened.
He lifted the ancient canopy-like treasure and said with a smile, "Sir, you have a keen eye! This is an extraordinary artifact. Once you infuse it with Mana, it will float above your head, and rays of light will descend to shield you, making you impervious to any attack."
"Is it truly that powerful? What grade is this canopy now?"
The middle-aged man crossed his arms, showing no intention of taking the canopy to examine it. He frequently visited the black market on Wu Kun Mountain to hunt for treasures and knew it was a place where the good and bad were mixed, with sellers often trying to pass off inferior items as valuable ones. Finding genuine treasures here was incredibly difficult.
Seeing the middle-aged man’s astuteness, the blue-robed young man looked a bit awkward and stammered, "This treasure... it used to be Emperor Level. But it’s been passed down for too long and was damaged in several great wars, so now its grade has dropped to Earth Level..."
"Earth Level? And you have the nerve to show off something like that?"
The middle-aged man sneered and turned to leave.
"Sigh..."
The blue-robed young man heaved a sigh, his face etched with deep dejection.
If I can’t sell this canopy, I won’t have enough Spirit Stones to buy a Heavenly Moon Order...
He sighed again, lowered his head, looking utterly dispirited.
Just then, a figure in white silently approached.
"Does this treasure have a name?"
Ye Yun squatted down, picked up the canopy, and examined it carefully.
"Of course, it has a name! After all, it was once an Emperor Level treasure..."
Seeing another potential customer at his stall, the blue-robed young man grew excited again.
He quickly looked up. Before him stood a young man in white. This newcomer was exceptionally handsome, with an extraordinary, almost ethereal temperament, and exuded an indescribable sacred aura.
To think such a man existed in this world!
The blue-robed young man’s eyes lit up, clearly captivated by Ye Yun’s refined presence.
"Hey, kid! My master is asking for the treasure’s name. Are you deaf or just dumb?" Big Black Cat swaggered over, speaking aggressively.
Sensing that this was a great demon of the Destiny Realm, the blue-robed young man was startled.
"Little Cat, speak politely," Ye Yun said, glancing up at Big Black Cat.
Big Black Cat shivered, then managed a forced, awkward smile. Looking at the blue-robed young man, he said, "Little brother, could you quickly tell my master the name of this treasure?"
"This treasure is an heirloom from my family. It’s called the Heavenly Treasures Cover," the blue-robed young man said, a note of pride in his voice.
"Heavenly Treasures Cover... a fine name indeed," Ye Yun murmured with a smile, his gaze falling upon the ancient, weathered, and somewhat damaged Heavenly Treasures Cover in his hands. A look of fond remembrance filled his eyes.
Without a doubt, this Heavenly Treasures Cover was at least one hundred thousand years old. It was an artifact providing both offense and defense that he, Ye Yun, had personally gifted to Lei Cheng all those years ago. Back then, this treasure had been Emperor Level Top Grade. But after a hundred thousand years of weathering the storms of time and the ravages of numerous great wars, it was a mere shadow of its former glory. The grade of the Heavenly Treasures Cover... had fallen to Earth Level.
Ye Yun gazed at it, a profound sense of wistful sorrow welling up within him.

chapters.title: Chapter 258: Senior, You’ve Mistaken Me for Someone Else, Haven’t You?
chapters.content:
Chapter 258: Chapter 258: Senior, You’ve Mistaken Me for Someone Else, Haven’t You?
"This Heavenly Treasures Cover of yours looks quite old, young man. How much is it?"
An old man in a golden robe came over, his eyes fixed on the Heavenly Treasures Cover in Ye Yun’s hand, a fiery interest glinting in them.
"Not much. I’m selling it for fifty thousand Spirit Stones," the blue-robed youth replied courteously, waving his hand.
The old man stroked his chin, hesitating for a moment before smiling. "Fifty thousand isn’t expensive. How about this: I’ll give you sixty thousand, and the Heavenly Treasures Cover is mine?"
Ye Yun’s expression shifted slightly. He stood up from the ground and glanced at the gold-robed elder.
The gold-robed elder had silver hair and a ruddy complexion. He was dressed luxuriously and possessed an extraordinary demeanor. He was a cultivator at the Sixth Level of the Destiny Realm, followed by several attendants whose cultivation bases were between the Third and Fourth Levels of the Destiny Realm.
"Shouldn’t things be done on a first-come, first-served basis?" Ye Yun asked with a faint smile.
Faced with these insignificant ants, he felt no interest at all. His only interest, if any, was perhaps to toy with them a little.
Ye Yun was not your typical wolf in sheep’s clothing. He was a man who had even dared to challenge the Heavenly Dao.
"Exactly! First come, first served! Don’t you understand this rule, old man? What’s wrong with you?" The Big Black Cat strode over, annoyed, waving a fist as if ready for a fight.
"What do you think you’re doing?" The attendants behind the gold-robed elder rushed forward.
The two sides stood in confrontation.
"You... you guys, don’t fight, please...?" The young man in blue was flustered by this predicament.
"I’ll give you one hundred thousand Spirit Stones," Ye Yun said, glancing at the young man in blue with a smile.
"Alright, then it’s sold to you!" The young man in blue nodded quickly.
He was short exactly fifty thousand Spirit Stones, which was what he needed to exchange for a Heavenly Moon Order from the black market. For this dilapidated Heavenly Treasures Cover to sell for one hundred thousand Spirit Stones was truly an astronomical price. He hurriedly agreed, afraid Ye Yun would change his mind.
"Here you are." The Big Black Cat quickly took out one hundred thousand Spirit Stones and handed them to the young man in blue.
"..."
Seeing the treasure snatched from under his nose, the gold-robed elder’s face turned gloomy.
Just as he was about to flare up, he caught a glimpse of a beautiful girl in a black dress gracefully walking out from behind the white-robed young man. The elder’s pupils contracted instantly, his face registering shock.
It turned out to be the Saintess of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird! The true power behind the Wu Kun Mountain Black Market!
"Master, this person has been so insolent. Shall I kill him?" Mu Qing bowed slightly to Ye Yun, her tone respectful.
"Tell them to scram," Ye Yun said nonchalantly.
He didn’t want to develop killing intent over a few ants and thereby ruin the nostalgic sentiment he cherished for his former brothers.
Mu Qing frowned, pointing her slender finger at the old man. "Get lost, now!"
"Yes, we’ll leave right now!" Facing the Saintess, the gold-robed elder didn’t dare offer the slightest resistance. He turned and fled.
His attendants, seeing the dire situation, hastily followed.
After they had gone some distance, the gold-robed elder stopped. He was now drenched in cold sweat, his robes soaked through.
He had never imagined that the Saintess of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird would address the young man in white as ’Master’. Just moments ago, he had arrogantly plotted to snatch the treasure the white-robed youth fancied—a truly suicidal act.
"Thank heavens for my good luck; otherwise, I would have lost my life..." the gold-robed elder muttered, wiping his sweat, his heart still pounding with lingering fear.
After he said this, he and his attendants felt a momentary daze. When they recovered their senses, they couldn’t remember anything that had just happened.
"Come on, let’s continue our treasure hunting." Gazing at the bustling streets on either side, the gold-robed elder’s spirits lifted, and he led his attendants away from there.
Ye Yun glanced impassively at their retreating figures, a faint, almost imperceptible smile playing on his lips.
