He did not want others in this world to see him. So, all along the way, anyone who had seen Ye Yun had their memories wiped by him. When he left Wu Kun Mountain, Ye Yun would erase all memories of him from everyone there as well. This included the elders of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird who had managed to escape.
His existence would forever be absent from anyone’s mind.
Having sold the Heavenly Treasures Cover, the young man in blue felt a weight lift from his shoulders. He gleefully put away the tattered cloth, stuffing it into his storage ring, and prepared to leave.
"Is your surname Lei?" Ye Yun asked, his gaze fixed on the blue-robed young man before him, his eyes growing hazy.
It was as if time had rewound a hundred thousand years, and a familiar youth stood before him once more. This youth was his sworn brother from days long past, Lei Cheng.
One hundred thousand years ago, when Ye Yun was the foremost hegemon of the Cangnan Continent, he naturally had many boon companions and sworn brothers. Chang Yuchun, whom he had met earlier, was one of them. And so was Lei Cheng.
If this Heavenly Treasures Cover was the heirloom of the young man in blue, then he was, in all likelihood, a Successor of the Lei family. He wondered, though, how many generations the Lei family had passed through in a hundred thousand years.
Hearing the white-robed youth utter such astonishing words, Lei Qinian, the young man in blue, felt a tempestuous wave crash through his heart.
How did this man know his surname was Lei? The secret of his family’s true surname had been guarded for tens of thousands of years! This meant that tens of thousands of years ago, the Lei ancestors had gone into reclusion, changing their surname from Lei to Li, a secret passed down through generations. However, not everyone in the Lei family knew this; only the Clan Leader of the Lei family was privy to this secret. And as the years passed, by the time the Lei family line reached Lei Qinian’s generation, he was the sole survivor. Thus, Lei Qinian, as the last of his line, naturally knew the secret of the family name that had been passed down for millennia.
"Senior, you must be mistaken. My family name is Li..." Lei Qinian barely managed to suppress the storm in his heart, forcing a smile as he spoke.
"Li?" Ye Yun raised an eyebrow, a flicker of doubt in his eyes.
This Heavenly Treasures Cover was, without a doubt, the very treasure he had gifted to Lei Cheng one hundred thousand years ago. Given that the young man before him claimed it was an ancestral heirloom, he was almost certainly of Lei family blood. But why then did the young man claim his surname was Li? Could there be some hidden reason?
"How could my Master mistake someone? Boy, don’t you lie, or else Old Cat won’t let you off!" the Big Black Cat threatened menacingly. His Super Divine Dragon Breath, indicative of a cultivator at the Fourth Level of the Destiny Realm, bore down on Lei Qinian, who was merely at the Fifth Level of the Nirvana Realm, making it difficult for him even to breathe.
"Senior, I am not lying! My surname truly is Li..." Lei Qinian’s face flushed crimson as he continued to argue.
Ye Yun waved his hand, dispersing the overpowering Super Divine Dragon Breath emanating from the Big Black Cat.
"Is there anyone else in your family now?" Ye Yun asked.
"There’s no one else. My parents passed away long ago. In this generation, I am the only one left..." The pressure vanished. Lei Qinian breathed a sigh of relief, his expression turning somber as he spoke.
He wasn’t lying. Over tens of thousands of years, the Lei family had declined, falling from prominence. His parents had succumbed to a strange illness long ago, departing from this world. Now, he was all alone, living a solitary and desolate life.
To enter the Heavenly Moon Secret Realm and fulfill his deceased father’s last wish, Lei Qinian had felt he had no choice but to sell the family heirloom, the Heavenly Treasures Cover.
After all, this treasure is already dilapidated and of little practical use.
But Lei Qinian had never expected to be so fortunate as to encounter such a generous buyer, willing to pay the exorbitant price of one hundred thousand Spirit Stones for the artifact. He was overjoyed, realizing that the additional fifty thousand Spirit Stones would significantly alleviate his dire financial straits.

chapters.title: Chapter 259: The Secret behind Lei Family’s Change of Surname
chapters.content:
Chapter 259: Chapter 259: The Secret behind Lei Family’s Change of Surname
After hearing Lei Qinian’s words, Ye Yun fell silent.
He did not expect this. The Lei Family, after a hundred thousand years, would be in such a tragic situation. They were far worse off than the descendants of Chang Yuchun.
"Sigh!" Ye Yun heaved a sigh, his expression melancholy as he looked towards the distant horizon.
"Master, what’s wrong?" Mao Bao’er rolled its eyes, quietly asking the Big Black Cat.
"I don’t know. Let’s all be quiet," the Big Black Cat said softly. He, too, noticed his master’s bad mood and dared not say too much.
"Master, I have an extra Heavenly Moon Order. Why not give it to this young man?" Mu Qing spoke softly from the side.
"That’s possible." An idea sparked in Ye Yun’s mind. He turned to look at Mu Qing, his eyes showing approval. After all, they had overheard the words of lament from this blue-robed young man on the other side of the street. This young man wanted to sell his Heavenly Treasures Cover and gather enough Spirit Stones to buy a Heavenly Moon Order. If Mu Qing indeed had an extra Heavenly Moon Order, Ye Yun wouldn’t mind giving one to the blue-robed young man.
Lei Qinian, who had been about to leave, was shocked when he heard the conversation between the two.
What? The Saintess of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird wants to give him a Heavenly Moon Order?
He found it rather unbelievable. He quickly pinched his thigh. Sharp pain confirmed it wasn’t a dream.
Mu Qing walked over with grace, turned her jade palm, and handed over a Heavenly Moon Order, saying with a smile, "Young man, this Order is for you."
"This..." Lei Qinian’s face immediately turned red with excitement. He stuttered, "Saintess, I can’t accept this! I dare not!"
"This Order is from the Master. You don’t need to be polite. If you really want to thank someone, thank the Master," Mu Qing said, forcefully pressing the Heavenly Moon Order into Lei Qinian’s hand before walking away.
Lei Qinian clutched the Heavenly Moon Order, his eyes reddened, and his body trembled, clearly deeply moved. He could see that the white-robed senior meant him no harm, yet he had deliberately hidden his surname from the senior.
Now, the Lei Family has only me left. What is there to fear even if this secret is revealed? My entry into the Heavenly Moon Secret Region is just to accomplish my father’s last wishes. But, with the dangers lurking in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, I don’t know if I can survive.
So at this moment, Lei Qinian decided to reveal his real family name to the senior.
Having thought this, Lei Qinian walked over, stood before Ye Yun, bowed, and said respectfully, "Senior, I was wrong earlier."
Ye Yun turned his head, looked at Lei Qinian with surprise, and asked, "What was wrong?"
"Senior, my surname is Lei, not Li. This has been a secret preserved by our family for tens of thousands of years," Lei Qinian said solemnly, taking a deep breath.
Changed the surname tens of thousands of years ago?
Ye Yun’s eyes widened suddenly, a rare look of surprise appearing on his usually impassive face.
The Lei Family was also a powerful family one hundred thousand years ago, their strength comparable to a Super Sect. How could they suddenly change their surname? This was no small matter. The decision by the Lei Family to make such a significant change must have been due to a major crisis within the family.
"What exactly led your Lei Family ancestors to change their surname?" Ye Yun’s brows tightened slightly, his tone serious.
"Senior, I can only tell you this much. Every generation of Lei Family descendants, upon learning this secret, swears an oath to the heavens not to divulge the true reason behind the Lei Family’s surname change..." Lei Qinian looked solemn as he shook his head, then let out a long sigh.
"I see." Ye Yun nodded. He looked at Lei Qinian’s somewhat youthful face and felt a growing heaviness in his heart.
At that moment,
he seemed to sense that a hidden manipulator had infiltrated his good brother’s family.
In Ye Yun’s eyes, tiny star-like runes shifted slightly. In that instant, Ye Yun had read all the information stored in Lei Qinian’s memories.
Since the descendants of the Lei Family had already sworn an oath, he had no choice but to use this method of directly reading memories to obtain the information he wanted. This would not be considered breaching the Lei Family’s oath. Lei Qinian would not bear any consequences of oath-breaking either.
After viewing these memories, Ye Yun’s face suddenly turned somber.
The Lei Family’s change of surname occurred ninety thousand years ago, a very long time ago.
According to Lei Qinian’s memories, a veiled woman visited the Lei Family. She had a prolonged conversation, spanning several Time Units, with the Clan Leader of the Lei Family in a secret chamber. The woman told the Clan Leader that if he desired the Lei Family to continue for longer, he must change their surname, retreat into obscurity, and relocate to a faraway place to avoid the looming disaster. Otherwise, the decline of the Lei Family would become unstoppable.
The Clan Leader initially didn’t believe her. However, just one hundred years later, the Lei Family’s decline began to accelerate. Clan Members started dying inexplicably one after another. The cause of their deaths could not be found, and the circumstances surrounding their deaths were exceedingly bizarre. This filled the Lei Family’s Clan Leader with dread. At that moment, the veiled woman appeared once again. Only then did the Clan Leader of the Lei Family believe the veiled woman’s words.
Later, under the veiled woman’s arrangements, the entire Lei Family relocated to a remote mountainous area. They settled in a valley resembling a paradise, changing their name and living in seclusion from that day forward. From that moment on, the Lei Family became the Li Family. This secret was verbally passed down from Clan Leader to Clan Leader. There was no written record.
Although the Lei Family relocated to Taoyuan Valley, far from worldly strife, they still declined after eighty to ninety thousand years. That was the entire process.
Watching these memories, Ye Yun’s eyes flickered like burning flames.
The veiled woman’s actions were extremely mysterious. Could she possibly be the missing Nangong Jade? Given that Nangong Jade had once given the Qin Family an eye of the Taixu Ancient Dragon, it was not unlikely that she could also assist the Lei Family in changing their surname and surviving the unknown catastrophe.
Thinking of this, Ye Yun lightly touched his forehead with his hand.
He only felt that Nangong Jade, this girl, made him increasingly befuddled.
This is...
In Lei Qinian’s memories, Ye Yun suddenly saw another segment of memory.
The reason Lei Qinian tried to procure a Heavenly Moon Order at all costs to enter the Heavenly Moon Secret Region was because a certain ancestor of the Lei Family had once entered this Secret Region and found a Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree, from which he plucked quite a number of Tianyue Osmanthus Fruits. These fruits were of exceptional quality; eating them noticeably enhanced one’s comprehension and aptitude. At the time, this ancestor ate a few and hid the rest in a nearby valley. The Tianyue Osmanthus Fruit would not rot and could be preserved within the Heavenly Moon Secret Region for thousands of years. Lei Qinian was entering the Heavenly Moon Secret Region to gather the remaining Tianyue Osmanthus Fruits.
Watching Lei Qinian, Ye Yun suddenly smiled slightly and said, "One of my disciples will also be going to the Heavenly Moon Secret Region. Why don’t you two team up? That way, you’ll be better able to handle any risks."
"Team up?" Lei Qinian was taken aback, not expecting this white-robed senior to make such a suggestion.

chapters.title: Chapter 260: The True Strength of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird
chapters.content:
Chapter 260: Chapter 260: The True Strength of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird
Ye Yun made such a suggestion because he was worried that Lei Qinian might perish within the Heavenly Moon Secret Region. After all, entering any Secret Region alone posed a very high risk of death. And Lei Qinian was only at the Fifth Level of Nirvana Realm, possessing merely average combat power.
"Senior, I appreciate your kindness. I have some personal matters to attend to in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, so it’s really impossible for me to join your disciples in forming a team."
After some thought, Lei Qinian still refused Ye Yun’s kindness, as he had to be extremely cautious with this mission. After all, those Tianyue Osmanthus Fruits were extremely precious, and he was afraid that others would covet them if they formed a team. Although the senior before him had treated him well, in reality, he had no idea about the senior’s background.
"You ungrateful brat! My Master is so kind to you, yet you have the audacity to refuse..." Big Black Cat gritted his teeth at the side, wearing an expression of thorough exasperation.
"Think it over. By the time the Heavenly Moon Secret Region opens, perhaps you will change your mind," Ye Yun smiled faintly, not insisting any further.
He naturally knew the secret Lei Qinian was hiding. After all, if they formed a team, Lei Qinian wouldn’t be able to act alone to find the Tianyue Osmanthus Fruits hidden in the valley.
There were still a few days until the Heavenly Moon Secret Region would open. Ye Yun was not in a hurry and decided to give the young man some time to think it over.
After all, he was the only descendant left in this world by his good brother. No matter what, Ye Yun had to take care of this bloodline and ensure Lei Qinian was safely sent on his way; only then could he feel at ease.
"Thank you for your understanding, Senior. I will take my leave now." Lei Qinian clasped his fists in a bow, then hurriedly departed.
He now possessed a Heavenly Moon Order and needed to hurry to the Heavenly Moon Dynasty. Not far from Wu Kun Mountain was a ferry port with large ships traveling between the Heavenly Star Dynasty and the Heavenly Moon Dynasty. By spending a certain amount of Spirit Stones, he could board a ship to quickly reach the Heavenly Moon Dynasty.
Watching Lei Qinian’s departing figure, Ye Yun smiled.
What a stubborn young man! His demeanor is very similar to my good brother, Lei Cheng. Lei Cheng was quite stubborn himself.
"Master, why are you treating this young man so kindly? Is he also the descendant of an old friend of yours?" Big Black Cat mused before boldly asking from the side.
After all, Big Black Cat had also been to the Chang Family and knew it was the family of an old friend of his Master from a hundred thousand years ago. And just now, his Master had repeatedly questioned the blue-robed young man about his surname.
Clearly, this young man in blue... he might also be a descendant of an old friend Master met a hundred thousand years ago.
"That’s right," Ye Yun nodded, not hiding it.
He looked down at the base of the mountain. With a mere thought, a command was instantly conveyed to the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s mind.
"Don’t worry, Master. I will definitely protect that young man," replied the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon. He then transformed into a red-robed young man and flew off in a specific direction.
With the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon gone to protect Lei Qinian, Ye Yun felt much more at ease. He had sent him because he didn’t want Lei Qinian to encounter any mishaps on his journey. Fortunately, Little Dragon had been idle, so this escort mission was a fitting task.
Big Black Horse looked in a certain direction, suddenly lowered his head, and sighed.
Alas, now only I am left... My lot is just to pull a carriage. Now that even the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon has a task and has left, I can only wait here for Master’s return.
Ye Yun continued to roam the streets, quietly awaiting any news from the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird.
「At the same time.」
Several Elders who had been teleported from Wu Kun Mountain to the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird immediately rushed towards an ancient tower on the Sect’s rear mountain upon their arrival.
"Supreme Elder, something terrible has happened! The Sect Master and Deputy Sect Master have been killed! The Saintess has also betrayed the Sect..." These Elders knelt before the ancient tower, crying and recounting the tale with faces full of grief.
At first, the ancient tower was silent. But as the Elders continued their tearful pleas, an emaciated, grey-robed Elder pushed open the tower’s large door and stepped out.
"Supreme Elder, you’ve finally come out!" Seeing the grey-robed Elder, fresh tears welled up in the eyes of the other Elders, and they were so overwhelmed they could barely speak.
The grey-robed Elder, his face deeply wrinkled but his eyes exceptionally sharp, said coldly, "Tell me in detail exactly what happened."
One of the Elders recounted in full detail everything that had transpired on Wu Kun Mountain, not forgetting to embellish his account to emphasize the white-robed youth’s despicable and terrifying actions.
After listening, the grey-robed Elder’s face turned so gloomy it seemed to freeze the air around him. A boundless fury ignited in his chest, threatening to erupt like a volcano.
Suppressing the fury in his chest, the grey-robed Elder said faintly, "This person is no simple character..."
"Supreme Elder, you must avenge our Sect Master..." Seeing the Supreme Elder had not immediately declared his intentions, the Elders burst into renewed tears.
"Revenge is a certainty. Follow me." The grey-robed Elder stated coolly, turning and departing, his wide sleeves fluttering. He navigated a winding path and soon disappeared into a long, narrow valley.
Within the valley lay a mist-shrouded Formation. The grey-robed Elder formed a series of hand seals, channeling a spell into it. Instantly, the Formation activated, and a large gateway opened. The grey-robed Elder led the way inside.
What is this place?
The other Elders, clearly unfamiliar with this location, exchanged puzzled glances. When the Supreme Elder didn’t respond, they prudently kept quiet, following him single file.
Beyond the gateway lay a pitch-black tunnel that slanted downwards, extending deep into the earth, its end nowhere in sight.
"Supreme Elder, is this a secret sanctum of our Sect?" one Elder asked cautiously, shivering slightly in the chilly wind that gusted through the tunnel.
"Indeed. Deep underground lies the greatest foundation of our Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird," the grey-robed Elder stated, a hint of pride touching his lips.
They quickened their pace, and after an hour, they finally arrived in a grand hall deep underground.
HISS! The Elders gasped, gawking at a massive megalith standing in the center of the hall. The megalith was crystal clear, emitting a potent life aura, and within its heart, a large black bird was sealed.
"Supreme Elder, this... could this be the legendary Xuan Bird Ancestor of our Sect?" one Elder exclaimed, a sudden realization dawning on him. His knees buckled, and he knelt on the ground.
The other Elders quickly followed suit, kneeling as well. All of them stared at the black Xuan bird encased in the transparent megalith, their expressions fervent and awestruck as they kowtowed repeatedly.
For tens of thousands of years, a legend had circulated within the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird: that a true Xuan bird once resided in the Sect. However, it was only ever a legend; no living Successor of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird had ever seen it.
"Each of you will contribute ten drops of Essence Blood. I shall awaken the Ancestor," the grey-robed Elder commanded, looking at the kneeling figures with an indifferent expression.
Upon hearing his words, the Elders immediately pressed their hands to their chests without hesitation, each coughing up ten drops of Essence Blood. The dark-red Essence Blood radiated a dense Profound Bird Bloodline aura.
The grey-robed Elder collected the Essence Blood into a small vial. He walked to the front of the megalith and levitated into the air above it, then tilted the vial.
The dark-red Essence Blood streamed down like a thin thread, entering the crystal-clear megalith. It passed through the stone and slowly seeped into the body of the black Xuan bird.

chapters.title: Chapter 261: Original Stone Seal, Xuan Bird Ancestor
chapters.content:
Chapter 261: Chapter 261: Original Stone Seal, Xuan Bird Ancestor
As the rich Essence Blood was injected, drop by drop, the aura of the giant black Xuan bird within the translucent massive stone grew stronger. Its black feathers trembled slightly, as if it was about to awaken.
The few elders kneeling on the ground felt their blood boil with excitement at the sight.
After dropping the last drop of Essence Blood, the gray-clothed elder put away the small bottle and landed back on the ground.
"The few of you may rise," the gray-clothed elder instructed softly.
The elders hurriedly stood up, drew closer, and asked in low voices, "Supreme Elder, could this massive stone where the Xuan Bird Ancestor resides be the legendary Original Stone?"
"You do have some insight..." the gray-clothed elder glanced at the round-faced elder beside him before proudly stating, "Our Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird may only be a Superior great sect, but in reality, our true foundation is comparable to that of a Super Sect! This Original Stone... it’s something that even Supreme Major Sects likely don’t possess!"
Hearing the Supreme Elder’s words, the other elders’ eyes burned with renewed fervor.
"Supreme Elder, could you tell us the Xuan Bird Ancestor’s cultivation base?" an elder asked excitedly, rubbing his hands together.
"It was quite powerful in the past, but..." The gray-clothed elder sighed. "The Xuan Bird Ancestor has lived for a hundred thousand years. Its physical body has long since withered, and its Primordial Spirit has also weakened. However, it can still demonstrate the power of a Half-Step Eternal Realm..."
"So strong!"
The elders rejoiced greatly.
An elder curiously asked, "Can even this mysterious Original Stone not preserve the Xuan Bird Ancestor’s lifespan?"
"After such a long time," the gray-clothed elder sighed again at their words, "even the Original Stone, despite its miraculous properties, cannot perfectly seal the Xuan Bird Ancestor’s Primordial Spirit and physical body without some leakage..."
The other elders exchanged glances, their shock palpable.
The fact that the Xuan Bird Ancestor could live for a hundred thousand years completely overturned their understanding. And all of this... stemmed from this mysterious Original Stone. Such a massive piece of Original Stone was truly a rare sight in the world. If news of it were to spread, even Sky-Level Sects would likely come to seize it.
A deep, muffled voice suddenly echoed from within the massive Original Stone.
"What has happened? Why have I been awakened?"
The giant black Xuan bird slowly opened its dark, glossy eyes.
The gray-clothed elder quickly knelt on the ground and said with an excited expression, "Ancestor, the Sect has encountered a great catastrophe. The current Sect Master and Deputy Sect Master have both been killed. We’re afraid we must ask you, esteemed elder, to personally intervene."
"Who possesses such audacity?" A murderous intent flashed in the black Xuan bird’s eyes.
"It’s a Life and Death Realm cultivator of unknown origin, currently at Wu Kun Mountain..." the gray-clothed elder hurriedly reported.
The black Xuan bird fell silent for a moment, then slowly spoke, "I have been barely clinging to life for a hundred thousand years. My physical body has long since decayed, and my Primordial Spirit is exceptionally weak. If I were to forcibly act, I would only have one chance. After that, I would depart from this world forever. Are you certain you want me to act this time?"
"Ancestor, we were truly reluctant to awaken you, but this time, we genuinely have no other choice..." the gray-clothed elder said, his voice filled with grief and indignation.
"So be it, so be it. Having lived for a hundred thousand years, I’ve truly lived long enough. What difference would a few more centuries make? It would be better to resolve this crisis for the Sect..."
The black Xuan bird heaved a long sigh, having made its decision.
"Thank you, Ancestor."
The gray-clothed elder was overjoyed.
If the Xuan Bird Ancestor took action, it could unleash an attack equivalent to the Half-Step Eternal Realm. No Life and Death Realm cultivator would be a match for it.
"Let’s go. Take me from this place," the black Xuan bird commanded.
"Yes."
The gray-clothed elder quickly took out a Divine Pet Ring and, with a wave of his hand, collected the massive, crystal-clear Original Stone.
"This is wonderful! With the Xuan Bird Ancestor taking action this time, those individuals will certainly be brought to justice!"
The other elders nearby visibly relaxed. They followed the Supreme Elder out of the great hall deep underground and then took a Teleportation Array to Wu Kun Mountain.
A ray of light flickered, and several figures appeared.
The gray-clothed elder scanned the surroundings, his Divine Sense spreading out. He immediately spotted the distinctive white-robed young man.
Beside the white-robed young man stood a beautiful young woman in a black robe, the attire of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird. It was the Sect’s Saintess.
"It’s that fellow, isn’t it..." the gray-clothed elder said lightly, pointing in a certain direction.
"Yes, Supreme Elder! It’s them. That white-robed young man’s cultivation base should be the highest. That black-robed Demon Clan youth is at the Life and Death Realm..." one of the elders said angrily.
"Alright, I understand. This time, we’ll send them all to Hell!" the gray-clothed elder declared with a sinister smile before vanishing in a flash and flying over.
"Young Master, the Teleportation Array flickered again. I’m afraid that Supreme Elder has arrived..." Mu Qing said softly, looking in a particular direction.
"He arrived right on time..." Ye Yun, who was strolling about idly, remarked with a faint, unconcerned smile.
A flash of light, and a gray-clothed elder abruptly appeared high in the sky. The moment he appeared, he exuded the terrifying aura of a Life and Death Realm cultivator, causing all the nearby cultivators to scatter in fear.
"You two Life and Death Realm cultivators, do you dare to come up and fight?" the gray-clothed elder challenged, his hands clasped behind his back. He looked down upon Wu Kun Mountain, his posture radiating an air of absolute dominance.
He chose the void as the battlefield because he didn’t want the black market on Wu Kun Mountain to be destroyed in the ensuing battle. After all, the Xuan Bird Ancestor’s final attack would be cataclysmic, its power unimaginable. The entirety of Wu Kun Mountain would likely be razed to the ground.
This fellow seems to have some trump cards. Let’s go up and take a look.
Ye Yun thought with a slight smile before stepping into the air and ascending.
Big Black Cat, Cat Baby, and Mu Qing followed closely behind him.
They ascended to an altitude of ten thousand meters.
The two groups faced each other from a distance. Ye Yun looked at the gray-clothed elder and said calmly, "You’re merely at the First Level of the Life and Death Realm. If you don’t have some trump cards, you won’t be leaving today."
"Such arrogance! How could a frog at the bottom of a well like you possibly comprehend the true heritage of my Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird?" the gray-clothed elder sneered. With a wave of his hand, a beam of light shot out from his fingertip.
As the light faded, a massive, crystal-clear stone floated in the void. And within this huge crystal stone resided a large black bird.
"Is that a Xuan bird?" Big Black Cat asked, blinking its eyes in shock as it gazed at the large black bird.
It hadn’t expected the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird to use a rare Original Stone to seal an ancient Xuan bird.
Mu Qing looked rather excited.
She possessed the Xuan bird bloodline. The moment she saw that Xuan bird, she felt an instinctual urge to fly over and draw near to it.
Ye Yun’s gaze swept over and landed on the black Xuan bird. His eyebrows then twitched slightly, as if something had occurred to him.
"We respectfully request the Ancestor to act!" the gray-clothed elder suddenly knelt in mid-air, his expression fervent as he spoke.
"We respectfully request the Ancestor to act!" the other elders behind him also knelt and roared, their voices thundering, shaking the heavens and the earth.
CRACK. CRACK...
The crystal-clear Original Stone began to slowly crack open.
The black Xuan bird opened a pair of incomparably fierce eyes. Its gaze was like two sharp swords, piercing towards the void opposite it.
"This is...?" When the Xuan bird saw a young man, dressed in white that surpassed snow, resembling a God Man from a painting, its expression suddenly changed drastically. An incredulous look filled its eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 262: Ten thousand years ago, he was unrivaled across the continent
chapters.content:
Chapter 262: Chapter 262 - Ten thousand years ago, he was unrivaled across the continent
Familiar brows and eyes, a peerless, transcendent temperament; every move exuded a dominating aura.
Throughout the entire world, in the heart of the Xuan bird, only the foremost master of the Eternal Realm from Cangnan Continent one hundred thousand years ago could be like this. It couldn’t be mistaken. It had to be him!
The Xuan bird grew agitated. It stared fixedly at the white-robed youth before it, who resembled a god man. A mix of sorrow and joy filled its eyes, and its throat choked up. In this moment, it was so overwhelmed, it couldn’t speak.
Ye Yun was also observing this black Xuan bird.
This black Xuan bird had been sealed within the Original Stone for a long time. Its physical body had long since withered, its Primordial Spirit was extremely weak, and its essence qi had long since vanished. It likely wouldn’t live much longer. Now that the Original Stone had cracked open for the last time, once it exhausted its remaining life force by taking action, it would dissipate from the world.
This black Xuan bird, despite emanating an ancient aura of death, gave him a familiar feeling.
One hundred thousand years ago, there was a Hundred Bird Forest on the back mountain of the Dragon God Sect. Various kinds of birds lived there. Among them were two Xuan birds, one large and one small. The larger one’s Cultivation Stage had reached the Life and Death Realm, while the smaller one was only at the Nirvana Realm. The birds in the Hundred Bird Forest had no natural enemies and cultivated peacefully in the Dragon God Sect, which was rich in Spiritual Energy. From time to time, Ye Yun, as the Sect Master, would also gift these birds some heavenly treasures. These birds, each possessing an extraordinary bloodline, cultivated without worry in the Dragon God Sect, a sacred place for cultivation, and their progress was extremely rapid. The black Xuan bird before him did look somewhat similar to the two Xuan birds from the Hundred Bird Forest of the past.
CRACK! CRACK!
The Original Stone shattered completely. Once shattered, the Original Stone immediately lost its crystalline luster, becoming as ordinary as common stone.
The black Xuan bird hovered motionless in mid-air, its eyes fixed intently on Ye Yun. Its body trembled, its expression excited.
This must be... A bold conjecture welled up in its heart.
"Ancestor, what’s wrong?" the gray-robed old man asked, looking up in surprise to see the Xuan Bird Ancestor completely still.
Shouldn’t it be attacking immediately to annihilate those fellows opposite us? Why isn’t the Xuan Bird Ancestor making a move?
Just as he was wondering, he suddenly heard the white-robed youth speak.
"Are you the older one, or the younger one?" Ye Yun asked calmly.
"Sect Master, I am the younger one..." the Xuan bird replied. Hearing that familiar voice by its ear, the Xuan bird could no longer contain its excitement, tears streaming down its face.
It really was him! The man who, one hundred thousand years ago, reigned supreme as the number one expert of the Eternal Realm on Cangnan Continent. The Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, an Eternal Level Sect!
Hearing the Xuan bird’s words, Ye Yun nodded silently.
It really was one of the two Xuan birds from the Dragon God Sect’s Hundred Bird Forest.
A flash of black light, and the Xuan bird suddenly transformed into a human form, kneeling at Ye Yun’s feet and kowtowing repeatedly.
"Xuan bird pays respects to the Sect Master!"
The Xuan bird continued to kowtow, tears streaming down its face.
One hundred thousand years! A full one hundred thousand years! It never imagined it would see the thirteenth Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect again! Regarding the matter of the Sect Master dying due to cultivation deviation, most of the divine birds in the Hundred Bird Forest had their doubts. The Sect Master possessed unparalleled talent; at twenty-four years old, he was already unmatched in the Eternal Realm. How could someone with such talent die from cultivation deviation while breaking through to the True God Realm?
But as time passed, the news of the Sect Master’s death was slowly accepted by many.
"Rise," Ye Yun said with a sigh. With a wave of his hand, a surge of Mana swept out, lifting the Xuan bird. "It truly wasn’t easy for you to survive sealed in the Original Stone for so many years."
One hundred thousand years... the world has changed so much. Ye Yun hadn’t expected to meet a Xuan bird raised by the Sect in the past... It must be said, the encounters in life are truly wondrous!
"This is..." The gray-robed old man looked up, stunned by the scene, utterly dumbfounded.
The Ancestor of our Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird knows this white-robed youth? Not only knows him but kneels and calls him Sect Master... What in the world is happening?
"Heavens, how could this be?" the other old men behind him exclaimed as they witnessed the scene, their worlds spinning, their hearts shattering.
They had originally thought the Xuan Bird Ancestor would avenge the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird. But unexpectedly, upon seeing the white-robed youth, the Ancestor had kneeled directly on the ground! This was truly astounding. Who exactly is this white-robed youth? Why would the Ancestor, a powerful demon beast at the Half-Step Eternity Realm, kneel at his feet?
The surrounding atmosphere was deathly still.
「A few breaths later.」
"Ancestor, are you truly not going to avenge us?" the gray-robed old man slowly stood up, his face ashen, and asked with a trembling voice.
Hearing someone speak, the Xuan bird whirled around, glaring angrily at those juniors.
Revenge? These bastards still want revenge?! Don’t they see who this is? This is its Master! One hundred thousand years ago, the Master was undefeated across the entire Cangnan Continent. And now, after one hundred thousand years, his Master has probably progressed immeasurably far on the path Above God!
The angrier the Xuan bird became as it thought about it. Its rage erupted like a volcano.
"You bastard! How dare you disrespect the Sect Master! I’ll fucking kill you!"
A flash of black light, and the Xuan bird landed before the gray-robed old man, striking down with its palm. With a SPLAT, the gray-robed old man was blasted into a bloody mist.
After obliterating the Supreme Elder of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird with a single palm strike, the Xuan bird’s anger subsided slightly, though its expression remained cold and stern.
As a demon beast of the Dragon God Sect, the Xuan bird naturally knew that, one hundred thousand years ago, the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird was merely a minor vassal sect subordinate to the Dragon God Sect. In the eyes of the noble Xuan bird, such a tiny vassal sect was as insignificant as an ant. Its residing within the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird for so many years was due to an agreement reached between both parties tens of thousands of years prior. It served as the greatest hidden ace of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, helping them overcome calamities. In return, the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird would periodically anoint the Original Stone containing it with Essence Blood to sustain its life. Having narrowly escaped death from the Dragon God Sect, it naturally didn’t want to perish so easily. It also hoped for the day its god-like Sect Master would descend upon the world once more. Therefore, it chose this minor sect, the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, sealing itself within an Original Stone to eke out an existence in the world.
"The Supreme Elder... is dead?"
Watching the bloody mist scatter in the wind, the remaining old men behind were scared out of their wits. None of them had ever imagined that the Xuan Bird Ancestor would turn around and obliterate the Supreme Elder into a bloody mist with a single slap.
"Ancestor, spare our worthless lives, please!" these old men cried out. Knowing escape was hopeless, they hurriedly knelt in mid-air, kowtowing repeatedly and weeping profusely.
"Hmph!" The Xuan bird slowly walked over from the void, sneering, "Spare you? Impossible! You have offended the Sect Master. Your crime is unpardonable. Death is your only way out."
Hearing these words from the Xuan Bird Ancestor, the old men’s faces turned ashen.
One old man looked up, gritted his teeth, and asked, "Ancestor, at least let us die understanding! Who exactly is this Sect Master?"
"One hundred thousand years ago, he was the number one expert of the Eternal Realm on Cangnan Continent, the Sect Master of the Eternal Level Sect, the Dragon God Sect," the Xuan bird declared proudly.
What? An invincible Grand Cultivator of the Eternal Realm from one hundred thousand years ago? And the Sect Master of an Eternal Level Sect?
The Xuan bird’s words struck them like a heavy hammer, making their minds reel.
"Die!" With that, the Xuan bird sneered, raised its hand, and slapped them into bloody mists.
After dealing with these individuals, it turned, flew back, and knelt once more at Ye Yun’s feet.
"Sect Master, regarding the affairs of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, I bear a share of the responsibility. Please mete out my punishment," the Xuan bird said, its head bowed in shame.

chapters.title: Chapter 263: Void Black Gate, Furry Arm
chapters.content:
Chapter 263: Chapter 263: Void Black Gate, Furry Arm
"You’ve been sealed within the Original Stone all this time, so naturally, you’re oblivious to what has occurred outside. This matter doesn’t concern you. Rise," Ye Yun said calmly, simultaneously releasing his mana to lift the Xuan bird’s body.
The Xuan bird stood to the side, flustered and unsure of what to say.
Big Black Cat and the others, standing behind Ye Yun and witnessing the entire process, were all visibly shaken, their faces etched with disbelief.
"Esteemed Senior, you’ve lived for a hundred thousand years?" Big Black Cat asked, his eyes wide as he mustered his courage.
In his memory, no one on the Cangnan Continent had ever lived for a hundred thousand years.
It was said that the Demon Clan had long lifespans, but even mighty demons of the Eternal Realm couldn’t live for a hundred thousand years.
"It’s quite embarrassing. I only managed to live for a hundred thousand years by relying on the Original Stone. But now, my physical body is decaying, and my Primordial Spirit is weak. At most, I can only live for about another hundred years..." the Xuan bird replied, his face etched with shame.
"That’s truly incredible!" Big Black Cat murmured to himself. He gazed at the Original Stone, now resembling an ordinary rock as it hovered in mid-air, a fervent glow igniting in his eyes.
Original Stones are truly miraculous!
He had heard of the renown of Original Stones but had never seen one.
Original Stones were extremely rare. Whenever one appeared on the Cangnan Continent, it would invariably trigger a bloody struggle.
After all, obtaining an Original Stone and using a special method to seal oneself inside could slow the decay of one’s lifespan.
However, the sealing capacity of an Original Stone was not limitless.
Generally, an Original Stone could only be used for sealing up to three times.
In other words, being sealed inside an Original Stone consumed its latent energy. The process of exiting and then re-entering to be sealed again counted as two uses.
The higher the quality of the Original Stone, the more times it could be used, but never more than three.
Whether Human Race or Demon Clan, individuals would absolutely not seal themselves within an Original Stone unless they were on the brink of death.
Original Stones were far too precious; each use of their sealing capacity could not be wasted frivolously.
Ye Yun surveyed his surroundings and stated indifferently, "There’s nothing much left to explore on Wu Kun Mountain. Let’s go."
After speaking, Ye Yun descended from mid-air and slowly made his way down the mountain trail.
The Xuan bird followed closely behind him, eager to speak with the Master about the many events that had transpired over the past hundred thousand years.
The moment Ye Yun began his descent, he once again activated the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye, erasing the memories of all cultivators on Wu Kun Mountain.
While on Wu Kun Mountain, Ye Yun had already erased the cultivators’ memories multiple times. He did not want anyone to witness his presence.
Ye Yun strode leisurely with his hands clasped behind his back, the Xuan bird at his side, while Big Black Cat and the others trailed further behind.
Ye Yun erected a barrier, isolating himself and the Xuan bird in a separate space.
Although the Xuan bird was merely a demon beast raised by the Divine Dragon Sect, it had lived for a hundred thousand years and should know a great deal about the sect.
"Sect Master, I have much to tell you..." The Xuan bird’s expression shifted slightly as the barrier appeared, and it spoke with a solemn countenance.
"Speak," Ye Yun nodded.
Then, as if remembering something, he chuckled and said, "A hundred thousand years have passed. I am no longer the Sect Master. The current Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect is the two hundred and ninety-eighth generation’s Luo Li. From now on, just call me Master."
The Xuan bird was momentarily stunned but quickly nodded in agreement.
"To think that My Divine Dragon Sect has successors... Heaven truly has eyes!"
The Xuan bird seemed quite agitated, his eyes turning slightly red.
He currently appeared as a gaunt, middle-aged man dressed in black, his complexion ashen, giving him a sickly aura.
Under the surge of emotion, a hint of color returned to his face.
"Master, not long after your fall, the Dragon God Sect was besieged by Ancient Giant Demons..." the Xuan bird said gravely.
His mood turned somber, and his vision blurred as if he had stepped into the river of time, returning to the Dragon God Sect of bygone days.
"The Ancient Giant Demons besieged the Dragon God Sect? What was the extent of the damage?" Ye Yun asked, his brow furrowing.
"Master, there weren’t many Ancient Giant Demons, and with the strength of our Dragon God Sect, we could have held them off. However, the ones who truly attacked our Dragon God Sect were not the Ancient Giant Demons," the Xuan bird suddenly uttered, his words astonishing.
"Oh?" Ye Yun’s eyes narrowed slightly, a sharp glint flashing within them.
So, the Ancient Giant Demons weren’t the main force attacking the Dragon God Sect. This was truly beyond his expectations!
Qin Yao had once seen Nangong Jade leading Ancient Giant Demons to attack the Dragon God Sect. Based on the strength of the Ancient Giant Demons, they were indeed capable of contending with the Dragon God Sect.
But Ye Yun hadn’t imagined that the true assailants of the Dragon God Sect were not the Ancient Giant Demons, but another party entirely.
"Who was it?" Ye Yun’s voice was calm, yet it carried an indomitable will, like an impending thunderstorm.
"It was a black gate," the Xuan bird said, his expression solemn.
"A black gate?" Ye Yun’s brow furrowed, a hint of shock appearing on his face.
"Master, when the Ancient Giant Demons besieged the Dragon God Sect, the battle was extremely chaotic. The Hundred Bird Forest was destroyed. At that time, my elder brother and I were too weak, no match for those Eternal Realm Ancient Giant Demons, so we planned to escape by flying away."
"But as we flew high into the sky, we saw a colossal black gate hidden within the clouds. It was open just a crack, and from that opening, countless black hairs rained down. These hairs were minute, carrying no aura whatsoever as they fell, making them almost impossible for anyone to detect."
"Many of our sect members were invaded by these black hairs. The hairs pierced their bodies. Those with low cultivation bases died instantly. While those with high cultivation bases didn’t die immediately, their constitutions seemed to be severely damaged..."
As the Xuan bird spoke of this, he couldn’t help but shiver, the mere thought of that enormous black gate filling him with an overwhelming sense of dread.
"This black gate... quite peculiar..." Ye Yun mused, stroking his chin with a casual smile.
Is it a magic weapon? Or perhaps a divine skill from someone in the Divine Land?
Several thoughts flashed through Ye Yun’s mind.
"Master, that black gate is truly strange. My elder brother and I decided to investigate, so we flew towards it. As we drew closer, we saw a hairy arm moving back and forth inside the gate. All those fine black hairs were falling from that arm..." the Xuan bird continued.
"A hairy arm?" Hearing the Xuan bird’s description, Ye Yun’s brow twitched sharply twice.
He had initially assumed that the enormous black gate amidst the clouds was spraying some kind of treasure as fine as ox hair.
But now, it seemed more probable that an incredibly ferocious creature was hidden inside, shedding the black hair from its arm to launch that catastrophic, heaven-sent assault.
"Master, upon seeing that black arm, my elder brother and I were greatly alarmed. We wanted to get a closer look to see what kind of monster it was. But unexpectedly, that monster discovered us! To shield me, my elder brother converted all his mana into a divine skill, sending me tens of thousands of miles away. Although I escaped, my elder brother was killed by that unknown monster..." At this point, the Xuan bird was choked with sobs, tears streaming down his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 264: Water of Life, Reshaping the Body
chapters.content:
Chapter 264: Chapter 264: Water of Life, Reshaping the Body
"Rest assured, I will not let the murderers go unpunished. Even if one hundred thousand years have passed, I have a way to root them all out," Ye Yun said calmly. His voice contained an authority as vast as the heavens.
Upon hearing this, the Xuan Bird felt a remarkable surge of spirit.
"Master, does this mean You have been reborn?" the Xuan Bird thought for a moment, then asked cautiously.
"No, I simply went to a place and cultivated there for one hundred thousand years," Ye Yun replied with a smile.
He went to a place?
The Xuan Bird was somewhat puzzled.
Why would the Master leave the immensely grand Dragon God Sect to go somewhere to cultivate? Without the Master to support it, the Dragon God Sect could only disintegrate before its enemies.
"Master, what is your cultivation base now?" the Xuan Bird hesitated for a moment, then plucked up the courage to ask.
"The Divine Monarch Realm," Ye Yun stated nonchalantly.
Upon hearing this realm, the Xuan Bird was somewhat confused. To be honest, he only knew that the True God Realm was above the Eternal Realm. As for what lay beyond the True God Realm, he was completely in the dark.
Ye Yun chuckled and lightly touched the Xuan Bird’s head with one finger. A stream of understanding infused into him, and the Xuan Bird suddenly comprehended. Now he had a basic understanding of the realms above the True God Realm.
「...」
"Master, after that great battle, the Dragon God Sect was severely damaged. I did not return to the Sect but went into hiding..." At this point, the Xuan Bird’s voice was somewhat suppressed, and his expression grave. He felt rather despondent and emotionally turbulent as he continued, "Master, it’s not that I am afraid of death. I just didn’t want to die in vain. Since no one in the entire Sect had noticed that strange black gate, I wanted to live on, awaiting Your return to this world, and then tell You everything."
Seeing the Xuan Bird’s cleverness, Ye Yun felt relieved and nodded. "I understand your reasons. Luckily, You are still alive; otherwise, I am afraid the culprits behind the Dragon God Sect’s fall would have vanished into the dust of history," Ye Yun sighed.
The Xuan Bird had truly endured hardship, suffering humiliation while scraping by for one hundred thousand years. This Original Stone, for instance, was likely obtained at a great price. After all, back then, the Dragon God Sect did not have surplus Original Stones to provide to the avian creatures in the Hundred Bird Forest.
Seeing that the Master understood him, tears instantly welled up in the Xuan Bird’s eyes. Choking with emotion, he said, "Master, I’m afraid I can only live for another hundred years at most. I can stay by Your side for a hundred years, and then I will completely return to this universe."
Ye Yun remained silent, an inexplicable sorrow, like that of a fox grieving for a dead rabbit, rising in his heart.
"Don’t worry," Ye Yun said calmly, reaching out and patting the Xuan Bird’s shoulder. "I... won’t let you die."
This time, the Xuan Bird had certainly made a great contribution. No matter what, Ye Yun could not let him live for only another hundred years. Ye Yun had a way to revitalize the Xuan Bird’s decaying body.
A moment later, Ye Yun took out a small bottle containing a Mysterious Green Liquid. He casually tossed the bottle to the Xuan Bird and smiled, "Drink up. Keep drinking until your body is back to normal..."
The Xuan Bird acknowledged, took the bottle somewhat mechanically, uncapped it, and peeked inside. Immediately, a vigorous life force billowed out. Just by taking one breath, he felt an indescribable vitality surge through his body.
What kind of treasure is this?
The Xuan Bird was extremely shocked, his hand trembling as he slowly raised the small bottle to his lips. Streams of Mysterious Green Liquid flowed from the bottle, like a small creek pouring into the Xuan Bird’s mouth.
After the Mysterious Green Liquid entered his body, it transformed into vigorous and overwhelming life energy, beginning to remodel his physical form.
Although Ye Yun had set up a barrier around them, it only blocked sound, not visuals.
When the Big Black Cat saw the Mysterious Green Liquid in the small bottle, his eyes instantly sparkled. He knew the terrifying nature of the Mysterious Green Liquid from the Master’s bottle; just a drop could dramatically heal even severe injuries in an instant. Elder Xuan Bird was drinking so much of the Mysterious Green Liquid as if it were water; his decaying body would undoubtedly regain new vitality.
At this moment, a layer of faint green radiance emerged from the Xuan Bird’s body, and his previously withered complexion became vibrant again. The tissues within his body were revitalized.
Feeling all these astonishing changes, the Xuan Bird could hardly contain the overwhelming shock in his heart. He knew that the Master was completely different from one hundred thousand years ago. The heaven-defying Mysterious Green Liquid in the small bottle had never before appeared on the entire Cangnan Continent.
The time it takes for an incense stick to burn passed.
The Xuan Bird himself felt somewhat numb, unsure how much of the Mysterious Green Liquid he had drunk. Finally, when he felt his body uncomfortably bloated, as if he couldn’t control the tremendous life energy within, he couldn’t help but feel horrified. He immediately put the small bottle away and capped it. The Xuan Bird knew he couldn’t consume any more of the Mysterious Green Liquid; if he continued, his body would explode instantly.
Staggering like a drunkard, the Xuan Bird walked over to Ye Yun and raised the small bottle with both hands. "Thank you, Lord, for granting me a new lease on life!" the Xuan Bird said gratefully.
As he spoke, his face was flushed red, his body swaying. The vigorous life energy within him was still surging like hundreds of giant dragons.
Seeing this, Ye Yun smiled faintly and accepted the small bottle. Then, he pointed a finger. A sacred white light descended upon the Xuan Bird’s body, instantly suppressing the rampant life energy.
The Xuan Bird took a long deep breath, feeling as if he had just taken a round trip through the Ghost Gate Pass.
It turns out that having excessively strong life energy isn’t always a good thing!
The Xuan Bird laughed awkwardly, his face turning even redder.
Having regained his vitality, his entire being had returned to a youthful state. He looked energetic and vibrant; where was the previously decaying and dying figure?
"Big Brother, what was that stuff the Lord gave Elder Xuan Bird to drink? How can it have such incredible healing effects?" Cat Baby, who had witnessed the entire process, was drooling with envy and quietly asked the Big Black Cat.
"It’s a Mysterious Green Liquid. I don’t know exactly what it is, but I’ve experienced its effects..." the Big Black Cat grinned proudly.
"Ah..." Cat Baby licked her lips, her eyes filled with envy.
"The Lord’s resources are truly profound, to actually possess such a terrifying sacred healing liquid..." Mu Qing, standing nearby, smiled gently, a similar gleam of envy in her eyes.
Hearing the conversation among the three, Ye Yun turned around. With a light flick of his finger, three droplets of green liquid floated before them.
"These are for you. No matter how severe your injuries, you can be healed instantly..." Ye Yun instructed.
"Thank you for the generous gift, Lord!"
The three of them were overjoyed. After bowing in gratitude, they scrambled in their elation to store the green liquid in small vials.
Seeing the clumsy movements of the two demons and one human, Ye Yun chuckled.
This sacred healing liquid, named Water of Life, filled his small green bottle in an amount comparable to all the water in Poyang Lake from his previous life. And in his storage, he had 10,000 more such small bottles.
Moreover, his Sacred Healing Medicines were not limited to this green liquid; he possessed even higher-level ones.
For instance, the Three Lights Divine Water...

chapters.title: Chapter 265: The Distorted System, Gone into Hiding
chapters.content:
Chapter 265: Chapter 265: The Distorted System, Gone into Hiding
This System, such a freak!
Ye Yun remembered how he had been signing in every ten minutes in the Dark Space for one hundred thousand years, an ordeal that had driven him to the brink of collapse countless times.
Whenever he recalled this, he couldn’t resist the urge to curse the System vehemently.
The System had him signing in with such high frequency that, over time, he had become desensitized. To re-stimulate his nerves, the System began to offer rewards that were not only diverse but also increasingly abundant with each sign-in.
So abundant, it was beyond imagination.
Luckily, his warehouses were infinite and could store so many resources.
Ever since the sign-in sessions ended, Ye Yun found that the System had fallen silent.
He had tried calling out to it, but there was no response.
This System really had a personality.
Once the sign-in task was completed, it simply withdrew into isolation...
After his thoughts briefly strayed, Ye Yun exchanged a few more words with the Xuan bird.
To verify the Xuan bird’s words, he had specifically extracted its memories. What the Xuan bird said was indeed true, without any falsehood. Ye Yun had extracted the Xuan bird’s memories stealthily because he was being extremely cautious.
After all, the mastermind was hidden extremely deep and had been continuously setting up schemes along the way.
He was also afraid that the Xuan bird might be one of their pawns.
After validating the Xuan bird’s memories, Ye Yun finally let out a sigh of relief and immediately removed the surrounding restrictions.
"You may have fully recovered physically, but your Primordial Spirit is still somewhat weak. I will teach you a Cultivation Technique to help it slowly recover..."
Ye Yun looked at the Xuan bird and smiled as he spoke.
"Thank you, Master!" the Xuan bird said gratefully.
Ye Yun pointed gently, and a ray of light entered the Xuan bird’s mind.
The Xuan bird felt the wondrous nature of the Primordial Spirit tempering Cultivation Technique in its mind and an expression of ecstatic joy appeared on its face.
Once all this was done, Ye Yun, his hands still clasped behind his back, slowly walked towards the carriage down the mountain.
"Senior, you’ve truly turned misfortune into a blessing this time..." the Big Black Cat said, approaching and smirking at the Xuan bird.
"Yes! If it hadn’t been for Master, I would have died long ago," the Xuan bird said, exhaling deeply, his voice tinged with lingering fear.
"Senior, what is your cultivation base now?" Little Cat asked, blinking her large, lively eyes as she also drew closer.
She had always been very interested in this Xuan bird senior who had lived for a hundred thousand years.
"Although I managed to survive, my cultivation base has dropped quite a bit. Now, I can barely reach the First Level of the Eternal Realm," the Xuan bird said, looking ashamed.
"Wow, so you’re also an Eternal Realm demon, Senior! That’s awesome!" Little Cat exclaimed after a few seconds of surprise, giving the Xuan bird a thumbs-up.
The Xuan bird scratched his head, looking somewhat embarrassed.
Laughing and talking, the group followed Ye Yun down the mountain.
At this moment, a black carriage gradually came into their view.
The Big Black Horse was idly bored when it suddenly looked up and saw Master approaching from a distance.
Huh! Why is there an extra fellow dressed in black?
The Big Black Horse’s gaze fell upon the Xuan bird, finding this person very unfamiliar.
The Big Black Horse curled his lip, baring his large white teeth as he muttered to himself, "He’s also of the Eternal Realm; his cultivation level is just a bit low."
He didn’t pay much mind to this newcomer.
After all, there was still quite a gap compared to his own cultivation level.
The group walked up to the carriage.
When the Xuan bird saw the Big Black Horse pulling the carriage, his eyes narrowed in an instant; he was utterly shocked.
The Big Black Horse pulling the carriage was actually a Great Demon of the Eternal Realm, with a cultivation base even stronger than his own.
"You all get acquainted," Ye Yun said with a smile, then stepped into the carriage.
"Senior, I am the Xuan bird," the Xuan bird said very respectfully to the Big Black Horse, clasping his fists in a salute.
"Brother Xuan Bird, no need for formalities. We’ll get along just fine," the Big Black Horse said with a hearty, nonchalant laugh.
"Uncle Ma, you can’t talk like that! The Xuan bird is a senior!" the Big Black Cat exclaimed, quickly stepping in to smooth things over.
"What did you say? The Xuan bird is a senior? His cultivation base isn’t even as high as mine?" the Big Black Horse retorted with a dismissive laugh.
The Xuan bird felt quite embarrassed upon hearing this.
Although he had lived for over a hundred thousand years, his cultivation base was indeed inferior to that of the Big Black Horse before him.
"Uncle Ma, Senior Xuan Bird was a Divine Beast raised by the Dragon God Sect over a hundred thousand years ago. He’s definitely our senior," the Big Black Cat hurriedly explained.
Over a hundred thousand years ago?
The Big Black Horse was immediately startled.
Someone from the same era as Master?
He quickly amended his tone, "Ah, so it’s Senior Xuan Bird! My apologies, I didn’t realize it before. I was rude!"
The Xuan bird waved his hand and sighed, "It’s fine. From now on, we are all fellow members of the Dragon God Sect."
The Big Black Horse nodded repeatedly, taking this to heart.
"Uncle Ma, this is Mu Qing, the Saintess of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird. She is now serving as our Master’s maid," the Big Black Cat said, taking on the role of introducer.
Mu Qing also knew that the Big Black Horse before her was undoubtedly an unparalleled Great Demon.
From their earlier conversation, even the Xuan bird had admitted his inferiority.
This demonstrated that the Big Black Horse’s cultivation base was also terrifyingly high.
"Greetings, Senior," Mu Qing said, cupping her fists and bowing.
"There’s no need for formalities! We’re all family from now on," the Big Black Horse declared with a hearty laugh.
"Yes," Little Cat chimed in with a giggle from the side.
After speaking, Little Cat was the first to jump onto the carriage, transforming into a cute little white cat.
The Big Black Cat also leaped into the air, transforming into a beam of black light before landing and turning into a black cat.
This?
The Xuan bird was momentarily stunned.
However, he quickly recovered. After all, when he lived in the Hundred Bird Forest, he also used to appear in his demon beast form.
With a quick transformation, he became a small black bird and landed on a front corner of the carriage roof.
Mu Qing was somewhat dumbfounded.
Seeing that all the demon beasts had reverted to their original forms, she didn’t know what she should do.
"You may come in," Ye Yun’s voice sounded from inside the carriage.
"Yes, Master!" Mu Qing replied. Hearing Master’s words, the bewildered Mu Qing snapped out of her daze. She quickly leaped up, jumped onto the carriage, lifted the curtain, and went inside.
"The space here is quite large. Find a spot and sit wherever you like," Ye Yun said with a slight smile.
Then, with a flip of his wrist, he took out the damaged Heavenly Treasures Cover.
Seeing Master take out this treasure again, Mu Qing blinked, wisely chose a corner to sit, and remained silent.
Ye Yun stroked the Heavenly Treasures Cover in his hand, silently reminiscing for a moment before placing it beside him.
Next, he once again reached into the warehouse accessible via his wrist. After several dozen seconds, Ye Yun took out a Bronze Ancient Box, about a zhang in size.
The Bronze Box had an ancient design, was covered with various mysterious runes, and also exuded a peculiar Super Divine Dragon Breath.
What is this?
Upon seeing this mysterious Bronze Ancient Box, Mu Qing’s heart inexplicably throbbed violently, and an indescribable, immense terror instantly washed over her.
"It’s nothing," Ye Yun said, casually waving his hand towards the Bronze Ancient Box, and that terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath instantly disappeared.
Mu Qing took a long, deep breath, her body drenched in fragrant sweat.
Ye Yun stroked the top of the box lightly. With a CLICK, the lid of the Bronze Ancient Box automatically sprang open.
Ye Yun picked up the Heavenly Treasures Cover and lightly tossed it into the Bronze Ancient Box.
What is Master doing?
Mu Qing’s eyes revealed her confusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 266: The Bronze Ancient Box, The Sea of Creation
chapters.content:
Chapter 266: Chapter 266: The Bronze Ancient Box, The Sea of Creation
CLACK!
With a light press of his hand, Ye Yun closed the Bronze Ancient Box once more.
He then sat upright, closed his eyes, and began to rest his mind.
So the Master has chosen to treasure this Heavenly Treasures Cover...
Mu Qing smiled faintly.
She glanced around; apart from a wooden table and several stools, there was nothing else.
She was idle, her assigned task from the Master being to serve tea and fetch water. But now...it seemed the Master had no intention of drinking tea.
"Master, would you like some tea? Or perhaps I should boil some water?" Mu Qing finally mustered the courage to ask after a long hesitation.
"Not right now; we can discuss it later..." Ye Yun replied calmly, his eyes still closed.
Mu Qing acknowledged and then took out the small bottle Ye Yun had previously given her. Gazing at the single, mysterious green drop of liquid it contained, a look of joy blossomed on her exquisite face.
This is a drop of Divine Liquid! Any grievous injury can be healed by drinking it; it’s truly incredible!
After admiring it fondly for a moment, Mu Qing put the bottle away.
Then she closed her eyes and began her cultivation.
Just a few minutes into her cultivation, she suddenly remembered something.
Wasn’t there a little red cat? Where has it gone?
Just as this thought crossed her mind, Mu Qing heard the Big Black Cat outside asking, "Uncle Ma, where did that senior go?"
"He went to carry out the Master’s instructions..." the Big Black Horse replied casually, its head lowered as it walked slowly along the mountain path.
"I see." The Big Black Cat nodded. Noticing Uncle Ma seemed dispirited, apparently weary of pulling the carriage, its eyes began to twinkle.
I have to cheer Uncle Ma up somehow. After all, Uncle Ma has taken such good care of me on this journey.
Just as the Big Black Cat was wracking its brains, Mu Qing, thanks to the saying ’walls have ears,’ learned of the little red cat’s whereabouts.
"It should be about time..."
Just as Mu Qing was preparing to resume her cultivation, she suddenly heard the Master’s voice near her ear.
When she opened her eyes, she saw the Master placing his hand on the Bronze Ancient Box once again.
Mu Qing was utterly bewildered.
What exactly is the Master planning? Didn’t he put the Heavenly Treasures Cover in the box to store it safely? And what did he mean by ’it should be about time’ just now? Does treasuring it only take a short while?
Mu Qing widened her eyes, watching Ye Yun’s movements without blinking.
Seeing the shocked expression on Mu Qing’s face, Ye Yun wasn’t concerned.
With a light push of his hand, the Bronze Ancient Box clicked open once again.
Ye Yun’s gaze penetrated deep inside the box.
The interior of the Bronze Ancient Box was extremely vast, containing a golden ocean that emitted a faint, mystical glow.
At this moment, the Heavenly Treasures Cover was immersed in the golden ocean, absorbing a kind of mystical golden light.
Soon, the Heavenly Treasures Cover looked entirely different from its previous ancient and weathered appearance.
It could be said that it was now completely renewed.
Most importantly, the Heavenly Treasures Cover’s grade had skyrocketed from Earth Level to the current Emperor Level Middle Grade.
It was now only one small grade away from its former peak of Emperor Level Top Grade.
Ye Yun waited quietly.
He estimated that it wouldn’t take long for the Heavenly Treasures Cover to be fully restored.
Mu Qing sat opposite Ye Yun, unable to see the scene inside the Bronze Box.
However, she didn’t dare to go over for a look, merely guessing anxiously at the motive behind the Master’s actions.
In merely the space of about ten breaths, the grade of the Heavenly Treasures Cover had completely reached Emperor Level Top Grade.
With a light grasp from Ye Yun, the Heavenly Treasures Cover flew out from the golden sea, out of the Bronze Ancient Box, and into his hand.
Gazing at the brand-new Heavenly Treasures Cover, its familiar patterns distinct, Ye Yun couldn’t help but sigh deeply.
At this moment, he seemed to see his good brother, Lei Cheng, standing before him again.
How he wished he could present this restored Heavenly Treasures Cover to Lei Cheng once more!
But he knew this was all just a vain hope.
Now, the restored Heavenly Treasures Cover could only be presented to his good brother’s descendant, Lei Qinian.
The Heavenly Treasures Cover in Ye Yun’s hand was entirely golden, adorned with various ancient patterns, and radiated a soft, shimmering golden light.
It exuded an extremely sacred aura.
From a distance, Mu Qing watched the Heavenly Treasures Cover, now as good as new. Her large eyes widened in astonishment, and she stood as still as a statue.
Mu Qing was utterly shocked.
She had personally witnessed an Earth Level treasure being placed into the Bronze Ancient Box, and in less time than it takes for an incense stick to burn, it emerged restored to Emperor Level Top Grade.
This was utterly unbelievable.
What kind of treasure is this Bronze Ancient Box? Its speed at repairing treasures is astonishing!
According to Mu Qing’s knowledge, on the Cangnan Continent, restoring an Emperor Level Top Grade artifact would demand an unimaginable amount of manpower, materials, and financial resources.
It might take several hundred years to successfully restore it.
Yet, the Master had restored the Heavenly Treasures Cover in such a short time, merely by using the Bronze Ancient Box.
This is simply too incredible!
Mu Qing muttered to herself, unable to stop the words from escaping.
Seeing Mu Qing’s astounded expression, Ye Yun smiled calmly and asked, "Do you happen to have any damaged artifacts?"
Hearing his question, Mu Qing finally snapped out of her shock.
She did indeed possess an artifact, one she had acquired from the Wu Kun Mountain Black Market, but it too was damaged.
Its quality had severely degraded.
She took out a bead. Raising it with trembling hands, she asked in a quavering voice, "Master, can you repair this for me?"
"No problem." Ye Yun smiled faintly and took the bead from her.
This bead, known as the Bead of Focus, was merely a Lower level of the heavenly grade artifact used to aid cultivation.
Ye Yun gently tossed it, casting the Bead of Focus into the Bronze Ancient Box.
Mu Qing mustered her courage, took a few steps forward, and peered into the Bronze Ancient Box.
What she saw astonished her once more.
Inside the Bronze Ancient Box lay an unexpectedly vast golden sea, and her Bead of Focus was within it, continuously absorbing the golden light.
"Master, what kind of treasure is this Bronze Box of yours?" Mu Qing stammered.
"This Bronze Ancient Box doesn’t have a name..." Ye Yun smiled faintly.
This Bronze Ancient Box truly has no name, but it possesses unimaginable power of creation. If I had to give it a name, I might as well call it The Sea of Creation!
This thought, however, only flickered in Ye Yun’s mind for an instant, and he didn’t share it with Mu Qing.
Ye Yun wasn’t actually concerned about the name of this Bronze Ancient Box; he had far too many artifacts in his collection.
He possessed tens of thousands of artifacts capable of repairing other treasures in his inventory alone.
Ye Yun had simply chosen this Bronze Ancient Box—one whose grade was acceptable by this world’s standards—to restore the Heavenly Treasures Cover.
After only two or three breaths, "Alright, it’s done." Ye Yun reached out, and the Bead of Focus flew out of the box.
At this moment, the Bead of Focus had advanced from the Lower level of the heavenly grade to Emperor Level Lower Grade.
It had ascended an entire major tier in grade.
The Bead of Focus had been restored to its original grade.

chapters.title: Chapter 267: Uncle Ma, Immortal Tea Offered As A Mark Of Filial Duty To You
chapters.content:
Chapter 267: Chapter 267: Uncle Ma, Immortal Tea Offered As A Mark Of Filial Duty To You
Ye Yun held the Bead of Focus, briefly examining it before casually tossing it to Mu Qing with a faint smile.
In his opinion, this Bead of Focus was utter rubbish—merely an Emperor Level Lower Grade, only capable of providing minor cultivation assistance for mental clarity and focus. It was practically useless.
He considered giving Mu Qing an artifact but decided against it. After all, Mu Qing had just joined the Dragon God Sect and hadn’t made any significant contributions yet, so it wasn’t appropriate to give her an artifact now. Although Ye Yun’s storage was filled with countless artifacts, he disliked distributing them willy-nilly. Even for the three disciples of the Dragon God Sect, he had only given each of them a sword and a robe, nothing more.
Having lived two lives, Ye Yun deeply understood the weaknesses of human nature. Some things are far more meaningful when earned through one’s own efforts. If treasures were given away freely, it would be no different from raising a wastrel.
"It’s repaired this quickly?"
Mu Qing accepted the Bead of Focus, her face full of surprise, her watery eyes brightening.
The Bead of Focus in her hand looked brand new, emanating a cool, refreshing aura that calmed her mind and spirit.
This aura was countless times stronger than before.
Mu Qing was inwardly shaken.
What kind of treasure is this Bronze Ancient Box? In just two or three breaths, a Lower level of the heavenly grade artifact was restored to its original peak condition. This is simply incredible! I’ve lived for so long, yet I’ve never heard of such a powerful artifact for repairing treasures on the Cangnan Continent.
What Mu Qing didn’t know was...
It wasn’t just the Cangnan Continent that lacked such a treasure; even the Divine Land didn’t have one!
In the Divine Land, repairing artifacts required a Refining Master to use various materials and formations.
The process was not only complex but also incredibly time-consuming.
It was impossible to repair artifacts as quickly and easily as the Bronze Ancient Box could.
The Bronze Ancient Box had no upper limit.
It wasn’t just Emperor Level treasures...
Even Emperor Level and God level items could be quickly and completely repaired within the Bronze Ancient Box.
After repairing the Bead of Focus, Ye Yun waved his hand, and the Bronze Ancient Box returned to his storage.
Then, Ye Yun sat down, closed his eyes, and focused on his cultivation.
The entire carriage once again fell into a state of tranquility.
Mu Qing remained in stunned silence for a long time before her emotions finally calmed.
In the future, if I get the chance, I must visit more auction houses or black markets to find treasures that have degraded in quality. Then I can ask Master to repair them...
As Mu Qing sat down, she began to indulge in these fantasies, her exquisite face repeatedly showing expressions of pleasant surprise.
It would be best if I could find an Emperor Level treasure... If it were restored, I would possess an Emperor artifact!
Thinking this, Mu Qing couldn’t help but feel a thrill and shiver slightly.
But she quickly suppressed this thought. An Emperor artifact, even a damaged one, was not something one could easily find. After all, any power that once possessed an Emperor artifact would undoubtedly have a significant heritage and would surely try everything to restore it. The chances of such an item appearing on the market were extremely low.
Just as Mu Qing was lost in her reverie, the Big Black Cat outside the carriage suddenly widened his eyes, a joyful gleam appearing in his gaze.
I’ve been trying to think of a way to cheer Uncle Ma up.
After pondering for a long time, the Big Black Cat finally came up with a reasonably good idea.
"Uncle Ma, guess what kind of treasure I managed to get this time?"
The Big Black Cat grinned slyly, a fawning smile plastered on his face.
"What treasure could you have? What rare thing could a scruffy little cat like you possibly find?"
The Big Black Horse said, slowly pulling the carriage without even lifting his head.
"Hehe, Uncle Ma, that’s not necessarily true,"
The Big Black Cat immediately retrieved a small, transparent glass vial from his storage ring. Inside were two emerald-green tea leaves.
"Uncle Ma, take a look! See if this is worthy of your esteemed gaze?"
The Big Black Cat stood up, holding the small vial aloft with his paw and shaking it a couple of times.
"What is it? Showing off like this."
The Big Black Horse casually turned his head. His eyes immediately fell upon the two vibrant, dew-kissed tea leaves in the small vial.
When his gaze fell upon the tea leaves, he noticed Dao patterns on them, and his eyes widened in astonishment.
These tea leaves are extraordinary!
The Big Black Horse instantly realized these were no ordinary tea leaves.
Seeing the change in Uncle Ma’s expression, the Big Black Cat smirked.
He leaped into the air, flew beside the Big Black Horse, opened the small vial, and took out one of the green tea leaves.
"Uncle Ma, this is a type of Immortal Tea that the Old Man once drank. Even though it’s been steeped once, its medicinal power is still incredibly potent. Back then, just a whiff made me pass out. I almost died! Thankfully, the Old Man intervened, otherwise you wouldn’t be seeing your Little Cat here anymore..."
The Big Black Cat explained with a laugh, his voice trembling slightly by the end.
The sheer potency of the Old Man’s Immortal Tea truly terrified me.
"Is that so? This tea is actually that powerful?"
With a mere thought, the Big Black Horse caused the green tea leaf to float up before his eyes. He examined the leaf carefully, growing more astonished the longer he looked.
After inhaling its faint aroma, the Big Black Horse instantly felt two opposing forces—creation and destruction—constantly tearing at each other within his body.
It was like being on a vast ocean brimming with life, yet volcanoes continuously erupted from the seabed, transforming the entire surface into a terrifying, apocalyptic scene.
The Big Black Horse was, after all, a great demon of the Eternity Realm and possessed the Dragon Clan Bloodline. He could still suppress the changes in his body caused by that tiny wisp of the tea’s fragrance.
While suppressing and refining it, an expression of blissful intoxication appeared on his face.
"WAH WAH, this is truly excellent! This tea leaf is practically an Immortal Tea!"
The Big Black Horse became excited.
After refining the energy from that wisp of fragrance, he felt his cultivation base seemed to have improved by a fraction.
"Uncle Ma, this tea leaf is my gift of respect to you."
The Big Black Cat chuckled.
Seeing Uncle Ma excited, he also felt happy and put the small vial away.
He had only two Immortal Tea leaves in total.
Now, having given one to Uncle Ma, he was left with only one.
The Big Black Horse’s expression softened. He raised his hoof, which transformed into a large hand, and gently patted the Big Black Cat’s head a couple of times, praising, "Good, Little Cat. Uncle Ma hasn’t doted on you in vain. You remembered to save something good for Uncle Ma. Truly excellent!"
"But of course, Uncle Ma! We’re close!"
The Big Black Cat chuckled, then turned and flew back.
He landed in front of Kitty, his expression somewhat fierce.
"Big Brother, what are you doing?"
Seeing the Big Black Cat’s fierce expression, Kitty was instantly frightened, her heart pounding.
"I say, Kitty, your cultivation base is so low. It’s too extravagant for you to hoard two Immortal Tea leaves. Why not offer one to Uncle Ma as a sign of respect too?"
Seeing Kitty avoid his gaze, the Big Black Cat’s expression instantly changed, becoming amiable and friendly as he said with a smile.
"You want my Immortal Tea?"
Hearing this, Kitty was on the verge of tears.
