Originally, there were four Immortal Tea leaves left in the bowl after the Old Man finished drinking. Two of them were given to the Big Black Cat back at Wu Kun Mountain.
Who would have thought that I wouldn’t even be able to keep the remaining two...

chapters.title: Chapter 268: Two Shields Combined, Invincible in the World
chapters.content:
Chapter 268: Chapter 268: Two Shields Combined, Invincible in the World
"Maobao’er, what nonsense are you spouting? It’s not that I want it; it’s for you to offer Uncle Ma a piece as a sign of respect. Can’t you even bear to do that?"
The Big Black Cat angrily raised his paw and thwacked Maobao’er on the head.
Stars swirled before Maobao’er’s eyes, their rims instantly reddening as tears welled up, glistening.
"You’re bullying me again!" Maobao’er wailed.
"I’m not bullying you; I’m doing this for your own good. Uncle Ma isn’t an outsider; you can’t be so stingy," the Big Black Cat lectured earnestly.
"But I originally had four pieces!" Maobao’er retorted stubbornly, still not producing the tea leaf.
She originally had four pieces. The Big Black Cat had taken half on Wu Kun Mountain, and now, of the remaining two, another half was about to be taken.
Maobao’er’s heart ached as if it were bleeding.
Seeing Maobao’er’s stubbornness, the Big Black Cat sighed, "Yes, you had four pieces, and you gave me two. Wasn’t that to thank me for helping you break off your engagement..."
After a moment of silence, Maobao’er reluctantly drew out a Small Jade Bottle and poured out a green tea leaf.
The Big Black Cat was instantly overjoyed, grabbing the green tea leaf and floating towards Uncle Ma.
"Uncle Ma, you see, Maobao’er here is quite considerate. She’s also sent a piece of Immortal Tea for you," the Big Black Cat said with a smile.
"Maobao’er is indeed considerate. As her senior, I can’t just accept it without giving something in return." Uncle Ma felt a bit embarrassed, a hint of awkwardness on his face. He gave a slight shake, and a black scale flew out from his body.
Uncle Ma breathed out blue lightning from his mouth onto the scale and began to refine it.
"TSK TSK..." An admiring look filled the Big Black Cat’s eyes.
"Maobao’er, as I said, Uncle Ma wouldn’t just take your Immortal Tea for nothing," the Big Black Cat glanced at Maobao’er behind him and declared proudly.
Maobao’er wiped her tears and nodded, her eyes still red.
Just then, Uncle Ma completed his refining, and a Black Shield appeared.
"Maobao’er, I don’t have much else to give. How about I give you a shield?" Uncle Ma chuckled softly. A wave of Mana swept out, and the Black Shield floated towards Maobao’er.
A shield?
Upon seeing the small Black Shield fluttering towards her, Maobao’er quickly grabbed it, her face lighting up with excitement.
She had seen the power of the Big Black Cat’s Black Shield before; it not only possessed an incredibly strong defense but also had offensive Divine Skills.
With the shield in her hand, Maobao’er’s tears of grievance turned into a smile of joy.
The Big Black Cat floated over, took out his own Black Shield, and compared them. "Not bad," he remarked, "our shields look exactly the same."
Maobao’er nodded. Their shields were indeed identical.
The Big Black Cat scratched his head with his paw and chuckled, "From now on, with our shields combined, we’ll be invincible!"
Hearing this, Maobao’er couldn’t help but giggle, her earlier feelings of grievance vanishing instantly.
Uncle Ma also nodded. Seeing Maobao’er happy, he, as a senior, also felt relieved.
After all, a mere Little Monster in the Divine Bridge Realm had offered him a piece of Immortal Tea, which made him, an Eternal Realm Elder, feel somewhat uneasy.
Now that he had given away a Black Shield, he felt much better.
Maobao’er began refining the Black Shield.
The Big Black Cat also put away his Black Shield and started cultivating.
He was still diligently cultivating the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye. He was extremely dedicated to this Divine Skill.
Uncle Ma put away one tea leaf. As for the other, he used his Mana to affix it between his eyebrows, continuously absorbing the fragrance it emitted. The aroma did not leak out at all, completely controlled by his Mana.
Uncle Ma, having shaken off his earlier fatigue and despondency, pulled the carriage forward once more, soon disappearing into the depths of the valley.
「Inside the carriage...」
Mu Qing had witnessed the entire event. Her heart was filled with a mix of shock and joy.
She hadn’t expected that the Master’s leftover tea leaves were actually Immortal Tea with such incredibly potent effects.
Now, her task was to serve tea and water to the Master. From now on, wouldn’t she be able to collect all the tea leaves the Master left behind?
The mere thought made Mu Qing so excited she felt like screaming.
Being the Master’s maid was truly great! So wonderful!
Her former status as the Saintess of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird had seemed lofty and prestigious, but in reality, it was utterly useless.
Being a maid for the Master is truly great...
Mu Qing closed her eyes, the corners of her mouth curling up in a smile, a hint of excitement on her face.
「Three thousand miles from Wu Kun Mountain.」
A huge flying ship was anchored atop a mountain.
This type of vessel, also called a ferry boat, specialized in transporting Cultivators and goods between different dynastic territories.
Many Cultivators stood on the dock, queuing to board the flying ship. Lei Qinian was among them, slowly moving forward with the crowd.
Also in the crowd was a young man in a red robe, his hands clasped behind his back. He was constantly looking around with a nonchalant, devil-may-care expression.
He looked as if he wouldn’t bat an eye even if the sky fell, giving off the air of a pampered young master from some prominent family.
The red-robed young man was queuing behind Lei Qinian, seven or eight people between them. His gaze kept drifting, intentionally or otherwise, towards Lei Qinian.
The Master instructed me to look after this lad. I must keep a close watch and ensure nothing goes wrong...
the red-robed young man thought to himself.
He was a great demon of the Eternal Realm. Ordinarily, he wouldn’t need to be so cautious for such a minor task.
But the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was inherently cunning and calculating, far from a simpleton. Thus, he did not underestimate this seemingly small task assigned by the Master.
He knew that the young man before him, merely at the Fifth Level of the Nirvana Realm, had an extraordinary background and status.
Otherwise, given the Master’s noble status, he would never have assigned him, a great demon of the Eternal Realm, to personally escort the youth.
The queue moved slowly forward.
At the entrance to the flying ship, a table was set up. Several Cultivators guarded it, responsible for collecting Spirit Stones.
Finally, it was Lei Qinian’s turn.
"I’m going to the Heavenly Moon Secret Region in the Heavenly Moon Dynasty. How many Spirit Stones will that be?" Lei Qinian asked.
"Thirty thousand," the middle-aged man at the table, who was responsible for records, replied, lifting his head.
"Is that you? Surnamed Li? Li Qinian?" The middle-aged man looked at Lei Qinian with surprise.
Lei Qinian was also slightly taken aback upon seeing the middle-aged man.
Decades ago, the two had come to blows over a Spirit Grass, and a feud had existed between them ever since.
Unexpectedly, they had run into each other again on this flying ship.
"You, Li! The price for the Heavenly Moon Secret Region has gone up. It’s 100,000 Spirit Stones per ticket now," the middle-aged man said, his expression darkening.
"One hundred thousand?" Hearing this number, Lei Qinian’s mind buzzed.
He only had a little over 30,000 Spirit Stones in his storage ring—nowhere near enough.
"Zhou Chun An, are you abusing your position to settle a personal score?" Lei Qinian took a deep breath, staring intently at the middle-aged man as he demanded.
"What nonsense are you spouting? Our Skywalker Commerce Alliance’s flying ships have always been fairly priced. We never arbitrarily raise them!" the middle-aged man sneered.
"You clearly said 30,000 Spirit Stones just now! Why has it suddenly jumped to 100,000?" Lei Qinian demanded angrily.
"I misspoke earlier. The price I just quoted you is the true fare to the Heavenly Moon Secret Region..." Zhou Chun An said with a cold laugh, a triumphant glint in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 269: Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, Rampage on the Ferry
chapters.content:
Chapter 269: Chapter 269: Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, Rampage on the Ferry
The reason Zhou Chun An held such a deep grudge against Lei Qinian was because, decades ago, they had brawled over a Spirit Grass, and Lei Qinian had injured him.
Although Zhou Chun An ultimately obtained the Spirit Grass, the incident had always been a thorn in his side.
However, in all these decades, he had not encountered Lei Qinian again, and thus the grudge had been left unresolved.
Now that he was working at the Tianxing Commercial Firm, he had even fewer opportunities to seek out Lei Qinian.
But to his surprise, he chanced upon Lei Qinian at this very ferry crossing.
As a minor manager in charge of collecting fees, he had a certain amount of power.
He could increase the price for Lei Qinian.
If Lei Qinian wanted to be a big spender, he would let the young man bleed his pockets dry.
If Lei Qinian didn’t have enough Spirit Stones, he would tell him to scram, thus venting his anger.
There were always plenty of passengers looking to board the ferry.
He didn’t need to worry about the Tianxing Commercial Firm’s income at all.
If his superiors questioned him, he could just make up the thirty thousand Spirit Stones himself.
His sole aim was to vent this frustration.
Zhou Chun An knew that if he prevented Lei Qinian from boarding this ship, it would be impossible for Lei Qinian to reach the Heavenly Moon Secret Region within a few days.
By the time Lei Qinian found another way to get to the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, the Secret Realm would have long since closed.
His goal was to ensure Lei Qinian’s efforts came to nothing.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, witnessing this from behind, felt a muscle in his face twitch twice as a cold light gleamed in his eyes.
The Master was indeed correct in ordering me to protect this young fellow.
It’s fortunate I came, or Lei Qinian might not have even been able to board the ship.
"Make way, make way."
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon pushed aside the few people in front of him and strode forward.
The people he pushed aside were furious and about to confront the red-robed young man. However, one glare from the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon sent them retreating, too scared to say anything.
The killing intent in the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s eyes was too intense; these people were terrified and dared not provoke any conflict.
So what if he cut the line? Best not to provoke such a murderous figure, lest they be the ones to suffer in a fight,
they thought.
"No cutting! Everyone needs to queue properly!" a man shouted at the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon.
"Queue for what? My wanting to board this flying ship is giving you face. Don’t ask for trouble," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon scoffed, stepping forward and slamming his hand on the table.
"I’ll cover his ticket. Let him in," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said coldly to Zhou Chun An, pointing at Lei Qinian.
Zhou Chun An looked at the red-robed young man before him and saw that his blood-red eyes had vertical pupils, radiating an astonishing killing intent.
A single glance made him tremble all over in fear.
Faced with this sudden development, Zhou Chun An quickly reassessed the situation.
This red-robed young man is a Destiny Realm cultivator, far stronger than a Nirvana Realm cultivator like me.
Since this person is willing to pay the Spirit Stones for Lei Qinian, there’s no need for me to press the issue.
Once Lei Qinian is on the ship, I’ll have other ways to deal with him.
"Let him in," Zhou Chun An waved at his subordinates.
The young men blocking the entrance immediately stepped aside, clearing a path.
"This..." Lei Qinian was a bit taken aback.
He didn’t know this red-robed young man at all.
However, seeing the evil aura on the red-robed young man’s face, Lei Qinian felt a little intimidated. He simply cupped his fists in thanks, then turned and boarded the ship.
Seeing Lei Qinian on the ship, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon heaved a sigh of relief.
At this moment, Zhou Chun An squeezed out an obsequious smile and said softly, "Senior, for the two of you, that will be 60,000 Spirit Stones."
"Shouldn’t it be 130,000?"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon glanced sideways at Zhou Chun An, asking with a sneer.
"Since Senior knows that young man, we’ll stick to the original price..." Zhou Chun An chuckled awkwardly.
"Heh heh, I’m broke right now. Not a single Spirit Stone on me..." the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon patted his chest brazenly and laughed heartily.
No money? Not even a single Spirit Stone?
Zhou Chun An was absolutely stunned.
So this fellow plans to ride for free?
The Tianxing Commercial Firm isn’t a pushover.
There was a team of guards on this flying ship, responsible for maintaining order and ensuring the vessel’s safety throughout the journey.
After all, the journey from the Heavenly Star Dynasty to the Heavenly Moon Dynasty was long, and they were very likely to encounter Demon Beast attacks along the way.
"Senior, if you cannot provide the Spirit Stones, neither you nor Lei Qinian will be allowed to board."
Zhou Chun An’s expression hardened. He had already noticed a team of guards rapidly approaching their location.
There were ten such small squads on the flying ship, taking turns on duty.
"Are you courting death?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon roared. "My wanting to ride your ship is an honor for you! Must you be so shameless?"
He was furious.
An Eternal Realm great demon like him, paying Spirit Stones to ride a flying ship?
If he were truly angered, one slap would be enough to smash this flying ship to pieces.
Of course, he only vented this anger internally.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon would absolutely not recklessly interfere with the mission his Master had given him.
After all, his duty was to protect Lei Qinian in secret.
As the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon spoke, he deliberately released the powerful aura of the Destiny Realm.
He had no choice; his original cultivation base was too high. To protect Lei Qinian secretly, he had to suppress his cultivation.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, much like Big Black Horse, loved to join in on the excitement.
Instead of using Divine Skills to protect Lei Qinian secretly, he transformed into a Demon Clan cultivator at the Destiny Realm and appeared before everyone, protecting Lei Qinian openly.
This way, I won’t feel lonely on the journey,
he thought.
At least I can chat with Lei Qinian along the way and relieve some boredom.
"Bold! Who dares cause trouble on a ship of our Tianxing Commercial Firm?"
The squad of about ten people quickly approached. It consisted of five Destiny Realm cultivators and five Nirvana Realm cultivators.
"I want to ride your ship, that’s showing you respect! And you still want me to pay Spirit Stones?"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon crossed his arms, looking as defiant as a dead pig unafraid of boiling water.
He had just emerged from the depths of Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge and truly didn’t have a single Spirit Stone on him.
Several Destiny Realm cultivators surrounded the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon. The leader, a middle-aged man, observed him, his eyes flickering.
It’s a young member of the Demon Clan,
the middle-aged man thought, inwardly alarmed as he sensed the faint Demonic Aura emanating from the other party.
When the Human Race and Demon Clan fight at the same realm, the Human Race is often slightly weaker. And this red-robed young man’s cultivation base has reached Destiny Realm Level 5, the same as mine. If we were to fight, I might not necessarily be his opponent.
The middle-aged man considered this and felt it was best to maintain peace.
After all, he didn’t want to engage in a major fight with this young Demon Clan member over a mere thirty thousand Spirit Stones. If anyone from their guard team was injured or killed, the cost would far exceed tens of thousands of Spirit Stones.

chapters.title: Chapter 271 Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass
chapters.content:
Chapter 271: Chapter 271 Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass
"Are you fucking asking for death?"
Seeing someone provoke him, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was displeased, halting abruptly like a thrown javelin.
A fierce gleam shot from his eyes as he stared coldly at these unfamiliar cultivators.
In that moment, he exuded a powerful aura indicative of a cultivator at Level Five of the Destiny Realm.
Among the eight individuals opposing him, six were cultivators in the Nirvana Realm. Upon sensing his formidable aura, their faces changed dramatically, and they all retreated.
"Sir, we mean you no harm and have no intention of fighting you. Please don’t be so aggressive," the old man at the Destiny Realm quickly stepped in front of the others, arms spread wide, shielding them from the overwhelming pressure.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon squinted slightly.
This old man’s cultivation base is at Level Eight of the Destiny Realm, three minor realms higher than the level I’m displaying. Under normal circumstances, many people would think that this old man’s strength would be higher than mine, a ’Great Demon of Destiny Realm Level Five.’
But surprisingly, the old man’s tone changed, and he didn’t continue to provoke him.
"If you don’t want to fight, then shut your mouth," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon retorted coldly.
I don’t want to cause a big scene here. My cultivation realm is far too high; I have no desire to bully these insignificant Destiny Realm cultivators. My mission is to protect Lei Qinian. Anyway, it will only be a few days before the airship reaches the Heavenly Moon Secret Region. At most, it will be seven days. I just need to endure it. In my mind, completing the Master’s task is my highest priority. As for things like showing off, slapping faces, or bullying others, I couldn’t care less.
"Good, we’ll leave each other alone," the old cultivator said, taking a deep breath. His face was slightly flushed as he nodded.
Just a moment ago, I felt the chilling premonition of death. That’s why I changed my attitude so quickly. I’m not confident I can defeat this imposing Great Demon at Level Five of the Destiny Realm. After all, some members of the Demon Clan possess astonishing Innate Divine Abilities, far surpassing Human cultivators.
"Hmph. Good that you know your place," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon snorted coldly. He ignored them and walked past.
Lei Qinian, his palms sweating, finally calmed down and slowly walked towards his bunk.
I had been terrified that this senior would fight them. If they started fighting, the ship would be destroyed. Although the ship is protected by Formations, a battle between Destiny Realm cultivators would severely damage them.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon walked to the ninth bunk and sat down with an imposing air.
I chose this spot to better protect Lei Qinian. I’ll leave the tenth bunk for Lei Qinian, as it’s furthest from the other eight cultivators.
"Thank you for your care along the way, Senior." Lei Qinian was extremely grateful and bowed deeply again to express his thanks.
From boarding the airship to settling into the room, the red-robed senior had taken care of him. Lei Qinian was immensely grateful.
"Don’t mention it. I only helped you because I find you agreeable," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon chuckled, then closed his eyes to rest.
Lei Qinian also sat on his bunk and began his Cultivation.
As they were both cultivators, seven days of meditation would pass in a flash.
「Meanwhile, in another direction...」
The Big Black Horse pulled a carriage, seemingly at a slow pace, but in reality, it was much faster than the ferry.
Ye Yun was in no hurry.
As long as I reach the Heavenly Moon Secret Region before it opens, it will be fine.
He had just glanced in a certain direction, his gaze falling upon the ten-person room where the atmosphere was extremely tense.
Ye Yun couldn’t help but smile faintly.
When it comes to carrying out missions, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s style is completely different from that of the Big Black Horse and the Big Black Cat. This fellow is adaptable and resilient, cunning, and capable of handling various crises.
Ye Yun’s gaze casually swept over the ferry.
"Hmm? Isn’t that Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass?" Ye Yun murmured to himself.
He had unexpectedly spotted a stalk of Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass in the ten-person room next to Lei Qinian’s. This stalk of Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass was entirely emerald green, resembling a Phoenix about to take flight, and it radiated an astonishing aura. The grade of this Immortal Herb was quite high, reaching the Emperor Level Lower Grade.
What interests me is that my first encounter with Nangong Jade, one hundred thousand years ago, was due to a dispute over a Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass.
「Back then...」
I had hidden my identity and teased Nangong Jade. It was at that moment Nangong Jade had fallen for me. I have plenty of Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass in my storage.
After a single glance, Ye Yun lost interest and looked away.
He swallowed a few pills and resumed his Cultivation.
This time, by the time I reach the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, I plan to elevate my cultivation base to the eighth layer of the Divine Monarch Realm.
The room next to Lei Qinian’s was also a ten-person room. Ten people occupied it. They were dressed uniformly, apparently from the same faction. The man in the lead had a pale complexion, as if he had lost a significant amount of blood, and his aura was weaker than an ordinary person’s.
"My Lord, please, consume this Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass. I feel your body is about to give out..." an old man beside him said, holding up a Jade Box, inside which lay a stalk of entirely emerald green Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass.
"There’s no need. I can still endure..." the pale-faced middle-aged man replied, his eyes slightly closed as he gently shook his head.
"My Lord, I understand your intentions. You wish to go to the Heavenly Moon Dynasty and find Master Zeng to refine it into a Nine Turn Spring Back Pill. That way, none of the Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass’s medicinal efficacy will be wasted..." the old man sighed. His cultivation was at Destiny Realm Level Seven, which was quite high. Among everyone in the room, his realm ranked second. The one ranked first was, naturally, this pale-faced Lord, who had reached Destiny Realm Level Nine. However, due to a severe injury, his current strength was greatly diminished, making it difficult for him to engage in combat.
"Put the box away. Those people next door are eyeing us like tigers stalking their prey. We don’t know when they might strike..." the middle-aged man coughed, a flicker of worry deep in his eyes.
I wonder who leaked the information that I possess an Emperor Level Lower Grade Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass. That group, though two fewer in number than ours, has been tailing us for so long yet still hasn’t made a move. What could they be planning? Are they waiting for reinforcements? In just two more days, we’ll reach Heavenly Moon City. Once I disembark there, I’ll be safe. No matter how audacious those people next door are, they wouldn’t dare to act in Dark Moon City. After all, the City Lord of Dark Moon City is my sworn brother.
Hearing the man’s words, the old man put the box away, returning it to his storage ring. Although the Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass had just emitted an astonishing aura, it hadn’t leaked out of the room due to the restriction array set up inside.
"Everyone, stay vigilant! That group will likely try to make their move in the next two days..." the old man scanned the room, speaking solemnly.
"Understood!" the other eight replied solemnly.
The pale-faced man glanced towards the adjacent room.
Although our group is slightly stronger than our neighbors, I can’t shake an uneasy premonition. That group has relentlessly pursued us all the way onto this ferry. When exactly will they truly strike? Making a move on a Tianxing Commercial Firm vessel isn’t easy; after all, there is a security team of a hundred guards here.
The enormous ferry sped through the sky at high altitude.
「At this moment.」
A ten-man squad stood on the deck at the bow of the ship. Their leader was an old man in white, a cultivator at Destiny Realm Level Eight.
A thousand li ahead of the ferry, dark clouds gathered, fierce gales arose, and streaks of lightning, like restless thunder serpents, slithered out from the churning clouds.

chapters.title: Chapter 272: Thunderbolt Shadow Mountain, Void Wolf Attack
chapters.content:
Chapter 272: Chapter 272: Thunderbolt Shadow Mountain, Void Wolf Attack
"Sir, the place ahead where the lightning converges, that’s Thunderbolt Shadow Mountain. Recently, there have been reports of Void Wolves appearing," a middle-aged man whispered, walking up to the old man.
"Hmm, I hope there aren’t too many Void Wolves around..." The old man nodded, his face becoming increasingly grave.
Looking at the intertwined lightning ahead, a celestial phenomenon, he had an ominous premonition.
The Tianxing Commercial Firm’s flying ship had a large protective array; ordinary lightning caused by natural phenomena would not cause any damage. What he worried about most was an attack by demon beasts.
In particular, the Void Wolf, a strange demon beast that appeared and disappeared without a trace, usually attacked in groups. If it attacked the flying ship, it would lead to an unimaginably fierce battle.
Void Wolves were known for their cruelty, bloodlust, and preference for devouring human Cultivators.
There were as many as ten thousand human Cultivators on this flying ship.
To the Void Wolves, this was an irresistible temptation.
Just as the old man was worrying, figures of demon beasts with terrifying auras suddenly materialized out of thin air atop a large mountain in the Thunderbolt Shadow Mountain range.
A flash of lightning illuminated the entire mountain range.
A dense pack of colossal, blood-colored wolves suddenly revealed their true forms on the mountaintop.
Each blood-colored giant wolf was dozens of feet long, wreathed in a bloody aura, its eyes glinting with bloodthirsty killing intent.
Just at the moment the lightning flashed, all the figures of the blood-colored giant wolves vanished from the sky in an instant.
The next moment, they appeared in another valley.
They kept leaping through the void, as if chasing the lightning falling from the sky.
The Void Wolf possessed Spatial Divinities for short-distance jumps and the ability to conceal itself within space.
Among the many demon beasts, it was one that human Cultivators particularly dreaded.
The Tianxing Commercial Firm’s flying ship quickly headed toward the thunderclouds thousands of miles away.
This expanse of thunderclouds was vast. It was their unavoidable path, and they certainly would not detour simply because of lightning interference.
「Within the ten-person Room No. 27.」
An old man at Destiny Realm Level Eight suddenly opened his eyes, a sharp, cold light flashing within them.
The others in the room sensed something and also abruptly opened their eyes.
The temperature in the room seemed to drop several degrees, exuding an indescribable, eerie killing intent.
What’s the matter?
What are these young human Cultivators planning to do?
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, who had been cultivating with his eyes closed, opened them, his own eyes filled with confusion.
He quietly glanced at the eight people and found that their current demeanor was completely different from their previous restrained state.
Each of them was like a sharp sword ready to be unsheathed, subtly radiating a keen edge.
He took another look at Lei Qinian beside him and saw that the boy was still cultivating with his eyes closed, seemingly unaware of the changes outside.
This kid is certainly carefree!
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon smiled, then closed his eyes again.
From the information he had gleaned at a glance, he could tell that those people probably weren’t targeting them.
It’s not my problem, so I’ll stay out of it.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s mission was to protect Lei Qinian.
He didn’t care if rivers of blood flowed outside.
BOOM! A great clap of thunder suddenly resounded from outside the room.
Following that, the flying ship shook slightly.
Have we entered the Thunder Zone?
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon released his Divine Sense, scanned the surroundings outside, and discovered that the flying ship had entered a region of thunderclouds.
This thundercloud region was extremely vast. Bolts of lightning, like angry dragons, constantly fell one after another, striking the flying ship.
At this moment, the flying ship lit up with a layer of hazy, azure light.
This layer of light was like a shield, enveloping the entire flying ship and deflecting all the lightning strikes.
Seeing that these were just ordinary lightning strikes, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon shook his head, unimpressed.
Suddenly, his brows twitched.
In the void, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon detected many shadowy, colossal figures.
Upon a closer look, he grinned.
A pack of red-furred wolf whelps,
he thought.
It seemed the middle-aged man he’d spoken to upon boarding had been right; they would indeed be attacked by demon beasts along the way.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon silently scanned the area. He discovered that enormous red wolves were hidden not only within the surrounding clouds but also in large numbers in the valleys below.
What Wolf Clan are these?
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s gaze flickered like flames as he assessed these giant red wolves.
He had lived through the Ancient Times, when the Dragon Clan reigned supreme over the Dragon Hidden Continent and other Demon Clans were pitifully weak; he had rarely paid such lesser beings any mind.
These giant red wolves, capable of Spatial Divinities, seemed unfamiliar. After a moment of thought, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon surmised they might be a race that had emerged after the Dragon Clan’s extinction.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon withdrew his Divine Sense, his attention returning to the flying ship.
At that moment, he noticed ten small teams stationed at ten different positions on the flying ship.
These were the escort teams from Tianxing Commercial Firm.
Every one of them wore a grim expression, like warriors facing a formidable enemy.
And in one of these teams, an elder at Destiny Realm Level Eight was continuously gazing up at the void, as if searching for something.
Suddenly, the elder’s pupils contracted violently, and his expression changed drastically. He roared, "It’s the Void Wolves! The Void Wolves are here!"
Amidst the cacophony of thunder, the elder’s voice, short and powerful, boomed throughout the entire flying ship.
Not only did the members of the ten teams hear it, but all the Cultivators in the other rooms heard it as well.
Everyone’s expression changed drastically.
Although the escort teams from Tianxing Commercial Firm would do their utmost to protect the flying ship, history had recorded instances where—under the furious assault of demon beasts—an entire escort team was annihilated, resulting in the ship’s destruction and the loss of all aboard.
At this moment, all the Cultivators grew tense. One by one, they released their Divine Sense to observe the situation outside.
After all, if they truly encountered a large-scale Void Wolf attack and the escort teams couldn’t hold, they would have to fight themselves. It would be a matter of self-preservation.
The elder’s voice also reached the ten-person Room No. 27.
Lei Qinian’s eyes snapped open.
"My heavens, we’re actually being attacked by Void Wolves..." Lei Qinian exclaimed in shock, his face turning pale.
Several hundred years ago, while searching for Immortal Herbs in a mountain range, he had encountered Void Wolves and knew firsthand how terrifying these demon beasts were.
Back then, tens of thousands of these Void Wolves had been besieging a Sect.
That Sect was a low-grade major sect.
Under the Void Wolves’ siege, that Sect had been utterly annihilated.
Because Void Wolves were skilled in spatial jumps and incredibly fast, not a single member of that Sect managed to escape.
Fortunately, Lei Qinian had been extremely far away at the time; sensing the danger, he had fled. He never expected that after so many years, on his way to the Heavenly Moon Secret Realm, he would encounter a large pack of Void Wolves attacking their flying ship.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon glanced at the horrified Lei Qinian and asked with a grin, "So, these creatures are called Void Wolves, huh?"

chapters.title: Chapter 273: Battles Inside and Out
chapters.content:
Chapter 273: Chapter 273: Battles Inside and Out
Lei Qinian was somewhat taken aback as he looked at the red-robed Demon Clan elder beside him.
This elder was also a powerful demon. How could he not know about the Void Wolves? It was quite strange.
Even though he was confused, Lei Qinian dared not show it. He just smiled and explained, "Elder, these are the Void Wolves. They are proficient in short-distance spatial jumps, spatial concealment, and group attacks. Their combat abilities are formidable, and they’re one of the most troublesome demon beasts for the Human Race."
"I see."
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon nodded, a flash of understanding on his face.
This dragon, resurrected from the Ancient Times, had just been given a lesson by a younger generation.
"I wonder how many Void Wolves there are. If there are a lot, our ship might be in danger," Lei Qinian voiced his concern.
"Why worry? Don’t we still have the guard team?" The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon scoffed nonchalantly.
No sooner had his words fallen than the elderly cultivator at Destiny Realm Level Eight suddenly thundered, "Move!"
The eight of them rose simultaneously, their movements synchronized, and filed out of the door.
Lei Qinian watched them leave, his eyes lighting up as he exclaimed, "They’re so loyal! That elder is probably taking his men to round up the Void Wolves..."
"That’s not certain. The Void Wolves are so strong. Wouldn’t going after them be suicide?" The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon dismissively shook his head.
Just then, an astonishing change occurred in the void surrounding the spaceship. Accompanied by a flash of lightning, the void rippled with distortions. Horrific figures of giant, red wolves began to fully emerge from it. Densely packed, Void Wolves filled the surrounding space—above, below, and on all sides.
The elderly cultivator in the guard team, a Destiny Realm Level Eight expert, saw the vast number of Void Wolves, and a look of horror instantly filled his eyes.
So many? The ones spotted earlier were just a small fraction; now all of them have emerged from the void.
There were thousands of Void Wolves, each possessing extraordinary strength. The weakest among them had a cultivation base at the Nirvana Realm. Among these Void Wolves, many were at the Destiny Realm.
"AWOOO!" A Void Wolf, larger than the others, suddenly let out a howl.
"Insignificant humans, stop your pointless resistance! Surrender willingly, and we might grant you a swift end!" this gigantic Void Wolf spoke, its voice chilling. Its blood-red fur flashed with crimson light, making it look like a peerless Demon King amid the interwoven lightning and the void.
As the Void Wolf’s words fell, all the surrounding Void Wolves let out a deafening howl.
"AWOOO..."
The sound was like rolling thunder, sweeping in all directions. At this moment, it seemed to overshadow the thunder in the sky.
"Quick! Notify all cultivators, especially those at the Destiny Realm! Have everyone come out to face the Void Wolves! If we don’t unite this time, we’ll all be eaten!" the terrified Destiny Realm Level Eight elder from the guard team suddenly bellowed.
Upon his orders, the trade company staff immediately sprang into action, heading to different living areas to notify the cultivators. Some cultivators heard the elder’s shout and rushed out onto the deck of their own accord.
Everyone looked terrified but helpless. It was their misfortune to be targeted by so many Void Wolves. Now, they had no choice but to fight for their lives.
Right after all the Void Wolves howled, they began to attack the spaceship. Suddenly, they all vanished, reappearing the next moment to crash into the giant light shield. The light shield shook violently, flickering uncertainly. Everyone watched, their hearts pounding with fear. They knew that once the barrier was broken, they would have to engage in a life-or-death battle with the Void Wolves.
A staff member, Zhou Chun An, rushed over. As soon as he reached the corridor, he found eight cultivators standing before room number twenty-eight. The eight cultivators stood motionless like stone statues, their faces exuding an astonishing killing intent.
What’s going on?
Zhou Chun An thought, his heart thumping with unease. He mustered his courage and knocked on the door of room number twenty-seven.
KNOCK, KNOCK!
Two clear sounds rang out.
"Senior, the Void Wolves are attacking! We need your help," Zhou Chun An said politely.
"Understood," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon responded, getting off the bed and walking towards the door.
"Senior, I’ll go too," Lei Qinian declared, his expression serious as he followed. He was fully aware of the Void Wolves’ ferocity; if they didn’t give their all, no one would survive this demon beast siege.
"Young man, your courage is commendable." Patting Lei Qinian’s shoulder, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon gave him an approving look.
The two of them approached the door. Lei Qinian glared at Zhou Chun An in annoyance. Zhou Chun An looked sheepish and, not daring to say anything at this juncture, turned and headed towards room twenty-eight.
Looking at those men who resembled fierce deities, Zhou Chun An cupped his fists and, steeling himself, said, "Fellow Daoists, Seniors, the Void Wolves are currently attacking our merchant guild’s ship! We need your help."
"Help out? Who do you think you are, daring to speak to us this way?" the Destiny Realm Level Eight elder sneered. As his hand lifted, his sword fell.
WHOOSH!
A cold light flashed. Blood sprayed from Zhou Chun An’s neck as his large head tumbled to the ground.
In the blink of an eye, the elder had slain Zhou Chun An with a single sword strike.
Seeing this, Lei Qinian’s heart pounded, and cold sweat broke out on his back.
These guys truly are devils who kill without batting an eye!
"Your swordsmanship is barely passable," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon commented casually, his hands behind his back.
The Destiny Realm Level Eight elder’s brow furrowed slightly, but he said nothing and continued to guard the door of room number twenty-eight.
"You’ve followed us all this way, and now you’re standing guard outside. What are you trying to achieve? Why not just attack?"
「Inside room number twenty-eight.」
Suddenly, someone coughed lightly and responded from within.
BOOM!
Suddenly, the entire spaceship began to shake violently. In that instant, the Void Wolves’ ferocious attacks shattered the grand protective formation outside. Countless Void Wolves flickered out of existence in mid-air, vanishing for an instant only to reappear above the deck the next moment.
All the Human cultivators drew their weapons or magical treasures and began to battle the Void Wolves fiercely.
"Attack!" The Destiny Realm Level Eight elder ordered, a sinister look on his face as he sensed the formation break and the Void Wolves pour in.
Then, he kicked the room’s door to pieces and was the first to rush in. The other seven, their faces grim with murderous intent, followed closely behind.
Eight versus ten. A fierce battle instantly erupted in the small room.
BOOM!
With rampant flashes of sword light, not only was room number twenty-eight obliterated, but the entire floor was also ruthlessly shattered by the relentless Sword Qi.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon stretched out his hand and pulled Lei Qinian to his side, shielding him from the terrifying Sword Qi.
Lei Qinian’s face paled with inner terror, and he sighed heavily.
The Void Wolves have broken the formation, and no one can escape, yet these people have started infighting...

chapters.title: Chapter 274: Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon Takes Action to Kill
chapters.content:
Chapter 274: Chapter 274: Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon Takes Action to Kill
"Young man, don’t be surprised. It’s human nature to covet good things..."
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon laughed heartily and spoke nonchalantly.
As rooms were destroyed one by one and several cultivators lay in pools of their own blood, Lei Qinian’s expression turned extremely grim witnessing such a brutal fight.
"Senior, if they continue to fight, I’m afraid this flying ship will be destroyed..." Lei Qinian said despondently.
If the flying ship was destroyed, he wouldn’t be able to reach the Heavenly Moon Secret Region.
He had barely managed to sell a family heirloom on Wu Kun Mountain to obtain a Heavenly Moon Order, but he hadn’t had a chance to use it.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon thought for a moment and immediately came to a realization.
He’s right. It would be better to have them fight outside... This ship... it absolutely must not be destroyed.
Therefore, he waved his hand, and an overwhelming force instantly swept out. The cultivators who were fighting found their bodies uncontrollably flung through the roof, into the sky above the flying ship.
The moment they appeared in the air, they found themselves surrounded by a gruesome scene of chaotic battle.
The cultivators on the ship were engulfed in a fierce battle with numerous Void Wolves. Corpses were scattered everywhere amid a river of blood.
However, most cultivators, trying to protect the flying ship, did their best to keep the battle airborne against these Void Wolves.
The two fighting groups initially had eighteen people in total. But after four or five Nirvana Realm cultivators died, only thirteen or fourteen remained.
Amidst the chaotic battlefield, they were only slightly stunned before they engaged in combat once again.
Just as the battle resumed, two Void Wolves suddenly attacked from the left and right, launching indiscriminate assaults on these cultivators.
Left with no choice, the cultivators had to shift their focus to fighting the Void Wolves.
For a time, the battle became exceedingly chaotic.
"Li, stop your futile resistance and hand it over! You might live a few more years..." the Heavenly Fate Realm Level Eight old man, who was battling the Void Wolves, roared. He forced back a Void Wolf with his sword and then charged towards the pale-faced middle-aged man again.
The pale-faced middle-aged man was already severely injured. Now, being forced to fight while trying to hold on, his condition worsened.
Despite his high cultivation base, he could no longer suppress the deterioration of his injuries.
The old man swung his sword again. The middle-aged man couldn’t dodge in time and was struck, blood gushing from the new wound.
"Master!" another old man cried out, rushing in furiously from the side to repel their enemy.
"Master, quickly consume this Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass!" the old man urged, extending his hand and taking out a jade box.
"My injuries are too severe. Even if I take it now, it won’t heal me instantly..." The pale-faced middle-aged man gave a bitter smile and waved his hand in refusal.
"Master, you can’t give up like this!" the old man pleaded frantically.
The middle-aged man frowned but said nothing, his gaze sweeping across their surroundings.
Eventually, he saw a red-robed young man standing nearby.
He knew it was this red-robed young man who had just used an unimaginable divine skill to forcibly move more than a dozen of them from within the ship to the sky above. Judging by this divine skill, he must be at least a Life and Death Realm expert. And to think the red-robed young man is also from the Demon Clan...
The middle-aged man instantly realized,
This incredibly powerful Life and Death Realm Great Demon is the only one who can resolve this chaotic crisis.
With that thought, he snatched the jade box.
The old man beside him immediately showed a joyful expression, thinking his master was finally going to consume the Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass.
"Hold them off for a while," the middle-aged man ordered, then his figure flickered as he flew in a certain direction.
The old man nodded quickly and immediately charged towards the opposing Heavenly Fate Realm Level Eight old man.
Although he was one minor realm weaker than his opponent, he fought with such desperation that the other party found it difficult to kill him.
The two men engaged in an intense, earth-shaking, and heaven-shattering battle.
Meanwhile, the middle-aged man skillfully evaded the Void Wolves and swiftly flew before the red-robed youth.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was still standing on the deck, loyally protecting Lei Qinian who was beside him.
He observed the brutal fighting around him, pondering how to drive away those Void Wolves.
He certainly wouldn’t expose his identity as an Eternal Realm Great Demon right now. That would definitely scare Lei Qinian.
At this moment, the surrounding Void Wolves were fiercely aggressive. Using their Innate Divine Abilities, they continuously attacked the Human cultivators, who kept falling from mid-air.
Observing all this, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon felt no particular emotion.
After all, he wasn’t Human. He was of the Dragon Clan from the Ancient Times. He had very little sympathy for such tragic scenes involving the Human Race. However, for the sake of protecting the flying ship, he was still prepared to make a move and drive away all those Void Wolves.
Just as the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was about to act, a flash of white light appeared before his eyes. A pale, middle-aged man landed in front of him.
"Senior, please save my life! I am willing to offer this Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass to you," the middle-aged man said, kneeling on the ground with a THUD and holding up a jade box with both hands.
"Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass?"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s expression flickered; he had naturally heard of this famous Immortal Herb.
The middle-aged man opened the jade box, revealing a stalk of Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass, as vivid and lifelike as a phoenix, before the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s eyes.
A vast life-force aura surged forward, converging right in front of him.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon took a deep breath, feeling a refreshing coolness spread through his internal organs.
It’s actually Emperor Level Lower Grade!
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was somewhat surprised.
He hadn’t expected someone on this flying ship to possess such a high-grade Immortal Herb.
"Senior, I beg you, please help me kill those enemies pursuing me..." Seeing the satisfied look on the red-robed youth’s face, the middle-aged man pleaded desperately.
"Alright! I accept your request."
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon laughed heartily and reached out to take the jade box.
To obtain an Emperor Level Lower Grade Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass so easily... what an incredible stroke of luck!
Just at this moment, a sword beam shot over from afar. The one wielding it was the old man from room twenty-seven, an eighth-level Heavenly Fate Realm cultivator.
"Hand over the Spirit Grass now!" the old man roared angrily. As the sword light drew near, it immediately transformed, becoming a rain of sword light as vast as a galaxy of stars, pouring down.
This single sword strike astonishingly enveloped all three of them.
In the old man’s eyes, the middle-aged man was too severely injured to fight back. And that Fifth Level Nirvana Realm youth was nothing to worry about. His only concern was the Demon Clan cultivator at the Heavenly Fate Realm. This sword strike contained all his lifelong cultivation; it was his most powerful attack.
"Seeking death!"
Seeing the old man still attempting to attack him, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon flicked his finger. A ray of blood-red light shot out, pierced through the deluge of sword light, and struck the old man’s chest.
The old man was completely unable to dodge, watching in horror as the blood-red light entered his body.
The next moment, he screamed.
His entire body contorted violently in mid-air before thudding onto the deck, where he finally transformed into a dried corpse.
The ray of blood-red light instantly flew out from the old man’s body.
The moment it flew out, the old man’s body suddenly exploded.
The blood-red light returned to the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s fingertip.
The middle-aged man witnessed this scene, his heart utterly shaken.
This Demon Clan senior... he’s truly powerful!

chapters.title: Chapter 275: The Consequence of Underestimating the Dragon Clan, The Destruction of the Void Wolf
chapters.content:
Chapter 275: Chapter 275: The Consequence of Underestimating the Dragon Clan, The Destruction of the Void Wolf
Lei Qinian was awestruck.
He had never imagined that this Demon Clan elder from the Destiny Realm standing beside him would be so powerful.
He casually made a move and wiped out a human cultivator from the Destiny Realm Level Eight.
His power was just too overwhelming.
After killing the elderly cultivator from the Destiny Realm Level Eight, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s eyes turned to another direction.
With a slight raise of his hand, the remaining underlings of the elderly cultivator were all killed.
"Thank you for saving my life, elder!"
The middle-aged man, witnessing his enemies being annihilated, was deeply moved. He brought his hands together in a fist and bowed in thanks.
"There’s no need to thank me; this is just a transaction," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon licked his lips and chuckled.
BOOM!
A thunderbolt lit up the sky as an enormous Void Wolf surprisingly pounced towards the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon.
"Oh my, this little wolf pup doesn’t want to live anymore?"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was taken aback, then broke into resounding laughter, and his body disappeared on the spot.
The next moment, he appeared above the Void Wolf.
He pressed his toes slightly, and a streak of bloody light emanated from him, quickly piercing into the Void Wolf’s body.
This gigantic Void Wolf immediately let out a mournful cry and fell from the sky.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon immediately caught the now withered Void Wolf and hurled it away.
After dealing with this Void Wolf, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon looked around to find the Wolf King among the pack.
To catch the thief, first catch the king!
Once the Wolf King was subdued, he could have it take its clan members and flee.
Both belonging to the Demon Clan, and out of consideration for that small bit of kinship, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon didn’t want to commit mass murder.
In this battle, many human cultivators died, and many Void Wolves also died.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s eyes flashed, spotting a gigantic Void Wolf on a mountaintop, its blood-red eyes full of killing intent as it gazed towards the sky.
It’s that one.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s body flickered, transforming into a streak of bloody light as he descended.
The Void Wolf below was three times the size of an ordinary Void Wolf.
Its cultivation base had reached the Peak of the Tenth Level of Destiny Realm; it was considered a great demon at the Half-Step Life-Death Realm.
The destruction a great demon like this could cause was unimaginable; the flying ship would be completely destroyed.
But the Wolf King had its dignity.
It didn’t attack personally; instead, it drove its clan members to attack the Tianxing Commercial Firm’s airship.
A streak of bloody light shot from mid-air like a meteor, accompanied by a flash of lightning. The Void Wolf King immediately discerned the newcomer.
It was a youth from the Demon Clan dressed in a red robe.
His cultivation base had reached Destiny Realm Level Five.
With this level of cultivation base, he dares to attack me, a Wolf King at the Half-Step Life-Death Realm?
Just as it had this thought, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon had already descended, hovering mid-air to confront the Void Wolf King from afar.
"Little wolf pup, you’re really causing quite the commotion, huh? If this old man hadn’t made a move, this airship would have been dismantled by you, and not a single person would have survived," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon casually chuckled.
"Which Demon Clan do you hail from? Your tone is incredibly audacious!" the Void Wolf King stared intently at the red-robed youth before it and questioned in a deep voice.
It didn’t make a move immediately.
Although its cultivation base far surpassed that of the other party, the opponent was, after all, a member of the Demon Clan. If he had a strong backer, making a rash move would entail huge risks.
"To think there are still people who care about this old man’s race, I am truly touched..." the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon spoke rather sentimentally.
Members of the Dragon Clan on the Cangnan Continent were now extremely scarce. Altogether, there were only a few. Those that survived had extremely diluted Dragon Clan Bloodlines and were no match for the Dragon Clan of the Ancient Era.
He exuded a trace of Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon breath.
This breath, like a tide, encased the Void Wolf King in an instant.
"Are you a member of the Dragon Clan?" The Void Wolf King was momentarily stunned.
"Quickly recall your wolf pups. I don’t wish to engage in a massacre..." the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon stated indifferently, the inherent pride of the Dragon Clan etched on his face.
"Haha, what a joke! The Dragon Clan is now in decline, without any powerful faction to its name, and you still dare to threaten me?" The Void Wolf King burst out laughing, a mocking smile gleaming in its eyes.
If this Demon Clan youth possessed significant power or backing, it might have shown some deference.
But if it was the Dragon Clan, it wouldn’t show even the slightest courtesy.
After all, the Dragon Clan... was no longer the dominant power on the Cangnan Continent.
Their glory had long disappeared with the battles of ancient times.
The Void Wolf King’s words instantly ignited the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s fury.
He had already released his Dragon Clan aura, giving the other party a chance to back down, yet he was unexpectedly met with ridicule.
This was something he couldn’t bear.
He immediately raised a hand and, with a gesture through the void, snatched the massive Void Wolf King out of the air.
An immense, powerful force restrained the Void Wolf King.
What... what kind of cultivation base is this?
The Void Wolf King lost control of its body, unable to move. Its heart instantly stirred with terror.
To be able to render it, a Half-Step Life-Death Realm expert, so helpless... could it be a Dragon Clan powerhouse from the Life and Death Realm? Thinking of this, the Void Wolf King deeply regretted its earlier treatment of an elder of the Dragon Clan. As a result, it now found itself captive, at the mercy of its captor.
"Little wolf pup, I, an old man, have lived a long life. Considering we both belong to the Demon Clan, I intended to spare your life. Yet, here you are, humiliating my Dragon Clan! Now, you—shall—die!"
As he spoke the final words, enunciating each one, two beams of bloody light shot from his eyes, like sharp swords striking the Void Wolf King.
The Void Wolf King screamed, its enormous body suddenly shrinking into a shriveled corpse.
Its blood and life essence were all absorbed by the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon.
It brought this upon itself!
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon cast the corpse onto the ground.
Looking up at the sky, where innumerable Void Wolves flew, his eyes flickered with a trace of a cold, bloodthirsty gleam.
Killing the Void Wolf King had thoroughly ignited his innate lust for slaughter.
"Die, all of you!"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon suddenly opened his mouth, and a vast expanse of bloody light swept towards the sky, like an ocean.
All the Void Wolves were instantly enveloped in this bloody light, turning into desiccated corpses.
WHOOSH!
The sea of blood swept back just as quickly, disappearing into the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s mouth.
The entire process was incredibly fast; most of the cultivators battling the Void Wolves didn’t even have time to react.
In that moment, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon had used a divine skill befitting an Eternal Realm Great Demon.
To avoid revealing himself, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon vanished from the mountaintop in the blink of an eye.
The next instant, he appeared on the deck, standing next to Lei Qinian.
"The Void Wolves... are all dead?"
The remaining human cultivators, hovering mid-air, were all dumbfounded.
Just moments ago, a sea of blood had swept past, and all the Void Wolves had turned into shriveled corpses, falling from the sky.
Who could have unleashed such a terrifying Great Divine Power?
"This Demon Clan elder is truly too strong!"
Among the crowd, only the middle-aged man knew the truth, and admiration flashed in his eyes as he looked at the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon.
"I haven’t had Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass in so many years..." The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon chuckled, suddenly opened the jade box in his hand, a craving look in his eyes.
Just then, amid the deafening roars of thunder, an intermittent voice drifted from an extremely distant location.
"Brin...g... it..."
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s expression changed as he looked towards a certain direction in the sky.
Though the voice was faint, he felt an unimaginably powerful aura rapidly approaching.

chapters.title: Chapter 276: A Severely Injured Spirit Arrives
chapters.content:
Chapter 276: Chapter 276: A Severely Injured Spirit Arrives
Eternal Realm?
Feeling that shocking aura, three words instantly surfaced in the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s mind.
The newcomer’s cultivation base was extremely high. Despite the vast distances of the void separating them, he could clearly sense the Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass in the Jade Box the dragon held.
Such strength is formidable...
A stir of anticipation rose in the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s heart.
"Who on earth is this person?" a Cultivator muttered to himself.
Not only did the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon hear this, but all the surrounding Cultivators heard it too.
The voice was intermittent, as if from someone grievously injured and on the verge of death.
The Cultivators exchanged glances, unsure if it was a blessing or a curse.
Fortunately, however, all the Void Wolves had mysteriously perished, sparing everyone’s lives.
After a while, the voice did not come again. The crowd breathed a collective sigh of relief and descended from the sky.
Some people then began clearing the deck, tossing the Void Wolf corpses down from the sky.
The lightning within the clouds had also weakened somewhat, but thunder serpents still slithered through the cloud layer from time to time, emitting deep rumbles.
The Jade Box in the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s hand remained open; he hadn’t consumed the Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass.
Given the dignity and pride of the Dragon Clan, he wanted to see why this powerful individual, who had come from so far away, possessed such incredible Divine Skills that they could perceive the Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass within the Jade Box from a single glance.
"Senior, tonight’s happenings are really mysterious, aren’t they? First, the Void Wolves all mysteriously died, and then..." Lei Qinian was trembling with fear as he continued.
Suddenly, all the Cultivators felt an immense pressure descend from above. Everyone found it difficult to breathe, as if an immense weight pressed down on them. They struggled to lift their heads and look skyward.
They saw the clouds suddenly tear apart, and a black-clad figure staggered out.
It truly is the Eternal Realm! And a tenth-level Eternal Realm at that...
When the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon sensed the other party’s aura, his expression changed slightly. This individual exuded an inexplicable sense of danger.
Although they hadn’t yet clashed, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon doubted he could definitively defeat this opponent. He, too, stared intently at the figure stumbling down from the sky.
The figure was enveloped in an indistinct halo of light, obscuring their true appearance. However, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon could discern that this person was severely injured, their aura chaotic.
As the figure’s staggering intensified, the surrounding light could no longer be sustained and vanished in an instant.
At this moment, all the Cultivators saw the figure’s true face.
SSS!
The instant they saw the figure’s face, everyone’s eyes widened in utter shock.
The stumbling figure was a young man in a black robe. One of his arms was severed and missing. Fresh blood gushed from the stump, dripping continuously as he descended. It showed no signs of stopping.
In the young man’s abdomen, a small Silver sword was embedded. This Silver sword seemed alive, writhing continuously and exuding a bizarre aura.
But the young man’s injuries didn’t end there. One of his legs was a mangled, bloody mess. His face was even more ghastly.
One of his eyes was missing, seemingly gouged out, leaving only a dark, empty socket. Dark red blood trickled continuously from around the socket. Even a part of his nose had been sliced off, a truly gruesome sight.
The black-robed young man stumbled downwards, his breathing ragged and chaotic. He stared in a specific direction and rasped, "Bring... Heavenly... Phoenix... Grass..."
Heh, as expected, he wants the Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass to treat his injuries!
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon narrowed his eyes, his expression turning stern. He had just obtained this Immortal Herb; how could he possibly hand it over to another? Besides, he had no connection to the black-robed young man, who was a complete stranger. The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was certainly not benevolent enough to gift the Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass to this person.
"What kind of blood is this?" Suddenly, a Destiny Realm Cultivator cried out.
The blood dripping from the young man onto the deck ignited into dark red flames where it landed. These flames emitted a terrifying aura, seemingly unlike any other flame in the mortal realm.
"This is Divine Blood."
Seeing the blood ignite, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon inhaled sharply, his expression growing even colder. This young man before him was unbelievably a Spirit. At the very least, he had a True God Realm cultivation base. It was just unknown what had caused him to suffer such grievous injuries, leading to his fall from the True God Realm.
The black-robed young man abruptly halted in mid-air, his remaining hand clutching a Longsword, pointing it at the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon.
"Ha...nd... it... o...ver..." he struggled to force out the words.
"Senior, he seems to want the Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass in your Jade Box..." Lei Qinian stammered, his heart pounding in terror.
This injured and desolate man was unimaginably powerful; by Lei Qinian’s estimation, he had likely reached the Eternal Realm.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s form flickered as he shot into the sky, confronting the black-robed young man from a distance.
"Fellow Daoist, your injuries are severe. You can’t even remove the sword from your stomach. This Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass won’t truly solve your problems. I suggest you leave this place quickly..." the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon stated indifferently.
With that, he closed the Jade Box in his hand and placed it into his Storage Ring.
Hand over the Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass so obediently? Impossible!
"Die..."
The black-robed young man exhaled laboriously and, without hesitation, raised his Longsword and slashed.
That single sword strike instantly caused the heavens and earth to dim. A sword light so dazzlingly bright forced all the Cultivators to shut their eyes tightly.
So strong!
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon thought, alarmed.
The black-robed young man was so grievously injured, yet he could still unleash such an astonishing strike; it was a testament to his original power.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon roared and thrust out his hand to intercept it. In mid-air, his arm transformed into a crimson dragon claw, wreathed in a dense, bloody light.
Instantly, a potent aura of blood permeated the void.
Many Cultivators on deck were overwhelmed by this aura of blood, their minds impacted, and they fainted instantly. The few remaining Destiny Realm Cultivators squeezed their eyes shut, desperately resisting the powerful aura of blood. But they only managed to resist for a single second. Then, they too were overwhelmed by the aura of blood and lost consciousness.
"Dragon Clan?" The black-robed young man’s single remaining eye showed a trace of surprise as he saw the red dragon claw.
After the great ancient war where dragons were slaughtered, to think such a powerful member of the Dragon Clan still lived on the Dragon Hidden Continent!
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s crimson claw clashed with the sword light.
BOOM! RUMBLE!
A heaven-shaking, earth-shattering sound erupted from the impact.
Despite the Dragon Clan’s formidable physique, the black-robed young man’s devastating sword strike still severed half of the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s arm.
As expected of a True God Realm expert, even though his realm has fallen, he’s still so strong...
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon let out a grim laugh. The severed half of his arm transformed into a bloody light and reintegrated into his body. Immediately, a new crimson dragon claw regenerated.
"An undying body? Could it be the bloodline of the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon?"
The black-robed young man, shocked, forced himself to circulate his Mana and, surprisingly, uttered this astonished sentence smoothly.

chapters.title: Chapter 277 Ye Yun arrives, interrupting the battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 277: Chapter 277 Ye Yun arrives, interrupting the battle
"Huh, how do you know?"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon suddenly faltered, surprised that the man before him had immediately recognized his Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon bloodline.
"Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, one of the Ten Super Divine Dragons! But you only carry a sparse trace of its bloodline..."
The young man sighed then, pointing his sword at the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, said, "You might as well give me the Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass, or else you’ll surely die by my sword."
"Give it to you? How could that be possible? Let’s see who’s stronger!"
At that moment, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon sneered. His body started to transform, unveiling his immense, blood-red dragon form.
The greatest strength of the Dragon Clan lay in their physical bodies. This form granted him his greatest power.
COUGH, COUGH... The young man in the black robe suddenly coughed twice, spewing out mouthfuls of blood.
His shoulders convulsed violently. Every time he coughed, blood spurted from his eye sockets, the stump of his shoulder, and even from the other wounds on his body.
He looked like a cup full of cracks that might shatter at any moment, on the brink of life’s end.
But even with such severe injuries, he still stood strong, refusing to fall.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, observing from afar, felt a sense of admiration for the young man in the black robe.
This guy’s willpower is truly formidable; he’s a real man.
If this fellow weren’t so insistent on snatching the Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass from me, I’d actually like to befriend him.
But now, they were adversaries.
Only the victor can claim the Heavenly Spirit Phoenix Grass.
The pride of the Ancient Dragon Clan would not allow him to retreat even a single step.
After another fit of coughing, the young man in the black robe looked at the Red Giant Dragon in the distance, a hint of caution visible in his gaze.
He raised his sword and slashed out.
This sword strike was almost identical to the previous one. A flash of sword light crossed the void, causing the entire world to dim, and even the distant thunderclouds scattered in retreat.
It seemed they dared not obstruct the might of this sword strike.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon showed no fear, meeting the sword strike head-on by lashing out with his enormous dragon tail.
BOOM! BOOM! His tail slammed into the sword light, forcefully shattering it.
At that moment, the man in the black robe coughed violently once again.
He struck out consecutively, releasing several beams of sword light that intertwined in mid-air, forming a sword net of indescribable power.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon also roused his spirits, not daring to be negligent. He spewed forth torrents of blood-red light that blotted out the sky, as if heralding the apocalypse.
KABOOM... KABOOM... The sword light and the blood-red light clashed, constantly shattering each other.
And so, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and the black-robed young man engaged in a fierce battle.
Despite his exceptional talent and formidable combat strength, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon felt immense pressure facing the black-robed young man, whose cultivation base and realm far surpassed his own.
After more than ten rounds of combat, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon found himself being suppressed by the man, gradually falling into a disadvantage.
His body had been cut apart countless times, but each time he relied on his Divine Skill of immortality to regenerate.
The black-robed young man was indeed powerful, but he still had no way to truly defeat the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, however, felt his confidence surge at this moment.
I possess an immortal body! If we keep fighting like this, that severely injured black-robed young man will eventually be worn down to death by me!
BOOM! BOOM! The two battled in mid-air, and immense shockwaves rippled out in all directions.
Damn it, this airship...
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, caught up in the heat of battle, suddenly remembered that the shockwaves from their fight could instantly disintegrate the airship if they struck it.
All the Cultivators aboard would be pulverized.
Including Lei Qinian, whom he was tasked to protect.
At this thought, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was scared out of his wits, nearly frightened to death.
If Lei Qinian dies like this, how can I possibly face the Master?
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon snapped his head up, looked down below, and saw a white figure who had, at some unknown point, appeared on the airship’s deck.
Master is here!
Seeing that familiar figure, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was both surprised and overjoyed, nearly moved to tears.
If Master hadn’t come, this airship would be destroyed, and Lei Qinian would be dead. My mission would have been a complete failure.
In that fleeting moment his concentration wavered, a shockingly brilliant sword light descended from afar, cleaving the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon in two.
「On the deck.」
Ye Yun stood with his hands clasped behind his back, observing the intense battle, his expression perfectly calm.
That this young man, so severely injured, still possessed such formidable combat power made Ye Yun regard him with a degree of admiration.
The ultimate loser of this battle will undoubtedly be the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon.
Ye Yun had discovered that this black-robed young man was still concealing some of his strength.
If he were to unleash his full strength, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon would surely suffer grievous injuries. In that event, his wounds would worsen, his realm would plummet drastically, perhaps to around the First Level of the Eternal Realm. If he were truly unlucky, he might even fall to the Life and Death Realm.
That sword in this kid’s abdomen seems to have quite a history...
Ye Yun’s eyes flickered like two balls of fire.
The Silver sword lodged in the black-robed young man’s abdomen had a dragon pattern carved onto its blade.
This dragon pattern was composed of countless, intricate runes.
These runes were extraordinarily mystical. Within a mere inch, they displayed myriad phenomena, combining to form a peculiar Divine Skill.
And at the very core of these runes, Ye Yun even spotted a miniature Seven-star formation.
Another Seven-star formation...
Upon seeing this Seven-star formation clearly, Ye Yun’s expression turned somewhat grim.
Throughout his journey, Ye Yun had encountered numerous Seven-star formations. This type of formation seemed to have an inescapable connection to the hidden hand behind the scenes.
A flash of white light.
Ye Yun suddenly appeared between the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and the black-robed young man.
"Enough fighting," Ye Yun said lightly, raising one hand.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon reverted to his human form, stood behind Ye Yun, and said with a shamed expression, "Master, I am truly useless. Thankfully, you arrived, otherwise the mission would have failed..."
"Today’s events were beyond your capabilities. I do not blame you. Go back and look after Lei Qinian," Ye Yun said softly.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon quickly assented, transformed into a streak of blood-red light, and landed on the deck.
He checked on Lei Qinian and found that he had merely fainted, which finally set his mind at ease.
Who is this?
The black-robed young man suddenly saw a white-robed youth who resembled an immortal banished to the mortal realm, as if from a painting. His one eye registered immense shock.
I can’t discern his cultivation base. This means his cultivation base is far higher than mine!
But isn’t it said by everyone... that there are no True Gods on the Dragon Hidden Continent at all?
"Sir, could you be... a True God?"
A wary look appeared in the black-robed young man’s one eye. He gathered all his Mana, his sword quivering slightly as he pointed it at Ye Yun.
"You need not guess my cultivation base," Ye Yun said with an indifferent smile. His gaze, filled with interest, fell upon the black-robed young man as he asked, "You must be from the Divine Land, correct?"
Upon hearing this, the black-robed young man’s heart clenched, and a tempestuous storm raged within him.
How did this man know I am from the Divine Land?
Could it be... he is the Defender of the restricted area on the Dragon Hidden Continent?

chapters.title: Chapter 278: The True Defender
chapters.content:
Chapter 278: Chapter 278: The True Defender
"Sir, are you the Defender of the Dragon Hidden Continent?"
The black-robed youth fixed his one eye on Ye Yun and said solemnly.
When he planned to escape to the Dragon Hidden Continent, he knew he might encounter the Defender of this place. But at that time, he had no choice but to brace himself and enter the Dragon Hidden Continent. If he hadn’t entered, his pursuers would have caught up, and he would have died without a burial place. But by entering the Dragon Hidden Continent, he had a slim chance of survival. After all, this place was known as God’s Forsaken Land, which held a potent Curse for Cultivators from the Divine Land. Many Cultivators dared not enter. The stronger a person’s cultivation base, the stronger the Curse they would suffer in this place. Fortunately, he was only in the True God Realm, so the Curse would be much lighter. However, the price of entry was still steep. During his journey on the Ancient Road to Heaven, he encountered various dangers that depleted all his magical treasures and left him with even more severe injuries. Now, his body was riddled with wounds, his injuries unimaginably severe.
Facing the True God Realm Defender before him, the black-robed youth understood... he couldn’t escape this predicament. The Defenders of the Dragon Hidden Continent would surely not be kind to an uninvited guest like him. They would definitely capture him. If he were lucky, he would be imprisoned and rigorously interrogated. If unlucky, he might be thrown back to the Divine Land immediately. And once he returned to the Divine Land, his life would be utterly forfeit. Thinking of this, the black-robed youth felt immense despair; this time, he truly couldn’t escape, even if he sprouted wings.
However, to his astonishment, the white-robed young man shook his head and said something entirely unexpected.
"I am not," Ye Yun said.
"You’re not the Defender?"
The black-robed youth was instantly stunned, his breathing quickening.
According to the intelligence he possessed, there could only be one God Realm Cultivator defending the Dragon Hidden Continent. There absolutely could not be a second. And Cultivators from the Divine Land almost never entered the Dragon Hidden Continent because it was a forbidden zone. Besides the potent Curse, that Ancient Road to Heaven... one simply couldn’t traverse it without substantial strength. But why would those possessing such strength come to this place, so remote and barren, with such thin Spiritual Energy? The higher the cultivation base of people from the Divine Land, the more they cherished their cultivation and prospects; they would never come to this God’s Forsaken Land to sever their path of cultivation.
At that moment, the void rippled. A figure suddenly emerged from within.
Seeing this green-robed elder, Ye Yun smiled and, pointing at him, said, "He is the Defender."
Seeing another powerful True God Realm Cultivator appear, the black-robed youth felt his vision dim.
This time, there was truly no hope left. The Defender before him was not someone he, currently in the Eternal Realm, could overcome.
After the green-robed elder appeared, he suddenly spotted a familiar white figure, and his face instantly lit up with pleasant surprise.
"Greetings, friend."
The green-robed elder quickly clasped his fists and spoke respectfully.
Ye Yun glanced at him, his eyes twinkling, and smiled. "You’ve done well to break through. Congratulations."
A joyous smile spread across the green-robed elder’s face. He nodded repeatedly and said with a laugh, "It’s all thanks to your Breaking God Pill, friend. Otherwise, I would never have been able to break through."
Listening to their exchange, the black-robed youth felt tumultuous waves crash in his heart. Who on earth was this white-robed young man? He wasn’t the Defender, yet he was so familiar with the Defender. Most astoundingly, he had even gifted the Defender a Breaking God Pill! He knew very well what a Breaking God Pill entailed. Even for him, the Young Island Master of Star God Island, acquiring a Breaking God Pill was exceedingly difficult.
"The Dragon Hidden Continent is called God’s Forsaken Land. Could a Breaking God Pill actually enable a breakthrough here?" The black-robed youth suddenly considered a possibility and couldn’t help but blurt it out.
Ye Yun was slightly taken aback.
The black-robed youth’s question was pertinent.
