According to the information the Defender had once shared with him, any Cultivator from the Divine Land who entered the Dragon Hidden Continent would be affected by the Curse’s power, causing their cultivation base to stagnate. So why wasn’t this Defender affected?
"What you say has some merit..." The green-robed elder glanced indifferently at the heavily injured black-robed youth, then turned back to Ye Yun, his expression shifting to a smile as he said, "I was stuck at the pinnacle of the True God Realm First Level for a very long time. Although I was affected by the Curse upon entering the Dragon Hidden Continent, with the aid of an external item like the Breaking God Pill, there’s still a chance to break through to the next minor realm. Friend, my luck was exceptionally good, so I happened to break through."
Hearing this explanation, Ye Yun came to a sudden realization.
According to the green-robed elder’s explanation, if one was Cursed, relying on one’s own cultivation base made a breakthrough impossible. However, leveraging the power of an external object like a medicinal pill offered a chance. This situation likely applied when one was stuck at the peak of a minor realm, essentially just needing a final push. The Breaking God Pill provided that powerful impetus, allowing this Defender from Cangnan Continent to break through to the Second Level of the True God Realm.
Having figured this out, Ye Yun’s gaze returned to the black-robed youth.
This fellow is also from the Divine Land; he’s probably also been affected by the Curse after entering here. The thought of the Curse immediately piqued Ye Yun’s interest. He decided to let the black-robed youth live so he could study it thoroughly. Of course, his decision to save the black-robed youth wasn’t solely to research the mysterious Curse. Another reason was that Silver Sword. Within the dragon pattern of the Little Sword, there was a miniature Seven-star Formation. Anyone the shadowy mastermind wished to harm, Ye Yun felt compelled to save. So, this was the true reason he intended to save the black-robed youth.
"Since you’ve broken through, friend, you’ve reached a new state entirely..." Ye Yun clasped his fists and smiled courteously.
He hadn’t extracted memories from the green-robed elder earlier because he feared some restriction in the elder’s mind might suddenly detonate. Thus, he had always addressed the green-robed elder as ’friend’. He had managed to glean a fair amount of information this way.
"I can live a little longer now, but that’s about all, haha! Now that I’m Cursed, breaking through to the True God Realm Third Level is utterly impossible..." The green-robed elder laughed, appearing quite nonchalant and philosophical about it. With a grateful expression, he continued, "To have broken through to the Second Level of the True God Realm is already deeply satisfying for me."
"With such a mindset, friend, you might travel even further on the path of the Great Dao in the future..." Ye Yun said with a chuckle.
"Heh, let’s leave it to fate..." The green-robed elder laughed heartily.
"COUGH, COUGH!"
At this, the black-robed youth’s injuries flared up, causing him to cough repeatedly, spitting out blood with each spasm.
"Which faction from the Divine Land are you from? Why did you enter the Dragon Hidden Continent? Did you not know how perilous this place is?" The green-robed elder turned, his hands clasped behind his back, his expression cold as he gazed at the black-robed youth.
"I knew. How could I not know? But I had no choice. If I hadn’t fled here, I would never have been able to shake off my pursuers..." Facing the Defender’s questioning, a wan smile touched the black-robed youth’s lips. The smile tugged at his wounds, causing him to spit out several more mouthfuls of blood.
Seeing the black-robed youth so grievously injured, the green-robed elder felt a pang of pity. He pondered for a moment before saying,
"I can allow you to rest here for a time. Afterward, I will send you out..."

chapters.title: Chapter 279: The Origins of the Youth in the Black Robe
chapters.content:
Chapter 279: Chapter 279: The Origins of the Youth in the Black Robe
After hearing the Defender’s words, the black-robed young man was initially taken aback, then an expression of gratitude immediately swept across his face. He hadn’t expected this Defender to be so kind-hearted as to give him a chance to catch his breath and survive.
Ye Yun, standing nearby, smiled faintly. "Companion, you’re mistaken."
"Please enlighten me, Companion."
The elder in the blue-green robe was slightly startled, his old face showing a hint of embarrassment. In his eyes, Ye Yun was an unassailable, sacred figure to whom he owed a great debt of gratitude. Therefore, even with his status as the Defender, he wouldn’t dare to act presumptuously towards Ye Yun and remained exceedingly polite.
"The Defender has his duties, so naturally, there are some matters he cannot conveniently handle. It’s better if I step in. You can stay by my side and focus on your recovery..." Ye Yun glanced at the black-robed young man and said calmly.
What?
He wants me to follow this Senior?
Hearing this, the black-robed young man was momentarily stunned. He hadn’t expected that the unfathomable young man in white before him would actually offer to take him in. He was overcome with emotion, his voice choked, and he was just about to speak. Suddenly, he broke into another violent fit of coughing, spitting out mouthfuls of fresh blood.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, standing on the ship and witnessing this scene, couldn’t help but curl its lips, muttering to itself, "This fellow is really having a stroke of incredible luck..."
To be taken in by the Master—what heaven-defying luck that must be!
In the Master’s eyes, the black-robed young man’s injuries were nothing at all.
Hearing that Ye Yun intended to take in the black-robed young man, the elder in the blue-green robe was initially surprised, then a hint of joy flickered across his face.
"Thank you, Companion." He hurriedly clasped his fist and bowed.
"You’re welcome, Companion. This little fellow will only survive if he’s with me. Otherwise, he won’t last a quarter of an hour," Ye Yun said softly, his eyelids lowered. After speaking, he raised his head and looked in a certain direction, as if waiting for something.
"Hm?" The blue-green robed elder’s expression suddenly changed. At this moment, he felt a powerful Super Divine Dragon Breath descending from the void above. A mountain-like pressure bore down on his shoulders, making it impossible for him, a Defender at the second level of the True God Realm, to resist.
Who could it be?
Their cultivation base is actually higher than his, a Defender at the second level of the True God Realm!
The black-robed young man, still rejoicing, felt this pressure. On his originally pale and bloodless face, the muscles instantly began to tremble.
"They’re here..." he murmured, his single eye losing focus. After speaking, he coughed violently again and spat out several more mouthfuls of fresh blood.
What a miserable little fellow...
Listening to the persistent coughs, Ye Yun also felt sympathy. He took out a small vial and flicked out a drop of green liquid.
"Swallow this..." Ye Yun’s words resounded beside the black-robed young man’s ear.
A drop of green liquid floated before the black-robed young man.
What is this?
At this moment, the black-robed young man’s severely injured body instinctively wanted to swallow this drop of green liquid. The life force emanating from the green liquid was simply immense.
"Thank you, Senior!" After thanking him, the black-robed young man opened his mouth and swallowed the drop of green liquid without hesitation.
An immense surge of vitality, like a river bursting its banks, rushed through every part of his body, beginning to repair his extremely severe injuries.
"UHH..." This healing process brought him an indescribable sense of pleasure, and he emitted a muffled sound.
In just a few breaths.
The black-robed young man’s injuries had all healed, and his overall mental state was vastly improved compared to before. The eye socket where an eye had been gouged out had completely healed over, and new flesh had regrown on his severed shoulder and the stump of his nose. All his external and internal injuries were completely healed. The only thing remaining was the small silver sword lodged deep in his Dantian, continuously draining his life energy. Although his injuries had healed, he still remained one-eyed, with a severed arm, and noseless, appearing exceptionally grotesque.
"Senior..." The black-robed young man was incredibly moved and immediately knelt at Ye Yun’s feet. "Thank you for saving my life!" The black-robed young man kowtowed repeatedly, tears streaming down his face like rain. He knew that this time, he was saved. This white-robed Senior was unfathomable; he believed that even with pursuers imminent, they would be utterly powerless against this Senior.
This...
Witnessing this astonishing scene, the blue-green robed elder’s eyes widened, so shocked he was speechless. He was naturally aware of how severe the black-robed young man’s injuries had been moments ago. The young man had been on the verge of death, yet after swallowing that drop of mysterious green liquid, he had recovered in an instant.
It was too incredible!
He turned to look at Ye Yun, his eyes filled with a fervent expression.
The blue-green robed elder knew this Companion in the Divine Monarch Realm was definitely not an unknown figure in the Divine Land. It was truly his honor to know such a mighty expert.
Sensing the Super Divine Dragon Breath from the void above growing stronger, Ye Yun smiled faintly, and the surrounding pressure instantly vanished.
"Companion, this time, I’m afraid we must trouble you to act." The blue-green robed elder felt his body lighten and hurriedly bowed. He knew the newcomer possessed a high-level True God Realm cultivation base, far beyond what he, as the Defender, could handle. Their only recourse was to ask this Companion from the Divine Monarch Realm to intervene.
"It’s a small matter. Companion, there’s no need for such formality." Ye Yun smiled faintly, his smile as gentle and warm as a spring breeze, giving an impression of great modesty. With a wave of his large hand, the black-robed young man kneeling at his feet immediately stood up.
"Which power from the Divine Land do you belong to? And who are the people pursuing you?" Ye Yun asked lightly.
"Senior, I am from Star God Island. The ones coming to kill me are likely from Skyreach Island..." the black-robed young man replied respectfully.
"Mm," Ye Yun nodded. He wasn’t very familiar with Star God Island or Skyreach Island.
However, the blue-green robed elder beside them exclaimed in surprise, "To think you’re from Star God Island! With Star God Island’s strength, it’s no match for Skyreach Island at all. I’ve heard that Skyreach Island has a Divine Monarch Realm expert presiding over it."
"Companion, to be honest, I was captured by them and barely escaped with my life..." The black-robed young man clasped his fists and said with a wry smile, "I was originally at the True God Realm Fourth Level. After being severely injured by those from Skyreach Island, my realm dropped to the First Level. After escaping, I struggled through the Dragon Hidden Continent’s Ancient Road to Heaven, lost all my Dharma treasures, and my realm fell further from the True God Realm First Level to the Eternal Realm..."
So that’s how it is...
The blue-green robed elder’s expression softened, and he felt great admiration for the black-robed young man before him. To be able to escape from Skyreach Island, endure countless hardships along the way, break through the Ancient Road to Heaven, and enter the Dragon Hidden Continent—the suffering involved was truly unimaginable.
He had also heard a little about Star God Island and Skyreach Island. Beyond the Dragon Hidden Continent lay a vast expanse of sea. Numerous islands were scattered across it like stars in the sky. These islands were divided into the Ten Great Ocean Areas. Star God Island and Skyreach Island were located in the Ninth Great Sea Region. Skyreach Island was the most powerful force in the Ninth Great Sea Region, ranked first, and legend had it that a Divine Monarch presided there. Star God Island’s power, however, was considerably weaker, ranking at best around the mid-teens.

chapters.title: Chapter 280: The Curse of the Ancestor Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 280: Chapter 280: The Curse of the Ancestor Dragon
"Sigh..."
The green-robed elder sighed, deeply admiring the black-robed youth before him. His willpower was unimaginably tenacious.
Even under relentless pursuit by the masters of Skyreach Island, he had managed to flee into the Dragon Hidden Continent. It was truly hard to imagine.
The space fluctuated.
A middle-aged man in a blue robe descended from it.
The middle-aged man surveyed his surroundings. When he saw the black-robed youth he had been hunting, a ferocious grin spread across his face.
He roared, "Jiang Hengyue, where will you run now?"
The black-robed youth looked at the middle-aged man, his brows deeply furrowed, and remained silent.
Although his body had recovered, his cultivation remained at the Eternal Realm Tenth Layer.
In his current state, he was no match for this middle-aged man at the True God Realm Tier Seven.
The middle-aged man’s gaze quickly shifted from Jiang Hengyue to the green-robed elder.
After glancing him up and down, he said indifferently, "You must be the Defender of this place."
The green-robed elder nodded calmly.
This middle-aged man’s cultivation base was higher than his, but his disrespectful tone angered the elder. Had his own cultivation not been inferior, he would have attacked already.
"You’ve come to this God’s Forsaken Land. Aren’t you afraid of the power of the curse?" the green-robed elder’s gaze flickered slightly, and he suddenly asked coldly.
The middle-aged man laughed loudly. "HAHA... Afraid? Of course, I’m afraid!" His laughter resounded, making the very heavens and earth hum.
The green-robed elder smirked and pressed, "If you are scared, why have you come?"
"The Island Master of Skyreach Island saved my life. Even if it means my cultivation stagnates, I must kill this Jiang Hengyue," the middle-aged man declared, his face turning vicious as he sneered.
He vented all his pent-up rage on Jiang Hengyue. If it weren’t for this brat, he wouldn’t have had to risk entering this God’s Forsaken Land and suffering its curse.
"You can’t kill him. He’s under my protection," Ye Yun stated, his hands clasped behind his back, looking calmly at the middle-aged man.
"Who are you?"
The middle-aged man’s pupils suddenly contracted. Only then did he realize another person was standing nearby.
But I clearly hadn’t seen him just moments ago!
Am I hallucinating? Or is this white-robed young man’s cultivation base far superior to mine?
That’s impossible!
On the Cangnan Continent, the Defender is the most powerful person.
How can such a powerful Spirit possibly exist here?
The middle-aged man stared coldly at Ye Yun, his gaze flickering as countless thoughts raced through his mind.
He himself was at the True God Realm Tier Seven. If a Spirit could appear so stealthily, without him noticing, they would have to be at least in the Divine Monarch Realm.
But how can a Divine Monarch Realm expert possibly appear on the Dragon Hidden Continent?
Absolutely impossible.
Why would a Cultivator at such a realm willingly risk their own cultivation path?
After all, this place is known as the God’s Forsaken Land, filled with terrifying and malevolent curses. Once someone enters, their cultivation will find it nearly impossible to advance further for the rest of their life.
Thinking this, he began to calm down.
The young man in white before me definitely can’t be at the Divine Monarch Realm.
If he is at the True God Realm... then even if this young man in white is at the True God Realm Tenth Layer, he absolutely couldn’t kill me.
After all, he possessed an Amulet given to him by the Island Master.
Once this Amulet was activated, it could unleash an attack with the might of the Divine Monarch Realm. Even a Cultivator at the True God Realm Tenth Layer Peak couldn’t withstand such power.
He would undoubtedly die!
Thinking of this, he felt reassured and, looking at Ye Yun, sneered, "Fellow Daoist, such bold words! I just wonder... do you actually have the ability to protect this fellow!"
After he finished speaking, the middle-aged man drew a treasured sword and swung it forward.
This sword strike was filled with world-destroying might.
If a great Cultivator of the Eternal Realm from the Cangnan Continent were here, the sight of this sword strike would likely cause them to faint on the spot.
An attack from a True God Realm Tier Seven Cultivator already completely surpassed the limits of this world.
"So powerful!"
The green-robed elder, watching this sword strike, felt his pupils constrict. He too sensed the terrifying power of this attack.
He was now very much looking forward to seeing what his Fellow Daoist Ye Yun, standing beside him, would do. He was eager to see what kind of Divine Skills Ye Yun would use to overcome the might of this sword strike.
Unexpectedly, Ye Yun didn’t budge an inch.
In his pair of enchanting eyes, countless tiny, star-like runes suddenly began to move, forming and vanishing. The whole world seemed to have entered a dream. Everything was upside down, black and white became indistinguishable, and it all felt utterly surreal.
That astonishing sword light suddenly disintegrated.
It was like a block of solid ice being instantly vaporized by intense heat.
How is this possible?
The middle-aged man’s eyes bulged, staring in disbelief at the scene before him.
He suddenly found the entire world had become dream-like. It made him feel utterly weak, as if he were being submerged in it.
The next moment, he closed his eyes, unable to open them again.
At this moment, the middle-aged man stood as still as a wooden puppet, motionless in the void, as if he had fallen into a deep slumber.
The green-robed elder, as an onlooker, witnessed this astonishing scene. He was so scared that he broke out in a cold sweat.
Are this Fellow Daoist’s Divine Skills too terrifying?
With all my knowledge and experience, I still can’t identify what kind of Divine Skill could so easily negate that heaven-shattering sword light!
Even more astoundingly, it caused a Spirit at the True God Realm Tier Seven to fall asleep without any warning!
Terrifying... Truly too terrifying!
The green-robed elder finally had a clear understanding of Ye Yun’s strength.
Hiss!
Jiang Hengyue, seeing this, couldn’t help but gasp.
This white-robed young man who took me in... what exactly is his cultivation base?
To so effortlessly deal with a Spirit at the True God Realm Tier Seven... it’s simply inconceivable!
However, an even more incredible event occurred in the next moment.
The middle-aged man’s body dissolved into countless microscopic particles, drifting in the air like a silken scarf.
What terrifying Divine Skills!
At this moment, this thought arose almost simultaneously in the minds of Jiang Hengyue and the green-robed elder.
Ye Yun observed these particles, his eyes flickering with an inscrutable light of deduction.
He was searching for the curse within the middle-aged man’s body.
This curse was hidden extremely deep.
Even with Ye Yun’s cultivation base, it took him a considerable amount of time to finally locate some minuscule granules.
These granules contained the curse the Cangnan Continent placed upon Divine Land Cultivators.
With a wave of his hand, Ye Yun gathered these cursed particles into his palm and began to observe them closely.
For some reason, these cursed particles gave Ye Yun a sense of familiarity.
A flash of inspiration suddenly streaked through his mind, and Ye Yun was stunned.
This curse... it actually carries a trace of the Ancestor Dragon’s aura!
This discovery shocked Ye Yun immensely.
Could it be that the curse on the Cangnan Continent was laid by the Ancestor Dragon when it perished?
Did it do this to prevent Divine Land Cultivators from coveting the Cangnan Continent?
If Ye Yun did not possess the Ancestor Dragon’s bloodline in his body, and at a concentration that had reached 99 percent, he would have struggled to detect the Ancestor Dragon’s aura hidden so deep within the curse.
Ye Yun’s expression turned grave.
"Fellow Daoist, have you discovered something?" the green-robed elder asked hurriedly, noticing Ye Yun’s unusual demeanor.
"It’s nothing."
Ye Yun put away the cursed particles in his hand. Then, with a gentle wave, the motes of the deceased man in the distance immediately dispersed into the heavens and earth.

chapters.title: Chapter 281: Cause and Consequence
chapters.content:
Chapter 281: Chapter 281: Cause and Consequence
The elder in the green robe saw Ye Yun’s solemn expression, but since Ye Yun didn’t seem to want to share, he could only shake his head and smile wryly.
He knew this fellow Daoist held secrets. However, with his current cultivation base and knowledge, he was completely clueless about what Ye Yun had discovered.
"Fellow Daoist, if the cultivators of Skyreach Island enter this world, you don’t have to take any more action. I’ll handle everything else," Ye Yun said calmly to the elder in the green robe.
"Then I am indebted to you, fellow Daoist," replied the elder, gratefully.
He had power behind him, but that power didn’t care about whether he lived or died. If he died here on the Cangnan Continent, his faction would simply send another Defender of the Second level of True God Realm to take his place. Skyreach Island was a massive force, far beyond the abilities of a mere Defender of the Second level of True God Realm like himself to deal with.
Since this inscrutable fellow Daoist before him was willing to take over the subsequent pursuit from Skyreach Island, the elder in the green robe was naturally more than happy to see it happen and wanted to stay out of these muddy waters.
The elder in the green robe cupped his fists, bid Ye Yun farewell, then turned and vanished into the sky.
Only Ye Yun and Jiang Hengyue remained in the void.
"You should follow me," Ye Yun said calmly, before descending onto the deck of the flying ship.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, having just witnessed the Master’s Great Divine Power effortlessly dispatch an opponent of True God Realm Tier Seven, felt an intense yearning for such abilities.
"Master, when will you teach me this Divine Skill?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon asked with a smile, rubbing his hands together, unable to suppress his eagerness.
He knew Big Black Horse and Big Black Cat had both learned the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye. Of course, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon wanted to learn it too.
"After you finish this mission..." Ye Yun said with a smile.
He wasn’t one to be possessive of his techniques. Once the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon completed his mission, he would impart this Divine Skill to him. Ye Yun possessed many Divine Skills, and teaching a few more was no great matter. In the future, he planned to gradually pass on Divine Skills to the disciples of the sect and these demon beasts, ensuring that the Ultimate Techniques of the Dragon God Sect were not limited to just those three.
Ye Yun glanced at Lei Qinian, still unconscious, and a faint smile touched his lips.
This little fellow’s luck really isn’t very good. If I hadn’t sent the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon to protect him, this calamity would likely have cost Lei Qinian his life.
"Master, do you want me to wake him up now?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon quietly asked from the side.
"No need." Ye Yun shook his head.
He turned to Jiang Hengyue and asked calmly, "You little fellow have suffered so much. After entering this world, your cultivation was severed, and you might be stuck in the Eternal Realm forever. Do you regret it?"
Hearing this, Jiang Hengyue’s eyes reddened, welling up with shimmering tears.
"Senior, I don’t regret it. If I hadn’t entered, I fear I would have died outside long ago," Jiang Hengyue sighed. As he spoke these words, tears streamed down the corners of his eyes.
"Tell me, what exactly is the enmity between you and Skyreach Island?" Ye Yun asked with a smile.
Having accepted this young man, Jiang Hengyue, Ye Yun naturally wanted to understand the enmity between him and Skyreach Island. Letting Jiang Hengyue tell his own story was also a test.
If this little fellow proved to be cunning and dishonest, Ye Yun would eliminate him on the spot. Water can carry a boat, but it can also capsize it. Ye Yun wouldn’t keep a liar by his side. Verifying Jiang Hengyue’s words would be simple; after he finished speaking, Ye Yun could directly read his memories.
Hearing Ye Yun’s question, Jiang Hengyue’s expression turned fierce as he recalled the past.
He gritted his teeth and said, "Previously, I was the Young Island Master of Star Holy Island. My fiancée was stolen by Fu Nanhua, the Young Island Master of Skyreach Island. I went to confront him but was captured and thrown into his prison, where I was severely tortured. He cut off my nose, broke my arms, battered my entire body, and even pierced my Dantian with a Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword, crippling it..."
"The people of Skyreach Island are truly vicious."
Upon hearing Jiang Hengyue’s account, Ye Yun’s brow twitched slightly.
He most disliked people who tortured others through various means. He always preferred straightforwardness and swift resolutions to grudges. If Fu Nanhua, the Young Island Master of Skyreach Island, had given Jiang Hengyue a quick death, Ye Yun would have considered him somewhat normal. But to resort to cruel torture, Ye Yun found Fu Nanhua to be a sadist. As a transmigrator, Ye Yun had read plenty of news about psychopathic killers in his previous life. He utterly detested such individuals. Now that he had taken Jiang Hengyue in, he would naturally help him vent his anger. The karma Fu Nanhua had sown for Jiang Hengyue, Ye Yun would ensure Jiang Hengyue repaid it all.
"You were imprisoned, so how did you manage to escape?" Ye Yun asked again.
Jiang Hengyue said angrily, "Senior, my fiancée pleaded for me, and that beast in human guise hypocritically let me go. But after releasing me, he sent people to hunt me down. With no other options, I gritted my teeth and desperately entered the Ancient Road to Heaven..."
"I see." Ye Yun nodded.
Although he himself had once been the foremost bully on the Cangnan Continent, even he hadn’t committed acts as outrageous and universally condemned as Fu Nanhua.
"Now that your fiancée has fallen into Fu Nanhua’s hands, I’m afraid things look bleak for her..." Ye Yun sighed.
He felt a degree of goodwill towards this girl for her actions. Without her, Jiang Hengyue would likely have perished in Skyreach Island’s dungeons long ago.
"I heard they are holding a grand wedding on Skyreach Island on the sixth day of next month..." Jiang Hengyue said despondently.
Seeing Jiang Hengyue’s dejected expression, Ye Yun could understand his feelings.
If his own woman were taken by another, he too would fly into a towering rage for his beloved, draw his sword, and charge in to kill. But Jiang Hengyue, despite being saved by him, had his cultivation dropped to the tenth level of the Eternal Realm. Moreover, he was afflicted by the Ancestor Dragon’s Curse. His cultivation was now completely stagnant at the tenth level of the Eternal Realm, with no possibility of further breakthroughs.
Ye Yun thought for a moment and decided to try breaking the Ancestor Dragon’s Curse.
Now that he possessed the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline, breaking a curse laid down by the Ancestor Dragon might not be a difficult task for him. Breaking it wouldn’t be that easy, however. Ye Yun would need to spend some time researching it.
Having made this decision, Ye Yun felt somewhat more at ease. Then, his gaze fell upon the silver sword embedded in Jiang Hengyue’s lower abdomen.
"Is this Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword Fu Nanhua’s?" Ye Yun asked softly.
Jiang Hengyue lowered his head, looking at the silver sword in his lower abdomen, and said through clenched teeth, "Senior, this exceedingly vicious sword indeed belongs to Fu Nanhua."
This sword seems quite extraordinary. If it were rashly pulled from your Dantian, the power unleashed by the blade would likely obliterate your Dantian completely...
Ye Yun’s eyes flickered, as if, in that instant, he could see through Jiang Hengyue’s abdomen to the perilous situation within his Dantian.

chapters.title: Chapter 282: Easily Obtaining the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword
chapters.content:
Chapter 282: Chapter 282: Easily Obtaining the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword
"Indeed, as the Elder said, the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword is well-known throughout the Divine Land and is an extremely malicious magical treasure."
Jiang Hengyue frowned, saying dejectedly, "Although my body has improved, I can’t pull out this sword at all. I can only wait for it to continuously drain my life force."
"Taking out this sword is not difficult..." Ye Tian withdrew his gaze, shaking his head unconcernedly. To him, removing a small Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword was not a challenging task. He just needed to destroy the Seven-Star Sword Array inside it, and the sword would lose all its prowess. Then, it could be easily pulled out.
Ye Yun speculated that there were very few people in the world who could see through the miniature Seven-Star formation within the dragon pattern. After all, not many people possessed his terrifying Pupil Technique Divine Power.
Hearing Ye Yun’s words, Jiang Hengyue’s eyes lit up. He immediately asked, "Elder, do you mean you have a way to remove this sword?"
Ye Yun nodded.
Jiang Hengyue blinked, his face showing an incredulous expression. Once this sword was inserted into a person’s body, it essentially declared a slow death for them. No cultivator in the Divine Land was unaware of the power of this sword, but there wasn’t any better solution either. It was said that once a Divine Sovereign Realm cultivator tried to pull the sword out for his disciple, but he ultimately failed. He had managed to pull the sword out, but the destructive force released by it destroyed the disciple’s Dantian, leading to his instant death. The powerful force released by this silver sword also destroyed the life force within the human body, causing instantaneous death.
"Hey, boy, what are you blabbering about?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said irritably from the side. "If the Master says it can be removed, it can definitely be removed. If you don’t believe it, I’d advise you to get lost as soon as possible."
"Elder, I apologize for my ignorance." Jiang Hengyue quickly knelt on the ground, apologizing with a gloomy face.
"Get up." Ye Yun calmly said, and a surge of mana instantly helped Jiang Hengyue to his feet.
Jiang Hengyue was also his pawn. So, Ye Yun had to figure out a way to completely cure Jiang Hengyue.
The Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye was activated. In his pupils, countless star-like small runes appeared and disappeared, as a powerful force of birth and annihilation fiercely struck the dragon pattern.
BOOM!
The Seven-Star formation was instantly shattered by the flood-like force of birth and annihilation. Ye Yun retracted his power of birth and annihilation and, with a thought, a mana hand pulled the sword out.
After the sword was pulled out, Jiang Hengyue felt a stinging pain in his lower abdomen, and a gush of blood splattered out. He was so scared that his soul almost escaped his body. But he quickly discovered that there was no force exploding in his Dantian. He was instantly overjoyed.
This Elder was truly amazing. He broke the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword so easily... The Elder’s unfathomable power was truly incredible!
Jiang Hengyue quickly circulated his mana, stopping the bleeding from his lower abdomen. "Elder, thank you for the gift of rebirth." He couldn’t contain the gratitude in his heart and burst into tears.
"Hehe, you boy, you really wouldn’t shed a tear until you saw the coffin! I told you the Master could get it out, but you didn’t believe me," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon crossed his arms, making a sarcastic comment.
Ye Yun glared at him. The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon quickly shut his mouth, not daring to make another sound.
"Although your body has mostly recovered now, you are still impaired..." Ye Yun said with a smile. He then took out a small bottle. After carefully examining Jiang Hengyue’s physical condition, he poured three drops of green Water of Life from it, flicking them towards Jiang Hengyue. One drop vanished into the stump of his severed arm at the shoulder. The other two landed on his head.
As the three droplets of mysterious green liquid entered Jiang Hengyue’s body, he was surprised to find a vibrant life force stimulating rapid growth within him. He felt his nose, shoulder, and even his eye sockets begin to itch.
This...
Watching as an arm slowly began to grow back from the empty space at his shoulder, Jiang Hengyue was momentarily stunned.
He hadn’t expected this mysterious green liquid to possess such a regenerative effect, capable of regrowing a severed arm.
Jiang Hengyue wasn’t an ordinary cultivator; he had once reached the True God Realm Fourth Level, and his physical body could be considered a God Spirit Body. Ordinary medicine could never achieve this.
In the Divine Land, there were indeed supreme holy medicines that could regrow flesh, but he had only ever heard of them.
With the passage of time, the severed tip of his nose regrew first. A new eyeball also grew in the empty socket. Feeling that he could see clearly out of his other eye again, Jiang Hengyue trembled with excitement, unsure what to say.
Ye Yun smiled faintly. He looked around at the cultivators who had fallen on the deck. All these people had seen Jiang Hengyue and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon. In Ye Yun’s eyes, star-like runes began to shift. In that instant, he erased a segment of memory from the minds of all the cultivators. Their memories now stopped at the moment all the Void Wolves were killed. The same was true for Lei Qinian’s memory. Ye Yun did not give him any special treatment. The more they knew, the higher the risk. These cultivators had cultivation bases that were too low; they should not be involved in this turmoil.
After erasing their memories, Ye Yun sent a voice transmission informing the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon about the matter. After all, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon would be needed to escort Lei Qinian to the Heavenly Moon Secret Region next. He needed to be informed in a timely manner so he could comfortably remain on the ship with Lei Qinian.
After quite a while, Jiang Hengyue finally recovered from his state of shock.
"Do you know where Fu Nanhua obtained this sword?" Ye Yun held up the small silver sword, looking at Jiang Hengyue as he asked.
"Senior, I do not know. Swords like this are not unique in the Divine Land..." Jiang Hengyue replied honestly.
Ye Yun was taken aback. His gaze shifted slightly, and in an instant, he read Jiang Hengyue’s memories.
Everything was indeed as he had thought. Jiang Hengyue had not lied in any of his previous statements. He truly didn’t know much about this Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword. After all, the Star God Island where he was from, located in the sea region very close to the Cangnan Continent, was considered a peripheral part of the Divine Land, still very distant from the true Divine Land.
Ye Yun’s eyes flashed. At that moment, he made a snap decision. He planned to take Jiang Hengyue away from the Cangnan Continent and head to Skyreach Island in The Ninth Sea Area to find Fu Nanhua and uncover the true origin of this sword. He would also resolve the regret in Jiang Hengyue’s heart. After all, his fiancée was still in Fu Nanhua’s hands, and their wedding was imminent. As Jiang Hengyue’s master, he could not sit idly by.
The Ye Yun of one hundred thousand years ago had many female confidantes. If someone had dared to steal one of them and tried to make her their Bandit Chieftain’s Wife, he would absolutely have hunted them down. Therefore, Ye Yun greatly sympathized with Jiang Hengyue at this moment and prepared to head to Skyreach Island to rescue his fiancée.

chapters.title: Chapter 283: Tearing Through the Void, Arriving at the Ancient Road to Heaven
chapters.content:
Chapter 283: Chapter 283: Tearing Through the Void, Arriving at the Ancient Road to Heaven
"Jiang Hengyue."
Ye Yun suddenly called out, his expression more serious than before.
Jiang Hengyue’s heart skipped a beat, and he quickly bowed. "Senior, please instruct me if there is any matter."
Ye Yun spoke in a calm voice, "Would you like to join my Dragon God Sect?"
"This junior is willing."
Jiang Hengyue agreed immediately without any hesitation.
His life had been saved by this Senior. Not only had the Senior saved his life, but he had even reconstructed his body. Such kindness was something he could never repay, even if he were ground to dust. Even though he was the Young Island Master of Star God Island, what did that matter compared to joining the Dragon God Sect?
"You are very good!" Ye Yun nodded, smiling as he continued, "I will take you to Skyreach Island to exact your revenge and win your fiancée back."
"Senior..."
Upon hearing Ye Yun’s words, Jiang Hengyue’s heart surged with emotion, and tears gushed from his eyes.
He had never imagined that this unfathomable Senior before him would actually take him to Skyreach Island for revenge.
He was incredibly moved.
Tears streamed down his face, and he didn’t even bother to wipe them away. Jiang Hengyue knelt once more, kowtowing repeatedly to Ye Yun.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon crossed his arms over his chest. "TSK TSK," he remarked. "You’re really lucky. As soon as you join the Dragon God Sect, you have the Master himself taking you out for revenge."
"Yes! I was so lucky to meet Master."
Jiang Hengyue wept and laughed, appearing somewhat unhinged.
He had been in an unimaginable predicament; if not for his resilient will, he would have died long ago.
Even so, he had never dreamed that he would one day counter-attack the unimaginably powerful Skyreach Island.
This immense surprise scattered the despair in his heart.
"Get up," Ye Yun said with a smile.
He quite appreciated this young man, Jiang Hengyue. He was sincere, straightforward, and possessed exceptional resolve. Such a person was destined for greatness.
The Dragon God Sect... Naturally, it couldn’t remain forever in this little corner of the Cangnan Continent. Sooner or later, it would have to venture out. In that case, Star God Island and Skyreach Island in the Ninth Sea Area would be the Dragon God Sect’s first step in expanding its territory.
"Okay, Senior."
Jiang Hengyue quickly wiped away his tears and stood up.
"Don’t call me Senior anymore. Just address me as Master. This is a rule of the Dragon God Sect," Ye Yun said with a light chuckle.
"I understand, Master," Jiang Hengyue said with a smile, wiping his tears.
"Brother, your swordsmanship is truly excellent," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon chimed in, patting Jiang Hengyue’s shoulder with a grin. "Now that we’re fellow disciples, we should spar more often when we have the chance..."
"Of course, of course. I apologize if I was offensive earlier. Please forgive me, Big Brother," Jiang Hengyue said modestly.
"Haha, it’s nothing, nothing at all," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon laughed heartily.
"Little Dragon, you continue on the flying ship to the Heavenly Moon Secret Region. I need to take Jiang Hengyue out for a while..." Ye Yun looked at the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and instructed calmly.
"Master, rest assured! I will take good care of that young fellow Lei Qinian." The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon thumped his chest—THUMP! THUMP!—and confidently vowed.
Ye Yun nodded.
At that moment, a beam of light enveloped him and Jiang Hengyue, and they instantly vanished into the void.
Ye Yun tore through the void, swiftly heading for the Ancient Road to Heaven, located within the astral winds of the sea region at the outer periphery of the Cangnan Continent.
Witnessing how the endless void became as fragile as thin paper before the Master, and how each of his spatial tears spanned at least several hundred million miles, Jiang Hengyue’s heart pounded, his astonishment beyond words.
The Master was truly too powerful. Such terrifying strength had long surpassed the Divine Monarch Realm. This potent ability to tear space likely meant he had already reached the Divine Sovereign Realm.
"Master, could it be that your cultivation base is at the Divine Sovereign Realm?" Watching Ye Yun effortlessly tear through the void beside him, Jiang Hengyue coughed lightly, gathered his courage, and ventured to ask.
"I’ll reach the Divine Sovereign Realm soon..." Ye Yun said with a smile, not hiding his cultivation base.
He was currently at the Seventh Realm of God King, only three minor realms away from the Divine Sovereign Realm. If he hurried, it wouldn’t even take a month.
For Ye Yun, cultivation was as simple as eating and drinking. It all depended on whether he felt like cultivating.
"Master, you are truly formidable! Even in the Divine Land, I have never seen anyone stronger than you," Jiang Hengyue rubbed his hands together and said with a laugh.
"Haha, no need for flattery," Ye Yun chuckled. With a powerful tear of his hands, they instantly stepped out of that space.
They were now in the outermost region of the sea, amidst the fierce astral winds.
The astral winds rolled in, howling as they approached.
WHOOSH! WHOOSH! They emitted continuous, thunderous roars.
However, when these violent astral winds reached Ye Yun’s side, they immediately detoured, not daring to blow upon him at all.
Jiang Hengyue was so frightened he could only click his tongue.
Ye Yun’s gaze flickered as he searched for the location of the Ancient Road to Heaven. After a few breaths, he confirmed the coordinates.
The next moment, Ye Yun reached out and tore apart the space within the astral winds.
"What? The Master can tear apart space even here?" Jiang Hengyue, standing beside him, widened his eyes again, dumbstruck with amazement.
The space within these astral winds was unimaginably resilient. In his understanding, only someone at the Divine King Realm could possibly tear through the space here.
Yet the Master had nonchalantly torn this space again, leaving him utterly astounded.
Ye Yun continuously tore through space, covering millions of miles, until he finally arrived at the Ancient Road to Heaven.
Standing amidst the fierce astral winds with his hands clasped behind his back, Ye Yun calmly gazed at the ancient passage.
The entire Ancient Road to Heaven was incredibly vast; its width alone spanned several thousand feet.
The Ancient Road to Heaven was entirely golden, emitting a faint yellow glow. It floated in the void, exuding an indescribable aura of ancient vicissitude.
WHOOSH! WHOOSH! Countless gales battered the Ancient Road to Heaven, yet they couldn’t damage it in the slightest.
"You entered through this road, didn’t you?" Ye Yun asked with a smile.
"Yes, Senior. This Ancient Road to Heaven is truly terrifying. I exhausted all my magical artifacts and suffered grievous injuries just to make it through," Jiang Hengyue replied, looking at the golden Ancient Road to Heaven before him, a hint of lingering fear in his eyes.
The Ancient Road to Heaven was truly horrifying.
At that time, he was at the True God Realm First Level.
Initially, he had thought he would pass through easily, but he hadn’t expected the sheer number of perils he would encounter. All sorts of bizarre celestial phenomena appeared one after another, and there were also unknown void-dwelling demon beasts that constantly ambushed him.
He had barely survived, relying on heaven-defying luck to break through.
If he had to traverse it a second time, even with the same magical artifacts, Jiang Hengyue doubted he could be so fortunate again.
Unless his cultivation reached the True God Realm Fifth Layer and he possessed twice as many magical artifacts, only then would he have the confidence to successfully cross the Ancient Road to Heaven again.
"Alright, let’s travel this road again." Ye Yun looked at the Ancient Road to Heaven, which emitted a faint yellow glow. A smile graced his face, and a hint of anticipation flashed in his eyes.
It had been one hundred thousand years. This was his first time leaving the Cangnan Continent to enter the Divine Land.

chapters.title: Chapter 284: Terrifying Heavenly Phenomenon, Flame Giant Eye
chapters.content:
Chapter 284: Chapter 284: Terrifying Heavenly Phenomenon, Flame Giant Eye
Although Ye Yun had gained the strength to journey through the Ancient Road to Heaven and leave the Cangnan Continent for the Divine Land after his rebirth, in reality, he was held back by his ties to the three juniors of the Dragon God Sect. Ye Yun had never taken that step forward. For Ye Yun, time held no meaning. Thus, as their Ancestor, he wanted to thoroughly nurture the three juniors of the Dragon God Sect before he could leave the Cangnan Continent for the Divine Land in peace.
It was fortunate he had such sentiments, as this allowed Ye Yun to continuously uncover various clues left by the mastermind during the subsequent process. Ye Yun believed that as he journeyed from the Cangnan Continent, he would continue to find more traces left by this mastermind. He also wanted to see just what kind of heaven-defying schemes this deeply hidden mastermind had laid out. Unraveling the situation step by step was quite interesting for Ye Yun.
This time, bringing Jiang Hengyue through the Ancient Road to Heaven and into the Divine Land was also a way for Ye Yun to fulfill a dream he had cherished for one hundred thousand years.
His heart stirred with some emotion. Ye Yun also wanted to see for himself what the Divine Land was truly like, as he couldn’t genuinely experience it through Jiang Hengyue’s memories alone.
"Senior, with such a high cultivation base, have you truly never ventured out?" Jiang Hengyue asked, shocked by Ye Yun’s words.
"That’s right, I’ve never been out," Ye Yun replied with a hearty laugh.
Jiang Hengyue was thoroughly stunned. After a long pause, he finally said, "Senior, I always believed you were a Wushang existence from the Divine Land. I never imagined... that you actually cultivated to this realm right here on the Dragon Hidden Continent."
"Indeed. It was here that I cultivated, step by step, to the Divine Monarch Realm," Ye Yun stated calmly with a smile.
With that said, Ye Yun clasped his hands behind his back and, with a leisurely stride, stepped onto the Ancient Road to Heaven.
As he set foot on the Ancient Road to Heaven, the Divine-level Array hidden within it seemed to sense his presence, instantly flaring with a light far more brilliant than before. The initially pale yellow radiance intensified, becoming as dense as a Golden Dragon extending far into the endless astral winds.
Jiang Hengyue quickly followed. Walking beside his senior, he was astonished to find that the astral winds on the Ancient Road to Heaven couldn’t even approach Ye Yun.
A storm of shock surged through him. The astral winds on the Road to Heaven were far more ferocious than anywhere else, yet now they behaved like docile lambs, automatically parting whenever they came within several dozen feet of the elder.
Ye Yun chose not to tear through space here. He sensed that the space around the Ancient Road to Heaven was somewhat unstable, and doing so might affect the Divine-level Array concealed within the ancient road.
Instead, Ye Yun flew swiftly with Jiang Hengyue. His current speed far surpassed that of a True God Realm Cultivator tearing through space.
All of this left Jiang Hengyue utterly astounded and in awe.
RUMBLE!
From the distant astral winds, dazzling pillars of lightning suddenly rained down from the sky, striking the Ancient Road to Heaven with deafening roars. Lightning scattered in all directions before instantly vanishing. Yet, the Ancient Road to Heaven remained completely unscathed, without a single mark.
Seeing this, Ye Yun pointed ahead and chuckled, "So, the Thunder Zone is next, is it?"
"Yes, Senior. The Ancient Road to Heaven has several distinct regions, each filled with various terrifying natural phenomena. Some areas even have Void Beasts roaming within them..." Jiang Hengyue quickly explained.
"Let’s proceed," Ye Yun smiled and continued forward with Jiang Hengyue.
Soon, they entered the confines of the Thunder Zone. The moment they stepped in, the entire region seemed to become agitated. Thunder boomed relentlessly from above as dense barrages of lightning bolts rained down.
Ye Yun, hands clasped behind his back, remained calm and made no move. A faint, sacred light emanated from his body. As the lightning pillars neared, coming within several dozen feet of them, they were instantly repelled by an inexplicable force, utterly unable to penetrate the protective barrier Ye Yun had established.
The two continued onward and soon passed through the Thunder Zone.
Beyond the Thunder Zone lay another region of fierce astral winds. However, this area was filled with vast quantities of black smoke. The smoke was so incredibly dense that it dyed the entire expanse before them as black as ink. Far ahead, the Ancient Road to Heaven, resembling a Golden Dragon, plunged headfirst into this blackened space.
"Senior, this smoke is highly toxic..." Jiang Hengyue whispered. He recalled the immense trouble he had faced here previously, expending numerous Dharma treasures just to force his way through.
Ye Yun gave a slight nod and continued onward.
As they entered the blackened space, countless streams of the black smoke, driven by the fierce astral winds, drifted towards them. Carrying an unimaginably potent toxin, the black mist began to sizzle and hiss upon contact with the shield of sacred light Ye Yun had manifested.
It seems this toxic mist severely erodes divine power...
Ye Yun mused inwardly, nodding to himself.
However, that only applies to ordinary True Gods. Such trivial mist poses no threat to me.
They passed through this Poisonous Fog Region with ease.
After the Poisonous Fog Region, heavy, goose-feather-like snow began to fall, plunging the surroundings into extreme cold. The dense yellow light emanating from the Ancient Road to Heaven couldn’t prevent the snowflakes from landing, and soon a thick layer of snow blanketed the golden path.
Witnessing this, Ye Yun couldn’t help but exclaim in admiration.
This place truly defies the workings of heaven and earth. Such terrifying natural phenomena, creating all sorts of obstacles, are clearly meant to prevent anyone from entering or leaving.
Who could have established all this?
The thought suddenly surfaced in Ye Yun’s mind.
Those capable of creating such terrifying phenomena could only be beings from the Divine Land or the ancient Dragon Clan. However, I suspect the ancient Dragon Clan is more likely. After all, these successive barriers seem designed to protect the Cangnan Continent. The Ancient Road to Heaven, on the other hand, was likely constructed by people from the Divine Land to facilitate their entry into the Cangnan Continent. That green-robed old man, being a Defender, must possess a travel Token for the Ancient Road to Heaven. Otherwise, with his mere True God Realm First Level cultivation base, he couldn’t possibly traverse this ancient road.
After this internal deduction, Ye Yun gained a clearer understanding of the Ancient Road to Heaven’s origins.
After traversing the extreme cold of the blizzard region, the landscape ahead abruptly transformed into a blazing inferno. The surrounding void was entirely filled with fire. Crimson flames burned violently, radiating an unimaginably intense heat that seared the very void red.
Ye Yun merely glanced at the flames before striding through. Jiang Hengyue followed closely, his heart pounding with trepidation. These raging infernos were potent enough to inflict severe damage upon a True God Realm Cultivator.
He recalled how, the last time, he had fortunately possessed a Fire-attribute treasure that shielded him from such ferocious flames, allowing him to pass through by a hair’s breadth.
Ye Yun remained serene, strolling casually amidst the flames. At that moment, all the fires recoiled, parting in every direction as if instinctively terrified. Just then, the flames surged violently, and a colossal Flame Giant Eye materialized without any warning.

chapters.title: Chapter 285: Flames, Poison Rain, Yellow Sand, Void Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 285: Chapter 285: Flames, Poison Rain, Yellow Sand, Void Beast
A scarlet Flame Giant Eye. It was several hundred feet in diameter, suspended in mid-air, its red orbs constantly rotating, creating an exceptionally eerie sensation.
"What is that?"
Jiang Hengyue looked up at the Flame Giant Eye, terror reflected in his eyes.
Ye Yun glanced up, the corners of his lips curling into a slight, cold smirk.
Someone is actually spying? What a joke.
He raised his hand, and a ray of light shot out.
This ray of light, like an unsheathed sharp sword, fiercely pierced the Flame Giant Eye.
"AARGH!"
The Flame Giant Eye let out a lamenting cry and then suddenly exploded.
Countless sparks scattered in all directions before merging back into the surrounding flames.
"Senior, what exactly was that?" Jiang Hengyue asked with a furrowed brow.
That Flame Giant Eye had actually made him feel a powerful spiritual pressure, as if a mighty Spirit was looking down on him from the highest heavens.
"Some people with ill intentions insisted on spying on us, so I just burst his eye..."
Ye Yun smiled faintly, as if he hadn’t taken the matter to heart at all, and continued to stroll leisurely through the raging flames.
All the flames retreated to the sides, clearing a path for him.
In the distance, within the flames, some illusory Fire Dragons were constantly weaving about, but they remained very far from Ye Yun, not daring to advance even half a step.
Senior is truly invincible!
Following behind Ye Yun, with not the slightest hint of fiery heat penetrating through, Jiang Hengyue couldn’t help but marvel inwardly.
Although he was the Young Island Master of Star God Island, Jiang Hengyue had never actually met a spiritual cultivator of the Divine Monarch Realm.
Even though there were rumors that Skyreach Island was guarded by a powerful being of the Divine Monarch Realm...
But in reality, this was just a legend, as no one had ever actually seen such a person.
In the True God Realm, each advancement to a new level is like ascending to another layer of heaven. The difference in combat power is extremely distinct.
So, he couldn’t begin to fathom the horrifying level of combat power that the Divine Monarch Realm could achieve.
Ye Yun led him through this expanse of flames quickly and effortlessly.
Ye Yun’s speed seemed slow, but it was actually incredibly fast.
After passing through the flame region, they entered an area of raging thunderstorms.
Countless black raindrops fell from mid-air, possessing immense corrosiveness. They landed on the Ancient Road to Heaven, making a SIZZLING sound, yet were unable to penetrate it.
Ye Yun, quite intrigued, stretched out his hand and caught some of the black rainwater, observing it closely as it lay in his palm.
This corrosive black rainwater SIZZLED in his palm as if it were alive, continuously trying to erode his hand.
But it was completely useless.
Ye Yun’s physical body was unimaginably powerful; the merely corrosive rainwater could do nothing to him.
"Senior, your physical body is truly too powerful! Mine, on the other hand, is not up to par..." Jiang Hengyue sighed beside him.
"Does the black rainwater corrode your physical body severely?" Ye Yun asked with a smile.
"Yes. My physical body has recovered now, and it can be considered a True God Realm physique, but even so, it cannot withstand the erosion of this black rainwater..." Jiang Hengyue gave a bitter smile, then also extended his hand to catch a droplet of the black rainwater.
Instantly, the black raindrop SIZZLED on his palm, and within a few breaths, it had burned a hole right through it.
The raindrop fell through the hole in his hand and landed on the Ancient Road to Heaven.
With a bitter smile, Jiang Hengyue held up his palm and gazed at the small hole in its center, shaking his head helplessly.
He currently had no defensive artifacts; relying solely on his True God Realm physical body, he simply couldn’t endure it.
"It seems I’ve somewhat underestimated this black rainwater..." Ye Yun’s gaze flickered. With a flick of his finger, a green droplet of the Water of Life flew into Jiang Hengyue’s palm.
This droplet of Water of Life merged into his skin, transforming into a surging wave of vitality.
The small hole in his hand instantly grew new flesh, becoming as good as new.
However, the remaining immense life force still surged within his body, causing Jiang Hengyue’s face to flush red as he couldn’t help but let out a muffled groan.
"Senior, this power is so strong! It seems to be seeking an outlet..." Jiang Hengyue said with difficulty, a terrifying thought actually rising in his heart at that moment.
He had no injuries at the moment, but the energy generated by this one droplet of Mysterious Green Liquid was too immense; his body felt like it was about to explode.
Seeing this, Ye Yun pointed a finger at him.
The surging life force within Jiang Hengyue’s body instantly calmed down, becoming docile and still.
"For now, let it remain stored in your body. In the future, if you get injured, it will help you recover quickly..." Ye Yun said with a smile.
"Thank you very much, Sir!" Jiang Hengyue was overjoyed. He quickly bowed in salute, respectfully performing a deep bow to Ye Yun.
He realized his good fortune had truly arrived.
Ever since he met this unfathomable elder from the Dragon God Sect, Jiang Hengyue felt as if a wondrous door had opened before him.
Many things he had never dared to imagine before, had never seen, or that had only existed in legends—he was now encountering them.
Jiang Hengyue shook his head, feeling as if he were in a dream.
The two of them also quickly passed through this region of raging thunderstorms.
Of course, Ye Yun led Jiang Hengyue the entire way; otherwise, with Jiang Hengyue’s own speed, it would have been impossible for him to pass through each region so quickly.
After the thunderstorm region, the next area was filled with yellow sand that blotted out the sky.
Countless yellow sand particles surged forward. It was unknown what these fine grains were made of, but they made THUDDING sounds as they struck the Ancient Road to Heaven.
At this moment, the yellow light emanating from the Ancient Road to Heaven grew denser, enveloping the entire path.
Upon seeing the yellow sand surging towards them, Jiang Hengyue’s expression turned grim.
Previously, in this place, he had almost lost his life.
Fortunately, he had possessed enough artifacts; he had only managed to pass through after losing many of them.
Ye Yun again stretched out his hand to gently feel the power of the yellow sand, then nonchalantly withdrew it.
This yellow sand seemed aggressive, but when it struck his hand, it felt merely like a gentle breeze.
It was even less forceful than a tickle.
Ye Yun sighed.
It seems this Ancestor Dragon body of mine is truly powerful to a perverse degree.
After passing through this region of sky-obscuring yellow sand.
「The surrounding scenery changed once more.」
In an expanse of void, a clear blue sky with white clouds suddenly appeared.
"Sir, this place is filled with many Void Beasts..." Jiang Hengyue whispered from behind him.
"It’s fine..." Ye Yun smiled faintly. He glanced around, and at that moment, his Divine Sense swept out in all directions like a tidal wave.
Indeed, within the void, he spotted several kinds of Void Beasts.
There were Void Wolves, like those he had encountered before at Thunderbolt Shadow Mountain, as well as Void Thunder Tigers, and Void Shadow Snakes... In the farthest reaches, he even spotted a few Void Divine Dragons.
These Void Beasts all possessed high cultivation bases, having reached the True God Realm.
"No wonder so few cultivators from the Cangnan Continent have managed to leave over all these years. These trials, one after another, are so difficult. Unless one is an exceptionally brilliant talent, it’s simply impossible to pass through." Ye Yun withdrew his gaze, sighing softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 286: Void Divine Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 286: Chapter 286: Void Divine Dragon
"Senior, you’re absolutely right," Jiang Hengyue sighed, a lingering fear in his voice. "For cultivators in this place, it’s simply too difficult to get out! Even for Divine Earth Cultivators like us, who are at the True God Realm, trying to enter would mean either death or severe injury."
"Indeed. These barriers isolate the spiritual cultivators of the Divine Land, but they also block the path of advancement for the cultivators on Cangnan Continent," Ye Yun sighed faintly.
Millions of years had passed from Ancient Times to the present. Cangnan Continent had undoubtedly produced many exceptionally talented individuals capable of cultivating to the True God Realm. If they wished to continue their cultivation, they had to go to the Divine Land. However, this path was fraught with peril, and the probability of dying was far too high.
Ye Yun suddenly recalled the two Eternal Realm cultivators he had encountered when he first arrived at the ocean barrier. They had once mentioned that Cangnan Continent had produced three True Gods who successfully traversed the Ancient Road to Heaven. Considering the current circumstances, it was difficult to say whether those three had truly made it all the way through. If they had indeed managed to pass, then the strength of these three individuals would definitely have far surpassed cultivators of the same realm in the Divine Land.
Dragon Xuan is one of them...
A figure surfaced in Ye Yun’s mind—Dragon Xuan, the 250th Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect.
That fellow inherited the legacy of the Nine Soul Emperor and also obtained all the resources of the Dragon God Sect; his passage through the Ancient Road to Heaven should be practically guaranteed.
"Senior, once we get through the area attacked by the Void Beasts, a clear path will lie ahead, and the Ancient Road to Heaven will finally end," Jiang Hengyue said, his expression relaxing as if he had seen a glimmer of hope. He had never imagined that following the Master would make traversing the Ancient Road to Heaven so effortless.
Ye Yun nodded.
With a dragon’s roar, the surrounding Void Beasts suddenly grew agitated and charged towards Ye Yun.
Seeing these small, True God Realm Void Beasts rushing towards him, Ye Yun raised an eyebrow, a faint smile playing on his lips. He didn’t even use any Divine Skills. He merely raised a palm and casually slapped outwards.
Instantly, countless Void Beasts shrieked as his slap sent them flying.
Ye Yun didn’t kill the Void Beasts here. If the major regions here were all established by the Ancient Dragon Clan, then he, as the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect who possessed the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline, naturally couldn’t destroy these places. Even if he were to destroy something, it would be the Ancient Road to Heaven itself. However, the current Ancient Road to Heaven served no real purpose; it was merely a formality. Destroying it or not was meaningless.
After this wave of Void Beasts was sent flying, an angry dragon’s roar echoed, and several more waves of Void Beasts charged over. Ye Yun waved his hand, once again sending all these Void Beasts flying.
His eyes narrowed slightly as he spotted several Void Divine Dragons in the distance. Dragons were now extremely rare on the Cangnan Continent, yet a few still lived in this place. Counting them, there were no more than six in total. All possessed a True God Realm cultivation base, with the strongest having reached the True God Realm Tenth Layer.
"Wait for me here," Ye Yun said lightly, casually conjuring a protective light shield around Jiang Hengyue before departing through the air.
Jiang Hengyue was startled, but seeing the light shield enveloping him, he calmed down.
He didn’t know what Senior was searching for in the depths of the void. Could it be that he planned to kill the Divine Dragons in here?
When Jiang Hengyue had first entered this area, he hadn’t been attacked by so many Void Beasts. Only a few Void Wolves had launched a symbolic attack against him, allowing him to pass through this area with ease.
What is that?
Just as Jiang Hengyue’s heart settled, he suddenly saw a faint shadow appear in front of him. He couldn’t see it clearly, but he could sense that someone seemed to be standing there. Then, to his astonishment, the figure stretched out a massive hand. It grabbed him, along with the protective shield, and pulled him directly into the void, disappearing in an instant.
Ye Yun, who was in mid-flight, suddenly halted and cast a meaningful glance behind him.
So it was that fellow... He actually captured Jiang Hengyue. But it didn’t matter. If that fellow dares to touch a single hair on Jiang Hengyue, I’ll wring his head off.
Ye Yun didn’t know the origins of this fellow either. Back then, in that region of fire, that fellow had used a Divine Skill, condensing flames into a Flame Giant Eye to spy on him. Ye Yun had shattered it with a casual move at the time.
Ye Yun quickened his pace, reaching the hiding place of those few Void Divine Dragons in an instant. These few Void Divine Dragons were concealed within space, yet Ye Yun could discern their hidden locations.
"There’s no need to hide anymore," Ye Yun said calmly, standing firm in the void and looking in a certain direction.
The void fluctuated, revealing six enormous figures. These were six Void Divine Dragons.
In Ancient Times, the Void Divine Dragon was also one of the Divine Dragons, though naturally not as renowned as the Ten Super Divine Dragons. However, the Void Divine Dragon lineage was closely related to the Spatial Mirage Dragon, one of the Ten Super Divine Dragons.
Gazing at these colossal creatures before him, Ye Yun’s eyes narrowed slightly as he observed them carefully. A hint of disappointment flickered in his eyes. The bloodline possessed by these Void Divine Dragons was extremely diluted. They couldn’t compare to the true Void Divine Dragons of Ancient Times.
However, upon further thought, he understood. After all, so much time had passed. Various types of Divine Dragons had long since become extinct on the Cangnan Continent, and any bloodlines that managed to survive would be exceedingly diluted.
Ye Yun extended his hand, laying down a restriction that sealed the surrounding space.
"What are you trying to do, Human?" the Void Divine Dragon with the highest cultivation base asked, staring nervously at Ye Yun, its eyes filled with immense fury. It couldn’t fathom the depths of this human before it.
When this human had entered the thunderstorm region, it had secretly snuck over and observed him from afar, finding him to be exceedingly powerful. Afterward, it had quietly returned and consulted with its kin. They ultimately decided to drive those Void Beasts to attack this human.
They wanted to see what his true strength really was.
But they hadn’t expected that all the Void Beasts combined would be no match for him; they were all defeated.
What astonished the Void Divine Dragons was that even though they were hidden in the void, this human could still accurately discover them and pinpoint their location. This instilled a great sense of crisis in the Void Divine Dragons. The Void Divine Dragons hadn’t imagined that human cultivators on the Dragon Hidden Continent of today could have become so powerful.
"How long have you few been guarding this place? And by whose command?" Ye Yun suddenly asked, looking at the six Void Divine Dragons before him.
"Human, don’t push your luck! This is none of your concern," the leading Void Divine Dragon roared, its dragon eyes flashing with a cold glint as it spoke with immense anger.

chapters.title: Chapter 287 - 9 million years, Guarding on the orders of the Ancestor Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 287: Chapter 287: 9 million years, Guarding on the orders of the Ancestor Dragon
"Humans, we acknowledge your strength, but if you push us, we won’t stop until one of us perishes."
Another Void Divine Dragon roared angrily.
Clearly, Ye Yun’s words had truly hit a sore spot, touching the deepest sensitivities of their hearts.
In their hearts, the Dragon Clan was seen as the most noble race in this world, with humans being nothing but insignificant ants beneath their feet.
Ye Yun merely smiled faintly.
He seemed undaunted by the Void Divine Dragons’ reaction.
It seemed that the Void Divine Dragon Clan had been guarding this place for a very, very long time, causing their beliefs to become deeply entrenched—that the Dragon Clan would forever be the world’s most noble and powerful race. But in reality, the Dragon Clan on the Cangnan Continent was already on the brink of extinction. The glory of the Dragon Clan had long since faded into the mists of history.
Ye Yun’s body shifted slightly, exuding a wisp of the Ancestral Dragon’s Breath.
At this moment, he had to reveal his identity. Within the Dragon Clan, the concept of hierarchy was extremely strict. As long as he released the Ancestral Dragon’s Breath, any member of the Dragon Clan would submit.
An immense and supremely majestic Ancestral Dragon’s Breath spread out.
The faces of the six Void Divine Dragons opposite him changed drastically. Their bodies trembled, their expressions filled with intense excitement.
"Ancestor Dragon... This is the Ancestral Dragon’s Breath!"
The leading Void Divine Dragon murmured to itself, looking at Ye Yun, profound confusion showing in its dragon eyes.
"You are clearly human, so why do you possess the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline?" this Void Divine Dragon asked in a trembling voice, its dragon eyes fixed firmly on Ye Yun, as if trying to see through the human’s entire body.
"Is this a question for insignificant Void Divine Dragons like you to ask? Kneel at once!"
Ye Yun’s expression turned cold as another wave of the mighty Ancestral Dragon’s Breath was released.
The Void Divine Dragons were instantly frightened out of their wits. No longer daring to harbor any rebellious thoughts, they all obediently prostrated themselves at Ye Yun’s feet.
In Ye Yun’s eyes, symbols as tiny as stars began to flicker in and out of existence. He started to probe the minds of these Void Divine Dragons.
There seemed to be no issue, nor any signs of manipulation or tampering.
Ye Yun’s pupils constricted slightly as he began to read the memories of one Void Divine Dragon.
BANG!
The head of this Void Divine Dragon inexplicably exploded.
Witnessing this, Ye Yun’s face turned extremely cold.
The mastermind’s scheme is truly far-reaching; even the Void Divine Dragons guarding this place have restrictions placed within their minds. Once their memories are read, they explode and die.
However, the vitality of Divine Dragons was exceedingly robust and tenacious. Even with its head blown open, the massive body still struggled in pain.
The other Void Divine Dragons, upon seeing their comrade die so tragically, had bloodshot eyes.
But under the pressure of the Ancestral Dragon’s Breath, they dared not make a single move.
Ye Yun naturally wouldn’t stand idly by.
As long as the Divine Dragon has only just died, I still have a way to bring it back to life.
Ye Yun reached into his storage, instantly retrieving a pale blue, transparent Eight Treasures Liuli Bottle containing the Three Lights Divine Water.
The Three Lights Divine Water was comprised of Sun Light Divine Water, Moon Light Divine Water, and Starlight Divine Water.
Within the Eight Treasures Liuli Bottle, they were stored in three separate compartments.
Ye Yun poured out a drop from each, merging them to form the true Three Lights Divine Water. With a flick of his finger, it landed on the Void Divine Dragon whose head had exploded.
The Void Divine Dragon’s head quickly regrew.
Its scattered Dragon Soul was also forcibly drawn back by the medicinal power, returning to its head once more.
Seeing this, Ye Yun nodded silently in approval.
This is indeed the most potent Sacred Healing Medicine in the Primordial World, possessing miraculous life-reviving properties. Among his rewards from one hundred thousand years of check-ins, Ye Yun had received too many treasures. These items came from various dimensional worlds across the cosmos. The Three Lights Divine Water, for instance, came from the Primordial World.
This Void Divine Dragon, resurrected from death, looked around in a daze, clueless about what had just transpired.
Ye Yun once again activated the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye to read its memories, but found that they had completely vanished.
It seemed the earlier explosion had destroyed all its memories.
Ye Yun sighed softly.
The other Void Divine Dragons sighed in relief to see their companion resurrected. They couldn’t help but feel a deep admiration for this human who possessed the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline.
"I have a few questions for you."
Ye Yun lifted his gaze, fixing it on the leading Void Divine Dragon.
Since reading memories is no longer feasible, I’ll have to obtain the information I want through questioning.
As he finished speaking, Ye Yun once again intensified the Ancestral Dragon’s Breath emanating from him.
The surging Ancestral Dragon’s Breath instantly made these Void Divine Dragons submit completely from the depths of their hearts.
Seeing the Void Divine Dragons completely submit to him, Ye Yun nodded with satisfaction.
These lesser Void Divine Dragons have probably been guarding this place for too long, their minds becoming extremely rigid. That’s why I had to release two more wisps of Ancestral Dragon’s Breath. However, these Void Divine Dragons are also quite pitiful. Ye Yun guessed that these Void Divine Dragons stationed here had likely been guarding for countless years.
"Lord Ancestor Dragon, please ask whatever you wish," the leading Void Divine Dragon said with utmost respect.
"How long has your Void Divine Dragon clan been guarding the Ancient Road to Heaven?" Ye Yun asked.
Such a simple question shouldn’t have its answer sealed in their memories by the mastermind. This first question was just to test the waters. If their memories weren’t locked, then I would continue asking.
"Lord Ancestor Dragon, our lineage of Void Divine Dragons has been guarding the Ancient Road to Heaven since the Ancient Times, following the command of the Ancestor Dragon. This duty has been passed down through generations, and it has now been over nine million years..." the leading Void Divine Dragon said respectfully.
Nine million years!
Ye Yun was profoundly shocked.
This branch of the Void Divine Dragon lineage has been guarding for so incredibly long. Even with the restrictions placed by the mastermind, they remained unaware, loyally carrying out the Ancestor Dragon’s command here.
"In the Ancient Times, did the Divine Land Spirit cultivators wage war against the Dragon Clan of the Dragon Hidden Continent?" Ye Yun asked.
"Lord Spatial Mirage Dragon once led us here to resist the Divine Land Spirits. Many of our Clan Members were killed or injured in that battle..." the leading Void Divine Dragon said.
Ye Yun nodded.
I never would have thought... One of the Ten Super Divine Dragons, the Spatial Mirage Dragon, actually led the Void Divine Dragon clan here to block the offensive of the Divine Land Spirits. From what Ye Yun understood, in the Ancient Times, the Spirits and the Dragon Clan had fought several wars, but none had resulted in a decisive victory. After the Ancestor Dragon vanished, the Ten Super Divine Dragons fell into internal strife, fighting amongst themselves and significantly depleting their combat strength. Later, the Divine Land Spirit Army invaded the Dragon Hidden Continent, nearly exterminating all Dragon Clan members and decisively securing their victory.
"Do you know what the Dragon Hidden Continent is like now?" Ye Yun’s eyes flickered as he suddenly asked.
"We do not know."
The leading Void Divine Dragon replied with a sorrowful expression, sighing, "Reporting to Lord Ancestor Dragon, after that great war in distant memory between our Dragon Clan and the Divine Land Spirits, we have remained guarding this place, never once leaving.
"But as the long eons passed, our Clan Members grew fewer and fewer. Now, only six of us remain. I fear that in another few tens of thousands of years, when we die of old age, there will no longer be any Dragon Clan members left to guard this place..."

chapters.title: Chapter 288: The Gatekeeper on the Ancient Road to Heaven
chapters.content:
Chapter 288: Chapter 288: The Gatekeeper on the Ancient Road to Heaven
Listening to the mournful voice of the Void Divine Dragon, Ye Yun’s mood also turned somewhat heavy.
The declining Dragon Clan was slowly disappearing from this continent.
This fate, with the disappearance of the Ancestor Dragon, seemed to have been predetermined long ago.
The six Void Divine Dragons before him, if they continued to guard here, would all die in tens of thousands of years.
None of these Void Divine Dragons were females; they had lost the ability to reproduce.
Ye Yun sighed, saying, "According to the memories in your inheritance, do you know how many battles the Dragon Clan and the Divine Land Spirits have had?"
"Lord Ancestor Dragon, we can’t remember clearly..." the Void Divine Dragon replied honestly.
"In the past hundred thousand years, you have been stationed here. Have any human True God Realm Cultivators successfully left from here?" Ye Yun turned serious and asked a question he had been wondering for a long time.
"None. Not one," the Void Divine Dragon gave a firm answer.
"Apart from the past few days, have any spiritual cultivators from the Divine Land entered again in these hundred thousand years?" Ye Yun asked again.
"None."
After getting two affirmative answers from the Void Divine Dragon, Ye Yun fell into contemplation.
It appeared that this segment of memory was completely sealed. If anyone tried to access it, it would instantly explode. The previous two Eternal Realm elders I met were right; three True God Realm Cultivators did emerge from the Cangnan Continent. One of them was the 250th Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect—Dragon Xuan. That Dragon Xuan was able to pass through here didn’t surprise me at all. This guy carried the Dragon God Bloodline; passing the last test should be extremely easy for him. Being kin, these Void Divine Dragons would unquestionably give Dragon Xuan a pass. Dragon Xuan had obtained the inheritance of the Nine Soul Emperor; his power was incredibly great, and passing through the previous sectors would be a breeze.
As for this Dragon Xuan, I am genuinely dissatisfied. Judging from the current signs, this guy must not be dead. Since he’s not dead, why didn’t he come back to check on the Dragon God Sect?
