In the past several dozen generations, the Dragon God Sect had been pitifully oppressed. By the time of Luo Li, the inheritance was nearly broken. If it weren’t for me ending the sign-in and timely emerging from the ancient tomb, the tragic fate of the Dragon God Sect might have abruptly ended.
Thinking of Dragon Xuan, I can’t help but think of Nangong Jade. I suddenly have a guess: could Nangong Jade also be one of those three who left the Cangnan Continent? After all, judging from Nangong Jade’s ability to mobilize the Ancient Giant Demon, she must have the backing of the Divine Land. With such a robust backing, leaving the Cangnan Continent shouldn’t be a difficult task.
His mind filled with various thoughts, Ye Yun shook his head, casting out the miscellaneous thoughts, his mood returning to calm.
"Now I command you, your duty of guarding the Ancient Road to Heaven is over. Come with me now," Ye Yun looked at the Void Divine Dragons, his expression suddenly serious as he delivered an order.
The six Void Divine Dragons looked at each other, their faces filled with joyous surprise. After guarding for millions of years, they, the Void Divine Dragons, were finally free! And this time, the order had come personally from Lord Ancestor Dragon.
"We are willing to follow Lord Ancestor Dragon!" The six Void Divine Dragons transformed into human forms one after another, their expressions extremely moved as they knelt on the ground.
"You go cultivate in this world for now. When the right time comes, I will summon you," Ye Yun said, taking out a small green ball that emitted a green glow.
The green light enveloped the six Void Divine Dragons, and they disappeared in an instant.
After settling the Void Divine Dragons, Ye Yun heaved a sigh of relief. The more he interacted with these Divine Dragons, the heavier the burden he felt on his shoulders. This feeling emanated from deep within his bloodline.
It was as if the Ancestor Dragon blood within me compelled me to save the declining Dragon Clan.
That lad Jiang Hengyue seems fine too. What on earth does that odd old man want to do?
Ye Yun looked towards a certain direction with a faint smile on his face, then vanished in a flash.
Soon, he left the territory inhabited by the Void Beasts, completely entering a dim void. In this void, there was only an Ancient Road to Heaven, stretching towards the distance. Not far off, on the ancient road, was a desolate little wood house. There was also a small yard in front of the house, with a row of fences enclosing it.
The next moment, Ye Yun appeared next to the small yard.
"What a rare guest!" The door of the wooden house opened, and out walked an old man wearing a black cotton-padded jacket. The old man was not tall, with a small and thin figure. He held a Bronze Pipe between his large yellow teeth, from which a thin wisp of blue smoke drifted out. With his hands behind his back, he slowly walked out, displaying a nonchalant demeanor.
"Where’s Jiang Hengyue?" Ye Yun cast a meaningful glance in the direction of the wood house. At that moment, Jiang Hengyue was locked up in the wood house by the old man. The house might look small from the outside, but it was a whole different world inside.
"Your companion, the Spirit who escaped from the Divine Land to the Dragon Hidden Continent, has been captured by me." The small old man held his Bronze Pipe, gently tapped out the ash, and said with a soft chuckle.
"Should the Spirits of the Divine Land be captured once they enter the Dragon Hidden Continent? And why didn’t you capture him when he first entered?" Ye Yun raised his eyebrows, asking nonchalantly.
The short old man, though seemingly unimpressive in appearance, was a spiritual cultivator in the Divine Monarch Realm. His cultivation base had reached the Eighth layer of God Monarch, one minor realm above Ye Yun. Because he was one minor realm higher, the small old man displayed an utterly fearless demeanor in front of Ye Yun.
"This old man here is the Gatekeeper of the Ancient Road to Heaven. This gate allows entry but forbids exit. However, rules are dead while people are alive. So, you can leave if you want. Just pay a little toll to this old man here..." He let out a chuckle, took a few puffs from his pipe, and lightly blew out a few smoke rings, appearing leisurely and comfortable.
Despite my relaxed demeanor, I am incredibly alert towards the young man in white standing before me. I don’t know where this young man in white has appeared from. His cultivation base is already at the Seventh Realm of God King, just one minor realm lower than mine! If it’s said that a native cultivator from the Dragon Hidden Continent could cultivate to the Divine Monarch Realm, that would be an absolute fairy tale; I don’t believe it at all. That place, with its scarce Spiritual Energy and devoid of any Divine Nature—managing to cultivate to the True God Realm is already no simple feat. To dream of reaching the Divine Monarch Realm is absolutely impossible! However, I don’t know the origin of this white-robed young man. If a Divine Earth Cultivator entered the Dragon Hidden Continent through a formal channel, they would inevitably have to pass through me, the Gatekeeper. But this white-robed young man clearly isn’t one of them. Feeling puzzled, I haven’t made a rash move; for now, I’m merely trying to test this white-robed young man’s background.
"A toll? I guess common treasures or magical pills probably don’t catch your eye, do they?" Ye Yun smiled faintly, his eyes glinting like a flame that flickered a couple of times.
I think I understand now. This old man is guarding here; if one wants to pass, they must hand over some rare treasures.
"You, sir, are a perceptive man. If you want to get past me, the Gatekeeper, you’ll have to offer something truly moving to pass this old man’s trial," the small old man giggled, revealing a mouthful of yellow, smoke-stained teeth.

chapters.title: Chapter 289: Emperor Level Treasure Sword, God Level Pipe
chapters.content:
Chapter 289: Chapter 289: Emperor Level Treasure Sword, God Level Pipe
"Snakes have their paths, rats have their ways. I understand that one needs to pay a toll to pass this stage of the Ancient Road to Heaven..."
Ye Yun smiled faintly, his expression as calm and composed as ever.
"You’re a straightforward person." The short old man chuckled, tapping the ash from his pipe. "Given that you’ve cultivated to the Divine Monarch Realm, you must possess substantial wealth. If you can’t produce anything decent, my pipe isn’t just for show."
"Are you threatening me?" Ye Yun’s eyes flickered as he asked with a smile that wasn’t quite a smile.
"A threat? Not exactly. Although I’m a minor realm higher than you, it would still be quite difficult to fight you to the death. However, this is the Ancient Road to Heaven..." A smug smile appeared on the short old man’s face, and he gestured downwards with his pipe. "In this place, you’re surely aware of a Formation, right?"
Hearing this, Ye Yun nodded with a smile.
He had, of course, noticed this Divine-level Array long ago. The Gatekeeper’s identity was special. It wasn’t surprising that he could control a large regional Formation on the Ancient Road to Heaven. And now, standing on the Ancient Road to Heaven, he was as if within that grand Formation. With the aid of this Divine-level Array and his cultivation base at the eighth layer of the Divine Monarch Realm, the other party effectively held all the cards.
Yet Ye Yun remained fearless.
The journey had been somewhat dull, and he was prepared to "communicate" thoroughly with this little old man.
Seeing the white-robed young man nod agreeably, the short old man chuckled again, then casually sat down on a stool and began puffing on his pipe.
Ye Yun swiped a hand over his wrist and produced a Robe. It was a green Robe, emitting a powerful Super Divine Dragon Breath.
"How about this one?" Ye Yun smiled lightly and tossed the Robe in his hand over.
The short old man’s eyes lit up slightly when he saw this green Robe. He said in surprise, "An Emperor Level Top Grade Robe?"
"Indeed," Ye Yun nodded.
The short old man didn’t dare to catch it directly with his hands. Instead, he willed his mana to coalesce into a large hand and grabbed the green Robe.
"It truly is an Emperor Level Top Grade Robe..." The short old man clicked his tongue in admiration, then raised his chin, looking askance at Ye Yun. He smirked and asked, "You think this little thing can satisfy me?"
"How about this then?" Ye Yun reached out, and a small white jade bottle appeared in his hand, which he then tossed to the old man.
The short old man remained cautious. He used his large mana-formed hand to catch the small bottle in mid-air, uncapped it, and sent a strand of Divine Sense inside to investigate.
"Emperor Level Dragon Tiger Pills?" This time, a hint of shock touched his features.
The small bottle contained Emperor Level Dragon Tiger Pills, well over ten thousand of them! Even for a powerhouse in the Divine Monarch Realm like him, such a vast quantity of Emperor Level Dragon Tiger Pills was a rare and highly sought-after treasure. As a Gatekeeper of the Ancient Road to Heaven, he had guarded this place for a long time with no perks at all. Suddenly receiving tens of thousands of Dragon Tiger Pills threw his mood into a state of wild elation.
The short old man quickly recapped the bottle and placed it on the table beside him. He feigned seriousness, put on a stern face, coughed twice, and said loudly, "If Your Excellency were a True God Realm cultivator, this might be enough to pass. But Your Excellency is a great power of the Divine Monarch Realm. Just these two items are not enough."
Faced with the short old man’s aggressive demands, Ye Yun’s expression remained calm, the corners of his mouth tilting up in a faint smile.
He just wants treasures, doesn’t he?
Ye Yun planned to take out some truly impressive treasures to really open the eyes of this Gatekeeper who had toiled away on the Ancient Road to Heaven.
The previous ones... were merely appetizers.
Ye Yun was also worried that if he brought out something too extraordinary all at once, it might scare the short old man to death.
Although the other party had reached almost the eighth layer of the Divine Monarch Realm and his horizons were already extremely broad...
In reality, compared to the myriad worlds of the heavens and dimensions, he was still just a frog at the bottom of a well.
"How about this Sword?"
Ye Yun flicked his hand, and a Sword, emanating a bone-chilling Super Divine Dragon Breath, appeared in his palm. This Sword was entirely a faint silver, its edge exceptionally sharp. The moment it appeared in the air, it emanated a terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath.
"Truly a fine Sword." The short elder squinted slightly, examining the Sword in Ye Yun’s hand, his interest immediately piqued. The Super Divine Dragon Breath emanating from this Sword indicated it was at least Emperor Level.
"Take it." Ye Yun tossed it lightly, and the silver Divine Sword floated over.
This Sword, though it seemed to float lightly, exuded a terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath.
The short elder, though cautious, extended his mana-filled hand and slowly grabbed this Silver Sword.
"Emperor Level Top Grade." After carefully sensing this Silver Sword again, a trace of wild joy appeared on the short elder’s face.
That fellow in white really has some good things.
This time, he even produced an Emperor Level Divine Sword.
Even though he was a dignified Divine Monarch, he only possessed a single Emperor artifact.
As the short elder gripped the Sword, his expression suddenly became a little dazed. He realized that his tens of thousands of years spent guarding this place had not been in vain after all. Obtaining an Emperor Level Top Grade Divine Sword was enough to compensate for all his losses.
According to his usual temperament, he would have definitely let him pass after receiving this Sword. But the greed in his heart, ignited by this Sword, made him look at the white-clothed youth as if gazing upon a delectable meal.
He knew this youth must have even more good things.
"Just this Sword is not enough..." The short elder managed to suppress his cheerful expression, took a drag from his smoking pipe, and stated unhurriedly.
"If it’s not enough, there’s more..." Ye Yun smiled faintly, flipped his palm, and a golden smoking pipe appeared in his hand.
The golden smoking pipe, upon appearing, emitted an indescribably powerful Super Divine Dragon Breath, and the surrounding void trembled slightly.
"What is this?" The short elder stared at the golden smoking pipe, his eyeballs nearly popping out of their sockets.
The Bronze Pipe he carried was an Emperor artifact; he usually used it for smoking, but it could also be used to attack enemies. He was extremely fond of this Bronze Pipe. But the short old man had never imagined that the golden smoking pipe opposite him would be of a quality far surpassing his own Bronze Pipe.
Could it be God level?
At this thought, the short elder grew anxious. He quickly waved his hand and shouted, "Bring it over here, quickly!"
Seeing the short elder’s unsightly expression, Ye Yun found it rather amusing. He still didn’t resort to any tricks, simply tossing the golden smoking pipe over.
The golden smoking pipe streaked through the air like a ray of golden light and landed before the old man.
This time, the short elder directly used his hand to grab the golden smoking pipe. Of course, his palm was covered in mana. He had initially been cautiously guarding against a sudden move from the white-clothed youth, but after catching the golden smoking pipe, the short elder found nothing amiss and couldn’t help but feel relieved.
It seemed the white-clothed youth understood the rules well enough.
He also knew that within this Divine-level Array, it was impossible to try any tricks.
Otherwise, the moment he activated the Divine-level Array, its terrifying destructive power would doom the white-clothed youth to a point beyond salvation.
"My heavens! This is actually a Lower God Rank golden smoking pipe!" The short elder stared at the golden smoking pipe in his hand, his arm trembling unceasingly, and his mind reeled as if struck by colossal waves. He was utterly and completely stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 290: A Freakish Day of Signing In and Smoking Pipe
chapters.content:
Chapter 290: Chapter 290: A Freakish Day of Signing In and Smoking Pipe
A God level pipe.
That’s what this heavy pipe smoker had always dreamed about in his life.
But in the vast Divine Land, not a single Refining Master could forge a God level pipe.
The Emperor Level pipe he held now had cost him countless resources to obtain.
The expenditure was inconceivable.
Now, on the Ancient Road to Heaven, he had suddenly acquired a golden God level pipe.
How could the sudden realization of his years-long dream not make him ecstatic?
"What a nice thing!
I wonder how pleasant it would be to smoke with this golden pipe.
"
The short old man closely examined the patterns on the golden pipe, his eyes filled with fanaticism, his lips trembling in admiration.
Seeing the old man’s excited look, Ye Yun smiled and said, "Is that enough?"
"Enou—"
Just as the old man was about to say ’enough,’ an inexplicable emotion interrupted him.
"Not enough! Your Excellency is a mighty figure at the seventh level of the Divine Monarch Realm; this God level golden pipe is still a bit lacking..."
The short old man chuckled. He had suddenly changed his tune.
This big fat sheep was right in front of him; this was an opportunity not to be missed. He had to fleece him thoroughly. If he wasn’t satisfied, he would just kill the other party. That way, all the magic treasures would be his.
With a slight flick of Ye Yun’s hand, a bronze-colored pipe appeared. As soon as this pipe materialized, the vibrations in the void intensified.
"This is..."
The short old man’s heart leaped into his throat, and he tensed up completely.
Gazing at the bronze-colored pipe, he managed to say with difficulty, "Could this be another God level one?"
"This one is Superior God level; the one you have is Inferior. That’s a difference of two minor quality realms, isn’t it?"
Ye Yun chuckled and tossed the bronze-colored pipe in his hand over to him.
The short old man, his face a mask of immense surprise, fumbled to catch the bronze-colored pipe. After a moment of feeling it, an expression of shock once again spread across his face.
Another God level pipe! And this one was even Superior God level, a higher grade than the golden pipe.
How could this be possible? Who on earth is this young man in white? How does he have so many pipes?
Throughout the entire Divine Land, he had never even heard of a God level pipe appearing.
Ye Yun observed the short old man’s peculiar expression and said with a smile, "Give me back that Inferior God level pipe in your hand. This Superior God level one is for you."
Hearing this, the short old man felt his heart ache as if it were bleeding. He said, the words tearing at him, "No way! I’m keeping both pipes! Do you have any other magic treasures? If not, you still can’t pass."
"How can you go back on your word?" Ye Yun smiled calmly, a hint of mockery in his eyes.
"I never said how many magic treasures it would take to let you pass," the short old man sneered.
He pointed the bronze-colored pipe at the ground and threatened, "Quickly, take out a few more God level magic treasures, or I won’t let you pass."
"Alright."
Ye Yun nodded, a faint, peculiar smile also appearing on his face.
This time, he extended his hand, and with a flash of light, ten pipes appeared. Each pipe was a different color, but without exception, all exuded a terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath.
Gazing at these pipes, Ye Yun also sighed.
He couldn’t help but chuckle bitterly as he recalled the experience of obtaining these pipes in the Check-in Space.
「There was a day...」
When he checked in, he suddenly received a pipe, but it was merely Emperor Level.
Ye Yun himself didn’t smoke, not even before he transmigrated from his previous life, so he had little interest in this pipe.
This kind of pipe, with its exquisite and beautiful design, its surface covered in various patterns, made Ye Yun think it would be rather nice to keep as a collectible. So, he stored the pipe away.
But he hadn’t expected that for the rest of that day, the check-in process would become utterly magical and fascinating.
He spent the entire day signing for pipes.
These pipes ranged from the initial Emperor Level to Emperor Level, then to God Level, and even Super God Level...
Eventually, the pipes grew more and more numerous. From signing for one pipe at a time at the start, to later signing for ten, then a hundred, then a thousand, Ye Yun himself was dumbfounded at the time.
This System is too devious! Has it pilfered all the pipes from the great smoking masters across all the heavens and universes?
Ye Yun knew what kind of mood smokers would be in if they lost their pipes.
Those great masters, after losing their pipes, would likely be irritable and furious. When their nicotine cravings hit, they might even feel like dying.
That day was designated "Pipe Day" by Ye Yun, to commemorate that magical and interesting day of signing in.
Now, a great many different kinds of pipes were stored in his warehouse.
So, when Ye Yun saw this short old man puffing on an Emperor Level pipe, a thought sparked in his mind.
He knew how to handle this old fellow.
You want pipes? Then I’ll give you plenty. I’m just afraid your appetite isn’t big enough to take them all.
Upon seeing ten more pipes of different colors suddenly appear in Ye Yun’s hands, all of God level quality, the short old man’s eyes bulged wide. His face flushed crimson, his expression ecstatic, and his lips trembled unceasingly.
His throat tightened, and he was so choked with emotion he couldn’t utter a word.
He hadn’t expected the young man in white before him to have collected so many God level pipes.
This is too terrifying!
After a few seconds, the short old man finally regained his composure and said, his voice trembling, "How could you possibly have so many?"
"Never mind that. Do you want them or not?" Ye Yun jiggled the ten pipes in his hand and asked with a smile.
"Yes... Yes... Give them all to me!"
The short old man suddenly shot up from his stool, roaring frantically.
With a gentle wave of his hand, Ye Yun tossed all ten pipes over.
The old man lunged forward, snatching all ten pipes and clutching them to his chest along with the two he already possessed.
He continuously examined them, muttering to himself, his emotions now completely spiraling out of control.
Having smoked his entire life, to suddenly obtain eleven God level pipes—it was impossible to imagine the state of his emotions at this moment.
At this moment, the short old man didn’t even know his own surname anymore.
He had plunged into a state of utter euphoria.
Witnessing the short old man’s disgraceful display, a hint of amusement flickered in Ye Yun’s eyes.
Good thing Jiang Hengyue is confined in that room. Otherwise, if that little fellow saw a Divine Monarch expert losing his composure like this, he’d probably laugh his head off.
"If that’s not enough, I still have more..." Ye Yun looked at the short old man and suddenly called out.
"Still more?"
The old man froze for a moment, then shouted urgently, "Quick... give them all to me!"
With a light tap on his wrist, Ye Yun produced another hundred God level pipes.
These hundred God level pipes were too many for Ye Yun to hold in one hand. He conjured a large hand out of Mana, which lightly grasped the God level pipes and waved them a few times in mid-air.
"One hundred God level pipes?"
Gazing at those one hundred pipes of various colors, all radiating a brilliant light, the short old man could no longer contain his surging emotions.
His body swayed, his eyes became glazed, and he slowly drifted towards Ye Yun.
"Quick, give them to me... give them to me..." the short old man mumbled, his expression crazed.

chapters.title: Chapter 291: Overwhelmed by the Breath of the Super God-Level Magic Treasure
chapters.content:
Chapter 291: Chapter 291: Overwhelmed by the Breath of the Super God-Level Magic Treasure
"I’m giving them all to you."
Ye Yun chuckled as if he were watching a comedy, feeling extraordinarily cheerful. In mid-air, as he waved his mana-infused hand, the hundred God level pipes fell.
The short old man used mana to create two large hands, which fiercely embraced all the God level pipes. He hugged them all to his chest, looking left and right, his face beaming with a foolish grin.
With over a hundred God level pipes added all at once, he didn’t even know how to describe his emotions. He only felt his brain hum, swirling into chaos as if his thinking process had come to a halt.
A single God level Magic Treasure in the Divine Land was extremely rare. Yet here he was, receiving so many at once; it was inconceivable!
The short old man caressed each pipe, treating them like little lovers, muttering to himself, "From now on, I will smoke with a different pipe every day, and you all must serve me well."
Seeing the short old man continuing further down the path of a mental breakdown, Ye Yun prepared to add more fuel to the fire.
"I still have God level pipes here. Do you want them?" Ye Yun asked with a smile.
"You have more?" The short old man jolted, becoming a bit more clear-headed than before.
Upon this sobering realization, he suddenly felt that something was awry. Could it be that he had just fallen for an Illusion Technique?
How could anyone in this world possess so many God level pipes and give them all away to him for free? This was absolutely impossible.
The short old man immediately pinched his thigh, feeling a sharp pain.
It didn’t seem like an illusion.
But he still wasn’t sure, so he lifted a pipe and fiercely smashed it against his own head. BANG! A large lump immediately swelled on his head, almost bleeding.
Only then was the short old man shocked to discover that he wasn’t under an Illusion Technique; everything before his eyes was real. His Divine Monarch Realm body was extremely tough; only a God level Magic Treasure could injure his head by smashing it.
The short old man swallowed hard and looked at Ye Yun.
At this moment, a storm of shock raged within him.
It was hard to imagine... Just what kind of person was this young man in white? A single person who had collected over a hundred God level pipes.
In the Divine Land, even God level experts seemed like ants compared to him. They were on completely different levels.
Terrifying. This fellow was truly terrifying!
Thinking of this, the short old man swiftly stomped his foot. The grand array of the Ancient Road to Heaven trembled and began to operate with a thunderous rumble. As long as he willed it, the array could unleash its annihilating power at any moment.
"Why make things difficult? I still have many pipes I want to give you," Ye Yun said with an unconcerned smile when he saw the grand array activate.
"Stop trying to deceive me! How could you possibly have more? This must be your cunning trick, planning to ambush me when my guard is down, right?" the short old man sneered.
"You really think too poorly of me. Why would I do something so foolish?" Ye Yun chuckled and stretched out his hand. Instantly, a dazzling array of multicolored pipes appeared before him.
This time, a full thousand pipes of various colors appeared. Every single one was at least God level.
Hidden among these pipes were also some Super God level ones. Ye Yun believed that with the old man’s eye for quality, he likely wouldn’t be able to identify them.
Gazing at the sky filled with God level pipes radiating all sorts of light, the short old man once again felt that poverty had limited his imagination.
Damn it!
At this moment, all he wanted to do was curse the heavens, the earth, and the very air. How could such an incredibly wealthy person exist in this world?!
Collecting over a thousand God level Magic Treasures might still be understandable. But where on earth could one gather over a thousand God level pipes?
"Well? Are a thousand enough?" Ye Yun asked with a smile. Though his smile was exceedingly gentle, it exuded an aura of ostentatious wealth.
"I..." The short old man stared blankly at the God level pipes filling the sky, his throat choked, unable to utter another word.
Everything before him had completely overturned his worldview. He needed time to process it all.
"If that’s not enough, I have more. They’re all yours..." Ye Yun waved his hand, and myriad lights shot into the sky. Instantly, several thousand more pipes appeared, all of them Super God level.
These Super God level pipes were even more difficult for the short old man to identify, as they surpassed the limits of this world.
Several thousand Super God level treasures floated in mid-air, emanating an unimaginable Super Divine Dragon Breath, pressing down like a great mountain.
Ye Yun smiled faintly and gently pressed his hand downwards. These several thousand Super God level pipes, along with the previous thousand God level ones, instantly converged like a great net, descending upon the short old man.
"Wow, so many... How can there be so many God level pipes? Am I dreaming? Haha, these are all mine!" The short old man had yet to realize the impending crisis. He actually stretched out his hand, dazedly trying to touch these God level pipes.
As the thousands of Super God level pipes converged, an unimaginable power gathered. An incredibly violent force pressed in on the short old man.
SPLAT! Accompanied by a dull thud, the short old man’s body was instantly crushed by the Super Divine Dragon Breath released from the thousands of Super God level treasures. He was pulverized into a mist of blood.
Even at the moment of death, the short old man remained immersed in that ecstatic joy, completely oblivious to his demise.
At this moment, the thousands of Super God level pipes were only about a hundred feet from the short old man. That mere distance was enough for a great Cultivator at the Divine Monarch Realm to be squeezed to death.
"A man’s greed is like a snake trying to swallow an elephant. Since you wanted them, I gave them to you, but unfortunately, your appetite wasn’t big enough..." Gazing at the mist of blood, Ye Yun chuckled faintly and waved his hand.
The blood mist dissolved into tiny particles and vanished instantly. With a sweep of his hand, Ye Yun returned all the pipes to his storage.
These God level pipes, which he had originally considered somewhat useless, had unexpectedly proven useful this time. Ye Yun was quite pleased.
A storage ring floated in the small courtyard—the remains of the short old man.
Ye Yun reached out, grabbed it, and tossed it into his own storage ring without a second glance.
This Divine Monarch Realm storage ring should contain many good things. However, they were of no use to Ye Yun.
The best thing that old fellow possessed was merely the Emperor Level Bronze Pipe he’d had in his mouth. In Ye Yun’s eyes, it was all rubbish.
With a wave of his hand, a sphere of light floated out from the house. Jiang Hengyue, who had been tense and terrified, stood within the sphere. When she suddenly saw the familiar white-robed figure opposite her, her eyes welled up, and a mix of emotions flooded her heart.
"Master, you’ve saved my life again!" As the Defense Light Shield of the sphere dissipated, Jiang Hengyue fell to her knees, tears streaming down her face.
The moment that powerful Divine Monarch Realm old man had seized her, Jiang Hengyue had thought she was surely going to die this time.

chapters.title: Chapter 292: Entering the Divine Land, Ye Yun’s Feelings
chapters.content:
Chapter 292: Chapter 292: Entering the Divine Land, Ye Yun’s Feelings
"Get up. That old fellow has already been killed by me!"
Looking at Jiang Hengyue, who was weeping and kneeling on the ground, Ye Yun smiled. A wave of Mana rolled out, lifting Jiang Hengyue to his feet.
After standing up, Jiang Hengyue wiped away his tears and looked around. He did not see any trace of the old man.
He couldn’t help but gain a deeper understanding of the Master’s strength in his heart. He hadn’t heard any noise from the fight just now, yet the old man in the Divine Monarch Realm had mysteriously died. Moreover, even his corpse had disappeared. This demonstrated the terrifying extent of the Master’s Divine Skills in killing. Jiang Hengyue wouldn’t even dream that the Gatekeeper’s death was due to being burst apart by the aura of thousands of Super God Level treasures.
"Let’s go."
Ye Yun smiled and continued along the Ancient Road to Heaven with Jiang Hengyue. This stretch of the road was free of any danger. They traversed through the void and, at the end, arrived at a transparent barrier.
After penetrating the barrier, they found themselves above a vast azure sea. The sea breeze was pleasant, waves surged, and in the distance, blue skies and white clouds framed various birds flying freely over the water.
Ye Yun took a gentle breath of the Divine Land’s air, a look of intoxication appearing on his face.
As expected of the Divine Land! The Spiritual Energy here contained Divine Nature, which offered indescribable benefits to a God’s Realm Cultivator.
In the cultivation system of the Cangnan Continent, the highest level is the True God Realm. When a Cultivator reaches the Eternal Realm and attempts to break through to the True God Realm, they need to transform their Law Yuan Power into Divine Yuan Power. This Divine Yuan Power is full of Divine Nature. However, the Spiritual Energy on the Cangnan Continent contains very little Divine Nature, so little that it can practically be ignored. The transformation to Divine Yuan Power has to rely solely on one’s own grit and determination. Therefore, unless one is extraordinarily talented or has an unimaginably fortunate encounter, it is extremely difficult to break through to the True God Realm. The True God Realm is like a heavenly chasm, firmly blocking all Cultivators of the Cangnan Continent.
Seeing the familiar sea area, Jiang Hengyue became somewhat emotional.
This time, he had escaped death. Had the Master not saved him, he wouldn’t know how many times he would have died.
Ye Yun glanced at Jiang Hengyue. "Do you want to go to Star God Island now, or Skyreach Island?"
"Master, Fu Nanhua’s wedding is on the sixth of next month. There’s still some time. I want to go back to Star God Island to take a look first..." Jiang Hengyue said after a moment of hesitation.
The influence of Star God Island was far inferior to that of Skyreach Island, and he didn’t know if he had brought any trouble to his family. He would feel at ease once he checked.
Ye Yun nodded slightly.
He understood Jiang Hengyue’s current thoughts.
Jiang Hengyue then led the way, with Ye Yun following behind.
The Ninth Sea Area had many islands, scattered about like green gemstones. Along the way, Ye Yun saw countless islands of various sizes. Each was inhabited by the Human Race. Some larger islands even housed numerous demon beasts.
Ye Yun observed carefully for a bit. He found that even newborn children on these islands had reached the Divine Bridge Realm, and many teenagers were already Cultivators in the Eternal Realm.
This discovery was somewhat hard for Ye Yun to swallow. Truly, comparing oneself to others could only lead to frustration. An Eternal Realm Cultivator was extremely rare on the Cangnan Continent. Yet, here in the Divine Land, Eternal Realm Cultivators were commonplace. Moreover, they could reach this level by the age of thirteen or fourteen. This truly broadened his horizons.
But Ye Yun also understood that all this was possible because of the Divine Nature contained in the Spiritual Energy. This Divine Nature continuously changed the various life forms within the Divine Land, so children born here started with a high aptitude and cultivated even faster. They were incomparable to Cultivators from the Cangnan Continent.
From another perspective, this also explained why the spiritual Cultivators from the Divine Land were unwilling to go to the Cangnan Continent. In their eyes, the Cangnan Continent was devastatingly barren; they wouldn’t even consider going there. That old man in green robes, for example, had been driven into a desperate situation and had no choice but to come to the Cangnan Continent to serve as a Defender. His goal was to obtain a Breaking God Pill to break through to the Second level of True God Realm.
Ye Yun flew slowly behind Jiang Hengyue, in no hurry. Many thoughts and emotions stirred within him along the way.
Observing Jiang Hengyue’s flight speed, which seemed much slower than in the Cangnan Continent, a thought suddenly flashed through Ye Yun’s mind. He reached out a finger and forcefully poked at the empty space. A cracking sound echoed in the void as he crushed that section of space.
"Master, what’s wrong?" Hearing the sound from behind, Jiang Hengyue was startled and quickly turned to ask.
"The spatial barrier of the Cangnan Continent is incredibly sturdy," Ye Yun said with a sigh.
"Yes, Senior," Jiang Hengyue said in a low voice. "The world of the Divine Land is generally much more stable than the Dragon Hidden Continent. A typical True God in the Dragon Hidden Continent could crush a large mountain with a casual finger, but here, they could only level a small hill."
Ye Yun nodded.
The Divine Land is a world of a higher order than the lesser world of the Cangnan Continent, so its structural integrity is understandable. It wouldn’t be as easy for him to tear space here as it was on the Cangnan Continent. He guessed that even True Gods here would have difficulty rending the void of the Divine Land.
As they passed an island, two figures suddenly rose from the ground, blocking their path.
Jiang Hengyue was slightly taken aback, then a smile appeared on his face.
He recognized the two youths. One, dressed in red, was the Young Island Master of Blue Snail Island. The other, in a violet robe, was the Young Island Master of Bronze Fish Island.
"Brother Jiang, we thought something had happened to you! It’s surprising you’re unscathed," the youth in red rushed over, embraced Jiang Hengyue, and said with a laugh.
"Nothing happened," Jiang Hengyue replied with a smile.
"Brother Jiang, I heard you were captured by Fu Nanhua of Skyreach Island, thrown into prison, then escaped, and finally fled into the Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon..." the youth in the violet robe asked with a smile, clasping his fists in respect. He briefly examined Jiang Hengyue as he finished speaking.
"Brother Jiang, has your cultivation base fallen to the Eternal Realm?" the violet-robed youth exclaimed, shocked.
"Yes, it’s a long story..." Jiang Hengyue replied with a bitter smile.
The events in the Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon were too unbelievable, and he didn’t want to tell his two friends about them.
"Brother Jiang, who is this friend of yours?" The red-robed youth glanced at Ye Yun and was utterly dumbfounded.
The youth in white appeared to be around their age but exuded a mysterious and elegant aura. He couldn’t discern Ye Yun’s cultivation base; it was as if Ye Yun possessed a unique Divine Skill to conceal it.
"This is my Master," Jiang Hengyue hastily replied, a look of admiration and pride on his face.
The red-robed youth and the violet-robed youth looked at each other, shock written in their eyes.
Jiang Hengyue was such an arrogant person! As the Young Island Master of Star God Island, he had dared to challenge Fu Nanhua of Skyreach Island. For such a proud and haughty man to now acknowledge someone as his Master... This was truly beyond their comprehension!

chapters.title: Chapter 293: Breaking the Ancestral Dragon Curse, The Miraculous Effects of the Rejuvenation Water
chapters.content:
Chapter 293: Chapter 293: Breaking the Ancestral Dragon Curse, The Miraculous Effects of the Rejuvenation Water
"Greetings, Senior."
After the initial shock subsided, the two youths showed some astuteness and quickly clasped their fists, bowing towards Ye Yun in a highly respectful manner.
"No need for formalities!"
Ye Yun smiled faintly and said nothing more.
Both of these young men were at the True God Realm Third Level, a minor realm lower than Jiang Hengyue’s original cultivation.
It seemed their factions were somewhat weaker than Star God Island.
After exchanging greetings with Ye Yun, the red-robed youth looked at Jiang Hengyue and asked, "Brother Jiang, are you returning to Star God Island?"
"Yes, I want to go back and see how Star God Island is doing. I wonder if that cur Fu Nanhua will make a move against Star God Island?"
Jiang Hengyue said, somewhat vexed.
"Then, Brother Jiang, you should hurry back. Although Fu Nanhua hasn’t made a move, it’s rumored that Star God Island is about to change its Island Master."
The purple-robed youth blurted out candidly.
Hearing these words, Jiang Hengyue’s heart skipped a beat, a sudden premonition of misfortune washing over him.
He quickly asked, "What do you mean? My two Dao Brothers, please don’t speak in riddles with me."
"Recently, a rumor has been circulating in the Ninth Sea Area that you, Brother Jiang, have offended Skyreach Island. Star God Island is in turmoil internally, and many clan members have unanimously decided to depose your direct lineage. However, there’s no definite conclusion yet."
The red-robed youth said, scratching his head.
Hearing the red-robed youth’s words, Jiang Hengyue’s face fell. He sighed and said, "So that’s how it is. It seems I’ve implicated my father."
The purple-robed youth standing beside him consoled, "Brother Jiang, don’t be like this. In any case, you’re back now. Why not hurry back to Star God Island and see for yourself?"
Jiang Hengyue nodded, bade farewell to the two youths, and quickly flew towards Star God Island.
Ye Yun remained silent, quietly following behind Jiang Hengyue.
Seeing the young man’s spirits were a bit low, Ye Yun smiled and said, "You don’t need to worry too much. A mere Master of Star God Island is no big deal. If Star God Island changes its Island Master, then I don’t mind gifting you Skyreach Island and letting you be its Island Master for fun."
Gifting him Skyreach Island?
Hearing Ye Yun’s words, Jiang Hengyue was utterly stunned.
"Senior, do you mean you intend to annihilate the Fu Family of Skyreach Island?"
Jiang Hengyue asked, his voice trembling.
Ye Yun nodded and smiled, "The Fu Family kidnapped your fiancée, threw you into the great prison, subjected you to various cruel tortures, and after releasing you, sent people to hunt you down. I will help you settle this score."
"Thank you, Senior!"
Jiang Hengyue once again knelt at Ye Yun’s feet.
"Get up."
Ye Yun smiled.
Jiang Hengyue stood up, took a deep breath, and continued flying towards Star God Island.
Although Ye Yun appeared to be strolling leisurely, he no longer had the inclination to admire the surrounding scenery.
In his left hand, he clutched the Ancestral Dragon Curse, which had been reduced to fine particles, studying it incessantly.
The more he studied it, the more Ye Yun felt that this Ancestral Dragon Curse was indeed exceedingly powerful.
For the spiritual cultivators of the Divine Land, it was practically unsolvable.
But for Ye Yun, he had already found a solution.
Ye Yun forced out a drop of bright red Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood from his body and fused it with these curse particles.
At this moment, a miraculous scene occurred.
This seemingly indestructible curse was actually melted away by the Ancestral Dragon Blood.
Ye Yun held this drop of blood on his fingertip, his eyes bright as he stared at it, beginning a careful analysis.
This drop of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood no longer contained any of the Ancestral Dragon Curse.
All the previous curse particles had vanished.
Ye Yun breathed a sigh of relief. After some thought, a look of sudden realization appeared on his face.
The Ancestral Dragon Curse could only be neutralized by Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood.
Even the Essence Blood of the Ten Super Divine Dragons in the world could not dispel it.
"Jiang Hengyue, stop for a moment."
Ye Yun suddenly said.
Jiang Hengyue paused, startled, and immediately turned around.
He saw Ye Yun holding a drop of bright red blood on his fingertip.
This drop of bright red blood contained a powerful Super Divine Dragon Breath, yet Ye Yun had forcefully constrained it.
Otherwise, all the creatures in the surrounding sea area would likely have gone mad.
With a light flick of his finger, Ye Yun transformed the drop of blood into a fine thread that drilled into the space between Jiang Hengyue’s eyebrows.
Under Ye Yun’s control, this wisp of blood traveled through Jiang Hengyue’s body, searching for the extremely subtle Ancestral Dragon Curse.
Jiang Hengyue stood dumbfounded, discovering that his body was completely immobilized.
Master... what is he doing?
Jiang Hengyue was puzzled, but he knew that the Master would never harm him.
He could only wait quietly, suppressing all the terror in his heart.
Within a few breaths, Ye Yun located the Ancestral Dragon Curse.
A wisp of blood began to touch the Ancestral Dragon Curse.
The curse merged into the wisp of blood and vanished in an instant.
Ye Yun retracted the wisp of blood and reabsorbed the drop of Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood into his body.
"Do you feel any different now?"
Ye Yun withdrew the force that had been controlling Jiang Hengyue’s body and asked with a smile.
"It seems... not much different."
Jiang Hengyue blinked, assessing his body’s condition, and found it felt no different from before.
Ye Yun took out a small red vial and poured out a drop of red liquid.
"Drink this."
Ye Yun instructed. With a flick of his finger, the drop of mysterious red liquid floated to Jiang Hengyue’s lips.
Jiang Hengyue swallowed the drop of red liquid without hesitation.
Just a second later, his Super Divine Dragon Breath began to grow rapidly.
BANG!
His body trembled slightly, and a clear sound resonated from within. His cultivation base astonishingly rose from the tenth level of the Eternal Realm to the True God Realm First Level.
Jiang Hengyue stared wide-eyed, feeling the changes occurring within his body, finding it hard to believe.
He had been to the Dragon Hidden Continent and was afflicted by that mysterious curse, which had severed his path of cultivation.
Jiang Hengyue had accepted the fact that he would remain in the Eternal Realm for the rest of his life.
But he never imagined that the Master giving him a drop of mysterious red liquid would actually cause his cultivation realm to soar by another level.
Gazing at Jiang Hengyue’s shocked and bewildered expression, Ye Yun smiled faintly and said, "That wisp of blood has already cleared the curse from your body, and this drop of Rejuvenation Water has helped you recover some of your cultivation base."
Speaking of which, Ye Yun flicked out three more drops of Rejuvenation Water.
Jiang Hengyue felt as if he were waking from a dream.
So... the Master had actually used his Wushang divine skills again to eliminate the curse within his body, and even used this miraculous Rejuvenation Water to elevate his realm once more!
Jiang Hengyue’s throat tightened, tears welling in his eyes. He stared blankly at the three drops of Rejuvenation Water before him, motionless.
"Quickly take these three drops of Rejuvenation Water. Return to Star God Island sooner and see what has happened..."
Ye Yun urged with a smile from the side.
"Yes, Master."
Only then did Jiang Hengyue come to his senses and hurriedly swallow the three drops of Rejuvenation Water.
As the three drops of Rejuvenation Water entered his body, his Super Divine Dragon Breath began to surge dramatically.
Second Level of True God Realm!
True God Realm Third Level!
True God Realm Fourth Level!
In just a few breaths, Jiang Hengyue’s cultivation base was restored from the True God Realm First Level to his original True God Realm Fourth Level!

chapters.title: Chapter 294: Star God Island, Jiang Clan Infighting
chapters.content:
Chapter 294: Chapter 294: Star God Island, Jiang Clan Infighting
Seeing the remarkable effect of the Rejuvenation Water, Ye Yun smiled and nodded.
Despite its mundane name, this Rejuvenation Water was actually a Super God Level miraculous healing elixir. It originated from an exceedingly powerful dimensional universe. A supreme entity had researched and refined this miraculous elixir, specifically to reverse the regression of cultivation levels. Whether one’s cultivation base had degraded due to a failed Heavenly Tribulation, severe injuries, or other reasons, taking Rejuvenation Water could restore it.
Of course, this required a healthy flesh body. If the injuries to the flesh body were not healed, the effect of the Rejuvenation Water would be greatly diminished.
Jiang Hengyue’s body had been healed with the Water of Life, and the Ancestor Dragon’s curse was eradicated using Ancestral Dragon Blood. Taking the Rejuvenation Water on this foundation yielded surprisingly good effects. Only four drops of Rejuvenation Water were required to restore Jiang Hengyue’s cultivation base to its original True God Realm Fourth Level.
Jiang Hengyue wiped away his tears, composed himself, and began to fly swiftly towards Star God Island. Now that he was at the True God Realm Fourth Level, his flight speed was many times faster than when he was in the Eternal Realm. He arrived above the peripheral waters of Star God Island in the time it took for an incense stick to burn.
Seeing the still peaceful and unchanged Star God Island, Jiang Hengyue heaved a sigh of relief.
He was terrified that Skyreach Island might vent its anger on Star God Island because of him, launching a large-scale attack and wiping them out. After all, this wouldn’t be difficult for Skyreach Island. In The Ninth Sea Area, Skyreach Island was ranked first in power. Legend had it that a Divine Monarch Realm expert presided there. Even if there wasn’t a Divine Monarch Realm expert, their Star God Island would surely stand no chance against Skyreach Island.
"Let’s go in and see," Ye Yun, beside him, said with a smile. He had merely glanced earlier and knew something had changed there, so he urged Jiang Hengyue to hurry inside. After all, they now needed the Young Island Master to restore order and suppress all opposing forces. Having been the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect before, Ye Yun was an iron-willed figure, and suppressing such unrest was nothing new to him.
"Yes, Master," Jiang Hengyue promptly complied and descended towards Star God Island.
Ye Yun trailed behind him, controlling his cultivation base to match the True God Realm Fourth Level. His cultivation base was now identical to Jiang Hengyue’s. He did this to avoid attracting unwanted attention. After all, when people couldn’t discern a person’s cultivation base, they would naturally assume it was unfathomably high. This was not what Ye Yun wanted. He tried his best to minimize his presence and let Jiang Hengyue handle most of the problems. If Jiang Hengyue failed to resolve them, Ye Yun would then step in.
"Young Island Master?" Seeing the familiar figure descending from the sky, the young guards at the docks were suddenly dumbstruck.
Jiang Hengyue landed before them in an instant.
"Young Island Master, didn’t you enter the Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon?" a young guard stuttered.
"Yes, but I’ve returned. How is the island now?" Jiang Hengyue smiled faintly, emanating the dignified aura befitting a Young Island Master.
"All is well," another young guard quickly said before the first could speak.
Jiang Hengyue shot him a meaningful glance and strode further inside. He moved quickly, like a swift breeze, reaching a magnificently ornate hall in moments. This Star God Palace was the core of the entire Star God Island.
"Oh, Cousin has returned?" A young man in black attire emerged from the hall. He looked slightly younger than Jiang Hengyue. Opening his arms, he enthusiastically moved towards Jiang Hengyue for a hug.
"Cousin?" Jiang Hengyue was slightly taken aback but still opened his arms to hug his cousin, Jiang Qingyang. The two cousins had been incredibly close since childhood, and their bond remained strong even as they grew up. However, his cousin, Jiang Qingyang, was from a branch lineage of the Jiang Clan, so his status was far inferior to Jiang Hengyue’s direct lineage.
After they separated, Jiang Hengyue, remembering prior rumors, looked at his cousin, Jiang Qingyang, with some skepticism.
Why had Jiang Qingyang come out to greet him as soon as he arrived at the Star God Palace entrance? Could one of the guards have tipped him off earlier? The Star God Palace was usually where his father handled the affairs of Star God Island; it was not a place Jiang Qingyang was normally permitted to enter.
Doubts began to form in his mind.
Jiang Hengyue asked in a low voice, "Where is my father?"
"Eldest Uncle and my father went to Skyreach Island to apologize. Cousin, you know the situation. You offended Skyreach Island, and Young Master Fu Nanhua is furious. He specifically demanded Star God Island send someone to apologize," Jiang Qingyang said with a sigh.
"How long have they been gone?" Jiang Hengyue asked, furrowing his brow.
"They’ve been gone for a few days. They should be back in the next day or two..." Jiang Qingyang said with a faint smile.
Jiang Hengyue nodded and headed for the Star God Palace.
"Cousin, you must be weary from your journey. You should go home and rest," Jiang Qingyang said, immediately blocking Jiang Hengyue’s path.
"That’s not necessary. Step aside," Jiang Hengyue said, reaching out and pushing Jiang Qingyang aside. He was at the True God Realm Fourth Level, while Jiang Qingyang was merely at the Second level of True God Realm. Therefore, Jiang Qingyang couldn’t possibly block him.
Upon entering the Star God Palace, Jiang Hengyue saw the hall was arranged completely differently from before. The layout was chaotic, and the atmosphere felt oppressive.
"Why have these cabinets and desks been rearranged?" Jiang Hengyue demanded.
"Why? Because Star God Island has a new Island Master. It’s no longer the domain of you and your father, Jiang Liufeng!" a man’s deep voice drifted in from outside the hall.
Then, a figure flashed and appeared inside the Star God Palace: an old, pale-faced man at the True God Realm Tier Seven, standing before Jiang Hengyue.
So the rumors are true,
Jiang Hengyue’s expression turned icy as he said, "Your branch of the family has always harbored ill intentions. Finally, you’ve seized your chance!"
"Well said, young man! Haha!" The pale-faced old man laughed loudly, his eyes filled with mockery. "You can only blame your father, Jiang Liufeng, for his misfortune in having such a trouble-making son like you! After offending Skyreach Island, did he really think he could remain Island Master? How naive!"
Looking at the pale-faced old man before him, Jiang Hengyue felt as if a knife were twisting in his heart, a chill seeping through his body.
The taste of betrayal by one’s own kin was truly unbearable. It was clear now—his father hadn’t gone to Skyreach Island at all. He had either been imprisoned or met with some other misfortune...
Jiang Hengyue trembled with rage. Pointing at the pale-faced old man, he shouted, "Jiang Taihu! After all these years my father treated you so well, looking after you and your son! And now you seize this opportunity to usurp power! My father was truly blind to your nature!"
"Speak such nonsense again, and I’ll lock you in the dungeon too!" Jiang Taihu sneered, his hands clasped behind his back. "Men! Arrest these two and throw them into the dungeon!"
With a wave of Jiang Taihu’s hand, several figures flew in from outside. Jiang Hengyue looked closely and saw they were all his father’s former trusted aides, their cultivation bases all at the True God Realm Fifth Layer or above.
Unbelievable. They had all defected.
"Young Island Master, please don’t blame us. Skyreach Island ordered this. If you and your father don’t step down, everyone on our island will be buried with the Island Master..." a middle-aged man said, looking at Jiang Hengyue with a pained expression as memories surfaced. He secretly sent Jiang Hengyue a voice transmission.
Ye Yun naturally overheard this voice transmission.
"Indeed. Some people still possess a sense of loyalty," Ye Yun said with a faint smile, stepping forward two paces.

chapters.title: Chapter 295: Decisive Killing, Rebellion Quelled
chapters.content:
Chapter 295: Chapter 295: Decisive Killing, Rebellion Quelled
Upon seeing the young man in white robes beside Jiang Hengyue suddenly step forward, Jiang Taihu was momentarily taken aback. He scrutinized the man from head to toe, then sneered and said, "And here I was expecting someone impressive. Turns out it’s just a piece of trash at the True God Realm Fourth Level."
"Jiang Taihu, dare to insult my master, and I’ll kill you!"
As Jiang Taihu openly disrespected his master, Jiang Hengyue became instantly enraged, drawing his sword and charging towards him.
"A firefly dares to compete with the moon?"
Jiang Taihu mocked with amusement, raising his hand and delivering a powerful slap. The slap cut through the sword light and was directed towards Jiang Hengyue’s chest.
He was a cultivator at True God Realm Tier Seven. If this strike landed, Jiang Hengyue would either be seriously injured or killed on the spot.
Just then, a white figure flashed by.
Jiang Taihu felt his wrist being seized all of a sudden. His vision blurred for a moment, before gradually clearing. The young man in white robes, who was merely at True God Realm Fourth Level, had somehow positioned himself in front of Jiang Hengyue and single-handedly caught Jiang Taihu’s wrist.
Jiang Taihu pulled back forcefully in an attempt to break free. However, he was shocked to discover that the youth’s hand had a vice-like grip on his wrist, rendering him immobile.
Such strength.
Surprised and alarmed, Jiang Taihu drew his sword with his free hand and swung it down.
BANG!
Ye Yun raised a foot, sending Jiang Taihu flying with a well-placed kick. With precision control, Ye Yun delivered just enough force to make sure that Jiang Taihu was severely injured.
Jiang Taihu landed on the ground, blood seeping from the corner of his mouth. He looked in terror at the young man in white, utterly incredulous of his formidable combat strength.
The sudden turn of events, particularly Jiang Taihu’s serious injury, left everyone inside the palace in shock.
"Who exactly are you?" Jiang Qingyang looked at the young man in white, his face filled with dread.
Ye Yun remained silent.
Jiang Hengyue coldly quipped, "Didn’t I tell you already? This is my master."
"Jiang Hengyue, you’re a traitor for joining another Sect!" Jiang Qingyang furiously retorted.
"Get lost! You have no right to meddle here."
Enraged, Jiang Hengyue darted forward and with a single punch, knocked Jiang Qingyang down. The close-quarters fight was completely lopsided given the disparity in their respective powers. Jiang Qingyang was no match for Jiang Hengyue.
The Jiang Clan followers who had burst into the palace were agape, shocked by the dramatic turn of events.
The young man in white, whose cultivation level didn’t seem high, had still easily inflicted severe injuries on Jiang Taihu—the man who was about to become Master of Star God Island. Was his combat strength really that high?
"What are you waiting for? Kill him immediately," Jiang Taihu flailed his hand and bellowed loudly.
"Quiet." Ye Yun shot Jiang Taihu a cold look, rendering him momentarily speechless.
With a wave of his hand, Ye Yun summoned Jiang Taihu’s body to his proximity. He grabbed Jiang Taihu by the neck and forcefully smashed him onto the ground.
CRASH!
Jiang Taihu’s body hit the ground hard, leaving a huge crater. His whole body was mangled, and he spat out a mouthful of blood, unable to move.
HISS!
He’s so strong!
The middle-aged man who had previously sent a voice transmission to Jiang Hengyue took a deep, chilling breath, his eyes twitching uncontrollably. Even though the opponent was merely at True God Realm Fourth Level, his actual combat strength was overwhelming, easily crushing a cultivator at True God Realm Tier Seven.
Could he be from the Demon Clan?
This possibility suddenly flashed across the middle-aged man’s mind.
"Clean up these two pieces of trash," Ye Yun glanced at Jiang Hengyue, ordering indifferently. He was interested to see how Jiang Hengyue would handle the situation: would he choose to capture them or kill them decisively? According to Ye Yun’s style, if he encountered such a situation, he would absolutely not be lenient and would just kill them.
"Yes, Master."
Complying with Ye Yun’s command, Jiang Hengyue jumped into the crater and with a swift raise and lower of his sword, cut off Jiang Taihu’s head.
A Primordial Spirit burst out from Jiang Taihu’s severed head, trying to get away.
Already prepared, Jiang Hengyue once again raised his sword and mercilessly exterminated the Primordial Spirit.
After killing Jiang Taihu, Jiang Hengyue’s eyes were cold, and his body seethed with a killing intent that rolled onward like a vast river.
He strode up to Jiang Qingyang, pointed his sword at him and asked in a cold voice, "Where is my father?"
Jiang Qingyang looked at his father’s head, which Jiang Hengyue was holding in his hand, still dripping with fresh blood. He was so scared that he crumbled to the ground. He never dreamed that Jiang Hengyue could be so cruel and heartless as to kill his own father. No matter what, they were still related by blood.
"Jiang Hengyue, your heart is so ruthless," Jiang Qingyang pointed at him, his face full of resentment.
"I was too kind to you all in the past. Then, when my father and I faced misfortune, you longed to usurp power. Now that I am back, there is only one fate for traitors like you—death!" Jiang Hengyue said with a cold smile.
Through the betrayal and pursuit at Skyreach Island, Jiang Hengyue’s mindset had turned steel-hard.
"Young Island Master, the Island Master is locked up in the prison. I’ll go get him right now."
One of the middle-aged men serving the Jiang Clan saluted with his fists and, leading a few subordinates, vanished from the palace.
Jiang Hengyue glanced at him without saying anything. This retainer of the Jiang Clan had not completely turned traitor, so Jiang Hengyue decided not to hold them accountable.
"Jiang Hengyue, if you dare to kill me, Master Fu Nanhua will surely destroy the entirety of Star God Island."
Looking at Jiang Hengyue, who was like a Demon God, the fear in Jiang Qingyang’s heart vanished. Laughing maniacally, he shouted.
PFFT!
A flash of the sword.
Jiang Hengyue raised his sword and beheaded Jiang Qingyang too. And Jiang Qingyang’s Primordial Spirit was also killed on the spot by him.
At the True God Realm, if the Primordial Spirit is not killed, there’s a chance they can seize a new body to reincarnate. Therefore, Jiang Hengyue would definitely not give this father-son pair a chance.
Witnessing Jiang Hengyue’s decisive and straightforward killings, Ye Yun showed a look of approval in his eyes.
Cultivation is like rowing upstream; not advancing means retreating. If you don’t kill others, they will kill you. One must always guard against unanticipated attacks. Only by being decisive in killing and never showing mercy can one go further on the path of cultivation.
"Jiang Taihu, you’ve been gone for so long without returning? Can’t you even handle a mere True God Realm Fourth Level Jiang Hengyue?"
A voice came from outside. A green-robed old man then walked in from the entrance of the palace.
His cultivation level had reached Eight-tier of True God.
When he entered the palace and saw the bloody scene, he couldn’t help but gasp in surprise. He quickly scanned the entire palace, only to find two young men at True God Realm Fourth Level.
One of them, Jiang Hengyue, he recognized. But the other, a young man in white, was a stranger to him.
Jiang Hengyue, at this moment, was holding a sword that was still dripping with blood, and in his other hand, he held two heads. The heads of Jiang Taihu and his son. Both of them stared with wide eyes, mouths agape, as if they died with grievances.
The green-robed old man, wide-eyed with disbelief, asked, "Jiang Hengyue, you killed Jiang Taihu?"
"Indeed!" Jiang Hengyue replied coldly.
He examined him from top to bottom, then asked, "You must be one of the eight guardians of Skyreach Island, right?"
"You’re right. I didn’t expect you, the Young Island Master of the small Star God Island, to have such discernment," the man in the green robe said arrogantly with his hands behind his back.
"What a bullshit guardian." Ye Yun, standing at the side, smirked slightly and gave a light slap.
SLAP!
A tremor in space. A burst of massive power, forming into an invisible huge hand, smashed the arrogant old man in the green robe onto the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 296: Annihilating the Protector, Father and Son Reunite
chapters.content:
Chapter 296: Chapter 296: Annihilating the Protector, Father and Son Reunite
Seeing the Master’s casual palm strike, one of the eight protectors of Skyreach Island, an elder in a blue robe, was directly knocked to the ground. The ground actually caved in, forming a deep crater. The elder in the blue robe, his face covered in dust, lay unmoving in the pit, seemingly having lost the strength to resist.
At this moment, Jiang Hengyue had a mocking smile on his face as he looked at the elder in the blue robe.
The Master is a powerful practitioner at the Divine Monarch Realm, not just an ordinary Divine Monarch Realm. On the Ancient Road to Heaven, even the Gatekeepers in the Divine Monarch Realm were no match for him. This protector before me is only at the Eight-tier of True God. Master can kill him with just a flick of a finger.
The elder in the blue robe, his face covered in dust, lifted his head and spat out the broken teeth in his mouth with force. A look of shock filled his face as he looked at the white-robed youth beside him.
What is this guy’s cultivation base, exactly? He merely reached out across the space and slapped me, plunging me into the depths of the hall floor. This overwhelming force is simply too terrifying. I finally understand where the other crater came from. It turned out that the white-robed youth was responsible for it too. However, no matter how powerful the other party is, he’s only at the True God Realm Fourth Level, right? Our Skyreach Island has Wushang, a supreme being in the Divine Monarch Realm. In the entire Ninth Sea Area, no one dares to offend Skyreach Island.
Thinking of this, the fear in the blue-robed elder turned into defiance.
"Hmph! You’re quite audacious, daring to lay hands on a proud protector of Skyreach Island. Today, everyone on Star God Island will die!" the blue-robed elder roared angrily as he stretched out his hand, a beam of light shooting into the air.
"Still trying to send a message?" Ye Yun laughed lightly.
The beam of light suddenly exploded in the air without warning.
The Sword-flying Messenger failed?
the blue-robed elder gaped at the white-robed youth.
I don’t know what kind of Divine Skill this guy just used to destroy my Sword-flying Messenger.
Ye Yun lightly waved his hand, and the blue-robed elder didn’t even have a chance to scream. His entire body turned into particles and dissipated within the grand hall.
Jiang Hengyue, seeing this scene from the side, couldn’t help but swallow hard.
I finally understand how the Gatekeeper on the Ancient Road to Heaven disappeared. Master’s Divine Skills are so terrifying; he kills without shedding blood. Both the body and the Primordial Spirit are obliterated. It’s truly horrifying.
At this moment, a few figures, the guardians of the Jiang Clan, flew rapidly from outside into the hall. They gently placed an elder, covered in blood and wounds, on a chair in the grand hall.
Seeing his father tortured beyond recognition, Jiang Hengyue’s eyes reddened instantly. He ran over and knelt at his father’s feet.
"Father, I returned too late. I’ve made you suffer."
Jiang Liufeng’s injuries were extremely severe. He struggled to open his eyes. Seeing his son alive and kneeling at his feet, his lifeless gaze brightened a little.
I hadn’t expected my son to return alive after entering the Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon.
"It’s good... you’re back..." After Jiang Liufeng said these four words with difficulty, he closed his eyes again wearily.
Ye Yun looked at him from the side and found that Jiang Liufeng’s injuries were indeed severe.
To be able to torture a powerful practitioner at the Eight-tier of True God to such a degree, they must have used countless cruel tortures and methods. Skyreach Island acts so arrogantly and their methods are excessively cruel. This time, I will annihilate all members of Skyreach Island’s Fu Family.
A twinge of anger rose in Ye Yun’s heart.
"Master, I beg you to save my father," Jiang Hengyue pleaded, as if suddenly remembering something. He swiftly turned, flew to Ye Yun’s feet, and knelt on the ground.
"Rest assured, this injury is nothing. It’s almost the same as what you had before," Ye Yun smiled, using a bit of Mana to help Jiang Hengyue up.
Jiang Hengyue wiped away his tears and instantly started to laugh.
Yes! Father’s injuries are almost the same as mine were. But Master has that miraculous green liquid that healed my injuries instantly. I really have nothing to worry about regarding Father’s injuries.
One of the Jiang Clan guardians, a middle-aged man, looked at Ye Yun with a shocked expression.
Such severe injuries are considered minor? The Island Master is almost dead!
he thought, wondering where the white-robed youth found the confidence to make such a statement. If his own strength weren’t so far beneath the white-robed youth’s, he probably would have spoken sarcastically by now.
Then, he saw the white-robed youth take out a small bottle and flick out a drop of mysterious green liquid. This drop of liquid moved extremely fast, like a bolt of lightning, and flew into Jiang Liufeng’s lips.
A miraculously shocking scene unfolded. He saw Jiang Liufeng’s mangled, bloody injuries healing at a speed visible to the naked eye. In just a few breaths, they were completely healed, with new flesh having grown over everything. Jiang Liufeng, whose breath had been weak and listless, also regained a rosy complexion.
The next moment, Jiang Liufeng suddenly opened his eyes and abruptly stood up.
"Am I dead?" After standing up, Jiang Liufeng looked around and uttered these shocking words. His injuries had been extremely serious just a moment ago; he had been on the verge of death. With his sudden recovery, Jiang Liufeng mistakenly thought he had entered Hell.
"Father, you’re not dead. The old master saved you," Jiang Hengyue quickly walked to his father’s side, speaking with a gentle smile.
"Old master? What are you talking about?" Jiang Liufeng asked in surprise.
"Father, this is the old master," Jiang Hengyue quickly explained. "I have now joined the Dragon God Sect. When I was heavily injured in the Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon and about to die, it was the old master who saved me." As he spoke about the Dragon God Sect, his face unintentionally showed a hint of pride.
Jiang Liufeng looked at the white-robed youth in shock.
Various thoughts flashed through my mind. Both my son’s life and my own were saved by this white-robed youth before me. With such a debt of gratitude, forget joining this Dragon God Sect I’ve never heard of; even if he asked for both our lives again, I wouldn’t even frown.
Thinking this, Jiang Liufeng strode quickly to Ye Yun’s side, abruptly knelt, and kowtowed respectfully.
"Thank you, old master, for saving our lives!" Jiang Liufeng said loudly, tears glistening in his eyes as he finished speaking. Having returned from the brink of death, he naturally knew the terror of that state. Now, given a new lease on life, he was, of course, incredibly grateful to the white-robed ’old master’ before him.
"Jiang Liufeng, if you join My Divine Dragon Sect, you can naturally call me ’old master’. If you don’t join, it would be better to call me ’Senior’," Ye Yun said with a faint smile. Although Jiang Liufeng appeared to be an elderly man, his age was far less than Ye Yun’s.
"Old master, this life of mine was given by you. Naturally, I am willing to join the Dragon God Sect!" Jiang Liufeng exclaimed excitedly.
"Mm," Ye Yun nodded. A wave of Mana surged out, lifting Jiang Liufeng up.
The reason I accepted this father and son is that I want to establish the Dragon God Sect’s first base in the Ninth Sea Area,
Ye Yun thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 297: God-level Asura Armor
chapters.content:
Chapter 297: Chapter 297: God-level Asura Armor
After Jiang Hengyue and his son Jiang Liufeng had their reunion, Ye Yun left Star God Island with Jiang Hengyue. Jiang Liufeng, however, remained on Star God Island to deal with the aftermath. After all, there were still many of Jiang Taihu’s people on Star God Island, and they all had to be removed promptly. Having experienced this crisis for power, Jiang Liufeng also realized some of his previous shortcomings and began to strengthen the management of his clan members in the Jiang Clan.
Before leaving, Ye Yun wiped a segment of memory from the minds of everyone on Star God Island who had seen him. Even though he didn’t erase the memory from Jiang Liufeng’s mind, Ye Yun had set a restriction on it. If anyone tried to read Jiang Liufeng’s memories in the future, the restriction would automatically erase all recollections of Ye Yun from Jiang Liufeng’s mind. As for Jiang Hengyue, Ye Yun had also placed a similar memory restriction on him. This was done for their protection. Otherwise, if the power behind the scenes one day traced its way here, they would be unable to resist with their insignificant cultivation bases.
Ye Yun was very cautious because, to him, the power behind the scenes was too formidable. It had to be at least at the God King Level.
Over the azure sea, two figures flashed past. Jiang Hengyue led the way, flying while saying with deep emotion, "Master, thank you so much for this."
Ye Yun shrugged it off with a smile and said, "Don’t mention it. You are now part of the Dragon God Sect, and Star God Island is our first base in the Divine Land."
Jiang Hengyue stopped mid-flight. He bowed respectfully and said, "Master, rest assured, we will not let you down. My father and I will certainly maintain this base of the Dragon God Sect in the Divine Land."
Ye Yun nodded. He pondered for a moment, then rummaged through his storage and took out a piece of armor. It was dark green armor, its surface covered with various runes, each emanating a cold glow.
"I am giving this Asura Armor to you. At your current cultivation base of True God Realm Fourth Level, commanding the Asura Armor can make you comparable to the Half-step Divine Monarch Realm." With a slight smile, Ye Yun tossed the green armor to Jiang Hengyue.
"Asura Armor?" Jiang Hengyue was shocked as he received it. He meticulously studied the dark green Asura Armor, growing more astonished the more he looked. Based on his intuition, he felt that the armor was at least of Emperor Level quality.
"This set of Asura Armor is of God-level quality. It will require some effort for you to refine it, but as your cultivation base improves, this armor will greatly enhance your combat power," Ye Yun said casually with a smile.
What? God-level quality?
Hearing Ye Yun’s words, Jiang Hengyue was dumbfounded. Ye Yun had actually given him a set of God-level Asura Armor. It felt almost like a dream.
"Master, this is too valuable! I am unworthy... to accept such God-level armor!" Jiang Hengyue, holding the Asura Armor, slowly offered it back to Ye Yun. His face was flushed with excitement, his eyes filled with both enthusiasm and unease.
God-level treasures were extremely rare in the Divine Land. Even Divine Monarchs might not possess a God-level treasure. Especially this kind of God-level Armor; it was pitifully scarce. After all, once this kind of God-level Armor was worn, it could increase one’s combat power many times over. It was quite terrifying.
In Jiang Hengyue’s perception, not a single person in the Ninth Sea Area possessed armor of this caliber. As for the other nearby sea areas, he had not heard of anyone possessing such armor either. After all, the divine materials and celestial treasures consumed in crafting a full set of armor were unimaginable. Many Refining Masters would rather make a sword than a full set of armor.
"Take it. This kind of armor may not mean much to me, but it is important for you. You can wear the Asura Armor when you go to Skyreach Island and make a great killing," Ye Yun said, looking at Jiang Hengyue with a hopeful smile in his eyes.
"Master, thank... thank you very much. I won’t let you down." Jiang Hengyue was moved to tears and eventually accepted the Asura Armor.
"Put on this armor and begin refining it. I’ll escort you on the way. Once we reach Skyreach Island, you can officially wield the Asura Armor," Ye Yun said with a smile. After speaking, he waved his hand, and a shield of light enveloped Jiang Hengyue.
"Yes, Master." Jiang Hengyue agreed, put on the armor, sat cross-legged with a solemn expression, and started the refining process. His first step was to establish a connection with the Asura Armor. This way, when the Asura Armor was not in use, it could shrink back into his body and enter his Dantian, where it would be continuously nurtured with Divine Yuan Power.
Ye Yun walked slowly through the air, his gaze fixed on the direction of Skyreach Island. He was not in a hurry. Giving Jiang Hengyue a day to refine should be enough for him to initially control the Asura Armor. After all, Jiang Hengyue was now a spiritual cultivator in the True God Realm. Refining this God-level Asura Armor naturally happened much faster than when Big Black Cat, then at the Destiny Realm, had refined the Emperor Level Teleportation Boots.
However, because the quality of this Asura Armor was so high, with Jiang Hengyue’s True God Realm cultivation base, he could only initially refine the Asura Armor. Despite this, this Asura Armor could still boost his battle strength to the True God Realm Tenth Layer Peak, or the Half-step Divine Monarch Realm.
As for further refinement, only after Jiang Hengyue broke through to the Divine Monarch Realm could he better control this God-level Asura Armor. By Ye Yun’s estimates, Jiang Hengyue would have to reach the Divine Sovereign Realm to fully refine this Lower God Rank Asura Armor.
True God, Divine Monarch, Divine Sovereign. These three realms corresponded to the refining levels of the Asura Armor—beginner, intermediate, and advanced. No matter the level of refinement—even if he only succeeded in the initial refinement—as Jiang Hengyue continued to break through within the True God Realm, the battle power of the Asura Armor would increase, and its effects would last longer. After all, once this set of armor was activated, it consumed a lot of Divine Yuan Power. Unless it was a life-or-death situation, Ye Yun would not recommend Jiang Hengyue use the Asura Armor. He believed that Jiang Hengyue would understand this after refining the Asura Armor.
Essentially, Ye Yun didn’t really like relying on external objects. A hundred thousand years ago, Ye Yun trusted more in his Divine Dragon Sword. One Sword Breaks Ten Thousand Laws. One sword could cut down all the demons and monsters in the world.
A hundred thousand years later, Ye Yun still held this conviction. Only now, he possessed the Ancestral Dragon Body, and his physical strength was terrifying. Under the philosophy of One Sword Breaks Ten Thousand Laws, Ye Yun trusted his fists even more.
There was nothing a punch couldn’t solve. If one punch couldn’t solve it, then he would throw a second, and a third... blasting away all obstacles without mercy!
It was because of this philosophy that even though he had countless God-level and Super God Level treasures in his warehouse, Ye Yun seldom made use of them.

chapters.title: Chapter 298: The Yuan Mo Clan, The Arrival of the False Demon Lord
chapters.content:
Chapter 298: Chapter 298: The Yuan Mo Clan, The Arrival of the False Demon Lord
The Divine Land is vast and boundless. Even a Spirit at the Divine Monarch Realm could spend their whole life without traversing its entirety. Most people prefer to dwell in one corner, and this corner alone is enough for a powerful cultivator at the Divine Monarch Realm to thrive for a lifetime.
The Divine Land is home not only to spirits of the Human Race but also to various divine races.
Within the Divine Land, on a territory known as the Netherworld Demon Territory, lives a group of weak Yuan Mo Clan People.
The Yuan Mo Clan People, back in Ancient Times, were one of the famous Ten Great Demon Clans.
However, after millions of years of changes, the current Yuan Mo Clan People have become extremely weak.
Especially facing the oppression of other Demon Clans, the status of their clan is now precarious, at risk of being driven out from their ancestral land.
「On this day.」
All Yuan Mo Clan People gathered deep underground.
Here, there was a deep and secluded hall, and within it, a huge, dark-red altar.
