Tens of thousands of Yuan Mo Clan People gathered around the altar, gazing fervently at the young woman standing upon it.
She was the High Priest of the Yuan Mo Clan.
The High Priest was beautiful, with a petite figure, bewitching curves, and skin as fair as jade. However, there was a black mark between her brows.
Other members of the Yuan Mo Clan looked very similar to her, each bearing a black mark between their brows.
The Yuan Mo Clan, in appearance, was completely different from other Demon Clans.
They were more similar to Human Cultivators, not as gigantic and terrifying as other Demon Clans.
But once the Yuan Mo Clan People activated the mark between their brows, their entire bodies would become huge, entering a different battle mode.
"In Ancient Times, our Yuan Mo Clan was one of the Ten Great Demon Clans. However, the world can be unpredictable. Over millions of years, our Yuandemon clan has been continuously oppressed by other major Demon Clans, resulting in our decline. Now, we find ourselves facing a matter of life and death..."
The beautiful and alluring High Priest held a White Bone Wand, her exquisite face bearing a gravely serious expression.
"High Priest, our Yuan Mo Clan will never decline!" a young girl shouted from below.
Her voice instantly resonated with all the Yuan Mo Clan People.
"Rise of the Yuan Mo Clan!"
Tens of thousands shouted in unison.
The sound was deafening, shaking the deep underground hall.
The High Priest raised her wand, her expression fervent, and shouted, "My dear Clan Members! After nearly one hundred thousand years of preparation, we have finally repaired this ancient altar. Now, we can summon the Demon Lord of the Yuandemon World again to lead our Yuan Mo Clan People towards glory!"
"Long live the Demon Lord!"
At this moment, all the fervent Yuan Mo Clan People knelt and shouted loudly.
The High Priest’s body suddenly floated in midair. She pointed her wand towards the dark-red altar.
The High Priest then began to recite an ancient and lengthy incantation.
As time passed, the dark-red altar began to gradually light up.
A dim, red light emanated from it, illuminating the shadowy hall.
Upon seeing this, everyone grew excited, their eyes fixed on the red altar in anticipation.
The High Priest did not stop; she continued to recite the incantation.
The light from the red altar grew stronger, illuminating the entire hall.
"Let the Demon Lord descend!"
The High Priest shouted abruptly, then fell rapidly from midair, kneeling on the ground.
A pillar of blood-red light shot skyward, passing through the altar and soaring beyond the clouds.
The next moment, the blood-red pillar of light vanished instantly.
Suddenly, a middle-aged man appeared. He wore a black robe, had handsome features, fair skin, and a mark between his brows.
"The Demon Lord has descended!"
Upon seeing the middle-aged man on the red altar, all the Yuan Mo Clan People cried out in elation.
The High Priest looked at the middle-aged man. Her gaze fell on the black mark between his brows, and a beautiful smile graced her lips.
After nearly one hundred thousand years of preparation, the Yuan Mo Clan People had finally summoned the Demon Lord.
「In ancient times.」
The Demon Lord descended upon the Divine Land and left behind his bloodline, giving rise to the Yuandemon clan.
Where is this?
Did I get in?
I actually got in?
The middle-aged man stood on the altar, stunned for a moment, repeating these three questions in his mind.
Then, an ecstatic expression appeared on his face.
This world was incredibly robust.
His current clone was not strong enough; no matter what he tried, he couldn’t penetrate it.
Fortunately, he noticed a summoning power.
Within this force was a Demon God from a certain Demon World.
To get in, he had instantly abandoned his original body and possessed this Demon God.
Following the summoning power, he quickly descended onto the altar underground.
Due to the haste of his possession, the Demon God’s Primordial Spirit was shattered by him, resulting in no memories being inherited.
This quite annoyed Wu De. Indeed, his original name was Wu De.
Looking at the Yuan Mo Clan People kneeling below, Wu De couldn’t help but yawn.
He reflexively put his hand to his mouth, ready for a smoke, but was dejected to find his Purple Gold Pipe missing.
Alas, I don’t know which fellow Daoist stole my Purple Gold Pipe, causing me to search for it endlessly across the myriad worlds...
Wu De sighed and reluctantly lowered his hand.
There was nothing to be done; without his Purple Gold Pipe, he couldn’t satisfy his craving.
However, entering this world made him extremely happy.
Because while wandering outside earlier, he had detected a faint aura that felt extremely familiar.
If he wasn’t mistaken, his Purple Gold Pipe might be here.
But this world was vast, and he had possessed someone else’s body, so finding his Purple Gold Pipe would be incredibly difficult.
I might as well settle down first and then search for it slowly.
With this thought, Wu De said, "You can all get up." He slowly descended from the red altar and approached the High Priest.
He stepped down from the red altar, worried that if these people noticed something amiss, they might reactivate it and send him back.
Having expended so much effort and used indirect strategies to enter this world to find his Purple Gold Pipe, he absolutely could not go back now.
As for his original body, it was currently floating outside this world in the void.
That place was vast, desolate, and uninhabited; nothing untoward should happen to it.
The High Priest raised her head, her gaze intensely fixed on the Demon Lord before her. "Demon Lord, our Yuan Mo Clan is oppressed by the Bloodthirsty Demon Clan. They now intend to seize our ancestral land. We implore you to intervene and drive them away!"
With his hands behind his back, Wu De did his best to affect the demeanor of a Demon King, lowering his voice and asking with feigned gravity, "What is the highest cultivation realm of the Bloodthirsty Demon Clan’s experts?"
The High Priest quickly replied, "They have one Demon King at the Divine Sovereign Realm, My Lord!"
Divine Sovereign Realm, eh?
Wu De quickly sensed the state of his current body.
The Demon God body he now inhabited was also at the Divine Sovereign Realm, and its original Primordial Spirit had been replaced by his, an even more noble one.
Wu De was confident he could easily deal with that Divine Sovereign Realm Demon King of the Bloodthirsty Demon Clan.
"Let’s go!"
Wu De waved his hand and led the men, women, old, and young of the Yuan Mo Clan People out of the great hall, thus beginning his first battle since entering the Divine Land.

chapters.title: Chapter 299: All Things are Impermanent, Lin Yanran Expresses her Resolutions Through Death
chapters.content:
Chapter 299: Chapter 299: All Things are Impermanent, Lin Yanran Expresses her Resolutions Through Death
All things are impermanent.
Ye Yun had not expected that after showing off his thousands of Super God Level pipes in the final segment of the Ancient Road to Heaven, there would still be a terrifyingly powerful being who sensed his own Purple Gold Pipe.
Perhaps this powerful being has some sort of hidden connection to this Purple Gold Pipe.
Even though the Purple Gold Pipe was shielded by the barrier of a world, this powerful figure vaguely sensed something. In the end, in an unimaginable way, they arrived in this world, becoming a Demon Lord of the Yuan Mo Clan in the Divine Land.
Even though the fellow called Wu De was still handling internal matters of the Yuan Mo Clan and had not sought out Ye Yun yet,
this is only a matter of time.
However, Ye Yun had already stuffed all the pipes into his warehouse. He wouldn’t leak any trace of Super Divine Dragon Breath.
For that being to find Ye Yun would be as difficult as climbing to heaven.
...
At this moment, Ye Yun was leisurely flying over the azure seascape, with a luminous orb floating behind him. In it sat Jiang Hengyue, wearing the Asura Armor.
To avoid drawing attention, Ye Yun had specially used a Divine Skill to hide himself and Jiang Hengyue. Thus, nobody would discover them.
Ye Yun planned to arrive at Skyreach Island in one day.
This way, Jiang Hengyue would have just enough time to finish the initial refinement of the Asura Armor.
But Ye Yun was generally a cautious person. He still released his terrifying Divine Sense, casting it out to scan the distant Skyreach Island.
Having read Jiang Hengyue’s memories, Ye Yun had some understanding of Skyreach Island’s Young Island Master, Fu Nanhua, and Jiang Hengyue’s fiancée, Lin Yanran.
Though Ye Yun’s Divine Sense was terrifyingly powerful, he controlled it with extreme precision. He didn’t cause any pressure on Skyreach Island, nor did anyone realize that a terrifying Divine Sense had descended upon it.
Continuously shifting his Divine Sense, Ye Yun finally located Fu Nanhua.
Fu Nanhua was not bad-looking—tall in stature with handsome features. His eyes held a hint of sinister chill, giving off the impression that he was not a good person.
Fu Nanhua’s cultivation base had reached the True God Realm Fifth Layer. In terms of talent and aptitude, he was slightly better than Jiang Hengyue.
At this moment, Fu Nanhua was walking slowly through an underground passageway, his hands clasped behind his back.
A young lady in a red robe followed him. Her facial features were exquisite, her skin as smooth as jade, and her appearance was remarkably striking, her bearing noble and elegant.
Through Jiang Hengyue’s memories, Ye Yun knew that Lin Yanran’s father, Lin Jun, was the Island Master of Green Cloud Island.
So, with her privileged family background, Lin Yanran had been well-versed in numerous arts since childhood and had not neglected her cultivation either. Currently, she too was at the True God Realm Fifth Layer.
Her talents were slightly higher than Jiang Hengyue’s.
Even though Lin Yanran was more advanced in her realm, she was fond of Jiang Hengyue and did not despise him for having a lower cultivation base.
Currently, Lin Yanran looked worried, her eyebrows knitted and her head lowered. Two maids followed behind her.
"We’re here."
After turning a corner, Fu Nanhua suddenly stopped. Turning around with a smile, he looked at Lin Yanran.
Lin Yanran lifted her head to see her father tied to an iron pillar in the jail cell before her, his head hanging low as if he had fainted.
"Father!"
Lin Yanran rushed forward immediately but was blocked by the bars of the cell.
"Lin Yanran, I haven’t done anything to your father. I just invited him here, gave him some sedatives, and let him have a good sleep," Fu Nanhua said with a smile, looking like a modest gentleman, not at all like a demon.
Seeing her father with his head lowered the entire time, Lin Yanran could not stop her tears from falling.
This Fu Nanhua was utterly wicked. He had barely set her fiancé free when he captured her father.
"I can’t wait for next month. How about we get married tomorrow?" Fu Nanhua stroked his chin, leering at Lin Yanran as he asked with a smile.
"I’m not ready," Lin Yanran wiped away a tear and said softly.
"No time like the present. How could I possibly give you forever to prepare? Lin Yanran, if you don’t agree, your father, Lin Jun, won’t be so comfortable. As for how uncomfortable? Just think about your old beloved Jiang Hengyue, haha..." Fu Nanhua erupted in laughter, his voice not loud but extremely arrogant.
Lin Yanran fell silent.
She had been trapped deep within Skyreach Island for many days and had witnessed her fiancé, Jiang Hengyue, being tragically abused by Fu Nanhua. Naturally, she didn’t want to see her father suffer the same fate.
"I’ll agree to marry you tomorrow, but you have to free my father," Lin Yanran said through gritted teeth, her expression freezing over.
"Very good! I knew Miss Lin was a sensible person; I haven’t misjudged you," Fu Nanhua laughed. With a snap of his fingers, two guards immediately came over, opened the prison doors, and took Lin Jun away.
"You can rest assured, I’ll just let your father-in-law find somewhere comfortable to stay for a day or two. Once our wedding is over, I’ll serve him well and personally apologize to him," Fu Nanhua said, smiling.
Lin Yanran was trembling with rage. She turned around and walked away, the two maids following closely behind her.
Watching Lin Yanran’s retreating figure, a cold and sinister look flickered across Fu Nanhua’s handsome face.
"Try to oppose me? You’re too naive. In the Ninth Sea Area, Skyreach Island is heaven, and the end for any resisters is a single word—death!"
After a cold snort, Fu Nanhua walked out.
When Ye Yun saw this, his expression darkened.
This Fu Nanhua truly is a lawless scion, his methods insidious and cruel, despised by all.
But Fu Nanhua’s life was now down to one day.
Tomorrow, Jiang Hengyue would personally end the lives of Fu Nanhua and his father.
Ye Yun’s Divine Sense settled on Lin Yanran once more.
He felt that this girl, who had undergone two major shocks, seemed a little off.
What’s more, her body had also been placed under a restriction.
Although her cultivation base had not decreased, her Divine Yuan Power had been sealed away.
Lin Yanran returned to her room with her head lowered and asked the two maids to stay outside.
She slowly walked to the mirror, looking at her tear-streaked, beautiful face reflected within, her eyes full of hatred.
She stood silently before the mirror for the time it takes an incense stick to burn.
Finally, Lin Yanran made up her mind. From the drawer of her dressing table, she took out a green pill.
She had hidden this pill there when she was first captured.
This was an Extremely Poisonous Elixir. Once consumed, she would die from the poison within a few breaths.
"Fu Nanhua, you beast in human skin! I will seek revenge on you in my next life!" Lin Yanran said through gritted teeth.
After she finished speaking, she brought the green pill to her mouth.
She no longer wanted to live.
Under no circumstances could she accept Fu Nanhua defiling her.
Now that the arrow was on the string, she could only protect her innocence by choosing death.
The Extremely Poisonous Elixir had not yet touched her lips.
"Lin Yanran, Fu Nanhua will die tomorrow. Why are you seeking death?"
A man’s voice resonated faintly in her mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 300: Breaking the Prohibition, Trust, Underwater Giant Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 300: Chapter 300: Breaking the Prohibition, Trust, Underwater Giant Dragon
The voice echoed suddenly in her mind, causing Lin Yanran to halt her actions instantly.
Who is it?
Lin Yanran wondered vehemently in her heart.
The man’s voice was completely unfamiliar, unlike anyone from Skyreach Island. Skyreach Island was teeming with powerful experts. The fact that this man could bypass those experts and project his Divine Sense into her mind indicated how formidable his cultivation base was.
"Jiang Hengyue will arrive on Skyreach Island tomorrow to execute Fu Nanhua and his son, completely changing who holds power on the island. As for who I am, Jiang Hengyue will tell you tomorrow." Ye Yun’s voice echoed calmly, lingering in Lin Yanran’s mind.
"Senior, although I want to believe you, the idea that the Fu father and son will be executed tomorrow is simply too incredible. I know Jiang Hengyue; how could he suddenly possess such immense power?" Lin Yanran calmed herself and voiced her doubts.
Far out on the sea, Ye Yun noticed Lin Yanran’s skepticism and couldn’t help but chuckle softly. Skepticism was natural, as Lin Yanran could neither discern Ye Yun’s identity nor verify the truth of his words.
In Lin Yanran’s estimation, Jiang Hengyue was only at the True God Realm Fourth Level. Therefore, it was highly unlikely he could pose any threat to the Fu Family father and son on Skyreach Island.
Ye Yun’s eyes flickered. He smiled and said, "I’ll help you lift the prohibition now."
"Lift the prohibition? Senior, can you truly lift the prohibition within me using only your Divine Sense?" Lin Yanran asked in astonishment.
The moment she finished speaking, a BOOM resounded within her. The prohibition that had suppressed her Divine Yuan Power instantly shattered. Surging Divine Yuan Power once again began to circulate through her body.
Lin Yanran was both shocked and overjoyed.
The prohibition on me wasn’t set by Fu Nanhua. It was cast by an ancestor of the Fu Family, a powerful expert at the Half-Step Divine Monarch Realm! This prohibition is extraordinarily strong; to break it, one’s cultivation base must reach at least the Divine Monarch Realm. Yet, it was shattered by a mere Divine Sense! This senior’s cultivation base... it’s likely approaching the Divine Sovereign Realm!
With this senior, who possesses such a profound cultivation base, assisting Jiang Hengyue in executing the Fu Family father and son on Skyreach Island, it won’t be difficult at all!
Lin Yanran was incredibly excited.
"Senior, thank you for your immense kindness!" she exclaimed, her voice filled with excitement.
"Just wait for the good news," Ye Yun replied with a gentle smile, retracting his formidable Divine Sense.
In the room, Lin Yanran remained stunned for a moment before a radiant smile blossomed on her lips. Her smile was like a hundred flowers blooming, exceptionally captivating and lovely. The heavy clouds of worry that had plagued her heart for so long finally dispersed.
After enduring for so long, the clouds have finally parted to reveal the moonlight. Now, all I need to do is wait patiently. My fiancé, Jiang Hengyue, will descend from the heavens tomorrow and kill that wicked Fu Family father and son on Skyreach Island, who have committed so many evil deeds!
「...」
After Fu Nanhua emerged from the main prison, he immediately became busy. The wedding was to be held the next day, and he began instructing the servants to decorate Skyreach Island.
Fu Nanhua’s father, Fu Wei, however, was not concerned with his son’s wedding preparations. He walked from the depths of the main hall into a small Teleportation Array. A flash of light later, Fu Wei’s figure vanished from within the Teleportation Array.
Skyreach Island was the largest island in the Ninth Sea Area. It covered an immense territory and was home to tens of millions of the Human Race. But no one knew that deep beneath the waters surrounding Skyreach Island, a large Formation emanated a hazy grey light, isolating all Super Divine Dragon Breath.
A light suddenly flared outside the Formation, revealing Fu Wei’s figure. He stepped out, raised a Token in his hand, and walked into the hazy Formation.
"Senior, these are some heavenly materials and earthly treasures collected recently for Cultivation. They are all in this storage ring. Little Wei has brought them for you." Upon entering the Formation, Fu Wei’s demeanor became extremely deferential. He clasped his fists, bowed deeply, and then presented a small storage ring.
Before him lay a Blue Dragon, tens of thousands of zhang long. This Blue Dragon exuded an overwhelmingly terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath. Dark blue Dragon Scales covered its entire body, shimmering with a somber luster.
Hearing Fu Wei’s words, the Blue Dragon opened one eye. "When will your Fu Family finally produce a Divine Monarch Realm Spirit Cultivator? So many years have passed, and not one of you has a cultivation base surpassing mine." The Blue Dragon sighed, a nostalgic look in its eye. "A pity Fu Changhe died so young..."
An embarrassed expression flickered across Fu Wei’s face upon hearing the Blue Dragon’s lament. The Fu Changhe mentioned by the Blue Dragon was an ancestor of the Fu Family. He had unfortunately perished while attempting to break through from the True God Realm to the Divine Monarch Realm. This ancestor, Fu Changhe, had been the true master of the Blue Dragon before them.
"Senior, my son is getting married tomorrow. We’ve invited many Island Masters from nearby islands, so we should receive a significant amount of betrothal gifts. If there’s anything you need, Senior, we will send it over then," Fu Wei said respectfully.
"Very well. Your Fu Family has treated me well, providing various resources over the years. If you encounter any difficulties in the future, I will definitely help you," the Blue Dragon said in a deep voice.
"Thank you, Senior!" Fu Wei smiled, bowed, and exited the Formation. He then took the Teleportation Array, leaving the depths of the sea.
「...」
「The next day.」
Skyreach Island was festooned with lights and decorations, bustling with crowds, and brimming with a joyous atmosphere. Streaks of light continuously flew in from all directions, landing on Skyreach Island. As soon as they landed, representatives from Skyreach Island would approach with smiles, warmly welcoming them.
The number of wedding guests steadily increased. Almost all the Island Masters from the Ninth Sea Area personally delivered their congratulatory gifts. From the other nine sea areas, those on good terms with Skyreach Island also came to celebrate.
Indeed, Skyreach Island was now host to a multitude of distinguished guests. Many were experts at the True God Realm Tenth Layer or the Half-Step Divine Monarch Realm.
The void rippled faintly, an anomaly unnoticed by anyone.
At this moment, Ye Yun and Jiang Hengyue had already descended into the airspace above Skyreach Island.
Jiang Hengyue had now completed the initial refinement of the Asura Armor. After refining it, he had stored the Asura Armor within his body. In the future, it would envelop his entire body with a mere thought.
This Skyreach Island is certainly bustling.
Gazing down at the brightly lit and joyously decorated Skyreach Island below, Jiang Hengyue’s expression turned cold and merciless.
If his Master hadn’t told him, he would never have believed that Fu Nanhua, that dog scoundrel, would dare to kidnap his own father-in-law for this wedding! Such an act was an outrage to gods and men alike!
"Go on. Don’t worry about consuming too much Divine Yuan Power. Unleash the full might of the God-level Asura Armor!" Ye Yun gently patted Jiang Hengyue’s shoulder, offering an encouraging smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 301: Rivals Meet, Fu Nanhua’s Shock
chapters.content:
Chapter 301: Chapter 301: Rivals Meet, Fu Nanhua’s Shock
"Master..."
Having heard Ye Yun’s words, Jiang Hengyue was slightly stunned.
Not having to worry about Divine Yuan Power?
His current cultivation base was at the True God Realm Fourth Level, and although he had begun to refine the Asura Armor, in reality, the Divine Yuan Power within his body was not enough to support the use of the Asura Armor for a long period of time.
Ye Yun smiled faintly, snapped his fingers, and a ray of light landed on the dark green Asura Armor.
"I will help replenish your Divine Yuan Power, so you can just focus on killing," he said.
"Thank you, Master!"
Only then did Jiang Hengyue understand.
So, the Master was going to personally replenish his Divine Yuan Power. For a moment, he was so moved that he didn’t know what to say.
But thinking about his fiancée still being on Skyreach Island, he was extremely anxious.
After thanking the Master, he immediately turned around and flew down.
In mid-air, Jiang Hengyue focused his thoughts, and a surge of tidal, cyan light rose, covering his entire body with the God-level Asura Armor.
This dark green Asura Armor, flowing with a mysterious cyan light, looked majestic and somewhat fierce, like a god of slaughter from the Nine Soul Nether Hell who had suddenly descended from mid-air.
This kid looks pretty handsome in the Asura Armor,
Ye Yun thought, standing in the void, looking at Jiang Hengyue’s cyan silhouette and nodding with a smile.
The design of the Asura Armor was unique. After putting it on, he looked dignified and murderous, appearing as a true Asura.
Ye Yun stood with his hands behind his back, his figure concealed, invisible to others.
He watched the battle from the air, supporting Jiang Hengyue.
The closer Jiang Hengyue got to Skyreach Island, the more his heart raced with excitement.
He freely released his Divine Sense, beginning to search for his fiancée, Lin Yanran.
When he was first thrown into prison, if Lin Yanran hadn’t pleaded for him, that scoundrel Fu Nanhua would have probably tortured him to death by now.
Jiang Hengyue felt deeply grateful to his fiancée.
As he sent out his Divine Sense indiscriminately, he quickly located Lin Yanran.
Now clad in the Asura Armor, Jiang Hengyue’s true strength had reached the True God Realm Tenth Layer Peak.
He could be regarded as a Half-step Divine Monarch Realm powerhouse.
Therefore, his Divine Sense was currently at its peak strength.
Even in the vast Skyreach Island, finding Lin Yanran’s whereabouts was as easy as pie.
He transformed into a cyan ray of light and descended from the sky, landing in a courtyard.
The courtyard was bustling with servants. The buildings were adorned with lanterns and colorful banners, creating a festive and joyful atmosphere.
The windows and doors were all pasted with characters symbolizing good luck.
When Jiang Hengyue descended from mid-air, bringing with him the powerful pressure of a Half-step Divine Monarch Realm cultivator, all the servants in the vicinity were instantly blown away.
Lin Yanran, who was in the midst of her makeup, suddenly heard the chaotic noises outside and her heart leaped with joy.
She was almost certain that her fiancé, Jiang Hengyue, had arrived.
Lin Yanran quickly got up, pushed open the door, and saw a man in green armor standing opposite her.
The man’s Super Divine Dragon Breath was incredibly fearsome, having reached the cultivation base of the Half-step Divine Monarch Realm.
"Yanran," Jiang Hengyue cried out.
Seeing the beautiful Lin Yanran standing at the door, he could no longer hold back his excitement and rushed towards her.
"Hengyue, it’s you," Lin Yanran said, extremely excited.
The two embraced, tears of joy streaming down their faces.
Having faced life-and-death situations, they were finally reunited.
Only those who have experienced such things can truly understand the myriad emotions.
Looking at Lin Yanran dressed in a bride’s red attire, Ye Yun’s eyes sparkled as an idea suddenly came to him.
Why not let this pair of lovers get married on Skyreach Island after killing Fu Nanhua and his son? As they say, there’s no time like the present. This way, it would be a beautifully concluded marriage.
Thinking about this, Ye Yun smiled.
「...」
"Who dares to trespass on my Skyreach Island?"
A furious roar echoed from outside the courtyard, and dozens of figures flew towards them.
Fu Nanhua stood in the center, like the moon surrounded by stars.
He was currently dressed in red festive attire, his face contorted with anger as he glared at the couple embracing in the distance.
Who is this man in the green armor? How dare he try to steal my wife?
Hearing Fu Nanhua’s voice, Jiang Hengyue turned around.
The Asura Armor covered his entire body, revealing only his eyes.
Even if Jiang Hengyue stood right in front of Fu Nanhua, Fu Nanhua wouldn’t recognize him.
"Fu Nanhua, you damned scoundrel, today I’ve come to take your life!" Jiang Hengyue declared, his pupils shooting out two fierce glints of light. His voice was icy, and the temperature in the entire courtyard plummeted.
"You are Jiang Hengyue?" Hearing the familiar voice, a trace of shock appeared on Fu Nanhua’s face.
Hadn’t this fellow escaped into the Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon? To eliminate this future trouble back then, I even specifically sent a family cultivator at the True God Realm Tier Seven from my clan to the Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon to hunt Jiang Hengyue. But how is this guy alive again? And he’s even wearing a layer of mysterious green armor!
Fu Nanhua sensed Jiang Hengyue’s cultivation base and was astonished to find that this fellow had already reached the True God Realm Tenth Layer Peak.
This discovery made his eyes widen, the shocked expression on his face solidifying.
"Jiang Hengyue, I never imagined that after entering the Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon, you not only survived but also had such a fortuitous encounter!" Fu Nanhua exclaimed. "What exactly is this armor? How could it elevate your realm so much?"
After the initial shock, Fu Nanhua licked his lips, a greedy, fervent light shining in his eyes.
This suit of armor has an extraordinary Super Divine Dragon Breath! If Skyreach Island could seize it, wouldn’t we be invincible in the Ten Great Ocean areas?
Figures rushed in from all directions.
It seemed the great commotion in this small courtyard had alarmed many of Skyreach Island’s powerful figures.
Most of these people were Island Masters from the major islands.
Their cultivation bases were not low.
The lowest was at the True God Realm Sixth Layer, and the highest had already reached the Half-step Divine Monarch Realm.
There were hundreds of them.
Everyone stared at the man in armor exuding a terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath, utterly astonished.
They could all tell that this set of green armor was of exceptional quality.
It was very likely of Emperor Level quality.
Seeing so many people suddenly arrive, Jiang Hengyue felt immense pressure. If he wanted to kill Fu Nanhua now, he had to strike first and gain the upper hand.
Thinking of this,
he decisively drew his sword. With a swift movement, he charged towards Fu Nanhua.
The Asura Armor frantically devoured the Divine Yuan Power in his body, granting him unimaginable speed!
Like a thunderbolt, Jiang Hengyue instantly reached Fu Nanhua and slashed down with his sword.
The sword strike was incredibly fast.
Many people didn’t even have time to react.
At this moment, two elderly men at the Half-step Divine Monarch Realm beside Fu Nanhua reacted and quickly moved to intercept him.
Two sword lights slanted upwards to meet Jiang Hengyue’s attack, crossing from left and right.
Jiang Hengyue’s sword light, containing astonishing Sword Intent, descended like a silver river.
Fu Nanhua was also startled by the sudden attack.
"Two ancestors, kill him and seize that armor!" Fu Nanhua roared, his face flushed with fanaticism as he drew his own sword.
BANG!
The three sword lights collided.
The two Half-step Divine Monarch Realm ancestors, caught off guard, couldn’t block Jiang Hengyue’s sword light at all.
This sword light, majestic and powerful, contained unimaginable force.
At this moment, the God-level Asura Armor displayed its true strength!

chapters.title: Chapter 302: Slaying All Around with the Sword
chapters.content:
Chapter 302: Chapter 302: Slaying All Around with the Sword
BOOM!
Under the horrified gazes of the two Half-step Divine Monarch Realm ancestors, their two sword lights instantly shattered. At this moment, a brilliant and dazzling sword light landed on Fu Nanhua.
Fu Nanhua’s eyes widened.
Even at the brink of death, he couldn’t believe Jiang Hengyue had killed him. A mere True God Realm Fourth Level cultivator, someone he once considered less than an ant. He had even severely injured Jiang Hengyue and driven him into the Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon. But how did Jiang Hengyue suddenly become so powerful? Was it just because he was wearing a mysterious Green Armor that he could display such terrifying combat power? The combined strike of two Half-step Divine Monarch Realm ancestors from Skyreach Island couldn’t even block this sword light. Am I... am I really going to die?
Many thoughts flashed through Fu Nanhua’s mind in an incredibly short moment. It seemed to stretch on for an eternity, yet also felt fleeting.
The brilliant sword light descended, cleaving Fu Nanhua’s body in two. A Primordial Spirit soared into the sky, transforming into Fu Nanhua’s ethereal form in mid-air.
"Kill him!" Fu Nanhua roared.
Although my physical body has been destroyed, Skyreach Island is teeming with experts now. There’s no way they’ll let Jiang Hengyue escape alive!
Having destroyed Fu Nanhua’s physical body with a single sword strike, Jiang Hengyue took a shallow breath.
That last strike, which had deflected the sword lights of two Half-step Divine Monarch Realm experts, had consumed most of his Divine Yuan Power. But in an instant, he found his Divine Yuan Power completely replenished.
He couldn’t help but look towards a certain direction in the sky, his eyes filled with gratitude.
Jiang Hengyue knew this was all his Master’s doing. It was an unimaginable Divine Skill; his Master had directly established some kind of Divine Yuan Power link between them. In that case, I won’t have to worry about my Divine Yuan Power running out at all!
「In the distance.」
Standing at the doorway, Lin Yanran, dressed in red, witnessed this scene. Her beautiful eyes widened in utter shock.
Everything was just as that mysterious man had said! Her fiancé, Jiang Hengyue, his strength had skyrocketed! So powerful... even under the combined assault of two Half-step Divine Monarch Realm ancestors, he still managed to cleave Fu Nanhua’s physical body apart. This is truly unimaginable!
Lin Yanran was so overwhelmed with emotion that tears streamed down her face.
「In the void.」
Upon seeing this, a calm and composed smile appeared on Ye Yun’s face.
This is just the beginning, merely the first step on a long journey. With my abundant Divine Yuan Power supporting him, Jiang Hengyue is now like an indefatigable War God of slaughter. His God-level Asura Armor provides him with impeccable defensive power. No one here can be his match. Not even if they ganged up on him. If a group were to fight him, the ones who would suffer the most devastating casualties would undoubtedly be these experts from Skyreach Island.
Perhaps Jiang Hengyue’s last strike had been too stunning. Fear welled up in the hearts of the surrounding onlookers, and for a moment, no one dared to make a move.
Seeing this, Fu Nanhua’s Primordial Spirit roared, "What are you waiting for? Attack now!"
As his voice fell, the Fu Family cultivators on Skyreach Island all sprang into action. Hundreds of them, a veritable swarm of locusts, lunged at Jiang Hengyue. Countless sword lights rained down like a torrential storm, interspersed with various magical treasures that radiated terrifying auras as they descended upon Jiang Hengyue.
「At that moment.」
A figure suddenly materialized beside Fu Nanhua’s Primordial Spirit. It was none other than Fu Wei, the Island Master of Skyreach Island. Seeing his son’s physical body destroyed, with only his Primordial Spirit remaining, Fu Wei trembled with rage, flames of fury blazing in his eyes.
"Father, I’m fine!" Fu Nanhua licked his lips, a fanatical glint in his eyes. "Just have the people of Skyreach Island kill Jiang Hengyue and seize that set of armor he’s wearing. Father, I *must* have that armor!"
"Good son, rest assured," Fu Wei said coldly, his hands clasped behind his back as he stared intently at the battle below. "Skyreach Island is teeming with experts. There’s no way he’ll leave here alive."
He too had noticed the potency of this set of armor. In the Ten Great Ocean Areas, armor-type magical treasures were exceptionally rare, and he had never heard of any Island Master possessing such a treasure. But from the looks of it, the armor on this brat Jiang Hengyue was incredibly formidable. The fact that it could elevate a mere True God Realm Fourth Level cultivator to the Half-step Divine Monarch Realm spoke volumes about its terrifying power. This set of armor... its grade has probably reached the Emperor Level! If I could seize this Emperor-level Armor and wear it myself, I could probably unleash the power of a Divine Monarch Realm cultivator! If that were true, Skyreach Island becoming the most powerful force in the Ten Great Ocean Areas would be within reach!
Watching the multitude of cultivators swarming him like a plague of locusts, Jiang Hengyue’s blood boiled, and he frantically channeled his power into the Asura Armor.
"KILL!" he roared furiously, drawing his sword and charging forward.
Sword lights shot out from his hand one after another, surging like a tidal wave towards the Skyreach Island cultivators.
Despite his astonishing combat strength, the attackers surrounding him were simply too numerous. Some magical treasures and sword lights still managed to land on Jiang Hengyue. Amidst thunderous BOOMS, Jiang Hengyue discovered in astonishment that his Asura Armor lit up with layer upon layer of shimmering, water-ripple-like patterns. None of the attacks that landed on it had any effect whatsoever, merely causing slight vibrations in his physical body. These vibrations weren’t strong, and he could easily withstand them.
This Asura Armor truly lives up to its God-level status!
Both shocked and overjoyed, Jiang Hengyue’s sword techniques became even fiercer.
He was like a peerless War God, wielding a Divine Sword as he moved through the void, slaughtering all in his path. Many True God Realm Fourth Level cultivators couldn’t even last a single exchange before being cut down by his sword. Blood sprayed high, like crimson blossoms drifting down through the void. One Skyreach Island Spirit after another fell tragically to Jiang Hengyue’s sword.
"Hengyue, you’re so incredible!" Watching Jiang Hengyue’s supreme display of power as he dominated the battlefield, Lin Yanran’s eyes shone with a fervent light.
A single set of Green Armor has elevated my fiancé’s combat power to such a terrifying degree! Who exactly is the man supporting him? His own strength must be even more terrifying!
The battle in the void was exceptionally fierce, with one Spirit after another plummeting from the sky. Some even fell into the small courtyard, landing at Lin Yanran’s feet. The experts from Skyreach Island were numerous, like an endless swarm of locusts that could not be exterminated. Under Fu Wei’s command, a constant stream of figures flew in from all directions to join the fray.
Gazing at that invincible figure, Lin Yanran began to worry again.
She was well-informed. Naturally, she knew that an armor as powerful as Jiang Hengyue’s would likely consume an enormous amount of Divine Yuan Power. If Skyreach Island resorted to a war of attrition, Jiang Hengyue definitely wouldn’t be able to hold out.
"Father, this kid is holding up surprisingly well," Fu Nanhua’s Primordial Spirit remarked, squinting and smirking coldly as he watched Jiang Hengyue, who was surrounded by hundreds.
"This set of armor is truly extraordinary, son. We *must* get our hands on it!" Fu Wei’s eyes glinted with a cold light, but his gaze shifted to another direction.

chapters.title: Chapter 303: Fu Wei’s conspiracy, Ye Yun breaks the game
chapters.content:
Chapter 303: Chapter 303: Fu Wei’s conspiracy, Ye Yun breaks the game
Today, Island Masters from all the major sea areas, numbering several thousand, had come to Skyreach Island to attend the wedding. These individuals all possessed high cultivation bases; many were at the True God Realm Tenth Layer, and some were even great cultivators at the Half-step Divine Monarch Realm.
If Skyreach Island were to try and seize this Emperor-level Armor, these people would likely form an obstacle.
Fu Wei looked at the surrounding Island Masters and found everyone’s gaze fixed intently on Jiang Hengyue ahead. Some even showed undisguised greed in their eyes.
Such a treasure, so close at hand. Who in this world could remain unmoved?
Fu Wei asked himself, and he knew he could not.
What should I do?
One idea after another rapidly surfaced in his mind.
He watched Jiang Hengyue, clad in the Green Armor, majestic and formidable, slaughtering his way through the opposition. One after another, Skyreach Island experts fell from the sky, their blood dyeing the ground red.
In his urgency, a flash of inspiration suddenly struck Fu Wei.
He turned to face the crowd and shouted, "Fellow Island Masters, I’m afraid Skyreach Island’s strength is insufficient! I implore you all to act and jointly eliminate this scoundrel! As for that Green Armor, it will belong to whoever is destined to obtain it."
As his words fell, the thousands of watching Island Masters from all major sea areas immediately erupted into a frenzy.
"Haha, Skyreach Island is truly righteous!"
"In that case, we won’t hold back!"
"This Green Armor must belong to us from The Ninth Sea Area!"
One by one, the Half-step Divine Monarch Realm Island Masters laughed heartily and charged toward Jiang Hengyue.
However, some with weaker cultivation bases remained motionless. They also realized that without being at the Half-step Divine Monarch Realm, there was no way to participate in this battle.
So, even though Fu Wei had spoken out, only about a hundred people actually took action. But every single one of these hundred people was a great cultivator at the Half-step Divine Monarch Realm, each possessing formidable strength.
Upon seeing this, a faint, cold smile touched Fu Wei’s lips. He immediately sent out a mental transmission.
All Skyreach Island cultivators below the True God Realm Tenth Layer who were besieging Jiang Hengyue withdrew. Ultimately, only seven or eight Half-step Divine Monarch Realm ancestors remained in the fight.
At this moment, over a hundred Half-step Divine Monarch Realm Island Masters also charged in. All sorts of attacks rained down like a torrential storm, bombarding Jiang Hengyue.
"Fu Wei, you’re so despicable!" Jiang Hengyue cursed angrily, desperately channeled his Divine Yuan Power, infusing it into the Asura Armor.
BOOM! BOOM!
The multitude of attacks landed on the Asura Armor, only to be neutralized by the rippling patterns that appeared on its surface. Nevertheless, tremendous vibrations still passed through to Jiang Hengyue’s body.
There are too many people!
Jiang Hengyue cursed inwardly.
Being surrounded and attacked by over a hundred Half-step Divine Monarch Realm experts, he too felt immense pressure. These individuals were comparable to him in speed, Divine Skills, and Swordsmanship. His only advantages were his formidable defensive power and immense strength.
So, despite the ferocity of the attacks, Jiang Hengyue held his ground and remained uninjured.
Relying on the Asura Armor’s incredible defensive power and the immense strength it granted him, he plunged into the crowd and engaged in direct combat. Many Half-step Divine Monarch Realm Island Masters were still sent flying by a single strike of his sword.
However, these Island Masters were no pushovers; they also possessed many Defense Treasures. Even when sent flying, they didn’t sustain significant injuries. Instead, they would stabilize themselves in mid-air and charge back into the fray.
For a time, the battle in the sky was exceptionally fierce.
Ye Yun witnessed this scene and couldn’t help but shake his head slightly.
Can people really be bullied to this extent?
Although Skyreach Island was already being utterly shameless, how could the Island Masters from the other major sea areas also stoop to such levels of shamelessness?
As this thought came to mind, countless star-like runes materialized in Ye Yun’s eyes, flickering with the incessantly shifting Power of Life and Death.
Targeting the Half-step Divine Monarch Realm cultivators not from Skyreach Island, Ye Yun activated his Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye.
An unimaginable Power of Annihilation descended upon them.
The Island Masters who were attacking Jiang Hengyue suddenly froze.
One of them, a middle-aged man, turned his head towards Fu Wei and roared, "You’re something else, Fu Wei! You actually want us to be your free enforcers? Dream on!"
Saying this, the middle-aged man flashed away and withdrew from the battle. He flew to one side, observing from a distance with his arms crossed.
"That’s right! We absolutely cannot be Skyreach Island’s free enforcers!"
At this point, another person departed.
Subsequently, it was as if the hundred or so individuals had come to an agreement, and all of them flew out of the battle zone. They didn’t go far, however, and continued to observe the battle from the periphery.
Seeing these Island Masters suddenly turn on him, as if they had all come to their senses, Fu Wei’s expression became exceedingly grim.
He was left with no choice but to drive the cultivators of Skyreach Island to continue besieging Jiang Hengyue.
"Father, Jiang Hengyue shouldn’t be able to hold on much longer," Fu Nanhua sneered from the side. "With so many people attacking him just now, his mere True God Realm Fourth Level Divine Yuan Power is insufficient to sustain an Emperor-level Armor for that long."
"My son is right. Jiang Hengyue definitely won’t last much longer!" Fu Wei also laughed heartily. Gazing at the Island Masters from the various sea regions in the distance, he announced loudly, "Since you fellow Island Masters are so accommodating, we shall graciously accept this Emperor-level Armor!"
When he said this, Fu Wei particularly emphasized the words "Emperor-level." His aim was to reignite the avarice in their hearts.
Unexpectedly, however, the hundred-plus Half-step Divine Monarch Realm Island Masters remained completely unmoved, each observing the battle with a cold expression.
"Father, could it be they intend to wait until our Skyreach Island obtains the armor before they make their move?" Fu Nanhua asked in a low voice.
"On Skyreach Island? Hmph! Even if a Divine Monarch enters, they’d better behave themselves. Otherwise, I’ll take their life!" Fu Wei declared with a fierce expression, his tone one of absolute certainty.
"Father, it’s widely rumored that our Skyreach Island has a Divine Monarch Realm expert in residence. How come I wasn’t aware of this? Are you referring to that legendary Divine Monarch Realm expert of our Skyreach Island?" Fu Nanhua blinked, asking curiously.
"My son, when you inherit my position one day, you will naturally understand," Fu Wei shook his head, not revealing the truth to his son.
However, in his mind, the image of the Blue Dragon within the great formation deep beneath the sea surfaced. This Blue Dragon was the true ace up the sleeve of their Skyreach Island’s Fu Family. Even if one or two God King Level Cultivators were to come, they would be no match for this Blue Dragon of their Fu Family.
This was a Dragon Clan expert at the Divine Monarch Realm. Its combat prowess was exceptionally terrifying. This single Dragon could withstand the attacks of several Human Race Spirits at the Divine Monarch Realm.
From his vantage point in mid-air, Ye Yun had been observing all activity on Skyreach Island. The conversation between the father and son naturally did not escape his ears.
So, Skyreach Island truly has a God King Level Cultivator presiding over it?
Ye Yun smiled nonchalantly.
In his eyes, a mere Divine Monarch was more fragile than an ant. Ye Yun couldn’t even be bothered to use his Divine Sense to locate this supposed Divine Monarch.
His gaze, however, fell upon the illusory Primordial Spirit of Fu Nanhua.
The Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword was Fu Nanhua’s possession.
The primary purpose of Ye Yun’s journey from the Cangnan Continent to the Divine Land was precisely to find Fu Nanhua and inquire about the origins of the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword.

chapters.title: Chapter 304: The Origin of the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword
chapters.content:
Chapter 304: Chapter 304: The Origin of the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword
As this occurred to him, Ye Yun gently extended his hand, tore open the void, and seized Fu Nanhua’s Primordial Spirit from below. The entire process left no trace. Fu Wei, below, had no idea his son had suddenly vanished.
Fu Nanhua was also somewhat bewildered.
How did space-time shift so suddenly, causing me to ascend?
He suddenly turned and discovered a young man clad in white standing behind him. This young man had deep-set features, was exceptionally handsome, and possessed an extraordinary bearing. He appeared to be at the True God Realm Fourth Level, yet he exuded an indescribable sacred aura, as if he didn’t belong in this world but was a true God Man from a scroll painting.
"Who exactly are you? Why did you suddenly bring me here?" Fu Nanhua glanced down and realized he was levitating at an immense height. Below, his father was still focused on Jiang Hengyue on the battlefield, completely unaware of his disappearance.
This young man in white must be terrifying,
he realized.
To capture me so silently... this is definitely not a feat an ordinary cultivator at the True God Realm Fourth Level could accomplish.
Ye Yun looked at this vile and wicked young man, smiled faintly, then flipped his wrist, revealing a silver sword. "Is this sword yours?"
"It’s mine! But how did you remove it?" Gazing at the silver Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword, Fu Nanhua was inwardly reeling.
I stabbed a Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword into Jiang Hengyue’s Dantian! If that sword is removed, it should instantly shatter his Dantian and kill him! But Jiang Hengyue survived unharmed and even obtained a suit of Green Emperor Level Armor. Someone powerful must be secretly helping him.
He had never imagined that this expert was now standing right before him—a young man in white who appeared to be merely at the True God Realm Fourth Level.
"It’s merely a sword. What’s so difficult about removing it?" Ye Yun smiled faintly.
I won’t rush to read the memories in Fu Nanhua’s Primordial Spirit,
he thought,
in case there are restrictive seals on him.
"How did you obtain this sword?" Ye Yun asked.
Hearing this, Fu Nanhua was momentarily stunned. "You... you want to know the origin of this sword?"
"Correct. If you honestly tell me its origin, I will spare your life." Ye Yun gently twirled the silver sword in his hand and smiled faintly. Though his smile was as warm as a spring breeze, it concealed a hidden killing intent. Ye Yun deliberately let this killing intent show to intimidate Fu Nanhua.
Fu Nanhua lowered his head, pondered for two seconds, then looked up.
This man in white is no simple character,
he thought.
If he wants to kill me now, it would be as easy as flipping his hand. If I don’t tell the truth, my Primordial Spirit will likely be destroyed immediately. This Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword... it doesn’t seem to have any truly unrevealable secrets. Although it’s powerful and rather sinister, it’s not some core secret of Skyreach Island.
"Senior..." Fu Nanhua’s expression turned respectful. He cupped his fists and said with a smile, "I acquired this Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword three years ago at an auction held by the Wishful Auction House on Giant Spirit Island, in the Third Sea Area."
"You acquired it at an auction?" Ye Yun was slightly taken aback, then pressed, "I’ve heard there are many Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Swords throughout the Divine Land?"
"Senior is correct. There are indeed quite a number of Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Swords in the Divine Land, though no one has tallied the exact figure. Their quality varies. The one I acquired at the auction isn’t of particularly high quality; it’s merely Heavenly Quality," Fu Nanhua replied respectfully.
After speaking, Fu Nanhua felt a flicker of curiosity.
Why is this mysterious Senior so interested in a Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword? If one has sufficient wealth, they could try to bid for one at an auction in the Divine Land. With good luck, it’s possible to acquire one. Though there are quite a few Dragon Soul Chasing Swords, not everyone is willing to put them up for auction.
Fu Nanhua considered his own luck to have been exceptionally good to have encountered one.
He himself had a rather sinister nature and a fondness for vicious magical artifacts. When Fu Nanhua first learned that this sword could control a person’s Dantian and continuously drain their vitality, he was immediately intrigued and spent a considerable sum to acquire it. Afterward, his father, Fu Wei, had been furious, believing he had wasted too many Spirit Stones on something unnecessary.
If we at Skyreach Island want to kill someone, why bother with such trouble?
Fu Wei had thought.
Just kill them directly. Why go through the hassle of impaling them with a Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword in their Dantian?
In Fu Wei’s opinion, Fu Nanhua’s purchase of the sword was entirely superfluous.Fu Nanhua, however, cherished the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword as a priceless treasure. Recently, when Jiang Hengyue came to Skyreach Island to confront him, Fu Nanhua had him seized and thrown into a dungeon, where he experimented on Jiang Hengyue’s lower abdomen with the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword. He had been thoroughly pleased with the results. At the time, Fu Nanhua had released Jiang Hengyue in Lin Yanran’s presence. However, he was still preoccupied with the sword and dispatched an expert from the island to hunt down Jiang Hengyue.
"Do you not know which Refining Master forged this Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword?" Ye Yun asked, staring at Fu Nanhua.
"Senior, I truly don’t know. However, I heard the manager of the auction house mention that the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword has a long history; it wasn’t forged within the last ten thousand years," Fu Nanhua replied cautiously after a moment of recollection.
Ye Yun nodded.
Judging by Fu Nanhua’s expression, the young man isn’t lying, and he doesn’t seem to know much more. If I want to learn more about the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword, I’ll probably have to visit the Wishful Auction House in the Third Sea Area.
"Oh, right!" Fu Nanhua’s eyes suddenly lit up. "I wouldn’t have guessed Senior also collects Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Swords. I just received news that the Wishful Auction House in the Third Sea Area has recently acquired another Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword. They’re preparing to auction it, I believe the day after tomorrow."
Another one?
Ye Yun smiled, his gaze falling on the silver sword in his hand.
The Seven-star formation on this one has already been destroyed by me; it’s useless now. If I can find a complete and undamaged Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword to study, I might uncover new clues. Perhaps that Wishful Auction House knows more about them.
Ye Yun gazed into the distance and let out a soft breath.
Once this business with Skyreach Island is concluded, I’ll make a trip to Giant Spirit Island in the Third Sea Area.
"Senior, I’ve told you everything I know. Do you have any other questions?" Fu Nanhua asked with utmost respect.
Ye Yun gave Fu Nanhua a profound look and, in that instant, read his memories. "Nothing more. You may go." With a wave of his hand and a final glance at Fu Nanhua, Ye Yun dismissed him. Fu Nanhua vanished from before his eyes.
By reading his memories, Ye Yun confirmed that Fu Nanhua had indeed told the truth; although the young man was cunning, he hadn’t lied. Finally, Ye Yun spared Fu Nanhua a glance and completely erased the memory of their encounter from Fu Nanhua’s mind.
A ripple went through the void. In the next instant, Fu Nanhua reappeared beside Fu Wei. Fu Wei, however, remained engrossed in the battle, completely oblivious to his son’s earlier disappearance and sudden return.

chapters.title: Chapter 305: Shura Sword, Emperor Level Quality
chapters.content:
Chapter 305: Chapter 305: Shura Sword, Emperor Level Quality
"What just happened?"
A dazed look flickered in Fu Nanhua’s eyes. He scratched his head, still not understanding what had occurred.
He turned his gaze back to the distant battlefield.
There, Jiang Hengyue, clad in Green Armor, fought like a Demon God, drenched in blood and wreaking havoc.
One corpse after another plummeted from the sky.
"Father, this isn’t working! That brat’s endurance is too good. How can he last this long with an Emperor Level armor?" An anxious look appeared in Fu Nanhua’s eyes.
"Let’s wait a little longer," Fu Wei said, his gaze cold as he licked his lips, his voice hoarse. "Perhaps his Divine Yuan Power will be depleted soon. Then, we can kill him without lifting a finger."
By now, the Tongtian Island Fu Family had already lost over a hundred members, all of them elite combatants.
If they failed to seize this Emperor Level armor this time, Skyreach Island’s losses would be truly immense.
"Who exactly is this fellow? How can he be so formidable? Could it be that the armor truly boosted his combat power so much?"
"That armor is of extraordinary quality; its defensive power alone is incredible. Look, so many attacks land on it, yet it’s completely unscathed."
"What a magnificent treasure!"
"It’s a pity my cultivation base is too low; I don’t stand a chance of competing for it."
"Get real. With your True God Realm Nine Layers cultivation, you’d just be throwing your life away."
"Haha, you’re right."
Many of the Island Masters with lower cultivation bases were discussing animatedly.
Although they were extremely tempted by the armor, they all knew it was not something they could hope to obtain.
The fact that all the Half-step Divine Monarch Realm Island Masters who had engaged earlier had retreated made it clear that Skyreach Island was determined to seize the armor.
SWISH! SWISH!
Beams of sword light tore through the void. Like a Nine Soul Killing God, Jiang Hengyue relentlessly slew one True God Realm Tenth Layer Cultivator from Skyreach Island after another.
Only the ancestors at the Half-step Divine Monarch Realm could barely contend with him.
However, no one could halt Jiang Hengyue’s advance.
Jiang Hengyue continued his slaughter as he charged towards Fu Nanhua.
Despite continuous attempts to block him, his opponents were either sent flying by his sword or slain on the spot.
Jiang Hengyue’s hatred for Fu Nanhua had long since seeped into his very bones.
Once he destroyed Fu Nanhua’s Primordial Spirit, that man would vanish completely from this world.
He would also be ridding the Ninth Sea Area of a menace.
「In the courtyard below.」
Lin Yanran had emerged.
She looked up at the sky,
and in her heart, she silently cheered for Jiang Hengyue.
If not for her low cultivation base, she truly wished she could fight alongside Jiang Hengyue in this battle.
"Father, quickly send someone to capture Lin Yanran!"
Seeing Lin Yanran in her bright red dress in the courtyard, an idea suddenly flashed through Fu Nanhua’s mind, and he hurriedly spoke.
If they capture Lin Yanran, they’ll have Jiang Hengyue’s weakness in their grasp. Then we won’t have to worry about him not surrendering.
Fu Wei slapped his forehead, instantly understanding.
He couldn’t help but regret not having thought of this sooner. If they captured Lin Yanran, Jiang Hengyue wouldn’t dare to use any of his strength, even if he possessed incredible power.
"Go, bring Lin Yanran here," Fu Wei ordered the two guards beside him in a low voice.
"Yes, Island Master."
With a flicker of movement, the two guards vanished, flying towards the courtyard.
Both were cultivators at the True God Realm Third Level. As the distance was not great, they appeared before Lin Yanran almost instantly.
Lin Yanran’s expression changed slightly when she saw people coming to capture her.
The next moment, she suddenly drew a silver treasured sword from her storage ring and, without any warning, slashed down at the two men.
The two guards had never imagined that Lin Yanran, whose cultivation base had supposedly been sealed by the Young Island Master, could actually fight back.
A silver sword light flashed past.
The two guards screamed as their heads were instantly severed from their bodies.
Two Primordial Spirits flew out.
Lin Yanran dashed forward and, with two swift slashes, extinguished both Primordial Spirits.
How is this possible? Wasn’t Lin Yanran’s cultivation base sealed by the Ancestor?
Fu Nanhua was aghast at this scene.
So many bizarre things have happened today. Even Lin Yanran has undergone an unimaginable change. Who on earth is orchestrating all this from behind the scenes? Who broke the restriction seal within her body?
As these thoughts flooded his mind, Fu Nanhua began to panic.
"I’ll go capture her myself!" With a sway of his body, Fu Wei flew towards Lin Yanran.
His cultivation base was also at the Tenth Layer Peak of the True God Monarch realm. However, he had only recently advanced to this stage and, strictly speaking, wasn’t yet a true great Cultivator at the Half-step Divine Monarch Realm.
Even so, dealing with Lin Yanran, who was merely at the True God Realm Fifth Layer, was more than enough.
Jiang Hengyue, still in the midst of battle, had been keeping a close watch on the movements of the Fu father and son.
When he saw Fu Wei suddenly rush towards Lin Yanran, he abruptly turned in mid-air and charged towards Fu Wei to intercept him.
"Stop him!" an ancestor at the Half-step Divine Monarch Realm shouted loudly.
Several thousand beams of sword light shot towards Jiang Hengyue.
They absolutely could not allow Jiang Hengyue to engage Island Master Fu Wei.
Jiang Hengyue completely ignored the beams of sword light behind him and lunged straight for Fu Wei. Raising his sword, he gathered all his strength and slashed down.
This beam of sword light formed a colossal pillar of light in mid-air, tearing through the void.
It thundered down towards Fu Wei.
"So powerful!"
Sensing the astonishing sword light, Fu Wei’s expression changed drastically. Without hesitation, he took out a golden shield, threw it towards the beam of light, and immediately retreated.
The golden shield expanded rapidly in the wind, growing to several hundred yards in size. Radiating a brilliant golden light, it met the silver-white pillar of sword light.
BOOM!
The two collided, creating an earth-shattering sound.
The silver-white pillar of sword light vanished, and the golden shield was forcefully knocked back.
"This guy is too monstrous!"
Fu Wei swiftly reached out and caught the golden shield. He glanced at its surface and, finding no marks, was instantly relieved.
This is an Emperor Level Top Grade Defensive Treasure. If it had been damaged by that sword light, I would have died from heartache!
He can’t even break an Emperor Level Shield; the sword in that little guy’s hand is too rubbish.
「In the air.」
Ye Yun observed the scene below and shook his head.
He rummaged through his repository for a moment and pulled out an azure treasured sword.
Shura Sword. The name isn’t bad, and it pairs well with the Asura Armor. It’s just a pity its quality is only Emperor Level...
Ye Yun smiled, looking at the sword in his hand, then tossed it down.
"Jiang Hengyue, catch the sword!"
Ye Yun’s voice suddenly resounded beside Jiang Hengyue’s ears.
Immediately after, Jiang Hengyue saw the void crack open as a streak of azure light sped towards him.
He hurriedly reached out and caught it.
In his hand was an azure treasured sword.
He lowered his head, carefully sensing it, and was greatly astonished.
This sword! If I’m not mistaken, this should be an Emperor Sword! A Divine Sword of Emperor Level quality!
Thank you, Master!
Jiang Hengyue thought gratefully. He put away his original sword, gripped the Shura Sword in his right hand, and charged towards Fu Wei once more.

chapters.title: Chapter 306: Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 306: Chapter 306: Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon
In Jiang Hengyue’s heart, he absolutely had to kill the father and son of Skyreach Island’s Fu Family. This pair was simply too villainous. If he hadn’t been constantly alert, watching them, Fu Wei would likely have succeeded earlier. If Fu Wei had managed to capture Lin Yanran, Jiang Hengyue probably wouldn’t have been able to go on such a killing spree. Although Jiang Hengyue knew Fu Wei definitely wouldn’t succeed—after all, the Old Master was still observing the battle from mid-air—he didn’t want to bother the Old Master. He wanted to personally kill Fu Wei and Fu Nanhua.
Now, seeing that his sword strike couldn’t break the golden shield, the Old Master had thrown him an Emperor Level precious sword.
With this precious sword in hand, Jiang Hengyue’s blood boiled, and his heart surged with ambition. His body transformed into a ray of light, and he charged towards Fu Wei once again. He paid no attention to the Half-step Divine Monarch Realm ancestors behind him. He was now relying on the formidable defensive power of the Asura Armor to withstand their attacks. This armor covered him from head to toe, leaving no blind spots at the back. On its front, there were only two small eyeholes.
Currently, Fu Wei was right in front of Jiang Hengyue.
What’s going on? How did he suddenly change his sword? That sword just appeared out of nowhere. Could someone else have sent him a sword?
Fu Wei wondered, observing the bizarre scene, a sense of unease rising within him.
Seeing Jiang Hengyue charging furiously towards him and striking out viciously with his sword, Fu Wei quickly threw out the golden shield again. The shield expanded rapidly in the wind, transforming into a massive barrier hundreds of feet in size. Simultaneously, Fu Wei crushed a Jade Talisman in his hand.
「In the depths of the sea beneath Skyreach Island.」
The sleeping Blue Dragon within the large array suddenly sensed something and opened its enormous dragon eyes.
What happened, Little Wei?
a majestic voice echoed in Fu Wei’s mind.
"Senior! This is a disaster! A formidable enemy has invaded Skyreach Island! We need your help!" Fu Wei hurriedly conveyed in his thoughts.
Alright. I’ve been cooped up at the bottom of the sea for too long. It’s a good time to stretch my bones!
The Blue Dragon’s enormous eyes suddenly lit up. As this happened, the light from the surrounding grand array dimmed. Its massive body began to move slowly, floating out from the array’s confines.
Just a Half-step Divine Monarch Realm brat has thrown the Skyreach Island Fu Family into such chaos?
The Blue Dragon mused, looking upwards. Its terrifying Divine Sense swept across the area, instantly comprehending the entire battlefield. With a flick of its massive dragon tail, it immediately swam upwards.
BOOM!
The seawater around Skyreach Island began to churn violently and boil, creating a tremendous roar. The entire Skyreach Island trembled slightly.
"What’s happening?"
"It looks like some colossal creature is about to emerge from the sea!"
The surrounding Island Masters, witnessing this scene, turned pale with shock. Then, a terrifying aura erupted from the depths of the sea.
"That’s the Divine Monarch Realm!"
"Heavens! The legends were true! Skyreach Island really is guarded by a Divine Monarch Realm powerhouse!" many exclaimed. Only then did they realize that a mighty expert of the Divine Monarch Realm was hidden deep beneath Skyreach Island’s waters.
BOOM!
Unaffected by the tumultuous sea, Jiang Hengyue’s sword struck the golden shield. The sharp, Emperor Level Shura Sword in his hand brutally split the golden shield in two.
"My treasured artifact!" Fu Wei cried out in alarm, retreating decisively.
For that green sword to split his Emperor Level Shield, it must be at least Emperor Level itself!
he thought. Fu Wei quickly fell back to Fu Nanhua’s side.
"Father, so Skyreach Island truly does have a Divine Monarch Realm powerhouse?" Fu Nanhua exclaimed, a laugh escaping him as he watched the sea roar and the terrifyingly high waves surge, heralding the imminent emergence of an unparalleled expert.
"Naturally," Fu Wei said solemnly. "With Skyreach Island on the brink of destruction, we can only beseech that venerable senior to help us resolve this crisis."
"Father, what on earth is that in the sea? It doesn’t feel human. Why do I sense a Demonic Aura?" Fu Nanhua asked, his voice laced with surprise and doubt.
"You’ll find out shortly," Fu Wei replied, deliberately keeping him in suspense.
The depth of their Fu Family’s resources was far beyond what the world imagined. This ancient Giant Dragon beneath the sea was a colossal beast at the Divine Monarch Realm, and a member of the Dragon Clan. Compared to an ordinary Divine Monarch Realm Cultivator, it was immeasurably stronger.
Ye Yun, hovering in mid-air, was also somewhat surprised by the sudden developments. He directed his gaze towards the seabed. The next moment, Ye Yun raised an eyebrow, a shocked expression appearing on his face.
Deep within the sea, a Blue Dragon, tens of thousands of feet long, was rapidly ascending. This Blue Dragon’s form and appearance differed slightly from other Giant Dragons. Its body was covered in dark blue scales, a pair of long blue dragon horns pointed skyward, and its massive dragon claws shimmered with a deep blue luster, matching its whiskers. Its eyes, however, were a clear sky blue.
What type of dragon is this?
Ye Yun wondered, staring intently at the Blue Dragon with keen interest. For a moment, he couldn’t identify the Giant Dragon’s true origin.
Ye Yun waved his hand, summoning the Void Divine Dragon.
"Lord Ancestor Dragon!" Upon seeing Ye Yun, the Void Divine Dragon instantly transformed into human form and knelt in mid-air.
"Take a look at the Blue Dragon below. What type of Dragon Clan does it belong to?" Ye Yun asked with a smile.
The Void Divine Dragon stood up and looked down. Its Divine Sense pierced through the seawater, observing the Blue Dragon as it was about to breach the surface.
"Master, that is an Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon! It’s a type of Divine Dragon that inhabits the ocean, never setting foot on land its entire life," the Void Divine Dragon replied.
"I see. Were they common in the Ancient Times? Does it count as a Divine Dragon?" Ye Yun inquired further.
"Azure Sea Heavenly Dragons were numerous in the Ancient Times. They are indeed considered a type of Divine Dragon, though they rank as mid-to-lower tier among them," the Void Divine Dragon explained.
"I understand." Ye Yun nodded with a smile and waved his hand, sending the Void Divine Dragon back into the inner world of the green Bead.
WHOOSH!
A huge torrent of seawater surged into the sky, and an immense blue figure leaped from the water, hovering in mid-air. A potent Divine Monarch Realm pressure, mingled with the distinctive Demonic Aura of the Dragon Clan, rolled downwards like a dark cloud.
"Heavens! It’s a Divine Monarch Realm Giant Dragon!"
Countless individuals were enveloped by the oppressive might, their faces etched with terror as they trembled uncontrollably. Some weaker True God Realm Cultivators even plummeted from the sky.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon unfurled its colossal Dragon Body, which radiated a dazzling, crystalline blue light under the sun. Its pair of cold, blue dragon eyes gazed indifferently at the small, armored human below.
God-level Armor?
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon thought, stunned when it clearly saw that the Green Armor worn by the tiny human was of God-level quality.
---
(End of Chapter Six. Please show your support!)

chapters.title: Chapter 307: Wealth has always moved people’s hearts
chapters.content:
Chapter 307: Chapter 307: Wealth has always moved people’s hearts
Armor-type magical treasures were incredibly rare. God-level armor, in particular, was so scarce it was seldom seen.
The entire Divine Land was pitifully short of God-level armor.
If any existed, they were possessed only by the most exalted individuals, the Mighty ones in God-honored realm.
Yet, this insignificant human, with a cultivation base only at the True God Realm, possessed a God-level armor—how could this not astonish the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon?
At that moment, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s inherent greed was ignited. It craved to immediately possess that God-level armor.
Currently, its cultivation base was at the Divine Monarch Realm First Level.
If it could wear the God-level armor, its cultivation base and combat power would experience an unimaginably terrifying enhancement.
It could completely surpass the form of a True Dragon.
At this thought, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s heart became incomparably fervent, like a volcano on the brink of eruption, and it lost all control.
It even cast all matters related to the Tongtian Island Fu Family to the back of its mind.
Wealth stirs the heart. This has been an immutable truth since ancient times.
Although the Fu Family’s ancestor had shown great kindness to the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, faced with this God-level armor, it too was tempted and could not control its inner greed.
The Dragon Clan had always loved collecting treasures since ancient times. This innate characteristic made it even more desperate to obtain this God-level armor.
Just as the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s gaze changed, everyone below erupted into commotion.
They all stared at the massive Blue Dragon, expressions of terror and complex emotions on their faces.
This was especially true for the Island Masters from other sea regions; their faces turned ashen.
The foundation of Skyreach Island was truly too powerful.
They were actually rearing an Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon of the Divine Monarch Realm!
Moreover, this Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s cultivation base had already reached the Divine Monarch Realm First Level; it was likely that even several Cultivators at the Divine Monarch Realm First Level combined would struggle to deal with it.
Although the most powerful islands in different sea regions all had their own foundations,
it had to be said that Skyreach Island’s foundation was exceptionally formidable, making them extremely wary.
Jiang Hengyue looked up at the incomparably massive Blue Dragon, his heart also filled with unimaginable shock.
A member of the Dragon Clan at the Divine Monarch Realm First Level! The surging might it exuded descended like dozens of great mountains, pressing down on him with immense force.
Although the Asura Armor helped him bear most of the pressure, he still felt his body was extremely heavy, and his breathing became somewhat labored.
Jiang Hengyue knew clearly that defeating this Divine Dragon would be extremely difficult; he was outmatched.
After all, his cultivation base had only advanced to the Half-step Divine Monarch Realm.
The combat strength of the Half-step Divine Monarch Realm was still vastly different from that of a true Divine Monarch Realm Cultivator.
Not to mention... the opponent before him was a Divine Monarch Realm dragon.
It was common knowledge that, whether in physical body or strength, a member of the Dragon Clan was vastly superior to an ordinary Divine Monarch Realm Cultivator.
At this moment, a red silhouette flashed, and Lin Yanran suddenly flew to Jiang Hengyue’s side.
"Hengyue, will you be a match for this Divine Dragon?" Lin Yanran asked, full of worry.
Jiang Hengyue knitted his brows, hesitating for a moment before he spoke, "Perhaps... I’m probably not its match."
"I am willing to fight alongside you. Even if it means death, I want to die with you." Lin Yanran moved closer, grasping Jiang Hengyue’s hand.
Her palm rested against the cold Asura Armor.
Even though a layer of armor separated them, Jiang Hengyue seemed to feel the warmth from Lin Yanran’s small hand.
"Don’t worry, the Master is still here," Jiang Hengyue lightly stroked Lin Yanran’s hand, and then spoke with a smile.
As he said this, a peculiar light flickered in his eyes.
Lin Yanran blinked her eyes and asked, "The Master you mentioned, he must be the man who removed the restrictions in my body, right?"
"Correct. Thankfully, the Master used his Divine Sense to discover your intention to commit suicide and stopped you in time. Otherwise, if we were to meet again today, I fear we would have been separated by death forever," Jiang Hengyue turned his head, looking at Lin Yanran with profound emotion in his eyes.
Without the Master’s timely intervention, Lin Yanran would have perished yesterday.
"If I see the Master, I must thank him properly." Lin Yanran was deeply moved, her heart surging with emotion, and glistening teardrops welled in the corners of her eyes.
"Yes!" Jiang Hengyue nodded heavily.
"Senior, it was that brat in the Green Armor who killed over a hundred of our Skyreach Island people! Please, Your Excellency, take action and kill that arrogant junior!" Fu Wei looked up at the sky and roared loudly.
His demeanor at this moment was extremely high-profile.
After all, Skyreach Island’s trump card had appeared, capable of intimidating the various Island Masters from other sea regions.
Simultaneously, it was a declaration that Skyreach Island was determined to obtain this Emperor Level armor.
Fu Wei, shallow in experience and harboring delusions, still didn’t know that the armor before him... was not Emperor Level, but God-level!
Furthermore, the Dragon Senior he spoke of was, at this very moment, also preparing to claim this God-level armor for itself.
"I know." Hearing Fu Wei’s words, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon was somewhat irritated. When it spoke, its voice boomed like rolling thunder, crashing down.
It made many people’s heads ring.
Even some ordinary Human Race members on Skyreach Island with low cultivation, not yet at the True God Realm, fainted at this moment.
"Insignificant Human Race, prepare to die!"
Greed erupted like a volcano at this instant.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon let out a low, furious roar, then extended its enormous blue claw, swiping downwards.
The enormous blue claw was easily the size of a small hill.
Under the sunlight, it glinted with an astonishing blue luster.
As the blue dragon claw descended, an immense pressure came with it.
Lin Yanran and Jiang Hengyue, standing together, bore the brunt of the attack.
Under that immense pressure, she felt as if her body would explode in the next moment.
Although Jiang Hengyue wore the Asura Armor, at this moment, he too found it extremely difficult to breathe. He couldn’t help but be inwardly shocked.
This Divine Monarch Realm Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon was truly formidable. Its mere pressure was enough to immobilize him.
A white figure flashed and landed before the two of them.
In that instant, all the pressure vanished completely.
"Greetings, Master!" Seeing the Master suddenly appear before him, Jiang Hengyue was both startled and overjoyed, hastily bowing in respect.
This is the Master?
Gazing at that peerless figure in white from behind, Lin Yanran also hurriedly bowed, paying her respects to Ye Yun with utmost reverence.
"Lin Yanran greets the Master! Thank you, Master, for saving my life!" she said excitedly.
"It’s nothing!" Ye Yun stood with his hands clasped behind his back, watching the blue giant claw descending from the sky, completely unperturbed.
Then he chuckled and said, "Jiang Hengyue, the Fu father and son are yours to handle."
Jiang Hengyue was instantly overjoyed.
Wielding the Shura Sword, he immediately transformed into a streak of light, rushing towards Fu Nanhua and his son.
First Fu Nanhua, then Fu Wei. He would kill this pair of wicked father and son today!
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, hovering in mid-air, suddenly saw a white shadow flash and dispel all of its pressure. Its expression couldn’t help but change.
Its giant claw abruptly halted in mid-air.
It carefully scrutinized the white-robed man before it.
What? How is he only at the True God Realm Fourth Level?
Upon sensing Ye Yun’s cultivation base, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon couldn’t help but be astonished.
"Human, who are you? Why are you concealing your cultivation?" the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon questioned grimly.
"A puny Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon like you is not worthy to speak to me in such a manner," Ye Yun laughed heartily.
Meanwhile, Jiang Hengyue had charged before Fu Nanhua. Immediately, two Half-step Divine Monarch Realm Ancestors moved to intercept him.
BANG! BANG!
Jiang Hengyue was incomparably valiant. With two swift sword strikes that sent both Ancestors flying, he then cut towards Fu Nanhua with his sword.
