"Human, you dare!" Seeing this scene from mid-air, twin flames of fury ignited in the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s eyes.
It opened its mouth, and a blue beam of light shot out like lightning, heading straight for Jiang Hengyue.

chapters.title: Chapter 308: Beating up the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 308: Chapter 308: Beating up the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon (Part 1)
"Do you really think you can protect Fu Nanhua, you treacherous bastard? You won’t be able to."
Seeing the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon blocking his way, Ye Yun gave a cold laugh and flicked his finger.
A ray of light shot out, colliding with the blue light beam fired by the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon.
BOOM!
The two disappeared simultaneously after a thunderous explosion.
Thanks to Ye Yun’s interference, an opportunity was created for Jiang Hengyue.
The Sword in Jiang Hengyue’s hand ruthlessly slashed towards Fu Nanhua’s Primordial Spirit body.
Fu Nanhua’s eyes revealed fear.
He found it hard to believe that Jiang Hengyue had reached him in an instant.
And in the distance, a young man in white managed to block the strongest asset of Skyreach Island—the assault of the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon.
Who is this young man in white?
That was the last thought in Fu Nanhua’s mind as he was about to die.
A streak of sword light flashed by. Fu Nanhua’s Primordial Spirit was instantly split in two, quickly fading into smoke and mist.
"Jiang Hengyue, you dare to kill my son! I’m going to kill you!"
Fu Wei, who was in the distance, saw his son’s Primordial Spirit being killed by Jiang Hengyue, and he was engulfed by grief.
He let out a roar of anger and charged towards Jiang Hengyue.
"Avenge our Young Island Master!" The death of Fu Nanhua also provoked the Cultivators of Skyreach Island. In an instant, all the Cultivators from all directions, roaring in anger, charged towards Jiang Hengyue.
"Excellent!"
After killing Fu Nanhua, Jiang Hengyue felt relieved. The depression he had felt for days was swept away.
Looking at the nearly one thousand Cultivators, densely packed, they flew over like an overwhelming swarm of locusts.
Jiang Hengyue was not afraid. His eyes were cold. Holding the Shura Sword, he slaughtered all around him.
This time, the one he wanted to kill was Fu Wei, to thoroughly eliminate this menace.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon in the air slightly squinted its eyes, looking at the small white figure below.
This white figure somehow gave it a sense of terror at this moment.
Time and again, with a light touch, he had destroyed its offensive.
"Come on, let me see just how well you, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, have cultivated under the nurture of the Human Race in all these years," Ye Yun said, looking at the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon and smiling lightly.
He took a step and arrived in mid-air in an instant, facing the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon from afar.
The expression in the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s eyes suddenly froze.
The young man in white has such an air of confidence, as if intending to challenge me. What is his cultivation base?
Looking at the stunned expression on the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s face, Ye Yun smiled slightly, as if he knew what the dragon was thinking.
So his body trembled slightly, immediately emitting the Super Divine Dragon Breath of the God Monarch Realm First Layer.
"As I expected, you are also a Divine Monarch," the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon said, coldly staring at Ye Yun, the glow in its eyes becoming even more intense.
The young man in white in front of me is definitely not a common practitioner at the God Monarch Realm First Layer. His strength is very powerful, far exceeding his peers. But what of it?
I am the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, a member of the Dragon Clan by nature and naturally more powerful than the Human Race at the same level.
"Die!"
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon roared angrily, its huge dragon claw lashing out directly at Ye Yun.
The overwhelmingly powerful force made the void buzz and tremble, shattering piece by piece.
The tremendous force on the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s claw was too much for even the void of the Divine Land to bear.
"This is incredible! The young man in white turns out to be a Cultivator of the Divine Monarch Realm!" an Island Master from other regions said, looking up at the void, his face showing shock.
"How come I’ve never heard of this powerful figure in the Divine Monarch Realm?" another Island Master murmured with a frown.
"Indeed, we’ve never heard of him. He is daring enough to fight a member of the Dragon Clan of the same level alone. I wonder if he’s truly capable or simply overestimating his abilities," said yet another Island Master nearby, a somewhat playful smile on his face, seemingly mocking the young man in white for overrating his abilities.
"’Don’t take on a task without the tools to complete it’! I, however, believe this young man in white is unfathomable. The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon definitely cannot beat him," a white-haired Island Master sneered.
For a moment, the Island Masters from different sea regions below were buzzing with various opinions, each voicing their own views.
Nearby, Lin Yanran watched Jiang Hengyue engaged in intense battle with Fu Wei and others, while also glancing across the sky to watch her Master’s duel with the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon.
Her heart was in turmoil, and she felt deeply shaken.
In midair, the colossal body of the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon had an overwhelmingly powerful visual impact.
Against it, her Master’s body in white seemed minuscule.
She was unsure if her Master in white could defeat this Divine Dragon.
What a great opportunity!
As the epic battle between a human and a dragon—both formidable figures of the Divine Monarch Realm—was about to commence, a middle-aged man at the Eight-tier of True God suddenly flew fiercely towards Lin Yanran.
He flicked his wrist, and a gold-and-silver rope flew out, attempting to ensnare Lin Yanran.
He was attempting to secretly kidnap Lin Yanran at this moment and then extort Jiang Hengyue for the Green Armor.
The golden rope in his hand had barely traveled about three yards when it suddenly halted mid-flight.
The very next moment, the middle-aged man screamed and plummeted from the sky.
He struggled for a bit after crashing to the ground but then stopped moving altogether. He didn’t even have the chance for his Primordial Spirit to escape.
The others stared at the scene wide-eyed, their hearts filled with shock.
The Primordial Spirit didn’t escape... Did that not imply that the middle-aged man’s Primordial Spirit was annihilated the moment he fell?
Everyone gazed at their surroundings, filled with a sense of dread.
They were unsure of who had dealt the fatal blow, silently eradicating the middle-aged man.
The middle-aged man’s fate deterred others from launching any sudden attacks on Lin Yanran.
Everyone feared meeting the same end as him, dying without even knowing who their attacker was or where they were hidden.
「In the void.」
Ye Yun met the towering, approaching blue giant claw with a faint smile on his face.
This Little Dragon has been raised by the Human Race for so many years and has been greatly influenced by them—it has become arrogant and selfish.
Today, I’m going to deflate the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s arrogance. Then I’ll take the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon away. The Dragon Clan is too scarce nowadays. Having finally found another one in the Divine Land, I can’t afford to let it wander freely.
As the blue giant claw was about to land on him, a faint light barrier suddenly sprung up in front of Ye Yun.
This thin, seemingly brittle barrier enveloped him.
The blue giant claw crashed onto the light barrier.
BOOM!
With an ensuing loud rumble, the blue giant claw was actually sent flying back!
"What kind of Defense Treasure is this?"
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon retracted its claw, staring at Ye Yun with incredulous eyes.
Now, I finally understand why this human before me had the confidence to battle me. With such a Defensive Treasure, it would be extremely difficult for me to break through.
"Human, is defending all you know? Try attacking if you dare! HA HA..."
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s eyes shifted as it suddenly let out a loud, derisive laugh.
After the mocking laughter, it suddenly threw its head back and laughed uproariously, the sound reverberating through the heavens and earth.
The clouds around them dispersed, and the distant sea roared, creating wave after wave.
"Try taking my punch."
Seeing this Little Dragon’s arrogant attitude, somewhat resembling the Fu Family’s style, Ye Yun laughed instead of getting angry. The light barrier in front of him disappeared.
He stepped forward and swung his fist at the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon.
His speed was so incredibly fast that by the time the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon reacted, the punch had already landed on its head.
BOOM!
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon felt the world spin as its colossal body instantly lost control and plummeted from the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 309: Beating up the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 309: Chapter 309: Beating up the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon (Part 2)
"My goodness, what did I just witness? A Cultivator of the Human Race actually knocked the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon from mid-air with a single punch?" a middle-aged man on Skyreach Island shouted aloud.
The fight just now had been too shocking. The white-robed young man from the Human Race had reached the top of the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s head in a single step and smashed it down with one punch. His speed was simply too fast, leaving the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon no time to react.
The Island Masters of other islands also looked on in astonishment. Seeing the colossal creature falling from mid-air, everyone’s expression changed drastically, fearing it would crash onto the island.
Fortunately, the force of the white-robed young man’s punch was slightly off, causing the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s massive body to plummet from mid-air towards the sea’s surface.
BOOM!
The enormous body of the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon crashed into the sea, unleashing colossal waves that surged violently towards Skyreach Island.
"Oh no, act quickly!"
The Island Masters from various major sea regions, their faces paling in fright, unleashed various Divine Skills to block the ferocious tsunami.
The tsunami towered hundreds of zhang high, its power astonishing. However, through the combined efforts of the numerous Island Masters, they managed to forcefully block it. They had no choice but to act. If they failed to stop the tsunami, its force would inflict immense damage upon them.
「In another direction」
Fu Wei and his clansmen were besieging Jiang Hengyue, but the latter broke through their encirclement repeatedly, leaving them in a sorry state.
Fu Wei, while battling, also kept a sliver of his attention on the fight in the sky. He had never imagined that the Dragon Senior he revered so greatly would be no match for the white-robed young man. With a single punch, he was sent plummeting from mid-air.
How could this be? How could that fellow be so powerful?
At this moment, an intense chill gripped Fu Wei’s heart; he knew that Skyreach Island was doomed this time.
The other Half-step Divine Monarch Realm ancestors from the Fu Family were also observing the battle outside. When they saw Skyreach Island’s greatest pillar of support struck down from mid-air, their spirits faltered.
Jiang Hengyue seized this opportunity.
A sword light flashed, clean and decisive, sending those ancestors flying. Then, he turned his sword towards Fu Wei.
A streak of sword light flashed, piercing towards Fu Wei’s body.
In his haste, Fu Wei pulled out several defensive artifacts, hurling them at the sword light. But he hadn’t expected that these artifacts couldn’t block the sword light at all; they shattered instantly.
Watching the sword light reach his eyes in an instant, Fu Wei closed his eyes in horror. He knew he couldn’t dodge it this time.
PUFF!
The sword light swept across Fu Wei’s body, cleaving him in two. A Primordial Spirit attempted to flee but was intercepted by the sword light and obliterated on the spot.
After killing Fu Wei, Jiang Hengyue’s spirits lifted considerably, and he couldn’t help but let out a triumphant roar to the heavens.
Seeing Fu Wei dead, the ancestors of Skyreach Island knew the situation was lost and began to flee in all directions. Jiang Hengyue transformed into a streak of green light and pursued them relentlessly.
「Deep underwater」
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon suddenly regained consciousness. It shook its massive dragon head, a furious expression appearing as it surveyed the surrounding seawater.
Just now, it had been ignominiously knocked from mid-air into the sea by that white-robed young man. This was utterly humiliating.
It violently flicked its dragon tail and shot up from the seabed.
WHOOSH!
The seawater roiled as the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon burst from the surface.
"Human, today, you will die without a doubt!" the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon stared coldly at Ye Yun in mid-air, its massive dragon tail swaying continuously as it let out furious roars.
"You Little Dragon, you must have been orphaned young, with no one to teach you discipline. You have no manners at all," Ye Yun remarked with a slight smile, gazing at the enraged Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon.
SWISH... SWISH...
As its dragon tail swayed incessantly, the surrounding seawater began to churn violently. Waves surged from the sea surface, forming colossal Blue Dragons, each as massive as the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon itself.
"Rise!" the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon roared furiously.
In an instant, tens of thousands of Blue Dragons rose from the sea surface. These Blue Dragons, resembling True Dragons, bared their fangs and brandished their claws. Roaring, they flew towards Ye Yun, who stood in mid-air.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon was most adept at Water Series Divine Skills. Now on the sea surface, it was on its home turf. Unleashing its Water Series Divine Skills, it conjured tens of thousands of water dragons. These water dragons all possessed the attack power of the Divine Monarch Realm.
Watching the tens of thousands of water dragons sweeping towards him, Ye Yun smiled placidly.
This Little Dragon’s abilities are truly too weak. They appear to be mere Innate Divine Skills, never systematically learned.
Tiny, starlike runes, representing the ever-changing Power of Life and Death in its infinite variations, once again surfaced in Ye Yun’s eyes.
Instantly, the tens of thousands of Blue Dragons that had surged into mid-air were frozen in place.
SPLASH!
All the seawater, suddenly losing its support, cascaded down from mid-air and returned to the ocean.
This seemingly ferocious and menacing attack, comprised of tens of thousands of water dragons, was thus effortlessly neutralized.
Gazing at the empty void before it, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon was too shocked to speak. Such a potent Water Series Divine Skill had been effortlessly neutralized right before its eyes. What it found most unacceptable was that it couldn’t even discern what Divine Skill the opponent had used to counter its attack. It seemed as if nothing had been done. Its powerful attack had simply vanished completely, as if it had never been.
The Island Masters on Skyreach Island, witnessing this scene, could only swallow hard, petrified like stone statues, rendered speechless.
This white-robed senior was truly too powerful. Monstrously powerful, unbelievably powerful.
What kind of Divine Skill was that? It had so easily neutralized the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s Water Series Divine Skill.
It appeared that even several more Azure Sea Heavenly Dragons would be no match for this white-robed senior.
"It seems Skyreach Island is destined to be destroyed this time!" an old man sighed.
Everyone silently nodded, a unanimous understanding forming among them at that moment. Having provoked such a figure, if Skyreach Island didn’t perish now, when would it?
Ye Yun stood in mid-air, looking at the stunned Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon with a faint smile. Then, he reached out and grasped at the void. Instantly, an immense power descended.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s entire body was uncontrollably snatched from the sea surface and pulled before him. In an instant, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon was before Ye Yun.
Ye Yun looked at the massive creature, stared into its dragon eyes, and calmly asked, "Do you submit?"
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon snorted coldly, remaining silent, its mouth firmly shut.
Ye Yun’s eyes flickered slightly; in that instant, he read the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s memories.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s eyes glazed over for a moment.
"What did you do to me?" After all, it had already cultivated to the Divine Monarch Realm. The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, possessing some worldly experience, sensed something was amiss and hurriedly demanded.

chapters.title: Chapter 310: Little Dragon Meets Lord Ancestor Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 310: Chapter 310: Little Dragon Meets Lord Ancestor Dragon
"I haven’t done anything; I’m just a bit curious about you."
Looking at the frustrated Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, Ye Yun smiled calmly.
At this moment, Ye Yun had a loose grip with one hand. The massive Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon seemed like a small bug clutched in his grasp, unable to move.
"What’s so curious about me? Are you trying to take me as a demonic pet?"
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon grunted.
In its heart, it had already admitted defeat.
The young man in white before it was terrifyingly strong. It was no match for him at all.
"I’m not interested in taking you as a pet, but I will adopt you," Ye Yun said with a smile.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon before him was hatched from a Dragon Egg by Fu Changhe, an ancestor of the Tongtian Island Fu Family.
After it hatched, it was carefully raised with various heavenly materials and earthly treasures.
It took the efforts of several generations of the Fu Family to cultivate a Dragon Clan member to the Divine Monarch Realm.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon grew up with Fu Changhe and was thus greatly influenced by him.
However, Fu Changhe perished directly when he failed to break through to the Divine Monarch Realm.
Later, this Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon was supported by the Fu Family’s successive ancestors, cultivating up to the Divine Monarch Realm First Level only now.
"Adopt me? Such bold words!"
An uncomfortable feeling rose in the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s heart, and it snorted coldly.
This human’s words felt very unreliable.
Wasn’t this guy trying to kill it? After all, a Divine Monarch Realm dragon is full of treasures; if sold, it could fetch an Emperor artifact.
"Don’t question my words. You, this little Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, have no right to," Ye Yun said indifferently.
"No right? Who do you think you are? I am a proud member of the Dragon Clan! Even before you humans, I possess immense pride! Even if I die, I will not let you adopt me!"
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon grew stubborn, bracing itself, ready to give up the will to survive.
At this moment, its noble Dragon Clan bloodline influenced its character.
Seeing the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s display, Ye Yun wasn’t bothered.
After all, at this moment, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon still thought he was a member of the Human Race.
At times like these, the divide between different races was indeed significant.
Ye Yun’s body trembled slightly, releasing a wisp of the Ancestor Dragon’s Super Divine Dragon Breath.
As soon as this wisp of the Ancestor Dragon’s Super Divine Dragon Breath appeared, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon on the opposite side immediately sensed it. It stared, its whole body trembling.
"How is this possible? What Divine Skill is this? Why does it make me tremble from the depths of my soul?"
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s expression was panicked as it muttered to itself.
Ye Yun smiled and said nothing.
When he was reading the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s memory, he had already set up a barrier.
Ye Yun didn’t want his conversation with the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon to be known to anyone.
This was a conversation between members of the Dragon Clan.
Looking at the panicked Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, Ye Yun’s eyes flickered twice; he seemed to understand what was happening.
This Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon was hatched from a Dragon Egg by Fu Changhe. It didn’t know much about the Dragon Clan itself. The panic and tremor it currently felt undoubtedly came from the suppression of its bloodline. This suppression would also gradually awaken the memories within its bloodline.
Ye Yun waited quietly.
Less than the time it takes for half an incense stick to burn, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon suddenly trembled.
It looked at the white-clothed human before it in horror and said fearfully, "You... how do you possess the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline?"
"That’s not a question you should ask. What you need to do now is obey," Ye Yun said coldly, once more releasing a surge of the Ancestor Dragon’s Super Divine Dragon Breath.
This surge of the Ancestor Dragon’s Super Divine Dragon Breath landed on the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, instantly causing its body to weaken.
"Greetings, Lord Ancestor Dragon."
Having awakened its bloodline and been suppressed by the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon finally seemed to awaken as if from a dream.
It spoke respectfully.
Ye Yun released his hand.
At this moment, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon transformed into a blue-clothed youth and knelt at Ye Yun’s feet.
"Little Dragon was unaware of Lord Ancestor Dragon’s arrival. Please forgive any previous offenses!"
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon said, clearly uneasy.
"Ignorance is no crime. I don’t blame you. Rise," Ye Yun said with a smile. A stream of Mana swept out, helping the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon to its feet.
「On Skyreach Island.」
The Island Masters observing the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon were utterly aghast at this unbelievable turn of events.
So easily... that Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon was subdued by the white-clothed youth just like that? It seems Skyreach Island’s power is truly gone. The island is about to change owners.
"I..." The blue-clothed youth, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s transformation, stood awkwardly before Ye Yun, fidgeting, unsure what to do.
Ye Yun looked at him and smiled slightly. "From now on, just call me Master."
"Yes, Lord Ancestor Dragon!" The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon replied nervously.
After speaking, he suddenly realized his mistake, slapped his forehead, and quickly corrected himself, "Yes, Master."
Ye Yun nodded.
Having acquired another dragon after entering the Divine Land, Ye Yun’s mood brightened considerably.
The Dragon Clan was on the brink of extinction. Now that he had the ability, he would do his utmost to save the endangered Dragon Clan.
Ye Yun gazed into the void below, where a green light was relentlessly chasing the elders of the Tongtian Island Fu Family.
These elders, fleeing like dogs that had lost their homes, were hunted down by Jiang Hengyue. After several brutal battles, all of them were slain.
"You were incubated from an egg by Fu Changhe. Where did you come from before that?" Ye Yun inquired.
There was no information about its origins in the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s memories.
Ye Yun was eager to know.
After all, this Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon was less than ten thousand years old; it couldn’t possibly be a Dragon Egg that had survived from the Ancient Times.
"Master, I’m not sure either," the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon scratched his head, looking somewhat embarrassed.
Ye Yun’s gaze flickered.
"Master, perhaps the Fu Family knows. However, the only one who might have known, Fu Wei, is already dead," the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon said after some thought.
"Fu Wei knew?" Ye Yun smiled faintly, his large hand immediately reaching down below.
Fu Wei’s physical body had just been cleaved in two by Jiang Hengyue; his corpse still lay on the ground.
Ye Yun grabbed the two halves of the corpse, took out an Eight Treasures Liuli Bottle, and dripped a drop of Three Lights Divine Water onto them.
He intended to resurrect Fu Wei, read his memories, and find out where that Dragon Egg came from.
What is Master doing?
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon watched Ye Yun’s actions, completely astounded, unable to comprehend what was happening.
Then, a shocking scene unfolded.
The two halves of the sundered corpse began to mend together at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Soon, fragments of Primordial Spirit light converged from all directions, returning to Fu Wei’s body.
After a few breaths, Fu Wei, whose eyes had been tightly shut, suddenly opened them and cried out, "Where am I? Am I dead?"
"You are not dead." Ye Yun smiled at Fu Wei, activated his Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye, and began to read Fu Wei’s memories.
HISS!
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon drew a sharp breath, utterly shocked by his Master’s incredible abilities.
A spiritual cultivator at the True God Realm Tenth Layer Peak, whose physical body and Primordial Spirit had been destroyed, could actually be resurrected. This was truly inconceivable.
After Ye Yun finished reading Fu Wei’s memories, he waved his hand. Fu Wei’s body instantly disintegrated into particles, vanishing completely from the world.

chapters.title: Chapter 311: The Origin of the Dragon Egg, the Dragon Breeding Clan
chapters.content:
Chapter 311: Chapter 311: The Origin of the Dragon Egg, the Dragon Breeding Clan
"Master, have you found out?" the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon asked nervously from the side.
Ye Yun nodded.
In Fu Wei’s memory, there was indeed information about the origin of this Dragon Egg.
In the Divine Land, there was an extremely mysterious tribe called the Dragon Breeding Clan.
This Dragon Breeding Clan, it was said, had been raising various Dragon Clans since the Ancient Era and would periodically bring out different Dragon Eggs for auction.
However, this Dragon Egg from the Fu Family was not obtained through an auction.
Thousands of years ago, Fu Changhe had met a member of the Dragon Breeding Clan and exchanged it for a Dragon Egg at an unimaginably great cost.
This was the origin of the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s egg.
Who would have thought that in the Divine Land, there’s a Dragon Breeding Clan? Is this considered protecting the continuation of the Dragon Clan?
Ye Yun stared into the void, muttering to himself.
According to Fu Wei’s memory, the Dragon Breeding Clan of the Divine Land was the most mysterious force there.
They were divided into four tribes, residing in different parts of the Divine Land.
If they did not reveal themselves, no one would know where they truly resided.
The Dragon Breeding Clan’s power was incomparably strong; they could dominate entire regions by themselves.
Even God King Level forces in the Divine Land did not dare to plot against the Dragon Breeding Clan.
"Master, what are you saying?" the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon asked a bit awkwardly, rubbing his hands.
Ye Yun smiled and simply told the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon about the Dragon Breeding Clan.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon had an epiphany. So, his heritage came from the Dragon Breeding Clan.
"Little Dragon, you must remember that your true roots are in the Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon. That is the true source of all Dragon Clans," Ye Yun said seriously, looking at the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon.
He deliberately emphasized the Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon.
In the minds of the people in the Divine Land, the Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon was the true name of the Dragon Hidden Continent. However, Ye Yun preferred to call it the Cangnan Continent.
"I understand, Master," the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon nodded, only half understanding.
Ye Yun sighed. Nearly ten million years had passed from the Ancient Times until now.
The new generation of life in the Divine Land no longer remembered that the Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon was originally where the Dragon Clan had originated.
But this was something that couldn’t be helped.
Ye Yun planned to take some time in the future to tell the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon about the ancient times of the Dragon Hidden Continent.
Or, after they returned, he would let the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon inform him.
Watching Jiang Hengyue still chasing the few remaining Half-step Divine Monarch Realm ancestors of Skyreach Island, Ye Yun waved his hand lightly.
In an instant, all members of the Fu Family vanished into smoke.
Ye Yun planned to turn Skyreach Island into the first base of the Dragon God Sect. Naturally, he could not leave anyone from the Fu Family remaining.
When cutting grass, one must remove the roots; he was never lenient when it came to killing.
This was the case a hundred thousand years ago, and all the more so after a hundred thousand years.
Ye Yun reached out his hand again and forcefully pulled Jiang Hengyue, who was still in pursuit, close to him.
"Master!" Jiang Hengyue was startled by the sudden shift in space and time.
When he saw Ye Yun standing before him, he quickly bowed in respect.
"I have killed everyone from the Fu Family. From now on, you will take over the administration of Skyreach Island. Since there are many people around, go ahead and hold your grand wedding with Lin Yanran," Ye Yun said calmly, though a hint of joy was evident on his face.
Now that everyone from the Fu Family had been executed, he was happy to see Jiang Hengyue and Lin Yanran tie the knot.
"Thank you for your grace, Master!" Jiang Hengyue was overjoyed and knelt before Ye Yun once again.
Ye Yun smiled, waved his hand, and sent Jiang Hengyue off to prepare for the wedding.
"Let’s go. The Fu Family on Skyreach Island has been eradicated. This place will soon change hands, and we didn’t even get to attend the wedding ceremony," a middle-aged man on Skyreach Island sighed, preparing to leave.
"Yeah, we didn’t get to attend the wedding this time, and we almost lost our lives," another old man said.
Everyone nodded in agreement, deep in thought. They had originally come to Skyreach Island for a wedding but hadn’t expected such a dramatic turn of events. Everyone’s mood was ruined.
Ye Yun, suspended in the air, naturally heard the chatter from below.
He just gave a faint smile and invoked the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye again.
In an instant, all relevant people on Skyreach Island entered an illusion.
In this illusion, their memories were also tampered with.
No one remembered Ye Yun ever having been there.
No one had seen him fighting the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon in mid-air.
In their altered memories, it was Jiang Hengyue who had displayed his might and killed the entire Fu Family.
As for the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon that had emerged from the sea, that part of their memory was also erased.
Finally, Ye Yun implanted another memory, compelling all the Island Masters to stay and prepare to attend Jiang Hengyue’s wedding.
The wedding took place the next day.
The parents of both the bride and groom came to Skyreach Island. Under the witness of the Island Masters from the various sea areas, they held a grand and glorious wedding.
Ye Yun did not appear at the wedding. Instead, after giving Jiang Hengyue his instructions, he took the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon and left Skyreach Island the day before the wedding.
He was now on his way to Giant Spirit Island in The Third Sea Area.
Ye Yun was going to the Wishful Auction House to bid for the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword.
At the same time, he wanted to learn about the true origins of this sword.
The distance from The Ninth Sea Area to The Third Sea Area was quite far.
But within each sea area, there were special teleportation points.
These teleportation points were built by the Ruyi Business Alliance. Anyone wishing to use a Teleportation Array had to pay a certain amount of Spirit Stones.
The Ruyi Business Alliance was the largest commercial organization in the Ten Great Ocean Areas.
The Wishful Auction House on Giant Spirit Island was one of their branches.
After leaving Skyreach Island, Ye Yun and the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon flew for only the time it takes an incense stick to burn before reaching the teleportation site.
This was also a small island.
Some guards from the Ruyi Business Alliance were stationed there.
"Master, we’ve arrived at the teleportation point," the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon said with a smile, looking at the green island below.
Ye Yun nodded.
The two descended from the sky and landed next to the Teleportation Array.
"How many Spirit Stones do we need to get to The Third Sea Area?" the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon asked.
"Senior, it’s five hundred thousand Spirit Stones per person, for a total of one million," an elder at the True God Realm Fifth Layer said respectfully, upon sensing that the other party was a powerful Divine Monarch Realm cultivator.
"That’s a bit expensive!" The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon exclaimed, a pained expression on his face.
Ye Yun was also taken aback. He hadn’t been in a hurry, so he had considered using the Teleportation Array. Seeing now that it would cost one million Spirit Stones for two people, the price was indeed astonishing.
"Forget it. We’ll go directly," Ye Yun said, waving his hand. He glanced around, and all the guards suddenly felt a wave of dizziness.
By the time these guards recovered their senses, the two had disappeared.
These guards had no idea what had just happened.
Ye Yun tore open the void and traveled with the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon.
Although the space in the Divine Land was very resilient, it still couldn’t stop Ye Yun.
The stability of the space here was even weaker than the space within the barrier on the Ancient Road to Heaven in the Cangnan Continent.
Ye Yun could tear space there, so this place was even easier for him.
SRRRT...
Seeing the resilient space being torn like paper so easily by his Master.
Each tear in the void spanned tens of millions of miles.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 312: Giant Spirit Island
chapters.content:
Chapter 312: Chapter 312: Giant Spirit Island
"We’re both at the First Layer of the Divine Monarch Realm, so how is Master so powerful?
Could it be because of the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline?
"
"Master, is your cultivation base really just at the First Layer of the Divine Monarch Realm?"
After pondering this for a while, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon couldn’t help but ask.
"Divine Monarch Realm, Seventh Layer."
Ye Yun smiled, not attempting to conceal it.
In a way, the differences in cultivation layers meant little to him. Ye Yun possessed numerous treasures in his repository capable of instantly negating such disparities.
"Oh..." The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon nodded slightly.
He rolled his eyes, carefully considering the matter. Ultimately, he concluded that Master’s strength wasn’t just due to being at the Seventh Layer of the Divine Monarch Realm. Based on his estimations, even a powerful cultivator at the Seventh Layer of the Divine Monarch Realm would likely find it impossible to tear through the Divine Land’s space as casually and effortlessly as Master had.
Throughout their journey, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon dared not speak, merely following quietly behind Ye Yun.
In just under an hour, Ye Yun had traversed tens of billions of miles by tearing through space, finally arriving at the Third Sea Area.
At this moment, in the space outside Giant Spirit Island, a slight ripple appeared, and two figures emerged from within.
Gazing at the enormous island before him, Ye Yun nodded to himself. Giant Spirit Island was even larger than Skyreach Island. It was reputed to be the largest island in the Third Sea Area.
Among the Ten Great Sea Areas, the higher a sea area was ranked, the larger its territory and the greater its overall strength.
With a casual sweep of his gaze, Ye Yun quickly located the Wishful Auction House on Giant Spirit Island. This auction house was the largest on the island and extremely prominent.
The two descended from mid-air, landing directly before the auction house entrance.
"The auction isn’t until the day after tomorrow; we might be a bit early," Ye Yun remarked with a smile.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon chuckled, his smile a little sinister, "Master, with your strength, who cares if there’s an auction or not? You could just take what you want."
"How could we do that? One must adhere to principles. If we rely on strength to act unscrupulously and disregard all rules, wouldn’t the world descend into chaos?" Ye Yun said, exasperated, lightly smacking the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon on the head.
"I was just kidding, Master. It’s mainly because we’re so early; I was afraid you’d get impatient waiting," the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon said, scratching his head sheepishly and smiling.
Ye Yun paused for a moment, then smiled. "Let’s go. We’ll head into the auction house first to understand the situation. If there’s an opportunity to purchase it beforehand, we’ll do so directly."
With that, he stepped inside.
From Fu Nanhua’s memories, Ye Yun knew that the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword being auctioned by the Wishful Auction House this time was of Top-Tier Heaven Level quality. It was far superior to the previous sword. It was considered of the highest grade among Heaven Level items.
As the two entered, many people inside looked up, their expressions shocked. Their gazes converged on the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon.
Ye Yun was momentarily taken aback but understood instantly. He had always concealed his aura exceptionally well, so no one could discern his cultivation base. The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, however, was different. The cultivation level he currently displayed was unmistakably at the First Layer of the Divine Monarch Realm.
Such a cultivation base, regardless of the sea area, represented the absolute apex of power—a terrifying existence. Moreover, the faint Demonic Aura emanating from him further enhanced his fearsome presence.
An elderly man, his face etched with alarm, rushed over. Reaching them, the elder bowed deeply and said respectfully, "So, it is two distinguished guests gracing our Wishful Auction House! This old one was slow to greet you, please forgive me."
Ye Yun glanced at the elder casually. "Are you the person in charge of the auction house?"
The elder replied with a beaming smile, "You could say that. This old one is the Second Manager of the Wishful Auction House."
Ye Yun nodded and continued walking forward, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon following closely behind him.
Seeing this, the elder’s expression shifted.
So, this white-robed young man is the actual master here! And that Demon Clan youth at the First Layer of the Divine Monarch Realm, following his every step, appears to be merely a subordinate. Just who is this white-robed young man? He looks so unfamiliar; he doesn’t seem to be from any of the Ten Great Sea Areas.
A flurry of thoughts crossed the elder’s mind as he hastily followed.
He led Ye Yun to a quiet, private room.
After they were seated, Ye Yun got straight to the point, smiling. "We are here for the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword."
A look of realization appeared on the Second Manager’s face. He chuckled, "So, Young Master is here for the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword. However, the auction is still more than a day away; it officially begins the day after tomorrow."
"I understand." Ye Yun nodded, looked at the elder, and asked, "Regarding the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword, do you know its origin?"
"Young Master, as for the origin of the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword, we are not too clear ourselves," the elder said with a smile.
"Strange. It’s said there’s more than one Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword in the Divine Land. Why does no one know its origin?" Ye Yun asked, his eyes glinting.
"Young Master speaks truly. The Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword, while of little practical value, is shrouded in mystery. For some reason, those who consign this sword for auction are never willing to reveal its origin. They simply hand it over to the auction house, collect their payment after the sale, and depart," the old man said, a peculiar smile on his face.
In his view, the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword was only collected by those with peculiar tastes. Ordinary cultivators wouldn’t spend a fortune auctioning for a Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword. After all, this sword is only effective when embedded in one’s Dantian. During combat, it wasn’t very useful.
But undeniably, some wealthy individuals enjoyed collecting such peculiar items, treating the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword as a collectible. For instance, a few years ago, the Young Island Master of Skyreach Island in the Ninth Sea Area spent a considerable sum to acquire a Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword.
Failing to obtain any useful information from this Second Manager, a hint of disappointment showed on Ye Yun’s face. Ye Yun wanted to investigate the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword to see if it had any connection to the mastermind he was pursuing. But for now, it seemed the trail had gone cold here.
"Can I meet the person auctioning the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword?" Ye Yun suddenly asked.
"This..." The elder hesitated.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon glared. "My Master merely wishes to meet the seller, not to rob them of their item! What are you hesitating for? Hurry up and arrange it!"
The powerful aura of the Divine Monarch Realm emanating from him with that glare almost made the old man collapse to the ground in fright.
"Of course, of course," the elder, having composed himself, quickly replied. "Young Master, the one consigning the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword this time is the same person as last time. Perhaps he has the information you seek. I will go invite him over immediately."
Ye Yun nodded.
The elder hastily scurried out.
"Master, these people won’t understand your true capabilities unless you show them a thing or two," the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon said with a cold smirk, arms crossed.

chapters.title: Chapter 313 Seven-Star Mound
chapters.content:
Chapter 313: Chapter 313 Seven-Star Mound
"You make some valid points."
Ye Yun smiled, seemingly affirming the words of the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon.
As the proverb goes,
Set a thief to catch a thief.
Sometimes, appearing to be fierce isn’t necessarily a bad thing.
Not long after, within the time it would take for an incense stick to burn, an old man hurried in with a young man.
Ye Yun took a glance.
The young man had thick eyebrows and large eyes, but his face was deathly pale. His aura was chaotic, and his footsteps were somewhat unsteady. He didn’t seem like a Third Layer True God Realm cultivator at all.
Ye Yun withdrew his gaze. The young man before him was gravely injured and near death.
"This is the gentleman who wishes to bid for your Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword. He also wants to know its origin," the old man introduced reverently after leading the young man into the private room.
The pale young man raised his head to look at the two individuals before him, an unconcealable trace of shock flashing across his face.
The blue-clad young man standing nearby emanated a demonic aura. He was a powerful demon of the Divine Monarch Realm.
And the white-clad young man sitting quietly before him...
He was exceptionally handsome, with an otherworldly temperament, resembling a celestial being from a painting.
A shudder ran through the young man.
He knew that these two individuals were extraordinary. Especially this white-clad young man, whose status was likely unimaginably noble.
Ye Yun glanced at the young man across from him and asked with a faint smile, "Over the past few years, were the two Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Swords sold at the Wishful Auction House both yours?"
"Senior," the young man replied respectfully, cupping his fists in salute, "these two swords are heirlooms passed down in my family. Our family has fallen on hard times, and I had no choice but to sell this sword."
Family heirlooms?
Ye Yun’s eyes flickered. He flipped his palm, revealing a small silver sword.
He then asked, "The first Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword is already in my hands. I also want to buy this second sword, but at the same time, I want to know the origin of these two swords. If you can tell me, I naturally won’t treat you unfairly."
Upon hearing Ye Yun’s words, the young man’s breathing became somewhat hurried. He suddenly realized that he might have stumbled upon a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. The unfathomable white-clad young man before him might be able to resolve his crisis. After all, his decision to auction the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword this time was also born of desperation.
Thinking this, the young man’s expression became even more respectful. In a low voice, he said, "Senior, I’ve been heavily injured due to persecution from my enemies, and I fear I won’t live more than a year. I’m selling the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword this time mainly to exchange it for some life-extending spiritual medicines."
Ye Yun smiled faintly. "You don’t need to worry about that."
A flash of joy quickly crossed the young man’s face. He knew he had made the right judgment this time. The Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword was inherently of limited practical use. If he was lucky, he could sell it for a good price. If he was unlucky, however, the price might not meet his expectations.
"Senior, this sword is for you." The young man suddenly flipped his hands over, produced a silver Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword, and respectfully placed it on the table beside Ye Yun.
"Aren’t you going to auction it?" the old man at his side asked quickly.
The young man took a deep breath and said calmly, "Since this Senior wants the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword, I will sell it directly to him. As for the Wishful Auction House’s commission, I will pay it."
"Alright." The old man nodded helplessly. There was no helping it; the buyer this time was simply too powerful. As for the auction scheduled for the day after tomorrow, they could only announce its cancellation at short notice.
Ye Yun looked at the silver Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword before him and nodded with considerable approval.
This young cultivator understands how to weigh his options; his judgment isn’t bad.
"Then tell me about the origin of this sword," Ye Yun said with a light smile.
The young man took a deep breath and said solemnly, "Senior, my Lu Clan has preserved the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Swords for several hundred thousand years and has never mentioned them to outsiders. This time, as I don’t have much longer to live, I’ve gathered the courage to tell you the origin of the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword, a secret our Lu Clan has always guarded."
Several hundred thousand years?
Ye Yun was inwardly startled.
Is the history of the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword truly that ancient? This is indeed unexpected.
At this point, the young man slowly said, "Senior, three hundred thousand years ago, a Secret Realm appeared in the Divine Land. It was in this Secret Realm that an ancestor of my Lu Clan obtained two Heaven Level Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Swords."
Ye Yun’s interest was piqued, and he asked, "Do you remember what the Secret Realm was called?"
"Senior, the Secret Realm was called the Seven-Star Mound, formed from seven large tombs. My Lu Clan’s ancestor entered the first great tomb and obtained the two Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Swords."
"But at the time, no one knew what happened inside. After emerging from the Seven-Star Mound, our Lu Clan ancestor went into seclusion and never came out. It wasn’t until he was on his deathbed that he told his descendants never to reveal the origin of the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword to the world..."
The young man recounted all the secrets from three hundred thousand years ago in one breath, feeling an unconscious sense of relief wash over him.
"Seven-Star Mound? So the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword actually originated from the Seven-Star Mound," the old man beside him exclaimed in shock.
"Yes," the young man nodded.
"I’ve heard of the Seven-Star Mound..." the old man mused. "That Secret Realm was ephemeral, appearing with astonishing momentum, yet few people actually obtained the opportunities they should have from it. Who would have thought! The truth about all those opportunities was actually buried."
The old man let out a light sigh, his shocked expression soon replaced by one of dejection.
Hearing this conversation, Ye Yun’s heart was thrown into turmoil.
Seven-Star Mound!
The moment these words entered his ears, Ye Yun instinctively felt an indescribable sense of danger.
Could it be that the mastermind behind everything is the Seven-Star Mound?
Journeying all the way from the Cangnan Continent, Ye Yun had encountered many formations related to the Seven Stars. All of this was intricately linked with that mastermind.
Even the Nine Soul Emperor, now that I think about it, seems to have some connection to this mastermind,
Ye Yun mused.
"Did the Seven-Star Mound ever appear again after that?" Ye Yun looked at the young man and asked again.
"No, Senior. In three hundred thousand years, it has only appeared that once," the young man replied.
"Prior to three hundred thousand years ago, are there any records of the Seven-Star Mound appearing?" Ye Yun then turned to the old man.
The old man pondered for a moment, then slowly shook his head and said, "Never. At least, in this old one’s memory, the enigmatic Seven-Star Mound has only ever appeared once."
After listening to the old man, Ye Yun fell silent. He now had a hunch that if he wanted to uncover the conspiracy, he would probably have to find the Seven-Star Mound.
But the Seven-Star Mound has only appeared once from Ancient Times until now; where am I supposed to look for it?
Ye Yun’s thoughts were somewhat chaotic at this moment, but he quickly regained his composure, his mindset returning to normal.
One must walk the path step by step,
he thought.
The Seven-Star Mound hasn’t appeared for so long... Perhaps, at some future point, it will reappear in this world...

chapters.title: Chapter 314: Black Token, Hidden Mystery
chapters.content:
Chapter 314: Chapter 314: Black Token, Hidden Mystery
Ye Yun set aside the matter of the Seven-Star Mound for the time being. There were still many clues worth investigating on the Cangnan Continent, so he was in no rush to explore the elusive Seven-Star Mound.
「After returning from the Divine Land.」
Jun Moxiao was about to enter the Heavenly Moon Secret Region. Ye Yun also wanted to see what kind of clues he could find there.
His gaze fell back to the young man across from him, and he smiled and nodded. "You’ll be fine, don’t worry, you won’t die."
With that, Ye Yun took out a small bottle. He dripped out a single drop of green liquid, which was the Water of Life.
"Swallow it."
Ye Yun smiled faintly and flicked his finger. The drop of mysterious Water of Life floated over to the young man.
Ye Yun had sealed the aura of this drop of Water of Life. Therefore, neither the old man nor the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon sensed its vigorous life-giving essence.
Both of them stared strangely at the drop of green liquid, both wondering in their hearts,
Can this tiny green droplet heal a True God on the brink of death?
The young man looked at the mysterious green liquid and, without any hesitation, opened his mouth and swallowed it. He had faith in this mysterious white-robed senior. Besides, he was indeed at death’s door. Out of a desperate desire for life, he unhesitatingly swallowed the drop of liquid.
BOOM!
An unimaginable surge of vitality erupted inside his body. The young man’s eyes widened as he incredulously felt the miraculous changes occurring within him. A torrent of vitality surged through every part of his body, rapidly repairing his wounds.
In the span of a single breath, he felt that most of his body had recovered. Then, after a few more breaths, his severe injuries had completely healed.
Even more miraculously, he had initially been poisoned with a potent toxin hidden deep within his blood. At this moment, that potent toxin was also neutralized.
"My goodness! What grade of Sacred Healing Medicine is this to have such magical effects!"
The Second Manager of the Ruyi Trading Company was so shocked upon seeing this that his jaw almost hit the floor. Having worked in the Ruyi Trading Company for so many years, he had never seen such a miraculous pill or elixir. It healed a severely injured person in an instant. This... this speed was too fast!
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon was also deeply shocked. In all his experience, he had never encountered such a potent Sacred Healing Medicine.
After just a few more breaths, the young man’s injuries were completely healed. His complexion became rosy and healthy once more.
"Thank you, Senior, for your life-saving grace!"
The young man knelt on the ground and continuously kowtowed to Ye Yun, tears streaming from his eyes. Initially, he hadn’t held much hope when auctioning the Dragon Pattern Soul Chasing Sword. Even if it sold for a good price, allowing him to exchange it for some pills to extend his life, it would only allow him to live for ten more years. Especially with the toxins constantly ravaging his body, he had essentially been in a hopeless, fatal situation.
"Stand up. What’s your name?" Ye Yun looked at the young man and asked with a smile.
"Senior, my name is Lu Xing," Young Lu Xing replied quickly, kowtowed deeply once more, and then stood up.
"If your family has fallen on hard times and you have nowhere else to go, you can head to Skyreach Island and seek out Jiang Hengyue. He will take you in," Ye Yun said with a smile. This young man, Lu, had made a good impression on him, and he didn’t mind lending him a hand. Considering the vastness of Skyreach Island, taking in another cultivator at the First Level of the True God Realm was a trivial matter.
"Thank you, Senior!" Lu Xing was overjoyed. Although he was in the Third Sea Region, he had heard of Skyreach Island. Skyreach Island was the most powerful force in the Ninth Sea Area.
"Young Master, could your green Sacred Healing Medicine be auctioned?" At this moment, the old man from the Ruyi Trading Company who was standing nearby rubbed his hands and asked hesitantly.
"No," Ye Yun responded promptly and decisively.
He gave the old man a profound look, activated his Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye, and erased a segment of the old man’s memory.
It wasn’t just this old man. A small segment of memory was erased from everyone present who had seen him.
After doing so, the void rippled, and Ye Yun departed, taking the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon and Lu Xing with him.
Watching Ye Yun effortlessly tear open the void and stroll away, Lu Xing, standing behind, was utterly dumbstruck and astonished. Only then did he truly realize the terrifying power of the senior before him.
Such a cultivation base... He must be at least in the Divine Sovereign Realm!
"Senior, there’s something else I would like to tell you," Lu Xing said, stuttering slightly as something came to mind.
"Go ahead." Ye Yun stopped tearing the void, and the three of them emerged.
They were currently still in the Third Sea Area, very close to the Fourth Sea Area.
"Senior, our Lu Clan has passed down a Token for generations. We don’t know what it is, but our ancestral teachings instruct us to guard it carefully, saying it might be useful one day. But so much time has passed, and it has never proven useful. I... I’d like to show it to you, Senior," Lu Xing said honestly, then took out a black Token from his storage ring.
He handed the black Token to Ye Yun.
Ye Yun took it curiously and examined it for a few moments. The next moment, his brow twitched slightly, and a brilliant light flashed in his eyes.
This black Token appeared unremarkable, bearing only some ancient-looking patterns and nothing else. However, within one of these patterns, Ye Yun discovered a Seven-star formation. This Seven-star formation was incredibly minute. If not for his astonishing Divine Skills, he would have been utterly incapable of discovering it.
This Seven-star formation was unlike any he had encountered before. It emanated a faint teleportation power.
An idea suddenly flashed through Ye Yun’s mind:
Could this be the Token to enter the Seven-Star Mound?
"Did your Lu Clan ancestors ever mention the function of this Token?" Ye Yun looked at Lu Xing and asked softly.
"They gave no specific instructions, only telling later generations to keep it safe, saying it might be useful someday," Lu Xing said, somewhat dejectedly. He looked at Ye Yun and said with utmost seriousness, "Senior, why don’t you take this Token and keep it? It’s truly of no use to me. Now, I am the only one left in the Lu Clan. If I were to unfortunately perish one day, this Token would be lost with me."
"Very well, I will accept this Token then." Ye Yun nodded and patted Lu Xing on the shoulder. This Lu Xing was quite perceptive and understood the bigger picture, a trait Ye Yun greatly admired.
He didn’t want to accept this black Token for free. Ye Yun decided to give Lu Xing something in return.
"What kind of weapon are you most skilled with?" Ye Yun asked with a smile.
"Senior, our Lu Clan has always specialized in saber techniques," Lu Xing replied respectfully.
With a flip of his palm, two items appeared in Ye Yun’s hand: a large silver saber and a grey Robe.

chapters.title: Chapter 315: Ancestor Dragon, Truly Sympathetic to the Dragon Clan
chapters.content:
Chapter 315: Chapter 315: Ancestor Dragon, Truly Sympathetic to the Dragon Clan
"This knife and this Robe are now yours."
Ye Yun casually tossed the knife and Robe over.
HISS!
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, standing beside Ye Yun, was the first to perceive the grade of the knife and Robe, and he couldn’t help but suck in a sharp breath.
The knife was Superior Emperor Level.
The Robe was Emperor Level Medium Grade.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon was greatly shocked, marveling at his Master’s incredible resources. He casually gave away Emperor Level treasures. Even he, a dragon of the Divine Monarch Realm, didn’t possess a single Emperor Level magical artifact.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s eyes burned with desire, and saliva almost dripped from his mouth.
"Senior, this is too precious! I really can’t accept it."
Feeling the astonishing aura emanating from the knife and Robe, Lu Xing was astounded. He hurriedly waved his hands, not daring to accept these two treasures.
"Just take them."
Ye Yun forcefully pressed them into Lu Xing’s hands.
As Lu Xing carefully sensed them, he grew increasingly amazed by the astonishing aura of the two treasures.
If he wasn’t mistaken, they were at least Emperor Level.
He, a mere cultivator at the First Level of the True God Realm, now possessed two Emperor Level treasures.
Lu Xing’s heart was thumping wildly. He hurriedly stored the two treasures in his Storage Ring, afraid that if their aura leaked out, it would attract a fatal disaster.
Ye Yun smiled at Lu Xing’s reaction.
He knew exactly what Lu Xing was thinking.
He also understood the meaning behind the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s fervent gaze.
"Unless it’s a life-or-death situation, try not to use these two treasures. That way, you won’t have to worry about anything," Ye Yun said with a gentle smile.
"I understand, Senior. Thank you for your immense kindness, Senior, for once again gifting this junior two Emperor Level treasures," Lu Xing said, deeply moved. His knees buckled, and he knelt before Ye Yun once more.
"I’ll take you to The Ninth Sea Area. Once there, go to Skyreach Island and find Jiang Hengyue. Tell him it was all my instruction," Ye Yun spoke softly. This time, he was prepared to return to the Cangnan Continent. He didn’t plan to linger even when passing through The Ninth Sea Area.
"I understand, Senior."
Lu Xing stood up and nodded.
Ye Yun began to tear through space again.
Soon, they reached The Ninth Sea Area. After leaving Lu Xing hovering above the sea, Ye Yun, accompanied by the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, tore through space and arrived upon the Ancient Road to Heaven.
"Master, is this the Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon? It’s said that when cultivators from the Divine Land enter this place, their cultivation base will cease to advance," the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon said, gazing at the dark-yellow ancient road stretching into the distant void, and couldn’t help but feel his heart pound with trepidation.
"Are you worried your cultivation base will also be cursed?" Ye Yun asked with a light chuckle.
"I am a little worried," the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon smiled awkwardly, speaking the truth. After all, it hadn’t been easy for him to reach the Divine Monarch Realm. If his cultivation stagnated at the Divine Monarch Realm, he would be utterly unreconciled.
"Rest assured, you don’t have to worry." Ye Yun chuckled but didn’t explain anything to the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon.
He also wanted to see whether the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, being of the Dragon Clan, would be affected by the Ancestor Dragon’s Curse after entering the Cangnan Continent.
After experiencing the various strange celestial phenomena on the Ancient Road to Heaven, Ye Yun finally brought the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon into the Cangnan Continent.
Seeing the familiar sea and the vast Cangnan Continent in the distance, Ye Yun felt an inexplicable sense of emotion well up within him.
After traveling around, the Cangnan Continent still felt like home.
Although the Spiritual Energy here was relatively scarce and lacked Divine Nature, it held countless wonderful memories for him.
"There isn’t even a single True God in this place. Little Dragon, restrain your aura," Ye Yun said, casting a casual glance at the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon.
"Master, is everyone’s cultivation base here so low?" The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon pursed his lips and quickly suppressed his aura.
"The strongest cultivators here are at the Eternal Realm. However, this place is the origin of all dragons. Millions of years ago, this continent was inhabited by countless members of the Dragon Clan; your ancestors lived here..." Ye Yun said with a smile.
"Ah, such vast changes over time! I never expected the Dragon Clan Ancestral Land to become like this," the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon sighed, shaking his head incessantly.
Although he understood that this was the origin place of all the Dragon Clan, he had always lived in the Divine Land, so his sense of belonging to this place was not strong.
At this moment, Ye Yun gazed at the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon and activated his Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye, searching to see if he was afflicted by the Ancestor Dragon’s Curse.
"Master, what are you doing?" Ye Yun’s gaze made the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s skin crawl, and he couldn’t help but back away a few steps.
"Don’t move," Ye Yun barked sternly.
A powerful force immediately enveloped and immobilized the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon was extremely uneasy. However, when he saw that his Master wasn’t launching any particular attack on him, he finally relaxed.
After observing for a moment and scanning every part of the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s body, Ye Yun found no trace of the Ancestor Dragon’s Curse. He couldn’t help but let out a sigh of relief.
The Ancestor Dragon truly is merciful towards the Dragon Clan.
Even members of the Dragon Clan who lived in the Divine Land would not be subjected to the Ancestor Dragon’s Curse if they returned to the Cangnan Continent.
The Dragon Breeding Clan, raising Divine Dragons... could there be some hidden secret?
A startling idea suddenly surfaced in Ye Yun’s mind. But he quickly dismissed it.
Unless there was some treasure on the Cangnan Continent that the Dragon Breeding Clan wanted to find by using the Divine Dragons they raised, having them enter the Cangnan Continent to search for it.
This way, they would avoid entering the Cangnan Continent directly and being affected by the Ancestor Dragon’s Curse.
But then Ye Yun reconsidered.
On the Cangnan Continent, there seemed to be no trace of the Dragon Breeding Clan.
And he had never heard of any Dragon Clan members returning to the Cangnan Continent.
Perhaps I am being paranoid.
Ye Yun chuckled and released the force that was immobilizing the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon. Then he told the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon about the matter of the Ancestor Dragon’s Curse.
"So that’s how it is. It seems His Venerable Self, the Ancestor Dragon, is indeed merciful to us, his descendants," the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon said, letting out a long sigh of relief, a look of lingering fear still on his face.
His greatest worry upon entering this world was that his cultivation would stagnate if he were cursed.
But this problem had now been solved.
Now, there was nothing left for him to be troubled about.
In that instant, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon felt his sense of belonging to the Cangnan Continent intensify.
"Let’s go... I’ll take you to meet your fellow disciples of the Dragon God Sect."
Seeing the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s relieved expression, Ye Yun shook his head, rather amused. With that, he led the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon away from the sea surface.
Ye Yun’s trip from the Cangnan Continent to the Divine Land and back had only taken two days.
By his estimation, the Big Black Horse would reach the Heavenly Moon Secret Region in another three or four days. The vessel from the Tianxing Commercial Firm should also arrive around that time.
Therefore, Ye Yun was in no hurry on his journey back to the Heavenly Moon Dynasty. Sometimes he would tear through space to cover long distances quickly; other times, he would fly at a leisurely pace, admiring the magnificent mountains and rivers of the Cangnan Continent. He would even take the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon to ordinary Human Race cities to enjoy some worldly cuisine.
「And so it went.」
Four days later, the two of them finally arrived at the Heavenly Moon Dynasty.

chapters.title: Chapter 316: Blue Cat?
chapters.content:
Chapter 316: Chapter 316: Blue Cat?
A black carriage was traveling slowly through the territory of the Heavenly Moon Dynasty.
"Uncle Ma, we should be almost at the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, right?" Big Black Cat yawned, stretched its neck, and looked into the distance.
"We can get there anytime, but Master hasn’t returned yet, so there’s no need to rush." Big Black Horse smacked his lips and chuckled slyly.
A piece of Immortal Tea was still embedded in the center of Big Black Horse’s forehead, continuously absorbing its energy over the past few days, which greatly benefited his cultivation base.
Big Black Horse suddenly sensed something.
Huh, Number Two just passed overhead,
he realized, looking up towards the sky.
High above in the sky, through the thick layer of clouds, a giant ship pierced through the fog and flew rapidly towards the Heavenly Moon Secret Region.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon also sensed the carriage below and couldn’t help but open his eyes. With a slight shake of his body, he vanished from the ship.
The next moment, he appeared on top of the carriage.
"Haha, we, the great demon beasts of the Dragon God Sect, meet again!" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon exclaimed with a boisterous laugh.
"Number Two, you’ve abandoned your post! Have you completed the task Master gave you?" Big Black Horse asked with a sly smile.
"Almost, almost! Isn’t the Heavenly Moon Secret Region just ahead? We’ll be there in less than two hours," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said, dismissing the concern with a wave of his hand.
"Didn’t I see you all? That’s why I came down to say hello. I’ll head back in a bit," he said with a laugh.
Looking down at the two little cats, one black and one white, lounging at his feet, he suddenly squatted and petted the heads of Big Black Cat and Little Cat with both hands.
"Have you two little ones missed me?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon asked, grinning.
"We have! We’ve missed Senior terribly!" Big Black Cat said with a shameless laugh.
"Senior, please hurry back. If Master returns and sees you here, he might reprimand you." Little Cat, whose fur was standing on end from being petted, quickly found an excuse, wanting the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon to leave.
"Master won’t be back that quickly! I just came down to say a few words to you. You think Master will just happen to return now?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said nonchalantly.
"That’s not necessarily true," a familiar male voice suddenly said from the void.
A ripple passed through the air, and then two figures emerged from the void above the carriage: one in snow-white robes, the other in sea-blue.
Seeing Master suddenly appear, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon felt like crying. He had just snuck off for a moment; how could his luck be so bad as to run into Master returning right then?
"Master, I was just spouting nonsense earlier! Please don’t take it to heart!" The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon immediately knelt.
"Haha, it’s fine. We’ll be at the Heavenly Moon Secret Region soon anyway. You can just stay here," Ye Yun said, surprisingly cheerful and not blaming the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon.
"Yes, Master!" The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was immensely grateful and quickly kowtowed to Ye Yun again.
"Rise," Ye Yun said with a smile. A surge of mana flowed out, lifting the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon to his feet.
Big Black Horse blinked, looking at the blue-robed youth beside Master.
I can’t see through his cultivation base at all! What level is he?
"Master, who is this?" Big Black Horse couldn’t help but ask.
"He is the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, from the Divine Land," Ye Yun said with a smile.
What? From the Divine Land?!
Big Black Horse was instantly shocked. Not only him, but the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and Big Black Cat were also stunned.
"Master, what cultivation level is this... elder brother from the Dragon Clan?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon asked, a little unconfidently.
"Don’t call him elder brother. In terms of seniority, he’s far beneath you," Ye Yun said with a hearty laugh.
Although the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s cultivation base was quite low, merely at the sixth level of the Eternal Realm, his seniority was exceptionally high. Moreover, in terms of bloodline, he also far surpassed the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon. After all, he possessed the bloodline of a Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, one of the Ten Super Divine Dragons.
"What kind of dragon are you?" the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon asked, staring intently at the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, his gaze flickering as he sensed the other’s bloodline.
"I am a Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon stated, his courage bolstered by the words. No matter what, even if this Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s cultivation base was higher than his own, when it came to bloodline, he still held the advantage. Having lived in the Ancient Times, he had naturally encountered Azure Sea Heavenly Dragons before, so he was not unfamiliar with them.
"Wow, Senior, you are truly formidable! To possess a trace of the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s bloodline—it’s far nobler than mine!" the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon said with great admiration, cupping his fists.
"Enough with the mutual flattery. From now on, you are both Divine Dragons of the Dragon God Sect, fellow sect members. There’s no need for such distinctions of high or low status," Ye Yun said with a smile from the side.
"I understand, Master!" the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon quickly nodded. Being new, he was still behaving very modestly.
"Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, what is your cultivation base?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon asked, still unable to sense the other’s cultivation after looking him up and down several times, unwilling to give up.
"God Monarch Realm First Layer," the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon replied.
What? God Monarch Realm First Layer? Such a high realm instantly sent shivers down the spines of Big Black Horse, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, Little Cat, and Big Black Cat, making them tremble.
They were all thinking,
God Monarch Realm? Isn’t that the same realm as Master? Although it’s only a few minor realms lower than Master’s, such a realm on the Cangnan Continent is practically like a being of the Heavenly Dao!
Big Black Horse’s throat went dry. Staring at the blue-robed youth, the shock in his heart was indescribable.
In the past, as an Eternal Realm great demon, I felt that few on the Cangnan Continent could rival me. Then, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon appeared, surpassing me by three minor cultivation realms. After that, a black Xuan bird arrived; though its realm was lower, its seniority was immense, effectively my elder. And now... a dragon with an intimidatingly high cultivation has arrived—an Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon at the God Monarch Realm First Layer! It seems I truly have to cultivate diligently, or I really won’t be able to keep up with everyone.
This train of thought made Big Black Horse feel increasingly insignificant, but he quietly encouraged himself.
A black Xuan bird flapped its wings, perched on the roof of the carriage, and said with a laugh, "Master, our Dragon God Sect is growing ever stronger! With the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon joining us, we’ll have no rivals left on the entire Cangnan Continent!"
"Indeed!" Ye Yun said, smiling and nodding.
However, he had no intention of letting the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon take action. After all, it was from the Divine Land, and its cultivation realm was far too high. Letting a giant fight children would be utterly ridiculous.
"Alright, everyone return to your positions," Ye Yun instructed softly.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon blinked, seemingly understanding Master’s thoughts. He somersaulted in mid-air, transforming into a streak of red light that landed on the carriage. He had become a cute little red kitten.
Witnessing this, the nearby Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon couldn’t help but purse his lips.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon turned into a cat?
He couldn’t understand what was happening.
"Little Dragon, while you’re with me, you won’t need to take action. Just focus on bonding with your fellow sect members," Ye Yun’s voice resonated in the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s ears.
The next moment, he discovered a magical change occurring in his body. A flash of blue light, and he had transformed into a little blue kitten.
What is this?!
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon lifted his head, glanced at a blue cat paw, and felt utterly speechless, on the verge of tears.

chapters.title: Chapter 317: Immortal Tea Knocks Down Another One
chapters.content:
Chapter 317: Chapter 317: Immortal Tea Knocks Down Another One
What Divine Skill is the Master using? He’s... turned me into a blue cat?
Feeling the bizarre changes occurring in his body, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon wanted to cry but couldn’t shed a tear, desperately wishing he could find a crack in the ground to disappear into.
To think that he, a majestic Dragon Clan member of the Divine Monarch Realm, whose true form spanned tens of thousands of feet, an embodiment of awe-inspiring power and grandeur, was now a cute little blue cat! The psychological blow was simply too much to bear.
"Aww, a blue cat..."
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, seeing the little blue cat, chuckled.
It was as if he was looking at a past version of himself.
Big Black Cat and Cat Bao’er exchanged glances, smiles twitching at their lips.
The Master’s Divine Skills are truly formidable! He had turned a dignified dragon of the Divine Monarch Realm into such a tiny, cute kitten. Could it be that from now on, the Dragon Clan is destined to join the cat family?
The Big Black Cat was chuckling inwardly,
Hehe...
but his outward expression remained utterly solemn and serious. After all, he wasn’t yet familiar with the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, so he didn’t dare to overstep.
The Xuan bird, perched atop the carriage, looked down at the row of kittens lounging below—black, white, red, and blue. It couldn’t help but marvel inwardly. Having lived for a very long time, its self-control was considerable, so it managed to refrain from any tactless remarks.
The Big Black Horse had seen its share of wonders in the warehouse; the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon didn’t faze it. So, upon seeing the little blue cat, it bared its large white teeth and burst out laughing with a SNORT.
"What are you laughing about?"
"What’s so funny about this?"
"Isn’t it just becoming a blue cat? Even the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, who possesses the bloodline of the Ten Super Divine Dragons, was turned into a kitten. What’s so strange about me becoming a cat?"
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon glared, looking around irritably.
"Senior, you are right..."
The Big Black Horse nodded in agreement, smiling.
At this, Ye Yun smiled. "In the Dragon God Sect, you must abide by the rules of My Dragon God Sect. Rest assured, there will be benefits for you in the future."
Hearing this, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon recalled the Emperor artifacts the Master had gifted to Lu Xing and immediately felt a surge of anticipation.
"Master, please rest assured. It’s just a few days as a kitten, right? That’s no problem. Besides, I won’t be fighting anyone on the Cangnan Continent. I’ll just nap in the carriage every day, conserving my strength."
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon chuckled, dispelling the lingering discomfort in his heart.
Ye Yun nodded, lifted the carriage curtain, and stepped inside.
Mu Qing quickly bowed in respect, smiling, "Master, you’ve returned. Would you like me to prepare you a cup of tea?"
"That would be good."
Ye Yun nodded slightly. He then noticed a tea set already prepared inside the carriage.
It seems Mu Qing put a lot of thought into this. I wonder where she managed to find such a tea set.
Ye Yun took out an ancient-looking small jar filled with Mandala Immortal Tea.
"These are tea leaves. Use three to four each time," Ye Yun explained with a smile.
Then he looked outside and said to the Big Black Horse, "Little Horse, let’s go!"
"Understood, Master!"
The Big Black Horse roused its spirits and started heading towards the Heavenly Moon Secret Region.
They were not too far from the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, roughly two to three thousand miles away.
Although the Heavenly Moon Secret Region had not officially opened yet, the area outside its entrance was already a sea of people. Cultivators from various sects and some Loose Cultivators were gathered outside, all waiting with eager anticipation.
A merchant guild’s ferry ship hovered in mid-air, and several cultivators flew down from it. Lei Qinian was among them. Seeing the dense crowd below, he chose a spot a bit further away to land.
No sooner had his feet touched the ground than another figure landed beside him. It was a fair-faced young man, also from the ferry ship.
"Fellow Daoist," the young man began, "why don’t we travel together?"
"I’d rather not. I prefer to travel alone," Lei Qinian cupped his hands and politely refused. He had entered this Secret Realm with a special mission and couldn’t team up with others.
"No matter. If we happen to cross paths in the Secret Realm, I hope Daoist Brother will show some mercy," the fair-faced young man said with a smile, sitting down beside him.
"No problem," Lei Qinian nodded.
The black carriage moved slowly.
By now, Mu Qing had already boiled the water.
"Master, I will use these tea leaves to brew tea for you," Mu Qing gazed at the quaint little jar, her voice filled with excitement as she spoke.
