"Mm," Ye Yun nodded with a smile. He naturally understood what this little girl, Mu Qing, was thinking.
She’s probably been eyeing the leftover Immortal Tea for some time now.
Mu Qing’s arm trembled slightly as she held the small jar, gently twisting open the lid. Gazing at the emerald-green Immortal Tea leaves, each radiating a divine light and intricately inscribed with Daoist patterns, Mu Qing’s heart couldn’t help but thump wildly.
The Master is right in front of me. I absolutely mustn’t make a mistake, or he might not want me anymore!
Mu Qing constantly encouraged herself inwardly, steadying her mind as she carefully poured out four tea leaves.
As she placed them into the cup, an indescribable Super Divine Dragon Breath instantly permeated the entire carriage.
After taking just a light sniff, Mu Qing fainted.
What a headache! It seems in the future, I’ll need to suppress the Super Divine Dragon Breath of these tea leaves,
Ye Yun sighed, touching his forehead with a look of wry helplessness.
With his other hand, he gently made a grabbing motion in the air, and the energy that had invaded Mu Qing’s body was drawn out by him.
Only then did Mu Qing slowly come to.
Her small face flushed crimson, and a wave of frustration washed over her. Tears welled in her eyes as she said, "Master, I’m such an incompetent maid. I can’t even brew tea properly."
"It’s not your fault," Ye Yun smiled, continuing, "Your cultivation base is simply too low. With your current realm, you cannot withstand the Super Divine Dragon Breath of these tea leaves. But don’t worry. Next time, I’ll seal the Super Divine Dragon Breath of the tea leaves so it won’t affect you. As for the dregs, they’re yours. As long as you don’t intentionally try to inhale its Super Divine Dragon Breath, you’ll be fine."
"Thank you, Master!"
Both astonished and delighted, Mu Qing quickly picked up the teacup and offered it to Ye Yun with both hands.
Ye Yun took it and slowly took a sip, then looked off in a certain direction.
That little fellow, Lei Qinian, was currently waiting quietly outside the Heavenly Moon Secret Region.
With a thought from Ye Yun, Jun Moxiao suddenly materialized.
"Ancestral Lord."
Upon seeing Ye Yun, Jun Moxiao hurriedly bowed respectfully.
"You couldn’t make it to the Nine Soul Underground Palace last time, so I’ll entrust the Heavenly Moon Secret Region to you this time," Ye Yun said with a smile.
"Thank you for this opportunity, Ancestral Lord!" Jun Moxiao was overjoyed, a wide smile spreading across his young face.
He glanced into the carriage and was surprised to see an exquisitely beautiful woman standing beside Ye Yun. Her cultivation base was shockingly high, already at the seventh level of the Destiny Realm.
"This is my new maid," Ye Yun said with a smile.
"Oh!" Jun Moxiao nodded, looking a bit bewildered.
Seeing Jun Moxiao’s expression, a thought formed in Ye Yun’s mind.
These new additions to the Dragon God Sect—Mu Qing, the Xuan bird, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, and the others... Jun Moxiao, Luo Li, and their third martial sibling don’t know any of them. Why not have everyone come out and get acquainted? Luo Li, as the Sect Leader of the Dragon God Sect, can’t solely focus on cultivation. She needs to establish good relationships with the Sect’s demon beasts.

chapters.title: Chapter 318: Why are there so many cute little kittens?
chapters.content:
Chapter 318: Chapter 318: Why are there so many cute little kittens?
After Ye Yun made up his mind, Luo Li and Su Wanyi, who were in the midst of their cultivation, were individually summoned by him from the small space within the carriage.
"Greetings, Grand Ancestor!"
The two young women, upon catching sight of Ye Yun, hastily bowed in respect.
"Very good, indeed. Now, all three of you are Cultivators in the Nirvana Realm."
After glancing at the two, Ye Yun revealed a smile of satisfaction. Although these three little fellows were insignificant compared to the cultivation base of the demon beasts outside, their progress, given their short cultivation period, had already made him quite content.
Who are these people calling Master ’Grand Ancestor’? Could they all be disciples of the Dragon God Sect?
Mu Qing stood nearby, anxious and uncertain about how she should address them.
Ye Yun, lifting his eyes for a moment, seemed to perceive Mu Qing’s thoughts.
"This is Mu Qing, the former Saintess of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird," Ye Yun said, looking at the three juniors of the Dragon God Sect with a smile. "She has now joined my Dragon God Sect and is currently my maid, serving me tea and water. Mu Qing, even though your Cultivation Stage is quite high, you must also follow the rules. First, meet Luo Li, the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect."
Ye Yun pointed at Luo Li as he spoke.
Hearing Ye Yun’s introduction, Mu Qing was instantly flustered. She hadn’t expected that the stunningly beautiful young woman before her was actually the current Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect.
Mu Qing hastily knelt, speaking softly, "Greetings, Sect Master."
Luo Li was taken aback; it was hard for her to accept an esteemed Cultivator of the Destiny Realm kneeling before her. She quickly took two steps forward and, using both hands, helped Mu Qing to her feet. "Sister, please, stand up."
Afterward, Ye Yun pointed in two other directions. "This is your Senior Brother Jun Moxiao, and this is your Senior Sister Su Wanyi."
Mu Qing’s mind was once again thrown into disarray. Subconsciously, she wanted to kneel before Jun Moxiao but found her knees seemingly held by an invisible force, preventing her from bending them.
Ye Yun, smiling by the side, said, "Interacting with the courtesy due to fellow sect members will suffice."
"Greetings, Senior Brother Jun. Greetings, Senior Sister Su," Mu Qing hurriedly said, cupping her fists respectfully.
Su Wanyi’s face turned beet red. With the Grand Ancestor arranging things this way, she too felt somewhat disconcerted. She quickly supported Mu Qing, saying, "Don’t be so formal, Sister..."
"The necessary courtesies must be observed. This is the rule of our Dragon God Sect," Ye Yun reminded from the side.
Not to mention a mere Destiny Realm practitioner, even the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon at the Divine Monarch Realm outside would have to perform a grand salute to show respect upon seeing Luo Li. Although Luo Li might seem weak now, Ye Yun would soon cultivate her into an unparalleled powerhouse. And before he left, he would certainly establish various safeguards for Luo Li. He would never allow any person or demon beast of the Dragon God Sect to possess the ability to defy the authority of the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect.
Ye Yun continued, "Currently, our Dragon God Sect has admitted a few more demon beasts. You three, follow me out and get to know them."
Saying so, Ye Yun stood up, pushed the door curtain aside with one hand, and walked out.
The Grand Ancestor has accepted a few more demon beasts?
Luo Li, Jun Moxiao, and Su Wanyi were slightly stunned but quickly followed the Grand Ancestor out of the carriage.
As soon as she stepped out of the carriage, Luo Li saw a row of kittens perched on it—red, white, blue, and black, four different colors in total.
"WOW, so many cute kittens!" Luo Li leaped forward at once, crouched before the red kitten, and gently stroked it. "It’s so cute!" she exclaimed delightfully.
"Really? Where did Grand Ancestor find so many kittens?" Su Wanyi, unable to contain her joy, stepped forward and crouched before the blue kitten. She rather liked the blue one; its fur was as azure as the ocean, a calming sight. Su Wanyi also gently stroked it. The blue fur was smooth and felt wonderful to the touch. However, the blue kitten was staring at her with wide eyes, clearly sulking but not daring to express it.
When the Big Black Cat saw Luo Li petting the red kitten—which was, in fact, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon—he couldn’t help but laugh heartily to himself. Cat Treasure also couldn’t suppress a smile. He and the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat, one black and one white, had rather plain coloring. Compared to the little red cat and little blue cat, their colors were far more subdued, which was why they had been spared this time.
"Master, who are these people?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon stretched his neck and asked loudly. If not for these people emerging from the carriage with their Master, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon would have attacked already.
Nearby, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon was also complaining loudly, "Miss, please take your hand away! I’m not a real cat!"
Not a real cat?
Su Wanyi was slightly taken aback. She quickly withdrew her hand and stood up. As the eldest senior sister, Su Wanyi was, after all, quite mature.Luo Li, however, remained squatting, grinning as she stared at the little red cat that had suddenly spoken.
Seeing this, Ye Yun also found it highly amusing and couldn’t help but chuckle.
"Alright, let me make the introductions." He cleared his throat. "This is Luo Li, the 298th Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect. I am the 13th. The Sect is now managed by Luo Li. When you see her, you must all perform the rites of greeting the Sect Master."
So, it’s the Sect Master!
Upon hearing Ye Yun’s words, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was greatly surprised and quickly shifted its position to kneel properly on the carriage. "Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon pays respects to the Sect Master!" it shouted.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon beside it was also inwardly shocked; it naturally understood the significance of the Dragon God Sect Sect Master’s status. The Master had just made things very clear. Even as a Divine Monarch Realm dragon of the Dragon Clan, it had to show respect upon seeing Sect Master Luo Li of the Dragon God Sect.
"Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon pays respects to the Sect Master!" it also hurriedly copied the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, kneeling on the carriage and kowtowing respectfully.
Seeing the two Little Dragons behaving so respectfully, Ye Yun nodded slightly, quite satisfied with their conduct.
"What? You’re not cats? You’re actually dragons?" Luo Li stared dumbfounded at the two little "cats" at her feet, too shocked to speak.
"Correct, these are two dragons," Ye Yun gently patted Luo Li’s shoulder and chuckled. "The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon is from the Ten Thousand Dragon Ridge of the Heavenly Star Dynasty, with a cultivation base at the Sixth Level of the Eternal Realm. The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon comes from the Divine Land, with a cultivation base at the First Level of the Divine Monarch Realm."
Eternal Realm, Sixth Level? Divine Monarch Realm, First Level?
Hearing such high cultivation levels and realms, the three juniors of the Dragon God Sect were immediately dumbstruck, tumultuous waves crashing in their hearts. This was especially true for Luo Li. She had never imagined that even a mighty Divine Monarch Realm dragon would kneel at her feet.
"Seniors, please rise quickly," Luo Li stammered, her exquisitely beautiful face flushing crimson.
"Get to know each other; no need to be so reserved," Ye Yun said with a smile, easing the awkwardness. "The Sect has its rules, but in private, you can all be closer."
Next, Ye Yun introduced the Xuan bird. When they heard that this Senior Xuan bird had lived in the Hundred Bird Forest of the Dragon God Sect one hundred thousand years ago, the three juniors of the Dragon God Sect were once again plunged into shock.
"Xuan bird pays respects to the Sect Master!" The Xuan bird flew down from the carriage, transformed into a black streak of light, then into human form, and knelt at Luo Li’s feet.
"Senior Xuan bird, please rise quickly," Luo Li hastily helped the Xuan bird up. She truly hadn’t thought that during her period of reclusive cultivation, the Grand Ancestor had managed to find a Xuan bird raised by the Dragon God Sect a hundred thousand years ago.
Luo Li, being the lively young girl she was, quickly became familiar with these seniors after a while.
Ye Yun gave them time to interact.
Only when they reached the Heavenly Moon Secret Region did he allow Luo Li and Su Wanyi to return to their cultivation. Jun Moxiao, however, remained on the carriage.

chapters.title: Chapter 319
chapters.content:
Chapter 319: 319
A black carriage slowly pulled out from the valley.
The Big Black Horse, hauling the carriage, passed through the territories of numerous sect cultivators as if no one else was there, yet no one saw it.
Ye Yun had used a Blindfold Method. He didn’t want the cultivators here to see the carriage’s appearance.
The Big Black Horse drew the carriage all the way to Lei Qinian’s side.
The carriage stopped. Ye Yun and Jun Moxiao stepped out.
On the way, he had already instructed Jun Moxiao to accompany Lei Qinian.
"Lei Qinian."
Ye Yun stood behind him and gently uttered his name. He immediately set up a restriction in the surrounding space, making it impossible for anyone to see what was happening there.
Lei Qinian heard the familiar voice. Looking back, he was taken by surprise and quickly got up.
"Greetings, Senior."
Seeing Ye Yun, Lei Qinian’s expression subtly changed, becoming respectful.
"This treasure has been repaired by me, and I am now presenting it to you," Ye Yun said directly, reaching out and producing the Heavenly Treasures Cover.
The Heavenly Treasures Cover had now been restored to Emperor Level Top Grade. Golden light suffused it, and its appearance and quality were truly extraordinary.
"What’s this?"
Seeing the completely refurbished Heavenly Treasures Cover, Lei Qinian was suddenly dumbfounded.
Isn’t this the family heirloom he sold to Senior? Just a few days have passed; how has this heirloom been completely refurbished?
His face filled with excitement. He stretched out his trembling hands, touched the Heavenly Treasures Cover, felt the aura emanating from it, and exclaimed excitedly, "Unbelievable! It has actually been restored to Emperor Level quality!"
"Take it. This originally belongs to your Lei Family!" Ye Yun gave a slight smile and forcefully handed the Heavenly Treasures Cover to Lei Qinian.
"Senior, I can’t accept this treasure. I have already sold it to you. How can it be taken back?" Lei Qinian’s face turned red as he promptly tried to return the Heavenly Treasures Cover.
Ye Yun gently shook his head. "I have some ties with the Lei Family, and I can’t bear to see you fall. In the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, this Heavenly Treasures Cover can both attack and defend, greatly increasing the chances of staying alive," Ye Yun said softly, his gaze particularly gentle.
After all, Lei Qinian was the descendant of his good friend, and now he was the only one left. Whatever the case, Ye Yun wanted to preserve this bloodline for his old friend.
"Senior, how did you come to be connected with my Lei Family?" Lei Qinian was taken aback. He had never heard his family elders speak of such a thing.
"You don’t need to bother about that. Even if I told you, you wouldn’t understand; it’s been too long..." Ye Yun sighed. He wasn’t fond of reminiscing about events from a hundred thousand years ago.
Then his eyes flickered slightly, and he spoke softly, "Lei Qinian, this is Jun Moxiao, a disciple of my Dragon God Sect. Why don’t you accompany him?"
Hearing Ye Yun’s words, Lei Qinian fell silent. Looking at the brilliant golden Heavenly Treasures Cover in his hand, numerous thoughts swiftly raced through his mind.
The fact that this Senior has restored the family heirloom to Emperor Level Top Grade shows that his resources are unfathomable. He doesn’t covet anything from me. This Emperor Level Top Grade heirloom is much more valuable than those few fruits in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region.
Coming to this conclusion, Lei Qinian felt extremely ashamed. He nodded and said ruefully, "Since Senior has arranged it so, how could I dare to disobey?"
"Haha, that’s great." Ye Yun happily patted Lei Qinian’s shoulder.
Then he turned around and beckoned to Jun Moxiao.
Jun Moxiao stepped over, clasped his fists respectfully, and smiled, "Nice to meet you, Brother Lei."
"Brother Jun, don’t be so formal," Lei Qinian quickly returned the gesture with a smile.
Seeing the two of them acquainted, Ye Yun was very happy. After giving a few instructions, he got back into the carriage.
However, a strand of his Primordial Spirit quietly infiltrated Jun Moxiao’s sea of consciousness without a sound.
The Heavenly Moon Secret Region was riddled with hidden dangers. As their ancestor, he had to protect the two juniors.
On their way here, Ye Yun had also given the Jade Tablet he had obtained from Shen Heng Sect’s Jade Box to Jun Moxiao. He told him to hang it on the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree once they found it. If there were any abnormalities, then they would consider it a success. What would happen after the Jade Tablet was hung on the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree? He was very curious. The mastermind had schemed meticulously, layer upon layer, hiding the rewards in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region. Were there truly rewards, or were there other plans? Ye Yun resolved to wait and see.
When Ye Yun disappeared, the restriction around them also vanished.
Lei Qinian led Jun Moxiao a few steps forward, and both of them sat cross-legged on the ground, waiting for the Heavenly Moon Secret Region to open.
"Another fellow cultivator has arrived?"
The pale-faced youth was shocked when he saw how young Jun Moxiao was—about fourteen or fifteen years old—yet already at the First Level of Nirvana Realm. He quickly came over to greet them.
Lei Qinian gave a brief introduction.
"Brother Lei, this isn’t right of you! This brother’s cultivation base isn’t as high as mine, yet you team up with him and not with me. What do you mean by this?" the pale-faced youth complained, somewhat annoyed.
"Things are different now, and some matters are not for outsiders to know," Lei Qinian said with a light laugh.
The pale-faced youth had no choice but to sigh and shake his head repeatedly.
Jun Moxiao found this amusing but said nothing.
The three of them waited silently.
Several Time Units later, a sudden exclamation came from up ahead.
"The Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree has appeared!"
All three quickly looked in the direction of the sound.
The void trembled, and a colossal Osmanthus tree materialized from it. This was only a phantom of the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree.
Above this Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree, a vortex spun continuously, emitting an astonishing spatial fluctuation.
"The Heavenly Moon Secret Region has appeared!"
Many cultivators were extremely excited. They immediately took out their Heavenly Moon Order, and a beam of light shot from it towards the vortex.
Jun Moxiao stroked his chin, his expression calm, not rushing to act. Lei Qinian was the same. Both had special tasks and thus felt no need to rush.
"Fellow cultivators, why don’t we hurry in?" the pale-faced youth asked, sounding a bit anxious.
"Let’s wait a little longer. We shouldn’t rush; there are too many people right now," Lei Qinian said, shaking his head.
"Then I’ll go in first." The pale-faced youth didn’t want to wait any longer. He took out his Heavenly Moon Order, shot into the air, transformed into a streak of light, and flew directly into the vortex.
After a while, seeing that a good portion of the surrounding cultivators had disappeared, Lei Qinian turned to Jun Moxiao and smiled, "Brother Jun, shall we go in?"
"Let’s go!" Jun Moxiao agreed. The two took out their Heavenly Moon Orders, transformed into two rays of light, and flew into the vortex.
Their surroundings seemed to shift and whirl. After a few seconds, they landed on the ground.
Then, their vision blurred, and they found themselves in a Miniature World. This Miniature World was rich in Spiritual Energy. Lofty mountain ranges extended endlessly in the distance, while nearby, a small river babbled and grass grew luxuriantly.
About a hundred zhang ahead of them stood a giant temple, also about a hundred zhang tall, glittering splendidly. Many cultivators were going in and out of this temple.
"Why is there a temple here?" After entering, Jun Moxiao was surprised to see the towering temple.
This seemed utterly different from the Secret Realm he had imagined.
"Our luck is good! The place we teleported to has a Great Saint Temple! Let’s hurry in, burn some incense, and pray for a safe journey!" Lei Qinian said excitedly, taking Jun Moxiao by the arm and walking towards the grand temple.
As the two drew nearer, Jun Moxiao saw a giant plaque hanging over the temple gate.
On the plaque, the words "Great Saint Temple" were written in large, shining gold characters.

chapters.title: Chapter 320: Great Saint in the Great Saint Temple
chapters.content:
Chapter 320: Chapter 320: Great Saint in the Great Saint Temple
"Brother Lei, why is there a temple in this Heavenly Moon Secret Region?" Jun Moxiao asked with a bewildered look as he walked along.
"I don’t know either. According to legend, there’s supposed to be a temple here. Some lucky people find it, while others who aren’t so lucky don’t. Let’s quickly go in and offer some incense," Lei Qinian said enthusiastically.
The two conversed as they walked and soon entered the temple’s gate, stepping into the main hall.
This temple had only one main hall.
Inside, the main hall was very tall and extremely spacious.
In the very center stood a colossal statue, nearly a thousand feet high, emanating an imposing and majestic aura that inspired awe in all who beheld it.
Upon seeing this massive statue, Jun Moxiao’s expression suddenly froze.
It was a monkey. No, it was more like a Black Devil Monkey.
This Black Devil Monkey stood in the main hall, radiating a domineering aura. It held a black staff in its hand, its gaze sharp and its formidable presence palpable, as it stared into the distance.
Many Cultivators took out incense sticks, lit three each, and placed them into an incense burner in front of the statue.
The incense smoke curled upwards, gradually filling the main hall.
Many Cultivators clasped their hands together, praying devoutly to the statue in the Great Saint Temple.
Jun Moxiao listened intently and gathered that they were mostly praying to obtain more Tianyue Osmanthus Fruits within the Heavenly Moon Secret Region.
Lei Qinian took out six incense sticks, lit them, and handed three to Jun Moxiao. Then, he chuckled and said, "This Great Saint in the Great Saint Temple is likely the guardian Spirit of the Heavenly Moon Secret Region. They say prayers here are very efficacious. Offering some incense and a prayer certainly won’t hurt."
After speaking, Lei Qinian walked over to the incense burner, bowed, placed his incense into the burner, clasped his hands together, and began murmuring prayers.
Jun Moxiao, seeing no other option, followed suit and copied his actions.
In Jun Moxiao’s mind, Ye Yun’s gaze flickered slightly upon seeing this divine statue.
This divine statue was just that—a statue; he found nothing particularly special about it.
Although there was nothing extraordinary, the sudden appearance of this temple was somewhat surprising to Ye Yun. It seemed a great secret was hidden within this Secret Realm.
Since he was concealed in Jun Moxiao’s mind, it wasn’t convenient for Ye Yun to use his Divine Sense to investigate. He wasn’t in a hurry anyway, so he settled down for the moment and focused on his Cultivation.
After Jun Moxiao and Lei Qinian had offered their incense and prayed, they walked out of the Great Saint Temple.
"Brother Jun, we should have a great harvest this time," Lei Qinian said with a laugh.
"Let’s hope so," Jun Moxiao echoed.
The two of them then set off, flying towards the mountain range in the distance.
The closer they drew to the mountain range, the more vast swathes of Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Trees they could see growing upon it.
Seeing so many Osmanthus trees, Jun Moxiao’s expression turned grim.
His ancestor had instructed him to hang a Jade Tablet on a Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree after entering the Heavenly Moon Secret Region. But with Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Trees blanketing the mountains everywhere, which specific tree should he hang it on?
Jun Moxiao took out the Jade Tablet and clutched it in his hand.
The two of them approached a Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree. Lei Qinian scanned it up and down but found no Tianyue Osmanthus Fruits.
He couldn’t help but shake his head.
"Brother Lei, why are there so many Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Trees here?" Jun Moxiao asked, furrowing his brows.
Lei Qinian chuckled and said, "The Osmanthus trees in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region are also classified by age. Generally, only Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Trees over a hundred years old bear fruit that is beneficial to us. This particular one is only a little over ten years old and hasn’t reached fruiting age yet."
"What’s the age of the oldest Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree in the Secret Realm?" A thought struck Jun Moxiao, and he quickly asked.
"The oldest are likely the Ten Thousand Year Osmanthus Trees. It’s said there are two or three of them, but they’ve all gained sentience and no one knows where they hide. Finding them is extremely difficult," Lei Qinian said with a sigh.
The Tianyue Osmanthus Fruits his Lei Family ancestors had hidden in the Secret Realm were, at most, a thousand years old. They could be considered of high to superior quality. As for ten-thousand-year-old Tianyue Osmanthus Fruits, it was said that only those blessed with immense destiny ever had the chance to encounter them.
After hearing Lei Qinian’s words, Jun Moxiao seemed to understand something.
He now had a bold speculation: perhaps hanging the Jade Tablet on a Ten Thousand Year Osmanthus Tree was the only way to complete the task his ancestor had given him. However, he still wanted to try it on ordinary Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Trees first.
With this thought, Jun Moxiao hung the Jade Tablet he was holding onto a branch of the Osmanthus tree in front of him.
"What are you doing?" Lei Qinian asked curiously.
"I don’t know either. This is what my ancestor asked me to do," Jun Moxiao said with a wry smile.
Hearing it was an instruction from Jun Moxiao’s ancestor, Lei Qinian’s expression turned serious.
After all, that white-robed senior had shown him immense kindness.
"Don’t worry, Brother Jun. I’ll help you find old Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Trees," Lei Qinian said, patting his chest reassuringly.
His ancestors had hidden thousand-year-old Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Trees in a certain location; he wondered if they could find any Ten Thousand Year Osmanthus Trees nearby.
"Then thank you very much, Brother Lei," Jun Moxiao said gratefully.
The Jade Tablet hung on the branch of the Osmanthus tree, swaying gently in the breeze, but nothing happened.
Jun Moxiao took the Jade Tablet down, walked a few steps forward, and hung it on the branch of another Osmanthus tree.
Still, there was no reaction.
After testing more than ten trees, Jun Moxiao finally reached a conclusion.
These Osmanthus trees, all less than a hundred years old and showing no unusual phenomena, were definitely not the kind his ancestor required.
So, he followed Lei Qinian, leaving that area and venturing deeper into the mountain range.
Although it was Lei Qinian’s first time here, he was surprisingly familiar with the terrain. Despite occasionally getting lost, he would always find the correct path after walking for a while.
Along the way, they encountered some hundred-year-old Osmanthus trees. Jun Moxiao tried his experiment again, but still, there was no reaction.
Observing this, Ye Yun nodded to himself.
These ordinary Osmanthus trees lacked spiritual nature and thus wouldn’t react to the Jade Tablet.
Presumably, if they found the Ten Thousand Year Osmanthus Trees, those sentient trees would be able to recognize the Jade Tablet and then bestow rewards.
These rewards were naturally intended for the Shen Heng Sect. It was just that now, Jun Moxiao was the recipient.
"If, as Lei Qinian said, there are Ten Thousand Year Osmanthus Trees here, then the one capable of recognizing the Jade Tablet must be at least a twenty-thousand-year-old Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree," Ye Yun mused.
The first-generation patriarch of the Shen Heng Sect had accepted that task ten thousand years ago.
If the hidden manipulator had set things up in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region back then, it meant that at least ten thousand years ago, there was already a ten-thousand-year-old Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree in the Secret Realm.
That would make it twenty thousand years old by now.
Ye Yun guessed that in the entire Tianyuan Secret Realm, there was probably only one such twenty-thousand-year-old Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree. As for the other Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Trees, their ages were likely just over ten thousand years.
「...」
After Lei Qinian and Jun Moxiao had journeyed deeper into the mountain range for two to three Time Units, they suddenly heard the sounds of fighting up ahead.
They crossed a valley and looked ahead.
There, they saw more than a dozen black Monkeys attacking a young man from all sides.
This young man was no stranger to them.
It was the same fair-faced young man who had been repeatedly inviting Lei Qinian to join his group.
Currently under siege by these dozen or so black Monkeys, he was already in grave danger.

chapters.title: Chapter 321: The Monkey Raised by the Great Saint
chapters.content:
Chapter 321: Chapter 321: The Monkey Raised by the Great Saint
These Black Monkeys were each tall and robust. Every Monkey wielded a staff, their staff techniques tricky and their attacks formidable. A flurry of staff shadows rained down from all directions. The pale-faced young man was completely outmatched and, under the assault of over a dozen Black Monkeys, had already been struck countless times.
"Are these Monkeys all at the Nirvana Realm?" Jun Moxiao exclaimed in surprise.
"Bro, we should quickly go and give him a hand!" Lei Qinian, ever righteous, seeing the pale-faced young man in dire straits, drew his sword and rushed forward.
Jun Moxiao followed suit, drawing his Chaos Element Unlimited Sword.
Two beams of sword light whistled in, descending suddenly from behind on either side, catching the Monkeys completely off guard.
The Monkeys shrieked chaotically. After a brief attempt to counterattack, they swiftly fled.
"Brother, are you alright?" Lei Qinian asked, approaching the pale-faced youth quickly once he saw the Monkeys had all fled. He didn’t bother to pursue them.
"I’ve sustained some injuries, but they’re not serious. Thank you both, Brothers, for your righteous assistance," the pale-faced young man said, his expression filled with gratitude as he looked at Lei Qinian and Jun Moxiao.
"Don’t mention it," Lei Qinian replied. "This place is incredibly dangerous; you need to be more careful, Brother."
"Brother Lei, why are there so many Monkeys here?" Jun Moxiao asked quietly, gazing in the direction the Monkeys had fled.
Seeing these Black Monkeys reminded him of the enormous idol in the Great Saint Temple. Wasn’t that also a Black Devil Monkey?
"These Monkeys, legend says, are raised by the Great Saint," Lei Qinian explained. "They are numerous and scattered throughout the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, posing the primary threat to us Cultivators who enter."
"Since they’re raised by the Great Saint, can these Monkeys be killed?" Jun Moxiao asked again.
"Absolutely not!" Lei Qinian said quickly, his expression tightening. "If you kill one, it will attract even more Monkeys. There’s also a saying that killing these Monkeys might provoke the Great Saint’s wrath and bring down heavenly retribution."
Jun Moxiao nodded solemnly.
This Heavenly Moon Secret Region is certainly interesting, he thought. There’s an elusive Great Saint who raises a troop of Black Monkeys. These Monkeys can attack Cultivators, but Cultivators can’t kill them. How is that fair?
Seeing Jun Moxiao’s expression, Lei Qinian couldn’t help but chuckle. "Bro, these Monkeys love all sorts of medicinal pills. If you give them pills they find satisfactory, they usually won’t take a Cultivator’s life."
"That’s truly strange. Is there really such a saying?" Jun Moxiao was momentarily stunned.
He took a deep breath and gazed in the direction the Monkeys had fled, a smile forming on his lips. He found this place truly fascinating. The Ancestor’s arrangements had led him to a good place indeed. This should be much better than the Nine Soul Underground Palace.
"Brother Lei is right," the pale-faced young man said with a bitter smile, swallowing a healing pill. "It was because I didn’t have any good medicinal pills on me that those Monkeys attacked. When I fought back, they just got angrier and angrier, eventually injuring me severely."
"Be more careful in the future. See these Monkeys? Steer clear of them," Lei Qinian advised.
Then he looked at Jun Moxiao and said, "Let’s go."
Jun Moxiao nodded.
"Brother Lei, this place is so perilous! You can’t just abandon me here alone!" the pale-faced young man cried out anxiously when he saw they were about to leave him.
Lei Qinian sighed and turned back. "Brother, we truly have important matters to attend to and cannot take you with us. How about this? I have a bottle of medicinal pills here; take it." With that, Lei Qinian produced a small white porcelain vial and handed it to the pale-faced youth.
The pale-faced young man sighed again but had no choice but to accept the porcelain vial. He then clasped his fists in salute and said gratefully, "Thank you for your profound kindness, Brother Lei. If fate allows us to meet again, I will surely repay you generously."
"You’re too kind, Brother," Lei Qinian said with a smile, returning the fist clasp. Then, he departed with Jun Moxiao.
In Jun Moxiao’s mind, Ye Yun was quite intrigued by Lei Qinian’s words. The sudden appearance of the Great Saint Temple was already peculiar. Even more unexpected was the presence of a troop of Monkeys in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, apparently raised by this Great Saint. But where exactly in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region was this Great Saint, elusive as a Divine Dragon showing only its tail but not its head, hiding? Could there be a connection to the Jade Tablet from the Shen Heng Sect? Ye Yun chuckled inwardly, deciding to wait and see. This was a perfect opportunity for a greenhorn like Jun Moxiao to gain experience and, in doing so, slowly unveil the mysteries of the Heavenly Moon Secret Region.
Jun Moxiao followed Lei Qinian, traversing mountains and crossing ridges for an unknown amount of time. Along their journey, they witnessed numerous Cultivators besieged by Black Monkeys.
Some Cultivators managed to use medicinal pills to temporarily alleviate their crisis. Others, however, were beaten black and blue by the Monkeys, barely clinging to life.
Yet, the Monkeys never delivered a killing blow. After injuring the Cultivators, they would let out a few strange chattering cries and then vanish into the mountain forests like a gust of wind.
This sight couldn’t help but leave Jun Moxiao marveling.
Besides these encounters, Jun Moxiao also began to spot centuries-old Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Trees. These trees had started to bear fruit.
The fruits came in two types. One was green; according to Lei Qinian, this type was inedible and contained a lethal poison. Only when the fruit turned golden yellow could it be picked and consumed.
However, they hadn’t seen any golden fruits along their path. Presumably, any mature ones had already been snatched up by others who arrived earlier.
After cresting another hill, they spotted a Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree growing in a small mountain hollow.
This particular Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree looked to be at least several centuries old.
What made Jun Moxiao even more excited was the sight of a single, gleaming golden Laurel fruit hanging on one of its branches. Apart from this one golden Laurel fruit, all the others were still green.
"It’s not easy to find a mature Laurel fruit," Lei Qinian said with a smile. "Bro, this one’s for you. Why don’t you try it first?"
Lei Qinian had millennia-old Laurel fruit stored by his ancestors, so he had little interest in these merely centuries-old ones. Since this was Jun Moxiao’s first time in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, he offered the Laurel fruit to him.
Jun Moxiao hesitated for a moment before nodding in agreement.
The two of them quickly descended from the hilltop and flew towards the hollow.
Suddenly, an even faster streak of sword light shot over from the distance, landing beside the Cassia Tree. It materialized into a red-robed youth.
He reached out, intending to take the golden Laurel fruit for himself.
"Stop!" Jun Moxiao yelled, rushing forward.
He hadn’t expected that the Laurel fruit he had spotted first would be snatched away by someone else.
"Get lost!" the red-robed youth snapped, his gaze sweeping coldly over Jun Moxiao and Lei Qinian.
With that said, he abruptly shot out his hand and plucked the Laurel fruit from the branch.

chapters.title: Chapter 322: Xuanyang Sect Disciple
chapters.content:
Chapter 322: Chapter 322: Xuanyang Sect Disciple
"Scram?"
Jun Moxiao stiffened, a wave of anger surging in his chest.
This red-clothed youth was too arrogant. Not only did he snatch the golden laurel fruit that they had discovered first, but he was even telling them to beat it.
Jun Moxiao immediately drew his Chaos Element Unlimited Sword, ready to charge forward and engage in battle with this red-clothed youth.
"Brother Jun, this guy is from the Xuanyang Sect," Lei Qinian abruptly grabbed Jun Moxiao’s arm, murmuring softly.
"Xuanyang Sect? Never heard of it." Jun Moxiao shook his head, his eyes gleaming with deadly intent.
Seeing such murderous intent on Jun Moxiao’s youthful face, Lei Qinian couldn’t help but be startled. As the killing intent radiating from Jun Moxiao intensified,
how could he possibly know how many people Jun Moxiao had actually killed?
"The Xuanyang Sect is one of the four major forces in the Heavenly Moon Dynasty. Just like the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, they are both Superior great sects," Lei Qinian explained in a low voice.
Although the red-clothed youth opposite them was at the Nirvana Realm Third Level, he definitely shouldn’t be underestimated. Who knew if other Xuanyang Sect disciples were lurking nearby? If they angered this red-clothed youth, they would likely invite retaliation from the Xuanyang Sect. And with Jun Moxiao only at the First Level of the Nirvana Realm, Lei Qinian was also worried he would rush up and needlessly get himself killed. Of course, if there was real danger, he wouldn’t just stand by; he would naturally help Jun Moxiao deal with the red-clothed youth. But if that happened, they would both offend the Xuanyang Sect and could invite violent retaliation from its other disciples. As a result, neither of them might be able to complete their respective missions.
Lei Qinian, being older and more mature than Jun Moxiao, naturally considered more factors. He could be patient, but Jun Moxiao, barely thirteen or fourteen, was at an age where, like a newborn calf unafraid of a tiger, his youthful impulsiveness often got the better of him.
"Since you two know I’m from the Xuanyang Sect, why don’t you scram now!" the red-clothed youth sneered, preparing to pop the golden laurel fruit he’d just picked into his mouth.
Even though it’s only a centuries-old laurel fruit, it can still help improve one’s aptitude,
he thought.
"Go to hell!"
Lei Qinian had his reservations, but Jun Moxiao had none. With a furious roar, he activated the Dragon God’s Nine Changes Method, transforming into an illusory Divine Dragon and lunging at the red-clothed youth.
A stream of sword light, intertwined with the phantom of a Divine Dragon, descended upon the red-clothed youth.
The mocking expression on the red-clothed youth’s face suddenly froze.
He hadn’t expected that the youth at the First Level Nirvana Realm opposite him would actually dare to attack, even knowing he was a Xuanyang Sect disciple!
Angry, he retaliated with a backhand sword strike; a swathe of red sword light, like a sea of fire, poured down from the sky.
BOOM!
Jun Moxiao’s sword strike, like a Jiao Dragon emerging from the sea, directly tore through the sea of fiery sword light and descended upon the red-clothed youth.
The red-clothed youth, sensing imminent danger, immediately retreated. But he was half a step too late; the sword instantly carved a deep, bloody gash on his shoulder.
Blood gushed out.
The red-clothed youth stared at Jun Moxiao, his face filled with horror.
A mere First Level Nirvana Realm boy wounded me with a single strike! This fellow’s strength is not to be underestimated!
"Here!" He hurriedly hurled the golden laurel fruit in his hand towards Jun Moxiao, then transformed into a red light and vanished into the air.
By the time Jun Moxiao caught the golden laurel fruit, the red-clothed man had disappeared.
"Good heavens!" Lei Qinian walked over, a shocked look on his face. "Brother Jun, I didn’t expect you to be this strong! You wounded him with a single strike despite being two realms below that Xuanyang Sect disciple. You are truly worthy of being a disciple of our predecessor."
"You’re too kind, Brother Lei." Jun Moxiao smiled sheepishly and put away his Chaos Element Unlimited Sword.
"Try this fruit quickly; I’ve heard it’s delicious," Lei Qinian said with a soft laugh.
"Since Brother Lei is so generous, I won’t be polite." Jun Moxiao chuckled, then brought the golden laurel fruit to his lips and took a bite.
A sweet, delectable sensation filled his mouth, flowed down into his abdomen, and immediately transformed into a cooling feeling that spread throughout his entire body. At that moment, he sensed some kind of change within his body, but when he tried to pinpoint it, he couldn’t find where the change had occurred.
Encouraged, Jun Moxiao unceremoniously ate the rest of the golden laurel fruit. After finishing it, he felt his body become somewhat lighter.
"Brother Jun, we should hurry and leave. That Xuanyang Sect disciple who escaped might call his sect members to seek revenge on us," Lei Qinian cautioned, glancing around warily in a low voice.
Jun Moxiao also nodded gravely.
Even though he had struck out in anger and wounded that Xuanyang Sect disciple, he realized he had probably stirred up significant trouble. Now that they were in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, things were completely different from the outside. Here, he could only rely on himself and Lei Qinian. If the Xuanyang Sect sent many cultivators, the two of them alone likely wouldn’t be able to defeat them; there was even a high chance they could perish.
Thinking of this, a strong sense of crisis welled up in Jun Moxiao’s heart.
"Brother Lei, I’m sorry for dragging you into this," Jun Moxiao said, his face etched with guilt.
"Brother Jun, don’t say that. In this Heavenly Moon Secret Region, we are brothers who will live and die together. I need to complete the task my ancestor entrusted to me, and you need to complete the task your senior assigned you. Neither of us can afford to die here," Lei Qinian said, clapping Jun Moxiao on the shoulder.
"Let’s go, Brother Lei." Jun Moxiao nodded, his expression more somber than before.
Lei Qinian surveyed their surroundings, chose a direction, and then quietly led Jun Moxiao away from the area.
「Not long after the two of them left.」
Immediately, four or five Xuanyang Sect disciples landed at the spot.
When they didn’t find Jun Moxiao and Lei Qinian, they cursed a few times and departed.
"Relay this message to all Xuanyang Sect disciples within the Heavenly Moon Secret Region: if you see these two loose cultivators, kill them without mercy!" While in flight, one of the young men issued the command, his face cold.
Another young man beside him immediately took out several Flying Swords. With a flick of his hand, these Flying Swords flew off in all directions.
Sword-flying Messenger.
The Xuanyang Sect disciples would likely receive these sword-messages soon. Once they found those two, they would be annihilated with a single, decisive strike.
Lei Qinian, after all, had roamed the Jianghu for years and understood its intricacies. Therefore, he was extremely cautious as he led Jun Moxiao onward, quickly taking cover whenever he detected anyone nearby.
Thus, a day passed, and the two of them remained unharmed. Although they hadn’t encountered any danger, they also hadn’t made any significant gains. They hadn’t even found a single century-old laurel fruit.
Jun Moxiao, however, was rather indifferent.
After all, his mission for entering the Heavenly Moon Secret Region was simply to find the Cassia Tree and hang the token on it.
And Lei Qinian, focused on finding the thousand-year-old laurel fruit hidden by his ancestor, naturally wouldn’t bother competing with other cultivators for mere centuries-old ones.
"Brother Lei, where exactly is that place you mentioned?" Jun Moxiao asked while they were resting on a large boulder.
"Don’t be anxious. The Heavenly Moon Secret Region is extremely vast. It will probably take four or five days to get there from here," Lei Qinian replied with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 323: Monkey that loves to eat elixir
chapters.content:
Chapter 323: Chapter 323: Monkey that loves to eat elixir
"It will take that long?" Jun Moxiao exclaimed, taken aback by Lei Qinian’s words.
"Yes! So, there’s no need for you to be too anxious. This trial in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region will take at least a month," Lei Qinian said with a smile.
"Alright," Jun Moxiao nodded.
"As one of the four major powers in the Heavenly Moon Dynasty, the Xuanyang Sect always retaliates in kind. Brother Jun, since you’ve injured one of their disciples this time, I fear they won’t rest until they get even. Therefore, we must be doubly careful in the coming days," Lei Qinian spoke gravely as he gazed at the undulating mountain range in the distance.
"Brother Lei, I understand," Jun Moxiao said.
CHATTER! CHATTER! CHATTER! CHATTER!
Suddenly, a cacophony of sharp, discordant noises erupted from the distant forest.
Lei Qinian’s expression changed slightly. "Oh no! There are a lot of monkeys over there!"
Both of them quickly stood up, only to see dozens of monkeys emerging from a nearby patch of jungle.
These monkeys were covered in black fur, each wielding a stick, chattering wildly as they charged towards them. Their targets were precisely the two of them.
Jun Moxiao drew his sword.
Lei Qinian held him back, saying in a low voice, "Brother Jun, don’t be impulsive. I have a pill here. Hopefully, we can bluff our way through. After all, there are too many monkeys this time, and the two of us alone may not be able to fend them off."
Seeing how seriously Lei Qinian regarded these monkeys, Jun Moxiao reluctantly nodded and sheathed his sword again.
The monkeys swarmed forward, surrounding them completely. There were a good seventy or eighty of them.
Each monkey’s cultivation base was at least at the First Level Nirvana Realm, and some had even reached the Fifth Level of Nirvana Realm.
Jun Moxiao’s facial muscles twitched. He could now understand Lei Qinian’s concern.
If so many monkeys attacked them simultaneously, even if Jun Moxiao could escape using the Divine Dragon Nine-Change Body Technique, Lei Qinian wouldn’t be able to. His ancestor had once instructed him to always team up with Lei Qinian and never go solo. So, Jun Moxiao now understood that Lei Qinian’s caution this time was correct.
Facing the monkeys, they could only try to outsmart them.
The monkeys thumped the ground with their sticks, making loud POUNDING sounds, while waving something in the air with their other hands and chattering.
Although these monkeys had high cultivation bases, they couldn’t speak human language, clearly different from the demon beasts outside.
Lei Qinian smiled at the monkeys and said, "Brother Monkeys, no need to be hasty. I have some pills here."
Hearing his words, the monkeys seemed to understand. They jumped about excitedly, chattering away.
Maintaining a smile, Lei Qinian took out a small bottle and tossed it to one of the monkeys.
The monkeys immediately pounced, but the strongest among them snatched the small bottle and uncorked it.
It peered inside, then poured out all the pills. There were over a hundred red pills in total.
The monkeys pounced on them excitedly. Each monkey grabbed one or two pills, stuffing them into their mouths and chattering excitedly as they chewed.
Seeing this, Lei Qinian couldn’t help but feel relieved. His ancestor had once entered the Heavenly Moon Secret Region and had written a journal detailing his experiences, even including a map drawn from memory. That was why he had specifically prepared some pills this time for these monkeys. He hoped that after the monkeys ate the pills, they would quickly leave.
After ingesting the pills, the lead monkey tossed the empty bottle aside. It licked its lips, seemingly unsatisfied, and began striking the ground repeatedly with its stick again. The other monkeys followed suit, ceaselessly beating the ground and producing a dense barrage of THUMPING sounds.
I didn’t expect these monkeys to have such big appetites,
Lei Qinian thought, surprised they still wanted more pills. Generally, giving them something once was enough; these monkeys had been quite reasonable in the past.As Lei Qinian was about to take out another bottle of pills, Jun Moxiao suddenly patted his shoulder and stepped forward.
"Brother Lei, you can’t always be the one footing the bill. Let me handle this one," Jun Moxiao said with a chuckle.
Then, he rummaged in his God-level storage ring and took out seven or eight small bottles, tossing them to the strongest monkey.
The monkey reached out its large hand, instantly catching the bottles. It then chattered excitedly at Jun Moxiao twice. Its expression seemed to say, "You’re a good kid!"
Jun Moxiao chuckled, cupped his fists, and spoke to the lead monkey, "Brother Monkeys, we still need to find those Laurel Fruits. Could you let us pass?"
The lead monkey opened a bottle, glanced inside, its face lighting up with excitement. It then hopped back a few steps and pointed into the distance with its stick. The other monkeys then dispersed, clearing a path.
Seeing the monkeys finally satisfied, Jun Moxiao breathed a sigh of relief. He exchanged a look with Lei Qinian, and the two quickly departed.
Once they were a safe distance away, Lei Qinian finally burst out laughing.
"Junior Brother Jun, I had no idea you had so many pills! You’re quite the tycoon!"
"I suppose so," Jun Moxiao said, scratching his head and laughing a little sheepishly. He had a considerable number of pills in his storage ring; he had acquired many from when he and his senior sisters constantly challenged various Sects.
It’s no big deal to give some to these monkeys,
he thought.
The two continued their journey.
After crossing a few mountaintops, they spotted another group of monkeys. This group was scattered beneath a giant Osmanthus tree. Some were frolicking, some were sitting and sunbathing, and others were huddled in pairs or trios, grooming lice from each other.
"Wow, so many monkeys! There must be over a hundred of them!" Jun Moxiao exclaimed, surprised by their sheer numbers.
"Junior Brother Jun, this is a thousand-year-old Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree," the nearby Lei Qinian whispered, seemingly ignoring the monkeys as he pointed at the gigantic tree in the distance. "There are quite a few fruits on it; at least seven or eight are ripe."
Hearing Lei Qinian’s words, Jun Moxiao squinted, his gaze quickly focusing on the colossal trunk of the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree.
Indeed, hidden amidst the leaves were seven or eight golden Laurel Fruits. These Laurel Fruits were a whole size larger than the hundred-year-old ones they had found earlier.
"Brother Lei, let’s go! Let’s pick those Laurel Fruits!" Jun Moxiao exclaimed, his excitement palpable as he immediately flew towards the tree.
Lei Qinian followed closely, a worried expression on his face. "Junior Brother Jun, with so many monkeys, I’m afraid they won’t be easy to handle!"

chapters.title: Chapter 324: The Dispute over the Millennium Tianyue Osmanthus Fruit
chapters.content:
Chapter 324: Chapter 324: The Dispute over the Millennium Tianyue Osmanthus Fruit
After hearing Lei Qinian’s words, Jun Moxiao immediately laughed.
"Brother Lei, don’t worry, I have plenty of elixirs," he assured.
"Alright then." Lei Qinian could only nod.
Suddenly, he realized that the youth in front of him, who was only at the First Level Nirvana Realm, was indeed a hidden tycoon.
Lei Qinian once again looked towards the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree.
He speculated that the over one hundred monkeys must have enormous appetites. Guarding this thousand-year-old Cassia tree, they were probably just waiting for cultivators to deliver elixirs to them.
Sure enough, when the two of them approached the Cassia tree, all the monkeys became excited. Picking up sticks from nearby, they quickly surrounded the two of them.
SQUEAK! SQUEAK! SQUEAK! SQUEAK...
The monkeys danced around in excitement, persistently banging their sticks on the ground.
"Brother Monkeys, this is a small token from this little brother, please accept it." Jun Moxiao clasped his fists and said with a broad smile.
After speaking, he skillfully took out more than ten small bottles and tossed them out.
The monkeys swarmed forward, and any bottles they snatched were given to a monkey at the Seventh Level of Nirvanic Realm.
This monkey was clearly the leader of this small group of monkeys.
The leader opened the small bottles, glanced at them, and an excited expression appeared on its face.
Then it poured out the elixirs from these small bottles, inciting a mad scramble among the other monkeys.
The monkeys that had snatched the elixirs stuffed them into their mouths, squeaking wildly, "SQUEAK! SQUEAK! SQUEAK!"
Jun Moxiao ignored this. He looked at the Monkey Leader and said with a smile, "Brother Monkey, we would like to pick the ripe Laurel fruit from the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree. Would you grant us passage?"
Hearing his words, the Monkey Leader immediately began to rapidly bang its stick on the ground.
The other monkeys also followed suit, banging their sticks on the ground.
"Brother Jun, it seems these Brother Monkeys feel the previous elixirs weren’t enough," Lei Qinian said with a wry smile.
"It’s alright, I still have more elixirs." Jun Moxiao smiled calmly, and with a flick of his wrist, produced another dozen or so bottles of elixirs.
Each bottle contained over one hundred elixirs.
He once again tossed these bottles to the Monkey Leader.
The Monkey Leader opened the bottles and again distributed the elixirs.
Yet, it didn’t consume a single elixir itself.
Its eyes gleamed as it continued to stare intently at Jun Moxiao, ceaselessly striking the ground with its stick.
Jun Moxiao’s expression faltered.
Could it be that this Monkey Leader looked down on the elixirs he had offered before?
Jun Moxiao pondered for a moment, then retrieved another small bottle from his storage.
The elixirs in this one should be of a somewhat higher grade than the previous ones.
He tossed this small bottle to the Monkey Leader.
"Brother Monkey, see if these elixirs are to your liking?" Jun Moxiao asked softly.
The Monkey Leader opened the bottle, glanced inside, and its eyes immediately lit up with excitement.
Raising its hand, it actually poured the entire bottle of elixirs into its mouth.
After consuming the elixirs, perhaps because the medicinal power was too potent or it was overly excited, it began to roll around on the ground. Then, it started swinging its stick, performing a set of staff techniques.
WHOOSH! WHOOSH! The shadows of the staff flickered, filling the air and enveloping its entire form.
"Brother Lei, what does this mean? Will it let us pass or not?" Jun Moxiao asked in a low voice, somewhat uncertain.
"Let’s wait a bit longer," Lei Qinian said, his expression solemn.
After finishing the set of staff techniques, the Monkey Leader’s Super Divine Dragon Breath was even stronger than before. It swayed unsteadily as it descended from the air, then pointed a finger towards the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree behind it.
"It seems to be a yes."
Jun Moxiao understood the implied meaning and walked over; the Monkey Leader did not stop him.
The other monkeys, all squatting nearby, also stopped banging their sticks on the ground.
Jun Moxiao arrived beneath the Cassia Tree, then soared into the air and began picking the golden Laurel fruits.
His figure was ethereal, like a butterfly flitting among flowers, weaving through the dense branches. Very quickly, he had collected eight golden Laurel fruits into a cloth bag.
As Jun Moxiao descended from the tree, seven or eight streaks of sword light suddenly flew over from the distance.
The sword lights landed, revealing eight young men dressed in red.
Seeing these eight individuals, Lei Qinian’s pupils contracted slightly.
He hadn’t expected to encounter disciples of the Xuanyang Sect at this moment.
As they flew over, these Xuanyang Sect disciples naturally saw Jun Moxiao picking the golden Laurel fruits.
"Haha... To think we’d stumble upon them here! Those two Loose Cultivators are hiding here and have even picked eight thousand-year-old golden Laurel fruits."
One young man drew his sword, looking at Lei Qinian and Jun Moxiao with a mocking smile.
The other seven also drew their swords, readying themselves for battle.
Seeing these people, Jun Moxiao’s expression also changed slightly.
Among these eight Xuanyang Sect disciples, the weakest cultivation base was at the Nirvana Realm Third Level, while most were at the Fifth Level of Nirvana Realm.
This was a very powerful group.
If they were to truly fight, it would undoubtedly be an arduous battle.
"Hey, kid! Hand over the Laurel fruits in your possession at once, and this great one might spare your life!" a red-clad young man shouted at Jun Moxiao, pointing his sword at him and laughing boisterously.
Jun Moxiao remained silent, not speaking.
At this moment, more than one hundred monkeys still surrounded him.
And these monkeys, upon seeing the eight young men, also didn’t attack immediately.
It was unclear whether they refrained from attacking due to the distance or because, having just eaten elixirs, they were temporarily uninterested in Human Cultivators.
"Brother Jun, it looks like this battle is unavoidable."
Lei Qinian immediately flipped his palm, took out the Heavenly Treasures Cover, and held it above their heads.
Streams of golden light descended from the Heavenly Treasures Cover, enveloping both him and Jun Moxiao.
"Well, well! I didn’t expect that Loose Cultivator to possess such a remarkable treasure. Our martial brothers are truly fortunate today!"
A red-clad young man stared at the Heavenly Treasures Cover above Lei Qinian’s head. Sensing its extraordinary quality, his eyes gleamed with greed.
"Brother Lei, don’t be hasty."
Jun Moxiao, however, became calm and composed. He looked at the Monkey Leader, and with a flip of his hand, another ten small bottles appeared.
"Brother Monkey, we are no match for those humans over there. I wonder if we could offer these elixirs to request Brother Monkey’s assistance just this once?"
After speaking, Jun Moxiao tossed out the ten small bottles in his hand.
These ten small bottles all contained the same type of high-grade elixirs he had offered the Monkey Leader earlier.
The Monkey Leader’s eyes lit up intensely, and it immediately caught the ten small bottles.
It opened one of the bottles, peeked inside, and then began to squeak excitedly, "SQUEAK! SQUEAK! SQUEAK!"
It then fiercely stuffed all these small bottles into its mouth, hiding them in its cheek pouches.
Then, it raised its stick and let out a few sharp squeaks. "SQUEAK! SQUEAK!"
The surrounding monkeys instantly became agitated, raising their sticks and screeching towards the sky.
"Senior Brother, these monkeys... could they have been bribed by that kid?"
A red-clad young man in the distance witnessed this scene, his eyes filled with an incredulous expression.
His words had barely faded when the Monkey Leader let out a furious roar. It transformed into a streak of black light and charged towards them, with the other monkeys following closely behind.
Over one hundred monkeys, like a black tide, surged forward and engulfed the eight red-clad young men.

chapters.title: Chapter 325: Jun Moxiao’s Thoughts
chapters.content:
Chapter 325: Chapter 325: Jun Moxiao’s Thoughts
"Damn it, that guy really managed to bribe these monkeys!" a red-clad youth yelled, his face a mask of terror as he watched the rain of clubs descend from the monkeys.
Although their Xuanyang Sect was powerful and influential in the Heavenly Moon Dynasty, that wasn’t the case within the Heavenly Moon Secret Region. These monkeys were one of the dominant forces in the secret region. If they killed a monkey, it would likely provoke retaliation from the entire troop. It could even incite the fury of the legendary Great Saint, bringing down divine punishment.
This troop of black monkeys moved swiftly, enveloping them like a cloud of smoke. The red-clad youths had no other option but to draw their swords and prepare for battle. Escape was impossible at this point; their only option was to fight.
The two sides clashed instantly.
In no time, the monkeys wielding clubs had thrashed the eight red-clad youths, sending them into a terrified rout. Fortunately, they were using clubs and not blades; otherwise, these eight red-clad youths would have been hacked to pieces long ago.
Seeing this, Lei Qinian couldn’t help but laugh heartily. "You’ve really got some tricks, Brother Jun!"
"Brother Lei, we should leave quickly! If they use the same tactic, these monkeys might turn on us," Jun Moxiao said with an awkward grin, pulling Lei Qinian as they both swiftly fled the scene.
"Stop hitting, Brother Monkeys! I have Healing Pills too!" one of the red-clad youths finally came to his senses. He hastily pulled out a few small porcelain bottles and tossed them out.
WHOOSH.
Instantly, several monkeys scrambled over and snatched the small bottles. The other red-clad youths quickly followed suit, throwing out their Healing Pills. Only then did the monkeys cease their attack.
Seeing the Healing Pills, the monkeys became extremely excited and scurried back under the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree.
Having been beaten up for no reason, all eight youths were bruised and battered, their faces swollen. However, none of the injuries were life-threatening. Although these monkeys were ferocious, they thankfully hadn’t aimed for vital spots.
"Damn our luck! Not only did we fail to get the Laurel fruits, but those two Loose Cultivators also escaped!" one of the red-clad youths roared in fury.
"Next time, we must capture them! Only by cutting them into a thousand pieces can we vent the hatred in our hearts!" another red-clad youth declared.
The other red-clad youths chimed in with curses, then swallowed some Healing Pills and departed. Of course, they couldn’t spend all their time searching for the two Loose Cultivators. Upon entering the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, their priority was also to find Laurel fruits.
Ye Yun’s wisp of Primordial Spirit couldn’t help but smile upon seeing Jun Moxiao and Lei Qinian escape danger.
The Monkey Leader from before was affected by a minor Illusion Technique I cast,
Ye Yun mused.
That’s why it so readily agreed to Jun Moxiao’s request. Otherwise, ten bottles of Healing Pills would never have been enough to tempt that monkey.
After traveling for half a day, Lei Qinian and Jun Moxiao felt they were out of danger. They found a cave and decided to rest for a while.
Jun Moxiao took out a bag, retrieved four Laurel fruits, and handed them to Lei Qinian.
Lei Qinian quickly shook his head, laughing. "Brother Jun, I don’t need these fruits. You keep them."
"Brother Lei, we’ll split them fifty-fifty." Jun Moxiao paused for a moment but still offered the four golden Laurel fruits.
Seeing this, Lei Qinian sighed and accepted them.
He suddenly became aware of his own selfish thoughts and felt a pang of guilt. This young Brother Jun Moxiao, despite his youth, is incredibly upright and truly a man of noble character. He just used so many Healing Pills to trade for Laurel fruits and even dealt with the Monkey Leader to resolve their crisis. I shouldn’t keep all these thousand-year-old Laurel fruits, left by my ancestors, for myself,
Lei Qinian thought.
I should share half with Jun Moxiao.
Thinking this, his mood lightened.
The two began to eat the millennium-old Laurel fruits. A refreshing sensation flowed into their stomachs, spreading throughout their bodies and continually improving their aptitude. This made both of them feel extremely comfortable. The four golden Laurel fruits each of them held were quickly eaten.
Then, the two of them continued on their journey.
Along the way, they saw many disciples from the Xuanyang Sect. These disciples were rushing about. If they encountered Cultivators from other sects, they would approach to inquire. Then they would show two portraits, asking these Cultivators to identify the people in them.
Lei Qinian and Jun Moxiao hid behind a distant mountain. Lei Qinian looked at the two figures in the portraits and couldn’t help but smile bitterly. "It seems the Xuanyang Sect has indeed taken notice of us. The entire sect is now hunting for us."
"Brother Lei, don’t worry," Jun Moxiao said, shaking his head dismissively. "The Xuanyang Sect disciples wouldn’t mobilize heavily just for two Loose Cultivators like us. After all, their primary task is to locate the Tianyue Osmanthus Fruits."
His gaze, however, fell upon another part of the jungle. In that patch of forest, a group of monkeys had surrounded several Cultivators. They were continuously banging their clubs on the ground, apparently trying to extort Healing Pills.
"Brother Jun, do you have an idea?" Lei Qinian asked hurriedly, seeing Jun Moxiao’s confident expression.
"Brother Lei, perhaps we can recruit a group of monkeys to escort us," an idea flashed through Jun Moxiao’s mind, and he said with a grin.
"Recruit monkeys?" Lei Qinian was stunned. He had never heard of anyone attempting such a thing in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region.
These monkeys are unruly and wild. Human Cultivators can only get past them by bribing them with Healing Pills. How could they possibly be recruited?
Jun Moxiao smiled. "Brother Lei, we can try it out later. We’ll know then..."
With that, he gave Lei Qinian a meaningful look, and the two of them left the mountain range. Since Xuanyang Sect disciples were searching for them ahead, they changed direction and continued on their way.
「Four hours later.」
They were extremely lucky to find another millennium-old Cassia Tree. Beneath this Cassia Tree, more than a hundred monkeys were guarding it.
"Haha, this Cassia Tree has mature fruits too!" Lei Qinian exclaimed, his eyes lighting up with excitement as he spotted golden glints among the tree’s green leaves.
Jun Moxiao was also thrilled. After all, no one had discovered this millennium-old Cassia Tree yet. This time, it would be their gain again.
The two quickly flew over, approaching the Cassia Tree.
When the monkeys saw Human Cultivators approaching, they immediately grew excited. CHITTERING loudly, they raised their clubs and charged. They continuously banged their clubs on the ground, producing rapid, POUNDING sounds.
Lei Qinian quickly took out a few small bottles, ready to throw them.
"Brother Lei, you don’t need to spend yours. I’ll take care of it," Jun Moxiao said with a smile.
He knew Lei Qinian wasn’t wealthy. To gather enough Spirit Stones for a Token to the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, Lei Qinian had even sold his ancestral heirloom to the Old Ancestor.

chapters.title: Chapter 326: Recruiting Monkey (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 326: Chapter 326: Recruiting Monkey (Part 1)
"Brother Jun, how can I keep letting you cover all the expenses?"
Upon hearing Jun Moxiao’s words, Lei Qinian’s old face flushed red, his expression becoming quite embarrassed.
"Brother Lei, don’t be so polite with me. We’re brothers here, no outsiders. Besides, my ancestor and the Lei Family share some history, so here, there’s no need for such distinctions between us," Jun Moxiao said with a smile.
The pills in his storage ring were immense in quantity, more than enough to recruit a troop of monkeys.
As for the pills in Lei Qinian’s Storage Ring, he likely had a pitifully small amount, barely enough for his own survival in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region. Wanting to recruit these monkeys with that would be like trying to extinguish a burning cart of firewood with a cup of water—completely insufficient.
"Sigh, alright then," Lei Qinian reluctantly nodded. He was indeed short on resources and didn’t have many pills left.
Jun Moxiao took out some small bottles, about a dozen or so. Spotting the monkey with the highest cultivation base among them, one at the Nirvana Realm Sixth Level, Jun Moxiao clasped his hands in a salute and said loudly, "Brother Monkeys, this is a small token of goodwill from this little brother. Please allow us the convenience of picking the Laurel fruits."
After speaking, Jun Moxiao tossed the small bottles over.
This troop of monkeys was rather disciplined; only the Monkey Leader reached out to grab the small bottles, while the other monkeys surprisingly remained still.
The Monkey Leader opened a bottle, looked at the pills inside, and was extremely satisfied, immediately starting to chitter excitedly.
It opened all dozen or so small bottles, tossed out the pills, and over a hundred monkeys swarmed forward, each snatching a pill.
After getting the pills, they stuffed them into their mouths and swallowed them all.
Then, the Monkey Leader stepped back and pointed its staff at the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree.
Jun Moxiao realized the Monkey Leader had agreed to let them pick the Laurel fruits.
Jun Moxiao didn’t bring up the matter of recruitment yet, deciding to pick the Laurel fruits first.
He soared into the air, flew into the crown of the Cassia Tree, and began to pick the golden Laurel fruits.
This Cassia Tree bore a good number of golden Laurel fruits, well over ten. After picking them all, Jun Moxiao counted them—exactly twelve.
Four more than before.
This made Jun Moxiao very excited.
After descending from the air, he gave six of the Laurel fruits from his bag to Lei Qinian.
Although Lei Qinian said nothing, his sense of guilt intensified.
Once we find those thousand-year-old Laurel fruits, I’ll definitely give more to Jun Moxiao,
he secretly vowed.
After they divided the Laurel fruits, Jun Moxiao prepared to attempt recruiting this group of monkeys.
He didn’t know if it would work, but he had to try anyway.
He had interacted with monkeys a few times before and discovered that these monkeys could understand human speech.
Since they could understand human speech, Jun Moxiao felt there was still hope for success.
"Esteemed Brother Monkey," Jun Moxiao began, licking his lips and gathering his courage, his hands clasped in a salute, his face sincere, "since my brother and I entered the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, we’ve offended a formidable power. Now, we can’t guarantee our safety from one day to the next, and our lives are in peril..."
The Monkey Leader clutched a small bottle, fiddling with it as if it hadn’t heard Jun Moxiao’s words, and discovered not a single pill was left inside.
Seeing this, Jun Moxiao quickly took out another small bottle, walked closer, and respectfully handed it over.
"Brother Monkey, I still have some here," Jun Moxiao said with a pleasant expression.
"CHIRP CHIRP?"
The monkey’s eyes lit up. It snatched the small bottle, opened the cap to glance inside, and then began to chitter joyfully.
Seeing the Monkey Leader was in high spirits, Jun Moxiao plucked up his courage and said, "Brother Monkey, could I ask a favor of you?"
"CHIRP CHIRP?"
The Monkey Leader looked at Jun Moxiao, curiosity in its eyes.
"I know you Brother Monkeys enjoy eating the pills refined by us humans, and I have prepared a good many. So, I’d like to propose a trade. You protect us for a period, and as for the pills? I can supply them plentifully. What do you say, Brother Monkey?" Jun Moxiao said slowly.
After speaking, he stared nervously at the Monkey Leader’s furry face.
Lei Qinian also grew nervous.
After all, no one had ever attempted such a thing before.
He didn’t know if these monkeys would agree to such a transaction.
The Monkey Leader stared intently at Jun Moxiao, a hint of surprise on its face.
It hadn’t expected a Human Cultivator to make such a proposition.
Their monkey clan had a particularly large demand for pills; no Cultivator had ever dared to make such an offer.
To test the sincerity of Jun Moxiao’s words, the Monkey Leader extended one finger.
Seeing a chance, Jun Moxiao was delighted and quickly asked, "Ten bottles?"
The Monkey Leader shook its head repeatedly.
"Then it’s a hundred bottles?"
After saying this, Jun Moxiao’s heart skipped a beat.
These monkeys are truly rapacious!
he thought.
The Monkey Leader nodded.
Then it extended five fingers, gesturing in front of Jun Moxiao.
Jun Moxiao was a bit baffled, not understanding what this new gesture meant.
Lei Qinian, however, seemed to have an idea. He walked over and said in a low voice, "Brother Monkey, could it be one hundred bottles of pills to protect us for only five days?"
The Monkey Leader let out a couple of strange chirps, then gave a thumbs-up and nodded repeatedly at Lei Qinian.
Lei Qinian felt as if his heart were bleeding. These monkeys are truly extortionate!
One hundred bottles of pills for just five days of protection—this was indeed too much.
He didn’t even have that many bottles of pills on him combined.
Now, they could only see if Jun Moxiao, Brother Jun, possessed that many pills.
Seeing this, Jun Moxiao was greatly relieved. Hiring over a hundred monkeys for five days for just one hundred bottles of pills—with each bottle containing roughly one hundred pills—was quite a bargain for him.
Compared to the inventory in his God-level storage ring, this was truly a drop in the ocean.
With this in mind, he took out fifty small bottles from his storage ring, handed them to the Monkey Leader, and said with a smile, "Brother Monkey, these fifty bottles are a deposit. On the fifth day, I will pay you the other half."
The Monkey Leader’s face immediately flushed red. It shrieked in apparent anger.
The other monkeys also seemed to understand Jun Moxiao’s words. They gathered around, continuously pounding the ground with their sticks.
At this, Jun Moxiao understood.
It seems these monkeys don’t accept deposits. Either it’s full payment upfront, or they won’t accept the employment.
Thinking this, Jun Moxiao decided to take a gamble and see what the character of these monkeys was like.
He once again took out fifty small bottles and handed them all to the Monkey Leader.
The Monkey Leader accepted them, inspected them, and then nodded in satisfaction.
It distributed all one hundred bottles of pills to its subordinates.
It only kept the single bottle from before for itself.
Witnessing this, Jun Moxiao felt a surge of admiration.
This Monkey Leader is exceptionally righteous,
he thought,
even more so than the previous one.

chapters.title: Chapter 327: Recruiting Monkey (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 327: Chapter 327: Recruiting Monkey (Part 2)
"Brother Jun, you are really something, actually managing to recruit these Monkeys..." Lei Qinian patted Jun Moxiao on the shoulder, full of admiration, and said telepathically.
"It’s alright. We and these Monkeys, it’s a mutually beneficial situation," Jun Moxiao responded, scratching his head with a smile.
These Monkeys were rather principled and wouldn’t harass humans relentlessly. That was why Jun Moxiao had thought of recruiting a group of Monkeys to protect himself. It turned out to be a fortuitous success; he had actually managed to hire over a hundred Monkeys.
These were over a hundred Nirvana Realm experts!
With them protecting him, he wouldn’t have to fear the people from the Xuanyang Sect for the time being. Unless everyone from the Xuanyang Sect gathered together, they likely couldn’t pose a threat to him.
"
This is really interesting.
"
Ye Yun watched this novel scene unfold and couldn’t help but laugh. With the protection of these hundred-plus Monkeys, the two young fellows would be safe for now.
Ye Yun had not interfered with the transaction Jun Moxiao had just made. It was purely Jun Moxiao’s good luck. Moreover, the Monkey Leader was rather honorable, harboring no intentions of murder and robbery, so they quickly came to an agreement, and the deal was struck.
Ye Yun also discovered that the Monkeys in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region indeed had no intention of relentlessly pursuing and killing Cultivators.
It seemed the so-called Great Saint had long ago implanted these rules in the hearts of these Monkeys.
Thanks to the protection of over a hundred Monkeys, Jun Moxiao and Lei Qinian no longer had to move about furtively as before.
After dividing the golden Laurel fruit, they both ate the fruit as they swiftly flew forward.
Their speed was not particularly fast. They found that if they moved too quickly, the Monkeys would protest, standing in place and constantly shouting at them while brandishing their staves. The two had no choice but to slow down.
Two Cultivators leading a troop of Monkeys, appearing in a grand procession through the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, naturally attracted the attention of many other Cultivators.
"Look! What’s that? Am I seeing things? Why are all those Monkeys following those two young men?"
"Truly strange. Since when did these Monkeys become so obedient?"
"Don’t the Monkeys in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region usually shout about attacking and killing any Cultivator they see, demanding medicinal pills? Why does it seem different this time?"
The surrounding Cultivators hid far away. Witnessing this scene, they were stunned and couldn’t help but marvel.
And those Monkeys, even when they saw these Cultivators, did not attack them. They continued to follow Jun Moxiao and Lei Qinian.
"Brother Jun, look! All the Cultivators are so shocked their jaws are about to drop to the floor," Lei Qinian said, laughing heartily.
"Haha, yes. Hopefully, we don’t encounter those fellows from the Xuanyang Sect up ahead," Jun Moxiao also burst into laughter.
If they were to encounter Xuanyang Sect disciples now, with over a hundred Monkeys behind them, those disciples would probably be scared out of their wits.
Speak of the devil, and he shall appear.
From above a mountain peak, seven or eight red sword lights suddenly flew over and descended, revealing seven or eight red-clothed Xuanyang Sect disciples.
"Brother Jun, Xuanyang Sect disciples are here, but there aren’t many of them," Lei Qinian said with a mysterious smile.
"Brother Lei, let’s charge over and scare them witless!" Jun Moxiao declared, full of heroic spirit. He drew his sword and flew towards the mountain peak.
Lei Qinian followed closely behind him.
Their flying speed wasn’t too fast, so the troop of Monkeys managed to keep up.
The seven or eight Xuanyang Sect disciples standing on the mountain peak saw these Monkeys charging alongside the two Loose Cultivators, and their expressions changed drastically.
