"Am I seeing things? How did these two Loose Cultivators team up with the Monkeys?" one of the red-clothed youths exclaimed, his eyes wide.
"Exactly! Could they be fleeing from that pack of Monkeys and trying to use us as scapegoats?" another person chimed in.
"That’s possible! But we absolutely can’t let them succeed. Let’s stop them quickly and create an opportunity for those Monkeys!" a slightly older red-clothed youth shouted.
After he finished speaking, these red-clothed youths immediately drew their swords, unleashing waves of sword light that formed a large, sweeping net of light.
Seeing the malicious intent of these Xuan Yang Sword Sect disciples, Jun Moxiao was furious. However, with just him and Lei Qinian, they were outnumbered and unlikely to be their opponents.
Jun Moxiao pulled Lei Qinian to a sudden halt. He turned his head and shouted to the Monkey Leader behind them, "Brother Monkey, the Xuanyang Sect disciples want to kill us! Quick, lend us a hand!"
The Monkey Leader shrieked. Wielding its staff, it soared into the sky, transforming into a black shadow that shot past over their heads. Its cultivation base had already reached the Nirvana Realm Sixth Level, while among these Xuanyang Sect disciples, only one was at the Fifth Level of the Nirvana Realm.
BOOM!
The Monkey Leader swung its staff, creating a blur of afterimages that instantly shattered the large net of sword light. The Monkey Leader hovered in mid-air, pointing its staff at the red-clothed youths ahead.
"EE EE..." At its command, the hundred-plus Monkeys behind it, wielding their staves, charged towards the red-clothed youths.
"
This can’t be happening!
" a red-clothed youth thought, his eyes wide with terror.
These Monkeys aren’t pursuers! They’re with those two Loose Cultivators!
The red-clothed youths were terrified. They immediately turned to flee, but how could the Monkeys let them escape? Instantly, the Monkeys swarmed and surrounded them, raining down a barrage of blows with their staves on the seven or eight red-clothed youths.
THWACK! THWACK!
These Xuanyang Sect disciples had no strength to retaliate. They were constantly pushed back, desperately manipulating their sword light and throwing out various magical treasures to defend themselves.
"Who would have thought! Haha! The Xuanyang Sect is one of the four major powers of the Heavenly Moon Dynasty, yet in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, their disciples are being beaten so miserably!" Lei Qinian burst into laughter.
Jun Moxiao also found it quite amusing and couldn’t help laughing out loud.
In previous battles, he had always been one against many, seeking breakthroughs on the verge of life and death. The pressure was immense, and the fights were extremely arduous. This time, he had a large group of thugs, each one ’fearless in the face of death,’ directly beating these Xuanyang Sect disciples until they threw away their helmets and armor, utterly routed.
After laughing for a moment, Jun Moxiao’s expression suddenly turned cold, and he drew his Chaos Element Unlimited Sword.
"Brother Jun, you’re going to attack?" Lei Qinian asked quickly, his heart skipping a beat.
"
Since these Xuanyang Sect disciples want to take our lives, how could I let them live?
" Jun Moxiao gritted his teeth and charged forward.
Lei Qinian was stunned at first. He hadn’t expected this young brother to be so ruthless and decisive, intending to kill Xuanyang Sect disciples at the Fourth and Fifth Levels of the Nirvana Realm while only being at the First Level of the Nirvana Realm himself. This level of boldness made Lei Qinian feel ashamed of his own inadequacy.
Lei Qinian also drew his sword and, transforming into a ray of sword light, charged forward. However, Lei Qinian was shocked to find that due to the sheer number of Monkeys, with staff shadows flying everywhere, he couldn’t even find an opening to join the fray.
Just then, a Divine Dragon Phantom miraculously weaved through the dense barrage of staff shadows and successfully broke into their midst.
A sword light flashed.
A red-clothed youth, busy dodging the Monkeys’ attacks, had no way to evade this astonishing sword light.
PUCHI.
The sword light vanished. A hole instantly appeared over the red-clothed youth’s heart, and hot, crimson blood spurted out like an arrow.

chapters.title: Chapter 328: Annihilating the Disciples of Xuanyang Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 328: Chapter 328: Annihilating the Disciples of Xuanyang Sect
"Dead?"
Across layers of rod shadows, Lei Qinian was shocked to see a splash of blood fly into mid-air, his expression freezing in surprise.
Little Brother Jun Moxiao’s skills aren’t too shabby...
In the midst of countless foes, directly taking the enemy commander’s head, he killed a disciple from the Xuanyang Sect with a single sword strike.
Truly impressive.
To possess such combat prowess at the First Level of the Nirvana Realm is truly unimaginable.
Of course...
Lei Qinian also knew this was because over a hundred monkeys were besieging these Xuanyang Sect disciples, creating an excellent opportunity for Jun Moxiao to launch a surprise attack.
But if it were him, Lei Qinian believed he absolutely could not have broken through to kill anyone.
These monkeys were demon beasts, yet they were extremely proficient with rods and cooperated seamlessly. Consequently, he could only stand aside in a daze, completely unable to break through.
If he were to force a breakthrough, he would have to shatter the screen of rod shadows before him.
Lei Qinian didn’t dare.
These monkeys were currently like hired help; if he attacked, he might anger them.
Once angered, the monkeys might turn on them.
"What? Junior Brother Liao is dead?"
A young man in scarlet robes saw his junior brother suddenly pierced through the chest by a sword light. His face immediately turned pale, his expression horrified.
He had never imagined that the young man at the First Level Nirvana Realm would be so formidable.
Moving unhindered amidst the countless, overlapping rod shadows of the monkeys, he had killed his Junior Brother Liao with a single sword strike.
WHOOSH!
The sword light flashed again.
Jun Moxiao silently charged toward another person.
Although this disciple of the Xuanyang Sect discovered Jun Moxiao’s sword light in time and put up a defense, he was continuously struck by the monkeys’ rods, which affected his attacks.
Jun Moxiao’s sword slashed across half his shoulder. Blood gushed out, and the young man was instantly thrown backward.
After this young man was injured, the monkeys, surprisingly, did not continue their attack on him.
Instead, they attacked the few other young men in scarlet robes.
Jun Moxiao paused, stunned.
Only then did he truly realize that these monkeys generally didn’t use lethal force against Cultivators.
At this moment, the results of Ye Yun’s previous training of Jun Moxiao were finally demonstrated. The young man didn’t hesitate; he activated the Dragon God Body Technique and quickly pursued.
THUNK!
A sword pierced him from behind, killing the young man on the spot.
In this manner, Jun Moxiao, like a roaming dragon, weaved through the rod shadows, striking left and right, killing the young men in scarlet robes one by one.
After a while, the monkeys all stopped, retracted their rods, and squatted on the ground.
The Monkey Leader kept tapping the ground with its rod, then looked at Jun Moxiao and chattered.
Jun Moxiao was completely baffled, having no idea what the Monkey Leader meant.
Is it planning to extort more elixirs again?
Seeing Jun Moxiao’s expression, the Monkey Leader pointed at the corpses, then pointed at Jun Moxiao again.
The meaning was clear: "You killed these people; it has nothing to do with us monkeys."
Jun Moxiao had a sudden realization and quickly nodded.
"Brother Monkey, I killed them all. It has nothing to do with you," Jun Moxiao said.
The Monkey Leader nodded in satisfaction.
Lei Qinian walked over, looked at the bodies on the ground, and said in shock, "Little Brother! Your strength is truly too great. I couldn’t even charge in. You... what kind of movement technique is that?"
Jun Moxiao said proudly, "This is the unique Dragon God Body Technique of my Divine Dragon Sect."
"Truly amazing!" Lei Qinian exclaimed in admiration.
Hearing this, Jun Moxiao wore a proud expression and laughed heartily.
The Dragon God Body Technique was one of the three Ultimate Techniques of the Dragon God Sect, an Eternal Sect, so it was naturally exceptionally powerful.
Since childhood, Jun Moxiao had lived a life of constant flight with his master and senior sisters. Of the three Ultimate Techniques, his Dragon God Body Technique was the best learned.
Jun Moxiao turned around and began to clean up the battlefield, collecting the storage rings from the red-robed youths.
Looking at the corpses, Jun Moxiao initially thought of burying them, but a sweep of his gaze revealed that some Cultivators had witnessed the battle.
He frowned and quickly led Lei Qinian away from the area.
The over a hundred monkeys trailed closely behind them.
"With the aid of these over a hundred monkeys, even the Xuanyang Sect would have a hard time dealing with these two Loose Cultivators. A smaller number of people simply wouldn’t work," a young Cultivator whispered.
"Exactly! Who would’ve thought that these monkeys could take orders from humans! Could it be they were given enough elixirs?" another young Cultivator said, his eyes lighting up.
"We could try, but we have too few elixirs with us. I doubt we would succeed."
That young Cultivator shook his head, a look of dejection in his eyes.
...
After killing this group of Xuanyang Sect disciples, both Lei Qinian and Jun Moxiao felt considerably bolder than before.
They no longer needed to fly through the valleys with such caution.
However, their group had also attracted the attention of many Cultivators.
Word gets around.
Soon, news of the Xuanyang Sect disciples’ murder gradually spread throughout the Heavenly Moon Secret Region.
Hearing the news, many disciples of the Xuanyang Sect were furious. They quickly assembled a team of nearly seventy to eighty members specifically to search for the two Loose Cultivators.
「Another day passed.」
Neither Jun Moxiao nor Lei Qinian found any more millennium-old Cassia Trees bearing golden laurel fruits.
"Little Bro! We’re probably too slow. Many people are faster than us..." Lei Qinian sighed while flying.
"Yeah!" Jun Moxiao also sighed in frustration.
The monkeys weren’t fast, which meant the two of them couldn’t travel quickly either.
This made their party’s speed much slower than that of other Cultivators.
Consequently, all the Cassia Trees they encountered along the way had already been stripped of their golden laurel fruits.
They had likely been taken by others who arrived first.
Jun Moxiao didn’t idle on the road either. When he saw millennium-old Cassia Trees, he always rushed over to give it a try.
He would hang the Jade Tablet on the Cassia Tree, only to find no reaction.
With each attempt, Jun Moxiao’s hypothesis became clearer: perhaps the Jade Tablet only had an effect when hung on Cassia Trees that were ten thousand years old.
Of course, if he encountered a Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree that was several thousand years old, Jun Moxiao wouldn’t pass up the chance to experiment.
Better to hang it on the wrong one than to miss a potential candidate.
After crossing another mountain range, the two stood on a peak, gazing into the distance.
"Little Bro, look! What’s that over there?" Lei Qinian suddenly exclaimed, shielding his eyes, his own filled with shock.
"What is it?" Jun Moxiao also looked.
A hundred miles beyond the mountain range stood a colossal Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree, its massive trunk unlike any they had seen before.
"That must be at least five thousand years old," Lei Qinian murmured.
Jun Moxiao’s gaze, however, dropped from the tree. He discovered three to four hundred monkeys gathered at the base of the Five-Thousand-Year-Old Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree.
Opposite these monkeys, a large number of Cultivators were assembled, seemingly in a standoff with them.

chapters.title: Chapter 329: The Five Thousand Years Old Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree
chapters.content:
Chapter 329: Chapter 329: The Five Thousand Years Old Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree
A five-thousand-year-old Cassia Tree, I wonder if any laurel fruits have matured,
Jun Moxiao muttered to himself.
"Brother Jun, the laurel fruits on this five-thousand-year-old Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree should not have been picked by those Cultivators yet. Let’s hurry and check it out!" Lei Qinian said, his eyes gleaming with excitement.
Jun Moxiao nodded, and the two of them swiftly flew from the mountaintop towards the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree, a large group of Monkeys trailing behind them. A hundred miles was a short distance for them and didn’t take long to cover.
Once they drew closer, Jun Moxiao realized there were as many as forty to fifty Cultivators from various forces gathered around. Among them were several people from the Xuanyang Sect. These Disciples from the Xuanyang Sect had their backs to the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree, facing the other Cultivators. Their faces were cold, and they seemed to harbor ill intentions.
"This Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree was discovered by our Xuanyang Sect first. All of you, piss off!" a red-robed youth from the Xuanyang Sect said coldly.
"We clearly discovered it first! You all came later. How did it become your Xuanyang Sect’s discovery? Have you no shame?" a blue-robed man shouted angrily.
"If you don’t leave now, once our Xuanyang Sect’s main force arrives, you won’t be able to leave even if you want to," the red-robed youth sneered.
Over twenty golden laurel fruits had matured on this five-thousand-year-old Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree. However, the few Xuanyang Sect Disciples present didn’t have nearly enough elixirs to deal with the Monkeys. There were three to four hundred of them, all with voracious appetites. So, they had claimed this spot, preventing other Cultivators from taking a single step closer.
After all, the Xuanyang Sect’s influence in the entire Heavenly Moon Dynasty was immense. Unless Disciples from the other three Superior great sects appeared, no one dared to provoke the Xuanyang Sect Disciples. Most of the other Cultivators were from minor sects and naturally didn’t dare to trifle with them.
"Hey, aren’t those the two Loose Cultivators?" one of the Xuanyang Sect Disciples exclaimed upon spotting Jun Moxiao and Lei Qinian, recognizing them instantly.
Those two really are being followed by a large group of Monkeys,
a red-robed youth thought, frowning. Within the past day, he had heard that several of his fellow sect brothers had been killed by these two Loose Cultivators, and the Monkeys following them were their accomplices."Never mind them. Our reinforcements will be here soon," another burly, red-robed youth said in a deep voice.
Their current strength was somewhat inferior to that of the two Loose Cultivators, especially since those two had a large group of Monkeys protecting them. However, they believed that as long as they didn’t provoke them, the Monkeys wouldn’t attack. To these red-robed youths, the two Loose Cultivators themselves weren’t to be feared; the Monkeys were the real threat.
"Brother Jun, there are so many Monkeys here. Without the backing of a great sect, I’m afraid it will be difficult to obtain any mature laurel fruits..." Lei Qinian whispered, a worried look in his eyes.
Jun Moxiao surveyed his surroundings, taking in everyone’s expressions. He then sent a sound transmission: "Brother Lei, we have to try no matter what. We must be quick, lest the Xuanyang Sect’s main force arrives and causes trouble for us."
"Brother Jun, do you still have enough elixirs?" Lei Qinian asked, his expression one of shock.
"More or less," Jun Moxiao nodded.
Lei Qinian gasped, looking at the young man before him with newfound respect. To employ these Monkeys, Jun Moxiao had already spent a vast quantity of elixirs. Now, with over three hundred Monkeys under the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree, satisfying all of them at once would require another significant outlay.
Jun Moxiao didn’t walk towards the red-robed youths. Instead, he circled around and headed in a different direction. One of the red-robed youths immediately flew over to block his path.
"Are you sure you want to fight me?" Jun Moxiao glanced at the red-robed youth, a cold sneer on his face.
Seeing more than a hundred Monkeys following closely behind Jun Moxiao, the red-robed youth’s face changed, and he immediately flew away. These hundred-plus Monkeys were local tyrants that no one dared to provoke; the few Xuanyang Sect disciples were no match for them.
Jun Moxiao walked towards the group of Monkeys under the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree. However, the Monkeys following him stopped after just a few steps. Their Monkey Leader sat on the ground, holding its staff, eyes closed. The other Monkeys emulated it, closing their eyes to rest.
Jun Moxiao glanced back and couldn’t help but click his tongue in amazement.
It seems these two different groups of Monkeys are wary of each other,
he thought.
Jun Moxiao scanned the Monkeys opposite him and found that the one with the highest cultivation base had reached the Seventh Level of the Nirvana Realm. This cultivation base was even higher than that of the Monkey Leader accompanying him.
Jun Moxiao stepped forward and cupped his fists. "Brother Monkeys, we wish to pick the laurel fruits from the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree. Would you please allow us?"
With that, he immediately took out thirty small bottles and tossed them to that group’s Monkey Leader. The Monkey Leader caught them, opened one bottle to inspect its contents, then casually tossed it to the ground. The other Monkeys remained seated, their eyes fixed intently on Jun Moxiao. He began to feel a little uneasy.
Are these many elixirs still not enough?
Jun Moxiao thought.
These Monkeys are indeed extremely difficult to deal with!
Throughout this journey, I’ve finally realized something,
Jun Moxiao mused.
The older the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree, the greater the demand for elixirs from the Monkeys guarding it. This demand seems to be twofold: one for quantity, and the other for quality.
Just as Jun Moxiao was about to take out more elixirs, he suddenly saw a streak of sword light shoot over from the distance, landing not far from him. When the sword light faded, seventy to eighty figures in red robes appeared. They were all Disciples of the Xuanyang Sect.
Jun Moxiao’s expression stiffened. He hadn’t expected the Xuanyang Sect to send so many people this time. Even with more than a hundred Monkeys guarding him, he couldn’t possibly handle this many Xuanyang Sect Disciples.
Without hesitation, he flipped his palm and instantly produced three hundred bottles of elixirs, throwing them all at the feet of the Monkey Leader.
SQUEAK!
The Monkey Leader stared at the multitude of small bottles scattered at its feet—far more than it had imagined. It grinned and immediately pointed its staff towards the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree.
"It’s that Loose Cultivator! Kill him!" a Xuanyang Sect Disciple shouted upon recognizing Jun Moxiao, immediately drawing his sword and charging forward. Another dozen or so Xuanyang Sect Disciples also charged over, apparently intent on killing Jun Moxiao on the spot. After all, they had heard rumors that eight of their fellow sect members had died at the hands of this young man.
"Brother Jun, be careful!" Lei Qinian hurriedly shouted a warning.
Facing the overwhelming barrage of sword lights, Jun Moxiao sneered. He transformed into a Divine Dragon Phantom and instantly vanished. All the sword lights struck empty air.
「The next moment.」
The Divine Dragon Phantom reappeared high above the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree.

chapters.title: Chapter 330: The Second Layer of the Dragon Reversal Decision
chapters.content:
Chapter 330: Chapter 330: The Second Layer of the Dragon Reversal Decision
Watching Jun Moxiao once again use his miraculous Dragon God Body Technique to escape danger, Lei Qinian couldn’t help but wipe away a cold sweat.
After the Xuanyang Sect Disciples’ attack missed, they fell from the sky one by one, their faces sullen as they stared at the figure above the thousand-year-old cassia tree.
"Kill him," a gloomy-faced youth said.
Soon, over seventy people rushed towards the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree.
The Monkey Leader, at the Seventh Level of Nirvana Realm, suddenly lifted his stick, leaped up, and swung out a flurry of stick shadows. The remaining three hundred-plus monkeys also attacked at the same time. An ocean-like wave of stick shadows whistled towards them.
BOOM...
The sword light collided with the stick shadows, creating a series of thunderous crashes.
All seventy-plus Xuanyang Sect Disciples were blocked. They fell from the sky, their faces sullen and expressions embarrassed.
They hadn’t expected these monkeys to actually stop them.
SQUEAK!
The Monkey Leader constantly drummed the ground with his club, making threatening noises.
"We better not try to pass. That kid offered them a large amount of elixirs, and now these monkeys won’t let us through," a red-clothed youth said, his face stern as he recognized the unfavorable situation.
"Senior Brother, why don’t we offer even more elixirs? Then we can rush through and kill that kid," a short, chubby youth said.
"Are you stupid? Can’t we just wait for him to come out here?" The red-clothed youth glared at the chubby youth.
The chubby youth finally understood and nodded repeatedly. "Senior Brother is right."
While the two were talking, Lei Qinian had quietly moved to the center of the more than one hundred monkeys. He was also afraid that these Xuanyang Sect Disciples might suddenly attack him violently, so he found a safe place. Even if the Xuanyang Sect Disciples wanted to attack him, they would have to get past these monkeys. And since he had hired these monkeys, they definitely wouldn’t let him die for nothing.
The red-clothed youth’s gaze suddenly shifted to Lei Qinian. "This kid is with that guy! We’ll kill him first to avenge our martial brothers!" the red-clothed youth said coldly.
As his words fell, a team of nearly eighty men, like a crimson cloud, swiftly flew over.
Seeing this, the Monkey Leader lifted his stick. The other monkeys also adopted a defensive posture, as if facing a formidable enemy. These monkeys weren’t stupid; seeing the large number of opponents, they knew this would be a tough battle.
Seeing the unfavorable situation, Lei Qinian hastily summoned the Heavenly Treasures Cover, holding it above his head. Streams of golden radiance descended, enveloping and protecting him.
Although this treasure had been restored to its original Emperor Level Top Grade by that senior, Lei Qinian still didn’t know the true prowess of the Heavenly Treasures Cover. After all, so much time had passed that he, a junior, had long forgotten the true might of this ancestral treasure.
While Jun Moxiao was picking the golden Laurel fruits and observing the commotion, he noticed that the Xuanyang Sect Disciples had surrounded Lei Qinian. A sense of foreboding immediately struck him. He quickly picked all the fruits, about twenty-six in total, transformed into a Divine Dragon Phantom, and swiftly returned to Lei Qinian’s side.
"Brother Jun, don’t act rashly. There are too many of them. This Heavenly Treasures Cover in my hand has been repaired by that senior. I think it will be very difficult for them to break through," Lei Qinian said in a low voice.
Jun Moxiao nodded, scanning his surroundings, yet there was no trace of fear in his eyes. In this battle, although the Xuanyang Sect had superior numbers, with the help of more than one hundred monkeys, they weren’t entirely without the ability to resist.
"Kill that kid, and the Tianyue Osmanthus Fruit will be ours!" The red-clothed youth leading the Xuanyang Sect raised his sword and shouted. Instantly, all the Xuanyang Sect Disciples launched a tidal wave of attacks.
To kill those two Loose Cultivators, they naturally first had to break through the defenses set up by the monkeys.
The Monkey Leader roared in fury, wielding his club as he charged forward. The other monkeys also swiftly joined the fray. In an instant, the Xuanyang Sect Disciples and the monkeys were engaged in battle.
Sword in hand, Jun Moxiao’s eyelids narrowed slightly. He was searching for an opportunity. The moment one arose, he was prepared to strike.
The group of monkeys Jun Moxiao had hired numbered just over one hundred and thirty. Although this was a considerable number, almost double that of the Xuanyang Sect Disciples, in terms of actual combat strength, they were still slightly inferior to the Xuanyang Sect Disciples.
The battle lasted only for the span of a few breaths. Some monkeys couldn’t hold on and were sent flying by the Xuanyang Sect Disciples.
Perhaps their True Fire had been ignited, for the Xuanyang Sect Disciples struck ruthlessly. The injured monkeys were covered in bloody gashes from the swords, but thankfully, none had died.
Seeing his Clan Members suffering injuries, the Monkey Leader’s roars grew fiercer, and his attacks more vicious. However, the red-robed youth opposing him was also at the Sixth Level of Nirvana Realm. The two were evenly matched, and for a time, their fight was a stalemate.
"Brother Lei, I’ll go deal with that guy." With a formidable foe before him, a crimson glint flashed in Jun Moxiao’s eyes. At that moment, his vital energy surged, and a faint, eerie blood-red light emanated from his body.
Jun Moxiao activated the second level of the Reverse Dragon Technique. Instantly, his combat power skyrocketed tenfold.
He transformed into a Divine Dragon Phantom, abruptly vanishing from beneath the golden light of the Heavenly Treasures Cover. The next moment, a beam of sword light descended as if from beyond the heavens, rushing straight towards the red-robed youth.
Startled by the sudden sword attack, the red-robed youth flicked his left hand, sending a golden bead flying out.
BANG!
The sword light struck the golden bead, sending it flying.
The red-robed youth was greatly shocked.
How can this sword strike be so powerful?
My bead is a Heavenly Top-Grade Attack Magical Treasure, yet it was sent flying in an instant!
He couldn’t help but feel a pang of distress, wondering if the bead had cracked.
Although Jun Moxiao had sent the golden bead flying, his momentum caused him to pause in mid-air for a moment.
"Die!" Jun Moxiao roared, charging forward with his sword once more.
He possessed the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline, granting him immense strength. Combined with the Emperor Level Divine Sword in his hand and the tenfold power boost from the Reverse Dragon Technique, sending a Heaven Level magical treasure flying was a simple matter for him.
BANG!
The red-robed youth dared not be careless and raised his sword to meet the attack. Their swords clashed in mid-air with a deafening sound.
The red-robed youth felt an excruciating pain shoot through the webbing of his hand. Looking down, he saw a bloody gash had been torn open there.
How can this kid have so much strength?
he thought, staring at Jun Moxiao—who was only at the First Level of Nirvana Realm—with a look of utter shock.
Just then, a black club came whistling through the air, smashing down abruptly from above. The Monkey Leader’s attack had arrived.
The red-robed youth swiftly dodged and lunged at Jun Moxiao once more. He wasn’t worried about the monkeys, as they rarely killed Human Cultivators.
The truly deadly threat,
he thought,
comes from this incredibly strong youth before me.

chapters.title: Chapter 331: The Great Saint’s Heavenly Might Descends
chapters.content:
Chapter 331: Chapter 331: The Great Saint’s Heavenly Might Descends
BANG! BANG!
In mid-air, two figures flipped and soared amidst a flurry of flashing sword lights.
The red-clothed youth and Jun Moxiao were fiercely locked in combat, their skills seemingly evenly matched for the moment.
Although a vast disparity existed in their cultivation realms, Jun Moxiao showed no signs of imminent defeat.
What surprised Jun Moxiao was that the Monkey Leader’s attacks had become less ferocious after he joined the battle. It seemed the Monkey Leader had no intention of dealing a fatal blow to this red-clothed youth.
Jun Moxiao felt a flicker of disappointment. However, he also understood.
The monkeys throughout the Heavenly Moon Secret Region probably bear no lethal malice towards humans.
Regardless, this Monkey Leader was still aiding Jun Moxiao by intercepting some of the red-clothed youth’s attacks. Otherwise, the pressure on him would have been far greater.
Jun Moxiao discovered that even after activating the second layer of his Reverse Dragon Technique, boosting his combat power tenfold, a significant gap still remained between him and the red-clothed youth.
These Disciples of Heaven’s Pride from superior great sects are truly frighteningly powerful! The disparity between them and the disciples of the same realm I encountered from inferior major sects is immense!
Due to their superior numbers, the Xuanyang Sect disciples gradually suppressed the monkeys’ assault. More of them then began to incessantly attack Lei Qinian.
But Lei Qinian was protected by the Heavenly Treasures Cover above his head. Golden light descended from it, rendering all attacks incapable of penetration.
I never imagined that once this ancestral treasure of mine was restored to the Emperor Level Grade, its defensive power would be so amazingly strong!
Lei Qinian sighed in relief.
He glanced around and, after a moment of hesitation, decided against activating the Heavenly Treasures Cover’s offensive function.
Its attack is indiscriminate; once unleashed, I’m afraid even the monkeys wouldn’t be spared. I daren’t fatally injure these monkeys. After all, my ancestor’s notes clearly stated that Human Cultivators must never kill the monkeys. Doing so would incur the Great Saint’s anger and bring down Heaven’s wrath!
The Xuanyang Sect disciples, while battling the monkeys, relentlessly attacked Lei Qinian’s defenses. Unable to break through, they grew increasingly restless.
The monkeys attacked relentlessly. Though they sustained injuries, they fought fearlessly to protect Lei Qinian.
Lei Qinian was deeply moved by this.
"These monkeys are so annoying!" a red-clothed Xuanyang Sect Disciple yelled angrily. Dodging an incoming staff, he retaliated with a punch, sending a monkey flying.
"These monkeys are infuriating! They keep harassing us! Even if that fellow has a magical treasure for protection, he can’t possibly withstand the attacks of so many of us!" another disciple complained bitterly.
"Indeed..." the other Xuanyang Sect disciples chimed in, airing their grievances. This shared frustration only served to heighten their irritability and gloom.
"Kill!" A red-clothed youth, his face contorted with rage, finally lost control of his violent temper and viciously swung his sword at a monkey’s neck.
The monkey, engaged in combat with others, never anticipated someone would target its vulnerable neck. It couldn’t dodge in time.
With a flash of sword light, the monkey’s head was violently severed.
WHOOSH! A column of blood spurted from the bowl-sized wound on its neck.
"Kill!" Seeing someone make a lethal move, the other Xuanyang Sect disciples could no longer restrain themselves and began to strike with deadly force.
In an instant, the monkeys were routed. Many fell, while others, gripped by fear, turned and fled in panic.
Lei Qinian frowned deeply at this scene.
These Xuanyang Sect disciples are too audacious! They’ve killed so many monkeys from the Heavenly Moon Secret Region all at once! Aren’t they afraid of incurring the Great Saint’s furious, heavenly wrath? Though it’s just a legend, for countless years, no one has ever dared to actually kill a monkey here.
Seeing its clan members flee or lie dead in pools of blood, the Monkey Leader’s eyes turned bloodshot. It roared and, in a frenzy of rage, lunged at the red-clothed youth who had initiated the killing. It made no attempt to escape; it sought vengeance for its fallen clan members.
Witnessing this, Jun Moxiao recognized an opportunity and intensified his assault on the red-clothed youth. Streaks of sword light, shimmering with Divine Dragon Phantoms, filled the air, relentlessly striking at the red-clothed youth. The red-clothed youth parried desperately, appearing extremely hard-pressed.
Meanwhile, in another part of the battlefield, the other red-clothed youths, witnessing the monkeys’ utter rout, rushed towards Lei Qinian. They began to relentlessly assault the defenses of his Heavenly Treasures Cover.
"I’ll go all out!" Lei Qinian roared. Surging Mana from his entire body immediately poured into the Heavenly Treasures Cover.
WHOOSH! WHOOSH!
The Heavenly Treasures Cover spun rapidly, emitting countless fine golden beams of light. These beams, like flying swords, shot towards the surrounding Xuanyang Sect disciples.
The Xuanyang Sect disciples were instantly stunned. None of them had expected the Heavenly Treasures Cover to possess offensive capabilities.
For a moment, everyone was in disarray. Some tried to block with their swords, while others hastily brought out their own magical treasures. Nevertheless, many were unable to withstand the attack of the Heavenly Treasures Cover’s golden light and were sent flying. Some were severely wounded; others perished on the spot.
The Heavenly Treasures Cover’s attack is actually this powerful?
Lei Qinian stared blankly at the disheveled Xuanyang Sect disciples around him, finding it hard to believe.
However, his Mana was now severely depleted. That single wave of attacks had consumed most of the Mana in his body. He was now incapable of launching a second wave. He could only barely maintain the golden light descending from the Heavenly Treasures Cover to protect himself.
WHOOSH!
A violent gust of wind swept through. The entire sky suddenly darkened. Dense black clouds roiled across the sky, and streaks of lightning began to flash within them.
"Why has the sky changed?" a Xuanyang Sect Disciple asked in surprise, looking up.
BOOM!
A deafening thunderclap echoed. Then, without warning, a bolt of lightning plummeted from the sky, striking that disciple. The disciple screamed and was instantly thrown sideways. His body, charred black and devoid of life, collapsed. He had perished on the spot.
This sudden turn of events terrified all the Xuanyang Sect disciples.
"Hahaha! Serves you right for killing the monkeys! The Great Saint is unleashing Heaven’s wrath!" Lei Qinian burst into laughter.
The legends were all true! Once the monkeys are killed, the Great Saint of the Heavenly Moon Secret Region—the elusive Divine Dragon, whose tail is often seen but never its head—will indeed unleash Heaven’s wrath!
BOOM!
Another thunderclap sounded. Over a dozen bolts of lightning rained down from the sky, instantly claiming the lives of another ten or so Xuanyang Sect disciples.
"Run!" someone yelled. The remaining dozens of Xuanyang Sect disciples immediately conjured streaks of sword light and frantically scattered, fleeing for their lives.
The red-clothed youth, who was fiercely battling Jun Moxiao and the Monkey Leader, was also greatly shocked by this development. His entire body trembled. He burned his blood essence, causing his strength to surge temporarily. He blasted the Monkey Leader back and then transformed into a blood-red streak of sword light, shooting into the sky to escape.
BOOM!
A bolt of lightning descended from high above. That blood-red sword light was instantly struck down from mid-air. The red-clothed youth transformed into a charred corpse that crashed to the ground, rolled twice, and then lay motionless.
BOOM! BOOM!
Astonishing bolts of lightning rained down from all directions. None of the fleeing Xuanyang Sect disciples were spared; all of them perished.

chapters.title: Chapter 332: God-level Dragon and Tiger Pill
chapters.content:
Chapter 332: Chapter 332: God-level Dragon and Tiger Pill
"Is this the divine might of the Great Saint?"
Around the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree, forty or fifty cultivators from different factions still stood. They watched helplessly as lightning bolts rained down from the sky with pinpoint precision. Not a single Xuanyang Sect Disciple escaped; once struck, they perished on the spot.
An involuntary chill ran down the spines of these cultivators.
Indeed, the Great Saint truly exists within this Heavenly Moon Secret Region.
They couldn’t help but look towards the dark, lightning-filled clouds. Within them, a tall, phantom-like figure seemed to be looking down upon the entire land with a dignified gaze. The phantom held a black iron rod, emanating an aura of stern authority and domineering presence. It bore a striking resemblance to the statue within the Great Saint Temple.
"This is the Great Saint."
Upon seeing this, the cultivators were so moved that they knelt on the ground.
"CHATTER CHATTER..."
Whether it was the monkey troop under the Five Thousand-Year-Old Tianyue Osmanthus Tree or the monkeys hired by Jun Moxiao, all of them knelt. They placed their rods neatly before them, their faces fervent, kowtowing continuously.
"Thank you, Great Saint."
Gazing at the colossal shadow in the clouds, which stood at least tens of thousands of feet tall, Lei Qinian was also overwhelmed with excitement. His knees buckled, and he too knelt. The Xuanyang Sect Disciples had mistakenly killed this group of monkeys, provoking the Great Saint’s wrath, which, in turn, had saved both him and Jun Moxiao. Lei Qinian pressed his palms together, murmuring prayers.
Jun Moxiao, however, remained standing, as tall and straight as a sturdy green pine tree. He merely squinted at the giant phantom in the sky, his expression remarkably calm.
What Great Saint? In his eyes, it was nothing. He had encountered two beings of the Divine Monarch Realm, and this so-called Great Saint probably hadn’t even reached the Eternal Realm. It merely possessed some power within this small Secret Realm, that was all. If this Great Saint dared to step out, his Ancestor could make it kneel and kowtow with a single thought.
At this thought, a smirk of satisfaction touched the corners of Jun Moxiao’s lips. After all, he was only fourteen; his youthful spirit was plain to see.
As the clouds rapidly dissipated, the towering phantom of the Great Saint vanished with them. The sky cleared once more.
Lei Qinian stood up. Seeing Jun Moxiao still standing ramrod straight, he laughed, walked over, and said, "Brother Jun, were you scared silly by the Great Saint just now? You didn’t even kneel and pray?"
"Brother Lei, I only kneel to my Ancestor. As for others, they aren’t worthy," Jun Moxiao replied with a faint smile.
Hearing the youth’s arrogant tone, Lei Qinian shook his head somewhat helplessly.
This kid is still young and knows nothing about the true horrors of the world.
Nevertheless, Lei Qinian didn’t press the matter with Jun Moxiao. Jun Moxiao did likewise. Both tacitly refrained from further discussing the Great Saint of the Heavenly Moon Secret Region.
Jun Moxiao turned and walked over to the Monkey Leader. "Brother Monkey, I genuinely feel bad that so many of your clan members died this time. Here is your compensation." Jun Moxiao flipped his palm, and two hundred bottles of elixirs appeared.
The Monkey Leader gripped its black rod, its head bowed in silence, seemingly still lost in sorrow.
Jun Moxiao sighed. He also realized that these two hundred bottles of elixirs probably wouldn’t be enough to compensate for the pain in the Monkey Leader’s heart. There was nothing he could do. The Xuanyang Sect Disciples had been determined to take his and Lei Qinian’s lives. In their murderous rage, they had even turned on the monkeys.
The Monkey Leader suddenly lifted its head and let out a loud cry to its surroundings. The fleeing monkeys began to return, their numbers now dwindled to only thirty or forty. Almost a hundred monkeys had perished.
The Monkey Leader accepted the elixirs from Jun Moxiao, tapped the ground three times with its staff, shook its head at Jun Moxiao, and then turned to leave with its remaining tribe.
Jun Moxiao understood.
This Monkey Leader was truly honorable. It had accepted these two hundred bottles of elixirs without making harsher demands and then left with its tribesmen.
Watching the Monkey Leader’s desolate figure retreating, Jun Moxiao felt a pang of melancholy. A thought suddenly struck him, and in that moment, he made a firm decision.
"Brother Monkey, wait a moment!" Jun Moxiao called out loudly.
The Monkey Leader paused, then slowly turned, looking at Jun Moxiao with a puzzled expression.
Is this human trying to take back the elixirs he’d already given out?
Jun Moxiao rummaged in his storage ring and produced another pill. The unique Super Divine Dragon Breath emanating from this pill immediately caught the attention of the Monkey Leader under the Cassia Tree. Its eyes lit up brightly. Its gaze was fixed on Jun Moxiao’s clenched fist.
Jun Moxiao quickly dashed over to the Monkey Leader, who was about to depart, and placed the pill into its hand. "I don’t have many of these pills; I can only give you one," Jun Moxiao said quietly.
The Monkey Leader was momentarily stunned, but the next moment, its nose twitched. An expression of inexpressible delight and excitement spread across its face. It cast a wary glance towards the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree, then carefully examined the pill in its palm. Then, without hesitation, it shoved the pill into its mouth.
"CHEE CHEE..."
The Monkey Leader cupped its fists in a salute to Jun Moxiao and bowed deeply. Then, in a flash, it swiftly led the monkeys away from there.
Jun Moxiao sighed, a wave of relief washing over him.
This was a Demigod Dragon Tiger Pill. He had wrestled with the decision but ultimately decided to gift it to the Monkey Leader. After all, the Monkey Leader was extremely honorable. It had lost so many of its clan members protecting him and Lei Qinian, so giving it a Demigod Dragon Tiger Pill was only right. Jun Moxiao believed his Ancestor wouldn’t blame him.
This kid is quite loyal and values relationships...
Ye Yun nodded from within Jun Moxiao’s mind, his eyes filled with admiration.
These monkeys are loyal and righteous, far nobler than some humans. Never mind one God-level Dragon and Tiger Pill; even a hundred would not be too many. However, Jun Moxiao’s supply of Dragon Tiger Pills is limited. Being able to give away one Demigod Dragon Tiger Pill is understandable. For that Monkey Leader, this is already an unimaginably vast fortune.
Jun Moxiao walked back.
"Brother Jun, what kind of pill was that? It seemed quite extraordinary," Lei Qinian asked with a smile.
"It’s just a slightly higher grade," Jun Moxiao replied evasively.
Although Lei Qinian wasn’t an outsider, the God-level Dragon and Tiger Pill was too shocking. If he were to speak of it, it would probably terrify Lei Qinian.
Just then, the surrounding cultivators exchanged knowing glances and suddenly swarmed forward, encircling them.
"You two Loose Cultivators, now that you’re without the monkeys’ protection, shouldn’t you hand over the golden Laurel Fruit you just picked?" a black-clad youth, arms folded across his chest, said with a menacing expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 333: Cultivators’ Shock
chapters.content:
Chapter 333: Chapter 333: Cultivators’ Shock
Listening to the words of the young man in black, Jun Moxiao’s eyes narrowed slightly.
Out of the wolf’s den and into the tiger’s lair.
The Xuanyang Sect Disciples had just been dealt with, and now, unexpectedly, these Cultivators were planning to attack him and Lei Qinian.
After all the difficulties they had just been through to obtain the twenty-six golden Laurel fruits, how could they possibly give them up?
The Cultivators before them came from various factions, some large, some small, but generally, their cultivation bases were not high.
The highest was only at the Nirvana Realm Sixth Level. There were about four or five at the First Level Nirvana Realm, and the rest were between the Second and Fifth Levels.
If a real fight were to break out, I’d stand a fighting chance,
Jun Moxiao figured.
Lei Qinian’s Heavenly Treasures Cover possessed powerful defensive capabilities. They could definitely rely on it to fight these Cultivators.
The Monkey Leader, who had been sitting under the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree, saw these Cultivators surrounding Jun Moxiao and Lei Qinian. It suddenly stood up, swung its stick, leaped into the air, and landed in the middle of their circle.
BOOM!
A Black Monkey landed on the ground, making the earth tremble slightly.
The sudden appearance of this Monkey Leader confused both sides.
The Cultivators immediately retreated a few steps.
After all, in this place, the Monkey Leader’s power was paramount. With over three hundred Monkeys under its command, no one was a match for this troop.
Jun Moxiao stood still. Upon seeing this Monkey Leader, he actually felt a sense of relief.
It seemed that this Monkey Leader had come for its elixir.
"EEK EEK..." The Monkey Leader shrieked impatiently, then clenched one fist and pointed with the hand holding its stick.
Jun Moxiao understood immediately.
This Monkey Leader indeed came for the elixir!
It seems that the Demigod Dragon Tiger Pill truly holds an unimaginable allure for these Monkeys.
Even from such a distance, the Monkey Leader could sense the unique Super Divine Dragon Breath of the Demigod Dragon Tiger Pill.
Jun Moxiao composed himself and said with a solemn expression, "Brother Monkey, this elixir is of exceptional quality, and I have very few. If you want it, would you accept our employment to protect us in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, ensuring we are no longer harassed or suppressed by others?"
Hearing Jun Moxiao’s words, the Monkey Leader frowned in thought for a few seconds.
Then, it slowly held up three fingers.
"Thirty pills? How could I possibly have that many?" Jun Moxiao feigned shock, exclaiming loudly, "Brother Monkey, you should be able to sense the quality of this elixir. I can’t possibly have that many."
The Monkey Leader nodded, then gently waved its fingers.
Jun Moxiao immediately breathed a sigh of relief.
He understood that the Monkey Leader just wanted three Demigod Dragon Tiger Pills.
"Brother Monkey, do you want three?" Jun Moxiao asked tentatively.
"EEK EEK..." The Monkey Leader quickly nodded, then held up five fingers.
"Protection for five days? That’s too short. It has to be at least fifteen days—one pill for five days of protection," Jun Moxiao began to bargain.
The Monkey Leader seemed a bit surprised but nodded in agreement.
Jun Moxiao was overjoyed. Reaching into his storage ring, he quickly retrieved three Demigod Dragon Tiger Pills.
He gently tossed the three pills to the Monkey Leader.
The Monkey Leader immediately caught the pills and popped them into its mouth.
It didn’t swallow the pills but tucked them into its cheek pouch, preserving them for the time being.
The surrounding Cultivators watched in stunned silence as the young man and the Monkey Leader successfully struck a deal.
"My heavens! That kid actually struck a deal with the Monkey Leader so quickly!"
The black-clothed youth’s expression changed instantly, and he turned and fled without hesitation.
What a joke!
There were over three hundred Monkeys here. Their group of thirty to forty Loose Cultivators stood no chance against them.
Once the black-clothed youth left, the others also scattered and fled.
Just like that, the crisis was averted.
"Brother Jun, you are truly amazing! You’ve actually hired a troop of Monkeys," Lei Qinian burst into hearty laughter, sending his voice transmission.
Ever since this young brother, Jun Moxiao, had entered the Secret Realm, his repeated actions had never failed to astound Lei Qinian.
Now, with just three pills of extraordinary quality, he had secured fifteen days of protection from over three hundred Monkeys. This was simply incredible.
If the Xuanyang Sect wanted to target them again, they would have to seriously reconsider their own strength.
Moreover, considering the precedent where the Great Saint’s phantom appeared in the sky and unleashed its wrath, wiping out some Xuanyang Sect Disciples, news of this event would likely spread throughout the Secret Realm very soon.
Then, no one would dare to provoke these Monkeys.
And if no one dared to provoke the Monkeys, their own safety would be even more assured.
The more Lei Qinian thought about it, the more delighted he became.
He finally understood the profound goodwill behind that senior’s earnest advice.
If he had entered this Secret Realm alone, he would likely have faced life-threatening dangers.
But by teaming up with Jun Moxiao, all those dangers had been neutralized.
This young man before him was truly extraordinary.
Even more extraordinary was that unfathomable senior in white.
Jun Moxiao looked around and smiled faintly, "Brother Lei, with the protection of these Monkey brothers, we should be completely safe now."
"Indeed," Lei Qinian nodded, but an awkward expression appeared on his face.
Although he didn’t know exactly what those three pills were, he could guess they were extremely precious.
Only something so valuable could have convinced the Monkey Leader to protect them for fifteen days.
Lei Qinian felt increasingly indebted, as Jun Moxiao always seemed to be the one footing the bill.
Just as this thought crossed his mind, Jun Moxiao took out the golden Laurel fruits and prepared to give half to him.
"Brother Jun, I really can’t accept them! Otherwise, how could I, your elder brother, show my face?" Lei Qinian’s face turned red as he repeatedly waved his hands.
"Brother Lei, don’t be so formal with me. We’re in this together, sharing fortunes and misfortunes. These Laurel fruits are nothing much!" Jun Moxiao laughed heartily and still insisted on giving half the golden Laurel fruits to Lei Qinian.
Lei Qinian sighed helplessly.
This debt of gratitude is just getting larger and larger.
"Brother Lei, please don’t dwell on it. My ancestor said that he had old ties with your ancestors. We can be considered family," Jun Moxiao quickly consoled him, seeing Lei Qinian’s dejected mood.
Lei Qinian nodded.
Jun Moxiao didn’t consume the five-thousand-year-old golden Laurel fruits he had obtained. Instead, he stored them all, planning to let his two senior martial sisters try them after leaving this place.
The two of them, leading a formidable troop of over three hundred Monkeys, advanced majestically towards the depths of the Secret Realm.
Along the way, they caused astonishment among countless Cultivators.
"It’s those two Loose Cultivators! They’re truly capable! They actually managed to find an even larger troop of Monkeys."
"Indeed! With over three hundred Monkeys protecting them, who in the entire Secret Realm would dare to cause them trouble?"
"Exactly! Even the Xuanyang Sect probably wouldn’t dare. After all, the Great Saint’s heavenly might descended, and the Xuanyang Sect’s wounds haven’t fully healed. They definitely wouldn’t dare to act out anytime soon."
The Cultivators discussed animatedly, their eyes filled with envy, jealousy, and resentment as they watched the grand procession.

chapters.title: Chapter 334: The Ten Thousand Year Old Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree
chapters.content:
Chapter 334: Chapter 334: The Ten Thousand Year Old Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree
On top of a mountain, a group of dozens of young people in red robes gathered. Their eyes filled with hatred as they stared fixedly at the large procession in the distance.
"It’s infuriating! Those two brats don’t have much power, but they’re really good at tricking those Monkeys."
A young man in a red robe clenched his fists, knuckles creaking.
"Senior Brother! Our Xuanyang Sect has suffered such a great loss this time. We lost more than eighty fellow Cultivators. If word of this gets out, how will we explain ourselves to the Sect’s elders?" a young man beside him asked, his face etched with worry.
"We will settle this score sooner or later, just not now." The red-robed young man chuckled coldly, watching the distant procession gradually disappear before speaking again, "The Sect Master has high expectations for us this time. Our current goal is to find the Ten Thousand Year Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree and obtain the Ten Thousand Year Golden Osmanthus Fruits. As for those two Loose Cultivators, we don’t need to bother with them for now."
"Understood, Senior Brother!" everyone beside him shouted in unison.
"That Ten Thousand Year Osmanthus Tree has already gained sentience. It moves without a fixed location and is skilled at disguise; we don’t know where it is currently. We must race against time to find the Ten Thousand Year Osmanthus Tree," the red-robed young man instructed again.
"Senior Brother, is it true that there are three Osmanthus Trees over ten thousand years old in this Heavenly Moon Secret Region?" someone asked.
"That’s right. It’s said that two of them are Ten Thousand Year Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Trees, and one has reached around twenty thousand years. If we can pick Twenty Thousand Year Osmanthus Fruits and contribute them to the Sect, the rewards we’ll receive are unimaginable," the red-robed young man said excitedly, clenching his teeth.
Though they greatly coveted the Ten Thousand Year Osmanthus Fruits, they were obligated to hand them over to the Sect for unified distribution. However, as long as they could submit Ten Thousand Year Osmanthus Fruits, the rewards they would receive would be massive, beyond their wildest dreams, making all their efforts worthwhile.
SWOOSH! SWOOSH!
Streaks of Sword light pierced the sky as the Disciples of the Xuanyang Sect scattered in different directions, searching for those Ten Thousand Year Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Trees.
「Time passed.」
In the blink of an eye, another seven or eight days had gone by.
Leading the troop of Monkeys slowed Jun Moxiao and Lei Qinian down considerably, so it took them this long to finally reach the place where Lei Qinian’s ancestor had hidden the thousand-year Laurel fruits.
"This should be the place."
Lei Qinian excitedly scanned his surroundings, spotting a Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree over seven thousand years old in the distance. However, the golden Laurel fruits on that tree had already been plucked.
Lei Qinian wasn’t disheartened, though. They had already obtained quite a few Laurel fruits along the way. Adding the thousand-year Laurel fruits hidden by his ancestor, their harvest was already far greater than that of ordinary Cultivators.
After shifting a huge rock aside, Lei Qinian began to dig furiously, going dozens of meters deep before uncovering a green stone slab.
"It’s under this stone slab!"
With an excited look, Lei Qinian lifted the slab, revealing a small space underneath. Neatly arranged inside were over thirty golden Laurel fruits.
"Brother Jun, come down quickly! We’ll split these Laurel fruits, half each," Lei Qinian shouted up excitedly from the bottom of the pit.
Now, he could finally repay some of Jun Moxiao’s kindness.
Jun Moxiao didn’t stand on ceremony and dropped down. The two began to divide the golden Laurel fruits. Despite the long time that had passed, the fruits showed no signs of change.
After dividing the Laurel fruits, the two of them returned to the surface.
Jun Moxiao walked straight to the several-thousand-year-old Cassia Tree. He took out the Jade Tablet and hung it on the tree. After waiting for a short while without seeing any change, Jun Moxiao sighed and shook his head.
"It’s still not working."
Lei Qinian came over and comforted him, "Brother Jun, don’t be too disheartened. If we can find a Ten Thousand Year Osmanthus Tree, we might be able to complete the senior’s task."
Jun Moxiao nodded.
"Brother Lei, I heard that these Ten Thousand Year Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Trees have gained sentience and don’t have fixed locations. Where should we even begin to look for one?" Jun Moxiao said with some frustration, looking at the countless Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Trees of varying ages all around them.
"We’ll really have to rely on luck for this one." Lei Qinian, having no better ideas, shrugged and smiled helplessly.
The Monkey Leader’s ears twitched as it heard their conversation, and it suddenly darted over. It tapped the several-thousand-year-old Cassia Tree twice with its staff and began to chitter.
Jun Moxiao’s eyes lit up.
Could these Monkeys actually locate a Ten Thousand Year Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree?
"Brother Monkey, are you saying you can help us find a Ten Thousand Year Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree?" Jun Moxiao asked instinctively.
The Monkey Leader nodded, then held up five fingers.
"Brother Monkey, you mean if we give you five of those pills, you can help us find a Ten Thousand Year Osmanthus Tree?" Jun Moxiao quickly asked.
The Monkey Leader nodded again.
Overjoyed, Jun Moxiao unhesitatingly took out five Demigod Dragon Tiger Pills from his Storage Ring and handed them to the Monkey Leader. The Monkey Leader examined them, then excitedly stuffed the five Dragon Tiger Pills into its cheek pouches for safekeeping.
Lei Qinian was dumbfounded by this scene.
He’d never imagined the Monkey Leader could actually find a Ten Thousand Year Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree. But on second thought, it was understandable. These Monkeys were native demon beasts of the Secret Realm; they were exceedingly familiar with the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Trees. Even if that Ten Thousand Year Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree was skilled at transformation and moved erratically, once spotted by the Monkey Leader, it could hardly escape its Fiery Golden Eyes.
The Monkey Leader suddenly let out a cry, leaped into the air, and flew off in a specific direction. Jun Moxiao and Lei Qinian quickly followed.
After flying merely seven to eight hundred zhang, the Monkey Leader abruptly descended from mid-air, landing beside a tiny Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree. It gently tapped the ground with its staff and pointed towards this Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree.
"Brother Monkey, are you saying this is a Ten Thousand Year Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree?" Jun Moxiao asked in surprise.
The Monkey Leader nodded and then began to rapidly strike the trunk of this Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree with its staff.
THUMP! THUMP!
After being forcefully struck more than ten times, the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree suddenly swelled, transforming into an incredibly enormous Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree.
Gazing at such an enormous Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree, Lei Qinian and Jun Moxiao both couldn’t help but suck in a sharp breath. This Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree was clearly different from all the previous ones; it was massive, at least ten thousand years old.
"Brother Jun, there are mature Laurel fruits up there!" Lei Qinian exclaimed in pleasant surprise, his eyes wide as he gazed at the green leaves high above.
Jun Moxiao looked up and instantly smiled as well. On this Ten Thousand Year Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree, there were dozens of golden Laurel fruits growing—at a rough count, at least forty or fifty of them.
This is truly a bountiful harvest!
Jun Moxiao was thrilled. He said loudly, "Brother Lei, you go pick the fruits. I’ll go hang the Jade Tablet and try my luck!"

chapters.title: Chapter 335: The Three Major Powers of the Heavenly Moon Dynasty
chapters.content:
Chapter 335: Chapter 335: The Three Major Powers of the Heavenly Moon Dynasty
"Excellent!" Lei Qinian replied excitedly, and the two figures immediately shot into the air.
He went to pick the thousand-year-old golden laurel fruits, while Jun Moxiao took out a Jade Tablet and hung it on a branch.
Hovering mid-air, Jun Moxiao stared intently at the Jade Tablet without blinking.
Encountering a Thousand-year Cassia Tree for the first time, Jun Moxiao was extremely thrilled. He fervently hoped for some unusual phenomenon to occur after he hung the Jade Tablet.
Yet, after waiting approximately the time it takes to burn one stick of incense, Jun Moxiao was disappointed to find that none of the phenomena he expected had occurred.
The Jade Tablet hung on the branch, swinging softly in the gentle breeze; everything seemed perfectly natural.
"Failed again."
Jun Moxiao flew over and removed the Jade Tablet.
Lei Qinian came over and comforted him, "Jun, don’t be too disappointed. There are other Thousand-year Cassia Trees."
Jun Moxiao nodded.
Lei Qinian muttered in a low voice, "Anyway, with Brother Monkey to help us, why worry that we won’t find the other two trees?"
"Brother Lei has a point."
Jun Moxiao laughed joyfully and descended from the sky.
He returned to the Monkey Leader’s side and took out five more Demigod Dragon Tiger Pills.
"I kindly ask that Brother Monkey continues helping us search for the other Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Trees. This is your reward," Jun Moxiao said with a grin.
The Monkey Leader, stroking its chin in a very human-like manner, stared intently at Jun Moxiao. This gave Jun Moxiao a chill.
Is this Monkey Leader going to drive a hard bargain?
After all, I’ve produced God-level Dragon Tiger Pills several times; perhaps it looked too easy.
As expected, the Monkey Leader shook its head and then held up two fingers.
Jun Moxiao understood instantly; this meant the monkey wanted double the reward.
In other words, ten Demigod Dragon Tiger Pills were needed.
The thought of giving so many Dragon Tiger Pills to this Monkey Leader made Jun Moxiao’s heart ache.
Nevertheless, there was no other way. Finding the Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Trees was impossible for Jun Moxiao and Lei Qinian alone.
After some consideration, Jun Moxiao still believed in the saying "no pain, no gain." So, he took out ten God-level Dragon Tiger Pills and handed them to the Monkey Leader.
Holding the pills, the Monkey Leader chittered excitedly.
Apparently, it realized that consuming these pills would yield unimaginably immense benefits to its cultivation.
The Monkey Leader chittered excitedly a few times and stuffed these Demigod Dragon Tiger Pills into its cheeks.
These monkeys did not have storage rings; if they wanted to hide pills, they could only stuff them into their cheeks.
Watching Jun Moxiao take out ten more of those precious pills, Lei Qinian’s heart was also bleeding.
At that moment, Lei Qinian decided he would not take a single one of the Thousand-year Tianyue Osmanthus Fruits they acquired. Not even if Jun Moxiao held a knife to his neck would he accept them.
After all, he felt he didn’t deserve them.
For Lei Qinian, obtaining the golden laurel fruits hidden by his ancestors was enough.
The Monkey Leader shouldered its staff and then began to lead the way.
Jun Moxiao and Lei Qinian followed behind it, and the other monkeys followed behind the two humans.
Initially, Jun Moxiao was extremely excited, thinking he would soon find the second Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree.
But he hadn’t expected things to go that way.
They searched the Heavenly Moon Secret Region for three full days but still found nothing.
Only then did Jun Moxiao realize that finding these Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Trees was probably extremely difficult.
After all, the Heavenly Moon Secret Region was incredibly vast and expansive. To find a Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree adept at camouflage and prone to running around, one truly needed immense luck.
Their luck before had been exceedingly good; there was a Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree nearby, allowing them to pick up a huge bargain for no reason.
Over these few days, Jun Moxiao encountered some disciples from the Xuanyang Sect again, but upon seeing Jun Moxiao’s group, those Xuanyang Sect disciples quickly fled.
They didn’t dare to approach and cause trouble at all.
"Brother Jun, those fellows from the Xuanyang Sect are terrified of you now," Lei Qinian laughed loudly beside him.
Jun Moxiao awkwardly chuckled along.
How could it be his achievement?
This was all thanks to the Old Ancestor’s grand gesture, wasn’t it?
Without the Old Ancestor’s God-level Dragon and Tiger Pills, trying to command the Monkey Leader would be harder than ascending to Heaven.
Their party continued searching everywhere for Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Trees without stopping. In a flash, another three days passed.
On this day, the Monkey Leader was in a cassia grove, searching for traces of a Thousand-year Cassia Tree.
Suddenly, Jun Moxiao heard a clamor from the distance.
He shot into the air, looking down towards the distant commotion.
He saw that a hundred miles away, three torrents of people were rapidly chasing something in a particular direction. Each torrent consisted of at least a thousand individuals.
"What are they chasing?" Lei Qinian also ascended, standing beside Jun Moxiao and murmuring to himself as he watched the distant scene.
"Could it be another Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree?" An idea suddenly flashed in Jun Moxiao’s mind, and he considered this possibility.
Lei Qinian nodded, "Brother Jun, your guess is likely correct. Those three forces are probably the three great sects of the Heavenly Moon Dynasty—the Xuanyang Sect, the Zhengyi Jianmen, and the Mo Xue Sect."
"There are so many people. If we want to get a piece of the action, it might be quite difficult." Jun Moxiao frowned, feeling uncertain.
He only had a little over three hundred monkeys on his side; they couldn’t possibly compare to those teams of thousands.
Let alone snatching the golden laurel fruits right under their noses.
"Brother Jun, your main task is to hang the Jade Tablet anyway. Once they’re done fighting and leave, we can just go over then, can’t we?" Lei Qinian said with a hearty laugh.
Jun Moxiao’s eyes lit up, and he couldn’t help but smack the back of his own head.
He had been so focused on snatching those golden laurel fruits that he had completely forgotten his task of hanging the Jade Tablet.
All he had to do was hang the Jade Tablet on a Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree. As for those laurel fruits, they weren’t particularly important.
Besides, they had already obtained quite a few.
Thinking of this, Jun Moxiao also laughed in embarrassment.
At this moment, the three torrents suddenly changed direction, splitting into three different paths, yet still tightly pursuing that one Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree.
"Strange. Why is that Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree running so fast, when they’re supposedly the same?" Lei Qinian blinked.
"It’s because that first Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree hadn’t detected us that it lowered its guard. Then, after Brother Monkey pummeled it for a bit, I reckon it was injured and couldn’t get away, so it had no choice but to reveal its true form," Jun Moxiao speculated after a moment’s thought.
"That’s probably it," Lei Qinian nodded in agreement.
Just then, the three torrents, numbering in the thousands, suddenly converged at one point.
Clearly, the three major forces had completely surrounded that Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree.

chapters.title: Chapter 336: Finding a Needle in a Haystack
chapters.content:
Chapter 336: Chapter 336: Finding a Needle in a Haystack
"The Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree won’t escape this time; it’s completely surrounded by three major forces," Lei Qinian said, his eyes glinting.
"Yes." Jun Moxiao nodded; he too had witnessed the scene.
He did not know what method these three Sects had used, but within a few breaths, a towering Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree had materialized in mid-air about a hundred miles away.
Even from such a great distance, Lei Qinian and Jun Moxiao could sense the immensity of the Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree.
Its massive trunk was so wide that it would take a hundred people holding hands to fully encircle it.
As for its vast, boundless canopy, it was so extensive it obscured the sky, defying description.
"The three major Sects are in a standoff. Negotiations are likely inevitable," Lei Qinian remarked softly, his eyes narrowed.
Jun Moxiao glanced around and suddenly noticed countless black specks in the far distance, surging like a tide from all directions.
"’What’s that?’" Jun Moxiao exclaimed, rubbing his eyes. Focusing, he saw that the black specks were, in fact, a multitude of monkeys.
With the Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree at the center, monkeys were everywhere.
These monkeys swarmed over the treetops, moving at an unimaginable speed.
Lei Qinian also saw this, his eyes widening in disbelief.
The sheer number of monkeys was astounding; a rough estimate put their count at over ten thousand.
"Haha... now the three Sects are really in for it!" Jun Moxiao burst into hearty laughter.
Lei Qinian instantly understood and couldn’t help but laugh along.
Tens of thousands of monkeys—it was as if the Disciples of the three major Sects were caught in a second encirclement.
Such an immense number could easily overwhelm the Cultivators from the three major Sects.
If the Disciples didn’t obediently make a hefty offering of medicinal pills, these monkeys would definitely not let them off easily.
Even if they managed to harvest the Tianyue Osmanthus Fruits, at least half the medicinal pills in their Storage Rings would be extorted.
"These monkeys are incredibly cunning," Lei Qinian marveled.
"The commotion earlier was too great. I’m afraid these monkeys knew about it all along. They’ve gathered now, preparing for a clean sweep," Jun Moxiao chuckled.
He suddenly felt... they had been incredibly lucky before.
That Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree was not far from where the Lei Family ancestor had hidden the Laurel fruits, and it hadn’t had a chance to escape.
So, it hadn’t caused much of a commotion.
This allowed the two of them to quietly obtain dozens of thousand-year-old golden Laurel fruits.
Their guess proved correct. Just as they thought, after the tens of thousands of monkeys surrounded the Disciples of the three major Sects, they began to continuously bang their staffs on the ground.
Even from a hundred miles away, one could hear the thunderous sound, like the roar of the ocean tide.
The Disciples of the three major Sects all turned ashen, their expressions a mixture of helplessness and unwillingness.
They had finally tracked down a Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree, only to be surrounded by tens of thousands of monkeys.
Now, if they didn’t hand over a certain quantity of medicinal pills, they risked a savage beating from these monkeys.
They had no other choice.
After some discussion, the Disciples of the three major Sects generously parted with a large quantity of medicinal pills. Only then did the tens of thousands of monkeys relent and retreat like a receding tide.
The leaders from the three major Sects gathered, and after some negotiation, they finally divided the golden Laurel fruits from the Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree equally among themselves.
Once all this was concluded, the three major Sects went their separate ways and dispersed.
"Brother Jun, it’s our turn!" Lei Qinian shouted, dashing out first.
Jun Moxiao followed closely.
The three hundred-odd monkeys behind them followed at an unhurried pace.
Both were experienced by now, maintaining their speed within a reasonable range.
However, this group of monkeys was much more diligent than the previous one. Sometimes, if they inadvertently sped up, the Monkey Leader would also have its monkeys increase their pace.
Jun Moxiao speculated this was all thanks to the God-level Dragon and Tiger Pill.
This Monkey Leader’s mind had probably been muddled by his God-level Dragon and Tiger Pill.
That’s why, at times, it even began to accommodate some of their actions.
Arriving beneath the Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree, Jun Moxiao soared into the air, hung the Jade Tablet on a branch, and waited quietly.
He was filled with anticipation.
However, after a while, when still nothing unusual occurred, Jun Moxiao shook his head and sighed.
This Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree was not the one he was searching for.
"Don’t lose heart, Brother Jun. There are still more Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Trees. We’ll keep searching; there’s bound to be a chance," Lei Qinian said comfortingly.
Jun Moxiao nodded calmly and retrieved the Jade Tablet.
"Brother Monkey, please continue to lead us in our search for a Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree," Jun Moxiao said, floating down beside the Monkey Leader and clasping his fists.
"CHEE CHEE..." The Monkey Leader nodded, then scanned its surroundings, identified a direction, and dashed off first.
After all, having accepted Jun Moxiao’s God-level Dragon and Tiger Pill, this Monkey Leader was indeed very diligent in helping them search.
「Two more days passed.」
Despite being tireless and extremely hardworking, the Monkey Leader still hadn’t found a single Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree.
"Finding this last Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree is like searching for a needle in a haystack!" Jun Moxiao sighed.
The more he wanted to quickly complete the task entrusted to him by the Ancestor, the more elusive this Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree became.
He felt extremely anxious.
Lei Qinian walked over, patted Jun Moxiao’s shoulder, and said comfortingly, "Brother Jun, don’t be anxious. The Heavenly Moon Secret Region is so vast; it’s said that no one has ever explored its true boundaries. Perhaps that Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree is hidden deep within the Secret Realm."
Jun Moxiao nodded.
Suddenly thinking of something, he beckoned to the Monkey Leader and shouted, "Brother Monkey, in the deepest part of the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, are there boundaries?"
The Monkey Leader paused, startled, and turned around.
It scratched its ear and fidgeted, jumping from foot to foot, seemingly deep in thought.
"CHEE CHEE..." It pointed in a certain direction, uttering a strange cry.
Jun Moxiao’s eyes lit up. He quickly flew to the Monkey Leader’s side and asked with a smile, "Brother Monkey, are you saying there are boundaries?"
The Monkey Leader nodded, then shook its head.
Jun Moxiao was baffled.
Lei Qinian, standing nearby, tentatively asked, "Brother Monkey, how about you take us there to have a look?"
"CHEE CHEE..." The Monkey Leader seemed to recall something, its eyes filling with terror. After a moment’s hesitation, it held up five fingers.
Does it want another five God-level Dragon Tiger Pills?
The corner of Jun Moxiao’s mouth twitched.
This monkey is too greedy!
However, judging by the terror in the Monkey Leader’s expression, could there be a place in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region that even monkeys dared not approach?
"Brother Lei, are there any forbidden zones in this Heavenly Moon Secret Region that Human Cultivators cannot enter?" Jun Moxiao turned and asked Lei Qinian seriously.
"I’ve never heard of any such place."
Lei Qinian frowned, thinking for a few seconds before replying, "The Heavenly Moon Secret Region is incredibly vast. Moreover, the duration of each trial period varies. Sometimes it’s as short as ten-odd days, other times as long as two or three months, and then we’re suddenly teleported out... So, no one knows if the Heavenly Moon Secret Region truly has boundaries, nor has anyone encountered any forbidden zones that Human Cultivators cannot enter."

chapters.title: Chapter 337: A Different World, Foggy Plains
chapters.content:
Chapter 337: Chapter 337: A Different World, Foggy Plains
"So that’s how it is!" After listening to Lei Qinian’s words, Jun Moxiao fell into deep thought.
Finding the remaining Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree was indeed difficult. In the entire Heavenly Moon Secret Region, it was like searching for a needle in a vast sea; the difficulty was beyond description.
The Monkey Leader’s earlier statement, while not definitively proving it was the edge of the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, certainly indicated a terrifying place. And it seemed no Human Cultivator had ever entered this place. There was no record of it yet.
Jun Moxiao mulled it over; he still felt he should go and try his luck.
Even if it costs five God-level Dragon and Tiger Pills, it would be worth it. Otherwise, wandering around blindly like this would only make me more desperate.
After making up his mind, Jun Moxiao took out five God-level Dragon and Tiger Pills, handed them to the Monkey Leader, and said in a deep voice, "Brother Monkey, please take us to that place."
The Monkey Leader nodded. It identified the direction again, quickly took to the sky, and flew rapidly ahead. Its flight speed this time seemed to be double what it was before.
Jun Moxiao was delighted.
This would greatly increase their efficiency.
Lei Qinian and Jun Moxiao closely followed the Monkey Leader, with a large troop of monkeys trailing behind.
Along the way, they still encountered Cultivators from various major powers, including those from the three major Sects, especially the Disciples of the Xuanyang Sect. However, everyone was quite spread out now, and seeing such a formidable procession, no one dared to try and stop them. Everyone’s current task was to search for golden laurel fruit, and no one wanted to get into unnecessary disputes.
The Monkey Leader flew steadfastly in a specific direction for a full seven days before finally stopping in front of a large, raging river. This great river flowed out from between valleys, surging powerfully into the distance.
After pondering for a few seconds, the Monkey Leader took flight again, this time heading upstream along the rushing river. Jun Moxiao and Lei Qinian continued to follow. Although they had been flying for seven days, neither of them showed any signs of fatigue.
Instead, a strong conviction grew in Jun Moxiao’s heart.
Perhaps this time there would be an unexpected gain.
After flying continuously upstream along the river for another full three days, Jun Moxiao saw a tall, white waterfall rushing down from a cliff. The waterfall was wide, its torrential waters pouring down ceaselessly. This river was formed by the waters of this waterfall.
The Monkey Leader chittered twice, then pointed its staff in the direction of the waterfall.
Jun Moxiao was taken aback for a moment.
What does it mean? Are we going behind the waterfall?
he wondered.
Before he could react, the Monkey Leader suddenly shot into the air, heading straight for the roaring waterfall. With a SWOOSH, its body pierced through the waterfall, plunging directly into it. Jun Moxiao and Lei Qinian had no choice but to follow closely.
The waterfall looked imposing, but it was actually just ordinary water, having no impact on Cultivators at their Nirvana Realm.
After passing through the waterfall, they found a hidden space—a pitch-black cave appeared behind the cascade. The Monkey Leader stood at the cave entrance, waiting for the two humans to fly over before continuing.
Jun Moxiao suddenly noticed that the other monkeys had not followed them in.
"Brother Monkey, your clan members didn’t follow us in?" Jun Moxiao pointed out.
The Monkey Leader lifted its staff, waved it in the air twice, but did not respond, continuing to fly forward.
Lei Qinian’s expression flickered. He transmitted his voice in a whisper, "Could there be some danger ahead? Perhaps it doesn’t want the other monkeys to risk themselves?"
"That’s possible," Jun Moxiao nodded, also sending a voice transmission in reply.
