After flying into the cave, they traveled for about an hour before seeing a patch of light shining at the far end.
"So there really is more to this cave!" Jun Moxiao exclaimed, surprised, and quickly followed the Monkey Leader.
After flying out of the cave entrance, they saw an endless expanse of green plain before them. Thick fog permeated the distant parts of the plain. The fog covered a vast area, and the far-off plain was entirely enveloped in white mist, with nothing else visible.
Once they were hovering above the plain, the Monkey Leader stopped advancing. It pointed at the fog ahead with its staff and squeaked twice.
Jun Moxiao understood.
So this is what the Monkey Leader considers the boundary. For the monkeys, this place must be terrifying, which is why they don’t dare to enter.
"Thank you, Brother Monkey. We’ll go explore it now." Jun Moxiao cupped his fists in salute, gave Lei Qinian a meaningful look, and the two of them immediately flew off into the distance.
The Monkey Leader watched the two humans, a flicker of terror still evident in its eyes. It seemed as though something terrifying, something it dared not approach, existed within the fog.
Jun Moxiao and Lei Qinian had been flying towards the fog on the plain for less than the time it takes half an incense stick to burn when, suddenly, numerous rays of sword light shot out from afar. These sword lights, of various colors, halted around the Monkey Leader, their forms gradually revealing themselves. These sword lights resolved into a large number of Cultivators.
If Lei Qinian had been there, he would have recognized them at a glance: these were Cultivators from the three major Sects.
"Just as I thought! This monkey knew some secrets after all. By following it, we’ve entered this miniature haven!" A red-robed youth gazed into the distance, his face alight with a fanatical expression. This youth was, naturally, a Disciple of the Xuanyang Sect.
"Your Xuanyang Sect has rendered a great service this time. If we discover the Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree and obtain Tianyue Osmanthus Fruits, your Xuanyang Sect alone will take a forty percent share." A white-robed youth gazed at the distant plain and said with a smile. He was a Disciple of Zhengyi Jianmen.
"Let’s go, let’s go! Let’s see what treasures this never-before-seen Foggy Plains contains!" From another direction, the leader of a group of black-robed youths spoke impatiently. After speaking, he was the first to shoot off into the sky, with the other black-robed youths following closely behind. These were Disciples of the Mo Xue Sect.
The four major powers of the Heavenly Moon Dynasty were the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, the Xuanyang Sect, Zhengyi Jianmen, and the Mo Xue Sect. Disciples of the Mo Xue Sect were known for their volatile tempers and their love for bloodshed and killing.
These three major powers had come to the Heavenly Moon Secret Region this time, but members of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird were conspicuously absent. The Disciples from these three major powers found it somewhat strange that the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird had not sent any Disciples.
These Disciples from the three major Sects who had entered the Heavenly Moon Secret Region were only at the Nirvana Realm and thus did not have access to core secrets. However, the upper echelons of these three major Sects already knew that the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird had undergone a drastic change. The Sect Master and several Elders of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird had perished. The Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird was now completely sealed off from the outside world, having activated its Mountain Protection Array.
「...」
As the Disciples of the Mo Xue Sect flew off into the distance, the Disciples of Zhengyi Jianmen and the Xuanyang Sect, unwilling to be left behind, also raced towards the Foggy Plains.
The Monkey Leader, its staff slung over its shoulder, squinted its eyes as it watched the Disciples of the three major Sects. It shook its head gently and let out a sigh.

chapters.title: Chapter 338: Small Island in the Middle of the Lake, Demonic Ape Corpse
chapters.content:
Chapter 338: Chapter 338: Small Island in the Middle of the Lake, Demonic Ape Corpse
The Monkey Leader still hung in mid-air, its eyes closed in recuperation.
It had accepted the medicinal pill from Jun Moxiao but had not yet found the Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree. Therefore, it had not left.
If these two humans could survive and emerge from that place, then this Monkey Leader would continue to fulfill its previous promise and keep searching for the Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree.
It was quietly waiting.
「Meanwhile.」
Just as Jun Moxiao and Lei Qinian were about to reach the edge of the white fog, they sensed the sound of something rapidly breaking the air approaching from behind.
They turned to look, their expressions subtly changing.
"It’s people from the three major sects! Have those guys been secretly following us all along?" Lei Qinian exclaimed, his face etched with shock.
Jun Moxiao’s face was grim as he nodded. "It’s possible." Gazing at the dense white fog ahead, he abruptly pulled Lei Qinian, and the two of them plunged headfirst into it, like moths drawn to a flame.
The disciples from the three sects were numerous and advancing menacingly. Jun Moxiao and Lei Qinian were definitely no match for them; their only option now was to hide within this white fog.
As soon as they plunged into the white fog, Lei Qinian instantly felt a strong aura of death emanating from it. He thought,
This fog... something feels off about it...
His body jerked violently, a chilling sensation permeating him.
"Brother Lei, what are you talking about?" Jun Moxiao blinked, not feeling anything out of the ordinary.
"Young Brother, didn’t you notice the dense aura of death within this white fog? The moment you make contact, your whole body feels ice-cold..." Lei Qinian said, his face filled with terror.
"I don’t feel anything. It’s just ordinary fog. I don’t have that icy feeling you mentioned..." Jun Moxiao assessed again but found nothing unusual, shrugging helplessly.
Lei Qinian, looking at Jun Moxiao, nodded helplessly. "You really are a strange one..."
"Haha!" Jun Moxiao laughed awkwardly.
After they had flown forward for only a few breaths, Lei Qinian’s face turned pale, and his body exuded an indescribable chill.
He thought,
So cold! This is bad; the aura of death in here is too heavy. I need to summon the Heavenly Treasures Cover.
At this, Lei Qinian raised his hand, and a golden Heavenly Treasures Cover appeared above his head, casting down strands of golden light.
Protected by this golden light, the corrosive effect of the fog on him immediately diminished greatly.
Lei Qinian sighed, having finally found a solution.
"Brother Lei, I’ll scout ahead. You just follow me," Jun Moxiao said.
He truly couldn’t sense anything peculiar about the fog, so he volunteered to scout ahead and find a path.
As the two flew aimlessly within the fog, the disciples from the three major powers also plunged headlong into it.
After flying for only a few breaths, they too sensed the eerie, terrifying, and cold aura of death emanating from the white fog.
Each of them was assailed by the fog, feeling a chill as if they had entered an icy tomb.
A red-clothed youth from the XuanYang Sect frowned, looking into the distance and muttering,
There’s something strange about this place, isn’t there?
"Everyone, be careful! Quickly protect yourselves with your First Level XuanYang Sword Qi!" he ordered loudly.
As his words fell, a fine layer of red Sword Qi materialized around every XuanYang Sect Disciple.
This layer of red Sword Qi carried a high temperature, like a burning flame.
The icy sensation brought by the white fog instantly receded.
The cultivation technique of the XuanYang Sect focused on the fire-attribute, so it possessed a certain mystical efficacy against this mist.
The disciples of Zhengyi Jianmen, who regularly cultivated Grand Righteous Qi, surprisingly managed to withstand the invasion of the cold fog by suffusing their bodies with it.
As for the disciples of the Mo Xue Sect, their unique slaughtering cultivation techniques meant they were not significantly affected in this place.
Instead, this chilling aura of death stimulated the bloodthirsty killing intent rooted deep within them.
These Mo Xue Sect disciples brandished their Blood Swords, eager to find opponents to dismember.
The fog was a vast expanse of white, making it difficult to discern directions.
The three forces darted in different directions and quickly lost contact with each other.
「Within Jun Moxiao’s mind.」
Ye Yun suddenly opened his eyes, calmly observing the cold fog.
This fog was saturated with an intense aura of death, suggesting this place might be a vast burial ground.
Ye Yun was quite interested and cast his gaze into the distance.
He wanted to know how far this fog extended and also if there were any creatures within its depths that might interest him.
Ye Yun scanned the area.
Is that... a Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree?
Deep within the fog, he discovered a vast lake. In the center of the lake was a small island, and upon this island grew a small Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree.
The island itself wasn’t large, yet it hosted only this solitary Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree.
Ye Yun’s eyes flashed. In an instant, he saw through the true nature of this Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree.
Sure enough, this Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree was over twenty thousand years old.
It now appeared as a very small, ordinary Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree, rooted on this small island.
There was no fog on the small island, nor on the surface of the lake. However, a dense fog still permeated the area surrounding the lake.
Ye Yun smiled inwardly, a look of anticipation on his face.
I’ve finally found the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree...
He discreetly sent out a mental impression, which settled into Jun Moxiao’s mind.
This faint mental impression gave Jun Moxiao a subtle inspiration, prompting him to fly rapidly towards the island in the lake’s center.
As Ye Yun withdrew his gaze, he was surprised to see many silver, snake-like creatures in the mist.
Huh? There are many Undead-type creatures in this fog—Soul Flying Snakes!
These creatures, as if having caught a scent, flew out from the lake water, plunged into the fog, and darted towards the Cultivators within it.
Ye Yun’s expression flickered slightly as he once again looked into the depths of the lake.
Interesting, this lake...
The lake was exceedingly deep, at least several thousand miles, and within its sunless depths lay a colossal, powerfully built figure covered in black fur.
It was a Demonic Ape.
It was strikingly similar in appearance to the Demonic Ape in the Great Saint Temple at the entrance.
However, the body of this Demonic Ape was already lifeless.
The white fog in the plains was likely the corpse qi emanating from this Demonic Ape.
Ye Yun’s eyes glinted as they pierced through the massive Demonic Ape’s body, discerning a few clues.
So, it hasn’t completely perished...
He smiled and withdrew his gaze.
This place is certainly quite interesting...
He was now looking forward to seeing what would happen when Jun Moxiao hung up the Jade Tablet.
The silver-white serpents rapidly traversed the fog, heading towards the Cultivators of the three major sects.
Yet, strangely, not a single silver-white serpent launched an attack on Jun Moxiao.
These silver-white serpents moved through the surrounding fog, their pale, snake-like eyes filled with terror as they looked at the youth, who was brimming with vigorous vital energy.

chapters.title: Chapter 339: Soul Flying Snake, Black Monkey
chapters.content:
Chapter 339: Chapter 339: Soul Flying Snake, Black Monkey
In the eyes of these Silver Long Snakes.
The young man in the black robe brimmed with vigorous vitality, seemingly engulfed in an indescribable divine flame. Within this flame, a terrifying Giant Dragon’s phantom lurked, emitting a dreadful Super Divine Dragon Breath.
All of this terrified them, and they dared not approach at all.
"What is that?"
Even while flying, Jun Moxiao also saw the Silver Long Snakes darting around in the fog.
"These are Soul Flying Snakes."
Lei Qinian’s Divine Sense swept over the area. His face stern, he murmured, "There are a large number of Soul Flying Snakes in this place. Could it be that there’s a large tomb in the depths of the fog?"
A large tomb?
At this remark, Jun Moxiao couldn’t help but feel his heart skip a beat, sensing an indescribable chill and terror.
However, since entering the fog, he hadn’t encountered any danger. Moreover, a faint voice in his mind kept urging him to fly forward. So, Jun Moxiao didn’t dwell on other matters and continued to fly, leading Lei Qinian.
After a while, Lei Qinian was astonished to find that those Soul Flying Snakes kept their distance, not daring to approach at all, as if terrified of the black-robed young man ahead of him.
Brother Jun Moxiao truly is an extraordinary person! No wonder the Senior told me to team up with him. If I were to enter this place alone, I would certainly be attacked by those Soul Flying Snakes.
Lei Qinian sighed inwardly.
Meanwhile, the flying disciples of the Xuanyang Sect suddenly saw Silver Long Snakes flying towards them within the range of their Divine Sense.
These Silver Long Snakes were dozens of meters long, enormous in size, and permeated an icy, cold aura.
Each Silver Long Snake was at the Nirvana Realm, and they pounced ferociously.
"These are Soul Flying Snakes! Everyone, be careful! Don’t let their attacks touch you!" a youth in red shouted loudly.
After shouting, his face turned ashen.
The fog ahead definitely conceals a massive graveyard,
he thought.
That’s why there’s so much deathly mist and so many Soul Flying Snakes.
This kind of Soul Flying Snake possesses extremely strong life force and can spit out a corrosive death light. Once touched, it’s incurable. The only way to survive is to amputate immediately, severing the affected body part to prevent the corrosive poison from spreading.
HISS! HISS!
A large number of Soul Flying Snakes pounced, opening their mouths to spit out beams of pale, white light.
"Everyone, be careful!"
The disciples of the Xuanyang Sect, as if facing a formidable enemy, scattered and engaged in battle with these Soul Flying Snakes.
In the other two directions, the Mo Xue Sect and the Zhengyi Jianmen also encountered numerous Soul Flying Snake attacks and were quickly embroiled in fierce battles. The disciples from the three Sects could advance no further.
Jun Moxiao and Lei Qinian, however, continued flying towards the large lake.
After roughly the time it takes for an incense stick to burn, Jun Moxiao and Lei Qinian suddenly broke out of the fog.
"My heavens! It’s not a graveyard! This place... there’s a large lake here?" Lei Qinian exclaimed, his face etched with shock.
He hadn’t expected to find a large lake in the center of the fog. The lake water, however, was dark and murky, impossible to see through.
"Brother Lei, there’s an island in the middle of the lake! Look, there’s a Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree growing on it!" Jun Moxiao shouted excitedly.
Although he couldn’t determine the tree’s age, they had finally reached this mysterious place after an arduous journey.
This Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree is probably the twenty-thousand-year-old one,
he thought.
And this tree might be the key to completing the mission assigned by the Ancestor.
Lei Qinian looked sharply towards Lake Heart Island, his gaze locking onto the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree.
"Brother Jun, it’s highly probable this is the twenty-thousand-year-old Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree! Let’s hurry over and give it a couple of knocks!" Lei Qinian grew excited, but he remained cautious and sent a Divine Sense transmission to Jun Moxiao.
The two of them swiftly flew over. The distance from the lake’s edge to Lake Heart Island was over a hundred miles, but for these two Nirvana Realm Cultivators, it was quickly traversed.
They landed from mid-air onto the small island, beside the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree, which stood less than about eleven feet tall.
THUMP! THUMP!
Jun Moxiao, mimicking the Monkey Leader, unceremoniously raised the Chaos Element Unlimited Sword and struck the tree trunk repeatedly with the flat of the blade.
Jun Moxiao’s strikes were powerful. After only three hits, the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree suddenly began to shake.
Seeing this, Lei Qinian and Jun Moxiao quickly retreated. Then, the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree revealed its true form.
This enormous Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree towered into the sky, its canopy so vast it covered more than a third of the entire Lake Heart Island.
Lei Qinian quickly looked up at the tree’s crown and was thrilled to find dozens of golden Laurel fruits nestled among its tender green leaves.
"Wow, Little Brother, we’ve struck it rich! This twenty-thousand-year-old Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree has at least fifty or sixty Laurel fruits!" Lei Qinian exclaimed excitedly.
Jun Moxiao was also delighted. He quickly urged, "Brother Lei, go harvest the Laurel fruits, and I’ll hang the Jade Tablet!"
"Alright!"
The two rose into the air.
Lei Qinian flew off to harvest the golden Laurel fruits, while Jun Moxiao took out the Jade Tablet and hung it on a tree branch.
Jun Moxiao floated in mid-air, anxiously waiting for something unusual to occur.
A few breaths later,
Suddenly, a GURGLING sound came from the lake, startling Jun Moxiao. He hastily looked towards the source of the noise. There, the lake water was forming a small whirlpool.
What on earth...?
Jun Moxiao was bewildered, unable to comprehend the meaning of this change in the lake water.
WHOOSH...
The sound grew louder. The whirlpool also began to expand, and then a dark shadow suddenly flew out from its center.
Transforming into a beam of black light, it landed about fifty feet in front of Jun Moxiao.
When Jun Moxiao looked closely, he saw it was a Black Monkey.
The Black Monkey carried no weapon. It stood with its arms crossed, observing Jun Moxiao in a remarkably human-like manner, then suddenly asked, "Was it you who hung the Jade Tablet on the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree?"
Jun Moxiao was taken aback. He hadn’t expected the Black Monkey before him to speak human language.
"Yes, I hung it there. May I ask, where is my reward?" Remembering the Ancestor’s instructions, Jun Moxiao asked calmly.
The Black Monkey scrutinized Jun Moxiao with a hint of suspicion and asked, "Are you from the Shen Heng Sect?"
"That’s right, I am indeed from the Shen Heng Sect," Jun Moxiao replied with a smile, clasping his fists in a polite salute.
The Black Monkey didn’t speak again. It lifted its chin towards the sky, seemingly lost in thought.
Jun Moxiao quietly waited for it to continue.
Meanwhile, high up in the tree’s canopy, Lei Qinian was still gathering golden Laurel fruit. Seeing that the Black Monkey wasn’t attacking Jun Moxiao, he felt a sense of relief.
"The Dragon God Sect... how many generations has it been passed down now?" the Black Monkey turned its head and asked, seemingly offhandedly.

chapters.title: Chapter 340: The Sneaky Black Ape, Ye Yun Appears
chapters.content:
Chapter 340: Chapter 340: The Sneaky Black Ape, Ye Yun Appears
The Black Monkey spoke nonchalantly, his demeanor as carefree as a cloud.
At this moment, he seemed like a benevolent old man, engaged in homely chatter with a teenager.
"The Dragon God Sect... it has been passed on for two hundred and ninety-eight generations now."
Jun Moxiao, only fourteen or fifteen years old and possessing a youthful impulsiveness, didn’t think too deeply in the moment and blurted out the information.
"Oh!"
The Black Monkey nodded gently, then watched Jun Moxiao attentively, a kind smile on his face.
This is bad.
In Jun Moxiao’s mind, Ye Yun suddenly sighed.
This ancient Black Monkey has such a sly mind. His previous inquiry about the Shen Heng Sect was just routine questioning. Because only disciples of the Shen Heng Sect, with their Jade Tablets hung, could collect the rewards. The Shen Heng Sect is the most powerful sect within the Shenfeng Dynasty, and has always been the hidden hand orchestrating actions against the Dragon God Sect. The implied meaning behind the name ’Shen Heng Sect’ is to ’check and balance’ the Dragon God Sect. As a pawn of the powers behind the scenes, it has always been at the forefront of suppressing the Dragon God Sect. The Black Monkey had nonchalantly asked how many generations the Dragon God Sect had been passed down. The reason he asked this was because, according to the Shen Heng Sect’s mission requirements, the Dragon God Sect needed to be passed down for three hundred generations before it could be completely annihilated. Only then would the mission be considered perfectly completed. But I hadn’t mentioned this to Jun Moxiao. This boy was completely unaware. So, he had straightforwardly stated the current number of generations the Dragon God Sect had been passed down. Once the Black Monkey heard that the Dragon God Sect had been passed down for two hundred and ninety-eight generations, he would immediately spot the loophole. After all, a true disciple of the Shen Heng Sect wouldn’t let the mission come to an abrupt halt at the Dragon God Sect’s two hundred and ninety-eighth generation.
"You’re doing great."
The Black Monkey looked at Jun Moxiao like an elder, praising him kindly.
"Thank you for your compliment, Senior."
Jun Moxiao scratched his head and smiled, unaware that his words had exposed a flaw that had already been caught by the Black Monkey.
"Stop!"
The Black Monkey’s expression suddenly turned cold, and he barked furiously, "You foolish child! I don’t know who encouraged you to come here and try to deceive me. You even dare to seek rewards?"
As his words fell, WHOOSH!
The Black Monkey suddenly extended his palm, reaching out to grab Jun Moxiao.
The Black Monkey, who had reached the Nirvana Realm Tenth Level Peak, was exceptionally powerful. As his large black hand shot out, it locked down the void around Jun Moxiao.
Jun Moxiao was startled.
How did the Black Monkey know I was an imposter? Could it be...
Thinking about the last question he was asked, Jun Moxiao immediately realized the crux of the problem. He was instantly filled with regret.
Jun Moxiao swayed, intending to activate the Dragon God Body Technique to escape. But to his surprise, he found that the surrounding void had been sealed by a powerful force.
"Break!"
At that moment, Jun Moxiao unhesitatingly activated the second level of the Reverse Dragon Technique. His qi and blood boiled, burning fiercely, instantly enhancing his combat power tenfold. He roared, his body swayed, and he transformed into a Divine Dragon Phantom, forcefully breaking out of the sealed void.
This all happened in an instant, though it seemed to unfold slowly.
The Black Monkey’s hand grasped at empty air. Seeing the illusory Divine Dragon, his expression suddenly changed as if he had realized something.
"So, it’s a remnant of the Dragon God Sect," the Black Monkey commented coldly. He didn’t chase after Jun Moxiao because, within this space, he was the master.
In mid-air, a Divine Dragon Phantom flashed, and Jun Moxiao’s figure reappeared.
But at this moment, Jun Moxiao’s originally youthful face had matured. His eyes became indifferent, as if everything in the world was so insignificant, unworthy of his profound gaze.
At this moment, Ye Yun took over Jun Moxiao’s body.
The current situation was beyond what Jun Moxiao could handle. Ye Yun also wanted to uncover the origin of this Black Monkey and the plans of the mastermind operating behind the scenes.
"Little brother, let me lend you a hand."
Lei Qinian flew rapidly out from the canopy of the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree, landing beside Ye Yun. He took out his Heavenly Treasures Cover and held it above his head. Golden rays of light cascaded down, enveloping both of them.
"Protect yourself well."
Ye Yun turned, patted Lei Qinian’s shoulder, and then took a step forward.
Lei Qinian was stunned.
This isn’t the Jun Moxiao I know! Why does his tone resemble that Senior so much?
A flash of understanding crossed Lei Qinian’s mind. He hovered motionless in the air, watching Jun Moxiao’s back, the expression in his eyes slowly changing from disbelief to fervent adoration.
Ye Yun landed, standing opposite the Black Monkey.
The Black Monkey hadn’t expected this young remnant of the Dragon God Sect to have the courage to face him again.
Does he truly think he can escape just by relying on the Dragon God Body Technique? Truly young and ignorant!
Due to the doubts in his heart, the Black Monkey didn’t attack immediately.
"Unexpected! The remnants of the Dragon God Sect have actually made a comeback. How did you infiltrate the Shen Heng Sect and obtain that secret?" the Black Monkey asked, his eyes fixed intently on Ye Yun.
"What’s so difficult about that?" Ye Yun replied with a faint smile.
"The Shen Heng Sect has Destiny Realm cultivators, doesn’t it? The Dragon God Sect has been in decline, suppressed and battered to such an extent that even having Divine Bridge Realm cultivators is a feat. How could you possibly infiltrate the Shen Heng Sect? What’s even more surprising is that you obtained such a top secret!" the Black Monkey pressed, firing off questions.
The more he thought, the more incredulous he felt.
Someone once calculated that as the Dragon God Sect’s succession approached its three-hundredth generation, the probability of a Divine Bridge Realm cultivator appearing was merely one in ten thousand. How could such a minuscule cultivation base possibly infiltrate the Shen Heng Sect, which is filled with experts? And how did this disciple from the insignificant Dragon God Sect obtain such a tightly guarded secret of the Shen Heng Sect?!
Watching the Black Monkey’s eyes dart around, his expression growing increasingly puzzled, Ye Yun felt amused.
"Our Dragon God Sect naturally has its methods. Otherwise, how could we have become an Eternal Level Sect?" Ye Yun said with a calm smile.
"It seems there’s no need for further discussion. Since the remnants of the Dragon God Sect have made a comeback, there will naturally be those outside to suppress them. As for you, boy, don’t expect to leave here alive."
The Black Monkey sneered coldly and suddenly moved, transforming into a black streak of light as he lunged at Ye Yun. He raised his furry fist, launching a whistling punch.
"You’re still too weak," Ye Yun laughed. "But since you’re here, there’s no need to leave."
A strange light flickered in Ye Yun’s eyes. The Black Monkey’s body swiftly went limp, collapsing at Ye Yun’s feet.
Ye Yun began to search the Black Monkey’s memories, but as soon as his Divine Sense entered, he found that the monkey’s memories were already fragmented, with many key points missing.
This mastermind behind the scenes is truly cautious. To think they’ve erased all clues even at this stage.
Ye Yun’s expression turned slightly cold. With a flick of his finger, the Black Monkey’s body exploded.
Its true body... I wonder if it would know a bit more?
Ye Yun murmured to himself, his gaze once again turning towards the bottom of the lake.

chapters.title: Chapter 341: Avatar and True Self
chapters.content:
Chapter 341: Chapter 341: Avatar and True Self
"So it really is Senior!"
In mid-air, Lei Qinian, sheltered by the golden light of the Heavenly Treasures Cover, gazed at Jun Moxiao’s back. His breathing was heavy, and his eyes filled with fervent admiration.
Although I don’t understand what this Divine Skill is, I know that as long as Senior is here, Jun Moxiao and I will be safe from any harm. No one can harm us.
Ye Yun stood quietly on the small island in the middle of the lake, watching the water with an impassive expression.
At the bottom of the lake lay a massive black Demonic Ape—a Zhan Tian Demon Ape, one of the most powerful branches of the Demon Clan.
The Black Monkey he had just eradicated with a flick of his finger was nothing more than an avatar of this Zhan Tian Demon Ape.
Throughout the entire Secret Realm, all the monkeys were avatars of this Zhan Tian Demon Ape.
If the Zhan Tian Demon Ape wished to awaken its true body, it had to reclaim all its avatars to mobilize its immense and decaying body.
This Zhan Tian Demon Ape had lived for too long; its body was gradually decaying, forcing it to find some way to prolong its life.
The Zhan Tian Demon Ape was under orders to guard the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree here, awaiting the successor of the Shen Heng Sect to enter the Heavenly Moon Secret Region and hang up the Jade Tablet signifying the completion of the task of keeping the Dragon God Sect in check.
It was the emissary designated to bestow rewards upon the Shen Heng Sect’s successor.
In its lifetime, this Zhan Tian Demon Ape had only reached Level one of the Life and Death Realm. Even now, if it retracted all its avatars to barely mobilize its decaying body, it could at most muster the strength of the Half-Step Life-Death Realm.
In Ye Yun’s eyes, this level of strength was less significant than an ant. That was why he gave the Zhan Tian Demon Ape time to re-mobilize its true body and face him properly.
"Senior, what is he waiting for?"
In mid-air, Lei Qinian looked at Ye Yun’s back, a bewildered expression on his face.
A flash of insight struck him as he suddenly remembered that the Black Monkey had emerged from the whirlpool in the lake.
Could it be... that some terrifying creature is lurking in the whirlpool?
The moment this thought crossed his mind, Lei Qinian’s curiosity was intensely piqued, and he observed the lake with great interest.
Unfortunately, his Divine Sense couldn’t penetrate too deeply into the lake, repelled by a formidable power.
Still, it gave him quite a shock.
This means there’s some unknown and incredibly powerful entity at the bottom of the lake, with an extremely high cultivation base!
Lei Qinian dared not look around recklessly anymore.
He could only hover quietly in mid-air, awaiting Senior’s actions.
After a while, whooshing sounds suddenly tore through the air from all directions.
One by one, monkeys emerged from the white mist, flew over the lake, and plunged violently into the water.
Watching monkey after monkey dive into the lake, sending up large splashes, Lei Qinian was utterly shocked.
What on earth happened? Why are these monkeys plunging into the lake like moths to a flame?
Ye Yun watched all this indifferently, his face expressionless.
I just hope this decaying Zhan Tian Demon Ape can provide some useful clues after it awakens. If this Zhan Tian Demon Ape’s mind holds no useful clues, I’ll need to find the mastermind elsewhere. I know many secrets still lie hidden across the vast Cangnan Continent. Even the mysteriously missing Nangong Jade might have laid traps for me to discover. And that little follower with pigtails—Little Miss Yunxiao. As the Demon Ancestor of the Demon Clan, Yunxiao has a long lifespan and must know more secrets. Therefore, I also want to investigate the Ruthless Palace.
SPLASH!
SPLASH!
One monkey after another plunged into the lake, sucked into the depths by a formidable suction force. They transformed into beams of light, entering the body of the Zhan Tian Demon Ape.
Most of the monkeys in the Secret Realm had extorted numerous elixirs from the human cultivators. Now, these elixirs transformed into a surging medicinal power, relentlessly replenishing the colossal true body of the Zhan Tian Demon Ape.
Ye Yun recognized one of the monkeys; it was the Monkey Leader who had guided Jun Moxiao to the Thousand-year Heavenly Moon Cassia Tree.
It morphed into a beam of black light. Upon entering the Zhan Tian Demon Ape’s body, it instantly provided an unimaginable surge of energy.
This potent energy naturally came from those God-level Dragon and Tiger Pills.
For the Zhan Tian Demon Ape, these God-level Dragon and Tiger Pills were like rare, potent tonics.
That powerful energy dispelled most of the decaying aura within its body, causing slight tremors to ripple through it.
Another monkey flew into the Zhan Tian Demon Ape’s body.
This was the leader of the monkey tribe Jun Moxiao had initially hired.
It too had consumed many elixirs, including one God-level Dragon and Tiger Pill.
This Monkey Leader also contributed a significant amount of energy.
Under the torrential, tide-like surge of energy, the Zhan Tian Demon Ape’s body regained vitality. Its fingers began to move, and its giant eyes soon opened.
The moment the Zhan Tian Demon Ape opened its eyes, winds surged and clouds churned throughout the Heavenly Moon Secret Region. The sky and earth changed color, and the Secret Realm was instantly plunged into darkness.
"What happened?"
"Why is it dark in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region?"
"I just saw many monkeys running around, all heading in the same direction. Could it be related to this?"
"Perhaps some reckless fool killed a monkey, and the Great Saint is about to unleash divine punishment!"
Cultivator after cultivator cursed. Looking at the suddenly darkened sky and earth, a nameless fear rose in their hearts.
「Inside the lake.」
Ultimately, all the monkeys transformed into black light and entered the body of the Zhan Tian Demon Ape.
Nourished by the God-level Dragon and Tiger Pills, the Zhan Tian Demon Ape, which at best could have recovered to the Half-Step Life-Death Realm, unexpectedly regained its strength at Level one of the Life and Death Realm.
It had returned to its former peak state.
The Zhan Tian Demon Ape closed its eyes and began to assimilate certain memories from its avatars.
Only a few seconds passed before it became aware of everything that had transpired in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region this time.
It also learned of the misfortune that had befallen the Shen Heng Sect, that remnants of the Dragon God Sect had entered the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, and that they had eliminated its strongest avatar.
Those insignificant remnants of the Dragon God Sect!
Rage burned within the Zhan Tian Demon Ape. The surrounding lake water churned violently, instantly pulverizing all the sand and stones on the lakebed.
It sat up abruptly.
At this moment, the lake water surged violently, forming a monstrous wave that rolled toward the small island in the center of the lake.
Ye Yun paid no mind to the lake water. With a slight flicker, he appeared in mid-air the next moment.
Heavens! What kind of monster has emerged from the depths of this lake?!
Seeing the towering, wrathful waves, Lei Qinian’s face instantly turned pale.
CRASH!
The lake water roared violently again. This time, it seemed as if all the water shot skyward, soaring a hundred zhang high, an astonishing display of power.
Even with the Heavenly Treasures Cover, Lei Qinian was swept by the surging water onto the descending golden light, sending him and the Heavenly Treasures Cover flying.
Ye Yun flicked his finger. A wave of Mana surged out, instantly pulling Lei Qinian high into the sky.
This Mana also formed a Defense Cover around Lei Qinian, protecting him.

chapters.title: Chapter 342: Zhan Tian Demon Ape
chapters.content:
Chapter 342: Chapter 342: Zhan Tian Demon Ape
"It must have been the Senior who sent me high into the sky and provided me with a Mana Protective Shield."
Feeling the changes in his own body, Lei Qinian looked at Ye Yun’s back, his heart filled with immense gratitude.
The raging waves just now were sky-high, their might astonishing.
Even with the protection of the Heavenly Treasures Cover, given his weak cultivation base, he would likely have struggled to defend himself.
If not dead, he would have been severely injured.
With a single move, the Senior had sent him high into the sky and even set up a protective shield, ensuring he faced no danger.
As Lei Qinian was overcome with emotion, his eyes suddenly widened, nearly popping out of his head.
He saw a colossal black figure slowly rising from the turbulent lake waters.
Despite the dim light, he could still discern the gigantic black figure—it towered into the heavens, immense and terrifying to behold.
"Isn’t this the Great Saint from the Great Saint Temple?"
When he clearly saw the black figure’s face, especially noting the black iron staff it carried, Lei Qinian could hardly conceal his shock.
So, the Great Saint... was hidden deep beneath the lake.
And all the monkeys it had previously raised had entered the lakebed. Could it be that the Great Saint’s true form had descended through some sort of sacrificial ritual?
Protected by the Defense Cover, Lei Qinian couldn’t sense the cultivation base of this gigantic Black Devil Monkey.
However, observing its immense body, Lei Qinian guessed that this Black Devil Monkey’s cultivation base was probably terrifyingly high.
SPLASH!
When the Zhan Tian Demon Ape stood up from the bottom of the lake, the water only reached below its knees, showing just how enormous its body was.
WHOOSH!
It shook its body, sending countless droplets of water spraying in all directions.
A large portion of them shot towards Ye Yun.
A smaller portion headed for Lei Qinian, high in the sky.
Ye Yun stood with his hands behind his back, his expression calm.
The myriad raindrops, upon reaching him, seemed to hit an invisible wall before scattering and falling into the lake water.
In the other direction, the raindrops struck the Defense Cover but couldn’t penetrate it, falling harmlessly away.
"Remnant of the Dragon God Sect, how wonderful! You’ve ruined the task given by my master, turning my long years of vigilance into failure at the very last moment!"
The Zhan Tian Demon Ape lowered its head and emitted a low, angry growl.
Its thick, black-furred arm slowly lifted the huge black iron staff, pointing it at Ye Yun in mid-air.
A powerful Super Divine Dragon Breath erupted from its body like a volcano.
In the white mist surrounding Lake Heart Island, the disciples of the three major sects, who were battling the Soul Flying Snakes, were all sent flying by the impact of this powerful Super Divine Dragon Breath; most of them fainted.
A very small number perished on the spot.
As for the Soul Flying Snakes, they now lay low in the mist, not daring to move.
"Zhan Tian Demon Ape, I’m very interested in who your master is. If you tell me, I don’t mind letting you live. I might even grant you a great opportunity," Ye Yun said, his eyes twinkling as he looked at the massive shadow before him with an interested smile.
He believed the Zhan Tian Demon Ape’s memories must have been tampered with.
Either certain memories were erased, or there were powerful restrictions in place.
Any attempt to probe them would cause them to shatter instantly.
After several previous attempts, Ye Yun no longer tried to directly read memories from others’ minds.
It was best if he could first obtain some information through other means.
Reading memories was only a last resort.
"My Zhan Tian Demon Ape tribe has always been loyal! We would never be traitors! You, escapee of the Dragon God Sect, you’d best give up that idea!" the Zhan Tian Demon Ape said coldly.
Its blood-red eyes, like two crimson moons hanging in their sockets, made the Zhan Tian Demon Ape look exceedingly ferocious.
After it spoke, the Super Divine Dragon Breath around the Zhan Tian Demon Ape’s entire body began to burn like flames. A dense black miasma roiled continuously over the surface of its thickly furred body.
It was preparing to strike.
The Dragon God Sect remnant before it was not to be underestimated—an unimaginable variable. It had to kill this opponent.
"It seems we can no longer communicate pleasantly. Come then, let me see what abilities you, a former first-level Life and Death Realm Zhan Tian Demon Ape, possess to guard this Heavenly Moon Secret Region," Ye Yun replied with a light, fearless smile, looking straight at the Zhan Tian Demon Ape.
This Zhan Tian Demon Ape could not be spared.
It’s too tight-lipped.
Now, the only option left is to read its memories.
Tiny, star-like runes appeared in Ye Yun’s mesmerizing eyes, the power of life and death surging within them, undergoing infinite transformations.
In an instant, the Zhan Tian Demon Ape, just as it was about to attack, suddenly faltered.
In that moment, Ye Yun seized the Zhan Tian Demon Ape’s memories.
Fortunately, its memories weren’t sealed by restrictions, though some key ones had been erased.
This Zhan Tian Demon Ape had been raised by a mysterious masked figure from a young age, all the way to the first level of the Life and Death Realm.
Then, this masked man assigned the Zhan Tian Demon Ape the task of guarding the Heavenly Moon Secret Region.
He also detailed various precautions.
These included:
It was to wait for the Shen Heng Sect’s successor to appear in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region at some future time and hang the Jade Tablet on the Ten Thousand Year Osmanthus Tree.
It had to verify a specific count: if the Shen Heng Sect had successfully counterbalanced the Dragon God Sect for a full three hundred generations, and if, after these three hundred generations, there were no more successors, then it was to give the reward to this Shen Heng Sect successor.
If not, then it meant an unforeseen, drastic change had occurred within the Dragon God Sect.
It was instructed to exterminate any remnants of the Dragon God Sect.
The loyal Zhan Tian Demon Ape accepted this task and entered the Heavenly Moon Secret Region to begin guarding this miniature world.
The masked man had even built a Great Saint Temple and taught the Zhan Tian Demon Ape a rudimentary Collection of Incense Divine Power, allowing it to use the Power of Incense Faith to extend its life.
Additionally, he taught it a Divine Skill of splitting, allowing it to transform into countless monkey avatars to seek elixirs from Human Cultivators.
The elixirs consumed by these avatars would all ultimately be channeled back to its main body.
This dual-pronged approach would allow its life to be extended until the time the Dragon God Sect was extinguished, in its three-hundredth generation.
These were the causes and consequences.
Ye Yun smiled faintly, unfazed.
This masked man is so secretive, not daring to show his true face; it really fits the typical style of a mastermind.
The power and stratagems of the mastermind far exceeded worldly imagination.
For instance, creating a fake Dragon God Sect and using a powerful luck-related Divine Skill to absorb the remaining Dragon God Sect’s luck on the Cangnan Continent was one such feat. This alone was something few in the vast Divine Land could achieve.
The Zhan Tian Demon Ape suddenly shook its massive head.
Just as it was about to attack, it had suddenly felt a moment of distraction.
It had missed the perfect opportunity to strike.
"What did you do to me just now?" the Zhan Tian Demon Ape roared in fury, simultaneously lifting its black iron staff and swinging it viciously down at Ye Yun.

chapters.title: Chapter 343: Xuan Yin Moon Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 343: Chapter 343: Xuan Yin Moon Dragon
WHOOSH!
The enormous iron staff swung down, carrying infinite, vast power. At that moment, the sky and earth abruptly changed color as an indescribably powerful aura swept in all directions.
The white mist surrounding the lake was instantly blown away by this ferocious wind.
Whether it was the Soul Flying Snakes or the disciples of the three major Sects within the white mist, all were blown thousands of miles away. They were scattered and in complete disarray.
Even the Soul Flying Snakes were knocked unconscious by the violent wind.
Further away, cultivators, terrified by the eerie, dark celestial phenomenon, sensed a raging wind sweeping toward them and fled in panic. Some hid in caves, some in valleys, and others clung tightly to the Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Trees. In that instant, all cultivators used various methods to protect their lives.
"So powerful!"
Watching the colossal Zhan Tian Demon Ape swing down its black iron staff, the mere visual impact made Lei Qinian’s heart pound, his entire body shivering. However, he was surprised to discover that, thanks to the protective shield, he was completely unaffected. The fierce wind from the iron staff split and flowed away the moment it touched the shield. This made him both surprised and delighted.
Lei Qinian looked at Ye Yun’s back, his eyes burning with even more fervor. He knew that Senior’s cultivation base was far superior to that of this colossal, black Demonic Ape. Therefore, he had nothing to worry about.
"A petty Life and Death Realm entity, daring to run rampant before me?" Ye Yun said softly.
His voice transformed into a powerful soundwave that instantly rushed towards the enormous black iron staff.
BOOM!
The black iron staff was instantly flung backward. The powerful soundwave, however, continued like a tidal wave towards the Zhan Tian Demon Ape.
"What!"
As the void trembled and an indescribable soundwave carrying a world-destroying aura swept in, the Zhan Tian Demon Ape was filled with an unspeakable horror. At that moment, it finally understood. The black-robed youth before it—his cultivation base had likely reached the Eternal Realm! He was far beyond what a first-level Life and Death Realm demon beast like itself could handle.
The thought had barely flashed through its mind when...
BOOM!
The huge soundwave slammed into the Zhan Tian Demon Ape.
The soundwave vibrated incessantly, and the Zhan Tian Demon Ape’s colossal body was instantly shaken into a mist of blood that rained down from mid-air.
A single sentence from Senior...
The formidable Zhan Tian Demon Ape had fallen.
From mid-air, Lei Qinian witnessed the entire battle from beginning to end.
HISS!
He sharply inhaled a breath of cold air.
Senior is too strong! A single sentence had turned a Life and Death Realm expert into a mist of blood. The power of such a Divine Skill was truly unimaginable!
After the Zhan Tian Demon Ape was killed, Ye Yun felt no joy, but rather a faint melancholy. It went without saying that the masked master of the Zhan Tian Demon Ape was another pawn placed long ago by the shadow manipulator. But now, that lead was severed.
Ye Yun stood quietly in mid-air, gazing into the distance, once again pondering everything the Dragon God Sect had encountered over the past one hundred thousand years. He slowly reviewed the timeline, including people he had met and events that had occurred during his lifetime, trying to find any trace of a clue.
After the Zhan Tian Demon Ape’s death, the sky and earth gradually cleared. Everyone breathed a sigh of relief; the phenomenon just now had been truly terrifying. At that moment, everyone thought the Heavenly Moon Secret Region was going to collapse.
After reviewing past events, Ye Yun found no new leads. He couldn’t help but sigh softly.
The shadow manipulator is skilled in divination and possesses some ability to predict the future. They had meticulously planned, step by step, a scheme that had begun a hundred thousand years ago. To trace it all back now would be extraordinarily difficult.
Ye Yun surveyed his surroundings, his gaze sweeping across the entire Heavenly Moon Secret Region, when an idea suddenly flashed through his mind.
This Heavenly Moon Secret Region, a miniature world guarded by the Zhan Tian Demon Ape, what is its origin? Could it have been specially created by that shadow manipulator?
As he mused, his eyes suddenly brightened, as if he had grasped a clue.
Ye Yun took a step and vanished in the blink of an eye.
"Senior!" Lei Qinian shouted, anxiety clear on his face. He was still enshrouded in a protective shield, unable to move at all.
The protective shield suddenly disappeared.
Lei Qinian regained his freedom. He looked down. The entire lake was dyed crimson with the Zhan Tian Demon Ape’s blood, the metallic stench extremely strong. It felt as if he had just awakened from a dream.
Where should I go now?
Lei Qinian looked around. Noticing the white mist had also vanished, he was momentarily unsure what to do.
Forget it, I’ll just stay here and wait for Senior to return. Perhaps after he resolves the matter, he will leave Jun Moxiao’s body.
After a moment of consideration, Lei Qinian decided to stay. He landed on the small island in the lake’s center.
...
Ye Yun continuously teleported through the void, meticulously inspecting the Heavenly Moon Secret Region. In the distant depths of the Secret Region, he surprisingly sensed a faint yet familiar trace of Divine Dragon’s Breath.
This discovery made Ye Yun slightly puzzled. This Divine Dragon’s Breath was very unique, belonging to an extremely rare type of Dragon Clan.
Ye Yun’s gaze swept over the lush Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Trees on the mountain range. His eyes suddenly lit up; he instantly knew the origin of this Divine Dragon’s Breath.
This breath is from a Xuan Yin Moon Dragon.
This was a type of Dragon Clan that dwelled on the Moon Star in the deep, dark night sky. It was said they never left the Moon Star their entire lives. They would never leave unless commanded by the Lord Ancestor Dragon.
Ye Yun’s eyes flickered. As he sensed this Secret Region once more, a look of surprise crossed his face.
Could this Secret Region have been forged from the body of a Xuan Yin Moon Dragon?
To forge a Secret Region from a Divine Dragon was an extraordinary feat, far beyond the capabilities of an ordinary major Sect. It would require, at the very least, a Super Sect.
With this deduction, Ye Yun could now surmise that this Secret Region was likely created by the shadow manipulator.
This Xuan Yin Moon Dragon died a very long time ago. I wonder if any remnant of its will still exists?
If he could find the will of the Xuan Yin Moon Dragon, then he might be able to discover what power constructed this Heavenly Moon Secret Region.
Ye Yun activated the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye. He began to deconstruct the fabric of this Secret Region, simultaneously searching for the Xuan Yin Moon Dragon’s will.
However, after searching for the time it takes for an incense stick to burn, Ye Yun found no trace of the Xuan Yin Moon Dragon’s will.
Has too much time truly passed, causing its will to dissipate completely?
Ye Yun stood silently in the void, motionless.
Perhaps if I stimulate the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline and mimic the Ancestor Dragon’s will to try and summon the Xuan Yin Moon Dragon, there might be a chance of success.
A glint flashed in Ye Yun’s eyes as another idea occurred to him.
Under Ye Yun’s control, Jun Moxiao’s body immediately surged, maximizing the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline within him.
Instantly, the body transformed into a colossal Golden Giant Dragon. This Golden Giant Dragon coiled high in the sky, radiating an unimaginably vast, mysterious, and noble aura.
At that moment, all living beings within the Secret Region fainted.

chapters.title: Chapter 344: Tianjige Creates the Heavenly Moon Secret Region
chapters.content:
Chapter 344: Chapter 344: Tianjige Creates the Heavenly Moon Secret Region
High above the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, a colossal Golden Giant Dragon exuded an incomparably resplendent golden light, illuminating the entire Secret Region. However, every living creature had fainted, missing the chance to witness this spectacular scene. This golden light was filled with an indescribable sense of mystique, grandeur, vastness, and desolation. If one looked closely, one could also glimpse various other colors shimmering within the golden glow. It was as if this golden light encompassed all the colors of the world.
Ye Yun activated the scarce Ancestral Dragon Bloodline within Jun Moxiao, transforming him into an Ancestor Dragon’s True Body. Of course, this Ancestor Dragon’s True Body was not the *actual* Ancestor Dragon’s True Body; it was merely a temporary transformation. If Ye Yun’s own body were to transform into an Ancestor Dragon, it could infinitely approximate the true Ancestor Dragon. Activating Jun Moxiao’s Ancestral Dragon Bloodline within the Heavenly Moon Secret Region to form the Ancestor Dragon’s True Body should now be sufficient to summon the Xuan Yin Moon Dragon.
"Xuan Yin Moon Dragon—I, the Ancestor Dragon, have descended upon this world! I summon you, members of the Dragon Clan, to appear!"
As the Giant Dragon opened its mouth, Ye Yun uttered a phrase in the Dragon language. This voice was exceedingly ancient and resonant, with a cadence that only the Dragon Clan could comprehend.
Only such a summons—using the Ancestor Dragon’s True Body and speaking the words of the Ancestor Dragon—could evoke resonance within the world of this Secret Region. This, in turn, would stimulate the fragmented and weak will of the Xuan Yin Moon Dragon, causing it to awaken and reconverge.
After the first call in the Dragon language was sent out, the world remained silent, with no noticeable changes. Ye Yun maintained his patience and continued to summon relentlessly.
When the seventh summons in the Dragon language was issued, Ye Yun felt the ground of the entire Secret Region begin to tremble. This tremor was slight at first but soon intensified, shaking the land continuously.
Then, Ye Yun issued an eighth call in the Dragon language.
At this, the sky also changed. The originally bright world suddenly plunged into a deathly, silent darkness. A radiant moon abruptly ascended from the horizon, hanging high in the sky.
It seems the will of the Xuan Yin Moon Dragon has responded to the summons and has reconsolidated within this land.
Seeing this change in the heavens and earth, Ye Yun visibly relaxed. He unhesitatingly issued a ninth call in the Dragon language.
"Xuan Yin Moon Dragon—I, the Ancestor Dragon, have descended upon this world! I summon you, members of the Dragon Clan, to appear!"
Above the moon, an illusory, pale-yellow Divine Dragon Phantom slowly materialized. The moment this Divine Dragon Phantom solidified, it transformed into a streak of light, flying down from the moon and arriving before Ye Yun.
"Your subject, Xuan Yin Moon Dragon, pays respects to Lord Ancestor Dragon!"
The illusory Xuan Yin Moon Dragon’s enormous body prostrated in mid-air, its voice deep and filled with supreme reverence.
Ye Yun fixed his bright dragon eyes on this Xuan Yin Moon Dragon.
The body condensed from this awakened will isn’t very strong; it will dissipate soon.
"Xuan Yin Moon Dragon, who exactly transformed your body into this Heavenly Moon Secret Region?" Ye Yun asked.
"Reporting to Lord Ancestor Dragon," the Xuan Yin Moon Dragon said in a solemn voice, "I fell in battle during Ancient Times. Afterward, this dragon corpse changed hands many times before a faction known as Tianjige transformed it into this Secret Region."
Ye Yun nodded slightly.
Although the Xuan Yin Moon Dragon had perished, the faint will remaining in its body still preserved some useful information.
What kind of faction is this Tianjige?
「Inside the carriage.」
Ye Yun, who had been cultivating with his eyes closed, suddenly opened them and looked at Mu Qing opposite him.
Mu Qing’s expression flickered in surprise. "Sir, Tianjige is a Super Sect within the Plough Heaven Dynasty. Their origins are mysterious and profound, and it’s said they rarely appear in the world."
"Mm," Ye Yun nodded.
So, it truly was a Super Sect that transformed the Xuan Yin Moon Dragon’s corpse into a Secret Region for Nirvana Realm Cultivators to gain experience.
"Sir, Tianjige isn’t like ordinary Sects. They specialize in various esoteric Divine Skills, including Formations, alchemy, and divination. Tianjige’s Sect location is extremely well-hidden, shielded by layers of grand Formations. It’s said that no outsider has ever set foot inside Tianjige," Mu Qing added with a smile after a moment of thought.
Although she didn’t know why Sir was asking about Tianjige, she told him everything she knew.
Ye Yun nodded slightly and closed his eyes again.
A minor faction like Tianjige is merely a pawn of the hidden mastermind. It’s not yet worthy of being my adversary. Only the true mastermind concealed within Divine Land, someone at the Divine King Realm, is qualified to contend with me. However, now is not the time for that. Improving the three juniors of my Dragon God Sect is the highest priority.
「Ye Yun’s consciousness returned to the Heavenly Moon Secret Region.」
The Xuan Yin Moon Dragon before him was still prostrating in mid-air, but its body was becoming increasingly illusory.
I know this Xuan Yin Moon Dragon only formed because I actively awakened the remnant will within this Secret Region. It won’t be able to last much longer.
"Lord Ancestor Dragon, back then, our Xuan Yin Moon Dragon clan guarded the Moon Star. We all perished in battle. The treasure you entrusted us to protect was also stolen by the Spirits of Divine Land."
The Xuan Yin Moon Dragon’s body trembled slightly, its voice growing sorrowful. Although it was merely an illusory phantom of a Divine Dragon condensed from remnant will, it still vividly remembered the tragic, fierce battle that had occurred on the Moon Star during the Ancient Era.
Ye Yun was momentarily stunned. Seeing the Xuan Yin Moon Dragon was about to disappear, he quickly said, "You are not to blame for this. You all did your best."
"Thank you for your understanding, Lord Ancestor Dragon. Our Clan Members can now rest in peace in the Nine Springs."
After the Xuan Yin Moon Dragon finished speaking in a low voice, immense sadness filled its dragon eyes. In the next moment, its body began to disintegrate, returning to the fabric of this world.
A glint flashed in Ye Yun’s eyes as he instantly read the memories from the Xuan Yin Moon Dragon’s mind.
The memories aren’t complete. They only cover the battle on the Moon Star, the one the Xuan Yin Moon Dragon cared about most. In that great battle, the Spirits of Divine Land launched a surprise attack on the Moon Star. All the Xuan Yin Moon Dragons fought to their deaths, and the entire clan was annihilated. As for the treasure it mentioned, it was something the Ancestor Dragon had once sealed on the Moon Star. The Xuan Yin Moon Dragon clan itself didn’t know its exact nature. After conquering the Moon Star, the Cultivators of Divine Land proceeded to break the Seal set by the Ancestor Dragon and seized that treasure. What exactly was this treasure of the Ancestor Dragon...?
Ye Yun gazed at the spot where the Xuan Yin Moon Dragon had dissipated, his voice tinged with desolation.
That battle from Ancient Times occurred far too long ago, a full several million years in the past. It would be difficult to uncover the truth now.
Ye Yun withdrew the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline, and his body reverted to Jun Moxiao’s appearance.
This trip to the Heavenly Moon Secret Region yielded great gains, but also profound regrets.
「Ancient Times.」
The conflict between the two major powers, the Dragon Hidden Continent and Divine Land, ultimately concluded with a decisive victory for the Spirits of Divine Land. The glory of the Dragon Clan silently faded in that age.
For the Ancestor Dragon, with its world-encompassing Great power of the Creation, to still need to seal a treasure on the Moon Star... what kind of treasure could it possibly be?
Ye Yun gazed into the void with a desolate expression, murmuring to himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 345: Leaving the Secret Realm, Under Siege
chapters.content:
Chapter 345: Chapter 345: Leaving the Secret Realm, Under Siege
「Ancient Times.」
As the head of the Dragon Clan, the power of the Ancestor Dragon was beyond question.
But it sealed away a treasure.
It is evident that this artifact must have an astonishing origin, so much so that even the Ancestor Dragon, with its heaven-creating power, seemed unable to control it, thus the need for the seal.
Ye Yun was quite interested in this sealed treasure.
Though his warehouse was nearly limitless with all sorts of treasures, compared to them, the treasure sealed by the Ancestor Dragon was nothing.
But Ye Yun knew that this artifact might have something to do with the causes of the great war between the two clans in those days.
This was where his interest lay.
However, from ancient times to the present, the timespan was simply too long. Who knows where this artifact had ended up in the Divine Land.
Ye Yun thought that there was no rush for now.
He would eventually head to the Divine Land, and the mysteries would be unraveled one by one.
The contest between him and the mastermind behind the scenes was just beginning.
This was a game.
Playing by the game rules would be very interesting.
If he broke the game rules, it would be like having GM authority in an online game from the start. While playing might be thrilling for a moment, it would ultimately become monotonous over time.
Ye Yun shook his head, temporarily discarding many thoughts.
He looked at the cultivators who had been knocked unconscious in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, including Lei Qinian. With a gentle wave of his hand, all the cultivators were teleported out the moment they awoke.
"I’ll leave this Heavenly Moon Secret Region here for now," Ye Yun mused, gazing into the distance. "If I take it away, it might alert the Tianjige."
Then, he vanished from the spot.
As soon as Ye Yun appeared outside, that wisp of Primordial Spirit dissipated.
Jun Moxiao’s consciousness retook control of his original body.
"What just happened?" Jun Moxiao scratched his head, looking completely bewildered as he surveyed the surrounding cultivators from various major forces. "Why were we suddenly teleported out after that Black Monkey appeared?"
Ye Yun had altered his memory.
Jun Moxiao’s memory now ended at the point where the Black Monkey began questioning him.
「Meanwhile.」
A small part of Lei Qinian’s memory had also been erased.
These two youngsters had better not know too much,
Ye Yun had decided.
"Junior Brother Jun, I finally found you!"
A ray of light flew over and landed beside Jun Moxiao; it was Lei Qinian.
The Heavenly Treasures Cover hovered above his head, streams of golden light cascading down, protecting both him and Jun Moxiao.
"Brother Lei, how did we all get teleported out?" Jun Moxiao immediately asked upon seeing Lei Qinian.
"That’s just how the Heavenly Moon Secret Region is; you never know when you’ll suddenly be teleported out," Lei Qinian said with a shrug, lowering his voice. "We were in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region for about a month this time. That’s not a short period, so it aligns with the usual timing for being sent out."
"Oh, I see," Jun Moxiao nodded, a look of understanding dawning on his face.
Suddenly, his heart leaped as he remembered something crucial.
He recalled finding the Ten-Thousand-Year-Old Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree with Lei Qinian on the small island in the lake. After he hung the token on it, a Black Monkey had flown out of the water.
The Black Monkey had only asked him a few questions before he was teleported out.
And as for the reward, the Black Monkey hadn’t given him anything!
This filled Jun Moxiao with immense regret; he had no idea if he had successfully completed the task his ancestor had entrusted to him.
"Junior Brother Jun, let’s get out of here quickly," Lei Qinian tugged at Jun Moxiao’s sleeve and whispered to him via voice transmission. "If the disciples from the three major Sects realize what happened, they’ll definitely come after us."
Jun Moxiao quickly nodded.
They had obtained so many Ten Thousand Years Golden Osmanthus Fruits. If the disciples from the three major Sects managed to intercept them, it would be a catastrophic loss.
Among the three major Sects, the Xuanyang Sect was their mortal enemy.
Now that they were out of the Secret Realm, the Xuanyang Sect certainly wouldn’t let them go.
The two were preparing to sneak away.
Suddenly, over a thousand cultivators surrounded them from all directions.
These cultivators, all clad in striking red robes, were unmistakably disciples of the Xuanyang Sect.
At this moment, a young man in red robes slowly walked out from the crowd, his hands clasped behind his back, his gaze cold and aloof. He let out a sneer, "You two loose cultivators, still think you can escape? You killed so many of our Xuanyang Sect disciples. Today, we will avenge our fallen brothers!"
His words were highly inflammatory, causing all the Xuanyang Sect disciples’ eyes to turn red as their blood boiled with righteous fury.
"Avenge our fellow disciples!"
They all drew their swords, pointing them at Jun Moxiao and Lei Qinian.
Lei Qinian’s face turned deathly pale.
There were two to three thousand Xuanyang Sect disciples here.
He and Jun Moxiao definitely couldn’t fight them.
This time, they were truly doomed.
"Those two loose cultivators really overestimated themselves!" a black-robed young man remarked, standing on a distant boulder. He was a disciple of the Mo Xue Sect. "Causing trouble in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region with a pack of monkeys, borrowing power they didn’t earn. Now that they’re out, they’ve become rats everyone wants to squash."
Behind him stood a large contingent of Mo Xue Sect disciples, their numbers roughly matching those of the Xuanyang Sect.
However, it was none of their business, so the Mo Xue Sect disciples had no intention of intervening in the Xuanyang Sect’s affairs. After all, the two insignificant loose cultivators had nothing to do with them.
"Mu Qing, go and bring those two little ones back," Ye Yun said calmly from inside the carriage.
Mu Qing was slightly taken aback.
Bring who back?
The Master’s words left her a bit confused.
But the next moment, the Void Force activated, and Mu Qing vanished from the carriage.
When she reappeared, Mu Qing was surprised to find herself high in the air. Below, a large group of Xuanyang Sect disciples had surrounded Jun Moxiao and Lei Qinian.
A huge battle was about to erupt.
Mu Qing’s expression changed drastically.
This is outrageous!
These Xuanyang Sect disciples actually dared to attack disciples of the Dragon God Sect? They truly have a death wish!
Mu Qing waved her wide sleeve, and an overwhelming surge of mana swept out like a fierce gale towards the cultivators below.
The Xuanyang Sect disciples, not expecting a powerful cultivator at the seventh level of the Destiny Realm to suddenly attack from above, were sent staggering back by the force of the wind. Many fell to the ground, and the scene instantly became one of extreme chaos, leaving them in utter disarray.
Mu Qing, dressed in black, descended gracefully from mid-air.
She clasped her fists and bowed respectfully to Jun Moxiao, saying, "Mu Qing greets Senior Brother Jun!"
Seeing a stunning beauty from the Destiny Realm—and one with such high cultivation—bowing to him, Jun Moxiao’s face turned beet red, despite their previous encounters.
"Junior... Junior Sister Mu, please, don’t be so courteous," Jun Moxiao stammered, quickly reaching out to help her up.
"..."
This scene, witnessed by every cultivator present, sent a wave of profound shock through them.
Everyone looked on with dazed expressions, completely petrified.
Wasn’t this beautiful girl in black, with her unbelievably high cultivation base, the Saintess of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird?

chapters.title: Chapter 346: Saintess Loses Her Temper
chapters.content:
Chapter 346: Chapter 346: Saintess Loses Her Temper
Upon seeing the young lad, Jun Moxiao, blushing deeply, Mu Qing gave him a faint smile and gracefully stood up.
Female cultivators usually possessed techniques to maintain their youthful appearance, allowing them to keep a look they favored. She was considerably older than Jun Moxiao, by an amount he couldn’t possibly guess.
Therefore, she didn’t lower herself to the level of a young boy like Jun Moxiao.
"Isn’t that the Saintess from the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird? Why is she..."
Lei Qinian was wide-eyed and tongue-tied with shock.
Some of his memories had been erased by Ye Yun, so he wasn’t very clear about what had happened at the Wu Kun Mountain Black Market.
With all eyes on him, Lei Qinian could only conceal his doubts deep inside.
However, he breathed a sigh of relief.
The Saintess from the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird had come here. With her transcendent status and strength, she would surely be able to resolve the dangerous predicament he and Jun Moxiao were in.
The Xuanyang Sect disciples, who had been sent sprawling by the fierce wind, struggled back to their feet.
Anger was evident on their faces as they stared at the beautiful, black-clad young woman before them.
"It’s the Saintess from the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird."
One of the leading youths in red grimaced as soon as he recognized Mu Qing.
The Saintess from the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, a powerful cultivator at Destiny Realm Level 7, was far beyond what these Nirvana Realm disciples could handle. This Saintess held a transcendent position within her sect, ranking second only to the Sect Master in the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird. They, mere juniors, couldn’t afford to offend such an eminent figure.
The cultivators from the various major Sects nearby watched as the Saintess of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird suddenly appeared and rescued the pair of Loose Cultivators. Puzzlement showed on each of their faces.
Previously, they had been too far away, and with the gale being so fierce, they hadn’t clearly heard the conversation between Jun Moxiao and Mu Qing.
However, the crowd had witnessed the Saintess’s respectful demeanor towards the black-robed youth.
For a great cultivator at Destiny Realm Level 7 to show such respect to a youth merely at the First Level Nirvana Realm was truly baffling. Could it be that this black-robed young Loose Cultivator had some extraordinary background that they had all misjudged?
The surrounding cultivators began to discuss this fervently, their curious gazes repeatedly sweeping over Jun Moxiao.
The only ones in direct confrontation with Jun Moxiao now were from the Xuanyang Sect.
However, these Xuanyang Sect disciples were all in the Nirvana Realm. Even united, they wouldn’t dare make a move against the Saintess of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird.
If they did act, in the end, only these Nirvana Realm disciples from the Xuanyang Sect would suffer.
However, for this training expedition, each of the three major sects had Destiny Realm Elders leading their groups.
The Xuanyang Sect was no exception.
A ray of sword light darted over, transforming into an elder in red robes, who landed opposite Mu Qing.
"Greetings, Saintess."
The elder in red robes cupped his hands and showed considerable respect.
He was merely an Elder in Charge, his cultivation base only at Destiny Realm Level 5. His status was in no way comparable to Mu Qing’s as a Saintess.
Mu Qing stood with her hands clasped behind her back, coolly observing the elder in red robes before her.
She recognized this elder in red robes; his name was Wu Qingzi, an Elder in Charge in the Xuanyang Sect.
In the Heavenly Moon Dynasty, each of the Four Great Sects had numerous Elders in Charge responsible for various affairs within the sects.
Compared to normal disciples, these Elders in Charge undoubtedly held a more prestigious position.
But when compared to her, a Saintess, they simply paled in comparison.
"May I ask the Saintess, is this young man a member of your esteemed sect?" the elder in red robes stared at Jun Moxiao, his gaze flickering, and asked in a deep voice.
"Indeed, we are from the same sect," Mu Qing narrowed her eyes slightly, her voice icy as she replied.
Although she was originally from the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, Mu Qing was now a member of the Dragon God Sect. Not only that, even the ancestor of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird—the Xuan bird itself—was now a demon beast of the Dragon God Sect.
The elder in red robes was startled.
He truly hadn’t expected this black-robed youth to actually be a disciple of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird. If that was the case, he truly had no grounds to argue with the Saintess any further.
"Let’s go!" The elder in red robes turned, his face ashen. With a wave of his hand, he issued an order to the surrounding Nirvana Realm disciples.
"Elder, many of our disciples were killed by these two," a youth in red approached and said in a low voice.
"Really?" The elder in red robes’ heart skipped a beat, a look of doubt in his eyes.
That youth was merely at the First Level Nirvana Realm, and the young man beside him was only at the Fifth Level of the Nirvana Realm. With such cultivation bases, could they really kill Xuanyang Sect disciples?
Hearing the words of the youth in red, Lei Qinian became furious and shouted, "You Xuanyang Sect disciples are utterly shameless! You were the ones trying to kill us, but you mistakenly killed the monkeys, provoking the Great Saint’s divine wrath and getting yourselves annihilated!"
"At first, wasn’t it this kid who killed eight of our fellow disciples?" the youth in red turned, pointed at Jun Moxiao, and angrily retorted.
"They deserved to die!" Jun Moxiao also spoke up; he looked at the youth in red and scoffed, "He wanted to rob us of our golden Laurel fruits and, with murderous intent, they besieged us. But they were thwarted by the monkeys. If I hadn’t killed them, should I have let them kill me instead? The reasoning of you Xuanyang Sect disciples is truly laughable!"
"You’re spouting nonsense!" The youth in red’s face flushed, and he trembled with anger.
The youth wasn’t wrong. His fellow Xuanyang Sect disciples had indeed relied on their superior numbers to attack these two Loose Cultivators. However, these two Loose Cultivators were exceptionally cunning; they used medicinal pills to incite a group of monkeys. That was how his eight fellow disciples ended up surrounded and attacked by the monkeys, allowing this youth to seize an opportunity to ambush and kill them.
This information, naturally, came from the rumors spread by the cultivators who were around the battle site at the time.
Mu Qing stepped forward, her eyes filled with murderous intent, and said coldly, "Senior Brother Jun, you did well killing them! If Xuanyang Sect disciples dare to provoke you, then don’t spare a single one!"
Seeing the Saintess of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird suddenly erupt in anger, the Xuanyang Sect disciples immediately fell silent, thoroughly intimidated.
Even the elder in red robes, a Destiny Realm Level 5 cultivator, shivered at this moment.
If they truly provoked this Destiny Realm Saintess into action, the losses on their side would be immense.
"Saintess, please don’t be angry. If the Xuanyang Sect has erred in any way, please overlook it, Saintess!" the elder in red robes quickly tried to smooth things over.
After the elder finished speaking, many cultivators around suddenly showed expressions of horror.
Because they had just heard the Saintess address the youth as "Senior Brother."
What in the world was going on? Since when did the Saintess of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird have a Senior Brother in the Nirvana Realm? And one whose standing was apparently so high! This was utterly shocking, too sensational!
After the elder in red robes finished speaking, this point also occurred to him, and he suddenly had a realization.
The Saintess of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird addressed this black-robed youth as Senior Brother. What on earth was this youth’s background? He couldn’t help but become deeply uneasy.
Mu Qing ignored him completely, instead looking at Jun Moxiao. She smiled gently and said in a soft voice, "Senior Brother Jun, which blind fools were they that angered you? Your Junior Sister will vent your anger for you and kill them all."
She spoke very gently.
But her gentle, breeze-like tone contained a potent killing intent!

chapters.title: Chapter 347: Luo Li’s Filial Piety
chapters.content:
Chapter 347: Chapter 347: Luo Li’s Filial Piety
"Junior Sister Mu Qing, those disciples from the Xuanyang Sect with whom I had grievances are all dead. I have no dealings with the rest, so let them go!" Jun Moxiao pondered and said.
There were many disciples of the Xuanyang Sect in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, but only a small handful of them had conflicts with him. In the end, they were struck dead on the spot by the heavenly might of the Great Saint.
As for the others, they had merely followed the two of them into the Plain of White Fog. Of course, it wasn’t just the Xuanyang Sect; the Mo Xue Sect and Zhengyi Jianmen were there too. These three major powers got lost in the white fog and had no opportunity to clash with him.
Jun Moxiao was a person who clearly distinguished between gratitude and grudges, and he didn’t implicate the entire Xuanyang Sect over disputes with a few individuals.
When Ye Yun saw this, he chuckled. This boy, Jun Moxiao, he thought, was indeed quite different from him. If it were him from a hundred thousand years ago, and the Xuanyang Sect had dared to treat him this way, he, the number one tyrant of the Cangnan Continent, would have long since led his forces straight to the Xuanyang Sect’s stronghold. However, the three juniors of the Dragon God Sect were all distinct individuals, and Ye Yun didn’t want to mold them all into his former self. Every generation has its own fortunes, after all. As an Ancestor, it wasn’t good for him to meddle in everything.
"I understand, Senior Brother Jun!"
Mu Qing smiled faintly, turned her head, and an icy chill emanated from her once more. Her gaze was like a sword as she shouted loudly, "Since my Senior Brother has spoken, you all get lost, now!"
"Yes..."
The red-robed elder dared not say a word. Mumbling an affirmative, he hastily led the Nirvana Realm disciples away from this place at top speed.
The disciples from the other major powers, naturally, didn’t dare to linger and departed one after another, tearing through the air.
In the void, the phantom of the colossal Heavenly Moon Osmanthus Tree gradually faded.
This expedition to the Heavenly Moon Secret Region had thoroughly come to a close.
"Junior Brother Jun, did you join the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird? You... aren’t you a disciple of Senior’s Dragon God Sect?" Lei Qinian put away the Heavenly Treasures Cover, rubbed his hands, and asked with a somewhat awkward smile.
Mu Qing looked at Lei Qinian and smiled faintly. "Esteemed Daoist Brother, it’s not that Senior Brother Jun joined the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, but rather that I have joined the Dragon God Sect."
"So that’s how it is..." Lei Qinian showed an enlightened look.
The Dragon God Sect had a senior like him presiding over it and was incomparably powerful. Therefore, it was understandable for the Saintess of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird to join the Dragon God Sect. People strive for greater heights, just as water flows downwards. That was precisely the principle at play.
"Senior Brother Jun, let’s go. Master is still waiting over there," Mu Qing said with a smile, lightly licking her sensual red lips.
"Okay." Jun Moxiao nodded.
Before the three of them could move, the void fluctuated. They felt as if the stars were shifting and the world was spinning, space rapidly changing around them. In the blink of an eye, the black carriage appeared in their line of sight.
The three looked at each other, then immediately understood.
"Little Junior Brother, you were gone for so long! How was your harvest?" Luo Li burst out of the carriage impetuously, like a whirlwind.
