Immediately after, Su Wanyi lifted the carriage curtain. With an expression as gentle as jade, she gracefully stepped out. Looking at her Little Junior Brother, Jun Moxiao, her exquisitely beautiful face was filled with a warm smile.
"I obtained quite a few Ten Thousand Year Osmanthus Fruits, but it seems I didn’t complete the task given by the Ancestor very well!" Jun Moxiao’s face turned red, and he scratched his head awkwardly.
Ye Yun walked out and smiled. "Your task can be considered perfectly completed."
"Really, Ancestor?" Jun Moxiao breathed a sigh of relief, then took out all the golden Laurel Fruits he had obtained.
"Senior Sisters, please try some..." Jun Moxiao raised the bag in his hand.
Lei Qinian also hurriedly held up a bag, saying in a flustered manner, "I have some here too, Junior Brother Jun! They’re all for you."
"Brother Lei, how can I accept that? Didn’t we agree already? Half each is enough." Jun Moxiao shook his head helplessly and didn’t accept the bag.
Lei Qinian then became anxious and forcefully shoved the bag into Jun Moxiao’s hand. "Junior Brother Jun, without you, I would have died long ago in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region! What use are these golden Laurel Fruits to me?" he said with a chagrined expression.
"Lei Qinian, you take half of these Laurel Fruits, and give the other half to Jun Moxiao," Ye Yun said with a smile from the side.
Seeing that this senior, Ye Yun, had spoken, Lei Qinian immediately deflated.
Jun Moxiao grinned, took out half of the golden Laurel Fruits from the bag, and put them into his own.
At this moment, Luo Li and Su Wanyi came over. Each took out a golden Laurel Fruit and brought it to her nose to smell.
"Senior Sisters, try them. They can improve one’s aptitude, especially those over ten thousand years old; the effect is even better," Jun Moxiao advised with a smile from the side.
"Little Junior Brother, you’re really thoughtful! Big Senior Sister and I haven’t doted on you for nothing, it seems." Luo Li giggled, her beautiful large eyes curving into crescents. She picked up a Tianyue Osmanthus Fruit and took a bite.
"It tastes so good!" After taking a small bite, Luo Li was full of praise.
"Sect Leader, could you spare one for me?" the Big Black Cat stretched its neck and shouted courageously.
"Here, there’s enough for everyone." Luo Li laughed heartily, grabbed a dozen or so golden Laurel Fruits from the bag, and tossed them out.
Each demon beast received three, and Mu Qing also got three. Even the Divine Monarch Realm Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon wasn’t left out.
"Sect Leader, I’ll pass. These are of no use to me." The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon used its Mana to make three golden Laurel Fruits float before its eyes. It sniffed them with its nose, then gave a helpless, bitter smile. These Tianyue Osmanthus Fruits were indeed excellent, but they had no effect on Cultivators at or above the True God Realm.
"Senior, why not give them to me and Little Cat then?" the Big Black Cat said eagerly from the side. It didn’t directly say it wanted them for itself but included Little Cat, who had the lowest cultivation base. This way, it also appeared selfless.
"Take them," the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon said with a smile.
"Thank you, Senior!" The Big Black Cat was instantly overjoyed. It beckoned with its paw, drawing the three golden Laurel Fruits before it. Then, it opened its mouth, preparing to swallow all three at once.
Little Cat quickly pulled it back, saying with an aggrieved look, "Big Bro, why are you eating mine too?"
"Oops, I forgot!" The Big Black Cat feigned ignorance, then gave Little Cat one golden Laurel Fruit.
Little Cat didn’t complain about receiving only one. After all, having gained an extra golden Laurel Fruit for nothing, it was already very content.
Everyone savored the golden Laurel Fruits, happy smiles appearing on their faces.
"Ancestor, would you like to try one too?" Luo Li came to Ye Yun’s side, holding the largest golden Laurel Fruit, and said with a beaming smile.
"I’ll pass. Didn’t you hear Little Dragon? The Tianyue Osmanthus Fruit has no effect on Cultivators at or above the True God Realm," Ye Yun shook his head and smiled.
"Ancestor, even if it has no effect, the taste is still very good. Won’t you try some?" Luo Li beamed, her smile as radiant as a flower, her filial piety commendable.
"You keep the large Laurel Fruit. I’ll eat a thousand-year-old one; it’s just a token gesture!" Ye Yun laughed heartily, feeling very gratified. He reached out and patted Luo Li’s head, then plucked a thousand-year-old Laurel Fruit from the air.
Bringing it to his lips, Ye Yun took a gentle bite. A sweet flavor instantly filled his mouth.
"Master, where are we going next?" Having finished its three golden Laurel Fruits, the Big Black Horse felt content and turned its head to ask.
"The Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird isn’t far from here. Let’s go take a look..." Ye Yun looked up towards a certain direction and said thoughtfully.
"Senior, is your Dragon God Sect still recruiting?" Lei Qinian timidly walked over, looked at Ye Yun, and asked with a blush.
"Brother Lei, you don’t possess the Dragon God Bloodline. If you join my Dragon God Sect, you won’t be able to learn the three Ultimate Techniques, will you?" Jun Moxiao was taken aback. His youthful impulsiveness made him blurt out his thoughts.

chapters.title: Chapter 348: Null Void Projections, Covert Dragon Coffin
chapters.content:
Chapter 348: Chapter 348: Null Void Projections, Covert Dragon Coffin
Upon hearing Jun Moxiao’s words, Lei Qinian’s face turned even redder.
He had not expected that a disciple of the Dragon God Sect must possess the Dragon God Bloodline. Otherwise, they would not be able to practice the sect’s ultimate techniques.
"Oh, Senior, I apologize for my imprudence," Lei Qinian said, hanging his head in dejection as he quickly took a few steps back.
Ye Yun glanced at Jun Moxiao, thinking,
This little guy is a bit too outspoken.
The Dragon God Sect...
Ye Yun mused.
Although it’s true that only disciples with the Dragon God Bloodline can learn the three ultimate techniques, the reality is different. Even a hundred thousand years ago, not all disciples under the Dragon God Sect possessed the Dragon God Bloodline. There were also quite a few ordinary human disciples, or disciples with other Divine Beast bloodlines. Now, a hundred thousand years have passed. The ultimate techniques of the Dragon God Sect, passed down through generations of Sect Masters, are limited to just those three. Therefore, in Jun Moxiao’s mind, the Dragon God Sect could only narrowly accept disciples possessing the Dragon God Bloodline. One can’t blame Jun Moxiao for this.
"Lei Qinian, you can join my Dragon God Sect," Ye Yun said to Lei Qinian with a smile, giving an affirmative answer.
"Senior, but I... I don’t have the Dragon God Bloodline..." Lei Qinian said helplessly.
"It’s alright. Some of the ultimate techniques of the Dragon God Sect can also be practiced by disciples who don’t possess the Dragon God Bloodline," Ye Yun said with a laugh.
"Oh!" Lei Qinian responded faintly.
Ye Yun looked at Lei Qinian with a nostalgic expression in his eyes and sighed, "Your Lei Family originally excelled in lightning-based cultivation techniques, but the version passed down to this day is incomplete."
"Senior, how do you know that?" Lei Qinian asked in shock.
"Don’t forget, I share an old bond with your Lei Family’s ancestors. Of course, I’m familiar with your Lei Family’s Cultivation Technique," Ye Yun said with a faint smile. He raised his fingertip and lightly tapped Lei Qinian’s forehead.
The next moment, a complete set of lightning-based cultivation techniques appeared in Lei Qinian’s mind. The Cultivation Technique was the Nine Heavens Thunderbolt Sutra, the same lightning-based technique the Lei Family had passed down for tens of thousands of years. However, the new Nine Heavens Thunderbolt Sutra he received was far more complete than the one his father had taught him.
Lei Qinian was greatly shocked, an indescribable emotion filling his heart.
"This Nine Heavens Thunderbolt Sutra, if practiced to profound mastery, is quite powerful," Ye Yun praised.
"Thank you, Senior, for bestowing this cultivation technique!" Lei Qinian’s eyes reddened as he knelt with a thud.
"Brother Lei, you shouldn’t call him Senior now. You are now part of our Dragon God Sect. Shouldn’t you call him Ancestor?" Jun Moxiao scratched his head and said with an embarrassed smile.
Lei Qinian had a sudden realization and immediately kowtowed, "Lei Qinian pays his respects to the Ancestor!"
"Get up. You are the only one left in the Lei Family now," Ye Yun said with a sigh.
He took out a green bead and smiled, "There is a world inside this; you can cultivate in seclusion there. Don’t worry about resources. You can come out once you break through to the Eternal Realm."
After he finished speaking, a green light enveloped Lei Qinian, who disappeared in an instant.
A sliver of Ye Yun’s Primordial Spirit entered this Miniature World, gave Lei Qinian some cultivation resources, and after a few simple instructions, retreated.
Ye Yun did this partly for personal reasons.
The Lei Family is down to this single descendant; he needs to be well protected. Otherwise, I wouldn’t be able to face my old friend. Once Lei Qinian breaks through to the Eternal Realm, there will be no further danger when he emerges. For Lei Qinian, I simply wish for his safety and well-being. As for the three juniors of the Dragon God Sect—Su Wanyi, Luo Li, and Jun Moxiao—they carry the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline and thus naturally shoulder heavier responsibilities and pressures. That’s why I will entrust these three with significant responsibilities.
After settling Lei Qinian, Ye Yun’s mood lightened considerably.
He was just about to enter the carriage when he suddenly sensed something and looked towards the void.
At this moment, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon did likewise, gazing up at the sky, seeming to have sensed something as well.
"What did you sense?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon asked alertly.
"You’ll see in a moment. Someone is using Void Throw," the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon said in a deep voice.
The next moment, as the spatial fluctuations intensified, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and the Big Black Horse, who were both at the Eternal Realm, also felt it.
A faint, spectral image of a coffin appeared in a certain part of the void. The spectral coffin was enormous; from the ground, it looked like a small hill.
"What in the world is this?" Ye Yun chuckled as he looked at the spectral coffin.
A hundred thousand years have passed,
he thought.
All sorts of malicious entities have begun to appear on the Cangnan Continent, which truly surprises me, the old Ancestor of the Dragon God Sect. Why weren’t there such interesting things a hundred thousand years ago? If there had been, my energy wouldn’t have been spent teasing all sorts of pretty girls.
The spectral coffin, initially faint, gradually solidified. Its surface textures also became remarkably clear and distinct.
This particular coffin was pitch black with various patterns on its surface, but what was most striking were the various dragon-shaped carvings on the coffin’s four faces. Many of the dragon-shaped carvings were lifelike and uniquely styled.
These are all different Divine Dragon races,
Ye Yun observed.
"This is outrageous! Who would be so bored as to carve dragon designs onto a coffin?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon cursed. As an Ancient Dragon Clan member, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was extremely sensitive to such things.
To carve the likeness of the noble God Dragon Clan onto a coffin—isn’t this a mockery and a curse upon us?
"Don’t be hasty. These Null Void Projections haven’t finished yet," Ye Yun said with a faint smile, his expression unchanging.
"Alright, My Lord," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon agreed, feeling a little uncomfortable. It squinted at the sky, its eyes emitting sharp glints of light.
I must see what other tricks are hidden behind this coffin!
"Is this... could this be the Covert Dragon Coffin?" Mu Qing’s expression changed slightly as she looked at the black, ghostly coffin covered in dragon motifs, a look of disbelief on her face.
"What is the history of this Covert Dragon Coffin?" Ye Yun turned his head to look at Mu Qing.
"My Lord, there is a popular verse on the Cangnan Continent: ’Covert Dragon Coffin, Coffin Bearers nigh, Dragon Cave appears, to bury the living,’" Mu Qing said respectfully.
"So it’s the Covert Dragon Coffin," Big Black Cat exclaimed in surprise upon hearing Mu Qing’s words, apparently also aware of the infamous name.
"How should this verse be interpreted?" Ye Yun asked with a smile.
This verse sounds cryptic and secretive, hinting at some clandestine dealings,
he thought.
"My Lord, there’s a mysterious group of Coffin Carriers on the Cangnan Continent. No one knows their origins. Whenever a Dragon Cave is about to appear, they cast Null Void Projections—first the Covert Dragon Coffin, then the Coffin Carriers. Afterwards, within the region where the Dragon Cave is to appear, they carry the Covert Dragon Coffin, traversing the void above for nine days..." Mu Qing explained in a low voice.
Hardly had her words faded when the void fluctuated again, and the spectral images of four masked, white-robed men appeared. After these four white-robed figures materialized, they positioned themselves at the four corners and abruptly lifted the Covert Dragon Coffin.

chapters.title: Chapter 349: The Legend of the Coffin Carrier
chapters.content:
Chapter 349: Chapter 349: The Legend of the Coffin Carrier
So, these are the so-called Coffin Carriers, are they?
Ye Yun’s eyes twinkled as he gazed at the four ethereal, white-robed figures in the void. The corners of his mouth curled up slightly, revealing a barely detectable smile.
This masquerading act is indeed amusing. It’s as if a few children, wearing masks, are performing acts of justice in front of adults—obviously full of flaws and fragile as can be.
However, Ye Yun didn’t expose their act.
The name of this Covert Dragon Coffin, and the Dragon Cave... made him think of more profound matters. He needed to watch this play unfold slowly, to see what kind of moves would truly come into play once the real Coffin Carriers appeared.
"My lord, these Null Void Projections of the Coffin Carriers, carrying the Covert Dragon Coffin, will persist in the sky for nine days before disintegrating. This implies that a Dragon Cave will surface within the area over which the Coffin Carriers have flown during these nine days. This Dragon Cave can be used to bury the dead, and it is said to hold the prospect of a second life."
Mu Qing gazed at the Coffin Carriers, her expression extremely solemn, and explained softly.
The legend of the Coffin Carriers was very mysterious, and this phenomenon sounded even stranger. If a dying person was placed in the Covert Dragon Coffin and subsequently taken away by a Coffin Carrier to be personally buried in the Dragon Cave, there was a certain probability of resurrection into a second life.
It was well known that on the Cangnan Continent, no one could live forever, unless they reached the True God Realm, where their lifespan would greatly surpass that of ordinary people. Some of the ancient beings from powerful factions would love nothing more than to enter the Covert Dragon Coffin and thus live a second life.
Historically, quite a few people had indeed been resurrected into a second life with the aid of the Covert Dragon Coffin. This further enhanced the legendary status of the Coffin Carriers.
But Coffin Carriers had one unique characteristic: they could only accept "gifts" from the most powerful forces within the area where they appeared. These so-called gifts meant that the strongest forces had to use various heavenly and earthly treasures to create a Covert Dragon Coffin. They would then bury a cultivator from their sect, one with little life left, inside it.
Once these steps were completed, the Coffin Carrier would project from the void, lift the Covert Dragon Coffin, and head straight for the Dragon Cave.
Mu Qing gradually shared all she knew about this with Ye Yun.
Hearing this, Ye Yun just gave a faint smile.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, and even the Big Black Horse were very interested after hearing this.
"Master, this is truly interesting! How come I’ve never heard that Dragon Caves have such powerful resurrection capabilities?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon blurted out with a laugh.
As a primordial Divine Dragon, he knew the Dragon Clan best; even if a member of the Clan died, it was impossible for them to have a second life. Of course, he, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, was an exception. As long as there was a drop of his blood, he could regenerate given the right conditions. But most of the Dragon Clan couldn’t do that. Even the Ten Super Divine Dragons, if they encountered powerful Divine Soil Spirits and unfortunately perished, their hope of resurrection would still be slim, unless they had prepared some sort of backup plan in advance.
"This claim is quite amusing, but some people have indeed succeeded. We just need to patiently watch how this play is performed," the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon said with a laugh.
As a Divine Dragon of the Divine Monarch Realm, he didn’t have much interest in such bizarre incidents.
Listening to the dialogue between these two Divine Dragons, Ye Yun nodded thoughtfully.
At this moment, the void fluctuated again. Surprisingly, two more Coffin Carriers appeared. These two Coffin Carriers flanked the others, supporting the middle section of the Covert Dragon Coffin.
"Why have two more Coffin Carriers appeared?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon asked with a laugh.
Mu Qing’s breath grew somewhat ragged. She quickly said, "Senior, if six Coffin Carriers appear, it indicates that the grade of this Dragon Cave is very high, at least Emperor Level Top Grade."
"Truly interesting! These people really know how to play!" The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon nodded, laughing heartily.
"Historically, what is the maximum number of Coffin Carriers that have appeared at once?" Ye Yun’s eyes twinkled as he asked.
"My lord, the most Coffin Carriers that have appeared simultaneously in history is sixteen. It is said that the Dragon Cave at that time had reached Emperor Level Superior Grade," Mu Qing answered honestly.
"Did the person buried in that Dragon Cave later achieve a second life?" Ye Yun asked again.
"I’m not sure about that. Many versions circulate in the world. Some say the person lived a second life, cultivated all the way to the True God Realm, and then left the Cangnan Continent. Others say that person didn’t live a second life. Still others claim that a second life was achieved, but their cultivation base did not surpass that of the first life," Mu Qing replied with a wry smile.
Ye Yun nodded upon hearing this.
"It is said that it was a Heaven Level force, extremely powerful. They later specifically suppressed news about this event, so very little information leaked out, and no one knew which Heaven Level force it was," Mu Qing added.
"It seems worth the wait then." Ye Yun smiled, looked at Mu Qing, and said, "Since the Coffin Carriers have appeared in the Heavenly Moon Dynasty, the Four Great Sects of the Heavenly Moon Dynasty will probably make their move soon, won’t they?"
Mu Qing nodded quickly. "That should be the case, my lord. The Four Great Sects will hold a competition. The most powerful sect will be responsible for providing the person, while the three losing sects will be responsible for crafting the Covert Dragon Coffin."
"Good. The Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird is not far ahead. As the Saintess, you should go back and take over as Sect Master," Ye Yun gazed ahead and said lightly.
Mu Qing was taken aback.
She had already defected from the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird. Would they even accept her back to become the Sect Master? If she returned with this status, would the people of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird still accept her?
"Don’t worry. If those little ones dare to be disobedient, just let *it* handle them." Ye Yun smiled, pointing to the Xuan bird on the carriage roof.
"My lord, leave this small matter to me!" the Xuan bird cackled, flapping its wings, instantly making a guarantee.
It was now the old ancestor of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird. Deciding who would be appointed Sect Master was merely a matter of its word, wasn’t it?
"They’re moving, they’re moving! The Coffin Carriers are starting to move!" Mao Bao’er suddenly shouted.
Everyone looked towards the sky again. They saw the six huge figures carrying the gigantic Covert Dragon Coffin, slowly moving north. The scene was spectacular.
At this moment, many cultivators in the Heavenly Moon Dynasty witnessed this scene.
"Covert Dragon Coffin, Coffin Carriers, Dragon Cave emerges, burying the living!"
「In the depths beneath the Xuanyang Sect.」
An old man with a withered face suddenly opened his eyes, gazing at the six gigantic figures in the distant void. His eyes held a fanatical look as he endlessly murmured that mysterious verse.
As an elder of the Xuanyang Sect at the Half-Step Life-Death Realm, he had only three years of life remaining.
If he could enter the Covert Dragon Coffin this time and be buried in the Dragon Cave by the Coffin Carriers, then he would have the opportunity to live a second life!
"AHHH!"
The more the elder thought about it, the more excited he became. He couldn’t help but abruptly stand up and, not hesitating to expend his Qi and Blood Magic, let out a furious roar towards the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 350: The Conflict of the Sect Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 350: Chapter 350: The Conflict of the Sect Master
A black carriage gradually came to a halt at the foot of a majestic mountain range.
"Master, we have arrived at the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird," Big Black Horse said, turning its head to smile.
"Mhm!" Ye Yun nodded, glancing over at Mu Qing beside him.
"Master, I will go ahead."
Mu Qing breathed deeply, a confident smile on her face as she pushed aside the carriage curtain and stepped out.
Becoming the Sect Master of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird was a challenge laid out by her Master. Fortunately, she had the Xuan Bird Ancestor as her support.
"Lass, go with peace of mind. If there are any issues, I’ll descend upon the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird at any time to lend you my support," the Xuan Bird Ancestor said to Mu Qing, his expression pleasant.
"Thank you, Ancestor." Mu Qing bowed slightly and instantly transformed into a ray of light, emerging from the carriage and rising into the distance.
At this moment, the Mountain Protection Array surrounding the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird had been activated. However, this posed no problem for Mu Qing. She had a Token; when she lightly brushed it against the array, an entrance appeared. She then, with a swift flicker, disappeared within.
"Greetings, Saintess!" A small squad in mid-air suddenly saw Mu Qing approaching and hurriedly paid their respects.
Mu Qing nodded, her expression stern, as she promptly flew towards the Sect Leader’s Main Hall.
The Sect Leader’s Main Hall must be bustling at this time. After all, the Coffin Carrier had appeared. The Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird had to come up with a plan.
Mu Qing, a Grand Cultivator of Heavenly Fate Realm Level 7, was very fast. In the blink of an eye, she arrived at the entrance of the Sect Leader’s Main Hall. As soon as her feet touched the ground, intense arguing could be heard from within.
"The Coffin Carrier has appeared! Our Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird doesn’t even have a Sect Master at the moment. We shouldn’t meddle in these murky waters," an old man said angrily.
"Exactly! If it weren’t for that traitorous Saintess, how could our Sect Master, Deputy Sect Master, and the Supreme Elder have mysteriously perished?" another person declared loudly, his tone filled with strong resentment towards the Saintess.
The Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird’s current combat strength was in a dire state, with significant losses. The simultaneous fall of the Sect Master and Supreme Elder, who were the backbone of the Sect, was a lethal blow. The Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird was now left with only a few Destiny Realm Cultivators; its overall strength had significantly regressed. Compared to the other three major Sects, they were much weaker.
Therefore, when the Coffin Carrier paraded the Covert Dragon Coffin across the skies of the Heavenly Moon Dynasty with awe-inspiring momentum and heart-shaking impact, it sparked intense discussions among the Sect’s remaining Elders. However, most of it was criticism directed at the Saintess.
This was because Ye Yun had initially wiped the memories of everyone at the Wu Kun Mountain Black Market. So, no one knew exactly how the Supreme Elder, Sect Master, and Deputy Sect Master had perished. However, their soul lamps had all extinguished, indicating their demise—a fact the Sect had only recently discovered. Before leaving, Gongsun Changsheng of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird had declared to one of the guards at the main hall that the Saintess had defected from the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird. So, they deduced from this clue that the demise of the Sect Master, the Supreme Elder, and others was certainly related to the Saintess. The Saintess’s mysterious disappearance from the Wu Kun Mountain Black Market further solidified the suspicion that she was the culprit.
"We need to stop arguing! Now that we are without a leader, we must elect a new Sect Master to take charge and prevent the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird from descending further into chaos," an Elder suddenly spoke.
That Elder was well-respected, and after he spoke, the rest fell silent.
At that moment, Mu Qing stepped forward and walked in.
"Since we are discussing selecting a Sect Master, perhaps I should take up the responsibility," Mu Qing said confidently as she walked.
Hearing this familiar voice, all the Elders in the hall simultaneously turned towards the entrance to see the young beauty dressed in black.
Indeed, it was the Saintess! The Saintess of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, who had been missing for days!
"Saintess, you have the nerve to return! Quickly, tell us—were the Sect Master and the Supreme Elder harmed by you?" an Elder immediately stood up, storming over and demanding angrily.
"Those two got what they deserved. They offended my Master, so they deserved to die!" Mu Qing said softly, her demeanor arrogant and her tone mocking.
Who was her Master? Even the ancestor of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird was once a Xuan bird raised by her Master. For the Sect Master and Supreme Elder to treat her Master that way was to court death. In the end, it was the Xuan Bird Ancestor who personally eliminated those ignorant individuals.
"What are you talking about, Saintess? Are you being coerced by some force from the three major Sects?" a female Elder approached, looking at the Saintess with deep concern. She was relatively close to the Saintess and shared a deep friendship, which was why she dared to speak her mind.
"Elder Li, there’s no need for you to overthink. It has nothing to do with the three major Sects," Mu Qing declared firmly.
After speaking, she swept her sharp gaze around and said casually, "This time, I intend to be elected as the Sect Master of our Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird. Does anyone object?"
"I object! You—a traitor—have the audacity to return? Do you consider the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird to be easy pickings?" an elderly man of Heavenly Fate Realm Level 7 abruptly drew his sword, pointed it at Mu Qing, and shouted loudly.
His words were inflammatory, instantly igniting the anger of about a dozen Destiny Realm Elders. They all brandished their swords and encircled Mu Qing.
Elder Li, the female Elder, watched the scene unfold, her gaze filled with regret. With no other choice, she also drew her sword. The Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird had been driven to a dead end. They had to eliminate this traitor.
Surrounded by so many Destiny Realm Grand Cultivators, Mu Qing remained composed.
Although she couldn’t defeat all these people, she believed that the Xuan Bird Ancestor would descend soon.
As expected, a powerful oppressive force suddenly descended from mid-air. Immediately, all the Elders in the main hall found their bodies immobilized. Their faces turned pale as they stared into the void in terror. Such immense pressure could only be exerted by a Life-Death Realm Grand Cultivator.
"You deceitful Saintess! No wonder you are so fearless. So you’ve found backing from a power that has a Life-Death Realm Powerhouse!" an Elder roared in anger.
"What nonsense are you children spouting?" A stern voice suddenly came from mid-air, followed by a crisp SMACK.
With a slap, the Elder was sent flying.
A black-robed young man appeared without warning in the main hall.
"Who might you be?" Gazing at the unfamiliar black-robed young man, an Elder managed to summon his courage and ask.
The black-robed young man was the Xuan Bird. He snorted coldly and said nothing.
He had no respect for these worthless Elders of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird.
"Mu Qing pays her respects to the Xuan Bird Ancestor." Under the watchful eyes of everyone present, Mu Qing still bowed respectfully.
After all, they were within the Sect, and the required courtesies had to be observed. This display was also for the other Elders in the main hall.
"Saintess, what are you saying?"
"This is the Xuan Bird Ancestor?"
"How can that be possible?" one of the Elders exclaimed in shock.
"What’s so impossible about it?" The Xuan Bird turned around and transformed, revealing his vast true form. Because they were in the main hall, he did not fully revert to his gigantic size. Even so, his massive body filled the hall, emitting a pure and powerful Profound Bird Bloodline that surged like a tide.
This immediately caused all the Elders, who had the Profound Bird Bloodline within them, to grow weak and drop to their knees one by one.

chapters.title: Chapter 351: The Candidate for the Covert Dragon Coffin
chapters.content:
Chapter 351: Chapter 351: The Candidate for the Covert Dragon Coffin
Atop the highest peak of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, a black carriage rested quietly. The white sea of clouds surrounding the mountain peak shifted into an array of indistinct and unpredictable forms, reflecting the myriad variations of life in the world.
Ye Yun silently admired the beautiful vista of clouds from the mountain peak. Three days had passed since Mu Qing entered the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird.
On the day she entered the Sect Leader’s Main Hall, the Xuan bird revealed its true form, subduing all the Elders in the hall with its formidable bloodline. Ultimately, without any further objections, the Elders unanimously elected Saintess Mu Qing as the Sect Master of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird. The previous Sect Master, Gongsun Changsheng, and the Supreme Elder were subsequently cast from the Elders’ minds.
After all, the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird now hosted the inscrutable Xuan Bird Ancestor. Although the Xuan Bird Ancestor had not revealed its cultivation base, they still speculated it was at least at the Life and Death Realm. Such a cultivation base stood supreme across the entire Heavenly Moon Dynasty. The most powerful figures in the other three major factions were merely at the Half-Step Life-Death Realm. They simply could not be compared to the Xuan Bird Ancestor.
After becoming Sect Master, Mu Qing didn’t host a grand succession ceremony. Instead, she simply convened all the disciples for a straightforward announcement of her succession. The Xuan bird did not show itself to all the disciples of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird. It was sufficient that Mu Qing had the unanimous support of the Elders. It had long since returned to the carriage.
At Ye Yun’s instruction, the Big Black Horse had come to the highest peak of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, planning to stay for a few days. Ye Yun was waiting for the phantoms of those Coffin Carriers to fade away. There were still six days left.
That day, Mu Qing, as Sect Master of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, received a Sword-flying Messenger from the Xuanyang Sect. It wasn’t just the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird; the Mo Xue Sect and Zhengyi Jianmen also simultaneously received Sword-flying Messengers from the Xuanyang Sect. The message requested the Sect Masters to travel to the Xuanyang Sect to jointly discuss candidates for entering the Covert Dragon Coffin.
"That old fellow from the Xuanyang Sect is truly impatient... It’s understandable, though. His lifespan only has three years left," Ye Yun smiled faintly.
Mu Qing, the newly appointed Sect Master of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, stood beside him. She had been accompanying Ye Yun for the past two days. After receiving the Sword-flying Messenger from the Xuanyang Sect, Mu Qing immediately informed her Master.
"Master, do you think we from the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird need to go?" Mu Qing asked from his side.
"You must attend this gathering of the Four Great Sects," Ye Yun said with a smile, "and you must aim to take the top spot, defeating the others. If you do, the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird will no longer need to contribute materials for building the Covert Dragon Coffin, only a person."
Hearing this, Mu Qing’s expression turned somewhat bitter. She didn’t quite understand. The Covert Dragon Coffin required someone on the verge of death. It seemed their Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird had no one with the qualifications to enter the Covert Dragon Coffin.
Ye Yun glanced back at the carriage and asked with a smile, "Who among you is willing to enter the Covert Dragon Coffin and go explore the Dragon Cave?"
"Haha, Master, leave this excellent opportunity to me!" the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon was the first to volunteer. As a Divine Monarch Realm cultivator, he found staying on the small Cangnan Continent incredibly dull. Transformed into a cute little blue cat, he spent his days languidly dozing in the carriage.
"Your realm is a bit too high. There’s no chance for you to act on the Cangnan Continent," Ye Yun bluntly rejected the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s request.
"Master, then let me go," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was the second to volunteer.
"The Eternal Realm is also too high; it would be too easy to scare them off," Ye Yun shook his head.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon looked dejected and flopped down onto the carriage.
The Big Black Horse grinned.
Good thing I didn’t speak up earlier, or the Master would have refused me too.
It seems those at the Eternal Realm can’t participate in this operation.
The Xuan bird on the carriage roof also kept its beak shut.
It too had almost volunteered just a moment ago.
On the carriage, only the Big Black Cat and Little Cat were left. The Big Black Cat blinked several times, countless thoughts racing through its mind.
Little Cat let out an "Eh?" then suddenly said rather naively, "Big Bro, your Heavenly Fate Realm seems quite suitable, doesn’t it?"
"Really? Little Cat, this... this... going into a coffin is no laughing matter!" the Big Black Cat stammered.
If everyone wasn’t watching, it really would have wanted to smack Little Cat on the head.
It truly didn’t want to enter the Covert Dragon Coffin.
That’s a place where the dead stay! Even if one isn’t dead... they’d become one of the living dead!
It was currently strong and robust, brimming with vigorous blood and qi; why would it ever want to get into a coffin and become one of the living dead?
"Little Black Cat, I think you’re quite suitable." The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s gaze fell upon the Big Black Cat, and he suddenly chuckled.
Fourth Level of the Heavenly Fate Realm. Although its cultivation base isn’t high, there really aren’t many other choices.
Below that are the Nirvana Realm cultivation bases of several senior brothers and sisters.
Then there’s Little Cat at the Divine Bridge Realm.
Those cultivation bases are all too low; they probably couldn’t even get into the Covert Dragon Coffin.
"Master, those at the Heavenly Fate Realm can enter, but I fear that a Nine-tailed Spirit Cat at the Fourth Level of the Heavenly Fate Realm might not be up to the standards of the Coffin Carriers," Mu Qing carefully chose her words as she spoke from the side.
"Let it go then. As for its cultivation base, I’ll make it appear to be a great cultivator at the Half-Step Life-Death Realm," Ye Yun chuckled dismissively, ultimately appointing the Big Black Cat.
The Big Black Cat’s face instantly contorted as if it had eaten a bitter melon, unsure of what to say. It was Little Cat beside it who reminded it.
"Big Bro, the Master has arranged such a great opportunity for you, and you’re not willing to accept it? I really wish I could go, but I can’t even if I wanted to!" Little Cat said with envy.
These words instantly ignited the Big Black Cat’s inner world like a flame; enlightenment dawned on it.
This was a mission personally assigned by the Master!
As long as it completed the mission assigned by the Master, how could the Master possibly shortchange it on rewards?
"Master, rest assured! I will definitely complete this mission!" the Big Black Cat abruptly stood up, vowing with conviction.
WHAP!
A black horsetail descended from above, swatting the Big Black Cat flat onto the carriage.
"Little cat, look at you, so promising. Realizing it now, isn’t it a bit late?" the Big Black Horse turned its head, its bright eyes staring at the Big Black Cat, which was almost pressed into a meat patty. It smacked its lips and chuckled.
"Mending the fold even after the sheep is lost is not too late," Ye Yun chuckled, then stepped into the carriage. "Let Little Black Cat go."
"Let’s go. We’re taking a trip to the Xuanyang Sect," Ye Yun’s voice drifted faintly from inside the carriage.
The Big Black Horse immediately wiped the smile from its face, its four hooves moved, and it pulled the carriage into the sea of clouds. Mu Qing also hurried onto the carriage and went inside. She boiled a kettle of water and brewed another cup of tea for Ye Yun.
The Big Black Cat wobbled a few times, its body returning from its pancake-like state to normal. Although it had been thrashed quite miserably, the Big Black Cat was already accustomed to Uncle Ma’s unique way of showing affection.
"Little Cat! Thank you for reminding me! Once I complete the Master’s task, if there are any rewards, I’ll be sure to think of you," the Big Black Cat said, reaching out its paw and lightly patting Little Cat on the head.
The pat looked very light. But when it landed on Little Cat’s head, it was as if she had been struck by five thunderbolts. She saw stars, and fainted on the spot.

chapters.title: Chapter 352 Ah! There’s a Thorn!
chapters.content:
Chapter 352: Chapter 352 Ah! There’s a Thorn!
Kitten was initially sprawled on the carriage. When the Big Black Cat’s paw landed on her head, the force of the blow immediately knocked her unconscious. Her fluffy, white little head then flopped onto his paw.
"Oh dear, Kitten, why are you so sleepy? Just one pat and you’re out cold?" the Big Black Cat said, lifting his paw and smirking with a glint of satisfaction in his eyes.
The force he’d used was just right; it wouldn’t injure Kitten but would merely send her into a brief nap.
"Little Cat, all you know is bullying people."
The Big Black Horse, head lowered as he pulled the carriage, huffed coldly.
"Little Black Boy, you’re a dignified demon beast of the Destiny Realm. What’s the sense in constantly picking on a little demon of the Divine Bridge Realm?"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon coolly swept his gaze over.
"Kitten here is the weakest demon beast in our Dragon God Sect. Shouldn’t you treat her with more care? Little Black Boy, what you did this time was truly uncalled for."
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon also lazily chimed in, his tone clearly disapproving.
Hearing the great demons speak up, the Big Black Cat felt somewhat rattled. He raised his fluffy paw, mustering his courage. "Seniors, as the saying goes, ’To hit is to show affection, to scold is to show love.’ Kitten and I have always played rough like this in the Nine Soul Underground Palace. Sometimes, I can’t hold back my strength."
"I don’t believe you, Little Black Boy. You’ve got a black heart," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon scoffed.
Just then, space rippled slightly, and the Little White Cat sprawled on the carriage suddenly vanished.
The Big Black Cat, solely focused on these seniors, completely missed it.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon saw this and chuckled. "Little Black Boy, Kitten is gone. Looks like you’re in for it now."
"What? Gone?"
The Big Black Cat exclaimed, whipping his head around, only to find that Kitten, who had been beside him, had indeed disappeared.
This discovery instantly made him break out in a cold sweat.
Undoubtedly, the only one capable of making Kitten vanish without a trace right under the noses of these Dragon Clan seniors was the Master.
The thought that the Master had taken Kitten away made the Big Black Cat as anxious as an ant on a hot griddle.
"Little Cat, it seems the Master also disapproves of you bullying Kitten, so he took her away," the Big Black Horse said, baring his large white teeth in a grin.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon chuckled and said ominously, "I’m not trying to scare you, Little Black Boy, but perhaps the Master will give Kitten a treasure specifically to counter you."
"Elder Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon speaks wisely, haha..."
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon also burst into laughter. Watching the uneasy, sweating Big Black Cat, he seemed to recall something, finding the situation increasingly amusing. He even stretched out a paw and scratched his chin.
"Seniors, I’m timid. Please don’t scare me," the Big Black Cat said with a mournful look on his face.
Kitten being taken away by the Master was not a good sign.
Perhaps the Master, having seen him bully Kitten all the time, finally couldn’t stand it anymore and would really give Kitten some treasure to counter him.
While the Big Black Cat was fraught with anxiety...
「Inside the carriage.」
Kitten slowly regained consciousness. Seeing a white figure before her, she was startled and leaped to her paws.
"Master, how did I get into your carriage? I’ll leave right now," Kitten said quickly.
"There’s no need to rush off," Ye Yun smiled faintly.
Even Ye Yun could no longer stand seeing the Big Black Cat constantly bullying the weaker Kitten. He decided to find a treasure to give Kitten for self-defense.
Hearing the Master’s words, Kitten immediately lay obediently on the ground.
She stared at Ye Yun with her large, beautiful, gem-like eyes.
Kitten was apprehensive, wondering what the Master had planned for her.
"Take this Rainbow Colored-Nimbus. Use it for protection, and don’t tell anyone," Ye Yun said, drawing a hand from his sleeve. With a gentle flick, a ray of multicolored light landed on Kitten.
The multicolored light disappeared the moment it entered Kitten’s body.
Kitten used her Divine Sense to scan her body and immediately felt an additional layer of protection within.
It was a resplendent Rainbow Colored-Nimbus, radiating myriad rosy lights, exceptionally beautiful.
However, these lights only manifested internally; not a single trace escaped outside.
"I’ve helped you refine it for now. It can protect you for a while. Once you reach the Destiny Realm, you can refine it yourself," Ye Yun said with a smile.
This Rainbow Colored-Nimbus came from that repository from the Primordial Era.
In the legends of the Journey to the West, while not an exceptionally powerful artifact, it was quite famous, known to many in later ages.
"Thank you, Master!" Kitten was overcome with gratitude and kowtowed three times in succession before Ye Yun.
"Go on then." Ye Yun waved his hand dismissively, and Kitten instantly vanished from the carriage.
"The Master is so good to his demon beasts, gifting a Rainbow Colored-Nimbus treasure just like that," Mu Qing said, a hint of envy in her eyes.
Just then, the space beside the Big Black Cat rippled, and Kitten’s figure appeared.
The Big Black Cat had been waiting anxiously. When he saw Kitten reappear, his face instantly lit up with joy.
"Kitten, where did you go?" he asked, moving closer, his face tense.
"I just went into the carriage," Kitten replied, blinking. She suddenly remembered the Master’s instructions and didn’t mention the Rainbow Colored-Nimbus.
Seeing Kitten hesitate, the Big Black Cat rubbed his paws together and asked with a grin, "Kitten, the Master didn’t give you any magical treasure, did he?"
"No, no!" Kitten quickly waved her paws, denying it emphatically.
The Master had instructed her; she wouldn’t reveal the Rainbow Colored-Nimbus even if it meant death.
"Big Brother, that swat of yours really hurt! You actually dared to strike so hard!" Kitten said angrily, scratching her head with her paw.
The Big Black Cat gave an awkward smile. "Relax, you’re just a little monster of the Divine Bridge Realm. How could I dare to strike you with killing intent? Kitten, look, aren’t you perfectly fine? Not even a scratch."
Kitten pouted and said nothing more.
She lay on the carriage, eyes closed, contentedly admiring the myriad rosy lights of the Rainbow Colored-Nimbus within her body.
The Master said this Rainbow Colored-Nimbus has a defensive function, but I don’t know how to activate it.
Kitten examined the Rainbow Colored-Nimbus within her. It lay dormant, and when she tried to activate it with her Mana, she failed.
Just as the Master said, she hadn’t refined it yet, so she couldn’t command this treasure as she pleased.
"Kitten, why are you sleeping again?" the Big Black Cat asked, stroking his chin as he looked at her, his eyes flickering thoughtfully.
There’s something off about this Little White Cat,
he thought.
Why has her enthusiasm waned so much after coming out of the carriage?
Kitten ignored him, continuing to admire the Rainbow Colored-Nimbus as it unfolded with myriad rosy lights within her body.
"Kitten, in a few days, I’ll be going into the Covert Dragon Coffin. You won’t see me for a while, so let’s chat," the Big Black Cat said with a grin, reaching out to pat Kitten’s head.
No matter what, he had to find out the truth—had the Master really given Kitten some magical treasure?
The moment his furry paw touched Kitten’s head, a sudden, intense pain shot up from it.
"ARGH! Something pricked me!" A sudden, sharp, and mournful cry erupted from the carriage, scattering the surrounding sea of clouds.

chapters.title: Chapter 353: This Carriage is Really Strange
chapters.content:
Chapter 353: Chapter 353: This Carriage is Really Strange
"Ouch, ouch! How did Little Kitty get spikes?"
Experiencing pain as if pricked by red-hot spikes, the Big Black Cat grimaced and kept shaking its paw.
The moment its paw touched Little Kitty, it felt countless spikes shoot out from the fur, piercing its palm directly.
After all, it was a Nine-tailed Spirit Cat at the Destiny Realm, with an extremely sturdy body, especially after consuming many Eternal Life Immortal Grasses within the Nine Soul Underground Palace. This had made its physique even more formidable. Yet, despite that, the spikes still managed to penetrate its palm.
The Big Black Cat quickly checked its palm but found no trace of blood.
It found this very strange.
Could this piercing pain be a spiritual attack?
"HAHAHA..."
At this, the Big Black Horse, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, and the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon all roared with laughter.
Especially the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, which possessed the highest cultivation base; it even used its small, blue, fluffy paw to slap the carriage, laughing until it was bent double.
As a powerhouse in the Divine Monarch Realm, it could see the colorful Rainbow Colored-Nimbus Robe within Little Kitty and had long anticipated the Big Black Cat’s miserable fate.
Laughed at by these seniors, the Big Black Cat felt its confidence waver. It shook its hand again and found that the pain was gone.
Hopeful thoughts began to surface once more.
Looking at Little Kitty, it said with a grin, "Little Kitty, stay still. Let me touch you again."
Little Kitty lowered its head, a mocking smile playing on its lips.
It finally understood now. The moment the Big Black Cat had touched it, the Rainbow Colored-Nimbus Robe within its body had instantly transformed into a burst of colorful light, erupting from its body as a multitude of colorful spikes. These spikes were incredibly potent... It knew how tough the Big Black Cat’s physique was and hadn’t expected the spikes to penetrate it so easily. This attack didn’t seem to be purely physical; the spikes drew no blood when they pierced, yet the pain was excruciating.
Seeing the Big Black Cat’s unrepentant urge to try again, extending its paw once more, the Big Black Horse and the other demon beasts sneered.
They eagerly awaited the unfolding drama.
Although the Big Black Cat spoke casually, it was extremely cautious this time.
It inched its paw closer and closer to Little Kitty’s forehead.
Just as its paw pad brushed against Little Kitty’s white fur, a five-colored light suddenly flared.
The Big Black Cat instantly felt an intense pain shoot from its paw pad.
It yelped and snatched its paw back like a bolt of lightning.
"What is this? Little Kitty, why does it hurt so much?" the Big Black Cat cried out, its face twisted in pain as it grimaced again.
"Big Brother, I don’t know either," Little Kitty said, laughing triumphantly, its large eyes curving into crescents.
It remembered its Master’s words clearly and would never reveal anything about this treasure.
"Did the Master give you a defensive treasure?" the Big Black Cat asked, moving closer with a fierce look.
"I don’t know anything. Don’t ask me," Little Kitty replied, its gaze firm.
"SIGH! How boring!"
The Big Black Cat sighed and didn’t press Little Kitty further.
It knew its every move was observed by the Master. The Master had given Little Kitty a treasure that covered its body in spikes; from now on, trying to discipline Little Kitty would be impossible.
The Big Black Cat looked dejected and rather displeased. It curled its body into a ball, tucking its head into its belly, whether asleep or too ashamed to face the others, no one knew.
This sight sent everyone into another round of uproarious laughter.
Little Kitty felt quite smug but chose not to provoke the Big Black Cat further. Instead, it closed its eyes and began its cultivation.
During this period, its cultivation base had advanced by leaps and bounds, already reaching the peak of the Tenth Layer of the Divine Bridge Realm, just one step away from the Nirvana Realm.
Therefore, Little Kitty wanted to break through to the Nirvana Realm as soon as possible.
The demon beasts laughed for a while longer, then chatted enthusiastically about the incident for a good while before they each resumed their cultivation.
Seeing all these demon beasts enter a state of cultivation, Ye Yun smiled faintly.
Life raising a group of demon beasts is certainly lively. If he, an old ancestor, were to roam the Cangnan Continent with just three disciples, it wouldn’t be nearly as interesting.
The Heavenly Moon Dynasty spanned a vast territory, many times larger than the former Ancient Moon Dynasty. The four superior great sects were established in four different directions.
To reach the Xuanyang Sect from the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, one could take a teleportation array to the largest city near the Xuanyang Sect and then fly to the sect.
However, Ye Yun didn’t have Mu Qing do that.
Too troublesome.
With the Big Black Horse, an Eternal Realm demon beast, pulling the carriage, such a distance was covered quickly.
「In the time it takes for an incense stick to burn.」
The carriage stopped, and the Big Black Horse’s voice came from outside.
"Master, we’ve arrived at the Xuanyang Sect."
"Let’s head up then," Ye Yun instructed. This time, he also planned to join in the excitement.
The Big Black Horse pulled the carriage as it descended from mid-air, landing in the plaza before the Xuanyang Sect Master Hall.
"Who goes there?"
Immediately, twenty to thirty cultivators rushed out, staring warily at the black carriage, wondering about the identity of its occupants.
"This carriage... it’s very strange!" an old man, sword in hand, exclaimed, gazing at the black carriage with astonishment on his face.
It wasn’t just him; everyone else felt the same.
The carriage was drawn by a large black horse, its cultivation base so concealed it appeared to be an ordinary steed. Four small cats of various colors—white, black, blue, and red—were perched neatly upon the carriage. On its roof, a small black bird preened its feathers.
These demon beasts were all extremely calm, showing no signs of panic despite being surrounded by so many cultivators.
Ye Yun glanced at Mu Qing.
"Master, I’ll go out," Mu Qing said, understanding his cue, and immediately stepped out of the carriage.
She stood on the carriage, her cold gaze sweeping around. "Is this how the Xuanyang Sect receives its guests?"
"So, it is the Saintess."
The leading elder, an old man, gasped upon recognizing Mu Qing and quickly waved his hand to dismiss the crowd.
The elder approached, cupped his fists in salute, and said with a smile, "I didn’t realize the Saintess of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird was gracing us with her presence. The Xuanyang Sect has been remiss in its welcome. Please forgive us."
"It’s no matter," Mu Qing replied, descending from the carriage with her hands behind her back.
"Ah, Sect Master Mu has arrived! Welcome, welcome!"
An elder in a red robe, at the Tenth Level of the Heavenly Mandate Realm, emerged from the main hall. Upon seeing Mu Qing, his face broke into a wide smile.
"Greetings, Lord Zhou," Mu Qing said with a fist-and-palm salute.
The red-robed elder at the entrance was the Sect Master of the Xuanyang Sect.
"I heard that a Supreme Elder of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird has fallen. I wonder which elder from the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird is in the carriage?" Sect Master Zhou asked, his eyes flickering as he continuously sized up the black carriage before him.
He, too, was startled by the peculiar demon beasts on the carriage.
Hearing Lord Zhou’s words, Mu Qing’s eyes instantly turned icy.
There must be a spy within the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird. Otherwise, news of the Supreme Elder’s death wouldn’t have reached them. But it didn’t matter now. With the Xuan Bird Ancestor, an Eternal Realm demon beast, presiding over the sect, never mind the Xuanyang Sect; even if Zhengyi Jianmen and Mo Xue Sect joined forces, the three major sects combined would be no match for the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird.

chapters.title: Chapter 354: Xuan Bird Ancestor, Suppresses the Three Major Sects
chapters.content:
Chapter 354: Chapter 354: Xuan Bird Ancestor, Suppresses the Three Major Sects
"Sect Master Zhou, you’re still not qualified to know."
Mu Qing’s face was icy cold; she flung the brusque remark back without a second thought.
"Well, Sect Leader Mu! To think you’d become so arrogant just after taking over the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird. Do you believe your Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird is still what it once was?" Sect Master Zhou said, exasperated and furious.
He had never imagined that the young woman before him would be so rude. On his own Xuanyang Sect’s territory, she dared to be so insolent.
Just as he was about to teach Mu Qing a lesson, he suddenly saw several streaks of light descend from mid-air.
Taking a closer look, his expression immediately changed.
The Sect Masters and Supreme Elders from Zhengyi Jianmen and the Mo Xue Sect had arrived.
"Greetings to the two Sect Masters and the two Supreme Elders," Sect Master Zhou said very respectfully, bowing deeply with a fist salute.
After all, the two opposing Sect Masters possessed the same cultivation base level, making them his peers. The positions of the two Supreme Elders were distinguished, and he was required to treat them with the utmost reverence.
"I didn’t expect that the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird would be a step ahead." A middle-aged man in a black robe glanced at Mu Qing, a smirk of mockery in his eyes. He sneered, "Sect Leader Mu, inheriting the leadership position with a mere Heavenly Fate Realm Level 7 cultivation base. That’s quite a struggle, isn’t it?"
An older man in a white robe, hiding a dagger behind his smile, said lightly, "Indeed, you’re too young and not talented enough. In my opinion, perhaps you should go back and find a replacement. The Dragon Cave is about to emerge, and this is a crucial event. The Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird only needs to contribute some materials for the Covert Dragon Coffin. There’s no need for you to be involved in the meeting of our great sects."
Noticing the cold ridicule from both the Sect Masters of the Mo Xue Sect and Zhengyi Jianmen upon their arrival, the Xuan bird on the carriage top was immediately filled with rage. Transforming into a streak of black light, it fiercely descended beside Mu Qing.
The Xuan bird transformed into a young man in a black robe.
"I pay my respects to Xuan Bird Ancestor." Seeing the Xuan Bird Ancestor suddenly arrive, Mu Qing dared not be disrespectful and hurriedly bowed.
What? Is this the Xuan Bird Ancestor?
The others couldn’t help but exchange glances. They had heard that the ancestor of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird was indeed the Xuan bird, but that was tens of thousands of years ago, wasn’t it? A Supreme Elder of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird had died, so how had another Xuan Bird Ancestor appeared now?
This Xuan Bird Ancestor... he’s probably just using the name of the original Xuan bird, right?
The crowd attempted to sense the "Xuan Bird Ancestor’s" cultivation base but were surprised to find his aura so profound that they could not determine his exact realm. Little did they know, the Xuan bird’s aura had long been masked by Ye Yun. Otherwise, the presence of an Eternal Realm Great Demon in the small Heavenly Moon Dynasty would be too conspicuous and likely alert whoever was pulling the strings behind the scenes.
"How strange. When did the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird gain another Xuan Bird Ancestor?" The Mo Xue Sect’s Supreme Elder, an old man in a black robe, surveyed the black-robed young man from top to bottom, a cold smile on his face.
"Hmph! So furtive, not daring to reveal your cultivation base, yet using the name Xuan Bird Ancestor. I see your Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird intends to play mysterious games this time, trying to fool us three great sects with some young man!"
A red light descended, and an elderly man in a large red robe appeared next to Sect Master Zhou. This was a Supreme Elder of the Xuanyang Sect, at the Half-Step Life-Death Realm of cultivation. The Supreme Elders of the Mo Xue Sect and Zhengyi Jianmen also had cultivation bases at the Half-Step Life-Death Realm. Although the Supreme Elders of the three great sects were of the same realm, there were differences in their combat abilities. The purpose of this gathering of the major powers was, naturally, to determine who was superior.
This Supreme Elder from the Xuanyang Sect, upon appearing, displayed intense hostility towards the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird. Not long ago, in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, many disciples of the Xuanyang Sect had died or been injured. It was rumored that a disciple from the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird had bribed a group of monkeys, leading to the Xuanyang Sect’s massive losses. After leaving the Secret Region, the Saintess of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, disregarding her status, had used her power to oppress others, driving away the Xuanyang Sect’s Elder in Charge and a group of Nirvana Realm disciples. It could be said that this matter had become the fuse that ignited the feud between the Xuanyang Sect and the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird.
"What are you?"
The Xuan bird finally became furious. Waving his hand, he aimed a slap towards the Supreme Elder from the Xuanyang Sect.
SMACK!
A crisp sound echoed. The Supreme Elder screamed as his body was sent flying backward. He crashed through several high walls before finally coming to a halt. As the Supreme Elder staggered to his feet, he spat out a mouthful of blood.
Looking at the black-robed young man, fear flashed in his eyes.
What kind of cultivation base does he possess? How could I, a formidable expert at the Half-Step Life-Death Realm, not even dodge a single slap?
The two Supreme Elders from the Mo Xue Sect and Zhengyi Jianmen, witnessing this scene, turned ashen and quickly retreated several steps.
He’s too strong. This black-robed young man is far too powerful.
Could it be that the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, aside from their original Supreme Elder at the Half-Step Life-Death Realm, truly possessed a Xuan Bird Ancestor?
"And you two, get out of my sight and cool off somewhere."
Having sent the Supreme Elder from the Xuanyang Sect flying with a slap, the Xuan bird, still not satisfied, struck out left and right, sending the Supreme Elders from the Mo Xue Sect and Zhengyi Jianmen flying as well. These two Supreme Elders also spat out mouthfuls of blood and crashed through an unknown number of courtyard walls.
HISS!
The Sect Masters of the three great sects couldn’t help but gasp upon seeing this. The Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird in the Heavenly Moon Dynasty had always been the strongest of the Four Great Sects. They had originally thought that after the deaths of the Sect Master and Supreme Elder of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, its ranking would plummet to last place. But unexpectedly, this unfathomable Xuan Bird Ancestor, with a single move, had heavily injured the Supreme Elders of the three great sects.
"Senior Xuan bird, we juniors spoke rudely and offended you, Senior. Please, overlook our transgressions. Considering that we Four Great Sects of the Heavenly Moon Dynasty share a common destiny, please spare our lives."
The three Supreme Elders quickly flew over, landed before the Xuan bird, and respectfully bowed.
Seeing these old men yield, the Xuan bird snorted coldly, "Is there any need for further discussion at this assembly?"
"None at all, Senior! Our three great sects are willing to construct the Covert Dragon Coffin. As for who is chosen, the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird will decide," the Supreme Elder of the Xuanyang Sect said in a fluster.
"Indeed, that is so. We are willing to bear all material and manpower expenses." The other two Supreme Elders also nodded repeatedly in agreement.
They weren’t fools; they could now guess that this Xuan Bird Ancestor before them was likely already a great cultivator at the Life and Death Realm, far beyond their ability to contend with. If their attitude was even slightly poor, it could bring disaster upon their sects.
"You few are still sensible enough to understand the situation."
The Xuan bird sneered, transformed into a streak of black light, and returned to the carriage roof.
The Sect Masters and Supreme Elders of the three major sects looked at the little black bird on the carriage roof and wiped the cold sweat from their foreheads. When they then looked at the four differently colored little cats below, a tempestuous storm simultaneously raged in their hearts.
The previously inconspicuous little black bird was already so formidable. Wouldn’t those four little cats be even more terrifying? Even the Big Black Horse pulling the carriage couldn’t possibly be an ordinary Great Demon, could it?
The more these individuals thought about it, the more frightened they became.
They couldn’t help but wonder about the terrifying background of the person inside the carriage...
That someone could make a Xuan Bird Ancestor, a Life and Death Realm cultivator, willingly stand guard on the carriage roof.

chapters.title: Chapter 355: Sudden Change, Life-Death Realm Powerhouses Arrive with a Coffin
chapters.content:
Chapter 355: Chapter 355: Sudden Change, Life-Death Realm Powerhouses Arrive with a Coffin
Seeing that the Xuan Bird Ancestor had returned to the carriage, Mu Qing knew that the Ancestor was preparing to let her handle the matters here once again.
Mu Qing glanced at the few old men in front of her and asked indifferently, "How many days will it take for your three sects to build the Covert Dragon Coffin?"
"If the three sects exert all their efforts, it can be done in ten days," the Supreme Elder of Xuanyang Sect said with a smile.
"Indeed, ten days is enough! We have already recorded the shape of the Covert Dragon Coffin from the Coffin Carrier’s Null Void Projections; it’s not difficult to build such a coffin," the Supreme Elder of Zhengyi Jianmen also said with a smile.
"Alright!" Mu Qing nodded.
After being dealt with by the Xuan Bird Ancestor, the Supreme Elders from these three major powers had become quite docile. Even their manner of speaking was remarkably polite.
A Life and Death Realm powerhouse in the Heavenly Moon Dynasty could truly act with impunity.
The Xuan Bird Ancestor was in the Eternal Realm. Suppressing these Supreme Elders was extremely easy for him.
However, Mu Qing had also noticed something earlier. When the Xuan Bird Ancestor entered the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird a few days ago, his cultivation base seemed to become vague and unclear. It was as if it were cloaked in chaotic mist, making it difficult to comprehend.
If she were to guess by experience, the feeling that the Xuan Bird Ancestor gave people was more like a Life and Death Realm Grand Cultivator.
Mu Qing glanced at them and said in a low voice, "Alright, just build the Covert Dragon Coffin in Xuanyang Sect. We will wait here for a few days."
"For Sect Leader Mu to stay in Xuanyang Sect is indeed our Xuanyang Sect’s greatest honor. I will arrange the best guest rooms for you," Lord Zhou said, his face lighting up with joy as he laughed politely.
The current situation was compelling. The Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird was unassailable, and the other sects could only try their best to maintain a good relationship.
"In that case, thank you for your hospitality," Mu Qing smiled slightly.
Though the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird was now invincible, the Four Great Sects of the Heavenly Moon Dynasty had maintained decent private relations over tens of thousands of years. There was no need to completely fall out with each other.
The construction of the Covert Dragon Coffin still required the effort of the three major sects.
Therefore, it was still necessary to keep up appearances and maintain a good relationship.
After discussing with the several Sect Masters for a while longer, Mu Qing was led by Lord Zhou to a guest room in the backyard to rest.
The Big Black Horse, pulling the carriage, followed them.
「Time flies.」
Six days passed in a flash.
The Coffin Carrier’s Null Void Projections had traversed nearly half the Heavenly Moon Dynasty.
Then, they vanished without a trace.
The three major sects began to mobilize vast amounts of manpower and resources to construct the Covert Dragon Coffin.
The Covert Dragon Coffin they built was identical in design to the one described in the projections, but its size was different; it only needed to be the size of a normal coffin.
All forces familiar with the Coffin Carrier legends knew this well.
On the tenth day.
Through the combined efforts of the three major powers, the Covert Dragon Coffin was finally completed.
This black Covert Dragon Coffin was placed on the summit of Xuanyang Sect’s highest peak.
The coffin lid was open and had not been closed.
Only when the chosen individual entered the Covert Dragon Coffin and the lid was closed would the Coffin Carrier be summoned.
Beneath the coffin stood the Sect Masters of the Four Great Sects and three Supreme Elders. A short distance away, a black carriage was parked.
The three major sects seemed to have grown accustomed to this mysterious black carriage.
In any case, they couldn’t guess the identity of the carriage’s owner.
Over the past few days, while the three major powers were constructing the Covert Dragon Coffin, they had also discussed matters in private.
They suspected that the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird was being controlled by an even more powerful force from behind the scenes.
It might be a Super Sect.
Perhaps a Super Sect was attempting to use the Coffin Carrier’s current action. They might place one of their own Supreme Elders, who was on the verge of death, into the Covert Dragon Coffin. Then, the Coffin Carrier would bury it in the Dragon Cave, allowing the elder to attempt to live a second life.
Although this speculation seemed reasonable, the three major forces dared not inquire about it.
Even if there really was a superpower interfering secretly, this was a taboo that should absolutely not be openly discussed.
At this time, it depended on whether the Coffin Carrier could discover the tricks involved.
If discovered, they might refuse to carry the coffin, causing all the efforts of this superpower to be in vain.
This possibility merely existed.
According to the cultivation levels of the Four Great Sects of the Heavenly Moon Dynasty, no one could cross the Life and Death Realm.
So, the Coffin Carrier’s requirement should also be a Destiny Realm cultivator who was about to die.
If the superpower behind the scenes wanted to arrange for a Life and Death Realm powerhouse to enter the Covert Dragon Coffin, it might be rejected by the Coffin Carrier...
Historically, such incidents were not uncommon.
However, it didn’t rule out the possibility that this Super Sect might arrange for a Destiny Realm cultivator to enter the Covert Dragon Coffin.
As for who would be chosen, that was beyond the control of their three major sects.
In any case, the Covert Dragon Coffin had already been made. As for what followed, they could only wait and see.
「...」
The Big Black Cat had a mournful face, squeezing out a few tears as he looked reluctant to part. "Cat baby, seniors, the coffin has been prepared for me. I must go in now; I really can’t bear to leave you!"
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon snorted coldly, looking very upset. "Little black boy, stop being so dramatic! You’re just going to lie in a coffin for a bit. What’s there to be scared of? I wanted this chance, and Master still wouldn’t give it to me!"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon added, "Yes, don’t be so ungrateful! You got such an interesting task; I’ve been in a foul mood these past few days!" He then raised his palm and slapped the Big Black Cat.
However, he was fairly gentle and did not use much strength.
Even so, it still made the Big Black Cat see stars, and he swayed unsteadily.
"Okay, Little Black Cat, you can go now," Ye Yun’s voice came from the carriage.
The Big Black Cat transformed into a young man in a black robe. He bowed respectfully towards the carriage and said with conviction, "Master, rest assured, I will definitely complete the task perfectly."
After saying this, he jumped off the carriage and walked towards the black Covert Dragon Coffin opposite him.
Due to the restrictive formation Ye Yun had placed around the carriage, the Sect Masters and Elders of the other three major sects did not perceive anything unusual.
For them, there was just a sudden blur before their eyes, and then a young man in a black robe flew down from the carriage.
This black-robed youth also possessed a very high cultivation base, having reached the Peak of the Tenth Level of Destiny Realm. He was also a Half-Step Life and Death Realm powerhouse.
Everyone had this illusion—naturally, this was Ye Yun’s doing.
The Big Black Cat had just taken a few steps.
Suddenly, fluctuations came from the void above. RUMBLE! A small vortex appeared.
A dazzling white pillar of light descended from the sky, landing on the mountain peak.
The light dissipated, revealing several figures.
The leading figure was a middle-aged man with a square face and a resolute expression. He wore a green robe and carried a sword on his back. His Super Divine Dragon Breath was overwhelming, and his Sword Intent surged like a great river.
His cultivation base had reached Level Three of Life and Death.
Behind the middle-aged man stood four more people.
The cultivation bases of these four people had all reached the Life and Death Realm. They carried a Vermilion Coffin and slowly walked towards the Covert Dragon Coffin.
"What power is this? Even their coffin bearers are Life and Death Realm Grand Cultivators!"
Seeing these figures, the Supreme Elders of the three major sects were all terrified, their hearts pounding.

chapters.title: Chapter 356: The Supreme Major Sect’s Nether Immortal Cave
chapters.content:
Chapter 356: Chapter 356: The Supreme Major Sect’s Nether Immortal Cave
"Just in time, not too late."
The green-robed middle-aged man with a sword on his back looked at the Covert Dragon Coffin. Seeing the coffin lid was not yet closed, he sighed softly and relaxed completely.
He emanated the powerful Super Divine Dragon Breath of a Life-and-Death Mirror Cultivator, causing the surrounding Elders and Sect Masters from the three major sects to tremble in fear.
The green-robed middle-aged man glanced around and said with a calm smile, "The Four Great Sects of the Heavenly Moon Dynasty have worked hard, crafting this Covert Dragon Coffin so quickly... However, rest assured, we of the Nether Immortal Cave will not let your efforts be in vain. We will provide appropriate compensation."
His voice had just fallen when the four Life and Death Realm cultivators carrying the vermilion coffin approached the Covert Dragon Coffin and gently set the coffin down.
Nether Immortal Cave... What kind of power was that? Several Supreme Elders exchanged glances, racking their brains.
Mu Qing also narrowed her eyes, scrutinizing the man in the green robe, deep in thought.
"I remember now!"
Just then, the Supreme Elder from the Xuanyang Sect exclaimed, his face filled with surprise and shock.
He waved his arm, his voice filled with excitement, "The Nether Immortal Cave is a Supreme Major Sect, one of the most powerful forces in the Nether Immortal Dynasty!"
"My heavens! So they are from the Nether Immortal Dynasty!"
The Supreme Elder from the Mo Xue Sect was also aghast, his mouth hanging open.
The Nether Immortal Dynasty bordered the Heavenly Sun Dynasty, and the two dynasties were of the same tier.
Both dynasties housed Supreme Major Sects.
However, the Heavenly Sun Dynasty and the Nether Immortal Dynasty were rival powers, so their respective forces seldom entered each other’s territories.
No one had expected this Covert Dragon Coffin to attract the Nether Immortal Dynasty’s most powerful Supreme Major Sect—the Nether Immortal Cave.
The thought of a Supreme Major Sect filled everyone with profound reverence.
The strength of a Supreme Major Sect far surpassed that of a Superior great sect.
They were simply not on the same level.
A Supreme Major Sect boasted numerous Life-Death Realm Powerhouses.
In contrast, the strongest combatant in a Superior great sect was merely a Half-Step Life-Death Realm powerhouse.
This was the vast disparity.
Hearing the Xuanyang Sect’s Supreme Elder, enlightenment flashed through Mu Qing’s mind, and she suddenly recalled certain matters concerning the Nether Immortal Dynasty.
Because the Heavenly Moon Dynasty was a relatively small territory under the Heavenly Sun Dynasty, their cultivation and activities were mostly confined within it, so they possessed little knowledge of the Nether Immortal Dynasty.
The green-robed middle-aged man merely smiled faintly at the shocked expressions on the faces of the few young monks opposite him. Hands behind his back, he maintained his aloof demeanor and said nothing more.
He hailed from the Nether Immortal Cave, one of the most powerful forces in the Nether Immortal Dynasty.
His arrival in the diminutive Heavenly Moon Dynasty made him akin to a deity.
If he wished to seize this Covert Dragon Coffin, no one would be his opponent.
Moreover, he had made his intentions clear this time: he would not take this Covert Dragon Coffin for nothing. Afterward, he would definitely provide the Four Great Sects of the Heavenly Moon Dynasty with proper compensation.
As a Supreme Sect, they had to maintain this level of decorum.
After the vermilion coffin was set down, the four Life-Death Realm cultivators gently moved the coffin lid.
As the coffin lid opened, a white-robed young man slowly sat up from inside.
The white-robed young man had a pale face and haggard features; he clearly didn’t have long to live.
His Super Divine Dragon Breath was very faint, but one could still discern he had reached the Peak of the Tenth Level of Destiny Realm.
"Father, is this the Covert Dragon Coffin?"
The white-robed young man glanced at the black coffin beside him and asked weakly.
"Yes, my son, this is the Covert Dragon Coffin. After you enter, the Coffin Carrier will bury you in the Dragon Cave. This way, you may have a chance to live a second life."
The green-robed middle-aged man flickered and appeared beside the vermilion coffin. He reached out, gently patted the white-robed young man’s shoulder, and said with a smile.
"Father, will this work?"
The white-robed young man coughed twice, his face flushing red.
"It should. Historically, quite a few people have achieved a second life from the Dragon Cave," the green-robed middle-aged man stated with extreme confidence.
"Then I look forward... to seeing you again, Father."
At this moment, the white-robed young man, with a sudden surge of strength from an unknown source, stood up from the coffin, preparing to enter the adjacent Covert Dragon Coffin.
Big Black Cat had already approached the Covert Dragon Coffin.
Upon seeing this, he immediately grew anxious.
Damn it... someone is actually trying to snatch the coffin from me?
"Hey, hey! You people from the Nether Immortal Cave, how can you be so unreasonable? This Covert Dragon Coffin was clearly built by us. How can you just come and try to snatch it?"
Big Black Cat darted over, stood before the Covert Dragon Coffin, and blocked the white-robed young man’s path.
The white-robed young man was slightly taken aback, sizing up the black-robed youth before him.
The black-robed youth before him was, like himself, also at the Peak of the Tenth Level of Destiny Realm, but he didn’t seem like someone on the verge of death.
He was full of vitality, showing no signs of imminent death.
Seeing the black-robed youth blocking the Covert Dragon Coffin, the green-robed middle-aged man’s expression instantly darkened.
"We, the Nether Immortal Cave, want this Covert Dragon Coffin. Didn’t we tell you earlier? Your Heavenly Moon Dynasty only has four Superior great sects. Do you really intend to challenge our Supreme Major Sect?"
As he spoke, the Super Divine Dragon Breath of the Life and Death Realm surged from him towards the black-robed youth opposite.
Big Black Cat felt an immense pressure enveloping him, making it difficult to breathe, and he was inwardly alarmed.
