With his true strength at the Fifth Level of Heavenly Fate Realm, he was still no match for a cultivator at the Fourth Level of Life-and-Death Realm.
"What’s so great about a Supreme Major Sect?"
Big Black Cat snorted coldly, resisting the pressure.
Fortunately, his physical body was exceptionally tough, allowing him to withstand the pressure from this Fourth Level Life-and-Death Mirror Realm expert.
"Hmph! Truly, backwater places breed unruly folks. Are the major powers of your Heavenly Moon Dynasty all blind?"
The green-robed middle-aged man turned, his face grim, and looked towards the Sect Masters of the Four Great Sects in the distance. His gaze, like two daggers, shot towards them.
"Esteemed Senior, please calm your anger! If you desire this Covert Dragon Coffin, please feel free to take it."
The Supreme Elder from the Mo Xue Sect rubbed his hands and said with a helpless, wry smile.
The Supreme Elder from the Xuanyang Sect looked at Mu Qing and earnestly advised, "Sect Master Mu, a Supreme Major Sect is not an existence we can afford to provoke. Shouldn’t you ask the young man from your Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird to step back?"
"Step back? How is that possible? Don’t bolster their arrogance and diminish our own spirit."
Mu Qing responded with an indifferent smile.
With the Master present, a host of Eternal Realm great demons in the carriage, and a Divine Monarch Realm expert from the Dragon Clan, why would we fear a mere Supreme Major Sect?
Thinking this, Mu Qing immediately turned and bowed with utmost respect.
"We humbly request the presence of the Xuan Bird Ancestor!"
The Xuan Bird in the carriage instantly transformed into a streak of black light, landing beside Mu Qing. It then took the form of the black-robed youth.
"So what if you’re a Supreme Major Sect? This opportunity belongs to our Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird. You can’t take it even if you want to."
Gazing at the Life and Death Realm cultivators from the Nether Immortal Cave opposite them, the Xuan Bird let out a derisive laugh.

chapters.title: Chapter 357: A Light Punishment Will Do
chapters.content:
Chapter 357: Chapter 357: A Light Punishment Will Do
"Huh?"
The green-robed middle-aged man stared at the Xuan bird, an expression of shock on his face. "To think that the insignificant Heavenly Moon Dynasty actually possesses a Xuan bird great demon of the Life and Death Realm! No wonder your Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird has the audacity to challenge our Supreme Major Sects."
The green-robed middle-aged man sneered, his eyes filled with mockery.
The figure opposite him has a chaotic and seemingly unstable Super Divine Dragon Breath, suggesting he’s a Xuan bird great demon at the first level of the Life and Death Realm. While the Demon Clan is formidable, he’s simply not in the same league as me.
Seeing the scornful gaze of the green-robed middle-aged man, the Xuan bird grew annoyed. His body quivered slightly, and his Super Divine Dragon Breath suddenly surged. At this moment, his Super Divine Dragon Breath also reached the fourth level of the Life and Death Realm.
Suddenly, Ye Yun’s voice reached the Xuan bird’s ear. "Go easy on them."
"Yes, Lord."
The Xuan bird was slightly taken aback, quickly responding in his mind.
He hadn’t expected the Lord to be so lenient with these few young monks from the Nether Immortal Sect, who were merely in the Life and Death Realm. But the Lord always had His own plans, and the Xuan bird dared not question further; he would simply obey.
「Inside the carriage.」
Ye Yun looked at the white-robed young man, a thoughtful expression flickering in his eyes.
This young man must not die. However, I’ll deal with the Covert Dragon Coffin first. I’ll make these cultivators from the Nether Immortal Sect back down for now. After that’s settled, I’ll plan a trip to the Nether Immortal Dynasty.
「...」
"What! You’re also at the fourth level of the Life and Death Realm? How is that possible? How can the Heavenly Moon Dynasty have such a powerful cultivator?"
Staring at the Super Divine Dragon Breath emanating from the Xuan bird, the corners of the green-robed middle-aged man’s mouth twitched as he roared in shock. Behind him, the four Life and Death Realm cultivators also displayed exaggerated expressions of astonishment.
The tiny Heavenly Moon Dynasty, with only four superior great sects, had unexpectedly produced a great demon at the fourth level of the Life and Death Realm. This was truly astounding.
"This... The Xuan Bird Ancestor of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird is actually an expert at the fourth level of the Life and Death Realm?"
The Supreme Elders and Sect Masters of the Mo Xue Sect, Xuanyang Sect, and Zhengyi Jianmen were all stunned into silence. A chill ran down their spines, and they broke out in a cold sweat.
Thankfully, they had pledged allegiance to the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird early on. Otherwise, with such a cultivation base, the Xuan Bird Ancestor already possessed the strength to contend with a Supreme Major Sect.
Big Black Cat, leaning against the Covert Dragon Coffin and watching the distant scene, chuckled. He looked back at the white-robed young man standing in the vermilion coffin opposite him and said with a smile, "Brother, as they say, ’only a fierce dragon crosses the river.’ You didn’t expect the Heavenly Moon Dynasty to have a fourth-level Life and Death Realm expert, did you?"
"I truly didn’t expect it..." The white-robed young man’s face grew even paler. After a sigh, a bitter smile touched his lips.
It seems Heaven truly intends to take my life.
He lowered his head, his expression contorted in extreme pain.
Watching the white-robed youth’s anguished look, Big Black Cat smacked his lips, a strange feeling washing over him.
For him, a living being, to be fighting over a coffin with someone about to die felt indescribably strange. But it couldn’t be helped; this was the task assigned by the Lord. He had to lie in the Covert Dragon Coffin, be buried in the Dragon Cave, and see what awaited inside.
"Sir, you are also at the fourth level of the Life and Death Realm. Must we truly become enemies with my Nether Immortal Cave?" the green-robed middle-aged man said coldly. He slowly drew the sword from his back, his body as straight and unyielding as a spear, radiating an overwhelming Sword Intent that swept forth like a tidal wave.
The distant Supreme Elders were aghast, hastily retreating tens of meters and erecting a defensive barrier to withstand the pressure.
Mu Qing, however, did not retreat. Just as the thought to fall back crossed her mind, a faint barrier materialized before her, blocking the surging Sword Intent.
Mu Qing knew this must be the Lord’s doing.
"Apologies, but the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird has laid claim to this Covert Dragon Coffin. No one can take it. You should withdraw," the Xuan bird stated calmly. His tone remained polite, as the Lord had instructed.
"That youth in the black robe doesn’t appear to be on death’s door. Why waste such a precious opportunity?" the green-robed middle-aged man said, pointing his sword at the Xuan bird, his demeanor desolate as he sighed.
"That is a secret of my Sect. I cannot disclose it," the Xuan bird replied, shaking his head faintly with his hands behind his back.
"Very well, then let’s settle this with our skills! The victor is king." The green-robed middle-aged man gritted his teeth, and his body abruptly vanished.
A brilliant streak of sword light suddenly tore through the void, slashing viciously towards the Xuan bird.
Facing the menacing advance, the Xuan bird remained entirely unfazed. He was, after all, a great demon of the Eternal Realm, merely concealing his cultivation base now to play a game with this insignificant Life and Death Realm cultivator. He extended a single finger, tapping it against the sword light.
BANG!
The instant his finger connected with the sword light, the green-robed middle-aged man’s body shot backward as if struck by lightning. He flew several hundred feet through the air before managing to stabilize himself, blood already trickling from the corner of his mouth.
This Xuan bird... how can he be so strong?
The green-robed middle-aged man wiped the blood from his lips, his eyes filled with an incredibly grave expression.
The Xuan bird is also an ancient Divine Beast. To think his combat power would be so terrifying at the same realm! He dared to meet my sword light with just a single finger.
But for his child, the green-robed middle-aged man resolved to make a last stand. "If you can withstand this next move of mine, I will turn and leave immediately," he declared coldly, his expression devoid of joy or sorrow as he slowly raised his sword.
"Bring forth whatever skills you possess," the Xuan bird replied with a faint smile. Looking at the green-robed middle-aged man’s sorrowful gaze, the Xuan bird seemed to understand in that moment why the Lord had instructed him to go easy and deliver only a light punishment.
The green-robed middle-aged man vanished.
Throughout the void, dazzling sword lights erupted everywhere. Each beam carried unimaginable power, a force so great it caused the very fabric of space to tremble. Powerful torrents of Sword Intent erupted from the sky full of sword light, blasting outwards in all directions. The surrounding rocks, trees, and plants were instantly pulverized.
The Supreme Elders and Sect Masters of the Xuanyang Sect, Mo Xue Sect, and Zhengyi Jianmen immediately sensed the danger and transformed into streaks of light, fleeing the mountain peak. The power of a Life and Death Realm expert was too immense; they couldn’t withstand the mere Sword Intent.
Strange, why does Sect Master Mu of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird seem completely unfazed?
they wondered, hovering at a safe distance in mid-air, their gazes fixed on the elegant black figure standing calmly on the summit.
The faces of the three great sect masters were etched with shock.
"Perhaps the Xuan Bird Ancestor intervened?" the Supreme Ancestor of Zhengyi Jianmen sighed, offering an explanation.
"Impressive swordsmanship, truly worthy of a Supreme Major Sect," the Xuan bird’s indifferent voice drifted from within the maelstrom of sword light.
WHOOSH!
A torrent of black light swept out like a raging gale. In an instant, all the sword light permeating the sky shattered, and the void returned to tranquility.
PUH!
The green-robed middle-aged man violently spat out a mouthful of fresh blood as he rematerialized in mid-air. His face was flushed crimson, his breathing ragged, as he stared in disbelief at the Xuan bird great demon opposite him.
Even the strongest sword technique of the Nether Immortal Cave was no match for him.
He... was defeated!

chapters.title: Chapter 358: Arrival of the Coffin Carrier
chapters.content:
Chapter 358: Chapter 358: Arrival of the Coffin Carrier
"You’ve lost."
Xuan Bird stood with his hands behind his back, calmly looking at the green-robed middle-aged man opposite him.
"Yes, I have lost..."
The green-robed middle-aged man’s face was crestfallen as he slowly descended, landing beside the vermilion coffin.
"Son! Your father is useless. I was defeated this time."
The green-robed middle-aged man’s eyes reddened, and he choked up as he spoke.
"Father, life and death are decreed by fate, and wealth by Heaven. Besides, I can still live for a few more days, can’t I? There’s no need for you to worry. I will spend my remaining days accompanying you."
The young man in white smiled and extended his hand to gently wipe the tears from the corners of the man’s eyes.
Seeing such a touching scene, Big Black Cat, who was standing to the side, pursed his lips, unsure of what to say.
"As long as you don’t blame your father, it’s alright."
Tears streamed down the green-robed middle-aged man’s face as he spoke, bowing his head in shame before his son.
The young man in white withdrew his arm and slowly lay down in the vermilion coffin.
With a slight wave of his hand, the red coffin lid closed over him.
"Let’s go back," the young man in white said softly from inside the coffin.
"Go!"
The green-robed middle-aged man swiftly wiped away his tears and gave a command to the four Life and Death Realm cultivators beside him.
These four Life and Death Realm cultivators lifted the vermilion coffin again and, along with the green-robed middle-aged man, ascended into the air.
In the void, the small vortex appeared once more.
A pillar of light descended, enveloping the five of them.
As the pillar of light vanished, so did they.
"The powerful Nether Immortal Cave... has also been defeated."
The Supreme Elder of the XuanYang Saint Sect swallowed hard.
"Indeed. The Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird is too strong. We must act with extreme caution from now on," the Supreme Elder of Zhengyi Jianmen said with a wry smile.
With an invincible figure like the Xuan Bird Ancestor presiding over the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, they would forever have to act subserviently, doing their utmost to curry favor with the sect.
The light shield around Mu Qing disappeared.
Xuan Bird walked over, looked at Mu Qing, and said with a calm smile, "Please, continue."
"Yes, Ancestor!"
After Mu Qing acknowledged, Xuan Bird instantly transformed into a streak of black light and flew back to the black carriage above.
Mu Qing quickly walked to the front of the Covert Dragon Coffin.
Big Black Cat looked at Mu Qing and gave an awkward smile. "I’ll get in now."
"Rest assured. With the Master present, nothing will happen," Mu Qing said with a smile.
Big Black Cat stepped forward and lay down inside the Covert Dragon Coffin. Mu Qing then came forward and gently placed the black coffin lid over him.
Big Black Cat suddenly felt darkness envelop his vision, plunging him into a pitch-black world.
He opened his eyes, looking at the dark coffin lid, and chuckled secretly to himself.
Experiencing what it’s like to be dead for the first time... it’s rather thrilling.
Now that this mission is complete, the Master will definitely reward me. It’s just lying in a coffin for a bit, no big deal. Our Dragon God Sect is so powerful; why would we fear a few Coffin Carriers?
Big Black Cat consoled himself in this way.
After Mu Qing closed the coffin lid, she quickly retreated some distance.
At this time, the Supreme Elders and Sect Masters of the other three major sects also descended.
They craned their necks in anticipation, silently waiting for the arrival of the Coffin Carriers.
According to legend, once the Covert Dragon Coffin was closed, the Coffin Carriers would appear near it via Void Throw.
The time it takes for a stick of incense to burn passed.
The Coffin Carriers did not appear.
The people of the Four Great Sects continued to look up at the void, only able to wait in silence.
"Why haven’t the Coffin Carriers arrived yet? This waiting is making me anxious."
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon raised its head, staring fixedly in the direction of the Covert Dragon Coffin.
It had always thought it would be interesting to watch these mysterious Coffin Carriers take a coffin and bury it in the Dragon Cave. It also wanted to see what the Coffin Carriers would do after they appeared.
Having waited this long in vain, the dragon was beginning to lose patience.
"Don’t worry, they might show up soon," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon responded calmly.
No sooner had it spoken than a whirlpool materialized in the void. A beam of light emerged, and from it, six white-robed figures flew out.
Each of these six white-robed figures wore a mask.
The masks were pitch black, engraved with several dragon patterns.
The six white-robed figures descended from mid-air, landing beside the Covert Dragon Coffin.
The people from the Four Great Sects in the distance looked at these six white-robed figures, their hearts stirred with excitement, yet their faces showed utter shock.
The aura of these six white-robed figures was incredibly powerful, even stronger than that of the green-robed middle-aged man from the Nether Immortal Cave.
"My heavens! With such formidable cultivation bases, they could probably rival a Super Sect, right?" the Supreme Elder of the Xuanyang Sect’s eyes flashed as he spoke in a low voice.
"That’s hard to say. The number of Coffin Carriers has always been unknown. Perhaps there are even some at the Eternity Realm. In that case, they could rival a Sky-Level Sect," the Supreme Elder of Zhengyi Jianmen shrugged and said in a low voice.
While they were discussing this, one of the white-robed figures suddenly glanced their way. His gaze was as sharp as a sword, piercing their very souls. It made the elders’ spirits tremble, and they nearly fainted from shock.
They quickly shut their mouths, daring not to speak rashly again.
The white-robed figure sneered, lowered his head to look at the Covert Dragon Coffin, and after gazing at it silently for a few seconds, suddenly smacked the coffin lid.
SMACK!
The black coffin lid instantly floated up, revealing a black-robed young man lying calmly inside.
The Covert Dragon Coffin could shield Divine Sense, so Big Black Cat had no idea that the Coffin Carriers had suddenly arrived.
The coffin lid abruptly flew open, and the sudden flood of light startled Big Black Cat.
The gazes of the six white-robed figures all converged on the black-robed young man in the coffin.
They scrutinized Big Black Cat unabashedly, as if inspecting him for something.
The leading white-robed figure coughed suddenly and said coldly, "Your cultivation base is passable, but your body is healthy and shows no signs of impending death. You do not meet the conditions for burial in the Dragon Cave."
"Not meeting the conditions?"
Big Black Cat was instantly stunned.
He had been lying in the coffin for so long, only for the Coffin Carriers to tell him he wasn’t qualified.
Are they going to make me get out?
Witnessing this, Mu Qing, who was watching from a distance, was also stunned. She hadn’t expected the Coffin Carriers to have such a standard.
In the carriage, Ye Yun heard the Coffin Carrier’s words and grew thoughtful. He gently flicked his finger, and Big Black Cat’s body instantly underwent a peculiar transformation.
Big Black Cat immediately sensed this change and understood. His Master was making adjustments to his body.
"I’m... I’m really dying..." Big Black Cat coughed twice, speaking feebly.
"You’re not dying. Get out quickly and let someone else in," the leading white-robed figure spoke coldly.
"You must have misjudged earlier. My body truly is failing; I don’t have many days left. If you don’t believe me, please, examine me again."
Big Black Cat raised his face, assuming a pitiful, dying expression.
This white-robed figure was meticulous. After a slight frown, he extended his Divine Sense, which enveloped Big Black Cat.
After this examination, a look of astonishment also appeared in his eyes.
Just moments ago, this young man’s physique was robust, his vital energy abundant, with not the slightest issue.
How could his body have suddenly deteriorated to this state? Could it be... had we truly misjudged earlier?

chapters.title: Chapter 359 Dragon Cave Appears, Big Dipper Seven Stars Emerge
chapters.content:
Chapter 359: Chapter 359 Dragon Cave Appears, Big Dipper Seven Stars Emerge
The Big Black Cat was quick-witted. As soon as he saw the change in the white-robed men’s eyes, he knew what was happening.
"You tiny Coffin Carriers, trying to make waves under my, your master’s, watch?"
Big Black Cat sneered inwardly.
"I am truly near death... I beseech you, venerable ones... take me to the Dragon Cave." Big Black Cat clutched his heart, speaking in an extremely feeble voice.
To make his act convincing, he deliberately put on a longing expression.
If he could be buried in the Dragon Cave, there would be a chance for a second life. Who wouldn’t want that? Any person on the brink of death would want to achieve this.
"Could it be that we really misjudged the situation just now?" the leading white-robed man mused aloud.
"I don’t think we were mistaken. Perhaps this fellow has some strange illness. Once it acts up, he might just end up like this," another white-robed man said.
"Never mind. In any case, his condition is suitable, and we were just short one body." The leading white-robed man gently tapped the coffin lid. It immediately fell into place, sealing the Covert Dragon Coffin tightly.
The six white-robed men positioned themselves at six different points around the Covert Dragon Coffin. They continuously formed hand seals, reinforcing the Covert Dragon Coffin.
Big Black Cat’s vision plunged into darkness. He stared blankly, unaware of what was happening outside. If he knew the Covert Dragon Coffin had been reinforced and he couldn’t escape, he would probably be scared half to death again.
After a round of reinforcement, the six white-robed men stopped simultaneously. They lifted the Covert Dragon Coffin, slowly raised it into mid-air, and then sped off in a certain direction.
"Those Coffin Carriers have finally left. They were truly terrifying." The Supreme Elder of the Xuanyang Sect exhaled at this moment, his face still showing lingering fear as he gazed towards a certain direction in the void.
They had lorded over the Heavenly Moon Dynasty for many years. When had they ever encountered so many great Cultivators of the Life and Death Realm descending upon this place?
Today, they had encountered several waves of great Cultivators at the Life and Death Realm. Enduring that powerful pressure repeatedly was truly agonizing.
"Sect Master Mu, the Coffin Carriers have taken the Covert Dragon Coffin for burial. May we return now?" The Supreme Elder of Zhengyi Jianmen looked at Mu Qing, performed a fist-and-palm salute, and asked with a smile.
"These past days, everyone has worked hard on the Covert Dragon Coffin. Thank you all for your efforts. Mu Qing thanks you all here." Mu Qing clasped her fists and said with a smile.
"Sect Master Mu, until we meet again." The six individuals bid farewell to Mu Qing one after another and then tore through the air, departing.
Mu Qing returned to the vicinity of the carriage and entered the compartment.
"Master, is there anything else you need me to do?" Mu Qing asked respectfully.
"No need. Just brew me a cup of tea," Ye Yun smiled faintly.
His Divine Sense was closely monitoring the movements of the six Coffin Carriers.
Not only him, but even the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, Big Black Horse, and the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon were also intently tracking the six Coffin Carriers with their Divine Senses.
However, the six Coffin Carriers moved at an incredible speed. After a short while, the Divine Senses of Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, both at the Eternity Realm, were no longer sufficient to keep up.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon immediately used a Divine Skill. A Little Mirror appeared before him, displaying an image of the Coffin Carriers.
"Divine Monarch Realm practitioners are truly impressive!" The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon sighed.
He, at the sixth level of the Eternity Realm, was truly no match for the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon.
"Senior, you don’t need to tease me. You were reincarnated from the Ancient Times. My current cultivation base would have been considered trash in the Ancient Times. Moreover, you possess the bloodline of the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon; you will surely surpass me one day," the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon said with a smile.
"What you say does make sense, haha..." The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon burst into laughter.
"I wonder where the Dragon Cave is?" Cat Bao’er also came closer, curiously staring at the image.
"Don’t be anxious. It should be within the territory of the Heavenly Moon Dynasty," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said in a low voice.
Ye Yun watched the three little cats gathered around the Little Mirror, observing intently, and couldn’t help but chuckle. The scene was quite heartwarming.
Because the cultivation realms of these great demons were too high, even though the six Coffin Carriers were being watched by powerful Divine Sense, they were completely unaware that they had been targeted.
"Master, please have some tea!" Mu Qing brought over a cup of tea.
Ye Yun accepted the teacup, looked at the expression on Mu Qing’s face, and said with a smile, "Why don’t you go out and join them? Go take a look."
Mu Qing blushed, nodded quickly, and went out. She had indeed extended a wisp of her Divine Sense earlier, secretly monitoring the situation outside. Mu Qing also wanted to know where the Coffin Carriers would ultimately end up.
Pushing aside the carriage curtain, Mu Qing squatted behind the little cats, cupping her chin in her hands, watching the image intently.
"They’ve stopped!" Suddenly, Cat Bao’er’s voice rang out.
In the image, the six Coffin Carriers had halted. The one in the lead pointed a finger towards the ground.
Suddenly, a beam of golden light shot up into the sky.
"Senior, quickly change the view! Let’s see the Dragon Cave!" Cat Bao’er exclaimed.
"Alright!" The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon shifted his Divine Sense, and the image immediately changed.
Within a vast mountain range, a golden pillar of light erupted from the midway point of one of the mountains. On the mountainside, a deep, unfathomable golden hole had appeared. This was undoubtedly the Dragon Cave.
"This Dragon Cave is indeed extraordinary." Mu Qing gazed at the image, roughly guessing its location.
She had never imagined that an Emperor Level Dragon Den was hidden within that mountain range.
The black Covert Dragon Coffin suddenly flew out of their hands, soaring through the air towards the Dragon Cave. It descended along the golden pillar of light, stopping abruptly at the cave entrance.
The six Coffin Carriers suddenly flew to surround the black Covert Dragon Coffin. They continuously circled it, forming hand seals, seemingly setting up some kind of formation.
In the clear, bright sky, seven large stars suddenly appeared, arranged in the shape of a ladle.
Cat Bao’er exclaimed in shock, "Is that the Northern Dipper?"
"Indeed." The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon nodded gravely, frowning as he said, "The Northern Dipper has suddenly appeared. What on earth are these Coffin Carriers doing?"
"These are merely phantoms of the Northern Dipper. They are just borrowing the power of the Northern Dipper." The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon observed for a moment before concluding.
The Northern Dipper again?
Although Big Black Horse was pulling the carriage, it had also sent out a wisp of its Divine Sense to observe the situation. When it saw the image on the Little Mirror, it instantly recalled the Seven-Star Dragon Kill Array in the underground palace of the fake Dragon God Sect, which suppressed a Black Dragon.
「Inside the carriage.」
Ye Yun’s brow twitched slightly, and a cold smirk touched his lips.
The Northern Dipper again. He hadn’t expected the Coffin Carriers to have some connection with the mastermind behind the scenes.
"Descend!" The six Coffin Carriers shouted in unison, forming hand seals and pointing towards the Covert Dragon Coffin.
The Northern Dipper sent down seven beams of light, which shot straight into the Covert Dragon Coffin.
Big Black Cat was staring wide-eyed at the coffin lid above him when he suddenly saw seven beams of light descend from above, striking his chest.
"AAAH!" Big Black Cat shrieked and died instantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 360
chapters.content:
Chapter 360: 360
"The Big Dipper... seven rays of light suddenly descended from it and entered the Covert Dragon Coffin. I hope Little Black Boy is alright," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said from atop the carriage. It raised its fluffy, cat-like paw, scratching its chin, its demeanor somewhat serious.
From its perspective, with the Big Dipper’s seven rays of light entering the Covert Dragon Coffin, something must have happened to the Big Black Cat. The outcome is unpredictable.
"It has been impossible to probe with Divine Sense since the Coffin Carriers fortified the Covert Dragon Coffin with Seals. I have no idea if Little Black Boy is dead or alive. Honestly, I’m quite worried about the little rascal..." the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon heaved a sigh.
"Little Black Boy is blessed and lucky. That kid is clever; he should be alright," the Big Black Horse turned its head and said, though worry was apparent in its eyes. It felt an instinctual awe towards the Big Dipper.
"Don’t worry, Little Black Cat will be fine."
Just as the demons were worried, Ye Yun’s calm voice came from within the carriage.
Everyone was overjoyed.
If the Master has spoken, then Little Black Boy’s life is definitely not in danger.
The crowd’s gaze returned to the image in the Little Mirror.
The Big Dipper in the sky had now disappeared.
The six Coffin Carriers stood around the Dragon Cave, continuously casting rays of light from their hands, which fell onto the Covert Dragon Coffin.
The Covert Dragon Coffin, pressing down on the golden light, sank bit by bit into the Dragon Cave.
"The burial is starting..." Cat Bao’er, her wide eyes staring intently at the Little Mirror, murmured.
"The Coffin Carriers are being so deliberately mysterious. What are they aiming for? Could there really be a second life?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon curled its lips, still not believing in the concept of a second life.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon said nothing; its gaze flickered as it stared intently at the scene, falling silent.
Inside the carriage, Ye Yun’s expression remained very calm.
Just moments ago, the seven rays of light from the Big Dipper had landed on Big Black Cat, indeed extinguishing all vitality within it.
At that instant, Big Black Cat was as good as dead.
However, the seven rays from the Big Dipper landed on its chest and formed a small formation.
The moment the formation took shape, it swiftly connected to the local dragon vein.
Strands of Dragon Qi were drawn by the Seven-star formation and injected into Big Black Cat’s body.
With this infusion of Dragon Qi, the faint trace of life remaining in Big Black Cat was not completely destroyed.
The Big Dipper Seven-star formation, controlled by the Coffin Carriers, was a risky endeavor, akin to plucking chestnuts from the fire. Their control over the timing throughout the process was exceptionally precise, which allowed them to preserve that slight hint of life.
Otherwise, if there had been even the slightest mistake, Big Black Cat would have been destroyed by the Seven-star formation.
Watching the Coffin Carriers’ skilled techniques, Ye Yun couldn’t help but nod inwardly in approval.
They must have practiced countless times to have mastered the knack in such minute details.
Naturally, Ye Yun would not let Big Black Cat risk its life; he had already concealed a wisp of his Primordial Spirit in its mind.
Although the Covert Dragon Coffin was reinforced with Seals, that wisp of his Primordial Spirit could still maintain contact with him.
In Ye Yun’s eyes, this Seal was extremely weak. His wisp of Primordial Spirit could easily break it. But now was not the time. He wanted to closely inspect this small-scale Big Dipper Seven-Star formation. This formation seemed different from the previous ones.
「...」
The Covert Dragon Coffin continued to sink. Its speed was not fast, as it constantly suppressed the golden light, descending slowly.
"This is so strange." The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon turned its head to look at Mu Qing and asked softly, "Shouldn’t only one person be buried in a single Dragon Cave?"
Mu Qing was taken aback and quickly nodded, "Yes! Sir, why do you say that?"
"You’ll see in a moment." The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon smiled but did not elaborate. Instead, it raised its fluffy paw and pointed towards the Little Mirror.
Everyone’s curiosity was instantly piqued, and they stared intently at the Little Mirror.
Ye Yun had been studying the small Seven-star formation on Big Black Cat’s chest. Upon hearing the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s words, his eyes flickered, and he instantly understood.
Yet, Ye Yun did not continue to watch that. His attention remained focused on the Big Dipper Seven-star formation.
Undeniably, the mastermind behind this had an incredibly thorough understanding of the Big Dipper Seven-star formation, with all sorts of variations. Their functions were also completely different.
The Dragon Cave widened below as the black Covert Dragon Coffin descended. After the time it takes for an incense stick to burn, it suddenly halted.
At this moment, the image on the Little Mirror clearly showed four other black Covert Dragon Coffins, bobbing up and down amidst a golden glow.
Including the Coffin Big Black Cat was in, there were five coffins in total.
"Why are there so many coffins? Judging by the style, they all appear to be identical Covert Dragon Coffins!" A look of shock appeared on the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s face.
Initially, it had not been concerned about the burial in the Dragon Cave, but the sudden appearance of five Covert Dragon Coffins was indeed startling.
"It seems I’ve never heard of Coffin Carriers burying so many Covert Dragon Coffins together like this, have they?" Mu Qing frowned, murmuring to herself.
"Sister, you’re right. I’ve also heard rumors that a Dragon Cave only buries one Covert Dragon Coffin," Cat Bao’er nodded and said.
"Rumors are just rumors. None of you have witnessed it yourselves, right? Each time these Coffin Carriers appear, they carry the coffins and swiftly fly away. Who could possibly see how they conduct the burial?" the Big Black Horse smacked its lips, voicing its doubts.
"Uncle Ma, then why do you think there are four other Covert Dragon Coffins?" Cat Bao’er looked at Big Black Horse and asked with a smile.
"I’m not entirely sure either, but I remember that day on Xuanyang Sect’s Peak, the Coffin Carrier once said that this was the last Covert Dragon Coffin they needed."
The Big Black Horse gazed at the sky and said in a low voice, "What he meant by that was probably that this Dragon Cave was supposed to be filled with five Covert Dragon Coffins."
The moment Big Black Horse finished speaking, everyone was astonished.
Indeed, on that day at Xuanyang Sect’s Peak, a Coffin Carrier had said such a thing. At the time, no one had paid it much mind. Especially Mu Qing; the notion that only one Covert Dragon Coffin should be buried in a Dragon Cave was so deeply ingrained in her mind that she hadn’t considered anything else at all.
"I have a guess..." The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s eyes sparkled as it slowly said, "The quality of this Dragon Cave has reached Emperor Level Top Grade. It might require five Covert Dragon Coffins to suppress it. The higher the grade of the Dragon Cave, the more Covert Dragon Coffins are needed to suppress it."
"What’s the principle behind this?" Cat Bao’er blinked her large eyes, scratching her head with her fluffy little paws, and exclaimed in confusion.
"Living a second life can’t be that easy, can it? Perhaps these five Covert Dragon Coffins hold the secret to this second life?" the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon conjectured boldly.
The secret to a second life?
Everyone looked at each other, finding it hard to accept for a moment.
This Emperor Level Top Grade Dragon Cave required the burial of five Covert Dragon Coffins... One of them was currently being interred, but when had the others been buried?
For a moment, a torrent of jumbled thoughts flooded everyone’s minds like a tidal wave.

chapters.title: Chapter 361: Seven-star Formation, Plundering Destiny
chapters.content:
Chapter 361: Chapter 361: Seven-star Formation, Plundering Destiny
"Almost done."
The lead Coffin Carrier glanced into the depths of the Dragon Cave and said indifferently.
Five black Covert Dragon Coffins were now floating side by side in the golden light, incredibly tranquil.
The six Coffin Carriers simultaneously cast a series of spells, sealing the entrance to the Dragon Cave.
The process was swift. In just a few breaths, the entrance to the Dragon Cave was sealed.
One of the Coffin Carriers used his mana to move some dirt, rocks, and vegetation to cover the top of the cave.
Once everything was in order, the six Coffin Carriers rose into mid-air.
"Is it all over?"
Little Cat stared blankly at the scene inside the Little Mirror, somewhat incredulous.
The Dragon Cave was sealed. Now it was impossible to detect what was happening inside. It was also impossible to determine whether the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat was dead or alive.
"Master, shall I go and check out the Dragon Cave?"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon stood up interestedly and turned to look in the direction of the carriage.
"No rush."
Ye Yun smiled lightly.
The drama was just getting started. He was still analyzing the small Seven-star Formation on the chest of the Big Black Cat.
In any case, the Dragon Cave had been sealed. It was a good opportunity for Ye Yun to track down the whereabouts of the Coffin Carriers’ lair.
"Oh."
Seeing the Master hadn’t agreed, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon could only lie on the carriage and continue to gaze at the scene in the Little Mirror.
Suddenly, a vortex appeared in the sky. As it spun, a pillar of white light dropped down swiftly.
"Are they going back?" the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon said, frowning.
At this moment, Ye Yun’s voice echoed lightly in the ears of the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and the Big Black Horse.
"Little Horse, Little Dragon, the two of you go and investigate the lair of the Coffin Carriers..."
Before the two Eternal Realm great demons could react, the view in front of them blurred, and they instantaneously left the carriage, entering a pillar of white light.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon watched as the six Coffin Carriers were nearby, only about thirty to forty feet away.
The Big Black Horse was also at its side.
Even though they were face-to-face with the Coffin Carriers, the Coffin Carriers did not detect them.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon understood.
This was the Master’s grand move. He had instantaneously torn open the void and placed them within the beam of light from the Void Throw. Simultaneously, he had added an invisible restriction, rendering the six Coffin Carriers, though mere feet away, unable to detect them.
The Big Black Horse transformed, instantly becoming a middle-aged man in a black robe.
Whenever the Master entrusted him with a mission, he naturally preferred to appear in human form. This was also the Big Black Horse’s preferred way.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, not to be outdone, also transformed, turning into a young man in a red robe.
The two glanced at each other. Without a word, a silent understanding passed between them, and a flicker of excitement danced in their eyes.
The white column of light descended, then retracted, disappearing into the vortex in the sky.
The two Eternal Realm great demons, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and the Big Black Horse, under Ye Yun’s careful planning, left the Heavenly Moon Dynasty along with the Coffin Carriers.
Inside the Dragon Cave, the five black Covert Dragon Coffins continued to bob in the golden light. Visible to the naked eye, streams of golden Dragon Qi surged up from the depths of the earth, entering the various Covert Dragon Coffins.
Ye Yun’s sliver of Divine Sense was also constantly analyzing this small Seven-star Formation.
The more Ye Yun analyzed, the more astonished he became.
He had never imagined that the mastermind behind this would be so utterly depraved. They had once plundered the destiny of the Dragon God Sect, and now they aimed to plunder the destiny of the entire Cangnan Continent.
There are numerous dragon veins on the Cangnan Continent, which are the focal points of its destiny. And the destiny gathered by these dragon veins, upon deeper analysis, constitutes the collective destiny of the entire continent.
The Cangnan Continent, also known as the Dragon Hidden Continent in the Ancient Era, was once the Dragon Clan Ancestral Land. Although the Dragon Clan’s glory has long faded, much of their ancient destiny still resides within this land.
If this destiny were allowed to develop naturally, it would only continue to grow. Gradually, this Dragon Clan Ancestral Land would reawaken with new vitality.
However, with the appearance of the Coffin Carriers, who employed a special Seven-star Formation technique—burying the living dead in Dragon Caves—they could absorb and destroy this subterranean Dragon Vein Qi.
This essentially meant that whenever a dragon vein emerged, the Coffin Carriers would intervene, using their Seven Stars Secret Technique to entomb it within a Covert Dragon Coffin, thereby beginning to plunder the continent’s remaining Dragon Clan destiny.
That’s why there are five Covert Dragon Coffins.
Ye Yun surmised that this Dragon Cave was of Emperor Level Top Grade quality. A single Covert Dragon Coffin could not completely absorb the Dragon Vein Qi here; five were needed.
Under the influence of this Seven-star Formation, the person inside the Covert Dragon Coffin has become a puppet on the verge of death. The Seven-star Formation absorbs Dragon Vein Qi, continuously replenishing this puppet. Once replenished to a certain extent, the puppet is destroyed again.
As for the rumor of living a second life...
Ye Yun guessed that after the Dragon Qi of this Dragon Cave was completely drained, the Seven-star Formation would likely undergo some further transformation.
This transformation is the key to whether the person in the Covert Dragon Coffin can truly live a second life.
"This Seven-star Formation is indeed wondrous."
Ye Yun sighed lightly.
Although he was powerful enough to destroy this Seven-star Formation easily, thoroughly deconstructing it would still require some time. However, Ye Yun was not in a hurry; he had plenty of patience.
Now that the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and the Big Black Horse had followed the Coffin Carriers, he would wait for news from them.
He had placed an invisible restriction on both these great demons. Unless a Divine Monarch Realm Cultivator with a cultivation base higher than his own appeared, no one would be able to perceive these two. Otherwise, once these two great demons reached the Coffin Carriers’ lair, it would be as if they were in an uninhabited land; no one would be able to see them.
Ye Yun closed his eyes, continuing to analyze the miniature Seven-star Formation while also awaiting good news from the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and the Big Black Horse.
「Outside the carriage.」
Seeing the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and the Big Black Horse suddenly disappear,
"SIGH!"
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon said with a frustrated expression, "It’s a pity my cultivation base is too high! Here on the Cangnan Continent, I’m completely useless."
"Senior, don’t be too upset. Perhaps the Master will assign you a new task soon," Little Cat said, covering her mouth with a chuckle.
"Don’t try to comfort me."
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon shook his head, retracted his Divine Skills, and sprawled back onto the carriage, soon falling fast asleep.
Just then, Mu Qing also returned to the carriage interior.
Only a small white cat remained on the carriage.
「In a desolate valley.」
A white light descended, revealing six Coffin Carriers dressed in white robes.
These six Coffin Carriers, ever cautious, glanced around. Seeing nothing unusual, they then swaggered off, flying in a specific direction.
"Where is this place? It doesn’t feel like we’re on the Cangnan Continent,"
The Big Black Horse, still invisible, sensed its surroundings.
This place is desolate and cold, with scarce vegetation and pitifully sparse Spiritual Energy.
It was taken aback.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon surveyed the area, seemingly having discovered something. Its expression shifted rapidly, and its pupils constricted.
After further observation, its face filled with shock, and it couldn’t help but murmur to itself, "This... isn’t this... the Moon Star?"

chapters.title: Chapter 362: Moon Star, Dragon Temple, Faceless God Statue
chapters.content:
Chapter 362: Chapter 362: Moon Star, Dragon Temple, Faceless God Statue
"Is this place the Moon Star?"
Hearing the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s words, the Big Black Horse was also taken aback.
It turned out the Coffin Carriers’ lair was actually set up on the Moon Star.
"Yes, it’s truly unexpected!"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s expression grew serious. As an ancient member of the Dragon Clan, he was naturally familiar with the Moon Star.
This huge star, hanging high in the sky, was the dwelling place of the Xuan Yin Moon Dragon Clan.
However, this place was off-limits to even the Ten Super Divine Dragons without an order from the Ancestor Dragon.
The reason for this was unknown to anyone.
A large number of Xuan Yin Moon Dragons lived on the Moon Star, with no other Dragon Clans present.
However, from ancient times to the present, most of the Dragon Clan had perished.
The Xuan Yin Moon Dragons on the Moon Star were no exception.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon had not expected the Coffin Carriers to set up their lair on the Moon Star.
This was an extremely secret place.
Standing on the Moon Star, one could monitor the entire Cangnan Continent.
It was truly the best vantage point for surveillance.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon looked at the Big Black Horse, his expression solemn, and said, "Boss, this time, Master has sent us to find the Coffin Carriers’ lair. I suspect it won’t be that simple. I have a premonition that these Coffin Carriers also have extraordinary origins!"
"Second Brother, you’re right. We need to be extra cautious and not act rashly. We’ll investigate thoroughly before making any moves."
The Big Black Horse also nodded solemnly.
When the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon joined the Dragon God Sect, he had voluntarily ranked himself second and referred to the Big Black Horse as ’Boss’. Thus, the monikers ’Boss’ and ’Second Brother’ were established from that time.
Over time, everyone became familiar with these address terms and used them out of habit.
"It seems the concealment restriction Master placed on us is still active. It looks like Master already considered this for us."
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon silently sensed the space around his body and then said with a smile.
"Then let’s go."
The Big Black Horse felt a wave of relief and said immediately.
The two of them followed closely behind the six Coffin Carriers, maintaining a certain distance.
After arriving on the Moon Star, the six Coffin Carriers seemed quite relaxed, chatting and laughing along the way, strolling as if not in a hurry.
They flew for about the time it would take to burn an incense stick.
After crossing a mountain range, they saw a large valley below.
In this valley, quite a few houses had been built. From a distance, they could also see many Human Cultivators in white robes.
This must be the Coffin Carriers’ lair.
The Big Black Horse nodded to himself.
After arriving, the six Coffin Carriers removed their masks, revealing their true faces.
Among the six men, there was one old man and five middle-aged men.
"This time... our mission went rather smoothly. That Emperor Level Top Grade Dragon Cave has been completely sealed. The Dragon Vein Qi won’t leak out. We just need to wait another hundred years for the five seeds to break through their cultivation. It won’t be long before we obtain a vessel."
"Elder, I’ve always had a doubt: what exactly is the use of us collecting so many vessels?"
A middle-aged man beside him asked.
The white-robed Elder immediately glared at the middle-aged man and said solemnly, "This is a secret of our Coffin Carrying Clan. Only the Clan Leader knows. You don’t need to ask so much. In any case, the more vessels we collect, the more beneficial it is for our Coffin Carrying Clan."
"Sigh..."
Having been rebuked by the white-robed Elder, the middle-aged man sighed, shook his head, and was the first to fly towards the houses ahead.
The white-robed Elder looked at the others and said with a wry smile, "Don’t think I’m not telling the truth. Truly, regarding the matter of the vessels, I am not very clear either. Only the Clan Leader knows."
"We understand, Elder."
The others nodded with a smile and then dispersed.
I should go report to the Clan Leader.
The white-robed Elder gazed at a distant black temple, and with a flash, his figure flew towards it.
On a distant boulder, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and the Big Black Horse inadvertently overheard the conversation between these people and the white-robed Elder. Both were utterly shocked.
The actions of this group of Coffin Carriers were bizarre, and their ambitions immense.
"Boss, what exactly is this ’vessel’ they’re talking about? What do you make of this?"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon stroked his chin and said thoughtfully.
The Big Black Horse watched the Elder disappear towards the distant black temple. His brow furrowed as he said in a low voice, "According to what these Coffin Carriers said, one vessel emerges from five Covert Dragon Coffins. It’s possible that the people in the five coffins are devouring each other until only one remains."
"It’s simply too inconceivable! What use could there be in cultivating such a vessel?"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon shook his head, finding it hard to understand.
"Let’s go. We’ll check things out up ahead."
The Big Black Horse spoke, then quickly flew forward, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon close behind.
Upon entering the valley, they were surprised to find many cultivators at the Eternal Realm—a good dozen of them. The one with the highest cultivation base among them, an old man, had already reached the Eighth Level of the Eternal Realm, two minor realms higher than the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon.
This place is even stronger than a Sky-Level Sect?
the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon murmured to himself.
Thankfully, their Master had placed an invisibility restriction on them. Otherwise, if the two of them had just snuck onto the Moon Star like this, they likely would have been discovered the moment they arrived. Once discovered, a fierce battle would have been inevitable, and then any further investigation would have been impossible.
After witnessing the Coffin Carrier Clan’s formidable strength, the expressions on both their faces grew increasingly grim; not a trace of a smile remained.
"Let’s go check out that place."
With a flicker, the Big Black Horse’s figure drifted towards a black ancient temple not far away.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon followed closely.
The two of them suddenly stopped in front of the black ancient temple.
"Dragon Temple?"
Seeing the three large characters on the temple’s plaque, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s spirit surged, and he almost couldn’t stop himself from tearing the plaque down.
The Big Black Horse gazed at the three large characters on the plaque and sent a voice transmission to the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, "This Coffin Carrier Clan actually worships at a Dragon Temple. Isn’t that too bizarre, Second Brother?"
"This place is very strange... Logically, the Coffin Carriers don’t even spare Dragon Vein Qi. How could they possibly worship a Divine Dragon?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon transmitted back, quite annoyed.
This ancient temple wasn’t large. Inside, a divine statue was enshrined.
The statue was entirely pitch-black and had no facial features, like a No Face person. One hand was placed on its chest, forming a Hand Seal, while the other hand was raised, holding a Black Mirror.
Four Little Dragons were coiled around the statue’s limbs.
Below the statue stood two elders, both dressed in white.
One of them was the Coffin Carrier Elder who had gone to the Heavenly Moon Dynasty on a mission.
The other elder, his face gaunt, was nevertheless exceedingly vigorous. His cultivation base was extremely shocking, having reached the Ninth Level of the Eternal Realm.
So this is their Clan Leader.
The Big Black Horse nodded to himself.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon leaned in. After seeing the situation inside the ancient temple clearly, he couldn’t help but show his surprise and transmitted, "Boss, this place is too bizarre! Even the god statue they worship is a Faceless God Statue!"

chapters.title: Chapter 363: The Revival of The Deity Statue, The Mysterious Black Mirror
chapters.content:
Chapter 363: Chapter 363: The Revival of The Deity Statue, The Mysterious Black Mirror
"I wonder what kind of god this temple venerates. Its face doesn’t even have features. Did they do this purposely to hide its true appearance?"
Big Black Horse sneered.
This kind of secretive behavior is truly contemptible.
"Yeah, I really want to rush in and smash it," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said with a cold huff.
"This ancient temple is called the Dragon Temple, so it stands to reason that this god would be the Dragon God. Second Brother, during the Ancient Times, have you ever seen such a Divine Dragon?" Big Black Horse suddenly asked.
"I’ve never seen one. Our Dragon Clan never wears images of dragons on our bodies, so this Dragon God must be a human," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said resentfully.
"Hmm..." Big Black Horse nodded and fell silent.
At that moment, the pair heard the two old men in the temple begin to speak.
"Clan Leader, the young ones in the clan are very interested in the container. They all want to know what the container will ultimately be used for?" the man in the white robe asked, looking up at the black statue before him with a flicker of caution in his expression.
"That is a secret of our clan. The Clan Leaders from generations past swore an oath before the statue of the Dragon Man God, vowing to never reveal it," the old Clan Leader said very seriously, his face tightening.
"Alright, I won’t ask anymore." The old man in the white robe shrugged, a look of embarrassment on his face.
Seeming to feel that his tone just now was a bit severe, the old Clan Leader explained further, "Our Coffin Carrier Branch was personally passed down by the Dragon Man God. This dwelling place on Moon Star was also personally chosen by the Dragon Man God. For almost 100,000 years, we have regularly received various cultivation resources from the Dragon Man God. This treatment far exceeds that of the Eternal Level Sects below us. As the Clan Leader, I absolutely cannot reveal the secret of the container before the statue of the Dragon Man God..."
"Alright, Clan Leader." Looking at the earnest old Clan Leader, the old man in the white robe helplessly shook his head and turned to leave.
It was no secret that the Dragon Man God regularly sent all sorts of cultivation resources to the Coffin Carrier Clan. After all, the spiritual energy on Moon Star today was sparse, and cultivation resources were extremely scarce. Furthermore, the Coffin Carrier Clan could not easily descend to the Cangnan Continent. So, for nearly 100,000 years, all cultivation resources had been provided by the Dragon Man God.
These cultivation resources were not only plentiful but also of high quality. This allowed the clan to have quite a number of powerful Eternal Realm Cultivators. Even Cultivators of the Life and Death Realm were quite common within the clan.
The Coffin Carrier Clan, in terms of strength, was slightly stronger than a Sky-Level Sect.
"Heh..." The old Clan Leader watched the white-robed old man leave, helplessly shaking his head.
He then turned and left the temple, closing the door behind him before heading to the living area in the front.
The entire Dragon Temple became empty again.
In the quiet Dragon Temple, rows of candles burned brightly. Amid the lingering incense smoke, the black, faceless statue looked even more eerie.
After listening to the conversation between the old Clan Leader and the man in the white robe, Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon became thoughtful.
Apparently, this black statue was revered by the Coffin Carrier Clan as the Dragon Man God. And the Coffin Carrier Clan, for nearly 100,000 years, had all their cultivation resources provided by the Dragon Man God.
This so-called Dragon Man God might come from the Divine Land,
Big Black Horse mused, stroking his chin.
Big Black Horse shook his head with a laugh and followed him in.
The two transformed back into their human forms, standing before the black statue.
"This faceless statue grows more terrifying the longer I look at it." Big Black Horse stared at the statue for a while, his growing unease finally compelling him to speak.
"Boss, I feel the same way. This damn so-called Dragon Man God is definitely bad news. I should just destroy this statue now." The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon felt equally terrified, but his wicked nature made him immediately think of destroying the statue.
"Don’t destroy it!" Big Black Horse stopped him urgently. "We should take this statue and let the Master have a look."
"Alright!" The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon promptly agreed, reaching out to pull the statue down.
"Wait." Big Black Horse suddenly grabbed the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s arm.
"What’s wrong, Boss?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon asked in confusion.
"Look at its other hand, the one holding the Black Mirror. Something flashed a moment ago," Big Black Horse said, his eyes wide.
"Don’t scare me! How come I didn’t see anything?" The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was astounded and quickly looked at the Black Mirror held aloft by the statue, but he found nothing unusual.
WHOOSH!
For no apparent reason, a thin layer of dark fog surged from the Faceless God Statue’s body. Veiled within the black mist, the Faceless God Statue twitched subtly, as if it had come to life.
The hand holding up the small Black Mirror abruptly began to rotate. The small Black Mirror immediately emitted a black glow downwards.
The black glow, sweeping like a vast ocean, quickly enveloped the entire ancient temple.
"What kind of light is this?" The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was taken aback.
Under this black light, he felt incredibly weak. He could barely manipulate his mana, and even the formidable physical strength intrinsic to the Dragon Clan was suppressed. The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon staggered, about to tumble to the ground.
Big Black Horse was experiencing similar symptoms at this very moment, albeit somewhat less intense.
What is this light?
A huge question arose in his mind. The light seemed to specifically target the bloodline within him.
I have a half-dragon bloodline! That’s why I’m less affected than Second Brother!
Big Black Horse instantly identified the cause. He whipped out a golden axe and hacked at the Faceless God Statue.
Big Black Horse knew that if they did not destroy the Faceless God Statue today, escape would be impossible for him and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon. The Faceless God Statue was extremely sinister. The even more sinister Black Mirror not only made them weak but also destroyed an invisible restriction around them. Therefore, their current situation was extremely precarious.
"Who dares to trespass in the Dragon Temple?!" An old man’s voice echoed from afar, and in no time, he was near the statue. With a single sword thrust, he blocked Big Black Horse’s golden axe.
Amidst the surrounding black light, the severe shockwaves from their Eternal Realm-level clash were surprisingly neutralized by the black light.
"Dragon Clan?" Suspended mid-air, the old Clan Leader recognized the Dragon God Bloodline of the two infiltrators in the Dragon Temple at a glance. Joy instantly swept over his face.
An Eternal Realm Divine Dragon!
Long vanished from the Cangnan Continent.
If I could capture one, it would be a great meritorious deed!
The commotion in the Dragon Temple alerted the entire Coffin Carrier Clan. In an instant, all the Eternal Realm Cultivators had besieged the Dragon Temple. Some rushed into the temple while others stood guard outside.
"Boss, you run! Go back and inform the Master!" Seeing the numerous Eternal Realm Cultivators, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s face turned ashen. As if summoning strength from nowhere, he gave Big Black Horse a forceful push and sent a voice transmission.
"Second Brother, I can’t flee and abandon you!" Big Black Horse said urgently.
"Don’t worry, I’m not that easy to kill. Don’t forget, I possess the Blood Leader Devil Dragon bloodline!" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon urgently transmitted.
With a stern look, Big Black Horse swung the golden axe forcefully. At this moment, he unleashed the Rebirth Thunder energy within the axe. Golden, violent Rebirth Thunder surged out of the small axe, carrying a world-destroying aura like a monstrous wave.
All the Eternal Realm Cultivators of the Coffin Carrier Clan turned pale immediately.
"Coffins, come!" Almost everyone roared in unison. A black coffin materialized outside each of their bodies. This meant that all the Eternal Realm Coffin Carriers had retreated into their coffins, using them to defend against the terrifying golden lightning.
At that very moment, the Faceless God Statue, shrouded in black fog, also swung its arm. The Black Mirror once again emitted a large area of bizarre black light.
The golden Rebirth Thunder and the bizarre black light clashed, creating an eerie SIZZLING sound as both dispersed simultaneously. It seemed as if they had neutralized each other.
Seizing this opportunity, Big Black Horse transformed into a streak of black light and fled.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 364: Catching Turtles in the Jar
chapters.content:
Chapter 364: Chapter 364: Catching Turtles in the Jar
Just as they burst out of the Dragon Temple, innumerable ferocious beams of sword light filled the void, forming a sword cloud that rained down on them.
At this moment, at least seven or eight Eternal Realm Cultivators had launched an attack on Big Black Horse. This group of cultivators worked in perfect concert, some guarding the exterior while others coordinated from within.
After bursting out from the Dragon Temple and being freed from the constraints of the black light, Big Black Horse’s body suddenly returned to normal. He raised his golden axe, and from its surface, Rebirth Thunder surged wildly, forming a golden ocean of lightning that roared as it surged towards the sword light.
BOOM!
The Rebirth Thunder destroyed the frenzied sword light. With unstoppable momentum, it furiously swept towards those Eternal Realm Coffin Carriers.
"Coffins, come!"
The few Coffin Carriers roared, and their bodies were instantly enveloped by black coffins.
WHOOSH!
The surging Rebirth Thunder crashed against the black coffins, CRACKLING loudly, but the coffins seemed undamaged.
Big Black Horse was inwardly alarmed.
The Coffin Carrier Clan truly is bizarre. Each one of them possesses a coffin-like Dharma treasure.
To think they could actually block my Rebirth Thunder!
Although breaking through the assault of sword light had weakened the Rebirth Thunder somewhat, the fact that these black coffins could withstand it attested to their extraordinary nature.
Big Black Horse didn’t know that within the inner walls of the coffins, there was a small Seven-star formation.
When the Rebirth Thunder struck a coffin, this small Seven-star formation would flare with silver light.
Mysterious silver light spread from the inside to cover the entire coffin, allowing these coffins to withstand the Rebirth Thunder’s assault without any damage.
It had to be said that these black coffins, empowered by the Seven-star formation, possessed an incredibly formidable defensive power.
After continuously unleashing the Rebirth Thunder from the golden axe, Big Black Horse glanced at the axe and saw it had become somewhat ethereal.
He couldn’t help but feel a pang of heartache.
This was a treasure gifted to me by Master. To save my life, I had no choice but to activate it twice in succession.
Each activation was at maximum power.
The Eternal Realm Coffin Carriers from within the Dragon Temple, seizing the opportunity while Big Black Horse was momentarily dazed, suddenly charged out and attacked him once more.
The old Clan Leader pointed a finger towards the void. A streak of black light flashed, and a pitch-black coffin appeared, instantly sucking the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon into it.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was currently extremely weak and couldn’t resist at all.
Just as Big Black Horse snapped back to his senses and was about to flee, the Eternal Realm Coffin Carriers from the Dragon Temple suddenly swarmed him again.
Most of these Cultivators were in higher realms than Big Black Horse.
Thus, for Big Black Horse to escape was incredibly difficult, almost unimaginable.
"ROAR!"
Big Black Horse roared in fury and, at that moment, finally transformed into his true form.
A black Giant Dragon, tens of thousands of zhang in length, suddenly appeared in the void.
Its massive Dragon Mouth clenched a small golden axe.
Blue lightning erupted from its entire body, accompanied by a continuous series of LOUD CRACKS.
"Another dragon?" an old man in white robes shouted excitedly.
In an instant, they had surrounded this Black Dragon.
At this moment, all the Eternal Realm Coffin Carriers had black coffins floating behind them, seemingly ready to provide immense defensive power at any moment.
It looks like escaping today will be incredibly difficult.
Big Black Horse looked at the dozen or so powerful Eternal Realm Cultivators surrounding him. Each carried a black coffin and wielded a Longsword, and every one of them emanated a terrifying aura. A sliver of despair crept into his heart.
Although I am exceptionally talented and possess the Rebirth Thunder axe given to me by Master, there are simply too many Eternal Realm Cultivators from the Coffin Carrier Clan. Many of them are in higher realms than I am. Moreover, they have those black coffins to defend against my Rebirth Thunder. This leaves me with no options.
Wait, how could I forget about the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye?
Big Black Horse suddenly muttered in annoyance.
My Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye is only at the rudimentary level. Although its power is limited, it might just be enough to make them hesitate for a moment.
With this thought, Big Black Horse’s eyes widened. He circulated Mana to his pupils and immediately activated the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye.
The wind in the void seemed to stagnate for a second. The Coffin Carriers attacking Big Black Horse paused, their minds momentarily dazed.
Big Black Horse swiftly transformed into a streak of black light and tore through the void to escape!
I must hurry back and get reinforcements. I have to tell Master everything that happened here. The bizarre Faceless God Statue, the Black Mirror that weakens Divine Dragons, the black coffins carried by the Coffin Carriers, and the mysterious container that will be born in the Dragon Cave... all of it... I must tell Master. These mysteries are too important. I absolutely cannot die here at the hands of the Coffin Carrier Clan on Moon Star!
「In the Dragon Temple.」
Seeing the Black Giant Dragon attempting to flee, the old Clan Leader’s expression shifted slightly. Without hesitation, he took the Black Mirror down from the god statue.
The very next moment, he appeared in the void.
He held the Black Mirror high, aiming it in the direction Big Black Horse had fled.
A beam of black light abruptly shot out from the mirror. It pierced through the void with unbelievable speed, striking Big Black Horse in an instant.
"Damn it all to hell!" Big Black Horse suddenly felt his body go limp; he could barely even circulate his Mana. He couldn’t help but curse aloud.
A figure flashed, and the old Clan Leader appeared in the void, holding the Black Mirror.
"You insignificant Little Dragon, merely at the fourth layer of the Eternal Realm, think you can run?" the Clan Leader said indifferently.
His expression was cold, the Black Mirror in his hand still emitting black light that completely enveloped Big Black Horse.
Figures flickered continuously as numerous Eternal Realm Coffin Carriers gathered around.
"Clan Leader, where did this dragon come from? We haven’t seen an Eternal Realm Divine Dragon on the Cangnan Continent for many years," an elder in a white robe said with a smile.
"Indeed! I wonder if this Black Dragon is a native. If so, it’s quite a treasure," another elder remarked.
"Let’s Seal it first," the Clan Leader decided immediately after a moment of thought.
Capturing two Eternal Realm Divine Dragons at once was an unimaginably huge gain for them. It was also an important clue. This indicated that Eternal Realm Divine Dragons might still be alive on the Cangnan Continent, perhaps having escaped from some Secret Realm. If they could follow this lead and capture all the Divine Dragons in that Secret Realm, the Dragon Man God would surely reward them generously, bestowing upon them even more high-quality cultivation resources.
"You want to Seal me? Give up that dream!" Hearing the Clan Leader’s words, a cold sneer spread across Big Black Horse’s face.
The golden axe made of Rebirth Thunder, still in his Dragon Mouth, had grown even more ethereal, no longer as solid as before.
After all, being activated twice in rapid succession, the Rebirth Thunder within the golden axe is also running low.
"You’re already a turtle in a jar. What other tricks can you possibly have?" With a cold smile, the Clan Leader slowly raised his hand and pointed gently into the air.
Black light flickered in the sky, and another black coffin appeared.
WHOOSH!
The coffin lid flew off. The pitch-black opening of the coffin, like the suddenly appearing maw of a monstrous beast, spewed forth a chilling beam of black light that descended.

chapters.title: Chapter 365: Purple Rune, Showcasing Divine Might
chapters.content:
Chapter 365: Chapter 365: Purple Rune, Showcasing Divine Might
"Seven-star Formation?!"
As Big Black Horse raised his head, he promptly saw a silver Seven-star Formation shimmering atop the black coffin.
He was instantly shocked.
No wonder these coffins are so powerful; they are reinforced by the Seven-star Formation.
Because Big Black Horse only had half Dragon Blood, under the radiation of the Black Mirror, he hadn’t fully weakened.
He fiercely drew on all his Mana, all of it pouring into the golden axe.
At this moment, the golden axe burst out with dazzling lights. Golden lightning continuously erupted like a world-ending wave, violently rushing towards all directions.
And within this golden light, three small Purple Runes suddenly rose.
These are... the runes Master once laid down!
Upon seeing the three Purple Runes, Big Black Horse was excited and immediately recognized them.
"Coffin, come forth!"
The surrounding Coffin Carriers saw the golden lightning energy surging once more and instantly summoned their black coffins, enclosing themselves inside.
The old Clan Leader held the Black Mirror, which radiated sheets of black light, blocking the golden lightning in front of him.
He squinted, watching the three Purple Runes appear before him, an unexpected feeling of fear descending over him.
What are those? These three tiny Purple Runes, though each is as small as a grain of rice, exude an extraordinarily terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath.
The old Clan Leader muttered to himself and instinctively became more guarded.
Meanwhile, the beam of black light descending from the black coffin that floated over Big Black Horse’s head also came down.
The three tiny Purple Runes suddenly trembled slightly. One of them flew towards the black coffin in mid-air.
The moment the Purple Rune contacted the black light shooting from the coffin, it shattered the light instantly, then sped towards the black coffin.
BOOM!
After an earth-shattering roar, the black coffin was unbelievably pulverized on the spot by this Purple Rune.
Then, the second tiny Purple Rune trembled slightly and took flight again, charging directly towards the old Clan Leader.
"This..." In his haste, the old Clan Leader immediately turned the Black Mirror in his hand towards the Purple Rune. A dense beam of black light instantly fell upon the Purple Rune.
The Purple Rune flashed with a breathtaking purple brilliance, continuously disintegrating the black light.
The black light was dismantled with extreme speed.
The small Purple Rune, carrying an overwhelmingly terrifying force, arrived before the old Clan Leader in an instant.
The old Clan Leader was immediately startled and violently threw the Black Mirror in his hand.
This Black Mirror is a treasure of the Dragon Man God. Right now, I can only use this mirror to resist the Purple Rune’s attack.
At this time, the third Purple Rune also rose into mid-air, trembled slightly, and charged straight for the old Clan Leader.
It seemed to have locked onto the one with the highest cultivation base on the field: the old Clan Leader.
The old Clan Leader’s eyes nearly popped out of his head. He hadn’t expected these three small Purple Runes to be so terrifying.
Without hesitation, he violently threw the Sword in his hand towards the Purple Rune.
The Purple Rune trembled slightly, and the precious Sword was instantly shattered.
Simultaneously, the second tiny Purple Rune collided with the Black Mirror in mid-air.
The black and the purple collided, and then both vanished at the same time.
It seemed they were evenly matched.
The old Clan Leader was furious and heartbroken. But seeing that one Purple Rune shooting towards him again, he quickly shouted, "Coffin, come forth!"
As his words fell, a pitch-black coffin immediately enclosed the old Clan Leader.
At the same time, the Seven-star Formation within the coffin began to operate. Silver light flowed inside, instantly enveloping the old Clan Leader completely.
The Purple Rune collided with this black coffin.
BOOM!
This black coffin was actually sent flying.
The coffin’s planks splintered, but it didn’t disintegrate like the previous black coffin.
As the shattered coffin fell, the Clan Leader flew out from inside, spewing mouthfuls of fresh blood.
His body swayed unsteadily in mid-air.
Despite the black coffin’s protection, he was still gravely injured by the Purple Rune’s impact.
What on earth is this Purple Rune? It actually shattered my natal coffin!
The Clan Leader wiped the blood from his mouth, waved his hand decisively, and roared, "Get him! Don’t let him escape!"
Only then did the dozen or so Eternal Realm Coffin Carriers snap back to their senses.
They were currently inside their black coffins, having just withstood the wave of ferocious golden lightning. Upon hearing the Clan Leader’s command, they immediately steered their black coffins towards the Black Giant Dragon.
At this moment, Big Black Horse witnessed the three Purple Runes left on the golden axe by his Master unleash their divine might, and his heart surged with violent excitement.
The first Purple Rune had shattered a black coffin; the second had taken the strange Black Mirror down with it.
The third had severely injured the Clan Leader, who possessed the highest cultivation base.
It was incredibly satisfying.
However, amidst his excitement, Big Black Horse had also paid a heavy price.
The golden axe, formed by the Rebirth Thunder, had been used beyond its limits three consecutive times, and its lightning energy was completely depleted.
Moreover, because he had been irradiated by that strange black light, his physical strength and Mana were still suppressed. He could only watch helplessly as the dozen or so Eternal Realm Coffin Carriers steered their black coffins to ram into him.
Big Black Horse had no other choice; at this moment, he could only rely on his Dragon Clan physique to endure the hit.
If I can withstand this blow and recover my Mana and physical strength, I might still have a chance to escape. After all, that strange Black Mirror has vanished, and I still have the golden Little Sword. Master also left me this Little Sword. I’ve only refined a fifth of it; a vast amount of its prowess remains untapped.
「Inside the carriage.」
Ye Yun suddenly opened his eyes and looked towards a certain direction in the sky.
He had actually sensed, on the Moon Star, the three Purple Runes he had once left on the golden axe.
These three Purple Runes served two purposes.
First, they stabilized the Rebirth Thunder, preventing it from wreaking havoc or becoming uncontrollable.
Second, they were to ensure Big Black Horse’s safety.
If Big Black Horse encountered a formidable opponent, causing the golden axe to also disintegrate, these three Purple Runes would emerge.
Ye Yun had never imagined that sending the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and Big Black Horse, two Eternal Realm great demons, to investigate the Coffin Carrier Clan’s lair would be so perilous.
Even the golden axe had been destroyed, only then did the three Purple Runes emerge.
Although these three Purple Runes were exceedingly powerful, Ye Yun still felt somewhat uneasy.
It seems... this Coffin Carrier Clan is not to be underestimated.
Ye Yun’s figure flashed.
In an instant, he disappeared from the carriage.
He tore through the void, traversing hundreds of millions of miles, and instantly arrived on the Moon Star.
When Ye Yun saw the dozen or so black coffins, radiating the Super Divine Dragon Breath of the Eternal Realm, hurtling towards the Black Giant Dragon, his sharp eyebrows twitched, and a grim coldness flickered across his face.
He gently waved his hand, and those black coffins instantly lost control and flew backward.
Ye Yun did not deliver a killing blow.
The Coffin Carrier Clan was extremely mysterious and held the key to finding the mastermind. Killing them directly might lead to the loss of important clues.
The next moment, Ye Yun appeared directly beside Big Black Horse from the sky above the Moon Star.
Seeing that familiar white-robed figure suddenly appear before him, Big Black Horse was incredibly moved, and tears instantly streamed down his face.
"Master..."
Big Black Horse sobbed uncontrollably.

chapters.title: Chapter 366: God-level Puppet, Ye Yun’s Test
chapters.content:
Chapter 366: Chapter 366: God-level Puppet, Ye Yun’s Test
"Little Horse, you’ve worked hard!" Ye Yun smiled softly at the weepy Big Black Horse. With a single wave of his hand, the strange power that had invaded Big Black Horse’s body vanished.
Big Black Horse immediately regained his physical strength, and his Mana also began to flow again.
He transformed, reverting to the form of a man in a black robe.
"Master, this place is extremely strange," Big Black Horse said, flying to Ye Yun’s side and bowing.
Ye Yun glanced at Big Black Horse. His pupils contracted slightly, and tiny, rune-like stars in his eyes flickered once. In an instant, he had read a section of memory from Big Black Horse’s mind.
He instantly understood everything that had happened to Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon after they had appeared on Moon Star.
Ye Yun also drew a sharp breath.
He hadn’t expected that the small Coffin Carrier Clan would have so many secrets.
The black coffins that Ye Yun had sent flying with a slap all vanished, revealing the figures of the Coffin Carriers, each dressed in white robes.
At this moment, the seriously wounded old Clan Leader, after taking some elixir pills to stabilize his condition, had already flown into the crowd of his Clan Members.
Looking at the young man in white who had suddenly appeared, the old Clan Leader squinted, observing him constantly.
