This young man in white had deep-set features and fluttering black hair. He was handsome and free-spirited, with an exceptional temperament. He seemed like an Immortal who had walked out of a painting, untouched by the breath of the mortal world.
No matter how he looked, he could not determine the young man’s cultivation base.
The young man in white looked like a mortal, yet he gave the impression of being a Spirit radiating limitless holy light.
"Clan Leader, what is his cultivation stage? Is he a True God already?" an elderly man in white robes asked quietly.
"Not a True God. It’s hard to discern his cultivation base. Perhaps he’s in the Eternal Realm?" the Clan Leader replied, shaking his head. After all, he had once seen the Dragon Man God, a figure even more formidable than those in the True God Realm.
So he was familiar with that kind of Super Divine Dragon Breath.
Based on the Super Divine Dragon Breath of the Dragon Man God, he could estimate the approximate cultivation base of the young man in white before him.
Just as the Coffin Carrier Clan hesitated, Ye Yun suddenly beckoned, and a black coffin flew out from the Dragon Temple.
Sealed inside this black coffin was the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon.
"Kill him! We absolutely cannot let the captive Divine Dragon escape!" the Clan Leader shouted, taking the lead and rushing forward.
A dozen Eternity Realm Cultivators from the Coffin Carrier Clan also surged forward to attack.
Ye Yun’s eyes turned cold. With a wave of his wide sleeve, these people were sent flying.
"You are not my opponents. Stand obediently and don’t move," Ye Yun stated casually.
He extended a finger and tapped the black coffin.
The black coffin trembled slightly and instantly disintegrated into dust, vanishing.
Witnessing this, the old Clan Leader, who was suspended in mid-air, felt his blood run cold.
This young man in white is too strong!
Relying solely on his physical body, he was able to turn the very coffin I spent my essence refining into dust!
What sort of powerful Divine Skill is this?
The other Coffin Carriers also showed expressions of terror; a chill ran down their spines, and their palms grew sweaty.
They had lived for so many years, yet they had never encountered such a powerful figure on the Cangnan Continent.
Is this still the Eternity Realm?
As the black coffin turned to dust, the figure of the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was revealed at its former location.
After the Seal on the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was released, he flipped over and stood up.
"Master, I am truly useless! I have disgraced you! I was actually sealed by these Coffin Carriers!" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon lamented, his head lowered and his face flushed red in dejection.
"This matter is not your fault. The main issue is that the Black Mirror is peculiar; it seems to specifically target the Dragon God Bloodline," Ye Yun said with a smile, patting the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s shoulder.
Upon hearing his Master’s words, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon felt somewhat relieved.
He breathed a sigh of relief, convinced that now that his Master had arrived, there would be no more complications.
BOOM! BOOM!
A tremendous noise suddenly echoed from within the Dragon Temple.
Everyone present turned towards the sound, only to see the divine statue that had been standing erect on the altar step down with great strides.
Although the statue was walking, it retained its peculiar posture.
Its left hand was forming a Hand Seal, while its right hand was held high, holding a Black Mirror.
How did this mirror return?
Big Black Horse was somewhat shocked. He hadn’t expected that the Purple Rune left behind by his Master would fail to shatter this Black Mirror.
Ultimately, the Black Mirror had vanished from mid-air only to reappear in the hand of the god statue.
Upon seeing the god statue suddenly step down from the altar, the surrounding Coffin Carriers grew agitated. "Dragon Man God!" they exclaimed, their faces fervent as they knelt in mid-air, as if seeing a savior.
Just a puppet. Is there really a need for such excitement?
Ye Yun’s eyes twinkled, a faint, cold smile touching his lips.
The statue before him was a puppet, possessed by a strand of remnant consciousness.
This puppet was of an extremely high grade, having reached the Lower God Rank.
With that strand of consciousness and the Black Mirror in its hand, this God-level Puppet could unleash power equivalent to a higher-order True God-stage expert.
The black statue stepped out of the Dragon Temple. Looking at the man in white robes opposite it, it asked in an icy voice, "Who might you be?"
"Just a Nameless Little Pawn," Ye Yun replied with a faint smile. His gaze fell upon the four Little Dragons wrapped around the statue, and a thought suddenly flashed through his mind.
"You must be the Dragon Raiser," Ye Yun inquired.
Hearing Ye Yun’s words, the black statue was visibly taken aback.
It seemed it had never expected that someone on the Cangnan Continent could identify its true identity.
"You are mistaken. I am not a Dragon Raiser, but the Dragon Man God of the Coffin Carrier Clan," the black statue replied, shaking its head and coldly refuting Ye Yun’s conjecture.
Ye Yun merely smiled.
His conjecture wasn’t wrong. The black statue’s momentary lapse just now was proof enough that this entity was indeed a Dragon Raiser.
The Dragon Raisers were a powerful and mysterious force within the Divine Land, as elusive as a dragon showing only its tail but never its head.
Unexpectedly, they weren’t just active in the Divine Land; they had also left a legacy on Moon Star of the Cangnan Continent.
The Coffin Carrier Clan has been continuously depleting the luck and vital energy of the Cangnan Continent’s dragon veins, creating one container after another.
Although he didn’t know what these containers were ultimately used for, Ye Yun suspected that the Dragon Raisers’ purpose was definitely not so simple.
This black statue before him was merely a God-level Puppet possessed by a strand of a Dragon Raiser’s consciousness. Ye Yun could easily defeat it.
However, Ye Yun did not act rashly for now. Nor did he attempt to probe the memories within the puppet’s body. He feared some kind of restriction was hidden within the memories. If he probed recklessly, he might trigger this restriction, causing the consciousness to explode completely, and all his prior efforts would be for naught.
"Regardless of what you call yourself, it doesn’t matter." Ye Yun smiled gently. Looking at the black puppet, he slowly continued, "You’ve passed down a lineage, created the Coffin Carrier Clan on Moon Star, and manufactured one container after another. For what purpose?"
"How do you know about the containers?!" the black statue exclaimed, clearly stunned by Ye Yun’s mention of them.
This was a highly confidential matter!
It had been carried out in extreme secrecy for nearly one hundred thousand years! How could news have leaked out now?
Its gaze tightened as it looked towards the old Clan Leader and the other Coffin Carriers standing nearby.

chapters.title: Chapter 367: Analyzing the Black Light, The Mirror Becomes Invalid
chapters.content:
Chapter 367: Chapter 367: Analyzing the Black Light, The Mirror Becomes Invalid
"Dragon Man God, I didn’t say anything! I don’t know how they found out..."
The Clan Leader knelt on the ground, frantically explaining.
His agitation aggravated his existing injuries, causing him to vomit blood again. He didn’t bother to wipe it off, hanging his head low, looking terrified.
"What a bunch of useless fools! How could such a confidential matter be known by outsiders!"
The Black God Statue snorted coldly, filled with rage.
It seems... I have to kill you all to eliminate any future trouble.
As the Black God Statue looked at Ye Yun and the others, a cruel smirk suddenly appeared on its face.
Even without facial features, it was able to portray visible emotions.
However, this faceless visage felt disturbingly eerie.
"You’re very confident."
Ye Yun smiled faintly, seemingly unconcerned.
The Black God Statue’s gaze landed on the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and Big Black Horse, a hint of fervent desire in its eyes.
Once I kill you, I can get those two little dragons. How wonderful! Hahaha!
As if thinking of something delightful, the Black God Statue burst into laughter.
As its laughter rippled out, layers of black light surged around it, cloaking its entire body and making it impossible to see clearly.
"Dragon Man God, these two Divine Dragons might hail from a secret realm on the Cangnan Continent," the Clan Leader suddenly lifted his head, exclaiming excitedly.
"Native Divine Dragons? Even better. If you can find another secret realm like the one on the Cangnan Continent, it will be a major credit to your Coffin Carrier Clan."
From within the black light, the arrogant voice of the Black God Statue emerged.
It laughed madly, its laughter echoing continuously. At this moment, the entire Moon Star seemed to tremble.
Trying to act all mysterious...
Ye Yun smiled faintly, waiting for the Black God Statue’s performance to officially begin.
"Master, that mirror is truly strange. You must be careful," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said quietly from the side, looking at the dense black light and inexplicably feeling a sense of powerlessness wash over him again.
"Don’t worry. I’ll test this black light from the mirror."
Ye Yun chuckled and stepped forward.
In an instant, he arrived in the void, roughly a hundred feet in front of the Black God Statue.
His body trembled slightly as he released a faint Divine Dragon’s Breath.
This was Divine Dragon’s Breath that Ye Yun had deliberately simulated using his Ancestral Dragon Bloodline.
Facing the mysterious Dragon Man God, he wanted to probe further.
"What? It turns out you’re also a Divine Dragon? Haha, that’s excellent! It seems the Cangnan Continent certainly has a secret realm inhabited by a group of Divine Dragons..."
The Black God Statue let out an excited laugh from amidst the dense black light. Its raised right arm began to rotate, and the Black Mirror in its hand shot a beam of black light toward Ye Yun.
This beam of black light, with a diameter of several dozen meters, looked extremely powerful, its presence eerie and terrifying.
Ye Yun stood still. Although he had gleaned some understanding of the Black Mirror from Big Black Horse’s memories, he still wanted to personally experience this beam of black light.
If this Dragon Man God is indeed a Dragon Raiser, then this Black Mirror might be a treasure specifically designed to restrain the God Dragon Clan.
"Has this fellow been scared silly by the Dragon Man God? He isn’t even dodging," an Eternal Realm Coffin Carrier sneered.
"It’s not that he can’t dodge; he’s unable to! The Dragon Man God’s cultivation base has probably already reached the High Order of the True God Realm. How could a mere Eternal Realm cultivator evade that?" a white-robed elder sneered.
In the hearts of the Coffin Carrier Clan members, the Dragon Man God was like their creator god, holding the highest status and authority.
Hearing the Coffin Carriers’ discussion, Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon exchanged glances, their eyes filled with contempt and mockery.
Could these insignificant ants possibly fathom the extent of Master’s strength?
WHOOSH!
The pillar of black light descended, completely enveloping Ye Yun.
Ye Yun remained unfazed as he experienced the power within this black light.
It was an extremely strange power, one he had never encountered before.
Once this power invaded his body, it would exert tremendous suppression on his Dragon God Bloodline.
Once suppressed, his physical strength and mana could no longer be utilized.
It had to be said that this Black Mirror was indeed a terrifyingly lethal weapon against Divine Dragons.
As expected of a Dragon Raiser. With such a formidable weapon, capturing Divine Dragons would be far too easy...
Ye Yun sneered inwardly.
He possessed the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline. As the Ancestor of Ten Thousand Dragons, how could he be affected by the bizarre power of this Black Mirror?
The Ancestral Dragon Bloodline within Ye Yun’s body stirred slightly.
BOOM!
The power of the black light shattered and instantly disappeared without a trace.
"Do you have any other tricks?"
Ye Yun strolled leisurely through the void, completely ignoring the radiance of the massive pillar of black light.
His white robes, crystalline as snow, were exceptionally conspicuous within the pillar of black light.
Gazing at that imposing, unparalleled, godlike figure, both Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon were momentarily stunned.
Master possesses the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline; the strange light from the mirror has no effect on him at all!
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was overjoyed and almost blurted this out.
However, he managed to stop himself in time.
The Moon Star is so bizarre; there might be ears everywhere. Master’s identity absolutely cannot be revealed.
So, you’re not a Divine Dragon. That wisp of Divine Dragon’s Breath was just to deceive me...
Seeing the light prove ineffective, the Black God Statue sneered.
This Black Mirror was specifically designed to counter Divine Dragons; it had no restraining effect on ordinary Human cultivators.
"Coffin, come!"
The Black God Statue roared. From its palm, where it had been forming Hand Seals, a black light suddenly flew out.
The black light landed in mid-air and immediately transformed into a pitch-black coffin.
This coffin looked exactly like a Covert Dragon Coffin. Its surface was covered with various intricate patterns, and its four sides even bore images of Divine Dragons.
The life-bound black coffins of the Eternal Realm Coffin Carriers seen earlier were vastly different compared to this Covert Dragon Coffin.
"Is this the true Covert Dragon Coffin?" Ye Yun lightly examined the black coffin and chuckled.
"You little whelp, you certainly know a lot!" the Black God Statue said through gritted teeth.
With a point of its hand, the black coffin shot forward, rushing towards Ye Yun.
Ye Yun smiled.
He had merely guessed correctly just now.
It seemed this black Covert Dragon Coffin before him was the genuine article. The Covert Dragon Coffins on the Cangnan Continent were all modeled after this one.
This Covert Dragon Coffin had reached the Lower God Rank.
Such a treasure could probably only be crafted in the Divine Land.
Watching the black coffin descend from the sky, Ye Yun had no intention of revealing the formidable nature of his Ancestral Dragon’s Body.
He fumbled at his wrist for a moment and gently drew out an Octagonal Bright Silver Hammer.
The palm-sized Octagonal Bright Silver Hammer expanded in the wind with a mere shake, immediately growing to three or four feet in size. The octagonal hammerhead was covered with mysterious patterns and flowed with a silver gleam.
"Master, you even have such a treasure?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon exclaimed in shock.
He gazed at the silver Octagonal Bright Silver Hammer from afar. Feeling its astonishing aura, an extremely covetous expression appeared on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 368: The Real Dragon Raiser
chapters.content:
Chapter 368: Chapter 368: The Real Dragon Raiser
"Second, you truly are pathetic." Big Black Horse shook its head as it watched the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon practically drooling at the prospect of a treasure.
"Although our Dragon Clan bodies are strong, we also enjoy various magical artifacts. Moreover, since my reincarnation, I haven’t had a single treasure, unlike you who at least has an axe," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said gloomily.
Despite his powerful Innate Divine Ability, he also had a fondness for magical artifacts. If he had a suitable weapon, he would undoubtedly be exceedingly delighted.
In his previous life, he had once obtained such a weapon: a Lower God Rank Chaos Element Vajra Hammer.
But after dying in battle, his most beloved weapon had vanished.
Now, seeing the Old Master present an Octagonal Bright Silver Hammer brought back those memories.
Big Black Horse had no idea that the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon had such a deep attachment to hammers, which was why it had laughed at him.
"After the Moon Star affair is over, you can ask the Old Master for that Octagonal Bright Silver Hammer," Big Black Horse said with a smile.
"I’d be too embarrassed to ask! After all, such a precious treasure has reached God Level. How could I possibly ask for it?" The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon rubbed his hands together, speaking rather awkwardly.
"Rest assured, if you find it too hard to ask, I’ll speak up for you..." Big Black Horse chuckled mysteriously.
It knew the Old Master’s resources well...
Even though it had never been to the warehouse of magical treasures, it knew that each of the Old Master’s Divine Pets had terrifying origins.
The Old Master had so many pets, he couldn’t even count them all.
And as for magical treasures... how could they be lacking?
However, Big Black Horse always considered itself the Old Master’s trusted Divine Pet and naturally wouldn’t disclose the Old Master’s resources to others.
While they were talking, Ye Yun soared into the air, rushing towards the sky.
He raised the silver Octagonal Bright Silver Hammer, aiming for the black Covert Dragon Coffin that was falling from above.
This guy has a God-level weapon too?
The black divine figure gazed at Ye Yun’s soaring figure, a hint of shock flashing in its eyes.
In its memory, God-level magical artifacts were extremely rare on the Cangnan Continent. Even Eternal Level Sects didn’t necessarily possess a God-level magical artifact. Yet, this youth in white before it was wielding one. His origins... were suspicious.
Could he be from the Divine Land?
The black divine figure pondered for a moment but found it unlikely.
How could a Cultivator from the Divine Land willingly risk stagnating their cultivation base to enter the Cangnan Continent? Wouldn’t that be digging their own grave?
As it was pondering, it saw the white figure and the black coffin collide.
Ye Yun’s face was impassive, his black hair fluttering, his robes rustling in the wind. He swung the Octagonal Bright Silver Hammer, which cut a silver arc through the air, and smashed it heavily onto the black Covert Dragon Coffin.
BOOM!
A deafening explosion instantly rocked the entire Moon Star.
A massive shockwave spread wildly from mid-air in all directions.
Seeing this, the Eternity Realm Coffin Carriers couldn’t help but shiver in fear.
Fortunately, the battle was in mid-air; otherwise, they would not have survived.
They hadn’t expected the youth in white to be this powerful.
Wielding an Octagonal Bright Silver Hammer, he had forcefully knocked the black Covert Dragon Coffin away.
Even though the battle occurred high in the sky, several distant mountain ranges were still flattened.
This demonstrated just how powerful the clash between these two formidable experts was.
Watching the Covert Dragon Coffin fly away, Ye Yun suddenly smiled and swiftly chased after it.
BOOM!
Ye Yun raised his hand again, smashing the Octagonal Bright Silver Hammer fiercely onto the coffin.
Subjected to the violent impact, the black coffin shot skyward once more.
Ye Yun vanished from his original spot.
The next moment, he appeared above the Covert Dragon Coffin, once again raising his Octagonal Bright Silver Hammer and smashing it down.
BOOM!
The Covert Dragon Coffin plummeted downwards.
With Ye Yun’s figure flickering, appearing left then right, the Covert Dragon Coffin was brutally battered under his relentless assault, becoming dented and misshapen—a truly pitiful sight.
Seeing its treasure being hammered into such a pitiful state, the black divine figure grew furious.
It fiercely raised the Black Mirror in its hand, aiming it at the distant Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and Big Black Horse.
A black column of light shot through the air.
When Ye Yun, in mid-air, saw the black divine figure daring to launch a sneak attack on Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, he merely smiled faintly.
With a light tap of his finger, the two instantly vanished.
The Black Mirror’s attack struck nothing.
Gripping the black coffin with one hand, Ye Yun descended from the sky and hurled it fiercely at the divine figure enveloped in black light.
"Take it!"
The black divine figure quickly reached out and grabbed the black coffin.
It glanced at the surface of the Covert Dragon Coffin, which was now dented all over, and then found that the Seven-star formation inside was currently unchanged.
This brought it some relief.
As long as the Seven-star formation remained, the Covert Dragon Coffin could still be used.
Ye Yun stood in mid-air, gently holding the Octagonal Bright Silver Hammer.
Though his expression was calm, he exuded a majestic, awe-inspiring presence, as if he were looking down upon the world, unmatched and supreme.
Ye Yun had not destroyed the Seven-star formation within the black coffin. He planned to study it once he dealt with the black divine figure.
Without this Seven-star formation reinforcing it, this coffin would have been shattered by him long ago.
It could be said that the addition of this Seven-star formation had significantly enhanced the black Covert Dragon Coffin’s capabilities in every aspect.
This is a very good formation.
Ye Yun had encountered various iterations of the Seven-star formation on his journey.
The mastermind’s design of the Seven-star formation truly exceeded his expectations. Though it seemed to consist of only Seven Stars, it actually contained countless densely interwoven runes, forming various arrangements and combinations.
Ye Yun raised an eyebrow, looking at the black divine figure within the black light. "Your Dragon Breeding Clan resides in the Divine Land and dares not set foot on the Dragon Hidden Continent, only appearing in Puppet Bodies. Are you afraid of the Dragon Hidden Continent’s Curse?" he suddenly asked.
"Ridiculous! Why would we be afraid?" the black divine figure immediately sneered.
After sneering, it suddenly realized the slip in its words.
Wasn’t that an indirect admission of being a Dragon Raiser?
"You despicable fellow, trying to trick me into talking?" The black divine figure was enraged. This time, it maneuvered the Covert Dragon Coffin and charged directly at Ye Yun, swinging the black coffin down violently.
So it really is a Dragon Raiser!
Ye Yun silently nodded.
The Dragon Raisers were also involved in the mastermind’s plot to destroy the Cangnan Continent.
Although no direct link to the persecution of the Dragon God Sect had been found yet, Ye Yun believed that the Dragon Raisers were definitely not innocent.
He swung the Octagonal Bright Silver Hammer, smashing it towards the black Covert Dragon Coffin.
BOOM!
An immense force struck, and the Covert Dragon Coffin was knocked from the black divine figure’s grasp once more.
Ye Yun reached out and snatched the black divine figure.
Witnessing the Dragon Man God—the supreme deity of the Coffin Carrier Clan—being subdued by the white-robed youth, all the Coffin Carriers who had been kneeling in mid-air instantly stood up.
"Hurry, save the Dragon Man God!" the Clan Leader roared, leading a group of Eternity Realm Clan Members as they charged towards Ye Yun.

chapters.title: Chapter 369: Body Restraint Divine Power, God Statue Explosion
chapters.content:
Chapter 369: Chapter 369: Body Restraint Divine Power, God Statue Explosion
"Back off!"
Gazing at the approaching group of young Eternal Realm Coffin Carriers, Ye Yun spat out a single word.
The over ten Eternal Realm Coffin Carriers were suddenly swept away by a powerful force.
"You dare to attack the Master? It seems you’re tired of living," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon laughed maliciously.
The Master was already a Spirit of the Divine Monarch Realm; dealing with these insignificant Eternal Realm Cultivators would be as easy as breathing for him.
In the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s heart, Ye Yun’s current cultivation base was roughly at the Seventh Realm of God King.
But in reality, during the time Jun Moxiao had entered the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, Ye Yun had already broken through from the Seventh Realm of God King to the God Monarch Realm tenth layer.
He was about to reach the Peak of the God Monarch Realm.
One more step, and he would reach the Divine Sovereign Realm.
One hundred thousand years had passed since his rebirth.
The reincarnated Ye Yun was advancing through cultivation realms as if he were riding a rocket. Any realm’s threshold meant nothing to him. This was the astounding reward he had received after signing in for one hundred thousand years in the Dark Space, enduring all kinds of loneliness and pain, and going mad countless times.
Ye Yun didn’t kill all these Coffin Carriers; he just casually swatted them away.
But these Coffin Carriers, upon seeing the Dragon Man God captured by Ye Yun, disregarded their injuries and, spitting blood, charged at him once again.
"Freeze!"
Ye Yun pointed his finger, and the over ten Coffin Carriers were frozen mid-air.
What Ye Yun hadn’t expected was that the remaining Coffin Carriers, whose cultivation bases were below the Eternal Realm, also rushed forward, braving death after seeing the Dragon Man God captured.
Ye Yun pointed his hand again.
In an instant, all the Coffin Carriers stood still, their bodies as rigid as puppets.
Such a powerful Body Restraint Divine Power immediately shocked both Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon. It was also the first time they had seen the Master use such a Divine Skill.
It was breathtaking.
"Second Brother, I heard the Master taught you a Pupil Technique Divine Power, right?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon suddenly transmitted via telepathy.
Big Black Horse nodded.
"Then I’ll take this opportunity to learn a Body Restraint Divine Power from the Master."
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon chuckled, rubbing his hands together. He was extremely interested in the Body Restraint Divine Power that the Master had used for the first time.
"Didn’t the Master promise you the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye?" Big Black Horse asked, glancing sideways at the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon.
He remembered that the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon had been very eager to learn the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye. Back then, the Master had said he would only teach it to him after he had performed a meritorious deed. Who would have thought this fellow would change his mind immediately after seeing the Body Restraint Divine Power? Big Black Horse felt rather helpless; the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s temperament was truly fickle.
"This Divine Power is more useful! Once the opponent is frozen in mid-air, won’t they be captured without a chance to fight back?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said smugly.
"Alright, suit yourself!" Big Black Horse chuckled.
All the Coffin Carriers in the entire valley had been immobilized. This Divine Skill of Ye Yun’s immediately shocked the black idol.
"Who... exactly are you?" the black idol struggled fiercely, but to no avail. It looked at Ye Yun with terror-filled eyes and asked.
"I’m just a Nameless Little Pawn from Divine Land. I wanted to see what exactly your Dragon Breeding Clan is plotting on the Cangnan Continent," Ye Yun said casually.
"So you’re from Divine Land too. But I must say, you are foolish. Don’t you realize this place is cursed? Once you enter the Cangnan Continent, your cultivation realm will be stuck here for your entire life," the black idol sneered.
"It doesn’t matter. This is just one of my avatars," Ye Yun laughed.
He didn’t speak a single word of truth. Regardless of whether this wisp of consciousness could be sensed by the Dragon Raiser’s true body, he wouldn’t reveal any information.
"You oppose our Dragon Breeding Clan; sooner or later, you’ll die without a burial ground! Even if it’s your true body, we’ll dig you out, even if we have to search three feet under the earth!" the black idol threatened.
"Then let’s see if you can find me."
Ye Yun’s palm suddenly exerted force, and the immense power instantly made the black idol feel a searing pain.
The black idol’s expression turned hideous, and it spoke resentfully, "Don’t bother trying to trick information out of me. This strand of my will was long severed from my true body and can be destroyed at any time."
"Really?"
Ye Yun’s pupils contracted slightly. In his mesmerizing eyes, tiny, star-like runes emerged. The power of creation and destruction swept out, landing on the wisp of consciousness within the black idol.
PSH!
As Ye Yun delved deeper into this wisp of consciousness, attempting to extract its memories, it immediately exploded.
The black idol, now devoid of consciousness, instantly lost its surrounding black light, and its arm fell limply.
Upon seeing this wisp of consciousness destroyed, Ye Yun’s face remained calm, showing no sign of disturbance.
This wasn’t the first time he had encountered such a situation.
However, the biggest gain this time was learning that the Dragon Raisers had an inseparable connection with the mastermind behind the scenes.
In the future, when he arrived at Divine Land, he could use the Dragon Raisers as a starting point for his investigation.
"Come here."
Ye Yun made a grasping motion with his large hand, instantly snatching the elderly Clan Leader of the Coffin Carrier Clan.
Seeing the young, white-robed man before him easily kill the Dragon Man God, the Clan Leader’s heart filled with despair, and he wished he could perish along with this person.
"If you reveal all the secrets about the vessels, I can spare your entire clan," Ye Yun looked at the Clan Leader and said in a leisurely manner.
"I don’t know," the Clan Leader answered succinctly.
"You swore an oath before the statue of the Dragon Man God. But now that this Dragon Man God is dead, it doesn’t matter if you speak. I can protect you," Ye Yun said calmly.
"You don’t have to waste your efforts, Your Excellency. Our Coffin Carrier Clan has been well taken care of by the Dragon Man God for these hundred thousand years. We will absolutely not betray him!" The Clan Leader’s gaze was resolute, showing a willingness to face death.
The Clan Leader also knew that the real Dragon Man God was still in Divine Land and had not died, so he would not reveal the truth.
A thought struck Ye Yun, and he suddenly reached out, grabbing a middle-aged, white-robed man from the Eternal Realm.
"Don’t use my clan members to threaten me!" the Clan Leader immediately warned, sensing Ye Yun’s intention. "Our Coffin Carrier Clan dedicated our lives to the Dragon Man God long ago."
Ye Yun smiled faintly and began to search the memories of the white-robed middle-aged man.
There were no restrictions placed on the middle-aged man’s memories, but Ye Yun still didn’t obtain any useful information.
The only thing he could ascertain was that over nearly one hundred thousand years, the Coffin Carrier Clan had cultivated at least a thousand vessels on the vast Cangnan Continent.
"Are you afraid of death?" Ye Yun suddenly shifted his gaze and asked the white-robed middle-aged man.
"What does death matter? From the moment we of the Coffin Carrier Clan are born, our entire lives are given to the Dragon Man God," the white-robed middle-aged man said with a fearless and resolute expression.
"Just a bunch of foolishly loyal subjects." Ye Yun gave a faint smile and, at that moment, activated the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye.
He read the memories of all the Coffin Carriers.
The only one whose memories he did not read was the current Clan Leader of the Coffin Carrier Clan.
...
「---」

chapters.title: Chapter 370: Ending the Sins of the Coffin Carrier Clan
chapters.content:
Chapter 370: Chapter 370: Ending the Sins of the Coffin Carrier Clan
Ye Yun’s guess was correct.
After reading the memories of all the Coffin Carriers except for the Clan Leader, Ye Yun found that none of their memories had been tampered with.
The Clan Leader knew all the secrets. His memories, like those of the Black Figurine, must have been tampered with.
A restriction must have been placed on them.
If Ye Yun were to use any method to probe those memories, the restriction would immediately annihilate the Clan Leader.
After acquiring all the Coffin Carriers’ memories, Ye Yun had initially planned to kill them one by one to force the Clan Leader to reveal the secrets.
However, by reading their memories, he learned that these Coffin Carriers were already fanatically devoted to the Dragon Man God to their very core; they would rather die than compromise.
In that case, since they all wish to die...
Ye Yun decided to grant them their wish.
"I once gave you a chance, but you didn’t cherish it. Now, that chance is gone."
Ye Yun looked at the white-robed, middle-aged man before him and smiled faintly.
The next moment, the middle-aged man instantly turned into a wisp of green smoke and vanished.
Witnessing such a bizarre Divine Skill, the Clan Leader was terrified.
He wasn’t worried about being killed by the white-robed youth before him.
Instead, he was worried that this unfathomably profound white-robed youth would, in the future, cause trouble for the Dragon Man God in the Divine Land.
Although the Dragon Man God was very strong, for some reason, the Clan Leader felt that the white-robed youth before him...
...seemed even more terrifying.
His various Divine Skills were inconceivable.
The Dragon Man God’s puppet, already at the High Order of the True God Realm, had still been no match for this person.
This person had defeated that God-level Puppet with such ease.
This means...
...the white-robed youth’s cultivation base might have also reached the Divine Monarch Realm.
Ye Yun looked at the Clan Leader, his expression stern, and slowly declared, "The Coffin Carrier Clan has plundered fortune on the Cangnan Continent for 100,000 years, committing innumerable crimes. Today, in the name of the Ancestor Dragon, I shall wipe out the Coffin Carrier Clan from the Cangnan Continent!"
As his voice fell, the entire world seemed to sense it, and a bolt of lightning instantly descended from the starry sky.
BOOM!
This bolt of lightning struck the Moon Star with astonishing force, causing the entire Moon Star to tremble.
Hearing the white-robed youth’s words, the Clan Leader knew he would not survive the day, so he closed his eyes.
Ye Yun’s face was cold. Star-like, minuscule runes appeared in his demonic eyes, and the immense Power of Life and Death instantly descended upon the entire valley.
At this moment, all the Coffin Carriers dissipated into smoke, their sinful lives coming to an end.
BANG! BANG!
One by one, black coffins fell to the ground, among them the Black Figurine’s Covert Dragon Coffin and the Black Mirror.
Ye Yun’s gaze swept over them, and he noticed that all the coffins contained a Seven-star formation. With a wave of his hand, he collected all these coffins and the Black Mirror.
These coffins were the Coffin Carriers’ life-bound magical artifacts, each containing a Seven-star formation. Ye Yun planned to gather them for careful study later.
"It had to be the Boss! He dealt with the Coffin Carrier Clan so easily."
Big Black Horse sighed, a look of admiration flashing in his eyes as he flew to Ye Yun’s side.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon also followed closely behind.
"Boss, what’s the name of that Divine Skill you used to immobilize the Coffin Carriers just now?"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon asked, rubbing his hands together with a grin.
Ye Yun glanced at him, seemingly having seen through his thoughts, and asked with a smile, "It’s just the Stasis Technique. Do you want to learn it?"
"I really want to learn it! Please, Boss, grant me this!"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon scratched his head, saying somewhat sheepishly.
"Still say you’re too embarrassed to ask? I think you’re plenty bold enough!"
Big Black Horse chuckled from the side.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon gave an embarrassed laugh, his face flushing at Big Black Horse’s remark.
Ye Yun raised his hand, and a beam of light shot into the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s mind.
"This Stasis Technique can immobilize bodies externally and freeze souls internally. Cultivated to its peak, it can halt the movement of heaven, earth, the sun, and the moon. It can stop the flow of time and the cycle of life and death. Anything that moves, the Stasis Technique can immobilize..."
Ye Yun’s voice echoed faintly.
Neither the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon nor Big Black Horse had expected the Stasis Technique to be so incredibly powerful.
"Thank you, Boss, for bestowing this Divine Skill upon me!"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was so excited he immediately knelt at Ye Yun’s feet.
"Get up. Cultivating this Divine Skill to its peak is extremely difficult. A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step. You must slowly and diligently work on your cultivation in the future."
Ye Yun encouraged with a smile.
"I understand, Boss! Rest assured, I will not disappoint your expectations!"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon smiled, stood up, and said.
"Little Horse, you’ve also worked hard this time. Do you want to learn this Divine Skill?"
Ye Yun asked him with a smile.
Big Black Horse scratched his head and said awkwardly, "Boss, I’ve only just gotten the hang of the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye. If I learn the Stasis Technique now, won’t I be biting off more than I can chew?"
"What you said makes sense. How about this: when you want to learn it in the future, just come and find me."
Ye Yun chuckled and nodded.
After saying this, he began to look around, surveying the depths of the valley.
He scanned the area but found no useful clues.
As for the "containers" mentioned by the Coffin Carriers, he didn’t find a single one.
According to Ye Yun’s speculation, these containers had probably been taken away by the Dragon Raiser long ago.
After all, all the cultivation methods of the Coffin Carrier Clan were taught by the Dragon Raiser. The ultimate purpose of the Coffin Carrier Clan carrying coffins to be buried in Dragon Caves was to cultivate a "container."
All of this was secretly orchestrated by the Dragon Raiser from behind the scenes.
A "container"... what exactly is it meant to contain?
Ye Yun chuckled softly. He pondered for a moment but couldn’t figure it out.
He decided not to dwell on it any longer. After looking around once more, he slowly walked forward.
The Moon Star, in Ancient Times, was the Daoist sanctum where the Xuan Yin Moon Dragons lived.
It was also a place where the Ancestor Dragon had once sealed treasures.
The Ancestor Dragon had once designated this area as a forbidden zone. Even the top ten Super Divine Dragons could not casually descend upon the Moon Star without the Ancestor Dragon’s command.
Ye Yun planned to search the Moon Star again to see if he could find the place where the Ancestor Dragon had sealed the treasures back then, and to check if there were any clues at that location.
Seeing their Boss walk straight ahead, Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon quickly followed.
"Boss, the Moon Star today is so desolate. It’s far from being as beautiful and prosperous as it was in the Ancient Era."
Following behind Ye Yun and looking at the desolate hills and desert, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was suddenly struck by a feeling and sighed, saying.
"Indeed..."
Ye Yun also sighed softly.
He had once plundered the memories of the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and also read the memories of the Xuan Yin Moon Dragons.
Although the memories of these two Divine Dragons were incomplete, he could still piece together an image of a beautiful and bountiful Moon Star.
In Ancient Times, hundreds of thousands of Xuan Yin Moon Dragons lived and dwelled on the Moon Star.
They had transformed this place into a beautiful homeland.
However, because the Ancestor Dragon issued an edict turning this place into a forbidden zone, most people looking up from the ground only ever saw the Moon Star as merely a luminous celestial body.

chapters.title: Chapter 371: Wandering Soul, Dragon Shadow Bug
chapters.content:
Chapter 371: Chapter 371: Wandering Soul, Dragon Shadow Bug
The Moon Star was immense, barren, and boundlessly vast.
A chilling wind arose, relentlessly blowing from all directions.
Ye Yun, with Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, halted above an abyss.
"Do you have any impression of this place?" Ye Yun glanced at the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, smiling as he asked.
"Master, although I have never been to the Moon Star, this abyss is so unique it must be the Moon Star’s sole core forbidden zone. Lord Ancestor Dragon once decreed that, aside from the Xuan Yin Moon Dragons, no other Dragon Clan members may approach—not even Super Divine Dragons."
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s eyes flickered as he stared at the dark abyss in the distance, speaking in a low voice.
In the eyes of the ordinary Dragon Clan, the Moon Star was a forbidden place. He himself had only ever caught a distant glimpse of it. Many legends circulated within the Dragon Clan concerning the Moon Star. Some believed it to be the place where the Ancestor Dragon practiced seclusion and cultivation. Others opined that the Ancestor Dragon had crafted the Wushang treasure here. Still others said that the Ancestor Dragon had once captured an Unparallelled Fierce Beast from the Divine Land. In short, there were various theories, all of which shrouded the Moon Star in a mysterious veil.
Ye Yun was naturally aware of the tales the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon knew. After all, he had once read the memories in the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s mind. This time, his visit to the Moon Star was also to see the place where the Ancestor Dragon had sealed the treasure.
This abyss before us must be the sealing ground.
As Big Black Horse gazed into the abyss, he suddenly spoke, "Master, it seems there are some wandering souls active down there."
"Correct. This is precisely our destination for this trip." Ye Yun nodded.
"Master, are you looking for something here?" Big Black Horse asked curiously.
"This is where the Ancestor Dragon once sealed a treasure. Let’s go down and see if we can find any clues." Ye Yun smiled faintly, his body abruptly drifting down from the mountaintop.
Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon quickly followed.
As the three of them descended, they discovered the abyss was filled with enormous dragon bones. Each dragon skeleton was like a small hill. The dragon bones were piled atop one another, looking like white Bone Mountains in the dim light of the night.
"Master, why are there so many dragon bones in this abyss?" Big Black Horse exclaimed in surprise.
"These are the remains of the Xuan Yin Moon Dragons. They once guarded the Moon Star under the orders of the Ancestor Dragon. But later, when the Spirits from the Divine Land invaded the Moon Star, these Xuan Yin Moon Dragons all died in battle. After their deaths, those Spirits tossed their bodies into this abyss. Now, after millions of years have passed, only these white dragon bones are left."
Ye Yun sighed softly, his expression somewhat sorrowful. The piles of white bones before them, stacked together, emitted a faint white glow in the cold wind, seemingly narrating the tragic and inhuman war fought long ago on the Moon Star between the Spirits and the Dragon Clan.
In that war of invasion, all the Xuan Yin Moon Dragons on the Moon Star perished. The great formation sealed by the Ancestor Dragon in the depths of this abyss was forcibly broken, and those ferocious Spirits plundered the treasures within. It had been a bloody massacre.
Hearing Ye Yun’s account, Big Black Horse was suddenly filled with solemn respect. He cupped his fists and bowed deeply towards the white bones.
"Seniors, I pay my respects!" Big Black Horse said softly.
Gazing at the bones of his kinsmen, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon also felt a wave of sorrow. Mimicking Big Black Horse, he too bent down and bowed.
An indescribable sorrow also touched Ye Yun’s heart, but he did not show it, continuing to drift deeper into the abyss.
White dragon bones carpeted the entire abyss, growing more numerous the deeper they went. At this point, they could see wandering souls shuttling continuously among the white bones, like kites with snapped strings. These souls mostly appeared in human form. But Ye Yun knew these were formed from the condensed remnant souls of the deceased Xuan Yin Moon Dragons.
When alive, the Xuan Yin Moon Dragons who guarded the Moon Star had also appeared in human form. The Dragon Clan’s bodies were too massive; generally, they only revealed their true forms during battle. For everyday activities, they appeared in human form. This was true from the Ancestor Dragon down to the Ten Super Divine Dragons. The Ancestor Dragon once convened a Myriad Dragon Convention, where every Divine Dragon attended in human form, including the Ancestor Dragon himself.
These wandering souls drifted everywhere among the dragon bones and in the abyss. There were males and females, old and young, each with a greyish-white face and a semi-transparent body, emanating a cold, yin energy. Their bodies were stiff, flying back and forth with vacant stares. Occasionally, they would greet each other, looking just like a troop of zombies.
"These wandering souls are so strong! Quite a few are actually at the Eternal Realm!" The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon squinted at the fluttering souls, exclaiming in shock.
"These souls, in their original bodies, likely had high cultivation bases when alive. After death, their remnant souls absorbed the Xuan Yin earth-vein energy of the Moon Star and bizarrely continued to exist. They had a high starting point, and after millions of years of unconscious, automatic cultivation, even the weakest of these souls now possesses a cultivation base at the Life and Death Realm." Ye Yun observed for a moment before stating his conclusion calmly.
"Master, if these souls were to get out, I’m afraid they would cause turmoil throughout the entire continent," Big Black Horse muttered. Seeing that these souls were all Eternal Realm experts, he too felt an indescribable, eerie sensation.
"They won’t get out," Ye Yun said with a light laugh.
"Why not? Is it because the Coffin Carrier did something?" Big Black Horse looked around, scanning the vicinity as if searching for clues.
"Not exactly." Ye Yun’s gaze flickered towards the distance, a smile playing on his lips. "Perhaps you’ll know in a little while."
Big Black Horse said, "Oh," and then fell silent.
The three of them continued forward. The souls seemed not to have noticed the three of them, continuing to wander about.
SQUEAK!
A strange cry rang out. A massive black shadow suddenly burst from a pile of white bones and lunged rapidly towards the trio.
Ye Yun looked up and flicked his finger lightly. The massive black shadow was instantly frozen in mid-air.
"What is this?" Big Black Horse stared, eyes wide. He found that this huge figure had a bizarre appearance, making it difficult to identify what kind of creature it was.
"This should be a Dragon Shadow Bug." The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon carefully examined the strangely shaped black shadow and recognized it at a glance.
"Correct. This is indeed a Dragon Shadow Bug. After a Divine Dragon dies, its corpse, when affected by external influences, has a chance to form a Dragon Shadow Bug," Ye Yun sighed. "This type of Dragon Shadow Bug is actually similar to the Corpse Worms that appear after a human dies."
There were not many Dragon Shadow Bugs in this abyss, only a little over a hundred in total, each with a cultivation base reaching the Eternal Realm. Although these Dragon Shadow Bugs were individually very powerful, surpassing even the Coffin Carrier in strength, due to the lingering obsession in the hearts of the Xuan Yin Moon Dragons, these Dragon Shadow Bugs born from their corpses also steadfastly guarded this abyss, just like those wandering souls.
Thinking of this, Ye Yun sighed again.
The Xuan Yin Moon Dragon Clan, loyal and true to the very end. They were indeed the Dragon Clan most devoted to the Ancestor Dragon.

chapters.title: Chapter 372: The Ruins Change, The Illusion of the Ancestor Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 372: Chapter 372: The Ruins Change, The Illusion of the Ancestor Dragon
THWACK!
With a slight flick of his hand, Ye Yun sent the Dragon Shadow Bug soaring into the distance.
He set up a restriction in front of him, isolating his Super Divine Dragon Breath, and immediately, no more Dragon Shadow Bugs rushed towards them.
The three of them continued their descent.
Now, they saw more and more wandering souls perpetually drifting in the Abyss.
When the three of them landed at the very bottom of the Abyss, Ye Yun noticed a damaged hall, beyond which lay a dismantled Formation.
Even though several million years had passed, the traces of the Formation still lingered.
The hall had long been reduced to a desolate ruin, but its scale could still be vaguely discerned.
In front of the hall was a desolate square, with not even a single wandering soul in sight.
Although the wandering souls in the distance roamed everywhere, not a single one approached the square, let alone dared to enter the ruined hall.
"This should be the place where the Ancestor Dragon sealed the treasure," Ye Yun said softly after careful observation.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon sighed, "Master, too much time has passed. There are no valuable clues to be found."
"Yes," Ye Yun nodded silently.
Indeed, there were no significant leads, but upon seeing such a desolate place, he could not help but feel a strange emotion welling up inside him.
Perhaps it has something to do with the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline within my body.
Anyway, since the wandering souls wouldn’t come in here, Ye Yun removed the restriction and walked slowly through the ruins.
From time to time, he would pick up a shattered piece of red stone and carefully examine it in his hand.
"Hmm?"
Ye Yun’s expression suddenly shifted slightly.
He sensed an exceedingly faint, bizarre energy from a fragment of red stone. It would have been very difficult to notice without his impressive ocular abilities.
He had never encountered such energy before. It was a strange, red energy.
However, it was so scarce that it was merely a few minuscule particles existing within the red rubble.
Any regular Cultivator would undoubtedly overlook it.
With a thought, Ye Yun immediately drew these tiny red particles out from the shattered stone.
These red particles floated before his eyes, so minute they were almost undetectable unless scrutinized closely.
"Master, what are these things?" Big Black Horse trotted over, curiously staring at these red particles. Even with his realm, he could not discern anything unusual about them.
"Can you tell what they are?" Ye Yun turned to the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and asked with a smile.
"Master, I have no idea. Aren’t they just dust from the red stone?" The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon scratched his head and responded awkwardly.
"No," Ye Yun smiled faintly but did not elaborate further.
It appeared that neither of them could detect the bizarre energy contained within these red particles.
This indicated that this energy was of an exceedingly high grade. Any Cultivator with an insufficient cultivation base was likely to mistake them for mere stone dust.
This discovery suddenly piqued Ye Yun’s interest.
His gaze remained fixed on the red particles as he attempted to deconstruct them, but he struggled to make any headway for the moment.
Just then, for reasons unknown, the wandering souls in the Abyss began flocking from every direction, quickly flying towards the square amidst the ruins.
The number of wandering souls grew rapidly.
Eventually, over a thousand wandering souls gathered, circling the outskirts of the square, yet still not daring to step onto it.
At this moment, however, these wandering souls seemed agitated, murmuring indistinct and incomprehensible words.
"What’s gotten into these wandering souls?" uttered the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, completely taken aback.
After sweeping his gaze over the wandering souls, he found that seven to eight hundred of them possessed an Eternal Realm cultivation base. Such a vast number startled him.
"Could it be because of Master..." guessed Big Black Horse.
Hearing their conversation, Ye Yun looked up and chuckled.
He stopped observing the red particles before him and turned his gaze towards the agitated wandering souls outside the square.
At that moment, a faint light suddenly emerged from all around the bottom of the Abyss.
Within this faint light, scenes began to materialize.
Where the ruins once lay, a Seven-color Palace appeared, straddling the line between illusion and reality.
The Seven-color Palace was magnificent, like countless rays of rosy light, grand and brilliant.
The once-decrepit square was now enveloped in layers of vivid phantom images, seemingly restoring it to the Ancient Times.
On the illusory square now stood many Xuan Yin Moon Dragon Clan Members, each clad in golden armor and holding weapons, as if guarding the Seven-color Palace.
"Is it a mirage? Or a memory lingering from the Ancient Times?" Ye Yun exclaimed in surprise.
He looked again at the wandering souls around the square and noticed their fanatical expressions, their minds pulsing with intense energy fluctuations.
It seemed these energy fluctuations were causing the changes in this place.
For a moment, Ye Yun couldn’t quite grasp what was happening.
He decided to observe quietly and see what unfolded.
HUM...
The image wavered, and the Seven-color Palace, originally radiating multicolored light, suddenly dimmed.
The Palace trembled slightly, as if something within was about to emerge.
The Xuan Yin Moon Dragon Clan Members guarding the palace watched the drastically changing Palace, their expressions altering dramatically.
The next moment, a narrow crack suddenly appeared on the palace door where the Seal was affixed, and a red light, like a venomous snake, slowly oozed out from within.
As soon as this red light emerged, it rapidly dispersed, engulfing all the Xuan Yin Moon Dragon Clan Members on the square.
The Clan Members, one after another, showed expressions of horror and roared loudly.
Following this, a layer of fine red hair bizarrely sprouted from their bodies. The red hair was unsettling, emitting a faint, eerie red glow.
These individuals all collapsed to the ground, rolling around in utter madness. The red light, like a serpent, constantly leaped outward, as if intending to attack more Xuan Yin Moon Dragon Clan Members.
Just as the situation reached a critical juncture, a beam of black light descended from the sky, and a middle-aged man dressed in a black robe materialized above the square.
"Retreat."
With a wave of his large hand and a soft command, the red light immediately receded like a tide back into the Palace.
Seeing this regal middle-aged man and the imposing, unique aura he exuded, Ye Yun was greatly shocked.
This... Isn’t this the Ancestor Dragon?
The wandering souls outside the square, upon seeing the middle-aged man in black, all knelt, prostrating themselves, overcome with awe yet remaining silent.
At this moment, Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon were also trembling uncontrollably.
The middle-aged man in black before them, even as a mere illusion, exerted an unimaginable pressure on them.
The Ancestor Dragon landed on the square and began to touch each of the Xuan Yin Moon Dragon Clan Members. With each touch, a strange red light would emerge from his hand, which he then cast back into the Palace.
After he did this several times, those Xuan Yin Moon Dragon Clan Members guarding the palace returned to normal.
"We greet Lord Ancestor Dragon!"
Dozens of Xuan Yin Moon Dragon Clan Members, upon seeing the man in black, became agitated and knelt in the square.

chapters.title: Chapter 373 The Sealed is a Broken Sword
chapters.content:
Chapter 373: Chapter 373 The Sealed is a Broken Sword
"This broken sword... it’s becoming more and more restless."
Lord Ancestor Dragon stood with his hands behind his back, gazing at the Colorful Palace, his eyes tinged with a touch of worry.
A serpent-like red light emerged from the cracks in the palace. Spotting Lord Ancestor Dragon still standing guard, it quickly retreated.
Lord Ancestor Dragon sighed.
He continuously formed seals with his hands, emitting beams of light that infused the small cracks in the palace, firmly sealing them.
After resealing the palace, Lord Ancestor Dragon vanished in a blink.
The phantom projection started to fade and eventually disappeared entirely.
The once-prostrate wandering souls listlessly rose and resumed their aimless drifting.
Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon let out long sighs of relief, feeling their bodies finally relax.
"So this is what Lord Ancestor Dragon looks like!"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon sighed, his eyes revealing a mix of surprise and desolation.
Although he had lived in ancient times, he was just an insignificant hybrid dragon who had never seen the legendary Lord Ancestor Dragon. Unexpectedly, millions of years later, he had the chance to see Lord Ancestor Dragon’s phantom projection on Moon Star.
Big Black Horse, however, did not have as many complex thoughts as the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon. After all, he was not a demon beast from this world. The Ancestor Dragon’s aura was simply too overpowering, leaving him deeply intimidated.
"So, the treasure sealed within this Colorful Palace is a broken sword..." Ye Yun murmured to himself, looking towards the ruins.
That a broken sword could emit such bizarre power is somewhat unbelievable. It seems this sword’s level possibly exceeds this world’s limits.
Items of this level also exist in my storage,
Ye Yun mused.
However, they’re too high-level, and I can’t bring them out.
I wonder where Ancestor Dragon found this broken sword,
he thought.
But this broken sword, even while sealed, could still pierce through its confinement to reveal that terrifying red energy. That shows how terrifying this broken sword truly is.
Ye Yun’s gaze flickered as he surveyed the entire ruins. Suddenly, he reached out and gathered some of the red energy particles, collecting them before putting them away.
This trip to Moon Star and dealing with the Coffin Carriers had been a minor affair. The true gain was discovering the nature of the treasure sealed by Lord Ancestor Dragon; that was crucial.
In the future, when I arrive at the Divine Land, I’ll have a clear target.
Ye Yun speculated that the phantom scene had appeared due to the lingering obsession within the hearts of the wandering souls, formerly Xuan Yin Moon Dragons.
My presence may have stirred something within them, causing them to gather. Their heightened emotions and agitated minds might have collectively produced a mirage-like Divine Skill, replaying the scene of Ancestor Dragon descending upon Moon Star to seal the Colorful Palace.
"Let’s go."
Looking around, Ye Yun hesitated momentarily before deciding to leave this place first.
These wandering souls were upholding the obsession of the Xuan Yin Moon Dragons by guarding the palace’s perimeter.
Let them continue,
Ye Yun thought.
Perhaps for these souls, guarding this place for Lord Ancestor Dragon is an immense honor. I don’t want to disrupt it for now.
Ye Yun tore through the void, bringing Big Black Horse and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon back to the Heavenly Moon Dynasty, landing them back on the carriage.
A thought suddenly occurred to Ye Yun, and he turned to Big Black Horse with a smile. "You’ve lost your weapon, Little Horse."
"Yes, sir," Big Black Horse said, scratching his head, visibly dejected. The golden axe given to him by his master had saved his life on Moon Star, but now this beloved treasure was gone.
"Wait."
Ye Yun took three strands of Rebirth Thunder from his storage, condensed them into an axe, and added four Purple Runes to it.
"This axe is three times denser than the previous one, and I’ve added an extra rune. It should be sufficient for a while." Ye Yun smiled lightly and tossed the golden axe to Big Black Horse.
"Thank you, sir!" Big Black Horse immediately knelt, cradling the golden axe with both hands, his voice filled with surprise and joy.
"Rise." Ye Yun smiled, and with a sweep of mana, he lifted Big Black Horse.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s eyes twinkled. Seizing the opportunity, he quickly said, "Sir, that Octagonal Bright Silver Hammer of yours is truly impressive. Could you perhaps give me one?"
"No problem." Ye Yun smiled lightly. He stretched out his hand, and a silver Octagonal Bright Silver Hammer appeared, which he tossed to the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon.
"This is fantastic! It’s a pity there’s only one; having dual hammers would be even better," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said, lovingly caressing the Octagonal Bright Silver Hammer and clicking his tongue in admiration.
"Indeed, there is a pair. You guessed right." Ye Yun laughed heartily and pulled out another Octagonal Bright Silver Hammer, tossing it to the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon.
"There’s another one?" The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was so excited he almost burst into tears, immediately catching the second Octagonal Bright Silver Hammer.
Wielding the two large hammers, he swung them twice, feeling ecstatic.
"Kitty, look at me flaunting these hammers! Am I impressive?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon asked, looking at Kitty and grinning.
"Senior, you’re indeed very impressive!" Kitty quickly flattered him.
She simply thought that this senior’s style, wielding his hammers... was quite amusing. But she couldn’t tell the truth.
"HAHA!" The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon laughed loudly twice, then started fondling the two Octagonal Bright Silver Hammers again with great affection.
"You two are really lucky! Going out on a mission and getting treasures from the Master in return," Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon said, raising his head and yawning, his tone sour.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon glanced at him and laughed. "Blame your own high cultivation base!"
Those words left Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon speechless.
When did having a high cultivation base become a fault?
He was quite frustrated and prepared to go back to sleep.
"Little Blue Cat..." Ye Yun said, looking at the adorable blue kitten at his feet and suddenly smiling.
"Master, do you have a mission for me?" Hearing his master’s call, Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon immediately raised his head and asked in high spirits.
"I’ll assign you a task next time. If you perform well, I’ll gift you a set of armor." Ye Yun, stroking his chin, looked at Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon and smiled. "I know you fancy that Asura Armor."
"Thank you, Master!" Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon immediately agreed, as energized as if he’d had a shot of adrenaline.
Ye Yun burst into loud laughter.
Big Black Horse put away his golden hatchet, transformed again, and resumed pulling the carriage.
"Master, where are we going?" Big Black Horse asked, turning his head.
"Let’s go to the Dragon Cave..." After Ye Yun spoke, he lifted the carriage curtain and went inside.
Big Black Cat was still in the Covert Dragon Coffin, with only a trace of life remaining. Ye Yun still hadn’t fully investigated the Seven-star formation on its chest. Now that he had annihilated the Coffin Carrier Clan, it was a good time to go to the Dragon Cave to explore.
I also want to know how this vessel was made,
Ye Yun thought.
Seeing Big Black Horse transform, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon immediately turned into a small red cat and lay on the carriage. However, he still held the two huge Octagonal Bright Silver Hammers and began to refine them incessantly.
「Somewhere in the Heavenly Moon Dynasty’s mountain range.」
A black carriage suddenly appeared from the void and landed.
Ye Yun stepped out of the carriage and stood above the Dragon Cave. With a light tap of his hand, the seal on the Dragon Cave instantly broke.
Ye Yun’s figure flashed, and he appeared next to the five black Covert Dragon Coffins.
These five Covert Dragon Coffins floated erratically in the golden light.
Upon closer inspection, streams of Dragon Qi could be seen continuously converging into each Covert Dragon Coffin.
Ye Yun pointed once again, shooting out four rays of light that landed on the other four Covert Dragon Coffins. The reinforced seals on them were instantly broken by him.
With the seals gone, Ye Yun could see the situation inside the other four Covert Dragon Coffins at a single glance.

chapters.title: Chapter 374: Speed of Modifying the Seven-Star Formation
chapters.content:
Chapter 374: Chapter 374: Speed of Modifying the Seven-Star Formation
Each black Covert Dragon Coffin quietly held a person inside.
The first coffin held an elderly man in a golden robe. He lay flat, with his hands crossed over his lower abdomen. His eyes were closed tight, a serene expression on his face with a hint of faint hope.
It seemed as if he was yearning to live a second life.
A silver Seven-star formation was attached to his chest, composed of seven silver star points. Dragon Qi followed the formation, seeping into the elderly man’s body.
Ye Yun narrowed his eyes and then extended a Divine Sense to explore inside the body.
The life force within the elderly man in the golden robe felt like a large river, flowing freely, not at all like a dead person.
The remaining three coffins each housed an individual: a middle-aged man in a green robe, an elderly man in gray, and a white-haired youngster.
The life force each of them held varied significantly.
The white-haired youth’s life force was the strongest, followed by that of the elderly man in gray, while the man in the green robe’s was the weakest.
The elderly man in the golden robe’s life force... was slightly weaker than that of the man in the green robe.
Ye Yun seemed to understand.
The four Covert Dragon Coffins absorbed differing amounts of Dragon Qi due to the sequence in which they were buried. This resulted in tiered changes to the life force within them.
Ye Yun then turned his attention to the formations on their chests.
The seven points, akin to twinkling stars, formed an image of the Big Dipper, creating a mysterious formation.
The formation was identical on each person, with no variation, aside from their differing life forces.
The humans in the four Covert Dragon Coffins had undergone some changes due to years of being saturated with Dragon Qi.
Their bodily tissues, soaked in Dragon Qi from the Dragon Veins for years, had taken on a golden hue. Their physical strength had also seen a significant increase.
Ye Yun muttered to himself thoughtfully, "So, the so-called vessel seems to be based on a powerful physical body..."
Cangnan Continent was the ancestral land of the Dragon Clan, and the Dragon Qi from the Dragon Caves here was entirely different from that found on other continents.
The Dragon Qi here was the real Dragon Qi.
Under the control of the Seven-star formation, a Human Cultivator’s body, after years of being soaked, washed, and modified by Dragon Qi, began to transform towards the strength of a Divine Dragon Body.
While there was still a profound distance from a genuine Divine Dragon Body, it had already surpassed the physical bodies of ordinary Human Cultivators and even some ancient Divine Beasts.
This discovery left Ye Yun lost in thought. He needed to conduct further verification.
Ye Yun looked away.
He resumed his research on the Seven-star formation on Big Black Cat.
If he could unravel the mysteries of one formation, the rest would also unravel.
「Three days later.」
A smile spread across Ye Yun’s face. He had finally understood more than ninety percent of this Seven-star formation.
As for the remaining ten percent, it concerned the fact that the five Seven-star formations could actually interact with each other in a certain way. Joining together as one, they formed a new Seven-star formation. Only then could Ye Yun further research the remaining ten percent.
I can now modify the speed at which Little Black Cat’s Seven-star formation absorbs Dragon Qi...
Ye Yun’s eyes flickered, and he made several points in the air with his finger.
At this moment, numerous inscriptions within the seven silver star points on Big Black Cat’s chest began a magical rearrangement and combination.
The change happened quickly and was completed in the span of a few breaths.
The seven star points radiated a silver light, engulfing Big Black Cat’s entire body.
The Dragon Qi within the Dragon Cave rushed madly into this Covert Dragon Coffin, entering Big Black Cat’s body through the seven star points.
Suddenly, the life force within Big Black Cat started to change rapidly. Simultaneously, Big Black Cat’s physical body also began to undergo the washing and tempering of Dragon Qi.
Fortunately, its body, having consumed a significant amount of Eternal Life Immortal Grass in the Nine Soul Underground Palace, was extremely robust.
Under the control of the Seven-star formation, a vast amount of Dragon Qi poured in, continuously scrubbing and tempering every inch of its body’s tissues, with no abnormalities appearing for the time being.
Ye Yun observed this process intently.
As soon as he detected that the intensity of the Dragon Qi exceeded the limit Big Black Cat’s body could tolerate, he would change the operating speed of the Seven-star formation to make it slower.
「An incense stick’s worth of time passed.」
"Not bad!" Ye Yun discovered that Big Black Cat’s body could withstand the current speed, so he nodded in satisfaction.
Ye Yun tapped twice on the Seven-star formation on its chest. He continued adjusting the speed of the Seven-star formation, then began to carefully observe it.
This process was repeated several times. Eventually, he stopped adjusting the Seven-star formation, as it had already reached the limit Big Black Cat’s body could endure.
If he continued adjusting, Big Black Cat’s body would collapse.
Ye Yun looked at the other Covert Dragon Coffins. After making some comparisons, he found that the Seven-star formation he had modified could absorb and control Dragon Qi at a speed thousands of times greater than that of the Seven-star formations on the other people.
That a member of the Demon Clan, after devouring so many Eternal Life Immortal Grasses, can achieve such a rate is truly remarkable,
Ye Yun thought with a gentle smile.
Since each person had been buried at different times, the growth of their flesh and the strength of their bodies differed. If they were to keep pace with Big Black Cat, they needed corresponding adjustments.
Ye Yun made virtual points in the air, slightly adjusting the other four Seven-star formations.
The Seven-star formation on the white-haired youth was adjusted the least, as he was the first to be buried in the Dragon Cave.
The Seven-star formation on the middle-aged man in the green robe was adjusted the most.
After all this was done, Ye Yun carefully compared the speeds of the Seven-star formations again, then nodded in great satisfaction.
If nothing went wrong, in ten days, everyone’s vitality would be restored to normal, and the evolution of their bodies would come to fruition. In such a perfect state, each person’s Seven-star formation would echo the others and create a new change.
Ye Yun flashed out, leaving the Dragon Cave and returning to the carriage.
Then, with a light touch of his hand, he sealed the Dragon Cave with an invisible restriction, preventing the golden light from escaping.
"Master, why were you gone for so long?" the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon asked Ye Yun with a smile.
"It took some time to break that Seven-star formation," Ye Yun replied with a smile.
Looking at Big Black Horse, he suddenly said, "Little Horse, we’ll wait here for ten days."
"Alright, Master." Big Black Horse nodded, then pulled the carriage down from mid-air onto a mountaintop.
With a flash, Ye Yun returned to the carriage compartment.
Mu Qing was boiling water for tea.
After Ye Yun drank a cup of tea, he began cultivating again.
He had ten days. Within this time, he should be able to break through to the Peak of the God Monarch Realm.
Not only Ye Yun was cultivating; the other demon beasts were also practicing quietly.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon had already refined the two Octagonal Bright Silver Hammers and was now studying the Stasis Technique-based Divine Skills.
"Sigh, on this continent, the spiritual energy doesn’t even contain Divine Nature. Cultivation is useless for me."
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon yawned, cradled its head in its fluffy paws, and fell into a deep sleep again.
「On Moon Star.」
In the valley of the Coffin Carrier Clan, the only building that hadn’t collapsed was the lone Dragon Temple.
Above the altar, the void suddenly fluctuated, and a small vortex appeared without warning.

chapters.title: Chapter 375: Puppet of the Divine Monarch Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 375: Chapter 375: Puppet of the Divine Monarch Realm
A streak of black light descended from the small vortex, transforming into a black puppet.
This black puppet was faceless and looked identical to the previous black statue.
However, its cultivation base was exceptionally strong; it had already reached the First Level of the Divine Monarch Realm.
It could be said that it was countless times more powerful than the original True God Realm statue.
The black puppet glanced around, its voice cold as it spoke, "Indeed, there has been a change. Puppet Number One has disappeared, and all the Coffin Carriers have vanished as well. There are signs of a struggle here."
"Who on earth could possess such formidable strength?"
"This is definitely not a power that a cultivator from the Cangnan Continent could possess..."
The black puppet mumbled to itself. The experts at the Eternal Realm on the Cangnan Continent amounted to only a small handful, and not a single one was at the True God Realm. How could they possibly contend with Puppet Number One?
"How interesting. Someone actually dares to oppose our Dragon Breeding Clan. I’d like to see just who this audacious entity is," the black puppet muttered, then its form flickered and vanished from within the Dragon Temple.
「The next moment.」
He appeared above a vast abyss.
After sweeping his gaze into the abyss and finding no changes, the black puppet breathed a sigh of relief.
"The extermination of the Coffin Carrier Clan seems to have nothing to do with these wandering souls of the Xuan Yin Moon Dragons or the Dragon Shadow Bugs," the black puppet muttered to itself.
He departed from Moon Star and stood amidst the cosmos, his immense Divine Sense sweeping downwards.
"Eh?"
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, which was sleeping, suddenly sensed a powerful Divine Sense sweep over it. After all, its cultivation base was also at the Divine Monarch Realm.
"Master, a Divine Monarch Realm cultivator is descending from the night sky! Could they be from the Divine Land?" the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon asked softly, looking towards the carriage.
"Indeed," Ye Yun replied. He looked up towards the void, and in an instant, he saw the black puppet. A faint smile touched his lips.
Another black statue, a God-level Puppet. However, this puppet’s cultivation is extremely high, already at the First Level of the Divine Monarch Realm.
"You go and meet him," Ye Yun ordered the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon.
"Yes, Master!" The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon was overjoyed. The Master had finally given him a task. Upon completing this task, he could obtain a suit of God-level Armor.
A flash of blue light streaked by.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon transformed into human form and instantly departed from the carriage.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and Big Black Horse both remained silent. The newcomer was at the Divine Monarch Realm; their own cultivation bases were too low, so it was best for them to say nothing.
Ye Yun gazed at the black puppet in the depths of the night sky. After a moment, his gaze settled on the Black Mirror in the puppet’s hand.
It seems every black puppet holds a Black Mirror. I’d like to see if this Black Mirror can affect the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, who is also at the Divine Monarch Realm. Although their cultivation levels are equal, a puppet is still just a puppet. In a real battle, how could it possibly be a match for a member of the Dragon Clan?
...
"What is that?"
The black puppet, currently scanning the entire Cangnan Continent, was startled to see a blue light suddenly appear before him. This blue light had arrived with unexpected and unimaginable speed. As the blue light faded, a youth in a blue robe materialized in front of him.
"Oh? A puppet?" The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon surveyed the black puppet before him, astonishment evident in his eyes. This black puppet had actually reached the First Level of the Divine Monarch Realm!
Good heavens, how many resources would it take to create a God-level Puppet? It’s simply unimaginable. Based on his long experience living in the Divine Land, he had never heard of a puppet at the Divine Monarch Realm.
"Your Excellency dares not descend in your true form, sending only a Puppet Body. Could it be that you are from the Divine Land?" the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon spoke coldly.
The black puppet was taken aback, clearly not expecting the blue-robed youth before him to discern its origins with a single glance.
HISS!
Upon sensing the opponent’s Super Divine Dragon Breath, the black puppet drew a sharp, cold breath. This blue-robed youth had also reached the Divine Monarch Realm. His cultivation base was the same as the puppet’s own, both at the First Level of the Divine Monarch Realm. However, he then felt a familiar Demonic Aura emanating from the blue-robed youth, and his expression shifted abruptly.
"A Divine Dragon of the Divine Monarch Realm! How is this possible? How can a Divine Dragon of the Divine Monarch Realm appear on the Cangnan Continent?" the black puppet exclaimed in shock.
Suddenly, he slapped his forehead in realization. "I get it! You must also be from the Divine Land!"
Seeing the black puppet’s swift reaction, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon frowned and chuckled coldly. "So what if I’m from the Divine Land? Now that you’re here, don’t even think about leaving."
"HA HA HA... A mere Little Dragon from the Divine Land! You are nothing more than a masterpiece of us Dragon Raisers. Do you actually intend to turn against us?" The black puppet laughed boisterously, raising the small Black Mirror in his hand and shaking it gently. "To deal with a Little Dragon like you, I don’t even need the Dragon Catching Mirror! HA HA HA!"
"You’re a Dragon Raiser?" Upon hearing the black puppet’s words, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon was also shocked.
He naturally knew his own origins. He was an ancestor of the Fu Family of Skyreach Island, hatched from a Dragon Egg purchased at great cost from a Dragon Raiser. Only after generations of nurturing by the Fu Family on Skyreach Island had he grown to reach the First Level of the Divine Monarch Realm.
Inside the carriage.
Ye Yun watched this scene, a slight arch to his eyebrow.
The Dragon Raiser’s God-level Puppet is brazenly confident. It seems they are extremely sure of the Dragon Eggs they sell. Could it be that they had long prepared some hidden measures?
