Just as Ye Yun was contemplating this, he suddenly heard the black puppet begin to chant a low, strange, and obscure incantation.
Ye Yun felt nothing upon hearing the incantation.
However, when the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, opposite the black puppet, heard it, he immediately began to sway. He clutched his head, his face contorting in agony, clearly in extreme pain.
"What is this incantation? Why can it control me?" The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, pressing his hands to his head, gritted his teeth and gathered all his strength to charge towards the black puppet.
He had not forgotten his Master’s instructions. Although he had been caught off guard by the black puppet’s incantation, he had to fight back with all his might.
As he surged towards the black puppet, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s form flickered, and he transformed into a colossal blue Dragon Body. It extended its claw, swiping viciously at the black puppet.
"Still trying to attack your ancestors?" the black puppet sneered, quickening his chant.
「In mid-air.」
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon felt its body suddenly lose control; its extended claw no longer obeyed its commands.
"’Hmm, let me capture you for now. When I return, I’ll check your designation number and see which part of the process went wrong...’" the black puppet muttered to himself. He then took out a small black bottle, aimed its opening at the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, preparing to absorb him.
Suddenly, the void rippled.
A figure in white stepped out from within.
「In an instant.」
The black puppet felt a soul-crushing pressure, like a great mountain, wash over him.

chapters.title: Chapter 376: Dragon Battle Armor, Superior God Level
chapters.content:
Chapter 376: Chapter 376: Dragon Battle Armor, Superior God Level
When Ye Yun appeared, he lightly waved his hand, immediately dispelling the curse energy acting within the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s body.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon gasped and immediately recovered from a state of extreme pain, returning to normal.
"Master, I failed to complete the task you assigned me."
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon said dejectedly, his head bowed, whispering softly.
"It doesn’t matter. I didn’t expect the Dragon Raiser to still have methods to restrain you."
Ye Yun chuckled, his expression gentle, showing no intention of blaming the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon.
"Sigh..." The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon sighed in frustration, keeping his head bowed, and dared not speak further.
The black puppet stared at the suddenly appearing youth in white. After sensing the youth’s aura, he was greatly surprised.
Another cultivator at the Divine Monarch Realm?
Moreover, this cultivator’s realm was indistinct; he couldn’t detect it clearly.
He could only vaguely sense that the youth’s cultivation base was at the Divine Monarch Realm.
"Could the grand scheme on the Moon Star be your doing?"
As a flash of insight struck him, the black puppet asked Ye Yun coldly,
This person’s cultivation is so high; his strength is sufficient to annihilate the Coffin Carrier Clan and their Number One Puppet.
"What Moon Star? What are you talking about?"
Ye Yun shrugged, feigning ignorance.
Uncertain whether the black puppet’s consciousness was connected to the Dragon Raiser’s main body, Ye Yun definitely wouldn’t reveal any information about himself.
In fact, when Ye Yun appeared, he had already changed his appearance and made his body simulate a faint demon beast aura.
"Hmph! There’s no need to pretend. Besides you two Demon Clan members at the Divine Monarch Realm, who else would possess such immense power to kill a True God Realm puppet and a group of Human cultivators in the Eternal Realm?"
The black puppet shook his head, letting out a cold sneer.
After he had spoken, he suddenly touched his face, and a black vertical eye abruptly appeared there.
He glared at Ye Yun with it.
Seeing this fellow had quite a few tricks up his sleeve, Ye Yun couldn’t help but give a slight smile, though he otherwise remained impassive.
But to Ye Yun’s surprise, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon behind him suddenly shrieked tragically and plummeted from mid-air.
Ye Yun turned to look and found that the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon was completely devoid of life.
What kind of Divine Skill is this?
Ye Yun was slightly alarmed.
He’d never imagined the Dragon Raiser possessed such advanced methods of control over the Dragon Eggs he sold.
A single Divine Skill was enough to make an Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon of the same cultivation level perish instantly.
This method was truly formidable.
Ye Yun steadied the falling Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, then seized the black puppet with a swift motion of his hand.
A vast power instantly and completely suppressed the black puppet, rendering his body and mana immobile.
"How can you be so strong? Your cultivation base must be at least at the fifth layer of the Divine Monarch Realm, if not higher, right?"
The black puppet looked at Ye Yun in shock, his eyes filled with immense fear.
When did such a heaven-defying, fearless great demon of the Demon Clan appear in the Divine Land?
So powerful, yet he came to a place like the Cangnan Continent?
Isn’t he afraid of jeopardizing his cultivation path by being Cursed?
The black puppet couldn’t understand.
"Seal!"
Ye Yun softly uttered a single word. A Purple Rune floated from his eyes, landing gently on the black puppet’s body before immediately vanishing.
The next moment, the black puppet felt utterly weak and collapsed limply.
Ye Yun had sealed this puppet.
He knew that methods for reading memories would likely be ineffective on this puppet.
It was better to seal it for now.
It might prove useful later.
After sealing the black puppet, Ye Yun put it away.
Then he came to the side of the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, whom he had immobilized in mid-air.
Ye Yun carefully examined it.
He discovered that the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s life force had been completely destroyed.
It seemed the Dragon Raiser had long ago planted some kind of Divine Skill within the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s body.
Ye Yun took out the Eight Treasures Liuli Bottle, poured out a drop of Three Lights Divine Water, and with a flick of his finger, sent it into the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s mouth.
After ingesting the Three Lights Divine Water, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon slowly regained consciousness.
"Master, thank you for saving my life."
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon transformed into his human form and knelt at Ye Yun’s feet.
When the black puppet had opened that black vertical eye, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon had suddenly felt an indescribable sense of death descend upon him instantaneously.
Then he lost all consciousness.
Even his Primordial Spirit had perished along with his physical body.
"It seems that all the Dragon Eggs and young Divine Dragons sold by the Dragon Raiser in the Divine Land have long had countermeasures placed within them. The moment a betrayal occurs, the Dragon Raisers can immediately launch a fatal strike to take their lives."
Ye Yun remarked softly.
As he said this, he gazed towards the Divine Land, a cold light flickering unceasingly in his eyes.
The Dragon Raisers... once he stepped into the Divine Land, he would annihilate them sooner or later.
"Master, I wonder... after dying once, is the restriction the Dragon Raiser placed within my body still present?"
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon eagerly asked.
"I’m not sure. Once we get back, I’ll examine your body thoroughly when I have time."
Ye Yun furrowed his brows and said gravely.
Although he had given him a quick scan earlier and noticed nothing amiss, Ye Yun still felt a little uneasy.
To be able to place such a countermeasure on a Dragon Clan member of the Divine Monarch Realm, it must involve an extremely sophisticated Divine Skill.
Ye Yun would need to conduct a detailed investigation to find any traces.
Fortunately, however, this kind of Divine Skill could be neutralized with Three Lights Divine Water.
So, Ye Yun wasn’t afraid of the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon dying at all.
He had plenty of Three Lights Divine Water in his storage. Resurrecting the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon only required a single drop each time.
So theoretically, even if hundreds of millions of Divine Dragons in this world were suddenly killed by the Dragon Raisers using their countermeasures, Ye Yun had the ability to resurrect them all in an instant.
"Little Dragon, your cultivation base is still a bit weak. This became evident when you encountered that God-level Puppet."
Ye Yun looked at the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon kneeling at his feet and sighed lightly.
Thankfully, he, an invincible ancestor, was here. Otherwise, no one would be a match for formidable enemies like the mastermind behind the scenes and the Dragon Raisers.
"Master, I have let you down."
Overwhelmed with sorrow, tears streamed down the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s face.
He had hoped to complete this mission flawlessly and earn a God-level armor reward from the Master.
But unexpectedly, the moment he clashed with that black God-level Puppet, he had been instantly killed.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon felt frustrated and wronged, tears streaming uncontrollably.
"Take this Dragon Battle Armor. It’s slightly stronger than the Asura Armor."
Ye Yun retrieved a suit of blue armor from his storage and said with a smile.
What?
Dragon Battle Armor?
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon snapped his head up. Staring at the suit of God-level armor radiating a blue glow, he felt as if his eyes would be blinded by its brilliance.
This was a Superior-grade God-level armor!
The most striking feature was its blue, dragon-shaped helmet. It exuded an awe-inspiring killing intent and radiated endless draconic might, creating an indescribable sense of pressure even for him.
"Thank you, Master!"
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon extended his hands and shakily received the Dragon Battle Armor.

chapters.title: Chapter 377: Breakthrough to the Peak of the God Monarch Realm Tenth Layer
chapters.content:
Chapter 377: Chapter 377: Breakthrough to the Peak of the God Monarch Realm Tenth Layer
"First, perform an initial refinement and store the Dragon Battle Armor within your body."
Looking at the ecstatic Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, Ye Yun was unconcerned, merely offering a faint smile.
This Superior God-level Dragon Battle Armor also hailed from another world.
Once the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon refined and wore the Dragon Battle Armor, his combat strength would soar, rivaling the ninth or even tenth layer of the Divine Monarch Realm.
"Alright, Master!"
The ecstatic Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon immediately began to refine the Dragon Battle Armor.
In the time it takes for an incense stick to burn, he completed the initial refinement. Then, with a mere thought, he retracted the Dragon Battle Armor into his body.
He kowtowed deeply to Ye Yun three times before respectfully standing up.
Even though this mission was a failure, the Master had not only pulled him back from the brink of death but also bestowed upon him a Superior God-level Dragon Battle Armor.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s eyes reddened, and he felt incredibly fortunate to be by his Master’s side.
Ye Yun tore open the void, bringing the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon back to the carriage.
He returned to the carriage cabin to continue his cultivation, while the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon transformed into a little blue cat, lying on the carriage and refining the Dragon Battle Armor within his body.
"Little Dragon, how did your mission go? Why did the Master have to intervene in the end?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon sidled closer, asking in a low voice with a very gossipy look.
"A puppet of a Dragon Raiser appeared. He possessed a divine ability that countered me. I effectively died then; it was the Master who revived me," the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon said, opening his eyes with a sigh.
"How thrilling! I almost lost you," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said in surprise, patting the little blue cat with his furry paw.
To think that a dignified Dragon Clan member at the first layer of the Divine Monarch Realm could be killed so easily! It just shows how formidable these Dragon Raisers are.
The Big Black Horse also shivered.
Recalling the eerie light emanating from the Black Mirror in the hands of the black divine statue, he swore he never wanted to encounter it again, not even in his next life.
That black light was simply too effective at suppressing the Dragon Clan.
It was truly a deadly weapon!
"Little Dragon, since your mission was a failure, I’m afraid the armor you’ve been dreaming of has probably slipped through your fingers," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said with a sigh, a thought having occurred to him.
"Senior, although my mission failed, the Master still bestowed a Dragon Battle Armor upon me in the end," the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon said excitedly.
"What did you say? The Master gave you a Dragon Battle Armor? What’s it like? Quickly, take it out and show me!" The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s interest was immediately piqued, and he urged him repeatedly.
"Yeah! What kind of armor is it? I also want to feast my eyes on it!" The Big Black Horse turned his head, a fervent glow in his eyes.
Armor given by the Master... how could it be ordinary? It must at least be God-level.
"Well, we’re not strangers here. I’ll put it on for you to see," the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, also eager to show off, said. With a shake of his body, he transformed back into the blue-robed young man.
Suddenly, a blue light flashed across his form, and the awe-inspiring Dragon Battle Armor appeared on him.
The azure dragon head, with horns pointing skyward, exuded endless majesty, as if an ancient Divine Dragon had suddenly been resurrected from this armor.
The rest of the armor was inlaid with various Mysterious Runes that emitted a blue light, making it difficult to look at directly.
"Little Dragon, wearing this armor, your cultivation base has surged, hasn’t it? You seem even stronger than before!" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon exclaimed, his eyes wide with shock, nearly popping out of their sockets.
Wearing such an imposing suit of blue armor actually boosted his cultivation base so significantly.
It was beyond his imagination.
"I’ve only refined it preliminarily. Right now, I can only reach the second layer of the Divine Monarch Realm," the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon said proudly.
He could naturally feel that wearing the Dragon Battle Armor in his human form made him incredibly imposing and magnificent.
Thinking of this armor’s unparalleled defensive and offensive power, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s heart burned with excitement.
He eagerly wished for the Dragon Raisers of the Divine Land to send another black God-level Puppet so he could engage it in a grand battle and test the Dragon Battle Armor’s might.
"Senior, you look so amazing in this armor!" Mao Bao’er’s eyes lit up, and she gazed, smitten, at the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s figure adorned in the blue armor, feeling that this Dragon Senior was incredibly heroic and handsome.
"Haha, Mao Bao’er, you have such a sweet way with words," the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon laughed heartily, immensely pleased by her compliments.
"Ah, Little Dragon, this is truly a blessing in disguise for you! It’s enough to make anyone green with envy!" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said, his tone tinged with jealousy.
"Indeed! This set of Dragon Battle Armor is so dazzling it’s practically blinding this old horse’s eyes!" The Big Black Horse also grumbled, unable to hide his jealousy.
Sitting in the carriage, Mu Qing observed the scene outside with her Divine Sense and was greatly astonished.
She couldn’t determine the armor’s grade but could sense its immense power and extraordinary nature.
"The Master’s foundation is truly profound..." the Xuan bird murmured to himself on top of the carriage, his expression somewhat dismayed.
Although he had known the Master for one hundred thousand years, it seemed he hadn’t had a chance to prove his worth recently.
As a result, he was empty-handed, having received no rewards from the Master.
Ye Yun opened his eyes, taking in everyone’s expressions and thoughts. With a faint, knowing smile, he remarked, "God-level armor is most potent when worn by those at or above the True God Realm. For cultivators in the Eternal Realm, Emperor-level Armor is sufficient."
"Master, does this mean I can take on the next mission?" Hearing Ye Yun speak suddenly, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon shot up excitedly and declared loudly.
Looking at the exhilarated Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and the other expectant demon beasts, Ye Yun smiled.
He said calmly, "Who undertakes each mission is not fixed. As long as you all cultivate diligently and give your all when on a mission, you will naturally receive corresponding rewards."
"Understood, Master!"
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was so excited he paced back and forth on the carriage.
The Master had spoken, implying that he too would have a chance to obtain armor in the future. Although he was only in the Eternal Realm, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon felt that receiving even Emperor-level Armor would be more than enough to satisfy him.
The Big Black Horse and the Xuan bird were also thrilled by the Master’s words.
Even Mu Qing, inside the carriage, found her imagination stirring.
The only one who remained calm was Mao Bao’er. She considered her cultivation base to be low and was already content with the Rainbow Colored-Nimbus the Master had bestowed upon her.
Taking in everyone’s reactions, Ye Yun waved his hand and laughed. "Alright, everyone back to your own business. This matter is now closed."
"Understood, Master!"
The few demon beasts outside responded in unison and immediately quieted down.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon transformed back into an adorable little blue cat, lounging on the carriage and continuing to refine his Dragon Battle Armor.
Ye Yun also resumed his cultivation.
In the following days, no further disturbances occurred. The Dragon Raisers also sent no more puppets into the Cangnan Continent.
「On the tenth day.」
Ye Yun’s body trembled slightly.
At that moment, he broke through from the tenth layer of the Divine Monarch Realm to the Peak of the Divine Monarch Realm.
He was now just half a step away from the Divine Sovereign Realm.
Although Ye Yun controlled his Super Divine Dragon Breath, not letting it leak out, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon still seemed to sense something.
"Master, surely you haven’t... cultivated to the Peak of the Divine Monarch Realm?" the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon transmitted his voice in astonishment.
"I just broke through to the Peak of the Divine Monarch Realm. After a while, I’ll go to the Divine Land. Once I find a suitable place, I can break through to the Divine Sovereign Realm!" Ye Yun replied with a smile via voice transmission.
What? Did I hear that right?
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon was utterly astounded.
Back on Skyreach Island, the Master had personally told him that he, Ye Yun, was at the seventh layer of the Divine Monarch Realm.
Not even two months had passed since then.
The Master had actually progressed from the seventh layer of the Divine Monarch Realm all the way to the Peak of the Divine Monarch Realm!
In all his years in the Divine Land, he had never heard of such a terrifying cultivation speed.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 378: Numerous Revivals, Seven Stars’ Changes
chapters.content:
Chapter 378: Chapter 378: Numerous Revivals, Seven Stars’ Changes
The Divine Land is vast and boundless, birthing many prodigies.
However, even the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon had never heard of anyone breaking through from the seventh level to the peak of the tenth level of the Divine Monarch Realm in just two short months.
The path of cultivation gets harder the further one advances.
For a prodigy of the Supreme Heaven, advancing one realm in a year is already quite a rare feat.
Looking at Master’s momentum, it seems that there are no obstacles for him to break through from the peak of the tenth level of the Divine Monarch Realm to the Divine Sovereign Realm.
The Divine Sovereign Realm is a challenging one to break through.
Though the Divine Land is filled with many cultivators, those in the Divine Sovereign Realm are scarce and pitifully few.
Being able to cultivate to the Divine Sovereign Realm is enough to dominate in one’s own right.
Seeing the shock on the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s face, Ye Yun just laughed it off, unbothered.
Cultivation, to him, meant nothing.
Possessing countless treasures from the Ten Thousand Realms, the meaning of Ye Yun’s life was certainly not for cultivation.
With a flash of his figure, Ye Yun tore through space and arrived inside the Dragon Cave in the next moment.
Ten days had passed, and the five Covert Dragon Coffins were about to undergo a new transformation.
Ye Yun’s gaze swept over the five Covert Dragon Coffins one by one. The five people in the coffins were full of vitality. Their bodies were nearly tempered to perfection, each one incomparably robust.
Next, the Seven-star formation on each person’s chest would undergo new changes.
Ye Yun waited quietly.
Sure enough, the Seven-star formation on Big Black Cat’s chest was the first to radiate light, flowing into his body.
Big Black Cat instantly regained consciousness and opened his eyes.
I... What happened to me?
Big Black Cat looked at the dark coffin lid, his face etched with confusion.
He only remembered seven beams of light entering his body before he lost consciousness.
Big Black Cat quickly checked his body.
How has my physical body become so strong? There’s no sign of injury at all. What exactly happened?
Big Black Cat was utterly shocked.
Finally unable to contain his inner excitement, he abruptly pushed open the coffin lid above him and sat up.
Big Black Cat immediately spotted a familiar white-robed figure standing opposite the Covert Dragon Coffin.
Master?
Big Black Cat blinked, thinking he was dreaming, and rubbed his eyes several times.
"Come out," Ye Yun said with a smile, looking at the bewildered Big Black Cat.
"It really is Master!"
Big Black Cat leaped out and landed beside Ye Yun.
"Greetings, Master!" Big Black Cat hurriedly knelt on the ground and kowtowed deeply.
He realized something extraordinary must have happened to his body for Master to have intervened and saved him.
Thus, he was overcome with gratitude, his eyes even reddening slightly.
"Get up."
Ye Yun smiled faintly and turned his gaze towards the other four Covert Dragon Coffins.
Big Black Cat stood up, only then noticing four identical Covert Dragon Coffins arranged next to his own.
What’s this?
Big Black Cat was instantly shocked.
So, I wasn’t the only one buried in the Dragon Cave?
"The situation is roughly like this..."
Ye Yun briefly explained what had happened on Moon Star to Big Black Cat. Then he instructed, "The small Seven-star formation on your chest will undergo some kind of change later. Don’t resist it; just go along with its will."
"Yes, Master!"
Big Black Cat nodded quickly, then lifted his clothes to look. Sure enough, there were seven silver points of light on his chest.
Big Black Cat thought for a moment, then suddenly asked again, "Master, I haven’t been turned into some kind of vessel, have I?"
"With me here, you definitely won’t die. If those four die and you survive, then yes, you would be the vessel," Ye Yun said with a laugh.
He guessed Big Black Cat would be terrified after hearing this.
As expected, Big Black Cat shivered involuntarily.
What is this vessel for, exactly? Why does it feel so dreadful?
His eyes darting around, Big Black Cat asked with a tremor in his voice.
"It’s unclear at the moment. We’ll find out more once we reach the Divine Land."
Ye Yun’s gaze returned to Big Black Cat. He patted him on the shoulder and said, "Being a vessel isn’t necessarily bad. At least your physical body is much stronger than before. As for the Seven-star formation on your chest, I’ll remove it for you later, so it won’t affect you."
"I understand, Master!" Big Black Cat calmed down and responded gratefully.
Ye Yun nodded.
Suddenly, a coffin lid flew open, and a young man in white emerged from it.
I’m alive?
The young man in white assessed his physical state and abruptly burst into laughter, a mix of tears and joy, unable to conceal his elation and excitement.
Who knows how many years this fellow was buried? He actually came back to life,
Big Black Cat thought, rolling his eyes at the white-robed young man and muttering to himself.
Ye Yun’s figure was concealed in the void, hands clasped behind his back, quietly observing everything.
"Who are you?" the white-robed young man suddenly exclaimed, spotting Big Black Cat in the distance, his voice filled with shock.
"I’m the one from..." Big Black Cat casually pointed to one of the black Covert Dragon Coffins.
"How can this be? Isn’t it said that a Dragon Cave can only entomb one Covert Dragon Coffin?" The white-robed young man was aghast, his expression turning exceedingly grim.
Just then, the lids of the other three Covert Dragon Coffins flew open, and three figures emerged: a middle-aged man, and two elderly men—one in grey robes, the other in a golden robe.
The three surveyed their surroundings, their faces etched with astonishment.
While inside the coffins, they had already sensed that their bodies were different, brimming with vigorous life force; living for several more millennia seemed entirely possible.
But what they hadn’t expected was that after emerging from the Covert Dragon Coffins, they would see four others.
And from each of those Covert Dragon Coffins, a person had emerged, all revived, stepping out almost simultaneously.
"An Emperor Level Top Grade Dragon Cave... actually entombed five Covert Dragon Coffins?"
"And all five of us have been granted a second life?"
"What in the world is happening?"
The golden-robed elder, his face flushing with anger, roared furiously at the others.
"How should I know?" The white-robed young man silently glared at the golden-robed elder, a cold glint in his eyes.
The current situation, while seemingly joyful for all, was actually quite awkward.
Though he appeared young, he was an old monster in truth.
His identity, status, and cultivation base were all exceedingly high, so he naturally wouldn’t be cowed by the golden-robed elder’s bluster.
Instead, it was the consistently silent grey-robed elder who suddenly looked up and exclaimed in panic, "My mana... why can’t I circulate it all of a sudden?"
His words instantly caused the expressions of everyone present to change.
At that moment, they all discovered they were unable to mobilize the mana within their bodies.
Heh, can’t use mana? That’s great!
A smug smile flickered across Big Black Cat’s face.
Among everyone present, those other individuals were all at the Peak of the Tenth Level of the Destiny Realm, while he was only at the Fourth Level of the Destiny Realm.
He was completely outmatched.
However, he hadn’t expected the Seven-star formation on his chest to suddenly flash strangely, sealing the mana in his body.
The other four experienced the same.

chapters.title: Chapter 379: The Birth of the Only Container
chapters.content:
Chapter 379: Chapter 379: The Birth of the Only Container
"It’s begun."
Ye Yun, hidden in the void, nodded quietly.
The Seven-star formation indeed underwent a new transformation after being stimulated by other formations. It first restricted the mana within everyone’s body, putting them all on an equal starting line. At this time, the real contest was who possessed the strongest physical body. A strong body is the fundamental vessel; the stronger the body, the more powerful the entities it can accommodate.
"So, to truly live a second life, only one of us five can survive," the white-robed teenager said, seeming to have sensed something. Suddenly, his mouth cracked open, and he began to laugh sinisterly.
"That’s right. If you want to live a second life, you have to kill the other four," the middle-aged man in the green robe, his eyes glowing red, chimed in, also starting to laugh maniacally.
"I’m going to devour all of you to accomplish my great achievement of a second life!" the golden-robed elder declared, then licked his lips, a bloodthirsty, murderous intent gleaming in his eyes.
"The one to live a second life will undoubtedly be me!" the grey-robed elder, his presence overwhelming, roared with ferocious eyes.
The tension was palpable as the battle was about to erupt.
Suddenly, a soft laugh broke the silence.
The Big Black Cat flicked its eyelids and sneered, "Can’t live without bragging, can you?"
"Kill!"
The moment the other four finished speaking, they rushed towards the Big Black Cat.
But as soon as the four reached mid-air, their Divine Senses seemed to be pulled by some force, and they began to fight amongst themselves.
A touch of chaos flashed in the Big Black Cat’s eyes; at this moment, his mind was controlled by the Seven-star formation. With a flicker, he too rushed into the air and began to battle the others.
Each person fought relying solely on their astonishing physical bodies. Every punch landed squarely on flesh, sending sprays of blood flying. THUD! THUD! The sounds echoed endlessly as people were continuously smashed and sent airborne.
Ye Yun watched this scene, his eyes shimmering.
He was constantly analyzing the Seven-star formation on the Big Black Cat’s chest. That Seven-star formation had just influenced everyone’s minds again, causing them to slaughter each other like beasts. This was a fair fight: each person indiscriminately attacked the other four. The one who survived to the end would be the ultimate winner and the only surviving vessel.
Ye Yun naturally wasn’t worried about this battle, as the Big Black Cat’s physical body was incredibly strong at the moment. He had already been strengthened once in the Nine Soul Underground Palace, and this was the second time. Coupled with his Demon Clan physique, the ultimate winner of this battle would definitely be the Big Black Cat.
The fight grew increasingly intense. The other four were covered in blood but still fought crazily. Only the Big Black Cat remained unscathed.
「Soon, an incense stick’s worth of time passed.」
The hotheaded golden-robed elder was the first to perish. After he fell, the Seven-star formation on his body instantly floated into mid-air. It cast a beam of light, and the golden-robed elder disappeared. That Seven-star formation, however, seemed a bit more powerful than before.
Then, the middle-aged man in the green robe also fell. His Seven-star formation too floated in the sky. As the middle-aged man’s body disappeared, the Super Divine Dragon Breath of this Seven-star formation intensified severalfold.
The third to fall was the grey-robed elder.
In the end, only the white-robed teenager and the Big Black Cat were left fighting. With only one opponent left, the Big Black Cat’s attacks grew increasingly frenzied. Eventually, he brutally overpowered and killed the white-robed teenager.
The four Seven-star formations floated in mid-air, their Super Divine Dragon Breath thick and strong, several times more potent than before.
The Big Black Cat was panting heavily, constantly looking around as if still searching for opponents. His mind had not yet recovered at this moment.
At this instant, the Seven-star formation on the Big Black Cat’s chest flashed fiercely. The other four Seven-star formations, as if summoned, quickly descended towards it. Each Seven-star formation perfectly overlapped according to the positions of the Seven Stars. After the first set of Seven Stars merged, there seemed to be no difference. However, when all four Seven-star formations overlapped with the one on the Big Black Cat’s chest, they suddenly emitted seven beams of light, which poured into the Big Black Cat’s body.
The Big Black Cat screamed and suddenly fell from mid-air, unconscious once again.
Ye Yun’s eyes flickered as he saw large amounts of Dragon Qi coursing through, scouring, and transforming the Big Black Cat’s body.
So that’s how it is. The energy absorbed by the Seven-star formation from the four deceased was all injected into the Big Black Cat’s body, further increasing his physical strength. The last surviving vessel would reach an unimaginable degree of strength, comparable to a Divine Dragon. The entire process was automatically guided by the Seven-star formation. It must be said, the design of the Seven-star formation was extremely ingenious.
Ye Yun quietly observed the Seven-star formation on the Big Black Cat’s chest. He realized that if it progressed at this rate, the Big Black Cat would need at least a year to awaken.
The Seven-star formation seemed to be permanently branded on his chest, never to disappear. This was the sole mark of the vessel.
Ye Yun decided to keep this Seven-star formation for now, letting the Big Black Cat serve as a vessel and survive in this manner.
Perhaps he will be of great importance in the Divine Land someday.
The Seven-star formation exhibited some new changes after the five merged into one.
After studying for a day, Ye Yun finally deciphered the remaining aspects of the formation. Then, he activated the Seven-star formation and retracted the force suppressing the Big Black Cat’s Soul.
The Big Black Cat’s eyes snapped open; he was awake.
"Master, what happened just now? I seemed to have fought with someone in my daze?" the Big Black Cat asked hastily, scrambling to his feet.
"The five of you, as seeds, had your minds suppressed by the Seven-star formation," Ye Yun said with a smile. "After a wild battle, only you survived. The energy from their bodies entered yours, continuously strengthening your physical body."
"So that’s how it is." The Big Black Cat scratched his head, looked at the other black Covert Dragon Coffins, and grinned. "Those arrogant bastards, thinking they were all Lawless, ended up being killed by me! Haha... This is so satisfying!"
"Being a member of the Demon Clan and having eaten so many Eternal Life Immortal Grasses, you naturally have the advantage in terms of physical strength," Ye Yun laughed.
The Big Black Cat blushed and lowered his head in embarrassment.
He knew that if Master hadn’t been assisting by the side, who knows what strange incidents would have occurred.
"Let’s go. You’ve had a blessing in disguise this time; your physical body has become increasingly comparable to a Divine Dragon," Ye Yun said with a smile.
After saying that, he tore through the void and brought the Big Black Cat back to the carriage.
Seeing the Big Black Cat return, the other Divine Beasts became quite excited.
"Big brother, are you okay?" Little Cat asked with a concerned look.
"What could be wrong?" the Big Black Cat grinned, his face filled with triumph. "Instead, lying in the coffin for over ten days has made me stronger than before!"
"We were worried about you for nothing. It’s good that you came back safely," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon sighed.
WHOOSH!
A black tail swept over, landing on the Big Black Cat. The intention was to flatten the bragging Big Black Cat into a meat patty, but the Big Black Horse’s surprise attack was unsuccessful.
The Big Black Cat’s body just swayed a bit.
"Aiyo, Little Cat, your physical body is many times stronger than before!" the Big Black Horse said, smacking its lips, its white teeth flashing in a shocked expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 380: Arrival at the Nether Immortal Dynasty
chapters.content:
Chapter 380: Chapter 380: Arrival at the Nether Immortal Dynasty
"Little Cat has absorbed a large amount of Dragon Qi and successfully devoured the Seven-star formations of several other seeds. Now, it has become a suitable container, and thus, its physique is naturally very different from before," Ye Yun said with a smile, standing nearby.
The Big Black Horse, which usually hit its targets with a flick of its tail, surprisingly failed this time.
This time, it had genuinely met a tough nut to crack.
The Big Black Cat’s physical body was much stronger than before, and this strengthening process was still ongoing.
"Little Cat, you’re indeed blessed in disguise. The rewards you received from this mission are truly substantial," the Big Black Horse said cheerfully, no longer annoyed.
"Uncle Ma, don’t flatter me. Don’t you know my capabilities? There’s a huge gap between my cultivation at the Fourth Level of the Heavenly Fate Realm and your cultivation as an Eternal Realm Great Demon," the Big Black Cat chuckled, then with a shimmer, he quickly transformed back into a Little Black Cat.
It obediently lay down on the carriage.
This move caused the nearby demon beasts to burst into laughter.
"Little Horse, head to the Nether Immortal Dynasty," Ye Yun said faintly, his expression serious as he gazed in a certain direction, seemingly recalling something.
"Alright, Master," the Big Black Horse replied, turning and flying towards the southeast.
"Master, you wouldn’t happen to be considering heading to the Nether Immortal Cave, would you?" the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon asked, opening its eyes.
For some time, it had been refining the Dragon Battle Armor and was now almost finished.
"We need to go to the Nether Immortal Cave to check on that kid," Ye Yun said with a smile, then flashed and entered the carriage.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon looked at the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, and they exchanged shocked glances.
That dying young man in white is actually worthy of the Master’s personal visit? He must have truly been fortunate.
The distance from the Heavenly Moon Dynasty to the Nether Immortal Dynasty was vast, at least several billion li.
With the Big Black Horse’s speed at the Eternity Realm, it took a full three days to enter the Nether Immortal Dynasty.
Ye Yun was in no hurry.
As the ancestor of the Dragon God Sect, he couldn’t personally attend to every matter. If he had to personally tear through the void and escort the carriage, it would truly be beneath his status.
During these three days, Ye Yun did not cultivate.
As he was on the verge of breaking through to the Divine Sovereign Realm, he needed to slow his cultivation. He focused most of his energy on comprehending Divine Skills.
"Master, we’ve arrived at the Nether Immortal Cave," the Big Black Horse’s voice announced from outside the carriage.
"Good!" Ye Yun nodded and looked towards the Nether Immortal Cave.
The Nether Immortal Cave was the most potent force of the Nether Immortal Dynasty, with the Sect itself situated on the summit of an immense mountain. Atop this mountain lay a deep, immeasurable cavern—the Nether Immortal Cave. This cave spanned several hundred li in diameter, its depth unfathomable, and it remained shrouded in clouds and mist throughout the year. The area was rich with Spiritual Energy, and many of the Nether Immortal Cave’s structures extended downwards into the cavern. Numerous disciples cultivated in these surrounding buildings.
Such peculiar architecture was considered extremely unique on the Cangnan Continent. After all, most sects were built on mountains, situated upon mountain ranges. They certainly wouldn’t construct buildings extending deep into a cave.
It was undeniable that the Spiritual Energy within the Nether Immortal Cave was exceptionally abundant. Compared to the mountain ranges outside, its concentration was at least ten times higher. This was why the disciples of the Nether Immortal Cave preferred to cultivate inside it.
At this moment, a black carriage was parked at the foot of the Nether Immortal Cave Mountain Range.
Just then, a ray of light descended from the mountain peak. The light dissipated, revealing three young men. Two of them flanked a young man in white robes, gripping his arms and forcefully shoving him forward.
"Go now! Your father has taken all the blame, and now he is imprisoned. I must say, you truly are a jinx!" one of the green-robed youths, who had shoved the white-robed man, taunted coldly, his arms crossed.
The young man in white swayed, his steps unsteady, coughing repeatedly. His face was deathly pale, devoid of any color.
"Father, why did you have to do this? You should have just blamed everything on me, a dying man," the white-robed youth lamented with a bitter laugh, staggering solitarily towards the foot of the mountain.
"Elder Yu has truly grown muddled. Could the Sect’s Void Transmission Array be used so casually? For the sake of his dying son, he not only lost his Elder status and was thrown into prison, but his worthless son was also expelled from the Sect. What a terrible miscalculation!" the other green-robed young man commented with a hint of regret as he watched the departing white figure.
"Never mind him. He won’t live for many more days anyway, and Elder Yu won’t be able to turn his life around," the first youth scoffed.
The two exchanged a glance and immediately transformed into a beam of light, soaring back to the mountain peak.
On the carriage.
"Isn’t this the guy I fought over the coffin with?" the Big Black Cat muttered, staring wide-eyed at the familiar young man in white, pursing his lips. A wave of complex emotions surged within him.
He watched the white-robed young man stumble with each unsteady step, looking as if a mere gust of wind could topple him.
COUGH, COUGH!
The young man in white coughed violently, spitting out a mouthful of blood. He quickly covered his mouth with his hand, but blood still seeped through his fingers. The blood, which should have been bright red, was mixed with a faint, horrifying green hue.
This kid really won’t live for much longer,
a look of pity appeared in the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s eyes.
"What a pity! His father has been locked up, and now he himself has been expelled from the Sect," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon sighed.
The seniors are right. Although this guy fought me for the Covert Dragon Coffin, I don’t know why, but I feel like I owe him something,
the Big Black Cat thought, sighing, his eyes filled with a complex mix of emotions.
"Little Black, you have a kind heart," Ye Yun’s voice came from within the carriage. Immediately after, a flicker of light revealed a small white jade bottle. "Give him this to take. This child can’t die yet; we still need to investigate the Nether Immortal Cave."
Gazing at the small white jade bottle floating before them, the cats exchanged glances, unsure who should go to rescue the young man.
"Little Black, you know him. Why don’t you go?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon suggested.
"Senior, I snatched his coffin. I feel awkward about it and don’t dare to face him," the Big Black Cat said with a woeful expression.
"Should I go?" Precious’s eyes suddenly lit up, and she volunteered bravely.
"Your cultivation base is still too weak. Even though you just broke through to the Nirvana Realm, that fellow over there is at the Peak of the Tenth Level of Destiny Realm," the Big Black Cat said, glancing at Precious with disdain. He still remembered the painful experience of being stabbed by her, so he always tried to get the upper hand in their verbal spars.
Hearing the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat call her cultivation base low, Precious’s eyes immediately reddened. She had been cultivating very hard. It was just that her starting point was a bit low; her actual breakthrough speed wasn’t slow at all.
"Let Precious go. She’s just delivering some medicine, after all," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said nonchalantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 381: Reasons, Detoxification, Demands
chapters.content:
Chapter 381: Chapter 381: Reasons, Detoxification, Demands
"Since Senior has spoken, let Cat Bao’er go."
Seeing that the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon had spoken, the Big Black Cat immediately put on a fawning smile.
"Little Black Boy! You truly don’t have an ounce of chivalry in your heart."
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon lifted its fluffy red paw and "lightly" patted the Big Black Cat.
"OUCH! Senior, please be gentle! My small frame can’t withstand your might!"
The Big Black Cat grimaced and cried out.
"Haha, I was just teasing you. I wanted to see how strong your physical body has become. Looking at you now, you indeed increasingly resemble an ordinary Divine Dragon," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said thoughtfully, scratching his chin with his claw and adopting a contemplative expression.
The Big Black Cat chuckled.
As a member of the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat Clan, his physical defense naturally couldn’t compare to that of a Divine Dragon. He hadn’t expected that two strokes of luck would lead to such a significant improvement in his physical body! Now, his physical body was definitely the strongest in the Nine-tailed Spirit Cat Clan.
"Seniors, I’ll be going then." Cat Bao’er grabbed the small white bottle and immediately flew off.
Watching these demon beasts fooling around, Ye Yun, who was in the carriage, merely smiled faintly.
This is rather amusing. Their boisterous play is quite enjoyable to watch.
That Big Black Cat is such a blockhead when it comes to romance; he doesn’t seem to notice women at all. Though he can be a smooth talker, he’s actually very reliable when it counts.
Ye Yun’s gaze flickered as he looked towards the white-robed youth staggering precariously in the distance.
This young man has been afflicted by a potent toxin. Antidotes capable of neutralizing such a potent poison in a short time are exceedingly rare, especially somewhere like the Cangnan Continent. If this were the Divine Land, an antidote might perhaps be found. This poison reminded Ye Yun of a particular type of Divine Dragon: The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon. Such Divine Dragons were numerous in the Ancient Times, but after the extinction of the Divine Dragons, almost none of their lineage survived. This type of Divine Dragon possesses potent toxins.
Ye Yun was very curious how a mere disciple of the Nether Immortal Cave could have contracted such a potent poison. However, now that he was outside the Nether Immortal Cave, Ye Yun had a rough understanding of the situation. He hadn’t expected the Nether Immortal Cave to hold such profound secrets.
Besides searching for clues about the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon, Ye Yun also felt an appreciation for this white-robed youth’s talent. Currently, members of the Human Race on the Cangnan Continent possessing the Dragon God Bloodline were exceedingly rare. And this white-robed youth before him possessed a faint trace of the Dragon God Bloodline. Although its concentration was lower than that of Jun Moxiao’s Dragon God Bloodline, upon encountering such an individual, Ye Yun naturally wanted to recruit him into the Dragon God Sect.
Just then, Cat Bao’er flew over. She hovered in mid-air, blocking the white-robed youth’s path down the mountain.
"Esteemed Senior, please wait a moment," Cat Bao’er said very politely. She was still in her Sky Spirit Cat form and had not transformed into a human.
Seeing a small white cat, whose cultivation base was merely at the Nirvana Realm, suddenly block his path, the white-robed youth was momentarily stunned.
"What is it?" the white-robed youth asked with a cough, his brow furrowed.
"Senior, I have a holy medicine for healing here. Please, take it," Cat Bao’er said gently.
"A holy medicine for healing? How can that be? The poison in my body... it’s incurable..."
The white-robed youth gave a bitter laugh and continued to stagger forward.
"Senior, please wait!" Cat Bao’er, feeling anxious, immediately drifted over and once again blocked his path. "Senior, this medicine truly is a holy healing remedy! Once you take it, your poison will be neutralized immediately!" Cat Bao’er said, her voice full of urgency.
"You are a strange little cat indeed. We are but strangers who have just met, yet you offer me medicine. What exactly is your purpose?" the white-robed youth asked, frowning.
"Senior, this medicine was given to me by my master for you," Cat Bao’er said with utmost sincerity, her large, gem-like eyes blinking.
"Who is your master?" the white-robed youth pressed.
"My master is..." Cat Bao’er began, then faltered, at a loss for words.
She couldn’t possibly reveal her master’s identity, could she? After all, her master was so noble; how could a mere Destiny Realm Cultivator like this youth ever come into contact with him?
"Never mind, never mind. I’m a man with only three days left to live; why should I quibble with a little Demon Cat like you? Be it a holy medicine or poison, just give it to me." The white-robed youth, as if something had occurred to him, let out a sudden, bitter laugh and extended a hand.
Overjoyed, Cat Bao’er quickly flew over, tossed the small bottle she held in her claw into the white-robed youth’s palm, and then flew a short distance away.
The white-robed youth smiled desolately. He opened the small bottle and sniffed it gently. A surge of immense life force flooded into his body through his nostrils, instantly making him feel much better.
What kind of medicine is this? How can it have such supreme, divine efficacy from just a single sniff?
The white-robed youth was aghast. He had been poisoned for three years and had consumed countless holy healing medicines during that time, but none had ever shown such immediate effects.
"Is... is this truly the antidote?"
A flush of excited crimson spread across the white-robed youth’s pale face. His body began to tremble, and his arm seemed unable to hold the small Jade Bottle steady.
"Senior, don’t hesitate! Drink it quickly!" Cat Bao’er urged from the side.
Seeing the white-robed youth so frail, as if he could die at any moment, Cat Bao’er also felt a surge of anxiety.
"Alright!" The white-robed youth raised the Small Jade Bottle to his lips and gulped down the green liquid inside.
BOOM!
An immense wave of vitality instantly exploded in his mouth. It flowed down his throat and into his abdomen, and this surging vitality immediately began to dispel the toxins within his body.
The speed was unimaginably fast, like a block of ice thrown into boiling water, melting away in an instant.
Within a few breaths, all the toxins in the white-robed youth’s body were completely neutralized. He felt invigorated and entirely free of his previous weakness, his spirits soaring.
"Thank you for saving my life!" The white-robed youth fell to his knees before Cat Bao’er with a THUD.
This sudden action flustered Cat Bao’er. "Senior, please get up quickly! If you wish to express your gratitude, you should thank my master!" she said hastily.
The white-robed youth stood up. Gazing at the small white cat before him, he asked eagerly, "Where is your master? Please, allow me to go and thank him in person immediately."
"Follow me," Cat Bao’er said, then immediately led the way. The white-robed youth followed closely behind.
Not only had all the deadly poison in his body vanished, but he had also recovered to his previous peak condition. He even felt as if he were on the verge of breaking through to the Life and Death Realm. He couldn’t help but be astounded by the potent effects of that small bottle of mysterious green liquid.
Cat Bao’er flew to the front of the carriage, pointing towards it with a small, fluffy paw. "My master is in the carriage ahead."
The white-robed youth, his expression fervent, strode to the side of the carriage and knelt on the ground with a THUD.
"Yu Long thanks you, Senior, for saving my life!"
Ye Yun looked at the white-robed youth outside and smiled faintly. "Get up. If you truly wish to thank me, then take me to the Nether Immortal Cave for a look..."
Hearing the words of the man from inside the carriage, Yu Long was momentarily stunned.
This Senior actually wants me to take him to the Nether Immortal Cave? This is truly beyond my expectations. But I’ve already been expelled from the Sect. Can I still go to the Nether Immortal Cave?

chapters.title: Chapter 382: Nether Immortal Cave
chapters.content:
Chapter 382: Chapter 382: Nether Immortal Cave
Yu Long’s face suddenly turned ashen.
He had just been expelled from the Sect, and his father, an Elder of Enforcement Hall in the Nether Immortal Cave, had offended many people in the past.
This time, to save his son’s life, he had abused the Sect’s Void Transmission Array, committed a major crime, and been thrown into prison.
Although the severe poison in his body had been neutralized, if he rashly took this Senior to the Nether Immortal Cave, it might prove disadvantageous to the Senior.
He himself wasn’t afraid of death.
But if this Senior were to be ensnared by the immense power of the Nether Immortal Cave, and if anything went wrong, he, as the guide, would feel utterly ashamed for failing to repay the Senior’s life-saving grace.
However, remembering that the Senior had saved his life and now put forth such a request, Yu Long found that he couldn’t refuse in his heart.
While he was anxiously contemplating, undergoing a fierce internal struggle, he suddenly heard a familiar voice booming in his ears like thunder.
"You’re being far too hesitant! What are you dawdling for? Do you intend to refuse the old man’s request?"
Following the voice, Yu Long saw that the speaker was actually a black cat lying on the carriage.
He was taken aback. Only then did he realize that there were four cats of different colors lying on the carriage.
The white cat was at the First Level of Nirvana Realm.
The black cat was at the Fourth Level of Destiny Realm.
As for the other red and blue cats, he couldn’t discern their cultivation base.
Looking up at the carriage roof, a black bird stood there, proudly tilting its head towards the sky.
Yu Long couldn’t discern this black bird’s cultivation base either.
That made him quite embarrassed.
This carriage... It’s filled with demon beasts?
Yu Long was somewhat dumbfounded.
Could it be a senior from the Demon Clan within the carriage? But why would a senior from the Demon Clan save me?
Countless thoughts flashed through his mind.
However, Yu Long quickly dismissed these thoughts.
He knew very well in his heart that he owed his life, his very resurrection, to the Senior in the carriage.
"Senior, if you wish to go to the Nether Immortal Cave, then I will lead the way now," Yu Long said respectfully, bowing low.
"Let’s go. You don’t need to worry about anything."
Ye Yun looked at Yu Long’s conflicted expression and gave a faint smile.
Ye Yun mused.
This child has a decent nature. He’s worried that I’ll encounter some misfortune if I go into the Nether Immortal Cave.
After all, in Yu Long’s mind, the Nether Immortal Cave was the foremost power in the Nether Immortal Dynasty. It possessed formidable and terrifying strength; no one dared to challenge it.
Seeing the certainty and encouragement from the Senior within the carriage, Yu Long had nothing more to say.
"Kid!"
The Big Black Cat glanced askance at Yu Long, chuckling. "Don’t hesitate anymore. Hurry up and lead the way."
Yu Long was taken aback. He looked at the black cat before him, and a look of sudden realization flashed in his eyes.
This voice... didn’t I hear it on the mountain peak of the Xuanyang Sect in the Heavenly Moon Dynasty? Wasn’t that the black-robed youth? A black coffin materialized in his thoughts...
A wave of inexplicable shock washed over Yu Long, and he blurted out, "You... didn’t you enter the Covert Dragon Coffin? How did you get out so quickly?"
Seeing this white-robed young man suddenly trying to pry into the Sect’s core secrets, the Big Black Cat snapped irritably, "Stop your incessant nonsense and lead the way!"
"Alright! Alright!"
Yu Long instantly broke into a cold sweat.
He suddenly realized his question had been rather impolite. After all, it was their secret; blurting it out like that was truly improper. Perhaps his recent resurrection had stirred his emotions, causing him to overlook the proper etiquette.
Yu Long turned around, too afraid to say anything more, and immediately headed towards the top of the mountain.
The Big Black Horse pulled the carriage along slowly.
When they reached halfway up the mountain, Ye Yun saw a towering gate guarded by two disciples of Destiny Realm.
"Yu Long, you’ve been expelled from the Sect! How dare you return?" a disciple stepped forward to block the path, questioning coldly.
"Junior Brothers, I am guiding a Senior to the Nether Immortal Cave. Please do not obstruct us," Yu Long explained courteously, smiling slightly and cupping his fists.
Even though he had been expelled from the Sect, he wasn’t yet mentally prepared to act against these two junior brothers, who were only at the First Level of Destiny Realm.
"Yu Long, just get out of here! Your father has been thrown into the dungeons, and you, a nearly dead man, have been banished from the Sect. Don’t come back, or we won’t be polite!" another disciple roared, drawing his sword, his face contorted with anger.
Yu Long shook his head with a bitter smile.
His father, as an Elder of the Enforcement Hall, had indeed offended many people over the years. Indeed, the father of this sword-drawing junior brother had once been punished by his own father,
Yu Long recalled. That was why this disciple harbored such a grudge against both him and his father.
"Junior Brothers, forgive my offense."
Yu Long’s figure swayed slightly, emitting the powerful aura of the Peak of the Tenth Level of Destiny Realm.
His entire demeanor changed, becoming like a sharp sword drawn from its sheath, no longer resembling his previously half-dead, languishing appearance.
A powerful oppressive force instantly immobilized the two young men, who were only at the First Level of Destiny Realm.
"Weren’t you poisoned? How did you suddenly become so strong?" one of the gatekeeping disciples stared at Yu Long, his face a mask of horror as he spoke.
Yu Long, without a word, darted forward like an arrow, tapped both disciples twice to immobilize their bodies, and then stepped back.
"Senior, please excuse my unseemly display. I will continue to lead the way," Yu Long said awkwardly, turning around and bowing courteously, his face slightly flushed.
"Human kindness and coldness are like drinking water; one knows the temperature for oneself. Let’s go."
From within the carriage, Ye Yun merely smiled faintly.
Upon hearing that the Senior did not intend to reprimand him, Yu Long felt invigorated, quickened his pace, and swiftly headed towards the mountaintop.
He didn’t fly too fast, naturally afraid that the carriage behind him couldn’t keep up.
However, when he reached the top of the mountain, he discovered that the carriage had always been steadily right behind him.
Only then did Yu Long realize that the Big Black Horse pulling the carriage must possess an extraordinary cultivation base.
This Senior... must be a mighty figure from the Demon Clan. I wonder why they wish to visit the Nether Immortal Cave. This is Human Race territory; any conflict could easily trigger a massive war between the Human and Demon Clans,
Yu Long thought, feeling somewhat apprehensive.
As a Supreme Level sect, the Nether Immortal Cave is unimaginably powerful. Throughout the entire dynasty, no Demon Clan dares to contend with them. This isn’t to say the Demon Clan isn’t powerful. It’s just that within the territory of the Nether Immortal Dynasty, the Human Race holds absolute dominance.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon remained prostrate and silent throughout.
After all, it was their Master who wanted to go take a look; it had nothing to do with them,
the two dragons thought.
Ever since passing through the mountain gate, they encountered no other disciples of the Nether Immortal Cave on their way to the summit.
It wasn’t that there were few disciples in the Nether Immortal Cave; rather, most of the time, the disciples of the Nether Immortal Cave were cultivating in the structures within the cave. They only left when they went out to undertake missions.
The carriage curtain was lifted, and Ye Yun stepped out.
"Master," the demon beasts on the carriage hurriedly greeted respectfully.
"Mm," Ye Yun nodded.
He stood with his hands clasped behind his back, gazing at the mist-wreathed entrance of the Nether Immortal Cave before him. Streaks of colorful light subtly shone through the vapor, creating a myriad of phenomena. It was an extraordinarily magnificent sight.
Ye Yun’s eyes glittered, as if he could see into the deepest parts of the Nether Immortal Cave with a single glance.
So this is the Senior,
Yu Long thought, his spirit shaken.
At that moment, an illusion overcame him: this white-robed Senior seemed like a Wushang Spirit who had stepped out of a painting. He stood resplendently on the carriage, his entire being radiating countless rays of light.

chapters.title: Chapter 383: In this world, are there really any immortals?
chapters.content:
Chapter 383: Chapter 383: In this world, are there really any immortals?
"Greetings, Senior!"
Yu Long’s heart pounded, and he was so overcome with emotion that he dropped to his knees before Ye Yun with a thud.
"Stand up!"
Ye Yun smiled faintly, looked at the unfathomable, mist-shrouded Nether Immortal Cave, and suddenly asked, "How long has the Nether Immortal Cave existed, and is there anything special about its heritage?"
Yu Long stood up and replied respectfully, "Senior, the Nether Immortal Cave has existed for about 90,000 years. It’s said to contain the corpse of an Immortal, which is why the cave is filled with an abnormal abundance of Spiritual Energy from top to bottom. From the first Patriarch onwards, the entire sect constructed its buildings on the rock walls surrounding the Nether Immortal Cave, a tradition that has continued to this day."
"The corpse of an Immortal?"
Ye Yun smiled faintly and then gently shook his head.
Where in this world could one find an Immortal? After the Eternal Realm comes the True God. The ’Immortal’s corpse’ in this Nether Immortal Cave was clearly a fabrication meant to mislead.
Ye Yun shifted his gaze, looking at the demon beasts beside him.
His gaze swept over the demon beasts possessing the Dragon God Bloodline, finally settling on the Xuan bird perched atop the carriage.
"Xuan bird, you come down with me," Ye Yun said with a smile.
If a conflict arose, he would naturally need the Xuan bird as his enforcer. As for Ye Yun himself, he had no intention of intervening. The demon beasts in this carriage were so powerful that there was no need for him, their Patriarch, to act. Moreover, the cultivation base of those in the Nether Immortal Cave was too low. With his Half-step Divine Venerate Realm cultivation base, Ye Yun disdained bullying the disciples of the Nether Immortal Cave.
"Alright, Master!" the Xuan bird exclaimed joyfully, instantly transforming into a streak of black light and landing beside Ye Yun.
The Master was giving him a task. The thought of a potential reward from the Master upon completing the task filled the Xuan bird with excitement. If possible, the Xuan bird also hoped to receive a piece of God-level armor.
"Let’s go. We’ll go down and take a look."
Ye Yun looked at Yu Long, smiled serenely, and started walking towards the Nether Immortal Cave.
Yu Long quickly followed, a sense of unease in his heart. He lowered his head and whispered, "Senior, the people of the Nether Immortal Cave are known for their arrogance and lack of judgment. I fear they might inadvertently offend you."
"It’s no matter. Didn’t you see I brought a helper?" Ye Yun chuckled softly, patting the shoulder of the black-robed young man beside him.
"Master, I’m merely here to assist you. I wouldn’t dare say I’m truly ’helping’; I’m not yet qualified for that," the Xuan bird said, immensely flattered by Ye Yun’s pat, its face flushing red.
He was just one of the many demon beasts in the Dragon God Sect. The Master singling him out this time was clearly a show of favor. A Supreme Major Sect would only have a few cultivators at the Life and Death Realm. To him, a great demon beast at the first level of the Eternal Realm, they were of no concern.
Ye Yun took a step and gently floated down through the swirling mist.
The Xuan bird and Yu Long followed closely behind him.
Ye Yun glanced at Yu Long and asked with a half-smile, "How did you get infected with this potent poison?"
"Senior, the Spiritual Energy in the depths of the Nether Immortal Cave is dense, and many Spirit Fruits grow on the surrounding rock walls. I was poisoned after eating one such Spirit Fruit," Yu Long explained.
"What about the others?" Ye Yun asked with a smile.
"Reporting to Senior, no one else was poisoned. I don’t know why the Spirit Fruit I consumed contained some strange, incurable poison. For the past three years, my father tried countless methods, consulted numerous renowned doctors, and I’ve taken many medicinal pills, but none could cure this potent poison." As Yu Long recalled these past events, he couldn’t help but sigh repeatedly.
He had been the top prodigy of the Nether Immortal Cave. At a very young age, he had already reached the Peak of the Tenth Level of Destiny Realm, only one step away from the Life and Death Realm. But unexpectedly, a seemingly harmless Spirit Fruit had nearly claimed his life. Recalling it now, Yu Long still felt a lingering fear; those past events were too painful to revisit.
After listening to Yu Long’s explanation, Ye Yun nodded.
The Spirit Fruit Yu Long had consumed had unintentionally absorbed the toxic aura of the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon. Fortunately, it was merely a wisp of the toxic aura; otherwise, it would have claimed Yu Long’s life instantly.
Ye Yun then looked towards the depths of the Nether Immortal Cave. The area teeming with Spirit Fruits was lush and verdant, the Spiritual Energy even more concentrated there.
But who would have thought that hidden deep within these rocky walls was a Dragon Egg of the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon? This Dragon Egg had likely been incubating for a very long time and was now close to hatching. Once the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon emerged, everyone in the Nether Immortal Cave would be killed by the poisonous gas it released; no one would be spared. Ye Yun planned to give this Little Dragon a bit more time to incubate, allowing it to break out of its shell on its own. In the depths of the Nether Immortal Cave, there were other things that intrigued him more, as if waiting for him.
"Who goes there? How dare you trespass into my Nether Immortal Cave?" A loud shout suddenly echoed from the depths of the mist.
The mist churned and billowed outwards. Instantly, a clear, mist-free zone appeared in the space. About 40 to 50 people appeared, immediately surrounding Ye Yun and his companions.
"Yu Long, is that you? Weren’t you expelled from the Sect? How dare you return?" The leading elder narrowed his eyes, his gaze fixed on Yu Long opposite him, an annoyed expression on his face.
"Hmm, something’s not right! This boy was poisoned for three years and was already at death’s door. How is he suddenly so full of life and vigor?" another elder beside him frowned, scrutinizing Yu Long with a look of bewildered suspicion.
As he spoke, everyone turned to look at Yu Long. Upon closer inspection, it was indeed true. The Yu Long of today looked no different than he did three years ago. He looked vibrant and energetic; where was the frail, terminally ill appearance from before?
This discovery instantly stunned everyone present.
They all knew about the poison afflicting Yu Long... it was considered virtually incurable. After three years of suffering, Yu Long should have been utterly drained, on the verge of death. How could he have recovered all of a sudden? Could it be that the strange, deadly poison in his body had been cured by someone?
"Martial Uncles..." Yu Long clasped his fists and said respectfully, "My poison was cured thanks to the benevolence of a Senior who bestowed upon me a supreme Sacred Healing Medicine, completely purging the potent poison from my body. This Senior wishes to visit the Nether Immortal Cave, so I hope you will not obstruct his path."
Although he was no longer a member of the Nether Immortal Cave, Yu Long still spoke very politely. After all, having cultivated and lived in the Nether Immortal Cave for so many years, he was very familiar with these elders before him. He couldn’t bring himself to completely sever ties with them, at least not at this moment.
"You audacious Yu Long! How dare you bring a member of the Demon Clan into the Nether Immortal Cave! It seems you’ve betrayed the Human Race and defected to the Demon Clan, haven’t you?" Hearing Yu Long’s explanation, the elder looked towards Ye Yun and the black-robed young man beside him. His expression suddenly changed, and he roared in fury.
He couldn’t discern the cultivation base of the white-robed young man. However, the black-robed young man beside him was unmistakably a powerful great demon. The Human Race and the Demon Clan had always been at odds, like fire and water. For Yu Long to bring such a powerful great demon into the Nether Immortal Cave was a blatant provocation!
Upon this realization, all the cultivators of the Nether Immortal Cave became instantly livid. One after another, they drew their swords, their tips all pointed at Yu Long.

chapters.title: Chapter 384: The Shocking Appearance of the Seven Stars Coffin
chapters.content:
Chapter 384: Chapter 384: The Shocking Appearance of the Seven Stars Coffin
"Martial Uncles, please calm down and listen to me..."
Seeing those Martial Uncles from his sect, along with some fellow disciples, raising their swords, glaring fiercely, their eyes filled with killing intent, Yu Long also became somewhat flustered.
"You brat, you’ve even brought the Demon Clan here to the Nether Immortal Cave. Your ambition is as clear as day," an old man said angrily.
"Martial Uncle, he is not of the Demon Clan; he is from the Human Race. And he doesn’t mean any harm." Yu Long’s face turned crimson as he frantically waved his hands, trying to explain.
He truly didn’t want the disciples of the Nether Immortal Cave to fight the black-robed Demon Clan youth under the senior’s command. After all, even his father couldn’t defeat that black-robed Demon Clan youth. His father, already at the Fourth Level of the Life and Death Realm, ranked among the top ten high-level combatants in the entire Nether Immortal Cave.
「In the depths of the Nether Immortal Cave.」
On a rock wall stood a magnificent golden hall. It was the Sect Leader’s Main Hall.
At that moment, two elders were standing inside. One of them, dressed in plain green robes, had a simple appearance. His cultivation base had reached the Fifth Level of the Life and Death Realm, and his white hair fluttered in the wind. The other, dressed in a white robe, had a ruddy complexion and a robust physique. His cultivation base had also reached the Fifth Level of the Life and Death Realm.
"Sect Leader Senior Brother, have you noticed? The poison in Yu Long’s body has disappeared, and his Super Divine Dragon Breath is as strong as before," the white-robed elder said in amazement, his hands clasped behind his back as he gazed up at the sky.
"This group is no ordinary one," the green-robed elder said seriously, his brow slightly furrowed. A thought crossed his mind, and he said solemnly, "That black-robed young man from the Demon Clan must be the one who defeated Elder Yu at Xuan Yang Sect’s Peak."
The white-robed elder’s heart stirred. He immediately grabbed a white scroll from a nearby table, opened it, and examined it closely. The scroll depicted a black-robed young man, who was indeed the Demon Clan youth from above.
"It really is him, Sect Leader Senior Brother." The white-robed elder looked towards the sky in astonishment, his brow furrowed. "Why has the Demon Clan come to our Nether Immortal Cave? Could it be they’re after the Immortal’s Shell buried underground?"
"I have no idea. Our Nether Immortal Cave has stood in the Nether Immortal Dynasty for tens of thousands of years, and no Demon Clan has ever dared to covet the Immortal’s Shell at its bottom," the green-robed elder said slowly. As he spoke, a cold glint flashed in his eyes, and he declared firmly, "If these Demon Clan members dare to make a move, we of the Nether Immortal Cave will make them regret ever setting foot here."
「Above the Nether Immortal Cave.」
By this point, Yu Long had no strength left to defend himself. After all, whatever he said now would hold no weight. In the eyes of the people of the Nether Immortal Cave, Yu Long was no longer a member of the sect.
"Xuan bird, these people are too noisy. Tell them to back off," Ye Yun said indifferently.
"Yes, Master." The Xuan bird immediately stepped forward, glanced coldly around, then suddenly thrust an arm outwards and swept it.
WHOOSH!
A fierce gust of wind erupted. The white mist was torn to shreds by the wind, and the cultivators of the Nether Immortal Cave, unable to maintain their footing, were sent tumbling chaotically in all directions.
CRASH! CRASH!
These cultivators slammed into the rock walls of the Nether Immortal Cave, and many impacts created deep pits in the walls.
"So strong."
Inside the Sect Leader’s Main Hall below, the two elders gasped in disbelief as they witnessed this.
That black-robed Demon Clan youth must also possess a cultivation base at the Fifth Level of the Life and Death Realm.
"Quick, summon all Life and Death Realm disciples of the sect!" the green-robed elder said with a grave expression.
The white-robed elder acknowledged and vanished in a flash.
"This..." Yu Long stared in astonishment at the scene.
This black-robed Demon Clan senior, his cultivation base isn’t just at the Fourth Level of the Life and Death Realm. The attack he just launched was at least at the Fifth Level!
Once a cultivator reached the Life and Death Realm, each level was a First Layer Heaven, marking a huge disparity in combat strength.
Having easily dealt with this group of Young monks from the Life and Death and Destiny Realms, the Xuan bird dusted off its hands, chuckling with a hint of nonchalance.
They were just too weak. As an Eternal Realm great demon, dealing with these Young monks was far too easy.
"Let’s go," Ye Yun said with a smile, suddenly increasing his speed of descent.
The Xuan bird and Yu Long quickly followed.
After descending a full hundred miles, a formation suddenly materialized, blocking their path.
"Break!" Ye Yun uttered a single word, and the formation silently vanished.
With the formation gone, the scene below came into clear view.
Below lay a verdant valley, extremely rich in Spiritual Energy, filled with all sorts of colorful Spirit Grass. In the center of the valley, seven black coffins were conspicuously arranged. What startled Ye Yun was that the seven coffins were arranged in the pattern of the Big Dipper.
Why is it the Big Dipper again?
Ye Yun was momentarily taken aback.
He had originally intended to search for the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon. As for the depths of the Nether Immortal Cave, he was merely curious to take a look.
But he hadn’t expected this.
After breaking through the Defense Formation that concealed the cave’s aura, Ye Yun saw a Seven-star formation composed of seven black coffins.
These seven coffins... they seem to resonate with the Big Dipper in the sky.
"Have you seen these seven coffins before?" Ye Yun turned his head and looked indifferently at Yu Long beside him.
Yu Long was also very surprised; this was his first time entering the deepest valley of the Nether Immortal Cave. He hadn’t expected seven coffins to be here.
Could it be that the rumors about the Nether Immortal Cave burying an Immortal’s Shell are true?
"Senior, this place is a core secret of the sect. This is also my first time entering," Yu Long said, his voice trembling with excitement, his whole body shaking. "It seems the legends are true! The Nether Immortal Cave truly buries an Immortal’s Shell!"
"What Immortal?" the Xuan bird beside him sneered and said dismissively.
Immortal is just a legend. Based on my senses, the most one could find buried here would be Eternal Realm cultivators. But to have so many Eternal Realm cultivators buried in one place is still quite astounding.
Doubt rose in the Xuan bird’s heart.
Just then, numerous figures suddenly appeared above the trio.
"Set up the formation!"
With a furious roar, the nature’s spiritual energy in the surroundings became chaotic. Streaks of sword light shot into the sky, forming a large formation above them.
Within the large formation, the phantom of an elder in a green robe slowly revealed a colossal face amidst the sword light.
"Yu Long, you damned traitor to the sect! You actually led outsiders into the sect’s most core area! Your crime deserves death!"
As soon as the elder’s voice fell.
"Yu Long deserves death!"
"Deserves death!"
An unknown number of Nether Immortal Cave cultivators roared in unison, their voices like a vast ocean. The sound was earth-shattering, and in that instant, all the dark clouds above the Nether Immortal Cave were swept away. For ten thousand miles around, all demon beasts fled in terror.
As the sound waves descended from mid-air, Yu Long barely managed to steady himself. His face was pale, and he trembled as he looked at the green-robed elder, stammering, "Sect Master, you must have misunderstood. Senior wouldn’t..."
Before he could finish his explanation.
"Kill!"
A heaven-shattering Sword Qi plummeted from mid-air, heading straight for Yu Long.

chapters.title: Chapter 385: The Immortal’s Shell, it’s actually the Elder of the Divine Dragon Sect.
chapters.content:
Chapter 385: Chapter 385: The Immortal’s Shell, it’s actually the Elder of the Divine Dragon Sect.
TCH!
With a flick of his finger, Xuan Bird shot a streak of light into the sky, intercepting the astonishing sword gleam.
BOOM!
The two forces collided with a thunderous explosion, then simultaneously vanished.
"These people from the Nether Immortal Cave... they’re all so stubborn."
Xuan Bird helplessly shook his head.
Yu Long is a decent young man; he’s always understood forbearance. Unfortunately, those fellows are far too aggressive.
"My Lord, shall I kill them?"
Gazing at the Nether Immortal Cave cultivators who had formed a large array above, a cruel glint flashed in Xuan Bird’s eyes.
With his Eternal Realm cultivation base, killing these Life and Death Realm cultivators would be as easy as flipping his hand.
Even if they formed an unparalleled killing array, they would still be no match for him.
"There’s no need for you to act."
Sensing the killing intent in Xuan Bird’s mind, Ye Yun smiled faintly and glanced upwards.
Tiny, star-like runes surfaced in his eyes. In that instant, Ye Yun activated the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye.
In that moment, all the cultivators from the Nether Immortal Cave, including their clan Elders, were instantly frozen in mid-air.
They plunged into a hazy, dreamlike world, unable to extricate themselves, completely forgetting the hatred before them.
"It’s quiet now."
Ye Yun smiled and descended towards the seven black coffins in the valley.
Until certain matters were confirmed, Ye Yun did not wish to engage in a massacre.
Killing these minor Life and Death Realm and Destiny Realm cultivators would achieve little.
Seeing his Lord use a Great Divine Power to effortlessly immobilize everyone present without spilling a drop of blood, Xuan Bird’s eyes filled with envy.
Yu Long, on the other hand, was bewildered.
He couldn’t understand what had just happened.
Xuan Bird paid him no mind and, with a swift movement, flew after Ye Yun.
A good while later, Yu Long finally came to his senses as if waking from a dream.
