He seemed to understand... The senior before him, who was like a spirit, had just used a Great Divine Power to immobilize all the Nether Immortal Cave cultivators in mid-air.
Could this senior be a mighty cultivator of the Eternal Realm?
Yu Long speculated nervously.
He hurriedly descended, also arriving beside the seven coffins.
"Heh, seven coffins indeed..."
"Is this another Seven-star formation?"
Ye Yun gently touched one of the coffins and remarked thoughtfully.
What else does this mastermind have in store?
Faint traces of seals remained on these coffins, isolating them from any prying senses.
Ye Yun lightly tapped with his hand, dispelling the seal on one of the coffins.
With another flick of his hand, the coffin lid flew off.
Inside this coffin lay a desiccated corpse.
"This is...?"
Upon seeing the attire on the desiccated corpse, Xuan Bird gasped, his expression drastically changing.
This dried corpse wore a distinctive black robe, which he recognized at a glance—it was a Daoist robe of the Dragon God Sect.
Two golden dragons were embroidered on the left and right sleeves, and on the right side of the chest, three words were embroidered.
"Dragon God Sect!"
"My Lord, why would there be cultivators from my Dragon God Sect here?"
Xuan Bird gazed at the desiccated corpse, unable to discern its identity. His heart surged, emotions spiraling out of control, and tears instantly gushed forth.
Looking at this desiccated corpse, Ye Yun recognized it at once.
Tang Hu.
One hundred thousand years ago, he was a Dharma Protector Elder of the Dragon God Sect, at the First Level of the Eternal Realm.
"How could this be? Don’t they even spare the dead?"
Ye Yun murmured to himself as he opened each coffin one by one. The seven corpses lying within were all dressed in the attire of the Dragon God Sect.
And Ye Yun identified each of them.
These were all Elders of the Dragon God Sect, great cultivators of the Eternal Realm.
He hadn’t thought that after the Dragon God Sect was annihilated, their bodies would be moved to this place.
Tears glistened in Ye Yun’s eyes.
An indescribable emotion weighed on his heart, making it difficult to conceal his profound sorrow.
Ye Yun gently flicked his hand, and a silver point of starlight suddenly appeared on the left chest of each of the seven corpses.
A total of seven starlike points formed a Seven-star formation.
Ye Yun silently sensed this Seven-star formation and suddenly let out a cold sneer. "You even want to exploit the little remaining value of the dead? Are you that desperate to exhaust the Dragon God Sect’s destiny?"
"My Lord, what on earth is happening?"
Xuan Bird asked nervously, not understanding Ye Yun’s words.
Ye Yun shook his head.
He did not explain the intricacies to Xuan Bird.
This matter had far-reaching implications, and Ye Yun did not plan to involve them.
These seven Elders of the Dragon God Sect had died in battle protecting the Sect. Afterward, their bodies were moved here, into this ancient cave, and a Seven-star formation was laid out using them.
This Seven-star formation contained extremely profound Destiny Manipulating Divine Arts. Its principles were remarkably similar to those of the seven small arrows stuck into the Black Dragon in that underground palace; it too was plundering the Dragon God Sect’s destiny.
Be it the successors of the Dragon God Sect or its artifacts, once "fixed" by such Destiny Manipulating Divine Arts, the activation of the formation would continuously drain the Sect’s destiny.
The Eternal Level Dragon God Sect was the only sect on the Cangnan Continent whose destiny was intertwined with that of the continent itself.
The destiny of the Cangnan Continent, in other words, was the destiny of the Dragon Hidden Continent—which was also the destiny of the Dragon Clan Ancestral Land.
The Dragon Clan Ancestral Land had been subtly protecting the Dragon God Sect, allowing it to continuously grow stronger.
Yet, the mastermind behind the scenes used various methods—either killing the Dragon God Sect’s successors or employing profound Destiny Manipulating Divine Arts—to plunder the Dragon God Sect’s destiny, and even the destiny of the Dragon Clan Ancestral Land.
Their methods were vicious and cruel, every step a carefully laid trap, every move startling.
If not for Ye Yun’s profound foundation, even the Ten Ancient Super Divine Dragons reborn would have been no match for this mastermind.
The mastermind was simply too powerful.
They possessed power, they possessed schemes, layer upon layer of plots, and inexhaustible tactics, all aimed at the complete destruction of this Dragon Clan Ancestral Land.
Once destroyed, no new dragons would ever be born on this continent.
The Dragon Clan’s lineage would then be truly severed.
...
Numerous thoughts flashed through his mind. Gazing at the desiccated corpses, Ye Yun felt a complex mix of emotions. With a light wave of his hand, he closed the coffin lids once more.
As for the Seven-star formation formed by the seven points of light, Ye Yun grasped it in his hand.
This formation was mystical, involving profound Destiny Manipulating Divine Arts, even more intricate and deep than the Nail-Head Seven Arrow Book in his Primordial Warehouse.
In this aspect of destiny manipulation, Ye Yun had to admit his own inferiority.
However, Ye Yun could vaguely guess that this Seven-star formation, through the seven Eternal Realm Elders of the Dragon God Sect, intercepted the destiny of the Dragon God Sect and transformed it into abundant Spiritual Energy that seeped out from the valley, thereby forming the rich Spiritual Energy within this ancient cave.
It had to be said, this Seven-star formation was truly powerful, seemingly even a fraction stronger than the seven small arrows.
RUMBLE!
Following a colossal rumble, the entire Nether Immortal Cave began to shake violently, and countless rocks rained down from above.
"What’s happening?"
Xuan Bird nervously watched the rock ceiling above. He could actually sense an Eternal Realm aura.
Ye Yun’s eyes flickered, piercing through eons in a single glance.
Deep within a section of the rock wall above the Nether Immortal Cave, he saw an enormous Dragon Egg. It was trembling violently, as if the giant dragon within could break out of its shell at any moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 386: The Birth of the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 386: Chapter 386: The Birth of the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon
"There’s a Little Dragon about to hatch, let’s go and see," Ye Yun said with a light laugh.
After he finished speaking, his body floated towards the upper reaches of the Nether Immortal Cave.
As Ye Yun crossed the great Formation, all the cultivators of the Nether Immortal Cave immediately stepped to either side, clearing a path for him.
Ye Yun hovered above the cultivators, looking up at the quivering rock wall ten miles above.
A Little Dragon?
The Xuan bird in the valley was startled.
How could there be a Divine Dragon hatching out of the Nether Immortal Cave? This Nether Immortal Cave is indeed strange. Firstly, there were seven coffins at the bottom, all buried with Elders of the Dragon God Sect’s Eternal Realm. And now, within the rock wall, there was a Divine Dragon about to break out of its shell. Could it also be a Divine Dragon of the Dragon God Sect?
After all, in that era, the Dragon God Sect did breed several Divine Dragons, albeit not in large numbers.
Seeing that the Master had flown into the air, the Xuan bird swayed slightly and quickly followed suit.
In the valley, only Yu Long was left, dumbfounded.
At this moment, Yu Long’s mind was in chaos. He hadn’t expected that the seven black coffins in the valley contained the bodies of elders from an ancient and venerable sect. Although he couldn’t understand these complicated relationships, he knew that the secrets involved were astonishing.
Yu Long looked up. The rock wall was shaking violently, with countless rocks falling like shooting stars, creating a spectacular sight. However, when the rocks fell around the Senior, they all disappeared mysteriously.
Yu Long stared in shock, his mind buzzing.
The Senior just mentioned... there’s a dragon being born over there? What does this mean?
Seeing those seven black coffins, Yu Long felt a chill in his heart. He didn’t dare to stay for a moment and hurried into the air.
Passing the path within the great Formation, he saw that all the cultivators of Nether Immortal Cave, including the Sect Master, were in a state of confusion. Yu Long felt his heart racing.
This Senior’s Divine Skills are terrifying! The Nether Immortal Cave, despite being a Supreme Major Sect, had its entire sect’s strength prove as fragile as a gnat before this Senior.
Yu Long flew to Ye Yun’s side, lowered his head, and dared not speak.
At this time, Ye Yun looked towards the valley and seemed to think of something. He stretched out his hand and set up a great Formation, resealing the valley once again.
As the saying goes, let the dead rest in peace. Seven Elders of the Dragon God Sect had rested here for nearly 100,000 years, and they should continue their eternal slumber here in the years to come. The Formation that Ye Yun set up at this moment could protect these seven Elders from all disturbances.
After giving it some thought, he threw a white stone into the Formation. This was a Spirit Stone, containing terrifying Spiritual Energy. The Formation would slowly release the Spiritual Energy contained in the Spirit Stone, maintaining the rich concentration of energy that Nether Immortal Cave had always had.
Ye Yun did this to maintain the Nether Immortal Cave, a Supreme Major Sect, in its original state, ensuring nothing would change. It was like having these people guard the seven deceased Elders of the Dragon God Sect.
After he leaves, Ye Yun planned to erase the memories of all cultivators in the Nether Immortal Cave. He would restore this place to the state it was in before he arrived.
As for Yu Long and his father, both possessed a trace of the Dragon God Bloodline. Ye Yun planned to take them both away to cultivate them as a reserve force for the Dragon God Sect. Nowadays, there were fewer and fewer Human cultivators on the Cangnan Continent who possessed the Dragon God Bloodline. Having encountered two, Ye Yun naturally wouldn’t let them go.
As for the memory of this father-and-son pair among all the cultivators in the Nether Immortal Cave, Ye Yun would also completely erase it when the time comes. To these people, it would be as if this father and son had never appeared in the Nether Immortal Cave.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
The tremendous rumbling grew louder and louder; the entire Nether Immortal Cave trembled at this moment as if a colossal creature was about to be born.
The complexion on the Xuan bird’s face grew increasingly solemn.
This Divine Dragon, just by emerging from its shell, has already reached Eternal Realm cultivation! This starting point is simply too high.
Ye Yun stood with his hands behind his back, calmly awaiting the emergence of the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon.
BOOM!
A huge section of the rock wall suddenly broke off and fell towards Ye Yun. Then, a giant green Dragon Shadow burst out of the rock wall.
Ye Yun’s eyelids twitched slightly, and the enormous rock instantly vanished.
Ten miles above their heads, a green giant dragon, its body tens of thousands of feet long, circled. This green giant dragon was covered in luminous green scales, but around its neck was a circle of red scales—conspicuously eye-catching.
ROAR—!
This newly-born green giant dragon was unbelievably excited, continually roaring up at the sky. With each roar, a lot of green, semi-translucent gas fell from the giant dragon’s mouth. The gas ethereally floated down.
Some fell on the surrounding rock walls, which were immediately painted in an eerie green color. Some landed on certain Spirit Grass, causing them to undergo a transformation where their growth speed drastically increased, becoming even more lush and vibrant than before. The trees growing Spirit Fruits also accelerated their growth speed; from bud to fruit-bearing, it only took a few breaths.
"Master, this Divine Dragon has the power of plant catalysis!" the Xuan bird observed, its expression shocked.
"Indeed," Ye Yun said with a smile. "This dragon is called the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon. It belongs to the Divine Dragons that are close to the Wood element. Whether it’s its Mana or its blood, even the toxic gas it exhales can spur the surrounding plant life to grow dramatically."
"Senior, those plants that have absorbed the green gas are all poisonous now, right?" Yu Long asked, looking fearfully at the Spirit Fruits in the distance and swallowing hard.
Ye Yun nodded and smiled, "The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon carries a strange toxin. After the gas it expels contaminates the surrounding plants, if a human were to consume them, those with a weak cultivation base would perish instantly."
"So that’s how it is..." Yu Long nodded, his face pale.
"That Spirit Fruit you encountered was affected by just a wisp of its Super Divine Dragon Breath, which it unintentionally leaked," Ye Yun looked at Yu Long and said calmly. "That’s why you managed to endure for three years. Otherwise, if you had eaten one of those affected Spirit Fruits, you would have died instantly."
"That’s terrifying!" Yu Long exclaimed, his heart filled with dread.
Ye Yun glanced in a certain direction below his feet and said indifferently, "Your father is still in the dungeon. Go rescue him."
"Yes, Senior!" Yu Long was overjoyed, bowed deeply in salutation, and quickly flew downward.
The excitement of the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon hovering above the Nether Immortal Cave finally subsided. It then realized that many cultivators were gathered below. It was familiar with these cultivators; they were the cultivators from the Nether Immortal Cave who had accompanied it for tens of thousands of years.
But in the void above these Nether Immortal Cave cultivators stood two figures—two young men.
One, a black-robed young man, emitted a faint Demonic Aura, and his cultivation base had reached the First Level of the Eternal Realm. This was identical to its own realm.
As for the other white-robed youth, he was a Human cultivator. The dragon couldn’t discern his cultivation base, as he was using some Secret Technique to conceal his Super Divine Dragon Breath.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 387: Xuan Bird Battles Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 387: Chapter 387: Xuan Bird Battles Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon
"Who are these two? How can there be such powerful Cultivators in the Nether Immortal Cave?"
The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon hovered in mid-air, its pair of bluish-green dragon eyes revealing a hint of confusion.
"Xuan bird, you’re also at the First Level of the Eternal Realm. Why don’t you try your hand against this Divine Dragon?" Ye Yun suggested with a smirk.
"Master, I also want to experience this Divine Dragon’s might, so I’ll go and meet it now," the Xuan bird said, bowing with clasped hands.
Although it was an ancient Divine Beast, it had never fought a Divine Dragon before. Now that their cultivation base was comparable, it also wanted to see who was truly stronger.
Ye Yun lightly tapped, and a white light entered the Xuan bird’s body.
"Go. This Mana can protect you from its potent poison," Ye Yun chuckled.
"Haha, thank you, Master!" the Xuan bird quickly expressed its gratitude. Its body flashed, transforming into a beam of black light that shot into the sky.
Ye Yun lifted his head, watching the imminent battle with keen interest.
Once in the air, the Xuan bird transformed, revealing its true form as a gigantic black bird. Only in its true form could it unleash its full combat potential. The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon opposite it was already in its Dragon Body.
This battle could be described as a ’dragon versus phoenix’ duel.
"Oh, my goodness! What kind of dragon is this?"
Outside the Nether Immortal Cave, the Big Black Horse peeked inside. Seeing the enormous, vibrant green Giant dragon, it too wore an expression of shock.
WHOOSH!
A red Little Cat suddenly landed on the Big Black Horse’s head and peered down.
"Boss, it’s unexpected, but there’s actually a surviving Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon on the Cangnan Continent." A hint of surprise appeared on the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s face. "Well, well," it said, clicking its tongue.
"This little dragon is pathetically weak." The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon opened one eye for a glance, then closed it again. As a Divine Dragon of the Divine Monarch Realm, it had no interest whatsoever in this kind of battle. It was like watching two infants fight.
"That dragon’s poison is so strong..." After hearing the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s words, the Big Black Horse nodded. Recalling the green gas, it mused aloud.
"Yes, in Ancient Times, some Dragon Clans were Poison Dragons, possessing potent and bizarre toxins. Their killing power was astonishing. Because of this, Lord Ancestor Dragon imposed strict restrictions on them during that era," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon murmured.
"This battle... who do you think will win, Number Two?" Hearing the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s words, the Big Black Horse grinned, revealing its white teeth.
"The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon will definitely win. The Xuan bird is still somewhat lacking," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon chuckled. As a member of the Dragon Clan, it naturally wanted to support its own kind.
"Well, let’s wait and see then," the Big Black Horse smiled and said.
In the void of the Nether Immortal Cave, a gigantic black Xuan bird and an enormous Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon faced off in mid-air. The auras of the two Divine Beasts clashed violently, creating astonishing popping sounds.
"You must be the legendary Xuan bird, correct? Why have you come to my Nether Immortal Cave?" the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon stared coldly at the Xuan bird and questioned loudly.
"Enough nonsense! Let’s exchange a few blows first!" the Xuan bird roared. Its wings flapped, creating a violent wind, as it shot out its black claws, swiping fiercely at the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon.
Seeing the Xuan bird attack at the slightest disagreement, the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon was also enraged. It roared, "You want to fight me? You’re not my match!"
With that, it shook its head and swished its tail, extending a scale-covered green claw to meet the incoming black one.
BOOM!
The claws of the green and black demon beasts collided, emitting a thunderous sound. A massive shockwave spread wildly in all directions. However, before it could reach the surrounding cave walls, the shockwave inexplicably vanished.
This was, of course, Ye Yun’s doing. He wanted to keep the Nether Immortal Cave intact, to prevent the battle between these two demon beasts from damaging other parts of the Nether Immortal Cave as much as possible.
A tremendous force sent the Xuan bird reeling backward continuously. It flapped its wings furiously, stirring up hurricanes, just to stabilize its body.
Truly worthy of the Dragon Clan! Such formidable physical strength!
The Xuan bird was secretly astonished.
However, with its Lord supervising from below, it dared not slack off. It charged at the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon once more.
"You’re courting death!" Enraged, the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon opened its mouth and spewed out a vast cloud of green poisonous gas.
WHOOSH!
The poisonous gas blotted out the sky, rushing towards the Xuan bird like a dark cloud.
The Xuan bird didn’t dodge or evade. Instead, it folded its wings and flew straight through the green poisonous gas, continuing its attack towards the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon.
What? It isn’t afraid of the poisonous gas?
Seeing the Xuan bird fly through the poisonous gas unscathed, the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon was utterly shocked.
It was very confident in its poison. If this Eternal Realm Xuan bird was tainted by its unique poisonous gas, although it wouldn’t die immediately, its movements would at least be hindered.
But clearly... this Xuan bird was completely unaffected, seemingly possessing some degree of immunity to its poisonous gas.
Seeing its poisonous gas was ineffective, the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon could only brace itself and rely on its powerful physique to battle the black Xuan bird.
BAM! BAM!
The two colossal figures engaged in a fierce close-quarters battle in mid-air.
Although the Xuan bird’s attacks were ferocious, they still couldn’t break through the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon’s defenses. Even when it occasionally managed to breach its defenses, the Xuan bird was astonished to find that the green Giant dragon’s recovery ability was incredibly strong. Even if its body was wounded, the injury would heal in an instant.
After dozens of rounds, the Xuan bird’s advantage had completely vanished. It could only rely on its extreme speed to constantly maneuver around the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon. Occasionally, due to a moment of carelessness, it would be struck by the dragon’s tail, losing a few black feathers.
Standing in the void below, Ye Yun observed the scene.
The Dragon Clan is indeed the Dragon Clan,
he mused.
Even one that has just hatched from its shell possesses such incredibly formidable combat strength.
His figure flickered, and in an instant, he appeared at the center of their battle.
BANG!
Ye Yun waved his arm, and a mysterious force rippled out, separating the Xuan bird and the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon.
"Xuan bird, stop. You are not its match yet," Ye Yun commanded with a smile.
Hearing his Lord’s words, the Xuan bird felt ashamed. It transformed back into the black-robed young man and landed beside Ye Yun.
"Don’t blame yourself." Ye Yun patted the Xuan bird’s shoulder, speaking softly. He then retracted his arm and turned his gaze to the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon opposite them.
"Xuan bird, has your helper arrived?" The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon, now truly enraged, lowered its massive head. Gazing at the two tiny figures before it, it let out the derisive chuckle of a victor.
"You, a mere Eternal Realm little dragon, are still no match for me. I’ll find you a new opponent," Ye Yun chuckled. With a mere thought, he teleported the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, who had been enjoying the spectacle, to their location.
In the void, a red Little Cat suddenly appeared.
The red Little Cat stared at the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon, which now appeared incredibly massive before it, its eyes filled with a bewildered expression.
It had been comfortably watching the excitement from the cave roof just moments ago. How did it suddenly end up right in front of the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon?

chapters.title: Chapter 388: Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon takes action, suddenly sees a Peach Wood Sword.
chapters.content:
Chapter 388: Chapter 388: Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon takes action, suddenly sees a Peach Wood Sword.
"Hmph! I’m so dumbfounded!"
It must have been the Master who sent me here to deal with that Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon,
the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon thought, raising its fluffy red paw to slap its head hard, an annoyed look on its face.
Once it figured things out, it grew excited instead.
In Ancient Times, I privately challenged a Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon and lost. Unexpectedly, I now have another chance to face the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon! And this time, I have an absolute advantage in cultivation! With my current Sixth-Level Eternal Realm cultivation base, dealing with a newly hatched First-Level Eternal Realm Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon should be a walk in the park.
As for its opponent’s venom, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon wasn’t worried at all.
This...
The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon was startled by the sudden appearance of a red kitten, finding the scene before its eyes rather peculiar.
But when it tried to sense the kitten’s cultivation base, it discovered that the latter had already reached the Sixth Level of the Eternal Realm.
That was five whole realms higher than its own.
In that instant, the urge to flee surged within it.
"This is the helper I’ve found. Little Dragon, let’s see if you can defeat it?" Ye Yun, with his hands clasped behind his back, watched the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon grow increasingly panicked and couldn’t help but chuckle.
This little dragon was newly hatched and inexperienced. Upon realizing the vast difference in their cultivation levels, it immediately prepared to flee.
"To hell with you! Who’s going to fight you?" the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon roared, spewing out a rolling cloud of poisonous gas that blanketed the area before it turned to flee.
Trying to flee?
A glint of blood flashed in the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s eyes. It transformed into a Red Giant Dragon and gave chase.One red, one green, the two giant dragons engaged in an aerial pursuit.
However, the chase was short-lived.
Given the huge difference in their levels, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon easily blocked the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon’s escape route.
"Little whelp, stop running! Come over here obediently and cross blows with your Dragon Lord," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon sneered, reaching its claw towards the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon’s head.
Although the gesture seemed gentle, like an elder patting a junior’s head, it struck immense terror into the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon.
What kind of dragon is this red one? I have no memory of such a dragon.
Being just a young dragon, the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon’s bloodline memories had not fully awakened, so it could not recognize its opponent.
With no escape, it had no choice but to extend its own dragon claw to meet the attack.
BOOM!
A red and a green dragon claw collided, sending the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon flying.
The difference in their cultivation realms was too vast. Coupled with the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon’s extraordinary bloodline, the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon was simply no match.
"So weak," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon pursed its lips and dived down again.
This little dragon had just hatched, and it intended to teach it a harsh lesson. To teach it not to be so arrogant in the future.
In mid-air, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon attacked the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon, but it exercised restraint, not intending to deal a fatal blow.
Because the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon knew that this Divine Dragon was to be taken into the Dragon God Sect by the Master.
This senior is truly powerful,
the Xuan bird thought, watching the battle between the two giant dragons in the sky, envy evident in its gaze.
The strength of the Dragon Clan was unquestionable.
As an ancient demon beast, I really don’t have much of an advantage when facing the Dragon Clan. Now, I can only hope that the Master will also reward me with a suit of God-level armor in the future.
"Stop fighting! I admit defeat, alright? We are all dragons; why must you be so ruthless?" The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon transformed into a youth in green robes, knelt on the ground, covering his head with his hands as he begged pitifully.
"Fine, I’ll stop then." The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon pursed its lips, then transformed back into the guise of a cute little red cat.
Seeing this adorable red kitten, the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon wore a bewildered expression.
Such a powerful Dragon Senior has an unusual preference to transform into a cat? It’s rather perplexing.
"Master, how do you think we should deal with this little dragon?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon asked, turning its head toward Ye Yun.
Ye Yun strode through the void to stand beside the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon. With his hands behind his back, he asked casually, "You little dragon, you’ve just hatched and have no sect or faction. How about joining my Dragon God Sect?"
Join the Dragon God Sect?
The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon was taken aback.
They beat me half to death just to make me join their sect? What is the background of this group?
"What? You’re unwilling?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon beside him interjected angrily.
"I need to think about it..." the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon mumbled, lowering its head as if deep in thought.
Ye Yun wasn’t in a rush. He stood with his hands behind his back, calmly observing the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon.
If this little dragon refused, he would issue a command with the power of his Ancestral Dragon Bloodline and force it to join the Dragon God Sect.
"Go down and see what’s keeping Yu Long. Hasn’t he returned yet? Perhaps the restrictions on the dungeon are giving him trouble," Ye Yun instructed the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, glancing downwards.
"Alright, Master, I’ll go take a look right now." With a flash of red light, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon vanished.
The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon remained with its head bowed.
Even the Xuan bird was growing anxious. It urged, "Haven’t you decided yet, fellow?"
"I..." The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon suddenly lifted its head. Just as it spoke that single word, a yellow sword light abruptly shot out from its mouth, heading straight for Ye Yun.
This sword light appeared with extreme suddenness, faster than a lightning strike.
"You dare!" Seeing the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon launch a treacherous sneak attack on the Master, the Xuan bird was enraged. It lunged forward, throwing a punch at the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon.
The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon showed no fear, extending its own fist to meet the Xuan bird’s attack head-on.
The yellow sword light, appearing with shocking suddenness, flew towards Ye Yun’s chest with incredible speed, only to halt abruptly just before impact.
As the sword light dissipated, a Peach Wood Sword was revealed.
"You actually blocked it! What level of cultivation does this human possess?" The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon was utterly astonished that its sure-kill attack had been stopped.
I originally thought this white-robed young man relied on his powerful background and used demon beasts to fight because his own cultivation wasn’t high. But I never imagined that my sneak attack, which I was so certain would succeed, wouldn’t even cause a ripple! The sneak attack failed.
Just as the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon was about to flee again, a vast power descended upon its body, immobilizing it.
This white-robed young man... he’s even more terrifying than that Red Giant Dragon!
At that moment, an immense terror washed over the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon. It began to tremble uncontrollably, its entire body shivering.
It knew then that it was probably doomed.
This white-robed young man could probably kill me with a single finger.
Ye Yun stared blankly at the pale yellow Peach Wood Sword hovering before his chest. Seeing the familiar runes carved onto the sword’s body, a faint trace of sorrow flickered in his eyes.
This Peach Wood Sword... it was from Liu Yiyi.

chapters.title: Chapter 389: Nangong Jade
chapters.content:
Chapter 389: Chapter 389: Nangong Jade
「A hundred thousand years ago.」
Ye Yun had many beautiful companions, each one of unparalleled beauty, enough to captivate nations. But when it came to swordsmanship, Liu Yiyi was undoubtedly number one. Liu Yiyi’s Sword Dao Talent was exceptionally high, and she often enjoyed sparring with Ye Yun. She could also be considered a Sword Infatuation. Because they often sparred, Ye Yun and Liu Yiyi developed a deep understanding of each other, and together they created a set of Swordsmanship techniques—the very Swordsmanship inscribed on the Sword King Stone: the Nine Heavens Lotus Sutra.
Ye Yun gently stretched out his hand, his expression one of considerable excitement as he grasped the small peach wood sword. This was no ordinary Peach Wood Sword; it was engraved with runes that Ye Yun himself had personally etched long ago. Within the Peach Wood Sword, there was also a Sword Intent left by Liu Yiyi. However, that Sword Intent had been expended in the attack just moments before. Even so, Ye Yun could still discern that it was Liu Yiyi’s Sword Intent.
Ye Yun fell into deep thought.
Back then, the Guardian near the Sword King Stone told me that his ancestor, Liu Yiyi, had long since departed the mortal world. I could accept that Liu Yiyi had passed on. After all, even if one cultivated to the True God realm, it was impossible to live for a hundred thousand years. After my rebirth, I was already mentally prepared for the fates of my old acquaintances. None of them could have lived that long. What puzzles me is that Liu Yiyi was a Sword Infatuation, her heart solely devoted to the Sword. So where did she obtain a Dragon Egg? And why did she seal this Dragon Egg deep within the rock walls of the Nether Immortal Cave? Even more astonishingly, she actually gifted this Peach Wood Sword to the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon. All of this is truly unfathomable.
Ye Yun took two steps forward, arriving before the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon. He released a trace of his Ancestral Dragon Bloodline’s breath. The Ancestral Dragon Bloodline, a power that has dominated for eons. All Dragon Clan in the world dared not disobey.
Sensing the oppressive might of the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline, like the Heavenly Dao itself, the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon’s expression changed drastically. It suddenly dropped to its knees, kowtowing repeatedly and saying respectfully, "Little Dragon pays his respects to Lord Ancestor Dragon!"
Seeing the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon submit, Ye Yun nodded faintly.
"Master, what happened to him..." the Xuan bird beside them muttered, staring wide-eyed, utterly dumbfounded by the scene. He didn’t know why this small Peach Wood Sword had caused such a drastic change in his master’s demeanor. The Xuan bird had never seen his master so discomposed.
"Where did you get this sword?" Ye Yun asked, his expression now calm as he gazed at the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon.
"Reporting to Lord Ancestor Dragon," the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon said respectfully, "my master gave this to me before she left the Cangnan Continent. She said that if I hatched and was fortunate enough to cultivate to the True God Realm on the Cangnan Continent, I should take this sword to the Divine Land to find her..."
"Your master? What does she look like? Quickly, use your Mana to create an illusion of her," Ye Yun instructed, slightly taken aback.
"Okay!" The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon immediately channeled its Mana, forming a phantasmal image of an exquisitely beautiful woman in mid-air.
Upon seeing the woman’s face, Ye Yun’s expression changed dramatically, and his body swayed slightly. Even with his firm resolve, he almost dropped the Peach Wood Sword in his hand.
To think the illusion of the stunning woman would be Nangong Jade! Why would it be her?
A tempest raged in Ye Yun’s heart.
Ever since my "fall" at the Dragon God Sect, Nangong Jade’s actions have been peculiar. Her conduct was extremely bizarre, alternating between righteous and nefarious, making her completely unpredictable. How could she possess Liu Yiyi’s Peach Wood Sword? And she even gave Liu Yiyi’s Peach Wood Sword to the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon when it was still in its Dragon Egg state. This is truly beyond comprehension.
"Do you know your master’s name?" Ye Yun asked calmly, collecting his thoughts.
"I don’t know, Lord Ancestor Dragon," the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon answered truthfully. "My master never told me her name, and we didn’t spend much time together. She sealed me in the Nether Immortal Cave, telling me to use the rich Spiritual Energy here to incubate."
"Incubating for over ninety thousand years?" Ye Yun raised an eyebrow, his voice indifferent.
"Before my master left," the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon explained, "she told me it was very dangerous outside and that I mustn’t break out of my shell until I reached the Eternal Realm. So, I followed her will and deliberately delayed my hatching by ten thousand years."
What on earth is this Nangong Jade up to?
Ye Yun’s gaze flickered, star-like runes flashing in his eyes. In an instant, he read the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon’s memories.
To Ye Yun’s surprise, there were no restrictions on the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon’s memories; they were relatively complete. Everything was indeed as the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon had said. Nangong Jade had sealed the Dragon Egg deep within the rock wall of the Nether Immortal Cave, given some instructions, and then gracefully departed. According to its memories, Nangong Jade should have gone to the Divine Land. Moreover, there was something the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon hadn’t had a chance to mention earlier: Nangong Jade had told it that if it one day reached the Divine Land, it should take this Peach Wood Sword and find her in the Daluo Region.
Could Liu Yiyi’s death also be related to Nangong Jade?
This question suddenly arose in Ye Yun’s mind.
It seems I must make a trip to the Divine Land. Originally, my cultivation base had already reached the peak of the tenth layer of the Divine Monarch Realm, and I was planning to go to the Divine Land for a breakthrough. Now that I have a clue about Nangong Jade, these two matters can be addressed together.
Ye Yun shifted slightly, withdrawing the oppressive Ancestral Dragon’s Breath.
"You may rise," he said softly.
Gazing into the void, Ye Yun slowly exhaled, releasing the oppressive feeling that had weighed down his heart.
Stumbling upon this clue about Nangong Jade is a good thing. This trip to the Nether Immortal Cave not only revealed traces of the mastermind but also yielded a Seven-Star Formation and a Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon at the first level of the Eternal Realm. These are all excellent omens.
Throughout his journey, Ye Yun had discovered that all the incidents he encountered were schemes orchestrated by the mastermind, plots laid out long ago. To date, the mastermind had not yet truly set foot on the Cangnan Continent.
Perhaps it’s because not enough time has passed. Additionally, I’ve erased the memories of many involved individuals along the way, so the mastermind lurking in the Divine Land has probably not noticed yet.
Ye Yun considered.
My sudden revival as the thirteenth-generation Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect after a hundred thousand years is a huge variable the mastermind could never have anticipated. After all, I am a transmigrator with a System—a significant anomaly. So, the mastermind has likely been complacently relying on its original, meticulous plans, quietly waiting for the fortunes of the Dragon God Sect and the Dragon Clan of the Cangnan Continent to completely decline...
A red light swept up from below, landing before him. The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon had returned with the Yu family’s father and son.
Ye Yun took out the green Bead and, with a wave of his hand, stored them inside. He then sent a strand of his Primordial Spirit into the world within the Bead and brought the two of them under the banner of the Dragon God Sect. After leaving some cultivation resources, the strand of Primordial Spirit returned.
Ye Yun checked the large formation in the depths of the Nether Immortal Cave to ensure there were no problems. He also dealt with the memories of all the cultivators in the Nether Immortal Cave.
Afterward, he returned to the carriage. Ye Yun gave some instructions to the three young disciples of the Dragon God Sect and a few demon beasts. Then, he left the Cangnan Continent with the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon and headed straight for the Divine Land.

chapters.title: Chapter 390 It seems like I’ve found someone with the same interest
chapters.content:
Chapter 390: Chapter 390 It seems like I’ve found someone with the same interest
"Master, the Ancient Road to Heaven is truly terrifying. If it weren’t for your presence, I wouldn’t have been able to pass even the first obstacle."
At the end of the Ancient Road to Heaven, two figures shot out.
One was a young man in white, with deep-set features and outstandingly handsome, his entire being radiating an indescribable, ethereal quality. The other, a youth in a green robe, looked a little inexperienced.
The one who had just spoken was the youth in the green robe. After he finished speaking, he glanced back, a terrified expression still lingering on his face.
"If the Ancient Road to Heaven weren’t challenging, how could it stop the passage of cultivators?" Ye Yun smiled faintly and shook his head, his gaze falling upon a small wooden house within a fenced yard in the distance.
The small wooden house was empty.
Evidently, after he had killed the Gatekeeper of the Ancient Road to Heaven, no one had guarded it since.
Ye Yun assumed that, sooner or later, a new Gatekeeper would be appointed to this place. After all, the powers of the Divine Land greatly distrusted the Cangnan Continent and, as much as possible, did not want its cultivators to venture out. Appointing a Gatekeeper was another layer of obstruction.
The Gatekeeper at that time, though appearing somewhat greedy, was actually a ruthless character, ready to kill at the slightest disagreement. Because of this, even if a cultivator from the Cangnan Continent had, by chance, managed to traverse the Ancient Road to Heaven, passing the Gatekeeper was still incredibly difficult.
The small wooden house flickered and vanished.
Ye Yun, accompanied by the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon, bypassed the final barrier of the Ancient Road to Heaven and stepped out over a vast, azure ocean.
"Wow, the Spiritual Energy in this air is different from that of the Cangnan Continent!" After inhaling some of the Spiritual Energy, a look of intoxication appeared on the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon’s face, which then turned into shock.
Wouldn’t cultivating in this place speed up progress severalfold?
"The Spiritual Energy in the Divine Land contains Divine Nature. For cultivators above the True God Realm, this place is a paradise for cultivation," Ye Yun said with a smile.
"This place is wonderful! No wonder Master told me to come here." The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon scratched his head, a look of yearning on his face.
"But you’d need the strength for that," Ye Yun laughed heartily, his laughter booming, which caused the green-robed youth opposite him to blush instantly.
"Master, I know I’m weak, and the countless challenges of the Ancient Road to Heaven are terrifying. With my strength, even if I reach the Tenth-Layer Peak of the Eternal Realm, I still can’t break through," the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon said, his face flushed.
"That’s right. At least you’re aware of your own limitations. Let’s go! We’re heading directly to the Daluo Region to see if Nangong Jade is there." Ye Yun laughed, then tore open the void and left with the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon.
「Just a few moments after Ye Yun left.」
Suddenly, a black Celestial Boat broke through the sky from afar, stopping near the barrier outside the Ancient Road to Heaven. A group of about thirty-four individuals stood on the Celestial Boat. These people looked similar to the Human Race, but each had a strange black mark on their forehead.
They were the Yuan Demon Clan People. They had come from the distant Netherworld Demon Territory, traversing hundreds of millions of miles to reach this place.
"This should be the right place," said a middle-aged man in a black robe, who stood out prominently among the many Yuan Demon Clan People. He was the Demon Lord of the Yuan Mo Clan.
However, his real name was Wu De, and he was from another world. Wu De had taken great pains to enter this world, seizing the body of this Demon God and naturally becoming the leader of the Yuan Mo Clan. Then, he led the Yuan Demon Clan People, easily defeating the Bloodthirsty Demon Clan and deterring the other great Demon Clans. After settling down for a while, Wu De’s craving for his pipe began to act up; he yearned for his treasured Purple Gold Pipe.
So, he led a group of his subordinates, following a mysterious sense, trudging over mountains and through waters, finally arriving at The Tenth Sea Region.
"Demon Lord, this is the entrance to the Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon..." the beautiful High Priest, her skin as fair as ivory and her features delicate, said while holding a White Bone Wand. She looked at the semi-transparent barrier below with a doubtful expression.
Their Netherworld Demon Territory was a considerable distance from here. However, as demons from the Divine Land, all Yuan Mo Clan members knew what the Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon implied. This was a true forbidden area. No cultivator dared to enter this terrifying place. Those who recklessly entered would face a dreadful Curse: their cultivation base would stagnate for life, and they would never be able to progress again. The Spiritual Energy inside the Forbidden Zone was extremely thin, with no Divine Nature to speak of. It was completely unsuitable for cultivators from the Divine Land to cultivate.
Upon hearing the High Priest’s words, Wu De could not hide his embarrassment. Due to the hasty possession, he had shattered the Demon God’s Primordial Spirit and had not inherited any memories. In the meantime, relying on his special status and formidable combat strength, Wu De had, through deception and trickery, obtained considerable information about the Shenhu Continent. However, this was the first time he had heard of this Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon.
Wu De coughed lightly and said seriously, "High Priest, what are the particulars of this Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon? Explain them to me. I have been dormant for so long that some things have slipped my mind."
The High Priest gave a charming smile, not taking it to heart. Ever since the Demon Lord descended, he had seemed somewhat befuddled, often surprising others with his behavior. However, this Demon Lord’s strength was exceedingly high; he had defeated the Bloodthirsty Demon Clan with a single blow. That battle astounded the entire Netherworld Demon Territory. It also solidified the standing of the Yuan Demon Clan People within the Demon Clan. Some members of the Demon Clan even began to once again count the Yuan Demon Clan People among the Ten Great Demon Clans. The other major Demon Clans also grew extremely wary of the Yuan Demon Clan People and no longer dared to bully them wantonly as they had before.
"Demon Lord, there is a terrifying Curse in the Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon. Any cultivator from the Divine Land who enters will be Cursed, making it impossible for them to advance further on their path of cultivation," the High Priest said softly. Gazing at the transparent barrier, her eyes also betrayed a hint of fear.
The path of cultivation is long. Who wouldn’t want to travel further on this grand road? But if the path of cultivation is severed, one’s lifespan will also stagnate, and death will eventually become inevitable.
"Oh..." Wu De nodded. After a few seconds of silence, he suddenly said, "Then I shall go in and take a look."
With that, his figure flashed and disappeared from the Celestial Boat.
"Demon Lord!" the High Priest shrieked, so terrified her heart felt like it would leap from her throat. She hurriedly flew towards the barrier.
The other Yuan Demon Clan People, in a panic, hurriedly maneuvered the Celestial Boat, transforming it into a beam of light that plunged through the barrier.
「After passing through the barrier.」
The High Priest breathed a sigh of relief. In the distance, she spotted a small wooden hut. The Demon Lord of their Yuan Mo Clan stood before it, seemingly searching for something. The High Priest hastily led the clan members and flew over.
"Demon Lord, this is the Ancient Road to Heaven! Fortunately, you didn’t directly enter the Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon." After flying closer, the High Priest caught her breath, still shaken with lingering fear.
"There’s a lingering smell of smoke here. It seems there’s a kindred spirit about!" Wu De said, his hands clasped behind his back, a brilliant smile on his face as he let out an appreciative "Tsk, tsk."

chapters.title: Chapter 391: Demon Lord
chapters.content:
Chapter 391: Chapter 391: Demon Lord
"Demon Lord, what exactly have you been searching for all this time?" the High Priest asked curiously, drawing a little closer and fluttering her beautiful eyes.
"I’ve lost one of my Purple Gold Pipes, so I need to find it," Wu De replied, waving his hand nonchalantly as he prowled around the small courtyard, constantly sniffing the air.
The Demon Lord is searching for a Purple Gold Pipe?
The High Priest and the nearby Yuan Demon Clan People exchanged a look, their faces reflecting their mutual surprise.
In the High Priest’s memory, since when did the Demon Lord start smoking?
She was extremely puzzled.
Therefore, the High Priest plucked up her courage and asked, "Demon Lord, do you smoke?"
Wu De turned, glared irritably at the High Priest, and grumbled, "What’s wrong with smoking? A man with a smoke feels like an immortal in paradise. You lot are certainly nosy."
The High Priest was dumbfounded, unsure what to say.
"Demon Lord, I remember when you first arrived in this world, you didn’t smoke back then," the High Priest stated awkwardly.
"Can’t I learn later? Can you lot give me some peace?" Wu De retorted irritably.
Seeing the Demon Lord was growing angry, the High Priest quickly shut her sensual, rosy lips.
"HAHA!"
Suddenly, Wu De burst into loud laughter. He sniffed the air a few times and chuckled, "The Purple Gold Pipe really has been here."
"Demon Lord, this should be the residence of the Gatekeeper of the Ancient Road to Heaven. However, for some reason, the Gatekeeper has disappeared," the High Priest said carefully from his side.
She was, of course, aware that the Ancient Road to Heaven had a Gatekeeper.
"So that’s why I couldn’t find it! The Gatekeeper stole my Purple Gold Pipe and hid it somewhere!" Wu De exclaimed, slapping his forehead.
There was a smell of smoke in the air. It was evident that the person who lived in this house also enjoyed smoking. And his Purple Gold Pipe had left a faint trace of its Super Divine Dragon Breath here, proving it was undoubtedly connected with the Gatekeeper. It was highly probable that the Gatekeeper had taken his Purple Gold Pipe and fled. After all, his Purple Gold Pipe was of such a high grade that no one in this Divine Land could resist its temptation.
This road leads to that Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon, right?
Wu De thought, gazing into the distance along the Ancient Road to Heaven. He prepared to venture into the Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon himself to search for it.
Upon hearing the Demon Lord’s intention, the High Priest immediately panicked.
"Demon Lord, you... you aren’t thinking of entering the Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon, are you?" the High Priest asked, her voice trembling.
"Well, I am considering it," Wu De murmured.
THUD!
The High Priest immediately knelt at Wu De’s feet, and the other Yuan Demon Clan People also quickly knelt.
"Demon Lord, please don’t go to the Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon! The Curse there is too terrifying. Once you step inside and are afflicted by the Curse, even a Divine King’s cultivation base will stagnate!" the High Priest’s beautiful face flushed crimson as she exclaimed fervently.
Wu De maintained a stern expression and said nothing. He didn’t particularly care about so-called cultivation. Besides, his original body was still adrift outside this world. However, seeing these small Yuan Demon Clan People kneeling at his feet, Wu De felt a momentary dilemma.
This world is so sturdy. If my cultivation stagnates, will I be trapped here forever, unable to leave?
A spark of insight flashed through his mind, and Wu De had a sudden realization.
Even if he went in and found his Purple Gold Pipe, what good would it do if he couldn’t escape this world? Wouldn’t that be a tremendous loss?
After much thought, Wu De felt that the High Priest’s words made a lot of sense. He couldn’t take such a risk just yet.
Seeing the Demon Lord still pondering, the High Priest grew somewhat anxious. She gritted her teeth and said, "Demon Lord, the Human Cultivators in that part of the world, the Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon, have pitifully weak cultivation bases; they don’t even have a True God among them. If you wish to find your Purple Gold Pipe, why not send one of our clan members in to investigate?"
"That’s a good idea..." Wu De’s eyes lit up, and he nodded eagerly.
Among the clan members he had brought this time, even the weakest was at the True God Realm.
The High Priest stood up, glanced back at the kneeling clan members, and pointed lightly at one. "You, step forward."
A young Yuan Mo Clan man at the God Monarch Realm third layer stood up, a hint of panic on his face.
The High Priest frowned in displeasure. "Serving the Demon Lord is your utmost glory," she said.
Hearing the High Priest’s words, the young man had a sudden realization, and his panicked expression transformed into fervent zeal.
Wu De pointed lightly, and a beam of light infused into the young man’s mind. "This is the information about my Purple Gold Pipe. Once you are inside, you must search for it diligently," Wu De solemnly instructed.
"Rest assured, Demon Lord! I will definitely find your Purple Gold Pipe!" the young man declared loudly, kneeling on the ground.
Wu De nodded in satisfaction. In a place without even a True God, sending a Yuan Demon Clan Person at the God Monarch Realm fifth layer was akin to delivering an invincible presence.
"I grant you a Divine Skill. With it, you can annihilate any being within the God Monarch Realm tenth layer in a single strike." Wu De, still feeling slightly uneasy, pointed again. Another beam of light entered the mark on the young man’s brow.
With this Divine Skill, he could finally rest assured. The so-called Gatekeeper would be no match for this young man.
Once everything was arranged, Wu De waved his hand. "Go!" he ordered.
"Wait a moment, Demon Lord. I have a few words for him," the High Priest said, suddenly seeming to recall something, and stopped the young man.
The young man halted.
With a solemn expression, the High Priest slowly said, "It is said that the Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon is also watched over by certain supreme powers within the Divine Land. Once you enter, you must not engage in wanton slaughter."
"I understand, High Priest," the young man nodded gravely, then vanished in a flash.
The High Priest let out a slow sigh of relief. Although the Human Cultivators within the Forbidden Zone of the Hidden Dragon were weak, she knew that the supreme powers in the Divine Land paid close attention to this restricted area. The Spirits of the Divine Land were not allowed to take advantage of their cultivation base and slaughter the cultivators inside.
"Alright, let’s head back for now," Wu De said, watching the young man’s figure disappear before turning and stepping onto the Celestial Boat. He, too, needed to return and cultivate diligently; after all, the higher his cultivation base, the greater his chances of escaping this world. And the Spiritual Energy of the Netherworld Demon Territory, imbued with demonic nature, was well-suited for the cultivation of his current Yuan Mo body.
WHOOSH!
The Celestial Boat ascended, transforming into a streak of light. It pierced through the barrier at the end of the Ancient Road to Heaven and then vanished over the horizon.
Ye Yun, currently tearing through space towards the Daluo Region, was still unaware that as he departed the Cangnan Continent, the owner of the Purple Gold Pipe had dispatched a Yuan Mo at the Divine Monarch Realm into the Cangnan Continent.
Fortunately, Ye Yun’s luck was exceptionally good. When he had previously revealed so many God level and Super God Level pipes, only one powerful individual had sensed them. Otherwise, if powerhouses from all the various dimensional universes had sensed them, this part of the Divine Land’s world would likely have been thrown into complete chaos.

chapters.title: Chapter 392: Brother, Are You a Dragon Raiser?
chapters.content:
Chapter 392: Chapter 392: Brother, Are You a Dragon Raiser?
After entering the Divine Land, Ye Yun did not first go to Skyreach Island in The Ninth Sea Area. Instead, he tore through the void, continually advancing toward the Daluo Region. The Daluo Region, adjacent to the First Sea Region, had a long coastline, a vast territory, and was filled with countless factions, both large and small. Ye Yun had once extracted Jiang Hengyue’s memories, so he was quite certain of the Daluo Region’s direction.
The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon was greatly shocked. His master had been tearing through the void continuously from Cangnan Continent all the way to the Divine Land. He whispered to Ye Yun, "Master, you’ve been constantly tearing through the void. Isn’t that draining too much mana? Shouldn’t we rest for a bit?"
"We will discuss it when we arrive," Ye Yun replied with a smile, continuing to tear through the void.
Continuously tearing the void was a huge burden, even for him. Fortunately, he possessed the Ancestral Dragon Body and could still endure it. However, Ye Yun’s mana consumption was also immense.
After a while, Ye Yun tore the void once more and emerged with the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon. They had now entered the territory of the Daluo Region.
"We have arrived. This is the Daluo Region." Ye Yun panted lightly, then swallowed a few pills and quickly recovered his mana.
"Master, the Daluo Region is so vast and teeming with people. Besides, a hundred thousand years have passed. How are we going to find anyone?" The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon looked around in bewilderment, completely clueless.
They currently stood atop a mountain peak, from where they could vaguely see the silhouette of a city in the distance.
"Let us go take a look at that city first," Ye Yun said with a smile, pointing with his right hand toward a massive city in the distance.
Searching for Nangong Jade now was indeed like looking for a needle in a haystack. After all, a hundred thousand years had passed.
Who knew what her current situation was?
Ye Yun speculated that Nangong Jade might have had backing from some power within the Divine Land. However, a hundred thousand years was an incredibly long time.
If Nangong Jade had not managed to break through to the Divine Monarch Realm, it was unlikely she would still be alive.
Although their journey had been rushed, Ye Yun’s heart gradually calmed now that they had arrived in the Daluo Region.
"Master, tearing through the void was very strenuous for you. How about I carry you from now on?" the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon suddenly suggested.
"Very well," Ye Yun replied with a slight smile, not refusing the offer.
The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon transformed, becoming a green giant dragon tens of zhang long, hovering in mid-air. Ye Yun stepped onto his head and said with a light laugh, "Let’s go!"
Carrying Ye Yun, the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon flew toward the distant city.
"Master, I have noticed that my speed has decreased here!" As he flew, the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon suddenly discovered this anomaly and was taken aback.
"The world of the Divine Land is of a higher order than Cangnan Continent. This means it is more stable, and the ambient pressure is greater. Therefore, it is quite normal for your speed to decrease," Ye Yun explained with a laugh.
"So that is how it is. This world is truly terrifying! I, a mere First Level Eternal Realm Little Dragon, am just cannon fodder here, barely able to ensure my own survival from one day to the next," the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon said dejectedly.
"Haha, rest assured. With me around, you will not be in any danger," Ye Yun said, laughing heartily.
The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon was at the First Level of the Eternal Realm. In the Divine Land, where True Gods were everywhere, his cultivation level indeed seemed pitifully weak.
Just then, streaks of light began to fly rapidly from all directions toward the distant city. Ye Yun observed that many of them were True God Realm cultivators, though there were also a few God King Level Cultivators among them.
Just then, two beams of light descended from the sky, revealing two middle-aged men. One of them, a burly man, smiled at Ye Yun, clasped his fists in salute, and said, "Brother, your Divine Dragon Mount is quite impressive, is it not?"
"And what might you two need?" Ye Yun asked, maintaining his composure with a faint smile.
"Fellow cultivator, it is said that a young dragon is soon to be auctioned in Yunxiao City up ahead. Could this be the one?" the middle-aged man inquired with a smile.
An auction for a young dragon?
Ye Yun’s expression flickered, and a look of keen interest immediately appeared on his face. In the vast Divine Land, only the Dragon-rearing Clan continuously and diligently bred dragon eggs and various young dragons, handing them over to auction houses for sale.
What impeccable timing! They had arrived just in time for a young dragon auction.
Perhaps he might even have a chance to capture a Dragon Raiser.
Seeing that Ye Yun remained silent, the other middle-aged man beside him asked with a smile, "Esteemed brother, could you be the legendary mysterious Dragon Raiser?"
Hearing this man’s question, Ye Yun could not help but laugh. "Not at all, not at all. Fellow cultivators, you have mistaken me for someone else. I am just an ordinary Loose Cultivator, not any Dragon Raiser," Ye Yun replied with a laugh.
Disappointment immediately showed on the faces of the two middle-aged men. If he were a Dragon Raiser, they would have wanted to befriend him. But if he was just a Loose Cultivator, then there was no need.
"Fellow cultivators, do you happen to know which auction house in Yunxiao City is auctioning the young dragon?" Ye Yun asked, clasping his fists.
"Is our fellow cultivator also interested in the young dragon auction? The largest auction house in Yunxiao City, the Jinyu Auction House, is responsible for this auction. It should be starting soon," the burly middle-aged man on the left said with a smile.
"Indeed, I have some interest. If the opportunity arises, I would naturally like to bid for it," Ye Yun replied with a smile. Now that he had encountered a member of the Dragon Clan, he naturally could not let it pass. He did not care in the slightest if this Divine Dragon, bred by a Dragon Raiser, had been tampered with in any way.
"Fellow cultivator, since you are but a Loose Cultivator, I would advise you to withdraw from this auction," the other, more slender middle-aged man said. Seeing Ye Yun’s keen interest, he gave a wry smile and threw cold water on his enthusiasm.
Ye Yun was slightly taken aback. "Fellow cultivators, are you perhaps suggesting my financial resources are insufficient?" Ye Yun feigned annoyance.
"Fellow cultivator, you misunderstand!" the slender middle-aged man said, his expression awkward as he waved his hands repeatedly. "The main issue is that a prominent figure from a Divine Monarch Realm faction has come to Yunxiao City. He has made it clear he intends to acquire this young dragon as a gift for the Sky Ritual of the Jianyun Sect."
A gift for the Sky Ritual of the Jianyun Sect?
Ye Yun was momentarily stunned.
What on earth was happening?
A Sky Ritual... Could it be they intend to kill a dragon for it?
Seeing Ye Yun’s expression, the two middle-aged men exchanged a glance and could not help but chuckle lightly.
"Fellow cultivator, you are mistaken," the burly middle-aged man explained with a smile. "The Sky Ritual is not about killing a dragon to sacrifice to the heavens. It is because the Sword Sovereign of the Jianyun Sect is very fond of raising Divine Dragons. Therefore, many factions seeking favors from the Jianyun Sect will gift a young dragon."
"Even if one does not have a young dragon, offering a Dragon Egg is also acceptable," the slender middle-aged man added at this point.
"So that is how it is!" Ye Yun nodded, a look of sudden realization dawning on his face.
So, in the Divine Land nowadays, has it become fashionable to give Dragon Eggs or young dragons as gifts?
The Dragon Clan, once capable of contending with the Sacred Land Divines, had actually fallen to such a miserable state.
It truly made one feel helpless and desolate.

chapters.title: Chapter 393: The Hobbies of Sword Sovereign
chapters.content:
Chapter 393: Chapter 393: The Hobbies of Sword Sovereign
"My God! This world is too terrifying; even young dragons are auctioned and used as gifts. I’m glad I came with Master, or I too might have been captured if I had come alone."
Upon hearing the words of the two middle-aged men, a tempest raged in the heart of the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon.
However, it feigned composure, hovering motionlessly in the void.
"Gentlemen, what kind of organization is this Jianyun Sect? To think so many people are giving them gifts," Ye Yun asked with a smile.
"Brother, you must be from somewhere else, right?" the burly middle-aged man asked cautiously.
Ye Yun nodded.
"No wonder then. The Jianyun Sect is a Divine Monarch level force in our Daluo Region. They are exceedingly strong, especially the Sword Sovereign. His Practiced Sword Art is superb; with a cultivation base at the tenth layer of the Divine Monarch Realm, he can fight evenly with experts at the Half-step Divine Venerate Realm," the burly man explained. As he spoke, an expression of infinite yearning appeared in his eyes.
"So, it’s a Divine Monarch level force," Ye Yun nodded.
In the Divine Land, forces were categorized by cultivation realms. There were True God Realm level forces, like Star God Island in the Ninth Sea Area. There were also Divine Monarch level forces. A step higher, there were God Sovereign level forces, and even Divine King Realm level forces. Each increase in level signified a revolutionary change in the force’s power.
This so-called Jianyun Sect, possessing a great cultivator at the tenth layer of the Divine Monarch Realm, was clearly a top-tier existence among Divine Monarch level forces. And this Sword Sovereign, capable of defeating Half-step Divine Venerate Realm cultivators while only at the tenth layer of the Divine Monarch Realm, was undoubtedly unparalleled in the Sword Dao.
"Brother, the Jinyu Auction House has many other items up for auction. You can take a look at those. We’ll be heading off first." The burly middle-aged man cupped his fists with a smile, and then the two of them tore through the air and departed.
Ye Yun chuckled. These two True God Realm Tenth Layer cultivators were quite enthusiastic. He was surprised they had revealed such important information.
Ye Yun resolved to make a trip to Yunxiao City. He had to obtain that young dragon. If the Dragon Raiser appeared, Ye Yun would naturally capture him as well.
"Master, it’s hard to believe that the Dragon Clan, who once called the shots in the Cangnan Continent, have been reduced to mere gifts here in the Divine Land," the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon said with a bitter smile.
"It can’t be helped. The Dragon Clan was defeated in the ancient war. After all these years, they have completely withdrawn from the stage of history," Ye Yun stated calmly. He pressed his foot lightly and said softly, "Let’s go."
"Alrighty!" The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon took a deep breath, then swished its tail and flew forward.
They had flown for little more than a hundred li when suddenly, several beams of light descended from the sky, blocking Ye Yun’s path.
As the light dissipated, a burly man in purple robes emerged. His cultivation base had already reached the First Layer of the Divine Monarch Realm. He cupped his fists towards Ye Yun and said, "Might I ask if you are the Dragon Raiser? This young dragon... could you sell it directly to us?"
"Sir, you are mistaken. I am not the Dragon Raiser. This little dragon is merely my flying mount," Ye Yun cupped his fists and explained, a wry look on his face.
Why does everyone mistake me for a Dragon Raiser?
Little did they know, he himself was still looking for the Dragon Raiser.
Upon hearing Ye Yun’s reply, a look of disappointment crossed the purple-robed man’s face. He sighed and said, "My friend, the Jianyun Sect’s Heaven Ceremony is about to begin. Many people are currently searching for young dragons to present as gifts to the Sword Sect. Flying around so openly like this, you’re likely to attract unwanted attention."
"Thank you for the reminder!" Ye Yun said with a laugh.
Anyone who dares to target me must be tired of living.
Seeing Ye Yun’s confident and fearless demeanor, the purple-robed man shook his head, turned, and left.
This fellow actually acts like he’s from a reputable sect; he didn’t try to rob me,
Ye Yun thought with a faint smile. He had concealed his Super Divine Dragon Breath, making it difficult for ordinary people to discern his realm. Some, fearing hidden trump cards, would hesitate to make a move. However, there were also those who were bold and ruthless enough to seize things by force.
However, we aren’t far from Yunxiao City now. I wonder if anyone will still have time to make a move.
After those figures had flown some distance away, one of the men asked in a low voice, "Senior Brother, why didn’t we snatch that young dragon?"
The purple-robed man frowned and said, "That white-robed young man’s cultivation base is indiscernible. He might be far stronger than either of us. It’s best not to get involved in this mess."
The man hesitated before asking, "The young dragon at the Jinyu Auction House... if the Hegemon Sect makes a bid, will we even be able to secure it?"
"We’ll do our best. If that doesn’t work, we’ll just have to find other gifts for the Sword Sovereign," the purple-robed man replied.
"Besides raising dragons, I haven’t heard of the Sword Sovereign having any other hobbies," the man said, his brows furrowed.
The purple-robed man glanced around and whispered, "Rumor has it that the Sword Sovereign enjoys carving figurines from peach wood. Our sect has a dozen or so Thousand-year-old Peach Trees on its back hill. When the time comes, we can just cut them down and present them to the Sword Sovereign."
"The Sword Sovereign enjoys carving figurines? Senior Brother, how do you know this?" the man asked, his eyebrows shooting up in surprise.
"This Heaven Ceremony is said to be exceptionally grand, a rare event in the world. It will include many events, including the official renaming of the Jianyun Sect, and a mysterious expert is rumored to be challenging the Sword Sovereign... That’s why it’s causing such a stir. All the forces in the Daluo Region, big and small, are in an uproar, all trying to gather information and curry favor with the Sword Sovereign. So, just recently, this top-secret news—that the Sword Sovereign likes to carve figurines—somehow got out through certain channels."
"So that’s how it is..." the man said, a look of realization dawning on him.
"Indeed. I paid a hefty price for this information. If we can’t obtain a young dragon or a Dragon Egg, we can only settle for the next best thing," the purple-robed man said smugly.
"Senior Brother, I remember the Jianyun Sect used to be called the Green Luo Sword Sect. They changed their name once before, ten thousand years ago. So what’s this about an official name change now?" the man asked.
"That time, the Sword Sovereign suppressed his master and forcibly changed the sect’s name. It wasn’t very honorable, after all. But now that old codger has passed on, and everyone in the Daluo Region knows the Jianyun Sect’s true name. Taking advantage of this Heaven Ceremony, the Sword Sovereign has decided to formally announce the Jianyun Sect’s name in front of all the cultivators in the world," the purple-robed man said in a low voice.
Hearing his explanation, the others nodded silently. They said no more and quickly flew towards Yunxiao City.
Meanwhile, Ye Yun was still some distance from Yunxiao City. In terms of speed, he was far slower than the purple-robed man and his group. After all, the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon was only at the First Level of the Eternal Realm. In a solid world like the Divine Land, its flight speed was relatively slow.
WHOOSH! WHOOSH!
After flying for the time it takes an incense stick to burn, suddenly, seven or eight figures descended from the sky, blocking Ye Yun’s path.
A black-robed elder at their head stepped out from the group, cupped his fists, and said, "Might I ask if you are a Dragon Raiser?"
"No!" Ye Yun shook his head.
"Since you are not a Dragon Raiser, how about selling your young dragon to us?" The black-robed elder stared at Ye Yun, a chilling light flickering in his eyes, a trace of murderous intent visible on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 394: Extinct Sky Demon Sect, King of All Paths Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 394: Chapter 394: Extinct Sky Demon Sect, King of All Paths Dragon
"Not selling," Ye Yun declared.
His voice was soft but extremely firm. A smile crept onto his lips, his eyes shining brightly like two full moons as he observed the cultivators before him with keen interest.
The black-robed old man possessed the highest cultivation base, already at the Fourth-tier of the Divine Monarch Realm. Three of the seven people behind him had also reached the Divine Monarch Realm, and the remaining four were at the True God Realm. Among those in the True God Realm, the one with the weakest cultivation base was at the Eighth-tier of the True God Realm.
Such a powerful force, if placed in the Ten Great Ocean areas, would undoubtedly sweep across the entire region. No faction would dare to oppose them.
After this formidable force blocked Ye Yun’s path, he noticed that a number of cultivators had stopped not too far away, seemingly very interested. They were eager to see how this spectacle would end.
Ye Yun knew he had to make an example of someone.
Although appearing publicly under such circumstances was somewhat of an exposure, he had not tampered with the memories of the surrounding crowd. After all, they were in the Divine Land, where high-level cultivators were numerous. It would be much more difficult than before to use his Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye to modify the memories of such a large number of True Gods or Divine Monarch Realm experts.
And now, upon emerging from the Ancient Road to Heaven, Ye Yun had changed his appearance, making it impossible for anyone to discern his true identity. In this world of the Divine Land, no one would recognize him.
"Not selling?"
The black-robed old man was taken aback. He hadn’t expected the young man in white to refuse so directly.
Could it be that this youngster’s cultivation base is higher than mine?
He glanced around and noticed many people hovering in mid-air, waiting to watch the show, which made him a little irritated.
"Get lost!" the black-robed old man roared. He waved his hand, and a surge of powerful Mana blasted out like a tidal wave.
Most of the surrounding cultivators were not of a high level. Even if there were Divine Monarch Realm cultivators among them, they could not compete in numbers with the power of this small team led by the black-robed old man.
"Such an arrogant aura from the great demon of the Extinct Sky Demon Sect!"
"Truly worthy of being a Demon Cultivation force of the Divine Monarch Realm; we can’t afford to provoke them!"
"Let’s go, let’s go! These demons are going to kill for treasure; let’s stay far away..."
The expressions of the surrounding cultivators changed dramatically. They could not afford to provoke these great demons and hastily withdrew to a distance.
Seeing the crowd suddenly disperse, a sinister smile appeared on the face of the black-robed old man. He turned his gaze back to the young man in white before him.
The black-robed old man had a fierce look, gritted his teeth, and coldly bit out, "My friend, we are determined to have this young dragon. I hope you can understand the situation and not make a choice that is disadvantageous to yourself."
The eyes of the seven people behind the black-robed old man were also as cold as swords, aimed at Ye Yun.
At that moment, one of the men in the group sneered, "Even though our Extinct Sky Demon Sect has committed many heinous acts, we are always fair when conducting business."
"That’s right! Haha!" the others laughed boisterously.
"Make me understand the situation?" Ye Yun chuckled. What use were the pedantic threats of these Demon Sect cultivators? If they had attacked directly, Ye Yun might have respected them a little more.
"To tell you the truth, I’m also a bully. I’ve done far too many outrageous things in the past! Your Extinct Sky Demon Sect? Compared to me, you’re just a pile of trash," Ye Yun laughed loudly, a mocking expression in his eyes.
Before the other party could react, Ye Yun crossed his arms and sneered, "I’ll also give you a chance. I hope you understand the situation and avoid doing anything detrimental to the Extinct Sky Demon Sect."
Hearing the words of the white-clothed youth, the eight cultivators of the Extinct Sky Demon Sect felt their hearts skip a beat and couldn’t help but exchange glances.
This handsome young man, who doesn’t look fierce at all, could he also be a great demon?
The carefree demeanor of this young man in white made them suspicious.
Could it be... does he have some kind of trump card?
"Haha, when did the Extinct Sky Demon Sect become so dithering? If you’ve taken a fancy to someone’s young dragon, just snatch it! Why waste breath chattering here? It’s truly disgraceful!"
A powerful male voice cut through the air from a distance.
Immediately, a flash of golden light appeared, revealing a middle-aged man dressed in a golden dragon robe. This middle-aged man was tall and sturdy, with thick brows and a pair of radiant, panther-like eyes. He stood in the void with his hands behind his back, his body emanating a powerful aura. He was clearly a great cultivator at the Fourth-tier of the Divine Monarch Realm.
The black-robed old man looked at the middle-aged man before him, his expression sinking. His eyelids narrowed slightly, concealing the glint in his eyes, as he said lightly, "Sir, are you perhaps the King of All Paths Dragon from the All-Path Divine Nation?"
The gold-robed man in the void was indeed the King of All Paths Dragon. At that moment, a trace of an arrogant smile touched his lips as he said solemnly, "I’ve heard that the Extinct Sky Demon Sect has a total of seven great demons. You must be the third-ranked Breaking Heaven Demon Lord, correct?"
"Correct," the black-robed old man nodded. He looked at the King of All Paths Dragon with great solemnity, countless thoughts flashing through his mind.
Without a doubt, the King of All Paths Dragon was also here for the young dragon from the Cloud Heaven Gold Jade Auction House in Yunxiao City. Now, outside the city, seeing the green young dragon controlled by the young man in white, he too had developed thoughts of snatching it.
Thus, their objectives aligned, and conflict was inevitable.
While the black-robed old man was contemplating, the King of All Paths Dragon squinted slightly, two beams of divine light shooting from his eyes towards the white-clothed young man in the distance.
