The young man in white was exceptionally mysterious; his Super Divine Dragon Breath was dim and indistinct, making it difficult to discern his true cultivation base.
However, the King of All Paths Dragon was very familiar with all the major and minor factions in the Daluo Region. He had never seen this white-robed young man before. This meant that the mysterious white-robed young man was not from the Daluo Region.
Did he really come to the Daluo Region alone, thinking it wasn’t a Dragon Pool Tiger’s Den?
"Someone still dares to call himself the King of All Paths Dragon? That name... is far too arrogant," Ye Yun shook his head. His aversion to this King of All Paths Dragon was even stronger than his dislike for the black-robed old man. Possessing ninety-nine percent of the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline and being infinitely close to the Ancestor Dragon, Ye Yun naturally found the title "King of All Paths Dragon" extremely grating.
"You, come here." Ye Yun’s expression turned slightly cold. He stretched out his hand, and an invisible force seized the King of All Paths Dragon, forcibly dragging him from the distant void to stand before him.
"You call yourself King of All Paths Dragon?" Ye Yun looked down from above, his face indifferent as he stared at the King of All Paths Dragon below him.
"I..." Gazing at the white-robed young man before him, the King of All Paths Dragon felt as if he were facing the most terrifying demon in the world; he was instantly scared out of his wits.
With his cultivation base at the Fourth-tier of the Divine Monarch Realm, he had been captured and brought before this white-robed young man with a single gesture, without any warning and without any ability to resist.
How terrifying could the other party’s strength be?
To render him incapable of resistance, the opponent had to be at least three realms higher than him.
Is this a great cultivator at the Seventh Realm of God King?
the King of All Paths Dragon guessed wildly, his heart pounding.
What? The King of All Paths Dragon was captured?
The black-robed old man watched as the young man in white reached out and pulled the King of All Paths Dragon before him, while the King of All Paths Dragon was completely immobilized.
A cold sweat instantly broke out all over his body; his heart felt as if it had leaped into his throat, and he was nearly frightened to death.
The seven people behind him also turned pale, sweating profusely and shivering, almost unable to stand steady.

chapters.title: Chapter 395: How about Calling it the Vandao Snake Emperor
chapters.content:
Chapter 395: Chapter 395: How about Calling it the Vandao Snake Emperor
How terrifying!
What kind of cultivation base does this mysterious white-robed youth possess?!
The King of All Paths Dragon, a Fourth-tier Divine Monarch, was like a feeble ant in his hands, utterly incapable of resisting.
Even if all eight cultivators from our Extinct Sky Demon Sect attacked him together, they might not be his match.
The black-robed old man felt a chill as if plunged into an ice cellar, yet he was drenched in a cold sweat.
He secretly guessed that the white-robed youth’s cultivation base must be at least at the seventh-tier of the Divine Monarch Realm.
"Damn it, isn’t that the King of All Paths Dragon? How did he get captured so easily by that white-robed youth? What kind of Divine Skill is this?"
"Too terrifying! So, this white-robed youth is a reclusive expert."
"Let’s get away from here, quickly! If we provoke this expert, we little True Gods won’t be able to withstand his fury."
The distant onlookers’ expressions changed drastically, and they all turned and fled.
They couldn’t even afford to provoke the cultivators from the Extinct Sky Demon Sect, let alone this mysterious white-robed youth.
In an instant, the surrounding void was empty; not a soul remained.
Seeing the King of All Paths Dragon’s face pale and his forehead covered in cold sweat, his mouth agape but speechless, Ye Yun’s expression turned cold.
"You’re called the King of All Paths Dragon?" From between his teeth, Ye Yun bit out a few chilling words.
It wouldn’t have mattered if he hadn’t known before. But now that they had met, Ye Yun was definitely going to take care of this fellow.
"I am... the King of All Paths Dragon..." The King of All Paths Dragon opened his mouth and said with great difficulty, "We have no grievances or enmity between us. Why have you captured me, Your Excellency?"
"I don’t like the look of you. Is that reason enough?" Ye Yun replied with a faint smile.
He suddenly raised his hand and, SMACK! He delivered a crisp slap to the King of All Paths Dragon’s face.
Ye Yun hadn’t used much force in this slap, fearing he might kill the King of All Paths Dragon with one blow.
But even so, the King of All Paths Dragon saw stars, his head swam, and he nearly fainted.
At this moment, the King of All Paths Dragon wanted to cry.
He was just passing by, intending to watch a good show. He never thought he’d be the first to be dragged into this mess. He did have ulterior motives, coveting that young green dragon. However, taking on eight members of the Extinct Sky Demon Sect alone was too difficult for him. Initially, he hadn’t taken this white-robed youth seriously. But the King of All Paths Dragon had never dreamed that the white-robed youth’s strength would be so terrifying. Truly a reclusive powerhouse. This time, he had truly run into bad luck, like walking a dark path at night and crashing headfirst into an iron plate.
"Let’s go."
Not far away, the black-robed old man saw Ye Yun viciously slap the King of All Paths Dragon. He shivered, made a hand gesture, and immediately turned to flee with the other seven.
"Still thinking of leaving?" Ye Yun sneered. Innumerable tiny, star-like runes appeared in his eyes, and a power of annihilation and creation instantly descended.
As the eight members of the Extinct Sky Demon Sect tried to flee, their bodies instantly dissolved into particles, rapidly dispersing between heaven and earth.
The storage rings of these eight people transformed into streaks of light and flew into Ye Yun’s hands, who then put them away.
He could use the contents of these storage rings later at the Jinyu Auction House. Although the resources in Ye Yun’s inventory were inexhaustible, their grades were too high, and he didn’t want to reveal them casually.
HISS!
The King of All Paths Dragon sucked in a cold breath. Witnessing the eight powerful cultivators from the Extinct Sky Demon Sect turn to ash and smoke before his very eyes, he nearly wet himself in terror.
What exactly was that Divine Skill? It’s far too terrifying!
He hadn’t even seen the white-robed youth make any move, yet the eight fleeing individuals had silently dissolved into particles and vanished. They didn’t even have time to utter a single scream. Their physical bodies and Primordial Spirits had disintegrated simultaneously, turning into those particles...
At this thought, the King of All Paths Dragon felt a bone-chilling cold, as if he had fallen into an ice cellar, and terror surged in his heart.
He knew that with his meager Fourth-tier Divine Monarch Realm cultivation, he wasn’t even considered an ant in the other’s eyes.
Closing his eyes, the King of All Paths Dragon prepared for death.
SLAP!
Ye Yun delivered another slap, this one landing on the other half of the King of All Paths Dragon’s face. Both sides of his face immediately swelled up red. The once majestic King of All Paths Dragon now looked utterly wretched.
"Why are you called the King of All Paths Dragon?" Ye Yun gazed at the golden-robed man before him and asked again coolly.
He hadn’t killed the King of All Paths Dragon. Instead, he had first dealt with the eight cultivators from the Extinct Sky Demon Sect. Those eight had harbored murderous intent towards Ye Yun from the start, wanting to kill him and seize the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon. Therefore, Ye Yun showed no mercy and directly annihilated them, body and soul.
As for this King of All Paths Dragon...
Ye Yun still had some use for him, so he wouldn’t kill him for now.
I’m not dead? I only got slapped?
The King of All Paths Dragon, who had closed his eyes expecting death, felt a flicker of joy in his heart upon receiving another slap instead.
The unfathomable young man in white had slapped him and repeatedly asked the same question; this clearly meant he didn’t intend to kill him!
The King of All Paths Dragon felt a surge of excitement and quickly opened his eyes.
"Senior..." he said respectfully, his form of address having changed. "Our Van Dao Divine Dynasty’s Imperial Family specializes in cultivating the Ten Thousand Dragons Divine Art. Therefore, every generation’s Emperor is called the King of All Paths Dragon..." The King of All Paths Dragon spoke with a humble and sincere expression.
"Ten Thousand Dragons Divine Art?" Ye Yun was slightly taken aback. "Oh?" he said with interest. "Come, come, perform it for me to see."
After saying that, Ye Yun released the pressure that had been pinning down the King of All Paths Dragon.
The King of All Paths Dragon felt his body lighten. He hurriedly moved his limbs and found that he could indeed move. He couldn’t help but heave a long sigh of relief.
This Senior before him was truly eccentric. The reason he hadn’t killed him was, surprisingly, just to have him demonstrate the Ten Thousand Dragons Divine Art.
"Senior, since you wish to see it, I shall demonstrate it for you."
The King of All Paths Dragon took a deep breath. Suddenly, his body erupted with myriad shafts of brilliant, dazzling golden light. Within the golden light behind him, ripples appeared, and over a thousand Golden Divine Dragons materialized. Each Golden Divine Dragon, condensed from Divine Skills, was lifelike, baring its fangs and brandishing its claws, its aura majestic.
"Alright, that’s enough. You can stop," Ye Yun said calmly, his eyelids lowered slightly.
He could roughly deduce some of the offensive maneuvers of the Ten Thousand Dragons Divine Art. In his eyes, it wasn’t weak. Compared to the three Ultimate Techniques of the Dragon God Sect, it was naturally somewhat stronger. After all, this Van Dao Divine Dynasty was a God King Level power, while his Dragon God Sect was merely an Eternal Level sect.
"King of All Paths Dragon, I can spare your life, but from now on, you need to change your title," Ye Yun stated calmly, his voice carrying an irresistible, supreme majesty, like the might of the heavens.
Change my title?
The King of All Paths Dragon stared, unable to believe his ears.
Why is this Senior so strange? He’s sparing my life, and all I have to do is change my title?
"Senior, may I ask... what title would you have me change to?" the King of All Paths Dragon ventured, plucking up his courage.
"What title should it be?" Ye Yun raised his head, gazed towards the distant horizon, and mused aloud, "How about... you just call yourself the Vandao Snake Emperor..."

chapters.title: Chapter 396: Yunxiao City, Goodbye Dragon Raiser
chapters.content:
Chapter 396: Chapter 396: Yunxiao City, Goodbye Dragon Raiser
Vandao Snake Emperor?
Upon hearing this name bestowed upon him by the senior, the King of All Paths Dragon was so shocked he nearly spat out a mouthful of old blood. His body trembled, his mind reeled, and he couldn’t control himself.
He was the distinguished King of All Paths Dragon, a noble figure occupying a position above all others, his influence reverberating throughout the Daluo Region. If he were to change his name to Vandao Snake Emperor, wouldn’t he become the laughingstock of all cultivators in the Daluo Region?
Wouldn’t that be equivalent to killing him?
The King of All Paths Dragon’s face was pale, tinged with a livid hue. He wanted to refuse but didn’t know how to voice it.
He was also afraid that if he spoke rudely, he would offend this senior and share the same fate as the Breaking Heaven Demon Lord.
Just as he was feeling uneasy, Ye Yun suddenly laughed.
Although there wasn’t anything inherently wrong with the title Vandao Snake Emperor, Ye Yun guessed it would be more unbearable for the King of All Paths Dragon than death itself.
"How about this?" Ye Yun said with a casual smile. "Remove the ’Dragon’ character. As for the rest of your title, it’s up to you."
He absolutely could not allow a name like King of All Paths Dragon to appear in the Divine Land. The reason he spared the King of All Paths Dragon’s life was because this title was widely known and deeply ingrained in the Divine Land.
To shatter this ingrained impression, the King of All Paths Dragon had to live and personally announce his change of title to the entire Daluo Region. That way, the old title of King of All Paths Dragon would gradually fade from people’s minds, and many perceptions would shift.
"Senior, perhaps you are a lover of dragons, and my title might have offended you. As for what my new title should be, why not let an esteemed elder like yourself decide?" the King of All Paths Dragon said humbly.
He worried that any new title he chose might displease this senior, who could kill him with a mere gesture. That would be a truly unjust end. Besides, the senior had just given him a chance by not forcing him to be called Vandao Snake Emperor. It seemed this senior didn’t genuinely want to kill him.
"Since you are the emperor of the Van Dao Divine Dynasty, how about calling yourself the Ten Thousand Paths God Emperor?" Ye Yun suggested after a moment’s thought.
"Thank you, Senior," the King of All Paths Dragon hurriedly bowed, a smile of relief spreading across his face.
No, he should now be called the Ten Thousand Paths God Emperor. That name wasn’t bad at all. If proclaimed to the world, it likely wouldn’t cause any controversy.
The Ten Thousand Paths God Emperor felt his heart settle.
"You may return. I will oversee the matter of your proclamation to the world," Ye Yun said, waving his hand with a faint smile.
"Senior, please rest assured. I will announce it to the world as soon as I return." The Ten Thousand Paths God Emperor performed a fist-and-palm salute and then turned to leave.
"Let’s go too," Ye Yun said softly to the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon.
The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon agreed and continued flying towards Yunxiao City.
His master had used some Great Divine Power to effortlessly kill several cultivators in the Divine Monarch Realm. This left the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon utterly astounded. His master was simply too strong. This kind of invisible killing Divine Skill was extraordinarily terrifying and impossible to guard against. Fortunately, it was the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon who had subdued him that day. If his master had been the one to act, the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon felt he would have long since been reduced to particles and dissipated.
The rest of the journey was surprisingly smooth; no impertinent cultivators dared to appear again.
As they neared Yunxiao City, Ye Yun had the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon revert to his human form. They flew to the gates of Yunxiao City. Although guards were on duty, none dared to obstruct Ye Yun. The two of them easily entered Yunxiao City.
Ye Yun’s gaze swept around, and he quickly located the Jinyu Auction House, then headed over with the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon.
Yunxiao City was extremely large, with a constant flow of people moving back and forth like a weaver’s shuttle. All of them were cultivators; even the weakest were at the Eternal Realm.
"Sir, I’m afraid my cultivation is the lowest in this entire city," the green-robed young man said with a bitter smile, his self-esteem taking a heavy blow as he shook his head.
"There’s no comparison between you and them. Don’t forget, you’re from the Cangnan Continent." Ye Yun smiled faintly and patted the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon’s shoulder. "Don’t belittle yourself in the future. The path of cultivation lies within. Only with a strong heart can one truly become powerful."
"I understand, Sir." The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon suddenly felt as if he had been enlightened; his expression turned solemn, and he nodded hurriedly.
Ye Yun said no more and continued towards the Jinyu Auction House. He walked at a leisurely pace, observing the bustling streets and silently taking in the local customs and atmosphere. If the auction hadn’t been about to start, Ye Yun would have liked to find a restaurant and sample some local dishes.
They soon arrived at the Jinyu Auction House.
Upon entering, Ye Yun stated his purpose, and a young attendant immediately led them to a large auction hall on the top floor. Ye Yun entered a private room and waited quietly.
In front of him was a small mirror. Spirit Stones were embedded in its back, and it displayed the scene at the auction hall’s main stage.
Live broadcast, huh...
Seeing the image on the small mirror, Ye Yun couldn’t help but recall certain things from before his transmigration, and he chuckled with a touch of sentimentality.
After waiting for two hours, the auction finally began.
A curvaceous and enchanting woman, at True God Realm Tier Seven, walked onto the auction platform. After a brief opening speech, the official auction began.
The initial items auctioned were some magical artifacts and elixirs. Ye Yun had no interest in these and merely watched as an observer.
He attempted to scan the entire Jinyu Auction House with his Divine Sense but found numerous restrictions preventing its passage. Ye Yun could easily break through them by force. However, that would cause too much of a commotion and might unnecessarily alert his targets.
Ye Yun also wanted to see if the Dragon Raiser would appear during the final auction segment for the young dragon, so he refrained from using his Divine Sense to scan further and waited quietly.
"Esteemed guests, our auction has now reached its final and most anticipated segment! We will be auctioning a young dragon of the Eternal Realm!" The hostess’s clear and melodious voice, like a silver bell, echoed throughout the auction hall.
This announcement immediately ignited a fire in the hearts of the cultivators waiting in the surrounding private rooms.
"This time, my Hegemon Sect is determined to obtain it. I ask all fellow Daoists to grant me this favor. I, Wang, will be immensely grateful." A powerful, masculine voice, like a great bell, boomed throughout the auction hall and into every private room.
The Hegemon Sect really is here. It looks like we don’t stand a chance this time.
I hear Sect Master Wang Teng is a mighty cultivator at the Seventh Realm of God King. His strength is formidable. Even if someone manages to win the auction, they probably wouldn’t be able to keep the young dragon once they leave Yunxiao City.
It’s best not to compete with him. As for the Sword Sovereign, we can just send some other gifts...
Various discussions arose in the private rooms. Faced with the Hegemon Sect’s declaration, most chose to exercise restraint.
As Ye Yun watched the mirror, his expression suddenly shifted.
He saw a man dressed entirely in black slowly walk onto the stage. His body was completely covered in black fabric, and he wore a mask. Even his hands were covered with black gloves, making it impossible to discern his true appearance.
In his left hand, the black-clad man held a clear, crystalline bead. Inside the bead, a miniature golden dragon was swimming restlessly.
Dragon Raiser?
Ye Yun’s eyebrows twitched, an almost imperceptible glint of cold light flashing in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 397: Successful Auction, Acquiring the Five-clawed Golden Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 397: Chapter 397: Successful Auction, Acquiring the Five-clawed Golden Dragon
"Heh, such a cunning Dragon Raiser. This man in black is merely a puppet."
Ye Yun’s eyes flickered with divine light, and he instantly saw through the man in black’s true nature.
This puppet looked rather different from those at the Moon and Star Dragon Temple.
The biggest difference was that this Dragon Raiser’s puppet from the Jinyu Auction House had distinct facial features, indistinguishable from a human’s.
Whereas the two puppets that appeared on Moon Star were faceless.
The Dragon Raiser’s puppet at today’s auction didn’t have a high cultivation base, merely at the first layer of the Divine Monarch Realm.
Ye Yun’s gaze shifted slightly.
An almost unnoticeable mark was instantly planted on the man in black.
The man in black was completely unaware.
Ye Yun planned to use this man in black to find the Dragon Raiser’s main lair.
"Ladies and gentlemen, the item for auction this time is a Five-clawed Golden Dragon. The auction starts now! The starting price is five billion Spirit Stones!"
The female host’s voice rang out.
"I bid six billion! No one else bother competing with me. Miss, this price should be quite good, right?"
In a certain private room, Wang Teng of the Hegemon Sect chuckled coldly.
"..."
The female host remained expressionless; naturally, she hoped the price would go higher.
However, the Hegemon Sect was formidable, and their Jinyu Auction House was unwilling to provoke them.
"Six billion Spirit Stones, that’s truly a terrifying figure..."
The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon looked shocked.
"The Spirit Stones of the Divine Land contain Divine Nature and are far superior to those of the Cangnan Continent," Ye Yun said with a smile, looking into the reflective surface of the private room.
He had already scanned the Spirit Stones in those storage rings.
They totaled seven billion.
"Seven billion," Ye Yun announced directly.
Anyway, those storage rings also contained some other pills and magic treasures. All told, they should be worth around ten billion.
This was all an unexpected windfall, so spending it wouldn’t pain him.
What? Someone dares to compete with me, the Sect Master?
In a private room, Wang Teng, dressed in a green robe, wore a displeased expression.
"Eight billion," he called out bluntly, another astonishing figure.
"Nine billion," Ye Yun followed.
No matter the cost, he had to acquire this Five-clawed Golden Dragon.
Seeing another high bid coming from that private room, Wang Teng’s face turned livid. With a wave of his hand, he declared, "Nine and a half billion!"
"Ten billion," Ye Yun countered again, without the slightest hesitation.
The continuous bidding suppressed Wang Teng of the Hegemon Sect, immediately sparking speculation among the cultivators from various factions in the other private rooms.
"Who on earth is this person? Daring to challenge the Hegemon Sect, he’s incredibly bold!"
"The Hegemon Sect has always been domineering. Haha, they’ve finally met a strong opponent today!"
Cultivators from different factions had varied expressions, all feeling a sense of admiration for the mysterious individual who had suddenly emerged.
They were eager to see the Hegemon Sect suffer a setback.
Just as Wang Teng was about to bid again, an elder beside him quickly tugged his sleeve.
"Sect Master, why lower yourself to his level? If he has the guts to buy it, then our Hegemon Sect has the guts to intercept it," the elder said with a cold chuckle.
"A valid point."
Wang Teng laughed heartily, a predatory glint in his eyes, and did not continue bidding.
The female host called out three times. Seeing no further bids, she brought down the gavel, concluding the auction and announcing the ownership of the young dragon.
An elder from the auction house entered Ye Yun’s private room.
Ye Yun tossed all eight storage rings to the elder.
"There should be ten billion worth in there. If it’s not enough, I’ll make up the difference..." Ye Yun said casually.
"Very well, Sir. I will go verify it immediately. Please wait a moment."
The elder took the eight rings and respectfully retreated.
After some time, the elder re-entered the private room.
Beside him stood the beautiful host, holding a small, transparent orb.
"Sir, your rings are worth a total of ten billion five hundred million Spirit Stones. After deducting the auction price, five hundred million Spirit Stones remain, and they are now in this ring. As for this young dragon, please accept it," the elder said courteously, placing a storage ring on the table.
Ye Yun nodded.
He hadn’t expected there to be an extra five hundred million Spirit Stones. It seemed this auction house conducted its business honorably, which made a rather good impression on him.
Ye Yun accepted the storage ring and took the crystalline bead from the host.
Watching the little golden dragon swimming restlessly inside, Ye Yun’s gaze softened.
Such a pitiful Little Dragon.
Even though the Dragon Raiser had sold it, a potent restriction was still deeply embedded within its body. No matter what level of cultivation it reached in the future, the Dragon Raiser could claim its life at any moment.
Ye Yun’s eyes flickered.
He wasn’t concerned when he noticed that the Dragon Raiser had hurriedly left Yunxiao City after receiving the Spirit Stones.
He had already placed a mark on that puppet; it couldn’t possibly escape his control.
Ye Yun put away the crystalline bead and, with the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon, walked out of the Jinyu Auction House.
Just as he reached the entrance, he saw two people standing outside, staring coldly at him.
"So it was you who bought the Five-clawed Golden Dragon. I was wondering what kind of extraordinary person it might be," Wang Teng said coldly, a mocking look in his eyes.
"What, you still have a problem with it?" Ye Yun asked with a faint smile, his indifferent gaze meeting Wang Teng’s.
He had long since noticed Wang Teng’s movements and had deliberately revealed the aura of the fifth layer of the Divine Monarch Realm.
Naturally, he also wanted to set a trap for Wang Teng, to make that arrogant fellow act against him sooner.
"You just wait," Wang Teng sneered, a sinister smile flashing across his face before he turned and left with the elder.
Ye Yun smiled, a look of anticipation in his eyes.
Wang Teng came for the young dragon, so he must have at least ten billion Spirit Stones in his storage ring.
Killing this fellow would mean another small fortune. Not bad at all.
Although he didn’t need it himself, he could take it back for the juniors and demon beasts of the Dragon God Sect to use.
After all, the Spirit Stones here contained Divine Nature, their quality far surpassing those from the Cangnan Continent.
"Sir, do you require protection? Our Jinyu Auction House has an expert at the seventh layer of the Divine Monarch Realm who can assist you," the beautiful auctioneer said with a smile, slowly walking up to Ye Yun and looking at his handsome face.
"No need."
Ye Yun smiled nonchalantly and immediately left the Jinyu Auction House, heading towards the gates of Yunxiao City.
"What a pity!"
The beautiful auctioneer watched Ye Yun’s retreating figure, a hint of regret in her eyes.
After leaving the city, Ye Yun had flown only about ten li when two beams of light descended from the sky, blocking his path from the left and right.
"Kid, hand over the young dragon, and I might spare your life!" Wang Teng stood with his hands clasped behind his back, his powerful aura surging like a flaming volcano. He looked at Ye Yun and laughed with extreme arrogance.
The elder beside him was also a powerful cultivator at the sixth layer of the Divine Monarch Realm.
Their powerful auras swept forth like a tidal wave.
Ye Yun remained unmoved.
His eyes were calm, and the corners of his lips curled up into a bright smile as he retorted, "You hand over your storage ring, and perhaps I’ll let you live."
"What?" Wang Teng was stunned.
Spare *my* life?
Wang Teng burst into laughter looking at the audacious young man in white.
This unknown young man in white is certainly arrogant!
What? Such speed!
The next moment, Wang Teng’s laughter froze. To his horror, a palm suddenly appeared before his eyes without any warning.
SLAP!
A crisp sound echoed.
Half of Wang Teng’s face was struck by Ye Yun’s slap, immediately turning red and swelling high.

chapters.title: Chapter 398 Kui Bull Overlord Body, One Sword Kill
chapters.content:
Chapter 398: Chapter 398 Kui Bull Overlord Body, One Sword Kill
SMACK!
A crisp slap zoomed across the sky, leaving Wang Teng seeing stars. Half of his face quickly swelled up. Before he had a chance to react, the white figure in front of him faded away abruptly. Not only did Wang Teng fail to react in time, but the old man next to him was also caught off guard.
HISS!
Such incredible speed!
With a terrified look, the old man stared at the young man in the white robe, his forehead instantly covered in sweat and his heart pounding rapidly.
If the white-robed youth had been holding a sword, at such close distance, he probably would have already slashed at the Sect Master’s neck.
The thought made the old man quickly summon a Mysterious Yellow Pagoda, which hovered above his head. Rays of light descended from the pagoda, defending him and Wang Teng. This pagoda was an Emperor Level Defensive Treasure.
Only when he saw that the light was covering him entirely did the old man breathe a sigh of relief.
"Sect Master, are you alright?" the old man asked softly.
His words brought Wang Teng back to his senses.
"How dare you ambush me? I’ll make this vile fellow pay!"
Wang Teng touched his swollen cheek and secretly used his Mana; the swelling disappeared instantly.
With a wave of his hand, two large hammers appeared. These hammers, shaped like gigantic black pumpkins, were covered in a glossy black sheen, with fine patterns all over that made them look incredibly robust.
The hammerheads were several times larger than a human head. Wang Teng gripped the hammers, his Super Divine Dragon Breath surged, making him seem like a Demon King descending upon the world.
"Oh, another hammer-user. It’s a shame the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon isn’t here." Ye Yun licked his lips and smiled nonchalantly.
Even if the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon were here, it would not have been a match for Wang Teng, who was at the Seventh Realm of God King. This fellow is the so-called sect master of the Overlord Sect and uses hammers as his weapons; he must have some brute force.
「Outside Yunxiao City.」
There were quite a few cultivators passing by.
Many people recognized Wang Teng from the Hegemon Sect, so everyone watched the scene from a distance in the void.
Because Ye Yun was too quick, none of those cultivators had noticed that Wang Teng had been slapped.
Among them, there was only one cultivator who was at the God Monarch Realm third layer; most were in the True God Realm.
"Wang Teng of the Hegemon Sect is about to make his move... That young man in white is at the God Monarch Realm fifth layer. There’s a two-minor-realm gap; does Wang Teng still need his Overlord Hammer?" a middle-aged cultivator hiding high in the sky murmured.
Next to him, an elder, stroking his long beard, frowned and said, "I don’t understand! Logically, this Wang Teng possesses the Kui Bull Overlord Body. His strength is boundless and as hard as diamond. Dealing with a cultivator of the God Monarch Realm fifth layer, one punch should be enough to make his opponent vomit blood..."
"You are right, Elder Brother. This is perplexing to me too," the middle-aged man nodded in agreement.
The two of them belonged to smaller factions, and their cultivation base was only at the True God Realm. Thus, they could not clearly see the details of the upcoming battle.
This wasn’t just true for these two.
In the surrounding void, about a few hundred cultivators were all discussing amongst themselves.
Many held great admiration for the young man in the white robe.
Facing Wang Teng of the Overlord Sect and not running away immediately after seeing his Overlord Hammer was a sign of courage that they admired.
"Maybe that young man at the God Monarch Realm fifth layer has some formidable techniques," a God Monarch Realm First Layer elder sighed.
After all, those who could cultivate to the Divine Monarch Realm were no fools; they all had their own life-saving skills.
Some possessed powerful magical treasures, while others had unpredictable escape arts. These could enhance their chances of survival when facing a stronger enemy.
Above Yunxiao City, several young cultivators floated, their cultivation ranging from True God Realm Tier Seven to Tier Ten.
One of the youths, arms crossed, stared into the distance and suddenly burst into laughter.
"Haha, is that kid scared stupid? What a blockhead! Who does he think Wang Teng is? That’s the Sect Master of the Hegemon Sect, possessing the Kui Bull Overlord Body, unbeatable among those of the same realm!"
"That kid’s as good as dead! I heard he caused a stir at the Jinyu Auction House and disrespected Sect Master Wang Teng. He deserves this!" another young man nearby chuckled coldly.
"To die early is to reincarnate early; it might not be a bad thing," yet another young man laughed faintly.
"Haha..."
The group exchanged glances and burst into laughter.
Ye Yun heard all the voices around him, but the words of these young men sparked a flicker of anger in his heart.
Ye Yun gave them a cursory glance and flicked his finger lightly.
SWOOSH!
A sword light burst out.
The young man who had spoken of dying early didn’t even have time to react before he was struck by the sword light, exploding into a mist of blood, his body and Primordial Spirit utterly destroyed.
"So strong! Everyone, run!"
These True God-stage youths were immediately scared out of their wits.
However, after killing the first young man, the sword light split into four, striking the remaining youths.
PUFF! PUFF!
A series of muffled sounds arose. The youths didn’t even have time to scream before they all turned into mists of blood.
Not even their Primordial Spirits escaped.
Seeing this, Wang Teng was furious, his blood boiling. He roared, "Kill!"
After activating his Kui Bull Overlord Body, his voice was filled with immense power, like rolling thunder, shaking the void in all directions.
Some True God cultivators with weaker cultivation bases were instantly shocked to the point of vomiting blood and hurriedly fled.
This showed that once the Kui Bull Overlord Body was activated, even a single roar possessed such formidable power.
One could only imagine how terrifyingly strong Wang Teng’s physical body must be.
The old man beside Wang Teng also drew a sword, ready to provide support at any moment.
"It seems that one slap wasn’t enough to wake you up." Ye Yun couldn’t help but smile faintly as he watched Wang Teng descend from the sky with a furious aura, his two black hammers shattering the void.
Truth be told, he could end Wang Teng’s life with just a glance. A poke of his finger could crush this so-called Kui Bull Overlord Body. He had countless ways to kill Wang Teng.
However, Ye Yun leisurely drew a Silver Sword. This Silver Sword was quite ordinary, stored in his inventory; it was a very trashy Emperor Level Lower Quality Treasure Sword.
At this moment, Ye Yun, dressed in snow-white robes, exuded an exceptional, detached aura. With an indifferent gaze, he swung his sword, and a startling flash streaked across the void.
This flash was unimaginably fast.
It seemed to have surpassed the ultimate speed of this world.
"This—?"
Wang Teng was now only about thirty to fifty feet away from Ye Yun.
Then, his eyes widened abruptly, staring fixedly as that thin ray of sword light landed between his eyebrows.
SPLAT!
Though thin, the sword light contained an unimaginable divine might.
With the Kui Bull Overlord Body activated, Wang Teng’s body was harder than diamond.
But even so, the sword light easily pierced his glabella.
"Ugh..."
With a low, pained groan, Wang Teng’s burly body suddenly froze in mid-air.
WHOOSH!
A thin line of blood suddenly appeared on his forehead. The blood line expanded, and a jet of blood mixed with white brain matter violently spurted out.

chapters.title: Chapter 399: The Mysterious Challenger of the Sword Sovereign is Him
chapters.content:
Chapter 399: Chapter 399: The Mysterious Challenger of the Sword Sovereign is Him
"You... how can you be so strong?"
With his eyes unfocused, Wang Teng forced an eerie smile and spoke to Ye Yun with great effort.
Soon after he finished, the crack on his forehead rapidly enlarged. His head was split into two halves. The crack extended, dividing Wang Teng’s whole body into two parts. His bisected form, its halves bleeding profusely, sprayed droplets of blood across the vast emptiness.
Despite his death, the two Black Hammers gripped in his severed hands remained clenched, falling heavily from the air.
BOOM! BOOM!
The two halves of his body slammed into the ground, creating two deep pits—a terrifying sight to behold.
With an unadorned slash, Ye Yun executed Wang Teng, the Sect Master of Overlord Sect.
The old man from the Overlord Sect, witnessing this scene, was horrified.
This white-clothed youth’s Swordsmanship was too formidable. Almost unparalleled.
In his memory, it seemed only the Sword Sovereign could muster such a potent Killing Sword Technique.
"Please spare my life, Senior," the old man pleaded, kneeling in mid-air, his spirit shattered.
He knew that in the face of this white-clothed youth’s peerless sword technique, his life was as brittle as paper, unable to withstand a single blow.
"Just now, you wanted to kill me. Do you think I’m that bored?" Ye Yun asked with a faint smile.
The silver sword light flickered and vanished into thin air. This sliver of sword light, infused with unimaginable divine power, effortlessly penetrated the cascading golden light of the Yellow Treasure Tower.
THWACK!
The old man screamed, also cleaved into two halves by Ye Yun’s blade, utterly annihilated in body and soul.
One sword, one kill. Easy and clean.
HISS...
The myriad Cultivators who watched the scene were chilled to the bone, gasping for breath.
"Terrifying! There are few people in this world who can withstand the unmatched power of this Killing Sword Technique!" a Divine Monarch of the Third Layer, deeply shaken, muttered to himself.
At this moment, a cold sweat had broken out on his back. Even from a great distance, he could still feel the oppressive aura of death.
"In our Daluo Region, perhaps only the Sword Sovereign could compete with this white-clothed youth," another Divine Monarch Realm powerhouse whispered, unable to conceal his inner turmoil.
"At the Grand Sacrifice, the mysterious powerhouse who challenged the Sword Sovereign—could it be this person?" a Divine Monarch Realm man suddenly announced aloud, his eyes brightening.
His voice instantly resonated with everyone present. The white-clothed youth’s unrivaled Swordsmanship slaughtered the Kui Bull Overlord Body as if he were butchering a dog. The old man from the Hegemon Sect, even with the protection of an Emperor artifact, was still penetrated by that sword light. This showed the horrifying power of this Swordsmanship.
"No doubt! The mysterious powerhouse who challenged the Sword Sovereign must be this man!"
"You’re absolutely right!"
The surrounding Cultivators, each with an excited expression, gazed at the distant white silhouette with fervor in their eyes. Just how powerful would his Swordsmanship have to be to challenge the Sword Sovereign?
A True God Realm Cultivator laughed aloud. "HAHA! How pitiful Wang Teng of the Overlord Sect is, daring to compete for the young dragon that someone else obtained from the Jinyu Auction House. How ridiculous!"
"That Wang Teng was accustomed to his arrogance and tyranny, committing all manner of evils. Now, he has finally met his retribution," another Cultivator chimed in with a laugh.
Many other Cultivators also joined in the laughter. It seemed that many had suffered from the oppression of the Hegemon Sect but had not dared to speak out. Now that this mysterious young man in white had slain Wang Teng, it truly brought them great satisfaction!
Killing two insignificant ants didn’t particularly excite Ye Yun.
He gestured with his hand, and Wang Teng’s two Black Hammers, as well as a storage ring, fell into his grasp. These two hammers were of no low quality, having reached the Emperor Level Superior grade. He could keep them for now. In the future, if any of his Sect’s Disciples or demon beasts favored hammers, he could gift these to them.
This guy is quite wealthy...
Ye Yun thought, a hint of faint surprise in his eyes as he glanced at the storage ring.
The Spirit Stones in the ring numbered fifteen billion. There were also some magical tools, medicinal pills, and Jade Slips of Cultivation Methods in substantial quantities.
Ye Yun gestured again, collecting the Yellow Treasure Tower and the old man’s storage ring as well. The Spirit Stones in that ring amounted to about four or five billion. Killing Wang Teng and the old man had yielded Ye Yun a considerable fortune.
WHOOSH!
The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon, who had been silently watching from the side, finally let out a breath, awakening from its shocked state. It had just witnessed its master’s incredible prowess, easily killing two powerful Divine Monarch Realm Cultivators with two sword strokes, leaving it profoundly stunned.
The master possesses the bloodline of the Ancestor Dragon, yet he hasn’t used it. I suppose this must be his true trump card...
the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon quietly thought to itself.
"Disperse," Ye Yun said with a faint smile, looking at the Cultivators around him.
Immediately, the surrounding Cultivators cupped their fists in salute and then scattered in all directions like startled birds and beasts. No one dared to linger even a minute longer in the presence of the formidable Mysterious Sword Cultivator. They were afraid that if they annoyed Ye Yun, they too would be cut down on the spot.
Silence quickly returned to the surroundings.
On a towering building in Yunxiao City, two figures stood. One of them was the beautiful hostess from the Jinyu Auction House. Next to her stood a middle-aged man. This middle-aged man was a cultivator at the Seventh Realm of God King and was the most powerful Gentry Elder of the Jinyu Auction House.
"Senior, I misjudged him. I didn’t expect this young man in white to possess such extraordinarily accomplished Swordsmanship. He’s truly too powerful!" the sexy beauty exclaimed, her enchanting face expressing an unspeakable despondency.
"You don’t need to blame yourself. I, too, didn’t recognize his strength before he made his move," the middle-aged man said with a slight smile, looking into the distance and murmuring to himself, "He must be the mysterious powerhouse who challenged the Sword Sovereign."
The sexy beauty took a deep breath, her expression returning to normal. She smiled gracefully. "Senior, this time’s Grand Sacrifice Ceremony will be held at the Jianyun Sect in three days. Our auction house plans to present a gift. Shall we go and join the festivities?"
"Let’s go. The Sword Sovereign’s talent is unparalleled in the world. He will sooner or later step into the Divine Sovereign Realm. It’s necessary for us to curry favor with such a remarkable individual," the middle-aged man said with a laugh.
Thinking of the peerless Sword Sovereign, a hint of fervor appeared in the middle-aged man’s eyes.
「Outside Yunxiao City.」
Ye Yun and the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon had flown for about a hundred miles when Ye Yun suddenly sensed something. The Dragon-rearing Puppet was continuously jumping through the endless Daluo Region, as if it were tearing through the void.
"This is odd. Can a puppet tear through the void?" Ye Yun mused, raising an eyebrow. He then immediately tore open the void and departed.
「The next moment.」
Ye Yun appeared inside a large city. In front of him was a Teleportation Array, guarded by four guards at the True God Realm Tenth Layer Peak.
Ye Yun immediately understood. The creature had been continuously jumping through the void by using Teleportation Arrays. And the Teleportation Array before him was the first one the Dragon-rearing Puppet had used for its jumps.
"Who’s there?"
Seeing two figures suddenly emerge from a tear in the void, the four guards instantly became alert and assumed defensive positions.

chapters.title: Chapter 400: Tracking the Puppet, Entering the Bronze Palace
chapters.content:
Chapter 400: Chapter 400: Tracking the Puppet, Entering the Bronze Palace
"Heh!"
Looking at these four guards on high alert, Ye Yun just gave a faint smile.
He turned around, tore through the void, and disappeared instantly.
One of the guards stared blankly in the direction where Ye Yun had vanished, his face filled with astonishment. "What’s his cultivation base? He was actually able to tear the void!"
"Tearing through the void is something only those at the Half-step Divine Venerate Realm can do," another guard stated.
"How terrifying, to think such a senior figure descended upon our Purple Cloud City," the third guard murmured to himself.
"Fortunately, this senior only appeared for a moment and didn’t make a move; otherwise, no one in the entire Purple Cloud City would have been his match," the fourth guard sighed.
"Any guesses why this senior glanced at the Teleportation Array?" the first guard asked.
The second guard thought for a moment, the mysterious dark-robed man naturally coming to mind, and ventured, "Could it be that man in the dark robe?"
"He’s the only one who used the Teleportation Array today. It’s definitely related to him," the first guard nodded in agreement.
They knew nothing about the man in the dark robe. However, since he was willing to pay with Spirit Stones, they certainly wouldn’t reject such a lucrative deal.
"Strange, I haven’t even left the Daluo Region, and the puppet has stopped."
Ye Yun, who was in the process of tearing through the void, also suddenly stopped, a hint of surprise on his face.
He had initially thought that the Dragon Raiser’s puppet would surely leave the Daluo Region. Unexpectedly, after leaping through just thirteen cities, it had begun to fly at an incredibly high speed.
These thirteen cities were no more than thirty million miles apart from each other.
For Ye Yun, tearing through the void meant he could quickly reach that location. There was no real need to use a Teleportation Array and navigate in circles, which was even more inconvenient.
Ye Yun tore through the void once more and arrived in the territory where the Dragon-rearing Puppet was located.
The void rippled.
Ye Yun and the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon emerged from within.
The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon was by now accustomed to its master tearing through the void. After all, it had journeyed with him from the Cangnan Continent, across the Ten Great Ocean areas, all the way to the Daluo Region. The total distance covered was almost unimaginable. His master had managed to continuously tear through the void over such vast distances. Covering such a short distance now was even more effortless for him. Thus, the Azure Wood dragon found this completely routine.
"Master, what are you tracking?" the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon asked with surprise, looking around.
It had no idea what its master had been up to all this time, as Ye Yun had not told it about the Dragon Raiser.
"Remember that Dragon Raiser? I’m looking for him," Ye Yun said with a faint smile.
At that moment, his expression shifted slightly.
The Dragon-rearing Puppet, after flying to a certain place, abruptly leaped again. It seemed to have used a Teleportation Array once more, covering a short distance.
Upon reaching a particular location, the puppet stopped and remained still.
Could this be the Dragon Raiser’s main lair?
Ye Yun’s interest was instantly piqued.
If he found the Dragon Raiser’s main lair and cleaned out the entire nest, the gains would be unimaginable. Perhaps... he could even find more clues about the mastermind behind the scenes.
"Let’s go."
Ye Yun tore through the void again, effortlessly covering the distance, and arrived at the Dragon-rearing Puppet’s last known jump point.
They were in a valley.
Ye Yun sensed the surrounding aura and discovered a Teleportation Formation hidden within a jungle at the center of the valley.
However, this Teleportation Formation was concealed by an invisibility ward that ordinary people could not detect.
A smile touched Ye Yun’s lips. "They’re certainly cautious. After teleporting to their main lair, they still use a dedicated directional Teleportation Formation."
He walked into the jungle, tiny, star-like runes flickering in his eyes. The invisibility ward protecting the Teleportation Formation was easily dispelled by him.
A small Teleportation Formation came into view.
The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon looked astonished. "Master, these Dragon Raisers are truly cautious, taking every precaution for fear of being discovered."
"It’s not hard to understand. A young dragon is worth ten billion Spirit Stones, and their lair contains many of them. That’s an unimaginably vast fortune," Ye Yun said with a smile.
He didn’t mention anything about the mastermind pulling the strings; the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon’s understanding was still shallow, and it was not appropriate to involve it.
Moreover, Ye Yun didn’t intend to let these juniors enter the Divine Land in the future. It was better for them to cultivate diligently and peacefully on the Cangnan Continent, the ancestral home of the Dragon Clan. As for this vast Divine Land, Ye Yun alone was more than enough to explore it.
Of course, now wasn’t the time. The three juniors from the Dragon God Sect had not yet matured, and the Dragon God Sect itself had not rebuilt its mountain gate. Everything still required time.
Having already signed in for a hundred thousand years, Ye Yun was not short on time. He had been resurrected from the ancient tomb less than a year ago, so there was no need to rush.
As he continued to overcome challenges on the Cangnan Continent, Ye Yun’s methods grew increasingly adept. Simultaneously, he gathered more clues, becoming more familiar with the mastermind’s style and techniques.
A ray of light flared.
Ye Yun activated the directional Teleportation Formation, and the two of them instantly vanished into the void.
「Deep underground.」
A colossal Bronze Palace sat there, sprawling in the earth like a giant beast.
At the palace entrance was an ancient Teleportation Formation. As the void fluctuated, a ray of light descended, revealing two figures.
Ye Yun glanced around and, finding no guards at the palace entrance, a cold smirk touched his lips.
It seems the Dragon Raisers are quite confident that no one can find this place.
Ye Yun walked towards the Bronze Palace.
The palace was incredibly ancient, exuding an aura of great antiquity.
At the entrance of the ancient Bronze Palace stood two massive stone pillars. Each stone pillar was entwined with two Bronze Giant Dragons. The Bronze Giant Dragons were lifelike, their dragon heads gazing into the void with ferocious expressions, creating a sinister and bizarre impression.
Reaching the entrance, Ye Yun peered inside through a crack in the ajar Bronze Door.
「Inside the grand hall.」
There was an immense silver pool, upon whose surface floated seven enormous golden Dragon Nests. Each Dragon Nest radiated a faint golden light, appearing both mystical and splendid.
Inside each golden Dragon Nest lay four or five massive Dragon Eggs, seemingly in the process of gestation and hatching.
The seven golden Dragon Nests were arranged in the formation of the Big Dipper.
A grim look flashed across Ye Yun’s face.
The Seven-star Formation again.
It was truly beyond belief that the Dragon Raisers would use a Seven-star Formation to incubate Dragon Eggs.
"Master, there are so many Dragon Eggs in this hall!" the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon transmitted in a shocked, hushed tone.
"Hmm?" Ye Yun’s expression suddenly shifted. He had spotted the Dragon-rearing Puppet walking towards a divine altar beside the pool.
It lit a stick of incense, bowed three times consecutively, and then placed the incense into the censer.
Upon the divine altar stood a divine statue, its limbs entwined with Divine Dragons.
In front of the statue was a God Plaque, inscribed with two words: Dragon Candle.

chapters.title: Chapter 401: Dragon Candle Branch
chapters.content:
Chapter 401: Chapter 401: Dragon Candle Branch
"Dragon Candle, what is it?"
A look of bewilderment appeared in Ye Yun’s eyes. These two words seemed to hold significant meaning, hard to fathom.
Since Ye Yun had deliberately concealed himself by casting a restrictive spell around his body, even the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon, whose cultivation base was extremely low, wouldn’t be detected by the Dragon-rearing Puppet inside.
At this moment, the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon looked utterly bewildered at the sight of the deity statue and the God Plaque. The various eerie scenes within the hall had completely exceeded his understanding.
After the time it took for an incense stick to burn, the puppet walked to the edge of the water, apparently monitoring the hatching process of the Dragon Eggs in the seven massive golden Dragon Nests. After a while, finding no abnormalities, it moved aside and sat down on the ground. It took out numerous Spirit Stones, stacked them in front of it, and began to rapidly absorb the energy within them.
Ye Yun quietly observed for a while. He found that after the Dragon-rearing Puppet returned, it continuously absorbed energy from the Spirit Stones and made no other unusual movements.
After a moment’s thought, Ye Yun pushed open the Bronze Door and walked straight in.
The puppet sensed something. It abruptly opened its eyes and saw a young man in white clothes, accompanied by a green-robed teenager, walking over as if no one else was present. And the green-robed teenager was emitting a Divine Dragon’s Super Divine Dragon Breath.
Ye Yun gently pointed with his finger. A tremendous power instantly acted on the Dragon-rearing Puppet, immobilizing it.
Ye Yun first walked over to a deity statue. He found that this statue wasn’t a puppet, but merely a statue. However, the God Plaque beneath the statue caught Ye Yun’s eye. This God Plaque was extremely ancient, emanating a clear feeling of vicissitude.
"What is Dragon Candle?" Ye Yun turned his head, his gaze landing on the Dragon-rearing Puppet in the distance.
The Dragon-rearing Puppet remained silent. From the two holes in its black mask, its eyes flickered continuously, as if it were also trying to gauge Ye Yun’s origin.
The white-robed youth opposite me appears to be only at the God Monarch Realm fifth layer. His cultivation base is not high. But incredibly, he precisely located this Bronze Palace. Which power did he come from?
"You dare to follow me? Is it your intention to steal Dragon Eggs?" the Dragon-rearing Puppet suddenly asked in a gloomy voice.
"Indeed. With so many Dragon Eggs here, stealing them all would hatch many Divine Dragons," Ye Yun nodded and laughed. He admitted it without hesitation. Naturally, Ye Yun was just making a feint, intending to give the other party an erroneous preconceived notion.
"Humph! Our Dragon-rearing Clan is dispersed throughout the Divine Land and is powerful beyond measure. Yet you, merely a Divine Monarch, think you can steal Dragon Eggs? It seems you are eager for death," the Dragon-rearing Puppet sneered.
"Finding me will not be easy. Since I dare to steal, I naturally have other means to ensure my survival," Ye Yun laughed carelessly.
"..." The Dragon-rearing Puppet was at a loss for words. It was astonishing that this white-robed youth was so audacious as to dare provoke their Dragon-rearing Clan. Although there were many different powers in the Divine Land, there were indeed some audacious people. But such audacity from someone merely at the Divine Monarch Realm was unheard of.
"What is this Dragon Candle? Is it some big shot in your Dragon-rearing Clan?" Ye Yun asked again.
"You don’t even know what Dragon Candle is. If I were to casually mention ’coffin-carrying,’ wouldn’t you be even more clueless?" the Dragon-rearing Puppet laughed loudly.
"Coffin-carrying?" Ye Yun blinked.
A glimmer of understanding flashed through his mind. He seemed to understand.
Just like the Coffin Carriers of Moon Star, Dragon Candle should also be an inheritance passed down by the Dragon Raisers. The Coffin Carrier Clan is specifically responsible for carrying coffins, burying people who are about to die into the Dragon Cave, stealing the luck of Cangnan Continent and forming a so-called container, the function of which is unknown. This Dragon Candle Branch, then, should be using the Seven-star formation to hatch Dragon Eggs.
In that instant, Ye Yun also understood why there was such a mysterious, hard-to-find restriction in the body of the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon: it had been affected by this mysterious Seven-star formation during the Dragon Egg hatching process.
It had to be said, Ye Yun’s thoughts were nimble; he immediately grasped several key points.
And in that pool of water, at the bottom of each golden Dragon Nest, were tiny silver specks of light. There were seven such specks in total, corresponding to the seven Dragon Nests.
"I really don’t know what you mean by ’coffin-carrying.’ But these Dragon Eggs, I’m set on stealing them, haha!" Ye Yun suddenly burst into laughter, turned around, and walked towards the Dragon-rearing Puppet.
The Coffin Carrier Clan. Ye Yun speculated that the Coffin Carrier Clan existed only in Cangnan Continent, so he promptly denied knowing about them.
Watching the mysterious white-clothed youth approach, the Dragon-rearing Puppet became somewhat nervous. It ground its teeth and said, "If you dare to kill me, you will regret it."
"There’s nothing to regret." Ye Yun sneered. The Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye activated, and a burst of life-and-death power instantly descended upon the Dragon-rearing Puppet. He would try to read the memories of this Dragon-rearing Puppet to see if any kind of restriction had been added to it.
As a force entered the mind of the Dragon-rearing Puppet, an even greater force suddenly burst out from within.
BOOM!
The head of the Dragon-rearing Puppet exploded into fragments with a loud noise. Those fragments shot out fiercely in all directions, displaying enormous power, not inferior to the full-force blow of a cultivator of the First Layer of the God Sovereign Realm.
What a great method!
Ye Yun sneered. With a wave of his large hand, he froze those fragments in mid-air. The Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye activated again, reducing these fragments into particles that dispersed.
The headless puppet’s body fell heavily to the ground. Ye Yun approached and lightly kicked the puppet’s body, producing a hard thud.
That restriction in its head just now—if one’s cultivation base didn’t reach the Divine Sovereign Realm, they would be instantly killed. Even a cultivator of the First Layer of the God Sovereign Realm would be severely injured by such an explosive impact. It had to be said, the methods of the Dragon Raisers were extremely profound to hide such a powerful restriction in a mere Divine Monarch Realm puppet. This also showed that the high-level combat power of the Dragon Raisers must include at least Divine King Realm experts.
Ye Yun released his Divine Sense, carefully scanning the puppet’s body. He discovered a small-scale Seven-star formation on its back. This Seven-star formation was different from all the previous ones. For the moment, Ye Yun didn’t know its function, so he simply reached out and collected the puppet’s body.
This puppet from the Dragon Candle Branch is completely different from the puppets of the Coffin Raising Lineage. The puppets of the Coffin Raising Lineage all have their lifebound coffins, possessing extremely strong defensive capabilities. The puppets of the Dragon Candle Branch do not; their only defense is that powerful restriction in their minds. However, the Dragon Raisers hold a great reputation throughout the Divine Land. Generally, people do not dare to mess with them. Therefore, it’s understandable why these puppets do not have any lifebound treasures.
Ye Yun walked to the edge of the pool. Gazing at the seven golden Dragon Nests, his eyes softened. Several Dragon Eggs were within each of the massive golden Dragon Nests. Should they all hatch, there would be dozens of Divine Dragons. The only question was what kind of Divine Dragons were inside these Dragon Eggs.
Ye Yun reached out, his hand moving towards the seven golden Dragon Nests.
RUMBLE!
Suddenly, the pool water churned violently. The Seven-star formation at the bottom of the pool seemed to be stimulated, creating brilliant columns of light that shot from the earth, straight to Yun Xiao.

chapters.title: Chapter 402: The One Involved is Bewildered
chapters.content:
Chapter 402: Chapter 402: The One Involved is Bewildered
"Thinking of escaping? That won’t be easy."
Ye Yun sneered. In the depths of his demonic eyes, countless tiny runes, like stars, shifted rapidly. Suddenly, seven Purple Runes shot out, flying furiously.
The seven Purple Runes, as tiny as grains of rice, transformed into seven rays of Purple Light, landing above the golden Dragon Nests.
HUM!
The seven Purple Runes trembled lightly, emitting halo after halo of purple light, instantly severing the silver pillars of light that surged skyward.
The purple halos continued to descend, forcefully suppressing those pillars of light back into the pool.
GURGLE...
The pool water churned, the Seven-star formation at its bottom seemingly unwilling to be suppressed.
The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon was gobsmacked. The Purple Runes that flew from Master’s eyes were truly profound.
As soon as they appeared, they instantly suppressed all the pillars of light.
"Master, are these pillars of light... intending to teleport the Dragon Eggs away?"
Seeming to have thought of something, the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon asked doubtfully.
"Precisely," Ye Yun nodded.
He was beginning to understand the Seven-star formation behind the Dragon-rearing Puppet now.
It appeared that the Seven-star formation was a key. Once the key was removed, any attempt to directly steal the Dragon Eggs would trigger the Seven-star formation at the bottom of the pool, teleporting the Dragon Eggs in the seven golden Dragon Nests to another location.
Ye Yun discovered this in time and decisively severed the pillars of light for teleportation.
At the same time, he suppressed the Seven-star formation as well.
WHOOSH!
Ye Yun swung his large hand, and all seven colossal golden Dragon Nests were collected by him.
The seven Purple Runes hovering mid-air continuously descended towards the churning pool water, finally being forcefully pressed into the water and landing on seven points of light.
Consequently, the Seven-star formation ceased its struggle, and the pool water regained its initial tranquility.
The Seven-star formation was thoroughly suppressed.
Ye Yun reached out again, plucking the Seven-star formation out.
He saw that each of the seven points of light had a tiny Purple Rune attached to it. The runes emitted a Purple Light, fiercely suppressing each point.
At this moment, Ye Yun’s pupils contracted slightly, and he retrieved the seven minuscule Purple Runes.
The Seven-star formation was now quiescent.
Ye Yun nodded slightly. With the Dragon Nests and Dragon Eggs gone from the pool, the Seven-star formation entered a dormant state.
Ye Yun scanned the surroundings. Finding no more valuable clues, he nodded and said, "Let’s go."
"Yes, Master."
The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon readily agreed. Tailing Ye Yun, they quickly exited the Bronze Palace.
Once outside the Bronze Palace, Ye Yun turned around and produced a green Bead.
With a fierce swipe of his large hand in the air, amidst a RUMBLE, he lifted the Bronze Palace and tossed it into the world within the green Bead.
SWISH!
Ye Yun flicked his finger, and the nearby Teleportation Array promptly crumbled.
He looked around once again, activated the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye, and obliterated all traces of Super Divine Dragon Breath here.
After that, he tore through space and reappeared in the jungle of the valley. Having destroyed that Teleportation Array, he then departed from this place with the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon.
「Ten million miles away.」
The void fluctuated, and two figures emerged from within.
"Master, where do we go next?" the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon asked.
With a wave of his hand, Ye Yun produced a Peach Wood Sword. He stroked it lightly, lost in deep thought.
"Master, isn’t the Jianyun Sect holding a Grand Heaven-Worshipping Ceremony? All the major and minor factions from the Daluo Region will be there. Why don’t we go join the excitement?" the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon suggested with a good-natured laugh.
"You’ve reminded me of something important," Ye Yun’s eyes lit up with a hint of approval as he smiled and said.
Just now, holding the Peach Wood Sword, he had been lost in memories from a hundred thousand years ago. For a moment, he too had been blinded by his own involvement. After all, in his established impression, that young lady Nangong Jade often acted in strange and unpredictable ways. Finding her now would likely take considerable effort. And Ye Yun had always believed that if Nangong Jade didn’t show herself willingly, finding her would be an almost impossible task. Moreover, Nangong Jade had the mighty backing of the Divine Land. After a hundred thousand years, her current cultivation base must be at least in the Divine Sovereign Realm. With such a cultivation base and status, if she intentionally hid, Ye Yun would find it extremely difficult to locate her. Because Ye Yun’s preconceived notions were so strong, he hadn’t put much thought into how to find Nangong Jade.
The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon’s words, however, gave Ye Yun a sense of sudden enlightenment.
I’ll go to the Jianyun Sect’s Grand Heaven-Worshipping Ceremony. Since it was a major event in the Daluo Region, Ye Yun also wanted to witness the Sword Sovereign’s abilities. He wanted to see what astounding level of mastery this powerful Sword Sovereign had achieved in swordsmanship. If Nangong Jade was truly in the Daluo Region, she definitely wouldn’t miss the Jianyun Sect’s Grand Heaven-Worshipping Ceremony. But... it was hard to say for sure. After all, a hundred thousand years had passed. If Nangong Jade had genuinely broken through to the Divine Sovereign Realm, she was most likely no longer in the Daluo Region. If that were the case, finding Nangong Jade would be like searching for a needle in a haystack.
「...」
Ye Yun cast aside the distracting thoughts. After flying for some time with the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon, he encountered a True God Realm cultivator. Upon inquiring about the Jianyun Sect’s location, he changed direction and flew towards it.
Their current position was 300,000 miles from the Jianyun Sect, which wasn’t too far.
Ye Yun didn’t tear through the void. Instead, accompanied by the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon, he leisurely traveled, admiring the landscapes and experiencing the local customs and culture of the Divine Land as they slowly flew towards the Jianyun Sect.
They only needed to arrive a day before it began, so they had two days to spend freely on their journey.
「...」
「Behind the mountains of the Jianyun Sect.」
The woman’s skin was fairer than snow, her beauty unparalleled, her face exquisite beyond compare, making it impossible to look at her directly.
Her pair of jade-like hands moved constantly. As wood shavings fell, the piece of peachwood in her hand gradually transformed into a lifelike doll.
The doll resembled a man.
"I’ve carved another one..."
Looking at the doll in her hand, her lovely brows furrowed slightly, and a faint sadness clouded her delicate face.
Her slender jade-like hand, clutching the Silver Knife, hesitated over the doll’s face for a moment, but ultimately, she did not bring the knife down.
This Peachwood doll remained faceless.
The woman in red took a deep breath, her expression calming considerably. She stood up, walked over to a row of shelves behind her, and placed the Peachwood doll upon it.
The shelves were piled high with rows of Peachwood dolls.
All the Peachwood dolls were identical in style and form.
Among these many Peachwood dolls, not a single one had a face.
"Master, may I come in?" a slender figure in white stood outside the bamboo pavilion, asking softly.
The beautiful woman in red nodded gently. "Come in..." She turned, walked to the nearby window, and gazed at the azure sky.
The bamboo door was pushed open, and a woman in white entered.
When she saw the increased number of Peachwood dolls on the shelf, she was deeply shaken.
Tens of thousands of years... For tens of thousands of years, whenever her Master had free time, she would stay in the Bamboo Building in the back mountains, endlessly carving Peachwood dolls, all depicting a man. It seemed there was a man in her Master’s heart whom she could never forget.
「...」

chapters.title: Chapter 403: The Tears of the Sword Sovereign
chapters.content:
Chapter 403: Chapter 403: The Tears of the Sword Sovereign
"Master, all arrangements for the Heaven Worship Ceremony have been taken care of."
The woman in white shifted her gaze from the peachwood dolls, bowed slightly, and said respectfully.
"Hmm."
The woman in red nodded slightly. Although she appeared to be in her early twenties, her aura was extremely restrained, showing no trace of her cultivation base. In reality, she was the awe-inspiring Sword Sovereign of the entire Daluo Region. She had earned fame through her swordsmanship. The Sword Sovereign’s Killing Sword Technique was unmatched in the Daluo Region; for tens of thousands of years, no one had dared to challenge her swordsmanship. In the hearts of all cultivators in the Daluo Region, the Sword Sovereign’s Sword Dao was unparalleled, and it was believed she would sooner or later enter the Divine Sovereign Realm.
"Master, a piece of news recently came from Yunxiao City..." the woman in white looked at the Sword Sovereign and said hesitantly.
The Sword Sovereign looked at her.
"Master, yesterday outside Yunxiao City, a white-clad sword cultivator, with a cultivation base at the fifth layer of the Divine Monarch Realm, displayed powerful swordsmanship and easily killed the Sect Master of the Hegemon Sect," the woman in white said in hushed tones.
"Hmm, his swordsmanship is not bad." The Sword Sovereign’s willow-leaf eyebrows arched slightly, a look of exceptional fascination in her eyes. This white-clad sword cultivator was able to kill Wang Teng of the Hegemon Sect despite being two minor cultivation levels lower, which demonstrated his supreme swordsmanship. The Sword Sovereign had always cherished such talents in swordsmanship.
"To which sect or clan does this white-clad sword cultivator belong?" the Sword Sovereign suddenly asked.
"Master, this white-clad sword cultivator does not seem to be from the Daluo Region," the woman in white said.
"A Sword Dao genius like him, if he were to join our Jianyun Sect, could well become the next Sword Sovereign." The Sword Sovereign smiled faintly, gazing out the window with a dreamy, yearning expression.
"Master, I understand," the woman in white quickly nodded. If she were to meet this white-clad sword cultivator in the future, she would certainly find a way to have him join their Jianyun Sect. This would also fulfill her Master’s wish.
"Master, many people are now saying that this white-clad sword cultivator is the one who challenged you," the woman in white, as if remembering something, suddenly added.
"It’s not him." The Sword Sovereign shook her head. Within her picturesque features, there was an indescribable hint of anger.
The woman in white was slightly taken aback. Sensing the anger in her Master’s tone, she quickly excused herself and withdrew.
After her beloved disciple left, the Sword Sovereign turned, looked towards a certain spot, and said coldly, "Why hide yourself? Come out."
The void rippled.
A chaotic black silhouette appeared next to the row of wooden cabinets.
The black figure placed a peachwood doll on the wooden cabinet and suddenly burst into loud laughter. "Sword Sovereign, oh Sword Sovereign, after all these tens of thousands of years, you still haven’t forgotten that wretched man?"
"What’s it to you?" The Sword Sovereign’s beautiful face was like ice, like an ice sculpture that hadn’t melted in ten thousand years, as she spoke coldly.
"Don’t you know how I feel about you?" the black figure said indifferently.
The Sword Sovereign shook her head, her expression cold as frost.
"Back then, if I hadn’t been so deeply infatuated with you, how could I have lost that duel to you? This position of Sect Master of the Jianyun Sect—if I hadn’t intentionally let you have it, do you think you would be sitting so securely now?" The black figure let out a derisive laugh. A layer of black fluctuations as thin as a cicada’s wings filled the surroundings of his body, making it impossible to discern his true appearance.
"If you’re not convinced, then we shall fight again at the Heaven Worship Ceremony," the Sword Sovereign said calmly. Her beautiful eyes suddenly turned sharp, and a layer of Sword Qi surged from her body, as if countless tiny, astonishing Sword Intents were dancing and transforming within it.
"I’m looking forward to it... If you lose, the position of Sect Master of the Jianyun Sect will be mine! HAHAHA..." The black figure suddenly burst into wild laughter. The sound waves shook the entire pavilion, and in that instant, countless peachwood dolls shattered into pieces.
"You dare destroy my peachwood dolls!" The Sword Sovereign’s expression changed drastically, a surge of rage erupting from her chest.
SWISH!
A sharp sword light tore through the void before her, stabbing towards the black figure. But the black figure vanished in an instant. It seemed that by appearing in such a bizarre manner, he had already prepared an escape route.
The Sword Sovereign’s figure suddenly vanished from the pavilion. The next moment, she was high in the void, her vast Divine Sense sweeping the surroundings, but she still couldn’t find the black figure. The Sword Sovereign’s face was icy cold, and the dense Sword Qi around her body constantly made crackling sounds in the void.
"Master, what happened?" Several figures flew over quickly from all directions, gathering beside the Sword Sovereign.
"It’s nothing. Just a defeated foe. He has already fled," the Sword Sovereign said coldly.
After saying this, she flew back into the pavilion. Gazing at the peachwood dolls that had turned to dust, the Sword Sovereign was deeply agitated, and two lines of crystalline tears streamed down from the corners of her eyes.
Brother Yun, I’ve failed you...
the Sword Sovereign murmured to herself, standing rooted to the spot like a stone statue, unmoving for a long, long time.
...
The Heaven Worship Ceremony of the Jianyun Sect was still a day away from starting. Various factions, large and small, from the Daluo Region had rushed to the Jianyun Sect, presenting their gifts. Some weaker sects were arranged to stay at the foot of the mountain. The stronger ones, however, were invited up the mountain, where the Jianyun Sect had arranged accommodations for them.
At this moment, about three hundred miles away from the Jianyun Sect, two figures were slowly flying over.
"Young Master, we’re almost at the Jianyun Sect," the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon gazed into the distance, a look of pleasant surprise in his eyes. On a majestic mountain range, crowds of people bustled about; countless cultivators from various major factions had arrived.
"Mm," Ye Yun nodded with a smile.
"I hear this Sword Sovereign enjoys keeping Divine Dragons. How about I offer you as a gift? You can then focus on your cultivation here," Ye Yun said, half-jokingly.
"No, Young Master! If you’re going to offer anyone, offer that Five-Clawed Golden Dragon! I want to stay by your side and cultivate," the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon said, looking flustered.
"If I can’t find your original master in the Daluo Region, I will return to the Cangnan Continent. Would you still want to cultivate in a place with such scarce Spiritual Energy?" Ye Yun looked at the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon and said earnestly.
"Young Master, I am willing to follow you and cultivate. This Divine Land is indeed good, but I don’t particularly like it," the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon scratched his head and said with a smile.
"Alright then! I’ll offer up that little Five-Clawed Golden Dragon," Ye Yun said with a laugh.
Exchanging jokes, the two soon arrived at the foot of the mountain where the Jianyun Sect was located. This place was already packed with people. Just the line of people offering gifts was incredibly long.
Ye Yun descended and joined the end of the queue.
"Young Master, I knew you would come." Just then, a familiar, gentle female voice came from the side.
Ye Yun turned his head and saw it was the beautiful auction host from the Jinyu Auction House. Beside her stood a middle-aged man at the seventh level of the Divine Monarch Realm.
"The Heaven Worship Ceremony of the Jianyun Sect is such a grand event; naturally, I wouldn’t miss it," Ye Yun said with a smile, his hands clasped behind his back.
"This queue is for ordinary factions presenting gifts, those below the Divine Monarch Realm. Why don’t we go over there? That side is specifically for receiving factions at the Divine Monarch Realm," the beautiful woman’s eyes darted around, then she pointed in another direction and said with a charming smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 404
chapters.content:
Chapter 404: 404
"That’s fine."
Ye Yun nodded with a smile.
The queue before him was too long; if he waited for his turn, he didn’t know how many time units it would take. Since there was a place especially for those at the Divine Monarch Realm, he naturally preferred to save some time.
"Please follow me, sir."
The attractive woman smiled slightly, leading the way like a graceful butterfly. The middle-aged man who had reached the Seventh Realm of God King followed her closely. Ye Yun and his Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon trailed behind them.
"Ah... I remember where that young man in white comes from!"
Within the queue, a middle-aged man suddenly smacked his forehead, speaking loudly.
"What did you recall?" someone asked, giving him a sidelong glance.
"Do you remember a few days ago, outside Yunxiao City, when Sect Master Wang Teng of Hegemon Sect was killed? That was the work of this young man in white..." the middle-aged man loudly proclaimed. As he said this, a glint of fanaticism shone in his eyes. He still remembered that battle where the man in white used unparalleled swordsmanship, killing two Divine Monarch Realm Cultivators with just two strikes. Moreover, the cultivation bases of these two slain Cultivators were higher than the realm of the young man in white. This exhibited just how terrifying his swordsmanship was.
"So it was him!"
Those present showed expressions of shock.
During this period, the news of a mysterious young Sword Cultivator in white, who had slain Wang Teng of the Hegemon Sect, had long since spread throughout the Daluo Region. Everyone speculated that this might be the mysterious person set to challenge the Sword Sovereign. Unexpectedly, he had been queuing to give a gift to the Jianyun Sect just now. What on earth was going on? Wasn’t he supposed to make a startling appearance at the Sky Sacrifice Ceremony, challenging the Sword Sovereign? Why would he give a gift?
