"Maybe he is not the mysterious challenger..." an old man at the True God Realm Nine Layers surmised, furrowing his brows.
"That makes sense. Would such a prominent figure, who could rival the Sword Sovereign, wait in line with us?" another man echoed.
For a moment, everyone agreed with the assumption that the young man in white was definitely not the mysterious challenger of the Sword Sovereign.
These people really love to gossip...
Ye Yun naturally heard the discussions among the Cultivators behind him. However, he didn’t care much about it and simply gave a serene smile. He certainly wasn’t here to challenge the Sword Sovereign; his purpose was to find Nangong Jade.
"Sir, your feat of slaying Sect Master Wang Teng of Hegemon Sect has already spread throughout the entire Daluo Region. Now, many people discuss this matter in their free time," the attractive woman said with a mischievous smile.
"A trivial matter, not worth mentioning," Ye Yun replied with a smile.
"May I ask for your honored name, Sir?" the middle-aged man at the Seventh Realm of God King asked courteously, his hands clasped in a bow.
"Ye Tian," Ye Yun replied without hesitation. He had no qualms about making up a name on the spot. Given that his appearance had already changed, adding a fake name didn’t matter either.
"I can’t believe that you and I share the same surname!" the seductive woman smiled charmingly. "You may call me Ye Wei."
"What a coincidence, indeed," Ye Yun couldn’t help but smile wryly and nodded.
"Right there ahead. That large compound is exclusively for receiving forces at the Divine Monarch Realm," Ye Wei said, pointing to a spacious yard lined with red-brick houses about a hundred zhang ahead, her smile never leaving her face.
Ye Yun nodded. They all ceased their chatter and strode forward into the compound.
「Meanwhile.」
At the top of the Jianyun Sect’s mountain stood a woman in white. Her gaze never left the white-clad young Sword Cultivator at the foot of the mountain.
Who would have thought! This mysterious youth also brings a gift for the Sword Sovereign; it seems fate binds him with my Jianyun Sect,
the white-clad woman thought, breaking into a smile. This white-clad Sword Cultivator did not belong to the Daluo Region, yet he offered a gift to the Sword Sovereign. It seemed he was not the arrogant, self-centered prodigy people usually imagined.
With a flicker, she disappeared from the mountain peak, appearing the next instant in the courtyard responsible for registering gifts.
"Loose Cultivator Ye Tian presents a Five-clawed Golden Dragon to the Sword Sovereign."
Ye Yun currently stood at a table, having taken out a transparent bead and placed it upon it.
Since the Sword Sovereign loves raising Divine Dragons, I might as well leave this Five-clawed Golden Dragon here for now. After all, it won’t cause any trouble, and the Little Dragon will be well taken care of. Besides, in my storage, I have many Dragon Eggs obtained from the Bronze Palace beneath the ground. I can hatch many more Divine Dragons in the future,
he mused.
"Wow, a Divine Dragon!"
The two Disciples in charge of registration were struck with surprise as they glimpsed the Five-clawed Golden Dragon in the bead. Only top-tier forces could hand out young dragons as gifts. Unexpectedly, this Loose Cultivator was so generous, directly gifting a young dragon to the Sword Sovereign. This indicated the depth of his strength—he was not weaker than those top-tier forces.
One of them quickly registered the gift.
At this moment, a woman in white floated over, stopping beside Ye Yun.
"Mr. Ye, your guest room has been prepared. Please follow me," the woman in white said with a gentle smile.
Ye Yun glanced at her. She was young, with a beautiful face that could rightly be called a national treasure. Her cultivation base was not low either; she had reached the God Monarch Realm First Layer.
Ye Yun nodded and followed the woman in white forward.
The two Disciples in charge of registration stared at the woman in white’s departing figure, shock in their eyes.
"A gift of a young dragon brought Elder Sister out herself?" one Disciple exclaimed in surprise.
"Indeed! Elder Sister holds a very high status. It’s rare for us to even see her. It’s surprising this Loose Cultivator has received such a high level of courtesy," the other Disciple remarked, his eyes filled with envy.
Seeing Ye Yun leaving, Ye Wei became anxious. She hastily presented her gift and tried to follow him. However, two Jianyun Sect Disciples stopped her halfway and guided her in another direction.
Why is there such a huge difference just because I don’t have a young dragon?
Ye Wei sighed helplessly.
"It’s well-known that the Sword Sovereign loves raising Divine Dragons. However, young dragons are extremely rare; they can be chanced upon but not actively sought," the middle-aged man by her side said, shaking his head.
"Yes, I remember the last time a Dragon Raiser sold a young dragon was about five hundred years ago," Ye Wei sighed once again.
Young dragons were extremely rare in the Divine Land primarily because Dragon Raisers sold them so infrequently, leading to a situation where there was a price but no supply. Only those exceptionally lucky enough to be present during a sale could acquire one.
Ye Yun followed the woman in white to a secluded small courtyard. Looking around, he noticed it was a standalone courtyard and couldn’t help but chuckle to himself.
Offering up a young dragon certainly grants excellent treatment,
he thought.
"Sir, please rest here today. The Sky Sacrifice Ceremony will be held tomorrow. At that time, please make your way to the peak," the woman in white said, turning to Ye Yun with a smile.
"Okay, I understand," Ye Yun nodded.
Gazing at Ye Yun with an unusual glint in her eyes, the woman in white suddenly voiced a thought she’d been having, "Seeing as you are a Loose Cultivator, Sir, I wonder... have you ever considered joining our Jianyun Sect?"

chapters.title: Chapter 405: One Sword, The Fall of the Tyrant Ancestor
chapters.content:
Chapter 405: Chapter 405: One Sword, The Fall of the Tyrant Ancestor
"Join the Jianyun Sect?"
Ye Yun was slightly taken aback, not expecting the woman in white to make such a sudden invitation.
"I appreciate your kind intention. Although I am a loose cultivator, I have long had my own goals in the Sword Dao, so it’s truly not suitable for me to join any sect."
Ye Yun politely declined without hesitation.
Aside from the Dragon God Sect, there was no other sect in the world that attracted him. Even Divine King-level powers did not catch his eye.
"Then, I must have been presumptuous."
The woman in white showed an apologetic smile, her cherry lips slightly parted as she gently exhaled.
It seemed this mysterious Sword Cultivator from other lands wouldn’t join the Jianyun Sect, nor any other power for that matter. He was the type of transcendent figure, like an idle cloud or a wild crane.
The woman in white deeply admired such individuals. So she didn’t persist, instead finding an excuse to quickly depart.
"Go back to the room and rest."
Ye Yun turned around and spoke indifferently.
He and the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon retreated to two separate rooms and began to cultivate.
As for Ye Yun, he was on the verge of breaking through to the Divine Sovereign Realm and didn’t need specific cultivation for that, so he focused on practicing his other Divine Techniques. The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon, however, was greatly stimulated after entering the Divine Land. It began to cultivate with extreme diligence, frantically absorbing the spiritual energy within the Divine Land.
「The Bamboo Building at the back mountain.」
The woman in white suddenly appeared here.
"Master, that mysterious young Sword Cultivator has also arrived and even presented a young dragon. I inquired about his intentions; he has no desire to join any sect. It’s truly a pity."
The woman in white spoke with a regretful look on her face.
Her Master held this mysterious Sword Cultivator in high regard. If he could join the Jianyun Sect, he would surely become another extraordinary figure like her Master in the future.
"No matter. Such a Sword Dao Pride possesses a resolute mind, far beyond ordinary people. Everything depends on fate; it cannot be forced."
The Sword Sovereign’s voice floated from the depths of the loft.
Although she felt some regret that this Sword Dao genius wouldn’t join the Jianyun Sect, she didn’t dwell on it. She had only thought of it fleetingly, out of an appreciation for talent. Aside from matters of the heart from her past, the Sword Sovereign had devoted her life to cultivating the Sword Dao. The Sword Sovereign was also extremely confident in her own Sword Dao.
Within a hundred years, she would certainly step into the Half-step Divine Venerate Realm.
Within a thousand years, she was confident of successfully assaulting the Divine Sovereign Realm.
SIGH...
Hearing her Master’s words, the woman in white sighed softly and then turned to depart.
At this moment, a long queue still snaked at the foot of the Jianyun Sect’s mountain. Countless disciples of the Jianyun Sect were busy attending to the cultivators from the major powers of the Daluo Region.
Dozens of li southeast of the secluded courtyard where Ye Yun lived, there was also a row of houses. Currently, two old men were sitting in a pavilion in the courtyard, drinking heavily. One looked dejected and was drinking incessantly in his frustration, while the other continually tried to console him.
Just then, a figure flew swiftly from afar.
"Ancestor, that person has arrived!"
This was a middle-aged man at the True God Realm Tenth Layer. He landed nearby and quickly knelt before an old man in a green robe.
"What nonsense are you spouting? Whose arrival has made you so alarmed?"
The green-robed old man took a sip of wine, his eyes narrowed slightly as he looked at the man kneeling before him, and asked sternly.
"Reporting to the Ancestor, that mysterious white-robed young man who killed the Sect Master is currently residing near us, in the Heavenly numeral ninth courtyard!" the middle-aged man said with a trembling voice, his expression extremely agitated and his face flushed red.
When he learned this news, he had immediately rushed to report it to the Ancestor.
When this Ancestor of the Hegemon Sect learned of the Sect Master’s demise, he had been greatly enraged and immediately set out to find the killer. However, unexpectedly, that young man in white seemed to have vanished from the face of the earth, and they could no longer locate him.
Thinking that the Jianyun Sect’s Heaven Worship Ceremony was about to begin, this Hegemon Sect Ancestor had come to the Jianyun Sect to try his luck, hoping to encounter that young man in white.
He was, in all likelihood, here to present a gift to the Jianyun Sect.
And sure enough, his target had appeared.
The Hegemon Sect Ancestor shot to his feet, his expression savage, his aura surging monstrously. He turned and prepared to fly towards the Heavenly numeral ninth courtyard.
"Dao Brother Hegemon, this is the Jianyun Sect. If you make a move, won’t you incur the Sword Sovereign’s wrath?" an old man in red robes opposite him hastily said.
"This brat killed my Hegemon Sect’s Sect Master! My sect shares an irreconcilable enmity with him. Now that the enemy is right here, how can I not take revenge?" the Hegemon Sect Ancestor said angrily.
"Dao Brother, I once owed you a favor. This time, I’ll help you make a move. That way, the disturbance caused can also be minimized," the red-robed old man sighed and also stood up.
"Excellent! Thank you, Dao Brother!"
The Hegemon Sect Ancestor was overjoyed. He had invited this Dao Brother, whose strength was comparable to his own, precisely because he intended to find a helper. Both of them were at the God Lord Realm Ninth level.
If the two of them couldn’t even take down a mere God Monarch Realm fifth layer cultivator, they would have no face left to live.
The two God Lord Realm powerhouses quickly reached an agreement and immediately flew towards the Heavenly numeral ninth courtyard.
Upon reaching the entrance of the small courtyard, the red-robed old man suddenly flicked his hand, and over a dozen array flags flew out, surrounding the entire courtyard. In an instant, a large array activated, completely enveloping the small courtyard and preventing any aura from leaking out.
"Dao Brother, you are indeed more thoughtful than I am."
The Hegemon Sect Ancestor cupped his fists and showed a grateful smile.
The red-robed old man smiled and shook his head.
With a flash, the two of them entered the courtyard.
"Whoever is inside, get out!"
With the protection of the large array, the Hegemon Sect Ancestor let out an angry roar as soon as he entered.
"Which blind fool has come to court death?"
Ye Yun, who was cultivating, suddenly smiled and abruptly opened his eyes. He pushed open the door and walked out.
In the courtyard stood two old men, one in green robes and one in red. Both were at the God Lord Realm Ninth Level.
"I don’t have many enemies in the Daluo Region. You old thing, you must be from the Hegemon Sect, right?" Ye Yun, with his hands behind his back, looked at the green-robed old man and calmly asked with a smile.
"You brat, still so arrogant when death is at your doorstep! It seems you truly don’t hold the cultivators of the Daluo Region in any regard!" the Hegemon Sect Ancestor roared, his vital energy and blood surging, and a vast, powerful aura instantly pressed down on Ye Yun. Simultaneously, with a flick of his hands, two Black Hammers appeared, making the Hegemon Sect Ancestor’s imposing aura even more astonishing.
"I killed one Kui Bull Overlord Body, and now another one comes. Are you all tired of living?" Ye Yun smiled faintly and drew his Silver Sword.
In the void, a thin silver sword light suddenly appeared without any warning. This sword light was unimaginably fast. In an instant, it landed between the Hegemon Sect Ancestor’s eyebrows.
The Hegemon Sect Ancestor’s eyes widened as if they were about to pop out. He watched, stunned, as that thin sword light slashed into his glabella; he hadn’t reacted in the slightest.
A red line appeared between his eyebrows and abruptly widened.
SPLAT!
A torrent of blood mixed with white brain matter gushed out.
Immediately, the Hegemon Sect Ancestor’s body split apart from the middle, and a large amount of blood erupted, dyeing the void red.
One sword strike, and the Hegemon Sect Ancestor had fallen.
Seeing this, the red-robed old man standing beside him felt all the hairs on his body stand on end, and an immense terror instantly overwhelmed him.

chapters.title: Chapter 406: The Grand Ceremony of Heaven Worship, Officially Begins
chapters.content:
Chapter 406: Chapter 406: The Grand Ceremony of Heaven Worship, Officially Begins
What kind of terrifying swordsmanship is this?
Even after activating the Kui Bull Overlord Body, Ancestor Batian, with his God Lord Realm Ninth level cultivation base, was still killed by a single sword strike. His Primordial Spirit didn’t even manage to escape.
This is truly terrifying.
The red-robed elder’s heart pounded as if it would leap out of his chest. He trembled, his entire body utterly ice-cold, as if death itself had descended upon him.
In his entire life, he had never encountered such a terrifying opponent. To slaughter a God Lord Realm Ninth level expert as easily as a dog, while only at the God Monarch Realm fifth layer! Such terrifying swordsmanship has already transcended the ordinary, reaching the pinnacle of perfection! The moment the flesh was split open, the Primordial Spirit was simultaneously slain. Ancestor Batian, whose might shook the entire Daluo Region, had fallen just like that.
The red-robed elder’s legs trembled ceaselessly. He desperately wanted to flee, but he knew there was absolutely no chance of escape.
Ye Yun sheathed his sword and looked at the red-robed elder with an indifferent expression.
"For those who dare to provoke me, I never show mercy."
A heaven-shocking sword light suddenly appeared in the void.
The red-robed elder widened his eyes, watching as a thin sword light landed between his brows, and then his entire body abruptly split into two.
SPLAT!
Blood sprayed out violently, dyeing the void before him crimson.
The two halves of his body remained standing rigidly on the ground, not toppling over.
Killing the red-robed elder was even more satisfying for Ye Yun, because the red-robed elder had no opportunity to resist whatsoever.
At this moment, after staring at Ye Yun for several seconds, the two standing halves of the red-robed elder’s body crashed to the ground with a thud. Ye Yun had killed him even faster than Ancestor Batian. Thus, the red-robed elder had managed to draw one last breath, allowing his bisected body to remain standing for a few more seconds.
In the moment before his death, the red-robed elder was filled with extreme regret. He should never have agreed to Ancestor Batian’s request to go to the Jianyun Sect. They had only just arrived when they encountered this terrifying Sword Cultivator, and now both their lives were forfeit at the Jianyun Sect. What was even more laughable was that the Formation he had laid to conceal their auras seemed to have been prepared for himself; even if they died here in this ninth courtyard, it was unlikely anyone would ever find out.
Ye Yun casually reached out his hand, and the two men’s storage rings, along with Ancestor Batian’s two Black Hammers, were collected by him. The two storage rings combined contained an astonishing sum of over one hundred billion Spirit Stones.
This was a pleasant surprise for Ye Yun. Two God Lord Realm Ninth level experts from the Divine Land were indeed wealthy. These Spirit Stones, if given to the Dragon God Sect, would be enough for those juniors to cultivate for a very, very long time.
Activating the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye, both bodies and the blood on the ground turned into particles, dissipating into the heavens and earth. Ye Yun waved his hand again, and the ground was restored to normal. Everything in the courtyard was restored, as if nothing had happened. Finally, Ye Yun also collected the large aura-concealing Formation outside and placed it into his storage.
After all of this was done, Ye Yun returned to his room and started cultivating again.
No one could have imagined that two distinguished God Lord Realm Ninth level great Cultivators would perish so silently at the Jianyun Sect. Even the Sword Sovereign, the one with the highest cultivation base in the Jianyun Sect, hadn’t noticed a thing. Who could have thought that two God Lord Realm Ninth level Cultivators would be eliminated without even surviving a single blow?
"The Master is truly too strong,"
After witnessing the events outside with his Divine Sense, the shock in the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon’s heart was beyond description. Throughout their journey, the Master had continually shattered his understanding with his formidable strength.
Previously, it was opponents at the Seventh Realm of God King. Now, even an expert at the God Lord Realm Ninth level couldn’t withstand a single sword strike from the Master. The Master’s various incredible Divine Skills and swordsmanship were truly eye-opening for him.
After a long while, the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon finally recovered from his shock. He gave a wry smile, returned to his bed, sat cross-legged, and resumed his cultivation.
「One day passed quickly.」
The next day arrived. The Jianyun Sect’s Sky Offering Ceremony was about to begin. Early in the morning, Ye Yun, accompanied by the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon, headed to the summit of the Jianyun Sect’s Main Peak.
At the summit of the Main Peak was a vast platform, already crowded with Cultivators from the various powers of the Daluo Region. Most were at the Divine Monarch Realm, with a few at the True God Realm Tenth Layer Peak. As for the True God Realm Cultivators, they were all arranged halfway up the mountain. There was no other way; too many Cultivators had arrived this time. It was overcrowded, far exceeding the Jianyun Sect’s capacity.
The major powers of the Daluo Region had come for two reasons: firstly, to show goodwill to the Sword Sovereign, and secondly, to witness the Sword Sovereign’s duel against the mysterious Cultivator. A battle between experts at the Half-step Divine Venerate Realm was exceedingly rare in the entire Daluo Region. Witnessing such a duel held immense benefits for one’s own cultivation and comprehension of the Sword Dao.
Ye Yun stood in an inconspicuous corner of the square, his hands clasped behind his back, waiting quietly. Many Cultivators on the square wore expressions of extreme excitement, finding it difficult to suppress their inner agitation.
Although Ye Yun maintained a low profile, many people still recognized him. After all, Wang Teng, the Sect Master of the Hegemon Sect, who was quite famous in the Daluo Region, had been slain by this youth with a single sword strike. This demonstrated the terrifying level of the white-robed youth’s swordsmanship.
"Greetings, fellow Daoist," a middle-aged man dressed in black said with a smile as he walked up to Ye Yun, clasping his fists. "I, too, am an enthusiast of the Sword Dao and hope for an opportunity to exchange insights with you."
Ye Yun smiled faintly and shook his head. "I am very busy and have no time to exchange pointers with anyone. Please leave."
He had no leisure to discuss the Sword Dao with others; it was purely a waste of time.
Upon hearing Ye Yun’s words, the middle-aged man’s face turned ashen. He felt as if a persimmon was stuck in his throat, an extremely uncomfortable sensation.
He hadn’t expected this white-robed youth to be so arrogant, not giving him any face at all. One must understand, he was an Eighth layer of God Monarch realm Sword Cultivator! He was also renowned in the Daluo Region.
Seeing the middle-aged man’s awkward expression, Ye Yun chuckled and added, "I am not from the Daluo Region. After the Sky Offering Ceremony, I will be leaving this place."
"Since that is the case, I apologize for the disturbance." The middle-aged man paused, stunned for a moment. He then clasped his fists, turned, and departed decisively.
With the middle-aged man setting an example, no one else came over to invite a rebuff. Ye Yun thus enjoyed some peace and quiet.
"Young Master Ye, I didn’t expect you to be here!" A familiar female voice drifted over.
Ye Yun turned his head and saw Ye Wei approaching with the middle-aged man at the Seventh Realm of God King.
Ye Yun felt a headache coming on. This Ye Wei, she’s truly like a persistent shadow!
However, out of consideration for the Jinyu Auction House’s good reputation, Ye Yun still held them in some regard and didn’t drive the two away. Fortunately, Ye Wei was tactful enough. After approaching Ye Yun, she simply stood respectfully nearby and didn’t say much.
Ye Yun scanned his surroundings, searching the crowd in the square for any sign of Nangong Jade. His gaze swept over all the Divine Monarch Realm Cultivators in the square, but he didn’t find Nangong Jade.
"Could she possibly be among that group of True Gods?" Ye Yun wondered, his heart skipping a beat.
He immediately released his Divine Sense, sweeping it towards the area halfway up the mountain where the True God Realm cultivators were gathered. This scan, however, left Ye Yun even more disappointed. There was still no sign of Nangong Jade.
At that very moment,
DANG! DANG! DANG!
Suddenly, the ethereal and resounding toll of a bell echoed. Immediately after, a woman’s voice drifted across the entire Jianyun Sect.
"The Sky Offering Ceremony officially begins!"

chapters.title: Chapter 407: Sword Sovereign, actually Liu Yiyi
chapters.content:
Chapter 407: Chapter 407: Sword Sovereign, actually Liu Yiyi
"The Grand Sky Sacrifice ceremony has begun!"
A shout from somewhere within the crowd instantly sent the atmosphere across the plaza into a frenzy. And not just that. The entire Jianyun Sect, from top to bottom, entered an explosive state, like an intense eruption of underground flames, burning furiously among the crowd.
"Ah!"
Ye Yun did not find Nangong Jade in the crowd, feeling a bit disappointed. He couldn’t help but sigh softly.
Nangong Jade perhaps had left the Daluo Region. She probably broke through to the Divine Sovereign Realm, leaving this area for elsewhere in the Divine Land.
Feeling down, Ye Yun lowered his head, losing interest in the Grand Sky Sacrifice ceremony.
Just then, "Please welcome the Sword Sovereign!"
A clear feminine voice echoed throughout the Jianyun Sect once again.
Ye Yun raised his head.
Regarding this Sword Sovereign, he was curious and wanted to see what kind of person they were.
In the void above, a sudden beam of cold sword light came swooping across. After a flash of the sword light, it transformed into an incomparably beautiful woman in a red dress.
The lady in red had bright eyes and white teeth, and her skin was fairer than snow. She possessed an exquisite, fairy-like beauty. Her refined features were stunningly breathtaking. She had a cold and noble demeanor, and her whole body emitted an undefinable, powerful allure.
Now, she was standing in the sky, with her hands behind her back, exuding the potent aura of the God Monarch Realm’s tenth layer.
"The Sword Sovereign is here!"
The entire plaza immediately erupted. The Sword Sovereign’s reputation in the whole Daluo Region was illustrious and deeply ingrained.
She could be said to be the foremost figure of the Daluo Region.
In ten thousand years, no one dared to challenge her. The Sword Sovereign’s Killing Sword Technique was extraordinarily terrifying, a fact acknowledged by all cultivators in the Daluo Region.
At this moment, Ye Yun was staring at the void in disbelief, suspecting he was seeing things.
He quickly rubbed his eyes and looked again toward the Sword Sovereign in the void.
No mistake! That was a familiar face, familiar beautiful eyes, familiar red lips, familiar skin like white jade...
Ye Yun had never dreamt of it.
The Sword Sovereign was actually Liu Yiyi, who he had long considered dead in his heart.
"How could it be her?" Ye Yun mumbled to himself, his expression becoming somewhat uncontrollable, his body slightly shaking.
He came to the Daluo Region to look for Nangong Jade. He hadn’t found Nangong Jade but had instead discovered Liu Yiyi, who had apparently returned from the dead.
The reason he said ’returned from the dead’ was that on the Cangnan Continent, Ye Yun had seen Liu Yiyi’s descendants. Therefore, in his heart, Liu Yiyi had long since fallen. But what Ye Yun did not expect was that the living Liu Yiyi appeared at this moment in the Daluo Region of the Divine Land, and had even become the Sword Sovereign of the Jianyun Sect.
Unbelievable!
At this moment, Ye Yun’s heart was filled with surging waves.
One hundred thousand years ago, Liu Yiyi’s cultivation base was only at the Eternal Realm. How did she get through the Ancient Road to Heaven? Even for cultivators at the True God Realm First Level, it would be incredibly challenging to pass through the Ancient Road to Heaven. How did Liu Yiyi, in the Eternal Realm, manage to break through?
Ye Yun had too many questions in his heart. But in the end, he held them back.
Now was the time for the Jianyun Sect’s Grand Sky Sacrifice ceremony, Liu Yiyi’s moment of glory. He absolutely must not interrupt her. After the Grand Sky Sacrifice ceremony ended, Ye Yun would find Liu Yiyi to ask for clarification.
"Boss, what’s wrong?" the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon softly sent him a telepathic message, noticing Ye Yun didn’t seem right.
"It’s nothing," Ye Yun said softly.
As he spoke, Ye Yun set up a barrier so Ye Wei and the middle-aged man—at the seventh layer of the Divine Monarch Realm—beside him could not hear.
"The Sword Sovereign is so beautiful. Even as a woman, I feel like I’m falling in love with the Sword Sovereign," Ye Wei said, looking up at the beautiful figure in red in the sky, her eyes filled with zealous admiration, murmuring to herself.
"Don’t even think about it. For so many years, the Sword Sovereign has never had any interest in the opposite sex. Her heart only belongs to the sword," the middle-aged man at the seventh layer of the Divine Monarch Realm said with a smile.
"That’s not necessarily true. Perhaps the Sword Sovereign has never met the man of her dreams," Ye Wei pouted, murmuring snidely. "I think if there is a man who surpasses the Sword Sovereign in swordsmanship, he might capture her heart. For instance, the mysterious character that’s about to appear."
"You might have a point." The middle-aged man beside her nodded, surprisingly not refuting her.
He was also greatly interested in the mysterious individual who was about to challenge the Sword Sovereign. After all, no one had dared to challenge the Sword Sovereign in tens of thousands of years.
Hearing this dialogue, Ye Yun remained expressionless, but his eyebrows were slightly raised.
If this mysterious guy dares to show up, Ye Yun will definitely rip his head off and kick it like a ball. Damn it! Daring to flirt with his woman? That’s asking for death!
At that moment, Ye Yun, once the most notorious bully on the Cangnan Continent a hundred thousand years ago, seemed to have returned. Just for a woman.
Upon the Sword Sovereign’s appearance, the formidable aura she emitted dominated all the cultivators in the Jianyun Sect. With an icy demeanor, she scanned the surroundings and declared indifferently, "Today, my Green Luo Sword Sect shall officially be renamed the Jianyun Sect."
As her voice died down, a wave of applause, like a tidal wave, rose from the mountains below.
All attendants who had come to observe the ceremony were clapping with all their might, expressing their congratulations.
Meanwhile, all the disciples of the Jianyun Sect flew upwards, positioning themselves around the Sword Sovereign. Before the Sword Sovereign, a Golden Incense Burner appeared out of nowhere.
The Sword Sovereign solemnly lit three incense sticks. With a calm expression, she respectfully bowed three times towards the sky. All the disciples behind her also followed suit, bowing three times towards the sky.
The Sword Sovereign inserted the three burning incense sticks into the Golden Incense Burner. Instantly, a few strands of blue smoke drifted upwards into the sky. She stood quietly in mid-air, patiently waiting for that person to arrive.
Meanwhile, all the disciples of the Jianyun Sect returned to the mountain peak.
This Grand Sky Sacrifice ceremony is rather simple,
Ye Yun thought, quietly nodding in the square.
Liu Yiyi, devoted to the sword all her life, was a woman of simplicity and directness. Hence, this Grand Sky Sacrifice ceremony was also extremely simple. After offering three incense sticks to the heavens and announcing the Jianyun Sect’s renaming, the ceremony was considered over.
Jianyun Sect?
Ye Yun’s eyes suddenly sparkled; he seemed to have guessed the hidden meaning behind the Sect’s name.
...
"A world-shaking battle is about to begin!" an excited cultivator at the God Monarch Realm’s tenth layer exclaimed in the square.
"In this battle, the Sword Sovereign will surely be victorious, forging her path to becoming the unparalleled God in the future!" another cultivator declared solemnly.
"Everyone, keep quiet," an Elder from the Jianyun Sect warned, glancing in their direction.
The two men immediately closed their mouths, and the other cultivators nearby became silent as cicadas in winter. The entire square was now utterly silent.
Tens of thousands of cultivators looked up towards the Sword Sovereign, waiting with bated breath.
They knew... the main event was about to begin. The mysterious figure was about to make his entrance.
Suddenly, a ripple in space revealed a black silhouette. It gradually sharpened, revealing a young man in black. He was extraordinarily handsome and elegant, with deep, captivating features.
As soon as he appeared, a powerful aura of the Half-step Divine Venerate Realm swept down from the sky like a mighty river.
"Sword Sovereign, today I challenge you!" the young man in black declared after appearing, standing with his hands behind his back. A trace of defiance flashed across his face as he issued his challenge to the Sword Sovereign.
His voice, like sudden thunder, boomed downwards.
Many True God Realm cultivators standing halfway up the Jianyun Sect mountain heard this voice. Their faces turned crimson, their bodies trembled, and they struggled to remain standing.

chapters.title: Chapter 408: Asura Armor Reappears
chapters.content:
Chapter 408: Chapter 408: Asura Armor Reappears
Experts at the Half-step Divine Venerate Realm are truly terrifying!
Many people were greatly shocked. Some weaker cultivators in the True God Realm couldn’t withstand the sonic assault and staggered, falling unconscious. Only some higher-level True God Realm cultivators managed to resist this wave of sonic attack. As for the Divine Monarch Realm cultivators, they were not affected in the slightest.
"Where is this person from? He feels unfamiliar. Could he be from outside the Daluo Region?" a Divine Monarch Realm cultivator frowned and asked.
"No, I have some impression of this person. He seems to be Sword Sovereign’s Senior Brother," another elder, at the seventh level of the Divine Monarch Realm, stated.
"Sword Sovereign’s Senior Brother?" Many people exclaimed in surprise.
"Sword Sovereign’s Senior Brother was defeated by her 20,000 years ago. Ashamed and enraged, he left the Green Luo Sword Sect of that time and vanished without a trace. Who would have thought that after all these years, he would return during Jianyun Sect’s Heavenly Worship Ceremony?" the old man sighed as he spoke.
"I’ve also heard of this Senior Brother from the Sword Sect. It’s said he was also a supreme talent in the Sword Dao. Before Sword Sovereign joined the Green Luo Sword Sect, he was the designated successor for Sect Master. But after Sword Sovereign’s meteoric rise, his supreme brilliance was overshadowed," another elderly man slowly recounted.
After hearing the accounts of these two seniors, many people gained a more comprehensive understanding of the black-clad youth. It turned out that he could also be considered a disciple of the Jianyun Sect. If this black-clad youth defeated Sword Sovereign, then the position of new Sect Master of Jianyun Sect would fall to him, this Half-step Divine Venerate Realm expert.
Hearing the hushed conversations around him, Ye Yun quickly understood.
Although this Senior Brother of Sword Sovereign sounded formidable, Ye Yun had immense confidence in Liu Yiyi. If Liu Yiyi could defeat this man 20,000 years ago, she could do so again now. Therefore, at such a climactic moment, Ye Yun decided not to interfere, letting Liu Yiyi handle it herself. Once the battle concluded, he would capture this black-clad youth, permanently eliminating this future threat for Liu Yiyi.
Sword Sovereign gazed coldly at the black-clad youth before her. She drew her sword and pointed it at him. "You destroyed my puppets. Today, I will definitely kill you!" Sword Sovereign declared icily.
Hearing Sword Sovereign’s words, a pained expression crossed the black-clad youth’s face. He gritted his teeth and said, "They’re just some worthless puppets! So what if they’re destroyed? What can you do to me?"
"You—go—die!" Sword Sovereign shouted sharply. In an instant, her entire being transformed into an incredibly fierce streak of sword light, slashing towards the black-clad youth.
The power of this sword strike was astounding. The Divine Monarch Realm cultivators in the square below felt a tremendous Sword Intent, even from a great distance, making their skin tingle painfully. Everyone was greatly shocked.
If they had faced Sword Sovereign directly, they would have already been injured.
"I will defeat you and reclaim the Green Luo Sword Sect!" the black-clad youth roared, transforming into a streak of sword light and charging forward to meet her.
BOOM!
Two terrifying sword lights collided in mid-air, producing a deafening explosion. Both lights recoiled simultaneously, revealing the two figures. Their first exchange ended in a stalemate; they seemed evenly matched.
"Sword Sovereign is, after all, at the tenth level of the Divine Monarch Realm, a minor realm lower than that fellow. Fighting like this, she’s bound to be at a disadvantage..."
"Although Sword Sovereign’s realm is slightly lower, she has long been capable of rivaling Half-step Divine Venerate Realm experts. So, Sword Sovereign will definitely win."
In the square, some Divine Monarch Realm cultivators couldn’t help but discuss this.
No sooner had they spoken than Sword Sovereign and the black-clad youth clashed once more.
Their Swordsmanship was simply too fast. Sword shadows and lights crisscrossed, making it impossible for anyone to discern their figures. All that could be seen were two blurs of sword light constantly colliding in mid-air, producing a series of earth-shattering sounds. Initially, there were two blurs of sword light, but they gradually multiplied until the entire void was filled with them. Powerful Sword Qi, like silver rivers, cascaded down from mid-air.
HUM!
Suddenly, a large formation activated, creating a light barrier that enveloped the entire Jianyun Sect.
"Jianyun Sect has been very thoughtful. By activating the Mountain Protection Array, we Divine Monarch Realm cultivators can avoid being caught in the battle’s aftermath," a cultivator said with lingering fear. He couldn’t help but give a thumbs-up, deeply grateful for Jianyun Sect’s actions. At this moment, nearly all cultivators attending Jianyun Sect’s Heavenly Worship Ceremony felt a similar sense of gratitude. Jianyun Sect, under Sword Sovereign’s leadership, had always been fair and just, earning an excellent reputation in the Daluo Region.
"Good, good..." Ye Yun nodded repeatedly as he watched the fierce battle in mid-air.
After 100,000 years, Liu Yiyi has become so much stronger. She truly is worthy of the title Sword Sovereign. Her breakthroughs in the Sword Dao have reached a terrifying level. However, that black-clad youth, her Senior Brother, also possesses exceptional Sword Dao talent. Coupled with a cultivation realm slightly higher than Liu Yiyi’s, it makes it difficult to determine a victor quickly. Still, Ye Yun was more experienced. From subtle clues, he deduced that Liu Yiyi would ultimately be the victor.
"Sigh, it’s truly hard to imagine I can still see a woman from 100,000 years ago." Ye Yun, a man of two lives, gazed towards the void, his expression complex, filled with myriad emotions.
Although he had met Qin Yao in the Red Dust Fairyland, she lacked a physical body and was merely a lingering obsession. Later, on Shenhu Mountain, he encountered a wisp of Yun Xiao’s will—Yun Xiao, who was revered by later generations of the Demon Clan as the Demon Ancestor. These were all illusory, without any true substance. But the Liu Yiyi before him was a tangible, living person.
Ye Yun’s check-in of 100,000 years had forged an eternal and imperturbable Dao Heart, yet at this moment, a touch of vibrant color was added to it.
At this moment, Ye Yun even recalled a phrase from his past life: ’It’s... good to be alive.’ That saying was perfect for this moment, truly fitting the scene.
After 100,000 years, for two lovers to meet again was no less than a world-ending cataclysm of heavenly thunder and earthly fire.
In mid-air, the battle raged with exceptional intensity. The aftershocks of the battle continuously slammed into the Mountain Protection Array surrounding Jianyun Sect. The Mountain Protection Array also began to shake violently. This made many cultivators and Jianyun Sect disciples quite alarmed.
Ye Yun glanced over and saw numerous Jianyun Sect disciples deep underground, channeling all their energy into maintaining the formation. Ye Yun gently pointed a finger. A ray of light instantly permeated deep into the earth, then transformed into countless motes of light that flowed into the Mountain Protection Array. The entire Mountain Protection Array immediately stopped shaking.
The disciples operating the formation couldn’t help but heave a sigh of relief. They didn’t know what had happened and assumed the battle’s aftershocks had weakened.
After about the time it takes for an incense stick to burn, Liu Yiyi gradually gained the upper hand. Suddenly, without warning, she thrust her sword into the black-clad youth’s shoulder.
SPLAT!
A spray of blood erupted. The black-clad youth, crying out in pain, instantly retreated.
"You audacious Liu Yiyi! Did you really think I wouldn’t dare to kill you?!" the black-clad youth roared. Instantly, a deep cyan light enveloped his entire body.
BANG! BANG!
Simultaneously, Sword Sovereign, who had closed in, unleashed ten thousand sword lights upon him. The ten thousand sword lights struck the deep cyan light but were all deflected.
The black-clad youth laughed arrogantly. As the light faded, a suit of armor, shimmering with cyan light, was revealed on his body.
Asura Armor?
Ye Yun frowned upon seeing the Asura Armor, which he had once gifted to Jiang Hengyue, now on the black-clad youth.

chapters.title: Chapter 409: Ye Yun Makes a Grand Appearance, Liu Yiyi’s Shock
chapters.content:
Chapter 409: Chapter 409: Ye Yun Makes a Grand Appearance, Liu Yiyi’s Shock
Jiang Hengyue only possessed the cultivation base of the True God Realm. After donning the Asura Armor, his combat power could surge to the Half-step Divine Monarch Realm. However, compared to this black-clad youth at the Peak of the God Monarch Realm, they were not on the same level at all. Thus, it would be a piece of cake for this person to snatch Jiang Hengyue’s Asura Armor.
Ye Yun hadn’t expected that the Ninth Sea Area, an extremely remote location where even Divine Monarch Realm cultivators were exceedingly rare, would be visited by this black-clad youth at the Half-step Divine Venerate Realm. This youth had actually gone to Skyreach Island in the Ninth Sea Area and snatched that Asura Armor.
This person is truly shameless!
Ye Yun thought.
This also demonstrates that Skyreach Island’s strength is insufficient to deter such a powerful cultivator. I’ll have to set up an impenetrable Defense Formation next time I visit Skyreach Island.
...
"Why does Sword Sovereign’s Senior Brother have an extra piece of armor?"
"What exactly is that armor? Its aura is so potent!"
"My heavens! His cultivation base has soared to the Divine Sovereign Realm!"
"Is that a God-level Armor? It actually allowed him to leap from the Half-step Divine Venerate Realm straight to the Divine Sovereign Realm! This armor... it’s simply terrifying!"
"The Sword Sovereign is likely in danger this time."
"Sigh..."
On the platform, all the God King Level Cultivators were visibly moved, unable to conceal the tempestuous shock in their hearts. Just moments ago, when the Sword Sovereign had unleashed her Killing Sword Technique, such a formidable attack had landed on the Green Armor to no effect whatsoever; it had been completely repelled. In other words, this Green Armor possessed an unimaginable defensive power.
In the void, Sword Sovereign suddenly ceased her attack. She stared coldly at the black-clad youth enveloped by the Green Armor, her aura intensifying. At this moment, Sword Sovereign was finally prepared to unleash her life’s ultimate techniques without reservation.
"Liu Yiyi! You are no match for me. This Asura Armor allows me to directly reach the Divine Sovereign Realm. Considering our fellowship as members of the same Sect, if you beg for mercy, we can still be Senior Brother and Junior Sister. What do you say?" the black-clad youth said gravely, his eyes filled with smugness and arrogance.
For nearly a thousand years, he had kept this body hidden, cultivating deep within the seabed of the Ninth Sea Area, far from the Divine Land. Unexpectedly, on Skyreach Island, he had discovered that a mere True God Realm Cultivator possessed a God-level Armor.
This discovery made him ecstatic. If he also possessed such a God-level Armor, wouldn’t his combat power increase manifold?
As a Great Cultivator at the Peak of the God Monarch Realm, he naturally knew that such God-level Armor was extremely rare even in the Divine Land. Even an Immortal honoring practitioner might not possess one.
At that moment, he had been tempted. He had acted decisively and snatched the Asura Armor. After obtaining it, he had spent a considerable amount of time thoroughly refining it. Now, this Asura Armor had made both his offense and defense terrifyingly formidable. Facing the lethal attacks of Sword Sovereign’s Killing Sword Technique, he no longer felt any fear.
In the square, Ye Yun’s eyes flickered, a divine light passing through them. In this situation, he naturally couldn’t stand by and watch Liu Yiyi get injured. No matter how strong Liu Yiyi was, she was only at the God Monarch Realm tenth layer. There was still a significant gap to the True God Venerable Realm.
With a flicker, Ye Yun appeared in mid-air. Under everyone’s watchful eyes, he did not acknowledge Liu Yiyi. With his hands clasped behind his back, he gazed indifferently at the black-clad youth opposite him, his eyes exceptionally cold.
Ye Yun’s sudden appearance stunned everyone in the Jianyun Sect.
"Isn’t that the White Clad Sword Cultivator who slew Wang Teng from the Hegemon Sect? How did he suddenly appear?"
"We originally thought he was going to challenge the Sword Sovereign. We didn’t expect it to be the Sword Sovereign’s Senior Brother who was issuing the challenge! We really made a blunder last time. Looking at it now, it turns out he wants to challenge the Sword Sovereign’s Senior Brother, doesn’t he?"
"Now this will be a good show to watch."
"They say this white-clad young man is at the God Monarch Realm fifth layer. Can his combat power match that fellow who is comparable to the Divine Sovereign Realm?"
"..."
On the square, those Immortal honoring practitioners all grew agitated, their gazes locked onto the figures in mid-air, voicing their various suspicions.
"Is this...?"
Gazing at the elegant, almost ethereal figure in white, Sword Sovereign, suspended in the void, seemed to fall into a daze. A warm current surged through her originally cold and unfeeling eyes.
So similar... He’s so similar.
The back view of the white-clad young man was strikingly, almost nine-tenths similar to the Brother Yun in her heart.
Sword Sovereign had naturally heard the discussions among the God King Level Cultivators in the square. Only then did she realize that the white-clad young man standing between her and the black-clad youth was the Mysterious Sword Cultivator who had slain Wang Teng of the Hegemon Sect.
"So alike! Truly so alike..."
At this moment, Sword Sovereign’s heart felt as if a hundred colossal waves were crashing within it, her emotions teetering on the brink of losing control. She had yearned for him for a hundred thousand years. Now, with the sudden appearance of someone who so closely resembled Ye Yun, Sword Sovereign could no longer contain her inner feelings.
"Who are you?" the black-clad youth shouted, his heart pounding as a white-clad young man suddenly appeared before him.
"This Asura Armor isn’t bad," Ye Yun said with a slow smile, leisurely drawing a Silver Long Sword. "Too bad it doesn’t belong to you. Today, I will reclaim this Asura Armor."
"How did you know?" the black-clad youth demanded, staring intently at Ye Yun, his mind reeling in shock.
The Ninth Sea Area is extremely far from the Daluo Region. That place is incredibly remote; cultivators from the Daluo Region almost never venture there. How could this white-clad Sword Cultivator know that his Asura Armor was stolen? This white-clad youth appears to be only at the God Monarch Realm fifth layer, yet he shows no nervousness when facing me. He even declared he would fight me to reclaim the Asura Armor. This person must have concealed his true cultivation base. His actual realm might be at least the Half-step Divine Venerate Realm, or even higher. At worst, he might even be an Immortal honoring practitioner.
Thinking this, the black-clad youth became extremely wary. Although he possessed the Asura Armor, he still felt a degree of nervousness when facing a True God Venerable Realm cultivator.
Ye Yun suddenly sensed something; he heard rapid breathing behind him.
It was Liu Yiyi’s voice.
Although Ye Yun had altered his facial features, his build remained unchanged. The sight of his white-robed back easily caught Liu Yiyi’s attention.
Ye Yun turned around.
Looking at that devastatingly beautiful and familiar face, he offered a slight smile.
Sword Sovereign Liu Yiyi’s eyes instantly widened. The white-clad young man before her, though handsome, was not Ye Yun.
"It seems I was just wishful thinking,"
Liu Yiyi sighed inwardly.
"Brother Yun has been dead for a hundred thousand years. How could he possibly appear in the Divine Land?"
In that instant, the raging fire in her chest was extinguished, and her heart began to freeze over once more.
"The Asura Armor your Senior Brother is wearing was stolen from a friend of mine," Ye Yun said with a gentle smile, as warm and refreshing as a spring breeze. "After I retrieve the armor, you two can continue your fight."
"That smile..."
Looking at Ye Yun, Liu Yiyi’s heart suddenly began to pound erratically.
Although this white-clad young man looked different from Brother Yun, for some reason, the hint of a smile on his face was strikingly, eight or nine-tenths similar to Brother Yun’s...

chapters.title: Chapter 410: Binary Sword Chant
chapters.content:
Chapter 410: Chapter 410: Binary Sword Chant
"Die!"
Taking advantage of the moment Ye Yun turned his head, the young man in black seized the opportunity. A cold glint flashed in his eyes as he launched a fierce attack.
WHOOSH!
WHOOSH!
WHOOSH!
Countless remarkable sword beams shredded the void, descending upon Ye Yun like lightning.
Facing such a powerful onslaught, nearly at the First Layer of the Divine Sovereign Realm, Ye Yun remained unfazed, merely positioning his Silver Sword horizontally across his chest.
In an instant, a subtle change seemed to ripple through the world. The grand momentum of heaven and earth appeared to converge upon the longsword Ye Yun held across his chest.
This Silver Sword, seemingly supporting heaven and earth, felt as heavy as ten thousand tons, yet in Ye Yun’s hand, it appeared effortlessly light.
At this moment, his body and the sword became one, melded with the universe.
FZZT! FZZT!
Countless astonishing sword lights surged forward, yet for some unknown reason, as they drew near, they were all absorbed by the Silver Sword held horizontally across his chest.
The Silver Sword seemed to possess a magical quality at this moment. All sword light attacks vanished as if stones sinking into the ocean depths the moment they approached the void near the longsword.
Only then did Ye Yun slowly turn his head to look at the young man in black.
"As a Sword Dao Pride, do you only know how to launch sneak attacks? Come on... I’ll give you a chance. Let’s see if you can break my swordsmanship," Ye Yun jeered.
His hand remained steady, clutching the Silver Sword across his chest, exuding an aura of ’one man guarding the pass, ten thousand unable to break through.’
Ye Yun’s current swordsmanship stemmed from his recent comprehension of the Binary Sword Chant.
This was a Divine Level Top Quality swordsmanship.
Named Binary, the entire swordsmanship comprised only two moves.
One was called Life.
The other, Death.
Extremely simple.
With the Sword of Life Realm, the sword held across the chest, no attack in the world could breach it.
With the Sword of Death Realm, a single strike unleashed, no defense in the world could withstand it.
He was now employing the Sword of Life Realm. With the sword held horizontally, no matter how vast the enemy’s army, they could not hope to pass.
"What on earth is this swordsmanship?"
The black-clad youth’s pupils contracted violently as he stared intently at the sword in Ye Yun’s hand.
He was, after all, a supreme Sword Dao genius from the Green Luo Sword Sect and had later traveled the Divine Land, vastly broadening his horizons.
Just moments ago, all his attacks on Ye Yun had inexplicably vanished, making him realize that his opponent’s Sword Dao Divine Skills were unimaginably powerful.
Simply by holding the sword horizontally across his chest, motionless, Ye Yun had completely blocked his formidable attack.
It was truly inconceivable.
The Sword Dao Divine Skill demonstrated by this swordsmanship was beyond his comprehension.
The Master’s swordsmanship...
the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon thought, standing alone in the square, a look of shock and disbelief on his face.
This was the first time he had seen his master utilize such potent swordsmanship.
It was not only simple and direct but also immensely powerful.
A single sword held across the chest could nullify thousands of sword lights.
Truly terrifying.
Young Master Ye is too strong!
Ye Wei thought, her face flushed as she stood nearby, her entire body trembling with excitement.
Although her Sword Dao cultivation was not high, she could perceive that the Divine Skill contained in that recent sword strike was simply unimaginable.
Too strong... Young Master Ye’s swordsmanship is truly something I’ve rarely seen in my lifetime,
the middle-aged man at the Seventh Layer of the Divine Monarch Realm sighed deeply.
All the Divine Monarch Realm cultivators and those at the True God Realm Tenth Layer Peak in the square were plunged into profound shock.
After a few seconds, people gradually began to recover from their astonishment.
A flurry of discussion erupted among the crowd, with everyone voicing their varied opinions.
They had nothing but praise for the Sword Dao Divine Skill Ye Yun had just displayed.
"Deep within the Divine Land, there’s a Sword Pavilion rumored to be teeming with sword masters. Could it be... that this white-robed young Sword Cultivator hails from there?" an elderly man mused, frowning.
"That’s hard to say. Our Daluo Region borders the sea, placing it on the very periphery of the Divine Land. Who knows what kind of powerful experts exist in the depths of the Divine Land?" another cultivator immediately chimed in.
"A faction like the Sword Pavilion would likely have Divine King Realm experts. Why would such a terrifying power be interested in our Daluo Region?" scoffed yet another cultivator.
"Then where could he be from..."
"Could it be..."
Everyone began to speculate, their hearts filled with a mixture of curiosity and fear towards this mysterious white-robed youth.
Suspended in mid-air, Liu Yiyi, as the Daluo Region’s foremost swordsmanship master, was utterly stunned after witnessing the white-robed youth execute such a divinely skillful sword technique.
In her entire life, having immersed herself in the Sword Dao for nearly one hundred thousand years, she had never encountered such a terrifyingly brilliant and unmatched sword technique.
This seemingly simple sword technique, in Liu Yiyi’s eyes, was filled with endless profundity. At that moment, she desperately wished she could rush over and learn from the white-robed youth.
"What, not daring to attack anymore?" Ye Yun looked at the black-robed youth opposite him, shrugged, and smiled faintly.
"Die!"
After a fierce internal struggle, the black-robed youth finally launched another attack.
This time, he held nothing back, activating the Asura Armor and unleashing his lifetime’s peak combat strength.
Endless rays of sword light erupted from his hand, blanketing the entire void.
Each ray of sword light contained unimaginable power. If they were to fall, the entire Jianyun Sect might be annihilated.
Seeing this, Liu Yiyi’s expression changed drastically.
Even if she could withstand this attack, she would be severely injured.
Moreover, she doubted she could block all the cascading sword light.
After all, her cultivation base was insufficient.
An onslaught from the Divine Sovereign Realm is truly horrifying,
many in the crowd thought, their hearts pounding.
The countless people in the square watched the sky nervously.
If the white-robed youth couldn’t withstand it, perhaps even the Jianyun Sect’s Grand Formation would collapse.
At that point, they would have to directly face that terrifying barrage of sword light.
Among so many, very few would likely survive.
How terrifying! I wonder if Young Master Ye can withstand it,
Ye Wei thought, her face paling. Even from behind the Grand Formation, she felt a chill run down her spine, sensing the dreadful power of the enraged black-robed youth’s attack.
"There’s no need to worry. Our Master can certainly withstand this kind of attack," the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon said with a calm, confident grin.
Is he really that strong?
the middle-aged man at the Seventh Layer of the Divine Monarch Realm next to him wondered, staring intently into the void.
He was astonished to see that Young Master Ye still held his Silver Sword horizontally across his chest, remaining utterly motionless in the face of the terrifying rain of sword light.
Seeing this, his heart clenched violently.
He’s still using that move to block such a powerful sword light attack?
Not just him, even the Sword Sovereign in mid-air felt a similar doubt arise in his heart.
"Now this is more like it," Ye Yun remarked with a casual smile, his composure unruffled.
His hand remained steady, still holding the sword across his chest.
How could the profound subtlety of the Binary Sword Chant be broken by this black-robed youth’s swordsmanship?
The sky filled with sword light, pouring down like a deluge.
Instantly, it seemed as if an invisible force drew the torrent towards the Silver Sword held across his chest.
Yet, just as the sword light neared the Silver Sword, it all inexplicably vanished once more.
This... How is this possible?!
The black-robed youth glared at this scene in fury and let out a fierce roar.
This time, he transformed into a meteor and charged forward, aiming his sword tip at Ye Yun’s brow.

chapters.title: Chapter 411 Retrieving the Armor, Killing the Black-clad Youth
chapters.content:
Chapter 411: Chapter 411 Retrieving the Armor, Killing the Black-clad Youth
"That White Clad Sword Cultivator is truly strong! With just a single, magical display of swordsmanship, he once again blocked the opponent’s ferocious attack!"
"Yes! Now the black-clad youth is forced into a close-quarters assault. If he still can’t break through the White Clad Sword Cultivator’s mysterious defensive swordsmanship, then he’s utterly defeated."
"This swordsmanship is truly groundbreaking; it’s simply too powerful."
Everyone in the square was buzzing with discussion.
Witnessing Ye Yun’s Binary Sword Chant, they all felt their horizons expand.
This type of sword technique was truly miraculous.
"Not bad. You finally stopped cowering."
Seeing the black-clad youth actually intending a close-quarters attack, Ye Yun couldn’t help but sneer.
He continued to hold his sword steadily across his chest, motionless.
The Sword of Life Realm could defend against any attack in the world.
The black-clad youth shot forward like a cannonball, thrusting fiercely towards Ye Yun. However, when he was about three zhang away...
The black-clad youth discovered that the tip of his sword, originally aimed at Ye Yun’s brow, had inexplicably shifted to Ye Yun’s chest.
His previously ferocious speed, at this moment, slowed as if he had entered a muddy quagmire.
He only managed to advance two zhang.
The black-clad youth could no longer push the sword in his hand towards Ye Yun.
To his astonishment, he found that the opponent’s sword, held across his chest, seemed connected to the entire world.
The might of heaven and earth converged upon that Silver Sword.
This formidable power rendered any attack incapable of breaking through.
So strong...
The black-clad youth was greatly shocked. He violently tried to withdraw his sword and retreat.
His first attempt to pull back the sword failed.
The entire blade felt as if it were mired in mud, utterly stuck.
On his second attempt, he drew upon all his Mana, pouring it into the Asura Armor, and instantly yanked the sword free.
This person is too strong; I’m no match for him. I must leave this place at once.
The black-clad youth took a deep breath, preparing to tear open the void and escape.
"Trying to leave?"
Ye Yun pointed lightly with his hand.
At that moment, he cast the Stasis Technique.
The black-clad youth, in the act of tearing the void, froze abruptly, fixed in mid-air as if he were a clay statue.
Ye Yun made a grasping motion, and an unimaginably vast power descended upon the youth.
The Asura Armor on his body was forcibly ripped off, landing instantly in Ye Yun’s hand.
"Sword Sovereign, I’ve retrieved the Asura Armor. The two of you can continue your duel now."
Ye Yun smiled faintly, put away the Asura Armor, then flew down to the square, landing beside the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon.
The surrounding Divine Monarch Realm Cultivators all retreated several steps, then gazed at Ye Yun with fervent admiration.
The mysterious White Clad Sword Cultivator was simply too strong.
His array of Divine Skills was incredible, leaving everyone in awe.
Even an expert at the First Level of the Divine Sovereign Realm couldn’t last a single move against him.
He... he got the Asura Armor back so easily?
In mid-air, Liu Yiyi was dumbfounded. Her beautiful, usually icy face took on an extremely strange expression.
Across from her in the void, the black-clad youth still maintained his posture of tearing the void, like a clay statue.
Ye Yun pointed lightly from afar.
The Stasis Technique affecting the black-clad youth immediately dissipated.
The black-clad youth instantly regained his freedom of movement.
But the immense fear in his heart had already made his body stiffen.
Just moments ago, he had been forcibly frozen in mid-air. Although his body couldn’t move, his thoughts and consciousness had remained active.
What kind of Divine Skill is this? It suddenly rendered me immobile! If a sword had struck me then, would I still be alive?
The black-clad youth thought, his heart filled with terror.
Now, without the Asura Armor, and facing the overwhelmingly powerful Sword Sovereign, he no longer had the courage to fight.
Liu Yiyi’s delicate figure flickered, and in an instant, she appeared before him, her sword pointed at his chest.
Despair filled the black-clad youth. He closed his eyes, preparing to abandon this body.
Liu Yiyi, her expression intense, said coldly, "You destroyed my puppets! You deserve to die!"
THUNK!
The sword in Liu Yiyi’s hand thrust fiercely into the black-clad youth’s chest, bursting his heart on the spot.
A ray of light suddenly shot up from between the black-clad youth’s eyebrows.
In mid-air, it transformed into an illusory figure.
"Liu Yiyi, you actually dared to strike me?"
The illusory Primordial Spirit in mid-air waved its arm, speaking in fury.
Liu Yiyi’s expression was cold as she said calmly, "If you hadn’t destroyed those puppets, I would naturally have considered our ties as fellow sect members."
"Haha..."
The illusory Primordial Spirit suddenly burst into laughter.
"Liu Yiyi! I know that man you love died long ago! You’ll never see him again in this lifetime! Compared to me losing a mere clone, your fate is far more tragic, haha!"
A clone?
Liu Yiyi was stunned.
The black-clad youth before me... was just a clone?
If his clone has already reached the Half-step Divine Venerate Realm cultivation base, then wouldn’t his true body have reached the Divine Sovereign Realm?
How could this guy’s Cultivation speed be so fast?
"Liu Yiyi, let me tell you the truth: my true body has already advanced to the Divine Sovereign Realm. Sooner or later, I will come to seek revenge on you."
The illusory Primordial Spirit laughed twice, then looked at the white-clad youth in the square and said mockingly, "You, an outsider Cultivator, can’t stay in the Jianyun Sect forever, can you? Once you leave, Liu Yiyi will be no match for me."
"You have a point."
Ye Yun smiled lightly, his expression remaining incredibly relaxed.
So what if he has broken through to the Divine Sovereign Realm?
I have plenty of ways to make Liu Yiyi even more powerful.
Just as the illusory Primordial Spirit was about to speak, he suddenly looked dazed for a moment.
Huh? What just happened?
The illusory Primordial Spirit shook its head violently, finding it hard to believe the daze it had just experienced...
A faint smile touched Ye Yun’s lips.
At that moment, he had activated the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye and read the Primordial Spirit’s memories.
Through its memories, he learned that Jiang Hengyue from Skyreach Island was not dead yet.
This fellow, puffed up by his status, had simply left after snatching the Asura Armor.
He hadn’t bothered to eliminate those few cultivators at the True God Realm Cultivation Level.
Their low cultivation base had, ironically, become Jiang Hengyue’s trump card for survival.
This fellow’s true body was currently in a hidden grotto-heaven, extremely far from the Daluo Region.
It wouldn’t be able to emerge for some time.
"Sword Sovereign, it’s not your style to cut the grass but not remove the roots."
As Ye Yun thought of this, he suddenly looked at Liu Yiyi, a smile appearing on his face.
Liu Yiyi was taken aback.
Why did that sentence sound so familiar?
A hundred thousand years ago, the man she loved most had once advised her similarly.
SWISH!
Without hesitation, Liu Yiyi raised her sword and, with a single strike, obliterated the illusory Primordial Spirit.
"Just you wait, Liu Yiyi! Sooner or later, I will return!"
The Primordial Spirit split in two. Just before vanishing, it let out a savage, furious roar.
The sound rumbled, echoing throughout the entire Jianyun Sect.
Then, the bisected Primordial Spirit completely vanished from the world.
"I’ll be waiting."
Liu Yiyi sheathed her longsword. Standing in the void, she resembled a peerless, God-tiered Sword, radiating an endless, divine light.
At this moment, the confident and stunningly beautiful Sword Sovereign left all the cultivators below utterly mesmerized.

chapters.title: Chapter 412: The Formal Meeting After 100,000 Years
chapters.content:
Chapter 412: Chapter 412: The Formal Meeting After 100,000 Years
"Truly worthy of the Sword Sovereign."
"Without his Asura Armor, her senior brother, even at the Half-step Divine Venerate Realm, is still no match for the Sword Sovereign at the tenth layer of the Divine Monarch Realm."
"The Sword Sovereign is incredibly strong, truly deserving of being the number one swordmaster in our Daluo Region..."
Many cultivators below gazed at the incomparably graceful figure, their eyes filled with frenzied admiration.
However, a flicker of concern crossed the eyes of some. After all, the young man in black had said before his demise that he was merely one of his incarnations. His true body had already cultivated to the Divine Sovereign Realm. With such a cultivation base, if he were to come to the Daluo Region to challenge the Sword Sovereign, she would likely not be his opponent.
"The Grand Heavenly Ceremony concludes here. Thank you all for your presence."
The Sword Sovereign’s cool and clear voice suddenly spread from the air, announcing the end of the grand event.
Many cultivators stared blankly at the stunningly beautiful Sword Sovereign in the void, seemingly unwilling to depart.
The Sword Sovereign turned to leave. But before departing, she looked deeply at the man in white standing in the square. As if remembering something, a painful expression suddenly flickered in her eyes.
The next moment, the Sword Sovereign vanished into thin air.
"Wait for me here."
Seeing the painful look in Liu Yiyi’s beautiful eyes, a string in Ye Yun’s heart was suddenly tugged. He sighed, patted the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon’s shoulder, and disappeared in the blink of an eye.
Ye Yun naturally understood Liu Yiyi’s feelings. His white robes, the familiar silhouette, and those familiar last words had all stirred memories buried deep in Liu Yiyi’s heart from a hundred thousand years ago.
According to Ye Yun’s guess, Liu Yiyi must have gone off to some secluded place to cry again. There was no way around it; the stronger a woman appeared on the outside, the softer and more vulnerable she often was on the inside.
At this moment, Ye Yun quietly appeared before a Jade Bamboo Tower on the back mountain of the Sword Cloud Sect. There, he saw Liu Yiyi in the Bamboo Building.
Ye Yun’s eyes flickered. Before him, the Sword Sovereign renowned throughout the Daluo Region was weakly sinking to the ground. She held a piece of peachwood in her left hand and a silver knife in her right, continuously carving the wood.
As she carved, she couldn’t stop crying. She was heartbroken, her beautiful face tear-streaked like a pear blossom in the rain.
Seeing Liu Yiyi crying her eyes out, Ye Yun, for some reason, suddenly felt an urge to laugh. However, he took a deep breath and suppressed it.
Ye Yun approached the Bamboo Building. His steps were light, and he exuded no aura whatsoever.
The Sword Sovereign, bowed in sorrow, had no sense that someone had entered.
The door was gently pushed open.
Ye Yun walked in, standing behind Liu Yiyi like a phantom.
"SOB..."
Liu Yiyi carved as she wept, her grief now even more intense. Her tears streamed down, soaking a large patch of her robe and dampening the peachwood in her hand.
Ye Yun smiled.
This little girl is truly heartbroken, he thought. But reflecting on it, he understood.
A flash of white light enveloped Ye Yun’s face, and his appearance changed. He had returned to his original form.
Ye Yun continued to stand quietly behind Liu Yiyi, gazing at the familiar back, and remained silent, allowing her to vent her inner sadness.
"Brother Yun, you’ve been dead for a hundred thousand years, yet I’m still alive. This feeling is too agonizing. Every time I think of you, I carve a doll..."
As Liu Yiyi cried, she constantly turned the silver knife. Wood shavings fell one after another, and the peachwood quickly transformed into a lifelike doll.
Ye Yun looked at the doll and couldn’t help but smile.
This Liu Yiyi, this master of the Sword Dao, possesses truly exceptional carving skills. Except for the lack of facial features, the doll’s aura and image were almost identical to his.
This girl, she has truly suffered...
Ye Yun sighed inwardly, his gaze softening.
He gently reached out, intending to pat Liu Yiyi’s small head.
Suddenly, his hand froze in mid-air.
Because Liu Yiyi spoke again.
"Brother Yun, that detestable Senior Brother of mine destroyed all the dolls here yesterday! They were my painstaking work of a hundred thousand years, and now everything is gone! I hate him so much..."
Liu Yiyi lifted the peachwood doll in her left hand, her gaze fixed on it as she sobbed heavily.
Just then, a warm and familiar voice suddenly resounded from behind her.
"The peachwood dolls may be gone, but I, a living, breathing person, have come... Yiyi, how about that? Isn’t this a surprise?"
Hearing this voice, Liu Yiyi froze.
How can this voice sound so much like her Brother Yun, speaking right in her ear? The tone, the inflection, the cadence—it’s all identical!
While she was still in shock, a gentle hand suddenly rested on her head.
"Ah... Who is it?"
Startled, Liu Yiyi immediately shot up like an agile monkey and spun around. With a flash of silver light, a treasured sword appeared in her hand.
"What, Yiyi? Planning to murder your dear husband?"
Gazing at the panic-stricken Liu Yiyi, Ye Yun withdrew his hand and smiled faintly.
Liu Yiyi pointed her sword at Ye Yun, her eyes widening as if they would pop out of their sockets. She stared at him in utter disbelief.
In that moment, tumultuous waves surged in Liu Yiyi’s heart. The white-robed figure before her was actually Ye Yun, the man she had longed for for a hundred thousand years. Her beloved Brother Yun.
But hadn’t Ye Yun been dead for a hundred thousand years? How could he suddenly appear before her?
Could it be... that all of this is just an illusion? Did someone exploit her emotional vulnerability to cast an Illusion Technique, tricking her?
"Who exactly are you?" Liu Yiyi bit her lip, suppressing her tumultuous emotions, and asked in a trembling voice.
"I’m Ye Yun! Yiyi, I’ve come to find you," Ye Yun said with a laugh.
At that moment, he was reminded of the time he’d climbed out of his coffin back in the day, scaring Luo Li half to death. It was just like this.
"Don’t try to deceive me! Brother Yun has been dead for a hundred thousand years! Tell me, who are you?" Liu Yiyi asked warily.
"You silly girl, why don’t you believe me?" Ye Yun chuckled, drew a sword, and casually performed the Nine Heavens Lotus Sutra.
This swordsmanship was something he and Liu Yiyi had created together.
"The Ni... Nine Heavens Lotus Sutra... Is it really you, Brother Yun?"
Watching the white-robed figure before her slowly execute the Nine Heavens Lotus Sutra, Liu Yiyi was overwhelmed with emotion, on the verge of breaking down.
"It’s me! Silly girl, I really didn’t die. I came from the Cangnan Continent, and as soon as I entered the Divine Land, I came looking for you." Ye Yun sheathed the sword and opened his arms to Liu Yiyi.
"Brother Yun!" Liu Yiyi cried out, overcome with emotion.
At this very moment, she finally confirmed that the person before her was indeed Ye Yun.
She dropped her sword and rushed toward him like a streak of light.
Ye Yun pulled Liu Yiyi tightly into his arms.
Embracing Liu Yiyi, who was fragrant, warm, and smoother than jade, and feeling her stunning curves, Ye Yun raised his eyebrows. He laughed and said, "Silly girl, it’s been a hundred thousand years, and your figure is still as good."
"Brother Yun, you’re teasing me again." Liu Yiyi, who had been sobbing uncontrollably, suddenly burst into laughter through her tears. A rosy blush spread across her beautiful face.
"I’m not joking, haha..." Ye Yun chuckled, and his hand slid down to rest on Liu Yiyi’s pert bottom. "It’s been a hundred thousand years, your figure hasn’t changed at all, and neither have you. Still so endearingly naive, so adorable..."
Ye Yun retracted his hand, lightly tapping Liu Yiyi’s fair little nose with his index finger.
Having her bottom caressed by her beloved and then her nose playfully tapped, Liu Yiyi turned bright red. She blushed delightfully, feeling so happy she thought she might die.
At this moment, the famously invincible Sword Sovereign of the Daluo Region flushed as red as a ripe apple. Her head was lowered slightly, and she looked as bashful as a bride-to-be.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 413: World-Destroying Heavenly Thunder and Earthly Fire
chapters.content:
Chapter 413: Chapter 413: World-Destroying Heavenly Thunder and Earthly Fire
"Brother Yun, you’ve been missing for a hundred thousand years. Where exactly have you been all these years?"
Having calmed down a bit, Liu Yiyi lifted her head, her beautiful black eyes looking at Ye Yun as she spoke.
"My Primordial Spirit mistakenly entered a mysterious cultivation space. I spent a hundred thousand years cultivating there before I finally came back to life..."
Ye Yun sighed gently, lightly brushing over the matter of the sign-in process.
"Brother Yun, that mysterious Sword Cultivator from before was you, right?" Liu Yiyi asked, blinking her beautiful eyes.
"Yes, I almost caused a terrible disaster this time..." Ye Yun sighed.
"Brother Yun, what do you mean by that?" Liu Yiyi scratched her head, asking in confusion.
Ye Yun lightly touched his wrist, took out the Asura Armor, and sighed, "I visited The Ninth Sea Area a while ago and gave this God-level armor to a junior. I didn’t expect that black-clothed youth to steal it and almost cause you tremendous harm."
Speaking of this, Ye Yun was filled with regret.
Luckily, he had visited the Nether Immortal Cave at that time. If he hadn’t gone to the Nether Immortal Cave, he wouldn’t have met the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon, and thus, would not have ventured to the Divine Land in search of Nangong Jade again. Unbelievably... he didn’t find Nangong Jade, but found Liu Yiyi instead. For Ye Yun, this was a tremendous surprise. How could he not be excited when a beautiful girlfriend from one hundred thousand years ago suddenly appeared before him, alive and well?
"Brother Yun, don’t blame yourself. Without you this time, I probably would have been seriously injured by that guy." Liu Yiyi reached out her slender hand to gently stroke Ye Yun’s handsome cheeks, speaking softly.
"Yiyi, you’re still as beautiful as ever."
Ye Yun, somewhat moved, held Liu Yiyi’s exquisite face in his hands and gently kissed her.
Liu Yiyi closed her eyes, her red lips slightly parted, waiting for the storm to arrive.
Their lips met once again after a separation of a hundred thousand years.
An indescribable electric current coursed through both their bodies.
Ye Yun’s Dao Heart, lonely after signing in for a hundred thousand years, felt more vibrant at this moment. It seemed as though the once top tyrant of the Cangnan Continent had revived.
Ye Yun extended his hand without hesitation.
He had enveloped the entire Bamboo Building in a powerful defense spell.
Then, a blossoming event, repeating after a hundred thousand years, an apocalyptic storm of passion, was quietly taking place within the Bamboo Building.
BOOM!
With a loud crash, the Bamboo Building actually crumbled.
Fortunately, a powerful restriction he had set up prevented anyone from seeing what had happened inside.
"HAHAHA!" Ye Yun’s hearty laughter reverberated within the restriction.
He stood amidst the smoke and dust, roaring with laughter.
Liu Yiyi, meanwhile, clung to him like a koala, her face flushed red, her head hidden in his shoulder.
"Brother Yun, the Bamboo Building collapsed! Was your strength a bit too much?" Liu Yiyi chided sweetly.
"I couldn’t help it; I didn’t control the power of my physical body well..." Ye Yun said with a faint smile, unconcerned.
His physical body was the Body of the Ancestor Dragon, the most powerful physical form in the world. He had barely begun, and the Bamboo Building couldn’t withstand it and collapsed. Of course, this Bamboo Building wasn’t an ordinary one, but it still couldn’t endure the immense power of Ye Yun’s physical body.
Hearing Ye Yun’s words, Liu Yiyi’s face turned an even brighter shade of crimson.
However, neither of them was a novice. They had been intimately familiar with each other a hundred thousand years ago.
Liu Yiyi looked up at Ye Yun, lost in passion and preparing to continue. Suddenly, Ye Yun waved his hand, and a streak of light flashed. In place of the destroyed Bamboo Building, an Immortal Palace appeared, radiating a brilliant glow.
"Brother Yun, what is this treasure?" Liu Yiyi asked in amazement.
"This is the Bronze Immortal Palace. It can be considered a Superior God-level spatial treasure." Ye Yun chuckled, explaining briefly before disappearing on the spot with Liu Yiyi in his arms.
The two of them entered the Bronze Immortal Palace, continuing the tempestuous passion from a hundred thousand years ago...
「Three days later.」
A woman in white suddenly fluttered down from a distance.
