"What’s going on? Why is there a restriction outside Master’s Bamboo Building?" The woman in white was immensely surprised. She used her Divine Sense to try and break through but found it impossible.
Due to the restriction, she couldn’t see anything inside.
Master must be cultivating. I should come back in a few days.
After considering for a moment, the woman in white drifted away.
「Meanwhile, at the top of Sword Cloud Sect’s Main Peak’s plaza.」
The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon sat cross-legged in the center of the plaza, unmoving.
The Master has been gone for three days. There’s still no sign of him; I can only wait tediously here.
During these three days, disciples from Jianyun Sect had invited him to rest elsewhere, but the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon refused them all.
The Master told me to wait here, so I must wait.
Thus, on the vast plaza, he remained the sole, lonely figure. The disciples of Jianyun Sect naturally knew that this pitifully low-cultivation Demon Clan youth was the mount of the mysterious White Clad Sword Cultivator, so they dared not disturb him.
「Another seven days passed in a blink.」
The woman in white returned to the back mountain and found the restriction still in place.
She called out a couple of times from outside but received no response, so she had to return, disheartened.
「On the tenth day.」
Inside the Bronze Immortal Palace, a soft plea for mercy could be heard.
"Brother Yun, please, spare me?"
"Alright." Seeing Liu Yiyi’s pitiful expression, Ye Yun smiled faintly and finally stopped.
Liu Yiyi’s delicate body suddenly trembled like a flash of lightning. To her surprise, she discovered that at that very moment, she had broken through from the God Monarch Realm tenth layer to the Peak of the God Monarch Realm!
"I’ve broken through, Brother Yun! I’ve actually broken through!" Liu Yiyi shouted excitedly, dancing with joy, as happy as a child.
"That’s right..." Ye Yun laughed happily.
He possessed the Body of the Ancestor Dragon, which was unimaginably strong. The life energy he released flowed into Liu Yiyi, naturally causing her cultivation base to break through.
This could be considered a method of dual cultivation. However, such a cultivation method could only be used occasionally. If used long-term, the foundation of one’s cultivation base would not be deep or stable enough.
Ye Yun had seen that Liu Yiyi was stuck at the God Monarch Realm tenth layer and wanted to give her a helping hand.
In the future, Ye Yun would not do this again. He would have Liu Yiyi ingest God-level pills to quickly break through to the Divine Sovereign Realm.
"Brother Yun, after a hundred thousand years, you’ve truly become stronger and stronger! I can’t see through you anymore. Your cultivation base must have reached the Divine Sovereign Realm by now, right?" Liu Yiyi asked, her eyes as alluring as silk as she gazed at Ye Yun.
"Not yet. I’m at the same stage as you right now, the Peak of the God Monarch Realm," Ye Yun said with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 414: Bronze Immortal Palace’s Gift to a Beautiful Woman
chapters.content:
Chapter 414: Chapter 414: Bronze Immortal Palace’s Gift to a Beautiful Woman
"What? Brother Yun! You’re only at the Peak of the God Monarch Realm?!"
Liu Yiyi widened her beautiful eyes, her face filled with shock.
With just a Peak God Monarch Realm cultivation base, Ye Yun had easily defeated her senior brother, who was at the First Layer of the God Sovereign Realm, without even wearing any armor.
And that senior brother of hers, putting all his strength into his attacks, still couldn’t break through Ye Yun’s miraculous sword techniques.
Such power, such divine skills...
Truly, a genius for the ages, unmatched throughout eternity.
Brother Yun...
As expected of the former number one master of the Eternity Realm on Cangnan Continent.
Now in the Divine Land, he still utterly crushes cultivators of the same level, and can even easily fight above his own realm.
In this moment, countless little colorful stars twinkled in Liu Yiyi’s lively, captivating eyes; she was just like a little fangirl, burying her head into Ye Yun’s chest.
"I’m about to break through. I just need to head out for a while; you’ll come along with me when the time comes."
Ye Yun said with a smile, lifting his gaze in the direction of The Ninth Sea Area.
The Asura Armor—he still needed to return it to Jiang Hengyue.
Since Skyreach Island was the first stop of the Dragon God Sect, he still needed to add some more defensive formations and lay out a few backup offensive measures.
Lest any other petty villains come to snatch the Asura Armor.
Once this matter was settled,
Ye Yun would find a place in The Ninth Sea Area to break through to the God Sovereign Realm.
Afterward, Ye Yun would bring Liu Yiyi back to the Jianyun Sect, and stay with her there for a while longer.
As for letting Liu Yiyi return to Cangnan Continent, Ye Yun didn’t have any such plans for the time being.
After all, the spiritual energy in that place didn’t possess divine nature; even if Liu Yiyi went back, it wouldn’t mean much to her.
And as for the descendant from the Sword King Palace, there was no need for her to meet a distant relative separated by countless generations.
"Brother Yun, that move where you held your sword horizontally before your chest—what swordsmanship was that? It was so mystical and incredible! Can you teach it to me?"
Liu Yiyi thought back to that earth-shaking battle in days past, and instantly grew interested in Ye Yun’s swordsmanship again.
She herself was a Sword Infatuation.
In her heart, aside from her beloved, the most important thing was the Sword Dao.
Now, seeing the man she loves wield such unpredictable, supernatural sword techniques, she naturally wanted to learn them, too.
"This Binary Sword Chant—it’s not really an especially formidable sword technique. Of course I can teach it to you."
Ye Yun smiled gently, touching Liu Yiyi’s fair brow with a finger; in that instant, the inheritance imprinted itself into her mind.
Liu Yiyi was instantly struck with enlightenment; her entire demeanor became solemn and dignified.
"What a powerful swordsmanship! One attack, one defense—utterly exquisite! Brother Yun, did you create this swordsmanship yourself?"
Liu Yiyi asked with reverence.
"I suppose so. These last hundred thousand years were rather boring, so I created a few sword techniques and divine skills here and there."
Ye Yun said with a smile.
He certainly couldn’t reveal the secret of his daily sign-ins, so for now he could only shoulder the credit himself.
Luckily Liu Yiyi trusted him deeply and wouldn’t probe too much.
"Let’s go, come with me to The Ninth Sea Area."
Ye Yun stood up, and at a thought, a white robe instantly appeared upon his body.
Liu Yiyi also blushed and stood up shyly.
However, after getting dressed, she took a bit of time to tidy up her makeup.
Staring at the exquisite little face in the mirror, Ye Yun couldn’t help but recall his other old flames.
If only those other girls were also still alive!
When Liu Yiyi finished getting ready, Ye Yun pointed at the Bronze Immortal Palace and smiled, "I’ll give you this treasure as well. Go ahead and refine and store it first."
"Thank you, Brother Yun."
Liu Yiyi was overjoyed. Following Ye Yun’s guidance, she began to refine the Bronze Immortal Palace.
This Bronze Immortal Palace wasn’t just suitable for daily living.
It could also serve as a powerful defensive magic treasure; entering it brought absolute safety, and the entire Bronze Immortal Palace could even be hurled out as a formidable attack treasure.
Its uses were many—truly killing three birds with one stone—its offensive and defensive power immense.
After refining the Bronze Immortal Palace, Liu Yiyi put it away.
Ye Yun then removed the nearby restriction.
At that moment, a woman in white, standing beside the restriction, stared dumbfounded at the two shadows within.
The young man in white before her actually bore some resemblance to that mysterious White Clad Sword Cultivator.
"Master..."
The woman in white’s heart was in chaos. Helplessly, she stared at her master.
At this moment, this Sword Sovereign who was renowned throughout the entire Daluo Region, her pretty face lightly flushed, radiant, stood by the white-clad young man’s side, and carried a gentle, indescribable glow all over her body.
As the Sword Sovereign’s disciple,
The woman in white had never seen her master this happy before, in all these years.
That kind of joy came from the heart, without the slightest bit of pretense.
Could it be...
This mysterious white-clad youth was the man her master had yearned for, day and night, for so many years?
"Yuer, what is it?"
Liu Yiyi coughed lightly, quickly gathering herself and putting on an air of dignity. She folded her hands behind her back and gazed at the woman in white opposite her.
This was her senior disciple, Bai Yuer.
"Master, for this Heavenly Sacrifice Ceremony, many forces have sent lots of Ten-thousand-year Peach Wood. I’ve brought them all to you."
Bai Yuer’s expression was a little nervous as she hurriedly produced a storage ring and respectfully handed it over with both hands.
"No need."
Liu Yiyi smiled gently, giving Ye Yun a glance filled with affectionate tenderness. She said softly, "My Dao Heart is already complete; I no longer need to carve peachwood dolls anymore."
"Congratulations, Master!"
A flash of insight passed through Bai Yuer’s heart. In that instant she understood something, and her face showed a hint of joy as she immediately knelt on the ground.
"Rise. For the next few days, take good care of the sect. I’ll be away for a while."
Liu Yiyi waved her broad sleeve, and a surge of mana lifted Bai Yuer up from the ground.
"Understood, Master!"
Bai Yuer hurriedly agreed.
"Brother Yun, let’s go."
Liu Yiyi gazed at Ye Yun, her voice tender and affectionate.
"Mm!"
Ye Yun nodded, giving Bai Yuer a meaning-laden glance. After altering her memory, he tore open the void and disappeared with Liu Yiyi.
Of course, Ye Yun couldn’t let anyone in the Divine Land see his true face.
So he altered Bai Yuer’s memory in time.
Since he would be returning to Jianyun Sect to spend time with Liu Yiyi, Ye Yun didn’t take the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon with him.
As for the Cangnan Continent,
Ye Yun wasn’t worried for the time being.
With the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon—a God Monarch Realm Divine Dragon—guarding the Dragon God Sect, those three juniors shouldn’t have any issues.
Ye Yun continued tearing through the void, rushing from the Daluo Region toward The Ninth Sea Area at incredible speed.
"Brother Yun, we’re both at the Peak of the God Monarch Realm, but I can only tear through tens of thousands of miles of void—nothing close to your ability to tear through billions of miles at a time."
Watching Ye Yun effortlessly tear through the void, Liu Yiyi said in astonished admiration.
"Once you’ve mastered the Binary Sword Chant and broken through to the God Sovereign Realm, you’ll be just as strong."
Ye Yun didn’t mind, smiling as he spoke.
After tearing through the void repeatedly, Ye Yun quickly arrived near the skies above Skyreach Island in The Ninth Sea Area.
The void fluctuated.
The two of them stepped out from within.
Outside, the sounds of slaughter shook the sky. Roars and howls filled the air without end.
At a glance,
what surprised Ye Yun was that Skyreach Island was actually being besieged by several thousand cultivators at this moment.
Relying on the original grand formation of Skyreach Island, and the troops of the Jiang Clan, they were barely able to maintain an undefeated front.
All around them, cultivators continuously unleashed all kinds of divine skills and treasures, casting multicolored lights that bombarded the protective formation.
Boom!
After repeated, frenzied bombardments, the grand formation of Skyreach Island finally shattered.

chapters.title: Chapter 415: The Sword Sovereign’s Order, As If The Sword Sovereign Himself Is Present
chapters.content:
Chapter 415: Chapter 415: The Sword Sovereign’s Order, As If The Sword Sovereign Himself Is Present
I have failed my Master!
On Skyreach Island, as Jiang Hengyue watched the grand formation collapse and a horde of cultivators swarm in like locusts, a grim smile touched his lips.
The Asura Armor his Master had bestowed upon him had been stolen by a mysterious powerhouse.
For some reason, this news had eventually leaked.
Consequently, Tongming Island, the largest in the Tenth Sea Region, set its sights on the Ninth Sea Area. They intended to seize Skyreach Island and use it as a stepping stone for their expansion.
The Tenth Sea Region was the most remote and weakest among the Ten Great Ocean areas. Thus, thousands of cultivators had fiercely attacked this grand formation for many days, eventually shattering it.
"Kill the Jiang Clan members, and Skyreach Island will belong to us from Tongming Island!"
An old cultivator at the True God Realm Tenth Layer Peak stood in mid-air. A crazed laugh twisted his gaunt face as he waved his hand.
"Kill!"
The cultivators of Tongming Island surged forward like an incoming tide.
A massive slaughter appeared imminent.
WHOOSH!
Suddenly, a powerful, imposing aura descended from the void.
In an instant, all cultivators on both sides were rendered immobile, feeling as if a great mountain pressed down on them, making even breathing incredibly difficult.
Cultivators from both sides were instantly dumbstruck with fear.
This earth-shattering aura undoubtedly indicated the arrival of a Divine Monarch Realm powerhouse.
"Why is there a Divine Monarch Realm powerhouse here?"
The elderly cultivator from Tongming Island was now utterly terrified.
Could it be... Could it be that a small place like Skyreach Island has a Divine Monarch Realm powerhouse backing it? If Skyreach Island truly had the support of a Divine Monarch Realm powerhouse, then Island Master Jiang Hengyue’s God-level armor would not have been stolen.
Could it be... Master is here?
Jiang Hengyue gazed at the void, a mixture of shock and elation on his face, but he could not see his Master’s silhouette.
"Besides Master, which other Divine Monarch Realm expert would come to save our Skyreach Island at a time like this?" Lin Yanran, standing beside Jiang Hengyue, asked with a remarkably calm smile.
Jiang Hengyue nodded silently.
But though he scanned the void, he found no trace of his Master’s arrival.
WHOOSH!
At this moment, a graceful figure in red suddenly materialized from the void without any warning.
This stunning, red-robed woman emitted countless tiny sword lights. They were so brilliant and dazzling that none of the True God Realm cultivators present could discern her true features.
"Such a powerful Sword Cultivator, and a Divine Monarch Realm cultivator too..."
Jiang Hengyue stared in amazement at the red figure in the sky, swallowing hard.
This scene was not what he had expected. Shouldn’t it be Master who descends? Whenever he thought of Master, the image that came to mind was of a young man in white robes, possessing unparalleled elegance and an extraordinary temperament. A casual glance from him seemed enough to command the entire world.
Lin Yanran also looked baffled, staring blankly at the suddenly appearing red-robed woman.
Although she couldn’t see the woman’s face clearly, her intuition told her this woman was exceptionally beautiful. Compared to her, she felt as insignificant as a firefly to the radiant moon.
Liu Yiyi hovered in the void. She glanced at the weak True God Realm Cultivators around her before her gaze finally settled on the leader of the attackers: the old cultivator at the True God Realm Tenth Layer Peak.
"Are you the leader?" Liu Yiyi asked indifferently.
She had appeared here at Ye Yun’s request.
Ye Yun did not wish to reveal himself.
A trivial matter like this could be handled by the Sword Sovereign of the Daluo Region.
Meanwhile, Ye Yun, hidden in the void, watched as Liu Yiyi once again displayed the Sword Sovereign’s domineeringly powerful side. He couldn’t help but recall the passion in the Bronze Immortal Palace and chuckled softly.
Such a stark contrast! Cold as ice to her enemies, yet passionate as fire to her lover. That was Liu Yiyi. A Sword Infatuation devoted to the Sword Dao for one hundred thousand years.
"Senior, I am the Island Master of Tongming Island, from the Tenth Sea Region. May I ask what guidance Senior has for me?" the old man stammered, his face panic-stricken as he immediately knelt in mid-air.
"Do you recognize this token?" Liu Yiyi demanded in a low voice, flicking her finger. A red, sword-shaped token appeared before the old man.
"This..."
Gazing at the ancient and exquisite sword-shaped token, the old man’s expression changed dramatically.
This was the Sword Sovereign Command of the Daluo Region! To see this command was akin to seeing the Sword Sovereign in person.
As the Island Master of Tongming Island, the dominant power in the Tenth Sea Region, the old man had, of course, visited the Daluo Region. He knew well that its most formidable force was the Jianyun Sect.
The Jianyun Sect’s supremacy stemmed from the presence of a formidable Sword Sovereign.
No one in the entire Daluo Region dared to disrespect the Sword Sovereign.
And he was merely a minor Island Master from the Tenth Sea Region.
"Greetings to the Sword Sovereign."
The old man hurriedly kowtowed three times before the sword-shaped token.
After kowtowing, he prostrated himself fully, not daring to rise.
The cultivators from Tongming Island were utterly shocked to see their Island Master behaving so respectfully.
Most of them had never even left the Tenth Sea Region, so they were ignorant of the Sword Sovereign’s fame in the Daluo Region.
Who is the Sword Sovereign? How could she... scare that fellow... into such a state?
Jiang Hengyue wondered, looking confusedly at Lin Yanran beside him.
Gazing at the sword-shaped token, Lin Yanran’s expression changed, her body trembling.
"Husband, this is the Sword Sovereign Command from the Jianyun Sect of the Daluo Region! Could this be the renowned Sword Sovereign herself?" Lin Yanran asked, her voice trembling.
Daluo Region... Jianyun Sect...
Jiang Hengyue murmured, then jolted as a memory surfaced.
The Daluo Region, which bordered the First Sea Region, was an exceptionally powerful territory. It boasted innumerable Divine Monarch Realm cultivators, their numbers far surpassing the combined strength found across the Ten Great Ocean areas.
Among the many powers in the Daluo Region, the Jianyun Sect was the strongest.
And the strongest within the Jianyun Sect was the Sword Sovereign.
She was regarded as the foremost Sword Dao expert in the Daluo Region.
At this moment, Lin Yanran’s eyes were fixed with fervent admiration on the red figure in the void.
Why would Senior Sword Sovereign come to a remote place like our Ninth Sea Area?
she muttered.
Could it be... the Sword Sovereign came to inquire about the God-level armor?
Such a thought suddenly sprouted in Jiang Hengyue’s mind, causing his unease to multiply.
The God-level Asura Armor had brought him unimaginable honor and a tremendous boost to his power, but it had also brought disaster. Fortunately, that Divine Monarch Realm powerhouse had not killed him back then, which was the only reason he had survived to this day. Now, another Sword Sovereign, one with a God King Realm Cultivation Level, had arrived. Did she also want to investigate the origin of the God-level armor?
Jiang Hengyue clenched his teeth. At this moment, he resolved that even if it meant death, he would absolutely not reveal any information about his Master.
He took out a poison pill and placed it under his tongue, ready to die at the slightest sign of trouble.
Lin Yanran’s attention was solely on the Sword Sovereign in the void; she did not notice his subtle action.
However, Ye Yun, concealed in the void, did notice Jiang Hengyue’s move.
He glanced over, recognizing the pill as highly poisonous.
If he bit down and swallowed it, Jiang Hengyue would perish instantly.
This little fellow truly has never disappointed me.
Ye Yun chuckled softly, a trace of admiration in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 416: God-level Armor, Abundant Everywhere
chapters.content:
Chapter 416: Chapter 416: God-level Armor, Abundant Everywhere
A beam of light flashed, and the Sword Sovereign’s Token returned to Liu Yiyi’s hand.
"You have two choices: first, Tongming Island surrenders to Skyreach Island; second, all of you go to Hell and reunite there."
A cold gleam flashed in Liu Yiyi’s eyes as she spoke indifferently.
The elder trembled, almost frightened to death by the Sword Sovereign’s words.
He understood perfectly what the Sword Sovereign meant.
He never dreamed that Skyreach Island was under the protection of the Sword Sovereign of the Jianyun Sect from the Daluo Region.
If he had known, even if he had ten thousand times the courage, he would not have dared to attack Skyreach Island.
Let alone him, even if all the forces from the other Nine Great Sea Regions combined their strength, they would not dare to challenge the Jianyun Sect of the Daluo Region.
The Sword Sovereign alone could wipe out everyone in the Ten Great Ocean areas.
The strengths of both sides were not at all on the same scale.
"Honorable Sword Sovereign, Tongming Island is willing to surrender to Skyreach Island."
After pondering for a few seconds, the elder quickly made up his mind. He kowtowed once more and chose the first option: surrender.
"Mm."
Liu Yiyi nodded lightly, then turned and landed before Jiang Hengyue and Lin Yanran.
"Go and incorporate Tongming Island. From now on, they are a force under Skyreach Island. With my Jianyun Sect protecting you, no force in the Ten Great Ocean Areas will dare to harbor any ill intentions toward you."
Liu Yiyi looked at Jiang Hengyue, her icy demeanor vanishing as she spoke with a smile.
"Thank you, Senior."
Lin Yanran was overjoyed and promptly knelt before Liu Yiyi.
Jiang Hengyue, however, still looked clueless. This sudden happiness was too much; he hadn’t yet processed it and stood rooted to the spot in a daze.
Suddenly, a white figure flickered, and he saw his familiar Master.
Ye Yun had unexpectedly appeared.
However, Ye Yun had placed a restriction around Jiang Hengyue, so no one else could see him.
"Go handle the affairs of Tongming Island first, then come and meet me in the backyard," Ye Yun ordered with a slight smile.
"Yes, Master!" Jiang Hengyue exclaimed.
In his excitement, Jiang Hengyue accidentally bit down on the poison pill hidden under his tongue.
Even more shockingly, the agitated Jiang Hengyue, after crushing the pill, unknowingly swallowed it.
THUD!
The next moment, Jiang Hengyue collapsed to the ground.
Fortunately, due to the surrounding restriction, no one witnessed Jiang Hengyue’s embarrassing predicament.
Lin Yanran gasped in shock.
"Husband, what’s wrong?" she cried, quickly kneeling to cradle Jiang Hengyue.
By now, Jiang Hengyue’s body had turned entirely jet black, as if coated with a layer of black lacquer.
Liu Yiyi was also stunned.
To think Jiang Hengyue would suddenly commit suicide by poison!
she thought.
Could it be that this fellow did something to wrong Brother Yun?
"This Jiang Hengyue... he can be quite a handful sometimes," Ye Yun remarked, shaking his head with a wry smile. With a flick of his finger, a drop of Three Lights Divine Water flew out and into Jiang Hengyue’s mouth.
After ingesting the Three Lights Divine Water, the blackness on Jiang Hengyue’s body rapidly faded, and he abruptly opened his eyes.
"No need for explanations now. Go and deal with those people from Tongming Island first," Ye Yun said.
With a wave of his wide sleeve, he sent Lin Yanran and Jiang Hengyue out.
He and Liu Yiyi then proceeded to the backyard.
「Two hours later.」
Jiang Hengyue hurriedly entered a courtyard in the backyard. To maintain confidentiality, he hadn’t even brought his wife, Lin Yanran, with him.
At that moment, Ye Yun and Liu Yiyi were seated in a pavilion, watching several golden fish swim in the lake below while chatting softly.
Jiang Hengyue hurried in and, upon seeing Ye Yun, immediately knelt.
"Master, I failed to protect the Asura Armor you gave me. It was stolen."
Jiang Hengyue was dejected, tears streaming down his face.
"I already know what happened. You don’t need to blame yourself anymore," Ye Yun said with a faint smile.
He couldn’t blame Jiang Hengyue for this,
he thought.
Facing that youth in black at the Peak of the God Monarch Realm, hardly anyone in the entire Daluo Region would be his match, let alone in this remote Ninth Sea Area.
"Master, I have failed to live up to your dedicated guidance..." Jiang Hengyue remained kneeling, weeping inconsolably, his sorrow deepening with each moment.
That was a piece of God-level Armor! It could have accompanied me for a lifetime, ensuring my combat strength would always surpass that of my peers!
he lamented internally.
But the Asura Armor was stolen. As the Island Master of Skyreach Island, I am so weak. Even with the Daluo Jade Sword Cloud Sect’s protection, I’m unworthy of the title.
"Brother Yun, this little fellow is really crying his heart out!" Liu Yiyi’s eyes narrowed into crescents as she sent a voice transmission with a soft laugh.
"Well, it is a piece of God-level armor. Even a cultivator in the Divine Monarch Realm would be heartbroken to lose it," Ye Yun said, touching his nose and looking gently at Liu Yiyi with a smile.
Liu Yiyi nodded.
Even someone as strong as I am... actually, I also really want a piece of God-level armor,
she mused.
That way, my combat strength could rival that of a great cultivator in the Divine Sovereign Realm. Unfortunately, God-level armor is incredibly rare and precious. That Asura Armor... Brother Yun probably only has that one. He gave it to this little fellow in the True God Realm. If he gets it back, he’ll probably return it to him.
These were Liu Yiyi’s thoughts.
Ye Yun, naturally, was unaware of them.
If he knew her thoughts, Ye Yun would definitely feel awkward.
Countless God-level armors are in my warehouse, too many to count! How could I only have this one? That would be severely underestimating me!
Not only did he possess God-level armor, but his warehouse was also piled high with Super God Level armor and even armor of higher quality.
He had been "signing in" for a hundred thousand years.
It was as if all the treasures from all the heavens and the Ten Thousand Realms of the universe had found their way into his warehouse.
For Ye Yun, resources were never an issue.
But he wouldn’t use his resources indiscriminately; he knew the importance of discretion.
Ye Yun took out the Asura Armor and, smiling, said to Jiang Hengyue, "That fellow from the Divine Monarch Realm has been killed by me. I’ve reclaimed the Asura Armor for you. Now, it returns to its rightful owner. Take it."
Upon hearing this, Jiang Hengyue abruptly raised his head, his gaze immediately falling upon the cyan Asura Armor in Ye Yun’s hand.
Jiang Hengyue was overcome with emotion, his breathing becoming rapid.
The Asura Armor I’ve yearned for day and night... I never imagined I’d see it again!
"Master, my cultivation base is too low. Even if I had the Asura Armor, I wouldn’t be able to protect it."
After some hesitation and a fierce internal struggle, Jiang Hengyue gritted his teeth, shook his head, and declined Ye Yun’s kind offer.
"Just take it when I tell you to! Enough nonsense!" Ye Yun snapped. "Never mind that Skyreach Island will be protected by the Jianyun Sect of the Daluo Region in the future; I will personally enhance its defenses so no one can breach them! So, you can be the Island Master of Skyreach Island without worry. And this place... this will also be the foremost gateway of our Dragon God Sect."
These words made Jiang Hengyue feel deeply ashamed, and he lowered his head.
I never imagined the Master would continue to place such trust in me. This... this is truly moving!
Shuffling forward on his knees, Jiang Hengyue practically crawled before Ye Yun and respectfully received the Asura Armor with both hands.
Ye Yun stood up.
He retrieved a Divine-level Array from his storage and tossed it out. In mid-air, the array transformed into numerous streaks of light that descended into the sea surrounding Skyreach Island.
"This is the control token for the array..." Ye Yun handed a token to Jiang Hengyue and smiled. "This Vajra’s Demon Subduing Formation... not even several cultivators in the Divine Sovereign Realm could easily break through it."
It’s that powerful?!
Upon hearing his Master’s words, Jiang Hengyue’s breath hitched, so shocked he nearly fainted.

chapters.title: Chapter 417: The Sword of Death, Breaking the Will of Heaven and Earth
chapters.content:
Chapter 417: Chapter 417: The Sword of Death, Breaking the Will of Heaven and Earth
Above a remote stretch of sea in the Tenth Sea Region.
The void rippled.
Two figures emerged.
It was Ye Yun and Liu Yiyi.
After setting up the Divine-level Array on Skyreach Island and giving instructions to Jiang Hengyue, Ye Yun and Liu Yiyi departed Skyreach Island and arrived in the Tenth Sea Region.
The Tenth Sea Region was even more remote, with few islands. Ye Yun planned to break through to the Divine Sovereign Realm here.
"Brother Yun, the breakthrough from the Divine Monarch Realm to the Divine Sovereign Realm is an extremely difficult hurdle, and the opportunity only comes once. Many who fail to break through are unable to attempt it again for the rest of their lives."
Liu Yiyi’s delicate jade hand held Ye Yun’s as she spoke softly, "Brother Yun, perhaps you should prepare a little longer? Doing so would increase your chances of a successful breakthrough."
"What you’re saying applies to cultivators from the Divine Land... but it’s completely useless for a native of the Cangnan Continent like me, you know."
Ye Yun gazed at Liu Yiyi with a faint smile, then suddenly reached out and gently tapped her fair, delicate nose.
Liu Yiyi’s face instantly turned beet-red.
She had been speaking seriously with Ye Yun and hadn’t expected to be teased in return.
But it had often been like this between them a hundred thousand years ago.
Liu Yiyi had long grown accustomed to it.
Gazing at Liu Yiyi, who was blushing like a red apple, Ye Yun’s vision blurred for a moment, as if many memories from a hundred thousand years ago resurfaced.
The first time he saw Liu Yiyi, she was an icy Sword Goddess.
Back then, as the foremost rogue of the Cangnan Continent, he had racked his brains trying to get close to this cold goddess. After employing all sorts of methods, he finally managed to capture her heart.
It had been anything but easy.
Ye Yun also suddenly remembered that Liu Yiyi had a nominal fiancé a hundred thousand years ago, whom he had beaten half to death.
That young man, terrified by Ye Yun, had quickly gone to the Liu family’s residence and hastily annulled the engagement.
Liu Yiyi’s parents had been quite furious at the time...
Recalling these past events, Ye Yun found them rather amusing now.
Perhaps back then, in his youth, wild and unrestrained, he had lived a bit like Wei Xiaobao from "The Deer and the Cauldron."
"Regardless, I still hope Brother Yun will be extra careful. Many have been injured by the heavenly tribulation when breaking through this realm and needed a long period of rest to recover."
Taking a deep breath, Liu Yiyi spoke with immense tenderness.
"Don’t worry, my beautiful Yiyi."
Ye Yun laughed heartily, then turned and moved away from Liu Yiyi.
The next moment, he appeared tens of thousands of miles away.
He was surrounded by vast waters, with no islands in sight.
It was a perfect place for a breakthrough.
WHOOSH!
Ye Yun’s body suddenly ascended, positioning him tens of thousands of feet high in the sky. He circulated the immense mana within his body and began to push towards the Divine Sovereign Realm.
Ye Yun had long been separated from the Divine Sovereign Realm by only a paper-thin barrier.
All he needed was a gentle push to break through.
BOOM!
Ye Yun’s body trembled, and his aura instantly surged dramatically.
In that moment, Ye Yun broke through to the Divine Sovereign Realm.
Next, he would have to undergo the baptism of the heavenly tribulation.
From a distance, Liu Yiyi watched this scene, her beautiful eyes wide with utter shock.
He broke through so quickly?
Brother Yun just went over there; how did he suddenly break through to the Divine Sovereign Realm?
When did... breaking through to the Divine Sovereign Realm become as easy as drinking water or eating a meal? This is too incredible!
Liu Yiyi recalled the ancient records within her Sect: any cultivator at the Divine Monarch Realm wishing to break through to the Divine Sovereign Realm had to make all sorts of meticulous preparations, and even then, success was only a possibility.
Who would have thought Ye Yun’s breakthrough would be so effortless?
RUMBLE!
In the sky, vast, thick dark clouds suddenly gathered. Streaks of blood-red lightning, like giant dragons, continuously darted through the cloud layers.
Even before the lightning struck, an astonishingly terrifying aura emanated from it.
All creatures in the sea below had long since fled to a safe distance.
Hiding far away, Liu Yiyi’s expression changed drastically when she felt the aura of the blood-red lightning.
It’s too terrifying.
Each bolt of this Divine Sovereign Realm’s heavenly tribulation is so terrifying; with my current strength, I probably couldn’t even withstand a single one.
The weather in the Tenth Sea Region suddenly changed. Although concentrated in a small area, the terrifying aura permeated the entire Tenth Sea Region.
Even many islands in the Ninth Sea Area sensed the terrifying aura, causing numerous cultivators to flee their islands in panic.
"Come on!"
Ye Yun looked up at the blood-red lightning in the sky, his eyebrows raised, a scornful laugh escaping him.
He possessed the Ancestral Dragon Body, the Indestructible Body of Ten Thousand Tribulations; any heavenly tribulation was like a mere tickle to him.
CRACK!
Dozens of blood-red lightning bolts, like blood dragons, suddenly descended from mid-air.
Under normal circumstances, when facing such heavenly tribulations, most cultivators would have to endure them with their physical bodies because the baptism of the heavenly tribulation would bring about a qualitative change in their bodies.
But Ye Yun didn’t need to.
He threw a punch upwards.
BOOM!
Those dozens of blood-red lightning bolts were instantly shattered.
RUMBLE!
A dull, furious roar echoed from within the clouds.
It seemed the will of heaven and earth had been enraged by the tiny human below. The clouds churned rapidly, and streaks of even thicker blood-red lightning continuously emerged from within.
Each bolt of blood-red lightning resembled a blood-red giant dragon, baring its fangs and claws as it descended from the sky.
Why are they dragon-shaped?
Ye Yun’s brow furrowed slightly.
Could this heavenly tribulation... also be related to the Dragon Clan?
Just as this thought occurred to him, those dozens of massive blood-red lightning bolts, each tens of zhang wide, descended upon his head.
Brother Yun will be fine... But why did he suddenly stop moving?
Far away, Liu Yiyi clenched her fists tightly, her palms slick with sweat.
Her heart pounded in terror as she watched the colossal blood-red lightning in the distance. Her soul trembled, and her delicate body quivered slightly.
Ye Yun paid no mind to the blood-red lightning.
As it neared, he punched out again.
BOOM!
The surrounding void shattered. Along with it, the countless blood-red lightning dragons also disintegrated. Shattered electrical currents rained down into the seawater around.
The turbulent sea constantly churned up monstrous waves.
"Wow, Brother Yun is handling such a powerful heavenly tribulation so easily! He truly is the unbeatable number one expert of the Eternal Realm from Cangnan Continent," Liu Yiyi exclaimed excitedly, her composure forgotten.
She seemed to recall again those magnificent scenes from a hundred thousand years ago when Brother Yun swept away all opposition.
Back then, there were many evil factions on the Cangnan Continent.
At least half of them were slain by Ye Yun.
The peace that the Cangnan Continent later enjoyed was mostly thanks to her Brother Yun.
"If this is all you’ve got, you’re no match for me. I suggest you pack up and go home."
Ye Yun looked at the dark clouds in the void and spoke calmly.
RUMBLE!
The powerful will within the dark clouds seemed to be provoked. The clouds roiled violently, and a colossal blood-red eye emerged from within the churning black clouds.
"Still want more?"
Ye Yun sneered.
WHOOSH!
He suddenly soared into the sky, straight towards the depths of the clouds. Drawing his sword, he thrust it towards the Blood Eye in the sky.
Binary Sword Chant.
Sword of Death Realm. When this sword struck, nothing in the world could block it.
An unimaginably terrifying sword light rose into the sky. It appeared slow but was incredibly fast, reaching the thick cloud layer in an instant.
SWOOSH!
The thick dark clouds were rent asunder by the sharp Sword Qi, and the countless blood-red lightning bolts within were also cleaved apart.
The blood-red eye stared in shock at the sword light from below.
It realized that even it could not block that human’s sword strike.
WHOOSH!
The sword light flashed.
The Sword of Death Realm pierced the blood-red eye.
BOOM!
With a heaven-shattering explosion, the blood-red eye instantly burst apart.
As the blood-red eye disintegrated, the vast black clouds frantically fled in all directions, vanishing in the blink of an eye.
The entire sky transitioned from dark to bright, returning to its azure state.
Employing the Binary Sword Chant, Ye Yun, with just one strike from the Sword of Death Realm, had annihilated the will of the heavenly tribulation!
Is this the Sword of Death Realm?
In the distance, Liu Yiyi, witnessing the world-shaking sword strike, was so stunned that her delicate body stiffened, and she was rendered speechless.

chapters.title: Chapter 418: Returning to Jianyun Sect, Arranging for the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 418: Chapter 418: Returning to Jianyun Sect, Arranging for the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon
Liu Yiyi, as a Wushang Sword Dao Pride.
Even after receiving Ye Yun’s inheritance of the Binary Sword Chant, how much could she truly comprehend in a short time?
To these two simple moves in the Binary Sword Chant, her feelings weren’t particularly profound.
The only thing that struck her was how, back then in the Jianyun Sect, Ye Yun crossed his sword before his chest and effortlessly blocked the endless sword rain attacks from mighty ones in the God-honored realm, revealing his calm composure and complete confidence.
As for the Sword of Death Realm within the Binary Sword Chant—
Liu Yiyi hadn’t even touched the threshold.
However, when she saw with her own eyes Ye Yun soaring to the heavens, forcibly slashing apart the blood-red eyeball forged from the will of heaven and earth—
Only then did Liu Yiyi realize...
The terror of the Sword of Death Realm.
The Sword of Death Realm truly is unmatched beneath the heavens.
Too powerful.
At this, Liu Yiyi was trembling all over with excitement.
If she too could fathom the Binary Sword Chant, then her progress on the path of sword would induce an unimaginable leap forward.
"It seems... they’re not coming again."
Ye Yun lingered a moment longer in the void, but seeing the sky was still a bright blue with not a single cloud and not the slightest sign of a counterattack from the will of heaven and earth, he shook his head, flashed, and appeared at Liu Yiyi’s side.
"Yiyi, are you alright?"
Ye Yun saw Liu Yiyi’s excitement, her exquisite face flushed scarlet, her alluring body trembling slightly. He couldn’t help but reach out in concern and lightly touch her forehead.
"Brother Yun, the Sword of Death Realm in this Binary Sword Chant is simply too powerful..."
Liu Yiyi murmured softly.
"It’s alright."
Ye Yun smiled.
Among the Ten Thousand Realms, countless great divine powers and supreme sword arts exist; the Binary Sword Chant is merely one that barely makes a name for itself.
Ye Yun liked the simplicity and directness of the Binary Sword Chant.
That’s why, among so many divine skills, he chose the Binary Sword Chant.
"Brother Yun, this Binary Sword Chant was created by you, wasn’t it?"
Liu Yiyi gazed at Ye Yun, her beautiful eyes filled with the scorching light of devotion.
A trace of embarrassment flashed in Ye Yun’s eyes, but he smiled and said, "Yeah! After a hundred thousand years with nothing to do, I casually researched a few sword arts and divine skills."
"Brother Yun, your talent is truly incredible! With such profound swordsmanship, and you can even create it—you really are a supreme monster!"
Liu Yiyi said affectionately.
After saying this—
She moved behind Ye Yun, and from behind tightly hugged his body, pressing her face in infatuation against his back.
"Brother Yun, after we return to Jianyun Sect, will you teach me this Binary Sword Chant properly?"
Liu Yiyi said softly.
Feeling the surging curves from his back, pressing against him, Ye Yun’s heart quivered as a wave of tender feelings arose anew.
But he quickly suppressed them.
If it had been a hundred thousand years ago, he certainly wouldn’t have missed such an open-air treat.
Now, his identity, status, and state of mind had all changed; Ye Yun no longer chased after all manner of thrills as he used to.
After signing in within the Mystical Space for a hundred thousand years, with his Dao Heart shattered countless times, Ye Yun’s temperament had matured greatly.
"Yiyi, once we return to Jianyun Sect, I’ll give you a thorough explanation of this swordsmanship."
Ye Yun replied with a gentle laugh.
"Thank you, Brother Yun."
Liu Yiyi was overjoyed, gently rubbing her cheek back and forth on Ye Yun’s back.
Even with the Ancestral Dragon Body, Ye Yun still felt the tingling heat flowing from his back, like surges of electricity boring into his body.
His blood boiling throughout.
"Is this a sword fanatic or a little minx?" Ye Yun smiled bitterly in his heart, suddenly turned around, wrapped Liu Yiyi in his arm, tore through the void, and left this place.
From the Tenth Sea Region to the Daluo Region’s Jianyun Sect, Ye Yun’s return was at least ten times faster than before.
After all, he now possessed a cultivation base at the First Layer of the God Sovereign Realm.
Having reached the Divine Sovereign Realm, his ability to tear open the void was even more formidable than before.
"Brother Yun is even stronger now!"
Watching Ye Yun’s terrifying speed in tearing through the void, Liu Yiyi was stunned.
She took a deep breath and secretly encouraged herself to break through to the Divine Sovereign Realm soon and quickly catch up to Brother Yun.
Back at Jianyun Sect—
Ye Yun found that Jianyun Sect was unchanged, his gaze flickering.
That black-robed youth had not appeared again.
It seemed he was in closed-door cultivation within that cave paradise.
Ye Yun planned to accompany Liu Yiyi in Jianyun Sect for some time, doing his best to help her break through to the Divine Sovereign Realm.
Even if she couldn’t break through—
Ye Yun would give Liu Yiyi a god-level armor, so her actual combat power would rise straight to the Divine Sovereign Realm.
If Liu Yiyi could also master the Binary Sword Chant, facing an opponent at the First Layer of the God Sovereign Realm, she could easily prevail.
That way, if that guy’s true self did show up, Ye Yun wouldn’t need to act—a mere Liu Yiyi could easily wipe him out.
Back at the rear mountain—
At this moment, Liu Yiyi was surprised to find that where the old Bamboo Building had been destroyed, a new emerald Bamboo Building had sprung up again.
And her disciple Bai Yuer was standing before the Bamboo Building.
"Yuer, you are so considerate."
Liu Yiyi and Ye Yun landed; she looked at Bai Yuer and praised her.
"Master, this is all as it should be."
Bai Yuer replied with a gentle smile.
At this moment, Ye Yun also stood beside Liu Yiyi, except he was in stealth.
"Brother Yun, I’ll return to the Sect Grand Hall to handle some affairs. Wait for me in the Bamboo Building."
Liu Yiyi sent Ye Yun a voice message.
She knew Ye Yun was currently invisible, so her disciple Bai Yuer could not see him.
This was something Ye Yun had already told her when they descended from midair together.
The whereabouts of Ye Yun’s true face would not be known to any disciple of Jianyun Sect.
"There’s still a Little Dragon on the plaza? I’ll go settle it in first."
Ye Yun blinked, suddenly recalling the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon he’d neglected for days.
He flashed away instantly.
Liu Yiyi smiled and followed Bai Yuer through the sky, returning to the Sect Grand Hall.
Ye Yun emerged from midair, resuming his appearance from when he first entered the Divine Land. At a glance, he saw the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon sitting on the plaza, sun beating down, eyes closed, desperately absorbing spiritual energy from all sides.
"Up you get. These days have been hard on you, waiting here so long."
Ye Yun said with a smile.
"So the master is back!"
The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon hurriedly stood, dusted off his clothes, and said with a grin, "Not hard at all, master, it’s only been a few days. How did you return so quickly?"
"Come with me."
Ye Yun smiled; he really appreciated this hardworking Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon.
With a wave, he took the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon and returned directly to Courtyard No. 9.
"We’ll cultivate here for a while,"
Ye Yun suddenly said.
"Master, aren’t we going to look for my previous owner?"
The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon asked in simple confusion.
"No need."
Ye Yun smiled and offered no explanation, then strode into his original room.
The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon scratched his head, still puzzled but not daring to ask further. He hurried to the room next door.
After all, this is the foremost power in the Daluo Region. At Jianyun Sect, spiritual energy is extremely abundant—he couldn’t wish for a better place to quietly cultivate.
Ye Yun saw the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon retreat to his room, smiled mysteriously, tore open the void, and quietly slipped away.
Before leaving—
He particularly sent Liu Yiyi another voice message.
He had the Sword Sovereign of Jianyun Sect issue an order: no one was to disturb the guests in Tianzi No. 9 Courtyard.
...
(Three Chapters today, this is the first Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 419 Dragon Breeding Valley, Testing the Five-clawed Golden Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 419: Chapter 419 Dragon Breeding Valley, Testing the Five-clawed Golden Dragon
Leaving No. 9 Courtyard, Ye Yun didn’t go straight back to the back mountain. Instead, he landed in a vast valley 2,000 li from the back mountain.
This valley spanned an extremely vast area. Around it, a powerful Formation was set up, completely enclosing the valley.
In the center of the valley was a large, sapphire-like lake, surrounded by a dense green jungle.
Whether in the lake, the jungle, or on the mountain ridges, Divine Dragons of various colors could be seen everywhere. Some were dozing with closed eyes, some were swimming in the lake, and others were soaring in midair.
Well, well! Yiyi has actually raised a full fifty Divine Dragons.
Ye Yun stood in midair, scanning the valley, a look of awe appearing on his face.
Fifty Divine Dragons; he wondered how much they must have cost.
Of course, many Cultivators from various powers had specifically sent Liu Yiyi Divine Dragons or Dragon Eggs to curry favor with the famous Sword Sovereign.
Ye Yun naturally knew why Liu Yiyi wanted to raise so many Divine Dragons.
It was simply a case of seeing things and thinking of a person.
100,000 years ago, when Ye Yun was the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, the Sect had raised many Divine Dragons. Liu Yiyi raised Divine Dragons to reminisce about the Ye Yun of the past. Seeing these Divine Dragons would remind her of the former Dragon God Sect and of herself within it.
This stemmed from almost the same psychological state as carving peachwood dolls.
After scanning around, Ye Yun noticed that out of nearly fifty Divine Dragons, one-third were Five-clawed Golden Dragons. There were also Azure Dragons, Yellow Dragons, Earth Dragons...
All were just ordinary mixed dragons. Compared to the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon, their bloodlines were far inferior.
In the Divine Land, there were generally two reasons for such situations.
Firstly, perhaps the Dragon Raisers did not want more precious young dragons to end up in this world.
Secondly, perhaps the Dragon Raisers themselves did not possess many Divine Dragons with precious bloodlines. If they didn’t have them, how could they let such young dragons be lost to the Divine Land?
Of course, these were just Ye Yun’s guesses. After all, the fall of the Dragon Clan had occurred eight or nine million years ago. It was too long ago, and many things could no longer be recalled or investigated. As for how long the Dragon Raiser heritage had been passed down, their current strength, and how many bloodlines of Divine Dragons they controlled... these were all unknowns.
Ye Yun prepared to descend and take a look at these Little Dragons in the valley.
His eyes focused, and the large Formation split open a gap. Ye Yun strolled in leisurely. Immediately after, the gap closed again.
"Hmm? Why is there a strange human here?"
A certain Five-clawed Golden Dragon, which had been lying on a ridge, suddenly opened its eyes. Divine light bloomed from them as it looked sharply in a certain direction.
"Not good! He’s not from the Jianyun Sect; he’s an outside Human Cultivator!" an Azure Dragon said solemnly.
Then, all the Divine Dragons in the valley discovered the intrusion of an unfamiliar human.
Originally, only the Sword Sovereign could enter this valley. As for the other disciples of the Jianyun Sect, they could only control the Formation and would regularly drop blood-food for these Divine Dragons to consume. Therefore, these Divine Dragons were very familiar with everyone in the Jianyun Sect.
Among them, even those with the lowest cultivation base had reached the tenth level of the Eternal Realm. Most were at the True God Realm. Four or five Divine Dragons had already reached the Divine Monarch Realm cultivation base. They were likely the first batch of Divine Dragons to enter the valley, raised by the Sword Sovereign.
Because Ye Yun had concealed his Super Divine Dragon Breath, he didn’t startle these little Divine Dragons when he entered the valley. Otherwise, if his Super Divine Dragon Breath from the God Venerable Realm were to be released, all the Divine Dragons in the valley would probably be scared half to death.
WHOOSH!
All the Divine Dragons in the valley soared into the air and flew towards Ye Yun. They surrounded him, baring their fangs and claws, and continuously let out roars.
"Human, you dare to enter the Jianyun Sect’s Dragon Breeding Valley! What is your purpose?" a Yellow Dragon at the True God Realm stared intently at Ye Yun and asked.
After it finished speaking, the rest of the Divine Dragons roared in unison, as if cheering it on. Fortunately, this great Formation was extremely powerful, so the sound didn’t travel outside.
Looking at these spirited Divine Dragons around him, Ye Yun suddenly smiled.
These little ones are all quite nervous, putting on an air of false bravado. Don’t tell me they think I’m here to steal Divine Dragons?
At this thought, Ye Yun wanted to burst into laughter, but he held it back.
The Divine Dragons here were all raised from hatchlings. Only the Sword Sovereign could communicate with them, so their thinking is simple.
"That’s right," Ye Yun said with a smile, suddenly nodding. "I am indeed here to steal Divine Dragons."
"As expected!"
"Audacious dragon thief! We won’t let you succeed!"
Anger etched the faces of the surrounding Divine Dragons as they roared again. They had lived in the Jianyun Sect for so many years, carefully nurtured by the Sword Sovereign, and had long since considered themselves disciples of the Sect. Now, seeing someone trying to steal Divine Dragons, they were naturally enraged.
WHOOSH!
Several True God Realm Divine Dragons, baring fangs and claws, pounced towards Ye Yun.
Ye Yun waved his hand lightly, and these few Divine Dragons were immediately swept away.
SPLASH! SPLASH!
They plunged one after another into the valley’s blue lake, splashing up water columns several meters high.
"Those at the True God Realm shouldn’t bother coming up. Those at the Divine Monarch Realm can still make a move," Ye Yun said with a smile.
His gaze fell upon the strongest Five-clawed Golden Dragon.
God Monarch Realm third layer.
This cultivation base is even higher than the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s.
Ye Yun also wanted to see just how powerful this Five-clawed Golden Dragon was.
"None of you make a move! This human must be a Divine Monarch Realm Cultivator," the Five-clawed Golden Dragon at the God Monarch Realm third layer roared loudly, immediately making all the other Divine Dragons retreat.
"Brother, this human is all yours," a nearby Five-clawed Golden Dragon at the God Monarch Realm First Layer said in a deep voice.
"Rest assured. A mere human can’t stir up any trouble in our Jianyun Sect," the Five-clawed Golden Dragon at the God Monarch Realm third layer sneered and lunged at Ye Yun.
Its enormous body descended like a dark cloud.
In this valley, the true forms of all Divine Dragons were restricted to a certain extent; otherwise, the valley could hardly accommodate so many Divine Dragons. However, despite this, the Divine Dragons’ reduced sizes were still exceptionally large.
"Brother, kill that arrogant human!"
"Brother, it’s all up to you!"
...
The surrounding Divine Dragons grew incredibly agitated and roared.
Ye Yun remained impassive and lightly threw a punch. He hadn’t used much force in this punch. He wanted to see to what extent the physique of this God Venerable Realm Five-clawed Golden Dragon had developed.
BOOM!
Ye Yun’s fist collided with the Five-clawed Golden Dragon’s claw, creating a deafening crash.
Although he hadn’t used any force, when the Five-clawed Golden Dragon’s claw struck his fist, it was repelled by its own power.
"This human’s physique is so strong! Quickly, go notify the Sword Sovereign!" The Five-clawed Golden Dragon halted its Dragon Body in midair, a look of terror in its Dragon Eyes, and hurriedly issued a warning.
It knew. Even if it fought to the death, it could not defeat this opponent!

chapters.title: Chapter 420: Revealing the Identity of Ancestor Dragon, Dragon Raiser Suddenly Appears
chapters.content:
Chapter 420: Chapter 420: Revealing the Identity of Ancestor Dragon, Dragon Raiser Suddenly Appears
The southwestern part of the valley.
An Eternal Realm Yellow Dragon was sprawled on a gigantic stone.
All the other Divine Dragons had gathered around the human, while this one alone remained, keeping watch.
The Divine Monarch Realm third-layer Five-clawed Golden Dragon suddenly gave a warning. The Eternal Realm Yellow Dragon jolted and, without hesitation, slapped its claw on the stone.
A ray of light instantly burst from the stone, soared into the sky, and then vanished.
Ye Yun glanced over and immediately understood.
He guessed this was Liu Yiyi, that little worrywart, fearing someone might steal the Divine Dragons. That’s why she set up a small Messaging Formation here. If any problem arose, they could call the Sword Sovereign for help.
The Sword Sovereign was just over two thousand li from here; she could arrive in the span of a breath if needed.
Looking at the light of the Messaging Formation disappearing into the sky, the Divine Monarch Realm third-layer Five-clawed Golden Dragon hovering in mid-air grew even more arrogant. It laughed coldly, "The Sword Sovereign is almost here! Get ready to meet your doom!"
Ye Yun touched his nose and smirked.
He didn’t know whether to call this little dragon stupid or crazy. If he were to curse at it, he would only appear immature.
So, Ye Yun simply remained silent, waiting for Liu Yiyi to arrive and clarify the situation.
Seeing Ye Yun remain silent, the Five-clawed Golden Dragon grew even more arrogant.
It snorted coldly. "Unless your cultivation base is at the Divine Sovereign Realm, you won’t leave this valley alive today!"
"Really? Do you think the Sword Sovereign could be my match?" Ye Yun chuckled.
"You’re no match for the Sword Sovereign! If Her Ladyship were to appear, you wouldn’t withstand a single strike!" the Five-clawed Golden Dragon retorted, its expression proud as it snorted coldly.
"Little Dragon, don’t spout such nonsense!"
A woman’s anxious voice suddenly came from afar. Immediately after, a red figure flashed and landed in the valley.
It was Liu Yiyi.
The Five-clawed Golden Dragon’s face lit up as if it had seen its savior. It cried out loudly for help, "Sword Sovereign, Your Ladyship has arrived just in time! This human tried to steal dragons from the Dragon Breeding Valley! I’m no match for him!"
Hearing the Five-clawed Golden Dragon’s words, Liu Yiyi’s expression froze; she looked at Ye Yun helplessly.
Ye Yun waved at the rapidly approaching Liu Yiyi, a smile on his face. "Hey... Sword Sovereign, good to see you! It’s been a while!"
"..."
Liu Yiyi was at a loss whether to laugh or cry.
She hadn’t expected Brother Yun to leave the Bamboo Building on the back mountain and come to her Dragon Breeding Valley, just to start teasing these little Divine Dragons.
Liu Yiyi knew the Divine Dragons she had raised very well. These Divine Dragons had grown up in this valley. Having never ventured into the outside world, they were naive and, frankly, easily frightened by Brother Yun.
"Brother Yun, stop messing around," Liu Yiyi chided him sweetly. "These little ones are just children."
With that, a red figure flashed. Liu Yiyi appeared at Ye Yun’s side, extended a delicate, jade-like arm, and affectionately hooked his.
"Brother Yun, let’s go," Liu Yiyi said with a giggle. "We should head back to the mountain. I’m still waiting for you to teach me swordsmanship!"
"Alright!"
With Liu Yiyi tightly holding his arm, Ye Yun had no choice but to relent.
However, her full figure did exert a certain psychological pressure on him, and he couldn’t help but feel a thrill.
He seemed to recall that intoxicating scene in the Bronze Immortal Palace once more.
"This..."
The Five-clawed Golden Dragon looked on, utterly bewildered, at the Sword Sovereign and the unfamiliar human.
It couldn’t comprehend the relationship between these two, who were acting so intimately. In its mind, the Sword Sovereign was always a cold, unfeeling goddess, one who rarely even smiled at them, the Divine Dragons. Unexpectedly, beside this white-robed young man, the Sword Sovereign was like a happy young girl, talking and laughing, her eyes full of affection. This completely overturned its understanding.
The other Divine Dragons around were also dumbstruck, looking at each other, speechless.
Was this still the Sword Sovereign they remembered?
Seeing the expressions on the surrounding Divine Dragons, Liu Yiyi blushed slightly. She straightened her posture and announced loudly, "Don’t be surprised. He is my husband."
"What? This is the Sword Sovereign... your husband?"
In that instant, all the Divine Dragons were dumbfounded.
This news struck them like a thunderbolt, leaving their minds reeling; they couldn’t process it for a long moment.
"You are all still young and don’t understand many things," Liu Yiyi took a deep breath and declared without reservation. "Let me tell you frankly, my husband is exceedingly powerful. A hundred thousand years ago, I was no match for him. Even now, after a hundred thousand years, I am still not his match. Now do you all understand?"
As she spoke these words, her face was slightly flushed, and her eyes shone with a fervent adoration.
In her heart, Ye Yun was not only her lover but also her idol, the one she worshipped.
The surroundings suddenly fell deathly silent; one could hear a pin drop.
All the Divine Dragons stared at each other, each one overcome with profound shock.
"Just reasoning with them won’t do," Ye Yun gently squeezed Liu Yiyi’s small hand and said with a smile. "Watch how I handle them."
At that moment, his body gave a slight tremor, and a wisp of the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline’s Breath was instantly released.
Ancestral Dragon’s Breath, suppressing all ages! All dragons in the world, who would dare disobey!
Even though these Divine Dragons were hatched in the Divine Land by the Dragon Raiser, their bloodline was no longer considered purely of the Dragon Clan.
But deep within their bloodlines, they still retained the memories of the Ancient Era.
Usually, these memories lay dormant within their bloodline. But upon encountering the Ancestral Dragon’s Breath, these sleeping memories would awaken.
All the Divine Dragons plummeted from the sky. Their bodies shrank, and they all prostrated themselves on the ground.
"We... we pay our respects to Lord Ancestor Dragon!" all the Divine Dragons stammered, trembling. Though their voices quaked with fear, their hearts surged with immense excitement.
To feel the Ancestral Dragon’s Breath was a supreme glory, an honor deeply embedded within their very bloodline. After all, in the Ancient Era, what ordinary member of the Dragon Clan ever had the chance to feel the Ancestral Dragon’s Breath? Only the Ten Super Divine Dragons had the privilege of an audience with Lord Ancestor Dragon.
"This..." Liu Yiyi’s mouth fell open, her eyes wide, a tempest raging in her heart.
Brother Yun... When did he become Lord Ancestor Dragon?
However, at this moment, Liu Yiyi remained very composed and tactfully silent.
After all, she had known Ye Yun for a hundred thousand years; she wouldn’t press the issue then.
She trusted Brother Yun; if he deemed it necessary, he would surely tell her the truth.
"All of you, rise!" Ye Yun’s gaze was majestic as he said calmly.
"Yes, Lord Ancestor Dragon!" the Five-clawed Golden Dragon responded.
All the Divine Dragons then slowly rose from the ground. However, they still didn’t dare to take to the air, merely standing there.
Ye Yun retracted the wisp of Ancestral Dragon’s Breath.
Only then did all the Divine Dragons feel as if a great burden had been lifted.
"Yiyi, let’s go," Ye Yun didn’t say much more to these Divine Dragons. Instead, he looked at Liu Yiyi and said with a smile.
Liu Yiyi nodded.
Ye Yun tore open the void, taking Liu Yiyi with him as he departed the valley.
Seeing the two of them disappear, all the Divine Dragons in the valley let out a collective, deep sigh of relief.
"Unbelievable!" the leading Five-clawed Golden Dragon was visibly thrilled. Gazing in the direction where the two had vanished, it muttered to itself. "To think we actually got to meet Lord Ancestor Dragon!"
「The void rippled.」
A black coffin suddenly burst forth from it.
Ye Yun had just left the valley and was now above the back mountain of the Jianyun Sect when he suddenly sensed something unusual in the Dragon Breeding Valley. He frowned and immediately halted his descent.
Ye Yun sensed a familiar aura.
That was... The deity worshipped by the Coffin Carrier Clan—the Dragon Raiser.

chapters.title: Chapter 421: Ye Yun’s Initial Attempt
chapters.content:
Chapter 421: Chapter 421: Ye Yun’s Initial Attempt
HUM!
A black coffin unexpectedly drilled out of the void, suspending in mid-air above the valley and aggressively releasing a powerful pressure.
All the Divine Dragons in the valley instantly prostrated on the ground, shivering in fear.
This unassuming black coffin was emitting a massive Divine Sovereign Realm aura.
WHOOSH!
The coffin’s lid opened, and a black figure floated out from inside.
This figure was a man swathed entirely in black cloth, his face indiscernible, making him extremely mysterious. Only a pair of bizarre and gloomy eyes were visible.
After the mysterious man appeared, his gaze continuously swept downwards, as if searching for something. Innumerable Divine Dragons bowed their heads, exchanging glances, daring not even to breathe loudly. Out of instinctive fear, even the Eternal Realm Divine Dragon guarding the Messaging Formation failed to activate it at this moment.
"They’re all ordinary Divine Dragons," the mysterious man furrowed his brow, murmuring softly.
Just now, he seemed to have sensed a powerful Divine Dragon’s Breath. In that instant, he felt as if he was facing a Super Divine Dragon. Eager to investigate, he broke through the void and hurriedly came here.
This valley was protected by a powerful formation that blocked everything, so theoretically, he shouldn’t have been able to sense any aura. But in reality, being a Dragon Raiser, even one merely from the Coffin Carrier Branch and not the Dragon Candle Branch, allowed him to vaguely perceive unusual auras. This was due to the special restrictions embedded within these Divine Dragons.
Each Divine Dragon or Dragon Egg on the Divine Land had ancient restrictions set by the Dragon Raisers. These restrictions were concealed deep within their bloodline, creating a magnetic-like connection between them and the Dragon Raisers. This sensation would have been clearer without the formation’s obstruction.
"
Perhaps I was mistaken? The Ten Super Divine Dragons from the Ancient Era fell long ago. How could they possibly reappear on the Divine Land?
" the mysterious man murmured to himself, his voice soft but somewhat eerie.
Above the valley, from within a spatial rift, Ye Yun coldly observed the mysterious Dragon Raiser below. Next to him stood Liu Yiyi, looking somewhat anxious.
"Brother Yun, the man who came out of the coffin gives me an indescribable, creepy feeling," Liu Yiyi said softly.
"Yiyi," Ye Yun asked indifferently, "you’ve been on the Divine Land for so many years. Haven’t you heard of the Dragon Raisers?"
"Of course, I’ve heard of them," Liu Yiyi said in surprise, "but the Dragon Raisers I know don’t live in coffins."
Saying this, she suddenly realized something and exclaimed, "Brother Yun, you mean—this mysterious man is a Dragon Raiser?"
"Exactly. He is a Dragon Raiser, though he belongs to the Coffin Carrier Branch. The ones you know probably belong to the Dragon Candle Branch," Ye Yun nodded.
From Liu Yiyi’s words, he could roughly understand that the Dragon Raisers of the Coffin Carrier Branch seemed to have never secretly revealed themselves on the Divine Land. Even Liu Yiyi, despite being on the Divine Land for so long, hadn’t heard of them.
It seemed that Dragon Raisers of this type primarily controlled the Coffin Carrier Clan of Moon Star remotely, their activities targeting the Cangnan Continent. Their main aim was to cultivate vessels.
Ye Yun didn’t actively release his Divine Sense to scan that Dragon Raiser, primarily out of fear of alerting the enemy. Therefore, he didn’t know if this Divine Sovereign Realm Dragon Raiser before him was a puppet or not. He hoped it wasn’t a puppet, as he wanted to capture a live Dragon Raiser.
The idea had barely formed when Ye Yun suddenly had an even bolder one.
Could there be a Dragon Raiser nest in the Daluo Region?
If he could follow the clues back to their source and find the Dragon Raisers’ nest, wouldn’t he be able to gather even more information?
Thinking of this, Ye Yun prepared to act. Previously, he feared startling the enemy, but now he intended to make a bold move. He decided to first punish this Dragon Raiser and see where it would try to escape.
"Brother Yun, has this Dragon Raiser suddenly appeared to steal Divine Dragons from the Dragon Breeding Valley?" Liu Yiyi asked nervously.
Ye Yun shook his head. "They haven’t the slightest interest in the Divine Dragons you’re raising."
Ye Yun smiled but didn’t explain, then suddenly disappeared from Liu Yiyi’s side. Liu Yiyi felt a pang of anxiety, then saw Ye Yun suddenly appear in the valley.
She didn’t act recklessly.
That Dragon Raiser gives off an extremely eerie vibe; Brother Yun is probably the only one who can handle him.
Ye Yun silently appeared behind the black coffin. The Dragon Raiser, his back to Ye Yun, remained oblivious. Even though they were both at the Divine Sovereign Realm, the gap between them was enormous.
"You thieving scoundrel! How dare you come to my Jianyun Sect to steal Divine Dragons! You’ll see how I deal with you!" Ye Yun drew a Silver Long Sword and, with a shout, suddenly launched an attack from behind.
Someone?
The Dragon Raiser was startled by the unexpected roar from behind. He turned around abruptly and saw a gleaming sword light ferociously descending before him. He was instantly filled with dread.
His meager Divine Sovereign Realm cultivation base had left him utterly unaware of the ambush.
WHOOSH!
A black coffin suddenly shot out to shield him, intercepting all the sword light.
After his sneak attack, Ye Yun, in contrast, didn’t continue attacking. He just coldly stared at the Dragon Raiser opposite him and asked indifferently, "My sword does not slay nameless spirits. You, fellow hiding in the coffin, from what sect or faction do you hail?"
"You are not qualified to know my origins." The Dragon Raiser sneered, his pupils glinting sharply as he looked over the white-robed youth before him. "Since when did the Jianyun Sect have a cultivator at the Divine Sovereign Realm?"
Seeing the Dragon Raiser’s arrogant tone, Ye Yun couldn’t help but be amused. The first probe revealed the fellow’s caution; he refused to divulge any information. This showed that the Dragon Raisers from the Coffin Carrier Branch were indeed a force that could not see the light of day on the Divine Land.
Ye Yun raised his sword, gently blew a breath across its blade, and said softly, "You talk tough... I just wonder, is your head harder, or is my sword sharper?"
AH! The Dragon Raiser suddenly slapped his forehead, a look of realization dawning on him. "I see! You’re that Mysterious Sword Cultivator from outside the region! You’ve even joined up with the Sword Sovereign. Were you captivated by her beauty?"
"You got it right. The Sword Sovereign is too beautiful, and now I’ve joined the Jianyun Sect," Ye Yun laughed.
He hadn’t expected that the Sword Sovereign’s renowned beauty would be known even to this mysterious Dragon Raiser from the Coffin Carrier Branch. He instantly felt a surge of pride.
In the air, upon hearing the conversation below, Liu Yiyi’s face flushed slightly. However, she was no longer the shy girl of a hundred thousand years ago; her expression quickly returned to normal.
She also wanted to see how her Brother Yun would display his might and eliminate this mysterious Dragon Raiser.
"Sir, I have no interest in the Divine Dragons raised by the Jianyun Sect, nor do I wish to fight with you. How about we call a truce?" the Dragon Raiser suddenly proposed.
"A truce?" Ye Yun was slightly stunned. He couldn’t believe this fellow suddenly didn’t want to fight him anymore.
How could that be? If he didn’t soundly beat this fellow, how could he find the Dragon Raisers’ lair?

chapters.title: Chapter 422: Seven Star Coffin Formation
chapters.content:
Chapter 422: Chapter 422: Seven Star Coffin Formation
"How can we just shake hands and make peace? It’s not every day one encounters a distinguished cultivator of the Divine Sovereign Realm in the Daluo Region. I won’t let this go without a proper contest."
Ye Yun stated calmly, a faint chuckle in his voice. His gaze was fixed intently on the Dragon Raiser opposite him, his entire aura growing stronger by the moment.
The Dragon Raiser frowned. He hadn’t expected this Mysterious Sword Cultivator from an outer region to be so difficult to deal with. Both of them were powerful cultivators at the God Monarch Realm First Layer. If they were to fight, they would inevitably both sustain some injuries.
He didn’t want to fight. He had only appeared in this world because he sensed the mysterious and powerful Super Divine Dragon Breath here.
"Sir, I am no match for you. I admit defeat. Farewell."
The Dragon Raiser suddenly looked up and spoke. Without warning, the black coffin beside him suddenly enveloped him.
BZZZ!
Tearing through the void, the black coffin plunged inside.
Seeing the Dragon Raiser so shamelessly admit defeat, suddenly crawl into the black Covert Dragon Coffin, and prepare to escape through the void, Ye Yun sneered and fiercely pursued him.
An incomparably sharp streak of Sword Light brutally struck the black coffin.
BOOM!
With a deafening roar, the black Covert Dragon Coffin, which had just slipped halfway into the void, trembled violently and was sent flying skyward.
Lying inside the black Covert Dragon Coffin, the Dragon Raiser felt the intense vibrations and was inwardly astonished.
This Sword Cultivator is incredibly strong!
Although he rarely fought, his strength was considerable. Moreover, their personally refined life-bound Covert Dragon Coffin possessed unimaginable defensive power. Just now, even though the Covert Dragon Coffin protected him, he still felt the powerful shockwaves from within. Fortunately, he wasn’t injured.
Ye Yun’s figure flashed, and in an instant, he appeared in mid-air.
A Sword Light swept out.
BOOM!
It struck the black Covert Dragon Coffin once more.
The black coffin buzzed and vibrated, shattering large swathes of the surrounding void. This demonstrated the terrifying power contained in Ye Yun’s sword strike.
Of course, Ye Yun had only slightly increased the power from his previous strike. If he had truly used his full strength, the coffin would have shattered long ago. He merely wanted to injure this fellow. At the same time, he wanted to secretly infuse his mark into the coffin. To be safe, he would naturally infuse it onto the Dragon Raiser’s body as well.
He would understand all of this after injuring him.
Ye Yun had finally encountered a Dragon Raiser who wasn’t a puppet. Naturally, he wanted to find the Dragon Raisers’ lair and uncover certain truths. For instance, what was the purpose of the Dragon Raisers instructing the Coffin Carrier Clan to cultivate so many ’vessels’ on the Cangnan Continent?
BOOM! BOOM!
He struck the Covert Dragon Coffin three consecutive times, each blow stronger than the last.
The Dragon Raiser hiding inside the black Covert Dragon Coffin finally couldn’t hold back and spat out a mouthful of blood. He now realized this Sword Cultivator’s sword was incredibly fast and powerful. If he continued to defend passively, he would become increasingly so. Although he was now lightly injured, it wasn’t serious, so he decided to go out and fight this person properly.
With a thought, he instantly emerged from the black Covert Dragon Coffin and floated in mid-air.
HUM!
The Dragon Raiser placed his hands before his chest and formed a strange Hand Seal. Suddenly, six streaks of black light drifted out from the Hand Seal, transforming into six black Covert Dragon Coffins in mid-air. Combined with the previous Covert Dragon Coffin, there were now seven in total.
The Seven Sleeping Dragon Coffins floated above his head, forming the shape of the Seven Stars.
Ye Yun’s pupils constricted slightly at this sight.
Indeed... a true Dragon Raiser possesses the Seven Sleeping Dragon Coffins, capable of forming the Seven-star formation.
"Sir, I initially had no desire to fight you, but you insisted on being aggressive. Today, once I activate The Seven Star Coffin Array, even if you don’t die, you will be severely injured by my hand!"
The Dragon Raiser’s gaze, sharp as twin swords, fell upon the white-robed Sword Cultivator opposite him as he spoke coldly.
"Is that so? Bring out whatever techniques you have. Let me see how formidable The Seven Star Coffin Array truly is."
Ye Yun laughed heartily and made a simple gesture. He slowly raised his right hand, holding the Silver Sword horizontally before his chest.
Binary Sword Chant, Sword of Life Realm.
Brother Yun is about to use this move again,
Liu Yiyi thought, watching from her hiding place in the distant void. She clenched her fists, her face slightly flushed with excitement. If not for her low cultivation base, she would have rushed over to lend Ye Yun a hand.
However, Liu Yiyi knew her limits. One hundred thousand years ago, when Ye Yun fought, he never needed help from women—neither her nor... Brother Yun’s... other women.
Thinking of those other women, Liu Yiyi felt a pang of jealousy and couldn’t help but huff coldly. Then, she laughed again.
A hundred thousand years have passed. Other than Nangong Jade, those other women are probably all dead, right? Nangong Jade had shown her kindness, so Liu Yiyi wouldn’t feel jealous of her.
The Dragon Raiser observed Ye Yun’s peculiar sword technique for a few seconds, then chuckled dismissively. "Is that move of yours supposed to be formidable?"
"Why don’t you try it and find out?" Ye Yun replied with a light smile.
He was using this swordsmanship technique partly as a demonstration for Liu Yiyi, who was watching from the side. The clash between two cultivators of the Divine Sovereign Realm was an excellent observational opportunity for Liu Yiyi. It would significantly aid her growth in the Sword Dao.
Seeing Ye Yun’s relentlessness, the Dragon Raiser finally grew enraged. After their earlier exchanges, he admitted this Mysterious Sword Cultivator in white was very strong. He hadn’t wanted a fight to the death... but seeing how things were, it seemed today would not end peacefully.
He changed the Hand Seal before his chest. As his mana surged, the Seven Black Buried Dragon Coffins above his head suddenly glowed with a layer of black light.
BUZZ! BUZZ! BUZZ!
The seven black Covert Dragon Coffins began to make strange, rhythmic sounds, as if they were starting to resonate with each other.
Following that, each black Covert Dragon Coffin suddenly shot out a beam of black light.
The moment this black light appeared, it triggered a violent change in the heavens and the earth. Dark clouds roiled across the sky, obscuring the sun and plunging the entire world into darkness.
Seeing such an astonishing scene, Liu Yiyi’s expression couldn’t help but change. This Dragon Raiser was far too strong. This attack method far exceeded the Divine Skills of ordinary experts at the First Layer of the God Sovereign Realm.
A faint smile touched Ye Yun’s lips, his expression unmoved as he calmly watched everything unfold.
WHOOSH!
The seven streaks of black light, suffused with a world-ending aura, instantly descended before Ye Yun.
But then, a bizarre scene occurred.
The seven terrifying black lights were drawn by a powerful force towards the Silver Sword. As they approached within the Three Zhang Void of the Silver Sword, the black lights vanished inch by inch, a process visible to the naked eye.
It was as if an endless void existed there, capable of devouring all attacks completely.
What kind of swordsmanship is this? How can it be so powerful?!
Seeing the powerful attack from his prided The Seven Star Coffin Array nullified, the Dragon Raiser’s expression changed drastically, his heart pounding wildly in his chest.

chapters.title: Chapter 423: The Horror of the Sword of Life Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 423: Chapter 423: The Horror of the Sword of Life Realm
The Dragon-rearing Clan, with its long heritage, had an in-depth understanding of the various major powers in the Divine Land.
