Especially concerning the powerful factions that used swords, they were well aware of the characteristics and power of their famous swordsmanship techniques. Among these Sword Dao forces, the Sword Pavilion was considered one of the strongest. While the Sword Pavilion was strong, it was not invincible; other Sword Dao forces were capable of rivaling it.
However, the swordsmanship of this mysterious young Sword Cultivator before them—whose origins were unknown—was so exquisitely profound it was awe-inspiring. Such divine swordsmanship surpassed their understanding.
Once activated, the Seven Star Coffin Formation of their Dragon-rearing Clan’s Coffin Raising Lineage possessed infinite power, formidable to cultivators of the same rank. Unexpectedly, everything changed when they encountered this mysterious Sword Cultivator.
The Dragon Raiser, however, was unwilling to concede. He roared angrily, "AWOOO!", once again changing his Hand Seal. His Mana surged out as he began to mobilize the Seven-star formation.
BUZZING...
The seven black Covert Dragon Coffins began to tremble slightly in the void, seemingly making some adjustments. A miniature Seven-star formation suddenly appeared on the surface of each coffin. Silvery light emerged on the surface of each black Covert Dragon Coffin. In this dark world, it was exceptionally dazzling.
"I possess a sword capable of moving mountains and overturning seas, subduing demons and exorcising fiends, and deflecting all attacks in the world. Who dares to challenge me?" Ye Yun muttered to himself, his right hand still gripping the sword steadily.
Although the sky and earth were plunged into darkness, he had already become one with them. Heaven, earth, man, and sword—all united as one. The great power of heaven and earth was all concentrated on his sword. No attack could affect him in the slightest. The Sword of Life Realm was just that powerful. Otherwise, it would not have earned its rank among the myriad swordsmanship techniques in the multiverse.
"You forced my hand! If I do not kill you today, I swear I am not human!" The Dragon Raiser stared fixedly at Ye Yun and let out another roar.
BUZZ!
The seven Covert Dragon Coffins in mid-air simultaneously shot out a ray of light. This light was no longer purely black but was black interspersed with strands of silver. The black light, now mixed with silver, carried an even more terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath. Liu Yiyi, hiding far away, felt her hair stand on end and began to tremble all over.
At this moment, the entire Jianyun Sect and all living beings within a million-mile radius felt this powerful and terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath. Many people fainted. Those who remained conscious collapsed, unable to even stand. Only Divine Monarchs could barely withstand it.
The Dragon-rearing Clan has always been elusive in the Divine Land. To think that just one of its branches, the Coffin Raising Lineage, is this powerful...
Liu Yiyi thought in fear. Although she had great confidence in Ye Yun, she couldn’t help but feel a little worried. She did not want her beloved Brother Yun to suffer any harm in this battle.
This is getting interesting...
Ye Yun’s eyelids narrowed slightly as he gazed at the silver light within the black radiance. It seemed the true Seven-star formation had begun to empower the Dragon Raiser’s Seven Star Coffin Formation. The previous Seven Star Coffin Formation was merely form without substance. Its power hadn’t been particularly strong. However, once the Seven-star formation appeared on each Covert Dragon Coffin, everything changed.
Ye Yun looked up, noticing the Big Dipper faintly appearing in the depths of the void. Streams of starlight descended from deep space, flowing into those Seven-star formations and infusing the entire Seven Star Coffin Formation with boundless energy.
This Seven Star Coffin Array is indeed quite something, able to channel the power of the heavens, earth, and stars.
Ye Yun nodded slightly.
WHOOSH!
Seven columns of black and silver light roared towards Ye Yun once again.
Without exception, the seven bicolored columns of black and silver light were still drawn by a mysterious force towards the front of the silver sword, where they abruptly vanished.
"How is this possible?!" The Dragon Raiser bellowed in rage upon seeing this.
How can this swordsmanship Divine Skill be so powerful?
"KILL!" The Dragon Raiser gave a desperate roar, funneling the inexhaustible Mana of his body into his Hand Seal.
HUMMING...
Each black Covert Dragon Coffin’s Seven-star formation released a brilliant light. At this moment, the previously dim Big Dipper in the sky became even more radiant. A torrent of violent energy poured down from mid-air into each Seven-star formation, which in turn nourished the black Covert Dragon Coffins. Columns of black and silver light, thicker than before, shot towards Ye Yun, blanketing the sky. The diameter of each light column reached dozens of zhang, their momentum overwhelming, like world-ending swords. A total of seven such world-ending swords pierced from seven different directions.
The Dragon Raiser seemed to have perceived a weakness in this swordsmanship and attempted to attack Ye Yun from different angles simultaneously.
Ye Yun simply smiled faintly.
How could he possibly imagine the true strength of the Binary Sword Chant?
The Sword of Life Realm could block all attacks, and not just those from the front.
"This..." Liu Yiyi looked into the depths of the sky and saw the Big Dipper suspended high above, continuously showering starlight onto the seven black coffins. Upon closer inspection, she noticed that each black coffin was inlaid with seven silver stars, forming what looked like a miniature Seven-star formation. Even for Liu Yiyi, renowned as the foremost swordswoman in the Daluo Region, this was the first time she had witnessed such a technique.
She was incredibly shocked. Seeing the giant columns of black and silver light sweeping towards Ye Yun, her beautiful face turned deathly pale.
Could Brother Yun’s Sword of Life Realm withstand such a powerful attack? After all, I’ve already cultivated to the Half-step Divine Venerate Realm, and my experience is vast. I know all too well that so-called ultimate defense is only effective within a certain range. When the power of an attack far exceeds that defensive range... the Sword of Life Realm might not be able to hold...
SHREEE! SHREEE!
The seven giant light columns tore through the void and descended mercilessly. From afar, it looked as if seven world-ending swords were set on destroying a tiny figure.
The Dragon Raiser maintained his Hand Seal, his gloomy eyes locked onto the seven light columns. This was his strongest attack. If it still had no effect, his only option would be to flee.
"What?!" "How can it still be like this?!" The Dragon Raiser’s pupils widened dramatically, and he let out a sharp cry of disbelief.
The seven cataclysmic beams of light, regardless of the direction from which they descended upon the White Clad Sword Cultivator, all seemed to be drawn toward him as if he had an avatar in every direction. Every assault ultimately converged in front of the silver sword and vanished without a trace.
Faced with such bizarre and powerful swordsmanship, a Divine Skill that transcended everything in the world, the Dragon Raiser felt a bone-chilling cold, as if he had been plunged into an icy cavern.
At this moment, he understood with chilling clarity: if he couldn’t suppress this mysterious Sword Cultivator in terms of cultivation base, he would never be able to defeat him.
"Take my sword!" Ye Yun suddenly uttered a low shout, and the sword in his hand moved.
A beam of sword light flashed across the void. It was extremely swift, piercing towards the still-stunned Dragon Raiser.

chapters.title: Chapter 424: Black Fog Abyss, Seven Sleeping Dragon Coffins
chapters.content:
Chapter 424: Chapter 424: Black Fog Abyss, Seven Sleeping Dragon Coffins
"
This swordsmanship...
"
The Dragon Raiser stared at a brilliant sword light slashing through the distant void, its momentum terrifying, robbing him of any thought of resistance.
This sword technique was indeed too overpowering. It treated space as if it were nothing. As if nothing in the world could stand in its way.
Although the Dragon Raiser was a bit stunned, the Seven Sleeping Dragon Coffins were his life-bound items. At this critical moment of life and death, they automatically flew forward to protect their master, one after another.
BOOM!
Ye Yun’s sword light pierced through clouds and mist, directly penetrating the first Sleeping Dragon Coffin. Its momentum undiminished, amid a series of explosions, it shattered all seven Sleeping Dragon Coffins in succession. Each Sleeping Dragon Coffin was pierced with a large hole. The final sword light, seemingly diminished, slowed by a fraction.
Only then did the Dragon Raiser realize that he had been locked on by the opponent’s swordsmanship and had nearly lost his life.
He swiftly changed his hand seal, Mana surging wildly, and spat out a mouthful of Essence Blood onto the hand seal. His body instantly became ethereal and indistinct, as if about to fade and vanish.
At that moment, a cold light flashed in Ye Yun’s eyes.
How could he allow the Dragon Raiser to escape so easily using a secret technique? How could he let him go without paying a price?
Even though he had just launched the powerful Sword of Death Realm, Ye Yun had only used a small part of its true prowess. After all, he only wanted to wound the Dragon Raiser, not take his life.
Ye Yun slightly increased the power of his swordsmanship and instantly pierced the body that was about to fade.
Then, the fading body vanished completely.
The Seven Sleeping Dragon Coffins that were pierced by Ye Yun also turned around in unison and plunged into the void one after another, disappearing as if they were controlled by someone.
Ye Yun stood in the void, his face calm, gently lowering the sword in his hand. With that sword strike, he had planted two marks: one in one of the Sleeping Dragon Coffins, and the other on the Dragon Raiser himself. At this moment, dark red blood dripped from Ye Yun’s sword tip. He had indeed struck the Dragon Raiser with that last thrust, successfully implanting the mark.
As the Dragon Raiser fled, the dark clouds in the sky scattered, and the heavens and earth became clear once more.
Ye Yun carefully sensed the astonishing spatial fluctuations surging throughout the Daluo Region. A confident smile emerged on his face.
Now, it was time to let out the long line and catch the big fish.
He also wanted to see where exactly the Dragon Raiser would flee to in the end.
A red shadow flashed. Liu Yiyi, who had been observing the battle from the void, flew to Ye Yun’s side.
"Brother Yun, how did the Dragon Raiser escape?" Liu Yiyi asked anxiously.
Ye Yun nodded, explaining to Liu Yiyi about the marks he had planted.
"Oh, so that’s how it is!" Liu Yiyi immediately broke into a smile.
She had to admit, Brother Yun was really impressive. His sword had moved so fast, yet he was able to plant two marks at the same time.
"Yiyi, come, follow me... Let’s see where the Dragon Raiser’s den is."
Ye Yun smiled and took Liu Yiyi’s delicate hand, then tore open the void and followed, unhurried.
He mustn’t move too fast.
Otherwise, with Ye Yun’s current strength, he could rip through space and reach the Dragon Raiser’s side in an instant.
"Yiyi, watching this battle between me and the Dragon Raiser, did you gain anything?" As Ye Yun casually tore open the void, he asked with a smile.
"Brother Yun, I gained a lot. I’ve gained a new layer of understanding regarding the myriad transformations of the Binary Sword Chant," Liu Yiyi said with a smile.
Witnessing the supreme duel between the two mighty ones in the God-honored realm brought unimaginable benefits to the advancement of her Sword Dao.
Ye Yun nodded. Liu Yiyi’s Sword Dao Talent was not bad. If she were to begin learning this Binary Sword Chant, her progress should be swift. However, to reach his level would require a long period of arduous cultivation. After all, not everyone possessed Ye Yun’s heaven-defying aptitude.
「Now, about the Dragon Raiser.」
He had been pierced in the lower back by Ye Yun’s sword. Blood streamed from his wound. As he fled, blood continuously dripped from the void. He dared not stop for a moment, terrified that the fearsome Sword Cultivator behind him would suddenly catch up. So, along the way, he desperately consumed his Essence Blood, continuously tearing open the void and fleeing frantically towards a certain direction.
Meanwhile, his Seven Sleeping Dragon Coffins had swiftly returned, surrounding him and vigilantly guarding against any threats.
I’m so unlucky! I originally thought I might discover some Super Divine Dragon. I didn’t find a Super Divine Dragon, but instead, I encountered a monstrous Sword Cultivator!
At this moment, the Dragon Raiser was desperately complaining in his heart. The continuous consumption of Essence Blood for escape would be a huge impediment to his future cultivation progress. It was equivalent to invisibly depleting nearly a thousand years of his cultivation base.
But he had no other choice. He had to rush back immediately in order to save his life.
The Dragon Raiser continuously tore open the void, heading west. After crossing a hundred million miles, when he saw a vast expanse of dense black fog crawling on the land before him, a look of joyous surprise appeared on his face.
He had finally reached "home". In this place, he no longer feared that terrifying Sword Cultivator. Because here, he had six other clan members. Each of these other six was stronger than him. The combined combat strength of the seven of them was terrifyingly formidable. Moreover, the seven of them could form the Seven-star formation, and its power was even more unbelievably immense.
Upon reaching the vicinity of the black fog, he stopped tearing open the void. Instead, he suddenly summoned a Covert Dragon Coffin, enclosed himself within it, and abruptly dived in.
The black Covert Dragon Coffin, like a black aquatic dragon, constantly shifted left and right within the fog, rapidly flying towards a certain direction.
BOOM! BOOM!
Faintly, colossal sounds like a tsunami emanated from the depths of the fog. Following that, massive chains began to resound with a loud CLANG! RATTLE! CLATTER! This made the entire fog-shrouded region seem exceptionally eerie.
Deep within this black fog lay a vast, circular abyss. The tremendous impact sounds and the clanking of chains originated from this circular abyss.
At this moment, at six distinct positions above the abyss, a black Covert Dragon Coffin floated. Each Covert Dragon Coffin, continuously rising and falling, exuded a powerful Divine Sovereign Realm Super Divine Dragon Breath.
The Dragon Raiser’s coffin abruptly broke through the black fog, flew to a specific position above the abyss, and then became still.
"Seventh Brother, did you gain anything from your hasty journey?" a hoarse voice came from a black Covert Dragon Coffin.
"Elder Brother, I didn’t find the so-called Super Divine Dragon at the Jianyun Sect. However, I encountered a Sword Cultivator from an outer domain. He is exceedingly formidable; I am no match for him," the Dragon Raiser, addressed as Seventh Brother, gritted his teeth and clutched the wound on his back as he spoke.
"What? Seventh Brother, you’re injured?"
"In this Daluo Region, how could there be someone capable of injuring you?"
"Despicable! Someone actually dared to attack us Dragon Raisers! Does he no longer wish to live?"
"Seventh Brother, is that Sword Cultivator still in the Daluo Region? I will go and kill him right now!"
The other six black Covert Dragon Coffins began to vibrate, all radiating a towering rage.

chapters.title: Chapter 425: Black Sky Burial Ground, The Great Clanking of Chains
chapters.content:
Chapter 425: Chapter 425: Black Sky Burial Ground, The Great Clanking of Chains
"Brothers, that mysterious Sword Cultivator from outside the realm, his swordsmanship is extraordinary, truly formidable. I’ve never witnessed such powerful and terrifying sword skills in my entire life."
The Dragon Raiser known as Seventh Brother, lying within his coffin, had a flicker of terror in his eyes.
Even now, the mere thought of Ye Yun made his entire body shudder uncontrollably.
Back then, he had been on the verge of being killed by a single sword strike from that man.
"Such a powerful Sword Cultivator... could he be from the Sword Pavilion?" a dull voice queried.
"Impossible. It can’t be the Sword Pavilion. They wouldn’t dare lay a hand on our Dragon Raiser Lineage, not unless they’ve all gone mad," another, older voice remarked.
"Boss, regardless of anything else, Seventh Brother has been injured this time. We must find a way to avenge him," yet another voice chimed in, filled with righteous indignation.
"We cannot leave this place for now."
Within another Covert Dragon Coffin, a black-robed elder spoke with a solemn expression, "As the Seven Supreme Gods, we guard this abyss. We absolutely cannot all depart from this place simultaneously."
"What’s the harm in leaving just once, Boss? That thing in the abyss has been suppressed for so many years and has no chance of escape. How could the seal jointly placed by three Divine Kings be broken so easily?" another voice said, unconcerned.
"Indeed, Boss! While guarding the abyss, we also need to use containers to gather the physical energy of that creature within it. The last container is almost ready now," a different voice added.
After speaking, as if still not quite satisfied, his black Covert Dragon Coffin trembled slightly, and a black ray of light shot down into the abyss.
A coffin was seen rising from the black fog, levitating above the abyss.
This was a black Covert Dragon Coffin, identical to theirs, only the Super Divine Dragon Breath it emanated was significantly weaker.
"Very well. Once this container is complete, we will then seek out that Sword Cultivator for revenge," the elderly man considered for a moment before nodding.
"Haha, Boss, you’ve finally agreed! It hasn’t been easy. We’ve been guarding this place for nearly one hundred thousand years. It’s been far too long..." the Dragon Raisers in the other Covert Dragon Coffins began to voice their complaints.
"Alright, that’s enough. Everyone, quickly help Seventh Brother heal," the Dragon Raiser known as "Boss" in one of the Seven Sleeping Dragon Coffins said hurriedly, his brow furrowed.
"Understood!"
The other Dragon Raisers agreed in unison. Six black Covert Dragon Coffins simultaneously emitted beams of light, pouring them into the seventh Covert Dragon Coffin.
Receiving this surging influx of energy, the injuries of the Dragon Raiser called Seventh Brother began to heal rapidly.
The black Covert Dragon Coffin hovering above the abyss slowly descended again, vanishing into the endless black fog.
CLANG! CLANG!
From the depths of the abyss echoed the loud clang of chains, as if some great beast was moving within.
But the seven black Sleeping Dragon Coffins seemed oblivious to it.
The black mist churned, and a giant black claw flashed out from the mist, trying to claw its way free.
But immediately, countless runes flickered on the cliff face above the abyss. They lit up with a layer of silver light that descended, forcefully pressing down the black, scale-covered claw.
BOOM! BOOM!
Violent impacts resounded from the depths of the abyss, shaking the very earth.
Yet the Seven Sleeping Dragon Coffins remained still, floating calmly within the black mist, apparently long accustomed to such occurrences.
This time, I should be able to locate their lair, right?
Sensing that the Dragon Raiser had lingered in a specific location for some time, a smile of excitement touched Ye Yun’s lips.
This time, he intended to infiltrate the Dragon Raisers’ main lair and uncover the secrets of the container.
Taking Liu Yiyi’s hand, Ye Yun tore through the void and vanished.
「The next moment.」
The pair emerged from the void near a vast land enveloped by black fog.
"Where are we?"
Scanning the area ahead, Ye Yun realized his Divine Sense couldn’t penetrate very far. The black fog, brimming with a strange energy, acted as a significant barrier, hindering and absorbing his Divine Sense.
Looking around, Ye Yun noted that the black fog shrouded the vast land endlessly, making it impossible to gauge its true extent.
"Brother Yun, who would have thought this is the Black Sky Burial Ground... The Dragon Raisers’ lair is actually hidden in this place!" Liu Yiyi gazed at the limitless black fog before them, her expression one of shock as she exclaimed.
"The Black Sky Burial Ground? What’s that?" Ye Yun raised an eyebrow, asking softly.
Gazing at the black fog with fear in her eyes, Liu Yiyi whispered, "Brother Yun, the Black Sky Burial Ground is the most mysterious place in the Daluo Region. It’s renowned in the Divine Land and considered a Forbidden Area for Gods. Spiritual cultivators are forbidden from entering; any who dare to do so usually perish..."
"Is it really that terrifying?" Ye Yun’s eyes widened slightly as he looked at the Black Sky Burial Ground once more.
The Dragon Raisers are truly cunning, hiding their lair in such a place. No wonder no one could enter.
Perhaps it wasn’t just the black fog that was lethal; the real danger... came from the Dragon Raisers themselves.
"Come on, let’s go in and take a look," Ye Yun said with a smile, taking Liu Yiyi’s hand as they flew into the black fog.
A divine glow burst from Ye Yun’s body, enveloping Liu Yiyi. The black fog immediately recoiled wherever it encountered this radiance.
Ye Yun reached out and grabbed a handful of the black fog. As he silently examined it, he was surprised to discover that the fog was saturated with a dark, deathly aura.
If an average True God Realm Cultivator were to be assailed by this deathly aura, they would likely perish within a short time.
Only cultivators at the Divine Monarch Realm could linger here for up to half a day.
Cultivators of the Divine Sovereign Realm could remain for even longer.
"Yiyi, you’ve been in the Daluo Region for so long. Have you never visited the Black Sky Burial Ground before?" Ye Yun asked with a smile, looking around leisurely.
Liu Yiyi’s face flushed slightly as she whispered, "Brother Yun, I only caught a glimpse from the periphery. After sensing how terrifying the black fog was, I never dared to venture further in."
Ye Yun nodded upon hearing her explanation.
Liu Yiyi continued, "Brother Yun, no one knows what strange entity the Black Sky Burial Ground has sealed. However, people often report hearing tremendous sounds emanating from deep within."
"It actually sealed something?" Ye Yun asked, taken aback.
"It could be an ancient Ferocious Beast, or an evil Demon God... You can often hear the sound of rattling chains," Liu Yiyi explained in a low voice, looking around as if searching for that very sound.
Just then, deep within the fog, the loud RATTLE! RATTLE! of chains being dragged echoed once more.
Ye Yun’s expression changed slightly.
The sound was faint, yet still discernible.
A massive creature seemed to be shackled by chains.
Could it be a dragon?
Such a guess immediately sprang to Ye Yun’s mind.
Given that the Dragon Raisers specialized in dealing with the Dragon Clan, it would make sense if they had sealed a Divine Dragon.
However, this idea seemed a bit far-fetched.
The Dragon Raisers were extremely powerful, rumored to have Divine King Realm powerhouses among them. Why would they seal a Divine Dragon rather than subdue it?
Given their bizarre and formidable methods, even subduing a Divine King Realm Divine Dragon probably wouldn’t pose much of a challenge to them.

chapters.title: Chapter 426: A Container from Cangnan Continent
chapters.content:
Chapter 426: Chapter 426: A Container from Cangnan Continent
BOOM!
BOOM!
The sound of the chains disappeared, followed by a huge impact, even more violent than the sound of the chains. To Ye Yun’s ears, it already sounded like an explosion.
An interested expression appeared on Ye Yun’s face.
It seemed that this trip to the Black Sky Burial Ground wouldn’t disappoint him.
"Brother Yun, should we continue going in?"
Hearing the terrifying sound, like continuous thunderous explosions rolling out from within, Liu Yiyi turned somewhat pale and asked shakily.
Though she held a prominent reputation throughout the entire Daluo Region and was revered as the Sword Sovereign, in the grand Divine Land, she wasn’t exceptional. The title of Sword Sovereign was just that—a title. Liu Yiyi also harbored some fear. Therefore, the mysterious and terrifying sounds continuously emanating from the Black Sky Burial Ground, touted as the Forbidden Area for Gods, left her feeling extremely uneasy. After all, the unknown often cultivates a greater sense of terror.
"You have nothing to worry about, Yiyi. As long as I’m here, there’s nothing to fear," Ye Yun said with a slight smile, gently rubbing Liu Yiyi’s soft and delicate hand, and continued flying forward.
The Dragon Raiser still stood immobile at that spot, indicating that it was the Dragon Raiser’s true lair.
After flying for a while and identifying the source of the loud sounds within the mist, Ye Yun was amazed to discover that the Dragon Raiser’s lair and the origin of the sound were, astonishingly, in the same location.
Interesting.
There must be some kind of earth-shattering secret concealed in this Dragon Raiser’s lair.
This piqued Ye Yun’s interest. He held Liu Yiyi’s hand and swiftly flew into the black fog.
「Near the Abyss.」
The remaining six Dragon Raisers were healing one of their Clan Members, nicknamed Seventh Brother, when suddenly their chief, an elderly man dressed in black, furrowed his brow as if he sensed something unusual.
"Have any of you noticed something within Seventh Brother?" the chief asked, frowning.
"It does seem like something is there. Let me take a closer look," a voice replied.
After the voice finished speaking, a Seven-star formation suddenly emerged from the Covert Dragon Coffin it occupied. The Seven Stars flickered lightly, condensing a silver ray of light that abruptly fell into the Covert Dragon Coffin where Seventh Brother lay.
After scanning for a while, a voice suddenly exclaimed, "It’s terrifying! There’s a mark at Seventh Brother’s wound that’s incredibly concealed. Could it be from that Sword Cultivator?"
"Although that Sword Cultivator is also in the Divine Sovereign Realm, he isn’t qualified to enter the Black Sky Burial Ground..." The chief’s face darkened, and he abruptly announced, "First, erase this mark!"
"Yes!"
A dazzling silver light fell into the Covert Dragon Coffin. The mark deep within Seventh Brother’s wound was quickly annihilated.
"Chief, why didn’t we leave the mark and lure that Sword Cultivator here?" Seventh Brother asked.
"Our mission is priority. We can’t afford to take any additional risks right now," the chief said cautiously.
The Dragon Raiser in each of the other Covert Dragon Coffins silently nodded in agreement.
Their tasks were twofold: to guard the Abyss and to operate the receptacle to absorb energy from the body of the entity within the Abyss. Both tasks were important, and neither had been completed. It would be best to avoid any mishaps.
"What?"
The chief’s expression suddenly changed—he could sense a human presence.
He immediately used his Divine Sense to scan the surroundings and promptly noticed a graceful young man in white leading a charmingly beautiful maiden in red. They had already arrived within a hundred miles of the Abyss.
"Seventh Brother, quickly look to the southwest. Is that the Sword Cultivator?" the chief said quickly.
Despite his injuries, Seventh Brother hastily released his Divine Sense for a swift scan and was immediately startled.
"Boss, it’s that Mysterious Sword Cultivator! The woman in red next to him is the Sword Sovereign from the Jianyun Sect," he hurriedly reported in a grave tone.
"That Sword Sovereign is merely at the Half-step Divine Sovereign Realm and not a threat. However, this Mysterious Sword Cultivator in the Divine Sovereign Realm is somewhat unfathomable..." The chief gazed intently into the distance, a fierce light glinting in his eyes.
If this foreign Sword Cultivator dares to come to the Black Sky Burial Ground, then he shouldn’t blame us for being impolite.
A great secret was concealed here; anyone who had approached in the past was brutally killed by them. As a result, no one dared to enter the Black Sky Burial Ground any longer. A True God with a low cultivation base would die instantly upon entering. Even those in the Divine Monarch Realm wouldn’t last long. And Cultivators in the Divine Sovereign Realm, once they entered, would be annihilated by them.
The Daluo Region, where they were located, rarely had Divine Sovereign Realm Cultivators. So, over the years, they had lived rather peacefully, allowing their second task to progress smoothly. Several receptacles had already been successfully prepared.
"Boss, since this Sword Cultivator is so arrogant, we might as well kill him here," a voice said, cold and arrogant.
"Exactly, that’s my plan!" The chief nodded with a stern face, increased his Mana output, and commanded, "Let’s give Seventh Brother another push—help him recover as much as possible."
"Yes!" everyone answered in unison.
The radiance emitted by the seven black Covert Dragon Coffins suddenly intensified, and Seventh Brother’s injuries began healing rapidly.
The moment the Dragon Raiser’s chief noticed Ye Yun, Ye Yun also detected their presence. The distance of a hundred miles was effortlessly reachable for him.
Clutching Liu Yiyi’s hand, he floated in the black fog, looking around and scrutinizing everything carefully.
Ahead was a massive black Abyss, its entrance resembling the terrifying, vast mouth of a Ferocious Beast. Black fog filled it, obscuring its true depth from view. The fog’s barrier against Divine Sense here was even stronger than the black fog outside.
Seven familiar black Covert Dragon Coffins floated at different points around the Abyss. Six of them were emitting a black energy towards another coffin.
Ye Yun understood; they were healing the injured one.
"Brother Yun, who would have thought there would be seven Dragon Raisers here? They’re stationed around this Abyss. Could they be guards?" Liu Yiyi whispered after observing for a moment.
"Maybe. These reclusive types seldom do anything good," Ye Yun grunted.
WHOOSH! WHOOSH...
A commotion suddenly erupted from the depths of the Abyss. It sounded like a gargantuan beast dragging enormous chains as it moved within.
Ye Yun ignored the seven black Covert Dragon Coffins and cast his gaze deep into the Abyss. He boosted his Divine Sense as much as possible, scrutinizing what lay below.
One black Covert Dragon Coffin floated erratically in the black fog, bobbing up and down.
Another Dragon Raiser?
Seeing this Covert Dragon Coffin, Ye Yun furrowed his brow, a thought striking him. He promptly concentrated his Divine Sense into a needle-like point, brutally piercing the restrictions on the coffin’s surface and penetrating it.
HISS!
When he clearly saw the face of a middle-aged man inside... Ye Yun gasped.
This person wasn’t a Dragon Raiser at all, but a vessel from the Cangnan Continent.

chapters.title: Chapter 427: Red Tassel Battle Armor, Divine Level Top Quality
chapters.content:
Chapter 427: Chapter 427: Red Tassel Battle Armor, Divine Level Top Quality
The middle-aged man inside the Covert Dragon Coffin currently had his eyes closed, seemingly in a deep slumber.
His cultivation base was at the Life and Death Realm.
Such a cultivation base was considered quite high on the Cangnan Continent.
However, here in the Divine Land, it was pathetically low.
Nevertheless, the physical body of this middle-aged man was extremely powerful.
Even with just a fleeting glimpse, Ye Yun could not help but be greatly shocked. His physical body had surpassed that of an ordinary Divine Dragon and was on par with the physical body of a high-level Divine Dragon.
Ye Yun’s eyes flickered. In an instant, he saw streams of energy seeping in from the bottom of the coffin, which were then absorbed by the middle-aged man’s body.
These streams of energy were pitch-black, almost identical in color to the mist in the Abyss.
The vessel from the Cangnan Continent had already developed an extremely tough body after absorbing the Dragon Qi from the earth’s veins. Why did it need to continue absorbing after arriving here in the Divine Land?
Ye Yun frowned slightly, momentarily unable to comprehend.
This black energy could actually strengthen the vessel’s physical body.
Then, what exactly is this black energy?
Could it be the energy from that creature sealed in the Abyss?
For a moment, many guesses flashed through Ye Yun’s mind.
He felt grateful that he had made the right wager this time. Following the Dragon Raiser to the Black Sky Burial Ground, he had discovered this astounding secret.
Ye Yun withdrew his strand of Divine Sense from the Covert Dragon Coffin and continued to project it deeper into the black mist.
He also wanted to see what kind of monster was sealed inside the Abyss.
Is it a ferocious beast from the Ancient Era?
Or is it a sinister Demon God?
Although Ye Yun’s Primordial Spirit was formidable, the black mist in the Abyss was also remarkably powerful in its ability to devour and obstruct his Primordial Spirit.
As he continued to probe deeper, his Divine Sense became increasingly weak.
CLANG!
CLANG!
The sound of massive chains echoed from the Abyss again.
Ye Yun continuously intensified his Divine Sense, trying to see deeper into the Abyss.
The black mist churned.
A gigantic, black, scale-covered claw suddenly reached out from within, as if it were about to grab onto the cliff wall above the Abyss. It seemed the massive body beneath would then use the claw’s grip to break free.
This is...
Ye Yun’s Divine Sense registered the black, scaled claw, and his expression immediately turned grave.
At a glance, he recognized that the black, scaled claw, in all likelihood, belonged to a Divine Dragon.
Could it be that a Divine Dragon is actually sealed here?
Ye Yun mused to himself.
However, if this Divine Dragon was able to move deep within the Abyss, why couldn’t it emit a dragon’s roar?
WHOOSH!
The enormous black claw passed through Ye Yun’s Divine Sense and reached for the exit of the Abyss.
Just as it reached the exit of the Abyss, countless runes flickered on the cliff wall above. They emanated a layer of silvery light that cascaded down like a tide, forcefully suppressing the black, scaled claw.
The moment the silver light descended, Ye Yun’s Divine Sense was abruptly severed.
BOOM!
BOOM!
Sounds of extremely furious collisions came from the depths of the Abyss, causing the entire ground to shake again.
Ye Yun’s expression turned somewhat grim.
The terrifying suppressive power from the seals just now was indeed extremely strong. To date, he had never seen a seal this powerful.
This could absolutely not have been set up by Divine Sovereign Realm Dragon Raisers.
At the very least, it would have to be at the Divine King Realm.
With that thought, Ye Yun understood.
The seven Dragon Raisers before him were merely chess pieces guarding the seal.
This place wasn’t even the Dragon Raisers’ main lair.
It could only be considered a small outpost.
At this moment, Ye Yun was a hundred miles away from the Abyss, with Liu Yiyi standing by his side.
He was worried that she might get hurt in the ensuing battle.
A thought crossed Ye Yun’s mind. He fumbled with his wrist for a moment, and suddenly, a red light swirled around his hand. He handed this bright red light to Liu Yiyi and said with a smile, "Yiyi, this suit of armor is for you."
This...
Liu Yiyi’s eyes widened instantly.
She was shocked to see a bundle of red light swirling in Ye Yun’s hand. Within the red light was a bright red suit of armor, emitting waves of powerful Super Divine Dragon Breath.
This Super Divine Dragon Breath was mysterious and ancient. Numerous mysterious runes adorned the armor, giving it an exceptionally powerful impression.
Liu Yiyi recognized it at first glance—it was a suit of God-level Armor.
And its quality was not low.
At this, Ye Yun smiled and said, "This is a suit of God-level Armor called the Red Tassel Battle Armor... Yiyi, refine it and wear it for now. This way, the black mist in the Black Sky Burial Ground will have less of an effect on you."
"Brother Yun, isn’t this armor too precious?"
Liu Yiyi’s face flushed with excitement, and her delicate body began to tremble.
Brother Yun didn’t even have a piece of armor on himself, yet he was giving this God-level armor to her.
How could she bring herself to accept it?
"I don’t need armor; you keep it."
Seeing Liu Yiyi’s hesitant expression, Ye Yun chuckled. "This was originally a suit of armor designed for women; it wouldn’t suit me anyway. Quickly put it on. Let me see how it looks."
"Really? Brother Yun, this is actually a suit of women’s armor?"
Excited, Liu Yiyi immediately reached out and took the Red Tassel Battle Armor, which was swirling with red light.
She channeled a surge of Mana and began to refine the armor.
As a Half-step Divine Venerate Realm powerhouse, her initial refining of this God-level armor was very swift.
In just a few breaths, she could integrate the armor into her body or instantly wear it on its surface.
With a thought from Liu Yiyi, the Red Tassel Battle Armor immediately disappeared from her hand and adorned her body.
Since the armor was designed specifically for women, it accentuated Liu Yiyi’s devilishly captivating figure, making her exceptionally alluring and charming.
A suit of brilliant red battle armor, noble and mysterious, adorned her, glowing with a captivating red luster. Every line and pattern on the Red Tassel Battle Armor was permeated with an ancient aura, hinting at the extraordinary origin of this suit.
"Truly beautiful!"
Ye Yun’s eyes lit up as he looked at the alluring Liu Yiyi, and he couldn’t help but exclaim in admiration.
This women’s armor was tight-fitting.
Although it also covered her entire face, leaving only Liu Yiyi’s limpid, beautiful eyes exposed, it perfectly accentuated her devilish figure, revealing its exquisite contours.
It was a sight that would make anyone involuntarily drool.
Looking at Liu Yiyi, for some reason, Ye Yun was reminded of his other beloved confidantes. He had many suits of God-level women’s armor in his warehouse. If all those confidantes were still alive, Ye Yun would want to give each of them a suit.
"Brother Yun, this armor is truly beautiful! It lives up to its name, the Red Tassel Battle Armor... Is its quality at least Superior God level?"
Liu Yiyi gazed at the mysterious red glow and touched her own impressive figure. Her heart swelled with excitement, and her voice trembled with emotion.
"You are my girlfriend. I wouldn’t present something merely Superior God level, as that wouldn’t be fitting. This one is Divine Level Top Quality," Ye Yun said with a smile, his hands behind his back.
Divine Level Top Quality?
When Liu Yiyi heard these words, she felt her head spin.
Initially, she had presumed it to be Superior God level, and even that was a high guess.
After all, possessing God-level armor in the Divine Land was extremely rare.
God-level armor was categorized into Inferior, Medium grade, Superior, and Top Quality tiers.
Superior God-level armor was already extremely rare.
Only legendary figures might possess such an item.
As for Divine Level Top Quality, Liu Yiyi had never even heard of such a thing.

chapters.title: Chapter 428: This Sword Cultivator has Great Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 428: Chapter 428: This Sword Cultivator has Great Power
Liu Yiyi was incredibly excited.
She now owned a Divine-level Top-Gear Armor!
Once she refined this armor, her combat power would catch up to the First Level of the Divine Sovereign Realm!
Even a Cultivator from the First Level of the Divine Sovereign Realm would not be a match for her.
The defensive power of this Divine Level Top Quality armor was astoundingly strong. Even in the preliminary stage of refining, Liu Yiyi could feel the mighty defensive power emanating from the Mysterious Runes densely covering the armor’s surface.
"Brother Yun, how did you get this kind of God-level Armor for women?"
Wrapped in a tremendous feeling of happiness, Liu Yiyi seemed to remember something and couldn’t help blushing as she asked.
Ye Yun paused slightly, then responded without blushing or his heart skipping a beat, "One hundred thousand years of Cultivation is too monotonous. Remembering you like to wear red, I decided to make an armor."
"Brother Yun, you’ve changed so much during these 100,000 years. I didn’t expect you to be able to craft this kind of God-level armor."
Liu Yiyi, her face filled with frenzied enthusiasm, stared intently at Ye Yun and said.
Brother Yun was extraordinarily gifted. He could overpower all Cultivators at the Eternal Realm while he was still in the Cangnan Continent.
All Cultivation Techniques and Divine Skills were basically learned straight away.
But back then, she had not seen Ye Yun specialize in Artifact Refining. So, in Liu Yiyi’s heart, Ye Yun was simply incapable of Artifact Refining.
Who would have thought that during these 100,000 years, Ye Yun would also learn Artifact Refining and had even crafted a Divine Level Top Quality armor.
This was truly unbelievable! She simply couldn’t imagine how Ye Yun had achieved this, and what kind of enormous price he had paid...
"Brother Yun, why didn’t you craft one for yourself?"
Liu Yiyi suddenly asked curiously.
"The materials required to craft a set of God-level armor are consumed at an astonishing rate. After crafting two sets, I didn’t continue."
Embarrassment flashed in Ye Yun’s eyes, and then he explained with a smile.
How was he supposed to explain to Liu Yiyi about him checking in for 100,000 years? Something like this simply couldn’t be explained. He also couldn’t say that in his storehouse, God-level armors had already piled up like a mountain, cheaper than cabbages on the street. Ye Yun didn’t intend to tell anyone these things. After all, it was too shocking. It was better for some people to live innocently in their own world. This silly girl Liu Yiyi was easy to fool; a few casual words would be enough to placate her.
"Brother Yun, I will collect some materials in the future. You should try and craft one for yourself then."
Liu Yiyi stated determinedly.
"Alright, it’s rare for you to be so thoughtful, Yiyi."
Ye Yun smiled again with embarrassment.
He didn’t expect this little girl Liu Yiyi to be so persistent, even thinking about collecting materials for him to craft a God-level armor.
He, as an Ancestral Dragon Body, didn’t need any armor at all. Of course, sometimes, to avoid exposing his identity, wearing an armor isn’t a big deal.
"Yiyi, wait here for me. I’m going to meet those Dragon Raisers."
Ye Yun lightly patted Liu Yiyi’s shoulder, instructed her, and then immediately disappeared.
"Brother Yun, be careful."
Liu Yiyi answered worriedly.
Due to Ye Yun’s absence, the white glow vanished, and the black fog immediately surged in.
Liu Yiyi injected Mana into the armor. Immediately, a glow arose from the surface of the Red Tassel Battle Armor, keeping the black fog at bay.
"This Red Tassel Battle Armor is really strong."
Seeing the horrific black fog that was unable to advance any further, Liu Yiyi let out a sigh of relief.
At this time, Ye Yun had already reached above the Abyss.
He floated within the fog, his body emanating light, causing all the fog to retreat far away.
"You guys, hiding here, what are you really after?"
Ye Yun’s gaze shifted. He didn’t attack immediately but decided to ask first.
Without a doubt, these Dragon Raisers were mere pawns, and their memories were certainly under a restriction. If he tried to read their memories, they would immediately explode. Therefore, while the other six Dragon Raisers were healing their injured companion, Ye Yun decided to probe them, hoping to glean some information.
"You, a Sword Cultivator from outside our territory, certainly have great courage to dare venture into the forbidden areas of the Black Sky Burial Ground. Haven’t you considered you might lose your life here?"
A cold voice suddenly issued from a black Covert Dragon Coffin.
"I haven’t considered that..."
Ye Yun leisurely drew his Silver Sword, pointed it at the black Covert Dragon Coffin, and said indifferently, "With my Sword, I can go anywhere under the heavens."
"What audacity!"
A roar came from another black Covert Dragon Coffin.
"Boss, let’s postpone healing Seventh Brother. Let’s kill this youngster first," that voice said.
"You six kill him! I’ll go snatch that God-level armor from the Sword Sovereign!" the leader of the Dragon Raisers commanded. He then drove his Covert Dragon Coffin, speeding towards Liu Yiyi in the distance.
"Trying to escape?"
Ye Yun sneered and instantly vanished.
His speed was so fast that the other six Covert Dragon Coffins didn’t even have time to react.
A flash of silver light.
Ye Yun’s Sword instantly lashed out towards the Covert Dragon Coffin threading through the black fog.
BANG!
The sword light struck the Covert Dragon Coffin, producing a deafening crash.
That black Covert Dragon Coffin could no longer advance and was forced back towards the Abyss.
"This Sword Cultivator’s strength is immense!"
Feeling the violent vibrations from the Covert Dragon Coffin, the leader’s expression changed drastically, a wave of terror surging through his heart.
Among the seven Dragon Raisers, he had the highest cultivation base.
He had already reached the peak of the Second Layer of the Divine Sovereign Realm.
He was only half a step away from the Third Layer of the Divine Sovereign Realm.
Yet, even when fully controlling the Covert Dragon Coffin, he was still knocked back by a single sword strike from that Mysterious Sword Cultivator.
This showed just how terrifying that sword light was.
"Set up the Formation!"
As the black Covert Dragon Coffin returned above the Abyss, a furious roar came from within.
The other six Covert Dragon Coffins immediately soared into the sky above the Abyss, arranging themselves into the shape of the Big Dipper.
Streaks of black light descended, and the seven Dragon Raisers emerged from their Covert Dragon Coffins.
The Seven Sleeping Dragon Coffins floated above their heads.
Seeing these seven form the Seven Star Coffin Formation, Ye Yun inwardly nodded in approval.
This Formation seemed to be only in its initial stage. However, its power was more than ten times greater than a Seven Star Coffin Formation set up by a single person.
A cold smile touched Ye Yun’s lips as he slowly brought his Silver Sword before his chest, a provocative glint in his eyes.
"Come on. Let me see what you guys are capable of," he said calmly.
"Boss, his swordsmanship is extremely powerful! Back then, even when I used all my strength, I couldn’t break through it!" Seventh Brother, recognizing Ye Yun’s familiar swordsmanship, quickly formed hand seals and warned.
"Can our Seven-star formation, set up by us seven Divine Sovereigns, not break through this mere Sword technique of his?" the leader retorted, shaking his head with a cold sneer.
He refused to believe that this foreign Sword Cultivator, only at the First Layer of the Divine Sovereign Realm, could be so powerful. After all, Seventh Brother was the weakest among their clan members. Now that all seven of them, Divine Sovereigns, had joined forces to set up the Formation, could they be stopped by a single sword technique? Impossible! In the Divine Land, even a supreme prodigy from the Sword Pavilion couldn’t possibly block them with just one Sword technique.
One hundred miles away, Liu Yiyi watched this battle anxiously.
She knew that once again, Brother Yun was providing her with an opportunity to watch and learn. To use the Binary Sword Chant against seven Dragon Raisers of the Divine Sovereign Realm... this was definitely going to be an unimaginably world-shaking showdown!

chapters.title: Chapter 429: The Second Layer Change of the Seven Star Coffin Formation
chapters.content:
Chapter 429: Chapter 429: The Second Layer Change of the Seven Star Coffin Formation
Ye Yun’s expression remained indifferent, his body erect, his longsword held horizontally against his chest. The general power of heaven and earth was contained within this one sword of his. Binary Sword Chant, Sword of Life Realm—nothing in the world could break it.
"Kill this brat."
A Dragon Raiser finally couldn’t stand Ye Yun’s nonchalant demeanor any longer.
To act so indifferently in front of them, seven Dragon Raisers of the Divine Sovereign Realm, was a blatant insult.
"Kill him!"
The leader roared, mana surging wildly into his Hand Seal. The black Covert Dragon Coffin above their heads began to hum and tremble.
"Kill!"
The other six roared in unison.
As the seven simultaneously changed their Hand Seals, the seven Covert Dragon Coffins instantly unleashed seven immense black light beams, piercing through the distance.
Each light beam was tens of feet wide, its power astonishing, like a light of annihilation, radiating a terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath.
Ye Yun nodded slightly.
Each black light beam was comparable to the strongest attack previously launched by that one Dragon Raiser.
Now there were seven light beams, and due to the differing cultivation bases of the seven men, the power of each beam progressively increased.
Ye Yun remained unmoved.
Liu Yiyi, watching from a distance, held her breath, her palms sweating.
These are seven experts at the Divine Sovereign Realm, and among them, a full five Dragon Raisers are at the Second Layer of God Respect Realm...
I hope Brother Yun... isn’t harmed...
Liu Yiyi felt anxious. She silently prayed and drew her sword, ready to support Ye Yun if the situation turned dire.
WHOOSH!
Seven menacing black light beams rushed straight at him, arriving before the Silver Sword in an instant.
A strange force guided these seven light beams into the empty space within thirty feet of the Silver Sword.
At a speed visible to the naked eye, the seven light beams bizarrely vanished.
"What?"
"How can this swordsmanship be so powerful? It actually withstood the combined attack of all seven of us?"
One Dragon Raiser’s eyes widened in disbelief as he stared at the scene.
"I told you, this kid’s sword skill is extremely strange. His style seems capable of deflecting all attacks," Seventh Brother said in a low voice, his eyes filled with deep apprehension.
"Is there truly an unbreakable shield in this world? If it cannot be broken, it only means the spear is not sharp enough," the leader stated indifferently, completely unfazed.
In his mind, Ye Yun’s swordsmanship merely utilized some powerful Divine Skill to divert their attacks into another dimension. Although this swordsmanship was miraculous, it had its flaws. Once the attacks reached a saturation point, exceeding the capacity of the swordsmanship, the technique would collapse. And naturally, the swordsman would perish along with it.
Thinking this, six black rays of light shot from his Hand Seal, and instantly, the other six Covert Dragon Coffins appeared above his head.
Seeing this, the other six men immediately summoned their respective six Covert Dragon Coffins.
Thus, seven black Covert Dragon Coffins now floated above each Dragon Raiser’s head.
This was the second-level transformation of the Seven Star Coffin Formation.
It was equivalent to increasing the original attack strength by several dozen times.
They had once used this attack to annihilate a cultivator at the God Venerate Realm Fifth Layer.
At the Divine Sovereign Realm, the disparity between each layer was enormous.
A cultivator at the Third Layer of God-Honored Realm could handle at least ten cultivators at the Second Layer of God Respect Realm.
Yet, these seven Dragon Raisers, by utilizing the second-level transformation of the Seven Star Coffin Formation, had hunted down a cultivator at the God Venerate Realm Fifth Layer. One could only imagine the formation’s terrifying power.
It was only natural that the seven Dragon Raisers guarding the Abyss of the Black Sky Burial Ground possessed such formidable backup measures. The peace that the Black Sky Burial Ground had enjoyed for so many years was largely due to their efforts.
"You seven have been guarding this Abyss for quite some years. You should know what’s hidden down there, right?" Ye Yun’s eyes flashed as he began to probe once more.
"You’re at death’s door and still trying to pry information from us? How ridiculous," one Dragon Raiser said with a loud laugh.
"The Seal of the Abyss is not something your God Venerable Realm level can touch!" another Dragon Raiser sneered.
After speaking, he flipped his Hand Seal again, mana surging forth. The seven Covert Dragon Coffins above his head immediately began to vibrate.
"This time, we strike to kill!" the leader of the Dragon Raisers snarled, gritting his teeth fiercely.
With their attack power now amplified dozens of times, even an expert at the God Venerate Realm Fifth Layer would fall before the might of this formation.
He refused to believe that this Sword Cultivator, merely at the First Layer of the God Sovereign Realm, could withstand it with that single sword technique.
As long as they kill this Sword Cultivator, the Sword Sovereign in the distance won’t escape. That armor... will ultimately be mine.
That red God-level armor had caught his eye the moment it appeared.
Just moments ago, he had been observing Ye Yun and Liu Yiyi from afar, overhearing their conversation.
Learning that it was a piece of Divine-level Top-Gear Armor, a tempest raged in his heart. Such Divine-level Top-Gear Armor was exceedingly rare, even in the Divine Land. If he were to present it to his superiors, he would likely receive an unimaginably bountiful reward. As far as he knew, one of the higher-ups was female. This Red Tassel Battle Armor would be perfect for her.
These thoughts flashed through his mind in an instant. Following his earlier shout, the seven Dragon Raisers launched their second wave of attacks.
The forty-nine black Covert Dragon Coffins now unleashed a total of forty-nine colossal black light columns.
Each light column was immense.
The forty-nine light columns blotted out the sky, completely enveloping the area within a hundred miles.
Compared to Ye Yun’s diminutive figure, these massive light columns were simply beyond comparison.
WHOOSH!
Forty-nine black light columns whistled through the air, cascading down from above like toppling mountains and a raging tsunami.
The black mist of the Black Sky Burial Ground, upon encountering these black light columns, was entirely swept away within a hundred-mile radius.
Ye Yun’s expression was calm, as steady as Mount Tai.
The Silver Sword remained quietly positioned horizontally before his chest.
"Brother Yun!"
Witnessing this cataclysmic attack, Liu Yiyi could no longer contain herself. With a shout, she prepared to rush over and provide support.
Suddenly, a familiar, gentle male voice reached her ear, "Yiyi, just wait there. No matter what happens, do not come over."
"Alright, Brother Yun!"
Liu Yiyi’s body halted in mid-air. She let out a slow breath, her heart relaxing considerably.
Brother Yun has this under control. These seven Dragon Raisers are no match for him.
WHOOSH! WHOOSH!
The overwhelming black light columns descended from all directions, yet they were still drawn by a mysterious, immense force, beginning to converge from different directions.
At this moment, it seemed as if multiple apparitions of Ye Yun had materialized, each facing a different direction. The uncanny power emanating from the Silver Sword absorbed all the black light columns from every direction.
"He absorbed them again? What in the world is this swordsmanship?"
The seven Dragon Raisers’ eyes nearly popped out of their sockets as they stared in utter disbelief at the terrifying scene unfolding before them.
Could this swordsmanship have actually touched upon some kind of fundamental law?
BANG!
BANG!
Just then, tremendous impact sounds once again echoed from the depths of the Abyss.
A massive black claw, wreathed in black mist, was once again attempting to break through the Seal.
The runes on the rock walls above the Abyss flared, forming a silver radiance that descended once more.
Ordinarily, this black giant claw would have been suppressed.
But for some unknown reason, this time, a black, ring-shaped light flickered in the palm of the black claw.
BANG!
The black giant claw slammed violently against the silver tide of light, forcefully shattering it.
The mist roiled.
THUMP!
The black giant claw paused in mid-air for a moment, then suddenly shot upwards, its talons tearing viciously into the rock wall above the Abyss.
At that instant, the silver runes also shattered.

chapters.title: Chapter 430
chapters.content:
Chapter 430: 430
"Is this ferocious beast about to break free from its shackles?" Ye Yun’s brow twitched as he cast his gaze towards the Abyss.
He also wanted to see. What exactly was this beast—is it a dragon? Or something else? The being suppressed here by the Dragon Raisers was certainly no ordinary entity. Having been suppressed for many years, it surprisingly still has a chance to break free. One can only imagine how terrifying its strength is.
Part of the Silver Runes had shattered, causing a sudden decrease in the power of the Seal. The seven Dragon Raisers were startled by this sight, scarcely believing their eyes. They had guarded the Abyss for many years, and the Seal had never broken before. If it were to break, even if all seven Dragon Raisers joined forces, they would be no match for that creature.
"Seal!" The Boss of the Dragon Raisers suddenly raised his hand. A brilliant silver light shot out from it, landing above the rock face. It was a silver sphere. Its surface was covered with various mystical patterns, emitting an enigmatic silver light that cascaded down like a river of stars. This silver light landed on the runes, and miraculously, the shattered sections were mended.
WHOOSH!
A vast expanse of runes once again unleashed a tidal wave of silver light, surging towards the black giant claw in an attempt to drive it from the rock face.
BANG!
The silver light fiercely collided with the black giant claw, resulting in a deafening explosion. The black giant claw, clearly in pain, recoiled swiftly, detaching itself rapidly from the rock face.
At this time, the runes surrounding the rock face blazed, silver light rising steadily to form yet another tidal wave of an attack. The Black Ring in the palm of the black giant claw began to glow intensely, emitting a terrifying black light. Under the support of this terrifying black light, the black giant claw seemed to regain infinite strength. With a powerful swipe, it shattered the tidal wave of silver light once more.
RUMBLE!
After the tide-like silver light was crushed, countless silver droplets scattered in all directions.
"What?! How can it be so powerful?"
"What exactly is that Black Ring in the giant claw?"
The seven Dragon Raisers were aghast, finding it hard to believe.
This was the Seal created by the combined efforts of three Divine Kings. If that creature could break this Seal, what could its cultivation base have been in its past life?
"Seal it!" The Boss of the Dragon Raisers issued another command.
The other six Dragon Raisers immediately understood. On the surface of each of their seven Sleeping Dragon Coffins, a silver Seven-star formation materialized.
FIZZ...
Streams of silver light, like a deluge of silver arrows, poured down upon the Silver Runes. The runes, augmented by the silver light, grew stronger. Meanwhile, the mysterious silver sphere continued to emit silver light, which streamed downwards, seemingly reinforcing the runes on the rock face.
Seeing the seven Dragon Raisers frantically busy and apparently ignoring his presence, Ye Yun’s lips curled into a cold smirk.
"I’m asking you all, are you going to fight or not?"
"Your Excellency, we have no grievances or enmity. Must we fight to the death?" The Boss of the Dragon Raisers turned, his eyes narrowed as he spoke grimly.
The White Clad Sword Cultivator before them was proving to be formidable. At this critical moment of reinforcing the Seal, they truly did not wish to engage him. If, by some chance, that creature escaped the Seal, the enormity of their crime would be immeasurable. The judgment from their superiors—for the seven of them, the outcome would undoubtedly be death.
"No grievances? Weren’t you just trying to steal the Red Tassel Battle Armor?" Ye Yun responded with a cold laugh, a look of mockery in his eyes.
Upon hearing this, the Boss of the Dragon Raisers’ expression turned awkward.
"Boss, there’s no need to hide anymore! Let’s use our strongest attack now and kill him!" one of the Dragon Raisers beside him arrogantly declared.
"Very well!" The Boss of the Dragon Raisers gritted his teeth, his decision made.
It’s better to deal with a sharp pain now than a lingering one. Only by eliminating the immediate threat before them could they focus on maintaining the Seal in peace.
Just as he thought of this, BOOM!
The black giant claw collided with the tide of silver light once again, producing an earth-shattering rumble. The silver tide dissipated. It seemed this strike still failed to repel the black giant claw. The black giant claw fiercely lunged for the runes on the rock wall. It seemed to realize that only by destroying these runes could it have any real chance of escaping.
"Kill!"
The seven Dragon Raisers, their minds linked, simultaneously changed their hand seals. Instantly, the Seven-star formation on the surface of each black Sleeping Dragon Coffin began to emit silver light.
「In the distant starry sky.」
The exceedingly bright Seven Stars of the Big Dipper suddenly blazed into view, casting down streams of silver radiance that merged with the Seven-star formations, becoming one. With the empowerment from the Seven Stars in the cosmos, the power of the Seven-star formations became even more terrifying. Then, each black Sleeping Dragon Coffin unleashed an immense pillar of black and silver light. These pillars, filled with an unimaginable destructive aura, smashed towards the small figure in the distance.
"Interesting," Ye Yun remained calm, remarking nonchalantly.
If this barrage were to strike the ground, it would likely blast countless abysses into this Black Sky Burial Ground.
In the distance, Liu Yiyi clutched her sword tightly, her gaze fixed nervously on the scene.
Although she believed Brother Yun could defeat the seven Dragon Raisers before her, the current onslaught was terrifyingly powerful, far surpassing her understanding of what constituted ’strong.’
WHOOSH!
Forty-nine immense pillars of black and silver light descended. In an instant, multiple illusory phantoms of Ye Yun’s body flickered into existence. They guided the pillars of black and silver light, which assaulted from various angles, towards the front of his Silver Sword.
What happened next was unbelievable. The terrifying attack vanished, inch by painstaking inch. In merely two or three breaths, all traces of the terrifying attack disappeared completely, without so much as causing a ripple.
Witnessing this, the seven Dragon Raisers shuddered, an icy chill gripping them as if they had been plunged into a frozen cavern. The shock in their hearts soared to unimaginable heights.
This swordsmanship was too terrifying! Such a formidable attack, dealt with so easily! What kind of swordsmanship was this? Perhaps... even the experts of the Sword Pavilion had never witnessed such formidable swordsmanship!
BOOM!
The black giant claw and the silver light collided violently once more. The black giant claw shattered the silver light, drawing dangerously close to the Silver Runes on the surrounding rock face.
The faces of the seven Dragon Raisers turned ashen.
This was truly a case of a wolf at the front door and a tiger at the back. They were already unable to defeat that terrifying Sword Cultivator, and now, the horrifying creature sealed in the Abyss also seemed to have the means to break the Seal.
"My turn," Ye Yun smiled faintly, a change coming over the sword in his hand. From life, it transitioned to death. The Sword of Death Realm.
SWISH!
A silver gleam of sword light slashed through the boundless darkness. Like a swift bolt of lightning, it shot straight towards the Seven Star Coffin Formation.

chapters.title: Chapter 431: The Last Madness of the Dragon Raiser
chapters.content:
Chapter 431: Chapter 431: The Last Madness of the Dragon Raiser
Ye Yun first needed to break the Seven Star Coffin Formation of the Dragon Raisers, cutting off all their hopes.
This sword strike was the Sword of Death Realm. Nothing in the world could block it. Naturally, the Seven Star Grand Array formed by these forty-nine Covert Dragon Coffins could not stop it either.
"What? Is he actually attacking us?"
Several Dragon Raisers were instantly terrified, feeling a wave of horror wash over them.
This Sword Cultivator can actually withstand such a powerful attack from us. His own offensive swordsmanship must be extremely terrifying!
"Boss, attack him quickly!"
Seeing the familiar sword radiance, Seventh Brother cried out in panic.
He would never forget that the seven holes on his Seven Covert Dragon Coffins had been pierced by a single sword strike. This terrifying Sword Cultivator not only pierced the Seven Covert Dragon Coffins with one strike but also injured his lower back. He was almost cut in two. If he hadn’t escaped quickly, he would have been a corpse by now. So even now, he remained terrified; every time he saw this sword radiance, he felt the threat of death.
Hearing Seventh Brother’s reminder, the other Dragon Raisers were startled and quickly formed hand seals. The Covert Dragon Coffins floating above their heads launched streams of black and silver light as attacks.
However, this time, the black and silver pillars of light were not as strong as before. After all, they had just launched such a powerful attack earlier, and the energy drain was immense; it was impossible for them to launch a similarly powerful second attack consecutively.
BOOM! BOOM!
A series of silver-white pillars of light descended towards the silver sword radiance, only to be violently shattered by it.
What kind of swordsmanship is this? How can it be so strong?
As the strongest among the seven Dragon Raisers, the Boss’s eyes bulged, shot with blood, as he stared in disbelief at the rapidly approaching sword radiance. At this moment, even he, the strongest, could not muster the slightest thought of resistance. It was as if he was resigned to death.
The other six Dragon Raisers felt the same way at this moment. It seemed that no matter how they defended, they could not destroy that sword light and could only await their deaths.
As the sword radiance drew near, the seven Dragon Raisers were astonished to discover that it was not targeting their bodies, but the Seven Star Coffin Formation above their heads.
BOOM!
Ye Yun’s heaven-shattering sword radiance struck the Seven Star Coffin Formation, producing a world-shakingly loud explosion.
The Seven Star Coffin Formation instantly crumbled.
Every black Covert Dragon Coffin struck by the Sword of Death Realm developed huge cracks on its surface. It seemed that with just one more casual strike, these forty-nine Covert Dragon Coffins would completely shatter.
Ye Yun still held back... These Dragon Raisers were not mere puppets; it was not time to kill them yet.
SPURT! SPURT!
The seven Dragon Raisers, their minds severely shaken, all spat out blood simultaneously. These Covert Dragon Coffins were their bonded life-items. Now that their life-items were heavily damaged, they too suffered severe injuries.
"Where did this Sword Cultivator come from? He’s so strong, the seven of us combined are no match for him..."
One Dragon Raiser, his face a picture of despair, swayed unsteadily before collapsing to his knees. He lay prone on the ground, continuously vomiting large mouthfuls of blood. The shattering of his bonded life-item was a fatal injury for him.
"Boss, our guarding mission has failed. We have no face to meet the esteemed sirs anymore," a Dragon Raiser said, his face pale after spitting out blood.
"Alas, yes..." the Boss of the Dragon Raisers sighed.
At this moment, his Dao Heart crumbled. He finally admitted that the terrifying Sword Cultivator possessed the strength to hunt down and kill all seven of them.
BOOM!
At the entrance of the Abyss, after the black monstrous claw swatted away the silver radiance, it shockingly seized the Silver Runes. The Silver Runes trembled, their light flickering erratically, as if they were about to shatter at any moment. The Mysterious Silver Orb hovering in mid-air continued to pour down streams of galaxy-like light into the runes, continually stabilizing the Seal.
Seeing this, a ruthless glint flashed in the Boss of the Dragon Raisers’ eyes. He gritted his teeth, made a beckoning gesture with his large hand, and the Mysterious Silver Orb in mid-air instantly returned to his grasp.
Ye Yun was taken aback by the old man’s mysterious move.
Could it be that this Mysterious Silver Orb has another trick up its sleeve? Could it contain an attack from a God King Expert?
Just as Ye Yun was speculating, a Dragon Raiser cried out, his face filled with horror as he frantically waved his arms, "Boss, what are you doing?"
"What am I doing? The mission has already failed! Either way, we’re dead. We might as well release that thing!" The Boss of the Dragon Raisers revealed a sinister smile and violently spat out a mouthful of blood.
"Boss, if that thing breaks free, all of us will die!" another Dragon Raiser cried out.
"Then let’s all die together, including this Sword Cultivator! Haha!" The Boss of the Dragon Raisers gritted his teeth, laughing viciously, his expression utterly crazed.
BOOM!
The black giant claw struck the Silver Runes. The black halo in its palm once again blazed with light, imbuing the claw with boundless power.
WHOOSH!
The black giant claw rose once more, and then fiercely slammed down again.
Aside from their leader, the remaining six Dragon Raisers stared blankly at this scene. They had never imagined that after guarding this place for nearly one hundred thousand years, they would end up personally releasing the entity they had sealed.
What an irony!
However, at this point, they had no other choice.
That White Clad Sword Cultivator is truly too terrifying. Even if we give it our all, we are no match for him. Now, our only hope is that this terrifying entity can defeat and kill that White Clad Sword Cultivator. That way, even if we die, we can die without regrets.
These fellows... their intentions are punishable by death. However, it’s merely something to scoff at!
Hearing the words of these Dragon Raisers, Ye Yun’s expression remained calm, as if he paid no heed to the present danger. He was more focused on the secrets held within the Dragon Raisers’ hearts.
"Since you’re about to die anyway, why not tell me some secrets?" Ye Yun hovered in mid-air, looking down at the seven Dragon Raisers and spoke lightly.
"What secrets do you want to know?" the Boss of the Dragon Raisers’ complexion turned cold as he asked through gritted teeth.
"Who are you exactly?" Ye Yun asked.
"There’s no harm in telling you this. We belong to the Dragon Raiser Lineage," the Boss of the Dragon Raisers said.
Seeing that these fellows seemed to be loosening their tongues before death, Ye Yun was inwardly pleased, though his expression remained impassive.
Ye Yun casually swung the sword in his hand and said, "Then how come I’ve never encountered Dragon Raisers who hide in coffins?"
"That’s due to the world’s ignorance. Our Dragon Raiser Lineage has four major inheritances, and we belong to the Coffin Raising Lineage!" the Boss of the Dragon Raisers puffed out his chest and declared with an air of arrogance.
"I see," Ye Yun nodded in apparent comprehension, then asked, "Then those Dragon Raisers on the Divine Land, which lineage do they belong to?"
"They belong to the Dragon Candle Branch," the Boss of the Dragon Raisers responded almost instantly. However, after speaking, he seemed to feel it was inappropriate, as if he had divulged too many secrets. He suddenly clenched his fists, waved his hand, and roared angrily, "Do it! Even if you kill us first, you’ll also be killed by that terrifying entity! The entire Daluo Region, not a single living being will survive!"
Seeing the old man clam up again after just loosening his tongue, Ye Yun sighed inwardly.
Extracting information is truly not easy.
"What exactly is the entity sealed in the Abyss? Is it a Ferocious Beast, or a Divine Dragon?" Ye Yun pressed on, not giving up, and asked his final question.

chapters.title: Chapter 432: Super Divine Dragon, Dark Heavenly Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 432: Chapter 432: Super Divine Dragon, Dark Heavenly Dragon
"Hahaha..."
Upon hearing Ye Yun’s question, the seven Dragon Raisers burst into wild laughter.
Especially The Boss of the Dragon Raisers, who laughed so hard he threw himself back and forth, his behavior exaggerated.
Ye Yun furrowed his brows.
Was there something wrong with what he had said?
Upon further thinking, Ye Yun found nothing inappropriate.
Could it be... because he mentioned the Divine Dragon? These Dragon Raisers, who spent their entire lives dealing with dragons, would surely not seal a Divine Dragon?
"Had enough laughter?"
Ye Yun lightly touched the ground with his sword, and a powerful suppressive force swept over them. The Dragon Raisers found it hard to breathe; their existing injuries worsened, and they vomited blood.
They finally stopped laughing.
The Boss of the Dragon Raisers looked up at Ye Yun with piercing eyes. A hint of scorn flashed in his eyes, and he sneered, "Neither of the things you said are correct. As for what it is? You’ll know sooner or later. Don’t hesitate now, just make it quick for us."
They were both incorrect?
Ye Yun was stunned for a moment, his eyes revealing a thoughtful light.
Could this giant claw belong to an evil Demon God? This was also a possibility.
BANG!
The black giant claw from the Abyss ruthlessly hit the Silver Runes. Numerous runes began to shatter and could no longer gather the silver suppressive light.
WHOOSH!
The giant black claw was raised high, and the Black Ring in its palm exuded a dazzling black light, amassing an unimaginable vast power. With a deafening boom, it once again struck the Silver Runes.
RUMBLING...
Much of the Silver Runes were completely shattered.
The Seal, which had been suppressing for countless tens of thousands of years, was finally broken.
Once the runes were shattered, they could no longer form a seal.
Thus, it could no longer be obstructed.
After breaking through all the seals, the giant black claw suddenly retracted, disappearing back into the black fog.
And then there was silence.
Ye Yun frowned slightly.
Was this creature dealing with the chains on its foot?
Just as he had this thought, he suddenly heard the clanging sound of chains deep in the Abyss. The black fog then broke open, and a huge black claw shot out.
With no seals to impede it this time, the black claw soared high into Yun Xiao.
Only after shooting a hundred zhang into the sky did it halt abruptly in mid-air.
Ye Yun, looking at the strange scene before him, was stunned.
High in the sky.
A black claw, reaching towards the sky.
The claw was fixed in mid-air, and there was no massive body behind it.
Just a giant black claw.
A very thick black chain, its surface densely covered with various runes, was tightly locking the back of the black claw.
The two were inseparable.
The black chain was extremely long, extending all the way into the Abyss, as if it reached the very bottom of the Abyss.
HISS!
Seeing this scene, Ye Yun took in a sharp breath.
He finally understood why the seven Dragon Raisers suddenly burst out laughing.
It was not because they sealed a Divine Dragon.
Instead, it was because the black claw they sealed was the claw of a Divine Dragon.
The terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath emanating from this black claw was frightening and had already far surpassed the aura of the Divine Sovereign Realm.
It had reached the Divine King Realm.
"Could this... be the claw of a Super Divine Dragon?"
Ye Yun’s heart skipped a beat; his deep gaze suddenly fluctuated.
In the Ancient Era, there were ten Super Divine Dragons below the Ancestor Dragon.
Each Super Divine Dragon had noble blood, with a cultivation base in the high-level Divine King Realm.
They had unparalleled strength, and each possessed distinctive Innate Divine Abilities.
If the Spirits of the Divine Land wanted to conquer the Dragon Hidden Continent, these Ten Super Divine Dragons would be a hurdle they could not overcome.
Unexpectedly, things changed later on.
The Ancestor Dragon mysteriously disappeared, and the Ten Super Divine Dragons had internal strife. The Spirits from the Divine Land seized the opportunity and emerged victorious amidst chaos, exterminating the powerful Dragon Clan.
Ye Yun squinted his eyes, carefully examining the black claw.
This black claw was covered in black scales. Between the scales, a thick black fog remained, releasing a strong deathly aura.
Ye Yun sighed.
Too much time had passed; none of the tissues of this black dragon claw remained alive. It had become something akin to an Undead creature.
CRASH!
After its initial unsuccessful attempt to break free from the black chains, the gigantic black claw flipped over and plunged back into the Abyss.
Before it could fully descend, it rushed out of the Abyss once again.
The Black Ring in the palm of the black dragon claw had become very faint at this moment.
It seemed like it could no longer supply it with abundant power.
BOOM!
Accompanied by a loud noise at the bottom of the Abyss, the black dragon claw surprisingly broke free from the chains binding it underground. Dragging the chains, it flew at high speed into the air.
Ye Yun nodded quietly.
The chains had weakened after the Seal of the Abyss was broken, allowing the black dragon claw to break free.
"Hahaha... It has finally broken free! Dark Heavenly Dragon! You just escaped from the Seal, so weak... hurry up and devour all the creatures of Black Sky Burial Ground!"
The Boss of the Dragon Raisers held his hands up towards the sky, his expression wild, and he began to shout with every ounce of his strength.
"Dark Heavenly Dragon, hurry up and devour us!"
The other Dragon Raisers had also turned frenzied at this moment.
They knew they would die today, so they decided to take Ye Yun down with them no matter what.
No matter how strong this Mysterious Sword Cultivator from beyond their realm was, how could he possibly compete with the black dragon claw that possessed the strength of the Divine King Realm? With one claw, all would be reduced to ashes.
Upon hearing the frenzied words of the Dragon Raisers, Ye Yun’s expression also became agitated.
He had certain suspicions all along... Now, the words of the Dragon Raisers aligned with his suspicions. This gigantic black dragon claw belonged to the Dark Heavenly Dragon, one of the Ten Super Divine Dragons.
