The Dark Heavenly Dragon was the only Dark-element Divine Dragon among the Ten Super Divine Dragons. It controlled the murderous power of darkness; its Divine Skills were mysterious and unpredictable, and its strength unfathomable.
The Dark Heavenly Dragon, even within the Ancient Dragon Clan of the Ancient Era, was an extremely mysterious existence.
It was born, hidden, and fought in darkness, seldom venturing out into the world.
Its nature was cold and ruthless, yet it was known for its patience and low profile. It was one of the Super Divine Dragons that all other Divine Dragons feared the most.
Aside from the Ancestor Dragon, no other Super Divine Dragon could come close to the Dark Heavenly Dragon.
Even regular Divine Dragons had no idea where the Dark Heavenly Dragon and the races under its command lived in the Dragon Hidden Continent.
This was a very mysterious force within the Ancient Dragon Clan.
Ye Yun did not expect that a claw from the Dark Heavenly Dragon would be sealed in the Divine Land for so many tens of thousands of years.
WHUFF! WHUFF!
As though it had heard the Dragon Raisers’ cries, the Dark Heavenly Dragon’s claw in mid-air let out excited whuffing sounds.
Despite the excitement in the sound, when it reached Ye Yun’s ears, an endless melancholy rose in his heart.
The Dark Heavenly Dragon, once one of the illustrious Ten Super Divine Dragons, had been reduced to an Undead creature after millions of years of being sealed. The supreme dignity of the Dragon Clan seemed to have disappeared.
WHOOSH!
After a sequence of excited whuffs, the black dragon claw forcibly descended from mid-air, reaching out towards the seven Dragon Raisers near the Abyss.
It was going to devour the seven Dragon Raisers.
A streak of sword light suddenly appeared out of nowhere, tearing through the air.
BANG!
The silver sword light struck heavily upon the black dragon claw, causing a thunderous crash.
The black dragon claw was repelled by a powerful force.
"These Dragon Raisers serve some purpose to me; you can’t kill them."
Ye Yun said indifferently, pointing his sword towards the black dragon claw in mid-air.
With a sweep of his large hand, the seven Dragon Raisers, along with their Covert Dragon Coffins, were immediately withdrawn by Ye Yun.
GRAAAWL—
The black dragon claw was surprised that someone would thwart it, and it let out an angry sound from mid-air.
Especially after seeing the seven Dragon Raisers being whisked away by the youth in white, the black dragon claw was furious beyond appeasement.
The black dragon claw emitted a terrifying Divine King Realm Super Divine Dragon Breath and attacked again. This time its target was Ye Yun.
Liu Yiyi, who was far away, could feel this powerful Super Divine Dragon Breath. Despite wearing the Red Tassel Battle Armor, she gasped for air; her body seemingly devoid of any strength to move.
"Is this the claw of a Divine King Realm Dragon?"
Liu Yiyi thought in disbelief.
「On the other side.」
Seeing the Dark Heavenly Dragon charge at him again, Ye Yun sheathed his sword. With a flash of cold light in his eyes, he sent forth a punch towards the humongous claw of the Dark Heavenly Dragon.
BOOM!
The entire Black Sky Burial Ground trembled at this moment.
Countless dark mists rolled away from the Black Sky Burial Ground, causing all creatures in the Daluo Region to shiver in fear.
At this moment, Ye Yun demonstrated the terrifying power of the Ancestral Dragon’s Body, sending the claw of the Dark Heavenly Dragon into the air with one punch.
In an instant, it turned into a small black dot in the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 433: Conjecture about the Blood-colored Broken Sword
chapters.content:
Chapter 433: Chapter 433: Conjecture about the Blood-colored Broken Sword
Since his reincarnation, Ye Yun had seldom used the physical strength of the Ancestor Dragon’s Body in combat. However, this time, facing the Dark Heavenly Dragon’s claw, he directly unleashed the terrifying power of the Ancestor Dragon’s Body, sending it flying with a single punch.
This claw had already transformed into an Undead creature, its nature vicious and unruly.
I have to teach it a lesson,
Ye Yun resolved.
His figure flashed, tearing through the void. Appearing in mid-air, he seized the thick iron chain and yanked it forcefully.
CLANG!
The black dragon claw was instantly dragged back.
BOOM!
Ye Yun struck it again, sending it hurtling towards the Abyss.
Against Ye Yun’s immense power, this Dark Heavenly Dragon’s claw, despite possessing Divine Sovereign Realm strength, was utterly outmatched.
CLANG!
Ye Yun yanked the chain again, dragging the black dragon claw back.
WHINE!
Struck twice consecutively, the Dark Dragon Claw was grievously wounded. Black blood oozed from its scales. It roared and lunged at Ye Yun once more.
BOOM!
Ye Yun’s fist shot out, sending the Dark Heavenly Dragon’s claw flying yet again. Gripping the chain with one hand, he delivered a barrage of punches with the other, leaving the Dark Dragon Claw severely wounded.
Despite its injuries, the Dark Dragon Claw remained fiercely defiant, seemingly determined to fight to its last breath as long as it lived.
Ye Yun frowned.
This thing is truly hard to deal with,
he mused.
With that, he pointed a finger and uttered a low command, "Immobilize!"
The potent Divine Skill, the Mind Restraint Technique, instantly froze the Dark Dragon Claw in mid-air. Unable to move, the Dark Dragon Claw could only emit pained whimpers.
Ye Yun shook his head and sighed.
This was once the claw of a Dark Heavenly Dragon, one of the Ten Super Divine Dragons. To think it would be reduced to such a state after being sealed for millions of years.
I wonder... is the main body of the Dark Heavenly Dragon still alive?
At that moment, Ye Yun activated his Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye. Within his pupils, innumerable tiny, star-like runes pulsed with the rhythm of creation and destruction as he attempted to read the Dark Dragon Claw’s memories.
With no wards or restrictions present, Ye Yun easily accessed its memories. A vast panorama unfolded before him.
A Black Giant Dragon, many times larger than mountain ranges, roared towards the heavens, its furious cries echoing as it battled terrifying Spirits who were barely clinging to life.
The battle was so cataclysmic that the sky turned grim and the sun and moon vanished; it was an exceptionally brutal conflict.
That Black Giant Dragon was none other than the Dark Heavenly Dragon, one of the Ten Super Divine Dragons. It was single-handedly battling three formidable experts at the Divine King Realm.
Although not at a disadvantage, it failed to gain any significant upper hand. The battle reached a tense stalemate.
Suddenly, one of the Divine Kings produced a treasure box. From within, he drew a Scarlet Broken Sword and slashed viciously at the Dark Heavenly Dragon.
A streak of blood-red light tore through the night sky. The Dark Heavenly Dragon, unable to dodge, had one of its claws brutally severed.
The Dark Heavenly Dragon, its claw severed, let out an agonized roar. From the stump of its limb, a layer of bizarre, crimson fur suddenly sprouted.
The memory abruptly ended there. Beyond this, Ye Yun found nothing more within the Dark Dragon Claw.
That Scarlet Broken Sword...
Ye Yun’s expression grew grave. In that fleeting glimpse moments ago, he had noticed three scarlet eyes upon the sword’s blade.
These three scarlet eyes were exceptionally eerie; however, they remained closed, not yet open.
Ye Yun had an odd premonition:
If the blood-red eyes on this broken sword were to open, something unimaginable would likely occur.
Ye Yun turned, his gaze directed towards The Tenth Sea Region. At that instant, the scene he had witnessed on Moon Star replayed in his mind.
He had once beheld a phantasmal image of the Ancestor Dragon. At that time, the Ancestor Dragon had mentioned that a broken sword lay sealed on Moon Star.
Could that be... the Scarlet Broken Sword from the Dark Dragon Claw’s memories?
After all, when that broken sword had struck the Dark Heavenly Dragon, a layer of brightly colored, unsettling crimson fur had sprouted from the wound.
This thought weighed heavily on Ye Yun’s heart.
The Dark Heavenly Dragon had to suppress that bizarre energy while simultaneously contending with three Divine Kings. Its chances of survival must have been slim.
Ye Yun shook his head, banishing the distracting thoughts, his focus returning to the Dark Dragon Claw. Even gravely injured, the claw showed no signs of submission; its defiance was unmistakable.
With a mental command, Ye Yun tugged the chain, pulling the Dark Dragon Claw into his Divine Pet Warehouse. Immediately thereafter, a wisp of his Primordial Spirit also entered the space.
"Eh? What’s this?" The moment the Dark Dragon Claw entered the dark expanse of the warehouse, it caught the attention of several Divine Pets.
"It’s a claw! Did Master lop it off?" one Divine Pet chirped with a laugh.
"Wow, this big black claw is incredibly powerful! Its cultivation base is certainly not low," another Divine Pet exclaimed in astonishment.
With a flicker of his form, Ye Yun materialized before the Dark Dragon Claw. His appearance instantly caused a stir throughout the Divine Pet Warehouse.
"Master, you haven’t visited in ages!"
"Master, have you forgotten all about us?"
"We’re practically dying of boredom in here..."
"Master, please, can you take us out too?"
Within the dark expanse, terrifying gazes lit up one by one, and colossal figures began to stir.
"I’ve been rather busy lately, so I haven’t had the time to come by," Ye Yun explained with a smile, looking at these endearing yet formidable Divine Pets.
"Master, what’s the point of bringing this claw in here? Is it for us to eat?" a massive shadow with bright, glittering eyes rumbled.
Ye Yun chuckled. "No, this isn’t for you to eat. I mainly wanted to find a place where it could settle down and be quiet."
"Master, just leave it to me! I promise I’ll take excellent care of it!" one Divine Pet immediately volunteered.
Ye Yun shook his head. Surveying his surroundings, he mused aloud, "I seem to recall we have some Undead-type Divine Pets in the warehouse. Where are they now?"
"Ah, so Master is looking for those half-dead creatures? We herded them to the very back. We even sectioned off an area for them to stay put," one Divine Pet explained with a chuckle.
"Why herd them so far away?" Ye Yun inquired with a smile.
"Those things stink to high heaven! We absolutely had to drive them far off so their stench wouldn’t bother us."
"Precisely! We gave them their own designated zone. They’re all crammed in there together, so they only have to endure each other’s deathly odor, HAHA!"
The Divine Pets chattered excitedly, each vying to be heard. Listening to them, Ye Yun felt rather speechless.
Still, he found it acceptable. The Divine Pets in his warehouse varied greatly in level and strength, so segregating them into different zones wasn’t necessarily a bad idea.
At the very least, they hadn’t killed those Undead-type Divine Pets. It demonstrated that these endearing creatures, for all their boisterousness, still operated with a certain moral baseline.

chapters.title: Chapter 434: Devouring Beast of Shadow Souls
chapters.content:
Chapter 434: Chapter 434: Devouring Beast of Shadow Souls
"Let’s go. Lead the way!" Ye Yun said, smiling at one of the Divine Pets.
"Yes, Master!"
The Divine Pet, quite obedient, shimmered and instantly transformed into a black shadow, flying off into the distance. Ye Yun, dragging the Dark Dragon Claw, followed at a steady pace.
The other Divine Pets yawned one by one and returned to their places, and tranquility was restored. After all, they had little interest in the Undead Divine Pets. Especially since just smelling that Super Divine Dragon Breath made them uncomfortable.
After flying for a while, they quickly reached their destination. The black space was primarily permeated by a layer of white death aura. Amidst the white death aura, there were also patches of black, green, and other colored death auras. Divine Pets of various sizes lay amidst these death auras, seemingly asleep.
Ye Yun glanced around and found, to his surprise, there were over ten thousand of these Undead Divine Pets.
I can’t help but shake my head and laugh bitterly,
he thought.
The Divine Pets accumulated from signing in over one hundred thousand years are simply too numerous. I can barely remember how many Divine Pets I own. I only have a general impression of their numbers.
"Hey, hey! All of you, get up! The Master is here," the leading Divine Pet roared loudly upon reaching the vicinity of the death aura.
This sound reverberated, causing the stagnant death aura to churn violently. At that moment, all the Undead-type Divine Pets opened their eyes. An even more intense death aura erupted from their bodies.
Ye Yun’s nose twitched; the foul stench of the death aura was palpable.
No wonder the other Divine Pets had driven them to this place, allocating them a separate area,
he mused.
"Master, you’ve finally come, esteemed elder!" A massive white Bone Dragon flew over from the distance and prostrated itself at Ye Yun’s feet, appearing to weep uncontrollably.
"Master, you’re here! We’ve finally been able to see you!"
"Yes! Master, we finally get to see you, a living person!"
All the Undead Divine Pets grew agitated, scrambling to fly out from within. A dense crowd of them gathered around, each one both incredibly excited and weeping profusely. These Undead Divine Pets came in all shapes and sizes. Some even carried coffin lids on their backs or had withered trees atop their heads, looking exceedingly strange.
"What’s wrong?" Ye Yun asked with a smile. "Aren’t you happy that I’ve come? Why is everyone crying with such long faces?"
"Master, we Undead Divine Pets have no status at all in this warehouse. We normally don’t dare to go out, so it’s been such a long time since we last saw you," the white Bone Dragon said, its face a mask of sorrow.
"I’ll come more often in the future." Hearing the white Bone Dragon’s lament, Ye Yun seemed to realize something. He took a deep breath and comforted it with a smile.
"Master, can you take us out with you?" the white Bone Dragon asked, lifting its head, its expression pitiable as it looked at Ye Yun with hopeful eyes.
Although it was entirely made of bones and lacked a physical body of flesh, I can still discern a certain expression in its empty eye sockets,
Ye Yun thought.
This feeling is quite peculiar.
"Not yet," Ye Yun said, shaking his head and firmly refusing. "This world is quite fragile. Most of you are at too high a level; you cannot appear."
Many of the Divine Pets in the warehouse were of exceptionally high levels. Moreover, their strength couldn’t be classified using this world’s Cultivation Stages.
Their starting points were different,
Ye Yun considered.
In other words, their life levels were not on the same tier.
"This is the claw of a Dark Heavenly Dragon. It has been under a Seal for several million years and has become an Undead creature. I’ll give it to you." Ye Yun gave a sharp tug on the iron chain in his hand, pulling the Dark Dragon Claw over.
"Goodness, Master! This Dark Heavenly Dragon even had its claw chopped off? Isn’t that a bit too tragic?" the white Bone Dragon exclaimed upon seeing the Dark Dragon Claw.
Ye Yun didn’t answer directly, but said thoughtfully, "Just take good care of it. This little fellow is somewhat rebellious and not in its right mind..."
"Rest assured, Master," the white Bone Dragon said, patting its chest. "I will definitely discipline it properly."
"Master, if the Bone Dragon can’t do it, there’s still us! We have so many Undead Divine Pets; are we afraid we can’t tame one tiny Dragon Claw?" the other Divine Pets chimed in enthusiastically.
Ye Yun chuckled. He suddenly remembered the black Death Qi in the Black Sky Burial Ground.
Leaving it there would be a waste,
he thought.
It would be better to let the Divine Pets here absorb it.
"There’s a lot of Death Qi outside. Who among you has the ability to absorb it all?" Ye Yun asked, looking around.
"Master, I can!"
"Me too!"
The moment he finished speaking, several thousand Divine Pets immediately jumped out. Ye Yun scanned them and found that most were of too high a level to appear outside. He searched carefully and finally selected a peculiar-looking Divine Pet. It was called the Devouring Beast of Shadow Souls. It possessed an incredibly powerful devouring ability and specialized in consuming various types of undead-related energies.
After Ye Yun gave it a few simple instructions, he left the warehouse with the Devouring Beast of Shadow Souls. The other Divine Pets watched them go with envious gazes.
This Devouring Beast of Shadow Souls was round like a ball. However, when it attacked, its entire body would bristle with sharp spikes. These spikes were highly venomous and could be used for both close-quarters combat and as projectiles for ranged attacks.
"Brother Yun?" A red shadow flashed, and Liu Yiyi flew to Ye Yun’s side from a distance. She found Ye Yun staring blankly, seemingly lost in thought, and wondered what was on his mind.
And the enormous black Dragon Claw from before is nowhere to be seen,
she noted.
"Oh, Yiyi, you’re here?" Ye Yun snapped back to reality and smiled at Liu Yiyi.
"Yes..." Liu Yiyi nodded. Before she could speak, she was suddenly amazed to see a black light float up from Ye Yun’s wrist. It transformed in mid-air into a black sphere approximately ten feet in diameter.
At first, I thought it was just a black sphere,
Liu Yiyi mused,
but looking closely, it’s actually a very strange demon beast. I’ve never seen anything like it.
"Master, is this the place?" The Devouring Beast of Shadow Souls floated in mid-air, looking down at the Black Sky Burial Ground. Sensing the dense Death Qi, it showed extreme excitement.
"Yes, this is it!" Ye Yun gave a slight nod.
"Alright!" The Devouring Beast of Shadow Souls shouted excitedly. Its round body suddenly swelled dramatically, instantly growing from its original ten-foot size to one hundred feet.
WHOOSH!
The Devouring Beast of Shadow Souls opened its massive mouth and took a deep breath, inhaling sharply from below. A mystical force seemed to emanate from its mouth, pulling the black, mist-like Death Qi into it like a great river. Its body also began to expand at a rate visible to the naked eye.
One hundred feet, one thousand feet, ten thousand feet...
It only stopped after expanding to a full one hundred thousand feet. At this moment, its colossal figure, vast enough to cover the sky, floated in mid-air—an incredibly terrifying sight.
Within a mere quarter of an hour, all the billowing black fog in the Black Sky Burial Ground had been completely devoured by the Devouring Beast of Shadow Souls.
"`This...?`" Liu Yiyi stared at the scene in utter disbelief.

chapters.title: Chapter 435: God Level Nurturing Spirit Pill
chapters.content:
Chapter 435: Chapter 435: God Level Nurturing Spirit Pill
The Black Sky Burial Ground was so vast, permeated everywhere by that dreadful black fog. Even for her, a cultivator at the Half-step Divine Venerate Realm, the sight of this black fog filled her heart with extreme fear.
But the round, rolling creature before her—a mystical demon beast of unknown species—had absorbed all the black fog from the entire Black Sky Burial Ground within the time it took for an incense stick to burn.
This was truly astounding.
It surpassed Liu Yiyi’s wildest imagination.
She had been in the Divine Land for 100,000 years. She had never heard of any demon beast possessing such terrifying Divine Skills.
"Brother Yun, what kind of demon beast is this?"
Liu Yiyi was exceptionally shocked and thrilled, her voice trembling as she asked.
"This is the Devouring Beast of Shadow Souls," Ye Yun said with a smile.
After speaking, he waved to the Devouring Beast of Shadow Souls hovering in mid-air. "Come down now!"
"Yes, Master!"
The Devouring Beast of Shadow Souls agreed. Its enormous body quivered and began to shrink dramatically.
Visibly, it quickly shrank back to its original size of ten feet.
It looked no different from before.
However, Ye Yun could tell that the Devouring Beast of Shadow Souls seemed somewhat bloated.
After returning, it would probably need some time to digest.
Or it might be robbed by those other Undead Divine Pets and be forced to spit some of it out.
"You did well. There’ll be other opportunities for you to come out again," Ye Yun said encouragingly, patting the round, rolling body of the Devouring Beast of Shadow Souls with a smile.
"Thank you, Master! HEH HEH, I am the first Undead Type Divine Pet to come out."
The Devouring Beast of Shadow Souls excitedly did a roll in mid-air.
Ye Yun smiled and immediately returned it to his storage.
Liu Yiyi was still incredibly shocked.
This was the first time she had ever heard the name Devouring Beast of Shadow Souls.
"Brother Yun, this Devouring Beast of Shadow Souls... where did you get it from?"
Liu Yiyi swallowed hard and asked.
"I once met a senior who gifted it to me," Ye Yun replied calmly.
He believed this reason would certainly convince this naive girl, Liu Yiyi.
Sure enough, Liu Yiyi nodded. A look of realization flashed across her face, and she didn’t pursue the question further.
"Is that a Covert Dragon Coffin?"
Ye Yun’s eyes flashed as he suddenly spotted a black Covert Dragon Coffin lying flat on the ground in the distant Abyss.
The middle-aged man inside this Covert Dragon Coffin was one of the vessels of the Dragon Raisers from the Cangnan Continent.
Now, this man’s physical body had become extremely strong, comparable to a High-level Divine Dragon.
"Yiyi, come with me," Ye Yun said and descended.
Soon, he landed in front of the black Covert Dragon Coffin.
Liu Yiyi also landed beside him at this moment.
"Brother Yun, the one inside this coffin... could it also be a Dragon Raiser?" Liu Yiyi asked curiously.
"No..."
Ye Yun smiled faintly, lifted his hand, and flung the lid of the Covert Dragon Coffin away.
The middle-aged man lay in the coffin with his eyes tightly closed, still in a comatose state.
"His cultivation base... how can it be at the Life and Death Realm?"
Upon sensing the middle-aged man’s cultivation base, Liu Yiyi immediately gasped in surprise.
She hadn’t seen a cultivator in the Life and Death Realm for many years.
In the Daluo Region, True Gods were everywhere; even the weakest cultivators were at the Eternal Realm.
It was rare to see anyone in the Life and Death Realm.
Tiny, star-like runes surfaced in Ye Yun’s enigmatic eyes. The Power of Life and Death enveloped the middle-aged man’s body.
Ye Yun began to read his memories.
It was exactly as he had guessed; this vessel was not bound by any restrictions.
However, Ye Yun did not obtain the information he wanted.
The middle-aged man’s memory only retained experiences from his past life.
These were memories from before he entered the Divine Land, back when he was still on the Cangnan Continent.
This meant that after becoming a vessel, he had fallen into a coma and been teleported to the Divine Land. Then... he must have been dropped into the sky above the Abyss.
He had been constantly absorbing energy from the Dark Heavenly Dragon’s claw, which made his body stronger.
However, the energy of that Dark Dragon Claw was extremely potent; a single vessel could not absorb it completely.
Therefore, Ye Yun guessed... there must be several more vessels. They had probably been cultivated here in the Abyss long ago, only to be moved elsewhere.
The Coffin Raising Lineage is only responsible for creating the vessels. Could it be that the other two lineages of the Dragon Raisers are responsible for handling them?
He pondered it and found it somewhat plausible, but the situation wasn’t clear enough yet, and his confrontation with the Dragon Raisers was still ongoing.
Ye Yun believed that, sooner or later, he would expose all the secrets of the Dragon Raisers one by one.
With a wave of his hand, the coffin lid slid back into place.
Then, he put this Covert Dragon Coffin away as well.
After dealing with all this, Ye Yun specifically took Liu Yiyi deep into the Abyss to investigate. However, after searching, they didn’t find any useful clues.
Thus, Ye Yun tore open the void, left the Black Sky Burial Ground, and returned to the Jianyun Sect.
Ye Yun had only temporarily imprisoned the seven Dragon Raisers.
He hoped he could extract some more useful information from them in the future.
Upon entering the Bamboo Building, Ye Yun took out a bag and handed it to Liu Yiyi with a smile.
"Brother Yun, what is this? Why are you giving me things again?" Liu Yiyi said coyly.
"These are Nurturing Spirit Pills. You can take them during your cultivation to aid your progress," Ye Yun said with a smile.
"They’re Nurturing Spirit Pills?!" Liu Yiyi exclaimed, shocked.
Nurturing Spirit Pills were an extremely precious type of medicinal pill.
Even in the Divine Land, these pills were extremely rare. Consequently, their price was exorbitant, far beyond what ordinary cultivators could afford.
When Liu Yiyi opened the bag and scanned it with her Divine Sense, she was stunned again.
The bag was densely packed with Nurturing Spirit Pills, over ten thousand in total! Moreover, they were all God-level Nurturing Spirit Pills!
The quality of these Nurturing Spirit Pills was very high, superior to the Middle-grade divine Nurturing Spirit Pills Liu Yiyi had previously consumed.
"Brother Yun, are these... all Superior-grade God-level Nurturing Spirit Pills?" Liu Yiyi’s face flushed with excitement as she asked eagerly.
"They are Divine Level Top Quality," Ye Yun replied with a gentle smile, lightly rubbing Liu Yiyi’s head.
Upon hearing Ye Yun’s words, Liu Yiyi was so shocked she froze like a clay statue.
"Divine Level Top Quality! Brother Yun, did you refine these too?" Liu Yiyi asked, looking at Ye Yun with fervent admiration after regaining her composure.
"They were also a gift from that senior," Ye Yun shrugged and said with a smile.
He couldn’t take credit this time; claiming he refined them himself would be too far-fetched. It was better to attribute everything to that mysterious senior.
"Brother Yun, these Nurturing Spirit Pills are too precious. I’ll just take a third. After all, you need them for your cultivation too." Liu Yiyi pushed the bag back towards Ye Yun, her beautiful eyes misting over.
"Don’t worry, I have more, enough for my own cultivation," Ye Yun said with a gentle smile, pushing the bag back to her.
In the end, Liu Yiyi had no choice but to accept them.
「Over the next three months.」
Ye Yun dedicated himself to teaching Liu Yiyi the swordsmanship of the Binary Sword Chant.
Although Liu Yiyi was a Sword Dao genius, after three months, she had only managed to grasp the rudiments of the Binary Sword Chant.
Despite this, her Sword Dao proficiency soared to a level she had previously never dared to imagine.
"That senior brother of yours... why hasn’t he shown up yet?"
One day, after practicing swordsmanship with Liu Yiyi, Ye Yun sheathed his sword and mused aloud.
Liu Yiyi blinked. "Brother Yun, are you talking about Ning Fangzhi?"
"Yes, I suppose it’s him," Ye Yun nodded.
"He probably knows you’re here, Brother Yun, and is too scared to come!" Liu Yiyi chuckled.
"If he doesn’t dare to come, then we’ll go to him!" Ye Yun said coldly, a flicker of killing intent flashing in his eyes.
"Brother Yun, the Divine Land is vast and boundless. Who knows where he could be hiding..." Liu Yiyi sighed.
"Don’t worry, I know his whereabouts. Come with me!" Ye Yun said with a confident smile, suddenly taking one of Liu Yiyi’s delicate hands.

chapters.title: Chapter 436: Cloud Mark Cave, Black Stone Treasury
chapters.content:
Chapter 436: Chapter 436: Cloud Mark Cave, Black Stone Treasury
The Black Water Region was vastly distant from the Daluo Region. It was separated by three or four domains, covering a distance of billions of miles.
This place was rife with miasma and sprawling swamps, a paradise for demon beasts.
Due to its harsh environment teeming with demon beasts, the Black Water Region had become a training ground for cultivators from some influential nearby Sects. Besides the cultivators on Sect training assignments, this place also concealed evil demons and some extremely vicious individuals. The Sect cultivators who came here for training often had to form groups to avoid harassment from these ruthless individuals.
Space fluctuated in a certain part of the Black Water Region, and two figures suddenly appeared.
This Black Water Region is indeed a desolate place.
Ye Yun scanned his surroundings. Marshes and miasma were everywhere, with various demon beasts lurking in the depths. He couldn’t help but shake his head and chuckle.
Liu Yiyi’s eldest martial brother, Ning Fangzhi, was hidden in the Mist Marsh of this Black Water Region. It was the vast, mist-shrouded black swamp area up ahead. Ning Fangzhi’s true self should be located deep inside the Cloud Mark Cave within the Mist Marsh. That clone only possessed vague memories about the location of Cloud Mark Cave, lacking clear details.
According to the clone’s hazy memories, Ning Fangzhi seemed to be engaged in something very important inside the Cloud Mark Cave. Therefore, he had completely neglected this clone. It hadn’t been managed for many years.
Finding a cave world was not a difficult task for Ye Yun.
"Brother Yun, is this the Mist Marsh?" Liu Yiyi gazed at the vast black marshland ahead, a trace of excitement flickering in her eyes.
"Yes, what is it?" Ye Yun asked with a smile.
"Brother Yun, I heard that deep in the Mist Marsh of the Black Water Region, a type of Immortal Nectar Dew grows. If a female cultivator applies this dew to her skin, it will make it incredibly delicate." Liu Yiyi licked her red lips with her pink tongue, her eyes sparkling as she spoke.
"Haha... I thought you were eager to go and challenge Ning Fangzhi. I didn’t expect you to be interested in that Immortal Nectar Dew." Ye Yun scratched his head, somewhat torn between amusement and exasperation.
Liu Yiyi had already cultivated to the Half-step Divine Venerate Realm, yet she was still so devoted to her beauty.
It shows that a woman’s pursuit of beauty lasts a lifetime.
Liu Yiyi’s face flushed, and she said coyly, "Brother Yun, you have no idea how precious this Immortal Nectar Dew is; it’s impossible to buy! For someone like me, who has maintained her appearance to look like she’s in her early twenties, if I apply this Immortal Nectar Dew, I could look at least seventeen or eighteen years younger. Don’t you think I should be thrilled?"
"Find it, we shall! We’ll start looking right now! Since we’re already here, a little extra time won’t matter." Ye Yun laughed heartily, reached out to rub her soft cheek, then took her hand, and they flew deeper into the marsh.
Once they were in the Mist Marsh, there was no longer a need to tear open the void. Although this place was vast, tearing the void would cover too great a distance, making it difficult to find the Cloud Mark Cave and the Immortal Nectar Dew.
Their figures quickly vanished into the white mist.
「Meanwhile.」
Deep within the Cloud Mark Cave, five figures with terrifying auras sat cross-legged in a dilapidated ancient formation. In the center, a black stone pillar stood. This black stone pillar was about ten meters wide and dozens of meters tall, entirely black, its surface densely covered with powerful Sealing Runes. Viewed from above, a black dragon pattern could be seen vividly imprinted on the top surface of the black stone pillar.
These five figures with terrifying auras each possessed a cultivation base at the God Venerable Realm. They had set up a small-scale restriction-breaking formation and were constantly refining the black stone pillar in the center.
At this moment, a young man in black, positioned at one point in the formation, opened his eyes. After glancing at the black stone pillar twice, a flicker of anxiety crossed his eyes, and he closed them again.
His actions, naturally, did not escape the notice of the other four Divine Sovereign Realm experts.
"Fifth Brother, what’s troubling you so much?" an elderly voice asked.
The young man in black opened his eyes again, his expression grave. "One of my clones," he said solemnly, "perished three months ago."
"Who was so audacious as to act against your clone?" the elderly voice asked again.
"I don’t know. This Cloud Mark Cave forms its own Miniature World, which made the connection with my clone very faint. I’m not clear about many of the specifics," the young man in black sighed and explained.
The connection between a clone and its main body isn’t unlimited in distance. The farther the distance, the weaker the connection. Now, he was deep within the Cloud Mark Cave, obstructed by this Miniature World, so his connection to the clone was almost non-existent.
Three months ago, the young man in black had felt his clone suddenly perish, which had filled him with extreme rage. However, the five Divine Sovereign Realm experts had a very important task at hand and couldn’t spare him. He had no choice but to suppress his anger.
He had originally thought the seal on the black stone pillar would be worn down in another month or two. Unexpectedly, a full three months had passed, and the seal on the pillar was still intact.
His heart grew increasingly anxious and restless. He was often on edge, his concentration wavering.
"It is indeed a pity your clone perished. It must have cost you considerable effort. However, the Black Stone Treasury will open soon. I believe there are many fine things inside that will definitely compensate for the loss of your clone," the elderly voice comforted.
"Let’s hope so. Otherwise, this loss will be too great." The young man in black sighed.
"Fifth Brother, you still sound displeased. But don’t forget, the Black Stone Treasury was left by a God King Expert! The treasures inside must be countless and will surely not make our many years of effort a waste," another old man added.
"I understand, Second Brother." The young man in black nodded silently and said no more.
All five of them were Divine Sovereign Realm Loose Cultivators. Thousands of years ago, this band of misfits had become sworn brothers. They then settled down in the harsh environment of the Black Water Region. They dared not go elsewhere because each of them had enemies they couldn’t afford to provoke. Thus, they hid in the Black Water Region, occasionally engaging in robbery and plunder. Their targets were naturally those Sect Disciples who went out for training.
Since accidentally discovering the Cloud Mark Cave 3,000 years ago, the five of them had moved into this Miniature World entirely. To their pleasant surprise, deep inside the Cloud Mark Cave, they had unintentionally activated an ancient formation and discovered this black stone pillar. The black stone pillar was covered with seals, and on the ground nearby, the words "Black Stone Treasury" were engraved.
Through various clues within the Cloud Mark Cave, they deduced this was a Treasure Pavilion left by a God King Expert. Overjoyed, the five of them joined forces to break the seals. This continued for 3,000 years. They broke one seal after another, but the final three, extremely powerful and difficult to breach, remained.
"The Sealing Runes on this Black Stone Treasury’s pillar are truly formidable. Elder Brother, when will that disciple of Skyfire God Honored arrive?" a middle-aged man asked.
"He should be here soon. I believe he is on his way now," the elderly voice replied.
Hearing the old man’s words, a hint of joy appeared on the faces of the other four.
Although one more person meant another to share the spoils, he was at least one of their own and would be arriving late. Once the Black Stone Treasury was opened, he wouldn’t be able to take too many treasures. This was a situation everyone could accept.

chapters.title: Chapter 437: Dragon God Bloodline, Nine-leaf Jade Grass
chapters.content:
Chapter 437: Chapter 437: Dragon God Bloodline, Nine-leaf Jade Grass
"Yiyi, have you been to this Black Water Region before?" After flying for a while, Ye Yun gazed at the distant marsh and suddenly asked.
"No. The Divine Land is vast, with countless territories large and small. Although I could be considered a strong cultivator in the Daluo Region, when it comes to other territories, I’m not as competent. So over the years, I’ve been training diligently in the Jianyun Sect," Liu Yiyi answered seriously.
"Hmm... what you’re doing is good." Ye Yun chuckled and gave his approval.
Living quietly in a corner and cultivating honestly allows one to live longer. If one relied solely on their talent and roamed everywhere, they would easily risk falling into peril. Luckily, Liu Yiyi was wholeheartedly dedicated to the Sword Dao. Aside from cultivating, she never thought about anything else. She had always remained in the Daluo Region, which allowed Ye Yun to encounter her. Otherwise, Ye Yun wouldn’t know if he could ever meet Liu Yiyi again in this lifetime.
BANG, BANG!
From within the distant mist, the sounds of fighting suddenly erupted.
Ye Yun glanced in that direction. Through the white mist, he saw five or six True God Realm cultivators ganging up on a blue-clad youth.
The youth was also a True God Realm cultivator. Surrounded, he was flailing and appeared to be in grave danger amidst his frantic counter-attacks.
Ye Yun’s eyes flashed. He surprisingly sensed the Dragon God Bloodline in this blue-clad youth.
"Let’s go and take a look..." Ye Yun flew straight over.
"Stop struggling! Hand over the demon beast’s inner core now, and I might spare your life!" one of the attackers, a man in his thirties with a ferocious expression, yelled loudly.
"Dream on!" the blue-clad youth roared in anger, unleashing a series of Sword Lights as he engaged them in a fierce battle.
However, being outnumbered, he was no match for the six of them. After only a few exchanges, he was injured.
Just then, an astonishing Super Divine Dragon Breath descended from above.
The cultivators on both sides, who had been fighting, froze, their bodies trembling in fear.
This terrifying Super Divine Dragon Breath was at least at the Divine Monarch Realm.
Ye Yun stood mid-air, looking at the blue-clad youth, and asked with a smile, "Which sect are you from?"
"Senior, I am just a Loose Cultivator," the youth responded with a bitter smile.
Ye Yun nodded slightly, his pupils contracting minutely as he instantly seized the memories from the youth’s mind.
The blue-clad youth was not lying. He truly had no sect.
This young man hailed from a primitive tribe in the Black Water Region. He had entered the Mist Marsh to hunt for demon beast inner cores, which he would then exchange for cultivation resources.
Ye Yun initially planned to take this youth with the Dragon God Bloodline under his wing, but after careful thought, he decided against it. In the Divine Land, the spiritual energy contained Divine Nature; cultivating here would allow one to achieve results with half the effort. In the future, when the Dragon God Sect expanded its branches into the Divine Land, it wouldn’t be too late to recruit these human cultivators possessing the Dragon God Bloodline. Ye Yun wasn’t surprised to find humans with the Dragon God Bloodline in the Divine Land. Perhaps, in very ancient times, before the great wars broke out, there were marital exchanges between the Spirits of the Divine Land and the Dragon Clan of the Dragon Hidden Continent. That was how the bloodline had been passed down.
"Hmm, you can leave now," Ye Yun said to the blue-clad youth with a smile.
"Thank you, Senior, for saving my life!" The youth gave Ye Yun a deep look, as if trying to commit his face to memory. Then, he bowed deeply to Ye Yun, turned, and departed.
"Senior, can we leave as well?" the other few True God Realm cultivators also asked nervously.
"You all may go too. Remember, never lay hands on him again," Ye Yun said indifferently.
"We swear by the Heavenly Dao that we will never touch that guy again!" one man declared, thumping his chest as he immediately swore an oath.
The others quickly followed suit.
Ye Yun nodded. Once they had all sworn their oaths, he allowed them to leave.
To him, killing or not killing a group of True God Realm young monks meant nothing. Besides, Ye Yun currently appeared in the Divine Land with a different appearance, and no one would know his origins.
After that little interlude, Ye Yun and Liu Yiyi continued to fly deeper into the Mist Marsh in search of the Immortal Nectar Dew.
From Liu Yiyi’s description, Ye Yun now had a clear understanding of the so-called Immortal Nectar Dew.
It was a rare Nine-leaf Jade Grass that thrived in damp environments. It absorbed the nature’s spiritual energy of the Mist Marsh and secreted a fresh essence on its leaves. This fresh essence was the extremely precious Immortal Nectar Dew.
A single Nine-leaf Jade Grass had nine leaves, and each leaf could only secrete one drop of Immortal Nectar Dew every thousand years. This highlighted just how rare the Immortal Nectar Dew was.
Therefore, many female cultivators, upon acquiring this dew, would apply it to their faces to transform their appearance, making themselves look younger and more beautiful.
「」
Half a day passed, but Ye Yun and Liu Yiyi found nothing.
Due to their powerful cultivation bases, many demon beasts in the Mist Marsh would sense their Super Divine Dragon Breath and immediately hide far away.
"Brother Yun, perhaps we should give up. The Immortal Nectar Dew is something one stumbles upon, not something sought. Shall we find Ning Fangzhi first?" Liu Yiyi said, her face etched with disappointment at not finding the Immortal Nectar Dew.
"There’s no rush. His true body is hidden in a cave deep within the Mist Marsh. I don’t know its exact coordinates, so we can search for the Immortal Nectar Dew while also looking for the cave’s location," Ye Yun said with a smile.
Why wouldn’t he be happy to kill two birds with one stone? The Cloud Mark Cave wouldn’t move; its entrance was just very well hidden.
After a few more Time Units had passed, the two of them ventured into the deepest, most remote parts of the Mist Marsh.
"Brother Yun, look ahead! That’s the Nine-leaf Jade Grass!" Liu Yiyi suddenly became extremely excited upon spotting the Nine-leaf Jade Grass. She raised her jade-like finger, pointed into the distance, and exclaimed.
Ye Yun looked up and saw a half-meter-tall small green plant growing in the swamp. It was hidden among the surrounding vegetation, very inconspicuous. If not for Liu Yiyi’s sharp eyes, Ye Yun might have truly missed it. After all, he had never seen this Nine-leaf Jade Grass before.
"There really is Immortal Nectar Dew on it!" Ye Yun glanced over and saw a crystal-clear dewdrop resting on each of the nine leaves. These dewdrops had no particular fragrance and looked quite ordinary resting on the leaves.
The two of them immediately flew over.
Liu Yiyi descended from mid-air, took out a small white jade bottle, and prepared to collect the Immortal Nectar Dew.
Liu Yiyi’s face was flushed, her heart pounding with excitement. She gently reached out her hand and said with a beaming smile, "Brother Yun, our luck is incredible this time! We found a Nine-leaf Jade Grass with Immortal Nectar Dew so easily."
"Yeah!" Ye Yun smiled faintly. Though he appeared nonchalant, his Divine Sense was already scanning the surroundings.
Just then, his expression shifted slightly. He noticed a ball of fire rapidly approaching them from the southeast.

chapters.title: Chapter 438
chapters.content:
Chapter 438: 438
"Eh? Immortal Nectar Dew?"
"Ha! I can’t believe my luck. This is something you stumble upon rather than seek. If I acquired this, I reckon my concubines would go crazy."
A terrifying figure, wrapped in flames, suddenly descended into the nearby void, spreading a powerful oppressive force all around.
The white mists were instantly evaporated.
Even the water in the swamp was rapidly decreasing at this moment.
"Yiyi, ignore him, just continue collecting."
Ye Yun smiled lightly, staring at this uninvited guest.
"Sure!"
Liu Yiyi responded brightly, acting swiftly to gather all the Immortal Nectar Dew on the nine leaves into a bottle.
"Hold it, I was clearly the first to spot it!"
The figure wrapped in flames was immediately enraged, lunging towards Liu Yiyi to swipe the jade bottle from her hands.
"Damn you... Have you no shame?"
Ye Yun flashed in front of Liu Yiyi in the blink of an eye, slapping out at the intruder.
The two palms collided mid-air.
BOOM!
The figure enshrouded in flames was suddenly sent flying.
"Tsk, tsk, First Level of the Divine Sovereign Realm, I must say you are quite powerful."
A voice chimed in.
Stabilizing his figure mid-air, the fire on the terrifying figure’s face faded, revealing the visage of a middle-aged man.
He stared at Ye Yun, sizing him up and down meticulously.
Liu Yiyi scrutinized the middle-aged man, then suddenly frowned and asked softly, "Could you be... Skyfire God Honored from the Flame Spirit Region?"
"Oh, you recognize me?"
Skyfire God Honored was slightly startled, his gaze shifting to Liu Yiyi as he studied her closely.
Suddenly, realization dawned on his face and he exclaimed, "I seem to have seen you at the Hundred Domains Alliance meeting. You must be the Sword Sovereign from the Daluo Region, am I correct?"
"Precisely!"
Liu Yiyi nodded, her face becoming icy.
The Skyfire God Honored before her, with his cultivation base at the pinnacle of the First Level of the Divine Sovereign Realm, was a prominent figure in the nearby territories.
He was a household name due to his amazing Fire-attribute Divine Skills and reportedly unbeaten record within his realm.
However, he didn’t have the best reputation.
Apparently, Skyfire God Honored had three thousand beauties in his harem, and he lived a life of hedonism and immorality.
Naturally, Liu Yiyi held a great displeasure for such individuals, especially after he tried to snatch her Immortal Nectar Dew. This incident proved his lack of character.
Hearing the conversation between Liu Yiyi and Skyfire God Honored, Ye Yun nodded slightly.
So, as the supreme fighting forces in their respective territories, they met once at some conference and thus had an impression of each other. However, it was merely a fleeting acquaintance.
"Since you’re the Sword Sovereign from the Daluo Region, I won’t fuss over the Immortal Nectar Dew anymore. I’ll take my leave!"
Remembering something, Skyfire God Honored suddenly performed a fist-and-palm salute, said his piece gravely, then turned to leave.
"Stop!"
A cold command sounded, echoing like a thunderclap.
Skyfire God Honored, who had just turned, stiffened and immediately swung back.
He looked at the young man in white in surprise.
"Did I allow you to leave?"
Ye Yun calmly looked at Skyfire God Honored, an amused expression on his face.
Trying to rob someone one moment and then leave as he pleased the next... How could there be such a convenient thing in this world?
"Who are you?"
Skyfire God Honored’s brows furrowed as he looked at the white-robed youth, asking in a deep voice.
"Come, let’s spar a little."
Ye Yun slowly pulled out a Silver Sword, pointing it at Skyfire God Honored, grinning coldly.
White robe, Silver Sword...
An image arose in Skyfire God Honored’s mind.
He suddenly realized and exclaimed loudly: "So it’s you, the mysterious Sword Cultivator from outside the region!"
"I didn’t expect the word to spread so fast..."
Ye Yun turned towards Liu Yiyi, gave her a smile, and said.
"Yes, indeed..."
Liu Yiyi shrugged, a helpless expression appearing on her beautiful face.
The grandeur of the Jianyun Sect’s Sky Worship ceremony in the past was unforgettable. Almost all the significant powers of the entire Daluo Region had participated. And in that grand ceremony, Ye Yun demonstrated his might by defeating the incarnation of Ning Fangzhi. Naturally, this news spread to other regions.
Although the Flame Spirit Region and the Daluo Region are far apart, separated by several other regions, Skyfire God Honored still had ways to learn about the happenings in the Daluo Region.
However, they all belonged to the Hundred Domains Alliance, considered a single power. There was no deep-seated hatred between them, only a certain competitive relationship.
"Even though people around the world speak of you in extraordinary terms, are you sure you want to take me on?"
Skyfire God Honored looked at the young man in white in front of him and said with a gloomy face.
WHOOSH!
Flames suddenly burst out from his body, instantly evaporating the water of the marsh on the ground.
"Why so much nonsense?"
Ye Yun, slightly annoyed, turned around and thrust his sword out.
A streak of Sword light tore through the space.
Skyfire God Honored didn’t even have time to react and abruptly found that the cold sword tip had already touched the space between his eyebrows.
What a terrifying move!
he thought.
How could this sword strike be so fast? Even though we are close, only dozens of meters apart, it’s impossible that a peak First Level Divine Sovereign Realm cultivator like me wouldn’t even have a chance to dodge!
"Kneel down!"
A soft voice came from Ye Yun’s mouth.
But it was like a thunderbolt to Skyfire God Honored. His knees softened, and he knelt down in mid-air.
At this moment, he finally understood the terror of the White-Clad Sword Cultivator. Even though they were in the same realm, if this White-Clad Sword Cultivator wanted his life, it would probably take just a single sword strike. It would be that simple.
The Skyfire God Honored had his own judgment from the countless battles he had experienced throughout his life.
This young Sword Cultivator didn’t kill me with one strike. This means that as long as my attitude is good, I still have a chance to live.
Therefore, he gave in without hesitation.
Ye Yun withdrew his sword, ruthlessly patting Skyfire God Honored’s face with its flat, making a slapping sound.
Skyfire God Honored didn’t dare to move. Even though the force was not great, the deterrent effect was immense.
He knew that if he dared to counter-attack, he would be decapitated in the next moment. After all, no matter how fast his Fire-attribute Divine Skills were, they couldn’t be faster than a Sword Cultivator’s sword. In this world, a Sword Cultivator’s sword was universally acknowledged as the fastest.
"Considering how difficult it must have been for you to reach the Divine Sovereign Realm through Cultivation, it wasn’t easy. Today, I’ll make an exception and spare your life. Scram!"
Ye Yun withdrew his sword, lifted a foot, and unceremoniously kicked Skyfire God Honored away.
Ye Yun hadn’t used much force in the kick, as he was also afraid of kicking Skyfire God Honored to death.
This fellow is in such a hurry to leave; he must have some ulterior motive.
While slapping him with his blade, Ye Yun had already secretly planted a mark on his body for tracking purposes.
Skyfire God Honored tumbled in mid-air a few times before finally stabilizing his body. He was surprised to find that he had not been injured, and his heart rejoiced greatly.
"Many thanks for showing mercy, Young Master! Until we meet again!"
Forcing a smile onto his face, Skyfire God Honored cupped his fists in a salute to Ye Yun, then turned and tore through the air, departing.
Ye Yun stood in the void, motionless.
Looking in the direction where Skyfire God Honored had disappeared, his face wore a faint, indiscernible smile.
I’m quite interested to see...
Ye Yun thought.
Just what unspeakable secret is this Skyfire God Honored in such a hurry to leave for...?

chapters.title: Chapter 439: Six Gods Gather at Cloud Mark Cave
chapters.content:
Chapter 439: Chapter 439: Six Gods Gather at Cloud Mark Cave
Having fled to some unknown depth of the Mist Marsh, Skyfire God Honored suddenly halted. He first sighed, then shook his head, and said with a smugly satisfied expression, "Damn, I’m lucky! To encounter such a terrifying Sword Cultivator and actually survive."
That last sword strike had nearly scared his soul out of him.
In his life, he had fought many cultivators of the same realm and had never once been defeated.
Yet against that White Clad Sword Cultivator of the same realm, he found himself as fragile as a thin sheet of paper.
He had no strength to fight back whatsoever.
Perhaps from a greater distance, he could have used his Divine Skills and magical artifacts to hold out for a while.
However, Skyfire God Honored suspected... regardless of what methods he employed, he would ultimately be no match for that mysterious White Clad Sword Cultivator.
"Could that guy be from the Sword Pavilion?"
Stroking his chin, Skyfire God Honored pondered. The only possibility he could think of was the Sword Pavilion.
In the entirety of the Divine Land, only cultivators from the Sword Pavilion were renowned throughout the world for their unfathomable and unpredictable swordsmanship.
If the White Clad Sword Cultivator was indeed from the Sword Pavilion, Skyfire God Honored felt his defeat wouldn’t be too shameful.
After all, he, a mere Skyfire God Honored from the small Flame Spirit Region, could in no way compare to a Successor of the Sword Pavilion.
The Sword Pavilion was a behemoth, its strength terrifyingly beyond imagination.
"From now on, I better stay away from any sword-wielding cultivators of the same level..."
Dejectedly shaking his head, Skyfire God Honored began to examine his surroundings.
After carefully comparing the space here, he took out a Token from his person and gently swiped it in the empty space above. An opening suddenly appeared in the mist.
"So it’s truly here. Who would have thought that the Cloud Mark Cave was hidden in this place!"
Putting away his Token, Skyfire God Honored smiled relaxedly, a hopeful light in his eyes. With a flash, he vanished through the opening.
He stepped through the opening into the Cloud Mark Cave.
「Inside the Cloud Mark Cave.」
He sped along, and in the time it took for over ten breaths, he quickly arrived at the perimeter of an ancient Formation.
The ancient Formation had already been damaged.
In the center of the Formation was a conspicuously long, enormous black stone.
Surrounding it sat five God Venerable Realm cultivators, dressed differently, cross-legged.
In their midst, a small-scale Prohibited Formation was operating.
Recognizing a familiar black-robed elder among them, Skyfire God Honored’s face broke into a warm smile. He immediately flew over and bowed deeply. "Master, I have arrived!"
"You’ve arrived just in time," the elder replied. "To break the Seal on the Black Stone Treasury, it will require the six of us working together with all our might to even have a chance."
The speaker was a black-robed elder with a gaunt, wrinkled face. His cultivation base had reached the Fourth Layer of God Respect State.
Among the five, he had the highest cultivation base and was their leader.
The other four God Venerable Realm cultivators opened their eyes, glanced at Skyfire God Honored, and nodded slightly.
Skyfire God Honored clasped his fists in return salute and, following the black-robed elder’s instructions, sat down in a designated position within the Formation.
The black-robed elder, still somewhat uneasy, looked at Skyfire God Honored and asked seriously, "Did you encounter any trouble on your way? Was anyone following you?"
"Master," Skyfire God Honored reported, "Inside the Cloud Mist Marsh, I encountered a terrifying fellow. His cultivation base is the same as mine, and his Practiced Sword Art is exceptionally fearsome. He looked like someone from the Sword Pavilion."
The image of Ye Yun’s stunning sword strike flashed in Skyfire God Honored’s mind, and an involuntary look of terror appeared on his face.
Upon hearing it was someone from the Sword Pavilion, all five God Venerable Realm cultivators shivered instinctively.
If someone from the Sword Pavilion had set their sights on the Cloud Mark Cave and successfully found the entrance to get in, they truly couldn’t afford to provoke them.
The black-robed elder sighed, his gaze fixed intently on Skyfire God Honored, and asked again, "This Sword Cultivator from the Sword Pavilion, did he place any kind of tracking mark on you?"
Skyfire God Honored replied with a smile, "Absolutely not. We merely exchanged a few blows; neither of us aimed to kill. That Sword Cultivator from the Sword Pavilion was actually quite reasonable."
"No, it’s better if I check you myself to be sure." The black-robed elder was still not reassured. He instantly released his powerful Divine Sense, scanning Skyfire God Honored from head to toe.
Skyfire God Honored had no choice but to accept his master’s Divine Sense scan.
After a thorough scan, the black-robed elder was completely relieved.
He nodded, his expression relaxing, and said in a deep voice, "There are no tracking marks on you."
Skyfire God Honored nodded in agreement repeatedly.
"It’s truly great that people from the Sword Pavilion aren’t involved..."
Upon hearing this, Ning Fangzhi let out a long sigh of relief, a heavy burden lifted from his heart.
His greatest fear was that the Black Stone Treasury would fall into the hands of others.
Having already lost a clone, if the Black Stone Treasury were also snatched away by others, he would truly suffer a devastating double loss.
"Alright, let’s begin!" the black-robed elder declared loudly. "We must strive to break the Seal on the Black Stone Treasury within a month!"
"Okay!" The others exclaimed. Upon hearing ’Black Stone Treasury,’ they were instantly invigorated, forming hand seals and pouring streams of Mana into the great Formation.
WHOOSH! WHOOSH!
The operating great Formation’s offensive power instantly doubled, frantically eroding the Seal on the black stone.
「Outside the Cloud Mark Cave.」
With a ripple in the void, Ye Yun and Liu Yiyi appeared below the entrance to the Cloud Mark Cave.
Ye Yun, with his hands behind his back, said softly, "This should be the place. Skyfire God Honored... vanished right here."
He then began to look around, searching for an opening.
If his guess was correct, Skyfire God Honored’s sudden disappearance here meant he must have entered a Miniature World.
The Miniature World within the Mist Marsh should be the Cloud Mark Cave.
Ye Yun hadn’t expected that Skyfire God Honored... would actually lead the way for him.
To think he’d searched high and low for it, only to have it fall into his lap so easily!
In Ye Yun’s mystical eyes, countless tiny, star-like runes began to emerge, shifting with the Power of Life and Death, as he searched for the entrance to the Cloud Mark Cave.
Within a few breaths, Ye Yun not only found the Cloud Mark Cave but also successfully opened an entrance.
Liu Yiyi gazed at the opening in mid-air and said in surprise, "Brother Yun, who would have thought the Cloud Mark Cave was hidden here!"
"Let’s go, we’re going in!" Ye Yun replied with a faint smile, pulling Liu Yiyi as they flew into the Cloud Mark Cave.
Upon entering the Cloud Mark Cave, Ye Yun found it was no different from other Miniature Worlds.
The only thing that puzzled him was that within this Miniature World, he actually sensed a trace of a Divine Dragon’s Super Divine Dragon Breath.
This Super Divine Dragon Breath was extremely faint.
If it weren’t for his Ancestral Dragon Bloodline, perhaps even an ordinary Divine Dragon wouldn’t have been able to sense it.
This naturally deepened Ye Yun’s interest.
Upon entering the Cloud Mark Cave, Ye Yun discovered that the Spiritual Energy here wasn’t very dense; it was even fainter than outside.
Barren mountains, treacherous waters, sparse vegetation—it was desolate everywhere, exuding an ancient atmosphere, as if a terrible, great battle had once occurred here.
Upon entering the Cloud Mark Cave, Ye Yun once again sensed the mark he had planted on Skyfire God Honored.
That mark was currently in an extremely remote part of the Cloud Mark Cave.
Ye Yun concealed his Super Divine Dragon Breath and then led Liu Yiyi as they flew towards the depths.

chapters.title: Chapter 440 A black dragon pattern
chapters.content:
Chapter 440: 440 A black dragon pattern
He concealed his aura and added an invisible restriction.
Ye Yun also wondered why Skyfire God Honored had snuck into the Cloud Mark Cave, and what his true intention was. Could it have anything to do with Ning Fangzhi, who was hiding deep within the Cloud Mark Cave?
A few breaths later, Ye Yun saw an ancient formation in his field of vision. In the center of the formation stood a long, black boulder that reached for the sky. The boulder was covered with many runes, as if something was sealed inside it. Around the black stone, Ye Yun noticed a total of six cultivators at the Divine Sovereign Realm. One of them, a young man clad in black, looked very familiar. It was Liu Yiyi’s Senior Brother, Ning Fangzhi.
"Brother Yun, what are these six Divine Sovereign Realm cultivators doing here?" Liu Yiyi asked curiously.
"This black stone pillar seems to be sealing something. Let’s get a closer look," Ye Yun said with a slight smile, taking Liu Yiyi with him as they flew a short distance closer. He and Liu Yiyi were now hovering above the black stone pillar, looking down from their vantage point.
"Hmm? What’s this?"
Ye Yun spotted a dragon pattern imprinted on the surface of the black stone pillar. It was a black dragon pattern, fused with the black stone, making it difficult to notice without close inspection.
Ye Yun pondered. This black stone pillar might indeed have some connection to the Divine Dragon’s Breath he had sensed upon first entering the Cloud Mark Cave.
"So, Ning Fangzhi has been hiding here all this time, consorting with these vicious individuals?" Liu Yiyi snorted coldly, her eyes filled with disdain as she looked down at Ning Fangzhi below. She had heard of the others; they were all notorious figures in the Divine Land. They had dark histories and criminal records, and after being hunted by several major sects, they had fled to the Black Water Region. Unexpectedly, Ning Fangzhi had also ended up here, associating with such people.
She could only imagine how far Ning Fangzhi had fallen.
"Since none of them are good people, let’s eliminate them while we’re at it. Consider it us delivering justice," Ye Yun said indifferently, a smile on his face.
"Brother Yun, I’ll deal with Ning Fangzhi. How about... you take care of the rest?" Liu Yiyi said with a playful smile, sticking out the tip of her tongue.
She was still at the Half-step Divine Venerate Realm, but with her Red Tassel Battle Armor, her combat power would soar, surely enough to defeat Ning Fangzhi. As for the others, Liu Yiyi wasn’t worried that Ye Yun couldn’t handle them. After all, in the Black Sky Burial Ground, Ye Yun had effortlessly handled seven Dragon Raisers all by himself, demonstrating just how terrifyingly powerful he was.
"Alright. It’s also a good opportunity for you to try out the Binary Sword Chant." Hearing Liu Yiyi’s words, Ye Yun smiled nonchalantly. Then, he dispelled the invisibility restriction around them.
"Well now, what are you all busy with here?" Ye Yun asked with a casual smile, looking down from above as he leisurely drew a silver longsword.
The sudden voice boomed like a thunderclap in the ears of the six Divine Sovereigns, nearly scaring their souls out of their bodies.
"Who is it?" The black-robed elder, who appeared to be their leader, snapped his eyes open, his gaze as sharp as lightning as he looked towards the empty space above. There, he saw a white-clad sword cultivator and a red-dressed beauty hovering in mid-air.
"Liu Yiyi! How can it be you?" Ning Fangzhi also opened his eyes. Upon seeing Liu Yiyi, his expression changed drastically.
Liu Yiyi is only at the Half-step Divine Venerate Realm, yet she managed to enter the Cloud Mark Cave. That white-clad sword cultivator by her side... he must be an extraordinary figure.
"How can it be you?" Skyfire God Honored exclaimed, looking towards the figures in the air with a face full of shock.
He had never imagined that the white-clad sword cultivator, who had nearly killed him with a single sword strike moments ago, would have unfathomably found his way this deep into the Cloud Mark Cave.
"Skyfire, do you know him?" the black-robed elder asked sharply.
"Teacher, he is the Sword Pavilion cultivator I encountered in the Mist Marsh," Skyfire God Honored said, steeling himself.
"So, he’s from the Sword Pavilion?"
The black-robed elder’s expression turned grim, his heart filled with unease.
Hearing the words "Sword Pavilion," the others started, their gazes darting around, scanning the rest of the Cloud Mark Cave.PHEW... Realizing that no one else had intruded into the Cloud Mark Cave, they collectively sighed in relief.
"Big Brother, he’s alone. What’s there to fear?" one of the men said, standing up. He drew his sword with a fearless expression and a cold smirk.
The black-robed elder nodded, his piercing gaze fixed on Skyfire God Honored. "Skyfire, was it you who brought him here?"
"It truly wasn’t me, Teacher! Heavens bear witness, I don’t even know him!" Skyfire God Honored, understanding the implication in his teacher’s words, immediately fell to his knees, his face a mask of distress as he pleaded.
"Hmph. Get up." The black-robed elder waved his hand dismissively. A surge of mana swept out, helping Skyfire God Honored to his feet. At the same time, he slowly rose to his feet, as did the others, including Ning Fangzhi.
The black-robed elder still trusted this disciple of his. His disciple lacked the capability and connections to be involved with the Sword Pavilion. A colossal power like the Sword Pavilion would hardly concern itself with a minor faction from the Flame Spirit Region.
"Ning Fangzhi, I killed that clone of yours. Today, I’ve come to challenge you to a fair fight!" Liu Yiyi declared, taking a step forward. She held her longsword with its tip angled downwards, her expressionless face icy cold.
"You? A mere Half-step Divine Venerate Realm cultivator, and you want to fight me? Liu Yiyi, do you honestly think you can leave the Cloud Mark Cave alive?" Ning Fangzhi sneered. In an instant, he shot into the air, his body exuding the powerful aura of the First Layer of the Divine Sovereign Realm.
WHOOSH! A red glow flashed around Liu Yiyi’s body, and then the brilliant Red Tassel Battle Armor materialized around her.
Seeing Liu Yiyi suddenly clad in the red armor, Ning Fangzhi was stunned. He was astonished to feel her aura skyrocket, instantly reaching the First Layer of the Divine Sovereign Realm—the same as his own cultivation base.
"A God-level Armor, is it? No wonder you had the confidence to demand a fair fight. So this is what you’re relying on," Ning Fangzhi said, taking a deep breath as his expression turned grave.
This Liu Yiyi was not to be underestimated. However, since it was a fair fight, he wasn’t afraid. He refused to believe that Liu Yiyi, merely by relying on a God-level Armor, could defeat him—a genuine cultivator at the First Layer of the Divine Sovereign Realm!
"Strange... how does a mere Sword Sovereign from the Daluo Region possess a God-level Armor?"
the black-robed elder muttered to himself, his gaze fixed on the red armor, a greedy glint in his eyes. This red God-level Armor looked extraordinary, at least medium-grade divine quality. If he could seize it, even if he couldn’t wear it himself, he could exchange it for a male armor of equivalent grade at the largest auction house in the Divine Land. Even if he couldn’t exchange it, he could thicken his skin and wear it; it could save his life at a critical moment.
Hearing the elder’s words, Ye Yun’s lips curled into a smirk.
"What’s so special about a God-level Armor? You, old codger, have the highest cultivation base among these people. How about... you experience the swordsmanship of my Sword Pavilion?" Ye Yun said, pointing his sword at the black-robed elder, his expression cold as he issued the challenge.

chapters.title: Chapter 441: Slaughtering God like Slaughtering a Dog
chapters.content:
Chapter 441: Chapter 441: Slaughtering God like Slaughtering a Dog
Since these people mistakenly believed he was from the Sword Pavilion, Ye Yun decided not to bother explaining.
Sword Pavilion it was, then.
Regardless, none of these individuals, who had committed heinous crimes, would survive today.
This included Skyfire God Honored, a man who led a life of debauchery and had countless misdeeds to his name; he especially could not be allowed to live.
"Master," Skyfire God Honored surreptitiously sent a voice transmission to the old man in black, his face etched with panic, "this man’s swordsmanship is extremely profound. You must be cautious!"
The old man in black shot Skyfire God Honored a cold glance, wishing he could slap him dead.
This is simply bolstering the enemy’s prestige while deflating our own spirit!
he fumed internally. He was a proud Cultivator at the Fourth Level of the Divine Sovereign Realm; how could he fear a mere First Level Divine Sovereign Realm Cultivator? Even if the opponent was from the Sword Pavilion, he was alone. The elder feared nothing. They currently held the absolute advantage, both in numbers and individual combat strength.
"Master is right," Skyfire God Honored said sheepishly, his old face flushing. "As your disciple, I was just flustered. When I realized our opponent was a Successor of the Sword Pavilion, I panicked..."
"Reflect on your actions properly!" The old man in black flicked his sleeve, snorted coldly, and rose into the air.
In the void, he and Ye Yun faced each other from a distance.
On the other side, Liu Yiyi and Ning Fangzhi had already engaged in battle.
BOOM!
Two heaven-shaking sword lights collided without any flourish, erupting with a tremendous roar. A powerful shockwave pulsed outwards in all directions.
The old man in black frowned, waved his sleeve, and the shockwaves instantly vanished.
When he saw that the two combatants were evenly matched in their first exchange, his desire for that red God-level armor intensified.
I must obtain that God-level armor,
the elder in black vowed internally.
"You old fiend, if you have any powerful Divine Skills, hurry up and use them!" Ye Yun said calmly, holding his sword horizontally across his chest.
WHOOSH!
The instant his voice fell, black flames, half a meter high, suddenly erupted around the old man in black. These fiercely burning black flames looked exceedingly eerie, continuously raging and emitting terrifying fluctuations of power.
"So this is the Nether Black Flame," Ye Yun smiled faintly, completely unfazed by the elder’s display of power. "I didn’t expect you to be a Demonic Cultivator proficient in fire-attribute Divine Skills."
"Humph! Sooner or later, you people of the Sword Pavilion will pay a bloody price for your arrogance and conceit!" The old man in black’s face turned cold, his expression filled with contempt. After speaking, black flames even ignited within his eyes.
"Go!"
With a forward push of his hands, over a dozen black fire serpents suddenly flew out into mid-air. These black fire serpents, formed from Nether Black Flame, were dozens of meters long. Their momentum was astonishing as they rushed over with extreme ferocity, bringing waves of intense heat.
"Haha! The fire serpents are too small. Don’t you... have a Fire Dragon?" Ye Yun asked mockingly, a look of disappointment on his face as he regarded the black fire serpents.
"To deal with a trifling First Level Divine Sovereign Realm Cultivator like you, one Divine Skill is more than enough," the old man in black sneered.
Even a Cultivator at the Third Level of the Divine Sovereign Realm couldn’t dodge this Nether Black Serpent Divine Skill, let alone this mere First Level Divine Sovereign Realm Sword Cultivator.
Ye Yun remained indifferent, his gaze calm. He didn’t move. He chose not to attack but to defend, holding his sword across his chest and employing the Sword of Life Realm.
The reason Ye Yun didn’t want to kill the old man in black too quickly was to create a good dueling opportunity for Liu Yiyi. If he killed the elder with a single strike, Ning Fangzhi would undoubtedly be scared to death, losing any mood to duel Liu Yiyi.
Skyfire God Honored looked up at the giant black fire serpents that filled the sky, their presence overwhelming and intimidating. A triumphant expression appeared on his face.
With Master taking action this time, that Sword Pavilion fellow is sure to die,
he thought gleefully.
Sword Pavilion disciples are too arrogant. They have the courage of a swordsman but are truly foolish. Entering the Cloud Mark Cave alone and daring to provoke our six Divine Sovereigns—isn’t that courting death?
Just as Skyfire God Honored was gloating, an event unfolded that nearly made his eyeballs pop out. He was shocked to discover that the myriad black fire serpents filling the sky were being drawn by a strange force, drifting towards the silver Longsword. When they were about thirty feet from the silver Longsword, the black fire serpents began to rapidly vanish, inch by inch. All the attacks from his Master’s Divine Skill had been effortlessly neutralized.
What kind of swordsmanship is this?
Skyfire God Honored shuddered.
It’s truly terrifying!
A dreadful premonition rose in his heart.
Even my Master might not be able to break through such powerful defensive swordsmanship.
"Master, let me assist you!" Skyfire God Honored shouted, soaring into the sky without hesitation to stand beside the old man in black.
At this moment, the black-clad elder was also staring at Ye Yun, his face a mask of shock.
This Sword Pavilion’s sword technique... it’s truly too powerful!
he thought. Despite a three-realm difference in cultivation, this White Clad Sword Cultivator had effortlessly nullified his Divine Skill.
Seeing Skyfire God Honored suddenly appear, a rare smile touched the black-clad elder’s lips.
This disciple... he’s not bad,
he mused.
We’re deep within the Cloud Mark Cave now, with no outsiders around. Who cares about righteousness or principles? We’ll just gang up on him!
「In another direction.」
BOOM!
Another deafening explosion echoed as Liu Yiyi and Ning Fangzhi clashed head-on once more, both sent flying backward.
"Liu Yiyi, you’re not all that great!" Ning Fangzhi roared with laughter. Even wearing God-level armor, Liu Yiyi wasn’t much stronger than him.
At least I can hold out for a draw,
Ning Fangzhi thought.
It’s about time...
Liu Yiyi muttered to herself. Looking at Ning Fangzhi’s arrogant smile, her face grew colder. She had just been testing how much her combat strength would improve after donning the God-level Red Tassel Battle Armor. After two consecutive exchanges, she had a clear understanding.
Next, I’ll unleash the Sword of Death Realm from the Binary Sword Chant. A single strike to kill. I will cut Ning Fangzhi down!
Liu Yiyi took a deep breath, her longsword quivering. Suddenly, her entire form vanished, transforming into a breathtaking sword light that instantly appeared before Ning Fangzhi.
"This—?!" Ning Fangzhi, who had been gloating, was aghast at the sudden appearance of the sword light. Strangely, enveloped by this sword light, he found himself unable to muster even a shred of resistance.
SCHLICK!
The sword pierced the center of his brow, and his Primordial Spirit within his sea of consciousness was instantly obliterated.
In that moment, Ning Fangzhi perished.
"What? Fifth Brother is dead, just like that?"
Below, the three Divine Sovereign Realm Cultivators watching the battle were utterly shocked to see Ning Fangzhi suddenly fall. Without any hesitation, they soared into the sky, charging towards Liu Yiyi.
A white shadow flashed.
Ye Yun suddenly materialized before Liu Yiyi like a phantom.
"Yiyi, leave these guys to me," Ye Yun smiled. The next moment, as his sword light flared, he vanished.
SCHLICK! SCHLICK! SCHLICK!
A stunning sword light crisscrossed the void. The heads of the three attacking Divine Sovereign Realm Cultivators were brutally blown apart by Ye Yun’s single sword art. Even their Primordial Spirits were annihilated on the spot.
Witnessing this scene from the side, the black-clad elder and Skyfire God Honored felt a chill run down their spines. They shivered, their very souls quaking from the depths.
Is this Sword Cultivator from the Sword Pavilion... really only at the First Level of the Divine Sovereign Realm?
they both wondered in horror.
Why... why is he slaughtering Cultivators at the Second and Third Levels of the Divine Sovereign Realm as if they were mere dogs?
"Master, we’re finished!" Skyfire God Honored’s face was deathly pale. Gripped by terror, his will to live completely evaporated. His body swayed, and he nearly collapsed.

chapters.title: Chapter 442: Apocalypse Flame, Cleaved by a Sword
chapters.content:
Chapter 442: Chapter 442: Apocalypse Flame, Cleaved by a Sword
Skyfire God Honored held an exalted position in the Flame Spirit Region. Everything was at his beck and call, and he reveled in a luxurious life filled with three thousand beauties in his harem.
He never expected that he would perish today in this Cloud Mark Cave.
These Sword Cultivators from the Sword Pavilion are really too powerful.
Killing across realms is as easy for them as slicing vegetables and melons.
Their swordsmanship is sublime, something he has rarely encountered in his life, and it’s hard to describe with any language.
In the blink of an eye, three cultivators from the Divine Sovereign Realm had fallen under the sword.
Recalling his first encounter with this Sword Cultivator from the Sword Pavilion in the Mist Marsh, the chilling sensation of the sword tip pressed against his brow seemed to resurface.
Skyfire God Honored shuddered with fear, his knees suddenly buckled, and he abruptly knelt in mid-air.
He looked at Ye Yun with a pleading expression and said with a trembling voice, "Senior, please spare my life! I only just entered the Cloud Mark Cave; I haven’t done anything..."
Seeing Skyfire God Honored’s will crumble, Ye Yun chuckled.
This fellow with three thousand beauties in his harem certainly doesn’t want to die!
If Skyfire God Honored were to die, what would become of all his women?
"Skyfire! How can you beg for mercy at a time like this? Get up quickly and fight the enemy with your Master!"
The black-robed old man was so furious his insides felt like they were burning. He shot out a hand, grabbed Skyfire God Honored, and shook him violently.
"Master, it’s useless. We cannot afford to provoke the Sword Pavilion," Skyfire God Honored, his fighting spirit completely gone, said with dull, lifeless eyes.
The black-robed old man roared, "Wake the hell up! Even if you beg for mercy, do you think he’ll let you go?"
"Master, I have no grudges or enmity with this Senior. He spared my life once in the Mist Marsh," Skyfire God Honored said with a bitter smile.
"Is that so?" The black-robed old man’s expression darkened, as if he had thought of something.
"Sir, we no longer want this Black Stone Treasury. We’ll give it to you. How about you spare us, Master and disciple?" the black-robed old man asked tentatively, his gaze fixed sharply on Ye Yun while still grasping Skyfire God Honored with one hand.
Ye Yun smiled faintly. "You two are utterly vicious and have committed countless evils. Do you really think I would spare you?"
