After speaking, he held his sword in one hand and slowly walked forward a few steps in the void.
With each step Ye Yun took, both the black-robed old man and Skyfire God Honored felt their hearts pound violently. It felt as if an immense pressure had instantly descended upon them. A great sense of terror welled up in their hearts.
"Don’t say I’m bullying the weak. You two insignificant cultivators of the Divine Sovereign Realm, if you don’t make your move now, you won’t get another chance."
Ye Yun continued his slow advance, raising the sword in his hand.
Possessing the Ancestral Dragon Body, mastery over various powerful Divine Skills, and an unimaginable hoard of treasures, the current Ye Yun felt no fear, even when facing a Divine King Realm expert. That was why, when dealing with two mere Divine Sovereigns, he would say he was bullying the weak. He was giving them one chance to act. At the same time, he wanted Liu Yiyi, who stood beside him, to witness the Sword of Death Realm again to deepen her comprehension. After all, her Binary Sword Chant was still only at a rudimentary level.
"Senior, are you truly not going to spare me?" Skyfire God Honored asked eagerly, seeming to regain some clarity upon hearing Ye Yun’s words.
Ye Yun shook his head.
Skyfire God Honored’s face immediately filled with disappointment.
He knew his Master had dragged him into this mess.
After a sigh, Skyfire God Honored wrenched himself free from the black-robed old man’s grasp. He formed a Hand Seal, and his entire body immediately erupted in roaring red flames. The color was completely different from the black-robed old man’s black flames.
"Skyfire, whether we live or die now depends on our fortune this time, Master and disciple," the black-robed old man said, his expression grave. He too formed a Hand Seal, and the aura around him intensified dramatically. Their Hand Seals were identical. This was their most powerful fire-attribute Divine Skill.
"Apocalypse Flame!"
The two shouted almost simultaneously, thrusting their hands violently towards Ye Yun. One red and one black, two surging seas of fire erupted from their Hand Seals, rolling forward like an unstoppable, world-ending torrent.
This fire-attribute Divine Skill is so strong... Skyfire God Honored really has some ability; he’s even stronger than Ning Fangzhi,
Liu Yiyi thought. She stood behind Ye Yun, her expression changing slightly as she watched the overwhelming Apocalypse Flame.
If she were to face Skyfire God Honored alone, it would likely end in a draw. However, she had the Red Tassel Battle Armor, so the Apocalypse Flame couldn’t harm her. In a battle of attrition, she would have a chance to defeat Skyfire God Honored.
Facing the vast red and black flames sweeping towards him, Ye Yun suddenly vanished.
A sword light, seemingly capable of sundering the heavens and splitting the earth, abruptly appeared in the void. The sword light was incomparably sharp and utterly unstoppable. The Sword of Death Realm—nothing in the world could block it.
SWISH! In an instant, the two apocalyptic red and black flames were cleaved in two.
"How is this possible?!" the black-robed old man roared in shocked disbelief. He was an expert at the Fourth Layer of the Divine Sovereign Realm and had unleashed his strongest fire-attribute Divine Skill. Combined with his disciple’s attack, their joint offensive was still so easily shattered by the Sword Cultivator. A single sword strike had destroyed their Divine Skills.
What terrified him even more was that as the sword light descended, he found himself utterly unable to muster any will to resist.
This is simply too bizarre.
It’s as if, at this very moment, I’m already dead.
"It’s over." Seeing the familiar sword light descend, Skyfire God Honored closed his eyes.
This Sword Cultivator is too terrifying.
Neither he nor his Master could possibly block such swordsmanship.
SPLAT! Skyfire God Honored’s head abruptly exploded, sending crimson blood and white brain matter splattering everywhere. His Primordial Spirit shattered in the same instant.
Skyfire God Honored had fallen!
The next moment, the black-robed old man’s head, his eyes wide with terror, also exploded. Blood and brain matter flew through the air. His Primordial Spirit was minced by that sword strike, and he too perished on the spot.
This Sword of Death Realm is truly too powerful. If one’s cultivation base isn’t high enough, or their Dao Heart isn’t firm enough, they wouldn’t even be able to muster the will to resist this sword,
Liu Yiyi murmured to herself, her face flashing with successive waves of realization. At that moment, her understanding of the Binary Sword Chant deepened considerably.
"Yiyi, go and collect all their storage rings," Ye Yun said with a smile, turning to Liu Yiyi.
"Okay, Brother Yun." Liu Yiyi nodded quickly and got busy.
Ye Yun descended from mid-air and landed beside the black stone pillar. There, he saw four words inscribed on the ground: "Black Stone Treasury."
Ye Yun nodded silently.
No wonder Ning Fangzhi and the others were guarding the depths of the Cloud Mark Cave; it was precisely because of these four words.
Perhaps they believed that by breaking the black stone’s Seal, they could enter a Treasure Pavilion and obtain countless treasures.
A Treasure Pavilion capable of attracting several Divine Sovereign Realm experts would naturally be of a high grade. Could it have been left behind by a Divine King Realm expert?
Ye Yun mused, his gaze slightly focused as he began to examine the Seal on the surface of the black stone pillar.
Countless tiny, star-like runes flickered in the depths of his eyes. His Annihilation Eye activated, and a vast power of creation and destruction instantly descended, beginning to wear away at the Seals.
BANG! After a few dozen breaths, accompanied by a soft crack, the Seal on the outer layer of the black stone pillar shattered.

chapters.title: Chapter 443: Breaking the Seal, Dark Divine Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 443: Chapter 443: Breaking the Seal, Dark Divine Dragon
"Brother Yun, why is there another Seal?"
Liu Yiyi, who had already collected the spoils of war, flew over and stood next to Ye Yun. Seeing the remaining layer of Seal on the surface of the black stone pillar, she couldn’t help but be taken aback.
"It seems this Black Stone Treasury has some secrets," Ye Yun nodded with a smile.
After the surface Seal was broken, the new Seal inside was revealed to be even stronger and sturdier than the previous one.
However, this didn’t pose a problem for Ye Yun.
Perhaps because he had been using the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye for a while, Ye Yun suddenly activated the Sword of Death Realm, slashing directly at the Seal.
BOOM!
A vast power, channeled through the sword’s tip, struck the black stone pillar, unleashing a deafening roar.
At that moment, the entire Cloud Mark Cave trembled violently. The momentum was shocking, as if the Grotto-Heaven was on the verge of collapse.
Startling Liu Yiyi, who stood beside him, her face paled.
Brother Yun’s sword strike is so powerful!
Liu Yiyi exclaimed inwardly.
With just one slash, Ye Yun broke through the sturdy Seal.
However, when he looked inside, he found yet another Seal.
He was momentarily stunned.
Ning Fangzhi and his group must have broken through quite a few layers of Seals already.
He had now shattered two layers in succession, only to find another one.
This Seal was even more robust than the one before it.
It appeared this Seal was indeed laid down by a God King Expert.
Ning Fangzhi and the others all possessed cultivation bases at the Lower Order of God-Honor Realm, so breaking these Seals was extremely difficult for them.
They could only rely on sheer perseverance, slowly wearing them down bit by bit.
BOOM!
Ye Yun swung his sword again, forcibly shattering this layer of Seal.
As this Seal fractured, black smoke suddenly billowed out from the depths of the black stone pillar, quickly enveloping the entire structure.
The black smoke continued to rise, drifting into the air and eventually forming a Black Giant Dragon.
This Black Giant Dragon, unlike a true Divine Dragon, was not tens or hundreds of thousands of zhang long.
It was merely several tens of zhang long.
Even so, hovering above their heads, it appeared extremely formidable.
A dragon?
An expression of surprise appeared on Ye Yun’s face.
It seemed the dragon insignia on top of the black stone pillar earlier was not without meaning.
The Black Stone Treasury and this Black Dragon before them were connected somehow.
But this Black Dragon was not a true Divine Dragon.
It was weak.
It was merely an ancient will, devoid of any Divine King Realm cultivation base aura.
The cultivation realm of this Divine Dragon body, condensed from will, had fallen to the First Layer of the God Sovereign Realm.
"Human, if you wish to inherit the Black Stone Treasury, you must agree to one condition. Otherwise, I will ensure both the Treasury and I are destroyed together," the Black Dragon hovered in mid-air, its gaze fixed on the two humans below, with no discernible emotion in its eyes.
"What condition?" Ye Yun asked, a particularly interested expression appearing on his face.
Despite its small size, the Black Dragon’s unique appearance reminded Ye Yun of a specific dragon type.
The Dark Divine Dragon.
Dark Divine Dragons were high-level Divine Dragons, masters of dark power, under the jurisdiction of the Dark Heavenly Dragon, one of the Ten Super Divine Dragons.
He then recalled...
Three months ago, in the Black Sky Burial Ground, he had encountered the claw of a Dark Heavenly Dragon. This led Ye Yun to a certain speculation.
But he needed further verification.
"This condition is extremely difficult to fulfill. If you dare to accept, you must swear an oath to the Heavenly Dao. Only then will I reveal the specifics," the Dark Divine Dragon said in a deep voice.
Swear an oath?
Ye Yun was taken aback once more.
He suddenly realized that this wisp of will from the Dark Divine Dragon probably had something of extreme importance to entrust to the inheritor of the Black Stone Treasury.
"Brother Yun, swearing an oath to the Heavenly Dao has serious consequences," Liu Yiyi suddenly gripped Ye Yun’s hand, speaking anxiously.
Who knows what this Black Dragon is truly planning? What if, after Brother Yun swears an oath to the Heavenly Dao, the Black Dragon makes a demand he cannot fulfill? Wouldn’t he suffer a backlash from the Heavenly Dao?
"It’s alright," Ye Yun gently patted Liu Yiyi’s hand and said with a smile.
He felt no fear regarding an oath to the Heavenly Dao.
Even if he were to violate such an oath, and the Heavenly Dao truly sought to trouble him, he wouldn’t mind revealing a few things that would make even the Heavenly Dao apprehensive.
"I can swear an oath to the Heavenly Dao. Whatever your demand may be, I will agree to it and carry it out without hesitation," Ye Yun declared, abruptly raising one hand, his expression solemn.
Seeing the human below so earnestly and genuinely swear an oath to the Heavenly Dao, the expression in the Black Dragon’s eyes suddenly grew sorrowful.
"I was right about you. I don’t know why, but I felt a sense of closeness the moment I saw you," the Black Dragon said, its tone low and somber.
"It seems we are fated to meet," Ye Yun replied with a calm smile.
He possessed the Ancestral Dragon Bloodline. Even without actively releasing its aura, it would naturally evoke a sense of affinity in Divine Dragons.
This wisp of the Dark Divine Dragon’s will was naturally no exception to this principle.
"I am a Dark Divine Dragon, one of the Eight Great Black Dragon Kings under Lord Dark Heavenly Dragon, from the Dragon-Hidden Continent, Sumeru Dark World... Years ago, I followed Lord Dark Heavenly Dragon, pursuing and killing the Spirits who invaded the Moon Star. That is how we entered the Divine Land," the Dark Divine Dragon said slowly, its tone carried a desolation that seemed to echo from ancient times.
Hearing this, Ye Yun’s calm expression turned grave.
It was just as he had suspected.
This Dark Divine Dragon had indeed entered the Divine Land with the Dark Heavenly Dragon.
"The Eight Great Black Dragon Kings, do you mean each one possesses the cultivation of the Divine King Realm?" Ye Yun asked.
"Indeed. To be a king among the Dragon Clan, one must possess the cultivation of the Divine King Realm. Before I perished, my cultivation was at the Second Layer of God King Realm," the Dark Divine Dragon stated proudly.
"Then what is your master’s cultivation level?" Ye Yun inquired further.
He was also very curious about the extent of cultivation reached by the Dark Heavenly Dragon, one of the Ten Super Divine Dragons.
The Dark Divine Dragon glanced at Ye Yun, hesitated for merely half a second, then trust once again filled its eyes.
It said in a deep tone, "There’s no harm in telling you. Lord Dark Heavenly Dragon is already at the Peak of the Tenth Layer of the God King Realm. His power is so immense that even Spirits at the Half-step Divine Emperor Realm in the Divine Land are no match for him."
Such a high cultivation level,
Ye Yun mused.
It seemed the Ten Super Divine Dragons likely all possessed cultivation at this level.
And the Ancestor Dragon, the Ancestor of Ten Thousand Dragons, must be at least in the God Emperor Realm.
"After entering the Divine Land, our Dark Dragon Clan Army waged a world-shaking war against the Spirits of the Divine Land!
"In that battle, Lord Dark Heavenly Dragon single-handedly fought against three Spirits who were at the Peak of the Tenth Layer of the God King Realm.
"In the end, those despicable Spirits actually used a treasure sealed by the Ancestor Dragon to sever Lord Dark Heavenly Dragon’s arm!
"Lord Dark Heavenly Dragon fled to an unknown destination. Our Dark Dragon Clan Army was scattered and subsequently annihilated by those Spirits, one by one."
The Dark Divine Dragon’s voice was hoarse, echoing slowly in the surrounding space, its eyes filled with endless desolation and sorrow.

chapters.title: Chapter 444: The Secret of the Ancient Dark Dragon Clan’s Fall
chapters.content:
Chapter 444: Chapter 444: The Secret of the Ancient Dark Dragon Clan’s Fall
"It seems that you, the Dark Dragon Clan, have suffered a great defeat in this battle..." Ye Yun sighed softly.
From the claws of the Dark Heavenly Dragon, he had witnessed that earth-shattering battle.
The mysterious Blood-colored Broken Sword sealed by the Ancestor Dragon was the direct culprit behind the Dark Dragon Clan army’s collapse.
However, the spirit from the Divine King Realm who could control the Blood-colored Broken Sword seemed quite familiar with it.
"This Cloud Trace Cave seems to originate from an even more ancient era. After I escaped into it, I waged a great war against the spirits. Although I ultimately eradicated them, I also sustained extremely severe injuries," the Dark Divine Dragon spoke again.
"Why didn’t you return to the Cangnan Continent?" Ye Yun asked.
"Do you think we didn’t want to?" The Dark Divine Dragon suddenly gave a desolate laugh and said helplessly, "At that time, the contingent of clan members I led fled to the entrance of the Ancient Road to Heaven. We had originally intended to return to the Dragon Hidden Continent to seek aid from other Dragon Clans.
"But unexpectedly, under a clear sky in broad daylight, seven large stars suddenly materialized in the heavens. A formation descended from them, sealing off the Ancient Road to Heaven. Left with no alternative, we were forced to flee towards Divine Land once more."
Upon hearing the Dark Divine Dragon’s words, Ye Yun’s expression changed dramatically.
"Seven large stars, did they form a Seven-star formation?" he asked urgently.
"Yes!" the Dark Divine Dragon stated decisively.
Ye Yun frowned.
He had never imagined that the Seven Star Grand Array would reappear in that great war of the Ancient Times. However, this Seven Star Grand Array did not directly participate in the battle to exterminate the Dragon Clan. It merely sealed off the entrance to the Ancient Road to Heaven. Consequently, those Dark Dragon Clans could never return to the Cangnan Continent in this life. What awaited them... was only the endless pursuit by the spirits of Divine Land.
"At that time, I was gravely injured and hid in Cloud Mark Cave for fifty thousand years," the Dark Divine Dragon sighed and continued. "Later, I secretly ventured to the entrance of the Ancient Road to Heaven, only to find the grand array still present. So, I returned to Cloud Mark Cave. Due to the severity of my injuries, I eventually perished. What you see now is merely the will I left behind before my demise, a will that remained within the seal."
"The Ancient Road to Heaven is now free of that Seven Star Grand Array," Ye Yun said softly.
"I surmised as much long ago. By the time a successor capable of breaking the Black Stone Seal arrived, I feared that all the Dark Dragon Clan members remaining in Divine Land had already perished." The Dark Divine Dragon’s expression was sorrowful.
"What is your request?" Ye Yun asked.
"The Black Stone Treasury represents my life’s accumulation; it can take you far on your cultivation path. My sole request is for you to return to the Cangnan Continent, enter the Sumeru Dark Realm, and rescue my own younger brother from imprisonment." As the Dark Divine Dragon spoke of this, a flicker of emotion touched his eyes.
"Your younger brother?" Ye Yun asked, slightly taken aback.
"Yes, my brother once offended Lord Dark Heavenly Dragon and was imprisoned. At that time, to pursue those spirits from Moon Star, the Dark Dragon Clan mobilized its full strength... I imagine that by now, the Sumeru Dark Realm must be completely deserted, apart from my brother in that prison." The Dark Divine Dragon looked at Ye Yun, his eyes filled with entreaty.
"After all these years, could he still be alive?" Ye Yun asked quietly.
"Before being imprisoned, my brother was already an expert at the Half-step God King Realm. Moreover, dragons have long lifespans; he should still be alive," the Dark Divine Dragon stated, his eyes gleaming with confidence.
After speaking, he seemed to recall something and added, "The Black Stone Treasury contains the key to that prison’s seal. If you enter the Sumeru Dark Realm and find my brother is no longer there, then your task will be considered complete."
"I understand." Ye Yun nodded gently, a sense of sympathy stirring within him at that moment.
This Dark Divine Dragon, one of the Eight Great Black Dragon Kings, had been an incredibly illustrious figure in his past life. Yet, for the sake of his younger brother, he held onto such a persistent desire even at the brink of death. It was astounding that the entire Dark Dragon Clan had mobilized to pursue the spirits who invaded Moon Star and reclaim the Blood-colored Broken Sword sealed by the Ancestor Dragon. Ye Yun hadn’t anticipated such dedication. It appeared this Dark Dragon Clan was fiercely loyal to the Ancestor Dragon. Even after the Ancestor Dragon vanished, they were willing to pay any price to retrieve the Blood-colored Broken Sword that the spirits had seized. However, the spirits of Divine Land were exceedingly cunning. A Divine King wielded the Blood-colored Broken Sword to gravely wound the Dark Heavenly Dragon, ultimately causing their campaign to end in failure.
"I accept your request. This Sumeru Dark Realm... where is it located on the Dragon Hidden Continent?" Ye Yun asked.
"In the center of the Dragon Hidden Continent, deep within the sky. There is a token inside the Black Stone Treasury that will grant you entry," the Dark Divine Dragon replied.
"I understand." Ye Yun nodded.
"I am but a wisp of will, soon to dissipate," the Dark Divine Dragon said, his voice now noticeably weaker. "I am delighted that you can inherit my Black Stone Treasury. If I’m not mistaken, the affinity I feel towards you is because you also possess the Dragon God Bloodline, correct?"
It seemed the energy within this wisp of will was also beginning to wane.
"I do indeed possess the Dragon Clan’s bloodline," Ye Yun said with a sigh, looking at the Black Dragon in mid-air and giving a gentle wave.
He knew that this wisp of the Dark Divine Dragon’s will, which had persisted for millions of years, was about to vanish completely.
"I am so happy!" Joy suddenly suffused the Dark Divine Dragon’s eyes. After uttering these words, his dark form began to dissipate.
It dissipated rapidly.
In the blink of an eye, the massive dragon form vanished without a trace.
"This..." Liu Yiyi, who had witnessed everything from the side, could not suppress her profound shock.
She had never imagined such an astounding secret lay hidden within Cloud Trace Cave.
"Brother Yun, are you returning to the Cangnan Continent?" Liu Yiyi’s heart tightened as she recalled the Dark Divine Dragon’s final request, and she asked hurriedly.
"I do need to make a trip back." Ye Yun nodded gently, turned, and smiled at her.
Various clues still lay hidden on the Cangnan Continent, and the three juniors of the Dragon God Sect had yet to fully mature. Coupled with the Dark Divine Dragon’s entrustment, he had to return, no matter what.
Liu Yiyi’s face turned pale with fright. "Brother Yun," she exclaimed, "the Cangnan Continent has a terrifying curse! If you go back, your cultivation base will be forever stagnant at your current realm!"
"Don’t worry," Ye Yun shrugged, offering a light smile. "I possess the Dragon Clan’s bloodline; that kind of curse is useless against me."
"Brother Yun," Liu Yiyi sighed, "as someone from the Cangnan Continent who has been in Divine Land for a hundred years, if I were to return to the Cangnan Continent, I would be cursed. My cultivation base would be unable to advance for the rest of my life. Therefore, I cannot accompany you there."
Back then, when she first learned this news, it was like a bolt from the blue.
People from Divine Land were only immune to the curse for a hundred years.
Once she broke through to the True God realm, she lost her eligibility to return to the Cangnan Continent.
"You don’t need to go. The spiritual energy in Divine Land contains Divine Nature. It’s better for you to stay in the Daluo Region and cultivate in seclusion. Perhaps I’ll come to see you sometime." Ye Yun reached out and gently stroked her soft, beautiful face.
He didn’t tell Liu Yiyi the secret of the curse. Because Ye Yun believed that since Liu Yiyi was on the verge of breaking through to the Divine Sovereign Realm, it was better for her to remain and cultivate at the Jianyun Sect in the Daluo Region. For an expert at the Half-step Divine Sovereign Realm who had cultivated for a hundred thousand years, a decade or even a century of secluded cultivation would pass in the blink of an eye. By that time, Ye Yun would have already nurtured the three juniors of the Dragon God Sect. Simultaneously, he would have largely unraveled the plots of the masterminds operating on the Cangnan Continent.

chapters.title: Chapter 445
chapters.content:
Chapter 445: 445
After communicating with Liu Yiyi, Ye Yun turned around and cast a strand of his Divine Sense into the Black Stone Treasury. Upon seeing the various heavenly and earthly treasures within, he couldn’t help but nod inwardly.
Indeed, this Dark Divine Dragon had built quite a collection.
However, time had taken its toll, with some of the treasures already decayed.
Despite this, the treasures in the Black Stone Treasury were still awe-inspiring.
Of course, none of these items caught Ye Yun’s interest.
However, they could be added to the Dragon God Sect’s Treasure Pavilion.
With a wave of his hand, Ye Yun collected the entire Black Stone Treasury.
"Brother Yun, should we go back now?" Liu Yiyi asked quietly, a hint of reluctance still in her water-like beautiful eyes. However, having cultivated for a hundred thousand years, Liu Yiyi’s Dao Heart was firm, and that trace of reluctance quickly vanished.
"Let’s not rush," Ye Yun said thoughtfully, looking around. "There’s something odd about this Cloud Mark Cave. We should explore a bit."
The bodies of the six Immortal honoring practitioners he had previously killed were still around, unmoved. However, for some reason, Ye Yun found that the energy from the flesh and blood on the corpses of these God King Level Cultivators seemed to have diminished slightly.
Upon hearing Ye Yun’s words, Liu Yiyi felt a chill run down her spine.
It seemed as if within this Cloud Mark Cave, an invisible pair of eyes were watching her.
Ye Yun walked over to Skyfire God Honored’s corpse and carefully sensed it. After some investigation, he confirmed that there was indeed a slight loss of flesh-and-blood energy.
It should be known... all of these were cultivators of the Divine Sovereign Realm, with powerful physiques. Even in death, their bodies contained potent energy.
If left within the Cloud Mark Cave, they wouldn’t decay for at least ten thousand years. Yet, just now, right under his nose, each corpse had lost a bit of its flesh-and-blood energy.
"Will you come out on your own, or must I drag you out?" Ye Yun suddenly spoke, his gaze sweeping the surrounding void, his tone calm.
Silence reigned, with no apparent response to Ye Yun’s words.
"Very well, then I’ll drag you out." A mysterious smile touched the corners of Ye Yun’s lips.
He had just mastered a peerless Divine Skill, perfect for this situation.
"Thousand Threads!" Ye Yun formed hand seals and let out a low cry.
At that moment, a silver sphere of light, about ten feet across, ignited behind him, radiating a dazzling brilliance.
SWISH! SWISH!
The silver sphere of light spun continuously, shooting out countless silver threads, fine as hair. The number of silver threads was incalculable, immeasurable. Endlessly, the silver threads extended, searching in every direction of the Cloud Mark Cave.
"What kind of Divine Skill is this?" Liu Yiyi stared, wide-eyed, at the silver threads that filled the sky, an indescribable shock in her heart.
Those silver threads gave her an extremely strange and terrifying feeling, as if contact would mean being instantly sliced apart.
The unending threads continued to expand into the depths of the Cloud Mark Cave. Whether in the void, on the ground, across mountains and rivers, or even deep underground, silver threads were now everywhere. These silver threads, as if alive, searched tirelessly.
Ye Yun watched all this with a faint smile. This Thousand Threads Divine Skill originated from a powerful being in a certain dimensional universe, a self-created Divine Skill. When that powerful being unleashed this technique, the entire universe would fill with silver threads, and no life form could hide from them. Although each thread was as fine and soft as a strand of hair, it was incredibly sharp, comparable to a God level Divine Weapon. These threads could not only cut but also entwine. Once targeted, escape would be exceedingly difficult.
In that universe, the mere mention of Thousand Threads would evoke immense terror.
SWISHING...
The overwhelming silver threads increasingly saturated every part of the Cloud Mark Cave.
Suddenly, a streak of white light shot out violently from the ground, flying at high speed, constantly evading the pursuit of the silver threads.
Seeing that strange thing emerge, Ye Yun couldn’t help but sneer. His Hand Seal shifted slightly, and silver threads from all other directions converged on the peculiar object.
The ball of white light darted left and right in the air, flying at high speed, but the countless silver threads moved ever faster, relentlessly pursuing it.
Soon, every inch of space within the Cloud Mark Cave was permeated with silver threads, and the ball of white light finally had nowhere to hide.
"Stop!" A furious roar, tinged with a childlike quality, suddenly erupted from within the white light.
Ye Yun was momentarily stunned.
The silver threads instantly halted in mid-air, forming an encirclement that sealed off the white light from every direction.
The ball of white light also stopped, its radiance fading to reveal a youth dressed in white.
"Aren’t you going too far, Your Excellency?" the white-robed youth stared coldly at Ye Yun, his eyes blazing with boundless fury. "You entered my Cloud Mark Cave, took the Black Stone Treasury, and now you want to silence me by killing me?"
The aura emanating from him suddenly became incredibly powerful, skyrocketing from the Ninth Level of God-Honor Realm all the way to the Divine King Realm!
A vast pressure, as if countless towering mountains were crashing down, descended. Liu Yiyi grunted, her body swaying, finding it hard to withstand. A red light flashed, and the Red Tassel Battle Armor suddenly appeared, making her feel somewhat relieved.
Ye Yun, however, felt nothing. The aura of a Divine King Realm expert posed no threat to him.
"Divine King Realm? Who exactly are you?" Ye Yun’s eyes narrowed slightly as he asked coldly.
In the Divine Land, anyone capable of cultivating to the Divine King Realm was an extraordinary figure. Could this be one of the masterminds?
"Since you know I’m at the Divine King Realm, why haven’t you surrendered?" The white-robed youth declared with a cold, aloof expression, looking down on them with an air of superiority.
"So what if you’re at the Divine King Realm?" Seeing the white-robed youth still daring to threaten him, a spark of anger flared in Ye Yun’s heart.
The Thousand Threads Divine Skill activated once more.
SWISH! SWISH!
Countless silver threads, like innumerable sharp swords, stabbed towards the white-robed youth from all directions.
The white-robed youth’s expression changed drastically. He once again transformed into a streak of light and fled in another direction.
This fellow... why does he only know how to run?
As Ye Yun watched the white-robed youth, a flash of insight struck him.
Could it be that this guy is bluffing?
Thinking this, Ye Yun fiercely intensified the Thousand Threads Divine Skill. Innumerable silver threads, like an overwhelming tide, blocked every escape route, completely surrounding the ball of white light.
The encirclement shrank rapidly.
Facing the silver threads from every conceivable angle, the ball of white light could no longer find any path to break through.
WHOOSH...
The endless silver threads, with irresistible force, instantly enveloped the ball of white light. The silver threads didn’t cut but instead tightly bound the light, finally forming a large silver cocoon in mid-air.

chapters.title: Chapter 446: Immortal Divine Silkworm
chapters.content:
Chapter 446: Chapter 446: Immortal Divine Silkworm
HISS!
HISS!
After the silver threads formed a giant silver cocoon, the remaining threads retreated like an ebbing tide, returning to the silver sphere of light behind Ye Yun.
"What a terrifying Divine Skill," Liu Yiyi observed, looking at the sphere of light behind Ye Yun with astonishment. She felt a strong urge to reach out and touch it.
"Would you like to learn it, Yiyi?" Ye Yun asked, amused by Liu Yiyi’s stunned expression.
"I think I’ll pass, Brother Yun. I’ve devoted my life to the Sword Dao, and the Binary Sword Chant is enough for me to comprehend for many years," Liu Yiyi replied, shaking her head with a smile.
Ye Yun nodded. Her response was as he had expected.
For the past hundred thousand years, Liu Yiyi had been devoted to the cultivation of the Sword Dao. She probably wasn’t interested in a powerful Divine Skill like ’Thousand Threads’.
With a grasping motion of his hand, Ye Yun brought the distant silver cocoon closer.
"Brother Yun, this Divine King Realm creature – it seems to fear your skill, doesn’t it?" Liu Yiyi laughed softly.
"It isn’t actually at the Divine King Realm. It was merely pretending," Ye Yun said, shaking his head with a smile. Looking at the silver cocoon, he continued, "You, what on earth are you? To think you can release the Super Divine Dragon Breath of the Divine King Realm! Confess quickly, or suffer the consequences."
There was silence within the silver cocoon.
"No tears until you see the coffin!" Ye Yun sneered. Suddenly, a silver thread shot out from the silver cocoon, cutting towards the glowing mass within.
"Senior, please stop!" a plea for mercy came from within the silver cocoon.
The silver thread, poised to cut, stopped abruptly.
"Reveal your true form. Let me see... what you really are," Ye Yun said with a light smile, a look of keen interest on his face.
"Alright, Senior, I have returned to my original form," another voice came from within the silver cocoon.
HISS...
Like an ebbing tide, countless silver threads retreated into the silver sphere of light behind Ye Yun. The enormous silver cocoon disappeared instantly.
Before Ye Yun floated a white silkworm, about a meter long.
This white silkworm had many archaic patterns on its surface, exuding an ancient Super Divine Dragon Breath.
"It’s actually a white silkworm?" Liu Yiyi exclaimed, her beautiful eyes wide with shock.
That such a small white silkworm could release a convincing Super Divine Dragon Breath of the Divine King Realm was simply unbelievable.
She had lived in the Divine Land for nearly a hundred thousand years and had never heard of such a demon beast.
"Senior, I’m actually very weak. I was just trying to scare you earlier," the white silkworm said, looking at Ye Yun in terror, an awkward laugh escaping it.
You look very familiar...
Ye Yun mused as he sized up this white silkworm. He suddenly remembered that he seemed to have a white silkworm in his warehouse.
However, the bloodline and level of that white silkworm far surpassed this one before him.
What’s it called?
Ye Yun stroked his chin, trying to recall.
There were so many Divine Pets in his warehouse that he couldn’t recall all their names.
"Senior, you must be joking. How could you have possibly seen me before?" the white silkworm said, its voice tinged with terror.
"I remember now!" Ye Yun suddenly snapped his fingers, laughed, and said, "You’re the Immortal Divine Silkworm, right?"
"Senior, how did you know?" As soon as the white silkworm heard Ye Yun call its name, it was immediately startled, its small eyes darting around nervously.
"You’re quite famous." Ye Yun seemed to recall something. He suddenly reached out, grabbed the white silkworm, and tossed it into the warehouse.
At the same time, a strand of Ye Yun’s Primordial Spirit also entered the warehouse.
"Master, you’re here! Who are you planning to take out with you this time?"
When Ye Yun’s Super Divine Dragon Breath manifested, the Divine Pets in the warehouse erupted in excitement once more.
"There’s a small matter this time. Quickly, find the Immortal Divine Silkworm for me," Ye Yun said with a smile as he observed the dark surroundings of the warehouse, which were suddenly illuminated by one flash of brilliant light after another.
"So, Master is looking for that little critter. Just a moment, I’ll call it over," a Divine Pet said with a laugh, then vanished in the blink of an eye.
What kind of place is this?
The white silkworm lay on the ground, not daring to move a muscle. At this moment, it felt as if it were about to die.
This place was filled with all kinds of terrifying demon beasts, each radiating various Super Divine Dragon Breaths that made it feel suffocated. It feared it would die of fright if it remained here even a second longer.
"Master, the little critter is here."
Like a whirlwind, the Divine Pet landed abruptly on the ground, then gently placed a small, white bug beside Ye Yun.
GASP!
Before Ye Yun could speak, the captured white silkworm gasped sharply, staring in shock at the small, white bug.
The little white bug looked almost identical to it.
It was also an Immortal Divine Silkworm!
However, the noble Super Divine Dragon Breath and the sheer power of the bloodline exuded by this other Immortal Divine Silkworm far surpassed its own.
At this moment, it felt a profound bloodline suppression, and simultaneously, the racial memories within its bloodline awakened.
"This subordinate pays respect to the Silkworm Emperor." This white silkworm suddenly trembled and prostrated itself on the ground, much like a human would.
Ye Yun couldn’t help but click his tongue in amazement at this sight.
"Master, where did you get this avatar of my clan member?" the Immortal Divine Silkworm from Ye Yun’s warehouse asked in surprise, lifting its plump upper body and turning its head towards Ye Yun.
"I stumbled upon it in a grotto-heaven outside," Ye Yun replied casually. Then, as if realizing something, he asked, "You mean, this is only one of its avatars?"
"Yes, Master, this is just one of its avatars," the Immortal Divine Silkworm confirmed, nodding.
"It seems its main body is still within the Cloud Mark Cave," Ye Yun remarked casually.
To think I misjudged this time,
he then mused.
I only caught an avatar and failed to find the Immortal Divine Silkworm’s main body.
"Master, do you want me to go out and help you find its main body?" the Immortal Divine Silkworm asked, its eyes glinting with eagerness.
It was desperate to get out and away from the terrifying demon beasts in this warehouse.
"You can’t go out yet," Ye Yun said, shaking his head and promptly refusing.
If he remembered correctly, the Immortal Divine Silkworm in his warehouse was an Immortal Level demon beast.
Demon beasts of that level simply did not exist in the world he was currently in.
Its appearance would provoke a violent reaction from this world’s Heavenly Dao, leading to unimaginable catastrophe.
"Silkworm Emperor, so this Senior is your Master!" the white silkworm prostrating on the ground suddenly lifted its head and exclaimed in utter shock.
"What nonsense are you spouting?" the Immortal Divine Silkworm lowered its head and snapped.

chapters.title: Chapter 447
chapters.content:
Chapter 447: 447
"Master, the bloodline of this clansman of mine is incredibly thin, and it has experienced death many times."
The Immortal Divine Silkworm remarked with a sigh after observing the white silkworm.
Ye Yun nodded silently.
Although the Immortal Divine Silkworm in the Cloud Mark Cave in the Divine Land was of the same species, it simply wasn’t comparable to the one in his warehouse.
Its bloodline was extremely weak.
It had long fallen out of the category of Immortal Level demon beasts.
That was why this particular Immortal Divine Silkworm could live inside the Cloud Mark Cave of the Divine Land.
"Are you saying it has lived for a long time?"
Moved, Ye Yun turned to the Immortal Divine Silkworm and asked.
"It should have, Master. Please wait a moment; let me see just how many times it has died."
The Immortal Divine Silkworm moved beside the white silkworm, its antenna cautiously touching the white silkworm’s antenna.
As their antennae met, the Immortal Divine Silkworm closed its eyes.
The white silkworm didn’t dare to move a muscle.
"Ah, truly enviable! You Immortal Divine Silkworms are virtually Eternal Life Forms. Once your life ends, you can be reborn after consuming a certain amount of energy."
A nearby divine pet, its form a hazy black silhouette, let out an envious sigh.
"What’s there to envy? It’s not the only eternal demonic beast here," another divine pet retorted disdainfully.
Listening to the divine pets’ conversation, Ye Yun gradually recalled certain memories.
The Immortal Divine Silkworm, known as an Immortal Level demon beast, was also considered an Eternal Life Form, possessing an incredibly long and ancient lifespan.
Before death, as long as it consumed the energy stored in its body and spun a cocoon, it could live a new life after a lengthy incubation period.
However, only Immortal Divine Silkworms with the purest bloodlines could retain memories from their previous lives.
As for other Immortal Divine Silkworms, they would lose most of their memories.
The more diluted the bloodline, the more memories it would lose, and likewise, the fewer times it could die and be reborn.
"Sirs, I’m not as strong as you imagine!" the Immortal Divine Silkworm suddenly said, opening its eyes and looking around fearfully, its tone humble.
HAHAHA... A roar of laughter instantly erupted from the surroundings.
It seemed those terrifying demonic beasts were quite satisfied with the Immortal Divine Silkworm’s humble demeanor.
After all, they were much stronger than it.
There’s always a higher mountain; here, no divine pet could afford to be too arrogant.
"Master, this Immortal Divine Silkworm has lived for approximately an era and has experienced death nine times. It’s currently on its ninth life. If it dies again, it won’t be able to be reborn," the Immortal Divine Silkworm said very seriously.
"Lived for an era?"
Ye Yun’s heart skipped a beat; he was extremely shocked.
In the world of the Divine Land, to live for an era is an unbelievably long time. Its lifespan is even more ancient than that of a Divine Dragon. It has witnessed the rise and fall of this world across hundreds of millions of years...
It’s a pity, though. This Immortal Divine Silkworm has a diluted bloodline and has already died nine times. It probably doesn’t remember much.
"Great Silkworm Emperor, please save me!"
Hearing the Immortal Divine Silkworm’s words, the white silkworm seemed to realize something. As if grasping a final lifeline, it began to kowtow repeatedly on the ground.
It had lived for an extraordinarily long time. Due to its diluted bloodline, it had only nine chances at rebirth, all of which it had already used up.
It had lost all hope, only wishing to live out its current life safely and soundly.
Unexpectedly, in its despair, it encountered the Silkworm Emperor of its own kind.
If the Silkworm Emperor spared just a drop of its blood, the white silkworm could gain one more chance at rebirth.
If it had the opportunity to follow the Silkworm Emperor and perform well, it could earn even more chances to be reborn.
Having lived for such a long time, although many memories had vanished, the opportunistic creature did not give up on this excellent chance before it.
"Master, should I save it?" the Immortal Divine Silkworm asked Ye Yun earnestly.
"If it is willing to submit to me, you can give it a chance," Ye Yun said with a gentle smile.
He wanted to take in this Immortal Divine Silkworm because he realized something. This little creature had lived for such a long time; even if many memories were lost, it might recall something useful eventually. That would be very important to him. Perhaps this Immortal Divine Silkworm knew the origin of the Seven Stars. It might even provide some useful information later about the Blood-colored Broken Sword sealed by the Ancestor Dragon.
Upon hearing Ye Yun’s words, the white silkworm immediately scrambled to Ye Yun’s feet, kowtowing constantly and exclaiming loudly, "Thank you, Master! I am willing to submit to you and will brave any danger without hesitation!"
"Get up."
Seeing that the white silkworm’s attitude was acceptable, Ye Yun waved his hand gently, signifying his acceptance of the creature’s submission.
"You little creature, follow the Master dutifully from now on. If you displease the Master, I won’t give you another chance at rebirth," the Immortal Divine Silkworm threatened the white silkworm fiercely.
"Silkworm Emperor, rest assured. I am one of your subjects; how could I possibly do such a thing?" the white silkworm said quickly, a look of grievance in its eyes.
Since even their Silkworm Emperor was this white-robed Master’s Divine Pet, how could this Immortal Divine Silkworm, with its diluted bloodline, dare to harbor any rebellious thoughts?
"Alright, let’s go out first," Ye Yun said, waving at the divine pets in the warehouse. Taking the white silkworm with him, he instantly left the warehouse and reappeared inside the Cloud Mark Cave.
Liu Yiyi waited quietly.
She knew Brother Yun had some secrets, but she wasn’t curious. As Brother Yun’s woman, Liu Yiyi knew what was appropriate.
"Go and retrieve your main body," Ye Yun said calmly, tossing the white silkworm in his hand into the air.
"Okay, Master!" the Immortal Divine Silkworm replied obediently, then turned into a beam of light and vanished into mid-air.
The entirety of Cloud Mark Cave suddenly fluctuated violently, and many white orbs of light appeared in various places.
"This little fellow has quite a few doppelgangers," Ye Yun commented with a chuckle.
The ability to create doppelgangers was one of the Immortal Divine Silkworm’s Innate Divine Abilities.
Among all these doppelgangers, one of them had to be its main body.
All its doppelgangers and its main body fused, transforming into a white Giant Silkworm tens of meters long. It came whistling from a distance and landed at Ye Yun’s feet.
A burst of white light flashed.
The massive body instantly shrank to about a meter in size.
"Master, I’m here. All the doppelgangers have fused with the main body. Please take me away from this Cloud Mark Cave," the Immortal Divine Silkworm said with a laugh, its voice filled with yearning for the outside world.
Ye Yun’s expression shifted slightly. He asked, "How much of your past lives’ memories do you still recall?"
"Reporting to Master, I only remember my first master was called Cloud Trace Taoist; he was the creator of the Cloud Mark Cave. From my first life to my ninth, it seems I’ve always hidden here, feeding on the energy of creatures that perished," the Immortal Divine Silkworm replied honestly.
"HMM."
Ye Yun nodded. In an instant, he activated his Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye and scanned the Immortal Divine Silkworm’s memories. He found its sea of consciousness to be empty, almost desolate.
Although all of this Immortal Divine Silkworm’s memories have supposedly vanished, some parts must be hidden within its bloodline. As this ninth-life body matures, some memories should gradually awaken,
Ye Yun mused to himself.
With this thought, he was no longer anxious.
Acquiring an ancient demon beast that had lived for an epoch was a huge gain from his journey to the Divine Land.

chapters.title: Chapter 448: Sumeru Dark Realm, Nowhere to be Found
chapters.content:
Chapter 448: Chapter 448: Sumeru Dark Realm, Nowhere to be Found
"Master, these bodies of the Immortal honoring practitioners... You don’t need them, right?"
After glancing at Ye Yun, the Immortal Divine Silkworm hesitated and spoke.
"They’re of no use to me. You can take all this blood and flesh."
Ye Yun smiled lightly.
This little guy’s cultivation base was not high, only at the Divine Monarch Realm, so it was no match at all for the six Immortal honoring practitioners. Since its ninth reincarnation, it had been guarding these six living people for who knows how long; it must have been starving by now.
So after Ye Yun killed the six Immortal honoring practitioners, this little fellow became somewhat impatient and sent out a clone to secretly absorb some of the energy from the flesh and blood. Although very covert, it was still discovered by Ye Yun. That was what led to the subsequent events.
If the Immortal Divine Silkworm hadn’t been so impatient, Ye Yun would have indeed had a hard time discovering it.
"Thank you, Master!"
The Immortal Divine Silkworm called out excitedly. It spat out a few silver threads from its mouth, shooting towards the six bodies, wrapping them and then pulling them back. Its upper body suddenly enlarged, and it opened its massive mouth to swallow all the bodies into its stomach.
Ye Yun silently nodded.
The bodies of these six Immortal honoring practitioners were a great supplement for the Immortal Divine Silkworm, which would ensure it wouldn’t lack energy for a long time.
After feasting, the Immortal Divine Silkworm shrank back to a size of one meter and obediently lay next to Ye Yun.
Liu Yiyi also watched with fascination from the side.
The origins of this Immortal Divine Silkworm were very mysterious. Brother Yun hadn’t told her, and she hadn’t thought to ask either.
This time, Ye Yun was about to leave the Divine Land and return to Cangnan Continent. Liu Yiyi made up her mind to seclude herself for a hundred years and make a qualitative breakthrough in the Binary Sword Chant.
"Let’s go!"
Ye Yun took Liu Yiyi’s hand and flew towards the entrance of the Cloud Mark Cave. The Immortal Divine Silkworm followed closely.
After leaving the Cloud Mark Cave, Ye Yun tore the void open and quickly returned to the Jianyun Sect.
"Yiyi, focus on your cultivation. It won’t take a hundred years; I’ll come back for you."
Ye Yun held Liu Yiyi’s hand and spoke affectionately.
"Brother Yun, rest assured, I will work hard in my cultivation."
Liu Yiyi spoke with determination.
"Good."
Ye Yun smiled, his heart greatly comforted.
Liu Yiyi, with her Sword Infatuation, was fully concentrated. Once she began her closed-door cultivation, a hundred years would pass in the blink of an eye, so he had no need to worry about her.
In the Bamboo Building at the back mountain, Ye Yun stayed with Liu Yiyi for another half a day, then went to the Ninth Courtyard.
"Little Dragon, come out!"
Ye Yun called out softly at the door.
"I’m coming, Master!"
Hearing Ye Yun’s voice, the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon was overjoyed, immediately rushed out the door, and appeared before Ye Yun.
When it saw a white silkworm floating next to Ye Yun, it paused for a moment. After sensing the other’s cultivation base, the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon’s face instantly turned green.
Another inscrutable demon beast, much more powerful than him.
"This is the Immortal Divine Silkworm, and this is the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon. From now on, you are both demon beasts of my Dragon God Sect," Ye Yun said softly, introducing them to each other.
Immortal Divine Silkworm?
After listening to the Master’s words, the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon was shocked.
Just hearing the name was terrifying. Could it be a truly immortal, terrifying Divine Beast?
After a few seconds of shock, the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon smiled awkwardly and greeted politely, "Nice to meet you, Senior!"
"No need to be so polite."
The Immortal Divine Silkworm also nodded humbly in response.
"Alright, let’s return to Cangnan Continent now."
Ye Yun smiled lightly, immediately ripped open space, and took the two demon beasts away from the Jianyun Sect.
After passing through the Ancient Road to Heaven, Ye Yun returned to the Cangnan Continent once again. He floated over the ocean outside this "colossal sea island." Gazing at the azure sea and inhaling the familiar scent, Ye Yun took a deep breath, feeling an indescribable comfort in his heart.
Although the Divine Land was great, with its Spiritual Energy rich in Divine Nature, the Cangnan Continent, after all, was his hometown. Every time he returned, he experienced profound sentiments.
"Master, this world’s Spiritual Energy does not contain any Divine Nature?" the Immortal Divine Silkworm said in shock.
"Yes, this is the Cangnan Continent. The Spiritual Energy here is just like this," Ye Yun nodded and said.
The Immortal Divine Silkworm stopped speaking upon hearing this, its two antennae continuously probing the air for something.
"Master, there seems to be something strange about this place?" the Immortal Divine Silkworm suddenly said.
"What have you found?" Ye Yun asked with interest.
This Immortal Divine Silkworm, although its lineage was very diluted, traced back to an ancestor of an Immortal Level demon beast. It possessed some Innate Divine Abilities and was not to be underestimated.
The Immortal Divine Silkworm solemnly said, "I can’t be certain right now, but it seems like there is a dreadful aura coming from a certain place deep underground."
"Hmm!" Ye Yun nodded.
The Immortal Divine Silkworm’s words were definitely not baseless; there was likely some truth to them.
"Don’t move. I need to examine your body first," Ye Yun suddenly said.
"Oh..."
The Immortal Divine Silkworm immediately floated mid-air, not daring to move a muscle.
It had already surrendered to this white-robed Master from the depths of its soul.
Ye Yun’s Divine Sense entered the Immortal Divine Silkworm’s body. After a careful search, he did not find the Ancestral Dragon’s Curse.
It seemed the Ancestral Dragon’s Curse hadn’t affected the Immortal Divine Silkworm.
Ye Yun found this remarkable and was also somewhat puzzled.
Could it be... Did the Ancestor Dragon only curse the spiritual cultivators of the Divine Land? Or was it that the Immortal Divine Silkworm’s bloodline didn’t attract the attention of the Ancestral Dragon’s Curse?
All of these were possibilities. However, Ye Yun planned to first visit the Sumeru Dark Realm.
The Sumeru Dark Realm was the world where the Dark Dragon Clan resided in Ancient Times. It was hidden deep within the skies in the heart of the Cangnan Continent and had never materialized in the human world.
Ye Yun was also curious and wanted to see what it was like inside. At the same time, if the Dark Divine Dragon’s younger brother was still alive, he intended to rescue him from his imprisonment.
Once again tearing through the void, Ye Yun arrived at a central region of the Cangnan Continent. He stayed deep in the void, sensing the surrounding space, but he did not detect any trace of a small world’s presence. So, he took out a Token, and after infusing his Mana into it, Ye Yun tried to find the Sumeru Dark Realm in the void. However, the depths of space were utterly empty; there wasn’t even a ghostly trace of the Sumeru Dark Realm.
Ye Yun did not lose heart.
This was because the current Cangnan Continent’s area had shrunk countless times compared to the Dragon Hidden Continent of Ancient Times. Perhaps its central point had already undergone some kind of change, and the Sumeru Dark Realm had shifted its location.
Ye Yun continuously tore through the void, persistently searching for the Sumeru Dark Realm in locations he speculated, but to his disappointment, he did not find it.
After searching a hundred times, Ye Yun finally decided to give up.
Too much time had passed. Who knew where this Sumeru Dark Realm had drifted to? Or perhaps, it had long since been destroyed in the flames of war.
Ye Yun decided to put this matter aside for now and deal with it later. He had to return to the Nether Immortal Dynasty first to see how the little ones were doing.
After all, on this trip to the Divine Land, he had stayed for a full three months or more. This was the longest he had ever been away from the Cangnan Continent.

chapters.title: Chapter 449: Wow, Such a Big Silkworm Baby
chapters.content:
Chapter 449: Chapter 449: Wow, Such a Big Silkworm Baby
Atop a towering peak in the Nether Immortal Dynasty.
The surrounding mountain peaks were grim and forbidding.
In the distance, clouds swirled unpredictably, accompanied by a radiant glow.
At present, a large black carriage was parked atop a massive boulder.
Four fluffy little cats of different colors were lying atop the carriage, looking utterly adorable.
A robust black horse was also resting on the rock, its eyes closed as if in the midst of Cultivation.
On top of the carriage stood a small black bird, looking here and there as if searching for something.
Beside the carriage stood three youths, their extraordinary auras prominent as they stood against the wind.
These three individuals were none other than the future leading figures of the Dragon God Sect: Sect Master Luo Li, Senior Sister Su Wanyi, and Junior Brother Jun Moxiao.
Three months had passed, and all three had reached Level Two of the Nirvana Realm in their cultivation.
Jun Moxiao was even further ahead, on the verge of breaking through to the Third Level of the Nirvana Realm.
"The Old Ancestor has been away for over three months now. Why hasn’t he returned yet? I wonder how he is doing," Luo Li said, withdrawing her gaze from the distance, her expression melancholic as she lowered her head.
"Indeed. When the Old Ancestor went to the Divine Land before, he returned quickly. I wonder why he’s delayed this time. Could he have encountered some powerful spirit that’s managed to entangle him?" Su Wanyi speculated.
Jun Moxiao’s face was somewhat pale as he gazed into the distance and murmured, "Senior Sister, I have a bad feeling. I’m afraid the Old Ancestor... might not return this time."
"What nonsense are you spouting, Junior Brother!" Luo Li lifted her head, glaring at him unhappily.
"The Divine Land is teeming with spirits, and powerful experts are numerous. I’m afraid the Old Ancestor might have encountered some danger," Jun Moxiao’s face flushed crimson as he said awkwardly.
"Are you cursing the Old Ancestor to die?" Luo Li abruptly put her hands on her hips, glaring fiercely at Jun Moxiao.
"Senior Sister, please don’t misunderstand! I would never think such a thing," Jun Moxiao quickly explained.
"Junior Sister, don’t be so hard on Junior Brother. He’s still just a child," Su Wanyi gently advised from the side.
"Sigh, I know Junior Brother wouldn’t think that way," Luo Li sighed.
The Big Black Horse suddenly yawned, opened its eyes, and looked at the three youths. It chuckled, its lips twitching slightly as it said, "Young Masters, there’s no need to worry about Master. In this world, there’s no one who can even threaten him."
A hint of pride flashed in the Big Black Horse’s eyes as it finished speaking.
As a Divine Pet from the warehouse, it naturally had some understanding of Master’s foundation. Not to mention other things, just one of the terrifying Divine Pets from that warehouse—if an Immortal Level one were released—the rules of this world simply couldn’t withstand it. As far as it knew, Master possessed many such warehouses; his resources were unimaginably profound. Therefore, Master was definitely in no mortal danger. His prolonged stay in the Divine Land must be for a specific reason.
"Little Horse, you’re right. We’ll wait a bit longer then," Luo Li said with a smile.
Jun Moxiao clenched his fists, his gaze fixed on the horizon. He murmured despondently, "The Nether Immortal Ancient Land has been open for several days now, and the Old Ancestor still hasn’t returned. It looks like we’re going to miss out this time."
"The Nether Immortal Ancient Land isn’t such a great place anyway. It doesn’t matter whether we go or not," at this, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, sprawled on the carriage, lazily opened one eye and drawled.
As the Divine Dragon with the highest cultivation base in the Cangnan Continent, it too had sensed the Nether Immortal Ancient Land and detected an unsettling aura emanating from it. By using its divine skills to invade the sea of consciousness of a cultivator, it had learned more about the Nether Immortal Ancient Land. It discovered that this small world housed many bizarre creatures. Even though numerous cultivators ventured there for training, the chances of perishing were extremely high.
"The Nether Immortal Ancient Land is known as one of the Ten Great Immortal Lands. Naturally, it contains many treasures. It would indeed be a pity to miss out," Luo Li didn’t agree with the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon. On the contrary, she felt her Junior Brother Jun Moxiao’s words made a lot of sense.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon snorted, tucked its head beneath its fluffy belly, and resumed its deep slumber.
As long as these three little ones weren’t in any danger, its mission would be considered complete. That was why it had been diligently trying to prevent Luo Li and the others from entering the Nether Immortal Ancient Land.
"Luo Li is right. It seems after three months, you’ve all been cooped up in this carriage so long you’re about to grow mold!" a warm, gentle male voice suddenly drifted down from mid-air.
Upon hearing this voice, everyone, including the several demon beasts, felt a jolt of energy. They all stood up and looked towards the sky.
"The Old Ancestor is back!" Luo Li cried out, her face flushing crimson with excitement.
A gentle smile graced Su Wanyi’s beautiful face.
The void rippled, and a figure in white, resembling a celestial being from a painting, stepped out.
"Old Ancestor, you’re finally back!" Jun Moxiao exclaimed, tears streaming down his face as he spoke, his voice choked with emotion, a mix of crying and laughing.
"I’m back." Ye Yun descended from mid-air. He reached out and gently ruffled the hair of the three young members of the Dragon God Sect.
"You’ve all done well. Your cultivation hasn’t slacked; you’ve all reached Level Two of the Nirvana Realm," Ye Yun said approvingly.
"Old Ancestor, now that you’re back, you won’t be leaving again after just a few days, will you?" Jun Moxiao asked anxiously, forgetting to wipe away his tears.
"Rest assured, I won’t be leaving again anytime soon," Ye Yun chuckled, then looked towards the four little cats on the carriage.
Little Cat’s cultivation base had broken through to the First Level of the Nirvana Realm, progressing with remarkable speed. The Big Black Cat was at the Fifth Level of the Destiny Realm. There wasn’t much change in the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon; after all, breaking through each level in the Eternal Realm required a considerable amount of time. As for the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, it had no opportunity to break through on the Cangnan Continent. The Xuan bird also showed little change. Mu Qing, inside the carriage, had also advanced to the Eighth Level of the Destiny Realm. She had been stuck at the Seventh Level of the Destiny Realm for a long time, so this breakthrough was a natural progression.
"Wow, what a huge silkworm baby!" Luo Li exclaimed, snapping back to attention. She had just noticed a plump, white silkworm floating behind the Old Ancestor. It was round and utterly adorable, and in her excitement, she gasped.
Silkworm baby?
A dark line instantly appeared on the Immortal Divine Silkworm’s forehead.
I’m this old, and I’m still being called a baby?
Ye Yun chuckled.
A silkworm baby that has lived for an epoch? This little girl Luo Li is truly adorable! She almost stunned me the moment she spoke.
"Little Silkworm, this young lady is Luo Li, the current Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect whom I mentioned to you," Ye Yun said, turning with a faint smile.
What?!
This... this is the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect?
The Immortal Divine Silkworm was instantly flustered. It hurriedly flew over and prostrated itself at Luo Li’s feet.
"Immortal Divine Silkworm greets Sect Master!" it kowtowed repeatedly, its voice loud and its demeanor utterly respectful.
On the carriage, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon craned its neck, staring at the plump white silkworm, its eyes wide with utter shock.
This inconspicuous white silkworm had a higher cultivation base than it did. The white silkworm had reached the Third Level of the Divine Monarch Realm.
The Big Black Horse stared at the Immortal Divine Silkworm, its eyes widening in astonishment. "Master," it exclaimed, "you let it out?"

chapters.title: Chapter 450: Hurry Up and Become a Green Little Cat
chapters.content:
Chapter 450: Chapter 450: Hurry Up and Become a Green Little Cat
Having heard what the Big Black Horse said, Ye Yun naturally understood what was going on. He laughed meaningfully and said, "No, I encountered this in the Divine Land."
"I see. You had me startled."
The Big Black Horse displayed an exasperated expression.
"HAHA!"
Ye Yun laughed loudly.
"My Lord!"
At this moment, Mu Qing also ran out of the carriage and excitedly greeted Ye Yun.
Ye Yun nodded, signaling Mu Qing to stand aside.
"Immortal Divine Silkworm, that sounds like a strong name! What is your cultivation base? I can’t detect it."
At this moment, the three juniors of the Dragon God Sect had gathered around the Immortal Divine Silkworm, sizing it up and down ceaselessly. Luo Li even plucked up the courage to gently poke its round body twice with her jade-like finger.
"I am at the Divine Monarch Realm, Sect Master."
Having been poked by Luo Li twice, I feel like dying! I am, after all, a noble-blooded Immortal Divine Silkworm! Yet I’m being treated like a baby silkworm; this is extremely frustrating!
"My goodness! You are actually also at the Divine Monarch Realm."
Luo Li abruptly jumped back, her face showing a shocked expression. Su Wanyi and Jun Moxiao beside her were also so stunned that they were unable to speak.
The Big Black Cat, Cat Bao’er, as well as the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and Xuan Bird, were also shocked. This round and plump white silkworm was actually a great demon beast at the Divine Monarch level! It was truly inconceivable. They had never heard of this demon beast’s name before. Immortal Divine Silkworm—it sounded very strong indeed!
"Grand Ancestor, why are there so many demon beasts in the Divine Land? You brought back a demon beast at the Divine Monarch Realm after a single trip. Our Dragon God Sect is becoming stronger and stronger!" Luo Li took a deep breath, her face still flushed, and said to Ye Yun with a smile.
"HAHA... Yes! The Divine Land is indeed a good place. You all should cultivate quickly and break through to the True God Realm as soon as possible. Then, I’ll take you to see it," Ye Yun said with a laugh.
"Grand Ancestor, don’t worry! We will definitely cultivate hard and enter the True God Realm as quickly as possible!" Luo Li immediately became serious, standing straight, and solemnly said.
"Grand Ancestor, we will work hard..." Jun Moxiao and Su Wanyi also made their statements at this moment.
"You don’t need to be so serious. Just knowing this is enough. I know you won’t be lazy," Ye Yun smiled slightly. He was quite satisfied with the performance of these three youngsters over the years. After all, these three little ones had suffered for many years, constantly living on the edge of life and death while on the run. Although their lives were better now, they hadn’t become lazy. Since leaving the Ancient Moon Dynasty, they had been tirelessly cultivating.
"Hey, Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon, come over here."
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon looked at the green-robed young man, its eyes darted, and it suddenly shouted.
The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon had dealt with each other before, so the two Divine Dragons were naturally very familiar. Therefore, even though the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was currently a red little cat, the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon could still recognize it by its voice and tone.
It flew onto the carriage.
"What’s up?"
"You’re green. Quickly turn into a green little cat!" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon said with a wicked smile.
Its words immediately reached the ears of everyone nearby.
Ye Yun was slightly taken aback, not expecting the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon to already know how to jump in on the teasing.
The Big Black Horse pursed its lips, baring a set of large white teeth as it laughed silently.
The Big Black Cat covered its mouth with its paw, wanting to laugh but not daring to. After all, the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon’s cultivation realm was much higher than its own. This dragon was also highly venomous, and the Big Black Cat felt a deep, instinctual fear.
Luo Li’s attention instantly shifted from the Immortal Divine Silkworm to the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon. She giggled but said nothing, eagerly anticipating the appearance of the fifth, green little cat.
Su Wanyi smiled sweetly, an image forming in her mind of five differently-colored little cats lounging on the carriage—a picture of cuteness and warmth.
"HEHE, how fun!" Jun Moxiao couldn’t resist laughing aloud.
The Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon sensed the atmosphere around him suddenly become bizarre and unsettling, stirring feelings of unease within him.
"Why do I have to transform into a cat, Senior?" the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon asked with a mournful look on his face.
"Because that’s our Dragon God Sect’s rule! Besides, you’re green, which is perfect for completing the color set," the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon chuckled.
"Senior is right! Look at me, an esteemed Divine Dragon of the Divine Monarch Realm, haven’t I turned into a little blue cat?" The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon raised its blue, furry paw, waved it in the air with a playfully fierce gesture, and then chuckled. At that moment, it too became an ’accomplice’ to the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon.
Upon finishing its words, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon deliberately released the Divine Dragon’s Breath of its Divine Monarch Realm.
What? Even an esteemed Divine Dragon of the Divine Monarch Realm... has also turned into a little blue cat?
Sensing the powerful Divine Dragon’s Breath, waves of shock roiled in the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon’s heart, leaving him speechless. He suddenly felt as if he were in a dream, lost in some unknown world.
Ye Yun lightly tapped his finger, and a ray of light entered the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon’s body. In an instant, it transformed into a little green cat.
"When in Rome, do as the Romans do. Being multi-colored looks quite good, and you won’t attract unwanted attention," Ye Yun said with a light laugh.
At this moment, five little cats—white, black, red, green, and blue—were lounging there, a pleasing sight for the eyes. However, the green little cat, in particular, looked somewhat dazed and goofy. This was probably because the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon hadn’t yet recovered from its shock.
Upon seeing this, the Immortal Divine Silkworm was suddenly struck with terror.
Will the Master turn me into a cat as well?
"Master, do I need to transform too?" the Immortal Divine Silkworm asked, trembling.
"There’s no need; we already have a white cat. However, you can shrink your body a bit and conceal the aura of your cultivation realm so you don’t take up so much space," Ye Yun glanced at it and said.
"Okay!"
The Immortal Divine Silkworm was greatly relieved, not having expected the Master to spare it from becoming a cat. It immediately flew onto the carriage and shrank until it was only the size of a little finger. Amidst the pile of five cats, it was hardly noticeable, exceptionally low-key.
GULP... Looking at this small white insect, the Xuan Bird on the roof of the carriage swallowed.
I really want to devour this little insect! Alas, this senior is at the Divine Monarch Realm; I can only fantasize about it...
"Senior! I feel like your name sounds so majestic. Does it mean you truly won’t die?" The Big Black Cat, taking advantage of its proximity, nestled close to the Immortal Divine Silkworm. It lowered its head respectfully and asked in a hushed voice.
"I used to be immortal, but it’s hard to say now!" the Immortal Divine Silkworm sighed. "I’m still in my probationary period. I can only get a drop of the Silkworm Emperor’s blood after I pass the assessment."
Ye Yun, seeing this from the side, couldn’t help but smile.
When the Immortal Divine Silkworm spoke of being immortal, it referred to whether it could be reborn once its lifespan reached its limit.
In fact, the Immortal Divine Silkworm had many incarnations. As long as its lifespan hadn’t ended, even if most of its incarnations and its true form were destroyed, it wouldn’t die as long as one incarnation survived. That single incarnation would continue to evolve and grow, slowly taking over as the true form.
Therefore, if the Immortal Divine Silkworm truly hid some of its incarnations, trying to kill it would be as difficult as ascending to the heavens.

chapters.title: Chapter 451: The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon Submits
chapters.content:
Chapter 451: Chapter 451: The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon Submits
"It couldn’t die in the past?"
When the Immortal Divine Silkworm uttered those words, all the demon beasts on the carriage were utterly shocked.
Even the Dragon Clan, whose members lived incredibly long lives, wouldn’t dare to speak of immortality in such a way.
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon stared wide-eyed, feeling a bit uncomfortable.
Even though it only possessed a diluted Blood Fiend Demon Dragon’s Bloodline, in its heart, only the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was truly an immortal demon beast. A single drop of its blood could bring it back to life. Which of all the demon beasts in the world could do that?
And it had lived for so long, from the Ancient Era to the present, yet had never heard of a demon beast called an "Immortal Divine Silkworm." Never even heard the name.
Although the Immortal Divine Silkworm had a high cultivation base, its words seemed so unreliable that they were hard to believe.
How could a mere Immortal Divine Silkworm possibly be stronger than the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, one of the Ten Super Divine Dragons? Absolutely impossible!
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was fuming inwardly, but it still managed to maintain its composure in front of its Master.
It raised its fluffy little red paw, gently scratched the carriage twice, and said slowly, "I say, big brother, aren’t you exaggerating a bit? Immortal in the past? How is that possible? Even we of the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon Clan wouldn’t dare make such a bold claim."
"You shouldn’t call me big brother. I’m far older than you."
The Immortal Divine Silkworm glanced at the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon. Realizing it only had an Eternal Realm cultivation, the silkworm couldn’t help but scoff.
Ye Yun found this amusing and didn’t interrupt their exchange.
Luo Li and the others, who felt similarly, stood beside their Ancestor, their faces brimming with amusement as they watched the demon beasts bicker.
"What? You dare say you’re older than me? I refuse to accept that! My cultivation base may be low, but when it comes to seniority, none of you here can compare to me!" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon suddenly widened its eyes and exclaimed angrily.
"The Elder is correct," the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon interjected with a smile. "It carries the Blood Fiend Demon Dragon’s Bloodline and has only recently been reborn. Millions of years have passed from the Ancient Era until now. Even I, a Divine Dragon of the Divine Monarch Realm, am an insignificant junior compared to this Elder."
It was actually quite displeased by the Immortal Divine Silkworm’s boastful talk.
After all, both it and the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon belonged to the Dragon Clan and had known each other for a long time. Naturally, it held some disdain for this pompous Immortal Divine Silkworm that had just appeared.
The Big Black Cat gulped, finding it a bit difficult to swallow.
It looks like these two Dragon Clan Elders are going to confront the Immortal Divine Silkworm, huh? As a mere Destiny Realm kitten, I’d better stay out of it.
Little Cat also remained silent. With her even lower cultivation base, she dared to say even less.
In her eyes, even that white silkworm, barely the size of her pinky finger and so inconspicuous, possessed a genuine Divine Monarch Realm Cultivation Level.
It was a mountain she could never hope to surmount in her lifetime.
Ever since Little Cat joined the Dragon God Sect, her world had expanded immensely. She had not only encountered Eternal Realm demon beast elders but had even met Divine Dragon elders of the Divine Monarch Realm.
This greatly broadened her horizons, making her deeply feel that the path of cultivation was incredibly long. Indeed, one couldn’t truly be said to be cultivating until reaching the True God Realm.
The Immortal Divine Silkworm, seeing that the small red and blue cat-like creatures seemed to doubt its words, said slowly and deliberately, "What dragon is this Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon? I’ve never heard of it."
"What? You’ve never even heard of the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, one of the Ten Super Divine Dragons?" The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon nearly leaped up, exclaiming furiously.
This was simply outrageous! In the Ancient Era, how majestic and powerful were the Ten Super Divine Dragons? Even the Spirits of the Divine Land had to make way for them. Within the Divine Land, there were likely few Divine King Realm Cultivators who could threaten the Ten Super Divine Dragons. If the Ten Super Divine Dragons hadn’t suffered from internal strife, how could those cunning Spirits of the Divine Land have found an opportunity to exploit?
"Brother, don’t get so agitated," the Immortal Divine Silkworm sighed. "I’m telling the truth. I really have never heard of the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon."
Due to its impure bloodline and having been reborn nine times, it had forgotten most of its past. Perhaps it had heard of the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon in a previous life, but it had long since forgotten. In the presence of its Master, it couldn’t lie, so it could only speak the truth.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon narrowed its eyes and said faintly, a hint of indescribable mockery in its tone, "You claim to be a mighty Divine Monarch Realm demon beast that has lived for so long, yet you don’t even know of the Ten Super Divine Dragons from the Ancient Era? I question your supposed longevity."
Seeing the unfriendly tone of the small blue, Divine Monarch Realm cat-like creature, the Immortal Divine Silkworm felt a little wronged, but it didn’t lash out in front of Ye Yun.
"I really have lived for a very long time, perhaps an entire epoch," the Immortal Divine Silkworm sighed deeply. "But because I’ve been reborn so many times, I remember almost nothing now."
"HMM!" Ye Yun interjected from the side, "I can confirm this. Little Silkworm has indeed lived for an epoch. Many of its memories have vanished with its rebirths."
"What? It lived for an epoch?"
All the demon beasts in the carriage were utterly shocked.
If the Immortal Divine Silkworm itself had said this, they would surely have scoffed. But now that even their Master had vouched for it, it meant this plump little creature truly had lived for an epoch!
"How terrifying! To have lived for so long!" Luo Li gulped, her eyes wide with disbelief. She had lived for little more than a decade at most. Compared to this silkworm that had lived for an epoch, there was simply no comparison.
HISS!
The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon finally processed this and gasped sharply.
Lived for an epoch! What kind of incredible demon beast was this? Why had it never heard of such a thing?
Their Dragon Clan had long lifespans, but none had a history stretching for an entire epoch.
"You are truly an Elder! This junior was offensive earlier and begs your forgiveness." The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon prostrated itself, speaking with utmost respect. Whether in terms of cultivation base or seniority, it was defeated. The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was thoroughly convinced and yielded sincerely.
"Greetings, Elder Immortal Divine Silkworm." The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon also prostrated itself on the carriage, offering a respectful greeting.
"Greetings, Elder..." Seeing this, the Big Black Cat and Little Cat also hurriedly offered respectful greetings. Then the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon and the Xuan Bird followed suit.
"There’s no need for such courtesy," the Immortal Divine Silkworm sighed, releasing a wave of mana to gently nudge the demon beasts upwards. "Although I’ve lived a long time, I’ve forgotten everything from the past. It’s as if I’ve lived in vain."
"Alright," Ye Yun said with a smile from the side. "You all belong to the Dragon God Sect. Just show Little Silkworm the respect it deserves. There’s no need to be so overly formal in your future interactions."
"I understand, Master!" The Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon was the first to affirm.
The other demon beasts also quickly agreed.
No wonder it’s lived so long, being the descendant of an Immortal Level demon beast...
The Big Black Horse mumbled enviously to itself, its words indistinct.
