chapters.title: Chapter 452 Su Family, Seven-Color Seal
chapters.content:
Chapter 452: Chapter 452 Su Family, Seven-Color Seal
"Miss, we’re not far from the Nether Immortal Ancient Land."
「Over the skies of the Nether Immortal Dynasty.」
A large celestial boat flickered and then vanished in the sky.
About twenty to thirty people stood on the celestial boat. Most of them were young. Among them, a girl in colorful clothes, beautiful as a painting, stood in the middle of the crowd, like the moon surrounded by stars.
"This time, we must find the Divine Element Longevity Fruit for our ancestor!" the girl in colorful clothes declared, clenching her small fists, her voice firm with resolve.
Although she was young, her cultivation base was not low, having already reached Heavenly Fate Realm Level Nine. Among the people beside her, there was only one middle-aged man at the Life and Death Realm.
"Miss, with you leading the way, we will surely find the Divine Element Longevity Fruit to extend the ancestor’s life," the middle-aged man said.
The girl in colorful clothes turned to the middle-aged man, her face full of gratitude. "Uncle Li, you are not a member of my Su family, yet this time, for the sake of our ancestor, you are risking your life to accompany me to the Nether Immortal Ancient Land. I truly don’t know how to thank you."
"Please, Miss, don’t say that," the middle-aged man replied passionately. "The ancestor has also shown me great kindness. If my life can be exchanged for the Divine Element Longevity Fruit, it is a worthy sacrifice."
"Sigh..."
The girl in colorful clothes sighed, at a loss for words.
The Nether Immortal Ancient Land was one of the Ten Great Immortal Lands of the entire Cangnan Continent. This miniature world permitted all cultivators to enter, with the exception of those at the Eternal Realm. However, cultivators with cultivation too weak would merely serve as cannon fodder if they entered. Generally, one needed to be at least in the Nirvana Realm to enter. The three qualifying Major Realms were: the Nirvana Realm, the Destiny Realm, and the Life and Death Realm.
However, the higher the cultivation base, the greater the risk. For some unknown reason, cultivators with higher cultivation bases were more likely to be attacked by strange creatures upon entering the Nether Immortal Ancient Land, and very few managed to emerge alive. Therefore, cultivators of the Life and Death Realm rarely entered the Nether Immortal Ancient Land without a special reason. Most who ventured in were from the Nirvana Realm or the Destiny Realm.
This time, she had brought many cultivators from her family who were in the Nirvana Realm and Destiny Realm, forming a powerful force. She was determined to obtain the Divine Element Longevity Fruit.
Their Su family was not from the Nether Immortal Dynasty but from the neighboring Jiangchuan Dynasty. The Jiangchuan Dynasty was slightly weaker than the Nether Immortal Dynasty, but it also harbored a Supreme Major Sect. The two dynasties coexisted peacefully and harmoniously.
The celestial boat sped onward.
Suddenly, the girl in colorful clothes noticed a black carriage parked atop a distant mountain peak, with a few people standing beside it. She was not particularly interested in the people. Rather, it was the row of adorable, variously colored kittens lounging on the carriage that instantly caught her attention.
"Such cute kittens!" the girl in colorful clothes exclaimed, a spark of excitement flashing in her eyes.
"Miss, would you like me to go down and ask for one for you?" a young cultivator from the Destiny Realm asked with a smile.
"Let’s go take a look," the girl in colorful clothes said with a smile, instructing those beside her.
The celestial boat quickly flew towards the mountain peak.
Meanwhile, Ye Yun had also noticed the celestial boat. When he saw the seven-color mark on the forehead of the girl in colorful clothes, he froze for a moment, a flicker of recollection in his eyes.
Su Qi!
A name suddenly surfaced in Ye Yun’s mind.
One hundred thousand years ago, when Ye Yun was the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, he had accepted four disciples. The eldest disciple was named Su Qi. Su Qi was considerably older than Ye Yun. Back then, the two had made a bet. Su Qi lost to Ye Yun and subsequently pledged himself as Ye Yun’s disciple.
Before joining the Dragon God Sect, Su Qi already had a family. The Su family had always passed down its lineage through a single heir in each generation. This was especially true for their Seven-colour Seal Magic, a Divine Skill only transmitted to direct descendants.
Before becoming Ye Yun’s disciple, Su Qi had also been a distinguished figure, having defeated many renowned masters with his powerful Seven-colour Seal Magic. It was only after encountering Ye Yun that Su Qi realized there was always a higher mountain to climb. Defeated, he willingly took Ye Yun as his master.
Once cultivation of the Seven-colour Seal Magic reached a certain level of achievement, a seven-colored mark would appear on the forehead, like a small, seven-colored seal imprinted there. It was very easy to recognize.
Ye Yun had never expected that, one hundred thousand years later, he would see a descendant of his first and chief disciple appear before him.
The celestial boat stopped in mid-air. More than a dozen figures descended from it.
"Someone’s coming."
Big Black Cat glanced over. Seeing their unimpressive strength, it lost interest and continued to recline lazily on the carriage. Apart from Little Cat, the other kittens, possessing terrifyingly high cultivation bases, naturally had no interest in these young cultivators of the Destiny Realm and Life and Death Realm. The kittens were all lying down, bored, some even closing their eyes.
After landing, the girl in colorful clothes quickly scanned the scene. She found that, apart from a beautiful woman in black whose cultivation base was quite good, the others’ cultivation bases were not particularly high. However, a young man in white, who seemingly had no cultivation base, gave her an impression of profound inscrutability. This made her feel a sense of caution.
"May I ask who these little cats belong to?" the girl in colorful clothes stepped forward, cupped her fists, and asked with a smile.
Ye Yun glanced at Luo Li.
Luo Li instantly understood.
As the Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, it was her time to speak.
"They are mine," Luo Li answered straightforwardly.
"Miss, I also adore the kittens on the carriage, especially the red, green, and blue ones. I wonder if you could find it in your heart to part with them and sell them to me? Rest assured, whatever the cost, I will gladly pay it."
She spoke quite politely, without the usual imperious arrogance of a large clan. Nevertheless, her words still astonished many of the onlookers.
Luo Li had never dreamed that this girl in colorful clothes would land so brazenly and then try to buy the three kittens.
She must be dreaming!
That blue kitten was the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, a Divine Dragon of the Divine Monarch Realm! The red and green kittens were both Divine Dragons of the Eternal Realm! Even the combined wealth of all the Eternal Realm Sects in the entire Cangnan Continent wouldn’t be enough to trade for them.
Luo Li swallowed hard, unsure how to respond to the girl in colorful clothes.
There’s nothing wrong with liking cats, but she should consider the time and place, shouldn’t she? What a terrifying group of beings was present here! That little blue kitten could annihilate any Eternal Realm Sect with a single swipe of its paw.
Jun Moxiao and Su Wanyi exchanged glances, a smile touching the corners of their lips.
This girl in colorful clothes really is rather adorable.
As for the kittens on the carriage, each one was inwardly seething with anger.
This ridiculously weak group of cultivators dared to have designs on them? Weren’t they courting death? If their Master hadn’t been present, the three kittens, who were actually Divine Dragons, would have probably reverted to their true forms and devoured this group of people.
"These three cats..." Luo Li coughed, preparing to politely decline.
Suddenly, Ye Yun’s expression shifted. He smiled and asked, "Are you going to the Nether Immortal Ancient Land?"
"Yes," the girl in colorful clothes nodded.
"Selling all three is impossible, but I can sell you the little blue cat," Ye Yun said with a light smile, his gaze fixed on the seven-colored mark on the girl’s forehead as he spoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 453: This voice, Soft and Cute
chapters.content:
Chapter 453: Chapter 453: This voice, Soft and Cute
Ye Yun’s words stunned all the disciples and demon beasts of the Dragon God Sect. They were all dumbfounded.
The Ancestor... wants to sell the Divine Monarch Realm’s Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon to this girl?
Shockwaves rippled through Luo Li’s heart. It was as if a heavy hammer had struck her head, causing her mind to buzz.
Why is the Ancestor doing this?
Luo Li racked her brains but still couldn’t understand.
Jun Moxiao and Su Wanyi could only offer a wry smile, but they dared not speak out. As for the other demon beasts, they were all petrified with shock. Each of them was confused, as if they were dreaming.
Especially the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon. It felt as though the world was ending, and it was on the verge of collapse.
Master, is he giving up on me? Or does he have other plans?
The girl in colorful clothes curiously stared at the people around her, realizing their expressions were quite strange. For a moment, she didn’t understand either. But when she heard the young man in white was willing to part with the cute blue cat, she was extremely excited.
"Brother, may I ask what price you’re asking for it?" the girl in colorful clothes asked with a smile.
Ye Yun touched his brow and said with a faint smile, "This little blue cat isn’t any rare breed. Besides being cute and good-looking, it’s not worth much. Just give me a thousand Spirit Stones for it."
"Just a thousand Spirit Stones?" The girl in colorful clothes was dumbfounded. She couldn’t believe that the cute little blue cat would be so cheap. It was unbelievably cheap.
"Ancestor, are you really going to sell the little blue cat?" Luo Li grew anxious and rushed to Ye Yun’s side, whispering her question.
Ye Yun nodded.
Luo Li hung her head in dejection, not understanding why the Ancestor would make such a decision.
"Junior Sister, don’t overthink it. The Ancestor must have his reasons," Su Wanyi quietly advised her.
"Oh!" Luo Li gently responded, then fell silent again. But her face relaxed somewhat. It seemed her Senior Sister’s words had helped her grasp something crucial.
Master, why are you giving me away? Did I do something wrong?
On the other hand, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon sent a nervous telepathic message.
"You didn’t do anything wrong. I just have a little task for you," Ye Yun replied with a smile.
What task, Master?
Upon hearing it was a task, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon immediately perked up.
"Protect this little girl and make sure she doesn’t run into any danger in the Nether Immortal Ancient Land. Also, those at the Eternal Realm cannot enter that place, but those at the God Realm and above are not restricted. You must exercise discretion and prevent these youngsters from discovering your true strength," Ye Yun sent via telepathy.
I understand, Master.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon immediately nodded, feeling thrilled.
Finally, it wouldn’t be spending its days bored and sleeping all the time. Master had given it a task; this meant Master valued it.
"Miss, a thousand Spirit Stones is a great deal, you should buy it quickly," a young man beside her advised.
The girl in colorful clothes still felt it was hard to believe. She looked at Ye Yun and asked again, "Is it really just a thousand Spirit Stones?"
"Indeed," Ye Yun laughed.
"Quickly, give him the Spirit Stones," the girl in colorful attire suddenly comprehended and promptly urged a young man by her side. She was afraid that the young man in white across from them might go back on his word.
A young Destiny Realm cultivator came up and handed over a thousand Spirit Stones to Ye Yun.
At this very moment, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon on the carriage stood up, shook its fur, and prepared to leap over.
Elder, are you really going?
Big Black Cat gritted its teeth, incredulously sending a telepathic message.
Oh yeah, could I not listen to Master? HEH HEH!
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon sent back a telepathic message, then leaped gracefully from the carriage and pounced towards the girl in colorful clothes."Little blue cat, come over here quickly." The girl in colorful attire sprinted forward and embraced the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon in her arms. She lovingly caressed its fluffy blue fur. It was crystal clear, smooth, and soft, with a delicate and extremely comfortable feel.
"MEOW~~~"
To make its act more convincing, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon suddenly lifted its head and let out a cry. The cry was soft and endearing. After it cried, it laughed internally.
A majestic Divine Dragon of the Divine Monarch Realm, having to role-play like this! It was fortunate this was a task from Master; otherwise, it would never agree to such a thing, even on pain of death.
"So adorable!" Holding the little blue cat, the girl in colorful attire thanked Ye Yun before swiftly flying back to her Celestial Boat. The others followed closely behind.
The Celestial Boat paused for a moment in mid-air before streaking away.
Looking at the disappearing Celestial Boat, a smile appeared at the corner of Ye Yun’s mouth. Since he had seen the descendants of his eldest disciple, he naturally couldn’t stand idly by.
Although he had never entered the Nether Immortal Ancient Land, just a fleeting glance was enough for him to sense the strange aura within. Furthermore, he had gleaned some memories from certain cultivators. He knew that there were many bizarre creatures inside; the higher one’s cultivation base, the more likely they were to be attacked by these creatures. Even if this little girl was protected by a Life and Death Realm cultivator, she was, in fact, in a precarious situation. The risk of her perishing was very high.
Many cultivators in the Nether Immortal Ancient Land operated in groups. They not only had to face attacks from bizarre creatures but also had to be wary of attacks from fellow human cultivators when they discovered the Divine Element Longevity Fruit.
Ye Yun looked at Luo Li and asked with a laugh, "You three little ones have been cultivating for a long time. Do you want to go to the Nether Immortal Ancient Land to gain some experience?"
"Ancestor, we’ve been waiting for you to say that! Previously, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon wouldn’t let us in..." Luo Li said excitedly.
"HAHA..." Ye Yun laughed heartily. The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon’s actions were naturally based on his instructions. After all, before leaving the Cangnan Continent, Ye Yun had instructed the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, who had the highest cultivation base, to prioritize safety. The Dragon God Sect only had these three young seedlings; they had to be protected properly. It was best they didn’t enter certain dangerous minor worlds yet. Because in such places, even with its high cultivation base, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon would be unable to protect them effectively.
Ye Yun looked around and laughed, "This time, you’ll go as a group. Little Black Cat, Cat Baby, Mu Qing, all of you go."
Hearing that she was part of this training, Mu Qing was both surprised and delighted.
"Wow, Old Master, rest assured, I will certainly safeguard the Sect Master well," Big Black Cat leaped from the carriage, its body floating in mid-air, and declared confidently.
"Although the Nether Immortal Ancient Land is a trial, cultivation should not be neglected. I went to the Divine Land this time and brought back some good things for you." Ye Yun suddenly flicked his finger, and rays of light shot towards Luo Li, Big Black Cat, and the others.
When the light dissipated, each of them suddenly had a Spirit Stone in their hand. This Spirit Stone looked like an ordinary Spirit Stone, but it emanated an indescribably mystical aura.
"This is a Spirit Stone from the Divine Land; it contains Divine Nature. Try absorbing it and see," Ye Yun smiled.
What?
Spirit Stones from the Divine Land actually contained Divine Nature?
Everyone and every demon beast present, except for the Immortal Divine Silkworm, gasped, utterly shocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 454: Five Hundred Million Spirit Stones
chapters.content:
Chapter 454: Chapter 454: Five Hundred Million Spirit Stones
Whether it was juniors of the Dragon God Sect like Luo Li, or demon beasts like Big Black Cat and Cat Bao’er, they all had one thing in common: they were all born and raised on the Cangnan Continent.
In their hearts, Spirit Stones simply contained rich Spiritual Energy—nothing more.
However, what they didn’t expect was that the Spirit Stones from the Divine Land contained not just Spiritual Energy, but also Divine Nature.
What was Divine Nature? With Ye Yun, an Old Ancestor at the God Venerable Realm, present, they naturally understood what Divine Nature represented.
Since the Spirit Stones from the Divine Land also possessed Divine Nature, wouldn’t that mean absorbing the Spiritual Energy from these Spirit Stones would enhance their Cultivation speed? Wouldn’t it be easier for them to break through to the True God Realm?
At this thought, everyone was stirred, their blood boiling with excitement.
The True God Realm—the realm they had dreamed of achieving!
"Wow... this Spirit Stone contains so much Divine Nature!"
The Big Black Cat couldn’t hold back. He took a deep draw of energy from the Spirit Stone in his hand, and his face instantly lit up with extreme surprise and joy.
"Is this Divine Nature? It’s absolutely fantastic!"
On the other side, after absorbing a Spirit Stone, Mu Qing closed her eyes, a look of rapture spreading across her beautiful face. This was the first time she had experienced the energy of Divine Nature. It was an indescribably magnificent sensation, and her entire body seemed to undergo some kind of sublimation.
Absorbing one such Spirit Stone far surpassed absorbing thousands of ordinary ones. If they were to use these Spirit Stones to aid their Cultivation, their progress would become terrifyingly fast! Moreover, once they began to accumulate Divine Yuan Power within them, breaking through the barriers of their Cultivation Stage would become much easier.
In other words, it was as if their bodies now possessed an extra "Divine Nature" dagger, capable of piercing through all the barriers between the Destiny Realm, Life and Death Realm, Eternal Realm, and True God Realm.
"Such powerful Spiritual Energy!" After absorbing the Spirit Stone in her hand, Luo Li looked as if she hadn’t had enough. "Old Ancestor," she said, clicking her tongue, "it’s such a pity. Is this the only one?"
"Yes, Old Ancestor, do you have any more?" Jun Moxiao also asked.
"There are many. This time, each of you gets ten million," Ye Yun stated nonchalantly.
He had killed several Divine Monarch Realm cultivators in the Divine Land and obtained tens of billions of Spirit Stones. Especially that Wang Teng, who had been quite wealthy. The Immortal honoring practitioners he had killed in the Cloud Mark Cave should have originally possessed even more Spirit Stones in their storage rings. However, at that time, Ye Yun had Liu Yiyi collect them and didn’t take them for himself.
The Spirit Stones he possessed were sufficient for these juniors’ cultivation. After all, these young ones were at relatively low Cultivation Stages, so their consumption of Spirit Stones was also pitifully small. Ten million Spirit Stones would be enough for them to cultivate for a very long time. Ye Yun estimated that this amount would be nearly enough for them to cultivate to the Eternal Realm.
"What? Ten million Spirit Stones for each person?"
When Ye Yun’s words landed, everyone’s expression changed drastically. Their breathing hitched, and they were plunged into profound shock. The Master’s words had scared them half to death.
Ten million Spirit Stones for each person. There were six people present preparing to go to the Nether Immortal Ancient Land, meaning a total of sixty million Spirit Stones.
Such a huge quantity!
Luo Li’s heart pounded, her face flushed, as she plucked up the courage to ask, "Old Ancestor, did you strike it rich in the Divine Land?"
Ye Yun laughed aloud. "Haha, I made a small fortune. Cultivate diligently. If you run out of Spirit Stones in the future, I’ll provide more."
With a flick of his hand, six storage rings shot out.
Everyone hurriedly caught the storage rings. Projecting a strand of Divine Sense inside, they discovered Spirit Stones packed as densely as small mountains. They were so shocked and delighted they didn’t know what to say.
Cat Bao’er clutched the ring tightly, her eyes firm. "With these Spirit Stones, I will definitely be able to break through to the Eternal Realm!"
The Big Black Cat glared. "Can’t you be a bit more ambitious, Cat Bao’er? You must at least aim to break through to the True God Realm!"
Cat Bao’er quickly nodded in agreement. "Big Brother is right. Little sister will definitely cultivate to the True God Realm."
The Big Black Cat whispered to Cat Bao’er, "Let’s transform into human form too. It’ll be better for following the Sect Master to gain experience." Then, with a shake of his body, he reverted to his black-robed young man appearance.
Cat Bao’er also transformed, becoming a beautiful woman in white.
Jun Moxiao clutched his ring, his heart surging with excitement, and couldn’t help but laugh heartily. "From now on, whether we’re eating, sleeping, or out on trial expeditions, we must constantly absorb the Spiritual Energy from these Spirit Stones! Everyone, let’s strive to break through to the next realm as soon as possible!"
The Big Black Cat chuckled. "Absolutely!"
Watching them, Ye Yun shook his head and smiled faintly. Jun Moxiao and Big Black Cat weren’t very good at hiding their emotions; their excitement was immediately apparent on their faces. As for the young women, aside from Luo Li who was somewhat restless, the others remained relatively composed. After all, in the Old Ancestor’s presence, these young ladies couldn’t possibly behave like lunatics.
Ye Yun looked at these juniors, his brow furrowing slightly as he spoke sternly, "The Nether Immortal Ancient Land is filled with many bizarre creatures. You must act as a group, look out for each other, and do not split up..."
Jun Moxiao stood straight, his expression resolute. "Old Ancestor, please rest assured. We will not disappoint you on this training expedition."
Ye Yun pondered for a moment, then added, "The Nether Immortal Ancient Land remains open for a considerable time. Proceed according to your abilities, and don’t stay longer than three months at most."
Luo Li asked curiously, "Old Ancestor, is there no time limit in the Nether Immortal Ancient Land?"
Ye Yun smiled. "There’s no time limit. Sometimes the Nether Immortal Ancient Land can remain open for up to three years, and the entrance won’t close."
Luo Li nodded. "So that’s how it is..." The others also appeared contemplative. They hadn’t expected the Nether Immortal Ancient Land to be such a peculiar place.
Ye Yun waved his hand magnanimously. "Alright, you may set off now!"
"Goodbye, Old Ancestor!"
"Goodbye, Sir!"
The six of them bid farewell to Ye Yun one by one, then turned, rose into the air, and flew towards the Nether Immortal Ancient Land.
Watching the group of juniors disappear from sight, Ye Yun sighed softly.
Being an Old Ancestor really isn’t easy!
For the safety of these six juniors, he had also taken the precaution of leaving a wisp of his Primordial Spirit in Luo Li’s mind.
Suddenly, the Big Black Horse’s timid voice came from behind him, "Sir, those Spirit Stones from the Divine Land... do you have any more?"
Ye Yun turned, a smile gracing his lips as he looked at the few demon beasts before him. Now, only the Big Black Horse, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon, the Xuan Bird, and the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon—four Eternal Realm demon beasts—along with one Divine Monarch Realm Immortal Divine Silkworm remained.
The Immortal Divine Silkworm, having devoured the corpses of the Six Great Divine Honoured Realm, would naturally not lack energy for a very long time. However, these four Eternal Realm demon beasts, whose cultivation had been progressing slowly, naturally craved the Spirit Stones from the Divine Land.
Ye Yun beckoned with a smile. "Come here..."
There’s a chance!
The Master is going to bestow Spirit Stones!
The hearts of the four demon beasts pounded with excitement as they quickly flew over.
Ye Yun took out four storage rings and handed them to these four loyal demon beasts respectively. "These Spirit Stones should be enough for you to cultivate to the True God Realm."
The demon beasts were ecstatic. "Thank you, Sir!" "Our thanks, Sir..."
The Big Black Horse took the storage ring and sent his Divine Sense inside. He was so shocked he almost fainted. Inside the storage ring, Spirit Stones were densely packed. A count with his Divine Sense revealed a staggering five hundred million Spirit Stones.
The Big Black Horse asked, his voice trembling, "Sir, are there... five hundred million Spirit Stones in here?"
Ye Yun nodded with a smile. "Mm-hm."

chapters.title: Chapter 455: Nether Immortal Ancient Land, Encountering a Strong Enemy
chapters.content:
Chapter 455: Chapter 455: Nether Immortal Ancient Land, Encountering a Strong Enemy
"Sect Master, in about half an incense stick’s time, we will reach the entrance to the Nether Immortal Ancient Land."
On a Celestial Boat, six figures stood. Mu Qing, heroic and dashing in her black attire, stood at the forefront, gazing into the distance and speaking with a smile.
She was at Destiny Realm Level Eight, possessing the highest cultivation base among them. As the Sect Master of the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, it was a simple matter for her to produce a small Celestial Boat for travel.
While speaking, she clutched a Spirit Stone, continuously absorbing the spiritual energy imbued with Divine Nature from it.
It wasn’t just Mu Qing; the other five also held Spirit Stones.
These were Spirit Stones from the Divine Land, unobtainable anywhere else on the Cangnan Continent. Absorbing these stones allowed their cultivation bases to improve rapidly.
Therefore, everyone was racing against time, constantly absorbing spiritual energy from their Spirit Stones.
"We’re finally almost there! Senior Sister and Little Junior Brother have both been to immortal lands or Secret Realms for training before. This time, it’s finally my turn!" Luo Li exclaimed.
"Senior Sister, last time I went to the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, I met a lot of monkeys. It was quite fun," Jun Moxiao said, chuckling as he recalled the interesting events there.
That time, he had formed a small team with Lei Qinian. The two coordinated perfectly, their teamwork seamless.
They stirred up considerable trouble within the entire Heavenly Moon Secret Region. Even the major powers, with their thousands of cultivators, couldn’t do anything to them.
"It’s a pity the Old Ancestor didn’t let me go that time..." Luo Li sighed, a look of disappointment on her small face.
Whenever she heard her Little Junior Brother talk about the monkeys in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, her heart felt as if it were full of little monkeys jumping around, scratching their ears and cheeks, making her feel antsy. She desperately wished she could have entered the Heavenly Moon Secret Region too.
"Senior Sister, aren’t we going together this time?" Jun Moxiao smiled nonchalantly.
"That’s true!" Luo Li laughed.
「...」
Amidst their chatter and laughter, they soon arrived at the entrance to the Nether Immortal Ancient Land.
The entrance to the Nether Immortal Ancient Land was located in a towering valley, where a massive Bronze Door, dozens of meters high, stood.
The door was slightly ajar. Wisps of black fog continuously wafted out from the crevices.
The Bronze Door and the black fog presented an extremely shocking and exceptionally bizarre sight.
Fortunately, it was daytime. If it were nighttime and they suddenly encountered a Bronze Door continuously emitting black fog, it would be quite terrifying.
It was as if the gates of the Nine Soul Nether Hell had suddenly appeared in the territory of the Nether Immortal Dynasty. It seemed possible that at any moment, terrifying creatures from Hell might swarm out.
The six figures descended from the Celestial Boat. With a wave of her hand, Mu Qing stored it away.
"Mu Qing, during your time at the Sacred Sect of the Mysterious Bird, have you ever visited this Nether Immortal Ancient Land?" Luo Li asked in a low voice, looking at the Bronze Door with slightly raised eyebrows.
Mu Qing answered respectfully, "Sect Master, I have not. The Heavenly Sun Dynasty and the Nether Immortal Dynasty are as incompatible as fire and water. Our Heavenly Moon Dynasty is under the jurisdiction of the Heavenly Sun Dynasty, so we dared not enter the territory of the Nether Immortal Dynasty."
Her words had barely faded when a large Celestial Boat rapidly approached from the distance.
"Make way!"
As the large Celestial Boat drew near, a furious roar came from aboard, ordering Luo Li and the others out of their path.
Seeing their aggressive approach, Luo Li frowned. She took a deep breath and promptly signaled her companions to step aside.
Their small team consisted of only six people, and their overall strength wasn’t particularly high. Therefore, she didn’t want to initiate any conflict. If they could endure it, they would.
After all, the other party was numerous and powerful, boasting many high-level cultivators, including a large number in the Destiny Realm. Their strength far surpassed that of her group.
From the Celestial Boat, a flurry of figures flickered, and over a hundred people descended.
Most of them were cultivators at the Destiny Realm, with some at the Nirvana Realm.
Their leader, a young man in a gold robe, possessed a noble aura and an arrogant, untamable gaze. His cultivation base had reached Destiny Realm Level Eight.
"Which power do you belong to?" the gold-robed young man squinted at Luo Li and her companions. "With just a few of you, do you think you’re going in there to die?"
When he noticed two members of the Demon Clan among them, he couldn’t help but sneer, giving a pair of cold chuckles.
Seeing the gold-robed youth’s outrageous arrogance, it wasn’t Luo Li who was angered first, but the Big Black Cat beside her.
"Sect Master, should I teach them a lesson?" the Big Black Cat asked, grinding his teeth.
"They’re quite strong. We... should probably avoid conflict," Luo Li said after a moment’s thought.
Actually, she didn’t want to bother the Old Ancestor. The entrance to the Nether Immortal Ancient Land wasn’t far from where the Old Ancestor was. Their current predicament was likely already within his enlightened sight. If a conflict erupted, they would still need the Old Ancestor to intervene to handle those people. Luo Li truly didn’t want to trouble the Old Ancestor. For this training expedition, they couldn’t rely on him for everything, could they? If they needed the Old Ancestor’s help before even entering the Nether Immortal Ancient Land, who would be there to assist them once they were truly inside?
"You, a member of the Demon Clan, dare to talk about teaching *me*, this young master, a lesson? I think you lot are truly seeking death!"
The gold-robed youth’s expression shifted. Hearing the black-clothed youth’s words, a flash of anger crossed his face, and he spoke coldly.
His words had barely faded when seven or eight cultivators at the Destiny Realm rushed out from behind him, lunging towards Luo Li and her party.
"Go!" Luo Li shouted, dashing towards the Bronze Door.
The others followed closely. In the blink of an eye, they passed through the Bronze Door and vanished.
"They sure run fast!" The gold-robed youth raised an eyebrow and let out a pair of extremely arrogant laughs.
He stared at the Bronze Door, frowning. "So this is the entrance to the Nether Immortal Ancient Land? It truly is rather strange..."
"Young Master, there are many bizarre creatures here. It’s a very dangerous place," a young man beside him said.
"Fortune favors the brave! Let’s go!"
After a few seconds of silence, the gold-robed youth decisively clenched his jaw. With a swift movement, he was the first to charge towards the Bronze Door.
The dozens of others also followed closely, entering the Bronze Door one after another.
In Luo Li’s mind, the wisp of Ye Yun’s Primordial Spirit sensed her current thoughts and felt somewhat bemused. This child not wanting to trouble him... her reasoning wasn’t actually wrong. Jun Moxiao and Lei Qinian, just the two of them, had managed to contend with the three major Sects in the Heavenly Moon Secret Region. Ye Yun hoped that this six-person team led by Luo Li could also adeptly navigate difficult situations. He hoped that Luo Li, the young 298th generation Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect, would mature quickly. Life isn’t always smooth sailing. When facing pressure and adversity, making appropriate compromises and understanding when to advance and when to retreat—that is how one truly grows. After all, he, the Old Ancestor, couldn’t protect them for their entire lives.
Upon entering the Bronze Door, the six of them suddenly plunged into a world permeated by black fog.
The black fog was relatively thin, and visibility was still acceptable. However, this black fog possessed a certain corrosive property.
It continuously seeped in through their facial orifices and pores, and even using Mana couldn’t block it.
"This fog is poisonous!" Mu Qing suddenly exclaimed.
"Is it poisonous?" Jun Moxiao asked in surprise. He checked himself but didn’t find the fog affecting him in any way.
"Sect Master, you all go hide up ahead. I’ll deal with these people for a bit," the Big Black Cat said suddenly, his eyes darting around.
"How can you, alone, be a match for so many of them?" Luo Li asked anxiously.
"The Old Master gifted me a pair of Teleportation Boots. They’re enough for me to contend with them. Besides, this fog doesn’t seem to affect me either," the Big Black Cat chuckled.
Luo Li had a moment of sudden understanding.
The Big Black Cat possessed a pair of Emperor Artifact Teleportation Boots, which he had already fully refined, allowing him to move at lightning speed. Back in the Nine Soul Underground Palace, he had devoured a significant amount of Eternal Life Immortal Grass, making his physical body extremely tough, so this black fog couldn’t affect him.

chapters.title: Chapter 456: Shadow Crow Attacks, Big Black Cat Wreaks Havoc
chapters.content:
Chapter 456: Chapter 456: Shadow Crow Attacks, Big Black Cat Wreaks Havoc
"Alright, we’ll wait for you up ahead."
Once Luo Li understood, she decisively said her piece and immediately flew into the depths of the fog with the others.
Big Black Cat had the Teleportation Boots, so she wasn’t worried about him.
His staying behind to block those people would also serve as a buffer.
WHOOSH...
Just as Luo Li and the others flew a short distance, numerous basin-sized black shadows suddenly flew out from the black fog.
"Sect Master, those must be Shadow Crows," Mu Qing said, looking into the distance, her heart pounding in her chest.
Tens of thousands of Shadow Crows flew in from all directions. Each possessed a Nirvana Realm cultivation base, with occasional ones in the Destiny Realm.
This enormous legion of Shadow Crows instantly surrounded them.
"Senior Sister, this Nether Immortal Ancient Land isn’t fun at all!" Jun Moxiao exclaimed, his face etched with misery.
Just as they arrived at the entrance, a powerful group had tried to hunt them down. Now, shortly after entering the Nether Immortal Ancient Land, and before they had gone far, they were surrounded by this vast number of Shadow Crows.
The Shadow Crows were a type of bizarre creature unique to the Nether Immortal Ancient Land.
Unlike the normal Shadow Crows formed from Yin energy in the outside world, the Shadow Crows in the Nether Immortal Ancient Land had blood-red eyes, and their black plumage was interspersed with sinister red feathers.
Each Shadow Crow exuded a distinct, eerie aura.
"Let’s break out!" Luo Li gritted her teeth, drew her Supreme Golden Dragon Sword, and took the lead in charging toward the Shadow Crows.
The others followed suit.
Watching this scene, Ye Yun was somewhat speechless.
These six youngsters were outmatched and alone. Upon entering the Nether Immortal Ancient Land, they were immediately faced with a Hell-level difficulty.
Could their luck be any worse?
Even he, their Ancestor, found it hard to watch.
At this moment, he had to give these little ones a cheat.
There was no helping it; Ye Yun, as their Ancestor, possessed an unbeatable cheat himself.
And in turn, Ye Yun was the cheat for these three young members of the Dragon God Sect.
With a mere thought from Ye Yun, Luo Li’s Supreme Golden Dragon Sword suddenly underwent a transformation.
Originally, it was a Divine Artifact whose power Ye Yun had sealed, so its true prowess was not apparent.
Now, Ye Yun had undone more than half of the Seal on the Supreme Golden Dragon Sword, allowing it to return to the Emperor Level.
Thus, this Emperor Sword could exert enough pressure to deter these bizarre Shadow Crows and resolve the current crisis.
ROAR!
The Supreme Golden Dragon Sword suddenly erupted with brilliant golden light, and the golden Dragon Soul within the blade let out an earth-shattering roar.
The tens of thousands of aggressive Shadow Crows, enveloped by the light from the Supreme Golden Dragon Sword, shrieked wretchedly and scattered in all directions.
"Huh? My Supreme Golden Dragon Sword... it seems much stronger than before. Could it be that Ancestor undid its Seal?" Luo Li exclaimed in astonishment.
"It must be!" Jun Moxiao chimed in, approaching. Seeing that all the Shadow Crows had fled, he burst into laughter.
"Let’s hurry and wait for Little Black Cat up ahead," Luo Li, her mind still clear, said with a wave of her small hand, immediately flying forward.
The others followed closely behind.
The dire situation of being besieged by Shadow Crows was effortlessly resolved thanks to the unsealing of the Supreme Golden Dragon Sword.
「On the other side.」
Big Black Cat turned around to face the direction of the Bronze Door, a sinister grin spreading across his face.
These guys, who knows where they crawled out from? They’re unbelievably arrogant, even more so than the Dragon Lord back in the day. They even dared to yell at the Sect Master of our Dragon God Sect! Today, I, Old Cat, will teach these insolent fools a proper lesson.
During this time, Big Black Cat had completely refined the Teleportation Boots and had even made some headway with the Sky Exterminating Phantom Eye, becoming stronger than before.
He was at the Fifth Level of the Destiny Realm and was fully confident in dealing with others at the same cultivation level.
However, since Sect Master Luo Li was in charge this time, Big Black Cat hadn’t deliberately shown off earlier. Now that the Sect Master and the others were gone, he could finally go on a killing spree.
Dozens of figures flickered as over a hundred people flew in through the Bronze Door.
The gold-robed young man was among them.
FLAP! FLAP!
The sound of flapping wings echoed from within the mist.
Big Black Cat turned his head and saw countless black-and-red Shadow Crows flying densely toward them.
These were the same Shadow Crows that Luo Li had driven away, now returning from that direction.
"Haha, the heavens are helping me!" Big Black Cat exclaimed, suddenly excited.
The Shadow Crows had arrived at the perfect moment.
With his Teleportation Boots, he was fast enough to easily evade their attacks.
And their primary target wasn’t him, but the hundred-plus Cultivators facing him.
"Damn it! How did we run into so many Shadow Crows as soon as we got in?" the gold-robed young man cursed, having also spotted the large flock.
"Who else but yourselves to blame for your impending doom? Even the Shadow Crows of the Nether Immortal Ancient Land find you repulsive and have come out to feast on you first! Haha!" Big Black Cat retorted, standing in the black mist with his hands clasped behind his back, laughing boisterously.
He had, at some point, already donned his Teleportation Boots.
Currently, the boots emitted a faint glow, inconspicuous within the dark mist.
"A mere Fifth-Level Destiny Realm Demon Clan member dares to be so arrogant? Kill him!" The gold-robed young man’s face darkened. With a wave of his hand, a young man at the Eighth Level of the Destiny Realm shot out from behind him.
Big Black Cat activated the Teleportation Boots and vanished instantly.
Where did he go?
The Eighth-Level Destiny Realm young man, who had just lunged, found his target gone.
Suddenly, he sensed an attack from behind.
He whirled around and threw a punch.
"Die!" Big Black Cat sneered. Relying on his superior speed, he deftly dodged the punch and landed a heavy blow squarely on the young man’s back.
BOOM!
The Eighth-Level Destiny Realm young man shrieked, sprayed a mouthful of blood, and was sent flying.
The force of that punch was immense.
In that instant, all his internal organs had been pulverized.
WHOOSH!
A dozen Shadow Crows suddenly swooped down upon the Eighth-Level Destiny Realm young man, their sharp beaks tearing viciously into his flesh.
The young man’s vital essence was rapidly drained as the Shadow Crows fed frantically, his body quickly shriveling.
SPLAT!
The Shadow Crows took flight, and the young man’s corpse plummeted from mid-air, crashing heavily onto the ground.
Watching this from a distance, the gold-robed young man felt his blood boil with rage.
He hadn’t expected... that the black-clad youth would be so powerful.
"Men, come with me and kill him!" the gold-robed young man roared furiously, personally leading more than twenty Destiny Realm Cultivators, swords drawn, as they charged toward Big Black Cat.
「Meanwhile.」
The swarms of Shadow Crows in the sky had already formed a tidal wave of attacks.
The hundred-plus Cultivators were immediately plunged into a bitter struggle.
Big Black Cat didn’t engage them directly. He vanished in mid-air, only to suddenly reappear from another direction.
BOOM!
With a single punch, he sent a Cultivator at the First Level of the Destiny Realm flying.
After knocking this Destiny Realm Cultivator away, Big Black Cat vanished once more.
He gave neither the other humans nor the Shadow Crows any chance to attack him.
And so it continued.
Big Black Cat, like a phantom, flickered in and out of existence, felling one Cultivator after another. Those he killed ultimately became feasts for the Shadow Crows.
The Shadow Crows, having gotten a taste of blood, finally came to a tacit understanding with Big Black Cat. They ceased attacking him and focused solely on the Human Cultivators.
This development made Big Black Cat’s battle even more favorable.
BOOM! BOOM!
As a black light flashed about, the hundred-plus men brought by the gold-robed young man fell one by one with astonishing speed. In the time it takes for an incense stick to burn, only he remained amidst the endless black mist.
His men had also killed two-thirds of the Shadow Crows. The remaining third, apparently satiated, flapped their wings and flew back into the mist, disappearing from sight.
Now, in the entire void, only Big Black Cat and the gold-robed young man were left.
"How... How can this be possible?!" The gold-robed young man’s Dao Heart was on the verge of shattering. Gazing at the black-clad youth who seemed like a Demon God, his face contorted grotesquely as he roared hysterically.
"You dare provoke our Dragon God Sect? Then I, Old Cat, will send every last one of you to Hell!" Big Black Cat’s eyes were icy. He let out a cold snort, activated his Teleportation Boots once more, and shot towards the gold-robed young man at lightning speed.

chapters.title: Chapter 457: Ancient Dragon Cave Map
chapters.content:
Chapter 457: Chapter 457: Ancient Dragon Cave Map
"I will kill you!"
The golden-robed youth screamed hysterically, wielding a chilling sword glow as he charged towards the Big Black Cat.
Relying on his astonishing speed, the Big Black Cat instantly dodged, rushed to the golden-robed youth’s side, and threw a violent punch.
The golden-robed youth hastily extended a fist in response.
BANG!
Their fists collided in mid-air. A powerful force suddenly shattered the knuckles of the golden-robed youth’s fist.
How can this Demon Clan member’s physical body... be so strong?
The golden-robed youth was instantly terrified.
No wonder those Cultivators in his clan were all defeated by this black-clothed Demon Clan youth. The strength of this Demon Clan member’s physical body is something I’ve rarely encountered in my life!
No, I must leave this place immediately.
After being injured, the golden-robed youth immediately decided to retreat and turned to flee.
At this moment, his body was engulfed in red flames. He moved at an incredible speed and flew out of the Bronze Door instantaneously.
Letting the grass grow by not pulling out the roots wasn’t the Big Black Cat’s style.
He absolutely couldn’t let this arrogant golden-robed youth escape from his grasp.
WHOOSH!
The Teleportation Boots activated, and the Big Black Cat chased after him.
His speed was almost on par with the golden-robed youth’s.
One in front, one behind, they quickly flew out of the Bronze Door.
How is this guy’s speed so fast too?
The golden-robed youth was greatly shocked. He frantically burned his Essence Blood, sparing no cost in his desperate escape.
The Big Black Cat pursued him closely.
Although he possessed the Emperor Artifact Teleportation Boots, his cultivation base was only at the Destiny Realm. This restricted him from truly maximizing the artifact’s utmost speed.
The golden-robed youth, burning his Essence Blood frantically, could only manage to maintain the distance between them.
One in front and one behind, two rays of light chased each other through mid-air.
In his panic, the golden-robed youth didn’t know where he was fleeing, but he noticed a black carriage conspicuously parked atop a distant mountain peak.
Why would there be a black carriage on such a remote mountain peak?
the golden-robed youth thought.
While still contemplating, he reached the mountaintop. Then, he saw the gigantic Black Horse pulling the carriage suddenly lift its head, curl its lips, and reveal a mouthful of large, snow-white teeth.
"Come on down, lad!"
The Big Black Horse spoke in human language. Instantaneously, a colossal force pressed down on the golden-robed youth, and he plummeted from mid-air.
This... is this another great demon?
The golden-robed youth was instantly scared half to death. He landed on a nearby rock and immediately knelt on the ground.
"Senior, please be merciful! There are enemies chasing me from behind; please spare my life! If Senior is willing to help me, I am willing to dedicate my life’s savings to you!"
The golden-robed youth exclaimed, holding a storage ring with both hands as he looked pleadingly at the Big Black Horse.
"Well, now, aren’t you a clever one, trying to bribe me?"
The Big Black Horse let out a strange caw and snorted twice.
Seeing this great demon Senior unmoved, the golden-robed youth grew anxious and pulled an ancient, yellowed map from his robes.
He cried out, "Senior, you can also have this Dragon Cave Map!"
A Dragon Cave Map?
The Big Black Horse’s eyes widened, its interest immediately piqued.
Aboard the carriage, the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon and the Nether Blood Green Wooden Dragon, upon hearing the words "Dragon Cave," couldn’t help but crane their necks to look.
Inside the carriage, Ye Yun, who had been resting with his eyes closed, opened them at this moment.
He looked at the ancient map.
Watching the black light in the distance draw nearer, the golden-robed youth grew more anxious and hurriedly said, "Senior, this Dragon Cave Map was accidentally obtained by my ancestors thirty thousand years ago. It’s said to be a treasure map left by a Divine Dragon from the Ancient Times. However, despite generations of my family studying it, we’ve never been able to find the Dragon Cave..."
"Generations of your ancestors couldn’t figure out this map, yet you, little whelp, think you can fool this old horse with a useless scrap of paper?"
The Big Black Horse glanced at the map but, seeing nothing special, scoffed coldly.
The golden-robed youth quickly said, "Senior, although we didn’t find the Dragon Cave, we did make some discoveries. It seems there’s a location within the Nether Immortal Ancient Land that bears a resemblance to a place described on this map."
"Oh, really? Your words aren’t very convincing. How do I know you’re not just spinning a tale to save your skin?"
The Big Black Horse remained unmoved and sneered.
He utterly disbelieved the golden-robed youth’s vague claims.
It was a well-known secret that many Divine Dragons in the Ancient Times loved to collect treasures.
But the idea that a member of the Dragon Clan would willingly chart their hoard’s location on a map and let it circulate in the outside world? That was highly improbable.
"I don’t believe it either!" a little red Little Cat in the carriage suddenly chimed in.
The golden-robed youth was stunned.
He hadn’t expected that the little red cat was also a powerful demon beast with an unfathomable cultivation base!
"Where do you think you’re going? Eat my fist!"
A black ray of light suddenly descended from the sky. The Big Black Cat raised his fist, aiming a heavy blow at the golden-robed youth’s chest.
My life is over!
The golden-robed youth, unable to move, closed his eyes and braced for death.
Suddenly, the Big Black Cat felt his fist strike a soft, yielding wall, halting its advance completely.
"Wait a moment."
A voice, familiar and revered by the Big Black Cat, sounded out.
A white figure flashed, and Ye Yun suddenly appeared.
"Master!" the Big Black Cat hurriedly greeted.
Ye Yun nodded. He reached out, took the yellowed ancient map from the golden-robed youth’s hands, and examined it thoughtfully.
"How did you get out?" the Big Black Horse glared at the Big Black Cat and asked grumpily.
"Uncle Ma, this fellow led a hundred men to hunt us down. We happened to run into a flock of Shadow Crows, which was a great help. I seized the chance during the chaos and killed all of them. This kid is just a fish that slipped through the net."
The Big Black Cat said smugly.
"Little Black Boy, you’ve become quite formidable! Slaughtering in all directions, not bad at all!"
The Big Black Horse chuckled, clicking his tongue in approval.
"Haha, Uncle Ma, don’t praise me. Don’t I know my own limits? Without Master’s Teleportation Boots, I couldn’t have handled those people."
The Big Black Cat scratched his head, looking somewhat embarrassed as he spoke.
So you had the Teleportation Boots.
The golden-robed youth’s gaze suddenly fell on the Big Black Cat’s feet, and he finally understood the true reason for his defeat.
Those Teleportation Boots are incredibly fast when activated—the fastest movement-type treasure I’ve ever seen in my life. They probably surpass the Emperor Level...
"So what if I do? Haven’t you figured it out yet, kid? Everyone here is on our side."
The Big Black Cat stared menacingly at the golden-robed youth.
The golden-robed youth hung his head.
I originally intended to find reinforcements, but instead, I walked right into the tiger’s den, falling into their encirclement. I don’t know what kind of power this group possesses, but the few demon beasts around the carriage all seem incredibly strong. Just the Big Black Horse pulling the carriage, in my estimation, has at least an advanced Life and Death Realm cultivation base. And that young man in white robes... he’s like a God Man, with such an extraordinary, transcendent demeanor. He might have already reached the Eternal Realm!

chapters.title: Chapter 458
chapters.content:
Chapter 458: 458
"
I’m so incredibly unlucky! I initially thought they were just some insignificant little group, but I never imagined they’d be backed by a major figure from the Eternal Realm...
"
The youth in the golden robe looked dejected, and the thought of ending his own life even crossed his mind.
He had been far too arrogant before; this time, he had truly provoked an existence he couldn’t afford to offend.
His face ashen, an intense urge to die washed over the golden-robed young man.
He knew he was doomed this time.
"Master, is this Ancient Dragon Cave Map genuine or not?" the Bloody Overlord Demonic Dragon asked from the carriage.
"I’m not sure," Ye Yun replied, his gaze fixed on the ancient map, deep and profound, seeming to flicker like flames. He suddenly glanced at the golden-robed youth and instantly read his memories.
The golden-robed young man hadn’t lied. This Ancient Dragon Cave Map had indeed been obtained by his ancestors. Despite it having been passed down through many generations, his family had never managed to comprehend this Ancient Dragon Cave Map. However, one of their ancestors had once entered the Nether Immortal Ancient Land and discovered a place there that bore a striking resemblance to a location marked on the Ancient Dragon Cave Map. Despite the similarity, they hadn’t found any treasure.
This time, the golden-robed young man’s objectives were to find the Divine Element Longevity Fruit and to further explore the Nether Immortal Ancient Land, hoping to locate the Dragon Clan’s hidden treasure. But now, his life was forfeit. He had no choice but to offer this Ancient Dragon Cave Map in exchange for his life.
"I’ll spare your life. You can scram," Ye Yun said suddenly.
The Mana binding the golden-robed youth instantly vanished. To Ye Yun, killing or sparing a mere Destiny Realm cultivator was inconsequential. He decided he would erase portions of the golden-robed youth’s memories, including those concerning Luo Li, Big Black Cat, and the others.
That should prevent any future complications.
In the version of events Ye Yun would leave in the youth’s mind, he had fled the Nether Immortal Ancient Land due to an attack by a large number of Shadow Crows, an attack that had claimed the lives of all his subordinates.
"Thank you, Senior, for sparing my life!" The golden-robed youth, never having expected to survive such a desperate situation, quickly kowtowed three times to Ye Yun, then turned and vanished into the sky.
"Master, is the Dragon Clan’s treasure hoard indicated on the map this fellow provided really within the Nether Immortal Ancient Land?" Big Black Horse asked curiously.
"I’m not sure. However, since Little Black Cat is also here, we can examine this map once we return..." Ye Yun handed the map to Big Black Cat.
"Rest assured, Master. I will definitely complete the task you’ve assigned me," Big Black Cat declared solemnly.
"Alright, then. You should head back now!" Ye Yun waved his hand.
Before Big Black Cat could react, he felt the world shift around him, and in the next instant, he found himself standing before the entrance to the Bronze Door of the Nether Immortal Ancient Land.
Such a powerful space-tearing Divine Skill! When will I ever be as powerful as Master?
Big Black Cat gave a wry laugh, then transformed into a streak of light and shot through the Bronze Door.
Ye Yun returned to the carriage and closed his eyes, the image of the Ancient Dragon Cave Map appearing in his mind. This Ancient Dragon Cave Map exuded an extremely ancient and remote aura. Ye Yun also noticed a very small, unique Dragon Clan character on the back of the map. It was the character for ’dragon’. This character was one that cultivators of the Cangnan Continent would not recognize; they would likely dismiss it as a mere decorative pattern. But Ye Yun recognized it.
This proves that this Ancient Dragon Cave Map... was genuinely the work of a Divine Dragon. But why would it draw a map? What secrets does it hold? Could this Divine Dragon have wanted to leave its legacy behind?
Ye Yun was somewhat curious, but he had no clues at the moment.
Coincidentally, the juniors have already gone to the Nether Immortal Ancient Land for training, so I can have Big Black Cat try to find some clues. If this so-called Dragon Cave really is in the Nether Immortal Ancient Land, that would be absolutely perfect. If it isn’t, then it must be hidden somewhere else on the Cangnan Continent, and we’ll still have a chance to look for it later.
Having mulled it over for a while and formed a plan, Ye Yun closed his eyes and began cultivating a new Divine Skill. Meanwhile, his avatar remained within Luo Li’s consciousness.
Luo Li and the others had been flying through the black fog for some time. Seeing that no cultivators were pursuing them, they stopped to wait for Big Black Cat.
"The Nine-tailed Spirit Cat... he hasn’t run into any trouble, has he?" Jun Moxiao asked with a worried expression, looking back in the direction they had come from.
"He should be fine. He has the Emperor Artifact Walking Boots. Even if he couldn’t defeat them, escaping wouldn’t be a problem. I suspect he probably lured them off in another direction," Su Wanyi mused.
"He’s back!" Cat Baby, who was observing their surroundings with the Heavenly Spirit Mirror, suddenly spotted a familiar figure and cried out in joyful surprise.
Everyone instantly felt a wave of relief.
A streak of black light pierced the fog and landed before them in an instant.
"Sect Master, I’m back," Big Black Cat said excitedly, his expression one of extreme elation.
He’d gone out for a bit, and the Master had given him a new task! If he completed it well and found this ’Dragon Cave,’ it would be a truly great achievement!
"Did you manage to lead those people away?" Luo Li asked, scrutinizing Big Black Cat. Seeing he was uninjured, she finally relaxed.
"I wiped out almost all of them. Only that fellow in the golden robe escaped," Big Black Cat said with a smug grin. He didn’t hide anything and recounted everything that had happened outside. After all, Luo Li was the current Sect Master of the Dragon God Sect. Since he, Big Black Cat, was now holding the Ancient Dragon Cave Map and would be searching for the supposed Dragon Cave within the Nether Immortal Ancient Land, he naturally had to inform Luo Li. They were a small team that always acted in unison, and as such, they naturally had to follow the Sect Master’s arrangements.
"So, there’s actually a Dragon Cave hidden within the Nether Immortal Ancient Land?" After listening to Big Black Cat’s account, Luo Li examined the Ancient Dragon Cave Map for a moment before handing it back to him.
This map is very important; it’s best to let Big Black Cat keep it.
"Senior Sister Luo Li, we should get going," Jun Moxiao reminded her from the side.
"Let’s go!" Luo Li waved her hand, and the group flew forward once more.
They flew for an hour. Fortunately, they didn’t encounter any attacks from strange creatures. However, Mu Qing’s complexion was steadily worsening.
"Sect Master, this black fog’s poison is truly bizarre," Mu Qing sighed.
"Yes, I feel unwell too," Cat Baby chimed in, nodding. Her small face was veiled by a faint layer of black gas.
"Strange, why do I feel perfectly fine?" Big Black Cat scratched his head, chuckling awkwardly.
What should we do?
Luo Li turned around. Seeing Cat Baby’s and Mu Qing’s faces darkening, she couldn’t help but worry.
"Sect Master, please don’t worry too much. While the black fog’s poison isn’t immediately lethal, it’s said that a Super Sect within the Nether Immortal Ancient Land has built many Heavenly Mechanism Towers. These towers not only offer temporary shelter but can also expel the toxins from one’s body," Mu Qing said with a thoughtful smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 459: Heavenly Mechanism Tower, Ghost Moth
chapters.content:
Chapter 459: Chapter 459: Heavenly Mechanism Tower, Ghost Moth
Heavenly Mechanism Tower?
Luo Li was taken aback; she hadn’t expected such a magical place within the Nether Immortal Ancient Land.
This Super Sect sure is thoughtful!
"Which Super Sect is this? Their might is so strong that they established the Heavenly Mechanism Tower within the Ten Great Immortal Lands?" Jun Moxiao asked from the side.
Mu Qing thought for a moment and murmured, "It’s said... it’s the Super Sect Tianjige."
HISS!
Jun Moxiao gasped.
It turned out to be a Super Sect—truly a grand gesture! To think they’ve built so many Heavenly Mechanism Towers in this place for these cultivators undergoing training.
Although the Dragon God Sect was an Eternal Realm Sect, that was already a hundred thousand years ago. As the 298th generation junior disciple, Jun Moxiao had never experienced what an Eternal Realm Sect was truly like.
On his journey, he had seen many large Sects of different grades and had already sensed their strength.
One could only imagine how powerful a Super Sect must be.
"Why would Tianjige build Heavenly Mechanism Towers here?" Su Wanyi asked curiously.
"There are too many strange creatures in the Nether Immortal Ancient Land; it’s impossible to kill them all," Mu Qing explained with a smile. "Each time it’s opened, many cultivators are needed to eliminate these creatures. Of course, this task involves high risk, but the rewards are also substantial. One can obtain the Divine Element Longevity Fruit, which extends lifespan and is a lifesaver for the ancestors of many large sects or ancient families."
"So that’s how it is."
Everyone nodded and then continued flying in silence.
"Sect Master, the Heavenly Mechanism Tower is just ahead," Mu Qing said, pointing into the distance, her face suddenly lighting up with joy.
Everyone looked into the distance. Amidst the layers of black fog, a cluster of silver light shimmered, its contents indistinct.
But they could imagine that within that glow stood a silver Heavenly Mechanism Tower, constantly radiating light.
WHOOSH WHOOSH...
The mist roiled, and suddenly, countless massive shadows howled as they converged on them from all directions.
"Are the Shadow Crows here?" Jun Moxiao exclaimed, startled. He immediately drew his sword, preparing for battle.
Luo Li also raised her sword and smiled. "Junior Brother, don’t worry about the Shadow Crows. My Supreme Golden Dragon Sword has a suppressive effect on them!"
"Senior Sister, the Dragon Soul in your Supreme Golden Dragon Sword doesn’t seem very spirited!" Jun Moxiao chuckled, covering his mouth.
The Supreme Golden Dragon Sword in Luo Li’s hand was not currently emitting a golden light, and the Dragon Soul within it seemed rather listless.
It seems the Dragon Soul can’t be summoned at will,
Luo Li thought, on the verge of tears.
"Perhaps the Ancestor Dragon instructed the Dragon Soul to only help us at critical moments?" Su Wanyi suddenly interjected. "We need to handle ordinary battles ourselves!"
"I understand, Senior Sister!"
Hearing Su Wanyi’s words, Luo Li nodded. Her expression changed from dejection to determination, her fighting spirit ignited.
Su Wanyi nodded silently.
Her junior brother and junior sister were both quite young. Though obstinate in a fight, they still retained a somewhat childish nature in everyday matters, making them more prone to emotional swings.
Everyone drew their weapons, preparing to fight.
"Huh?" Big Black Cat suddenly exclaimed, "These aren’t Shadow Crows! They look like a swarm of moths!"
"Could they be Ghost Moths?" Mu Qing’s heart skipped a beat as she spoke quickly.
Just as she finished speaking, a sky-filling swarm of Ghost Moths descended upon them.
These Ghost Moths were pitch-black, with a few streaks of red fur on their backs. Each was as large as a millstone, several times bigger than the Shadow Crows they had encountered earlier.
Each Ghost Moth possessed a sharp beak, and as they flew, their bodies continuously shed a powder that mingled with the mist.
"Everyone, be careful! It’s said that the powder these Ghost Moths shed will drive you mad if it touches your skin!" Mu Qing shouted.
She raised her sword, and a sharp beam of sword light flew out, instantly cleaving a Ghost Moth in two. The creature fell from mid-air.
That particular Ghost Moth was only at the First Layer of Heaven’s Will Realm.
The others also engaged the Ghost Moths in battle.
However, the sheer number of Ghost Moths was overwhelming—at least a few thousand.
After fighting for a while, they inevitably came into contact with the powder.
The first to show signs of delirium was Cat Baby, who had the lowest cultivation base.
Her body swayed, and a crazed look appeared on her face.
Fortunately, Cat Baby’s willpower was relatively strong, and she didn’t truly lose her mind.
"Little Cat, quickly take Cat Baby to the Heavenly Mechanism Tower!" Luo Li shouted.
The powder didn’t affect Luo Li much.
But there are too many Ghost Moths; it’s impossible to eliminate them all. We’d better take refuge in the Heavenly Mechanism Tower for now,
she thought.
"Alright!" Big Black Cat agreed, immediately dashing over, seizing Cat Baby, and vanishing on the spot.
Luo Li and the others fought as they retreated, flying towards the Heavenly Mechanism Tower.
By the time they neared the Heavenly Mechanism Tower, they had already slain over a thousand Ghost Moths.
Just then, a faint silver glow permeated the fog.
Upon seeing this light, the Ghost Moths’ wings fluttered rapidly, and they all vanished into the mist.
"This Heavenly Mechanism Tower... it’s truly a lifesaver," Mu Qing sighed, her face showing the relief of someone who had narrowly escaped death.
Fortunately, her cultivation base was high, and she had been suppressing the toxicity of the black fog as well as the poisonous powder from the Ghost Moths.
This dual assault of toxins had brought her to the brink of collapse.
However, they had luckily reached the area illuminated by the Heavenly Mechanism Tower just in time.
Though the silver light was faint, she felt a little more comfortable.
"We should hurry over..." Seeing Mu Qing’s face darkening, Su Wanyi quickly moved to support her, and they swiftly flew towards the Heavenly Mechanism Tower.
A silver tower, soaring over a hundred feet high, came into view.
It released a soft, silver light that gently spread across the surroundings.
Many cultivators were already gathered around the Heavenly Mechanism Tower.
Each sat cross-legged with their eyes closed, apparently purging toxins from their bodies.
Big Black Cat and Cat Baby were sitting somewhat apart from the main group.
Luo Li’s group quickly flew over to them.
Mu Qing was the first to land, settling down beside Cat Baby.
She immediately began to meditate, working to purge the toxins from her system.
The energy of the Heavenly Mechanism Tower entered her body and, fusing with her Mana, began to neutralize the poisons within.
Seeing the color begin to return to Mu Qing’s face, Luo Li breathed a sigh of relief, her expression softening.
"Senior Sister, how are you feeling?" Luo Li turned her head to ask Su Wanyi.
"The powder had a slight effect, but now that we’re at the Heavenly Mechanism Tower, it’s gradually waning," Su Wanyi said softly after assessing her condition.
"Mm!" Luo Li nodded.
The three siblings—Luo Li, Su Wanyi, and Jun Moxiao—exchanged a knowing glance.
It was thanks to the Ancestral Dragon Essence Blood, with which the Ancestor had altered their physiques, that they now each possessed about ten percent purity. That’s why they could resist the toxins spread by these strange creatures.
"How are you?" Luo Li asked Big Black Cat with concern.
"The Ghost Moth’s powder affects me, but only slightly," Big Black Cat replied after assessing his condition.
"That’s good." Luo Li nodded, finally relieved.
Now she truly understood the Ancestor’s earlier warnings. The Gloomy Ancient Land was indeed exceedingly dangerous. Regardless of a cultivator’s strength, even Life-Death Realm Powerhouses would find it difficult to withstand the attacks of these bizarre creatures.

chapters.title: Chapter 460: The Most Powerful and Mysterious Creature in Nether Immortal Ancient Land
chapters.content:
Chapter 460: Chapter 460: The Most Powerful and Mysterious Creature in Nether Immortal Ancient Land
Inside the Nether Immortal Ancient Land.
If an exceedingly powerful being stood at the highest point in the sky of the Nether Immortal Ancient Land and looked down, through the thick black fog, they would see one hundred and eight clusters of silver light. Each cluster of light, flickering in and out of sight within the black fog, resembled a guiding lantern, tracing a winding path into the depths of the Nether Immortal Ancient Land. These were the one hundred and eight Heavenly Mechanism Towers. They resembled a sprawling silver giant dragon, weaving through the entirety of the Nether Immortal Ancient Land.
Legend told that these one hundred and eight Heavenly Mechanism Towers were constructed by the Super Sect, Tianjige.
At the entrance to the Nether Immortal Ancient Land, the Heavenly Mechanism Towers were only over ten zhang high, and adjacent towers were arranged quite densely. Of these one hundred and eight Heavenly Mechanism Towers, the farther they extended into the depths of the Nether Immortal Ancient Land, the more sparsely they were arranged; however, the towers themselves grew progressively taller. In the deepest part of the Nether Immortal Ancient Land, one such Heavenly Mechanism Tower reached a height of a thousand zhang. It blazed like a torch with a dazzling silver light, illuminating a region of the world. But the surrounding black fog was also countless times denser than at the entrance. The silver light and black fog constantly converged in mid-air, occasionally emitting sizzling sounds.
Around the third Heavenly Mechanism Tower, a considerable number of cultivators had gathered, numbering about two or three hundred. Many cultivators were moving in and out of the Nether Immortal Ancient Land. Some had just entered and were still in the exploratory phase, venturing deeper. Other groups, however, had suffered severe casualties and were forced to retreat from the depths. Thus, beneath this third Heavenly Mechanism Tower, there were people both advancing and retreating.
A young woman in a colorful dress, leading twenty to thirty people, sat cross-legged beneath the Heavenly Mechanism Tower, all of them continuously expelling the toxins from their bodies. A cute little blue cat lay quietly beside the colorfully dressed young woman.
This is so boring! The aura in this wretched place is truly unsettling,
the little blue cat yawned, thinking to itself.
This little blue cat was, in fact, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon that Ye Yun had given to the young woman in the colorful dress. Throughout their journey, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon had not intervened. They had only encountered some bizarre creatures, none truly lethal, so there was no need for it, a Divine Dragon of the Divine Monarch Realm, to act.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon had already made its plans.
This time, I just need to follow the Master’s orders and protect the girl in the colorful dress. However, I also can’t be too conspicuous. I must maintain a low profile and do my utmost to prevent others from discovering my existence. After all, my cultivation base is too high. It’s like a tiger entering an ant’s nest. Combat on such different levels of existence wouldn’t even be a contest.
Deep in its heart, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon held a certain disdain for this Nether Immortal Ancient Land. It glanced up at the young woman in the colorful dress and saw that, under the influence of the Heavenly Mechanism Tower, her exquisite face had returned to normal. It nodded inwardly.
This Heavenly Mechanism Tower isn’t bad, though.
If not for the Heavenly Mechanism Towers, even low-level cultivators of the Eternal Realm would encounter trouble entering this place.
After a while, the young woman in the colorful dress stood up, bent down, and scooped the little blue cat into her arms.
"You little cat, you truly are strange. You seem completely unaffected by this poisonous fog," the young woman remarked with amazement, curiously stroking the little blue cat’s fur.
"MEOW!" The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon cried out, its jewel-like eyes glinting with smugness.
I am a Divine Dragon of the Divine Monarch Realm! To put it bluntly, I could obliterate this Nether Immortal Ancient Land with a single swat of my paw!
"So adorable!" the young woman in the colorful dress said with a smile, gently stroking the blue cat’s head. "Perhaps you’re a unique, naturally gifted creature, unafraid of these toxins. That’s quite a benefit for me."
"MEOW!" The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon cried out again, a hint of dissatisfaction in its eyes.
If the Master hadn’t ordered me on this mission, would I be suffering such indignity?
"Alright, alright, I understand. What a temperamental little cat you are." Seeing the little cat seemingly throwing a tantrum, the colorfully dressed young woman gently rubbed its head, smiled softly, and offered a few words of comfort.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon couldn’t be bothered to interact with her further. It tucked its head under its belly and began to snore softly. Unless the young woman’s life was in danger, it had no intention of even lifting its head.
"Miss, this is only the third Heavenly Mechanism Tower. We’re still far from our destination. Let’s continue onward," a young man said, approaching them.
"Alright, let’s keep moving!" the young woman in the colorful dress nodded.
The others followed, and the group prepared to leave the vicinity of this Heavenly Mechanism Tower to venture deeper. Suddenly, from within the black fog in the depths of the Nether Immortal Ancient Land, eerie wailing cries echoed. It didn’t sound like a beast’s cry, but more like a human’s voice.
Upon hearing this sound, the expressions of all the cultivators beneath the Heavenly Mechanism Tower changed drastically.
"Suibai is here!"
It wasn’t clear who shouted it first, but everyone instantly froze. They stood rooted to the spot, their faces turning pale. Some who had been sitting immediately jumped to their feet, their bodies stiffening, not daring to move a muscle.
Suibai. The most mysterious humanoid creature within the Gloomy Ancient Land. His origins were unknown, and his power was terrifyingly high. No one had ever withstood a single move from Suibai. Suibai was merciless. Once he engaged in a fight, it was to the death. If Suibai killed someone, he would also devour their corpse. Suibai of the Nether Immortal Ancient Land was a terrifying existence, the mere mention of whose name made cultivators pale.
"Miss, why would Suibai be patrolling around the third Heavenly Mechanism Tower?" a Destiny Realm youth asked, his expression turning fearful as he gazed at the distant black fog.
"I don’t know," the colorfully dressed young woman sighed. "Usually, Suibai only appears beyond the thirtieth Heavenly Mechanism Tower and is rarely seen near the entrance. Why he has suddenly appeared now, I have no idea."
Her group also stood frozen in place. Patrolling was Suibai’s style. He liked to get close to each cultivator. If he found anything amiss or unsatisfactory, Suibai would kill them. Although Suibai was brutal, as long as one stood still obediently, usually nothing would happen. So, while everyone was terrified, they didn’t lose their composure entirely.
The black mist rolled and churned. A tall, shadowy figure suddenly strode out from it. This was a towering figure covered in black fur, interspersed with a significant amount of red fur, giving it an extremely bizarre appearance. Since its face was entirely covered with this red and black fur, its features were obscured. Only a pair of sinister and frenzied eyes were visible.
"HEH HEH HEH..." Gazing at the cultivators beneath the Heavenly Mechanism Tower, Suibai suddenly let out a sinister and eerie chuckle.
He strode forward. With every step, the ground boomed, showcasing Suibai’s immense physical strength. The group led by the young woman in the colorful dress was closest to Suibai, so they would be the first to be inspected.
Suibai marched over, first stopping before a youth at the First Layer of Destiny Realm. He leaned his nose close and sniffed around the young man. The young man’s face was bloodless, his body trembled slightly, and he didn’t dare to breathe too loudly.
After sniffing for a moment, seemingly finding nothing out of the ordinary, Suibai turned and walked to the second youth. The second youth appeared calmer and quickly passed Suibai’s inspection. Inspecting them one by one, Suibai eventually reached the young woman in the colorful dress.

chapters.title: Chapter 461: Suibai
chapters.content:
Chapter 461: Chapter 461: Suibai
"It seems Suibai...really is as the rumors say. As long as we stay quiet and still, he won’t attack Human Cultivators,"
the young girl in colorful clothing thought.
She hugged the little blue cat, her stunning face slightly pale. She remained completely still, awaiting Suibai’s inspection.
Suibai stepped before the young girl.
However, for some unknown reason, he hesitated. Looking at the young girl, his uncanny and ominous eyes suddenly betrayed a bout of madness.
"HEHE!"
Suibai laughed eerily again, prompting the faces of the onlookers to pale once more.
The girl in colorful clothing held her breath, straining her eyes wide open.
She knew that Suibai disliked people closing their eyes during his inspections. It gave him the impression that they were hiding something.
Keeping her eyes wide open, on the other hand, greatly increased the chances of passing.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon, which had hidden its head within its fluffy belly to sleep, suddenly sensed Suibai’s arrival.
"Eh, this guy’s cultivation base is not low at all; he’s actually reached the True God Realm!"
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon released a strand of Divine Sense, examining Suibai’s body, and was somewhat taken aback.
It was indeed rare to find a True God in the Nether Immortal Ancient Land. Didn’t the Master say this place didn’t even have a single True God? How come there’s one hidden in the Nether Immortal Ancient Land?
However, the Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon quickly detected that Suibai’s aura was unstable, fluctuating between strong and weak. Moreover, his cultivation base seemed intentionally concealed. If it hadn’t reached the Divine Monarch Realm, it would have likely been unable to discern Suibai’s true cultivation base.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon decided that if this Suibai had any ill intentions, it would slap him to death with a single strike.
Suibai’s gaze remained fixed on the little blue cat.
The madness in his eyes grew increasingly intense.
"AH!"
It was unclear what he sensed, but he suddenly cried out, turned, and rushed into the surrounding black fog, disappearing from sight.
"He’s finally gone."
The girl in colorful clothing let out a long sigh of relief, her expression softening.
She didn’t know why Suibai hadn’t inspected her and had instead suddenly gone mad.
However, legend had it that Suibai himself was a madman.
Within the Nether Immortal Ancient Land, many tales of Suibai’s various mad exploits circulated.
