"Miss, Suibai has gone mad again. It’s actually a good thing. Otherwise, I was truly afraid he might do something terrifying," a young man said with a wry smile.
"Let’s go!"
The girl in colorful clothing smiled faintly and immediately led her people away from this Heavenly Mechanism Tower.
The Azure Sea Heavenly Dragon yawned, not giving Suibai’s matter a second thought, and curled up to continue its deep sleep.
...
「Below the first Heavenly Mechanism Tower.」
Mu Qing and Cat Bao’er each held Spirit Stones, absorbing Spiritual Energy while simultaneously expelling the toxins from their bodies.
In just the time it takes for an incense stick to burn, their bodies returned to normal.
After opening her eyes, a look of astonishment appeared on Mu Qing’s face.
"Sect Master, it seems the Divine Nature contained in these Spirit Stones also has some kind of suppressive effect on toxins!"
Mu Qing conveyed this to Luo Li via voice transmission, a mix of surprise and delight in her tone. Since there were many Cultivators nearby, she naturally didn’t dare reveal the secret of the Spirit Stones.
Fortunately, these Spirit Stones looked extremely ordinary, no different from the Spirit Stones on the Cangnan Continent, except that the Spiritual Energy inside was filled with the profoundness of Divine Nature.
"Is that so? If that’s the case, then if you absorb more Spirit Stones, the more Divine Nature you accumulate in your bodies, the more you’ll be able to suppress the toxins from these strange creatures in the Nether Immortal Ancient Land," Luo Li replied, pleasantly surprised.
"Yes, Sect Master!" Mu Qing said with a smile. Then, she communicated with Cat Bao’er again, and they both decided to accelerate their absorption of the Spirit Stones.
Thus, both of them held a Spirit Stone in each hand and began to rapidly absorb them.
"Senior Sister, let’s set off again..." Jun Moxiao said, eager to try.
He felt a bit frustrated for not having obtained anything since entering the Nether Immortal Ancient Land.
After all, when he first entered the Heavenly Moon Secret Region, Jun Moxiao had obtained quite a few Tianyue Osmanthus Fruits.
This time, on the trip to the Nether Immortal Ancient Land, he naturally also wanted to obtain more Divine Element Longevity Fruits.
Although Longevity Fruits have different grades, the lowest can increase one’s lifespan by a hundred years, while the highest can increase it by as much as three thousand years.
Generally speaking, an Eternal Realm Cultivator in the Cangnan Continent can live for at most ten thousand years.
If one could consume a top-quality Divine Element Longevity Fruit, their lifespan would instantly increase by three thousand years.
One could imagine... just how important these Divine Element Longevity Fruits were.
However, a Divine Element Longevity Fruit that grants three thousand years of life is extremely rare.
Each time the Nether Immortal Ancient Land opens, finding even two or three such Divine Element Longevity Fruits would be considered a good haul.
Lower-quality Divine Element Longevity Fruits appeared more frequently.
Moreover, Divine Element Longevity Fruits usually grew in the depths of the mountain ranges within the Nether Immortal Ancient Land, surrounded by many strange creatures. Snatching them from the tiger’s mouth, as it were, was naturally very difficult.
"Let’s go!" Luo Li said.
The group immediately left this Heavenly Mechanism Tower.
Not long after leaving the Heavenly Mechanism Tower, they were attacked by a swarm of Ghost Moths.
However, this time, the number of Ghost Moths wasn’t large. After a short battle, these Ghost Moths all dispersed.
Everyone continued forward.
Upon reaching the second Heavenly Mechanism Tower, the six of them paused for a while before continuing on their journey.
Thus, along the way, they continuously killed those strange creatures, steadily advancing towards the depths of the Nether Immortal Ancient Land.
Since the mountain ranges near the entrance had already been swept clean by other Cultivators, Luo Li and her group found no Divine Element Longevity Fruits.
According to Mu Qing’s speculation, they would need to advance to at least the vicinity of the twentieth Heavenly Mechanism Tower to have a chance of finding Divine Element Longevity Fruits.
Since they had entered relatively late, they naturally needed to speed up if they wanted to obtain any Divine Element Longevity Fruits.
On their first day, this team of six rushed all the way to the ninth Heavenly Mechanism Tower before stopping to rest.
"This is infuriating! We’ve killed so many Ghost Moths and Shadow Crows along the way, but we haven’t spotted a single Divine Element Longevity Fruit!" Big Black Cat grumbled resentfully.
"There’s no need to be too anxious. The Ancestor gave us three months to operate. This is just the first day," Su Wanyi said with a faint smile.
"That’s true. Haste makes waste..." Big Black Cat scratched his head and chuckled sheepishly.
He glanced at Cat Bao’er and saw that the little cat was already holding a Spirit Stone in each paw, continuously absorbing them.
"You little rascal, Cat Bao’er! Absorbing Spirit Stones without even calling me!" Big Black Cat scolded angrily. He plopped down beside Cat Bao’er, took out two Spirit Stones, and also began to absorb them.
The Spirit Stones contained Divine Nature, which was of immense help to the growth of their cultivation.
Therefore, even though they only rested for one night in the Heavenly Mechanism Tower, their cultivation bases were progressing rapidly.
"Do I still need to remind you of this?" Cat Bao’er opened her eyes and said, looking at Big Black Cat reproachfully.
Big Black Cat’s face darkened, and he ignored her.
The others were also preparing to absorb Spirit Stones when they suddenly heard a series of roars coming from within the fog.
"It’s Suibai!"
A Cultivator abruptly shot to his feet, standing ramrod straight and motionless, a look of terror on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 462: Taking You... To a Place
chapters.content:
Chapter 462: Chapter 462: Taking You... To a Place
As the cultivator’s shouts rang out, all the cultivators beneath the Heavenly Mechanism Tower immediately stood up tensely.
Suibai was coming for his routine inspection. If anyone was found not standing, it could enrage Suibai.
"What is Suibai?"
The Big Black Cat looked at all the surrounding cultivators, who had suddenly stood up. It felt somewhat out of place still sitting on the ground. It turned towards Mu Qing and hurriedly asked.
"Suibai is the most powerful and bizarre creature in the Nether Immortal Ancient Land..." Mu Qing’s expression turned solemn, and she hastily revealed all she knew about Suibai.
When the Big Black Cat heard that even cultivators at the Life and Death Realm could not withstand a single blow from Suibai, its expression changed dramatically, and it scrambled to its feet. The others also promptly stood up, staring nervously in the direction of the mist.
This Suibai was arguably the most powerful strange creature in the Nether Immortal Ancient Land, so powerful that it was impossible to resist. Fortunately, Suibai possessed some wisdom and was not a wanton killer. Since their cultivation bases were not high, as long as they obediently stood still, they would generally not incite Suibai’s murderous intent.
"It’s strange. We just arrived at the ninth Heavenly Mechanism Tower. Why would Suibai come now?" a middle-aged man in the distance muttered to himself, frowning.
A cultivator beside him shook his head and said, "Who knows? But I heard from a friend that Suibai appeared at the third Heavenly Mechanism Tower today. Now that Suibai has appeared at the ninth Heavenly Mechanism Tower, it might not be that strange after all!"
Everyone nodded, agreeing wholeheartedly.
The enigmatic Suibai could not be judged by conventional standards. It was said that Suibai had existed ever since the Nether Immortal Ancient Land first appeared. No one knew how many years he had lived. He was the most powerful humanoid strange creature in the Nether Immortal Ancient Land. Fortunately, Suibai did not wantonly slaughter innocents, completely different from strange creatures like the Shadow Crows and Ghost Moths.
BOOM! BOOM!
The sound of giant footsteps drew nearer, each step causing an earth-shaking vibration as it struck the ground. This sound seemed to fall heavily upon their hearts, making them feel anxious and uneasy.
WHOOSH.
The mist suddenly roiled.
A muscular giant covered in long black and red fur abruptly emerged, stepping into the silver light of the Heavenly Mechanism Tower. The tide-like silver light from the Heavenly Mechanism Tower washed over him but had no effect at all. It could not repel him in the slightest.
With Suibai’s appearance, the cultivators beneath the Heavenly Mechanism Tower became even more anxious. These cultivators were also seeing Suibai for the first time. Recalling the horrifying and bloody legends about him, they naturally trembled in fear.
Suibai stood on the ground and looked around. Suddenly, a flash of realization lit his wild, strange eyes. He strode towards a certain direction.
"Sect Master, it seems Suibai is coming right for us," Mu Qing whispered. Her heart was racing, and sweat suddenly broke out on her palms.
"Hmm!" Luo Li’s delicate face was slightly cold as she looked at the massive figure, her eyes narrowing.
What does this Suibai want, coming straight for their small team? Could it be that it intends to attack the six of them? If Suibai were to make a move, Luo Li wasn’t confident she could handle him. After all, rumor had it that even cultivators in the Life and Death Realm could not withstand a single blow from Suibai. This indicated that Suibai’s strength might have already reached the Eternal Realm.
"Everyone, be careful. Don’t provoke this Suibai. As Mu Qing said, don’t move your bodies," Su Wanyi whispered.
At this moment, without the Ancestor’s protection, they could only rely on themselves. Fortunately, this Suibai had his own rules; as long as they obediently remained still, nothing should happen.
Suibai walked up to Luo Li. His gaze first fell on Luo Li for a moment, then moved to Jun Moxiao and Su Wanyi.
「Meanwhile.」
The wisp of Ye Yun’s Primordial Spirit in Luo Li’s mind was also calmly observing this burly Suibai covered in long black and red fur.
This Suibai was over ten feet tall, far surpassing the height of a normal human. The black and red fur on him exuded a strange Super Divine Dragon Breath.
Could this Suibai have been a human in his past life? Now that his body is covered in red and black fur, it somewhat resembles the strange red fur formed by the Blood-colored Broken Sword of the Moon Star,
Ye Yun’s gaze flickered as this thought crossed his mind.
However, the juniors were still undergoing their experiential training. As long as this Suibai did not make a move, he naturally would not act against Suibai.
Therefore, Ye Yun took no action.
"It looks like those kids have caught Suibai’s attention," a young man in the distance commented, eyeing them with a schadenfreude-filled expression. As soon as Suibai entered, he went straight for that group; his target was clear.
It looked like it had nothing to do with them.
"I hope Suibai only targets those people and doesn’t come over here..." In another direction, a middle-aged man prayed inwardly. This sentiment was naturally shared by all the other cultivators present. None of them dared to face Suibai directly. After all, the sensation of Suibai carefully scanning everyone was deeply unsettling, almost as if they were passing through the Ghost Gate Pass.
"You... you all..." After staring at Luo Li and the others for a good few tens of seconds, Suibai’s long, fur-covered lips fluttered a couple of times as he mechanically uttered a few words. His voice was extremely hoarse and somewhat indistinct; it was difficult to make out unless one listened carefully.
The moment Suibai spoke, Mu Qing, standing to the side, stared in shock.
According to legend, Suibai never spoke. Why, then, had the Suibai before her suddenly started talking?
Is it because of our Sect Master’s prestige in My Divine Dragon Sect? Has Suibai come specifically to pay his respects to the Sect Master?
the Big Black Cat blinked, a peculiar thought forming in its mind.
"..." Luo Li, Jun Moxiao, and the others looked at each other, speechless.
Taking a deep breath, Luo Li’s heart surprisingly calmed. She asked softly, "Suibai, our cultivation bases are not high. We shouldn’t have violated any rules, right?"
Suibai shook his head. His gaze fell upon Luo Li, and his expression became extremely complex. The sinister, eerie, and frenzied look in his eyes was suddenly replaced by a wave of dazedness.
"I... will take you... to a place..." Suibai spoke again, mechanically uttering a few more words.
Take us to a place?
This startled all six members of the team. Suibai, the most terrifying figure in the legends of the Nether Immortal Ancient Land, had not only refrained from troubling them but had also spoken, intending to lead them somewhere. This entire situation was simply too bizarre.
Hearing Suibai’s words, all the cultivators around the Heavenly Mechanism Tower were also plunged into immense shock.
Has Suibai gone mad? Why would he take these few people somewhere? What kind of place could it be? Why would he bring these six people?
"I know! Suibai probably wants to eat them," a young man murmured.
"If he wanted to eat them, he would have done it already! Why would he need to take them somewhere? What kind of logic is that!" another young man nearby scoffed.
"Maybe Suibai wants to take them back for others to eat? After all, if he took them back to be eaten directly, they would be very fresh," the first young man chuckled nonchalantly.
Although their conversation was quiet, many people around them heard it.
Suibai suddenly looked up towards the two, raised a finger, and pointed.
PUFF!
The bodies of the two young men instantly shuddered, then they exploded into two clouds of blood mist.
